«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || vararucir uvāca || || kṣutkṣāmā koṭarākṣī masimalinamukhī muktakeśī rudantī nāhaṃ tṛptā vadantī jagadakhilam idaṃ grāsam ekaṃ karomi || hastābhyāṃ dhārayantī jvalad analaśikhāsannibhaṃ vāṇam ugraṃ | dantair jambūphalābhaiḥ pariharatu bhayaṃ pātu māṃ bhadrakālī || 1 || kolākhye ca trikūṭe himagiriśikhare yāś ca jālandhare ca | saurākhye sindhudeśe magadhapurataṭe kāmarūpe mṛgendre || pātāle cāntarikṣe sakalabhuvi gatā sarvaloke prasiddhā sā me kāmān dadātu prakaṭitavadanā caṇḍamuṇḍāpahaṃtrī || 2 || (fol. 1v1–9) «End» māryyābhaṭṭārikāyāḥ stutir aghadahanī ye paṭhantīha bhaktyā | sandhyākalāntarāle vararuciracitāṃ taṅgatāgraikacittāḥ || teṣāṃ dāridryarogajvaramaraṇabhayaṃ nāśayantyāśu mārī | saṃghāre ghorarūpā mama haratu bhayaṃ bhadradā bhadrakālī || 9 || (fol. 3r3–7) «Colophon» iti vararuciviracitaṃ mahāmārīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || || śrībhadrakālyai namaḥ śubham (fol. 3r7–8)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ devadeveśi sarvajñe sarvalokaikaśāṃkari tan me brūhi mahādevi lokānāṃ hitakārakam 1 śrīpārvaty uvāca savibhaṅge tava prāṇe lokahṛt tāpahārakaṃ sādhvitthaṃ lokavihitā yat tvayāhaṃ prabodhitā 2 etad vijñāpitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ purārir adhikam mayā kenopāyena deveśa naro duḥkhād vimucyate 3 (fol. 1v1–4) «End» pratyāvṛttiḥ japen maṃtram aṣṭottaraśataṃ śatam saṃpuṭīkṛtya yatnena sā māyāvat svaśaktitaḥ abdasaṃkhyāṃ vijānīyāt sabhāyāṃ yat svaśaktitaḥ svayaṃ vā brāhmaṇadvārā paṭhet stotram ananyadhīḥ gṛhe tīrthe vane vāpi japed devatasaṃnidhau tasyāriṣṭaphalaṃ nāsti grahadoṣādisaṃbhavam 24 yoginīnāṃ daśājanyaṃ nāriṣṭaṃ jāyate kvacit nākāle maraṇaṃ tasya nāgnicaurabhayaṃ bhavet 25 etat te kathitaṃ devi yoginīgrahaśāntikam | tava snehān mayākhyātaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit 26 (fol. 3r4–v2) «Colophon» iti kāmadhenutaṃtre umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde yoginīstotram samāptaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śubham iti saṃvat 1948 sāla miti bhādra va di 8 || 5 || (fol. 3v2–4)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ namaś caṇḍikāyai || caṇḍikāṃ hṛdaye nyasya smaraṇaṃ yaḥ karoty api || anantaphalam āpnoti devī caṇḍīpraśā(!)dataḥ || 1 || ravivāre yadā caṇḍī paṭhed āgamasammatām || na vā vṛttiphalaṃ tasya jāyate natra saṃśayaḥ || 2 || somavāre yadā caṃḍī paṭhed yatra samāhitaḥ || sahasrāvṛttipāṭhasya phalaṃ jānīhi suvrate || 3 || kujavāre jagaddhātrīṃ paṭhed yāmalasammatām || śatāvṛttiphalaṃ tasya budhe lakṣaphalaṃ dhruvam || 4 || (fol. 1v1–6) «End» maheśāni varārohe bravīmi satyam uttamam || abhaktāya na dātavyaṃ na me prāṇādhikaṃ śubham || 61 || mama bhaktāya śāntāya śivaviṣṇupriyāya ca || dadyāt kadācid deveśi satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśvarīm || 62 || anantaphalam āpnoti śivacaṇḍīprasādataḥ || aśvamedhavājapeyarājasūyaśatena vai || 63 || tuṣṭāś ca pitaro devā tathā ca sarvadevatā || durgeyaṃ manmayī dhyānaṃ rudrayāmalapustakam || 64 || ata eva mahāmāye kiṃ vakṣye tava sannidhau || kṣīṇāyuḥ prāptamṛtyur vā mahārogahatopi vā || 65 || sadyaḥ sukham avapnoti dīrgham āyuś ca vindati || lambodarādhikaś caṇḍī śravaṇāt paṭhanāj janaḥ || 66 || tat tvam asīti vākena(!) mṛtyum āpa sudurlabham || || (fol. 5v3–6r2) «Colophon» iti śrīrudrayāmale haragaurisaṃvāde rudracaṇḍī samāptaṃ śubham || || || śrīkālīsaraṇa || || (fol. 6r2–3)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || kārkaṇḍeya uvāca || anekamantrakoṭīśaṃ nṛsiṃhanāmam uccaret || anekavidhirakṣāya viṣaroganivāraṇam || 1 || oṃ asya śrīlakṣmīnṛsiṃhamaṃtrakavacasya brahmā ṛṣir anuṣṭubpchaṃdaḥ oṃ kṣauṃ bījaṃ rauṃ śakti oṃ klīṃ kīlakaṃ śrīnṛsiṃho devatā mama sarvarogāṇāṃ sarvagrahāṇāṃ gaurapannagavyāghravṛścikabhūtapretapiśācaśākiniḍākiniyaṃtramaṃtranivāraṇārthe jape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1v1–7) «End» sarvabhūtapretapiśācaśākiniḍākinīyaṃtramaṃtrabaṃdha kīlaya kīlaya mardaya mardaya | cūrṇaya cūrṇaya aiṃ aiṃ virodhānāṃ sarvato haraṇaṃ daha daha mathaya mathaya pacay pacaya || cūrṇaya cūrṇaya || cakreṇa gadāvajreṇa bhasmīkuru kuru || oṃ jrīṃ jrīṃ jrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ kṣīṃ kṣīṃ kṣīṃ nṛsiṃhāya namaḥ || (fol. 3v1–4) «Colophon» iti śrīlakṣṃīnṛsiṃhakavacam samāptam śubham saṃvat 1947 miti jeṣṭha śu di 5 roja 7 || || (fol. 3v4–5)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || janamejaya uvāca || kathaṃ vai śrāddhadevatvam ādityasya vivasvataḥ || śrotum icchāmi viprāgryaṃ śrāddhasya ca paraṃ vidhim || pitṛgrāmādisarggaṃ ca kathaṃ te pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ evaṃ ca śrutam asmābhiḥ kathyamānaṃ dvijātibhiḥ || 2 || svargasthāḥ pitaro ye ca devānām api devatāḥ || iti vedavidaḥ prāhur etad icchāmi veditum || 3 || ye ca teṣāṃ gaṇāḥ proktā yac ca teṣāṃ paraṃ balam || yathā ca kṛtam asmāhbiḥ śrāddhaṃ prīṇāti vai pitṝn || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End» ye cānye dhārayiṣyanti teṣāṃ caritam uttamam || tiryagyoniṣu te jātu na gamiṣyaṃti karhicit || 34 || śrutvā cedam upākhyānaṃ mahārthaṃ mahatāṃ gatim || yogadharmo hṛdi sadā parivarttati bhārataḥ || 35 || sa tenaivānubaṃdhena kadācil labhate śamam || tato yogagatiṃ yāti śuddhāṃ tāṃ bhuvi durllabhām || 36 || vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca || evam etat purā gītaṃ mārkaṇḍeyena dhīmatā || śrāddhasya phalam uddiśya somasyāpyāyanāya vai || 37 || somo hi bhagavān devo lokasyāpyāyanam param || vṛṣṇivaṃśaprasaṃgena tasya vaṃśaṃ nibodha me || 38 || (fol. 29r2–7) «Colophon» iti śrīkhileṣu harivaṃśe pitṛkalpe navamo dhyāyaḥ || 9 || śubham śrīnaranārāyaṇābhyān namaḥ (fol. 29r7–8)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || oṃkāro sarvatra | oṃ viṣvasmai namaḥ 1 oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ 2 oṃ vaṣaṭkārāya namaḥ 3 bhūtabhavyabhavaḥprabhave namaḥ 4 bhūtakṛte namaḥ 5 bhūtabhṛte namaḥ 6 bhāvāya namaḥ 7 bhūtātmane namaḥ 8 (exp. 3 left-hand, 1–9) «End» kṣitīśāya namaḥ 92 pāpanāśanāya namaḥ 93 śaṃkhabhṛte namaḥ 94 nandakine namaḥ 95 cakriṇe namaḥ 96 śāraṅgadhanvine namaḥ 90 gadādharāya namaḥ 98 rathāṅgapāṇaye namaḥ 99 akṣobhyāya namaḥ 99 sarvaprahaṇayudhāya namaḥ 1000 oṃ sarvaprahaṇayudhoṃ namaḥ iti 1000 iti viṣṇo nāmāvalī samāptaṃ śubham | (exp. 12, left column,14–27) «Colophon»

«Beginning» atha vaṃśakavacaṃ likhyate || || nārada uvāca || || bhagavan devadeveśa pārvatīprāṇavallabha || vaṃśalābhākhyakavacaṃ kṛpayā me prakāśaya || 1 || īśvara uvāca || vaṃśalābhākhyakavacaṃ durllabhaṃ bhuvanatraye || yasya prasādāt kamalā lebhe tanayam uttamam || 2 || kāmadevam aparṇā ca vināyakaṣaḍānanau || jayantam indravanitā devapatnyaḥ sutān api || 3 || vaṃśalābhākhyakavacasya bhairavaṛṣir anuṣṭupchandaḥ pārvatī devatā jīvatanayaprāptaye viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1v1–6) «End» iti te kathitaṃ vipra kavacaṃ devapūjitaṃ || 8 || etat śrutvā paṭhitvā ca akṣayaṃ tanayaṃ labhet || 9 dhyānam asyā(!) pravakṣyāmi yathā dhyātvā paṭhen naraḥ || udidā(!)dityasaṃkāśāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāṃ || trinetrāṃ pāṇivinyastapāśāṃkuśavarābhayāṃ || 10 || (fol. 2r4–7) «Colophon» iti bhairavītaṃtre vaṃśalābhākhyakavacaṃ sampūrṇam || ❖ || (fol. 2r7)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || || brahmovāca || oṃ śkulāṃ brahmavicārasāraparamām ādyāṃ jagadvyāpinīṃ vīṇā pustakadhāriṇīm abhayadāṃ jāḍyāndhakārāpahām || haste sphāṭikamālikāṃ vidadhatīṃ padmāsane saṃsthitāṃ vande tāṃ parameśvarīm bhagavatīm buddhipradāṃ śāradām || 1 || hrīṃ hṛdyekabīje śaśirucirakalākalpavispaṣṭaśobhe bhavye bhavyānukūle kumativanadave viśvavaṃdyāṃghripadme || padme padmopaviṣṭe praṇatajanamanomodasaṃpādayitri prokṣiptākārakūṭe hariharanamite devi saṃsārasāre || 2 || (fol. 1v1–6) «End» pakṣadvaye pi yo bhaktyā trayodaśyaikaviṃśatiḥ || avicchedaṃ paṭhed dhīmān dhyātvā devīṃ sarasvatīṃ || 11 || sarvakāmasamāyuktas triṣu lokeṣ viśrutaḥ || vāṃchitaṃ phalam āpnoti kokesmin nātra saṃśayaḥ || 12 || (fols. 2v7–3r2) «Colophon» iti śrībrahmāṇḍapurāṇe nāradanandikeśvarasamvāde brahmaproktaṃ sarasvatīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || (fol. 3r2)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || kathaṃ sārasvataprāptiḥ kenopāyena suvrata || mahāsarasvatī yena tuṣṭā bhavati tad vada | āśvalāyana uvāca śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve guhyād guhyataraṃ mahat | daśaślokīti vikhyātaṃ dhyānapūrvṃ vadāmy aham 2 śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśāṃ ravibiṃbasamaprabhām | vandendutuhinābhāsvāṃ siṃhāsanagatāṃ śubhām | 3 | aṃkuśaṃ sākṣasūtraṃ ca pāśapustakadhāriṇīṃ | muktāhārasamāyuktāṃ devīṃ dhyāyec caturbhujām 4 (fol. 1r1–7) «End» sarasvaty uvāca dattaṃ te nirmalaṃ jñānaṃ kumatidhvaṃsakārakam | stotreṇānena ye bhaktyā māṃ stuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ 7 te labhaṃte paraṃ jñānaṃ mama tulyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ kavīnāṃ matprasādena prabhavanti manojavāḥ 8 trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhen nityaṃ madrūpaṃ paṭhati stavam | tasya kaṇṭhe nivāso me bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ 9 (fol. 5v8–14) «Colophon» iti bṛhaspatikṛtaṃ sarasvatīstotram 5 ślokī (fol. 5v14)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || devyā(!) sa(!)tanāmam || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || ahaṃ tatra pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tvaṃ kauśiko mune || mahātejā(!)vatī devī trailokyaṃ śaktirūpiṇī || 1 || yasyāntaṃ paṭhyate nityaṃ madbhāvā vāñchitaṃ phalam || devī ca triguṇā khyātāḥ(!) vadāmi sarvakāmakam || 2 || brahmāṇi carcitāḥ caṇḍī gaurī nārāyaṇī śivā || vārāhī vāśinī durgā śailānī ca maheśvarī || 3 || sāvitrī ca mahākālī kālarātrī kapālinī || kātyāyanī mahādevī kālarātrī vasundharā || 4 || (fol. 1v1–6) «End» ya(!)kaviṃśati vāran tu paṭhed evaṃ japet tu vā || rājadvāre smasāne ca videśe sa(!)trumaṇḍale || bhūtāgniraṇamadhye ca sarvakāryāṇi sādhayet || caṇḍikāhṛdayaṃ guhyaṃ triśa(!)ndhyaṃ kīrttaye dvija || sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca vindati || || (fol. 4r1–4) «Colophon» iti śrīrudrayāmale saptasatihṛdayaṃ samāpta śubham || || śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ (fol. 4r4)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīsūryyāya namaḥ || || saṃbaṃ saṃbamahābāho śṛṇu me kavaca śubhaṃ || trailokyamaṃgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ param adbhutaṃ || 1 || yad dhṛtvā maṃtravit saṃyak phalam āpnoti niścītaṃ || yad dhṛtvā ca mahābāho gaṇānām adhipo bhavet || 2 || paṭhanād dhāraṇāṃ viṣṇuḥ sarveṣāṃ pālakaḥ sadā || evam indrādayaḥ sarve sarvaiśvaryam avāpnuyāt || 3 || kavacasya ṛṣir brahmāṃ dvaṃdonuṣṭub udāhṛta || śrīsūryā devatā cātra sarvadevanaskṛta || 4 || ārogyaṃ yaśamokṣeṣu viniyoga prakīrtita || praṇavo me siraṃ yātu ghṛṇī me pātu bhālakaṃ || 5 || (fol. 1v1–7) «End» sirapāyāmathavā kaṇḍe sopi suryyā na saṃśayaḥ || īti te kathitaṃ sāmbva trailokya maṃgalādhikaṃ || 17 || kavaca durlabhaṃ lokye tava śnehā prakāsitaṃ || ajñātvā kavacaṃ divyaṃ yo jayat sūryye muttamaṃ || 18 || siddhir na jāyate tasya kalpakoṭisatair api || 19 || (fol. 2v5–8) «Colophon» iti śrībrahmāyāmale trailokyamaṃgalaṃ nāma sūryyakavacaṃ samāptaṃ śubham || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || (fols. 2v8–3r1)

«Beginning» oṁ svasti śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ || vāraṃ vāram udārasasmitamukhaḥ śikyoparisthāpitaṃ hāraṃ hāram ulūkhaloparigato haiyaṃgavīnaṃ haṭhāt āyāṃtīṃ purato valokya jananīm ādāya yaṣṭiṃ karo(!) dhāvaṃ dhāvam iha prakāśitabhayaḥ pāyāt sa māyārbhakaḥ kalhārotpalakairavāṃbujadalanmākaṃdasanmaṃjarī kodaṃḍaṃ karapaṃkajena dadhatīṃ puṃḍrekṣadaṃḍodbhavaṃ sauvarṇāṃkuśapāśapāṇim aruṇām āraktavastrāvṛtām ātāmrāṃbujasaṃsthitāṃ trinayanāṃ caṃdrārdhacūḍāṃ bhaje praṇamya śaṃkarācāryacaraṇāṃburuhadvayaṃ | viṣṇupakṣe pi saundaryalaharīvyākhyāṃ karomy ahaṃ || tatra bhavānīpakṣe || nanu hariharaviriṃcyādidevam apāsyāv iti kātyāyanīstuter ācaraṇam iti śiṣyāśaṃkām apaninīṣur hāre || ○ || śivaḥ śaktyā yukto yadi bhavati yuktaḥ prabhavituṃ || na ced evaṃ devo na khalu kuśalaḥ spaṃditum api || atas tvām ārādhyāṃ hariharaviriṃcyādibhir api praṇantuṃ stotuṃ vā katham akṛtapuṇyo prabhavati || (fol. 1v1–9) «End» janināṃ jīvā vākvacanaṃ tāsāṃ jananivācāṃ madhye dvayaṃ stutis tvadīyābhir eva vāgbhir aṃtaryāmitvayaiva nirmitānān mukhān niḥsaraṇamātrametasyā ity arthaḥ 102 arthaṃ madīyam avalokya tato pi samyag arthāṃtaraṃ samadhigamya na niṃdyam etat || atyaṃtadurgamatare pathi saṃcaraṃtaḥ ślāghyā bhavaṃti kavayaḥ puraprayātāḥ bhedo na te janani jātu janārdanena vaikuṃṭhanātha paratāpi kṛtrātra tena || mātar bhavāni karavāṇi tathāpi kāku saḥ kuṃṭhitās tu mayito stupayite karuṇākāṭakṣaḥ(!) || || (fol. 56r5–9) «Colophon» imamayāyavvurarahavānīśaṃkarau jāyataḥ śubhaṃ || saṃvat 1811 tatra varṣe mārgaśirakṛṣṇadvitīyā śani (fol. 56r10)

«Beginning of the root text» || śrīballabho jayati || prāṇādhikapreṣṭabhavajjanānāṃ tvadviprayogānalatāpitānāṃ || samastasaṃtāpanivarttakṃ yad rūpaṃ nijaṃ darśaya gokuleśa || 1 || (fol. 1v6–7) «Beginning of the commentary» || śrīgokuleśo jayatiḥ(!) || natvā śrīgokuleśaṃ taṃ rasarūpaikā(!)vigrahaṃ vyākhyāsye bhaktabodhārthaṃ kṛtvā tatprārthanāṣṭakaṃ || 1 || atha prabhusvarūpasya pūrṇaśṛṃgārarasātmakatvāt tasya rasasya ca saṃyogaviprayogātmakatvena dvirūpatvāt prabhūṇā svabhaktānāṃ pūrvaṃ saṃyogarasānubhavaṃ kārayitvā pūrṇarasānubhavārthaṃ viprayogaraḥ (!) svadāya(!) māne sati viprayogasya vikalatvāsyā prakṛtikatvenātigāḍhatāparūpatvāt tattāpam asahamānās tāmasabhāvāpannā bhaktās tāpanivṛttyarthaṃ prabhum uddiśya svarūpadarśanaṃ prārthayate || (fol. 1r1–7) «End of the root text» śrīgokuleśāṣṭakam iṣṭadātṛśraddhānvito yaḥ paṭhatīti nityaṃ || paśyaty avaśyaṃ sa(!)tadīparūpaṃ nijaikavaśyaṃ kurute ca hṛṣyan || 9 || (fol. 5v4–6) «End of the commentary» śrīgokuleśeti || idaṃ śrīgokuleśāṣṭakaṃ nityaṃ śraddhayā yaḥ paṭhati iṣṭaṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti tataśca tadīyaṃ rūpaṃ avaśyaṃ paśyatīti | paścāt harṣayuktaḥ san tatprabhusvarūpaṃ saṃbaṃdhīnaṃ ca karoti || rājasānāṃ cāṃchitaṃ prāptisātvikānāṃ svarūpadarśanaṃ || tāmasānāṃ svarūpādhīnakaraṇaṃ ceti phale traividhyaṃ || (fol. 5v2–3, 7–9) «Colophon of the root text» īti(!) śrīgokuleśāṣṭakaṃ tatsvarūpapradakṛṣṇarāyaproktaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śrīr astu |(fol. 5v5–6) «Colophon of the commentary» iti śrīkṛṣṇarāyaproktṃ svakṛtaśrīgokuleśāṣṭakavivaraṇaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ miti sāvaṇakṛṣṇapakṣatithau 5 caṃdravāsare saṃvat 1880 (fol. 5v9–10)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kailāsaśikhare ramye gauri pṛcchati śaṃkaram brahmāṇḍākhilanāthas tvaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ || tvam eva pūjyase lokair brahmaviṣṇusurādibhiḥ || nityaṃ paṭhsi deveśa kasya stotraṃ maheśvara || 2 || āścaryyam idam ākhyātam jāyate mayi śaṃkara || tatprāṇeśamahāprājña śaṃśayaṃ chiṃdhi śaṃkara || 3 || śrīmahādeva uvāca || dhanyāsi kṛtapuṇyāsi pārvati prāṇavallabhe || rahasyātirahasyaṃ ca yat pṛcchasi varānane || 4 || (fol. 1v1–6) «End» śrīvṛndāvanacandrasya prasādāt sarvam āpnuyāt || yadgṛhe pustakaṃ devī pūjito yatra tiṣṭhati || 69 || na māri na ca durbhikṣaṃ nopasargabhayaṃ kvacit || sarpyādibhūtayakṣyādyā naśyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 70 || śrīgopālo hi mahādevī vase(!) tasya gṛhe sadā || yasya gṛhe ca deveśi sahasraṃ nāma tiṣṭhati || 171 || || (fol. 16v3–7) «Colophon» iti śrīsammohanataṃtre haragaurīsaṃvāde śrīgopālasahasranāmasamāptam || || iti saṃvat 1939 sāla śrāvaṇa vadi roja 2 śubham || (fol. 16v7–17r2)

«Beginning» sya paśyāmi 2 | śokaduḥkhakṣayaṃkarī || 7 || yais tu bhaktyā smṛtā nūnaṃ teṣāṃ vṛddhiḥ prajāyate || pretasaṃsthā tu cāmuṇḍā vārāhī mahīṣāsanā || aindrī gajasamārūḍhā vaiśṇavī garuḍāsanā || māheśvarī vṛṣārūḍhā kaumārī śiṣivāhanā || 9 || brāhmī haṃsasamārūḍhā sarvvābharaṇabhīṣitā || nānābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā nānāratnpaśo(!)bhitā || 10 || (fol. 2r1–5) «End» patnīr(!) manoramāṃ dehi manovṛttānusāriṇī || tāraṇīṃ durggasaṃsāraḥ sāgarasya kulodbhavā || 23 || idaṃ stotra(!) paṭhitvā tu mahāstotraṃ paṭhen naraḥ || sa tu sa(!)ptasa(!)taṃ saṃkhyāvaram āpnoti saṃpadā || 24 || || || (exp. 15, 2–4) «Colophon» ity argalāstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || || oṃ namaś caṃḍikāyai || viśuddhajñānadehāya trivedī divyacakṣuṣe | śreyaḥ prāptinimittāya namaḥ somārddhadhāriṇe || 1 || sarvaṃ me vṛddhināṣa(!)s tu maṃtrāṇām api kīlakaṃ || sopi (exp. 15, 4–6)

«Beginning» ❖ sahyādri khalu || ekādaśarudramūrttidhyānaṃ || || ajaikapādahirbudhno virūpākṣaś ca raivataḥ || haraś ca bahurūpaś ca tryaṃbakaś ca sureśvaraḥ || rudrā ekādaśa proktā jayantaś cāparājitaḥ | atha rudrān pravakṣyāmi vāhuṣoḍaśakānvitān || aja(!)nām ādimo rudro dhatte śūladharo ʼṅkuśam | kapālaṃ ḍamaruṃ sarppaṃ mudgalaṃ ca sudarśanaṃ || (fol. 1r1–5) «End» vivasvanmūrttir eṣā syāt padmalāñchanalakṣitā | pūṣākhyasya bhaven mūrttir dvibhujā padmalāñchitā | sarvvapāpaharā jñeyā sarvvalakṣaṇalakṣitā || dakṣiṇe tu gadā yasyā vāme caiva sudarśanam | padmavyagrā tu sāvitrī mūrttiḥ sarvvārthabhāvinī || gadā ca dakṣiṇe haste vāmahaste ca kīlakam | mūrttis tvaṣṭrī bhaved vatsapadmaruddhakaradvayā || sudarśanakarā savye padmahastā tu vāmataḥ || eṣā sā dvādaśī mūrttir vviṣṇor atulatejasaḥ | eteṣāṃ tatra tīrthāni dvādaśaiva nṛpottama || (fol. 4r4–v4) «Colophon»

«Beginning» piṃgākṣaṃ gajavaktraṃ caturthakaṃ || 2 || laṃbodaraṃ paṃcamaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ vikatam eva ca || saptamaṃ vighnarājaṃ ca dhūmravarṇaṃ tathāṣṭamaṃ || 3 || navamaṃ bhālacaṃdraṃ ca daśamaṃ tu vināyakaṃ || ekādaśaṃ gaṇapatiṃ dvādaśaṃ tu gajānanaṃ || 4 || etad dvādaśanāmāni trisaṃdhyaṃ ya(!) paṭhen naraḥ || na ca vighnabhayaṃ tasya sarvasiddhikaraṃ prabho || 5 || (fol. 2r1–2v3) «End» samvatsareṇa siddhiṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśaya || 7 || aṣṭānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca likhitvā ya samarpayet || tasya vidyā bhavet sarvā gaṇeśasya prasādata || 8 || (fol. 3v1–5) «Colophon» iti śrīśaṃ(!)kaṣṭanāśanagaṇeśastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || śubham || ❖ || || (fol. 3v5–6)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kalpakṣoṇikarodayaḥ kati kati dvīpi dvipānāṃ tvacaḥ | kā kolāḥ katican(!) nagāḥ kati sudhā dhāmnaś ca khaṃḍā kati || kiṃ ca tvaṃ ca kati trilokajanani tvaddvāripūrodare majjajjaṃtukadaṃbakaṃ samudayaty ekaikam ādāya yat || 1 || devi tvatpulināṃgaṇe sthitijuṣāṃ nirmānināṃ jñānināṃ svalpāhāranibaddhaśuddhavapuṣāṃ vāṇīṃ guhaṃ śreyase || nānyatra kṣitimaṃḍaleśvaraśataiḥ saṃrakṣito bhūpateḥ praāsādo lalanāgaṇair adhigato bhogīndrabhogonnataḥ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End» vācālaṃ vikalaṃ khalaṃ śritamalaṃ kāmākulaṃ vyākulaṃ cāṃḍālaṃ taralaṃ nipītagaralaṃ doṣāvilaṃ cākhilam || kuṃbhīpākagataṃ tam aṃtakakarād ākṛṣya kas tārayen mātar jahnunarendranaṃdini tava svalpodabinduṃ vinā || 7 || śleṣmaśleṣaṇayāmalemṛtavile kāśākule vyākule kaṃṭhe ghargharaghoṣanādamaline kāye ca unmi(!)lati || yāṃ dhyāyann api bhārabhaṃguratarāṃ prāpnoti muktiṃ naraḥ snātuś cetasi jāhnavī nivasatāṃ saṃsārasaṃtāpahṛt || 8 || (fol. 2v3–7) «Colophon» iti kālidāsasya gaṃgāṣṭakaṃ (fol. 2v7)

«Beginning» śrīgaṅgāyai namaḥ || || bhagavati bhavalīlāmaulimāle tavāṃbhaḥ- kaṇam aṇuparimāṇaṃ prāṇino yaṃ spṛśaṃti || amaranagaranārīcāmaraggrāhiṇīnāṃ vigatakalikalaṃkātaṃkamaṃke luṭhaṃti || 1 || brahmāṇḍaṃ khaṃḍayaṃtī haraśirasi yadā vallavīm ullāsayaṃtī svarlokād āpataṃti kanakagiriguhāgaṃḍaśailāt skhalaṃti || kṣoṇivṛkṣe luṭhaṃti duritacayacamūnirbharaṃ bhartsayaṃtī pāthodhīṃ pūrayaṃti suranagarasarīt pāvani naḥ punātu || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End» bhagavati tava tīre niramātrāsano haṃ vigataviṣayatṛṣṇakṛṣṇam ārādhayāmi | sakalakaluṣābhaṃge svargasopānasaṃge taralatarataraṃge devi gaṃge prasīda || 7 || mātar jāhnavi śaṃbhusaṃgavalite maulau nidhāyāṃjaliṃ tvattīre vapuṣovasānasamaye nārāyaṇaṃ hṛddvayaṃ || sānaṃdaṃ smarato bhaviṣyati mama prāṇaḥ prayānotsavo bhūyād bhaktir avicyutā hariharād dvaitātmikāḥ sāśvatī || 8 || (fol. 2r7–v3) «Colophon» iti śrīmacchaṃkarācāryaviracitaṃ gaṃgāṣṭakaṃ saṃpūrṇam || || ❖ || || || || || || || || || || || || || || (fol. 2v3–4)

«Beginning» oṃ namo lokanātyāya || stutvā praṇamya .. .. .. yarkaṃ ra sarvvasatvā sampūrṇacandravadanāmbujapatranetraṃ | sarvajñajñānasakutotkalamuktimārggaṃ taṃ padmapānivarabhūṣitajñānarāśiṃ || 1 || uttuṃganāsavarapīnakapolavaktraṃ | raktādharaṃ himatuṣāram ivā (!) sudantaṃ || brahmeśvaraṃ śrutidharaṃ madhurañ ca vākyaṃ tam padmapāni mṛduvarṇṇasvaran namāmi || 2 || (fol. 1v1–2r2) «End» yat pate tena karuṇāstavanityakālaṃ śāntiṃ ca puṣṭiṃ dhanavṛddhisurarddhakāmā | āyuvibhūtibahuputravisārabhāgī pralayāṃtikālam api paśyati lokanāthaṃ || 24 || saṃkitti (!) yaṃti tava vīryamahānubhāvaṃ rātrau divā ca tava nāmam anusmaraṃti | duḥsvapnavighnabhayapāpavināśayanti tuṣyanti devaṃ satataṃ tava rakṣayanti || 25 || (fols. 10v2–11v2) «Colophon» iti śrī āryyāvalokiteśvarasya karuṇāstotraṃ samāptaṃ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || (fol. 11v2–3)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || sarasvatyai namaḥ || śrīgurave namaḥ || || gopya ūcuḥ || jayati teʼdhikaṃ janmanā vrajaḥ śrayata indirā śaśvad atra hi || dayita dṛśyatāṃ dikṣu tāvakas tvayi dhṛtāsavas tvāṃ vicinvate || 1 || śaradudāśaye sādhujātasat sarasijodaraśrīmuṣā dṛśā suratanātha teʼ śulkadāsikā varada nighnato neha kiṃ vadhaḥ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End» vrajavanaukasāṃ vyaktiraṅga te vṛjinahaṃtryalaṃ viśvamaṃgalaṃ || tyaja manāk ca nas tvatspṛhātmanāṃ svajanahṛdrujāṃ yanniṣūdanam || 18 yat te sujātacaraṇāṃburuhastaneṣu nītāḥ śanaiḥ priya dadhīmahi karkaśeṣu || tenāṭavīm aṭasi yat vyathate na kiṃsvit kūrppādibhir bhramati dhīr bhavadāyuṣāṃ naḥ || 19 || (fol. 3r7–v2) «Colophon» iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe daśamaskaṃdhe gopikāstutiḥ | ekatriṃśodhyāyaḥ || || (fol. 3v3)

«Beginning» || svasti śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyai namaḥ || || śrīmahākālikā uvāca || || mahākautuharāstotraṃ hṛdayākhyaṃ mahottamaḥ || śṛṇu priya mahāgopyaṃ dakṣiṇāya sugopitam || 1 || avācyam api vallāji tava prityā prakāsitam || anyasya kuru gopyaṃ ca satyaṃ satyaṃ ca sailaje || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) «End» paṭhet stotraṃ kalesānīḥ jivanmuktaḥ sa uceteḥ || rajasvalābhaga dṛṣṭā paṭhedekāgramānasaḥ || 39 || labhate paramasthānaṃ devī loke varātaneḥ || mahāduṣyamahāroge mahāsaṃkaṣṭke dine || 40 || mahābhayamahāghore paṭhet stotraṃ mahottamam || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ gopayan mātṛjāravat || 41 || (fol. 4v1–5) «Colophon» iti śrīkālikulārṇavadakṣiṇakālyā hṛdayaṃ samāptaṃ śubham || || (fol. 4v1–5)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || surādriśikhare ramye mālūrasya vanālaye || āśvalāyanam ekāgraṃ papraccha (!) munayaḥ purā || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || kathaṃ sāraśvatḥprāptiḥ kenopāyena suvrata || mahāsarasvatī yena tuṣṭā bhavati tadvada || 2 || āśvalāyana uvāca || śṛṇvaṃtu ṛṣayaḥ sarve guhyāguhyataraṃ mahat || daśaślokīti vikhyātaṃ dhyānapūrvaṃ vadāmy aham || 3 || (fol. 1v1–6) «End» pāśāṃkuśadharā vāṇī vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī || mama vaktre vasen nityaṃ dugdhakundendunirmalā || 53 || ityāśvalāyanamunir nijagāda devyāḥ stotraṃ samastaphalabhoganidānabhūtam || etat paṭhan dvijavaraḥ kavitām upaiti sarvāṇi vāñchitaphalāny upayāti śīghram || 54 || etatstotraṃ sarasvatyā muhūrtte brahmaḥaḥ paṭhet || acirāt bhāratī tasya toṣam āyāty asaṃśayaḥ || 55 || (fol. 7r5–11) «Colophon» iti śrī āśvalāyanamuniviracite daśaślokyākhyaṃ sarasvatīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śubham || sāradāyai namaḥ || (fol. 7r11 and right-hand margin)

«Beginning» ❖ oṃ hariharābhyāṃ namaḥ || viśveśvaraṃ guruṃ natvā mahimākhyastuter ayaṃ || pūrvvācāryyakṛtavyākhyāṃ saṃgrahaṅkriyate mayā || kaścit kila gandharvvarājaḥ kasyacidrājñaḥ pramadava⌠da⌡[na]kusumādi harann āsīt | tajjñātvā ca śiva[ni]rmālya laṃghanena matpuṣpacorasyāntardhānādikā sarvvāpi śaktir vinaśyatītyabhiprāyeṇa rājñā śive nirmmālyaṃ pādya[ṃ] nikṣiptaṃ tadapratisandhāya gandharvvarājaḥ praviśan avakuṇṭhaśaktir babhuva || tataḥ śivanirmmālyalaṃghane ca mamaiva dādṛśaṃ vikalpam iti pratidhānena viditvā paramakāruṇikaṃ bhagavantaṃ sarvvakāmadaṃ tameva tuṣṭāva | na tu stutir nāma guṇakathanaṃ tac ca guṇajñānādhīnaṃ ajñātasya kathanāsambhavāt | (fol. 1v1–5) «End» kleśena atiprayāsena vaśyam iti vā tena tvadaguṇavarṇṇane ʼtyantāyogam ity arthaḥ guṇānāṃ sīmāsaṃkhyāparimāṇayor iyattā tāsūllaṅghituṃ śīlaṃ yasyāḥ sā guṇasīmālaṅghinī śaśvadṛddhiḥ nityāvibhūtiḥ tenaitādṛśadurvvāsanāsasahasrakaruṣamatyalpaṃ viṣayaṃ mama manaḥ kva atyantanityā tava vibhūtir vvā kveti atyantāsambhāvanā mama bhabhahetur ity arthaḥ etadadhīraṇe ca tava bhaktir eva kāraṇam iti bhakter atyantāsambhāvitakaladānepi sāmarhyam iti darśayati yasmād evaṃ tasmāt sarvvoparādhān avigaṇayya paramakāruṇikena tvayā śaktireva tamoddīpanīyeti vākyatātparyyaṃ || || kusumadase(!)ti || ayaṃ ślokaḥ stavāntargataḥ sugamaśce (fol. 39v7–40r2) «Colophon»

Beginning śrīgaṇēśāya namaḥ || || oṃ || sa jayati sundaravadano devo yat pādapaṅkajasmaraṇaṃ || vāsaramaṇivivatamasāṃ rāsaṃ nāśeti (!) vighnānāṃ || 1 || gaṇapatiparivāraṃ cārukeyūrahāraṃ girivaradharasāraṃ yoginīcakracāruṃ || bhavajalaparivāraṃ duḥkhadāridra (!) hāraṃ gaṇapatim abhivaṃde vakratuṃḍāvatāraṃ || 1 || ? (fol. 1:1–4) End vyāsāṣṭakamidaṃ puṇyaṃ gaṇeśastavanaṃ nṛṇāṃ || paṭhanā(!) duḥkhanāśāya vidyāśrīyamavāpnuyāt (!) || 9 || (fol. 1:21–23) Colophon iti śrīśaṃkarācāryaviracitaṃ vya gaṇapatistotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || śrī || || || śāradāśāradāmbhojavadanā vadanāmbuje || sarvadā sarvadāsmākaṃ sannidhiṃ sa nidhiṃ kriyāt || (fol. 1:23–25)

Beginning śrīgaṇēśāya namaḥ || nandikeśvara uvāca || ataḥ paramidaṃ guhyaṃ rudrodgītaṃ mahodayaṃ || mahāvighnaḥ praśamanaṃ mahāśāntikaraṃ śubhaṃ || 1 || akālamṛtyuśamanaṃ sarvvavyādhinivāraṇaṃ || paracakrapraśamanaṃsadā vijayavarddhanaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End goghnaścaiva kṛtaghnaśca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ || śaraṇāgataghātī ca mitraviśraṃbhaghātakaḥ || 87 || duṣṭapāpasamācāro mātṛhā pitṛhā tathā || śravaṇāttasya bhāvena mucyate copapātakaiḥ || 88 || śāntidhyāyamidaṃ puṇyaṃ nadeyaṃ yasyakasyacit || śi[[va]]bhaktāya dātavyaṃ śivena kathitaṃ purā || 289 || || (fol. 18r1–4) Colophon iti śrīśivadharmaśāstre nandikeśvaraprokta śāntikādhyāyaṃ samāptaṃ (!) śubham || ❁ || || 513 | 73 | 752 | 6172 | 822 | 53 | 8271 || (fol. 18r4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇēśāya namaḥ || he viṣṇoḥ avinayaṃ ānītiṃ (!) apanaya dūrī kuru manaścittaṃ damaya viṣayā cāsau mṛgatṛṣṇā ca tāṃ śamaya śāntiṃ kuru bhuteṣu (!) dayā bhūtadayās tāṃ vistāraya. saṃssāraścāsau sāgaraśca tasmāt tāraya uddhara || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) avinayamapanaya viṣṇo damaya manaḥ śamaya viṣayarasatṛṣṇāṃ bhūtadayāṃ vistāraya tāraya saṃsārasāgarataḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v5–6) End nārāyaṇa karuṇāmaya śaraṇaṃ karavāṇi tāvakau caraṇau || iti ṣaṭpadī madīye vadanasaroje sadā vasatu || 7 || (fol. 3r4–5) Colophon iti śrīdharmarājakṛtā śālagrāmaprārthanā ṣaṭpadī samāptaṃ (!) śubham astu || iti śrī gaṇēśabhaṭtasuta bhavānīśaṃkara niyojitaḥ śālagrāmaprārthanā ṣaṭpadī samāptārthaḥ samāptaṃ śubhamastu sarvadā || (fol. 3r5–9)

Beginning śrīgaṇēśāya namaḥ || skanda uvāca || bhagvan devadevesa (!) śītalāyāstavaṃ śubhaṃ || vaktumarhasyaśeṣeṇa visphoṭakabhayāpaham || 1 || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu putra pravakṣāmi śītalāyā stavaṃ varaṃ || yaḥ śruṭvā sarvapāpebho naraḥ sadyo vimucyate || 2 || (exp. 2:1–5) End etāni kharnāmāni śītalāgre tu yaḥ paṭhet || tasya gehe śuśūnāṃ ca śītalāruṅ na jāyate || 24 || śītalāṣtakamevedaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || dātavyaṃ hi satā tasmai bhaktiśraddhānvitāya vai || 25 || (exp. 4b:7–11) Colophon iti śṛīskandapurāṇē śītalāstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam śubham || 2008 phāgun 8 gate roja 4 taddine likhitamidaṃ bhuvaneśvaraśarmaṇā (exp. 4b:11–13)

Beginning śrīgaṇēśāya namaḥ || śrī śitalādevyai namaḥ || oṃ asya śrīśītalāyā stotramaṃtrasya īśvara ṛṣī anuṣṭup chandaḥ śitalā devatā lakṣmīr bījaṃ bhavānīti śaktiḥ praṇava kīlakaṃ sarvavidhavisphoṭakopadravaśāntyarthe pāṭhe viniyoga || || (fol. 1v1–4) End śītale tvaṃ jaganmātā śītale tvaṃ jagatpitā || śītake tvaṃjagaddhātrī śītalāyai namonamaḥ || 22 || rāsabho gardabhaścaiva kharo vaiśākhanandanaḥ || śītalāvāhanaścaiva durvākandanikṛntanaḥ || 23 || etāni kharanāmāni śītalāgre tu yaḥṭhet || tasya gehe śiśūnāṃ ca śītalā ruṅ najāyate || 24 || śītalāṣtakamevedaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || dātavyaṃ hi sadā tasmai bhaktiśraddhānvitāya vai || 25 || (fol. 3v5–4r2) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe śītalāstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam śubham || (fol. 4r2)

Beginning śrīpaśupataye namaḥ || || prāleyamalavindukundadhavalaṃ gokṣīraphenaprabhaṃ bhasmābhyaṃgamanaṅgadehadahana jvālāvalī locanaṃ || viṣṇubrahmamarodgaṇārcitapadaṃ ṛgvedanādodayaṃ vandehaṃ sakalaṃ kalaṃkarahitaṃ sthāṇor mukhaṃ paścimaṃ || 1 ||(fol. 1v1–4) End etāni pañcavadanāni maheśvarasya ye kīrttayanti manujāḥ śatataṃ prabhāte || gacchanti e śivapadaṃ rucirairvimānaiḥ krīḍanti śaṃkaragaṇaiḥ śatataṃ śivāgre || 6 || (fol. 2v2–4) Colophon iti paṃcamuṣīstotraṃ śubhaṃ || (fol. 2v4)

Beginning śrīgaṇēśāya namaḥ || || vyāsa uvāca || || ekadsāmunayaḥ sarve dvārakāṃ draṣṭum āgatāḥ || vāsudevaṃ ca sotkaṇṭhāḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasā || 1 || tataḥ sa bhagavān prītaḥ pūjāṃ cakre yathāvidhi || teṣāmāśīs tato gṛhya (!) bahumāna puraḥ saram || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End śivanāmasahasrasya varṇituṃ na hi śakyate || koṭikoṭI madechānti (!) nāmnāṃ sahasrakīrttanāt || 63 || anena mantritaṃ bhasma duḥkhaduṣtavighātakam || piśācasya vināśāya japtavyamidamuttamaṃ || nāmnāṃ sahasra jñānena samaṃ kiṃcinna vidyate || 264 || || || (fol. 14v6–8) Colophon iti śrīpādme śivasahasranāma samāptaṃ śubham || || || śrīśāke 17[[0]]1 samvat 1836 || ❁ || ❁ || śrī || rāmaḥ || śi || ❁ || rāma || (fol. 14v8–9)

Beginning śrīgaṇēśāya namaḥ || śrīsadāśivāya namaḥ || vande deva umāpatī (!) suraguruṃ vande jagatkāraṇaṃ vande pañcagabhūṣaṇaṃ (!) mṛgadharaṃ vande paśūbhām (!) patīm|| vande sūryaśaśāṃkavahninayanaṃ vande mukundapriyaṃ vande bhaktajanāśrayaṃ ca varadharaṃ (!) vande śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–5) End ādau devakidevagarbhajananaṃ gopīgṛhe varddhanaṃ māyā putanā jīvidāpiharaṇaṃ (!) govarddhanadhāraṇaṃ || kaṃsa chedanaṃ (!) kauravādi mathanaṃ kuntisutāpālanaṃ śrīmadbhāgataṃ (!) purāṇakathītaṃ śrīkṛṣṇalīlā mrītam (!) || 1 || Colophon

«text:» oṃ namaḥ śrībhagavate vāsudevāya || arjuna uvāca || yena mustāśi (!) me deva yadyahaṃ pāpadullabha || yepramāda . . hitumanārthaṃ kretha tuṣyaśī mādhava || śrībhagavāna uvāca || kiṃtyanāmasahasrāni vijñāyatestu pārthiva || tāni nāmāni vakṣāmi out pāpai pramucyate || perathamaṃ tu hariṃ vidyāt dvitūyaṃ keśavastathā || tṛtīyapadmanābhañca caturtha vāmanasmṛtaṃ || (!) pṃcamam vedagabhañca (!) ṣaṣṭhaṃntu madhusūdana (!) || saptamaṃ vāsudevo hi vārāhā nāma ātamaṃ (!) || navamaṃ puṇḍarikākṣā daśamaṃ tu janārdana || kṛṣṇamekādaśaṇ nāma dvādaśa śrīdhanastathā || etadvādaśa (!) nāmāni viṣṇu proktāni savaśaḥ sāyaṃ prataḥ pathestu (!) puṇyāpuṇya . . . saṃdhyākāle pathe yastu (!) sarvapāpaṃ pramucyete (!) sarvapāpaṃ viśurddhātmā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || iti śrīviṣṇudvādaśanāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || (exp. 2a:5:4a:2)

>Excerpts «Text:» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsūryāyaḥ || (!) yakṣa uvāca || prathamaṃ bhāskaraāma dvitīyañca dvivākalaṃ (!) tṛtīyaṃ timirāṃdhanye caturthaṃ lokacakṣuṣū || 1 || pañca prabhāskaraṃ nāma sahasrāṃgu ca ṣaṣṭhamaṃ(!) mārtaṇḍaṃ saptamaṃ nāma ādityañca ta++maṃ || 2 || navamaṃ ravināmañca daśamaṃ sūrya ucyate ekādaśaṃ bhavedarkka dvādaśaṃ tīkṣna tekṣasaḥ || 3 || (!) etad dvādaśanāmānityaṃ trikāraṃbhayaḥ pathet nara, sadyahaṃkūṣṭahalaṃ dāridrośca haredhruvaṃ || 4 || sarvvatīrtha kṛrttaṃ snānaṃ sarvvalokeṣu vāndataṃ, prabhāte viṣṇurūpañca madhyāhne brahmarūpakamalparāhe hararūpaṃ, raghunāthaṃnamostute || ḥ || 5 || iti śṛīpadmapurāṇe ādityadvādaśanāmastotraṃ samāptaḥ || || śubhamastu sarvvadākālaṃ || śubha || (exp. 24a5:24b5)

Complete Text oṃ namaḥ śrīśīvāyaḥ (!) || prathaman tu mahādeva dvitīyañ ca maheśvara tṛtīyaṃ śaṃkaraṃ nāma caturthaṃ tu vṛṣavadhvaja (!) paṃcamaṃ kīrttivāsañ ca ṣaṣṭamaṃ (!) kāmāṅganāśanam saptamaṃ devadeveśa nīrakaṇṭhas tathāstamaṃ (!) navamaṃ cailyaaśvaraṃ nāma daśamaṃ pārvvatīprīya rudram ekādaśaṃ nāma dvādaśa śivam ucyate || eta dvādaśanāmāni trisaṃdhya ya pathet tu (!) goghna kṛtaghna caiva brahmahā gurutarpakaḥ (!) viśvāśaghātaka (!) caiva surāpo vṛṣayāpati (!) sarvapāpavinirmuktaṃ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati || iti śivasya dvadaśanāmastotram || (exp. 4a3:b:1)

Beginning ōṃ nama paśupate namaḥ (!) || lokeścaturānanaḥ sṛjati yaḥ sarvaṃ jagadvedavān yo viśvaṃ kurute sthitiṃ madhuripur bhūtāntarātmā hariḥ | sṃbhāre jagatā (!) haro bhavati yaḥ soyaṃ trimūrttir vvibhuḥ paṃcāsyasyas paramātmakaḥ paśupatiḥ pāpāpahaḥ pātu māṃ || (exp. 4b:2–4) «Ending:» eteṣāṃ śivaliṅgānāṃ midaṃ (!) stotraṃ jagaddhitaṃ || mānavā ya paṭhantebhyo bhakti (!) cirtta (!) samanvitāḥ || phalavāṅkṣītadaṃ yacca mokṣa dadantu śaṅkarāḥ || 24 || (exp. 6a6:6b1) «colophon:» iti śrīgaṇapati śamanā kṛtaṃ śrīmūlapśupateścatuḥṣaṭhi svayaṃbhuśivaliṇgānāṃ stotraṃ samāpta (!) || || śubhamastu || || (exp. 6b:1–2)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīnavagrahāya || ōm javākumasaṃtāsaṃ (!) kāsyapyayaṃ mahādyuti | tamori sarvapāpaghna (!) pranamāmi divākaraṃ (!) || 1 || (exp. 6b:3–4) «Ending:» abhipretārtha sirddhāya navagrahasamanvita || śucitāntu sadākālaṃ pīḍādeha vepohanti(!) || 12 || (exp. 7b:1–2) «colophon:» iti navagrahastutī stotra samāpta (!) || ❁ || śubhamastu sarvadā kālaṃ śubha || (exp. 7b:2–3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ caṇḍikādevyai namaḥ || pracaṇḍavādu dantatā nimindu khandu te khalaṃ phani saṃhārarani haniprīyāṃ jagadūraṃ dhalātarttadhūmānalo madūdhisiddhidāyakaṃ śivacarikalistu satdeva guhyakārikāṃ || 1 || (exp.7b:4–6) End oṃ vajra yurkta vāsarkta nakta tamisa ‥ bhavisaṃyukta prajape mantra mantra mantra sirddhikā urddhapāna dipapāna dāmanā tarkicchakā nāmāmi oṃ guruparābhe vajrakālikāṃ kṣeme ca vajra dehi pāpanāśi śusthirābhadejāhaṃ pūnaparāgati || 8 || (exp. 8b:4–7) «colophon:» iti śrīguhyakālikā vajrayogini varanāma bhujaṅgatostraṃ samāpta (!) || || śubhamastu sarvvadā || (exp.8b8:9–1)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ caṇḍikā devai namaḥ || na tāṭo na mātā na bandhū na dātā na putra na putrī na bhṛto na bhaktā (!) || na jāyā na vṛrtaṃ na vṛrtti mame vā gatistvaṃ gatistvaṃ tumyakā bhavāni || 1 || (exp. 9a:2–4) End ya idaṃ parthati padma bhaktyā stotrameta samyagraha sa bhavati sūlapūjāmāna niyo nṛpānā, bahurajaṃnaṃ (!) bhakto bhogi kavindra sakala bhuvana mā tatra dibhā na mantra || 9 (exp. 9b:7–10a:2) «colophon:» iti śrīśaṃkarācāryaviracita divyāṣtakaṃ samāpta (!) || 2 || śubha || || (exp. 10a:2)

>Excerpts Beginning oṃ namaḥśrīdurgādavyai (!) namaḥ || oṃ brahmāyani barmasārvitri brahmatatvanivedani catubhuja catuvaktra catuvada +++ ṇI || 1 || catubhujabalaṃvyāpi catu++ gaparāyaṇI hamṣayuktavimānastaṃ sādharūpi pitāmahi || 2 || pūstakā japamārāñca baladābhaya++ ṇāṃ pi +++ devī pitāṅgi pirttavāsā || 3 || (!) (exp. 10a:3–6) End vaikuṇṭhapīṭha śrīlakṣmī devī gva pārini yoginī || ehi saṃsāramadhyaje pūrūṣāyi ekapaṃcāsa pīṭhe nāma sūnūve || sapūrūṣe || taptāyi kadācit mānneśrīkaje pāpacchilā sakarapāpavidhvaṃsahe yā avaāśyaṃ śivaloka giyā || 26 || (exp.18:4–7) «colophon:» iti śrī 3 muktipadapāyi ve ekapañcāśadyavai joginīpīṭha juvatārastotra samāpta || ❁ || śubham astu | sarvvadākālaṃ || śubha || (exp. 18a7 :18b1)

Beginning śrīgaṇēśāya namaḥ || kuśeśvarāya namaḥ || durgātīrthāya namaḥ || bhīmeśvarāya namaḥ || devatīrthāya namaḥ || kāphīśvarāya namaḥ || suvarṇatīrthāya namaḥ || kaśyapeśvarāya namaḥ || kāśyapatīrthāya namaḥ || sphaṭikeśvarāya namaḥ || kāntitīrthaya namaḥ || (exp.2a:1–6) End mṛgasthalītīrthāya namaḥ || bhasmeśvarāya namaḥ || bhasmagaṃgātīrthāya namaḥ || bhuvaneśvarāya namaḥ || jñānakuṇḍatīrthāya namaḥ || rudrāgāreśvarāya namaḥ || rudrasnānodakatīrthāya namaḥ || || (exp.7a6 :7b4) Colophon iti satīrthacatuṣasṭitīrthanāmāni samāptāni ||(exp. 7b:4–5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇēśāya || śrīkālīkāyai || 3 || asya śrīmahāmāryyāsṭākastotramṃtrasya vararuciṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ mahāmāryyā mahśakti devatā oṃ kālī bījaṃ mahākālī śakti rudrakālī kīlakaṃ mahābhūtapiśāca brahmarākṣasa yamadūṭa (!) śākinī ḍākinī sarvvopadravasaṃhāradvārāt (!) śrīparamaiṣṭakāryya siddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || || nyāsaḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) End mārī lo⟪ka⟫pamasūrikābhayaharaṃ jantālabhūpāpahaṃ cīrevyāghramahoragādi viṣaharaṃ śītajvaroccāṭana | strībhāgodaya vahaṃ sūcikaraṃ varccaḥ sūpūtrapradaṃ tanmāryyāṣṭakamamtramiṣṭaphaladaṃ strotraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ yapet || 14 || || || (fol. 4r6:4v1) Colophon iti śrī[[rudrayāmale]] kālīkhaṃḍe vararuciracitam mahāṃ mahāmārīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ samāptaḥ (!) || || śubham || liṣitā bhākudattena kālīmāhātmya mūrttamam | yadiśurddham aśurddhaṃ vā kṣamatāṃ parameśvarī || yathā dṛṣṭaṃ tathā liṣitaṃ leṣako nāsti doṣayet || śubhamastu || || ❖ samvat 901 māgha vadi 14 śubha || ❁ || (fol. 4v2–4)

Beginning /// . . . . bhanāta parayā bhaktyā mana /// kāyabhaktitaḥ | taratyākhiladuḥkhāni tasmādbhakta itīritaḥ | 20 | śarīramarthaṃ prāṇaṃ ca sa /// yo nivedyayaḥ | gurubhyaḥ śiṣyato yogaṃ śiṣya ityabhidhīyate | 21 | yonimudrānusandhāna /// rijāpādasevanāt | nilīnopādhivibhavād yoginītyabhidhīyate 22 (exp 1:6–10) End abhyarcya devatā buddhyā bhogapātra nivedayet | tadante kuṃ /// pramadāśca manoharā | saṃpūjya devatā buddhyā dadyāt pātra pṛthak 2 gurudaivatamantrṇām aikyaṃ savi /// yāvādullāsa paryaṃta mupadeśe piben madhuḥ | carukaṃ siddhidaṃ prokytaṃ dīpo jñānaprado bhavet | (exp. 7:6–10) Colophon

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeyāye (!) namaḥ || || muktā ma[[yā]] kṛta mū⟪kta⟫kti veṇī bhaktābhayaprā(ṇa)nibaṃdhaveṇī | ma⟪stā⟫stāli guṃjan makaraṃdaveṇī (!) śrīmat ⟪pra⟫ prayāge jayati triveṇī || 1 || (exp. 3b:1–2) End triveṇī(!)daśakastotraṃ sāyaṃprāta (!) paṭhet nara (!) || tasya veṇī veṇītisaṃtuṣṭhā (!) dadātyarthacatuṣṭayam || 10 || (exp. 4a7–8) Colophon iti śrīśaṃkarācāryaviracitaṃ triveṇīdaśakastotraṃ sṃpūrṇna (!) || ||( exp. 4a:8–9)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeyāye (!) namaḥ || || muktā ma[[yā]] kṛta mū⟪kta⟫kti veṇī bhaktābhayaprā(ṇa)nibaṃdhaveṇī | ma⟪stā⟫stāli guṃjan makaraṃdaveṇī (!) śrīmat ⟪pra⟫ prayāge jayati triveṇī || 1 || (exp. 3b:1–2) End triveṇī(!)daśakastotraṃ sāyaṃprāta (!) paṭhet nara (!) || tasya veṇī veṇītisaṃtuṣṭhā (!) dadātyarthacatuṣṭayam || 10 || (exp. 4a7–8) Colophon iti śrīśaṃkarācāryaviracitaṃ triveṇīdaśakastotraṃ sṃpūrṇna (!) || ||( exp. 4a:8–9)

Beginning ❖ śrībhairava uvāca || oṃ jaya tvaṃ mālinīdevī nirmmale malanāśanī (!) | jñānaśaktiḥ prabhur ddevi buddhis tvaṃ tejabarddhanī (!)|| jananī sarvvabhūtānāṃ saṃsāresmin vyavasthitā | mātā pitā balī devī kāruṇyaṃ kuru vatsale || (exp.2a:1–3) End nīlāñjanasamaprakhyaṃ kubjarūpāṃ mahodarāṃ | īṣat karālavadanāṃ varvvarorddhe śiroruhāṃ || surupāñ ca virupāñ ca anekākārarupinīṃ (!) | vāme prasāritakarāṃ vāmadevīm uvāca ha || ājñānandamahāviṣṭo stutyānandākulīkṛtā | na vetti kotramā strauti (!) kāhaṃ kasya varapradā || (exp.4:a6–b:2) Colophon iti śrīmālinī stutiḥ samāptaḥ (!) || ❁ || (exp 4a8–9)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo ʼstu te mahāmāye śūkṣmadehe parāpare | ekākini viśuddhātmai nādākhye bindumāliṇi (!) | adehāc ca samutpanne acale viśvadhāriṇī | mahākuṇḍalinī nityaihaṃsamadhye vyavasthite || somasūryāgnimadhyasthe vyomavyāpi parāpare | ḍekāravigrahāvasthe hakārārddhārddhadhāriṇi || (exp.5a:1–4) End tathā kālī umā devī devadūti namo ʼstu te | rudrakālī mahādevi carmmamuṇḍe bhayāvahe || mahocchuṣme mahāśānte namaste śaktirupiṇi | bhūrbhuvaḥ sveti svāhānte dayāṃ nāthe kuruṣva me || jñānārthino mahāmāye etad icchāmi vedintaṃ (!) || yasvidaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ trisaṃdhyo ceva mānavaḥ || prāpnoti cintitān kāmān strīṇāṃ bhavati vallabhaḥ | (exp.6b:6–exp7a:3) Colophon iti śrīśivaśakti samarasatve māhāmāyāstavaḥ samāptaḥ || ❁ || (exp.7a: 3–4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namas tripurāyai || kalyānavṛṣṭibhir avāpūritābhilakṣmī svayaṃ varaṇa maṅgala dīpibhiḥkābhiḥ | sevābhiraṃba tava pādasarojamūle nāgāri kimanasi bhaktimatāñ janānāṃ || 1 || etāvadevi (!) janani spṛhanīyam (!) āste tvad vandanena salilasthagiteva netre | sānnidhyam udyatakalāyuta sodarasya tad vigra⟪sya⟫hasya parayā sudhayāplutasya || 2 | (exp.7b:1–4) End lagnaṃ sadā savatu (!) mātar idaṃ tvad īyaṃ tejaparaṃ bahulakuṃkama (!) paṅka sonaḥ (!) | bhāsvad kirīṭamamṛtāśu kalāvatāśaṃ (!) madhye trikoṇa muditaṃ paramāmṛtādraḥ || 14 || hrīṃkāratrayasaṃyutena mahatā mantrena(!) saṃjīvitaḥ stotre yaḥ prativāsaraṃ tava pure mātar jayan mantravit | tasya kṣauni(!) bhujo bhavanti vaśagā lakṣmīsthirasthāyanī(!) vānī(!) nirmmalaśuktibhāra bharitā jāgranti dīrghanvayaḥ || 15 || (exp.9a:3–exp.9b:1) Colophon mantroddhāra iti śrītripurasuṃdarīdaivyāḥ (!) saṃkarācāryaviracitā (!) kṣaramālastotraḥ samāptaḥ (!) || ❁ || ○ || (exp.9b:1–2)

Beginning ❖ mādanantadadhaḥśaktis tadanta vvindumālinī | aindram ākāsabījasthaṃ adhastād analākṣaraḥ || māyāviddh īśvarayuktaṃ sarvvopari nijojitaḥ (!) ayaṃ sa vāgbhavo devi vāgīśatvaṃ pravarttakaiḥ || 1 | (exp.9b:2–4) End tyaktā sṛṣṭikraman devi prāg ucā(!)rakrameṇa tu | evam eṣā mahādevi mahātripurasundarī || 3 || ○ || (exp.10a:2–3) Colophon mantroddhāra iti samāptaḥ || trīkūṭāni samāhṛtya tridasākṣaramudharet (!) (exp.10a:3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāyaḥ (!) || kailāśasyāṅgare śrīṭhā sūddhasphaṭikasaṃṇibhe (!) | tamoguṇavihīne tu jarāmṛtyu vivarjitre || sarvārtha saṃpradādhāre (!) sarvvajñānakṛtālaye | kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā sukhāsīnaṃ sadāśivaḥ || papṛccha prato bhūtvā jānubhyāmavaniṃgataḥ | kenopāyena deveśa cirāyurlomaśo bhavet || tan me vrūhi mahādeva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | śrīsadāśiva uvāca || (exp. 11b:1–5) End evaṃ samkīrttayed astu (!) śuciprayatamānasa | bhaktā śṛnoti yo brahman mṛtyuñjaya namostu te || (!) nāpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya juktakāle (!) ca laṃghayet | vyādhayo nopapadyaṃte nopasaṃgabhayavet (!) || tābhyā saṃtatarekāle (!) saptekārvattane (!) kṛte mṛtyu najāyate … satamā(!) varttayedyastu satameva (!) sa jīvati …|| iti śrī |śiṃvadaṃ (!) rahasye paramaṃ devaṃ harati pāpa sadā [[ dusvapnanāśanaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvavi++ḥ || (exp. 14a5-14b1) Colophon iti mṛtyuṃjay (!) samāptaḥ (exp.14b:1) (exp. 14b1)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāyaḥ (!) || śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ || niḥsīmānandayā devyā nityaṃ samarasātmanaḥ paramasya śivasyāhaṃ śraye [[śrī]]pādukādvayam || 1 || sarvvānugrahiṇīn nityāṃ sarvvamaṅgalamātaraḥ | sarvvaśaktiṃ bhajeśaktiṃ(!) pañcakṛtyakarīṃ prabho || 2 || pālitaṃ vahirindrādyaiḥ parameśvaryaśobhitaḥ | prapadye paścimādvāra(!) mṛḍānyā mandiraṃ mahat || 3 || pāsāṃ(!)kuśahalāṃbhoja(!) pāṇipāṭala (!) tūṇḍilaḥ | vīraṃ vighnacchidaṃ vande gajavaktraṃ gajeśvaraḥ (!) || 4 || (exp. 14b2–7) End ekāmanuttarakalāākulanāthakātāṃ bālārkkatulyasahasāṃ bahupuṇyalabhyāṃ | ānandamūrttim akhilārtha vilāsahetum ādyāsparāpaviratā paramātmavidyā || 46 || yatkāmasiddhir iti maṅgalakāmadhenuṃ kāmeśvarī tuti(!)mimāṃ paṭhatir pranītaḥ (!) | kātyāśriyā kavi⟪tra⟫[[ta]]yā guṇasaṃpadā ca sorabhyayaśritataeva kimu priyābhiḥ || ❁ ||(exp. 21a2–b1) Colophon iti śrīvatsarājastava samāptaḥ || liṣitaṃ śubha || (!) (exp. 21b1) iti sadśivaśadvādaśanāma śamāpata || (!) (exp. 21b2–4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || namaste nirmmalaṃ devaṃ namaste jñānarupiṇam | namaste jyotirupañca niskalañ(!) ca namostu te || 1 || ādhāre tiṣṭhate (!) jyotiḥ sūryamaṇḍala bheditam | somacakrantadūrddhaṃñca tadūrddhañca śivārcanam | 2 || sva āsanastu karttavyaṃ padmāsanamanuttamaṃ | tatra mantrīsanaṃ (!) kṛtvā pañcapretāsanaṃ śuabham || 3 || prāṇāyāmam pravakṣāmi svādhāre yojitaṃ japet | brahmā tu pūrakaṃ yasya kumbhako viṣṇudevatā || 4 || recakāgnisvarupañca śivaśaktiṃ samuddharet | paścimābhimukhaṃ liṅgaṃ pūrako brahmamaṇdalaṃ || 5 || (exp.22a1:22b1) End somacakraṃ mahādevi pūrṇṇapīṭhaṃ manoharam | brahmaśaktirmahādevī bhageśvarī namostu te || 26 || trikūṭāni samāhṛtya tridaśākṣaram uddharet | tūryabījaṃ mahādevi brahmakhaṇḍendvalaṅkṛtam || 27 || eṣā mantramahāvidyā parambā śaktirūpiṇīṃ || kūṭamekaṃ sthitaṃ devī bhukti mukti phalapradām || 28 || somasūryāgnipīṭhañca dāḍimīkusumopamām | pāśāṅkuśa trinetrañca pañcabāṇadhanurdharām || 29 || brahmacakraṃ(!) sthitaṃ nityaṃ jñānaśakti svarupiṇīm | oḍiyāna (!) mahādevi… (exp.24b:1–6) Colophon śrī namaḥ iti ‥ śrījyotiśāstre … (exp.25:1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīmad saptasatī āryāmayūrakṛta prāraṃbha || śrīmad viṣṇu prabhucīna milīvaradā asi mahāmāyā || braṃhmāṇḍa śatātajicā yogyana mahimā asi mahāmāyā || 1 || devācā śatru adhipa asurācā mahiṣakarini he kulahā || śatavarṣāṃtī pāunipari bhavaśatamanyu ca hmaṇe balahā || 2 || (fol. 1r1–6) End kādambinī śiveteṃjo śatamakhamukha tayāhi lekhāṃteṃ || cātakamayūra aiṃseṃ taccarita hi amṛtavarṣalekhāte || (fol. 40v3–5) Sub-Colophon iti śrīdevīmahātmye mahiṣāsurasainyavadhe prathamodhyāyaḥ || (fol. 9r9–10) iti śrīdevīmāhātmye mahiṣāsuravadhe dvitiyodhyāya (!) || 2 || ❁ || (fol. 16r5–6) iti śrīdevīmahātmye śumbhaniśumbhavadhodyame tritīyodyāyaḥ(!) || 3 || || ❁ || || ❁ || (fol. 22r4–5) iti śrīdevīmahātmye śumbhaniśumbhavadhodyame caturthodhyāyaḥ || 4 || || ❁ || || (fol. 24v7–8) iti śrīdevīmahātmye caṃḍamuṃḍavadhe paṃcamodhyāyaḥ || 5 || ❁ ||(fol. 27r6–7) iti śrīdevīmahātmye ṣaṣṭa(!)dhyāyaḥ || ❁ || || ❁ || || (fol. 32v1–2) iti śrīdevīmahātmye niśumbhavadhe saptamodhyāyaḥ || 7 || ❁ (fol. 36v6–7) Colophon iti śrīdevīmahātmye mayureśvaraviracite śumbhavadhe aṣṭamodhyāyaḥ || || śrī || śubhaṃ bhavatu || hastākṣāra (!) apābbalavaṃta dikṣitopanāma || yadakṣara padabhraṣtaṃº || ❁ || (fol. 41r5–8)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo bhagavatyai caṇḍikāyaiḥ || mārkaṇḍēya uvāca || sāvarṇṇisūryatanaya (!) yo manuḥ kathyateṣṭamaḥ || niśāmaya tad utpattiṃ vistarad gadato mama || māhāmāyānubhāvena yathā manvantarādhipaḥ | sa babhūva mahābhāgaḥ sāvarṇṇis tanayo raveḥ || svārociṣentare pūrvvaṃ caitravaṃśasamudbhavaḥ || suratho nāma rājābhūt samaste kṣitimaṇdale || tasya pālayataḥ samyak prajāḥ putramivau[ rasān || ] (fol.1r1:v1) «Sub:Colophon:» ity ādivarāhapurāṇe iti triśaktimāhātmye mahiṣāsuravadhaḥ || || (fol.3v4–5) iti mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvaṇṇike (!) manvantare mahiṣāsuravadhaḥ || || (fol.10v5) iti mākaṇḍeya (!) purāṇe sāvaṇive (!) manvantare devīmāhātmye || || (fol.13v1–2) iti mākāṇḍeya (!) purāṇe sāvaṇike (!) manvamtare devīmāhātme dūtavacana || || (fol.25v1–2) End yā devī sarvabhūteṣu mātṛrūpeṇa saṃsthi///(tā || namas tasyai namas tasyai) namas tasyai namo namaḥ || yā devī sarvabhūteṣu bhrāntirūpeṇa saṃsthitā || namas tasyai namas tasyai \\\( namas tasyai namo namaḥ || yā devī sarvabhūteṣu dhṛtirūpeṇasaṃsthitā || namas tasyai namas tasyai namas tasyai namo namaḥ || [(indriyāṇāmadhiṣṭhātrī)]\\\ bhūtānāṃ cākhileṣu yā || bhūteṣu tasyai satataṃ vyāptidevyai namo namaḥ || citirūpeṇa yā ///[kṛtsnam etad vyāpyasthitā jagat | )] namas tasyai namas tasyai namas tasyai namo namaḥ || stutā suraiḥ pūrvam abhīṣṭa saṃśrayā tathā [(surendreṇa dineṣu sevitā )] (fol.33:1–5) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya || cakroddhāraṃ vakṣe || ṣaṭkoṇaṃ pañcavṛttiṃ tadabahi viditam aṣṭapatraṃ praparṇaṃ tadbāhyemaṣṭaśṛṅgaṃ digacaturayutaṃ dvāritantarrvviśuddhiṃ | nīlaṃ jīmūtavarṇṇaṃ phaṇivalayaśiraṃ bālacandraṃ trinetraṃ hālaṃ kaṅkālamālaṃ ḍamaruphaladharaṃ cakranāthaṃ namāmi || kṣetrayā || ṣaṭkoṇamadhūpatraṃ bhṛtayavṛtayutaṃ vedaśṛṅgaṃ prayuktaṃ jvālālīnaṃ vicitraṃ vipuravaladharaṃ (!) dhāraṇaṃ dhyāna dhūṇyaṃ (!) | mādyaṃ (!) pūjyaṃ kuleśaṃ kaṭitaṭakatakaṃ kṣudraghaṇṭhaṃ (!) trinetraṃ naumi śrī barhiyānaṃ (!) bhayasakalaharaṃ gaurisūnaṃ bhajehaṃ || (exp.1a1:2:1) «Sub-Colophon:» iti gurumaṇḍala naivātmā cakroddhāra || ○ || (exp.3a:4–5) iti karmm(!)acakroddhāra (exp.7b:1) iti śrīcandradīṣāvatāre cakroddhāraḥ || ○ || (exp.8 a6:b1) End puṣpabhājanaṃ kṛtvā || śūddhaḥ śāntahśivapraśādaparamaḥ sarvva ‥ śaktiśvaraṃ sānandaṃ suranāyakaṃ sa bhagavān saṃpūrṇa kāmapradaṃ | vāgīśāvarastu vāgbhava yato turvvā vāmādi cakreśvaraṃ vyādhiḥ śokavināśa kuṣṭabhayahā (!) mṛtyuṃjaya trāhi māṃ || siddhir astu || (exp.26b:3–6) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ asya śrīmahāvidyāvanadurgāstotramantrasya araṇyaīśvara ṛṣir anuṣṭupchando ʼ ntaryāmī nārāyaṇaḥ kirātarūpī īśvaro vanadurgāparameśvarī devatā oṃ duṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ klīṃ kīlakaṃ mamavanadurgāprasādasiddhyasrthe sarvopadravanivāraṇārthe jape viniyogaḥ || oṃ nityānapavādinīṃ hrāṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyān namaḥ (!) || oṃ haṃsinī hrāṃ tarjanībhyānnamaḥ (!) || oṃ padminī hruṃ madhyamābhyānnamaḥ (!) || oṃ cakrṇī hraiṃ anāmikābhyānnamaḥ (!) || oṃ śaṃkhinī hrauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyānnamaḥ (!) || oṃ triśūlavaradhāriṇīṃ hraḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭābhyānnamaḥ (!) || evaṃ rītyā hṛdayādinyāsaḥ karttavyaḥ || oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaromiti digbandhaḥ || dhyānaṃ || maṃgalaṃ diśatu me maheśvaro maṃgalaṃ diśatu me maheśvarī || maṃgalaṃ diśatu me gaṇādhipaṃ maṃgalaṃ diśatu me gaṇeśvarī || 1 || hema prakhyāmindukhaṇḍāvataṃśāṃ śaṃkhāryabjāṃ bhītihastāṃ trinetrāṃ || hemābjāsthāṃ pītavastrāṃ prasannāṃ devīṃ durgāṃ divyarūpāṃ namāmi || (fol. 1v1–2r1) End [lipyantara cha10-13 pege samma]? || brahmagāyatrīṃ paṭhet ||śrī nārāyaṇa caraṇau śaraṇaṃ prapadye śrīmate nārāyaṇāya namaḥ || ugraṃ vīraṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ jvalantaṃ sarvatomukhaṃ || nṛśiṃhaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ mṛtyūṃ mṛtyuṃ namāmyaham || caṇḍīṃ karālavadanāṃ raktalocanabhīṣaṇām || kāladaṇḍīṃ parāṃ mṛtyuṃ vijayāṃ vaṃdayāmyaham || pañcayojana vistīrṇāṃ mṛtyośca mukhamaṃḍalaṃ || tasmādrakṣa mahāvidye bhadrakāli namostu te vārijalocana sahajagaṃtiṃ vārayā sukaranīkarai pūritameghāṅga ⟨ga⟩nātītāṃ gopa kanyake śodaravat ○ | oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya ○ 2 oṃ kṣaṃ bhakṣaṃ jvālājihve karā[[la]]draṃṣṭra pratyaṅgire kṣaṃ hrīṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhā oṃ hrīṃ yāṃ kalpayaṃti norayakrūrāṃ kṛtyāṃ vadhūmiva tāṃ brāhmaṇāpanirar(!) guṇaṃ pratyakkarttāramṛcchatu || oṃ hrīṃ pratikūlaṃ me naśyatu || anukūlaṃ mestu mahādevyai ca vidmahe viṣṇupatnai ca dhīmahi tanno lakṣmī pracodayāt || oṃ blūṃ hraiṃ śrīṃ brahmakosini mām rakṣa 2 huṃ phaṭ svāhā || oṃ sahanā bhavatu(!) sahanau bhunaktu sahavīryaṃ karavāvahai tejasvināvadhītam astu mā vidviṣāvahai || oṃ śāntiḥ 3 || ❁ || oṃ bhagavatyai namaḥ || || (fol. 12v2–13r6)

Beginning śrīrāmāya namaḥ || | nārada uvāca || ||<ref name="ftn1"> covered with red ink and illigible / from orogonal book </ref> vāsudevaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ vāvanaṃ (!) jalaśāyanaṃ (!) || janārddanaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śrīvatsaṃ garuḍadhvajaṃ || 1 || vārāhaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ narasiṃhaṃ narakāntakaṃ || (!) avyaktaṃ śāśvataṃ viṣṇumanantaṃ majamavyayaṃ || 2 || nārāyaṇaṃ gadādhyakṣaṃ goviṃdaṃ kīrttabhājanam (!) || govarddhanaṃ dharaṃ(!) devaṃ bhūdharaṃ bhuvaneśvaraṃ || 3 || vetāraṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ yajñeśaṃ yajñavāhanaṃ || cakrapāṇiṃ gadāpāṇiṃ śaṃkhapāṇi narottamaṃ || 4 || (exp.2a1:b1) End iśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtasamaprabhu || (!) iti nāmaśatadivyaṃ (!) vaiṣṇavo khalupāpahaṃ || 12 || vyāsena kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvapāpa praṇasanaṃ || ya (!) paṭhet prātarutthāya saṃ(!) bhavet vaiṣṇavo naraḥ || 13 || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā viṣṇusāyojyamāpnuyāt(!) || cāndrāyaṇI (!) sahasreṇa kanyādānasatāni ca || 14 || gavālakṣaṇa (!) sahasrāṇi muktibhāgi bhave (!) naraḥ || aśvamedhāyutaṃ puṇyaṃ phalaṃ (!) prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 15 || (exp.3b1:4a1) Colophon iti śrīviṣṇupurāṇe divyaśatanāmaḥ (!) stotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śubham ||<ref name="ftn2"> covered with red ink and illigible / from orogonal book </ref> (exp.4a:1–2)

«Text:» oṃ japākuśma (!) saṃkāśam kāśyapeyaṃ mahādvitim (!) || tamoriṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ praṇatosmi divākaraṃ || 1 || dadhi śaṃkhatukhārābhaṃ(!) chirodā(!)rṇavasaṃbhavam || namāmi satataṃ somaṃ śambhormukuṭadhāriṇīṃ || 2 || dharannyā (!) garbhasaṃbhūtaṃ viduttejasamaprabhuṃ (!) || kumāraṃ śaktihastaṃ ca maṅgalaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 3 || priyaṃgukalikāśyāmaṃ rūpeṇa pratimaṃ himam || saumyaṃ saumyaguṇopetaṃ namāmi śaśinaḥ sutam || 4 || devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca guruṃ kāṃcana saṃnibhaṃ | vadhu(!)bhūtaṃ trilokeśaṃ praṇamāmi bṛhasppatim || 5 || hemakuṃḍaṃ mṛḍā[[lā]]bhaṃ daityānāṃ paramaṃ guruṃ || śarvaśśāstrapravaktāraṃ bhārgavaṃ | praṇamāmyaham || 6 || nīlāṃjanasamākāraṃ raviputraṃ māhādvi(!)tim || chāyāmārta⟪n⟩yṇḍa saṃbhūtaṃ praṇamāmi śanaiścaraṃ || 7 || arddhakāyaṃ mahāvīryaṃ candrādityavimarddanaṃ || siṃhīkāgarbhasaṃbhūtaṃ taṃ rāhuṃ praṇāmāmyaham || 8 || parāladhūmaśaṃkāśaṃ (!) tārāgraha vimarddanaṃ || raudraṃ raudrātmakaṃ ghoraṃ taṃ ketuṃ praṇamāmyaham ||9 || iti vyāsamukhodbhūtaṃ ye paṭhaṃti samāhitā(!) || divā vā yadi vā rātrau śāntis teṣāṃ prajāyate || aiśvaryamatulaṃ caiva ājñapuṣṭi(!) [[vi]]varddhanam || naranārī nṛpāṇāṃ ca bhave(d) duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ || graha nakṣatra pīḍāś ca taskarāgni samudbhavā (!) || tāḥ sarvā praśamaṃ yānti vyāso brūte na śaṃsayaḥ | iti vyāsakṛtaṃ navagrahastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || || (exp. 4a2:5b:5)

Beginning anena nālāyana yā nāma kayā o asvasyāyamāna stuti yāla || 25 | pāṇḍava uvāca || nāpa padāmi na śuneti na vintayāmi nānyasmalāmi bhajāni na vā śrayāni ya kalvadiyacalanadvaya mādalene śrī śrīnīvāsa puluṣottarmadoḍhidāsyaṃ || || he śrī śrīnivāsa he pūlukhotma || || dāna julasā mevayā nāmo makāyāḥ me vayāḥ me vayā sya go mayāṅa mevayā āsā mayāṅā chalavorayā pāli nipāyā cela juya dhakaṃ ji mana (exp.4:1–7) End śrīiśvala uvāca || śrīkṛṣṇanālāyanaḥ tyakā puyā kalva śatataṃ gaṅgām [sa]rvva tīthekhū snātāḥ bhavati nityamā || || upāsarkarmma śataddhi || || yāṅā puvvana gaṅgā[na]di dako tīrthaḥ asnāna yāṅā punyaḥ yukhe nālāyana 2 ḍhakaḥ thvate nālāyanayāḥ nāma kāyānaḥ thvate punya dava ḍhakaṃḥ śrīmahādevana śrīkṛṣṇayā thāsaḥ ājñādayakasya vijyāka || 40 || śrīpārvvati uvāca || || tateka gaṃgāḥ jamunā yaḥ ca gvadāvali tatra salasvatiś caḥ sarvvāni tirtha[ā]niḥ vasaṭi tatra jatrācyuṭo dālakathā prasaṃga || || gugulithāyasaḥ śrīnārāyaṇayā || || kathā kaṅā coṅā u gulithāḥ gaṃgā jamuṇā gvadāvaliḥ sarasvatiḥ ādi nadi ko tīrtha a āju ma va dako tirtha a… (exp. 3b:6,6:7) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || iha lhalu sakalokahitāvatāro bhagavān mahāviṣṇur bhūvanitayābhyasrthito bhūbhāraparijihīrṣayā yadukule kilāvatīrṇaḥ sanakādimunijanairanudinamanigīyamānasaccarito bhagavān nandaveśmani vijahāra | tameva vihāramaṣṭabhiślokaiḥ satyamityādibhiḥ upavarṇayan bhagavatpūjyapādamunir nirastasamastaviśeṣaṃ saccidānandādvayaṃ paramātmānaṃ abhiṣṭauti | satyam iti | (fol. 1v1–4) satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ nityamanākāśaṃ paramākāśaṃ goṣṭhaprāṅgaṇariṅgaṇalolamāyāsaṃ paramāyāam māyākalpitanānākāramanākāraṃ bhuvanākāraṃ kṣmāmānāthamanāthaṃ praṇamata govindaṃ paramānandaṃ || 1 || (fol. 2r8:2v8) End goviṃdāṣṭakametadadhīte govindārpita cetā yo govindānyuta mādhavaviṣṇo gokulanāyakakṛṣṇeti drarvidāṅghri sarojadhyānaśuddhvā jaladhautasam astāghogovindaṃ paramānandāmṛtamantastha samabhyeti (fol. 8r5–7) Colophon iti govindāṣṭakamṃ || govindāṣṭakānandagirīyaṃ | śrī || rāma || rāma | rāma |(fol. 8r7,9)

«Text:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || kecitsvadehāntar hṛdayāvakāse prādeśamātraṃ puruṣamvasantam | caturbhujaṃ kañjarathāṅga saṅkha gadādharan dhāraṇayā smarāmi || 1 || prasannavaktraṃ [[na]]līnāyatekṣaṇaṃ (!) kadambakiṃjalkapisaṃgavāsasam || lasan mahāratnahiranmayāṃ (!)gadas phuran mahāratnakirīṭakuṇḍalam || 2 || un hṛdrarityamkajakarṇikālayet (!) yogeśvarāsthāpita pādapallavam || śrīlakṣmaṇam kaustubharatnakaṃdharaṃ amlānalakṣmā vanamālayācitam || 3 || vibhūṣitāmmekhalayāṃgulīyakair mahādhanair nupura kamkaṇādiviḥ (!) || snigdhāmalākuñcita nīlakuntalai vircamānāna (!) hāsapesalam || 4 || adīnalīlā hasidekṣaṇollasat bhūbhaṃga saṃśucibhuryanugraham || (!) ikṣetacintāmaya me na miśvaraṃ (!) yāvanmanodhāraṇa yāvasiṣṭate || 5 || ekaikaśogāni (!) dhiyānubhāvaet pādādipāladhasitaṃ gadābhṛtaḥ || (!) jitaṃ jitaṃ sthānamayo svadhārayet paraṃ paraṃ sudhati (!) dhīryathā yathā || 6 || yāvannajāṃmeta (!) parāvaresmin vīsveśvare (!) draṣṭari bhaktiyogaḥ || yāvatsavīyaḥ puruṣasya rūpaṃ kṛyāvasāne prayata (!) smaretat (!) || 7 || iti njārāyaṇastotraṃ śubhaṃ || iti nārāyaṇastotram śubham 1947 (fol.1–4)

«Text:» ❖ oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || naraṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ naranāthamacyutaṃ pralambabāhuṃ kamalāyatekṣaṇaṃ | kṣitīśvarairarcitapādapaṅkajaṃ namāmi viṣṇuṃ puruṣaṃ purātanam || 1 || jagatpatiṃ kṣīrasamudramandiraṃ rathāṅgapāṇi(!) munivṛndavanditaṃ | śriyaḥ patiṃ śrīdharamacyutaṃ prabhuṃ namāmi govinda manantavarccasaṃ || 2 || ajaṃ vareṇyaṃ jaraduḥkhanāsanaṃ guruṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣottamaṃ prabhuṃ | sahasrasūryadyutimacyutaṃ tanuṃ namāmi bhaktyā harimadya mādhavaṃ || 3 || puruṣṇutaṃ(!) puṇyavatāṃ parāṅgatiṃ kṣiterddharaṃ(!) lokadharaṃ prajāpatiṃ | (!) paraṃparāṇāmapi kāraṇaṃ hariṃ namāmi lokatrayakarmmasākṣiṇaṃ || 4 || bhogetyanantasya payonidhau mudā purā hi śete bhagavānanādikṛt | kṣīrodavīcī kalikāmbunākṣitaṃ taṃ śrīnivāsaṃ praṇamāmi keśavaṃ || 5 || yo nārasiṃhaṃ vapurāsthito mahān purā murārir mmadhukaiṭabhāntaka | samastalokārttiharaṃ hiraṇyakaṃ jaghāna viṣṇuṃ satataṃ namāmi taṃ || 6 || anantamavyaktamatīndriyaṃ prabhu sparśādinīlādivihīnamekaṃ | yasyedṛśīśasya hareḥ svarūpaṃ vadanti tajñāḥ praṇamāmi taṃ hariṃ || 7 || ānandamekaṃ tvajaraṃ vidātmakaṃ hṛdālayaṃ yogibhireva pūjitaṃ | aṇoraṇīyān mamabuddhisakṣayaṃ namāmi bhaktaṃ priyamāśva(!) hariṃ || 8 || iti śrīnārasiṃhapurāṇe nārāyaṇastotraṃ samāptam iti || || (fol.1–2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāye (!) namaḥ hari oṃ-m asya śrīnāyaṇahṛdayastotramaṃtrasya brahmāṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇo devatā śrīlakṣmīnāyaṇaprasādasiddhyarthaṃ jape viniyogaḥ ath nyāsaḥ nārāyaṇa paraṃ jyotir iti aṃguṣṭhābhyām namaḥ nārāyaṇāparaṃ bhrahmeti tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ nārāyaṇa parodeva iti madhyamābhyām namaḥ nārāyaṇaparaṃ dhāmeti anāmikāº nārāyaṇaparodharma iti kaniṣṭhikābhyām namaḥ viśvaṃ nārāyaṇāyeti karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ (fol. 1–1:2r3) End iti guhyatamaṃ śāstraṃ prātpaṃ(!) brahmādikaiḥ purā tasmāt sarvaprayatnena gopayet sādhayet sudhīḥ 28 yatraitat pustakaṃ tiṣṭhellakṣmīnārāyaṇātmakaṃ bhūtapaiśācavetālaṃ na sthiraṃ tatra sarvathā 29 lakṣmṛdayaproktena vidhinā sādhayetsudhīḥ bhṛguvārepi rātrauca pūjayet pustakaṃ (!) dvayaṃ 30 sarvadā sarvadā nityaṃ gopayetsādhayetsudhī gopanāt sādhanālloke dhanyo bhavati tatvataḥ (!) 31 (fol. 9v4–10v4) Colophon iti atharvaṇa rahasye uttarakāṃḍe nārāyaṇahṛdayastotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ ❁ mārgaśirṣa śukla 3 bhṛgudine saṃvat 1927 mīrajāpura viṃdhakṣetre gaṃgātīre jānakīrāme (!) likhitaṃ śrīrāmaprītyarthaṃ śubhaṃ bhavatu ❁ śrīlakṣmīnārāyanāprasadāstu ❁ pustakamidaṃ śrīkṛṣṇa jośī (fol.10v4:11r6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ mkaṃḍeya uvāca || || evaṃ yuddhamabhūd ghoraṃ raudraṃ daityabalaiḥ saha || nṛsiṃhasyāṃga saṃbhūtai nārasiṃhair anekaśaḥ || 1 || daityakoṭihatās tatra kecid bhītāḥ palāyitāḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvātīvasaṃkruddho hiraṇyakaśyapuḥ svayam || 2 || bhūtapūrvairamṛtyur me iti brahmavaroddhataḥ || vavarṣaśaravarṣeṇa nārasiṃhaṃ bhṛśaṃ balī || 3 || dvaṃdvayuddhamabhūd ugraṃ divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam || daityendrasāhasaṃ dṛṣṭvā devaścendra purogamāḥ || 4 || śreyaḥ kasya bhavedatra iti cintā parā bhavan || tadā kruddho nṛsiṃhastu daityendra prahitānyapi || 5 || viṣṇucakraṃ mahācakraṃ kālacakraṃ tu vaiṣṇavam || raudraṃ pāśupataṃ brāhmaṃ kauberaṃ kuliśānilam || 6 || āgneyaṃ bāruṇaṃ saumyaṃ mohanaṃ saura pārvatam || mārgavādi bahūnyastrāṇyabhakṣayata kopanaḥ || 7 || (fol. 1v1–7) End yadihāsti tadanyatra yannehāsti na tat kvacit || kathitaṃ te nṛsiṃhasya caritaṃ pāpanāśanam || 238 || sarvamaṃtramayaṃ tāpatrayopaśanaṃ param || sarvārthasādhanaṃ divyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi || śrīnṛsiṃhaṃ mahāvīryaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 239 || saṃsārasāgara samuddharaṇaika maṃtraṃ brahmādidevasurapūjita siddhamaṃtram || dāridryaduḥkhabhayaśokavināśamaṃtraṃ vandemahābhayaharaṃ narasiṃhamaṃtram || 240 || || ❁ || || (fol.17v6:18r3) Colophon iti śrīmadbrahmāṇḍapurāṇe śrī nṛsiṃhaprakṛtibhāve sarvārthasādhanaṃ nāma śrīmaddivy nṛsiṃhasahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || || ❁ || || śrīnṛsiṃhāya namonamaḥ satatam || || śubham bhavatu || || navajaladhimahībhṛdavanimite 1749 śālivāhanaśake bhādrakṛṣṇa paṃcamyāṃ ravivāsare likhitamidaṃ pustakaṃ śarvarīramaṇa śarmaṇā kāntipuryām śubhaṃ bhavatu lekhakapāṭhayoḥ (!) || || śubham || || (fol.18r47)

«Text:» ❖ namaḥ paramātmane || sthānaṃ namānaṃ na ca nādabinduṃ rūpaṃ na rekhaṃ na ca dhātuvarṇṇaṃ | na dṛṣṭi na dṛṣṭā (!) śrutī na śrutvā (!) tasmai namo deva nirañjanāya || 1 || (!) svetaṃ (!) na pītaṃ na raktaṃ na retaṃ hemaṃ na rūpyaṃ na ca varṇṇa varṇṇaṃ | candrārkavahniṃ udayo na astaṃ tasmai namo deva nirañjanāya || 2 || (!) arddhaṃ na urddhaṃ na śivaṃ na śaktiṃ nārī na pusāṃ (!) na ca liṅgamūrti | brahmā na indro na devarudro tasmai namo deva nirañjanāya || 3 || (!) vṛkṣaṃ na mūlaṃ na ca bīja aṃkulaṃ (!) śākhā na patraṃ na belapallavam | puṣpaṃ na gandhaṃ na phalaṃ na chāyā tasmai namo deva nirañjanāya || 4 || brahmāṇḍakhaṇdaṃ na ca indra daṇḍaṃ kālopi jībo na guruṃ na śiṣyaṃ grahaṃ na tārā na ca meghajvālā tasmai namo deva nirañjanāya || 5 || vedaṃ na śāstraṃ na saṃdhyā na saucaṃ (!) maṃtraṃ na jāpaṃ na ca dhyāna dharanaṃ (!) | homaṃ na yajñaṃ na ca devaujā tasmai namo deva nirañjanāya || 6 || gambhīradhīraṃ sa nirvvānasūnyaṃ (!) saṃsārasāraṃ na ca pāpapuṇyaṃ | vyaktī na vyaktā na ca bhāvabhinnaṃ sā devadeva mama cittalīnaṃ || 7 || na sāgare paṃkajañca na grāme kṣetrameva ca | jātī na kulaṃ na ca bheda bhedaṃ pṛthaklena pṛthaktvehaṃ na stvaṃ na tasmai namo deva nirañjanāya || 8 || (!) iti śrī śaṅkarācāryaviracitaṃ niraṃjanāṣṭakaṃ samāptaṃ || || (exp. 1–2)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīgurugaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrī 3 viparitapratyagirāya (!) namaḥ || oṃ asya śrīviparītapratyaṃgirāmaṃtrasya śrībhairava ṛṣiranustapū (!) chaṃndaṃḥ (!) śrīpratyaṃgirādevatā astottaraśatan[ā]maḥ (!) maṃtrosyāsya prakīrttiṃtāḥ || sarvaiḥ kṛṣṇapacāraiś ca dhyāyat preḥ praṃgirāṃ śubhāṃḥ (!) ṭatkaṃ (!) kapāla ḍamarutriśūlaṃ sa bibhrati candrakalāvataṃsā pigo (!) rddhakeśi (!) sita bhīmadraṃṣṭrā | bhujāddhibhuto mamaṃ (!) bhadrakāliḥ || evaṃ dhyātvā japet matram ekaṃviśati (!) vāsaraṃḥ (!) || śatruṇāṃ tāsanaṃ jya tatḥ (!) prakāśo ya suniścitaṃ || 1 || astabhyāṃ (!) maddharātri tu śaratkāre mahāniḥ śiḥ (!) ārātāce māhākāli tatkṣaṇā (!) siddhiḍā bhavet || 2 || (!) sarvopacāra saṃpan va vastara (!) staratnaphalādibhiḥ || puṣpaiśca kṛṣṇavarṇe ska (!) sādhayet kālikāṃ parā || 3 || (exp. 2b1:3a5) End virūpaṃkaṃ kārayiṣyatiḥ (!) vā abhūmodayatiḥ vākaḥ (!) karmarṇā (!) manasā vācā ye devāsuvāra (!) rākṣasāḥ ||19 || (!) triryyak pratavahisakāvirupakaṃ kurvati || mamaṃtra jantra yaṃtra viṣacurṇa sarvaprayogādi nāmātmahaste tavāṃya || 20 || karoti kariṣyati kārayiṣyati ḥ vātāt sacānyeṣāṃ vivarttitvāyatani mastake || 21 || (exp. 4b6:5a3) Colophon īti (!) śrīmāhābhairavataṃtre viparita (!) pratyaṃgirā samāpat (!) || oṃ namaḥ kṣuṃ bhaṃ kṣaṃ jvaṃ lvāṃ jiṃ hriṃ kaṃ lāṃ raṃ drasta(!) pratyaṃgire kṣaṃ hrīṃ huṃ phaṭ || || || saṃkalpa || amukanāma samohaṃ (!) mamā (!) sarvārista (!) sāmti śatrupadravasapūrvakaśatrukṣayaṃ kāmanāyāṃ viparita(!) pratyaṃgirā japamahaṃ kariṣya || ḥ || ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ (exp. 5a3:5b1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama (!) || śrībaṭūkabhairavebho (!) namaḥ || devy uvāca || bhagavan sarva[ta]tvajña devānāṃ priyakārakaṃ || bhairavaṃ kavacaṃ brūhiḥ yadi cāstīkṛpā mayi || prānatyāgaṃ(!) kariṣyāmi yadi no kathyase vit vame (!) || saṃte(!) satyaṃ puṇa(!) satyaṃḥ(!) satyam meva na saṃśaya ||(!) īti(!) daityā(!) vacaḥ śrutvāḥ vihasan parameśvara || (!) bhairavaṃ kavaca prāha catuvarggaphalapradaṃ (!) || śrī īśvarruvācaḥ (!) || kavacaṃ baṭukakhyasya śṛṇu mat prānavallabhe || caṃdrikātaṃtrasarvvasvaṃḥ (!) baṭūko yaṃ visyaṣata (!) || tatra maṃtrādyakṣarantuḥ vāsudevasvarūpaka || varṇya dvitiyo brahmaiva baṭukaścadraśe ʼṣara (!) || caturvvargasya siddhyarthaḥ āpaduddhāraṇāya ca || kuru dvayaṃ mahaśāniḥ (!) mohanaṃ parikīrttita (!) vatukāya maheśāniḥ (!) bhuvanaṃ parikīrttitam || lajjābījaṃ mahāvidyā muktidā parikīrttitā || 1 || (exp.5b2:6a5) End īdaṃ kavacamajñatvāḥ(!) yo jaṭodvaṭukaṃ ṇara (!) || || na prāpnoti phalaṃ syāsyaḥ paramaṃ dukhamāpnuyāt (!) || manvantaratrayaṃ sthitvāḥ tiryyagyoniṣu jāyate || || īha loke mahārōgīḥ drāridryeṇāti piḍitaḥ || śatruṇāṃ vaśago bhutvāḥ karapātraṃ bhaveṃ naraḥ || yaḥ parikṣya pradātā vaiḥ sāstiddhi (!) labhate naraḥ || āyur ścityā yaśo dharmmaṃḥ varaṃ mokṣa na saṃśayaḥ || || (exp.7b5:8a1) Colophon īti śrībaṭukabhairavakavacaṃ saptaṃḥ (!) || || (exp.8a2)

Beginning śrīīśvaruvāca (!) || merupṛṣṭe sukhāsinaṃ (!) devadeva maheśvaraṛḥ|| śaṃkaraṃ paripapracchaḥ Pārvvatīvāca bhagavān sarvvadharmajñaḥ sarvvśāstrāgamādiḥ (!) || āpaduddhārakaṃ mantraṃ sarvvasi[ddhi] pradaṃ nṛṇāṃ || sarvveṣā[ñ] caiva bhutānām (!) hitoyaṃ vāṃchito mayā || saviśeṣa rājā vaiḥ śānti puṣṭi vivarddhanaṃ || aṃganyāsaḥ karanyarasaḥ (!) deda(!) nyāsa ḥ samaṃvitaṃḥ (!) || vaktumarhasi deveśa mama harṣa vivarddhanaṃ || (exp. 8a2–7) End nigadaiścāpi (!) vaddho yaḥ kārāmgṛhaḥ (!) nipātitaḥ || śṛṅvalālābandhanaṃ prāpta paṭhecaiva divāniśiṃ || mayaṃ(!) kāmayate kāmaṃḥ paṭhet stotramanuttamaṃ | taṃ taṃ kāmamavāpnoti sādhakātra saṃśaya || (!) aprakāsya paraṃguhyaṃḥ nadeyayaṃ yasyakasyacit || satkulīnāya śāṃtāya ṛjave dambhavarjite || dadyāstotramidam (!) puṇyaṃ sarvvakāmaphalapradaṃḥ || evaṃ śrutvā tato devī nāmāṣtaśatam uttamam | | santoṣaṃ pa[ra]maṃ prāpya bhairavasya mahātmana || yayā ca parayā bhaktyāḥ sadā sarvveśvareśvari || bhairavasya prasannobhuta yasvayaṃ ca maheśvaraḥ || (!) (exp. 15a9:15b8) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmaleḥ (!) amṛtasāroddhāreḥ (!) āpadudhārastotraṃ (!) samāṃptaḥ (!) || saṃva[[t]] 1928 sāla miti śrāvanaśudi 4 roja 6 śubhm leṣaka rūpanarān nāṃcākṣa (!) śubhmaṃ (exp. 15b8:16a2)

Beginning śrīgaṇēśāya nama (!) || prāta astute (!) || jayaḥ ekadaṃtaṃ gajiṃdrarupa siṃdūradhuridhatisuladaṃsaṃḥ (!) saṃsāraddhi (!) karaṇāyaḥ bhavasāgaraṃ ca umāsutaṃ gaṇapatiḥ jayatu jayastu te mama suprabhātaṃ || 1 || ādi te devaahāsurjyā munitaṃḥ pitāmahesa śivahari jayaviṣṇumurti || ṇikatatra pāṃ sakala ṇāthaḥ gaṇeśarūpaṃ chaprati jayati jaya namostu te mama su prabhāte || 2 || (!) bhīrguvandisṛjemadagni paulastyara garagapārāsaḥ varakṣāṣigautumakā sipta ca dvapāyaṛṣi madhye surajagapā kalayā brahmāsuta jayati jaya namostu te mama suprabhāte || 3 || (exp. 22a1–22b3) End raviṃdava jayadevaḥ ṇisākareṇaḥ pṛthivisuto buddhagaru bhṛiguṇandaṇe (!) || śaniscaraṇeḥ navagra sāmti (!) jayatu jaya namastu te mama prabhāte || 8 || manohāriḥ jaya jānakiḥ pāravatiḥ ca pacālikāḥ surabhimā kuṃtimāca ahalyāḥ tārāḥ satī jaya jānaki pārvati ca pacālikā surabhimā ca jaya viṣṇupriya jayati jaya namostu te mama suprabhāte || 9 || (exp. 23b1–6) Colophon iti gaṇeśastotra saṃpurṇa samāpat (!) śubhmaṃ (!) 28 sāla śrāvana śudi 14 roja 1 śbhm (exp. 23b6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ yakṣarūpaṃ dasadisi (!) vasitaṃ bhumikaṃpāyamānaṃḥ (!) saṃ saṃ saṃ saṃhāramūrti siramukuṭajaṭāśeṣaraṃ candrabimbaḥ daṃ daṃ daṃ dādyakāya vimalanaṣamukhaṃ ūrddhvaromakarālaṃḥ (!) paṃ paṃ pāpanāśaṃ praṇamatu satataṃ bhairavaṃ kṣatrapālaṃḥ (!) raṃ raṃ raṃ raktavarṇaṃ kaṭakaṭitaṭanuti kṣāṃ daṃṣṭā (!) karālaṃḥ (!) ghaṃ ghaṃ ghaṃ ghoraghoṣaṃ ghaghaghaghaghatiṭaṃ ghargharaṃ ghoranādaṃ kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ kālapāsaṃ(!) dhṛka dhṛka dhṛkiṭa ṃ jvālitaṃ kāmadahmaṃḥ (!) taṃ taṃ taṃ divyadehaṃ pranamataḥº (exp. 26b1:27a1) End kvākāsaṃḥ ko samīraṇaṃḥ kva dahaṇaḥ kvāpaḥ kva viśvaṃbharaṃ kva brahmā kva viṣṇuḥ kva īndaḥ kva janārddanaḥ kva taruni kva duḥ kva devāḥ kva surauḥ || kaleṃtāramatinata pramudita śrīsidhajogeśvaraiḥ kriḍānāṭhaka nāyaḥko vijayatya devo mahābhairavaṃḥ ityavaṃ (!) bhāvayuktaṃ paṃṭati (!) jogino nityeśaṃ bhairavaṃ syāstakaṃḥ (!) yonirvighanaṃ dustaḥ nāsaṃḥ asuraḥ bhayaharaṃḥ ḍākinī śākināṃ || 11 || (!) (exp. 28b5–29a4) Colophon īti śrīmat saṃkarācārjya vilacitaṃ (!) bhairava ustakaṃ saṃpurna samāpataṃ śubhmaṃ || ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ (exp. 29a5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ oṃ namo hanumaṃtāyaḥ (!) pavaṃdanātmajāya namah || oṃ asaya śrīpaṃcamuṣa hanumānaḥ maṃtrasya brahmā ṛṣi gāyatrī chanda || paṃcamukha vida ṛṣiḥ hanumāna devatā hrīṃ bijaṃ śrīśakatiḥ (!) kau kilakaṃ kuṃ kavaca hrau astrāya phaṭa || (!) īti digbaṃdha || (!) śrī īśvara uvācaḥ || (!) atha dhyānaṃḥ pravakṣāmi sṛrnu (!) sarvāṃga sudariḥ || yatkṛtadevaḥ (!) devesi dhyānaṃ hanumanta (!) priyaṃ || (exp. 29b1–6) End bhutapreṭa piśāca brahmarākṣasa śāṃkiḍākinī antarikṣa grahaparayaṃtra parataṃtra sarvagraha uvāthanāya (!) sakalasatru saṃhāraṇāya paṃcamūṣi hanumāna sakalavasye (!) karanayaḥ sakalaloka paranāyaḥ paṃcamūṣi hanumāna varaprasādakāya māhāsarvarakṣakāya jaṃ jaṃ jaṃ jaṃ jaṃ svāhāḥ || idaṃ kavacaṃ paṭhitvā tu mahākavacaṃ paṭhennaraḥ || aikavāraṃ paṭheta stotraṃ sarvaśatru nivāraṇaṃ ḥ || (!) dvivāraṃ tu paṭhe nityaṃ (!) putrapautrapravarddhanaṃḥ (!) tiṛvāraṃ (!) grapaṭhennityeḥ sarvalkaraśivaṃ caturvāraṃ paṭhennityeṃḥ (!) sarvaroganivāraṇaṃ paṃcavāraṃ paṭhennityeṃḥ (!) brahmāṇaṃ vaśaṃ nayeta (!) ṣaṣṭhavāraṃ paṭhenityaṃḥ sarvadevaḥ vaśīkṛtaṃ . . . kavcacaṃ smaraṇē caivaḥ (!) mahālakṣmīsamanvitaṃḥ guhyātiguhyagotā tvam gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ ca yataḥ || (exp. 34a6:2a5) Colophon iti śrīrāmacandrayoktaṃ (!) paṃcamūkhī hanumamta kavacaṃ sampūrṇa śubhmaṃ (!) ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ (exp. 2a6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama (!) || oṃ siddhilakṣmī nama (!) || atha karaṃganyāsa || oṃ hrāṃ śrāṃ krāṃ hinyāyo aguṣṭābhyāṃ namaḥ hrāṃ śrkrīṃ kriṃ haṃ ṇI tarjanibhyāṃ (!) namaḥ || oṃ hruṃ śruṃ kruṃ suvarṇarataskatita śrījāyo madyemābhyāṃ (!) namaḥ oṃ hraiṃ śraiṃ kraiṃ candrāyo anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ hrauṃ śrauṃ krauṃ hiraṃnyāyo kaṇiṣṭātikāhyāṃ (!) namaḥ oṃ hraṃ śraṃ kraṃḥ karatalapṛṣṭābhyāṃ nama || yaṃ vaṃ eṃ hirdayādiḥ . . . īti (!) śrīsūkta japetḥ || (!) oṃ hiraṇyavarṇā hariṇīṃ suvarṇa rajita (!) sṛjāṃḥ (!) caṃdrāṃ hiraṇmayīlakṣmīṃ jātavedo mamāvaha || 1 || (exp. 16a3–17b3) End lakṣmīpriya sakhīdevīḥ namomucyatavallabhāṃ || dhanurddharāya vidmahe sarvvasiddhī ca dhīmahiḥ || tanno dharā pracodayāt || sarvvasakti samudra te saṃkhavarṇa mahitaleḥ (!) || anekaratna saṃbhute bhumidevi namostu te ḥ || 35 || syātmā vicitrā navaratnabhuṣaṇāṃ payodharāṃ tugapayodharāṃnvitāṃḥ (!) īṃdīvarākṣmīṃ navaśāriyaṃjari (!) śukadadhānāṃ bhavadāṃ bhajāmahe || ikṣuśāliphalasasya samṛdriyārij (!) satataḥ ruśyobhi[ta]mule suvarnaratna mati maṃṭaca madhye cintayat sakalalokadhariṃtrī || (!) kāyan vācā manuseṃdrī yogāḥ (!) buddhyātmano vā prakṛti svabhāt || karomi yaṃdmat (!) sakalaṃ parasmai śrīmaṃnnārṇāyeti samarpayāmi || (exp. 21a6–21b7) Colophon śubhmaṃ samvat 1928 sāla śrāvana sudi 11 roja 6 subhmaṃ (exp. 21b7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namo || brahmauvāca (!) || aṇekamatrakoṭiśa nṛsiṃhanāmamācaret || anyo vidhi rakṣāṃtiḥ viṣarogādi nivāraṇa || oṃ asya śrīlakṣmīḥ nasiṃ (!) kavacaṃ brahmā ṛṣiraḥ raḥ nuṣṭaprachandaḥ (!) śrīnaraha (!) devatāḥ mama sasarvarogānāṃ devadoṣānāṃḥ caurapatraḥ gavyāghra viścika (!) bhutaḥ preta piśācikaḥ ḍāṃkiniḥ śāṃkiniḥ aṇekanivāranārtheḥ (!) jape vinijogaḥ (!) | oṃ kṣauṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyaṃ nama oṃ praum tarjanibhyaṃ namaḥḥ oṃ brauṃ maṃdhemābhyāṃ (!) nama oṃ sauṃ anāmikābhyām namaḥ oṃ vrauṃ kaṇiṣṭhikābhyāṃ (!) nama oṃ jauṃ karatala 2 pṛṣṭābhyāṃ nama oṃ kṣauṃ hṛdayāya nama oṃ prauṃ silasya svāhā oṃ hrauṃ siṣāya vauṣaṭ oṃ rauṃ kavacāya huṃ oṃ brauṃ ṇetra trayāyā vauṣaṭaḥ (!) oṃ jrauṃ astāya phaṭaḥ jauṃ au hrauṃ namaḥ || atha dhyānaḥ (!) (exp. 24a1–25a1) End oṃ jrīṃ hrīṃ nṛsiṃhāya namaḥ oṃ nama nṛsiṃhāya kapilajaḥ jatāyaḥ (!) amoghavācāḥ satvaṃḥ suvrataṃḥ mahāugrarūpāyaḥ oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrauṃ phaṭa svāhāḥ (!) || sarvarogāṇāṃ baṃdha baṃdhaḥ sarvacaurāṇāṃ baṃdha baṃdha sarvagrahānāṃ baṃdha 2 sarvadevadoṣānāṃ baṃdha 2 sarva viścikānāṃ baṃdha 2 sarva vyāgrānāṃ (!) baṃdha 2 sarvabhutapraṭa pisācikaḥ ḍāṃkiniḥ sāṃkiniḥ yatra maṃtraḥ baṃdha baṃdhaya kilaya kilayaḥ marddaya (ma)rddaḥ curṇaya curṇaya curṇayaḥ (!) yama u virodhitāyāṃḥ(!) sarvaviṣaharaṇaṃḥ dahadahaḥ mathamathaḥ pacapacaḥ gadā cakreṇa vajreṇaḥ bhasmī kurukuru svāhā oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hruṃ phaṭa svāhāḥ (exp. 25b3–26a6) Colophon iti śrī nṛsiṃhapurāṇe brahmāsāvitri saṃvāde nṛsiṃha kavacaṃ samāpat śubhmaṃ (!) || ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ (exp. 26a6–7)

Beginning . . . vyaktāvyaktanirūpitaṃ ca paramaṃ ṣaḍviṃśatatvādikaṃ tasmāduttamatatvamakṣaramiti dheyaṃ sadā yogibhiḥ || oṃkārādisamastamantrajanitaṃ sūkṣṃātisūkṣmaṃ paraṃ vande pañcamamīśvarasyavadanaṃ ca vyāpitenāmayam || (fol. 5r3) End etāni pañcavadanāni maheśvarasya ye kīrttayanti manujā satataṃ prabhāte gacchanti te śivapadaṃ rucirairvimānaiḥ krīḍanti śaṃkaragaṇaiḥ satataṃ śivāgre || 6 || (fol. 5r3) Colophon iti śrīpañnavaktaśivastotraṃ || || śubham || (fol. 6r1–3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || oṃ śrīnāthādi gurutrayaṃ gaṇapatiṃ pīṭhatrayaṃ bhairavaṃ siddhebhyo baṭukatrayaṃ padayugaṃ dūtikramaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ | vīreṣṭa catuṣṭaṃ ṣaṣṭhi navakaṃ vīrāvalīva paṃcūkaṃ (!) śrīmanmālinī mantrarājasahitaṃ vaṃde gurormmaṇḍalaṃ || || śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrī śāradāyaiḥ namaḥ || anekaśaktisaṃghaṭṭaprakāśaraharīghana | śuddhasaccinmayaḥ pāyā śrīśaṃbhuḥ parameśvaraḥ || śrīśaṃbho te mahimnastutipathabharitāḥ sāgravedāḥ saśāstrāḥ siddhāntāḥ saṃgavidyā sacakitagatayo naiva paśyanti pāraṃ | sādyāntāstvāmanantaṃ paramaśivaguruṃ te kathaṃ varṇayeyu stasmā (!) prajñānusārādahamapibhavatastaumi kiñcic caritraṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–5) Sub-Colophon iti prathama prakaraṇaṃ || || (fol. 3v7) iti bhāraśmiprakaraṇaṃ || || (fol. 4v1) iti parāskamdharaśmi prakaraṇaṃ || || (fol. 4v6) iti icchāśakti skarasmi (!) prakaraṇaṃ || || (fol. 5v7) iti jñānaśakti prakaraṇaṃ caturthaḥ || || (fol. 6v4–5) End vaṇṇatvādhātavaḥ syur vvividha padacayastad bhavastena vākyaṃ tasmājjātaṃ pramānaṃ (!) vivinigamanaṃ tena siddhāntajālaṃ | tatasmān nānātmatva prakaṭitam iti yā śalyavidyā ) tvadīyā tvaṃ cedeko dvitīya pramarahitamahā saṃvidātmā maheśa (!) || 47 || yajñāsthānaṃ smaśānaṃ sakalamitigṛhaṃ bhāsvadoṃkārapīṭhaṃ prā(durbhūte) yāgasthalamiti vipulaṃ kalpakṣāḍhirūḍhai | saṃvītaṃ bhairavauścoragapatigaṇapaistatra divyārghapātraṃ vahnibrahmendu kliptaṃ parasi + sakalaṃ vyasta vasvātmanā+|| 48 || cit pūjādi kriyātmā gurukathitamahā rudramūrttiśrayaṃtā dātmīyairaṃśudevai radhigatavidhayā + + + kutirnnivvikalpani . . . . (fol. 7v3–7)

«Text:» ❖ oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || umāṃgaṃgajakarṇavaktraṃ gaṇeśaṃ bhujākaṃkanaṃ (!) śobhitaṃ dhūmaketuṃ || gale hārayuktā phalāśobhayataṃ (!) namo jñānarūpaṃ gaṇeśaṃ namaste || 1 || gaṇeśaiyakadaṃtaṃ (!) subhaṃ sarvvakāryyaṃ smaraṃ ṣāṇmukhaṃ jñanadaṃ (!) sarvvasiddhi || manaścititaṃ (!) kāryasiddhiṃ bhavantaṃ namo buddhikātaṃ (!) gaṇeśaṃ namaste || 2 || mahāsundaraṃ vikṛtaṃ vighnarājaṃ caturbhirttajair ekadantaika varṇaṃ || idaṃ daivarūpaṃ gaṇāsiddhināthaṃ namo bhālanetraṃ ganeśaṃ namaste || 3 || śiraḥ sindūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ dehavarṇa śubhaṃ modakaṃ prītaye vighnarājaṃ mahāśaṃkaṭaṃ cheditaṃ dhūmaketuṃ namo gauriputraṃ gaṇeśaṃ namaste || 4 || yathā dhātakacheditaṃ viṣṇunāmaṃ (!) tathā dhyāyataṃ (!) śaṃkaraṃ pāpanāśaṃ || yathā pūjitaṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ śokanāśaṃ namo vighnarājaṃ gaṇeśaṃ namaste || 5 || sadā sarvvadā dhyāyataṃ ekadaṃntaṃ sadā pūjitaṃ siṃdūraṃ raktapuṣpa (!) || sadā arccitaṃ caṃdanaṃ kuṃkumāgaṃ (!) namaḥ siddhināthaṃ gaṇeśaṃ namaste || 6 || namo gauri aṃgaṃ malotpannatubhyaṃ namo jñānarūpaṃ namaḥ siddhipatyaṃ || namo dhyāyataṃ pūjitaṃ buddhipatyaṃ namo vakratuṃḍaṃ gaṇeśaṃ namaste || 7 || bhujaṃgaprayātaṃ paṭhed yastu bhaktyā prabhāte paṭhed buddhinaikāgracittaṃ || ayaṃ yāti vighnaṃ diśeśo bhayaṃtaṃ namo jñānarūpaṃ gaṇeśaṃ namaste || 8 || iti śrīparamahaṃsaparivīrāryya śrīsaṃkarācāryya viracitaṃ śrīgaṇeśabhujaṃga saṃpūrṇa || śubhaṃ || 9 || || (exp. 3a1:3b6)

Beginning na tāto na mātā na bandhurnna dātā na putro na putrī na bhṛtyor na bharttā || na jāyā na vṛttir na vṛttir mmamaiva gatistvaṃ gatistvaṃ tvamekā bhavāni || 1 || na jānāmi dānaṃ na ca dhyāyamānaṃ na jānāmi mantraṃ na ca stotra yantraṃ || na jānāmi pūjāṃ na ca nyāsayogaṃ gatistvaṃ matistvaṃ tvamekā bhavāni || 2 || bhavābdhovapāre mahāduṣkhabhīrau prapātaḥ prakāmī pralobhī pramattaḥ kumāyā kulajjaḥ prabandhaṃ sadāhaṃ gatistvaṃ matistvaṃ tvamekā bhavāni || 3 || na jānāmi puṇyaṃ na jānāmi tīrthaṃ na jānāmi muktyālayaṃ vā kimetat || na jānāmi bhaktiṃ kṛtaṃ vāpi mātar gatistvaṃ matistvaṃ tvamekā bhavāni || 4 || prajeśaṃ rameśaṃ sureśaṃ maheśaṃ gaṇeśaṃ dineśaṃ niśeśaṃ vanaṃ vā || na jānāmi cānyaṃ sadāhaṃ bhavāni gatistvaṃ matistvaṃ tvamekā bhavāni || 5 || kukarmmi kusaṃgī kubuddhiḥ kudāsaḥ sadācārahīnaḥ kadācāralīnaḥ || kudṛṣṭiḥ kuvākyaḥ sadāhaṃ bhavāni gatistvaṃ matistvaṃ tvamekā bhavāni || 6 || vivāde viṣāde pramāde pravāse jale cānale parvvate śakramadhye (!) || araṇye śaraṇye sadāhaṃ bhavāni gatistvaṃ matstvaṃ tvamekā bhavāni || 7 || anātho daridro jarārogayukto mahākṣīna dīna sadājāḍyavaktraṃḥ (!) || vipatti praviṣṭa sadāhaṃ bhavāni gatistvaṃ matistvaṃ tvamekā bhavāni || 8 || yadiha paṭhati bhaktyā stotrametat samagraṃ sa bhavati surapuryyāṃ mānanīyo nṛpānāṃ (!) || bahukulajanabhaktā bhuktabhogī kavindraḥ sakalabhuvanamātas trāhi māṃ bho namaste || 9 || || iti śrīśaṃkarācāryyaviracitaṃ bhavānīdevyā bhujaṅgaprayātastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || pāṭhakasya śrīr astu || || || (exp. 3b6:4b7)

Beginning śrīpaśupataye namaḥ || brahmaviṣṇu ūcatuḥ || oṃ paśupate tejāya jyotiṣāṃ pataya (!) namaḥ || tejaḥstambhātmane deva īśvarāya namostu te || 1 || avyaktāya ca liṃgāya vyaktakiṃgāya bhaktināṃ || vyaktāvyaktasvarūpāya sarvveśvara namostu te || 2 || ādyāya samanādyāya antasthāya namo namaḥ || antaścarāya cāntastha vyaṃjanāya namostute || 3 || na jānantīśa ye tvāṃ śaṃtaṃ eva paśavaḥ smṛtāḥ || paśūnāṃ pataye teṣāṃ tubhyaṃ deva namostu te || 4 || kṣitirūpāya rudrāyaṃ ghrānāṃśāya (!) namonamaḥ || jalarūpāya cogrāya rasāṃsāya namo namaḥ || 5 || tejorūpāya bhargyāya cakṣuraṃsāyave namaḥ || vāyurūpāya bhīmāya śotrāṃśāya (!) namo namaḥ || 6 || vyomātītāya devāya mahāvyomāyate namaḥ || avyaktaśabdarūpāya vyaktaśabdāya vai namaḥ || 7 || anāhati (!) ninādāya kāraṇadhvanine namaḥ || parāya parameśāya parāparāya vai namaḥ || 8 || parāpara pratītāya sarvveṣāṃ pataya (!) namaḥ || ānandāya tathaikāya saccidānanda rūpiṇe || 9 || nirānandāya nandāya liṃgāya naṃdine namaḥ || oṃkāyasvarāṃśāya śrutāya nādarūpiṇe || 10 || mūlarūpa trimātrāya mūlatārāya vai namaḥ || 11 || vimohitaṃ tava rudramāyayā tvadīya yeśāna bhajāmi santataṃ || prabodhayā vā manukampahite (!) kaṭākṣapīyūṣa sudhārayādhunā || 12 || skanda uvāca || ye paṭhanti ca māhātmyaṃ paśupateḥ stutiṃ sadā || paśuyonyudbhavaiḥ pāpair mucyate (!) te na saṃśayaḥ || 13 || grahapīḍā vinaśyanti paṭhanād gāḍhakilviṣāt || jayamāpnoti saṃgrāmeṣvasādhyaṃ sādhayet kṣaṇāt || 14 || paśuyoniṃ parityajya duḥkhasaṃsāra saṃsrate (!) || ciraṃ bhuktepsitānante rudrasāyujyam āpnuyāt || 15 || || iti himavatkhaṇḍe śrīpaśupatistotraṃ samāptaṃ || || pāṭhakasya paśujanmānaṃ na bhavatu || [[śubhaṃ]] || (exp. 4b7–6a2)

Beginning nityānandakari (!) varābhayakarī saundaryaratnākarī nirdhūtākhilaghorapāvanakarī pratyakṣamāheśvarī prāleyācala vaṃsamocanakarī kāśīśvarādhīśvarī bhikṣāndehi kṣamāvilamvanakarī mātānnapūrṇeśvarī || 1 || nānā ratna vicitra bhūṣanakarī hemāmbarāḍīśvarī muktāhāravilambamānavilasad vakṣoja kuṃbhastanī kāśmīrāguruṇāṃ chitākarikarī kāśiśvarādhīśvarī bhikṣāṃ dehi º | 2 || (exp. 3a1:b4) End annapūrṇē sadāpūrṇe śaṃkaraprānavallabhe (!) jñānavairāgyasiddhyarthaṃ bhikṣān dehii ca pārvvati || 11 || (exp. 6a3–4) Colophon jati śrī śaṃkarācārjya viracitānnapūrṇāstava samāpta (!) || (exp. 6:4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāyanamaḥ || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || 1 || sāvarṇṇIḥ sūryatanayo yo manuḥ kathyateṣṭamaḥ || niśāmaya tadutpattiṃ vistarād gadato mamaḥ || 2 || mahāmāyānubhāvena yathā manvantarādhipaḥ || sa babhūva mahābhāgaḥ sāvarnistanayo raveḥ || 3 || svārociṣentare pūrvaṃ caitravaṃśaṃ samudbhavaḥ || suratho na rājābhūt samaste kṣitimaṇḍale || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) Sub-colophon iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye madhukaiṭabhavadhaḥ || 1 || (fol. 7r7–8) iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye mahuṣāsurasainyavadhaḥ || 2 || (fol. 12v5–6) iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye mahiṣāsuravadhaḥ || 3 || (fol. 15v8–9) iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye mahiṣāsuravadhi(!) śakrādistutiḥ || 4 || (fol. 19v4–6) iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye devīdūtasaṃvādaḥ || 5 || (fol. 25v5–6) iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye śumbhaniśubhasenānī dhūuralocanabadhaḥ || 6 || (fol. 27r6–7) iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye caṇḍamuṇḍavadhaḥ || 7 || (fol. 29r5–6) iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye raktabījavadhaḥ || 8 || (fol. 33v6–8) iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye niśumbhavadhaḥ|| 9 || (fol. 36v5–6) iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye śumbhavadhaḥ || 10 || (fol. 38v7–8) iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye nārāyaṇīstutiḥ || 11 || (fol. 43r1–2) iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye śumbhaniśumbhavadha samāptaḥ || 12 || (fol. 45v9–46r1) iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmāhātmye surathavaiśyayorvarapradānaṃ nāma trayodaśodhyayaḥ || 13 || (fol. 47r7–10) End mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || 24 || iti datvā tayordevī yathābhilaṣitam varam || babhūvānntarhitā sadyo bhaktyā tābhyāmabhiṣṭutā || evaṃ devyā varaṃ labdhvā surathakṣatriyarṣabhaḥ || sūryyājjanmasamāsādya sāvarnir bhavitā manuḥ || 27 || ślokā || 580 || maṃtrāṃkā 700 || (fol. 47r5–9) Colophon samvat 1938 shāgunakṛṣṇa paṃcamyāṃ budhavāsare sisnyāri brahmapuragrāmasthāne likhitaṃ rāiṭara vāburāma śarmmaṇā śubhm ||(fol. 47v10–12)
