Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kailāśasyottare śṛṃge śuddhasphaṭikasannibhe || tamoguṇavihīne tu jarāmṛtyuvivarjite || 1 || sarvārthasampadādhāre sarvajñānakṛtālaye || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā sukhāsīnaṃ sadāśivam || 2 || prapaccha praṇato bhrahmā jānubhyām avanīṃ gataḥ || kenopāyena deveśa cirāyurlomaśo bhavet || 3 || tan me vrūhi mahādeva lokānām hitakāmyayā || hitakāraṇalokānāṃ trailokye sa carācare || 4 || śrī mahādeva uvāca || śrṛṇu Brahman pravakṣāmi cirāyurmunisattamaḥ || saṃjātaḥ karmaṇaḥ yena vyādhimṛtyuvivarjitaḥ || 5 || tasminnekārṇave ghore salilaughapariplute || kṛtāntabhayanāśārthaṃ stuto mṛtyuñjayaḥ śivaḥ || 6 || tasya saṃkīrttanān-nityaṃ munirmṛtyurujjhitaḥ || tameva kīrttayed brahman mṛtyuṃ jetuṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 7 || asya śrīmṛtyuñjayastotramaṃtrasya lomaśa ṛṣir anuṣṭupchandaḥ śrīmṛtyuñjayo devatā āyurārogyavṛddhayarthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ || || (fol. 1v1:2r1) End sadādhāraḥ prajānāṃ ca mṛtyuṃjaya namostute || evaṃ saṃkīrttayed yastu śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ || 41 || bhaktyā śṛṇoti yo Brahman na mṛtyuvaśago bhavet || nāpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya yuktakālaṃ ca laṃghayet || 42 || vyādhayo nopapadyante nopasargaṃ bhayaṃ bhavet || atyāsannantare kāle śataikāvarttane kṛte || 43 || mṛtyur na jāyate tasya rogastaṃ ca vimuṃcati || paṃcamyāṃ vā daśamyāṃ vā paurṇamāsyām athāpi vā || 44 || śatamāvarttayedyastu śatavarṣaṃ sa jīvati || idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ devasya haṃśayoginaṃ (!) || 45 || duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvāriṣṭavināśanam || susvapnavarddhanaṃ nityaṃ sarvvaduskṛtanāśanaṃ || 46 || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivalokaṃa sa gachati (!) || śatavarṣaṃ sa jīvet tu putrapautra pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 47 || uttamottamavipraḥsyād uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ śubhaḥ || mṛtyuñjayena japtena cirakālaṃ sa jīvati || 48 || saptajanma kṛtāt pā[pā]n mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 49 || || (fol. 4r2:4v2) Colophon iti śrīpārameśvarataṃtre caturāśītisāhasre śrīmṛtyuñjayastavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || || śrīśamanajanakanayanaṃ naumi divāniśam || śubham (fol. 4v2–3)

Text śrīrāmaḥ || prātaḥ smarāmi raghunātha mukhāravindaṃ mandasmitaṃ madhurabhāṣi viśālabhālam || karṇāvalambicalakuntalaśobhigaṃḍaṃ karṇānta dīrghanayanaṃ nayanābhirāmam || 1 || prātaḥ smarāmi raghunātha karāravindaṃ rakṣogaṇāya bhayadaṃ varadaṃ nijebhyaḥ | yad rājasaṃśadi vibhajya maheśa cāpaṃ sītākaragrahaṇa maṃgalamāpa sadyaḥ || 2 || prātar bhajāmi raghunātha padāravindaṃ padmāṃkuśādi śubhareṣa śubhāvahe me || yogeṃdra mānasa madhuvrata sevyamāna śāpāpahaṃ sapadi gautama dharmapatnyāḥ || 3 || prātaḥśraye śrutinatāṃ raghunātha mūrttiṃ nīlāṃbujotpalasitetararatnabhāṣām || āmuktacūḍamaṇiratna vibhūṣaṇāḍhyāṃ dhyeyaṃ samasta munibhir nijamṛtyuṛtyai (!) || 4 || prātarbhajāmi raghunāthamanāthanāthaṃ vāgdoṣahāri saklaṃ samalaṃ nihanti || yatpārvatī svapatinā sahabhoktukāma prītyā sahasraharināma samaṃ jajāpa || 5|| yaḥ ślokapaṃcakamidaṃ niyataḥ prabuddho nityaṃ prabhātasamaye manujaḥ smareta || śrīrāmakiṃkaragaṇeṣu sa eva mukhyo bhaktyā prayāti hariloka mananya labhyam || 6 || rāmāya rāmacaṃdrāya rāmabhadrāya vedhase || raghunāthāya nāthāya sītāyāḥ pataye namaḥ iti prātastutiḥ || (fol. 4v4–5r6)

Text śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || brahmovāca jaya jayajagadīśa vaṃditacaraṇa nirguṇanirākāra svecchāmaya bhaktānugraha nityavigraha gopaveṣamāyayā māyeśa suveṣa suśīla śāṃta sarvakāṃta dāṃta nitāṃta jñānānanda parātparatara prakṛteḥ parasarvāṃtarātmarūpanirlipta sākṣisvarūpa vyaktāvyakta niraṃjana mārāvatāraṇa karuṇārṇava śokasaṃtāpagrasana jarāmṛtyubhayādiharaṇa śaraṇāpaṃjara bhaktānugrahakātara bhaktavatsala bhaktasaṃtadhana oṃ namostute || 1 || sarvādhiṣṭhātṛ devāyetyuktvā vai prīṇanāya ca | punaḥ punar uvācedaṃ mūrcchita śca babhūva ha || 2 || iti brahmakṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ || tatsarvābhiṣṭasiddhiś ca bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 3 || aputro labhate putraṃ priyāhīnaṃ labhetpriyām | nirdhano labhate satyaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ dhanam || 4 | iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā cāṃte dāsyaṃ labheddhareḥ || acalāṃ bhaktimāpnoti mukterapi sudurlabham (!) || 5 || iti śrībrahmavaivartamahāpurāṇe kṛṣṇājanmakhaṇḍe brahmakṛta stotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śubhaṃ || (fol. 1:1–9)

«Text:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || bhuvanaguptaye brahmaṇārthitaṃ daśarathālaye vyaktimāgataṃ || janakanaṃdinī lakṣaṇānvitaṃ bhajamanaḥ sadā rāmamadbhutaṃ || 1 || kamalalocanaṃ pāpamocanaṃ svajana raṃjanaṃ dvaitabhaṃjanaṃ || ṣaḍarimardanaṃ buddhi varddhanaṃ bhajamana saº || 2 || agaṇitaujasaṃ daṃḍasāgaraṃ praṇana (!) tāpasaṃ sādhumānasaṃ || amitabhāsasaṃ pītavāsasaṃ bhajaº || 3 || nijatanuprabhābhāsitākhilaṃ bāliratnayuk divyakuṃdulaṃ || padavirājitaṃ kṣoṇimaṇḍalaṃ bhajaº || 4 || madanakoṭisauṃdarya mohanaṃ paramabhaktidaṃ kāmadohanaṃ || hṛdaya paṃkajedhyātnābhavaṃ bhaº || 5 || surapatistvayodhyāpure vare suratarusthale maṃḍapāṃtare || maṇimayāsane saumyamāsthitaṃ bhajamanaḥ saº || 6 || amarakiṃnnaraiḥ siddhacāraṇair munivarair nararr apsarogaṇaiḥ paramaśraddhayā bhaktitorcitaṃ bhajamaº || 7 || caritavistaraṃ koṭibhiḥ śataṃ śatrubhaṃjanaṃ rāmasaṃsthitaṃ || bhajanaśaṃkaraṃ prāpya hṛt kathaṃ || bhaja8 || evamadbhutaṃ rāghavāṣṭakaṃ pratidinaṃ paṭhet bhaktipūrvakaṃ || ahilayārcitaṃ pādapaṃkajaṃ || bhaja maº || 9 || iti śrīmat paramahaṃ ○ paº śrīmachaṃ (!) karācāryaviracitaṃ rāghavāṣṭakaṃ saṃpuṇaṃ (!) || (fol. 1a:b)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || brahmauvāca (!) ||śloº || vaṃde devaṃ, viṣṇumaśeṣa, sthitihetuṃ, tvamadhyātma , jñānibhiraṃta, hṛdibhāvyaṃ || heyāheyadvaṃdavihīnaṃ, paramekaṃ, sattāmātraṃ, sarvadṛṣṭisthaṃ, dṛśirūpa || 1 || ṭīkā || aśeṣasya sthitik kāraṇaṃ, adhyātmajñānina ātmaviṣayatatva jñānavaṃtaḥ || heyāheye duḥkhasukhe tat sādhane tadrūpadvaṃdavihinaṃ (!) | kūṭasthatvāt sattāmātraṃ sarvasya hṛdi tiṣṭhatīti vyavahara niyāmakaṃ | iti dṛśir jñānam || 1 || śloº || prāṇāpānau niścayabuddhyā hṛḍirudhvā chitvā sarvaṃ saṃśayabaṃdhaṃ viṣayaughān || paśyaṃtīśaṃ yaṃ gatamohā yatayas taṃ vaṃde rāmaṃ ratnakirīṭaṃ ravibhāsaṃ || 2 || (fol. 2v1:3r8) End śloº || śraddhāyukto yaḥ paṭhatīmaṃ stavamādyaṃ brāhmaṃ brahmajñānavidhānaṃ bhuvimartyaḥ || rāmaṃ rāmaṃ kāmitakāmapradamīśaṃ dhyātvā dhyātā pātakajālair vigataḥ syāt || 9 || ṭīº || brāhmam brahmakṛtaṃ | brahmajñānabhidhānam tajjanakam | kāmitakāmapradaṃ abhiṣṭavastudātāraṃ(!) | tādṛśaṃ dhyātvā yaḥ paṭhati sa dhyātā puruṣaḥ pātakajālair vigataḥ hīnaḥ syāt || 9 || (fol. 8v2–7) Colophon iti śrīmad adhyātmarāmāyaṇe umāmaheśarasaṃvāde yuddhakāṃḍe brahmastutitrayo (!) sargaḥ || śrī kṛº || (fol.8v7–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || bhagavati bhagavatpadapaṃkajaṃ bhramarabhūta surāśurasevitaṃ || sujanamā(na) sa haṃsa parirakṛtaṃ (!) kamalayāmalayā nibhṛne(!) bhajet || 1 || tām vubhāvapi vaṃdehaṃ vighneśa kuladevate naranāgānanas te ko narasiṃhonanopāra || 2 || hariharagurupadmaṃ hṛdyapadmenurāgād adhigata parabhāsaṃ nidhaye saṃdareṇa || tadanucarikaremi pritaye(!) bhaktibhājāṃ bhagavatipadapadme pādya pūṣpāṃjali te || 3 || (!) kenaite racitāṃ kuto na nihatāṃ śuṃbhādayo dūrmadā kenaite lavapālitā iti hatā praśne kimācakṣmahe || 4 || (fol.1v1:2r3) End raṃduramyo vahavigamyor marubaṃdhuhṛdyastutaḥ sādhuvadyastataḥ || śrīpatainunāka hi satsununāṃ(!) viśvamātu pade pādyapuṣpāṃjali te || 32 || (!) iti śrīmat bhagavatī pūjapādāraviṃda makaranda sā dūṣnudhām ullasaṃn madhukara maṃjurapūravāri bhaṭ bhuri śrīpatitanuja rāmakṛṣṇakavi kṛyato(!) bhagavati padyapuṣpāṃjali te || 33 || (!) prāvinācāryavaryā madudayanācāryasiddhānta siddhamaṃgalaṃ || phalagocaratāmalakalayāṃ sa ka ramaṇīya mukumudiramampāramyastara dharmāsamadharmamadadhāt || 34 || (fol.8r6:9r2) Colophon iti śrībhagavatipādyapuṣpāṃjali (!) || bhavānisakarābhyām (!) namaḥ śrībhavāṇī (!) prītaye namaḥ || śubhamastuḥ || śrīr astu || || || || (fol.9r2–4)

Beginning śrībhavānyai namaḥ || || na tāto na mātā na baṃdhurna dātā na putro na putrī na bhṛtyor na bharttā || na jāyā na vittaṃ na vṛttir mamaiva gatistvaṃ matistvaṃ tvamekā bhavāni || 1 || na jānāmi dānaṃ na ca dhyāna mānaṃ najānāmi maṃtraṃ na ca stotra maṃtraṃ najānāmi pūjā na ca nyāsa jālaṃ gatistvaṃ matistvaṃ tvamekā bhavānī (!) || 2 || bhavābdhāvapāraṃ mahāduḥkhabhīru pratāpaḥ prakamī pramattaḥ pralobhiḥ || kumāyā kucakṣuḥ pravarddhaḥ sadāhaṃ gatistvaṃ matistvaṃ tvamekā bhavānī (!) || 3 || najānāmi tīrthaṃ najānāmi mitraṃ najānāmi bhutkā(!)layaṃ vā kimetat || najānāmi bhaktiḥ vrataṃ vāpi mānaṃ gatistvaṃ matistvaṃ tvamekā bhavānī (!) || 4 ||(fol.1v1:4r2) End tiraśkurvato nyāmaropāsanārccāṃ parityaktadhamādhvarasyāsya jaṃtoḥ || tvadārādhana nyastacittasya kiṃ me kariṣyaṃtyamī dharmarājasya dūtāḥ || 32 || namanye hariṃ vidhātāramīśaṃ na vahniṃ na cārkaṃ na cendrādidevān || śivodīritāneka vākya prabandhais tvadarcyavidhānaṃ viśaṃtyaṃba martyān || 23 ||? = 33 narā māṃ viniṃdaṃtu niṃdaṃtu nāma tyajaṃtyamba cājñātayaḥ saṃtyajaṃtu || yamīyā bhaṭā nārake pātayaṃtu tvamekā gatir me tvamekā gatir me || 34 || mahākālarudroditaṃ stotram etat sadā bhaktibhāvena yo dhyeti bhaktaḥ || nacāpanna rogo na śoko na mṛṭyur bhavet siddhir aṃte ca kaivalya lābhaṃ || 25 || ? = 35 (fol.21v1:24r1) Colophon iti śrībhavānīkīlakaṃ saṃpūrṇam || || śubham astu || (fol.24r2–3)

Beginning ❖ śrībhavānyaiḥ (!) || || na tāto na mātāḥ (!) na baṃdhur n-na dātāḥ (!) na putro na putrī na bharttā na bhṛrttṛ (!) || na jāyā na vṛttā na vṛttī mamaiva || gatistvaṃ gatistvaṃ tvamekā bhavāṇī (!) || 1 || na jānāmi dānaṃ na ca dhyāyamāmaṃḥ (!) na jānāmi maṃtraṃ na ca stotra yaṃtraṃḥ (!) na jānāmi pūjāḥ na ca nyāsayogaṃ || gatistvaṃ gatistvaṃ tvamekā bhavāni || 2 || bhavadvāvaṣāreḥ mahāduḥkhabhīrau prayāttaṃ prakāmi pralobhiḥ pralobhi prasannaṃ kumāyā kulahya prabaddhaṃ sadāhaṃ || gatistvaṃ gatistvaṃ tvamekā bhavāni || 3 || na jānāmi tirtha najānāmi punyaṃ (!) na jānāmi pu[tryā]layaṃ vāpi metat najā nāmi bhaktiṃ vrata vāpi māta (!) || gatista matista tvamekā bhavāni || 4 || (!) vrajesaṃ (!) nabhesaṃ (!) suresaṃ mahesaṃ (!) gaṇesaṃ diṇeśaṇ niśesaṃ vana vā (!) na jānāmi nyāsaṃ sadāhaṃ śaraṇyaṃ || gatista(!) matistaṃ tvamekā bhavāni || 5 || (!) kurkarmi kuśaṃgi(!) kubuddhi kudāsa kulācārahīna kadācālahīna kudṛṣṭī (!) kuvākya sadāhaṃ bhavāṇi || gatista (!) matistva (!) tvamekābhavāṇi || 6 || (!) vivāde vaṣāde (!) pramāde pracāmeḥ (!) jale cānale pavvate (!) śatrumadhyeḥ aranyā saranyā saranya sadāhaṃ bhavāni ||(!) gatistamatista (!) tvamekā bhavāni || 7 || (!) anātho daridro jarārogayukto mahākṣīnahīna(!) sadājāḍya vaktaḥ(!) vipattiḥ praviṣṭa sadāhaṃ bhavāni || gatistamatista(!) tvamekā bhavāni || 8 || iti śrīśaṃkarācāryyaviracitaṃ śrībhavānibhujaṃga prasto (!) samāptaṃ || || śubhm || || || || || (fol.1v1:4r2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāyanamaḥ śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ oṃ asyaśrīnavārṇamantrasya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāṛṣayaḥ gāyatritriṣṭuvanuṭup chaṃdāṃsi mahākālimahālakṣmimahāsarasvatyodevatāḥ nandāśākambharībhīmāḥ śaktayaḥ raktadantikābhīmābhrāmaryo bījāni agnivāyusūryas tatvāni abhiṣṭasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ (fol. 1v1–5, 2r1) Sub-colophon iti pūjāvidhānam saṃpūrṇam || (fol. 11v1–2) iti āgamāṃtare argalāstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || (fol. 16v4–5) iti māyottare svāyaṃbhuve mārkaṃḍeyoktaṃ bhagavatyāḥ kīlakastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || (fol. 21r2–3) iti vārāhapurāṇe hariharabrahmaviracitaṃ devyāḥ kavacaṃ saṃpūrṃ (fol. 34r3–5) iti ṛgvedoktaṃ sarasvatisūktaṃ || (fol. 39r1) it śrīghaṭatantre rudrayāmale devīmahātmye śivoktaṃ mahākālīsūktaṃ (fol. 43v2–3) iti mārkaṃḍeyapuº sāº maº deº śivaproktaṃ mahākālīsūktaṃ (fol. 46v4–5) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvaṃtare devīmahātmye madhukaiṭabhavadho nāma prathamo dhyāyaḥ (fol. 63v2–4) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvaṃtare devīmahātmye viṣṇuproktaṃ mahālakṣmīsūktam saṃpūrṇaṃ (fol. 68v3–4) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvaṃtare devīmahātmye mahiṣāsurasainyavadho nāma dvitīyo dhyāyaḥ (fol. 81v1–3) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvaṃtare devīmahātmye mahiṣāsuravadho nāma tṛtīyodhyāyaḥ (fol. 90r2–4) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvaṃtare devīmahātmye śakrādayastuti catuº 4 dhyāya (fol. 99v6–7) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike sāvarṇike manvaṃtare devīmahātmye dhumralocanavadhaḥ || 6 || (fol. 128r1–2) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvaṃtare deº caṇḍamuṇḍavadhaḥ || 7 || (fol. 133r1–2) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvaṃtare deº raktabījavadhaḥ || 8 || (fol. 144r5–144v1) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapuº sāº maº deº niśumbhavadhaḥ || 9 || (fol. 151v3) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapuº sāº maº devīº śumbhavasdhaḥ || 10 || (fol. 156v5) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvaṃtare devīmahātmye nārāyaṇīstutiḥ || 11 || (fol. 166r3–5) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe sāº maº deº bhagavatīprabhāvakathanaṃ nāma || 12 || (fol. 173v3–4) iti devīmahātmye prādhānikaṃ rahasyaṃ (fol. 184v3–4) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapuº sāº maº deº vaikṛtikaṃ nāma dvitīyaṃ rahasyaṃ (fol. 191v5) iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe sāº maº deº māº mūrttirahasyaṃnāma saṃpūrṇam || || (fol. 196v1–2) End putakaṃ kiṃcidādhāre sthāpayitvā japonuṣṭheyo na tu haste || taduktam vārāhītantre || ādhāre sthāpayitvā tu pustakaṃ vācayet tataḥ hastasaṃsthāpanāddevī bhavedardhaphalaṃ yata [[etena vāṅmanase(!)]] sarvārthaviṣayiṇī tābhyām api tava mahimā avadhārayituṃ na śakyate na ca pratyakṣeṇānubhāvena gṛhyate sa kathaṃ tava mahimānaṃ śrutir api || vedo pi ..kitam abhidhate(!) bhītabhītaṃ (śru?)tena niścayataḥ || kayā || atadvāvṛtyā(!) na tat(!)atadrūpā cāsau vṛtiś(!) cā(!) yā tadvyāvṛttis tayā || sa ('nyaṃ) bhūto mahimā kasya stotavyo 'pi tu na kasyāpīty arthaḥ || tathā katividhaguṇas tasya bhagavataḥ kiyaṃto guṇās te parijñātuṃ śakyate || kasya viṣayaḥ kasya gocaro bhavet | na kasyāpīty arthaḥ || etena niṣkalasvarūpeṇa stuter anadhikāritvaṃ pratipāditaṃ || sakalasyāvakāśatvaṃ pratipādayann āha || (fol. 2r1-4, 8-9) End kuśumadaśananāmā sarvagaṃdharvarājaḥ śaśidharavaramauler ddevadevasyā(!) dāsaḥ || svagurunijamahimno bhraṣṭa ivāsa(!) roṣāt stavanam idam akāṣṣī(!) divyadivyaṃ mahimnaḥ || 34 || suravaramunipūjaṃ svargamokṣaikahetu(!) paṭhati yadi manuṣyaḥ prāṃjalī nānyacetāḥ || vrajati śivasamīpaṃ kinnaraiḥ stūyamānaḥ stavanam idam amoghaṃ puṣpadaṃtapraṇītaṃ || 35 || (fol. 12v2-5) Colophon iti mahimastotraṭīkā samāptaḥ(!) || saṃpūrṇa || śubhaṃ bhūyāt || || || (fol. 12v5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ śrīsiddhimahāgaṇapataye || || aviralamadajalanivahaṃ bhramarakulānekasevitaka⁅po⁆laṃ | abhimataphaladātāraṃ kāmeśaṃ gaṇapatiṃ vande || || kārttikeya uvāca || gaṇeśa tava ⁅nāmā⁆ni sahasraṃ yad udīritaṃ | tattvaṃ kathaya bhāvena mahimānaṃ tava prabho || 1 || tava kīrttiḥ siddhi⁅ka⁆raṃ tathā vighnaharaṃ paraṃ | amarāṇāṃ pravaraṃ jñeyaṃ bhaktānām abhayapradaṃ || 2 || ṛddhisiddhiprada+ hi brahmavid brahmarūpadhṛk | jñānamūrttiḥ śiva(sthaṃ) hi kṛpāṅ kuru mamopari || 3 || gaṇapatir uvāca || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi mama nāmasahasrakaṃ | bhaktyā śṛṇudhva matimān(!) saṃsārārṇṇavalaṃghanaṃ || 4 || oṃ gaṇeśvaro gaṇakrīḍo gaṇanātho gaṇādhipaḥ || ekadaṃṣṭro vakratuṇḍo gajavaktro mahodaraḥ || 5 || (fol. 1v1-2r1) End surūpaḥ sarvvanetrādhivāso vibhāji nūpuraḥ | pītāmbaraḥ khaṇḍaladaḥ khaṇḍavaiśāṣasaṃsthitaḥ || 18 || citrāṅkaḥ śyāmadaśano bhāra(ca)ndro havirbbhujaḥ | yogādhipas tārakas tu puruṣo ga° (fol. 2v6-7)

Beginning śrībhavānyai namaḥ || śrīśaṅkaraṅ gurun natvā audya(!)nāthān api kramāt || sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya nṛpāṇāñ jayadāyakam || sādhanam vividhaiś caiva vidyānandam vitanyate || kalpamudrādhanaprāpte guṭikātilakāñjana(m) || pādukākhaḍgavetālavīrasādhanapūrvvakam || kṛtrvā gṛhe śmaśāne vā nirbhayaṃ raṇam āviśet || asādhyas tasya naivāsti śatruṣ ko pi mahītale || śrīdevy uvāca || bhagavan sarvva[[dha]]rmmajña sṛṣṭisthityantakāraka || devadeva sadādeva sarvvajñānamahodadhe || sarvvaughadhīnām madhye yā paramā siddhimūlikā || tasyāḥ kalpam mahādeva kathayasva trilocana || śrī īśvara uvāca || sādhu sādhu mahāprājñe sarvvatatvārjite śive || atigūḍhataraṃ pṛṣṭo brahmādīnāṃ sudurlabhaḥ || sarvvakalpeṣv imaṃ sāraṃ sarvvasiddhipradāyakam || kathayāmi na sandehas tava snehād varānane || vicitrabodhā vijayā samvic cātisusiddhidā || saṃjīvanīti vikhyātā mama prāṇapradhāriṇī || (fol. 1v1-2v1) End nāsti tasmāt paraṃ loke siddhamūlamahauṣadham || pratyabhūtāmṛtaṃn(!) divyam idam stotraṃ na śakyate || siddhamūlī mukhe yasya bhuktibhuktir(!) bhave(!) dhruvam || caitanyasphuṭikan ta[[sya]] hṛdaye harayel labhet || īdṛśaḥ paramaḥ kalpaḥ kalpānāṃ sārasaṃgrahe || ⟪māyasu....kalpanāṃ sārasaṃgrahe ||⟫ satyam uktam mahādevi tava snehād idam vacaḥ || || (fol. 15r2-15r6) Colophon iti śrīparākramasaṅgrahasāre atirahasye śivahṛdayasthite samastasandehopaśamane kanyādhipāvatāre citāmbaravivaraṇe siddhimūlikākalpa samāptaṃ || śubham || śrīrāmaḥ (fol. 15r6-15v3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ ⁅namaḥ⁆ +sūryyāya || || samantur uvāca || māghe māsi śite pattre saptamyāṃ kurunandana | nirāhāro raviṃ bhaktyā pūjayed vidhinā nṛpa || 1 || pūrvvoktena japej japyaṃ devasya purata(!) sthitaḥ | śuddhaikāgramano(!) rājan jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ || 2 || || śatānika uvāca || kena mantreṇa japyena darśanaṃ bhagavān vrajet | stotreṇāne(!) pi savitā tan me kathaya suvrata || 3 || samantur uvāca || stuto nāma sahasreṇa yadā bhaktimatā mayā | tadā me darśanaṃ jāta(!) sākṣārd(!) devo divākaraḥ || 4 || śatānika uvāca || || nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ savituḥ śrotu[[m icchā]]mi ta(!) dvija || (fol. 1v1-2r5) End kīrttimān subhago vidvān sasukhī(!) priyadarśanaḥ | bhave varṣasatāyuś ca sarvvabādhāvivarjjitaḥ || 131 || nāmnā(!) sahasram idam aṃśumataḥ paṭhet | <ref> One syllable is missing at the end of this pāda </ref> prātaḥ śucinniyatamān sumanādhiyuktaḥ | dūreṇa taṃ pariharanti sad eva rogā bhītāḥ suparṇṇim iva sarvvamahoragendrāḥ || 133 || (fol. 22v5-23r2) <references/> Colophon iti śrībhaviṣyottarapurāṇe bhagavataḥ śrīsūryyasya nāmnā(!) sahasrakaṃ samāptaṃ || || śubha || | saṃvat 821 śrāvaṇakṛṣṇa 4 saṃpūrṇṇa (...) kīrttipurīyā śrīviṣṇudharaśarmmaṇe ananayudhye(?) namamavaṃśe śubhaṃ bhūyāt || śrāvaṇaśuklapūrṇṇamāsika hnuṣayoyājuju (...)<ref> Short passages in Newari . </ref> (fol. 23r2-23v1) <references/>

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || mahimnaḥ pāran te paramaviduṣo yady asadṛśī , stutir bbrahmādīnām api tad avasannās tvayi giraḥ || athāvācyaḥ sarvvaḥ svamatipariṇāmāvadhi gṛṇan mamāpy eṣa stotre hara nirapavādaḥ parikaraḥ || 1 || atītaḥ panthānan tava ca mahimā vāṅmanasayor atadvyāvṛttyāyaṃ cakitam abhidhatte śrutir api | sa kasya stotavyaḥ katividhaguṇaḥ kasya viṣayaḥ pade tv arvvācīne patati na manaḥ kasya na vacaḥ || 2 || (fol. 1v1-3) End asitagirisamaṃ syāt kajjalaṃ siṃdhupātraṃ surataruvaraśākhā lekhanīpatram urvvī | likhati yadi gṛhī.. ..radā sarvvakālaṃ tad api tava guṇānām īśa pāraṃ na yāti || 35 || śrīpuṣpadantamukhapa⟪ñjakaṃ⟫ṅkajanirggatena stotreṇa kilbiṣahareṇa harapriyena(!) | kaṇṭhasthitena paṭhitena gṛhasthitena saṃprīta⟪..⟫to(?) bhavati bhūtapatir maheśaḥ || 36 || (fol. 3v4-6) yāce haṃ yāce haṃ śiva tava caraṇārhaṃ vindayor bhaktim , yāce haṃ yāce haṃ punar api tām eva tām eva | śiva śiveti śiveti śiveti vā , hara hareti harati harati vā | bhava bhaveti bhavati bhavati vā , bhaja manaḥ śivam eva niraṃtaraṃ || śive..ktiḥ śivabhaktiḥ śivabhaktir bhave bhave | sadā bhūyāt sadā bhūyāt sadā bhūyāt sadā mamaḥ(!) || maheśān nāparo devo , mahimno nāparastutiḥ | aghorār(!) na paro mantro , nāsti tatvaṃ guroṣ paraṃ || dīkṣā dānaṃ tapas tīrthaṃ , homaṃ yāgādikā[[ḥ]] kriyāḥ | mahimnaḥ pāṭhamātreṇa kalā nārhaṃti (ṣoḍa)śīṃ || || || (fol. 3v6-9) Colophon iti śrīpuṣpadantaviracitaṃ mahimnastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 3v10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || jaigīṣavya uvāca || namaḥ śivāya śāktāya sarvvajñāya śubhātmane | jagadānandakandāya paramānandahetave || arūpāya sarūpāya nānārūpadharāya ca | virūpākṣāya vidhave vidhiviṣṇustutāya ca || sthāvarā[[ya]] namas tubhyaṃ jaṃgamāya namo stu te | sarvvātmane namas tubhyaṃ namas te paramātmane || namas trailokyakāmāya kāmāṅgadahanāya ca | namo śeṣaviśeṣāya namaḥ śeṣāṅgadāya te || śrīkaṇṭhāya namas tubhyaṃ viṣakaṇṭhāya te namaḥ | vaikuṇṭhavandyapādāya namaḥ kuṇṭhitaśaktaye || (fol. 20r4-7) End iti stutiṃ samākarṇṇya muneś candravibhūṣaṇaḥ | uvāca ca prasannātmā varaṃ brūhi ti(!) taṃ muniṃ || || śrī īśvara uvāca || dade śṛṇu mahābhāga jaigīṣa vyāparāt paraṃ | tvayedaṃ cet kṛtaṃ stotra(!) yogasiddhikaraṃ paraṃ || mahāpāpaughaśamanaṃ mahāpuṇyapravarddhanaṃ || mahābhītipraśamanaṃ mahābhaktipravarddhanaṃ | etatstotrajapāt puṃsām asādhya(!) naiva kiṃ cana || tasmāt sarvvaprayatnena yajanīyaṃ susādhakaiḥ || || (fol. 21r5-7) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe kāśīkhaṇḍe jaigīṣavyaviracitaṃ śrīviśveśvarastuti(!) samāptaṃ || || śrīviśveśvaraprītir astu || || (fol. 21r7-8)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || aṅgirasa uvāca || jaya śaṅkara śānta śaśāṅkaruce rucirārthada sarvvada sarvvasuce | śucidatta mahopahṛte kṛtajanāhṛtatāpatate ||<ref> pāda s c and d are unmetrical with syllables missing </ref> tat(!)sarvvaṃ(!)hṛdambaravaranate na(!)vṛjinasahā(!)vanadāhakṛte | kṣata(!)vividha[[jana]]caritratano sutano tanuviśiṣa(!)viśeṣanadhairyyanidhe || <ref> all pāda s are unmetrical </ref> nidhanādivivarjjitakṛtanati(!) kṛtakṛt vihitamanoratha pannagabhṛt | nagabhartṛsutārppitavāmavapuḥ svavapu(!)paripūritasarvvajagat ||<ref> pāda b is unmetrical </ref> (fol. 21r8-1) <references/> End asmāl liṃgārccanan(!) nityaṃ jīvabhūto si me yataḥ | ato jīva iti khyātiṃ triṣu lokeṣu yāsyati || vācāṃ prapañcaiś caturair nniḥprapañcaṃ yatas tataḥ | ato vācaprapaṃcasya patir vvācespatir(!) bhava || asya strotrasya(!) paṭhanād api vāggadagāś ca yaṃ (?)| tasya syāt saskṛtā(!) vāṇī tribhir vvarṣe trikālataḥ || || (fol. 21v6-8) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe kāśīkhaṇḍe bṛhaspatikṛtaṃ śrīmahādevastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || śrīsadāśivaprīti || ○ || śubha || || (fol. 21v8-9)

Complete Transcript ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || niddhaitāmalapaṅkāya sobhāvāmalamūttaye(!) | sitabhasmāṅgarāgāya deveśāya namo stu ta(!) || 1 || nīlakaṇṭhāya sarvvāya ajāyāmitamūrttaye | va⟪ṅu⟫g(!)rūpāya sāntāya śāśvatāya namo stu te || 2 || mahāyogīndrahārāya piṅgalocanacarave(!) | vicitraracitādyāya anantāya namo stu te || 3 || parāpara+reśāya sarvvagāya mahātmane | atitaguṇasaṃhāya visveśāya namo stu te || 4 || sarvvapraṇatadehāya svayamapranatātmane | pūjyānāṃm(!) api pūjyāya anantāya namo stu te || 5 || brahmendraviṣṇuvandyāya svayaṃm(!)utpati(!)hetave | bhuktimuktipradānāya saṃstutāya namo stu te || 6 || vāmāya vāmarūpāya vāmācārāya bhāvine | vāmakāntārddhadehāya anantāya namo stu te || 7 || ja(!) idaṃ kīrttaya(!) nityaṃ prāsādo dhyāyam urttamaṃ(!) | sarvvapāpavinirmmuktaṃ gānāpatyām(!) avāpnuyāt || 8 || (fol. 21v9-22r4) Colophon iti śivadharmme śivastotra samāptaṃ || || śubham āyum(!) ārojñem(!) iti śubha || || (fol. 22r4-5)

Complete Transcript ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || sadyojātaśaśāṅkaśṛṣṭivadanaṃ sarvvārthakāmapradaṃ | śṛṃgāraṃ la(si)taṃ sasaumyavadanaṃ śrīvāmadevottaraṃ || ghoraṃ bhīmakalālaghoravadanaṃ ghorāt paraṃ dakṣaṇaṃ(!) | pūrvvaṃ tatpurusaṃ susāntavadanaṃ śānte śive sāśvate || urddha(!)mokṣapadaṃ sukāntivadanaṃ brahmāṇḍayogeśvaraṃ | pātāle varahotakeśvaramukha(!) nāgendraśaṃpūjita(!) || nityaṃ nityaṃ(!)surāsurai stutiparaṃ saṃmūrttihuṃkāraṇaṃ sarvvajñe praṇato smi viśvam uditaṃ tailokye(!) nāthaṃ śivaṃ || || (fol. 22r5-8) Colophon iti pañcavaktra samāpta || || (fol. 22r8-9)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādhātuvicitrite | nānādhūmalatākīrṇṇe nānāpuṣpopasobhite || haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇṇe cakravākopasobhite || taruṇādityasaṃkāśe taptakāñcanasannibhe || śuddhasphaṭikasopāṇe(!) bhadrapadmaśilācale | mandirasthaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ brahmā pṛcchati śaṃkaraṃ || abhivādya yathānyāyaṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇaṃ | stute kasmin stuteś(!) caiva kena vā dhāryyate jagat || || iśvara(!) uvāca || sarvvabhūtātmako rudraḥ sarvvarudraśivātmakaḥ | umārudrātmakaṃ sarvvaṃ trailokye sacarācaraṃ || || brahmovāca || kuta sthānāni guhyāni devadeveśa bhūtale | eva(!) me saṃśayo deva brūhi tatvena śaṅkara || || īśvara uvāca || vārāṇasyāṃ mahādevaṃ prayāge tu maheśvaraṃ | naimiṣe devadeveśaṃ gayāyāṃ prapitāmahaṃḥ(!) || kurukṣetre viduḥ sthānuṃ prabhāśe śaśibhūṣaṇaṃḥ | puṣkare tu ajogandhaṃ viśve ca vimaleśvaraṃ || aṭṭahāse mahānādaṃ mahindre(!) tu mahāvrataṃ | ujjenyāṃ tu mahākālaṃ marudaṅge mahotkaṭaṃ || (fol. 22r8-22v4) End idaṃ guhyaṃ śucībhūtvā yaḥ paṭhec chivasannidhau || deśāśvamedhayajñānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || saṃvatsalaṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śrūyamāne vinaśyati || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭisatāni ca | kāñcanena vimānena rudraloke mahīyate || rudra rudreti rudreti trīśaṃ kuryyād dvijottamaḥ | kīrttanād eva deveśaṃ sarvvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 28 || || (fol. 23r3-5) Colophon iti aṣṭaṣaṣṭiliṃga saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || śubha || (fol. 23r5)

Complete Text ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || brahmovāca || namo rudrāya devāya madanāntakarāya ca | bharggāya bhūribhāgāya trinetrāya tripiṣṭaye || śipiviṣṭāya bhīmāya bhīmākṣāya namo namaḥ | tryambakāya jagadrā(jñe) viśvarūpāya vai namaḥ || tvan dhātā sarvvalokānāṃ pitā mātā tvam īśvaraḥ | tvan nātho jagatāṃ svāmi trātum arhasi naḥ prabho || ity ākarṇya vacas teṣāṃ surāṇān nandikeśvaraḥ | krpayā parayo(!) yukto vijñaptuṃ śastum ārabhet(!) || vijñapto nandinā tena śailādena mahātmanā | dhyānasthito mahādevaḥ surakāryyārtham eva ca || brahmādayaḥ suragaṇāḥ surasiddhasaṃghā draṣṭuṃ tvam eva surararyya(?) viśeṣayanti | kāryyārthino suravaraiḥ paribhatsyamānās(!) samāgatās<ref> three syllables are missing </ref> tārakamardditāś ca || tasmāt tvayā hi deveśa trātavyādhunā(!) surāḥ | evaṃ tena tadā su(sthu) vijñapto nandinā dvijāḥ || śanaiḥ śanair uparame(!) śastuḥ paramakovidaḥ | samādheḥ paramātmāsau uvāca parameśvaraḥ || || (fol. 23r6-23v1) <references/> Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe kedārakhaṇḍe brahmaproktaṃ śrīmahārudrastotraṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || || śrīsadāśivaprīti || || (fol. 23v1-2)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || bṛhaspatir uvāca || || namo rudrāya bhīmāya nīlakaṇṭhāya vedhase | kaparddine sureśāya vyomakaśāya vai namaḥ || vṛṣadhvajāya momāya somanāthāya vai namaḥ | digambarāya bharggā(!) umākāntakaparddine || tapomayāya vyāpyāya śiviviṣṭāya te namaḥ | vyālapriyāya vyālāya vyālānāṃ pataye namaḥ || mahīdharāya vyāghrāya paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ | tripurāntakāya siṃhāya śāddūla(!)sakhāya ca || mīnāya mīnanāthāya siddhāya parameṣṭhine | kāmāntakāya buddhāya buddhīnām pataye namaḥ || (fol. 23v2-5) End namo namaḥ kāraṇāya te mṛtyuṃjayāyātmabhavasvarūpiṇe | tryambakāya śivikaṇṭhagarbhagagaurīpate sakalamaṃgalahetave namaḥ ||<ref> the metre is unclear </ref> nāmnāṃ śata maheśasya bṛhaspatim udīritaṃ || ○ || <references/> Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe kedārakhaṇḍe bṛhaspatikṛtaṃ mahādevasya śatanāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || śubha || || mahādevaprītir astu || (fol. 24r2-3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || sudarśanākhyaṃ yac cakraṃ labdhavāns(!) tat kathaṃ hariḥ | mahādevād bhagavata(!) sūta tad vaktum arhasi || || sūta uvāca || devāsurāṇām abhavat saṃgrāmo dbhutadarśanaḥ | devāś ca nirjjitā daityair vviṣṇuśaraṇam āgatā || stutvā taṃ vividhai stotraiḥ praṇamya purasasthitāḥ(!) | bhayabhītāś ca te sarvve dānavaiḥ kleśitā bhṛśaṃ || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha bhagavān devadevo janārddinaḥ | kimartham āgatā devā vaktum arhatha sāmprataṃ || vacaḥ śrutvā harer ddevāḥ praṇamyocuḥ surottama | nirjjitā dānavaiḥ sarvve śaraṇaṃ tvām ihāgatā(!) || gatis tvam eva devānāṃ trātā tvaṃ puruṣottama | hantum arhasi tān kṣipram avadhyān vārijekṣaṇa || (fol. 58r1-4) End aśvamedhasahasrasya phalam bhavati niścitaṃ | paṭhate sarvvabhāvena vidyā ca mahatī bhavet || jāyate mahad aiśvaryyaṃ śivasya dayito bhavet | dustare jalasaṃghāte taj jalaṃ sthalatāṃ vrajet || hārāyante mahāsarppāḥ siṃhakrīḍā mṛgāyate | tasmān nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa stotavyo bhagavān śivaḥ || prayacchate khilāt[[kā]]mān(!) dehān te ca parāṃ gatiṃ || || (fol. 58r1-3) <references/> Colophon ity ādityapurāṇe mānavīyasaṃhitāyāṃ nārāyaṇasya sudarśanapradānaṃ nāma ekonacatvariṃśatitamo dhyāyaḥ || || śrīsadāśivaprītir astu || || śubhaṃ bhūyāt sarvvadā || || (fol. 62r3-4)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ namaḥ śivāya || || vāsudeva uvāca || tataḥ sa prayato bhūtvā mama tāta yudhiṣṭhiraḥ | prāñjaliḥ prāha viprarṣir nnāmasaṃgraham āditaḥ || upamanyur uvāca || brahmaproktair ṛṣiḥ(!)proktair vvedavedāga(!)saṃbhavaiḥ | sarvvalokeṣu vikhyātaṃ stutyaṃ stoṣyāmi ⁅nā⁆mabhiḥ || 2 || mahadbhir vvihitaiḥ satyaiḥ siddhaiḥ sarvvārthasādhakaiḥ || ṛṣiṇā taṇḍilā(!) bhaktyā kṛtair vvedakṛtātmanā || 3 || yathoktaiḥ sādhubhir khyātair munibhis ta⁅tva⁆darśibhiḥ || pravaraṃ prathamaṃ svarggyaṃ sarvvabhūtahitaṃ śubhaṃ || 4 || śrutaiḥ sarvvatra jagati brahmalokāvatāritaiḥ || satyais tat paramaṃ brahma brahmaproktaṃ sanātanaṃ || 5 || va⁅kṣye⁆d(!) yadukulaśreṣṭha śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhava || varayaitaṃ bhavaṃ devaṃ bhaktas tvaṃ parameśvaraṃ || 6 || (fol. 62r4-8) End taṇḍi[[ḥ]] provāca śukrāya gautamāya ca bhārggavaḥ || vaivasvatāya manave gautamaḥ prāha mādhava || 177 || nārāyaṇāya sādhyāya samādhiṣṭhāya(!) dhīmate || yamāya prāha bhagavān sādhyo nārāyaṇo 'cyutaḥ || 178 || nāciketāya bhagavān āha vaivasvato yamaḥ || mārkkaṇḍeyāya vārṣṇeya nāciketo 'bhyabhāṣataḥ || 179|| mārkkaṇḍeyān mayā prāpto(!) niyamena janārddanaḥ || tavāpy aham amitraghna stavaṃ dadyādya(!) viśrutaṃ || 180 || svarggyam ārogyam āyuṣyaṃ dhanyaṃ vedena sammite(!) || nāsya vighnaṃ vikurvvanti dānavā yakṣarākṣasāḥ || 181 || piśācā yātughātyāś(!) ca guhyakā bhujagā api || yaḥ paṭheta śuciḥ pārtha brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ || 182 || abhagnayogī varṣan tu so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 183 || (fol. 67v1-5) Colophon iti śrīmahābhārate śāntiparvvaṇi dānadharmmeṣu śivasahasranāma samāptaṃ || || śubham astu sarvvadā śivaprītir astu kṣamasva || || ○ || || (fol. 67v5-6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivaśaktaye namaḥ || oṃ namaḥ śivāyeti ca samṛtyuṃ(!)jarat(!)trimūrttaye | tupā(?)devī maheśānī namas te śaktirūpinī(!) || digmātṛkādi sā devī maṇḍale yatra tiṣṭhati || sarvvavighnavināsāya dvārādīny api śāntaye | nandyādidvārapāleśa(!) gurupakti(!)<ref> Below irregular spelling is not always marked because it is so frequent. </ref> tathaiva ca || dvārādidvāravāśinyaḥ śāntisuprītabhāvanaiḥ | pātālādiśivāntaś ca bhuvana..ṭakeśvara || asuraś cāsurī sarvvā śāntim āśu karotu me | nāgāś ca nāganāginyā viṣadarppabalāyutāḥ(?) || pātāle vasate sarvvāḥ śāntiṃ kurvvatu me sadā || rākṣaśā rākṣaśī sarvvāḥ piśācāś ca viśācinī(!) | te sarvvadevayonyaś ca śāntim kurvvatu me sadā || (fol. 67v6-10) <references/> End bhayasarvvavinirmmuktaṃ yaśaḥsarvvasukhaṃ bhavet | rāja.. vimucyante<ref> One syllabe is missing and one illegible. </ref>śatāṣṭahāyanāyuṣaṃ | ihatra bhogabhāgī ca paratre ca parāṅgatī | yasmiṃ deśeṣu pathyante(!) tatra deśeṣu śāntikaṃ || yaś ca te śāntikādhyāyaṃ svayaṃ vācaiva yaś ca te | uddeśaṃ vācayaty eva mahāpātakanāsanaṃ || śāntyadhyāyam idaṃ nāma paṭhety evaṃ samāhitaṃ | sarvvapāpavinirmmuktaṃ sarvvakāmārthasiddhaye || || (fol. 68v10-69r2) <references/> Colophon iti netrajñānārṇṇave mahātantre mṛtyuṃjayaśāntyadhyāyo nāma tṛtīya samāptaṃ || || śrīmṛtyuñjayāya sadāśivāya namaḥ || || śubhaḥ śivaśaktiprītir astu || śubhāṃ(!) || (fol. 69r2-3)

Full Text ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || || prathaman tu mahādevaṃ dvitīyañ ca maheśvaraḥ | tṛtīyaṃ saṅkaraṃ ṇāma(!) caturthaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaṃ || 1 || paṃcamaṃ kartti(!)vāsañ ca ṣaṣṭham kāmāṃgaṇāsanaṃ(!) | saptamaṃ devadeveśaṃ nīlakaṇṭham athāstakaṃ || 2 || navamañ ca iśvaraṃ(!) nāma daśamaṃ pārvathīprīyaṃ(!) || rudram ekādaśaṃ nāma dvādaśaṃ śivam ucyate || 3 || ete dvādaśa nāmāni tṛśaṃdhyā(!) yaḥ paṭhe(!) naraḥ | goghnaś caiva kṛtaghnaś ca brahmahā gurutalpakaṃ(!) || 4 || strīvāraghātakaś cai⁅va śu⁆rāpo vṛṣaripatiḥ | śaranāgataghātañ ca mitraviśvāsaghātakaṃ || 5 || mucyate sarvvapāpebhyo(!) śivalokaṃ śa gacchati || || (fol. 3v10-4r3) Colophon iti skandapurāṇe śiva+++nāmastotraṃ samāptaḥ || || śubhaṃ || || (fol. 4r3-4)

Complete Text ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya namaḥ || bṛhaspatir uvāca || namo devādhidevāya tryambakāya kaparddine | tripuraghnāya śarvvāya namo ndhakanisūdane || virūpāyātirūpāya bahurūpāya śambhave | yajñavidhvaṃsakartte(!) ca yajñānāṃ phaldāyine || kālāntakāya kālāya kālibhogidharāya ca | namo brahmaśirohantre brahma..ya namo namaḥ || (fol. 69r4-5) Colophon iti bṛhaspatikṛtaṃ indrasya jīvadānaṃ nāma śivastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || śubhaḥ || (fol. 69r5-6)

Complete Text ❖ oṃ śivāya namaḥ || oṃ namaḥ śivāya śāktāya kāraṇatrayahetave | nivedayāmi cātmānaṃ tvaṅ gatiḥ parameśvaraḥ || 1 || anādivevadeveśa viśveśvara maheśvara | sarvvajñajñānavijñāna pradāneka(!) namo stu te || 2 || anantakāntisaṃpann anantāsanasasthitaḥ(!) | anantaśaktisaṃbhoga parameśa namo stu te || 3 || parāparaparātīta utpattisthitikāraṇa | sarvvārthasādhanopāya viśveśvara namo stu te || 4 || bahurūpamahārūpa sarvvarūpottamottama | paśupāśārṇṇavātīta varaprada namo stu te || 5 || svabhāvanirmmalābhoga sarvvavyāpi sadāśiva | yogayogimahāyogin yogeśvara namo stu te || jihvācapalabhāvena khedito si hi yan mayā | tat kṣantavyam anaupamya kas tvāṃ sto(?) nirgunārṇṇavaṃ || 8(!) || liṅgotpattim mahāpuṇyāṃ(!) yaḥ śṛṇoti naras sadā | notpadyate na saṃsāre sthānaṃ prāpnoti śāsvataṃ || tasmāt sarvvaprayatnena śṛṇuyād bhāvito naraḥ | pāpakañcukam utsṛjya prāpnoti paramaṃ padam || (fol. 69r6-69v2) Colophon iti śivadharmmaśāstre nandikeśvaraproktāyāṃ liṅgotpattistotraṃ samāptaṃ || || śubha śivaliṅgaprītir astu || || (fol. 69v2)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || tatheti kaśyapaś cokto saṃprasthāpya bṛhaspatiṃ || jagāmārccayitun devaṃ rudraṃ bhūtagaṇeśvaraṃ || tatra saumyaṃ mahātmānam ānarccya(!) vṛṣabhadhvajaṃ | varārthī kaśyapo dhīman adityā(!)sahitaḥ prabhuḥ || tuṣṭāva ca tam āsīnaṃ mārīcaḥ kaśyapas tadā | vedoktaiḥ sukṛtaiś caiva stavaiḥ stutyaṃ jagadguruṃ || || kaśyapa uvāca || gurukramaṃ viśvakarmmāṇam īśaṃ jagatsraṣṭāraṃ dharmmadṛśyaṃ vareṇyaṃ | tat sarvva(!) tvāṃ dhṛtimaddhāma divyaṃ viśveśvaraṃ bhagavantaṃ namasye || yo devām adhipaḥ pāpaharttā tataṃ viśvaṃ yena jagan mahatvāt | āyogarbbhā yasya śubhā dharitryo viśveśvaraṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye ||<ref> The metre in most of the stanzas is unclear and the meaning in many places, too. </ref> (fol. 69v2-6) <references/> Excerpt praśūnu(!) bhayo(!) prasthataś(!) ca sūkṣmāṃ pṛthagbhūte tyāna(?) pṛthak abhūtaḥ(!) | svayambhūtaḥ pātu māṃ sarvvasāraḥ padadhyānaḥ sampadaḥ pātu ratnaṃ || āsannaḥ sannataḥ sādhanānāṃ śraddhāvatāṃ śrāddhavṛttipraṇetā | patir ggaṇānāṃ mahatāṃ satkṛtīnāṃ pāpāntaikaḥ pūraṇaḥ sadguṇānāṃ || || antarbbahirvṛjinānāṃ nihantā nihantā svayaṃ karttā sūtabhāvī vikurvvan || dhṛtāyudhaḥ sukṛtīnām uttamaujāḥ praṇāyan me vṛjinan devadevaḥ | yenārddatās(!) traipurāmāyino vaidambaḥ(!) ghoreṇa vitathāntaḥ śareṇa | mahat kurvvatāṃ vṛjinaṃ devatānāṃ pāyād īśaḥ pātu viśvo dadhātā(?) || (fol. 70r9-70v2) End gamyatāṃ tatra dharmmajña dākṣāyaṇyā saha tvayā | adityā śakrasadanaṃ śreyase putrayā dhruvaṃ || iti haravacanaṃ niśamya vidvān kamalabhavātmajasunur aprameyaḥ | tridaśagaṇaguruṃ praṇamya rudraṃ muditamanāḥ svam adhaukasaṃ jagāma || (fol. 70v10-71r1) Colophon iti harivaṃśe pārijātaharaṇe kaśyapakṛtaṃ mahādevastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || śrīmahādevaprīti sarvvadā || || (fol. 71r1)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || || saṃpūjya tān tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛtvā snānam adhoktajaḥ(?) | udakañ ca grahārthāya bilvañ ca harir avyayaḥ || devam āvāhayām āsa rudraṃ sarvvesvareśvaraṃ | tataḥ prāpto mahādevaḥ somaḥ sa pravaro vibhuḥ || tasthāv upari bilvasya tathā gandhodakasya ca || taṃ pārijātakusumair arccayām āsa keśavaḥ || tuṣṭāva vāgbhir vviśveśaṃ sarvvakarttāram īśvaraṃ || rudro deva tvaṃ rodanād rāvanāc ca rorūyamāṇād rāvaṇāc cādidevaḥ | bhaktaṃ bhaktānāṃ vatsalaṃ vatsalānāṃ kīrttyā suddho śāvyaprabhavām antareṇa ||<ref> Pāda s b and d are unmetrical. With the reading rorūyāmāṇād pāda b would be correct . </ref> grāmy(!)āraṇyānāṃ tvaṃ patis tvaṃ paśūnāṃ khyāto devaḥ paśupatiḥ sarvvakarmmān | nānyas tvattaḥ paramo deva devo jagatpatiḥ suravīrārihantā ||<ref> Pāda a is written in a metre called Vaiśvadevī , the other pāda s differ slightly, with pāda b (maybe unintentionally) corresponding to the metre Vātormī. </ref> (fol. 71r1-5) <references/> End atrāntarddharaṇīdeśe tac cākramya mahābalāḥ | ete daityadurātmāno jagato lokakaṇṭakāḥ || channā vasanti govinda sānāv asya mahāgireḥ || avadhyā devadevānām ūreṇa(?) brahmaṇo nagha | mānuṣākaritas tasmā(!) tvam etān jahi keśava || evam uktvā mahādevas tatraivāntaradhīyata | pariṣvajya mahātmānaṃ vāsudevaṃ narādhipa || || (fol. 71v8-10) Colophon iti śrīharivaṃśe mahāviṣṇukṛtaṃ śrīmahādevastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || śrīsadāśivaśaṅkaraprīti || || (fol. 71v10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || || jaya vṛṣabhadhvaja hatamakaradhvaja puramathana pramathādhipa deva || deva trijagannātha triśaktinātha tridaśa namasya namasya namas te || 1 ||<ref> Pāda s a and c are unmetrical. </ref> jaya śaśiśeṣara surāpagādhara sarvvagate śarvveśa maheśa | śarvvānīśa(!) sarvvajagadīśa nīlakaṇṭha hara namo namas te || 2 || jaya juga(!)nāyaka maṅgaladāyaka maṅgaleśa caturānana rakṣa | raktārakta viṣakta vināsana viśvanātha viśvesa namas te || 3 ||<ref> In both stanzas above and in the one below the metre is unclear and every pāda is different. </ref> (fol. 71v10-72r2) <references/> End jaya bhūtādhipa bhūtivibhūṣita bhujaṃgarāja bhujabhūṣaṇa bhavya | bhaved bhīma tripurādhīśa triguṇa tryambaka nātha namas te || 11 || (fol. 72r8) Colophon iti śrīmahādevastotra sampūrṇṇam || śubhaḥ śivaprīti || || ( (fol. 72r8-9)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || || hemasiṃhāsanāsīnaṃ caturbbāhuṃ kirīṭinaṃ | pītāmbala(!)dharaṃ devaṃ śyāmalaṃbanamālinaṃ || sarvvasaubhāgyanilayaṃ nārāyaṇam anāmayaṃ || praṇamya śirasā rukmi[[nī]](!) idaṃ vacanam abrīt(!) || || rukmany(!) uvāca || devadeva jagannātha śaṃkha cakra gadādharaḥ | śivanāmāṣṭaśatakaṃ śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ prabhoḥ || || śrībhagavān uvāca || mahādevo(!) śivaḥ śambhuḥ śaṅkaro vṛṣavāhanaḥ | nīlakaṇṭhaś caturbbāhuś caturvvakras trilocanaḥ || mahānandī mahārudro mahākālo gaṇeśvaraḥ | umāmāyāmayaḥ saumyaḥ sarvvajñoḥ(!) bha(kta)vatsalaḥ || parvvatīramaṇaḥ siddhaḥ sāvvyo(!)<ref> or: sāddhyo </ref> nār[[ā]]yaṇapriyaḥ | (fol. 72r9-72v2) <references/> End bhūtanātho jagadyoniḥ bhasmaśāyī maheśvaraḥ || bhaktipriyo mahāyogī bhogī kalyāṇavān prabhuḥ || antarātmā svadhātmā ca vācaspatir ahaḥpatiḥ || sarvvapāpaharaś ceti nāmnāṃm(!) aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ || ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ nityam eva vā || japed aṣṭaśataṃ nāmnāṃ sadgatiṃ labhate naraḥ || trisaptakulam uddhṛtya rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || || (fol. 72v7-9) Colophon iti śrīpadmapurāṇe bhūmīkhaṇḍe śrībhagavand(!)rukminī(!)saṃvāde śrīmahādevādi aṣṭottaraśatan nāma sampūrṇṇa || || śrīīśvaraprīti || (fol. 72v9)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || viśveśvarāya narakārṇṇavatāraṇāya jñānapradāya karuṇāmṛtasāgarāya | karppūrakundadhavalāya jaṭādharāya dāridraduḥkhadahanāya namaḥ śivāya || 1 || gaurīpriyāya niśirājakalādharāya kālāntakāya bhujagādhipakaṅkaṇāya | gaṃgādharāya gajarājavimarddanāya dāridraduḥkhadahanāya namaḥ śivāya || 2 || bhaktapriyāya bhavarogabhayāpahāya divyāya divyavasanāya guṇārṇṇayāya(!) || tejomayāya nikhilāgamasaṃsthitāya dāridraduḥkhadahanāya namaḥ śivāya || 3 || (fol. 72v10-73r2) <references/> End muktāya yajñaphaladāya gaṇeśvarāya gītapriyāya vṛṣabheśvaravāhanāya || mātaṅgacarmmavasanāya maheśvarāya daridraduḥkhadahanāya namaḥ śivāya || 8 || vaśiṣṭhena kṛtaṃ stotraṃ sarvvarāganikṛntanaṃ | sarvvakāmapradan nṛṇāṃ hatyākoṭivināśanaṃ || goghnaś caiva surāpeya(!) strībālagurughātakaḥ | yaḥ paṭhet prayato bhaktyā śivasāyujyam āpnuyāt || (fol. 73r6-8) Colophon iti vaśiṣṭhakṛtaṃ śivāṣṭakaṃ sampūrṇṇaṃ || || śrīśaṅkaraprītir astu || || śubhaḥ || || (fol. 73r8-9)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || eko rudro na dvitīyo yatas tad brahmaivaikaṃ neha nānāsti kiñ cit || yady astv anyaḥ ko 'pi vā kutra cid vā ceṣṭāṃte<ref> Unmetrical, one syllable is missing. </ref> tasya śaktiḥ samagrā || 1 || yaḥ kṣīr[[ā]]bdher mmandarāghātajāto jvālāmālī kālakuṭo(!) tibhīmaḥ || taṃ śoḍhuṃ vā ⟪saḥ⟫ ko 'paro 'bhūn maheśād yat kīlābhiḥ kṛṣṇatām āpa viṣṇuḥ || 2 || (fol. 73r9-73v1) <references/> End nānyaṃ devaṃ vedmy ahaṃ śrīmaheśān nānyaṃ devaṃ staumi śambho[[. .]]te haṃ || nānyaṃ devaṃ cānamāmi tritrāt(?) satyaṃ satyaṃ satyam etan mṛṣā na || 8 ||<ref> Pāda c is unmetrical. </ref> itthaṃ yāvat stauti śambhuṃ maharṣis tāvan nandī śāmbhavādṛkprasādāt || tad dostambhaṃ tyaktavāṃś cāvabhāṣe smāyaṃ smāyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo namo vaḥ || 9 || (fol. 73v5-7) nandikeśvana(!) uvāca || idaṃ stavaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ vyāsena parikīrttitaṃ | yaḥ paṭhiṣyati medhāvī tasya tuṣyati śaṅkaraḥ || vyāsāṣṭakam idaṃ prātaḥ paṭhitavyaṃ prayatnataḥ | duḥsvapnapāpaśamanaṃ śivasāntidhyakārakaṃ || mātṛhā pitṛhā vāpi goghno bālaghna eva vā | surāpaḥ svarṇṇahṛd vāpi niḥpāpo 'syā stuter jjapāt || skanda uvāca || pārāśaryyas tadārabhya śambhuśaktiparo bhavat | liṅgaṃ vyāseśvaraṃ sthāpya ghaṃṭākarṇṇagra(dā)huteḥ(?) || etc. etc. vyāseśvaraḥ prapannena draṣṭavyaḥ kāśivāsibhiḥ || ghaṃṭākarṇṇakṛtasnānaiḥ kṣetrapātakabhīrubhiḥ || || (fol. 73v7-74r3) <references/> Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe kāśīkhaṇḍe vyāsabhujastambhano nāma pañcanavatitamo dhyāyaḥ || || stutikarttuṃ na jānāmi stutikarttā tvam eva hi | vācyas tvaṃ vācakas tvaṃ hi vākyaṃ tat praṇato smi te || nānyaṃ vesmi(!) mahādeva nānyaṃ staumi maheśvara | nānyaṃ jānāmi gaurīśa nānākhyāṃ ādade śiva || etc. etc. || || (fol. 73r3-6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || gaṃgātaraṃgaramaṇīyajaṭākalāpaṃ gaurīnirantaravibhūṣitavāmabhāgaṃ | nārāyaṇapriyam anaṅgamadāpahāraṃ vārāṇasīpurapatiṃ bhaja viśvanāthaṃ || 1 || vācām agocaram ameyaguṇapravāhaṃ vāgīśaviṣṇusurasevitapādapīṭhaṃ | vāmena vigrahabhareṇa kalatravantaṃ vārāṇaśīpurapatiṃ bhaja viśvanāthaṃ || 2 || (fol. 73r6-8) End śrīviśvanātha karuṇākara śūlapāṇe śaṃbho girīśa śiva śaṅkara candramaule || śrīnīlakaṇṭha madanāntaka viśvamūrtte gaurīpate mayi nidhehi kṛpākaṭākṣaṃ || 9 || vārāṇaśīpurapate stavam īśvarasya vyāsoktam aṣṭakam idaṃ paṭhate manuṣyaḥ || vidyāṃ śriyaṃ vipulakīrttim anantasaukhyaṃ saṃprāpya dehanilayaṃ labhate ca mokṣaṃ || || (fol.. 73v3-5) Colophon iti śrīvyāsakṛtaṃ viśvanāthāṣṭakaṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || || śrīviśvanāthaprīti || || (fol. 73v5-6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo vīreśvarāya || ekaṃ brahmaivādvitīyaṃ samastaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ neha nānāsti kiñ cit || eko rudro na dvitīyo vatasthe tasmād ekaṃ tvāṃ maheśa prapadye || 1 || eka[[ḥ]] karttā tvaṃ hi sarvvasya śambho nānārūpeṣv ekarūpo sy arūpa | yadvat pratya(hy a)rkka eko py anekas tasmād ekaṃ tvāṃ vineśa prapadye || 2 || rajjau sarppaḥ śuktikāyāñ ca rūpyaṃ te vaiḥ pūras(?) tan mṛgākhye marīcau || yadvat tatvad(!) viṣvage(!) (vā?) prapañco | yasmin jñāte taṃ prapadye maheśaṃ || 3 || (fol. 73v6-8) End tvattaḥ sarvvas tvāṃ hi sarvva(!) smarāre tvaṃ gaurīśas tvaṃ vanāgno tiśāntaḥ || tvaṃ vai vṛddhas tvaṃ yuvā tvaṃ hi bālas tat kiṃ ya(!) tvaṃ nānyatas tvāṃ nato smi || 8 || stuteti(!) bhūmau nipapāta vipraḥ sadaṇḍavatyācad(?) atīva hṛṣṭaḥ || tāvat sa bālo khila vṛddha vṛddhaḥ provāca bhūdeva varaṃ vṛṇīhi || 9 || tata utthāya hṛṣṭātmā munir vviśvānanaḥ kṛtī | pratyabravīt kim ajñātaṃ sarvvajñasya tava prabho || (fol. 74v2-3) etc. etc. abdaṃ japtam idaṃ stotraṃ putradaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | ity uktā(!)ntarddadhe bālaḥ so pi vipro gṛhaṃ gataḥ || || (fol. 74v9) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe kāśīkhaṇḍe indrāgnilokavarṇṇanaṃ nāma śrīvīreśvarastotra daśamo dhyāyaḥ || || śrīvereśvara(!)prītir astu || || (fol. 74r9-10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || || ādau karmmaprasaṅgāt kalayati kaluṣaṃ mātṛkukṣi[[sthi]]to haṃ , tan mūtramedhyama+ ⁅vyatha⁆yati vitarāṃ(!) jātharo(!) jātavedāḥ | yad yad vā tatra duṣkhaṃ prabhavati sutarāṃ śakyate kena vaktraṃ(!) , kṣantavyo me 'parādhaḥ śiva śiva śiva bhoḥ śrīmahādeva++ || 1 || bālye duṣkhātireko malarulitavapus stanyapāne pipāsā no śakyaṃś cendriyebhyo bhavaguṇajanitā jantavo mān tudanti | nānārogotthe duṣ++danaparavaśāc chaṃkaraṃ naḥ(!) smarāmi , kṣantavyo me || 2 ||<ref> Most of the last pāda is left out in the ms. because it is the same as in the stanza above (refrain) . </ref> (fol. 4r4-7) <references/> End karacaraṇakṛtaṃ vā karmma vā (kā)yajihvā-, śravaṇanayanajaṃ vā mānasa++rādhaṃ | vihitam apahitaṃ vā sarvvam etat kṣamethā , jaya jaya karuṇābdhe śrīmahāśaṃbho || 18 ||<ref> Two syllables are missing in pāda d. </ref> aparādho bhavaty eva sevakasya pade pade | kopaṃ ca kṣamyatāṃ deva kevalaṃ svāminaṃ vinā || bhūmau skharitapāpānāṃ bhūmir evāvilambanaṃ | tvayi jātāparādhatvaṃ tvam eva śaraṇaṃ mama || ○ || || (fol. 5r7-9) <references/> Colophon iti śaṅkarācā⁅ryyav⁆iracitaṃ aparādhastotraṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || || (fol. 5r10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || bhārggava uvāca || tvaṃ bhābhir ābhir abhibhūya tamaḥ samastam astaṃ nayaty abhima(!) niśācarāṇāṃ || dedīpyase suvimale gagaṇe hitāya lokatraya(!) jagadīśvara tan namas te || 1 ||<ref> One syllable is missing in pāda b and one in pāda d . </ref> stoketi velam ativelam aho mahobhir nnirmmāsi kaumudam udañcaṃ samut samudraṃ || vidrāvitākhilatamāḥ sutamāṃ himāṃśoḥ pīyūṣapūraparipūritatan(!) namas te || 2 || (fol. 74r10-74v2) <references/> End ātmasvarūpa tava rūpa paramparābhir ābhis tataṃ haravarāvararūpam etat || sarvvāntarātmanila(!) pratirūparūpa nityaṃ nato smi paramātmatano ṣṭamūrtte || 8 || (fol. 74v7 ity aṣṭamūrttibhir imābhir(!) umābhivandya vandyābhivandya tava viśvajanīnamūrtte || eta(!) stutaṃ suvitataṃ praṇatapraṇīta sarvvārtha sārthaparamārtha tato nato smi || aṣṭamūrtte ṣṭakeneṣṭaṃ parituṣṭeti bhārggavaḥ || bharggyabhūmimilanmauliḥ praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ || iti stuto mahādevo bhārggavenātitejasā | utthāya bhūmer bbāhubhyāṃ dhṛtvā taṃ praṇataṃ dvijaṃ || uvāca daśanajyotsnāpratidyotidigantaraṃ | anenātyugratapasā hy ananyācaritena ca || liṃgasthājpanapuṇyena liṃgasyārādhanena ca | citraratnopahāreṇa śucinā niścalena ca || (fol. 74v7-75r1) etc. etc. tvaddine śukra kūpe ye kṛtasarvvodakaḥ kriyāḥ | vyayate vighnās te sarvve janāḥ syuḥ sukhavāsinaḥ | (fol. 75r8-9) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe kāśīkhaṇḍe bhārggavena kṛtaṃ śrīmahādevastotraṃ sampūrṇṇaṃ || śubhaḥ || śrīmahādevaprīti bhavati || || (fol. 75r9-10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || śrīrāmovāca(!) || deva prapannārttihara prasīda prasīda viśveśvara pāhi viśvaṃ | prasīda gaṃgādhara candramaule māṃ trāhi saṃsārabhayād anāthaṃ || tvatto hi jātaṃ jagad edīśa(!) tvayy eva bhūtāni vasanti nityaṃ | tvayy eva śaṃbho vilayaṃ prayānti bhūmau yathā vṛttalatādayo pi || brahmendrarudrāś ca marudgaṇāś ca gandharvvayakṣāsurasiddhasaṃjñāḥ | gaṃgādinadyo varuṇālayāś ca vaśanti(!) bhūristavavaktram ete || (fol. 75r10-75v2) End dadarśa pañcavadanaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ trilocanaṃ | vyāghracarmmaparīdhānaṃ bhūtibhūṣitavigrahaṃ || phaṇikaṃkaṇabhūṣā(ḍhyaṃ) nāgayajñopavītinaṃ | vyāghracarmmottarīyañ ca udyatpiṃgajaṭādharaṃ || ekākinaṃ candramauliṃ varaṇyam(!) abhayapradaṃ | caturbhujaṃ khaṇḍaparaśuṃ mṛgahastaṃ jagatpatiṃ || athājñāya puras tasya praṇamyopavi(!) śeśi(!) saḥ | athāha rāmaṃ deveśo yad yat pṛṣṭum(!) abhīpsyasi || tat sarvvaṃ pṛccha rāma tvaṃ matto nānyo sti te guruḥ || || (fol. 76r3-6) Colophon iti śrīpadmapurāṇe śivagītāyāṃ viśvarūpadarśane rāmakṛtaṃ śrīmahādevastotraṃ sampūrṇṇaṃ || || śrīviśveśvaraprīti || || (fol. 76r6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || hara śaṃbho mahādeva viśveśāmaravarllabhā(!) | śiva śakara(!) sarvvātma nnīlakaṇṭha(!) namo stu te || mṛtyuñjayāya rudrāya nīlakaṇṭhāya śaṃbhave | amṛtīśāya sarvvāya(!) mahādevāya te namaḥ || ṛṇarogādi dāridraṃ(!) pāpaṃ kṣudaya(?)mṛtyava(!) | bhayaśokamanastāpa(!) naśyantu mama sarvvadā || || śubham astu || ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || ❖ oṃ gaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ namaḥ śivāya || sūta uvāca || vyapoha[[na]]stavam vakṣye sarvvasiddhipradaṃ śubhaṃ | nandinaś ca mukhāc chrutvā kumāreṇa mahātmanā || vyāsāya kathitaṃ tasmād bahumānena vai śrutaṃ | namaḥ śivāya śraddhāya nirmmalāya yaśasvine || duṣkhāntakāya(!) sarvvāya(!) bhavāya paramātmane | pañcapaktro(!) daśabhujo hy a(kṣa)pañcadaśair yutaḥ || śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaiḥ sarvvaratnavibhūṣitaḥ | sarvvajñas sarvvagaśāntas sarvvopari saṃsthitaḥ(!)<ref> unmetrical </ref> | (fol. 76r7-76v1) <references/> End hastā citrā tathā svātī viśākhā cānurādhikā | jyeṣṭhā mūlā mahābhāgā pūrvvāṣāḍhā tathaiva ca || uttarāṣāḍhakā(!) caiva śravaṇā ca śraviṣṭhikā | śatabhiṣā pūrvvabhādrā tathā prauṣṭhapadā śubhā || pauṣṇā ca devyas satataṃ vyapohantu malaṃ mama | jvaraḥ kuṇḍodaraś caiva śaṅkukarṇṇo mahābalaḥ || mahākarṇṇaḥ prabhūtaś ca mahābhūtapra° (fol. 78v5-6)

Beginning ❖ pīṭhaṃ yasyā dharitrī jaladharakalaśaṃ liṃgam ākāśamūrttiṃ nakṣatraṃ puṣpamālā grahe gaṇakusumaṃ netracandrārkkavahniṃ | kukṣau sapte samudrā bhujagiriśiṣaraṃ saptapātālamūlaṃ<ref> in the margin: °pādaṃ </ref> vedaṃ vaktraṃ sa<ref> in the margin: ṣa° </ref>ḍaṅgaṃ daśadiśavadanaṃ divyaliṃgaṃ namāmi || || śivaprītir astu (oṃ) nīlakaṇṭhāya namaḥ || kathaṃ tad utthitaṃ ghoraṃ , viṣaṃ sūryyāyutaprabhaṃ | kathaṃ pītaṃ bhagavatā śaṃkareṇāmitojasā || kathaṃ ca devadevasya , kaṇṭhe kundendusaprabhe | nīlavarṇṇaḥ samutpanne , etad icchāmi vedituṃ || || sanatkumāra uvāca || pravṛtte jyotiṣāṃ cakre , madhyaṃ prāpte divākare | devatā niyatātmānaḥ sarvve tiṣṭhanti tāṃ kalāṃ || niyamāś ca samāpyante tasmin kāle divaukasāṃ | teṣāṃ madhyagato vāyuḥ prāṇināṃ jīvitodbhavaḥ || (fol. 5r10-5v4) <references/> End tathā stavavariṣṭho yaṃ , stavānāṃ brahmanirmmitaḥ | yaś caitac chrāvayec chrāddhe brāhmaṇān pādam antataḥ || akṣayyam anupānam vai pitṛbhyaś copatiṣṭhate | manasā cintitaṃ yac ca yac ca vāco nukīrttitaṃ || sarvva(!) sampadyate tasya stavasyāsyānukīrttanāt | śrutvait(!) paraṃ guhyaṃ ye pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ || striyaḥ śūdrāś ca ye pīha rudralokaṃ vrajanti te || || (fol. 9r8-10) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe 'mṛtamathane nīlakaṇṭhastavaḥ samāptaḥ || ○ || yad akṣarapadabhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnañ ca yad bhavet | tat sarvvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ deva kasya .. niśvaraṃ(?) mamaḥ(!) || || śrīnīlakaṇṭhaprīti || || (fol. 9v1-2) (6669)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śivāya || || nandikeśvara uvāca || ataḥ param idaṃ guhyaṃ rudrodgītam mahodayaṃ | mahāvighnapraśamanaṃ mahāśāntikaraṃ śubham || akālamṛtyuśamanaṃ sarvvavyādhinivāraṇam | paracakrapramathanaṃ sarvvavijayavarddhanam || sarvvadevagrahānīkaṃ samabhīṣṭaphalapradam | sarvvaśā⟪..⟫ntyadhikārākhyaṃ dharmmaṃ vakṣyāmi śāsvatam || śaśāṅkārddhadharas (tyakṣo)(?) nāgajñopavītakaḥ(!) || caturmmukhaś caturbbāhuḥ śitabhasmāvaguṇthitaḥ || varo vareṇyo varado devadevo maheśvaraḥ | trailokyanamitaḥ śrīmān śāntimāśukarāndra(?) me || (fol. 9v2-5) End tat puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ prāpnoti śravaṇād iha | daśānāṃ rājasūyānāṃm(!) agniṣṭomaśatasya ca || śravaṇāt phalam āpnoti koṭikoṭiguṇottara(!) | avadhyaḥ sarvvadevānāṃm(!) anyeṣāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || jīve(!) varṣaśata(!) sāgraṃ sarvvavyādhivivarjitaḥ | go⁅ghna⁆ś caiva kṛtaghnaś ca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ || saranāgataghātī ca mitravisrambhaghātakaḥ | duṣṭapāpasamācāro mātṛhā pitṛhā tathā || śravaṇād asya bhāvanaṃ mucyate sarvvapātakaiḥ || sāntyadhyāyam idaṃ puṇyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasya cit || śivabhaktāya dātavyaṃ śivena kathitaṃ purāḥ || ○ || (fol. 17r3-6) Colophon iti śivadharmmasāstre śānty[[kā]]dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 17r6-7)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śivāya || || himāṃsugaṃgāparibhūṣaṇāya kṛśānucandrārkkatrilocanāya | yakṣendranāgāsuravanditāya śrīnīlakaṇṭhāya nama(!) stu nityaṃ || 1 || manobhavasyāṅgavilocanāya cakrīphalā(?)kuṇḍalamandarāya | śilātmajāvaktravilocanāya śrīnīlakaṇṭhāya nama(!) stu nityaṃ || 2 || khaṭvāṅgabrahmāśiradhāraṇāya vibhūtisarvvāṅgavilepanāya | triśūlaśastrākṣadharāyavāya(?) śrīnīlakaṇṭhāya nama(!) stu nityaṃ || 3 || (fol. 17r7-9) End trailokyapuṣpā(ṃ)jalipūjitāya jyotisvarūpāya surādhipāya | rogādiduḥkhā(!) bhayanāśanāya śrīnīlakaṇṭhāya nama(!) stu nityaṃ || 7 || śrīnīlakaṇṭhāṣṭakam ātmaśuddhe paṭhanti mānuṣyavicakṣaṇenaḥ(!) | prātaḥ sadā kālaśivālaye vā gacchanti lokaṃ khalu dehamu(ktā)n(!) || ○ || (fol. 17v2-4) Colophon iti śrīnīlakaṇṭhāṣṭaka(!) samāptaḥ || || śubham astu || || (fol. 17v4)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śivāya || ity evaṃ pañcadhā vittaṃ bhāvayitvā yajec chivaṃ | iṣṭā(!) tu parayā bhaktyā bhagavantaṃ maheśvaraṃ || kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā stotram etad udīrayet || namas te jñānarūpāya sarvvajñānaikahetave | jñānāya jñānaśuddhāya nityaṃ jñānāya te namaḥ || sūkṣmāya sūkṣmarūpāya sūkṣmajñānaikahetave | sūkṣmāṇām api sūkṣmaya(!) nama(!) sūkṣmatamāya te || divyānām api divyāya divyajñānaikahetave | divyāya divyarūpāya divyarūpaikahetave || divyānām api divyāya namo divyatamāya te || (fol. 17v4-7) End ajitāya namas tubhya(!) bhasmāṅgāya namo stu te | sarvvajñāya namas tubhyaṃ anāthāya namo stu te || avyaktāya namas tubhyaṃ śāśvatāya namo stu te | sarvvajñāya namas tubhyaṃm(!) ajñānāya namo stu te || sarvvārthāya namas tubhyaṃm(!) anarthāya namo stu te | anantāya namas tubhyaṃ sarvvagāya namo stu te || iti stavena divyena ya stunoti maheśvaramḥ(!) | sa vidhūyāśu pāpāni rudraloke mahīyate || bhogārthī labhate bhogān rā(jyā)rthī rājyam āpnuyāt | kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ yogārthī yogam āpnuyāt || mucyate vyādhibhir vyādhī duḥkhī duḥkhāt pramucyate | bandhanā(!) mucyate baddho yaśorthī yasam(!) āpnuyāt || yān yān cintayati kāmān tān tān prāpnoti bhāvinaḥ | śaivaṃ padam avāpnoti nityaṃ paṭhati yo naraḥ || || (fol. 18v3-7) Colophon iti śivadharmmaśāstre | śrīmaheśvarastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 18v7)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śivāya || yadā dāruṇā bhāṣaṇā bhīṣaṇā me vadiṣyaṃty upānte kṛtāntasya dūtāḥ | tadā manmathas tvatpadāmbhoruhasthaṃ(!) kathaṃ niścaraṃ(!) syān namas te stu śambho || 1 || yadā dunnirvvāra(!)vyatho haṃ śayāno ruṭhan nistaraṃ niṣkṛto vyaktavāṇī | tadā jahnukanyājalālaṃkṛtaṃn(!) te jaṭāmaśulaṃ(?)<ref> unmetrical </ref> manmano mandiraṃ syāt || 2 || yadā pāram asmā⟪dya⟫d yamasthānamahir jjanair vvā vihīnam gamiṣyāmi dūraṃ tadā tan niruddhaṃ kṛtāntasya mārggaṃ mahādeva mahyaṃ manojñaṃ prayaccha || 3 || (fol. 18v8-10) <references/> End mahādeva śambho girīśa triśūlīn(!) tvadīyaṃ samastaṃ vibhātīti yasmāt | śivād anyathā daivataṃ no hi jāne tasmāc chivo haṃ śivo haṃ śivo haṃ || 14 || anena stave(n ā)darād ambikeśaṃ parāṃ bhaktim ātanvato ye namanti | nṛtau nirbhayās te lasantaṃ bhajante hṛdāmbhojamadhye samāsīnam īśaṃ || 15 || (fol. 19r9-19v1) Colophon iti śaṅkarācāryyaviracitaṃ śivabhujaṅgaprayātaṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || || śivaprītir astu sarvvadā || śubha || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || (fol. 19v1-2)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śivāya || saurāṣṭradeśe vasudhāvakāśe jyotirmayaṃ cendra(!)kalāvataṃsaṃ || bhaktivrajānāṃ kṛpayā vitīrṇṇaṃ taṃ somanāthaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye || 1 || avantikāyāṃ vihitāvatāraṃ muktipradānāya ca sajjanānāṃ || akālamṛtt(!)<ref> one syllable is missing </ref>uparikṣaṇārthaṃ vande mahākālam ahaṃ sureśaṃ || 2 || pravetti me paryalikābhidhāne sadāvasannaṃ girijāsametaṃ || surāsurārādhitapādapadmaṃ śrīvaidyanāthaṃ tam ahaṃ namāmi || 3 || kāmarikā(!) narmadayā pavitre samāgame sajjanatāraṇā yaḥ || sa devam ā⟪dyā⟫dhāya(!)<ref> one syllable too many </ref> tripure vasantam oṅkāram īśaṃ tam ahaṃ namāmi || 4 || (fol. 19v2-5) <references/> End etāni<ref> one syllable too many </ref> dvādaśaṃ(!) liṃgāni prātaḥ prātaḥ paṭhen naraḥ || sa kadā cin na saṃkaṣṭaiḥ pīḍyate kṛpayā haraḥ || 13 || jyotirmmayaṃ dvādaśaliṃgakānāṃ śivātmajeṇoktam idaṃ tu tena || stotraṃ paṭhe<ref> one syllable is missing </ref> manujo tibhaktyā phalaṃ tadā loke nijaṃ labhet saḥ || 14 || <references/> Colophon iti śrīmatsaṃkarācāryyaviracitaṃ dvādaśajjotir(!)mayaṃ liṃgakānāṃ stotraṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 20r3-4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīvāgmatyai nama(!) || brahma piśācuḍaṃ(?) || nābhikuṇḍe samut(!)bhūte rudrakaṇṭhād vinisṛte || vāgmatīn(!) niśṛtā devī jalamūrtyai namo 'stu te || 1 || rudracyūḍā(!)mane(!) bhūte yogeśvari prapāvinī manamatī(!) trīvi(kha)+ +++rtyai nama(!) stu te || 2 || (fol. 1v1-5) End vāgmatī śiva gaṃgeje(!) śīva(!) brahma sarasvatī | yo brūyā(!) devi tatra sa nityapāpaharāmpahaṃ(!) || 19 || (fol. 4v2-4) Colophon iti śrīskaṇḍa(!)purāne(!) hemavat(!)vaṃde śaṃṣamūlastudatvā(!) ca sarvakarmāni(!) prasiddhyaṃti na śaṃsaya(!) ti (!) samāptaṃ śubhm || ślokayekāgra(!) taṃtrasya || tāṃmrakhaṇḍacayoḍbhaveṭ(!) || yad akṣarapada(!) bhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnaṃ ya yoḍbhaveṭ(!) taṭ(!) sarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ devī prasiddhaparameśvara || śubhm || ❁ (fol. 4v4-5r6)

(fol. 10v3-6)
