Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīsūryyāya namaḥ || || atha śuklapa(2)kṣeṣu daśādityavidhir vrata liṣyante || brāhmaṇasya agre pītacūrṇe(3)na dvādaśadalapadmaṃ liṣet || tasya vāme paṃcabali || dakṣe svasti'(4)kalaśa sthāpayet || liṣyopari dhānya āsanaṃ nidhāya || kamalo(5)tpari tāmrapātre śrīsūryyapratimā sthāpya || devasya pṛṣṭe pañcāyana(6) ca || kalasya(!) dakṣa pārśve gogrāsa sthāpya || (exp. 21t1-6) End oṃ timiranāsine namaḥ || mālāsvāṃ || mā(2)lāpuṣpa sugaṃdha ca nānājāti samanvitaṃ || mayā datta hi pūjāṃ ca gṛhyaṃ (3) parameśvarau || durvākṣata paraṃ divyaṃ sarvapūṣpotamotamaṃ prasīda devadevesa(4) gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara || durvā||kṣata || (exp. 30b1-4) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || saptāśvaratham āruḍho(!) aruṇo sārathittamaḥ (!) || śvetapadmadharaṃ devaṃ tva(!)ṃ sūryya[ṃ] praṇamāmy ahaṃ || 1 || baṃdhu(!)kapuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ hāraku⟨ṃ⟩ṇḍalabhūṣitaṃ || ekacakradharaṃ devaṃ tva(!)ṃ sūrya[ṃ] praṇamāmy ahaṃ || 2 || lohitaṃ sarvasaṃkāśaṃ sarvalokapitāmya(!)haṃ || sarvavyādhiharaṃ devaṃ tva(!)ṃ sūryya[ṃ] praṇamāmy ahaṃ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End koṭiti(!)rthakṛtaṃ snānaṃ viṃśabra(!)hmā(!)ṇabhojanaṃ || kurukṣetrakṛtaṃ dānaṃ ttva(!)ṃ sūryya[ṃ] praṇamāmy ahaṃ || 14 || ekabhaktrikṛto bhāvopoṣitaṃ ravivāsare || vyādhikūṣṭa[ṃ] na drāridraṃ sūryyalokaṃ sa gacchati || 15 || (fol. 2v6–3r3) Colophon iti sūryyastotram samāptaṃ śubham śāke 1771 māse 10 pakṣe 2 vāre 1 liṣitaṃ balabhadra upādhyāya(!) śubham astu śubhaṃ || = || =|| = || = || = || = || = || = || (fol. 3r3–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || sarasvatyai namaḥ sagoṇa, kaumāri, gogrāsa, gaṇeśa, paṃcabali, rāṣanu, draskaṃ, śidhramu, bhayā devapratimā, na bhayā thaṇḍīla banāunu<ref name="ftn1"> These lines are written in antiquated Nepali. </ref>, dharmmavaratastrīṇā(!) saṃkalpaṃ kuryyāt, adhyetyādi, māghaśuklapūrṇimāyāṃ bhartur āyur vṛddhipūrvakānekasvargasukhaprāptikāmā svasthānīvratakarmāhaṃ kariṣye, tato(!) pūjāsaṃkalpaṃ kārayet, adya pūrvasaṃkalpavākyasiddhir astu yathāvidhi,kalaśārcanaṃ kārayet, (fol. 1v1–6) End āyur yyaso stu satataṃ priyam astu nityaṃ pūjādi[[putra]]pautrakulavṛddhi[ṃ] karotuṃ(!)my(!) ahaṃ || nirāra(!)stu śari(!)ra(!)stu supuṇi(!)tasyā prasannadevī rahajanmani mokṣyakānte ||<ref name="ftn2"> This stanza is unmetrical. </ref> ... kalaśābhiṣeka, caṃdanādi, sagunādi-āsi(!)rvādaḥ gaṇeśa,gogrāsādi,kaumāriviśarjanam, baliviśarjanam, sarveṣāṃ puṣpaṃ dadyāt ñāṁhā deṣi phalāhāra garnu (fol. 9v8–10r2 and 10r4–6) Colophon iti svasthāni(!)vratapūjāvidhi[ḥ] samāptā(!) śubhaṃ bhūyāt iti śrīśāke 1790 samvat 1925 sāla phāguṇaśudi 7 roja 5 mā liṣitaṃ midaṃ pustkaṃ śrī3balabhadra-upādhyā luñiṁṭyāl śubham rāmaḥ rāmaḥ rāmaḥ rāma[ḥ] (fol. 10r6–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama[ḥ] || || ya[ṃ] bra⟨ṃ⟩hmavedāṃtavido vadaṃtī(!) paraṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ tatho(!)nye || viśvat(!)gateḥ kāraṇam īsvaraṃ vā tasmai namo vighnavighātakāya || 1 || vimalakanakavarṇaṃ pūrṇalakṣmīpradaṃtaṃ gajamukham aruṇākṣaṃ caṃcala⟨t⟩[ṃ] karṇayugmaṃ || bhramaravarasupu(!)jyaṃ raktavastraṃ surejyaṃ paśupatisutam īśaṃ naumi sarvvārthasidhyai || 2 || vāgīśādyāḥ sumanasaḥ sarvvārthānām upakrame || yaṃ natvā kṛtakṛtyā syū(!)[ḥ] tan namāmi gajānana⟨ṃ⟩m || 3 || oṁ asya śrīvighnesvarāṣṭottarasatanāmastotrasya īśvara ri(!)ṣir anuṣtup chando vighnesvarodevatā mama sarvārthasidhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || || oṁ vināyako vighnarājo gaṇeśaḥ pāpanodanaḥ || gajānano mahākāyo mahātejojayadyutiḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2r1) End bhaktavatsala[ḥ] śarvveśa[ḥ] sarvvalokaikanāyakaḥ || nāmnām asto(!)ttarasataṃ sarvvadevaiś ca sammitaṃ || 15 || purāṇe ca bhaviṣye tu dhṛtaṃ yasyā (!) sunirmmitaṃ || ye paṭhaṃti narāḥ bhaktyā trisaṃdhyaṃ ca samāhitā[ḥ] || 16 || teḥ(!) sarvvaiḥ (!) prāpnuyād iṣṭaṃ acirān nātra saṃśayaḥ || ye(!)kakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ vāpi ye ⟨n⟩narāḥ || ṣaṇmāsāṃ(!) labhate siddhiṃ vatsarān nātra śaṃsaya[ḥ] || 17 || (fol. 2v7–3r4) Colophon iti bhaviṣyottarapurāṇe vighnesvarāṣṭottaraśatanāmastotram || 1 || || || śrī || || (fol. 3r4–5)

Beginning śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || sekaḥ saṃkalpagāyatrīdevatābhyajapāśanaṃ || āvāhanaṃ vikīraṇaṃ japo rghān pu(!)(ja)naṃ tathā || 1 || gaṃdhādir maṇḍalaṃ cāgnau karaṇaṃ svāmine baliḥ || pariveṣo madhujapaḥ mātram ālabhyam utsṛjet 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End savyaṃ kṛtvā || ācamya || oṁ prāṇāya(!)mya || oṁ pramātā(!)t kurvatāṃ karma pratyavetādhvareṣu yat || || smaraṇād eva tadviṣṇoḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ syādhi(!)ti śrutiḥ iti paṭhitvā karmapūrṇatārthaṃ viṣṇuṃ smaret || śrāddhīyavastūni brāhmaṇāya pratipādayet || tato balivaiśvadevakarma⟪ṇa⟫ kuryyā⟨⟨‥⟩⟩d iti || || (fol. 11v5–8) Colophon eṣa⟨ḥ⟩ pārvaṇaśrāddhavidhiḥ || || || || śrīśāke 16||97 kārtikavadi 5 tithau 5 liṣitaṃ pustakaṃ remeśvara(!) liṣitaṃ || ṭi(!)kārāmaśarmaṇe paṭhanārthaṃ || śubhaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ⟨ḥ⟩ || (fol. 11v8–9)

Beginning tvām ahaṃ vṛṇe oṁ vṛto smīti prativacanam || yathāvihitaṃ karma kuru, yathājñānaṃ karavāḥi, || oṁ adyāmukagotrasyāmukanāmaśarmmaṇa(!) yajamānasyāmukakarmaṇi tadaṃgatayā dīpakalaśagaṇeśapūjanapūrvakaṃ rakṣyāḍorapūjanam ahaṃ kariṣye, || atha dīpapūjā, || namos tv anantāya iti maṃtreṇa , || atha kalaśapūjā, || bhūrasi(!)ti maṃtreṇa bhūmiṃ saṃsodhya, vedyā i(!)śānadeśe dhānyam asi(!)ti dhānyaṃ saṃsthāpya || (fol. 2r1–7) End brāhmaṇasya śarmānntaṃ, || kṣatriyasya varmāntam , || vaiśyasya guptāntam || śudrasya dāsāntam || nāma vety avadhāryaṃ strīṇā[ṃ] devyantam , || nāmeti cāturvarṇyasādhāraṇam, || || (fol. 12r9–12v3) Colophon iti ābhyudayikaśrāddhaḥ || || śubham astu || śrīr astu śrīśāke 1780 śrīsamvat 1915 sāla caitravadi 14 roja 7 mā liṣitam idaṃ pustakaṃ śrī3balabhadraupādhyāya[ya]luñiṁṭyāla bhīrpānivasati śubham brāhmasi (!) 1 māheśvary asi 2 kaumāry asi 3 vaiṣṇavy asi 4 vārāhy asi 5 indrāny asi 6 cāmuṃḍāsi 7 (fol. 12v3–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrībhairavāya namaḥ || oṁ ātmatattvāya namaḥ || oṁ vidyātattvāya namaḥ || oṁ śivatattvāya svāhā || oṁ āṁ ādhāraśaktyādibhyo namaḥ ity ādhara[ṃ] saṃpūjya || phaḍ iti tālatrayeṇa śirovyaṣṭanaṃ kṛtvā || apasarpetu<ref name="ftn1"> for apasarpantu </ref> te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhūvi saṃsthitā || ye bhūtā vighnakarttāras te naśyaṃtu śivājñayā || iti digbaṃdhanaṃ kṛtvā || || (fol. 1v1–2r1) End aparādha(!) bhavaty eva (se)vakasya pade pade || ko [ʼ]para[ḥ] sahate loke kevalaṃ svāminaṃ vinā || iti puṣpāṃjali[ṃ] datvā || saṃhāramudrayā hṛdaye viliṣya || ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ kṛtvā ācamya namaskāraṃ kuryāt || tato devatām utthāpya prasādaṃ dhṛtvā yathāsukhena viharet || ❁ || (fol. 18v5–19r4) Colophon iti śrībaṭukabhairavārcanavidhi[ḥ] samāpta⟨m⟩[ḥ] śubham || ❁ || samvat 1943 sāla caitrasuklapaurṇamasi bhṛguvāsare ⟨na⟩ likhitaṃ śubham || ❁ || (fol. 19r4–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atra ṣaṣṭyā(!)bdānāṃ madhye amukanāmasaṃvatsare śrīsūryye dakṣiṇāyaṇe(!) varṣā-ṛtau bhādrapadamāse śuklapakṣe paṃcam⟨yā⟩yāṃ puṇyatithau siṃharāśisthite bhāskare mukarāśisthite cā(!)ṃdramasi [a]mukarāśisthite devagurau yathānāmagotrāya mama⟨ḥ⟩ | (fol. 1v1–3) End nyu(!)nāni rikātāni parisphuṭāni yāni(!)ha karmāṇi pū(!)rā kṛtāni tāni(!)ha sarvāṇi mama⟨ḥ⟩ kṣidhaṃ<ref name="ftn1"> Pāda c is unmetrical. </ref> tuṣṭā sadā saṃtu mai(!) dvijesā iti kṣamāpana(!)ṃ || eva[ṃ] saṃpūjya viśvai (!) bhaktiyuktena cetasā teṣām agratame(!) veda śrotavyaṃ ca kathānakaṃ || || (fol. 2v7–9) Colophon iti ṛṣipaṃcami(!)vratapūjāvidhi samāpta[ḥ] śubham (‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥) (fol. 2v9–10)

Beginning bhyaś ca || kṛmṛdṛruhibhya⟨ṃ⟩ś cha[ṃ]dasi | ciṇ te padaḥ | 3 || dīpajanabudhapūritāyipyāyibhyo [ʼ]nyatarasyāṃ | acaḥ karma karttari | (fol. 9r1–2) End halo yamāṃ yami lopaḥ || 5 || jharo jhari savarṇe || 6 || udāttād anudāttasya svaritaḥ || 7 || nodāttasvaritodayam agārgyakāśyapagālavānāṃ || 8 || a a || 9 || (fol. 50v5–6) Colophon ity aṣṭamo dhyāyaḥ samāptam a(!)likhitaṃ kāsīmadhye || gaṃgāsamīpe subhasthāne || †kvā†ramāse suka(!)lapakṣe || saniścarabāre || tithai(!) ta(!)yodasyāṃ || śrīrām (fol. 50v6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kaṇṭhe yasya virājate hi garalaṃ śīrṣe ca mandākinī vāmāṅge gīrirājarājatanayā jāyā bhavānī satī || nandiskandagaṇādhirājasahitaḥ śrīviśvanāthaḥ prabhuḥ kāśīmandirasaṃsthito khila gurur deyāt sadāmaṅgalam || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End vighnāvāsanivārakāraṇamahāgaṇḍasthalālambitaḥ siṃdūrāruṇatuṇḍacandrakiraṇapracchāditāṃga (fol 2v3–4) sa nottamagato śrūyāt paṭhed vā yadi kāśīvāsa- sukhāny avāpya satataṃ pīto bhaved dhūrjaṭe[ḥ] || 23 || || (exp. 3b ll. 1–2) Colophon iti [śrī]macchaṅkarācāryaviracitaṃkāśi(!)viśve[[svara]]stotraṃ samāptam || śubham || viśve || śrī (exp. 3b ll. 2–3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || dālabhya uvāca || || bhagavan prāṇinaḥ sarve viṣarogādyupadravaiḥ || duṣṭagrahopaghātaiś ca sarvakālam upadrutāḥ || 1 || a(!)bhicārikakṛtyābhi sparśarogaiś ca dāruṇaiḥ || sadā saṃpīḍyamānās tu tiṣṭhanti munisattama(!)ḥ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–2) End viṣnubhakto viśeṣeṇa śucis tadgatamānasaḥ || viṣṇoḥ prītikaraṃ stotraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 18 || paṭhed vā śṛṇuyād vāpi viṣṇo[ḥ] mahātmyam uttamaṃ || manasā ciṃtitaṃ kāryaṃ labhate nātra śaṃśaya[ḥ] || 19 || (fol. 11r4–7) Colophon iti śrīviṣṇudharmmottare ʼpāmārjanastotraṃ samāptaṃ śubham || || śrīśāke 1703 samvat 1837 || śubham || || || || || || || (fol. 11r7–9)

Beginning lokagamanārthaṃ vatsatarīsahitaṃ vṛṣotsargam ahaṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryyāt tataḥ uttarābhimukhaṃ brāhmaṇam upaveśya adyāmukagotrasyāmukapretasya kartavyavṛṣotsargāṃgabhūtahomakarmaṇi kṛtākṛtāve(kṣaṇa)rūpabrahmakarma kartu⟨ṃ⟩m amukagotram aukaśarmāṇaṃ brāhmaṇam ebhiś caṃdanapūgīphalapuṣpākṣatavāsobhi[r] brahmatvena tvām ahaṃ vṛṇe iti brāhmaṇaṃ vṛṇuyāt vṛto smi(!)ti prativacanam yathāvihitaṅ karma kuru iti yajamānas tam uddiśya vadet karavāṇīti prativacanam (fol. 22r1–5) End athādhikāriṇaḥ || sarvatra dāhapiṇḍādi apatitādi je(!)ṣṭha aurasaḥ putra[ḥ] kuryyāt, tadasannidhau kaniṣṭhaḥ teṣā[ṃ] sarveṣām asaṃnidhau pautro je(!)ṣṭhaputrapautrādikrameṇa tadbhāve tathaiva prapautraḥ eṣām abhāve putrikāputrādayaḥ putrākrameṇa tadabhāve tatputrādayaḥ pūrvavat uktābhāve patnī evaṃ uktādyabhāve patnyā bharttā tadabhāve sapatnī patnyā(!)bhāve bhrātṛputraḥ bhrātā snuṣā duhitā dauhitraḥ anyaḥ sagotraḥ sapiṇḍaḥ sabra (fol. 56v7–11) Colophon No colophon is there.

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha du(!)rvāṣṭamīvratam || tatra prayogaḥ || śuklāṃbaradharam iti viṣṇuṃ prārthya | oṁ viṣṇuḥ 3 adyahetyādi | amukīdevī(!)haṃ | akhaṃḍasaubhāgyaphala(!)vāptaye putrapautrādivṛddhyarthaṃ adyārabhya śarīrāvasānaparyaṃtaṃ du(!)[r]vāṣṭamīvratam ahaṃ kariṣye idaṃ vrataṃ mayā deva kṛtaṃ prītyai tava prabho || nirvighnaṃ siddhim āyātu tvatprasādāt sureśvara⟨ḥ⟩ || (fol. 1r1–3) End aṣṭamyāṃ phalapuṣpaiś ca kha[r]jūrair nārikelakaiḥ || drākṣāmalakapitthaiś ca vadarair lakucais tathā || nāraṃgair jatukari āmrair bījapūraiś ca dāḍimaiḥ || dadhyakṣataiḥ (dhva)jābhiś ca dhūpair naivedyadīpakaiḥ || maṃtreṇā[[ne]]na rājeṃdra śṛṇuṣvāvahi (fol. 1v8–9) Colophon No colophon is there.

Beginning posi gṛhāṇārghyan namo stu te | tripādūrddhvaʼudait puruṣaḥ pādosyehābhavat punaḥ | tato viṣṣvaṅ vyakrāmat sāśanānaśaneʼabhi | athacamanī[ya]m | vyaktetiºº surāṇām īśāya devāya kṣīrābdhiśayanāya ca | dadāmy ācamanaṃ tubhyam anantāya namos tu te | (fol. 3r1–3) End oṁ tat sat 3 viṣṇuḥ 3 adyetyādi saṃkīrttyāmukagotrāmukadevīmatkṛtaitatsomavārānvitāmāvasyābratādhiṣṭhātṛdevapūjanasāṅgatāsiddhyarthaṃ idaṃ rajataṃ caṃdradaivataṃ amukagotrāyāmukaśarmaṇe brāhmaṇāya dakṣiṇātvena tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade | iti saṃkalpa(!) dadyāt āśīrvādapūrvakaṃ tilakaṃ gṛhītvā haviṣyabhojanaṃ kuryāt (fol. 5v4–8) Colophon iti somavadamāvasyāyāṃ viṣṇor aśvatthasya somāyā amāvasyāyāś ca pūjanavidhiḥ samāpta[ḥ] || | śrīśāke 1759 likhitaṃ haridattasyedaṃ pustakam (fol. 5v8–9)

Beginning ghoṭi lāvanu tāmāgrha jā || main kāṁḍhākā phala ghoṭi lāvanu bhagiṃndraṣaṭi rojā || kālo rudhilo ghoṭi lāvanu karṇamūla jā || jhinuvā bhātale lepa garnu varuṇaṣaṭiro jā || (fol. 3r1–3) End bihiko jaro 1 karciḍāko jaro 1 noṣura 1 belako jaro 1 ginyārijaro 1 ṭaṭalāko jaro 1 ṣamāriko jaro 1 pāḍariko jaro 1 (fol. 4v5–7) Colophon iti samvat 1910 sāla mītī pauṣa śudi 10 roja 2 mā liṣitaṃm idaṃ pustkaṃ balabhadraupādhyā[ya]luñiṁṭyāla śubham (fol. 4v8)

Beginning oṁ kārttavīryyārjunāya namaḥ || || pārvaty uvāca⟨ḥ⟩ || || devādhideva sarvajña sarvalokahite rata || kena rakṣā bhaven nṛṇāṃ bhītānāṃ vividhāpadi⟨ḥ⟩ || 1 || rajacaurādipīḍāśu śastrāgniviṣapātane || māridḥsvapnapīḍāsu graharogabhayeṣu ca || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End dorddaṃḍeṣu sahasrasaṃmitakareṣv eteṣv ajasraṃ lasat †kordaṃḍeṣu† srair udragravisiṣaur(!) udyadvivasvatprabhuḥ || brahmāṇḍaṃ paripu(!)rayaṃ tad akhilaṃ gaṃḍasthā(!)lāloḍitaṃ dyotatkuṃḍalamaṃḍito vijayate śrīkārttavīryyā[r]jjunaḥ || 170 || || || (fol. 11v7–12r1) Colophon iti śrī-uḍḍāmaheśvarataṃtre umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde kārttavīryyārjjunakavacam śubham⟨ḥ⟩ || || śrīśāke 1703 samvat 1838 māse 11 phālguṇamāse dinagatā 3 śomavāsare caturddaśyā(!)yāṃ tithau 14 nakṣatre 22 liṣitaṃ pustakaṃ śubham⟨ḥ⟩ || || śrīgopāleśvarapāunikaṭe likhitaṃ śubham⟨ḥ⟩ || || || || || || || || || || adṛṣṭabhāvo naca mānaṃ vibhrat [[padārthahi(!)naṃ lipātrāḥ ||]] tat sa sarvam etat[t] parisodhani(!)yaḥ || kopaṃ na kuryyāt ṣa(!)va(!)lu leṣa(!)kasya⟨ḥ⟩ || 1 || śrīrāma (fol. 12r1–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīmanmahākālikāyai namaḥ || kailāśaśikhare ramye nānādevagaṇāvṛte || nānāvṛkṣalatākīrṇe nānāpakṣiravair yute || 1 || caturmaṇḍapasaṃyukte śṛṃgāramaṃḍapasthitaṃḥ(!) || samādhau saṃsthitaṃ śāṃtaṃ krīḍaṃtaṃ yoginīpriyaṃ || 2 || || ||(fol. 1v1–5) End kuṃkumāraktakenaiva rocanāgaruyogataḥ || bhūrjapatre likhet pustaṃ sarvakāmārthesiddhaye || 94 || iti gaditam aśeṣaṃ kālikāvarṇarūpaṃ prapaṭhati yadi bhaktyā sarvasiddhisvarūpāt || abhinavasukhakāmaḥ sarvavidyābhirāmo bhavati sakalasiddhiḥ sarvavīrā samṛddhiḥ || 115 || (fol. 38r6–10) Colophon iti śrīmadādināthaviracitāyāṃ mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ kālīkālasaṃvāde su[n]darīvaradākhyaṃ kakārādisahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || śubham || adṛṣṭabhāvān mativibhramāc ca yady atra hīnaṃ likhitaṃ mayā ca || tat sarvam āryyaiḥ pariśodhanīyaṃ kopaṃ na kuryāt khalu lekhakasya || = || = || = || = || = iti śrīśāke 1800 śrīsamvat 1935 sāla pauṣaśudi 12 roja 1 mā liṣitam idaṃ pustakaṃ śrī3balabhadra upādhyāya [[luñiṭyāla liṣaka]] sarmmaṇasya(!) likhitaṃ śubham || yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣtā(!) tādṛśaṃ likhitaṃ mayā padi śuddhom(!) aśuddho(!) vā mama doṣo na di(!)yate || = || = || = || = || = || = || = || = || = || = || (fol. 38r10–38v10)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || maṃtrākṣaraṃ dviguṇaṃ kṛtvā nāmākṣaraṃ samanvitaṃ || dvādaśabhi[r] harate bhāgaṃ seṣajam maṃtra ucyate || || ālāmeṣarāsike || oṁ kliṃ anaṃtāya namaḥ || oṁ nārāyaṇāya namaḥ || iti lmī(!) nārāyana(!)maṃtraḥ || oṁ kliṃ anaṃtāya namaḥ || iti annamaṃtraṃ(!) || uvā vṛṣarāsike || oṁ dadhibhakṣanārāyana(!) so[ʼ] haṃ || iti bāladāmodaramaṃtraḥ || || oṁ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya || || iti vāsudevamaṃtraḥ || oṁ kliṃ vaṃsagopālāya namaḥ || || iti vaṃsagopālamaṃtraḥ || || kāchāmithunarāsike || || oṁ kli(!) kṛṣṇāya namaḥ || ||iti kṛṇṣamaṃtra[ḥ] || oṃ kliṃ keśavāya namaḥ || || iti keśavamaṃtraḥ || || ḍāhākarkaṭarāsike || || oṁ hiṃ kiraṇyagarbhavyaktarūpine(!) namaḥ || iti hira[ṃ]ṇyagarbhamaṃtra⟨ṃ⟩ḥ || || māthāsiṃharāsike || (fol. 1v1–9) End atha karanyāsaḥ || || hrāṁ a[ṃ]guṣṭhābhyā[ṃ] namaḥ || || hriṁ(!) tarjjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || || hruṁ madhyamābhyā[ṃ] namaḥ || || hrauṁ anāmikābhyā[ṃ] namaḥ || || hrauṁ kanikṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ || || hruṁ karatalakarapṛṇṭābhyāṃ namaḥ || || atha aṃga⟨ṃ⟩nyāsaḥ || || hriṁ(!) hṛdayāya namaḥ || || hriṁ(!) śirase svāhā || || hruṁ sikhāyai vausaṭ || || oṁ hrauṁ kavacāya huṃ || || hrauṁ netratrayāya vaukha(!)ṭ || || hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || || atha dhyānam || || †ghanābhārāṃḍadurābhimāṃ muktakeśidigaṃvarā || || muṇḍāsīrpābhayakarāṃ muṇḍālipretagāṃ bhajet† || || (fol 5v1–6) Colophon No colophon is there.

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha saṃkalpapārvaṇavidhinā darśaśrāddhaprayogaḥ || sapiṇḍakaśrāddhāśaktāvāhahemādrau sarvarta[ḥ] || samagraṃ yas tu śakto tikarttuṃ naiveha pārvaṇaṃ api sa[ṃ]kalpavidhinā kālena tasya vidhi(!)yate || pātrebhyo †jyasya| cānnasya tyāgaḥ saṃkalpa †udradhyate† || (fol. 1v1–4) End oṁ astu paripūrṇam iti brāhmaṇā brūyuḥ || oṁ prasādāḥ kurvaṃtu || āyuḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃºº || oṁ kāyena vāceti nārāyaṇāya samarpayet || oṁ sya smṛtyā ca nāmoktyā tapoyajñakriyādiṣu || nya(!)naṃ saṃpūrṇatā[ṃ] yātu sadyo vaṃde tam acyutaṃ || acyutāya namaḥ || 3 || pūrṇaṃ da[r]śaśrā⟨r⟩ddham iti || (fol. 12v6–13r2) Colophon iti saṃkalpapārvaṇaśrā⟨r⟩ddhaprayoga[ḥ] || || || || leṣakapāṭ[h]akayoḥ śru(!)vaṃ(!) bhavatu⟨ḥ⟩ || śubhaṃ [bhū]yāt iti śrīsamvat 1903 sālamiti māṛgasiravadi 12 roja || 1 || śu⟨ṃ⟩bhaṃ bhvatu || || (fol. 13r2–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || athārkkavivāha[ḥ] || śubhadine prācyām udīcyāṃ vāʼrkasamīpaṃ gatvā snātvāʼhatavāsasī paridhāya tattanmantraiḥ sthānaśuddhibhūtaśuddhikaraṇapūrvakasvaśākhoktasthaṇḍilanirmmāṇaṃ kuryāt atha saṅkalpa[ḥ] oṁ adyetyādi, amukagotrasyāmukaśarmmaṇo mama bhāvitṛtīyamānuṣīkanyāpariṇayaśubhatāsiddhyarthaṃ śrīgaṇeśapūjanapuṇyāhavācanamātṛkāpūjanābhyudayikaśrāddhācāryyādivaraṇapūrvakārkkavivāham ahaṃ kariṣye iti saṅkalpaṃ kuryyāt tato dīpaṃ prajvālya saṃpūjya gaṇe[[saṃ ca]] pūjayet (fol. 1v1–7) End oṁ adyetyādi kāśyapagotrasya kāśyapāvatsāranaidhruveti tripravarasyādityasya prapautrim savitu[ḥ] pautrīm arkkasya putrīm tathā amukagotrasyāmukapravarasyāmukaśarmmaṇaḥ prapautrāya pautrāya putrāya ubhayoḥ trivāraṃ paṭhitvā amukaśarmmaṇe varāya kāśyapagotrotpannām imāṃ kanyāṃ tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade iti paṭhitvā varahaste jalam utsṛje[t] (fol. 5v3–7) Colophon No colophon is there.

Beginning saṃhatiparigrahatā ca śaṃbhoḥ śobhāṃ bibharti girijai(!) tava sāhacaryyāt || 9 || oṁ śrīś ca te lakṣmīś ca patnyāv ahorātre pārśve nakṣatrāṇi rūpam aśvinau vyāttam || iṣṇi(!)nniṣāṇam ummayiṣāṇa sarvalokam mayīṣāṇaḥ || 10 || gaṃdhadvārāṃ durādharṣāṃ nityaṃ puṣṭāṃ karīṣiṇīm || i(!)śvarīṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tān ihopahvaye śrī(!)yam || 11 || ṛṣir uvāca || iti stutyavaśāne sya viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ prādurbhūtā mahālakṣmīr mahiṣāsuraghātinī || 12 || (fol. 1v1–5) End oṁ khaḍgaṃ cakragadeṣucāpaparighān śūlaṃ bhuśuṃḍīṃ śiraḥ || śaṃkhaṃ saṃdadhatīṃ karais trinayanāṃ sarvāṃgabhūṣāvṛtām || yāmau staut svapite harau kamalajo haṃtuṃ madhuṃ kaiṭabhaṃ nīlāśmadyutim āsyapādadaśakāṃ seve mahākālikām || = || mahākālīmahālakṣmīmahāsrasvatīr dhyātvā mānasopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya⟨ḥ⟩ sapet || = || oṁ bījatrayāya vidmahe tatpradhānāya dhīmahi tan naḥ śaktiḥ pracodayāt || = || (fol. 6v5–9) «Sub-colophon:» iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike manvaṃtare devīmāhātmye viṣṇukṛtamā(!)hālakṣmīsūktaṃ saṃpūrnam || = || (fol. 5v6–7) Colophon iti gāyatrī || = || iti samvat 1928 śrīśāke 1793 sālamiti śrāvaṇavadi 6 roja 7 mā liṣita⟨ṃ⟩m idaṃ pustakaṃ kāṭhamāḍau ṭhahaṭivasata kkāvāhālaṭolasannidhānaṃ gṛhavasata śrīśrīśrībalabhadra-upādhyā luñiṃṭyālalaliṣaka⟨ṃ⟩m idaṃ pustakaṃ śubham || bhagnapṛṣti[ḥ] kaṭigri(!)vā baddhamuṣṭir adhomukha⟨ṃ⟩[ḥ] || kaṣṭena likhitaṃ granthaṃ yatnena pratipālayet || 1 || śrīrāmaḥ || śrīrāmaḥ || śrīrāmaḥ || śrīrāmaḥ || śrīrāmaḥ || śrīrāmaḥ || (fol. 6v9–7r4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama[ḥ] || pūrṇimāvratavidhiḥ || adya karttā śuklāṃbaradharāṃ cānte gaṇeśapatiṃ smṛttvā pūjayet || oṁ adyetyādideśakālādi smṛtvā⟨ḥ⟩ caṃdramā(!)pūjānirvighnaparisamāptyarthaṃ gaṇeśapūjanam ahaṃ kaṛiṣye iti saṃkalpaḥ || namo stv anaṃtāyeti dīpaṃ saṃpu(!)jya⟨ḥ⟩ || varuṇasyottaṃbhanam iti kalaśaṃ saṃpūjya gaṇānāṃ tveti maṃtreṇa gaṇapati[ṃ] paṃcopacārai[ḥ] saṃpūjya || (fol. 1v1–6) End atha dakṣiṇādānaṃ || adyetyādikṛtam etat ṣoḍaśakalāsahitapūrṇacandrapūjāsaṃgatāsiddhyarthaṃ dakṣiṇā rajataṃ candradaivataṃ yathānāmagotrayā brāhmaṇāya tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade || iti dakṣiṇādānaṃ⟨ḥ⟩ || oṁ svasti || athābhiṣekamaṃtra⟨ṃ⟩[ḥ] || āsi(!)rvāda[ḥ] || tata(!) brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ || = || (fol. 3r13–3v4) Colophon śubhaṃ iti saṃvat 1924 sālamiti bhādraśudi 9 roja 7 mā liṣita⟨ṃ⟩m idaṃ puṣ[ta]kaṃ śrī3balahadra-upādhyā[ya]luñiṃṭyāl li(!)ṣaka[ḥ] bhīrapānivāstavya⟨ṃ⟩[ḥ] śubham || =|| =|| =|| =|| =|| =|| =|| =|| (fol. 3v4–6)

Beginning oṃ namo śrīmadāryyatārāyai || śrīmatpotalake ramye nānādhātuvirājite || nānādrumalatākirṇe nānāpakṣini kūjite || 1 || nānānirjharajhakāre nānāmṛgasamākule || nānākusumajātibhiḥ samantād adhivāsite || 2 || (fol. 1v1-4) End jātismaro bhaved dhīmān kulīnapriyadarśanaḥ || prītimān samahāvāgmī sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 59 || kalyāṇamitrasaṃsevī bodhicitavi bhūṣitaḥ || sadā virahito buddhai(!) yatra yatropapadyata(!) || 60 || tatra tatra sarvabuddhair akṣayiṣyanti sarvadā || (fol. 8v1–4) Colophon iti śrīmad aryyatārābhaṭṭārikāyā(!) nāmāṣṭottaraśatakaṃ buddhabhāṣitaṃ parisamāptam || || namas tāre ture vīre tuttāre bhayanāśinī ture sarvāture kāre svāhākāraṃ namo ’stu te || yaśodharamahāvihāra(!) vasthitanīlarājena liṣitam(!) nīlarājavajrācāryyabuvāhāla(!) (fol. 8v4–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || || || varggāḥ pṛthvīpurakṣmābhṛdvanauṣadhimṛgādibhiḥ || nṛvrahmakṣatravi(2)ṭśūdraiḥ sāṃgopāṃgair ihoditāḥ || 1 || bhūr bhūmir acalā nantā rasā viśvambharā sthirā || dharā dhari(3)trī dhariṇiḥ kṣoṇī (!) jyā kāśyapī kṣitiḥ || 2 || sarvaṃsahāvasumatī vasudhorvī vasundharā || gotrā kuḥ (4) pṛthivī pṛthvī kṣmāvanir medinī mahī || 3 || bhūtadhātrī ratnagarbhā vipulā sāgarāmbarā 31 || mṛn mṛ(5)ttikā 2 praśastā tu mṛtsā mṛtsnā ca 2 mṛttikā || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) End syur llagnakā pratibhuvaḥ 2 samikā (!) dyūtakārakāḥ || dhyūto striyām a((3)kṣavar)tī kaitavaṃ paṇa ity api 4 || 44 || paṇo kṣeṣu glaho2kṣās tu devanāḥ pāśakā((4)ś ca) te 3 || pariṇāyas tu śārīṇāṃ samantān nayane ʼstriyām || 45 || aṣṭāpadaṃ ((5) śā)riphalaṃ 2 prāṇidyūtaṃ sahvayaḥ 2 || uktā bhūriprayogatvād ekasmin ye tra yau(6)gikāḥ || 46 || tāddharmyād anyato vṛttāv ūhyā liṃgāntare pi te || 47 || || || || (7) iti śūdravarggaḥ || || || || (fol. 66r2–7) Colophon ity amarasiṃhakṛtau nāmaliṃgānu(66v1)sāsane || bhūmikāṇḍo dvitīyo yaṃ sāṃga eva samarthitaḥ || 1 || || || || ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ (fol. 66r7–66v1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ oṁ namaḥ pratyaṅgirāyai oṁ asya śrīpratyaṃgirāstotramaṃtrasyāṅgirā ṛṣir anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ śrīpratyaṃgirādevatā oṁ bījaṃ hrīṁ śaktir mamābhīṣṭasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ ... kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ bṛhadrūpāṃ raktakuṃcitamūrddhajāṃ śirakamālamālāṃ ca vikeśīṃ ghūrṇitānanāṃ 1 (fol. 1v1–3 and 2r1–3) End ādigraha gajādigraha mātṛkāgraham eva ca pitṛgraha vetālagraha rājagraha cauragraha 19 gotragraha svadevatāgraha gotradevatāgraha ādhigraha vyādhigraha <ref name="ftn1"> Aaforementioned stanzas don not follow Pāṇini. </ref>(fol. 4r4–6) Colophon No colophon is there.

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrīrājarājeśvarīmahātripurasundaryyai || || śrīdevy uvāca || devadeva mahādeva bhaktānugrahakāraka || tvattaḥ śrutam mayā sarvaṃ rahasyātirahasyakaṃ || idānīṃ śrotum icchāmi †trśatī†stotram uttamaṃ || yena sarvārthasiddhiḥ syān tan me vada dayānidhe || (fol. 1v1–3) End ajñātvā stotrarājaṃ hi ṣodaśī(!) japate dhamaḥ || alpāyuḥ sa bhavet sadyo devatāśāpam āpnuyān(!) || iha loke daridraḥ syād ante narakabhāg bhavet || tasmāt sarvaprayatnena paṭhanīyaṃ ca sarvadā || || || (fol. 8v2–4) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale śivapārvatīsamvāde śrīmahātripurasundarīdevyāḥ †triśatī†stotraṃ sampūrṇaṃ śubhaṃ japaṣoḍākṣarīmaṃtra[ḥ] || oṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ klīṁ aiṁ sauṁḥ oṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ ka e (i) la hrīṁ ha sakala hrīṁ sa[[ha]]kala hrīṁ sauḥ aiṃ klīṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ svāhā || || (fol. 8v5–7)

Beginning varākṣamālābhayaṭaṃkahastaḥ sarojakiṃjalkasamānavarṇa trilocanaś cāru caturcaturmmukho māṃ pāyād ucīcyāṃ diśi vāmadevaḥ || (fol. 4r1–2) End jānudvayaṃ me jagadīśvaro vyāt | pādau mamāvyāt suravaṃdyapādaḥ maheśvaraḥ pātu dinādiyāme māṃ madhyayāme vatu vāmadevaḥ || tryaṃbakaḥ pātu tri(!)tīyāme ṣṭavṛṣa[ḥ](dhva) (fol. 4v5–7) Colophon No colophon is there.

Beginning ❖ śrīlipilambodarāya || pūrvvasūripraṇitānāṃ (!) kārikānāṃ (!) virecanaṃ | krīyate (!) pāṇinīyānāṃ śi(2)ṣyānāṃ (!) bodhahetave || yasminn arthe(!) vidhīyante lakāras tad [d]vidhāḥ (!) kṛtāḥ | samāso vā bhaved yatra (3) sa uktaḥ prathamā tataḥ || bhavatyāṃkuraḥ babhūva bhavitā bhaviṣyati bhavatu abhavat bhavet (4) bhūyāt abhūva (!) abhaviṣyati (!) (fol. 1v1–4) End śabdā na pṛcchati cchāstraḥ (!) mṛduta vā (4) nara tarum avalokayati kutukī anuktam mapi nokta (!) syāt || nṛtyate gīyate naṭena bhoktu(5)m atra pacati bubhukṣitaḥ ānīya guruṃ pūjati śiṣyaḥ || 19 || (fol. 16v3–5) Colophon iti ṣoḍaśakārikā samā(6)ptaḥ || || śrī śrī śrībhavānīśaṃkarābhyāṃ namaḥ || || śreyo vrūyāt śivam astu || (fol. 16v5–6)

Beginning śrīśaṃkarāya namaḥ || || upamanyur uvāca || || jaya śaṃkara pārvatīpate mṛda śaṃbho śaśikhaṇḍamaṇḍana madanāṃtaka bhaktavatsala priyakailāsa dayāmbudhe || 1 || (fol. 1r1–2) End uapanyukṛtaṃ stavottamaṃ paṭhataḥ(!) śaṃbhusamīpavarttinaḥ | abhivāṃchitabhāgyasaṃpada[ṃ] paramāyuḥ(!) pradadāti śaṃkaraḥ || 21 || śaṃkarasya caritaṃ kathāmṛtaṃ caṃdraśekharaguṇānukīrttanam | nīlakaṇṭha tava pādasevanaṃ saṃbhavaṃtu mama janmajanmasu || 22 || (fol. *2v5–7) Colophon iti śrī upamanyukṛtaṃ śaṃkarastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || śubham (fol. *2v7)

Beginning śrīmatparamagurugaṇapatiśāradābhyo namaḥ || || karabadarasadṛśam akhilaṃ bhuvanatalaṃ yat prasādataḥ kavayaḥ paśyaṃti sūkṣmamatayaḥ sā jayati sarasvatī devī 1 khinno si muṃca śailaṃ bibhṛmo vayam iti vadatsu śithilabhujaḥ bharabhugnavitatabāhuṣu gopeṣu hasan harir jayati 2 kaṭinataradāmaveṣṭana- lekhāsaṃdehadāyino yasya rājaṃti valivibhaṃgās sa pātu dāmodaro bhavataḥ 3 sa jayati himakaralekhā cakāsti yasyomayonmukhān nihitā nayanapradīpakajjala- jighṛkṣayā rajataśuktir iva (!) 4 bhavati subhavatvam adhikaṃ vis‥ritaparaguṇasya sujanasya vahati vikāsitakumudo dviguṇaruciṃ himakaro dyotaḥ 5 viṣadharato py ativiṣamaḥ khala iti [[na]] mṛṣā vadaṃti vidvāṃsaḥ yad ayaṃ nakuladveṣī sakuladveṣī punaḥ piśunaḥ 6 (fol. 1v1–3) End evaṃ samastam itas tato nidhanam avāpa sainyaṃ anaṃtaraṃ yasyāśramo bhagnas tena muninā kuśodakam ādāryagatena pratipannavṛttāṃ tena mamāśramo bhagno taḥ śilāmayī bhavet iśāptāham kṣaṇena ca bahuduḥkham anubhavatīṃ māṃ vilokya āryaputraka(ru)ṇayā āryakarasparśāvadhiśāpam akarot tataḥ kandarpaketuḥ samāgatena makarandena vāsavadattayā saha svanagaraṃ gatvā yathābhilaṣitāni sukhāny anubhavan kālaṃ nināyeti (fol. 32r1‒4) Colophon iti śrīmahākavisubaṃdhuviracitā vāsavadattākhyā ākhyāyikā samāptim agāt śrīmanmahāgaṇapatiśāradābhyāṃ namaḥ śrīviśveśvarāpanamanaḥ || khavahniśailadharaṇī saṃmite pramāthināmni samvatsare āṣāḍamāsya(!) site raviyutadaśamyāṃ likhitam idaṃ śrīvinodaśarmaṇākāśyāṃ (fol. 32r4‒6)

Beginning putra dīrgharātnam anuśikṣato(!) bhūt || tvaṃ sāriputra bodhisatvasatmantritena bodhisatvarahasyen(!) iha mama pravacane utppannaḥ sa tvaṃ śāriputra bodhisatvadhiṣṭhānena(!) tatpūrvakaṃ cāryāpraṇidhānaṃ bodhisatvasatmantritaṃ bodhisatvarahasyan na samanusmarasi nirvṛto smīti manyase || (fol. 35r1‒2) End atha śāriputra sa puruṣas teṣāṃ svakānāṃ putrāṇāṃ vātajavabalasaṃpaṃnāt gonarathakāṃnevānama(!)prayacchet saptaratnamayāṃ savedikāṃ sakaṅkaṇījāṇābhipralaṃbitānuccām(!) pragṛhītāṃ āścaryādbhutaratnānākṛtaratnadāmasakṛtāśātān(!) puṣpamālālaṃkṛtāṃstūlikāgolikāṃstaraṇāt(!) || dūṣyapaṣṭavastrās tīrṇānurbhayato(!) lohitopadhānāt || svataiḥ prapāṇḍaraiḥ sīghrajavaiḥ goṇaiyejiyitvā(!) bahupuruṣaparigṛhītāṃ vaijayantāt || (fol. 35v4‒7)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || viśveśvaraṃ jñānamūrttiṃ praṇipatya giraṃ guruṃ || ṭīkāṃ śiśuhitāṃ kurve tarkkasaṃgrahadīpikāṃ || 1 || cikīrṣitasya graṃthasya avighnaparisamāptyarthaṃ śiṣṭācā(2)rānumita śrutibodhitakarttavyatākaṃ iṣṭadevatānamaskāralakṣaṇaṃ maṃgalaṃ śiṣyaśikṣārthaṃ nivadhnan cikīrṣitaṃ pratijānīte || || nidhāyeti || (fol. 1v1–2) End nityanaimittikair eva kurvāṇo duritakṣayaṃ | jñānaṃ ca vimalīkurvan abhyāsena ca pācayet | abhyāsā(5)t pakvavijñānaṃ kaivalyaṃ labhate naraḥ | ity ādinā karmmaṇo jñānasādhanatvapratipādanāt jñānadvāraiva karmamokṣasādhanaṃ | na sākṣāt | tasmāt padārthajñānān mokṣaḥ paramaprayojanam iti sarvaṃ ra(6)maṇīyaṃ || (fol. 13r4–6) Colophon iti śrīmad annaṃ bhaṭṭopādhyāyakṛtatarkkasaṃgrahaṭīkā dīpikā samāptā || || (fol. 13r6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ śṛṃgārarasāṣṭakaṃ aviditasukhaduḥkhaṃ nirguṇaṃ vastu kiṃcit jaḍamatir iha kaścit mokṣa ity ācacakṣe mama tu matamanaṃgasmeratāralpapūrṇan, madakalamadirākṣī vimokṣo hi mokṣaḥ 1 (!) kadā kāntāgāre parimalamilat puṣpaśayane śayānaḥ kāntāyāḥ kucayugam ahaṃ vakṣasi vahan aye kānte mugdhe kuṭilanayane candravadane prasīdeti krośan nimīṣam iva neṣyāmi divasān 2 (fol. 1v1–4) End taṃ (5) vīkṣya veputhumatī sarasāṃgayaṣṭir nikṣepa eva padam uddhṛtam arpayantī mārgā (!) calavyatikarā kuliteva sindhuḥ śailā(6)dhirājatanayā na yayau na tasthau 7 kā kā valā nidhuvanaśramapīḍitāṃgī nidrāṃ gatā dayitabāhulatā(7)nubaddhā sā sā tu yātu bhavanaṃ mihirodgamo yaṃ saṃketavādhyam iti kā kacayā vadanti 8 (fol. 2r4–7) Colophon iti mahāmahāka(1)vi kālidāsaviracitaṃ śṛṃgārarasāṣṭakaṃ samāptaṃ ○ śubham ❁ (fol. 2r7–2v1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśā (!) namaḥ || || sādhanapaṃñcakaṃ (!) || vedo, nityam adhīyatāṃ taduditaṃ, karma, svanuṣṭhīyatāṃ, teneśasya, pidhīyatā(2)m apaniti, kāme, matis tyajatāṃ || pāpaughaḥ paridhrūyatāṃ bhavasukhe, doṣo nusandhīyatām, ātmecchā vyavasīyatāṃ (3) nijagṛhāt tūrṇaṃ vinirgamyatāṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End yaḥ śloka paṃcakam idaṃ paṭhate (!) manuṣyaḥ sañcintayaty anudinaṃ sthiranam upetya || tasyāśusaṃsṛtidavānalatīvraghora- (5)tāpaḥ praśāntim upayāti citiprasādāt || 6 || || (fol. 2r4–5) Colophon iti śrīśaṃkarācāryaviracitaṃ sādhanapañcakaṃ samāptam || (fol. 2r5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || rāmāya namaḥ || || oṃ namaḥ sarvaṃbhūtāni (!) viṣṭabhyaḥ paritiṣṭhate || akhaṃḍānaṃda(2)bodhāya pūrṇāya paramātmane || 1 || adhyayanabhāvanābhyāṃ sāraṃ nirṇīyam akhilataṃtrāṇāṃ || dīdhitim adhiciṃtāma(3)ṇI tanute tārkikaśiromaṇi śrīmān || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End ata eva prāṇagrāhyaguṇatvādinā sādhyatāyāṃ dravyatvāder vyabhi(7)cāritvam api sādhusaṃgachata (!) ity api kecit iti kṛtaṃ pallavitena || nanu ye eva militvā vahnyabhāvajalahradādau vahnir nāstīti dhiyaṃ (8) janayaṃti ta eva pratyekaṃ dhūmavati mahānasādau vartante tatra ca teṣāṃ svasvāvacchedaka tat tad vahnitvādy avacchinnavaiyadhikaraṇye nirūpitāyāḥ (fol. 18v6–8) === Colophon === (fol.)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ namaḥ sarvabhūtāni viṣṭabhya paritiṣṭhate || akhaṃḍānaṃdabodhāya pūrṇāya paramātmane || 1 || a(2)dhyayanabhāvanābhyāṃ sāraṃ nirṇīya nikhilataṃtrāṇāṃ dīdhitim adhiciṃtāmaṇi tanute || tārkikaśiromaṇiḥ śrīmā(3)n || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End kintu vahnyabhāvaviśiṣṭa parvatādikam eva tatheti prakārāṃtaraṃ u(6)pavarṇitaṃ | tad api na parvataḥ parvatānye dhūmād ity ādau parvatānyatvābhāvaviśiṣṭaparvatātmakabādhaniścayapratibaddhyatāvachedaka(!) viṣayitvā(7)prasiddhyā tatrāvyāptiprasaṃdād eva nirastam ity āstaṃ vistaraḥ | || || ||(fol. 255v5–7) === Colophon === (fol.)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrībhagavān uvāca || jñānaṃ paramaguhyaṃ me yad vijñānasamanvitaṃ || sarahasyaṃ tad aṃgaṃ ca gṛhāṇa gaditaṃ mayā || 1 || yāvānahaṃ yathā bhāvo yad rūpaguṇakarmakaḥ || tathaiva tattvavijñānam astu te madanugrahāt || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End etan mataṃ samātiṣṭha parameṇa samādhinā || bhavān kalpavikalpeṣu na vimuhyati karhicit || 7 || (fol. 2r4–5) Colophon iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe ʼṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ vaiyāsikyāṃ dvitīyaskaṃdhe bhagavadbrahmasaṃvāde catu⟨ḥ⟩ślokī(!)bhāgavataṃ(!) samāptaṃ || (fol. 2r5–6)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śivāya || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || sudarśanākhyaṃ yac cakraṃ labdhavāṃs tat kathaṃ hariḥ || mahādevād bhagavataḥ sūta tad vaktum arhasi || 1 || sūta uvāca || devāsurāṇām abhava,t saṃgrāmodbhutadarśanaḥ || devāś ca nirjitā daityair, vviṣnuṃ(!)śaraṇam āgatāḥ || 2 || (fol. 12v1–4) End jāyate mahadaiśvaryyaṃ śivasya dayito bhavet || dustarejalasaṃghāte taj jalaṃ sthalatāṃ vrajet || 151 || ... prayacchate khilān kāmān, dehānte pramāṃ gatiṃ || || (fol. 33r1–3 and 5) Colophon ity ādityapurāṇe mānavīyasaṃhitāyāṃ nārāyaṇasya<ref name="ftn1"> Probably for nārāyaṇaṃ </ref> sudarśanapradānaṃ nāma ekonacatvāriṃśatitamo dhyāyaḥ || || śubham astu || (fol. 32r5–32v1)

vajragarbham avalokya smitam akārṣīt || samanantarasmite smin vajragarbha-utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṃgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ bhūmau pratisthāpya kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhagavantam etad avocat || (fol. 1v1‒2r1) «Sub-Colophon:» iti mahāguhyātiguhyaguhyasamāje parārddhabodhicittotpādādibhāvanātatvaprakaraṇaḥ (!) || prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ (!) || (fol. 7r1) iti mahāguhyādi(!) guhyasamāje parā ’rddhabodhicittāvatāraṃ nāma dvitīyaprakaraṇaṃ paṭalaḥ (!) || (fol 11v4–5) iti guhyātiguhyaguhyasamāje parā ’rddhatatvoddeśaprakaraṇan tṛtīyapaṭala (!) || (fol 13v4–5) «End:» anyaiś ca punaḥ puruṣair upabhujyamānam ṛtabhāvam āpadyate || evam te kulaputrā rāgādaya āśaye viśeṣabhāvinā viśiṣṭaphalāvāhakā bhavantīti | prakṛtiniravadyetvāt(!) prayogaḥ || ye ya(!) viśiṣṭasantānabhāvinas te viśiṣṭaphalāvāhakā yathā ketakyupaviśiṣṭasantānavarttinasvarāgādaya iti svabhāvaviśuddhāḥ || (fol. 142v3–143r1) «Colophon:» iti śrīguhyātiguhyasamāje mahātantre parārddhe sarvakalparājanidānatilakaṃ nāma paṃcadeśaḥ paṭalaḥ || samāptaḥ guhyasamājo parārddhaḥ | || || ye dharmā hatuprabhavā hetu(!) teṣāṃs tathāgataḥ hy avadat teṣāñ ca yo niroda evaṃvādī mahāśramaṇaḥ || śubham astu jagat || || śreyo stu samvat 967 adya vaiśāṣa(!)māse śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ mahāpuṇyatithau rohiṇīnakṣatre saubhagayoge yathākarṇṇamuhutre ādityavāsare meṣarāsigate savitare vṛṣarāsigate candramasi || etat dine śrīguhyasmādhipustakali|khāpitaṃ(!) || dānapati śrīlalitāpūramahānagarayā ekakṣe vakaṃbāhālayā kāyaṣṭa(!) jyeṣṭa(!)naravīrasiṃha bhāryyātejalakṣmī jyeṣṭa(!)putra mānavīrasiṃ dvitīyaputra kṛṣṇṇamānasiṃ tṛtīyaputra kulamānasiṃ caturthaputra gajamānasi thuti sakalaparivārayāṃ dharmacitta-utpatti juyā o thva śrīguhyāsamādhipustaka cocakaṃ dayakā julo || thvaguyā puṇyaṃ dānapatiyā saptavṛhiṃ paripūrṇṇajuyamāla guhyasamādhipustakasahlānātakāsāphalyajuyamāla jula śubhaṃ || lekhaka śrīcakravāhālayā śrītejadattana coyā jula || śubhaṃ || || (fol. 143r1–v5)

Beginning atha saptaviṃśad(!)bodhipākṣikān dharmān kathayiṣyāmi adhyātmakāye bahiḥkāye ādhyātmabahirdhākāye kāyānudarśī viharatīty api saṃprajānaṃ smṛtimān vinīya loke avidyādaurmmanasye adhyātmavedanā bahirdhāvedanā adhyātma[[bahirdhā]]vedanā svavedanānudarśī viharatīty api saṃprajānaṃ smṛtimān vinīya loke avidyādaurmanasye adhyātmadharmeṣu bahirdhādharmeṣu adhyātmabahirdhādharmeṣu dharmānudarśī viharatīty api saṃprajānaṃ (fol. 6r1–4) End anyaiś ca punaḥ puruṣair upabhujyamānam ṛtabhāvam āpadyate evan te kulaputrā rāgādaya āśayaviśeṣabhāvino viśiṣṭaphalāvāhakā bhavantīti prakṛtiniravaṃdyatvāt prayogaḥ ye ye viśiṣṭasantānabhāvinas te viśiṣṭaphalāvāhakā yathā ketakyupaviśiṣṭe santānava(rtti)nasvarāgādaya iti svabhāvaviśuddhāḥ (fol. 121r4–121v1) Colophon iti śrīguhyātiguhyaguhyasamāje mahātantre parā[r]ddhe sarvakalparājanidānatilaka(!) nāmaḥ(!) pañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥ samāptaḥ guhyasamājāparārddhaḥ || || || (fol. 122v1–3)

Beginning ❖ namaḥ śrīvajrasattvāya || namaḥ śrīyogāmbarajñānaḍākinīnavakoṣṭhadevatāherukanairātmā(!)disarva-devadevībhyaḥ || || evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān sarvatathāgata[ḥ] kayavākcittavajrayoṣidbhageṣu vijahāra || sarvākāśadhātvaparimitabodhisattvādisarvāvatīparṣanmadhye vajragarbham avalokya smitam akārṣīt || samanaṃtarasmite smin vajragarbha-uthāyāsanād (ekāntam) uttarāsaṅgaṅ kṛtvā dakṣiṇajānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyā pratiṣṭhāpya kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhagavantam etad avocat || śrotum icchāmi jñānendra sarvatantranidānarahasyaṃ guhyasamājaparārddhaṃ sampū(!)ṭodbhavalakṣaṇaṃ || aho vajragarbha sādhu sādhu mahāsādhu sādhu sādhu bodhisattvāḥ sādhu sādhu guṇākarāḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) End anyaiś ca punaḥ puruṣair upabhujyamānam amṛtabhāvam āpadyate evaṃ te kulaputrā rāgādaya āśayaviśeṣabhāvino viśiṣṭaphalavāhakā bhavaṃtīti || prakṛtiniravadyatvāt prayogaḥ || ye ye viśeṣasantānabhāvinas te viśiṣṭaphalāvāhakā yathā ketakyuda(yā)viśiṣṭasantānava(rtti)ś(!) ca rāgādaya iti svabhāvaviśuddhāḥ || || (fol. 114v8–115r2) Colophon iti śrīsarvatathāgatakāyavākcittavajraguyās tathāgataguhyakābhidhāne śrīguhyasamājākhye sarvatantrabodhirāje sarva-|| ||-buddhaherukādiguhyādguhyakādevatāyoginīprabhṛtiguhya†sabhāṣasaṃbhāṣaṇe† sarvakalpanidānan nāma saṭtriṃśatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ samāptaḥ || || samāptāś(!) cāyaṃ śrīsarvatathāgatakāyavākcittavajraguhyā(‥)tathāga(!)guhyakābhidhānaḥ śrīguhyasamājasya pārārddha(!) samāpto †ʼjījat† || || (fol. 115r2–5)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrīkālacakrāya⟨ḥ⟩ || || sarvajñaṃ jñānakāyaṃ dinakaravapuṣaṃ padmapatrāyatākṣaṃ buddhaṃ siṃhāsanasthaṃ suravaranamitaṃ mastakena praṇamyaṃ || pṛcched rājā sucaṃdraḥ karakamalapuṭaṃ sthāpayitottamāṃge yogaṃ śrīkālacakre kaliyugasamaye muktihetor narāṇāṃ || 1 || śūnyajñānaṃ ca binduṃ varakuliśadharaṃ buddhadevāsurāś ca bāhye dehe pare ca prakṛtiṣu puruṣaṃ paṃcaviṃśātmakaṃ ca || dehe viśvasyamānaṃ tribhuvanaracanāṃ bhuktidevāsurāṇām etad vyākhyāhi samyak tridaśanaraguror maṇḍanaṃ cābhiṣekaṃ || 2 || tuṣṭo haṃ te sucaṃdra pravarasuranarair rākṣasair daityanāgair na jñātaṃ vītarāgaiḥ paramamunikulair yat tvayā pṛṣṭam etan nirvāṇā⟨ṃ⟩dyaṃ dharāṃtaṃ padagatisahitaṃ dehamadhye samastaṃ yogaṃ vyākhyāyamānaṃ śṛṇu ca narapate maṇḍalaṃ cābhiṣekaṃ || 3 || (fol. 1–6) End taṃtrārthaṃ deśayitvā paramakaruṇayā sarvva[ta]ttvārthakarttā putrasyājñāṃ dadāti pravaraguṇanidhiḥ puṇḍarīkasya nūnaṃ || karttavyaṃ pustakasthaṃ sakalam avikalaṃ taṃtrarājaṃ tvayādau ṭīkāṃ kṛtvā tato vai parapadagamanaṃ svecchayā lokabaṃdhoḥ || 259 || ūrddhvaṃ ye bodhisattvāḥ paramabhayakarā mārapakṣesthitānāṃ daityānāṃ marttyaloke diśi vidiśi gatāḥ krodharājāḥ sabhāryāḥ || pātāle ye phaṇīndrāgrahaparamaśubhaṃ sarvadā baṃdhayaṃti te sarve pālayaṃtu pratidinasamaye ʼjñānalokaṃ samaṃtāt || 260 || sattvānāṃ mokṣahetor jinapatigaditaṃ deśitaṃ yan mayā ca taṃtraṃ śrīkālacakraṃ laghutaram akhilaṃ vajrasattvādhidaivaṃ || prajñopāyaikayogajinapatikuliśaiḥ ṣoḍaśākāratattvaṃ sattvāḥ puṇyena tenākṣaraparamasukhaṃ yāṃtu tasmai namo stu || 261 || || (fol. 91v2–7) Colophon iti śrīdvādaśasāhasrikādibuddhoddhṛte †śrāmati† kālacakre jñānapaṭalaḥ paṃcamaḥ || 5 || || iti śrīmatkālacakrataṃtrarājaḥ samāptaḥ || || śubham || || (fol. 91v7–8)

Beginning svasti śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīsarasvatyai(!) namaḥ || śrīsvasthānīkathā liṣyate || śrīsvasthānīparameśvaryyai namaḥ || yaṃ brahmāvaruṇendrarudramarutas tvaṃnvaṃti divyaiḥ tavair || vedai(!) śāṅgapadakramopaviṣadair gāyaṃtī yaṃ śāmagāḥ || dhyānāvasthita tad gatena manasā paśyaṃti yaṃyogino yasyāntaṃ na viduḥ surāsuragaṇā devāya tsmai namaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End śrīsvasthānīparameśvarīkā vratavidhiko phalale pheri ihalokamā dhana bhayo saṃtāna bhao ityādi saṃpūrṇa suṣapāi paralokamā śrīkailāśavāsa holā bhani kumārale agastya mini prati kahyā sohī kathāhā yathāmati matyalokamā prakhyāt bhayo || (fol. 102r5–8) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe māghamāhātme kedārakhṇḍe kumāra agastya saṃvāde liṃgapurāṇādi nānāśāstrasaṃgrahe śrīsvasthāniparameśvaryā kathā dvāvīṃśodhyāya || = || 22 || = || śrīparameśvari svsthāniparameśvaryā kathāhā samāptaṃ śubham || = || upanayatu maṃgalaṃ vaḥ … candrārkamedinī || 1 || iti samvat 1930 śāla śrīśāke 1795 vaiśāṣa māse dena 16 gate śānivāsare tithau 14 paraamāvaśyā liṣitaṃm idaṃ pustakaṃ śrīśrīśrībalabhadra upādhyā lumiṭyāla liṣakaṃ bhīrpāni vaśāta śrīśvasthānīparameśvarīkathāhā śubhaṃ śrīnārāyaṇaśivaśakti śubham || = || (fol. )

Beginning svasti śrīgaṇeya (!) namaḥ atha mekharāśiguṇa (!) || putravān bhāgyavā (!) paropakāraṇerataḥ (!) || rajayujyo dharmaratah subhogi (!) śilavān bhavet || 1 || hi bhāryāñ (!) capalas (!) te ’pi bhīru varṣajvari (!) bhavet || prathame saptame varṣe vatsare vratrayodaśa (!) || 2 || tritiye (!) vatsare toyapūrṇabhāḍāniyamañjati || dvādasābde (!) tathā nadyāṃ śoḍasābde (!) ’lpamṛtyukṛt || 13 || (fol. 1v1–5) End smaratrikoṇe dharaṇītanūje śanau vatanauvāyavanaprakopaṃḥ (!) || kṣiṇendumadau vyayabhāvayātau tathāpi vāttādhikatā narāṇām || 14 || vaṃśocchitikaraḥ śaśāṅkabhṛgujakrūraiḥ khakāmāṃ bhyugai (!) || śilpi keṇdragatārkiṇā vidhutu tasyāṃ śesamālo kite | aṃtye daityagurau dineśvarasuta- syāṃśecandrabhisuto ni caḥ (!) kālagayoḥ kharāśu śaśinoḥ saureṇa saṃdṛṣṭayoḥ || 15 || (fol. 18r9–18v5) Colophon iti jātakābharaṇe siṣṭādhyāyaḥ || || kauḍinya vaṃśodbhava pada (!) nāmabhidho dvijendo likhyad ātmajādeḥ pāṭhāyamedhābde mite (!) śakābde nepāladeśe meṣarāṣisthite ’rke || (fol. 18v5–7)

«Beginning of the root text:» ❖ oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya || śrīśuka uvāca || varīyān eṣate praśnaḥ kṛto lokahito nṛpa | ātmavitsaṃmataḥ puṃsāṃ śrotavyādiṣu yaḥ paraḥ || 1 || śrotavyādīni rājendra nṛṇāṃ saṃti sahasraśaḥ | apaśyatām ātmatattvaṃ gṛheṣu gṛhamedhināṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v5–6) «Beginning of the commentary:» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || dvitīye tu daśādhyāye śrībhāgavatam āditaḥ | uddeśalakṣaṇoktibhyāṃ saṃkṣepeṇopavarṇyate || 1 || tatra tu prathamādhyāye kīrtana+śravaṇādibhiḥ | sthaviṣṭhe bhagavadrūpe manaso dhāraṇocyate || 2 || (fol. 1v1–2) «End of the root text:» śrīśuka uvāca || tasyāṃ vidarbho ʼjanayat putrau nāmnā kuśakrathau || tṛtīyaṃ romapādaṃ ca vidarbhakulanaṃdanaṃ || 1 || romapādasuto babhrur babhroḥ kṛtir ajāyata || uśikas tat sutas tasmāc cediś caidyādayo nṛpa || 2 || (exp. 419t7–8) «End of the commentary:» yathoktaṃ bhāryā vaśyās tu ye kecid bhaviṣyanty athavā mṛtāḥ || teṣāṃ tu jyāmaghaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śaivyāpatir abhūn [[nṛ]]pa iti || 38 || (exp. 419t3,9) «Sub-colophon of the commentary:» iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe aṣṭādaśasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ vaiyāśikyāṃ dvitīyaskandhe daśamodhyāyaḥ || 10 || iti samāptoyaṃ dvitīyaskaṃdhaḥ || || || (exp. 43v3-4) iti śrībhāgavatabhāvārthadīpikāyāṃ śrīdharasvāmiviracitāyāṃ bhāvāryadīpikāyāṃ dvitīyaskandhe daśamodhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || 10 || || (exp. 43v2,5) iti navame trayoviṃśo dhyāyaḥ || (exp. 419t9) «Sub-colophon of the root text:» iti śrībhagavate mahāpurāṇe navamaskaṃdhe yaduvaṃśānukathanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatitamo dhyāyaḥ || (exp. 419t6–7)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || aciṃtya[[ā]]vyaktarūpāya nirguṇāya guṇātmane || samastajagadādhārabrahmaṇe liṃgamūrttaye || || oṃ saptāviṃśatinakṣatrebhyo (!) namaḥ || || atha kṛttikānakṣatre jananaphala (!) kathayati || somena kalyāṇa, (!) aṃgāreṇa siddhi (!) budhena mṛtyu, (!) bṛhaspati (!) śubha (!) śukrakulasthāna (!) viṃśati muhūrtta, (!) maheśvaradevatā, agnikuṇḍa āsana, rākṣasa jāta, chāga sattva, vaiśāyanī gotra, sthānaśubha, raktavarṇa, uttaradvāra aṃgārakṣatrapāla 1 (fol. 1v1–4) End nadyā bhaya varṣa 50 udaravyathā, atisāra ete akālamṛtyubhaya || śāṃti śaṃbhūpūjā, tīrthe jala, yajña, homa, balyārcana(!) śāṃti svasti ete || paramāyu jīvyati varṣa95 paścāt kārtikamāse śukle dhaneṣṭhā ṛkṣe budhavāre rātryāṃ mṛtyur bhavati || || iti bharaṇī nakṣatrasya || || (fol. 18r7–18v1) Colophon iti saptā(!)viṃśatinakṣatrāṇāṃ jananamaraṇanirnnayopākhyānaṃ samāptāsīt (!) || || || śubham astu sarvadākālaṃ || || || || śubhaṃ, yāte naipālikābde nabharasavivare cāśvine māsi kṛṣṇe paṃcamyāṃ rohiṇṛkṣe śaradṛtuguravoḥ (!) bhānuge san tulāyāṃ || kāvyanyāyajñanṛtyadvijavaramathurānātharā(ye)ṇa śīghraṃ nakṣatrāṇāñ ca mālāṃ janahitakam idam pustakañ cālilekha || || || || || 960 samvat || || (fol. 18v1–5)

Beginning /// -sa na leṣakaḥ (!) || 31 veda vedārthattatvajño (!) japahomaparāyaṇaḥ || āśirvā(2)daparo yukta (!) hy eṣa rājñaḥ purohitaḥ || 32 || alasaṃ mukharaṃ stabdhaṃ krūraṃ vā(3)maṃ tathā śaṭham || asaṃtuṣṭam abhaktaṃ ca tyejed bhṛtyaṃ narādhipaḥ || 33 || tyeje(4)t svāmi namaty ugram atyugrāt †kṛparaṃ† tyajet || kṛpanādaviśeṣajñaṃ tasmā(5)c ca kṛttināsakam (!) || 34 || murkho niyujyamāne (!) tu trayo doṣā mahīpa(6)te || ayasaḥ (!) svārthanāśaś ca narake patanaṃ tathā || 35 || prājñe niyujyamā(7)ne tu saṃti rājñaḥs (!) trayo guṇāḥ || yaśaḥ satruvināśaś (!) ca vipulaś ca dhanā(5v1)gamaḥ || 36 || (fol. 5r1–5v1) End madhya(3)mā dhamanamānau ca mānenāpi hataṃ dhana (!) māṇo pahatacittasya lābho pi na sukhāva(4)haḥ 169 udaye savitā rakto raktaś cāstamane tathāḥ (!) saṃpattau ca vipattau ca ma(5)hatām ekarūpatā 170 bhavitavyaṃ bhavaty eva karmaṇā gatir idṛśī vipattau kiṃ (6) viṣādena saṃ[[pa]]ttau harṣanena (!) kim 171 yasya na saṃpadī (!) harṣo vipadi viṣādo raṇe cā(7)cābhirūtvaṃ (!) taṃ bhuvanatrayatilakam janayati jananīsutaṃ viralam 172 (fol. 18v2–7) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || gopya ūcuḥ || jayati teʼdhikaṃ janmanā vrajaḥ śrayata indirā śaśvad atra hi || dayita dṛśyatāṃ dikṣu tāvakās tvayi dhṛtāsavas tvāṃ vicinvate || 1 || śaradudāśaye sādhujātasat- sarasijodaraśrīmuṣā dṛśā || suratha(!)nātha teʼśulkadāsikā varada nighnato neha kiṃ vadhaḥ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End yat te sujātacaraṇāṃburuhaṃ steneṣu bhītāḥ śanaiḥ priya dadhīmahi karkaśeṣu || tenāṭavīm aṭasi tad vyathate na kiṃsvit kūrpādibhir bhramati dhīr bhavadāyuṣāṃ naḥ || 19 || (fol. 4r2–5) Colophon iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe daśamaskandhe pūrvārddhe rāsakrīḍāyāṃ gopīgītaṃ nāmaikatriṃśoʼdhyāyaḥ | 31 | śrīnandanandanaprabhūko dāsasya dāsasya ca dāsadāsaḥ leºº (fol. 4r5–7)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || chaṃdasāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yena śrutamātreṇa budhyate || tam ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śrutabodham avistaraṃ || 1 || saṃyuktādyaṃ dīrghaṃ rānuśvā(!)raṃ visargasaṃmiśraṃ || vijñeyam akṣaraṃ guru pādāṃtasthaṃ vikalpena || 2 || ādimadhyāv asāne[[ṣu]] bhajasā yāṃti gauravaṃ || yaratā lāghavaṃ yāṃti manau tu gurulāghavaṃ || 3 || yasyā[[ḥ]] pāde prathame dvā(daśa) mātrās tathā tṛtīye pi || aṣṭādasa dvitīye ⟨ca⟩ caturthake paṃ(ca)dasa sāryyā || 4 || (fol. 1v1–7) End catvāro yatra varṇāḥ prathamamalaghavaḥ ṣaṣṭagaḥ saptago pi dvau tāvat<ref>for tadvat</ref> ṣoḍaśādyau mṛgamadam udite ṣoḍaśāṃtyau tathāṃtyau || raṃbhā(4)staṃbhorukaṃte muniṃ(!)munimuni⟪r⟫bhir dṛśyate ced virāmo bāle [[ā]]dyaiḥ kav⟪i⟫[[ī]]ndraiḥ sutanu nigaditā sragdha(6)rā sā prasiddhā⟨ḥ⟩ || 42 || (exp. 6b1–6) Colophon iti śrīkavicakravartikā(7)lidāsa⟪‥ ‥⟫viracitaṃ śrutabodhanāmachaṃdo(!)(8)lakṣaṇaṃ samāptaṃ ❁ śāke 1667 māsa 5 tithau 11 (exp. 6b6–8)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ śrīsūryyāya namaḥ || || sūryo (!) vande śubhaṃ pakṣye, nānāśāstre ca saṃgrahe | dai..sya avodhānyaḥ tatra śāstra (!) vicārayet || || atha grahanāma || āditya (!) savitā sūryyo bhāskarokto divākaraḥ | tīkṣṇāṃśu suparo bhānuḥ sahasrāśuḥ (!) prabhākaraḥ || śītāṃśu (!) candramāḥ somo mṛgākendu (!) niśākaraḥ || śītalakṣmīr nniśānāthaḥ śaśāṃka śaśalāṃchaṇaḥ (!) || (fol. 1v1–4) End bhavet saṃdhyāgate paścāds (!) tam eṣān dinatraya (!) dinānīya ca pūrvvena | yatkṛtaṃ karma varjjayet | yātrācūḍāvivāhaśrutivimalavidhiśaṃjñā (!) śasya (!) praveśaṃ prāsādodyānavāpīsuranara mao nārambha vipradāna aujīrandhrapratiṣṭhām aniradakanakādhāra na kurvvate je mṛtyus teṣāṃ ca sime guru dinakarayor ekarosi…… ||| (fol. 40v4–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśaṃ śivabhāṣkaraṃ rāmacandraṃ bhavānī praṇamyātha ṭīkāstaramyaṃ (!) camatkāraciṃtāmaṇerdevavedī pravodhāya dharmeśvaraḥ saṃpravṛttiḥ || 1 || lasatpītapadyaṃ varaṃ kṛṣṇacaṃdraṃ mudārādhayāliṃgitaṃ vidyuteva || ghanasaṃpraṇamyātha nārāyaṇo na camatkāra ciṃtāmaṇIṃ saṃpravakṣye || 2 || kvaṇatkiṃkiṇī jāla kolāhalāḍhyaṃ lasatpītavāsovasānaṃ calaṃtaṃ || yaśodāgaṇaiyogināmapyagamyaṃ bhajehaṃ mukuṃdaṃ ghanaśyāma varṇam || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End gṛhagrahagaṇitādi sapta vargā nija gopyaphalādi vatsareṇa || dinakaradhairyayutā praṇamya vodhau iha phala niścitameva satya satyaḥ || iti meṣādi rāśyāṃ targataścaśvinyādi saptaviṃśati nakṣatrāṇI nava caraṇādi pratyeka phalasamāptomāgāt || || pārāvāraghanābdamṛgyarke tithyādaunadya yugāśvivatsa ---- śrīnārāyaṇa grāma vasvadhīmān lakṣmīnātha dvijasya likhyako dhīḥ || 1 || (fol. 12v1–5) Colophon śubhamastu sarvadā || || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ samāptoʼyaṃ rāśi jalapaṭaḥ (fol. 1v5)

Beginning śrīvighneśāya namaḥ || || athakavinandadāsakṛta anekārthanāmamālā liṣyate || doharā || juprabhu jotimaya jagamaya kāranakarata abheva || vighana haraṇa savasukha karana namo namo tā deva || 1 || ekaivastu aneka hai jagamagātajajagadhāma || jyau kaṃcana tai saṃkṛta samubhunako asamartha || tinahita naṃda sumati jathā bhāṣā karachu suartha || 3 || (fol. 1v1-6) End rajaśabda || rajarāja saāeakta raja rajajuvavatīmaihoī || raja dhūlīrajapātakauṃ hariniramala jala hoī || 19 || kuśadva || kuśa sītāsutadarabhakuśakuśala kahiyaipuninīra || kusadānavadatidvārakā tahāṃ vasaivalavīra || 20 || kūṭa śabda || kūṭa vahuta aru kūṭa giri aharana kūṭa kahaṃta || kūtakapaṭakoṃ nipaṭataji bhajile manabhagavaṃta || 21 || ṣaraśabda || ṣaragardhava samatejagata jaunadhanasyāma || 22 || kuja śabda || yamaśabda || kuja maṃgala kuja ana druma ------------------------------------------------------------------- /// (fol. 11v3-7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ vargāḥ pṛthvī purakṣmāmṛdvanauṣadhi mṛgādibhiḥ || nṛ vrahma kṣatravṛṭ śūdraiḥ sāṃgopāṃgairihoditāḥ 1 bhūrbhūmi racalānantā rasāviśvabharā sthitā || dharāṃ dharitrī dhariṇī kṣoṇījyā kāśyapī akṣitiḥ 2 sarvaṃ sahā vasumatī vasudhorvvīvasuṃdharā gotrākuḥ pṛthivī pṛthvī kṣmāvarnīrme dinīmahī 3 mṛnmṛttikā praśastātu mṛtsā mṛtsnā ca mṛttikā urvarā sarvasasyāḍyā syādūṣaḥ kṣāramṛttikā 4 (fol. 1v1–4) End uddhārortha prayogastu kusīdalaghni(!) jīvakā yāśvāyāptaṃ yācitakaṃ viyamādābhapityakaṃ 4 uttama smīdhaṇomargho prayotkṛgrāhakau kramāt kusīdikovārddhuṣiko vṛddhyā jīvaścavārdhurṣI(!) kṣetrājīvaḥ karṣakaśca kṛṣikaśca kṛṣI valaḥ kṣetravraiheya śāleya vrihī śālyudbhavecitaṃ 6 yavyaṃ javavyaṃ ṣaṣṭīkyaṃ ya vādi bhavanaṃ hiyat tolyaṃtai -------------------------- /// (fol. 38v4–7)

Beginning rupaṃ || śucau manojñe vijanevidadhyā (!) chiḷātalemaṇḍalakaṃ viśuddho || 9 || pītaḥ śureśaḥ kapilāhūśaḥ kṛśomamaḥ (!) śyāmavapūrakṣaḥ || śuklaḥ praceno hari tat samīra citrodhanodhavalo maheśaḥ || 10 || evaṃ vidhā padmadalodaleṣu krameṇa dikṣaṣṭa sūlokapālāḥ || ācāryya vākyān gatena pūṃsāṃ amhāhaṃ pūjā vinārccaniyāḥ || 11 || (fol. 1r1–3) End bhūmi hatāśaya yo gaganānāṃ piṃgalakhagena kṛteṣu hṛteṣu || syāta paradeśa samuccalitānāṃ vāchita siddhirathāgamana || 84 || bhūpavanāmvu hutāśana śabdāḥ syuḥ kramato yādi piṃgalikāyāḥ tinniyamena jayo yudhirājñāṃ sidhyati cānyadabhīṣṭamaṣṭāt || bhūmya (fol. 6v7–9) Colophon iti vasantarāja śākune piṃgalārutedvisaṃyoga svaraphalaprakaraṇaṃ ṣaṣṭaṃ || (fol. 6r3–4) Sub–colophon iti vasantarājaviracitaṃ dāridravidrāvanaṃ (!) nāma samāptaṃ || || (fol. 19v9) iti vasantarājaśākune śivārute vicāryyāyāma prakaraṇaṃ prathamaṃ || (fol. 13v7)

Beginning of the root text sāṃvādityas tadārabhya sarvavyādhiharo raviḥ dadāti sarvabhaktebhyoḥ nāmayā sarvasaṃpadaḥ 47 sāṃvakuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā ravivāre ʼruṇodaye sāṃvādityaṃ ca saṃpūjya vyādhibhir nānubhūyate 48 || (fol. 573r2–3) Beginning of the commentarya 47 48 sevanāt pūjanāt ayameva vā pāṭhaḥ 49 raviparvasamaṃ sūryagrahaṇasamaṃ 50 51 52 (fol. 573r1) End of the root text vitanovāca kiṃpaṇena bhaginy atra kathayāmy evam eva hi tvajuyekā (!) ca me prītis majuye (!) kintu te sukham 8 (fol. 580v8–9) End of the commentary paṇaṃ jayānaṃtaraṃ devaṃ na yātuṃ āgachatu (!) na yātīti kkacit (!) 78 (fol. 580v8–9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurave namaḥ || ❖ || brāhmāja (!) śaṃkarabīndu kuśajña jīva śukrārka putragaṇanātha guruṃ praṇamya || yaḥ saṃgrahorka varalābha viśuddhabuddhe rāvaṃtakasya tamahaṃ vivṛṇomi kṛtṣṇaṃ || 1 || yachāstraṃ savitā cakāra vipulaiḥ skaṃdhai stribhirjyotiṣastasyochiti bhayātpunaḥ kaliyuge saṃśrityayo bhūtalaṃ || bhūpaḥ svalpataraṃ varāhamihira vyājena sarvavyathā ditthaṃ yaṃ pravadaṃti mokṣa kuśalā tasmai namo bhāsvate || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End veda brāhmaṇa sādhu pujanarataḥ prājñaḥ śucistrijitaḥ prāsūśunnata nāsika kṛśacaladgatroṭanorthānvitaḥ || hīgāṃga (!) krayavikraye sunipuṇaṃ devadvijāmātparu (!) gvaṃdhūnāmupakāra kṛhibhiṣitatpakta (!) śvatai saptame || 21 || pṛthusūnayanavakṣāvṛtta ----------------- /// (fol. 43v9–10) Colophon iti bṛhajjātake caṃdrayogādhyāyaḥ || 13 || (fol. 41v7–8) Sub–colophon iti bṛhajjātake nābhasaṃyogādhyāya || 12 || (fol. 41r3)

Beginning śrīḥ || lagnātputra kalatraṃbhe śubhapati prāptethavālokite caṃdrādvā yadi saṃpadasti hitayorjñeyonyathā saṃbhavaḥ || pāthodayaravau (!) ravisuto mīnasthitodārahā putrasthānagataśva putramaraṇaṃ putrorvaneryachatiḥ || 1 || krūragrahaiḥ sita caturasrasāṃsthitaimadhyaste bhṛgutanaye thavograyoḥ || saumyagrahai rasahitasaṃnīrīkṣate jāyāvadho dahana nipātapāśajaḥ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End svadhātikesarpa viveṣṭitāṃgo vastrairvihīnaḥ puruṣastvaṭavyāṃ || caurānalavyākulitāṃtarātmā vikośatetyo pagatobhuṣasya || 36 || ādityadāsa tanayastadavāptabodhaḥ kāṃpilpale savitṛladhvavaraprasādaḥ || āvaṃtike munimatānyavalokya samya gdyorāṃ varāhamihiro rucirāṃ cakāraḥ || 36 || (fol. 8v3–5) Colophon iti śrī bhaṭṭotpala viracitāyāṃ varāhamihirakṛtau bṛhajjātake dreṣkāṇaḥ svarupādhyāyaḥ paṃcaviṃśatitamaḥ || 25 || samāpto yaṃ jātakapustakam agamat || likhitaṃkṣarodvijoyaṃ idrāṃdyā haraye gurorprasādaṃ || horāśāstramidaṃ anantaguhyaṃ lakṣmīnāthadvijottamena siddhiṃ || 1 || pārāvārādyanābdavikramerke durgāsoma sutaḥ kalāvihīne || kaṣṭeno likhitaṃ na jyotiṣoyaṃ yatnena pratipālayedvudhasya || 2 || aṃśakādjñāyate dravyaṃ deṣkāṇaistaskarāḥ smṛtāḥ || rāśibhyaḥ kāladigdeśāvayo jātiścalagnapāt || 3 || (fol. 8v5–9)

Beginning tnamālāyāṃ yogaprakaraṇaṃ caturtho dhyāyaḥ || 4 || ❁ || vavāhūyaṃ vālavakaulavāṣye (!) tato bhave taitilanāmadhyeyaṃ || garābhitrānaṃvanijaṃ ca viśiṣṭim ity āhur āryyākaraṇāni sapta || 1 || caturddasījā śasiniprahīne tasyā vibhāge sakunī dvitīye || darśārddhayoś ca caturahināgaṃ kiṃstughnim ādyapratipaddaletu || 2 || (fol. 9r1–5) End ayam akā (!) rkas tuhinakiranād rākṣāsād vāsnā sajñau pi tryagno yo kṣitisutadine caṃdraputrabhijicya || pitri vrāhmābhṛgusutadine rākṣasāpyaistave bho- jaṃ (!) ghosā (!) savitṛtanaye varjanīyo mahutau || 5 || (fol. 21v5–7) Sub-colophon itī srīsrīpatibhaṭṭaviracitāyāṃ yotiṣaratnamālāyāṃ karaṇaviṣṭiprakaraṇaṃ paṃcamo dhyāya || ❁ || (fol. 11r1–2) Colophon iti srīsrīpatibhaṭṭaviracitāyāṃ yotiṣaratnamālāyāṃ nakṣatraprakarana ṣaṣṭamo dhyāya || (fol. 21r4–5)

Beginning khamaṃdire valayogātphalamaṃśakarkṣayoḥ || 13 || āśarka jayostrikoṇage caṃdreʼste visṛjyatevayā (!) || dṛṣṭemararājamaṃtriṇā dīrghamāyuḥ sukhabhākkasasmṛtāḥ || 14 || pāpekṣite tuhinagāvudaye kujeʼstetyakto vinasyati kujārka jayostathāye || saumyepi paśyati tathā viśva hastameti saumyerateṣu purahastagatopyanāyuḥ || 15 || (fol. 10r1–4) End ekasthaiścaturādibhir valayutairjjātāḥ pṛthagvīryagaiḥ śākyājīvika bhikṣu vṛddhacara kānirgraṃthavanyāśanāḥ || māheyajña gurukṣapākara sita prābhākarīṇaiḥ kramātpravajyā valibhiḥ samāparayutai svasvāmibhiḥ pracyuteḥ (!) || || 1 || ravi lupta karairadīkṣitāḥ valibhistadgata bhaktayo narāḥ || abhiyācitā mātra dīkṣitānihataisya ---- /// (fol. 22v5–8) Colophon iti śrīvarāhamihira viracita bṛhajjātake dvigrahayogādhyāyaścaturddaśaḥ || (fol. 22v4–5)

Beginning yavanaśāstra praṇayanāt dvijānāmapi sūrya siddhāṃta vadetadadhyayanaṃ yuktamityuktaṃ || keśaviṣṇu mukhanirgata śāpāt mlechatādhigatati mamarīceḥ || romakeṇa purilabdhamaśeṣaṃ tat dviādibhiratodhyayanīyamiti || puriromakapattano yadātu tedevaṃ prameyaṃkana citsuvuddhinā samarasiṃhādinā adhīta tadīpajyotiḥ śāstreṇa dṛḍhatarasaṃskārādatyanta saṃjñā paribhāṣeṇa saṃskṛta śabdairupa nivaddhaṃ cetpaḍhyate tadāna kopi doṣa iti jñeyaṃ || (fol. 3r1–4) End janmalagnād vaṣelagnamaṣṭame yadi jāyate || tasminvarṣe bhavetpīḍā mṛtyuḥ pāpayute kṣaṇāt || aṣṭamalagnemutha heśvara yogānniṣiddha iti tājakasāre || hṛdeśvaro hāyanalagnanāthaḥ saptāṃtyagaḥ krūrayutaḥ karoti || mṛ ----- /// (fol. 68v11–12) Colophon iti śrīmaddaivajña varya paṇḍita dāmodarātmaja valabhadraviracite hāyanaratne māsapravesādi vicārādhyāyoʼṣṭamaḥ || (fol. 65v5–6)

Beginning oṃ nama (!) śrīgaṇeśāyaḥ (!) || || prapadye devam īśānaṃ sarvvajñam aparājitaṃ || saṃbhavaṃ sarvvabhūtānāṃ, manādiṃ (!) sarvvato mukhaṃ || 1 || vedādau yaḥ suraḥ prokto, oṃkārākhyo maheśvaraḥ || sṛjate sarvvabhūtāni, paṃcamūrtimaheśvaraḥ || 2 || saaṃkhyānāṃ paramaṃ yogaṃ dhṛtaṃ pāsupate tathā || sarvvaj~nānasya karttāram ādidaivam umāpatiṃ || 3 || sṛjate bhagavān devo mūrttitrayavikāravān || rakṣāṇārthaṃ sarvvajaṃtunāṃ (!) tridhātmānaṃ sṛjatyajaḥ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–3) End śrībhagavān uvāca || ityate brāhmaṇaḥ putrā āśrubhyātmānuśāsanaṃ | sanandanam athā narvvuḥ siddhā jñātvā manogatiṃ || ity aśeṣasamāmnāye purāṇo pariṣaḍrasaḥ (!) | samuddhṛtaḥ pūrvvajātair vyāsayānair mahatmabhiḥ (!) || (fol. 48v4–5) Colophon iti śrīśivapurāṇe nāmasaṃkīrttanaṃ || ekādaśa || (fol. 33r6)

Beginning yathā brahmavidyayā acirāt adīrgheṇa kālena sarvapāpaṃ nikhilaṃ duḥkhakāraṇāṃ ajñānaṃ sasaṃskāraṃ (!) vyapohya vividhaṃ parityajya vināśety arthaḥ parāt nikhila jagatkāraṇād dhiraṇyagarbhāt paraṃ utkṛṣṭaṃ ajñānāśrayaviṣayatvābhyā (!) puruṣaṃ paripūrṇaṃ upaiti prāpnoti vidvāna hamevaso (!) smi iti sākṣātkāṛavān || 3 || (fol. 3r1–3) End yat paraṃ brahma (!) sarvātmāviśvasya patanaṃ mahat| sūkṣāt (!) sūkṣmataraṃ nityaṃ tattvam eva tvam eva tat || 20 || jāgat (!) svapnasuṣuptyādiprapaṃca yat prakāśate | tad brahmāham iti jñātvā sarvabaṃdhai pramucyate || 21 || triṣu dhāmasu yat bhogyaṃ bhoktā bhogaś ca yad bhavet | tebhyo vilakṣaṇaḥ sākṣī cinmātro (!) haṃ sadāśivaḥ || 22 || (fol. 7r7–9)

Beginning ❖ oṃ nama || gulugaṇēśāya nama || || jamaṃjaya uvaca || dvāvale ca samupeta śagare ca hastinā puli ,, gurunāpṛchato lājā,, jamaṃjaya mahāvari || || rājā jamaṃjayaḥ | anika ṛṣīśvaa paniske, pāthanā, vimatiyāṅāo, ṅese vijāta, thva hastināpula, dhāyāgura, lājya, dvāpajugasanikaṃ , tpatijuralā, thva deśayā,, rājāyudhisthirayākha, saṃsunaka se vijyāyāmāra, dhakāo, dunāvayāsya vijyāta || 1 || (fol. 1v1–5) End vaisamāya uvāca || dhameṣuhametevyādhi,, dharmmapuhane tegraha, ddharmma mekhuha netra śatru jato dharmma tatvajaya || || dharmana sogaduyuo, dharmmana, mabhiṅa, grahaṃphuyio , dharmana sa .. ciṃmoyuva, ganadharmmadaḍha arajayaju iva dhakāo, vaisaṃpāyana ṛṣina rājā jamaṃjayakanaṃ || 107 || (fol. 373–37v1) Colophon iti śrīmahābhaate satasahasāṃ sahitāyāṃ, asomedvajajñadharmajudhisthira, saṃvāde, judhidsthirajajña samāptaṃ || śubha samvat 641 caitakṛṣṇa, patipada || śubha, maṃgaraṃ bhavatu savadākālaṃ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 37v1–3)

Beginning ṛṣiparamadhārmika (!) || udālako ti vikhyāto brahmaputraḥ sutāpasaḥ || 9 || vedavedāṃgatattvajñaḥ smṛtisiddhāṃtapāragaḥ || dāṃto (!) dakṣo muniśreṣṭho mahāprājño mahātapā (!) || 10 || tasyāśramaṃ paraṃ ramyaṃ ṛṣibhir munisevitaṃ nānādrumasamākīrṇaṃ nānāpuṇyopaśobhitaṃ || 11 || haṃkakāraṃḍavākīrṇaṃ (!) cakravākopaśobhitaṃ || sevyamānaṃ khagānīkaiḥ kamalai rupaśobhitaṃ || 12 || (fol. 2r1–5) End punaḥś caiva yathājñāyaṃś ca bhivā (!) || ghagatāśvāte (!) || nāsiketas tato jñānam abhisaṃmokṣagāminaṃ || 48 || idaṃ tu kathitaṃ guhyaṃ nāsiketa kathām ata (!) || śuṇoti (!) mahābāho prapanno bhaktimān naraḥ || 49 || api sarveṣu pāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || nāsiketasya mahātmā ye śṛṇvaṃti paṭhaṃti ye || 50 || punargarbha (!) na jāyaṃte svarga (!) yāṃti yathocitaṃ || (fol. 35v7–10) Colophon iti śrīnāsiketopākhyāne śubhāśubhaṃ kṛtaṃ karmajanmaṃ ca bhāvavarṇano nāmaṣṭādaśo dhyāya (!) samvat 1690 (!) || 18 || (fol. 35v11–12)

Beginning ma (!) śaṭhaṃ bhaja sarvātmanā sadā || aklībaṃ madhuraṃ caiva satyaṃ janamanoharaṃ || alpākṣaram anekārthaṃ vākyaṃ brūhi mahāmate || abhīto bhava sarvatra vipakṣeṣu vipatsu ca || bhīto bhava brahmakule pāpe ca guruśāsane || jñāti bandhuṣu mitreṣu bhāryyāyāṃ tarayeṣu ca || samabhāvena varttethā (!) tathā vajanapaṃktiṣu || (fol. 45r1–2) End japenāgatya taṃ deśaṃ māgadhe rāṣṭatas (!) tathā || bāhyamānaṃ krandamānaṃ hṛtastrī (!) gṛhato dhanaṃ || dṛṣṭhā (!) rāṣṭraṃ janaṃ sarvve rājaśūnyaṃ bhayākulaṃ || krodhadhyātamanās tūrṇaṃ praviśya ripuvāhināṃ || ākarṇād dṛṣṭako daṇḍo vavarṣaśarasantati (!) || te hanyamānā ripavo rājaputreṇa sāyakaiḥ || tamabhīddhṛtya (!) .......................................||| || (fol. 48v8–10) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe brahmottarakhaṇḍe śivakavacakathanaṃ nāma dvādaśo dhyāyaḥ || (fol. 48r4)

Beginning || gacha(!)ti cet tad ājñāṃ yo, vinā śaṃbhos tad antikaṃ || avimṛṣya tathā bhaktaḥ prāpnoti sa mahāpadaṃ || || inda(!) uvāca || bho bho dahana tejasvī rudrāṃśas tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || bhadraṃ kuru (..) devānāṃ, rājyānāṃ hi viśeṣataḥ || dehaparo paro kāya, dharmmarakṣāya vai vacaḥ || sarvvakāmaghugha(!)vātmā, kṣaṇāṃ tiṣṭhaty asaṃśayaḥ || (fol. 3r1–2) End pacyante matsya vaddhāpyāṃ(!), vividhanarakeṣu tān || etat pramāṇaṃ kathitaṃ mayā te, pātālapātur nila yasya sūkṣmaṃ || bhūyo rasādeḥ kathayāmi kīrttiṃ, tat saptalokasya śṛṇujña mattaḥ || 137 || || skanda uvāca || pātālānāṃ ca saptānāṃ, uparisaṃsthitā mahī || ||(fol. 17v6–7) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe himavatkhaṇḍe pātālakīrttanaṃ nāma pañcamo dhyāyaḥ || 5 || (fol. 17v5)

Beginning . . . . . . /// gari gadgadvāṇile gari vujhāuṃdābhayāḥ he bhrātārāmacandra hajura jastā puruṣale yesto soka garnu johye chaina he bhrātā tapāī kastā hau bhanyā sākṣāt nārāyaṇakā avatāra bhayākā. tapāīkā māyāle gari saṃsārakana moha garāī duniyā māyāmā luvdha bhayākā chan. pheri testā ajñāniharukana pani jñāna di duddhāra garnu huncha. yestā puruṣa tapāī bhaikana yaso garī mohabhairahanu jogye chainaḥ (fol. 2r1–3) End he svāmi maile yeka samācāra sunyāki chu tyo kurāmā viṃti garchu sunnuhavasḥ he svāmi tapāīko putra aṃgada sikāra jādāmā suni āyāko kurā malāī kahyāko cha so ma bhanchu. ajudhyākā rājā daśarathakā putra rāmalakṣmaṇa sitā sahita gari āyākā thiyā tinaki sitā rāvaṇale cori lagyo ra. ti rāmalakṣmaṇa sitāko ṣojanā nimitta āuṃdā ṛṣimuṣaparva . . . . . . . . /// (fol. 7v10–12) Colophon || iti śrīmadadhyātmarāmāyaṇe umāmaheśvarasamvāde kiṣkiṃdhyākāṇḍe sugṛvastutināma prathamadhyāyaḥ || 1 || (fol. 6r7–8)

Beginning /// ṇair eva tuṣye tato ṣite brahmā devā teḥ | narakepi citaṃ magnāḥ pūrvvajāye kuladvaye | tā devayātti te svagrjaṃ yadārccyani suto hariṃ | kiṃ teṣāṃ jīvite neha paśuvacyeṣṭi tena kiṃ | dhyānatasya pravakṣāmi yan na pṛṣṭhaṃ hi kenacit | śrūyatāṃ bhūpa kaivalyaṃ kevalaṃ malavartitaṃ || || śrīnārada uvāca || yathā dīpo nivātastho niśvalo vāyuvaritaḥ | prajñalen nāśayet sarvam andhakāraṃ mahāmate | (fol. 5r1–4) End tasya dharmaḥ pasannātmā puṇyaṃ saukhyaṃ prayachati | yaṃ yaṃ cintayat prāñas taṃ taṃ prāpnoti durllabhaṃ || || deva śambhauvāca || || sarvvam evaṃ samākhyātaṃ dharmākhyānam anunnatamaṃ | kathaṃ putram ayaṃ vidyā dvaiṣṇavaṃ guṇasaṃyutaṃ | vadatvaṃ me mahābhāge yadi jānāsi suvrate | dharmamārga tvayā sarvvaḥ pituḥ prāptaḥ purā nadye | mamaitad vidite kvā/// (fol. 16v5–7) Colophon iti śrīpadmapurāṇe vaiśāṣamāhātmye devaśarmmasumanopākhyāne || (fol. 16r2–3)

Beginning tathaivākarot tat sarvaṃ bhagavan nirdiṣṭaṃ tat kāryaṃ loke prasiddhaṃ jātam ity āha garbhe prāṇīta iti garbhe prakarṣeṇa nīte rohiṇyudaraṃ prāpite yoganidrayeti (!) karṣaṇaprāpaṇayoḥ sarvājñānaṃ nirupitaṃ aho ity āścarye viśrāṃsita (!) iti sraṃsudhvaṃsvadhaḥ (!) patane tena paṃcamo māsaḥ (fol. 16r1–3) End yaṃ satyaṃ satyam eva vrataṃ yasya tādṛśaṃ vāṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannā iti saṃbaṃdhaḥ evaṃ vrata satyayor aikyam uktaṃ ubhayoḥ paratvāt ataḥ paraṃ yat paramaṃ loke vedeva dvādaśavidhaṃ nirupitaṃ satyaṃ tapo damo rāmaḥ dānaṃ dharmaḥ prajananamagnayaḥ agnihotraṃ yajño manaḥ sanyāsaś ceti tat sarvaṃ bhagavataḥ satyam eva yathārthameva (!) nanu............... ||| (fol. 20v9–11)

Beginning cca (!) tathā viṣṇusamānīto makhaṃ prati || devendro hi samānīta indrādyā (!) saha suprabhaḥ | tathā cāndro hi rohiṇyā, varuṇaḥ priyaya (!) sahaḥ(!) || kuveraḥ puṣkarārūḍho, mṛgārūḍho tha mārutaḥ || chāgo rūḍhaḥ pāvakaś ca pretārūḍho hi naiṛtaḥ || evaṃ sarvve samāyātāḥ yajñavāḍha (!) dvijanmanaḥ te sarvve satkṛtās tena, dakṣeṇa ca durātmanā || (fol. 5r1–3) End jitendriyā vītarāgāḥ sarvvaviṣaya vairi++++++++ parivṛtaḥ śaṃkaro loka śaṃkaraḥ | dṛṣṭas tayā tapo viṣṭha, āsane paramād bhute || ākṣipta citta (!) sahasa (!) +++++++++++++++ nidhiṃ | śivena sthāpitā svāṃke, prītiyuktena vallabhā || premoditai vvacobhiḥ sā bahumāna purusaraṃ (!) | +++++++++ (fol. 7v4–6) Colophon (fol. )

Beginning ------- /// paśca kāmaścāṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || atohaṃ vravīmi utpanneṣu kārya --- tyādi || +++++ damanako vadati | upayaḥ kriyatāṃ tathā coktaṃ || upāyena hiyachakyaṃ, natachakyaṃparā ++++++ | damanakaḥ kathayati | kasmiścitta raurvaya sadamyatīnivasataḥ | tapoścā patyā ++++++ ---- sī ---- taṃ | (fol. 1r1–4) End kimiti sarvva paśuchedaḥ kriyate | vayameva +++++ | tataḥ prabhṛtyaikaikaṃ paśu bhakṣayannāste | atha kadācit vṛddha śaśakasya ++++ kriyate jīvitā śayā | paṃcadutvaṃ caṃga(!) miṣyāmi, kiṃ siṃhān naye na me || (fol. 45v3–5) Colophon (fol.)

Beginning ❖ oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || natvā sarasvatīṃ devīṃ svalpāpraśnottarāvalī || kriyatelpa dhiyānena, śrīgaṇapati śarmmaṇā || śrīharipati pautreṇa kamalāpatisūnunā | padminī tanaye naiṣā vinoda karaṇāyasā || (fol. 1v1–3) End tataḥ sāvaraṇāṃ devī, mudvase (!) hṛdayā jammu (!) || śeṣekāyai samarthyāya, sthalaṃ matraśodhayet || || 63 || syāvāgbhavaṃ hṛduchiṣṭhaścaṇḍolitadantaram | badenmātaṃgi sarvānte vaśaka (!) riyugmakam || 64 || ekaviśati (!) bhirvvarṇṇa, śeṣikāmanurī-------/// (fol. ) Colophon (fol. )

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || nārāyaṇaṃ namas kṛtya naram caiva narottamam || devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayam udīrayet || 1 || vyāsa uvāca || ○ || śṛṇu sūta pravakṣāmi māghasyānaṃtakaphalam || yad uktaṃ tu vasiṣṭhena dilīpapurato yathā || 1 || sūta uvāca || pādme mādhasya māhātmyaṃ bhagavan bruhi me śubham || anugrāhyosmi śiṣyosmi bruhi tan me yathātatham || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End maṇimayagirisaṃdhau snānamātreṇa māghe madanavadanarupas tatra vidyādharobhūt || 43 || kṣapita niyama deho vidhyapādāvatīrṇāṃ bhṛgur api saha śīṣyai rājagāmāthare vāṃ || akhilabhūvanaṃ sāraṃ māghamāhātmyam etad dijavara bhṛguṇoktaṃ bhūpavidyādharāya || 44 || vividhaphalavicitraṃ yaṃ śṛṇōti iha bhaktyā rucirasakalakāmān prāpnyād devavatsaḥ || 45 || (fol. 11r6–11v1) Sub-colophon iti kārttikamāhātmye dīpapradānādhyāyaḥ samāptam iti || (fol. 4r4–5)

Beginning ///sarvvaṃ prakuryyātriguṇapramāṇa, mavyasthitasyāpy atha dīparājaḥ || daleṣu śibhārtham atīva kuryyā, manorathaṃ prāpya palabdha ye ca || dhaṃṭḥāṣṭhakaṃ laṃvitapuṣpadāma, sarpastraśobhānvitamatrapaścāt | saṃśodhyabhūmiṃ tvathagomayena, sa candanāktena jalena liptvā || aneka parṣṇe rathamaṇḍalas tu, kṛtvā ṣṭhapatraṃ kamalapramāṇaṃ || phalāni mūlāni tathe javaṃ ca, lājādadhīkṣīramadthānnapānaṃ || nānāvidhaaṃ bhakṣaviśeṣaṇaṃ ca, sanṛtyagītaṃ madhuraṃ ca vādyaṃ | nivedya dharmāya harāya bhūmau, dāmodarāyāpy aśvadharma rājñe | prajāpatibhyas tvathasapitṛbhyaḥ pretebhya evāndhatam āsthitebhyaḥ || (fol. 2r1–6) End kṛteti karmam ajñānā, dajñānā dapyanāśanaṃ || kartavyam avyapachinna, smard bhir madhūdana(!) || pulastya uvāca || nārakās ted vacaḥ śṛutvā, tamūcūrati duḥkhitāḥ | kṣutkāmakaṇṭḥātṛt tāpa, parisphaṭitatālukāḥ || bho bho sādho kṛtaṃ karmma, yadasmāmis tad ucyatāṃ | narakasye vipākoyaṃ, bhujyataṃ yasya dāruṇaḥ | || diṅkarā ūcuḥ || yusma/// (fol. 7v4–5) Colophon iti kārttikamāhātmye dīpapradānādhyāyaḥ samāptam iti || (fol. 4r4–5)

Beginning śrīrāmasītālakṣmaṇahanūmadbhyo namo namaḥ || sā rākṣasīmadhyagatā ca bhīrur vāgbhir bhṛśaṃ rāvaṇatarjitāṃ ca || kāṃtāramadhye vijane visṛṣṭā vāleva kanyā vilalāpa sītā || 2 || satyaṃ vatedaṃ pravadanti loke nākālamṛtyur bhavatīti saṃtaḥ || yatrāham evaṃ paribhartsyamānā jīvāmi kiṃcitkṣaṇam apya puṇyā || 3 || (fol. 1r1–5) End tarasvinau dhvārayatāmṛgasya satvena rupaṃ manujendra putrau nūnaṃ viśaranau(!) mama kāraṇāntau siṃharṣamaudvā mivavaidyutena 9 nūnaṃ kalālo mṛgarupadhārī mām alpabhāgyāṃ lulupe tadānīṃ yatrārya putrair visasarjamūḍhā rāmānuja lakṣmaṇā bāuju māhili gurumā (fol. 2r5–3r2)

Beginning yallagnaṃ tadyaḥ saptamo rāśiḥ sajayaturyathā maithunaṃ karoti tathā maithunaṃ vaktavyaṃ || tasminneva +++++ grayukta dṛṣṭe tanmaithuna sāyāsaṃtryāyāsayutaṃ vaktavyaṃ || śubhaidṛṣṭayutai punaḥ vidagdhaṃ sitkārā (!) +++++ sāmāstyānnakecidṛṣṭe yuktena sāyāsaṃna vīdagdhaṃ vaktavyaṃ | miśraiḥ śubhāśubhai dṛṣṭe yute vāta ++++ hitaṃ vidagdhaṃ vaktavyaṃ miti || dīpajñānamāha || (fol. 9r1–4) End evaṃ tāvatvrahmalagnaṃ svaguṇai khaścaṃ guṇanīyaṃ || tatra tatra lagne yadi graho bhavati tadā tallagnasvaguṇaguṇitaṃ grahaguṇai ravi guṇayet || ekadvayelagnavarttini ekagraha guṇaguṇitamapagraha guṇairapi guṇayet || (fol. 40v7–9) Colophon || iti laghujātake nairyyānikāyo dvādaśaḥ || || || (fol. 40r7)

Beginning /// ntārako dānavaiḥ saha | cakāra tridive rājyaṃ vidrāṇya tridaśāndiṇaḥ(!) | tadvināśāya jānīhi hetur mmajanmakuṃbhaja | rudramukhāravindādvipurāpragalitaṃ śrutaṃ || || ṛṣaya ucuḥ || daityai rājye kṛte svargadevasainyeṣu vidrute | kim akurvvan surās tatra tadvalārdditasaṃbhramā | labdhavaropi devān sa tārakākhyo mahāsuraḥ | kathaṃ nirjjitavān devān prabho tadvadanodhunā || (fol. 106r1–2) End evaṃ samīlya vṛtreṇa kaṃcitkālaṃ nināya ca || puruhūtaḥ samaṃ svarge saravatvena mudānvitaḥ | tathāpi aniva lebhe ca puruhūtaḥ śivaṃ dvija || hṛdaye hūya mānas tachidrānveṣaṇatatparaḥ | bhadrāvasya site pakṣe, ekādaśyāṃ puraṃdaraḥ || bhaktyā labhad varaṃ bhadraṃ talliṃgaprasevanāt || samācādhyāsīchakumārghahṛdevāṣā | labdhavaro mahārekhād vatraṃ huṃtu manā bhavat | ta/// (fol. 3r4–5) Colophon iti śrīskaṃdapurāṇe himavatkhaṃḍe nepālamāhātmye virupākṣatīrthayātrāyāṃ sarvveśvaramāhātmyaṃ nāma sattatriṃśaduttaraśatamādhyāmaḥ || 737 || (fol. 287r4–5)

Beginning 2 oṃ namaḥ śivāya || tan man mahe maheśānaṃ priyārbbhakaṃ | gaṇeśānaṃ karigaṇeśāno namanāmayaṃ (!) || bhūmiṣṭhāpi na yātra (!) , bhūstridivato pyuccair adhaḥsthāpita | yāvad bhābhuvimuktidāsyutā (!) yasyāṃmṛtā jantavaḥ yā nityaṃ tripurārirājanarīyāyāda (!) yāyāṅgagat || (fol. 1v1–2) End vihitā katrinīrekhā (!) kundāvanāvatīkalā || prāyonmadanabhūpāla, harmya ratnāmbare śubhe || lomāvalīṃ lakṣitārddham iva yaṣṭiṃ vidhir vyadhāt || tasyā nābhīdarīṃ prāpya, kandaryyo naṅgatāṅgataḥ | punaḥ prāpnum (!) ivāṅgāni, tapyate paraman tapaḥ || guruṇai (!) tan nitambena, mahāmanmathadīkṣayo || || (fol. 442v3–5) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe kāśikhaṇḍaviśveśvaraliṃgamahimākhyāno (!) nāma navanavatitamo dhyāyaḥ || (fol. 436v7–438r1)

Beginning ❖ śrī 3 nṛtyeśvarāya namaḥ || || ādau vidyāvilāpanāṭake nāndīślokaḥ || || sānandaṃ himakuḍakairavasudhākarpūrakuṃjaprabhaś candrārddhāṃkita śeṣaṇe giristā dehārddabhākkāmadaḥ || gīrvvāṇaughasupūjitāṃghrikamalo gaṃgādharaḥ śūlabhṛd devaḥ pannagahāra kaṃkaṇakaro nṛtyeśvaraḥ pātu vaḥ || || tato nāndīgītena nṛtyeśvarī varṇitaḥ || || nāndīme || nandīmālava || javādhā || jayajayaśaṃkaradevanadveśvara vahaśira surasaridhāra | (fol. 1v1–5) End || sunda he pitāmātā hamara praṇāma || sarvve he śiva śarmmā hamarā sabahika praṇāma || āiva manoratha siddhirastu || || guṇa he śivaśarmmā rājakumāra āu vaisu || ubhau mahārāja avaśya || viśrāma || || śivaguṇadāna || || śiva he mahārāja ehākaputra rājakumāra śastrāstra vidyā nipuna bhelāha || (fol. 23v4–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśam vande || || praṇamya heramvamathodivākaraṃ guroranaṃtasya tathāpadāmbujaṃ || śrīnīlakaṃṭho vivinakti sūktibhi stantājikaṃ sūrimanaḥ prasādakṛt || 1 || pumāścarogniḥ sudṛḍhaścatuṣyā draktoṣṇapitāvitavodrirudraḥ || pītodinaṃ prāgviṣamodayolpa saṃgaprajorukṣa nṛpaḥ samojaḥ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End tadātmajonaṃta guṇostvanaṃto yo dhok saduktiḥ kilakāmadhenuṃ || sattuṣṭhaye jātakapaddhatiṃ ca nyarupa yaduṣṭamataṃ nirasya || 65 || padmāṃ vayāsā vitato vipaśvi cchrīnīlakaṃṭhaḥ śrutiśāstravijñaḥ || vidvacchiva prītikaraṃ vyavadhātta tsaṃjñāvivekaṃ sahamāvataṃsaṃ || 65 || (fol. 21r5–7) Colophon iti saṃjñāprakaraṇaṃ samāptam || (fol. 21r8)

Beginning oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || taṃ vaṃde saccidānaṃdaṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇa(!) | vibhūtiguṇasampannaṃ gaṇeśaṃ śāradāṃ guruṃ || brahmā viṣṇus tathā rudrāḥ vibhūtinityam arcayet | tasmād ādyas tayo vandyaḥ sadguruś cāśramāvahān || ṛṣīn siddhān tathā sādhyān yogatatvaikavarttināṃ | vibhūtyā vaṃdanīyās te sohaṃ haṃsāśivātmakān || oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti śivaṃ praṇavasaṃjñitaṃ | oṃ namaḥ śivāyeti praṇavaṃ viṣṇuhṛtpadaṃ || (fol.1v1–4) End vibhūtitriguṇāsūtraṃ tripadā kālalakṣaṇaṃ | śavanaṃ tayamūrddhāyā turiyā praṇavātarā || sāvidyopanīṣattatvaṃ asyādivākyaniścayaṃ || paricaye mimākhyātaṃ praṇavaṃ vedavaṃditaṃ || taṃ vaṃde śāṃtavaṃjñānaṃ ṣaḍadhvāmnāya dīpakaṃ | śivagītārtharāmeṇa rāmeśvaraharo hariṃ || utthānaṃ pauruṣe taṃtro paṃcamaṃ puruṣārthakaṃ | avācya vācya yoge... (fol. 3v4–7) Colophon īti(!) śrīpadmapurāṇer uttarakhaṃḍe māghamāhātmye dilipa(!)saṃvāde ekonaviṃśsvodhyāyaḥ || samāptī śubham hari hari viṣṇu (fol.6r8–9)

Beginning prathama lavagataḥ san vāsave vāsavejyā || nikhilajana hitārthaṃ varṣavṛṃde variṣṭaḥ prabhava iti sanāmnā ------ dānīṃ yugaṃ bhavadvatsarapaṃcakena yugāni ca dvādaśa varṣa ṣaṣṭyā || bhavaṃti teṣā ---- krameṇa vakṣyāmi muni praṇītaḥ || 13 || viṣṇujjīvaḥ śakrodahanastvaṣṭrā cāhi --- viśve somaḥ ścendra jvalanainā saptākhyantyaśca bhagaḥ || 14 || (fol. 2r1–4) End vidyāraṃbha surapati guru jñatvabhiṣṭārthadāi (!) kartuccāyusuramapi karotrṛsumānmadhyamorkka || nīhārāṃśo bhavati jaḍatā paṃcatā bhūmiputro chāyāsūnāmapi ca munaya kīrtayaṃ teva mādyaṃ || 20 || maṇīṣinorddha praharā dvitīyādārabhya ----- /// (fol. 6v6–8) Colophon iti śrīpatibhaṭṭa viracitāyāṃ jyotiṣaratnamālāyāṃ tithiprakaraṇaṃ dvitīyaṃ || ❖ || (fol. 4v7–8) Sub–colophon iti śrīpatibhaṭṭa viracitajyotiṣaratnamālāyāṃ samvatsaraprakaraṇaṃ prathamaṃ(fol. 2v6–7)

Beginning nadoste (!) bhaviṣyati | tamupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi, yena yūto bhaviṣyati || yathā gotra kṛtaṃ vardhya, mapahāsyasi pāṇḍava | aśvamedha kratuvaraṃ, yajasva kurunandana || rāmenāpi pūrāvīra, hayamedhatrayaṃ kṛtaṃ | yajñaṃ kṛtvā tathā putra, rājyaṃ pālayamāriṣa || rājadharmmeṇa yallabdhaṃ, śāsanaṃ mādhavasya ca | tadrājatvaṃ parityājya, kasmāstvaṃ gantumichasi || (fol. 2r1–2) End || jaiminir uvāca || śilīmukhaistataḥ pārthaṃ, vyāvṛṇotsa diśodaśa | sudhanvā roṣatāmrākṣo, vidhunvan saraṃdhanuḥ || uvāca keśavaṃ bhūyo, yathā govarddhano giriḥ | gavā ------- /// (fol. 75v6–7) Sub-colophon || iti śrīmahābhārate āśvamedhikeparvvaṇI arjjunaśāpo nāma pañcadaśodhyāyaḥ || (fol. 56r4)

Beginning locanaḥ | gṛhāṇa sāyakaṃ haste, śīghraṃ pārthamamājñayā || || jaiminir uvāca || gṛhītaḥ sāyako haste, pāṇḍavena mahātmanā || vāsudevastu vāṇantaṃ, sudṛḍhaṃ deva saṃyugaṃ || vrahmāṇaṃ pachime bhāge, yojayitvā śarasyahi | madhyekālaṃ phalatasthau, svayameva janārddanaḥ || puṇyaṃ rāmāvatāre ca, kṛtantatmāyakerppitaṃ || tato hāhākṛtaṃ viśvaṃ, parārthena nasaṃhitaḥ | sagarastādṛśo rājan, sudhanvāvākyamavravīt || (fol. 77r1–3) End bhrātṛbhyāṃ sahitaṃ vīraṃ, munibhiḥ parivāritaṃ | tilokyahāmasaṃbhūta dhūmenāruṇalocanaṃ || suvarṇa sītayāyuktaṃ, maṇḍapasthamidaṃ vaca | he rāma teśvaḥ pṛthivīñca (!) vāra vīrāpi kaścinnadadhārataṃ ---- /// (fol. 115v6–7) Colophon ityāśvamedhikaparvvaṇi kuśalavopākhyānaṃ || 3 || (fol. 115v1) Sub–colophon ityāśvamedhikaparvvaṇI kuśalavopākhyāne ekonatriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 29 || (fol. 110v5–6)
