Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāye (!) namaḥ || atha vaidyamanotsava likhyate || dohā || śivasutapada praṇamo sadā riddhi siddhi budhi dei | kumati vināsana sumatikaraṇa maṃgala mudita kareī || 1 || alakha amūrata alakhagatī kinahūṃna pāyo pāra || jori jugala kara kavikahai dehu dehu mati sāra || 2 || āyuravedasaba mathanakari racyo subhākhā āna || aratha dikhāuṃ pragaṭakara auṣadha roga nidāna || 3 || (fol.1v1-5) End mātrāchaṃdaju aṃka mahikahyo alpamati soi || gunijanasavai saṃbhāriyo hīna adhika jahāṃhoi || 51 || soraṭhā || kiyo pragaṭa dadhimaṃtha auṣadiroga nidāna pinī || sakalasudhā samagraṃtha kahe vasamāpata ādite || 52 ||(fol.40v3-6) Colophon iti śrīpaṃḍīta vaidya kesavadāsasuta nainasukha viracite vaidyamanotsave istrī(!) puruṣa duragaṃdha aṃga vagala muṣa sira gaṃghakaraka bālaroga paramita kathanaṃ nāma saptamo samudeśa || 7 || samāpta śubhamastu || saṃvat 1817 || mī. Bhādo vadī || 13 || vāra budha ||(fol.40v6-41r2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || bhṛgvādi devadeveśam ahaṃ pṛcchāmi śaṅkaram || skandādyāś ca mahāmāyā bhṛṃgā(!) caiva vināyakaiḥ || śrīvakratuṃḍāya namaḥ || kailāsaśikharāsīna umāsārddhaṃ jagad guruḥ || yoginyaṣṭaka tantre ca guhyād guhyataraṃ param || sarvajñānaprakāśāya sarvājñā sarvakṛcchayaḥ || etaiḥ kāryaṃ kathaṃ deva tvayā sarvaṃ mamopari || śṛīiśvara (!) uvāca || (fol.1v1-3) «Ending:» iti sarvāṅgasundararasaḥ || kṛṣṇasāramṛgaśṛṅgakaṃ yathā sūkṣma cūrṇakṛta haṇḍikāsthitam | bhāvayet snuhila mocikārase uddhṛtaṃ samṛduvahni dāhitam || caṇḍēśarākhyaṃ pravadanti saṃtaḥ || datvā jalenaiva savyoṣakaraṃ prabhātakāle (!) hyaruṇodaye vā bhūtaṃ jvaraṃ śāntim upaiti coktaḥ || kuṣṭaṃ gandhaka viṣado triphalā pāradaḥ samaḥ || bhṛgvāṃvu mardditā hyete mudgamāṣa vaṭīkṛtāḥ || jvaraṃ hantyaṣṭayabhiryāme hy aṣṭapraharakāṇi vā ||(!) (fol. 32r2-5) Colophon iti śrīkākacaṇdeśvarīmataṃ samāptam || śubhamastu sadā (fol.32v5-6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya || ❖ oṃ śrīgurave namaḥ || ||❖ śrīdhanvantarivaidyāya namaḥ || bījaṃ śrūtīnāṃ sudhanaṃ munīnāṃ jīvaṃ jaḍānāṃ mahadādikānāṃ || āgneyamantraṃ (!) vaha (!) pātakānāṃ kiñcitsahas sāmaramāśrayāmi (!) labdhā kapola madhu vā madhuvratālī kumbhasthalī madhuvibhūṣaṇa sāhitāṅgī (!) | māṇikya mauli virājati yasya maulau vighnāni vāḥ paridhunosi sa vighnarājaḥ || (!) yo dhvānta santati viśāla payodhi madhyā (!) niḥkāsa yasya saraṇaṃ bhuvanaṃ nimajjet || datvā jagattraya hitaḥ svakarāvalambaṃ vāñchś sadhā(!) ni nakaraḥ sakalī karotu (!) (fol.1v1–4) «Sub:Colophon:» iti madanapāraviracite madavinode nirghaṇṭau madhuvarggaḥ navamaḥ || 9 || ❁ ||(!) (fol.38v1-2) End śastraṃ strīṇāṃ ca baṃdhyānāṃ dhanyāyubaladapradaṃ || (!) alakṣmī pāparakṣoghnaṃ sarvvagraha nivāraṇaṃ || kalyānakaḥmidaṃ (!) sarppiḥ śreṣṭapuṃsavaneṣu ca || yānikalyāṇa ghṛtaḥ || tatra evasthirīdīni jalekalkekaviṃśati | rase tasmin pacetsarpi, samtrīkṣīra caturguṇaṃ || vīrādvimāṣakā kolā, svayaṃ guptāṣarbhaka dvibhiḥ || dvemedocca same kalke, kalyāṇaka mahatparaḥ || mahākalyāṇakaghṛtaḥ || || (fol.45r5-7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha vaidāṃga liṣyate (!) || atha cittāṣṭaka || cito bhāga 1 śuṭho bhāga 1 maca(!) bhāga 1 yavānu bhāga 1 sidhāsaucala bhāga 1 triphalā bhāga 1 javāṣāra bhāga 1 phurā hiṃga /// māsā 1 vaṭulā iti bhāga 1 kuṭa bhāga 1 vijayā bhāga 1 ini voṣada pisanu vastra galita garnu/// virālā pada pramāṇa tātā pānisita ṣānu anna pacai bhūṣa lāgai dehi puṣṭakarai || (fol.1v1–4) End yeka eika bhāga garnu kapura bhāga. sipicūrṇamā vanāikana pakāvanu tolā pramāna khānu śukravṛddhi ho. vājikara ho valiyo ho dhātu pūrṇa ho aneka vilāsa ho aneka bhuka ho aneka rogahara aneka strī ramana ho āyu vaḍha teja baḍha rupa suṃdara ho vālaṣa juvāna ho asi prakārako vāyuhara śleṣmarogahara aṭhāraprakārako kuṣṭhahara aṭhāraprakārakā prameha hara bhuka lāga gulma roga hara phiyo svāsa…(fol.43r6–10)

Beginning /// ḍī picumaṃda kucha vijayā karpāsa siddhārthakai(!) ṣadbhaṃthātagaraṃ surendratanubhir mārtaṇḍamūlānvitaiḥ || candrātāpanarudra nirmālyasahitair madhvāsavairmāditai(!) dhūpoyaṃ grahasannipātajanitāṃ pīḍāṃpinaṣṭi kṣaṇāt || iti dhūpaḥ || iti bhagnanetra sannipāta cikitsādhikāraḥ || (fol. 5r1-5) End || atha pralāpa nidānaṃ || saṃjñānā savi/// na tāpa || kaṃpa sutaṃdrā aura pralāpa || niraṃtara kaṃṭha vithā jehi hoi || jānavavaidya pralāpaka se/// atha cikitsā || dasamūla moṃthā soṃṭhi suvāla || rusā paparā caṃdana lāla || aura usīra/// lehu || sanyapātako nāsa karehu || ❁ || pārada gaṃdhaka samakai ⟪pījai⟫līsai || phala dhaturake rasaso /// (fol.73v10-13)

Beginning dhanvantaraye (!) namaḥ || || hariṃ śivaṃ vidhātāraṃ tatpatnīstu sutān gurun || namaḥ samastānpratyūha śāṃtaye maṃgalāya ca || 1 || ādau sarveṣu rogeṣu nāḍī jihvā ca mūtrakam || parīkṣayet svayaṃ vaidyas tad vidhānaṃ nigadyate || 2 || kare tu dakṣiṇe puṃsāṃ vāma haste tu yoṣitāṃ || prakoṣṭhe maṇibaṃdhādhaḥ sparśayet tribhir aṅgulaiḥ || 3 || śiva śaktyātmakatvena puruṣāṇāṃ ca yoṣitām || śivāṃśo dakṣiṇebhāge vāmabhāgas tu śaktijaḥ || 4 || tasmāt puṃṣāṃ dakṣahaste vāme strīṇāṃ parikṣayet || aṅgūṣṭhamūlamāśritya cāṅgulatraya mātrakam || 5 || (fol.1v1-4) «Ending:» pretabādhārayodoṣo dhruvaṃ jñeyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ || tailamadhye trikoṇāṃgaṃ sūtrasaṃ ca prajāyate || 21 || śākinī pūrvajā doṣā doṣābhūta samudbhavaṃ || (!) mūtramadhye yadā taiaṃ narākāro prajāyate || 22 || grahadoṣa(!) vijānīyāt jñeyo doṣas tathaiva ca || mūtraṃ ca dṛśyate tailaṃ mastakaṃ dvaya saṃyuktaṃ (!) jñeyo vara dadhī doṣo(!) dhruvaṃ jñeyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 23 || ( fol.5v4-7) Colophon || || iti vaidyavallabhe mūtraparīkṣā || || || || ( fol.5v7)

Beginning oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ atha nāḍīparikṣā (!) sadya snātasya bhuktasya tathā snehāvagāhinaḥ kṣutṛṣārtasya suptasya samyak nāḍī nabudhyate 1 aṃguṣṭa(!)mūlabhāge yā dhamanī jīvasākṣiṇī tac-ceṣṭayā sukhaṃ dukhaṃ (!) jñeyaṃ kāyasya paṃḍitaiḥ 2 strīṇāṃ bhiṣag vāmā(!)haste pāde vāme tvayatnataḥ śāstreṇa saṃpradānena tathā svānubhavena vai 3 parīkṣedratnavac-cāsā vabhyāsād eva jāyate agre vātavahānāḍī madhye vāhatipittalā 4 ante śleṣmavikāreṇa nāḍI jñeyā sadā budhaiḥ (fol.1v1:2v1) «Ending:» kāmakrodhād vegavahā kṣīṇaciṃtāmayaplutā maṃdāgneḥ kṣīṇadhātoś ca nāḍīmaṃdatarā bhavet asṛkpūrṇā bhavet kośnā(!) gurvī sāmā garīyasī labdhvī vahati dīptāgnes tathā vegavatī mahā capalā kṣudhitasyasyāpi tṛptasya vahati sthirā śīghranāḍīmalāpyate (!) dinārdheḥgni (!) samojvaraḥ dinaikaṃ jīvitaṃ tasya dvitīye mṛyate bhṛśaṃ ( fol.3v1-6) Colophon iti nāḍīparīkṣā samāptā śubhaṃ bhavatu savat 1790 ( fol.4v6-7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || bhṛgvādi devadeveśaṃ ahaṃ pṛchāmi (!) śaṃkaraṃ | skaṃdādyāś ca mahāmāyā bhṛṃgāś (!) caiva vināekaiḥ (!) || śrīvatkratuṃḍāya (!) namaḥ || || kailāṣaśikharāsīne umāsārddhaṃ jagatguruḥ(!) || yoginyaṣṭakataṃtre ca guhyādguhyataraṃ paraṃ || sarvajñāna prakāśāya sarvajñā sarvakṛachrayaḥ (!) | etai kāryyaṃ kathaṃ deve (!) tvayā sarvaṃ mamopari || (fol.1v1-4) «Ending:» jīrṇajvarārucibalakṣayamehakāśa (!) pāmdhvāṃ (!) mabhūmagododaradoṣahaṃtā iti sarvāṅgasuṃdararasaḥ || || kṛṣṇāsāramṛgaśṛṅgakaṃ yathā sūkṣmacūrṇa kṛta haṃḍikāsthitaṃ || bhāvayet snahila mocikārase uddhṛtaṃ sa mṛḍuvahnidāhitaṃ || caṃḍeśvarākhyaṃ pravadaṃti saṃtaḥ || datvā jalenaiva sa vyoṣakararaṃ (!) prabhātakāle hyaruṇodaye vā bhūtaṃ jvaraṃ śāṃtimupaiti coktaḥ | kuṣṭhaṃ gandhaka viṣado triphalāpādaḥ samaḥ || bhṛgvāṃvu marditā hyete mudgamāṣavaṭī kṛtvāḥ (!) || jvaraṃhaṃttyaṣṭabhiḥ yāme hyaṣṭa praharakāni vā || ||(fol. 56v2:57b2) Colophon iti śrīkākacaṃḍeśvarīmataṃ samāptam || śubham astu sadā || śubhaṃ || (fol57b2-3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurave nārāyaṇāya namaḥ || || ādhāya rādhādhavapādapadme manomanojñe satataṃm(!) svakīyam || +++ nārāyaṇa vaidyaśarmā ṭīkāṃ svakīya jvaranirṇayasya || 1 || nirbighna parisamāptaye samuciteṣṭa devatāṃ granthakṛn-namaskaroti || vadeti + nuyogaḥ praśnaṃ bhiṣabhiṣajaṃ vaidyakapaṭena niḥśaṃkaṃ gopī krīḍā saṃbhavāt || atha ca sarvāvatārabharaṇād dhanvaṃtari rūpaṃ || 1 || vināyakam iti || saṃdihānāḥ saṃśayaṃ prāpnuvānāḥ prakṛtajvaranirṇaya siddhyarthaṃ prathamam upoddhāta prakaraṇam āha || nidānam iti ||(fol.1v1-5) «Ending:» || durgā hi jvarabheda nakranikarair bhīme gabhīre paraṃ saṃdehāṃbunidhau nimajjadagadaṃkāra vrajaṃ vyākulam || itthaṃ tārayituṃ vivekakalaśair nārāyaṇa svachadhīr(!) ātṃiya jvaranirṇayaṃ vivṛtavān evaṃ vibhāvyāsakṛt || 1 || ❁ || ( fol.30v1-3 ) Colophon iti śrīmad vaidyakulatilakāyamāna śrīkṛṣṇapaṃḍitātmaja bhiṣaṅnārāyaṇa paṃḍita praṇītaṃ jvaranirṇaya vivaraṇaṃ samāptim agamat || || ❁ || || śrīr astu śubhaṃ bhūyat(!) || graṃthasaṃkhyā || 770 || śrāvaṇasya sitepakṣe daśamyāṃ kujavāsare alekhi mādhavenedaṃ jvaranirṇaya ṭippaṇaṃ || 1 || vasvagniṣaṭ caṃdramite ca caṇake kuje ʼsite śrāvaṇike daśamyāṃ | vyalīlikhan mādhava saṃjñako bhiṣak svapūrvaṭīkāṃ jvaranirṇayasya || 1 || śaṃbhuṃ suśruta carakau guruṃ ca nāgeśayā namya || nāyāyaṇo vivṛṇute vātaghnatvādi nirṇayaṃ svakṛtaṃ || 1 || bhiṣajāṃ paritoṣāya vātaghnatvādi nirṇayaḥ || nārāyaṇena racito nāgeśasya prasādataḥ iti ||1744

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || kapolatalanirmita pramadavāridhārā lasātsadaṃdhri kulakākalikalitaḥ maṃjukolāhala || girīśa tanayo guruḥ sakala siddhivāra (nidhirbmina)ttu duritāninaḥ satata modakādaḥ sadā || 1 || hṛdayabhujā viśālakarā mandāramālaḥ samarabhivikarālaḥ śociśā śobhitālaḥ || danujanicayakālaḥ sarvalokaikapāla sa jayati matiśālaś chadnagopāla vālaḥ || 2 || (fol.1v1-6)? 211/23 «Ending:» piṣṭānne salilaṃ priyāluphalaje pathyāhitā māṃsaje kṣīraṃgaulyabhave ca kathitaṃ sasyodbhave kāṃjikaṃ godhūmeṣu ca karkaṭī hitakarā śeṣāni buddhyā jayet || iti vaṃśyādyupasaṃhāra padyāni pustakajairṇyādūpekṣitāni padyāni boddhyāni sudhībhiḥ || (fol.72r1–4) Colophon iti śrīnaravaidya manmathātmajaḥ kṣemaśarmma vinirmmite kṣemakutūhala graṃthe gorasapānādipraśaṃsano nāma dvādaśotsavaḥ samāptaṃ || || śubhamastu || || ślokapū 1349 || ||

Beginning ❖ śrīganyasāyaṃ (!) namaḥ || śvanaṇdaṃ nadi hastā hatamurujarabāhau, na kaumāra vahe, trāsā nāsāgra visatu tu phanupatu bhogasaṃkoca bhāji … atha vaṃga anupānavidhi liokhyateḥ (!) || kesarisaṃgamāsā ādhakarṣa kesarimāsā ādha vaṃga ṣāī tau mūrvā jāī | (exp.2:1-3) «Sub: colophon:» aiti rudantīkalpa || (fol. 2r4) iti kālājñānavaidyakosāra samāpta || (fol.6v:5) iti sīravidhi (!) || (fol.14r6) iti imdrajāladhyāyaḥ prathamaḥ ||(fol. 68r2) iti śrīpaṃḍitavaidyake sodāsaputra naiinasuṣa viracite vaidyamanotsave kṣarasaṃnipātasaṃgrahaṇiroga peatīkāra nāma dvitīyañ samudesa (!) ||(fol. 40v1-2) End … kuṭI vasana mahacchāniye sava sama jaise ān goli bādhau jai ṭikai pāṃcaṭāka paramān auṣadhi hoino puṣṭiko bhacchanakarai jau raini || tā upara dūdha hi pārā saṃpūrṇṇa | vai vaḍhaai dhātubala maina || iti bhaiṣaja saṃpūrṇṇaṃ ||(fol.93r2-4) Colophon iti śrī paṃḍitavaidyaka sodāsaputra nainasuṣaviracite vaidyamanotsaveṣudarapuṣyavāsabamdhyāgarbhapātapradarakuṣṭhīṣthī istrīvidhā kucavidhā liʼgavidyānirdhātaprajogapratīkāranāma saptamaḥ śamudesa (!) || (fol. 51v5-6) iti ānaṃdaviracite kokamaṃjarī saṃpūrṇṇaṃ | samāpta (!) śubhaṃ bhavamtu (!) || iti samvat 902 āśviṇa vadi 13 sukravāraṣu thāsā phocoya sidhuko juro, dhaṃju vaidyana coyā juro, śubha || || (fol.93r4-6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || auṣadhipati netrāya padminīpati mūrttaye || kālakālāya nīlāya pārvatīpataye namaḥ || 1 || garbhabhāra pariklinnā kanyā mandodarī śubhā || rāvaṇaṃ paripapraccha pūjānte tuṣṭamānasam || 2 || mandodaryuvāca || svāmin daityasurārādhya caturvedaviśārada || sadāśivāt prāptukāma bhuvanatrayapālaka || 3 || (fol.1v1–4) End tato ʼmlavarge daśadhā kṣāravarge tridhā punaḥ || kumārikā drave bhasma jale caivaṃ viśodhayet || 96 || evaṃ śuddhas tva jepālo vāṃti dāhavivarjitaṃ || mandodarī tavākhyātaṃ yanmayā śivataḥ śrutam || 97 || etad jñātvā tu gaṃbhīryaṃ (!) tvaritaṃ yatnam ācaraḥ (!) || evam uktā tyu bhaiṣajya rahasyaṃ sa daśānana || 98 || sāyaṃ saṃdhyāvidhiṃ kartu (!) utthito maṃdiraṃ yayau || 100 || (fol.61v9–62r4) Colophon iti laṃkānātha rāvaṇakṛtorkaprakāśe dhātuśuddhiśatakaṃ daśamaṃ samāptam || 10 || śubham bhūyāt || (fol. 62r4–5)

Beginning oṃ namo garuḍāya || || pāyakpīyūṣasārāharaṇam arabhasau jṛṃbhitātmāvaruddhaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ bhindikāmaṃ smara yadi vapurā svāṇḍa saṃpiṇḍitastvam || trailokyākāṇḍakalpakṣayabhayam idaṃ muñcavraṣmet prathelya prasthākhyānāt svarūpaṃ punar upagamitaṃ śārṅgiṇā cogarutmā || gāthābhir mṛdubuddhi bhedanatayā yat saṃhitāsāra ityanvarthakakramakari(!) garuḍam iha śrīśaṃkukenādarāt tad vyayaktiṃ samasaṃskṛtir nara mayām pathantu(!) kaścit || vyācakṣe kṣamatāṃ vicakṣaṇajanaḥ kleśā kṣamaḥ śikṣatā || yad anyair vyākhyātaṃ tad asad upapatyādi virahān maduktaṃ tad yogāt sahiti na sato vaktum ucitaḥ || tathya tadvedā ‥‥suvimalinitaṃ bhyatinatathā visaṃvāde vrīḍāṃ sṛjati tu jadi(!)rapya sajarā || (fol.1v1­–4) «Sub-colophon:» idānīṃ vyākhyātasyā svādhyātme viṣayā dvitīyā vyākhyā | ṇavarindetyādi… (fol 25v6–7) End he sakhe śaśadharasya haṃsasyāyaṃ svabhāvaḥ padasāvāt pelita pavano vipūtrayakṣānilo viṣena krīḍati || viṣeṇa ceti śliṣṭoktiḥ || viṣa viṣayaṃ krīḍanaṃ stobhādi jananam | tathā nādetyādi | nādo dhvani viśeṣaḥ | sa eva niraṃjanaṃ nirvyājaṃ sucaritaṃ sādhuceṣṭitaṃ yasya sa tādṛśa reḥ sa tu punar viṣaṃ nāsayati nādamātreṇa | tad abhāvaṃ nayatītyarthaḥ | tasya haṃsasya iva viṣeti krīḍana vidhvaṃsanādau tubhyaṃ svātaṃtryam iti prabhāvātiśaya pratipādanārthāḥ śliṣṭoktir eveti || 203 || (fol.25v4–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || harako pānalenaiva bhasmībhūyā karosmaraḥ || (!) arddhanārīśarīraṃ hi yasya tasyai namostu te || 1 || samyag ārādhitaḥ kāmaḥ sugaṃdha kusumādibhiḥ || vidadhāti vara strīṇāṃ mānagranthi vimocanam || 2 || aneka kāmaśāstrāṇāṃ sāram ākṛṣya yatnataḥ || bālavyut[[pattaye]] strīṇāṃ cittasantoṣāṇāya ca || 3 || kāmaśāstraṃ pravakṣāmi nāti saṃkṣipta vistṛtam || āyurvedāgame taddhi yad vinā vṛṣyatā vṛthā || 4 || (fol1v1–3) «Ending:» saṃdhyākāle baliṃ dadyāt kukkuṭāṃ vāruṇīyutaṃ || tataś cullhyāṃ lohapātre taile dhatturabījakai || 25 || ukṣiptvā viṃśat palaṃ pācyaṃ tad rasaṃ māṃsa pīḍitaṃ || samārabhyāsya maṃdāgnau yāvat sūryo[[dayo]] bhavet || 26 || haṭhā jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād anyathā tan na sidhyati || prātaruddhṛtya guṭikāṃ kṣīrabhāṇḍe vinikṣipet || 27 || tatkṣiraṃ śuṣyati kṣipraṃ etat pratyayakārakaṃ || ratikāle mukhaṃ dhāryā guṭikā vīryyarodhinī || 28 || kṣīraṃ pītvā ramed rāmāṃ kāmavyākulitānvitāṃ || mukhasthāṃ dhārayed dhaste tadā vīryaṃ na muñcati || 329 || || (fol.42r2–5) Colophon iti vīryarodhinī guṭikā || || iti saurāṣṭradeśodbhava kulāvataṃsasa upādhyāya dvijavarya mādhava viracite āyurvedaprakāśe upaśārīrake strīlakṣaṇa sevanādi kāmaśāstrasya viṣaya nirupanādhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || ○ || (fol. 42r4–5) baddhamuṣṭi kaṭīgrīvā taptaḍṛṣṭīr adhomukhaḥ || kaṣṭena likhitaṃ graṃthaṃ yatnena pratipālayet || || samvat 1983 sāla jyeºº śudi 10 roja 1 śubham bhuyāt(!) || ❁ ||

Beginning śrīmāhāmañgalamūrtīye (!) namaḥ || janaleḥ pṛthviko bhāra garnyā rāvanakana saṃgrāma viṣe māri jagatko baḍo upakāra gardā bhayāḥ || janale vānar haruko phauja saṃmeta vaṃhasvarupi samudrajalakā pāra helaile gardā bhayā || sitākā hṛdayakā hārajastā bhayākāḥ estā śrīrāmacandrakana namaskāra gari kāśirājanāmā grathakāra jocha ajīrṇamañjarī nāu bhayāko graṃtha banāudachanḥ || 1 || (fol.1v1–6) śrīrāmacndrāya namaḥ || || yo rāvaṇaṃ raṇamukhe bhuvanaikabhāraṃ hatvā cakāra jagtḥ (!) paramopakāraṃ || yo brahmavādividadhe jaladheḥ supāraṃ tannaumi maithira (!) sutā hṛdayaikahāram || 1 || (fol. 1v4­–5) End ekaśāyī dvibhojī ca ṣaṇmūtrī tripurīṣu(!) kṛt || ṛtusaṃgamakārī ca vyādhibhir nābhibhūyate || 40 || (fol.12v:8–9) ekpherā sutanyāḥ, duya I pherā ṣānyā, 6 pherā piśāpa grarnyā (!) tīnapherā jhārāphenyāḥ(!) ṛtukālamāhā strīsaṃga bhogagarnyā esto manuṣya kailhai pani rogale piḍita huṃdaina || 4 0 || (fol. 12v:10–11) Colophon iti kāśirāja viracitā ajirnamaṃjarī samāptaṃ(!) || || su(!)bham astu || iti kāśirājare banāyāko ajirṇamaṃjarīko bhāṣā samāpta bhayo || śubham astu || saṃ-m-vat 1888 sāla miti śrāvana vadi 2 roja 5 saṃpurṇa subhaṃ || ||

Beginning śrīmaanmagalamūrti (!) gaṇapataye namaḥ śrī viṣṇukā putra hunāle kevala mūrtibhayākā anaṃganāmā devatā jochan so śarīra nabhayākā chan taipani devatā daitya manuṣyaprabhṛti saṃpūrṇa saṃsārako utpatti, sthiti, pralaya gari āphnā vaśa garī rāṣchan pheri āphu bahutai jayale yukta bhai savai bhaṃdā thūlā kahalāuṃchan 1 ava uprāṃta bagaicāko praśaṃsā kahiṃcha (fol. 1v1–4) puṣpadhanvā vijayate naṅgenāpuakhilaṃ jagat vaśīkṛtaṃ yena haṭhāt sa surāsura mānuṣam 1 pumsāṃ sarva sukhaika sādhanaphalāḥ saundaryya garbhodhara krīḍālolavilāsinī janamanaḥ sphītapramodāvahāḥ guṃjad bhṛṃga vinidra paṃkajabharas phārollasad dīrghikā yuktāḥ saṃti gṛheṣu yasya vipulārāmāḥ sa pṛthvīpatiḥ 2 (fol. 1v5–7) «Ending:» gokolāsthikarīṣaistu dagdhe gartte viśodhite uktaṃ ca bālukā pūrṇe mūlakaṃ garttavad bhavet 36 Iṣṭakacite samamtād puruṣanikhāte ʼvaṭe tarur jātaḥ vāmana eva hi dhatte phala kusumaṃ sarva kāma phalaṃ 37 iti vicitrīkaraṇam (fol. 33r4–6) Colophon ittyupavanavinode tarumahimā śubhāśubha phala bhūnirūpaṇḥ ukti dhiḥ(!) vṛkṣāropaṇa niṣecana rakṣā upavana kri kūpajala cikitsā poṣaṇa (krarāpa) jalatarucikitsā citrikaraṇaṃ samāptam iti ❁ ❁ (fol. 33r6–33v5) yas prakārala bagaicāmā rukhaharukā citra vicitra phulaphala sapranyā upāya kahiyoḥ yas upavanavinodanāmā śārṅadharagratha(!)mā jhikyākā bagaiṃcā banyāunyā khaṃḍa ekamā eti thāka bhayā śubhma ❁ (fol. 34r9–11)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || sveṣṭadevasya caraṇān natvā dhyātvā gurun hṛdi bhāṣayā vaidyaśāstrasya ṭīkāṃ kurve yathāmati karasyāṃguṣṭhamūle yā dhavanīr (!) jīvasākṣIṇī || tac ceṣṭayā sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ jñeyaḥ kāyasya padītai (!) || 1 || pahile nāḍī vicāragarnuḥ dāhinyā hātakā buḍhi aṃguṭhākā jarāmāhāṃ jīvanu maraṇu garāvanyā nārī heranu tasakī gatile sukha duḥkhako prakāra paṇḍitaleḥ jāndachan śarīrako roga jānaicha || 1 || (fol.1v1–5) «Sub: colophon:» iti śrīvaidyajīvane tṛtīyollāsaḥ samāptaḥ || (fol.26r3) End launyā auṣadhi || līlāthotā (!) māsā 2 rumi mastaṃgī [[1]] supeda (!) ṣaira [[1]] sāvana [[1]] || saṣabhaṣma bhā 5 sidho 2 hiṃga 1 suṭho 4 marca 3 pipalā 3 lavaṃga 1 jirā 2 nāgakesara || saṃṣa vaṭikā || || satāvarī pippali dhānya mustaṃ sarohiṇī śvetatilaṃ ca dhātrī || viśvopakalpe ṣana kaṭha cūrṇa samaṃ sarkara bhāgatulyaṃ || lihet prabhāte madhurāmlapitam hṛdroga hṛdśvāsa svaropaghātaṃ chardirito rocaka gulma kāsaṃ || satāvarī cūrṇa || (fol.26v5–10)

Beginning oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || rasādi auṣadhiyoṃ kāanūpānakā kitāba saṃkṣepakarke likhā jātā haiṃ || prāṇeśvara rasa || itane rogoṃ main kāma lagatā hain || 1 ghora navajvara || 2 vātajvara || 3 pittajvara || 4 kaphajvara || 5 sannipāta || 6 śūla || 7 gulma || 8 vāyu || 9 ajīrṇa || mātrā yeka ratti saiṃ pāṃca ratti taka umara doṣa deṣa karke karnā paḍatā hai || ghora navajvara jiskauṃ hoya || uskauṃ pānamaiṃ raṣakara denā || uparase tīnaghuṃṭa garma pānī pilānā . || (fol. 1:1–8) End pramehamai gurijākā rasa sahatake sātha denā ○ kapharogamai pipalā sahatke sātha denā○ dhātukṣīṇamai maṣanamiśrī vaṃśalocanake sātha denā ○ nirbalatāmaiṃ gāyadūda miśrī vaṃśalocana keśara dālacīni sāmamamiśrīke sātha denā○ iti ○ līlāvilāsarasa amlapittake rogamaiṃ 1 golī sahatake sātha denā ○ śubham bhavatu sarvadā ○ iti ○ (fol. 31:3–9)

Beginning kīṭhko matānusāra (saṃskṛtasāhityakā itihāsa pṛ 514) alakajendriyāmā 3 sencyurī BC mā manuṣyako śarīrako kāṭne kurāko pracāra bhaeko pāincha . maskulara veskular siṣṭamko thika jñāna thiyo yadi bhāratale grīkabāṭa lieko bhae usko sāthamā nāḍī haḍḍiko gaṇanāsaṃga milnuparcha . mileko dekhidaina (exp.1:1–5) End ilāhāvāda pāṇinīkāryālayabāṭa hindūsamājavijñāna saṃbandhamā vinayakumāra sarakārale lekheko aṃgrejī ākaravijñāna khanijatatva –ralatatva ityādi viṣaya baṃgalāharmā anuvāda bhayo ki? (sabhyatā ra yuga ) yasko bamgalā anuvāda bhayo ki? pramathanāthabosa B.sc (exp.169:15–21) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ | śrīṣoḍaśīdevyai namaḥ || dhanvaṃtaraye (!) namaḥ | aśvinī ( ///kumārā)bhyāṃ namaḥ | atha vaidyakasaṃgrahaḥ || || śivasutapadapraṇamau sadā ṛddhisiddhi ni(///ti deī) | sumati vistārana kumatiharana maṃgala mudita karei | 1 | alaṣa amūrati alaṣa(///ga) ti kinahī napāyo pāra | jori yugalakara kavi kahai dehi deva matisāra | 2 | (fol.1v1-4) End keśavadāśasuta nayanasukha kīyo graṃtha amaīkamda || subhaganagadī sihanaṃdamau [[śrī]]akavararāja nareṃdra | 70 | aṃkaveda śubha medinī śuklapakṣa sucmāsa | tithi dvitīyā bhṛguvārapuni mukhyacaṃdra supragāsa (!) | mātrā aṃka suchaṃda puni kahyo antyamati soī | gunijana parisama vārihau | hīna jahaā kucha hoI | (fol.26v1–5) Colophon iti śrīpaṃḍita vaidya kesavadāśātmaja nayanasukhaviracite vaidyamahotsave pradararoga strīpuṣpa garbha saṃkoca kuca kaṭhina liṃga śūla pratigaṃdhīharaṇaṃ nāma saptamopadeśaḥ || (fol.26v5–7) likhitam idaṃ vaidyavaryena (!) śobhanaśarmaṇā nagakoṭI yena vaidyajagadīśas tasyātmajeneti |

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo gaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurun natvā || auṣadhipatinetrāya padminīpatimūrttaye || kālakālāya nīlāya pārvatīpataye namaḥ || 1 || garbhabhāra pariklinnā kanyā mandodarī śubhā || rāvaṇaṃ paripapra[c]cha pūjāṃte tuṣṭamānasaṃ || 2 || mandodaryuvāca || svāmin daityasur ārādhya caturvedaviśārada || sadāśivādāptakāma bhuvanatrayapālaka || 3 || iadaṃ śukra mamodyaṃte yadyārabhyodaresthitaṃ || tadārabhya na śaknomi karttuṃ cakramaṇaṃ manāk || 4 || (fol.1v:1–4) End naviṣaṃ viṣam ityāhuḥ jaipālo viṣam ucyate || śodhitoyaṃ virekeṣu camatkṛtikaraḥ paraḥ || paṃcagavye tu saṃśodhya dūrīkuryāc ca jihvakāṃ || tato ʼmlavarge daśadhāṃ kṣāravarge tṛdhā(!) punaḥ || kumārikādrave bhasma bhasma jale caivaṃ viśodhayet || evaṃ śuddhe tu jaipālo vāṃti dāhavivarjitaḥ || mandodarī tavākhyātaṃ yan mayā śivataḥ śrutaṃ || etad jñātvā tu bhakṣīyaṃ tvaritaṃ yatnam ācara || evam uktvā tu bhaiṣajya rahasyaṃ sa dasānanaḥ sāyaṃ saṃdhyā vidhiṃ kartuṃ-m utthito maṃdiraṃ yayau || (fol.54r5:54v1) Colophon iti laṃkānāthakṛtaṃ dhātuśuddhiśatakaṃ daśamamarkaprakāśaṃ saṃpūrṇam || saṃvat 942 pauṣa śudi 6 roja śubhaṃ || lepaḥ pāṭhāpaṭolaūṣadharuvuka jaṭāśigrudadrughna kuṣṭairdhānyāmlena piṣṭai(!) praśamayati mahāmūrdhnirogān aśeṣān || (fol. 54v1­–2)

Beginning …rthakṣmakaḥ | tasya kaphajvaraścaiva buddhimadbhiḥ prabhāṣitaḥ || 32 || raktamūrddam adhaḥ śvetaṃ cihnaṃ syād rājayakṣmaṇaḥ || mūtraṃ sarakāṃbhasaṃkāsaṃ kā‥ śca ‥ sāpapāditaḥ (!) || 33 || arddhaścetamadhaḥ pīta mūtrasyādanyarogakṛt | cirāt pravattīta (!) yastu na pītaṃ na sitaṃ kvacit | kṣema ‥ lakṣaṇaṃ tadvad pathyādevopaśāmyati || 34 || (exp.1:1-3) «Sub: colophon:» iti kālajñāna samāptaḥ || || ❁ śrī || || ❁ || || śrī || || ❁ || || śrī || || ❁ || || śrī || || ❁ || (exp.2:b4) iti kālajñānavaidyake jvarotthānalakṣaṇavivaraṇa samuddeśaḥ || || (exp.3a:4) iti kālajñāne vaidyake svaralakṣaṇa gatilakṣaṇa mṛtyulakṣaṇa triyasvarāstammanaṃ (!) jīvitalakṣaṇana kṣaṇalakṣaṇādau vivarasamuddeśa samāptaḥ || (exp.4a:1–2) iti kālajñāne vaidyake kālalakṣaṇavivaraṇa samuddeśaḥ || (exp.5a:1) End varṇahīnaṃ yadātmānaṃ paśyatyātmā kathaṃcina (!) || nāśau jīvita lokesmin kāle naivā vilokitam || 15 || prattatiṣtho (!) sadā jīvo | vitta taṃ naiva gacchati || sa ca vai kāladṛṣṭosti | kālestojo vivarjitaḥ ||16 manaḥ sthiraṃ kuryāt | manasā mārutasthira | mārutena sthiraṃ tejaḥ || kālastejopi dṛṣyati(!) || 16 || aṃgakaṃpolave (!) yasya | ātmānaṃ dṛyyate … (exp. 6:11–13) Colophon

Beginning …stu nādeyaṃ vātajvaraharaṃ paraṃ 7 rasaṃ gadhāvdhiphenaṃ ca hiṃgulam marddaye ahaṃ ārdrāṃbhasā vallayugmaṃ khāded (!) vātajvarāpahaṃ sūta gaṃdha viṣaruk triphalābhi vyoṣamaṃ kuru rasato guṭikaiṣā haṃti muhatulitā navatanhāsvāgate ca vanitā khilatāyaṃ dināṃte chāyayayet pathyaṃ sajvare vijvarepi vā 8 (fol.4r1–4) «Ending:» samaṃ bhāgāni saṃcūrṇya madhunā saha dhupayet ciṃta (!) bhrama pratīkāra hima śiśira śarīraḥ śvāsa hikā (!) prasekaḥ śiṣṭilita (!) savalāṃgaṃḥ chigna (!) nāhogratāpaḥ llavamavamathukāsaḥ (!) charghati(!)sāra mūrcchās tvarita māraṇahāyī śītamātra prabhāvāt 31 śītāṃga lakṣaṇaṃ paṃcakolārka ruk śigrubhaniṃbograkaṣāyakaṃ pāyayed atiśītāṃ… (fol.18v2–5 ) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāyanama (!) || || atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi bhuvaneśvarīpaddhatīm || śṛṇuṣva ekacittena rasaje prāṇavallabhe || 1 || śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ gurupuṣye ca lakṣaṇām || samaṃtras tu samuccārya sopacāraṃ samuddharet || 2 || oṃ sarvārthasādhanīlakṣmaṇāyai svāhā || śubhaṃ tanmūlam ādāya kṛṣṇonmatta phalesthitam || tridinaṃ ca svaśukreṇa maṃtrya cūrṇena vaśyakṛt || 3 || rocanaṃ lakṣmaṇāmūlaṃ caṃdanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ samam || mukhalepāditaḥ sarve vaiśeṣyaṃ naramohanam || 4 || (fol.1v1–4) «Ending:» atha musalīkalpa || atha vravīmi deveśī muśalīkalpam uttamam || svarṇapuṣpī ca kharjurīpatra vanyāti śobhanā || 1 || atiśvetā ca nārā cā musalī musalī smṛtā || tanmūlañ ca samūdhṛtya chāyā śuṣkaṃ tu cūrṇitam || 2 || karṣaṃ madhvājyasaṃyuktaṃ prātaḥ śuddhaḥ samullihet || jīrṇe dugdhānnabhojīsyād rākṣannantu vivarjjayet || 3 || ṣaṣṭe māsi bhaved bālo vṛddhopi labhate dhiyam || payasā musalīcūrṇāṃ dagdhā kāyaḥ pivetsudhi || 4 || śatavarṣam avāpnoti śatastrīgamane paṭu || 5 || (fol.20r12:20v4) Colophon iti śrīśivaproktāyāṃ kalpalatāyāṃ musalīkalpaḥ || kalpalatā samāptam(!) || śubham || (fol. 20v4-5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrōgaṇapataye || ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || praṇamya jagadutpatyai sthitisaṃhārakāraṇaṃ svarggāpavargayordvaṃ trailokya śaraṇaṃ śivam || || prakṣīṇabalamāṃsasya śeṣadhātuparīkṣayā || tasmādrupadravān kṛcchrān brūhinaḥ pracikitsakān || dehendriya manastāpi sarvarogāgrajo balī | jvara pradhāno rogāṇāṃ mukto bhagavatā purā || (fol. 1r1–3) Sub-colophon iti jvaranidānaṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 10r3–4) iti arśanidānaṃ || (fol. 13r6) iti grahaṇīnidānaṃ || (fol. 16r4) iti kṛmiroganidānaṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 18v7) End te paṃcanāmnā kṛmayaḥ †kākerūkamakerukoḥ† || sausirādāḥ salūnākhyā leliha janayanti ca | viḍbheda śūlaviṣṭaṃbha kārśyapāruṣyapāṇḍutā || rome harṣāgnisadana gudakaṇḍur vimārggagāḥ || 16 || || (fol. 18v5–7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāyaḥ || nivadhi (!) jagadbhāvābhāvodayavyaya viśramakrama nirupama krīḍā sauṇḍopyakhaṇḍa samasthitiḥ || satatama pṛthagbhogyabhogāvarodha rasātmakaṃ kam api diśatād ānandaṃ vāna vyandu (!) vibhūṣaṇaḥ || vyaktārthato vidadhato haramekhalāyā buddheḥ svabhāva carati haramekhalāyāḥ || santo yathā haracirād abhiyogatāntāḥ syuḥ saṃśayādi virahād abhiyogatāntā vidyānidhe jagati sarvaguro dvijendra cūḍāmaṇeḥ svayamanugrahatodhigamya | (!) tad vastu sundaradhiyāṃ smṛtaye cikīrṣāḥ sayyāniviṣṭam athakotra manobhimānaḥ || || thvate ṭikākārasyaṃ dayakā śloka || || (fol.1v1–5) «Sub-colophon:» iti haramekhalāyāṃ kautūhalādiprakāśe prathamaḥ | sambaṃdhābhidhānābhidheyaprayojana samuddeśo nāma || ❁ || (fol.2v6–7) End kasturi, karpūra, sukamyāla, lavaṅatvāca, triphalā, pātaka, kuṃkuma, elā, jātīkkasacchoyā vaikātyaṃ , ketakīsvāna navā saca yāva mukha vaḍI dayake thvayānāna duṃvārija ta mukhavāsa dhāya || 24 || yugalakaṃ || 21 || madatuhinalāvat kvala triphalādalaghuśṛṇala (!) (fol.118v4–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || athāto jvaracikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ || vijjvaraṃ jvarasaṃdehaṃ paryapṛchan punarvvasu || vivikte śāstram āsīnam agniveśaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ || dehendrīyamanastāpī sarvvarogāgrajovalī || jvaraḥ pra‥no rogiṇā‥ ‥ ‥ bhagavatā purā || tasya prāṇi sapannasaya(!) dhruvasya prakayodaye || prakṛtiṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca prabhāvaṃ kāraṇāni ca || pūrvarūpamadhiṣṭhānaṃ balakālātma lakṣaṇaṃ || vyāsato vidhibhedaṃ ca pṛthag bhinnasya cākṛtiṃ || ligamāmasya jīrṇasya auṣadhaṃ ca kriyā kramaṃ || vimuṃcataḥ praśāntasya cehṅgaṃ yac ca pṛthak pṛtha || (fol.1v1–6) End dāhaśūlābhisaṃkṣobha svapnanāśāratijvaraiḥ vidahyamānaṃ jānīyāt gulmatastupanāhayet vidāhalakṣaṇālpatve vahistuṃge samunnate syāviṣaraktaparyyante saṃsparśe vastisaṃnibhe nipīḍitonnate lodhra svapne tat pārśvapīḍanaṃ tatraiva piṃḍitemūle saṃpakvaṃ gulmam ādiśet tatra dhātvaṃtare prāṇem(!) adhikāraḥ kriyāvidhau vahisthā pārśvaniryūti pakvaḥ śrotāṃsi saṃkledaḥ vrajaty ūrddham adhopi vā svayaṃ pravṛttaṃ taṃ upekṣate pathyabhojanaiḥ (!) (fol.26v6–9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśo jayati || ❁ || yo rāvaṇaṃ raṇamukhe bhuvanaikabhāraṃ hatvā cakāra jagataḥ paramopakāraṃ || yaṃ vrahmātrātidadhire parato pipāraṃ tan naumi maithilasutā hṛdayaikahāraṃ || 1 || (fol.1v1-4) End ekaśāyī dvibhojī ca ṣaṇmūtrī tripurīṣakṛt || ṛtusaṃgamakārī yo vyādhibhi(!) nābhibhūyate || 41 || (fol. 9v1-2) Colophon iti śrīkāśirājaviracite ajīrṇamaṃjarī samāpti magāt || śubham || śrīrāma śitā(!)jikā caraṇa o sukirtidattaś caraṇa sadāsarvadā śubham bhūyāt || āṣāḍhike śite pakṣe bhūrāmāṅkenduvatsare || alikhat sukradattena daśami bhaumavāsare || 1 ||

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha pākāvaliṃ vakṣe kaṭutiktādibheṣajaiḥ || vicikitsāvatāṃ dṛṇāṃ rājasānāṃ hi [t]āya vai || 1 || cikitsāyāṃ chayaṃ sāraṃṃ pākavidyā rasāyanaṃ || pākovaleha bhedasyāt sa mṛduḥ sa ghanaḥ paraḥ || 2 || atra śikṣakāṣṭau vadhyaḥ pṛthak peṣyāḥ sugandhādi pṛtha kvidhiṃ (!) || sapṛṣya vastrasaṃyūtam ūbhayaṃ (!) sthāpayed bhiṣak || 3 || drāksā śṛīphalavādāmaprabhṛtisyād adātra tu || tantaveṣyaḥ bhiṣakavaryaiḥ kiṃtu bhūri vikhaṃḍayet || 4 ||(fol. 1v1–4) End jātiphalaṃ lavaṃgaṃ ca pṛthak karṣa yugaṃ mataṃ || dhānyārkaṃ keśaraṃ patraṃ karṣatrayamitaṃ pṛthak || 77 || kaṇāpala pramāṇāsyāt palamātura romakaṃ || maricāt pitavaḥ sapta trivinmūlāt paladvayaṃ || 78 || pṛthak dṛśākṣaṃ sāmudraṃ seṃdhavaṃ nāgaraṃ tathā || śarāvasaṃmitaṃ cukru tad ardhatitinīphalaṃṃ || 79 || dhanaṃjayavaṭī hy eṣā dhanaṃjayavivarddhinī || ajīrṇaṃ jarayaty ābhu śulam unmulayed drutaṃ || 80 || (fol. 19v4–6) Colophon iti śrīsaurāṣṭradeśodbhavasārasvatakulāvataṃśaupādhyāyamādhavaviracite āyurvedaprakāśe pākāvalīnāmādhyāyaḥ samāptam (!) || śubham. samvat 1880 paladvayaṃ tu prasṛti … droṇakaḥ kathito budhaiḥ || iti mānasaṃjñā (fol. 19v10–11)

Beginning śrīrāmāya namaḥ || || yo rāvaṇaṃ raṇamukhe bhuvanaikabhāraṃ hatvā cakāra jagataḥ paramopakāram || yaṃ vrahmacāridadhire parato pipāraṃ tan naumi maithilasutā hṛdayaika hāraṃ || 1 || nārikeraphaleṣu taṇḍulamathakṣīraṃ rasālehitaṃ jaṃvīrottharasoghṛte samucitaḥ sarpis tu mocāphale || godhūmeṣu ca karkaṭīhitatamā māṃsātpaye kāñjikaṃ nāraṇge guḍabhakṣaṇañ ca kathitaṃ piṇḍāluke kodravam || 2 ||(fol.1v:1-3) End ekaśāyī dvibhojī ca ṣaṇmūtrī tripurīṣakṛt || ṛtusaṃgamakārīṇyo vyādhibhir nābhibhūyate || 39 || atrādy apady advayatas tu sarvāṇy arvāñci padyāty anavadyavidyaḥ || śrīkāśirājasmṛtaye śiśrūnām ārṣair vacobhir vicitair atānīt || 40 || tat tan mahājīrṇavināśane trījīyāccirāyāmṛtamañjarīyam || sa ṣaṭpadānandamayīm asanto ghuṇādravai nāmavadhārayantu(!) || 41 || (fol. 3r4-6) Colophon iti śrīkāśirājaviracitā ʼmṛtamañjarī || (fol. 3r6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || yasya jñānamayīmūrtī saccidānaṃdakāriṇi || tatpādapaṃkajaṃ vaṃde graṃthasaṃpūrṇahetave || 1 || dhātus tathopadhātuś ca viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamaṃ || tasya vikāraśāṃtyarthaṃ vakṣye rūpānamañjarī(!) || 2 || apakvapakvadhātūnāṃ viṣadaṃṣṭreṇa bhakṣaṇāt tathopadhātūnāṃ tadvat vikāraśāṃti kathyate(!) || 3 || (fol.1r1-4) End tailaṃ cāmlaṃ tathānidrāṃ viṣapīḍita varjayet || taṃḍulaṃ ghṛtadugdhaṃ ca pathyaṃ sraṣṭaṃ(!) viṣāture || 96 || dhātus tathopadhātuś ca viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamaṃ || sareveṣāṃ vamanaṃ sraṣṭaṃ(!) virecanaṃ tathā punaḥ(!) || 97 || jñātājñātavikāreṇa sadā sevyaṃ ca bheṣajaṃ || 97 ||(!) (fol.8v3-6) Colophon ity ānupānaṃañjaryā jaṃgamaviṣaśāṃtiprakaraṇaṃ nāma ca[tu]rthaḥ samuddeśa || śrīrāmakṛṣṇāya namaḥ ||(fol.8v8-9)

Beginning śrigaṇeśāya(!) namaḥ || atha dhanvaṃtaraya(!) nama(!) || bījaṃ śrutīnāṃ sudhanaṃ munīnāṃ jivaṃ jaḍānāṃ mahadādikānāṃ || āgneyamaśraṃ(!) bhavapātakānāṃḥ(!) kiṃcin(!) maha(!) syāmalam āśrayāmī(!) || 1 || atha harītakī nāma guṇā(!) || śivā haritakī pathyā cetakī vijayā jayā || pramathyāṃ pramathā moghā kāyasthā prāṇadāmṛtā || 1 || jīvani(!) yā haimavatī pūtanāmṛtadā ʼbhayā || vayasthānaṃdinī jñeyā śreyasī rohiṇī tathā || harītakī paṃcarasā lavaṇā tu varotkaṭāṃ(!) || 2 || (fol.1v1-7) «Ending:» dhanakaṃ dhānyakaṃ dhānyaṃ dhānyakaṃ ca vītunnakaṃ || ka(ratuṃ)vara tadārdhanadhāne dhāna ca kālikā (!) || 183 || dhānyakaṃs tu varaṃ snigdhaṃ (avṛṣo) mutralaṃ laghu || hṛdyaṃ rucyaṃ vadhaviṭkaṃ svādu pāke tridoṣajit || 184 || pācana svādukā sāśratrīnā masi krimīn jayat(!) || ālakā tad guṇā proktā viseṣā pittanāśinī || 185 || (fol.13v3-6) Colophon iti śrikāsirājanighaṃṭavaidyaauṣadhasamgyā liṣitaṃ pustakaṃ śaṃvat(!) 1794 jyeṣṭa 31 gata caṃdravāsarea 12 dasyāṃ tithau 11 kuṃbhe guru (fol.13v7-8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || dālbhya uvāca || bhagavan prāṇinaḥ sarve viṣarogādy upadravaiḥ || duṣṭagrahopaghātaiś ca sarvakālam upadrutāḥ || 1 || ābhicārika kṛtyābhiḥ sparśarogaiś ca dāruṇaiḥ || sadā saṃpīḍyamānās te tiṣṭaṃti(!) munisattama || 2 || yena karma vipākena viṣarogādy upadravāḥ || saṃbhavaṃti nṛṇāṃ tan me yathāvad vaktum arhasi || 3 || (fol.1v1-3) End stotrarājam idaṃ nāmam apāmārjanakaṃ hareḥ || tasya tuṣyati govindo manasā ciṃtitaṃ labhet || 28 || koṭijanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ paṭhanād eva naśyati || gosahasraphalaṃ tasya paramaṃpadam āpnuyāyāt || 130 || (fol. 7v5-6) Colophon iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dālbhyapulastya saṃvāde apāmārjanastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || || khatyadibhūyutaśake māsyūrjjye bhaumavāsare || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturddaśyām alīkhad idaṃ tvaraṃ || || śrīḥ || (fol.7v7-8)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || methī guḍucī musalī saṭī ca vidārikaṃda trisugaṃdhi siṃdhuḥ | dhātrī lavaṃgekṣuragokṣurāś ca śatāvarī movarasau ca yaṣṭī | kṛṣṇāśvagaṃdhā kadalīpakaṃda nāgāhvajātīphala jātipatraṃ | śṛṅgī dhanīyā hvayakabphale ca cūrṇān mṛnābhaṃ dviguṇaṃ niyojyaṃ | sarvaturyāṃśa vijayā sarvadviguṇa śarkkarā | piṃḍī ca madhusarppiḥs sami māṣo ṭaṃko ʼtha vāmiti || (fol.1r1-4) End doṣān dūṣyān alabalavaya kāladeśā [[ʼ]]navasthāḥ satvaṃ sātmyaṃ prakṛtim asakṛdyaḥ parīkṣa prayuṃkte || roge yogaṃ bhiṣaganala svasya sisidhyaty abhīṣṭaṃ tasmād eṣā liṣita paṭhitā dhīradhībhir nnibodhyā || 99 || deśānāṃ varadātaṭaṃtaramataḥ sārthābhidhānaṃ mahā sthānaṃ devapadaṃ sadāgrajagaṇā gaṇyāḥ sahasraṃ dvijāḥ || tatrā ʼmīṣu dhaneśakeśavavidoḥ śiṣyaḥ sutaś ca kramāc cakre ślokaśataṃ bhiṣaṅmadapaviḥ śrīvopadevaḥ kaviḥ || || 100 ||(fol. 21r1-5) Colophon iti śrīvopadevaviracitā śataślokī samāptā || ❁ || || || || || śake 1515 svasti śrīmannṛpavikramārkarājyātīta saṃvat 1650 vaiśākhyām amāvāsyām citravavaṃśotpanna bhiṣagvaryelhopaṃḍitasuta nārāytaṇena kāśyām idaṃ ślokīpustakaṃ likhitaṃ svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca || (fol.21r6-8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || athāto vikṛtivijñānīyam adhyāya vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || puṣpaṃ phalasya dhūmogner varṣasya jaladodaya || yathā bhaviṣyatau liṃgaṃ riṣṭaṃ mṛtyos tathā dhruvaṃ | 1 | yāyuṣmati kriyāḥ sarvāḥ saphalāḥ saṃprayojitāḥ | bhavati bhiṣajāṃ bhūtyaiḥ kṛtajña iva bhūbhuji | 2 | kṣiṇāyuṣi kṛtaṃ karma vyarthaṃ kṛtam ivādhame | ayaśo dehasaṃdehaṃ svārthahāniṃ ca yachati(!) | 3 | (fol.1r1-3) End śuklā sumanaso vastram(!) amedhyā lepanaṃ phalaṃ | śailaprāsāda saphala vṛkṣa siṃhanara dvipān | 68 | ārohed gośvayānaṃ ca taren na dahadodadhīn | pūrvottareṇa gamanam agamyā gamanam ṛtiṃ | 69 | saṃbādhān nṛsṛtir devai pitṛbhiś cābhinandanaṃ | rodanaṃ patitottpā dviṣatāṃ cāvamardanaṃ | 70 | yasyasyādāyurārogyaṃ cittaṃ bahu ca so śrute | maṃga[lā]cāra saṃpaṃna<ref name="ftn1"> Read; saṃpanna </ref> parivāras tathāturaḥ | 71 | addadhānonukūlaś ca prabhuta(!) dravyasaṃgrahaḥ | satvalakṣaṇa saṃyogo bhaktir vaidyadvijātiṣu | 72 | cikitsāyām anir vedas tadārogyasya lakṣaṇaṃ | ity atra janma maraṇaṃ yataḥ samyag udāhṛtaṃ | 73 | śārirasya tatasthānaṃ śāriram idam ucyate | 74 | (fol.9r2-6) Colophon ity aṣṭāṃgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ vāgbhaṭṭaviracitāyāṃ śārirasthāne dūtādi vijñānīyonāma ṣaṣṭodhyāyaḥ | iti dvitīyaṃ śārirasthāṇaṃ | ❁ ❁ ❁ saṃ. 1834 miti likhitāṃ vyaṃkaṭeśena(fol. 9r7-9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama (!) || || atha cikitsāsāra likhyate (!) || || so || kamalanayanasasibhāla nāgavadana ekaradanayuta || varadaviradapratipāla harevighana ghanasyāmaju || 1 || karamuralī uramāla subhaṭa mukuṭasira bhṛkuṭighana sakhā saṃgalīrāguāla hare vighana ghanasyāmaju || 2 || chapai suṃnya caṃdra‥[[tacandra]] varakha vikrama sukhadāya[[ka]] jeṭhasudī ravidūji avarahara guru dina nāika || pāi goviṃdaprasādi sāra graṃthanako līno || nāmacikitsā sāra graṃthayaha bhākhā kīno kṛpārāma dvija lalahi tāko naṃdana dhīradhara || kario graṃtha bhūlokahū lehu sudhāra tuma vaidavara || 3 || (fol.1v1-2r1) End iti khoḍa sāṃga cūrana aḍilā | vāṃsāsoṃṭha giloi kaṭāī lijiye le indrajau aupavāḍa puna dijiye || avarabhaṃgarā ajavāina puna ānīye pīje karake kuātha sīta juarahānīe || 45 || iti sītajuarake kuātha do kūṭhanīma sarasoṃ haraḍa yava vaca lākha maṃgāi ghrita juta dhūpadī vījī rā sakala tāpa miṭajāi || 46 || (fol. 38v4-39r2) Colophon śrīlīkhīkāramī go mānikya purījī goḥ sīvarāmagirījī līkho svaraca rāma – śrīgaṇe/// (fol. 39r8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || līlāvatikalākalpavallilāvaṇyapeśale || karotu vighna vighaśanāvi ‥‥‥ sāyakaras tava || vivālo caṃcala locanesu vadane te śailatulyau stanau tulyaṃ me kusumair vapur dṛḍhataraṃ mā mā yady āligasimābalār aham idaṃ sarvaṃ yaśodāpuro vakṣyāmīti bhaṇan hasan bhavabhayā lakṣmīpatiḥ pā tvānyagadhū prayāsi bhagavan netan mṛṣā vatsale cet satyaṃ prabhaved ityaṃ yadupate tarhi prasannānaṃ ‥‥‥‥‥‥‥ śailarājaśikharāt pātaṃ kariṣyedhunānyat kiṃcid iti śramaṃ haratu me rādhācyutoktaṃ vacaḥ || 3 || (fol.1v12r3) End śārdūlavikrīḍitaṃ ghṛtaṃ aṣṭāñgahṛdayāt || uṣṇarditoyaś ca dināvasāne śītārdītoyaś ca niśāvasāne || hikkārdito yaḥ kasanārdito yaḥ sa yāti mṛtyor avalokanā (fol.15v5–7) Colophon

Beginning śaktir uvāca | yady eatat sarvajaḥ ṣyāpta (!) sivavat (!) siddhidāyakaḥ || rujājarāpahaḥ ṣyātto mṛtyudāridranāsanaḥ (!) ṣecaratvānim ādyāni prayacchati yadā hi saḥ ttadāvadusva me guhyaṃ baṃdhanaṃ sarvajasya tu | rase rasāyane caiva hematārakaro yathā | kriyayā jāyate sūtas tad guhyaṃ vada me prabho || śrīkaṃṭha uvāca śṛṇu śakte yathā saṃsthaṃ sūttakasya nivaṃdhanaṃ | guhyād guhyataraṃ hy etat sarvakāmodayaṃ śubhaṃ | sarvasiddhi pradātāraṃ mahabūtyā sudīpakaṃ | tatrādau tu rasaḥ sūtaḥ sivadehād vinirgataḥ (exp. 3a: 1–7) End gurugamyam idaṃ śāstraṃ na cānyat pṛthivītale | nṛpānāṃ (!) ca hitārthāya kṛpāsaṃghaṭṭakīrttitaḥ kvacitc chāstre kṛyā (!) nāsti kramasaṃṣvyāna (!) ca kvacit mātrāyukti kvacin nāsti saṃpradāyaḥ kvacin na ca. tena siddhir na tatrāsti rase cāpi rasāyaṇe (!) | na krameṇa vināśāstraṃ na śāstrena (!) vinākramaḥ śāstraṃ kramayute jñātvā yaḥ karoti sa siddhibhāk (exp.117b:4–8) Colophon ity āde svacchande śāntayāvatāre śatasāhastryaṃ gorakṣasaṃhitāyāṃ bhūtiprakaraṇe śivasūtraṃ rasāyanavidhiḥ paṭalaḥ 9 samāptaḥ subham astu | rāma(exp.117b:8-9)

Beginning [ṭīkā] śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || natvā śivasya caraṇau tātaṃ koṇetisaṃjñitam || vaidyajīvanakāvyasya dīpakāṃ pratanomy aham || graṃthakṛtc śiṣṭācāraparipālanāya graṃthādau maṃgalam ācarati || prakṛtīti || tat kim api anirvācyaṃ dhāma tejo nirākārarūpaṃ vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ maṃgalaṃ diśatu || maṃgalaṃ śreyasi śrute iti viśvaḥ || (fol.1v1-2) [mūla] prakṛti subhagagātraṃ prītipātraṃ ramāyā diśatu kim api dhāmaḥ śyāmalaṃ maṃgalaṃ vaḥ || aruṇakamalalīlāṃ yasya pādau dadhāte praṇataharajaṭālī || gāṃgariṃgattaraṃgaiḥ || 1 ||(fol.1v9-10) End [mūla] graṃthī prajāmarapuraḥ kṛmiśatrubhārgīr bhṛgī tṛkaṭuṃnalakaṭuphalapauṣkarāṇām || rāṣṇābhayā(!) bṛhatikādvayadībyabhṛṭtakasīkarāta kirātaka vaco ca vikāmṛtānāṃ || 46 || (fol.4v15) [ṭīkā] śamayatīti || mātuluṃgasya kesaraṃ aruci tṛṣṇāṃ śamayati |śāṃtiṃ nayati | āśu śīghraṃ | athavā | carako dāḍima carvaṇaṃ rucikāri rucikartteti sūcayāmāṃsa(!) kathayāmāsa | kathaṃbhūtaṃ salavaṇaghṛtam | ubhayor viśeṣaṇam idaṃ | śeṣaṃ spaṣṭam || 46 || (fol.4v19-20)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śivaṃ praṇamya vāgīśaṃ dhanvantarim athāśvinau || kriyate ṭoḍarānaṃdo granthaḥ sadvaidyasammataḥ || 1 || diśan tu śaṃke śavaśaṃkarādyāḥ devāḥ sudevā ʼvvyagasaṃbhavādyāḥ || śrīṭoḍarendre nṛpatau sūmūrtte dharmasya bhūmau parirakṣake ca || 2 || māṃ dhātṛduḥkuntasutādibhir yā pūrvvaṃkṛtā paddhatir adyayena || mūrddhābhiṣaktālikabhūṣaṇena samuddhṛtā śrīvaraṭoḍareṇa || 3 || bhūdevadevān bhuvidānayajñaiḥ santoṣyasādhūn atha sarvvavarṇān || kāmair aṇekaiś ca vilokya rugṇān ājñāpad digvijaye narendraḥ || 4 || prācīna śāstrāṇi sudurgamāṇi bhinnaprameyāni nirīṣa samyak || ekatrasarvaṃ bhavatāt suboddhuṃ mataṃ kṛte ṭoḍaramallabhūpaiḥ || 5 || (fol.1v1-4) «Sub-colophon:» iti śrīṭoḍarānande āyurvedasaukhye nighaṃṭau sākavargā navatitamo harṣa || || (exp.409a:4) «Ending:» niṣtuṣair bharjjitaiḥ piṣṭaiś caṇakiḥ sa yavai(!) kṛtā sajtavaḥ sarkkarā yuktā gṛṣmeti pūjitā | piṇḍiproktā tatas teṣāṃ dravatvāl lehikā laghuḥ | na tu kvānaradaiḥ kṣitvā na niśāyāṃ na vābahu | na jalān taritātbhiḥ saktunādy ādyān na kevalān | bhṛṣṭasālyādijālājādhāno bhṛdṛg yavodbhavā | lājā laghutarāḥ (exp.411a:10-11)

Beginning jvarādau laṃghanaṃ proktaṃ jvaramadhye tu pācanam || jvarānte bheṣajaṃ deyaṃ jvaramukte virecam || nāgaradevakākṣaṃ vacānyakaṃ vṛhatī dvayam || dadyāt pācanakaṃ pūrvva (!) jvarīṇī ca jvarāham || soṭhī devadāru || ṣaniāreganī | varahaṭhā || prativastu māsā 5 ī sava vastu avaṭi kvātha piai deva || (fol. 2r1–5) End || ❁ || nāḍī vraṇādhikāreti || ❁ || a[[tha]] bhagandarādhikāraḥ ❁ || gudasyaṃtravathu dadhvā viśoṣya śodhayet tataḥ || raktāvadevanaṃ kāryaṃ tathā pākaṃ na gachati<ref>Read: gacchati</ref> || vadayatreṣṭayakā śūrāṭhī gurucyaḥ sa punarnnavāḥ || sūpiṣṭaya piṭhakāvastre lepaḥ sstoto citrakārkatṛvṛt pāṭhe manalapṛhamā

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || auṣadhipati netrāya padminīpati mūrttaye || kālakā[[ lā ]]ya nīlāya pārvatīpataye namaḥ || 1 || garbhabhārapariktinnā kanyāmandodarī śubhā || rāvaṇaṃ paripapraccha pūjānte tuṣṭamānasam || 2 || mandodary uvāca || svāmin daityasurārādhya caturvedaviśārada || sadāśivād āptakāma bhuvanatrayapālaka || 3 || (fol.1v1-4) End paṃcagavye tu saṃśodhya dikuryāc ca jihvikāṃ || tato ʼmlavarge daśadhā kṣāravarge tridhā punaḥ || 97 || kumārikādrave bhasma jale caivaṃ viśodhayet || evaṃ śuddhas tu jepālo vāṃtidāhādi pīḍitaḥ || 98 || mandodari te vyākhyātaṃ yan mayā śivataḥ śrutaṃ || etad jñātvāṃ tu bhuñjīta tvaritaṃ yatnam ācara || 99 || evam uktvā tu bhaiṣajyarahasyaṃ sa daśānanaḥ || sāyaṃ saṃdhyā vidhiṃ kartum utthito maṃdiraṃ yayau || 100 || (fol. 79v5-9) Colophon iti laṃkānāthakṛtārkaprakāśe dhātuśuddhiśatakaṃ daśamaṃ samāptoyaṃ granthaḥ || (fol.79v9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || nāḍīlakṣaṇaṃ || saptaśatānimadhyāc caturadhikaviṃśatisphuṭāḥ | tāsam ekā parīkṣaṇīyā dakṣīṇakaracaraṇā vinyastā || karasyāṃguṣṭamūle yā dhamanī jīva sākṣiṇī | tac ceṣṭayā sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ, jñeyaṃ kāyasya paḍitaiḥ | sādhyāsādhya vivekaś ca, sarvvaṃ nāḍī prakāśate | vātapittaṃ kaphadvaṃdvaṃ, tritayaṃ sānnipātakaṃ | vātād vakragatā nāḍī, capalā pittavāhinī || (fol.1v1-4) End kaṭabhī saptakaṃ caiva pāribhadraṃ tathā vidhi | gharmme vā agnināyogān mardya mardya viśoṣayet || tripuṭedd hastamātre ca saptaparṇar vimarddayet | svāṅgaśītaṃ samudhṛtya ślakṣṇaṃ cūrṇaś ca kārayet || māṣārddhamanubhuṃjīta chinnātoyaṃ pived anu | pathyaṃ ca jīrṇam annasyād, deśakālaṃ vicārayet | mahātāleśvaro nāma sarvvakuṣṭha nikṛntanaḥ | prasuptaṃ ca tathā citraṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca kākaṇaṃ | vātaraktaṃ tathā dyo (fol.35v 3–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || prakṛtisubhagagātraṃ prītipātraṃ ramāyā diśatu kimapi dhāma śyāmalaṃ maṃgalaṃ vaḥ || aruṇa kamalalīlāṃ yasya pādau dadhāte(!) praṇatahara jaṭālī gāṃgariṃgattaraṃgaiḥ || 1 || ratnaṃ vāmadṛśāṃ dṛśāṃ sukhakaraṃ śrīsaptaśṛṃgāspadaṃ spaṣṭāṣṭā daśabāhutadbhagavato bhargasya bhāgyaṃ bhaje || yad bhaktena mayāghaṭasta nighaṭī madhye samutpādyate padyānāṃ śatamaṃganādharasudhā spardhāvidhānoddhure || 2 || (fol.1v1-4) «Sub: Colophon:» iti śrīloliṃbarājakṛte jvarapratilāronāma prathamovolāsaḥ sampūrṇaḥ || (fol.7v1) iti śrīloliṃbarājaviracite vaidyajīvanṇe (!) grahaṇīpratīkāronāma dvitīyovilāsaḥ || 2 || (fol.9r4-5) iti śrīvaidyajīvane garbhiṇīruka (!) pratīkāronāma tṛtīyo vilāsa || (fol.11v3) iti śrīvaidyajīvane kṣayādi caturthovilāsaḥ ||(fol.14v8–9) End nārāyaṇaṃ bhajatare jaṭhareṇayukto nārāyaṇaṃ bhajatare pavanena yuktāḥ || nārāyaṇaṃ bhajata (!) bhavabhītiyuktā nārāyanātparataraṃ kimapīha nāsti || iti saṃkṣapaḥ (!) || āyurvedavidāṃ vicārasamaye dhanvaṃtariḥ kevalaṃ sīmāgānavidāṃ divākarasudhāṃbhodhitriyāmāpatiḥ uttaṃsaḥ kavitākṛtāṃ matimatāṃ bhūbhṛt sabhābhūṣaṇaṃḥ(!) || kāṃtoktyāś (!) tu vaidyajīvanam idaṃ loliṃvarājaḥ kavi || 24 ||(fol.16r9-16v3) Colophon iti śrīvaidyajīvane paṃcamollyāsaḥ (!) samāptaḥ || | || || || || || |…(fol.16v3-4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || kṛṣṇasya taṃtrasya grihīta dhāmnā cikitsatā viprasṛtasya dūraṃ || vidagdha vaidya pratipūjitasya kariṣyate yogaśatasya baṃdha || 1 || parīkṣahetvāmaya lakṣaṇāni cikitsitajñena cikitsakena || nirāmadehasya hi bheṣajāni bhavaṃti yuktānyaṛtopamāni || 2 || chinnodbhavāṃ ʼbudharadhanvayavāsaviśvair duḥsparśa parpaṭakamedhakirātatiktaiḥ || mustāṭaruṣakam ahauṣadha dhanvayāsai kvāthaṃ pived analapittakaphajvareṣu || || 3 || (fol.1v1-5) End guṇādhikaṃ yogaśataṃ nivadhya prāptaṃ mayā puṇyamanuttamaṃ yat || nānāprakārahy apanīya bhūtaṃ kṛsnaṃ jagat ye naracatvarogaṃ(!) || 23 || kṛtiriyaṃ sukhadā hi mahākave vaidyapater amṛta prasavasya || vararuce sudhiyāṃ hi hitārthaṃ jayatu yoga śatāhvavibhāṣā || 24 || (fol.16r5-16v1) Colophon saṃvat 1760 mītī(!) vaiśāṣa(!) kṛsna aṣṭamī somavāra || kāśī madhe(!) || līṣataṃ (!) bhaṭajīvārāmaḥ || iti yogaśataṃ saṃpurṇaḥṃ(!) || śrī gurucaraṇakamalebhyā(!) namaḥ || saṃkhyā 100 | 24 || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī || śrī ||(fol.16v1-4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam || devīsarasvatī (!) caiva tato jayam udīrayat(!) || 1 || brahmāsmṛtvāyuṣovedaṃ prajāpatīm ajīgrahat || śośvinau tau sahassrāksaṃ sotriputrādikān(!) munim || 2 || tegnivesādikāste tu pṛthak taṃtrāṇi teṇire(!) || tebhyopi viprakīrṇebhyaḥ prāyasāratarośrayaḥ(!) || 3 || bālānāṃ sukhabodhāya rogīnāṃ(!) ca hitāya vaiḥ(!) || sūkṣmaṃ karoti carakaḥ graṃthaṃ tu carakākhyayā || 4 || iti vedotpatti(!) yas tu rogam avijñāya karmānyārabhate(!) bhiṣak || jñātavyo vakṣate(!) yoyaṃ jvarādīnāṃ viniścayaḥ || 5 ||(fol.1v1-6) End śālimudgādimaṣnīyāt(!) pived dugdhaṃ saśarkkaram || sevyaṃ nadī saro vāri karajālaṃ ca śītagoḥ || 21 || ikṣavaḥ śālayo muṃgāḥ(!) saroṃbhaḥ kvathitaṃ payaḥ || śaradetāni pathyāni pradoṣe ceṃduraśmayaḥ || 22 || tīkṣṇamamlaṃ salavaṇaṃ dadhitailāsavātapaṃ || divāsvapnaṃ purovātaṃ śaratkāle vivarjayet || 23 || (fol.30v1-4) Colophon iti śrīsahasravadanasyāṃsa(!) carakācārya viracitā(!) saṃhitāyāṃ carakākhye bhūta ciṃtādi kathanan nāma trayadaśo(!) dhyāyaḥ || 13 || samāptaṃ pūrvakhaṇḍaḥ || ||śubham || (fol. 44v4-6) iti śrīsahasravadanasyāṃsa(!) carakācāryyaviracitāyāṃ viracitāyām saṃhitāyām carakākhye rasauṣadhi bhakṣaṇe sāmānya pathyāpathya kathanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśodhyāyaḥ || 16 || samāpto(!) madhyamakhaṇḍaḥ || 2 || śubham || ||( fol. 60v4-6) iti śrīsahasravadanasyāṃsa(!) carakācāryyaviracitāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ carakākhye svsthavṛttikathanaṃ nāmaikādaśodhyāyaḥ || 11 || samāptoyaṃ uttarakhaṇḍaḥ(!) || || śubham || fol. 30r4-6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || namo viśveśvaraṃ śāmvaṃ (!) ḍhuḍirājamahodaraṃ (!) || rasakalpaṃ prakāśyāmi (!) śatkriyā yogasaṃyutaṃ || prathamaṃ rasarājasya śodhanaṃ jāraṇāni ca || hiṃgulād rasakarṣaṃ ca mūkhīkaraṇam eva ca || himabījādikaṃ caiva bījacālana jāraṇaṃ || sāraṇaṃ mukhabaṃdhāni krāmanaṃ rasamaṃtrakaḥ || dravyavargaṃ yaṃtramūṣāpuṭakhalo vidhir mataḥ(!) || matimān kuśalo vaidya karmaṃ (!) kuryād vicārataḥ || (fol.1v1-5) End bīje pādārddhakaṃ deyaṃ †jīrṇarevaṃ† karoti saḥ || daśaṣoḍaśabhāgena dvātriṃśāṃśena ca kramāt || rasaviddhaṃ yat kanakaṃ ye kṣaṇe bhuviśītale || tāpyaṃ karttavyohīna †tāraṇatādāho† paścātkaraṇīyaṃ || yatra vedhī satavedhī sahasra sāranena(!) tu || salakṣaṇaṃ pratisārena koṭi vedhi tu sārite (!) || (fol.33r9-33v2) Colophon iti śrīdaṇḍapāṇiputradevānandakṛte kalpoddhāre rasoparasadhātubaṃdhano nāma tṛtīyollāsaḥ || 3 || || śubhm (!) (fol.33v3-4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || svargāpavargavistārau sāmarasyodarodareḥ || bhavarogaharau vaṃde caṃḍikā candraśeṣarau (!) || 1 || rasoparasa lohānāṃ tailamūla viṣaiḥ saha || sa śādhya (!) pratyayopetaṃ kathyate rasa rasāya[[naṃ]] (!) || || 2 || vaidyānāṃ ca hitārthāya vyādhitānāṃ hitāya ca || vādināṃ kautukārthāya vṛddhānāṃ dehasiddhaye || 3 || maṃtriṇāṃ matraṃsiddhyarthaṃ (!) vividhāścaryakārakam || hato haṃti jarāmṛtyuṃ mūrcchito vyādhighātakaḥ || 4 || hale ca khegate baṃdhuḥ konyaḥ sūtāt kṛpākaraḥ || yāvat sūtaṃ na śuṃddhaṃ na ca gaganemṛtamūrcchitaṃ baṃdhaḥ (!) || 5 || (fol.1v1-4) End yāmāṃte pūrvavad dalpaṃ svayaṃ niryāti na svayaṃ || †sāvuṇī ṭaṃkaṇaṃ† tutthaṃ pūrvavan madhunā yutaṃ || 93 || tadvad vartiś ca piṇḍaṃ ‥‥svirālpaharaṃ bhavet || putraṃ jīvaphalāmajjātoyaiḥ piṣṭvā prapācayet || 94 || abhyaṃtaragataṃ haṃti hy asthisalyotthitaṃ viṣaṃ || || siddhe rasaiḥ sakalaroga nivāraṇāya proktaṃ sajastam anumuya (!) hitaṃ narāṇāṃ || dhanvaṃtareḥ sakalakīrtikaraṃ nirīkṣya mārātisārarasasāgarasiddhakhaṇḍaṃ || 1 || śrī || (fol.37v8-38r2) Colophon iti śrīpārvatīputraśrīnityanāthasidha viracite rasaratnākare siddhakhaṇḍe sthāvara viṣādiśalyanivāraṇaṃ nāma caturdaśopadeśaḥ || 14 || || samvat 1906 sāla miti phārguṇa(!) vadi 14 roja 1 kā dina maṣanavāhālako (!) śrīarjavegī thākumanīle saṃpūrṇa leṣyāko (!) ho śubhaṃmm (!) astu (!) sadā sarvadā kalyānaṃ (!) dṛrgham (!) āyūrastu (!) || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol.38r2-5)

Beginning śrīmahāmaṃgalamūrttaye gaṇeśāya namaḥ || || bījaṃ śrutīnāṃ sudhanaṃ munīnāṃ jīvaṃ jaḍānāṃ mahadādikānāṃ || āgneyam astraṃ bhava pātakānāṃ kiñcit mahaḥ syāmalam āśrayāmi || 1 || lubdhvā kapola madhuvāri madhuvratālī kumbhasthali madhuvibhūṣaṇa lohitāṅgī | māṇikyamaulir iva rājati yasya maulau vighnaṃ sa dhūnayatu vighnapatiḥ sadā vaḥ || 2 || yo dhvāṃta saṃtati viśāra payodhi madhyān niḥkkāsayat ya saraṇaṃ bhuvanaṃ nimajjat datvā jagattrayahitaḥ svakarāvalaṃvaṃ vāṃchāṃ sa vo dinakaraḥ saphalī karotu || 3 || (fol. 1v1–3) End /// tukān || yo rājñāṃ mukhatilakaḥ kaṭāramallas tena śrīmadanṛpeṇa nirmitetra | graṃthe bhūnmadananāmni pūrṇaḥ karṇānāmamṛtarasapradā praśāstiḥ (!) | (fol. 39r1) Colophon iti śrīmadanapā[la]viracite madanavinode nighaṃṭau praśastivargaś caturdaśaḥ | | samāptaś cāyaṃ nighaṃṭuḥ | | dṛṅnetracārvāha śake madhauśitau pakṣe maheśasyatithau kaver dine nārānidhisvasya vilokanārthaṃ saṃprālikhatturṇam imaṃ nighaṃṭuṃ | yathāpratilikhitaṃ sadbhiḥ saṃśodhanīyaṃ | śubhamastu satatam | | ❁ | |śivaprasādāc chubham astu | trikaṭuka ajamodāsaiṃdhavaṃ jirake he samadhāraṇādhṛtānām aṣṭamohiṃgughāgaḥ || (fol. 39r1–3)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīguruga[[ṇe]]śāya namaḥ || || oṃ dhanvanarīn natvā || preṃkholasphuṭanīlanīrajadalādvaitapratītipradā dṛṣṭir dollatamālanīlimaguṇagrāhiṇyataṃ tasya vaḥ || lakṣmyāḥ sāstu sukhāya ciṃtitavatī yā bhāti nīlāṃvuda yābhṛśrīyamunāpravāhajaṭhare loleva mīnāṃganā || 1 || jayati vidita sāraḥ sṛṣṭa viśvopakāraḥ pravalagadakuṭḥāraḥ sobhitā kaṃṭhahāraḥ || sakalaguṇasamājaḥ siddhavidyā nikuṃjas tripuraharastanūjas tejasāṃsphārapuṃjaḥ || 2 || (fol.1v1-3) End gaṭiṃ(!) vidhatte dhamanī gajeṃdram arālavāle ca kapholvaṇena || tṛptasya dṛptasya ca medurasya nidrākulasyāti mukheratasya || 90 || yatair dhidoṣāya samastavipraur vidhiśrair bhiṣajāvadhāryyā ||(!) nāḍī yathā kālamapi trayāṇāṃ prakopasāṃtyādibhireva bhūyaḥ || 91 ||(fol.22r7-8) Colophon iti śrīṭākānvayamaṇḍalana ratnadevasuta rāmadevaviracite rasaratnapradīpaḥ saṃpūrṇam || || śrī 3 dhanvantariprasannastu(!) || rūpanavanidhisāla aidhikabhādraśuklapūrṇyamā (!) || || śubhaṃ || || (fol.21r8-9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīdhanvantaraye (!) namaḥ || śritvārajaḥsatvatamāmsi viśva (!) nirmāti pāti kṣapati svayaṃ yaḥ || aśeṣavṛṃdārakavṛṃdavaṃdyaḥ pāyād apāyān manujān girīśaḥ || ālokya vaidya taṃtrāṇi yatnād eṣa nivadhyate || vyādhitānāṃ cikitsārthaṃ pathyāpathya viniścayaḥ || bhiṣaksarveṣu rogeṣu nirdiṣṭāni yathā tathaṃ || nidānā pathyapathyāni trīṇi yatnād vicintayet || pūrvaṃ sarvagadekuryān nidāna parivarjanaṃ || tenaiva rogāḥ śīryaṃte śuṣkanīrā ivāṅkurāḥ || (fol.1v1-5) «Ending:» mustā śirīṣa kastūrī tiktāni madhurāṇi ca || hemacūrṇāni vagroyaṃ(!) pathyāpathyaṃ yathā viṣaṃ || viṣarogeṣu sarveṣu prayoktaṃvyovijānatā(!) || krodhaṃ viruddhādhyasanaṃ vyavāyaṃ (taṃbūmāyā) (!) samap (!) pradāttaṃ (!) || amlaṃ ca sarvaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca sarvaṃ sesvedanaṃ(!) tadvividhāni tāni || nidrābhayaṃ dhūmavikāragharmo viṣāturo naiva bhajet kadācit || iti viṣaroge pathyāpathyavidhi || 60 || (fol.26v6-10) Colophon iti pathyāpathya nighaṃṭuḥ samāptaḥ || ❁ || (fol.26v10)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || yasyāṅgrikakaṃja makaraṃda liholayomī vyāsādayo vividhavāṅmayamāṃ cikīrṣuḥ (!) || bhaktārttidaityadalanāya kṛtāvatāro vighnaṃ sa no naraharir nikhilaṃ nihanyāt || 1 || jaṃbudvīpa vitita suyaśo rāśirudbhāṣita goradhverākāpatiriva hare rāvirāśīd dvijeśaḥ (!) || lakṣmīdāsa sakalajagatāṃ vaṃdanīyānubhāvo dhvastājñānāṃdhakāraḥ karagaladamṛtā naṇditāśeya viśvaḥ || 2 || (fol.1v1-4) End āyurvrdavaco vicārasamaye dhanvantarī (!) kevalaṃ sīmāṃgānividāṃ divākarasudhāṃbhodhitriyāmāpatiḥ | uttaṃsa kattārvatāvatāṃ (!) matimatāṃ bhūbhṛt sabhābhūṣaṇam kāṃto narākṛtāṃ (!) vaidyajīvanamidaṃ lolimbarājaḥ kaviḥ || 45 || iti vaidyajivane paṃcamo vilāsaḥ || || (fol.45v1-3) amṛta samaudrastasya triyāmāpatiścaṃdraḥ | punaḥ | kavitāvatā utaṃsaḥ sirobhūṣaṇaṃ punaḥ || matimatāṃ buddhimatāṃ bhūmadrājā punaḥ sabhābhūṣaṇaṃ || athavā matimatāṃ matikavitāvatāṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ punaḥ bhūbhṛtāṃ rājñāṃ sabhā bhūṣayati aneka kavitā prastāvavādibhiḥ || śobhayatītyevaṃbhūt || 36 ||(fol.45v7-10) Colophon iti śrīmanmanohara sūnunā gosvāmīnā harināthakṛtāyāṃ vaidyajīvanaṭīkāyāṃ paṃcamo vilāsaḥ || śrīmadbhūpati vikramābda gaṇanā khaṃ vahni sapteṃdubhir māse jeṣṭha asi saptami tithai (!) vāre bhṛgu śoriyaṃ || ṭīkā || vaidyajivanasya (!) racī (!) śrīnātha gosvāmībhir caitastvaṃṭamāsthite (!) śarapure dhāryābhiṣaghi sadā likhitaṃ brāhmaṇa saṃbhūrāmeṇa (!) likhāyataṃ cīraṃjī (!)gosvāmi bālakṛṣṇajī miti bhādrapada śuklapakṣe tithau || 2 || ravivāsare || || saṃvat ||1849 || vṛṣe śākhe || || 1714 || || śubhaṃ bhūyāt || śrīmuthareśa(!) (fol.46r1-4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || cakradattaḥ || || vātottareṣu sarpi vamanaṃ śleṣmottareṣu kuṣṭeṣu || pittottareṣu mokṣo raktasya virecanaṃ cāgrā || prachannam alpakuṣṭemehati ca śastraṃ śirāvyadhanam || bahudoṣa saṃśodhyāḥ kuṣṭī bahuśonurakṣitāḥ prāṇāḥ || vacāvasā paṭolānāṃ nimbasya phalinītvacaḥ || kaṣāya madhunā pīto vāntikṛd madanānvitaḥ || (fol.1v1-4) End gaṇḍikādya tailam || citrakasyātha nirguṇḍī hayamārasya mūlataḥ || pakṣātpakṣād vāmanānyabhyupeyotmāsātmāchraṃ sanaṃ cāpyadhastāt tryahāstryat ahānnas tataś cāvapīḍānmāsaiṣvasṛgmokṣayet ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu || yoṣityāṃsa(!) surātyāgaiḥ śālimudga yavādayaḥ | purāṇa tikta śākaṃ ca jāṅgalaṃ kuṣṭināṃ hitam || (fol.13v2-5) Colophon || iti kuṣṭādhikāraḥ || (fol.13v5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || praṇamya jagad utpattis thitisaṃhārakāraṇaṃ || svargāpavargayor dvāraṃ trailokyaśaraṇaṃ śivaṃ || 1 || nānā munīnāṃ vacanair idānīṃ samāsata sad bhiṣajāṃ niyogāt || sopadravāriṣṭanidānaliṃgo nivadhyate rogaviniścayoyaṃ || 2 || nānā taṃtra vihīnāṇāṃ bhiṣajām alpamedhasāṃ || sukhaṃ vijñātum ātaṃkam ayameva bhaviṣyati || 3 || nidānaṃ pūrvarūpāṇi rūpāṇyupaśayas tathā || saṃprāptiś ceti vijñānaṃ rogāṇāṃ paṃcadhā smṛtaṃ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–4) End subhāvitaṃ yatra tadasti kiṃcit tatsarvamekīkṛtam atra yatnāt || viniścaye sarvarujāṃ narāṇāṃ śrīmādhaveneṃdra karātmajena yatkṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ kiṃcit kṛtvainaṃ rugviniścayaṃ || muṃcaṃtu jaṃtavas tena nityamātaṃkasaṃtatiṃ || || śrīr astu || || || (fol. 92v7–92v2) Colophon iti śrīmādhavakaraviracitarugviniścayaḥ saṃgrahaḥ saṃpūrṇaḥ || ||… saṃvat 1848 mīṭī (!) māgha vadī 2 vāra budhavāra || || kāśyāṃ madhye || || śrīrāmacaṃdrāya namaḥ || śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ || śrīgopālo jayati || śrīhanumataye || śrīlakṣmī najīāya(!)namaḥ || ❁ ❁ ❁ śrī śrī rājārāmacaṃdrāya nama (!) || || (fol. 92v6–93r1)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ sarvajñāya || dhyātvā śivaṃ paramatatvavicāravaidyaṃ caṇḍimabhiṣṭaphaladā sagaṇaṃ gaṇesa(!) | dhanvantariṃ munivaraṃ munisūśrūtādi nātreyasūgratapalaṃ(!) manasā pranamya(!) || nānāmataprathita dṛṣṭaphalaprayogaiḥ prastāvavākyasahitair iha siddhiyogaḥ | vṛndenamandamatinātmahitānvitāyaḥ saṃlikhyate gaḍa(!) viniścayaja krameṇa || 2 || (fol.1r1-3) End hnasakacchūyāḥ ateriḥ hallajiraḥ sevarā svātharahāḥ apāmārgaharaḥ kūṭaḥ mahāraṅaḥ thvate samabhāg thutakaṃna yāvḥ cekanaṣuneḥ phoyaḥ thane, hnasakacchunāsaḥ dūvane vavaṃnāsa || || lvāhāmālanaḥ yāyaḥ dharīpāṅna vālaḥ (fol.72v6-7)

Beginning …kṣārairamlaiśca saṃyutā | kṛtaṃ kāṃtāya saṃsoyaṃ bhavetkoṭiguṇo rasaḥ | viśāletare dvaṃdaikavacanaṃ kṛtvā khalva viśeṣaṇaṃ viśālo vistṛtaḥ itaro laghu || asmin paṃcapalaḥ sūto marddanīyo viśuddhaye tattadaucityayoge malhalyeṣvanyeṣu yojayediti vacanaād ubhayor upādānaṃ susnigdheti | (fol.8v1-3) End nakarmaṃ kārayet kiṃcit varjaye (!) chītamātapaṃ (!) /// atha duṣṭagrahanivāraṇaṃ | vilvamūlaṃ devadāruṃ gokṣīraṃca priyaṃgukaṃ | mār⟪yā⟫jārasya malaṃ ku/// jvarastū bhūtabrahmarākṣasān | maṃtraḥ | paṃcagiṇI (!) parasini u ṭhaḥ svāhā | śrīkhaṃḍa/// ke piṣṭvā tṛtīye vedanāvatī | (fol.75v5-8) Colophon iti vaṃdhyāprayogaḥ |(fol.75v8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāye (!) namaḥ || oṃ namo bhagavate bhāṣkarāya || gaṇādhīśaṃ bhāskaraṃ praṇamyottarataṃtrakaṃ || (!) bhīmasena vinodesmin vaśyateti parisphuṭa (!) || tatrādau bālakarogāḥ || trividhaṃ kathito bālaḥ kṣīrānnobhayavarttinaḥ || svāsthāṃ (!) tābhyāṃ madyuṣṭābhyāṃ duṣṭābhyāṃ roga saṃbhavaḥ || dhātryās tu gurubhir bhojyai viṣamaiderivastathā (!) || doṣāḥ kadācit kupyati (!) tatas tanyaṃ pradūṣyati (!) || jvarāḍyā vyādhaya sarve mahatāṃ ye purohitāḥ || bāladehepi te tadvad vijñeyāḥ kuśalair iha || bhaiṣajyaṃ pūrvvamuddiṣṭaṃ mahatī yat (!) jvarādiṣu | (fol.1v1-4) End dāḍimāmalaṃ kadarītakha khachūla valkala kvāthaḥ || sārdhrakṣaudrasameto deyās tad bhāvanāḥ satyaṃ || samyavakṣaume chāyāśuṣkaṃ kṛtvā bhagāṃtare nyastaṃ ṛtukāle tvativṛddhā daśavarṣā bhavennārī || kokilākhyasya bījāni ajākṣīre tu lāṃgalī || kvāthayellepayettena yonīkṣālyāttataḥ punaḥ || jale kāryā sa mūlaṃ ca piṣṭvā.. (fol.28v11-13)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || śrīdhanvantaraye (!)namaḥ || namāmi dhanvaṃtarim ādidevaṃ surāsurair vaṃdita pādapadmaṃ || loke jarārugbhayamṛtyunāśaṃ dhātāram īśaṃ vivīdhauṣadhīnāṃ (!) || 1 || aneka deśāṃtara bhāṣiteṣu sarveṣvathaprākṛta śaṃskṛteṣu (!) || ‥‥‥‥‥‥‥‥ca nāsti saṃkhyā dravyābhidhāneṣu tathauṣadheṣu || 2 || prayojanaṃ yasya tu yāvatāsyāṃ tāvat sa gṛhṇāti yathāṃvukupāt (!) || tathā nighṃṭābunidher anaṃtād gṛhṇāmyahaṃ kiṃcidihaika deśaṃ || 3 || nāmoktam ekasya yathauṣadhasya nāmā parasyāpi tadeva coktaṃ || śāstreṣu lokeṣu ca yat prasiddhaṃ na gṛhyatesau punarukti doṣaḥ || 4 || (fol.1v1-7) «Ending:» || guṇāḥ || ṛddhivṛddhimadhuraśītākṣayapittānilān jayet || raktadāhajvarān haṃti vṛddhisyāt kaphaśukrayoḥ || bhūyakoholā nāmaḥ || vidārikāmṛt muktā svādukaṃdā śṛgālikā || vṛkṣakaṃdā vidāri ca vṛkṣavallī vidārikā || guṇāḥ || vidāri śiśirā svādu guru snigdhā samīranut || pittāsmajit tayā balyā vṛṣyā caiva prakīrtitā || /// (vi)dārīnāmaḥ || anyākṣīra vidāri…(fol.10v10-14)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kapolavigalallola dānapānīyapichilam (!) vibhramad bhramaramākāraṃ vande haṃ dviradānanaṃ 1 (!) śrīmat trimallabhaṭṭena nāmnā yogataraṅgiṇī cikitsā likhyate bhūri granthebhyaḥ svaparārthinā 2 dehā utpadyate (!) puṃsaḥ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam na niroga sa kutrāpi tachāṃtis (!) tu cikitsaya (!) 3 (fol. 1v1–3) End brahmadakṣāśvirudreṃdra bhūcaṃdrārkānilānalāḥ || ṛṣayaḥ auṣadhigrāmā bhūtasaṃghāś ca pātu naḥ || svārthaṃ ca /// m ādaratayā dṛṣṭvā catuḥpaṃcasān granthān vaidyakṛtān prasiddhapathagān bhāṭṭaiḥ trimallābhidhaiḥ || eṣā yogataragiṇī ra/// sādhvīkṛtā saṃmitā (!) saṃtaptā sarasāmukhena suciraṃ jīyād anekāḥ samāḥ || (exp. 128a5–7) Colophon iti yogataraṅgiṇyāṃ trimallabhaṭṭa/// thitāyāṃ ṣaḍṛtucikitsānāmāṣṭasaptatimas taraṅgaḥ || 78 || saṃvat padmapayodhiśailavasudhābhiḥ saṃmite śrī–/// (exp. 128a7–8) iti vātanāśakatailaṃ || iti śrītrimallabhaṭṭa/// yogataraṅgiṇīgraṃthaḥ samāptaḥ || || miti vaiśākhaśukla 3 (exp. 128b1–2)

Beginning /// rūpamāhurmunīśaḥ || iti vātajvaralakṣaṇam || tīkṣṇo tikṣṇotisāro vamimukha kaṭutā śoṇake nātitarṣāḥ pāko vakrauṣṭanāsepyarucir api mado vipralāpobhramau ca || pītatvaṃ-matta viḍūtvaṅ makhanayanamukhe svedasaṃtāpadāhā nidrālpatvaṃ bhavati jvara iha viṣamāḥ paittikemī vikārāḥ || || iha pittajvara lakṣaṇam || (fol.3r1–4) End gotra huṃ pātra ( pāuṃ hitalka bhiḍa) tela vā ghyū ho poṇai sidhū hoi nikasau ra sāu ra rāu || cāra ḍhaṃgā cāridiśā (a) phālananu vairībhaya na ho || || haritāla māraikāu maṃtraḥ | | hara hara mahādeva harayīṣī e haritāla niraṃjanaka prājñā satakarttāka dohāi haraī vīsa haritāla harahara || (fol.31v1–3) Colophon iti śrītrimallabhaṭṭaviracitā vṛttamāṇikyamālā samāptā || śubham || || śrī || || (25v10) iti dhanvaṃtari praṇīta vaidyaśāstraṃ sampūrṇam || śubham || || (fol.31v3)

Beginning namo āryāvalokiteśvarāya || praṇipatya lokanāthaṃ lokottaravairājamuhu(!) karuṇam || nānāvyādhy upaśamanaṃ pākavidhiṃ saṅgrahād vakṣe || drākṣāmadhuka dhānyaka kākoli kāśmarīphala vyoṣaiḥ || granthika vidiṅga bhārgī nāgavalośīrakuś mulaīḥ || śatamūlī ca vyotpalacandanahayagandhaśigrusitajīraiḥ || sahaniṣkvāthya jalādakam atha kuryāt prasthaśeṣam idam || kṣīraprasthasametaṃ dhṛtakuḍavayutaṃ viśuddha guḍapādam || tenodakena vidhivad vipacen mandāgninā tadanu || uttārya pakvam enaṃ jātīphalajātīkośamarīcānāṃ || (fol.1v1-3) End ata eva vihāyadoṣajātaṃ guṇaleśaṃ parigṛhya sādhavosya || jagad arthakaraṃ susaṃgrihītaṃ śṛṇu tailaṃ valavarṇadaṃsadaghnam || tad apañcararatāt sadaiva kalpadrumavat satvasukhapradaḥ prakāśaḥ || bhavatāj janatāvaśuddhavṛtā sukhinī vitarujā vivṛddhapuṇyaḥ || pravidhāya mayāvata pākavidhiṃ yadu vāpimalaṃ kuśalañjanatā || labhate paripakva phalaṃ śubhadaṃ susapākam upetvamunā kuśalam || (fol.10v4-6) Colophon samāptoyaṃ pākavdhir nāmānekarogapaśamanaḥ(!) || kritir iyaṃ paṇḍita śrīdivākaracandrasyeti || || śrīvaikramīye 1983 varṣe rājakīyapustakālaya prācīna tāḍapatrapustakam avalavya śrīmad rājaguru hemarāja śarmaṇā acārjo papada ravinātha śarma dvārā likhitam idam || śubham || śrīḥ || || (fol.10v6-7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śritvārajaḥ satvatamāṃsiviśvaṃ(!) nirmāti pāti kṣapati(!) svayaṃ yaḥ || aśeṣavṛṃdākaravṛṃdavaṃdyaḥ pāyādapāyān manujāt girīśaḥ || ālokya vaidha taṃtrāṇi yatnād eṣa nivadhyate || vyādhitānāṃ cikitsārthaṃ pathyāpathya viniścayaḥ || bhiṣāk sarveṣurogeṣu nirddiṣṭāni yathāyathaṃ || nidānāḥ pathyapathyāni trīṇi yatnād viciṃtayet || pūrvaṃ sarvagade kuryān nidānaparivarjanaṃ || tenaiva rogāḥ śiryaṃte śuṣkanīrā evāṃkurāḥ || (fol.1v1-4) End muṣtā śirīṣakasturī tiktāni madhurāṇi ca || hemacurṇāni vargoyaṃ pathāvasthaṃ yathāviṣaṃ || viṣarogeṣu sarviṣu prapoktavyo vijānatā || krodhaṃ virudvāsanaṃ(!) vyavāyaṃ tāmmbulamāyāsam api pravātaṃ || amlaṃ ca sarvaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca sarvaṃ saṃsvedanaṃ tad vividhāni tāni || nidrāmayaṃ dhūmakaṭu kṣudhāṃ ca viṣāturo naiva bhajet kadācit || iti viṣe || (fol.26v4-6) Colophon iti pathyāpathya saṃgrahaḥ || saṃ 1730 caitrakṛṣṇa 6 bhaume ātmārāmasy edaṃ pustakaṃ || 1 || śrir astu || śrīḥ || śrīḥ || śrīḥ || śrīḥ || śrīḥ || śrīḥ || śrīr astu || (fol.26v6-7)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || namāmi dhanvaṃtarim ādidevaṃ surāsurair vanditapādapadmae lokejarārugbhayamṛtyunāśaṃ dhātaram īśaṃ vividhauṣadhīnām || || 1 || anekadeśāntarabhāṣiteṣu sarveṣu [[ca]] prākṛt(!)pratisaṃskṛteṣu || gūḍheṣv agūḍheṣu ca nāsti saṃkhyāṃ dravyāvidhāneṣu tathauṣadhīṇāṃ(!) || 2 || prayojanaṃ yasya tu yāvatā syāt tāvat sa gṛhṇāti yathāmbukūpāt || tathā nighaṃṭāṃbunidharanaṃ tā gṛhṇāmy aha(!) kiṃcid ihaikadeśaṃ || 3 || (fol.1v1-6) End aśvaśvaraśvetapuṣpī śvetā ca gīri(!)karnīkā(!) kākārbhadī śvetanāmā śvetaspaṃdāparājitā nīlapuṣpī mahāśvetā girīkarṇigavādīnī(!) (vahvīcātpūgaṃdhā ca) nīlaspaṃdā prakirtītā girikanīkāyugalaṃ syāt tiktaṃ hi malanāśanaṃ aparājitādvayo nāma guṇā aparājitā prasiddha †tu yu gu va ca gu abharātisvāṃ† natukārī jatukṛt syāṃ jatukārī gaṇīmatā jananī caiva saṃharṣā kaṭu/// (fol60v5-10)

Beginning śrī gaṇeśa (davai kuvati kī viṃda kusadakī chīnakī mulari pho chala S|| phiphara phīchala S| nagavarī gocha S| nīlaphale S| sīṃgarā S| guppuru S| mocarasa S| savapha vahaphara duhudha masaphara pagavana vaisava urīddei ppyuraphacārī bharikarttā rāma) ||(X3a:1-5) End «Here are some tantric garaph illustrations »

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ śrīsaraśvatyai namaḥ śrīkāśī viśvanāthāya namaḥ śriannapurṇā[[yai]](!) namaḥ śrīgurubhyo namaḥ śrīśārṅgadhara(!) likhyate || ❁ || śrīyaṃ(!) sa dadyād bhavatāṃ purārir yadaṃgatejaḥ prasare bhavānī || virājate nirmalacaṃdrikāyāṃ mahauṣadhīva jvalitā himādrau || 1 || prasiddhayogā munibhiḥ prayuktāḥ cikitsakair ye bahuśonubhūtāḥ vidhīyate śārṅgadhareṇa teṣāṃ susaṃgrahaḥ sajjana raṃjanāyā || 2 || (fol.1v1-6) End āyurvedasamudrasya guḍharthasyāni(!) saṃyataḥ | jñātaḥ kaiścid budhais tas(!) tu kṛtā vividhasaṃhitā || kaṃcid arthaṃ tato nītvā kṛteyaṃ sa hi mayā || kṛpākaṭākṣavikṣepam asyāṃ vvraddhaṃti(!) jaṃtavaḥ | vividhagadārttidaridranāśaṃ yā hariramaṇīva karoti saūbhagaṃ yaḥ || vilasatu sa śārṅgadharasya saṃhitā sa kavihṛdayeṣu sarojanirmmaleṣū || ❁ || (fol.155r2-6) Colophon iti śrīśārṅgadharacikitsā samāpta(!)|| śrībhavānīśaṃkarābhyāṃ namaḥ || śubham astu || 6 || śrīkalyāṇam astu || mohanajibhahālajamiṭhālahena svārthaṃ paropakārārthaṃ śārṅadharākhyaṃ pustakaṃ yal likhitaṃ tat śrīmatkāśyāṃ kṣayasavatsare pauṣamāsi śuklapakṣe trītiyāyāṃ(!) samāptaṃ || || śubhaṃ bhavatu || śrīsadāśivārpaṇam astu (fol.155r6-11)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīgurave namaḥ || || siddhibuddhidāyaka sakalagavarīputra gaṇeśa || vighnavidāraṇa sukhakaraṇa harṣadharī praṇameśa || 1 || śrīdhanvaṃtari caraṇayuga praṇamo dhari ānaṃda || roganasaiti sunāmate savajanako suṣakaṃda || || 2 || vividhaśāstradeṣīkarī sugama karauṃ adhikāra || rāmavinodaha graṃtha rahu sakala jīva sukhakāra || 3 || (fol.1v1-5) End atha saṃvat dohā || gagana pāṇi phunidīpa sasi hi maruta magasiramāsa || suklapakṣa tairasadinai budhavāra dina jāsa 100 maradāno aru mahābalī avaraṃga sāha niraṃda || tāsu rāja maiharṣa sauṃracyo śāstra ānaṃda || 1 || suraguṇesā cosadā jagataguru jinacaṃda || pravala paḍū reparagaṇodīpaiṃ jyauṃ ravicaṃda || 2 || uttaradisaṣu rāsāna maivannū desa pradhāna sajala bhūmi hai sarvadā sakkī sahareṃ subhathāna || 3 || paradukha bhaṃjaṇakai liye kipāgraṃthasuṣakaṃda || ciralagaye rahi jo sadā jālaga merudi niṃdā 4 (fol.141r8-141v3) Colophon iti śrīpaṃḍitapadmaraṃgasiṣyarāmacaṃdreṇa viracitaṃ śrīrāmavinode ||... saṃvat 1875 sāla miti māgha vadi 2 budhavāsare liṣitaṃ śubham || (fol. 141v4-142r7)

Beginning (///saḥ || savadasuṇe je karṇa hī || nāhi natā suvinā 14 || jibhyāṃ komala sarīlatā || kasya dau staju///3 || rālakṣanajasa puruṣake || vyādhīṣarainaso/// avaramaina uragaṃdhātā ||) (fol. 1v1–3) End atha maṃtrajaṃtrako kahanāri parīkṣā jāna mūtra pariṃkṣā hemanalīṣyo || so kahī vicāra || pasarai jīvanavadhe doṣa || ove maranavatāi || sādhya asādhya vājīvake || damṣogratha vicāri || iti hemasāraviraṃca te || mūtra parīkṣā saṃpūrana samāpta || 1 || (fol. 33r6–33v6)

Beginning oṃ namo gaṇapataye || || sa jayati dainya sadā phalam akhilam idaṃ paśyato jagat yasyā hṛdayasyeva gaṇitvā(!) jātā rasarūpiṇīkaruṇā || natvā śrīpārvatīṃ devīṃ bhairavaṃ siddhasaṅgatim | rasaratnaṃ prakāśyāmi dehe lohe śubhaṃkaram || sūte sūtavaro varaṃ hi nayanaṃ śabdātparaṃ sparśanād dhrūmād dīpyati tatkṣaṇād atha saṃkhyā‥‥‥‥ (fol.1v1-2) ath rasasya gatibhedam āha || dhūmaḥ śuddhaś ca kaṃ paś ca maṇḍuka(!)plutir eva ca | ctuś caiva gatis tasya aṛśyā paṃcamī gatiḥ || praṇāmaḥ || rasendroparasas tubhyaṃ haravīryāya vai namaḥ | namas te hararūpāyā pāradāya namo ʼstu te | samastam etatkathitaṃ prayatnāt satvādikānāṃ sukhakāmadharmadam | rasāṅkuśā vā dhanatatparāṇāṃ || || (fol.30v5-7) «Sub-colophon:» iti śrīnāthaviracite rasaratne sādhakānāṃ rasasya siddhikaraṇaṃ nāma dvādaśopadeśaḥ || || || (fol.30v7-8) End abhrakaṃ harabījan tu. ṣoḍaśośena kāñcanam || dhmātaṃ prakāśabhūṣāyāṃ tantujīrṇaṃ sa vedhayet || dakṣiṇāvarttasaṃ…ntaṃ harabījena melakam || lākapāla(!)śataṃ tyaktvā dattvā bhairavadundubhiḥ || jayaśabdañ ca nirghoṣair arghyahastair abāhutaiḥ || rājimātrasūtena vrajet kailāsamandiram || krīḍataḥ saptalokeṣu śivartulyaparākramaḥ || || (fol.64r5-7) Colophon iti śrīmūlasūtre rasasvacchande caturviṃśatisāhasre dravaṇādhikāro nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ || || (fol.64r7-8)

Beginning śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || śrīsāradāyai namaḥ || yannāma smaraṇaṃ samastaduritadhvaṃsāvahaṃ puṇyadaṃ bhaktānām abhayaṃkaraṃ sukhakaraṃ sarvārthasiddhipradaṃ || taṃ natvārjjunam īśvaraṃ gurukṛpā ʼvāptaiḥ susiddhair varair yogai(!) vaidyarahasyam adya tanute vidyāpatiḥ kautukāt || 1 || asmadgraṃthād ādṛtāṃn(!)siddhayoga[[n]] nānyagraṃthe sthāpayiṣyaṃti kecit || || nātra sthāne ye vadiṣyaṃti teṣāṃ nāṣaṃ kuryād īśvarobhīṣṭasiddhai || 2 || (fol.1v1-4) End dīrghadīrghās tu bahavo graṃthāḥ saṃti tathāpi me || sāṃpradāyika(!)yogānāṃ saṃgrahārtham ayaṃ śramaḥ || 6 || catuḥ paṃcāśadbhir munividhuśatenādhisahiter(!) gatebde || 1754 || bhūpārkān nabhasi śitapakṣopaṇitithau || || iti śrīmadvaṃśīdharatanujavidyāpatikṛto bhavat pūrṇo graṃthaḥ sakalabhiṣagānandajanakaḥ || 2 || (fol.101r1-3) Colophon iti śrīmadupādhyāyavaṃśīdharātmajamiśravidyāpatinirmito vaidyarahasyābhidho yogasamuccayaḥ || śubhaṃ va(!) bhūyāt || śrī || saṃvat 1862 śrāvaṇasudi caṃdravāsare likhitaṃ paṃḍyā catrabhujeṇa || ||(fol. 101r3-5)

Beginning ///raiḥ | bhaktaṃ takrañ ca dātavyaṃ , pathyād vāriṇām(!) iha || deyaṃ sthūlamanuṣyasyāpi sāyaṃ paṃcāmṛto rasaḥ || asyārthaḥ || śuddhamṛtarasacūrṇṇa śuddhamṛta(konda)lohacūrṇṇa śuddhamṛtatāmracūrṇṇa tathā āmracūrṇṇa mṛtasuvarṇṇa mākṣīkacūrṇṇa, eteṣāṃ pratyekaṃ pla 1 śuddha gandhaka pla 5 rasagandhakābhyāṃ kajjalī karttavyā tataḥ sarvvam ekatra svārddrakasurasena bhāvayitvā dinatrayaṃ marddayet || || (fol.56r1-3) End (arśāgnibhutagāvarttir,gulavyoṣakalod bhavā | kṣotsnikānuna kalpeta lepo raktārśasāṃ hitaḥ || asyārthaḥ || gulamaṃsā 4 sotase salakala dhūpamaṃsā 4 kiñcij jalaṃ datvā saṃmardya copalipya varttiḥ kāryāḥ(!) (agnau)/// (fol. 120v5-6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ natvā viśveśvaraṃ sāmbaṃ vāgīśaṃa ca guruṃ tathā śiṣyāṇāṃ sukhabodhāya vakṣye nirghaṇṭudarpaṇam 1 tathā ca dhanaṃtariḥ(!) prayojanaṃ yasya tu yāvatā syāt tāvat sa gṛhṇāti yathāṃbukuryāt(!) tathā nighaṇṭāmbunidher anaṃtā gṛhṇāmy ahaṃ kiṃcid ihaikadeśe kirātagopādhipatāya sādhyāḥ vanecarās tat kuśalās tathānye vidaṃti nānāvidhabheṣajānī(!) pramāṇavarṇākṛtināmajāti(!) tebhaḥ sakāśād upalabhya vaidyaḥ paścāt svaśāstreṇa vimṛśyabuddhyā (fol.1v1-5) End anyā tu dakṣiṇāvarttā vṛścikālī viṣāṇikā meṣaśṛgīrase tiktā vātalāśvā sakāmahā rukṣāḥ pāke kaṭu pittavarṇaśleṣmākṣiśūlanut meṣaśṛgīphalaṃ tiktaṃ kaṭur mehakaphapraṇut dīpanaṃ strasanaṃ kāsa kṛmivraṇaviṣāpaham atha haṃsapadīhaṃsapādī(!) haṃsapadīraṃtupādatripādikā pra/// (fol.69v6-9)

Beginning ///ṣadhaṃ || māsadvayāt tathā cūrṇaṃ hīnaviryyatvam(!) āpnuyāt || hīnatvaṃ guṭikālehau labhete vatsarāt paraṃ | hīnāḥ syur ghṛtatailādhyāś caturmāsādhikās tathā || auṣadhyo aghupākāṃsyur nirvīryyā vatsarāt paraṃ || purāṇāḥ syur guṇair yuktā āsavā dhātavo rasāḥ || vyādhe(!) yuktaṃ yad dravyaṃ gaṇoktam api tat tyajet || anuktam api yuktaṃ tad yojayet tatra tad budhaiḥ || || iti yuktāyuktavicāraḥ || ||(fol.4r1- 4) End viṣaharīvarttiḥ || āyurvedasamudrasya gūḍhārthamaṇisaṃcayaḥ || jñātaḥ kaiścin na vibudhiḥ kṛtā vividhasaṃhitā || 112 || kaṃcid arthaṃ tato nītvā kṛteyaṃ saṃhitā mayā || kṛpākaṭākṣavikṣepam asyāṃ kurvaṃtu sādhavaḥ || 113 || vividhagadārttidaridranāśanīyā hariramaṇīva karoti yogaratnaiḥ || vilasatu śārṅgadharasya saṃhitā sā kavihṛdayeṣu sarojanirmaleṣu || 114 ||(fol.93r3-6) Colophon iti dāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyām saṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne netraprasādhanakarmavidhir nāma dātriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 332 || śubham astu || || || ||(fol.93r6-7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || jayat(!) paramavaṃditā tripurasuṃdarī devatā vibhogavibhavānvitā paramatatvaciṃtā(!) citā || upādhirahitā hitā sakalaśāstranirddhāritā prapaṃcaparavaṃditā tribhuvanaikarmatā matā || 1 || rasaciṃtāmaṇir nāma rasaratnakaraṃjakaḥ || bhaviṣyaty eṣa me graṃthaḥ śrīmatāṃ hastapustakaḥ || 2 || phalaṃ svādugata(!) svāmidāridraḥ kṣutprapīḍitaḥ || yathā prāpyamanaḥ kuryāj jano graṃtham amuṃ śamī || 3 || (fol.1v1-5) End kaṃguṇī sarṣapair aṃḍatailaṃ vātha kusuṃbhakaṃ meṣākṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ vāpya gokṣīraṃ cāranālakaṃ | eteṣv ekaṃ tu bhāṃḍāṃtaḥ kiṃ dūnaṃ prapūrayet | badhvā vastreṇa tadvaktraṃ gaṃdhacūrṇaṃ tatopari(!)| lohapātre nirudhyātha (pṛṣṭeṣṭa ppaṃca) kharpparaṃ | sāgnim upalakaiḥ pūrṇaṃ evyaṃ drāvyaṃ samuddharet | taṃ dhartūradravai(!) piṣṭvā spuṣkaṃ drāvyaṃ ca pūrvavat | punar eva prakarttavyaṃ saśuddho gaṃdhako bhavet || || (fol.113r3-7) Colophon iti rasaciṃtāmaṇau gaṃdhakaśuddhiḥ | samāptoyaṃ graṃthaḥ || (fol.113r7)

Beginning oṃ svasti || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || māsuvikāre guḍa bhakṣaṃ || 1 || ṣiravikāre dadhi bhakṣaṃ || dadhivikā(2)re sidho bhakṣaṃ || dudhavikāre ṣāḍa bhakṣaṃ || vaṭuka vikāre sidho bhakṣaṃ || māchāvikāre hiṃga sau(3)valo bhakṣaṃ || lāḍuvikāre guḍa bhakṣaṃ || pigavikāre luna bhakṣaṃ vāsiṣāyā vikāre haradāi(4) sitalapāni bhakṣaṃ || amila vikāre gahu bhakṣaṃ || roṭivikāre āvabhakṣaṃ || āva vikāre ma(5)ha bhakṣaṃ (fol.1v1–5) End svātiḥ vāyuḥ vyavaṣṭiḥ pavanaḥ balaḥ sāsanaḥ prabhaṃjanaḥ(2) samanaḥ || 8 || viśāṣā iṃdrāgniḥ dudevato || 3 || anurādhāḥ maitraḥ maitraṃ || 3 || jyeṣṭhā iṃdraḥ śakraḥ(3) puraṃdaraḥ vāstoṣpatiḥ || 5 || mūlaḥ niritiḥ jātakaḥ rākṣasaḥ || 4 || pūrvāṣāḍhaḥ āvaḥ anilaḥ(4) nila jalaṃ toyaṃ || 5 || sisyādhi vaiśvadevaḥ || 3 || abhiciḥ takrabhāḥ || 2 || (5)śravaṇaḥ śrutaṃ hariḥ vaiṣṇavaḥ || 4 || dhaniṣṭāḥ śraviṣṭāḥ vāsasiḥ brahmavāḥ || 4 || śatabhiṣāḥ vāru(1)ṇaḥ yasyati jalaṃ || 4 || pūrvābhādrapadaḥ ajaikapāt || 2 || uttarābhādrapadaḥ ahiḥrbudhnaḥ || 3 || revati(2) pūṣā pausnā || 3 || iti aṣṭaviṃśatiḥ nakṣatrasaṃjñā || || || (fol.62r1–62v2) Colophon saṃvat 819 māghakṛṣṇa amāvā(3)syāṃ tithau saṃpūṇaṃ(!) || ○ || ❁ || śubham || śrīmāya namaḥ || || || ……. || (fol.62v2–3)
