Beginning śrī gaṇēśāya namaḥ || || yaccakṣur bhuvanasya divyamamalaṃ dhāmaśṛtīnāṃ paraṃ yad brahmaika niketanaṃ ca payasāṃ bījaṃ yadekaṃ satāṃ || satreṣvagni hutasya veda viditaṃ sthānaṃ ca yat sarvadā tadvaḥ pātu sanātanaṃ harimahastatva prabodhodayaṃ || 1 || daivajñāgama dharmaśāstra nigamāyurveda dugdhodadhī nāmaṃdhyasphuradātma buddhi giriṇā viśvopakārojjvalaṃ ālokāmṛtamātanoti vibudhair āsevamatyadbhutaṃ śrīmaṃtomaradevavarma tanayaḥ śrī vīrasiṃhā nṛpaḥ || 2 || iha khalu puruṣārtha catuṣṭayāya dhīmatāṃ pravṛttiḥ || tatrādyo dharma sa śarīramantareṇa na bhavati | tacca roga pratīkārāya rogāḥ parigaṇyate || (fol. 1v1–6) End na śreṣṭhastaraṇī prabhāva janito vaṃśa samālakṣate rāmādyāḥ pṛthivīśvarāḥ samabhavan yatra pratīyonnatāḥ || no vā yatra yudhiṣṭhira prabhṛtayo bhūyābabhūvus tataḥ sṛṣṭastomaravaṃśa eva vidhinā satkarma saṃsevinā || 3 || [a]bhavat kalaśasiṃha iti prasiddhaḥ sarvāgamācaraṇa sevita devasiddhaḥ || tasmād bhujaggati bhūpati devavarmā vidyāvinodam ati sad vrata puṇyakarmā || 4 || śrī deva varmātmaja eva dhīraḥ svaśastra saṃtāpita śatruvīraḥ || śrīrasiṃhaḥ kṣitipāla siṃhaḥ śāstra trayādgraṃthamimaṃ vyadhatta || 5 || samāptaṃ || (fol. 126v9–127r4) Colophon || saṃvat || 1881 mārgaśīrṣa kṛṣṇa 5 saumyavāsare || || śrī viśveśvarārpaṇāmastu || || śrī sītārāmacaṃdrāya namaḥ || || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 127r4–5)

Beginning śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ natvā viśveśvaraṃ sāmbaṃ vāgīśaṃ ca guruā śiṣyāṇām sukhabodhāya vakṣye nighaṇṭa darpaṇam 1 tathā ca dhanvantariḥ prayojanaṃ yasya tu yāvattāsyāttāvat sa gṛhṇati yathāmbupānāt tathā nighaṇṭāmbunidheranaṃtād gahvāmyahaṃ kiṃcidihaika deśam 2 kirātagopādhipatāya sādyāḥ vanecarāstatkuśalāstathānye vidaṃti nānāvidha bheṣajāni pramāṇa varṇākṛti nāma jātiḥ 3 (fol. 1v1–4) Ending tvagdoṣā graṃthayaḥ śothārogyaḥ śoṇita saṃbhavāḥ raktamokṣaṇa śīlānāṃ na bhavaṃti kadācana 6 iti dinacaryā rātricaryā sampūrṇam nighaṇṭudarpaṇo nāma nātisaṃkṣiptavistaraṃ śiṣyāṇām sukhabodhāya viśvanāthasya saṃgrahaḥ ( fol. 282v7–9) Colophon iti śrī viśvanāthakṛta nighaṇṭudarpaṇe dravyasya nāma rasa guṇa vipāka śakti prabhavādipūrvaka ṛtucaryā dinacaryā rātricaryādi samāptam samāptaścāyaṃ nighaṇṭu darpaṇam śubhambhūyāt vedāṃvarāṣṭendvabde likhat (fol. 282v9–11)

sūtrasthāna Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || dīptyā yasyeṃdranīlotpalaśakalarajonīlayā nīlitābhāṃ lakṣṃīm uttaptabhāsvatkanakarucim api sparśaromāṃcitāṃgiṃ || kālīty āśaṃkya mānaḥ sphuradadharapuṭaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ kilābhud bhartrā lokasya śaśvat sa bhāvatu bhavatāṃ bhūtaye padmanābhaḥ || 1 || ko matś(!)ariṇi loke [']smin vidvān kiṃcic cikīrṣati || kiṃtu kaścid bhavet sādhus tato [']yaṃ matpariśramaḥ || 2 || śrīman mṛgāṃkatanayaṣ ṭīkām aṣṭāṃgahṛdayasya | śrīmān aruṇaḥ kurute samyagdraṣṭuḥ padārthabodhāya || 3 || iha hi śāstrakarāḥ śāstrasamāptaye sarva eva sabhābhuṣaṇābhūtāḥ nikhilajanitapramodasaṃdohāḥ ruciracitavacananicayacacarcitaprabaṃdhāḥ prabaṃdhaviracanapravarāḥ iṣṭadevatānamaskāraṃ taṃrtakārā vidadhuḥ | tad ayamam(!) api taṃtrakāraḥ iṣṭadevatānamaskārapuras(!)saraṃ grantham āriripsur idam āha || rāgādirogān iti || rāgaḥ ādir yeṣāṃ te rāgādayaḥ ādiśbdena dveṣalobhādiparigrahaḥ rujatīti rogāḥ dehamanasī saṃtāpayatīty arthaḥ | nanu manaḥsthitatvān mana eva te rujaṃtīti ve(!)ktuṃ yuktaṃ maivaṃ | dehamanolakṣaṇayor vast(u)nor ādhārādheyabhāvena sthitatva(!)d dvayor api saṃtāpo yuktaḥ | yathā ādheyena āyogolakena saṃtaptena tadādhārasya kaṭāhādeḥ saṃtāpaḥ | ādhāreṇa ca kaṭāhādinā saṃtaptena ādheyasya ghṛtādes(!) saṃtāpaḥ || (1v1 - 2v1 *exp. 178a1 - 178b1) End tucchetyādi | tucchadagdhasyāgnipratapanaṃkāryaṃtathā coṣaṇ bheṣan ayṣadhaṃ | raktasya vila(y)anārtham āha | tat yatas tucchadagdham avaśyaṃ styānam asṛg bhavatīti yuktyā pratipādayann āha | styāna ityādi | lohite styāne saty atiśaye tabh(!)as m(!)avati vilīne rakte pīḍāyā maṃdatā mārdavaṃ bhavaty atas tucchadahdge agnipratapanaṃ kāryam | durdagdhe śītam uṣṇaṃ ca paryāya(!)ṇauṣadhaṃ tatrādi prathamaṃ himaṃbheṣahaṃ ju(ṃ)jyāt | samya(!)dagdhe tavakṣīrādibhir la(!)payet | kiṃbhūtaiḥ sājyāmṛtaiḥ ghṛtaguḍucīyuktaiḥ āfv ity atrāp yojyaṃ | ādav etair lepayet || urddhvam anaṃtaraṃ pittavidradhivat kriyā kāryeti śeṣā | atidagdhe drutaṃ śīghram eva sarb(!)aṃ bahir antaś ca bheṣajaṃ pittavisaepa iva kuryāt | snehadagdhe sati tathā rūkṣaṃ yojayet | bhṛśataragrahaṇāc ca bāhulyena rūkṣaṃ dehadeśāt snigdham api yathāvasthaṃ yathāyogaṃ yojayet | samy(!)āpyata iti | vaktravyaṃ yadvastu tasya sarvasyaevoktatvād idaṃsthānaṃ samāpyate niṣpādyate | kiṃbhūtaṃ rahasyavat rahasyam arthaṃ guhyarūpaṃ madyasyāstīti tadrahasyavat | kasya sthānaṃ hṛdayasya hṛdayaśabdenāṣṭāṅgahṛdayam upalkṣyate | yathā saty abhāmā bhāmeti kuta etat sthānaṃrahasyavad ity āha || atra sūtritā sūcitāḥ kiṃbhūtāḥ sūkṣmāḥ | tīkṣṇātaram atisamadhimyāḥ | yataḥ tavat sahasranavaśatādhikaṃ cam(?) iti sūtritaṃ || 9900 sarvasmin taṃtre pratanyaṃte vistāryaṃte || tasmād idaṃ sthānaṃ taṃtrasaṃbaṃdhinām anyasthānānāṃ rahasyavad iy uktam iti || || (283v8 [exp. 472a] - 284r9 [exp. 472b]) Colophon iti śrīmṛgāṃkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇādattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṃgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvaṃgasuṃdaryākhyāyāṃ kṣārāgnikarmavidhis triṃśo [']dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || śubham astu || || śrīgoviṃdo jaya || || śrīnārāyaṇa || || (284r9-11 [exp. 472b]) śārīrasthāna Beginning śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīlakṣmīnṛsiṃhāya namaḥ || || atha sūtrasthānād anaṃtaraṃ śārīrasthānam idam ārabhyate || tatrāyaṃ saṃbaṃdhaḥ || pūrvasmin sthāne kāyādīny aṣṭāvaṃgāni cikitsādhārabhūtāni sakalataṃtrasārabhūtāni sūtritāni kāyabāletyādinā graṃthena kāyaś ca nijāgaṃtūnāṃ vyādhīnām adhiṣṭānaṃ || tasya ca kāyasya caturvargasādhanasya pālanārthaṃ hetuliṃgauṣadhaskaṃdhabhedena triskā(!)ṃdho yaṃ graṃtho graṃthakṛtā praṇitah | tataś ca śarīrasya ⟪cakā⟫ prathamaṃ sūtritvāt prādhānyāc ca prāk sūtrasthānād anaṃtaraṃ śārīrasthānam idam ārabhyata ity āha || (1v1 - 1v5 [exp. 474a]) End maṃgaletyādi || praśastācaraṇaṃ nityaṃ apraśastavivarjanaṃ | etad dhi maṃgalaṃ proktaṃm(!) ṛṣibhis tatvad arśibhiḥ || ācaraṇam ācāraḥ sadvṛttānuṣṭānaṃ maṃgalācārābhyāṃ saṃpanno yuktaḥ kaḥ parivāraḥ tathā śraddhāno [']vaśyam eva vyadhir ayam naśyatīyu evam āturaḥ śraddhānaḥ tathā ca paricāraḥ anukūlo dakṣiṇaḥ tathā prabhūtasya dravyasya saṃgrahaḥ saṃgrahaṇaṃ | tathā satv(!)alakṣaṇayoḥ saṃyogaḥ vaidyādiṣu bhaktiḥ | cikitsāyāṃ upakrame anirvedaḥ sotsāhatā | tadetad ārogyalakṣaṇa | kasmādādi idaṃsthānaṃ śārīram ucyata ity asya niruktim āha || || ity atriti || iti parisamāptau || atrāsmin sthāne yato yasmāc charīrasya hanmasamyagadhiparītaṃ garbhāvakrāṃtyādibhi(ś) catirbhir adhyāyaiḥ prasaktānuprasaktikayā udāhṛtaṇ | maraṇaṃ vikṛti vijñanīyākhyena tathāha (114v3 - 114v10 [exp. 589a]) nidānasthāna Beginning oṃ namo gaṇeśāya namaḥ | atha śārīrasthānad anaṃtaraṃ nidānasthānāraṃbhaḥ | asya cāyaṃ saṃbandhaḥ | hetuliṃgoṣadhaskaṃdhalakṣaṇo [']yam āyurvedaḥ parṇītaḥ || tāni ca hetuliṅgauṣadhāni sūtrasthāne sūcitāni | śarīralakṣaṇaṃ cādharaṃ samutpādhatāni vistareṇopadeṣṭuṃ śakyaṃte || tasmāc chārīrasthānaṃ pūrvam ārabdhavān || tatraevaṃ saty auṣadhaskaṃdha eva prāk prādhanyād upadeṣṭuṃ nyāyyaḥ | naivaṃ | hetuliṃgābhyāṃ hy āmayaṃ parīkṣyānaṃtaraṃ yathāyogam āmayapraśāmārtham auṣadhaṃ dātum ucitaṃ | tasmād dhetuliṃgayor ai(!)vopadānaṃ prāg yuktaṃ na tv auṣdhasyeti || cikitsitasthānāt prāg idam eva sthānam upadeṣṭym yuktaṃ || tathā coktam muninā || rogam ādau parīkṣyeta tato [']naṃtaram auṣadham<ref> CarakaS 1.20.20ab </ref> iti || tasmād auṣadhād dhetuliṃgayor evāmayaṃ prati prādhānyaṃ | ato nidānasthānāraṃbhaḥ || (1v1 - Beginning śrīgaṇeśāye (!) namaḥ || śrīyaṃ(!) sa ṭhadyād bhavatāṃ purārir yadaṅgatejaḥ prasare bhavānī || virājate nirmalacaṃdrikāyāṃ mahauṣadhīvajjvalitā himādrau || 1 || prasiddhayogā munibhiḥ prayuktāś cikitsakair ye bahuśonubhūtāḥ vidhīya śārṅgadhareṇa teṣāṃ susaṃgrahaḥ sajjanarajanāya || 2 || (!) hetvādirūpād yuti sātmyajāti bhedaiḥ saminnyātura sarvvarogān || cikitsitaṃ kurṣaṇa bṛṃhaṇākhyaṃ kurvvīta vaidyo vidhivat sa jogaiḥ || 3 (fol. 1v1–4) End kṛṣṇāṃjanaṃtayostulyaṃ sarvam ekatra cūrṇayet dasamāsena kapura tasmiṃ cūrṇe pratāpayet etat pratyajanaṃ netra gachanājanāmṛgabhāvanayāmṛtaṃ (!) patraṃ janam || (!) (fol. 138r6–7) Colophon iti śrīśārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne /// rasaṃ cūrṇaṃ saṃpūrṇa (śubham astu) || vikrama karasaradharāvāṇayuktaṃ pauṣa śuklāṣṭamī budhe leṣanīyam kṛpālanāmaṃ chatri upādhyākaisya pūtraṃ prathamam samaye gatavaraṣa vedi vasu || || ||(fol.138r7-10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ svasti śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || sphurat ripurasundarī araṇayugmam ārādhayan praṇamya varujāripuṃ prathamavaidyammbodhvijam(!) || vilokya vividhāgamān karaṇavīra kubhātmaja (!) kim siśvitam iti nijāṃ prathayatīha cūḍābhidhaṃ || 1 || kāraṇaṃ maṇḍalavitataṃ lakṣmīr atha bhaiṣajye dyotaṃ || jvaratimirabhāṣkarāhvaṃ graṃthaṃ tanute sarogiṇas trātum || 2 || (!) (fol.1v1–4) End vāsānimbapaṭolapuskarajaṭā bhūnimbasārdhaṃ samaṃ kvāthaṃ tandrikanāśanaṃ jvaraharaṃ dhyānādibhiryyājitaṃ || kṣudrā pathyāmṛtā viśva puskaraṃ taṃdrikāpahaṃ || vyoṣā rāsnāraser nasyaṃ vāśvalāleʼṃdra saindhavaṃ || viṣatruṭi kirātaṃ ca karppūraṃ karahāṭakaṃ || cūrṇṇāsurārasai līḍhaṃ muhus tandrika nāśanam || iti tandrikaḥ || ||– (fol.75r5–75v4) Colophon iti kāyastha caṃdakṛte jvaratimirabhāṣkare oṣadhādiprarikramo nāma tṛtīyodhyāyaḥ || || (fol. 24r1–2)

Beginning /// na va phakyā lejyaṃ tha julaḥ samarthaṇ ju va yāṃ thajulaḥ parastrīrāyalapyaṃ tha julaḥ dravya thurāvadānayā ethaṃ julaḥ ciku tinaphala rāya dava || 94 || vānevaivacare dharmmaḥ anitya ṣala jīvina phalānima pipakkānāṃ śāsvataṃ pratanaṃ bhave || (X.a:1–3)? End rkhala sarṣapramātrāniḥ(!) palācchidra nipaśyatiḥ || ārtmāni vilbumādyāniḥ yasante pi na dṛṣyate || || durjjuyānaḥ mevathācchidra yayukā vahaṃkhaṃḍaḥ thavarjula sāvyāla vāsavajulasāṃ makha… (X. 87b5–7)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ || || namo raye vidhihlāya || vāṅa gaṃdhaka emasakhāra sedhu, madatasā, sābhara, samabhāga. lāṣana naya nayati sayāya, misacchoya gomatisa thone hanoṃ hanothathe tuhna [[sa]]yorayāya onanali neya bhassma juyiva || || namo raye || (fol. 1r1–2) End prātaruddhṛtya guṭikāṃ kṣīrabhāṇde vinikṣipet | tata kṣīraṇḍaṣyati kṣipram etan pratyayakārakaṃ ratikāre mukhe dhāryyā guṭikā vīryyarodhinī | kṣīraṃ pītvā ramed rāmā, sundarī ca kalānvitāṃ (!) mukhasthāṃ ddhārayed dhasti tadā vīryyaṃ pramuñcati || || rasaratnākarāt || || (fol. 10r2–4)

Beginning ❖ śrīgurabhyo (!) namaḥ śrīdevyauvāca (!) yat tvayā gaditaṃ śaṃbho ādisūtre maheśvara | yogayantravidhānaṃ ca tatphalaṃ kathayasva me || /// hā deva manujā duḥkhitāḥ sadā | kalau yūge mahāghore alpaṃ jīvati (!) mānavāḥ || vyādhi śoka jarā mṛtyu śītoṣṇā paripīḍītā /// hīna narāḥ śambho gandhapuṣpārccanādikaṃ || (exp. 1a:1-3) End lokapālaśataṃ tyaktvā datvā bhairava duṃdubhiḥ || jayaśabdañ ca nirghoṣair arghyahastairavāhutaiḥ || rāji/// mātrasūtena vrajet kailāśamandiraṃ | krīḍataḥ saptalokeṣu śivatulya parākramaṃ ||(!) (fol. 11a:6–7) «Sub: colophon:» iti śrīmūlasūtre rasasvacchande caturviṃśatisāhasre dvitīya/// ḥ || (exp.2a:3–4) iti śrīmūlasūtre rasamaṇḍāne caturviṃśatisāhasre /// ddhāras tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || || (exp.5b:10–11) iti [[mūla]]sūtre rasasvacchande caturviṃśatisāhasre rañjanādhikāro/// nāma ca[[tu]]rthḥ paṭalaḥ (exp.6b:8–9) iti śrīmūlasūtre/// svacchande caturviṃśatisāhasre nirṇṇayoddhāraḥ pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ || || (exp.8b:8–9) iti śrīmūlasūtre rasasvacchande catu(rviṃ)śatisāhasre dravaṇādhikāro nāma saṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ (exp.10a:7–8)

Beginning – rāgāstathāpare || jāyante nātura svāsthā (!) svasthavṛttaparo bhavet || prāvṛtśu (!) vinabhau jñeyau †śara hṛrjasaṃhau yuḥ† (!) || na paśyaś ca madhuś caiva vasaṃtaṃ sodhanaṃ prati || mādhava prathame māse nabhasya prathe punaḥ || sahasya prathame cāpi vāha ye doṣasaṃcayaṃ || snigdhāḥ svinyasarīrāṇya mūrdhvaṃś ca nityaśaḥ || vāstikarma tata kuryān nas taḥ || karmma ca buddhimām ||(!) (fol.14r1–3) «Ending:» || iti tatra ślokaḥ || cikitsāprābhṛtaguṇo doṣoyaś cetanāśrayaḥ || yogāyogātiyogānā (!) lakṣaṇaṃ śuddhisaṃśrayam || bahudoṣasya liṃgāni samśodhanaguṇāś ca ye || cikitsāsūtramātraṃ ca siddhir vyāyanti (!) saṃśrayam || yā ca yuktiś cikitsāyāṃ paṃcārthaṃ kurute bhiṣak || cikitsā prābhṛte dhyāye tat sarvam avadan muniḥ || || (fol.35v5–8) Colophon iti kalpanācatuṣke cikitsāprabhṛtīyodhyāyaḥ || || samāptaṃ kalpanācatuṣkaṃ caturtham (!) || || (fol.35v7–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha madhyamakhaṃḍaḥ || tatrādau jvarādhikāram āha yataḥ samasta rogāṇāṃ jvaro rājeti viśrutaḥ ato jvarādhikārotra prathamaṃ likhyate mayā || tatra jvarasya prathamam utpattim āha || [[su]]śrutaḥ dakṣāyamāna saṃkruddha rudra niśvāsasaṃbhavaḥ kṣaro ʼṣṭadhā pṛthak dvaṃdva saṃghāt⟪u⟫āgaṃtujaḥ smṛtaḥ | asyāyam arthaḥ dakṣakartṛko yo ʼpanas tena saṃkruddho yo rudras tasya yoniḥ śvāsas tasmāt saṃbhava utpattir yasya sa jvaraḥ | krurddha rudraniḥśvāsa saṃbhūtatvena jvaraḥ svabhāvāt paittika iti bodhyate || (fol. 1v1–5) End ahany ahani kartavyā yābhiradbhir ataṃ⟨taṃ⟩dritaiḥ | tapasāṃ tejasāṃ caiva yaśasāṃ vamuṣāṃ (!) tathā || nidhānaṃ yo ʼvyayo devaḥ sa te skandhaḥ prasīdatu | grahasenāpati (!) devo devasenāpatir vibhuḥ devasenāripuharaḥ pātu tvāṃ bhagavān guhaḥ | devadevasya mahataḥ pāvakasya vayaḥ sutaḥ gaṃgom ākṛtināṃ ca sa te śarma prayachatu (!) rakta– (fol. 486v5–7) «Sub: colophon:» iti śrīmisralaṭakanatanaya śrīmanbhāvamisraviracite bhāvaprakāśe strīrogādhikāraḥ (fol. 483r 6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ asmākaṃ gaṇanāthosau pratyūhadhvāṃtabhāskaraḥ karotu tūrṇacikitsākhaṃḍam adbhutaṃ (!) yat karas sparśanād eva vikasaṃty ajagāḥ śriyaḥ tvat prasādena vaiyānāṃ (!) vikasantu yaśaḥ śriyaḥ athāto jvaram upakramiṣyāmaḥ tatrādau nidānaṃ janmātara (!) kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vyādhirūpeṇa bādhate tac chāṃtir oṣadhair dānir japahomasurārcanaiḥ (fol. 1v1–3) End atha sādhyalakṣaṇam nṛṇāṃ duṣṭapratiśyāya sarvajaś ca na siddhyati || sarva eva pratiśyāyo narasyā pratikāraṇaḥ (!) || duṣṭatāṃ yāti kālena tadāsādhyā bhavaṃti ca || atha nivṛtti śiraso lāghavaṃ sasyaka (!) svarūpānāṃ (!) ca darśanaṃ || samyak svāsapravṛttisyān nāsāroge same satiḥ (!) || (fol. 299r2–4) Colophon iti dāmodara kṛtaṃ bhīmavinode cikitsākhaṃḍe catuḥpaṃcaśaḥdhikāraḥ (!) || 54 || samāptoyaṃ cikitṣākāṃḍaḥ śubhamḥ (!) || || svasti śrīsaṃvat 1949 sāla miti māgha śukla 3 etadine (!) likhitṃ śrīlalitāpuranagasya (!) mahābauddhopāśaka (!) śrīmaheśvarānandena samarpita (!) śubham || graṃthasaṃkhyā 9500 maheśvarānanden likhita (!) graṃthasaṃkhyā 1831 (fol. 299r4–7)

Beginning śrīkālātmane namaḥ || śrīkaṃṭhaṃ girijāgaṇeśasahitaṃ natvā śaraṇyaṃ satāṃ nānā dravyaguṇāguṇān kathayato granthān vicāryā sakṛt | pathyāpathyavide guṇāguṇayutaṃ yad vastu toyādikaṃ tat saṃkṣepatayā vravīti ha śataślokyā trimallaḥ kaviḥ || 1 ||(fol.1v1–3) «Sub: colophon:» iti dugdhdadhighṛtanavanītavargaḥ (fol. 5r2) «Ending:» kāravī pālaṃkyā nīlī kāsamardakalāyāḥ || śītāḥ sārā apittāḥ dadrugnaḥ (!) pittalaḥ saraścolaḥ || 44 || kuṣmāṇḍaṃ bhedyapittāsṛg aguru śiśiraṃ sūraṇo ddīpatodhmo vātārśaḥ śleṣmahantā laghurathasamaru ddiṃḍīśo śmaprabhedī (!) vārttākaṃ nātipittaṃ kaphapavanaharaṃ ddīpanaṃ recanodhyaṃḥ (!) vṛṣyaṃ kāsajvaraghnaṃ–(fol.7v7–9)

Beginning samūlaphalapatrābhāmindrāśana śataṃ palaṃ | sacchudyo dūṣalecchitvā jaladroṇa dvaye pacet || kvathite pādāvasiṣṭaṃ(!), vastrapūtaṃ ca gālayet | kṣīraprastaṃ(!) samādāya, khaṇḍasyārddhaṃ śataṃ nyaset || śatāvarīrasasyāṣṭau, pippalyāḥ kulavantathā | sarvvametat samāloḍya, ghṛtaprasthena pācayet | auṣadhānām tato mānaṃ, dāpayet palikaṃ bhiṣak | trikaṭu triphalā cavyaṃ melātvavyatra kelaraṃ(!) || (fol. 1r1–4) End trikaṭu, kūṭa, sipi, ajamoda, ṣorāsāni, ajavāina jira, hakajiraṃ, vilisipu, citakahā, mithisā, jiravāra, javākhāra, sāmaraci, varaci, sedhu, pāgāci, sohāgā, hi, to 2 rā 2 x hāmara cekanaku 1 rasuna karṣa || (fol. 13r5–7)

Beginning śrīvighnacchide namaḥ athāto dīrghaṃ jīvitīyaṃ adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ dīrghaṃ jīvitaṃ avicchannaradrāja upāgamat iIṃdramugratapābuddhāśaraṇyaṃ amareśvaraṃ brahmaṇā dīyatā proktaṃ āyurvedaṃ prajāpatiḥ jagrāha nikhile nādā vaśvinau u punas tathātaḥ (!) aśvibhyām bhagavān śakraḥ pratipede hi kevalam (fol. 1v1–4) «Ending:» samakaśca ekaś caiva paripraśnaḥ sanirṇyayaḥ (!) yathā vācyaṃ yathārthaṃ ca vadhātraikadeśikāḥ 2 arthe daśamahāmūle tat sarvve saṃprakāśitaṃ saṃgrahaś cāyaṃ madhyāyas taṃtrasyāsyaiva kevalaḥ 3 yathā sumanasāṃ sūtraṃ saṃgrahārthaṃ vidhīyate saṃgrahārthe tathārthānām ṛṣīṇāṃ saṃ⟪gra⟫grahaḥ kṛtaḥ 4 ity arthe daśamahāmūlīyo nāmādhyāyas triṃśaḥ agniveśakṛte taṃtre caraka pratisaṃskṛte sūtrasthānam idaṃ citraṃ yathāvac ca samāpyate 1 adhyāya (fol. 132v5–9) Colophon iti carakasaṃhitāyāṃ sārdha trisahasraṃ sūtrasthānaṃ samāptaṃ saṃvat 1891 śubham (fol. 132v9–133r1)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo lokanāthāya || guṇatrayavibhāgāya mu /// /// trāya trikokīpataye namaḥ nānāyurveda vikhyāta/// /// saṃgraho gūḍhavācyabodhaka vākyavān || rogam ādau parīkṣkṣeta /// /// karma bhiṣaṃk(!) paścāt jñānapūrvvaṃ samādiśet || (fol. 1v1–4) End /// tailātmapippalīcūrṇṇat śirddha (!) śīte ca mākṣikāt | bhihyad vacā bhaya nitya mataḥ khāde prasāyanāt || (!) tadvaltī paritaṃ hanyā varṇṇāyu balabarddhanaṃ | pañcakāśāṃn ntayaṃ śvāsaṃ hikkā saviṣamajvarān || hanyāta (!) (fol. 104v5–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || natvā viśveśvaraṃ śyāmāṃ guruṃ vāgīśvarīṃ harim || śiṣyāṇāṃ sukhabodhāya kriyate sātmyadarpaṇaṃ || 1 || svarasa puṭa kalkaś ca kvāthaś ca himaphāṃṭakau || jñeyākaṣāyāḥ pañcaite laghaḥvaḥ syur yathottaram || 2 || || tad yathā || āhṛtā tat kṣaṇāt dravyāt kṛṣṭāt kṣusmāt samuddharet || vastraniṣpīḍito yaś ca svaraso rasa ucyate || 3 || kuḍavaṃ cūrṇitaṃ dravyaṃ kṣiptaṃ dviguṇe jale || ahorātraṃ sthitaṃ tasmād bhaved vā rasa uttamaḥ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–3) End tatas tasmiś caturjātaṃ jātikośaṃ lavaṃgakaṃ || karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ vāpi yathālābhaṃ niyojayet || taṃ yathāgnibalaṃ martyaḥ pivet sarvakṣayāpahaṃ || māṃsena saha cānnena snigdhena madhurena(!) ca || naro navativarṣīyopy anena daśakāminī || pratyehaṃ (!) ramayaty eva yuveva na ca hīyate || paṃcasāyaka || || (fol. 186r1–3) Colophon iti śrīviśvanāthakṛte sātmyadarpaṇe āsāvādyariṣṭadhyāyo dvādaśa (!) || || sarasa kvātha kalkas tu cūrṇaṃ ca guṭikā rasā || avalehādi pākaś ca pethyā paṃthyo hi kīrttanam || (!) ghṛtatailaṃ prehādyāsa vāsa iti prakīrtitā || iti saṃkṣepataḥ prokta sātmyadarpaṇasaṃgrahaḥ || śiṣyāṇāṃ sukhabodhāya viśvanāthena dhīmatā || iti sātmyadarpaṇa samāptam || || śubham || ❁ || ||(fol. 186r3–5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo siddhanāgārjuṇāya (!) namaḥ || || yaḥ śānta paramānvayaḥ paraśivaḥ kaṃkālakolātakoḥ dhyānātītam anādinityanicaya saṃkalpasaṃkocakaḥ || ābhāsāntarabhāsakaḥ samarasaḥ sarvātmajābodhakaṃḥ (!) soyaṃ sarvamayo dadotu (!) jagatāṃ vidi (!) siddhyaṣṭakaṃ || || yā nityā kulakeliśobhitavapuḥ pūrvvoditā jṛṃbhateḥ (!) pūrṇṇābhāmṛtakuṇḍalī paraparā mantrātmikā siddhidāḥ (!) mālā pusṭaka (!) dhāriṇī triṇayaṇā (!) kundedu (!) varṇṇācalā nityānandakule prakāśajananī vāgdevamāśreya (!) || || (fol. 1v1–5) End guṇaikāmaiśvarairudrairaṃkulītaila miśitaṃ (!) triloha veṣṭitaṃ vaktre (!) dhāritaṃ puṣyabhāṣkarai adṛśyo jāyate satyaṃ devir (!) api na dṛśyete || digveda gubhikāmaiś ca hyaṃgulītaila lepitam puṣpa (!) bhāṣkara jogena (!) trilohe ca tu veṣṭaya (!) mūrddhasthaiṣe ca ratvaṃ ca yojanānāṃ śatāvadhi ete sarva mahāyogāś caṃdramaṃtreṇa siddhiti (!) mani (!) maṃtrauṣadhaṃ jñātvā ʼsyaka gurupade gata (!) || || sāṃpratāyāt prayogāgnyā jñātavyāḥ tata (!) kvacit siddhasya siddho bhavat || || (fol. 156r1–4) Colophon iti śrīsiddhanāgārjunaviracite kakṣapuṭe alpāhāra sāṃgvapāṃga (!) nāma pañcaviṃsati (!) paṭalaṃ || samāt (!) (fol. 156r7)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śivāya || || dhyātvā śivaṃ paramatatvavicāravaidyaṃ caṇḍīm abhīṣṭaphaladāṃ sagaṇaṃ gaṇeśaṃ | dhanvaṃtarīṃ munivaram munisuśrutādīn ātreyam ugratapaso manasā praṇamya || 1 || ādivyādhiharaṃ vande parāśaktiyutaṃ śivaṃ ādāvaṃtorujaṃ jñāne prayatetac cikitsakaḥ ||(!) sādhyāsādhyavibhāgajñaḥ tataḥ kuryāc cikitsitaṃ kṛcchropāya sukhopāyo dvividhaḥ sādhya ucyate || (fol. 1v1–4) End vaidyasmaraṇaḥ || || brahma tvam eva viṣṇuś ca rudraś ca sahadurgayā || ārttasya roganāśāya pratyakṣo bhavapāyaka || (!) agnau prārthanā || || atha sva duṣṭadevatāṃ smṛtya (!) amṛtīkṛtya auṣadhaṃ bhakṣayet || || vasvaṃkavedasahite śubhavatsare vai īṣasya śukla phaṇirājatithau niśīśe (!) bhīṃdyāla vaidya sujano harikṛṣṇasevī vaidyāṃgasāra lalitaṃ bhiṣajāṃ lileṣa || || (!) (fol. 144r4–6) Colophon iti śrīvaidyāṃgasāre jvarādi viṣaparyaṃtaṃ bājīkaraṇaṃ saṃpūrṇam || || śubham astu sarvajagatām || (fol. 144r7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || yan nāma smaraṇaṃ samastaduritadhvaṃsāvahaṃ puṇyadaṃ bhaktānām abhayaṃkaraṃ sukhakaraṃ sarvārthasiddhiḥ pradaṃ || (!) taṃ natvārjjunam īśvaraṃ gurukṛpā ʼvāptaiḥ susiddhair varair yogaṃ vaidyarahasyam adya tanute vidyāpatiḥ kautukāt || 2 || (!) yataḥ samastarogāṇāṃ jvaro rājeti viśrutaḥ || ato jvarādhikārotra prathamaṃ likhyate mayā || 2 || aṃśāṃśaṃ yatra doṣāṇāṃ vivektuṃ naiva śaknuyāt || sādhāraṇīṃ kriyāṃ tatra vidadhīta cikitsakaḥ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End dīrghadīrghāsu bahavo graṃthā saṃti tathāpi me || sāṃpradāyikayogānāṃ saṃgrahārthaṃ mayaṃ (!) kṛtaḥ || 6 || catuḥpaṃcāśadbhir munividhuśatenādhisahitair gadebde (!) 1754 bhūpārkān nabhasi sitapakṣe phaṇitithau iti śrīmad vaṃśīdharatanujavidyāpatikṛto bhavat pūrṇo graṃthaḥ sakalabhiṣagānaṇdajanakaḥ || 7 ||(fol. 97r6–8) Colophon iti śrīmad upādhyāya vaṃśīdharātmaja vidyāpatinirmmito vaidyarahasyābhidhoyoga samupaset (!) || likhitaṃ radhunaṃdane (fol. 97r8–9)

«Beginnings:» -daśāhaṃ vā dvādaśāham athāpi vā | sa †tatpāyo† visajjīsyāt saṃtataḥ sa nigadyate | ahorātre satatako(!) dvau kālāvanuvarttate | (anye vadyutkathyavaho(2)tra) ekakālaṃ pravarttate | tṛtīyakas tṛtīyeʼhni caturthe hni caturthakaḥ dinam ekaṃ tu visamya (!) pratyeti sa tṛtīyakaḥ dinadvayam atikramya pratyeti sa (3) caturthakaḥ | kecid bhūtāmiṣaṃ gottyraṃ bruvate viṣamajvaraṃ | (fol.5v1–3) «Sub-colophon:» iti mādhavaviracitaṃ mādhavanidānaṃ samāptam || || ❁ || || saṃvat 1564(causaṭhasame jeṭhya) sudi 11 sanivāsare (uṃ (2) maṃ‥) gopāletyādi mahārājādhirājasrīsatkipālabhujyamānarājye (maghupalpāṃ || ṭhakurabhuvanadāsasyātmajena) paramā(3)nandena liṣitam idaṃ pustakaṃ || subham astuṃ || || namo dhanvantaye || namo munubhya (!) || namaḥ sivāya || namaḥ sarasvatyai || (4) gaṇesāya namaḥ || || (X. 2a:1–4) End (karasthā guhyamūle yā dhamanī jī‥‥‥tīta vekṣayāṃ) suṣaṇ duḥkhaṃ jñyeyaṃ kāyasya paṃḍitaiḥ || nāḍī ‥((5)tre manutko) jalaukaḥ sarppayor(nartīkuliṃgakāka‥‥‥) tiṃ pittasya kopanaḥ | haṃsapārāvanagariṃ dhatte śleṣmapra(6)kopanaḥ vāvatittiravarttīkagamanaṃ saṃnipātakaṃ || kadācid mandagamanā kadācid vegavāhinī || dvidoṣakopano jñeyo hanti ca khyāta (7) vi‥ saḥ || pītvā sthitvā ca vati yā sā smṛtā prānanāsinī || atihlārā ca śītā ca nīvanaṃ hanty asaṃṣayaṃ || jvarakope manīsoṣṇa- (X. 2a:4–7)

(fol.594r8;594v1) Colophon || atha nepālabhāṣā || saṃvat 850 mārgasira kṛṣṇa daśamī bṛhaspativārakuhnu śrī śrījayaraṇajitamalla mahārājasana, yajñanārāyaṇapradhānāṃgayā valasa thva guli siddhayoga saṃgrahanāma aśvaśāstrayā nepālabhāṣāna ṭīkādayakaṃ sidhayakā julo || thva guli grantha mahākaṣṭana dayakā thvatena uttamaprakārana rakṣāyāṅa taya māla || pūnarvādajñānījanana (!) aśuddha ju o thāsa vicārayāṅā o śuddha juyake māla, jīpanisayā makhu, svāmiyā ājñāmātra yathā śaktina praṃāṇa yāṅā || || ❁ || śubham stu || || (fol.594v1–5)

Beginning ❖ śrī ganeśāya namaḥ || jayati sapāṇḍavanātho dharmanidhāno yudhiṣṭhiro nṛpatiḥ | bhīmārjjuna sahadevāstadanutraye vājiśāstra tatvajñāḥ || 1 || dṛṣṭvā samyaṅa nakulaḥ śāstraṃ kṛtsnaṃ hi śālihotrīyaṃ | vrate śāstramanaṃtaṃ śāstraṃ kṛtvā samāsena || 2 || sapakṣā vājinaḥ pūrvaṃ sadā te vyomacāriṇaḥ || gaṃdharve‥ yathā kāmaṃ gacchati ca samanvitāḥ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–6) End kuṣṭhī koṣṭhī jvarī pakṣī parasparaṃ dūṣayaṃti | kṣaura kṛtārtha vāṃdhaiścakṣuṣāśca prākpīrānirā dīyāt || 8 || aśvasyāṃge praliṃpeta haridrayāpiṣṭa yogān | maṃgalyā ca yāti cātvaṃga doṣaghnair vibhūṣayedalaṃkāraiḥ || 9 || (fol. 26v8–27r1) Colophon iti nakula cikitsite aśvaśālā kathanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśodhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || || śāke 1553 tathā saṃvat 1688 pravarttamāne śrāvaṇakṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ 11 jīvavāsare śālihotrasya pustakaṃ samāptaṃ || || ādarśa doṣānmati vibhramādvā tvarā viśeṣāllikhanasya vegāt | tanmārjjayitvā pariśodhayaṃtī kṣamaṃ tu saṃtaḥ khalu lekhakasya ||| śubhaṃ || || oṃ || rāmāya namaḥ || || || śrī śrī sumati jayajitāmitramalladevasana thva pustaka dayakā, bhāgirāma paramānayāvelasa, saṃvat 810 kārtika śudi 9 (fol. 27r1–7)

Beginning [netracikitsā] || ghṛtena puṣpaṃ madhunāśrupāta bhṛgenakaṇḍū timiraṃ jalena (2)nat sāṃdhiko kājikayogpiṣṭa (!) piṣṭo punarnavānetra punarnavī(3)kṛt roti (!)…(fol.1r1–3) śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || auṣadha jholāpara || lahasunu pīṭhī udarakī tāke varā vanāi || sātadinā jo ṣāiyai tu(2)ratai jholā jāi || anyac ca || āphū paisācāribhari 2 karutelu bhari pāu cha ||| lohapātrame auṭikai sāta di(3)nā lagavāu || balabalātura hi jāi javale je telu utāri || vai hari sītu vacāi yai jholā jaihai hāri ||| (fol.1v1–4) End pathya alone canākī roṭī || tathā aura vidhi || kaṭhūmīri (8) vakucīke bījā varāvarikai piai ṭaṃka 3 alone canākī roṭī ṣāi | ajīta varanu nīkahoi || (9) atha śveta kuṣṭapara oṣadha || arnnekaṃḍāko tela kāṭhai so pahile lagāvai || puni suvarake viṣṭākā (10) telu vaise hī jaṃtru kari lagāvai tau śveta kuṣṭa nīka hoi || dehaja || atha kisoraguggulakai vidhi || || (fol.12v7–10)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāyanamaḥ || atha rāmanāma māṃtravidhir li(2)khyate || oṃ śrīrāmaḥ 3 oṃ śrīrāmaḥ 4 || athātaḥ (3) saṃpravakṣāmi maṃtraṃ trailokyamohanam || śrīrāmaca(4)ndrasya vikhyātaṃ sarvakāryaprasādhakam || 1 || (!) pra(5)thamaṃ lakṣam ekaṃ tu likhe (!) maṃtraṃ maheśvari || godhū(6)me ca vaṭi (!) kṛtvā jalajantau vinikṣipet (!) || 2 || (7)daśāṃśaṃ havanaṃ kuryā (!) mārjanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā || brāhma(8)ṇā (!) bhojayet paṃcā (!) dakṣiṇābhiś ca pūjayet || 3 || (fol.1r1–8) End tatālaṃ mriyate citra puṇendu (!) sadṛśaprabham || se(15)vayed bhaktikāmājaṃ vātātapavivarjitam || ṣaṇamā(16)ṣasya (!) prayogeṇa khecaro jāyate naraḥ || kuṣṭāni (!) tena na(17)śyanti maṃḍalāṃ nātra saṃsayaḥ || rasepunarnavāyāś ca pā(18)radaṃ sardayet (!) sudhiḥ || taja (!) suraṇamadhye ca dadhyāt sa(19)ptapuṭāni caḥ (!) || guṭikā jāyate nūnaṃ vīryastambhakari (!) bhavet || (fol.49r14–19) Colophon iti kalpāvalī samāptaḥ || iti samvat 1975 sāla (fol.49r20) ❁ iti rāmanā(15)mavidhiḥ samāptam śubham || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 7:14–15)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīnirmmala gurucaraṇam aphullakamalebhyaḥ (!) || śrīkamaladalavipulanayanābhirāmāya sakalalokabhayaharāya nārāyaṇāya || athā⟨ne⟩(2)to dīrghajīvitīyam adhāyaṃ (!) vyākhyāsyāma || iti hasmā bhagavān-n ātreyaḥ || dīrghajīvitam anvicchan bharadvāja upāgamat || indram ugratayā buddhyaśaraṇyam amareśvaraṃ || brahmaṇā(3)di yathā proktaṃ-m āyurvedaṃ prajāpatiḥ || (!) jagrāha nikhile nādāvaśvinau tu punaḥs (!) tataḥ (fol.1v1–3) «Sub: colopohon:» iti kalpanācatuṣke cikitsāprabhṛtīyodhyāyaḥ || || samtaʼ kalpanācatuṣkam caturtham || || (fol. exp.16b1) End bhvaty utpadyate taṃdrā tathālasya(8)masocakaḥ || vātācchulaṃ (!) bhramaṃ kaṃpaḥ pittād āho madas tṛṣā || kaphāgurūtvaṃ taṃdrā ca śiroroge tridoṣaje || tilakṣīraguḍājīrṇapūritaṃ kīrṇabhoja– (fol. 36:7–8) [last exp.]

Beginning oṃ namorddhanārīśvarāya nārāyaṇāya || || abodhatimirachanna (!) cakṣuṣāṃ bhiṣajāṃ kṛte || sūkṣmaṃ karoty agniveśo graṃthaṃm (!) aṃjanamākhyayā || 1 || doṣaroṣorujāṃ hetus tatprakope tu kāraṇam || pratyekaṃ hīnam ityātiyogaḥ kālārthakarmaṇām (3)|| 2 || (fol.1v:1–3) End iti mukharogāvalokaḥ || akālapalitaṃ pīḍā sūryāvarttārddhabhedakāḥ || indraluptaṃ keśapāta ity ādyā syuś śirogadāḥ ||(5) 331 || iti śirorogāvalokaḥ || jihvāmauṣyaśirodāha bhramonmādārucijvaraiḥ || svāsahikkādantaharṣaṃ jānīyāt sthāva(6)raṣam || 232 || daṃśavaivarṇyaśophābhyāṃ sekarekatamo bhramaiḥ || nidrākṣIṇarasanā (!) mauḍhyaṃ cāhi viṣaṃ vahet || 233 || viddhaṃ tu (7) vṛścike nāgaṃ jvaradaṃgārabhāgi (!) ca || saddāhamohamanyad yathā khaṃ viṣam unnayet || 234 || iti viṣāvalokaḥ …|| 235|| (fol.11r:4–8) Colophon cakā(9)racaturocitaṃ tad idam agniveśoṃjanaṃ paropakṛtaye kṛtī param idaṃ rujāṃ jñāpakam tata rasā muditais sadā sukṛtarāśibhis tuṣya(10)tān tuṣāragirikanyakā paridṛḍhas sa yoṣit sutaḥ || śubham astu || saṃmvat 18 || 27 samai nāma agahan vadi 13 (fol. 11v8–10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || yasyeśvarasya jagataḥ paripālanāya śaktyā dhṛtaṃ sahajam adbhutam aṣṭarūpaṃ || pratyakṣataḥ prabhavati prabhaves tu tasmai sarvvārthasiddhipha(3)ladāya namaḥ śivāya || cakrakramād adhikam udgrathane prayogān icchāś cikitsitavidhāv adhikaprakarṣaṃ || dhanvantarer iva hare vvimalātmajanmā vārendra (3) vaidyapuruṣottamadattanāmā || (fol.1v1–3) End raktapittātisāreṣu ruddhaśabdas tu pūjitaḥ || tathānye cāpi ye śabdās talliṅgās teṣu pūjitā || tathaivākṛṣya hā kaṣṭam ā(10)kandaruditasvarāḥ || cchardir vātapurīṣāṇāṃ śabdo vā garddhabhoṣṭra⟪jā⟫yo || pratiṣiddha tathā rugṇaṃ kṣataḥ skhalitam āhataṃ || pāṇḍvānāṃ (!) saṃgavascthānāṃ sva– (fol.7r9–10) === Colophon ===X

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ pratyaṅgirāyai || praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ bhaktyā śaṃkaraṃ sarvvadehināṃ || śivāya jagatām jātāṃ śivāñcāpi viśeṣataḥ || sūryaputro mahābāhoc-chāyā hṛdayanandanaḥ | turaṃga me kuru śāntiṃ revaṃtāya namonamaḥ || (!) sukhāvabodha śabdārthaṃ grantha vistara varjjitaṃ | lakṣaṇaṃ vājidehasthaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa yathākramaṃ || cikitsāś ca samāsena siddhauṣadhi samanvitā | muniproktāni śāstrāṇI samagālokya vājināṃ || śrīmadvijayadattasya putreṇa kriyatedhunā śrīmatā jayadattena vāhānāṃ hitam icchatā || (fol.1v1-6) End rasāyanādhyāyaḥ || śrīśālihotrādi muni praṇītaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca śāstraṃ bahuvistarañ ca | svalpaṃ subodhaṃ sa[[ra]]laṃ yathārthaṃ kṛtañ ca tad vai jayadattakena || || (fol.139v4-6) Colophon mahāsāmanta śrījayadattakṛtam aśvavaidyakaśāstraṃ samāptaṃ || |(fol.139v6)

Beginning ❖ śrīganeśāya namaḥ || jayati sapāṇdavanātho dharmmanidhāno yudhiṣṭhiro nṛpatiḥ | bhīmārjuna sahadevāstadanu ca ye vājiśāstratatvajñāḥ || yudhiṣṭhira rājā jayayukva tha jura gathiṃ yudhiṣṭhira rājā, pāṇḍavayā nātha, dharmmayā nidhāna bhīma arjuna sahadeva mevameva (!) aśvaśāstra dayaka vahmaṃ jayayukva tha jura || 1 || dṛṣṭvā samyaṅ nakulaḥ śāstraṃ kṛtsnam hi śālihotrīyaṃ | vrūte śāstram anantaṃ śāstraṃ kṛtvā samāsena || śālihotraśāstra saṃpūrṇṇana soyāva, nakulana anantaśāstra daśenaṃ cibhāyana se yaji yakaṃ thva nakulacikitsitanāma grantha dayakā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–7) End aśvasyāṃge praliṃpeddharidrayāpiṣṭayāṅgāni | maṅgalyāni yāni tvaṅgadoṣaghnair vvibhūṣayed alaṃkāraiḥ || salāyā śarīrasa, maṅgala vastu[[na]] halaḍi potana lepana yāya, salāyā aṃgadoṣa mhocaka va, alaṃkāra satiyake || 9 || (fol. 89r1–89v1) Colophon iti nakulacikitsite aśvaśālākathanaṃ nāma śoḍaśo ʼdhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 89v1–2) śrī śrīhemantamallanatha[[va]]tā nimirttina (!) dayakā || kayaṃgalana pitāṃ viya mate va || mahādullaṃbha vastu || samvat 799 māghamāsa śukla pakṣa śrīpañcamyāṃ tithau revatī nakṣetre gurudine || śubham astu sarvvadā || (fol. 89v5–7)

Beginning oṃ revaṃtāya nama (!) ❖ oṃ namo herambāya || praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ bhaktyā śaṅkaraṃ sarvvadehināṃ | śivāya jagatāñjjātaṃ śivañcāpi (!) viśeṣataḥ || sukhabodhaṃ ca śabdārthaṇ grantha vistara varjjitaṃ | lakṣaṇaṃ vājidehasthaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa yathākramaṃ || cikitsāṃ ca samāsena siddho yogasamanvitā | muniproktāni śāstrāṇi samyagālokya vājināṃ || śrīmadvijayadattasya putreṇa kriyate ʼdhunā | śrīmatā jayadattena vāhānāṃ hitamicchayā || (fol.1v1-4) End bhiṣak chāgasya mūtrena varttiṇkṛtvā tataḥ sudhīḥ | unmāditeñjanaṅkuryāt tayācchāyā viśuṣkayā || aśvagandhā vacākuṣṭha rocanā madhusarpiṣāḥ | rakṣārthe puṭikā kāryā kaṇḍakarpaṭa veṣṭitā || gomūtra ghṛtadudghaiś ca dadhnāca śakṛtā tathā | pañcagavyaṃ bhavet sarppis tasya pānārtham uttamaṃ || nasyam iti pāṇāntaraṃ(!) || ❁ || (fol.73v7-74r4) Colophon ity unmādi cikitsādhyāyaḥ || || yathā liṣitaṃ tathaiva liṣitaṃ (!) || jagajjayamalla (fol.74r5)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || athātaḥ sampravakṣāmi, āvarttānāṃ viniścayaṃ | śubhāśubha vivekāya, yathā śāstra vyavasthitaḥ || (!) uttarauṣṭhaḥ prapālasyāt tatāvatraḥ śubhaḥ smṛtaḥ | (!) sṛkkvanaś ca tathā prokta sakāmaś ca phalapradaḥ || trayovātha ca catvāro vājino yasya romajāḥ | dvau vā lalāṭaja yasya sa tu dhanyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ || (fol.1v1–3) End thva ghāra, dakosa, vu, bheḍarayo, viśeṣa. seya || vātana, bhedarayu, ghārajurasā tāmbu hneya mapholana bheḍarayu ghāraju rasā tava (fol.30v4–6) Colophon ❖ samvat 802 śrāvaṇa kṛṣṇa saptamī aṃgāra (!) vāra thva kuhnu śrī lalitapattana naka vahiri svahara nihma, rājalavantā gṛha dvijavara śrīdevaśaṃkarala thva saṃḍayā, oṣadhī coyā juro || thvaḥ saṃṅkuri, sunānaṃ sidhayake teva || dako cosyaṃ tayā || || śubhaṃ || || (fol.31r1–3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo pratyaṅgirāyai || praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ bhaktyā śaṃkaraṃ sarvvadehināṃ || śivāya jagatām jātāṃ śivāñcāpi viśeṣataḥ || sukhāvabodhaśabdārthaṃ grantha vistaravarjjitaṃ || lakṣaṇaṃ vājidehas taṃ (!) saṃkṣepeṇa yathākramaṃ || cikitsāśca samāsena siddhauṣadhi samanvitā | muniproktāni śāśastrāṇī samyag ālokya vājināṃ || śrīmad vijayadattasya putreṇa kriyatedhunā || śrīmatā jayadattena vāhānāṃ hitam icchatā || (fol.1v1–4) End || rasāyanādhyāyaḥ || || śrīśālihotrādi muni[pra]ṇītaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca śāstra (!) bahuvistarañ ca | svalpaṃ labodha saṃcāla yathārthaṃ kṛtañ ca tañ ca dvai jayadattakena (!) || || (fol.99v2–6) Colophon mahāsāmanta śrījayadattakṛtam aśvavaidyakaśāstraṃ samāptaṃ || || gulagunnubhārahā aśvagadhahā kakuṭhi cuyāhā, thvate nāsara kvāka ju vastuna taṃ na pitasasitala naṃtanaṃ śleṣa sapāru padārthanatanaṃ || || śubhaṃ bhava || (fol. 99v4–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo bhagavate jinaputrāya || sūryyaputramahābāhoc-chāyā hṛdayanaṃdana | turaṅga me kuru śāntiṃ revantāya namonamaḥ || śālihotra ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ nararājasya mātulaḥ | bhojadevamataṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃkṣepa kriyate ʼdhunā || pūrvvaśāstrārtham ādāya, racitaṃ sārasaṃgrahaṃ | kudṛṣṭād annadravyam vā, vājīsādhanam icchatā || vājinām karmma tatvajño śreṣṭhaṃ prāgeya vājināṃ | ye umantim (!) athā kānti dhāvanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || (fol.1r1–5) End || dvikarṇīhna savāva || dvikhuri nāyavāva || stanīghorayā dududava | kukudhusi || ṭittīḍīsannibha, titihutrithyaṃ cyākva || vānarākṣa (mākatamikhā ) || dvipadraṣṭra vāutvaṃ mahāka || e || (fol.34r5-34v2) Colophon thvate sārakāsyaṃ jukkamuṅna saḍaṃyālakṣaṇa hlāyā || ○ || śuabham ||…(fol.34v2)

Beginning śrīrevantāyā namaḥ [[prathama]] || loyāyā upacāla hlāya || khvāla huguīva moḍako chu/// pāyu laṃṣamatoniva hnāsana hni hāyu va deṇāī /// yākāla ṇāva dhikudhik (exp.25b:1-3) End (vānarākṣa kṛṣṇa śaṃṭhaiḥ kṛṣṇa guhya guhyastathaiva ca (kṛsna proktaṃśca śukaṃśca) yaśca tittira saṃnibha || 67 || viṣamaḥ śvetapādaśca tuvāvartta vivarjjitaḥ || aśubhāvarttasaṃ jutto vatraṃniyo turaṃgamaṃ || 68 || randhroparandrayo dvau dau…) [[missing at Reel] gavāmūtreṇapiṣṭaiś ca marddanaṃ kaṇḍanāśanam | śītāmadhuyutaḥ kvathaḥ nāsikāyāṃ sakeśaraḥ || 99 || raktapittahara pānād aśvajarṇa tathaiva ca | saptame saptadeyaṃ maśvānāṃ(!) damanaṃ dine || 100 || tathā bhuktaṃ vatādayā abhipāne tu vāruniḥ | jīvanīyaiḥ sumadhurais mṛddhikāśarkkarāyutaiḥ || 101 || sapippalīke savadi || (!) (exp.49b:1-5) Colophon samvat 923 miti kārttikaśudi 12 roja 5 thuṣunu siddhayānā julo śubham ||

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsūryyāya namoḥ (!) || || dhanvaṃtarir uvāca || aśvavāhanasāraṃ ca vakṣye cāśvacikitsanaṃ || vajināṃ (!) saṃgrahaḥ kāryyo dharmmakāmārtha siddhaye || 1 || aśvinī śravaṇaṃ hastaṃ uttarātritayan tathā || nakṣatrāṇi prasastāni hayonāmā hi vahane || 2 || hemante śiśire caiva vasante cāpi vāhanaṃ || grīṣme śaradi varṣāsu misiddhaṃ (!) vāhanaṃ hayaṃ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End vipratyo (!) dakṣiṇāndadyān naimirttika (!) mataḥ śṛṇu || makarādau hayānāñ ca parvvair vvi+ śriyaṃ jayet || 124 || brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ somam ādityañ ca tathāśvimau (!) || revantaṃ muccaiśravasaṃ(!) dikpālāś ca daleṣvavi || 125 || pratyekaṃ kuṃbhapūrṇaśva vedyāṃ tat saumya tau kulet || tilākṣatājya siddhāthāne devatānāṃ śataṃ śataṃ || 126 || upeṣitepi ttavyaṃ (!) karmmajāś ca rupājahaṃ (!) || || (fol. 11v1–5) Colophon iti āgnaya mahāpurāṇe aśvaśānti ʼ samāptaḥ(!) || 127 || śubham astu || || || || || || || || || || || || || || (fol. 11v5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśaṃ vande || gīrvāṇayuddhādimavikrameṇa gīrvāṇayuddhavikrameṇa rājñā | ādau graṃthāraṃbhe ❖ gaṇeśaṃ vighnarājaṃ vidhivat | vidhimanatikramya praṇamya praṇāmaṃ kṛtvā iti maṃgalaṃ | śāstrodbhavam arthasāraṃ śāstra svataḥ siddho yo ʼrthasya sāraṃ mukhyārthaṃ vicāryya | etad vājirahasyannāma vājināṃ rahasyatvaṃ vāji lakṣaṇa sūcakatvāt | (fol.1v1–3) śrī || gaṇeśam ādau vidhivat praṇamya vicāryyaśāstrodbhavam arthasāram | viracyate vājirahasyam etad gīrvāṇayuddhādimavikrameṇa || 1 || aśvapraśaṃsādi yathokta māghais tathā mayāpyatra nibadhyate sat || pramāṇabhūtaṃ munisaṃmatatvād ato budhair ādaraṇīyam etat || 2 || (fol.1v4–6) End dīrghagrīvo dīrghanetro ruṇauṣṭa sarvāṃgair yaḥ śobhano rakta jihvaḥ || śuddho bājīmandurāyāṃ subaddho rājño bhūyāc-chatrunāśāya nityam || 99 || (fol.14r4–5) Colophon iti bājirahasyannāma śatakam || śubham || || ❁ || || (fol.14r8) śrīman mahārājādhirāja gīrvāṇayuddhavikrama sāhadevena kaviśreṣṭhena kāṃtipura virocamānena rājñai tad bājirahasyaṃ nāma śatakaṃ śāstrapramāṇāt kṛtatvād atipramāṇam ity āha || rājñīti …(fol.14r9-10) iti gauridattakṛto vā [[jirahasyaprakāśaḥ || śubham ||]] (fol.14r12)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrībhavānī śāṅka[rā]bhyāṃ || vātayā śubhaphala salaṃyāhmaṃ sacoyātatina thanā pikāsyaṃtayā || uttaroṣṭha thaṃthahmathusi || sṛkka, hve, sarvvakāmaviva || lalāṭadhāya, hmosata, the 2, 3, 4 dhanya theṅa duna 3 conasā niśreṇīnāma, kāmanā phalaviva || mnuva hmosataḍo antarajaya || nigāla, devamaṇi nāma śubha || (fol.1v1–4) End asmāditi, thva vāsarathaṃ ṅā prayogana salaṃ rajalapara ṅāva, bhidyotrakāyā va, saharayāya, thvanali māsalaṃ yāhmaṃ dayaṃ sarvāṅgasa, pyākapaṃkana lepana yāke || karmaṇeti, thva guli prakāraṇa, cā matholasalaṃ yāke, prayogayāta ṅāva, salaṃcātholapiva, salaṃcā tholake karmasa, thva mahāprayoga atyanta bhiṃṅa || iti garbhadhāraṇopāyaḥ || (fol.82r1-4) Colophon iti nānāgraṃthasamuccayam aśvaśāstraṃ samāptaṃ || śrī śrīsumati jayajitāmitramalladevasana thva pustaka dayakā || bhāgīrāma pradhāṃnāṃgayā velasa saṃvat 810 kārttika sudi 9 || || (fol.82r4-6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namao śrīganeśāya namaḥ || jayati sapāṇdavanātho dharmmanidhāno yudhiṣṭhiro nṛpatiḥ | bhīmārjunasahadevās tadanu ca ye vājiśāstratatvajñāḥ || dṛṣṭvā samyaṅ nakulaḥ śāstraṃ kṛtsnam hi śālihotrīyaṃ | vūte (!) śāstram anantaṃ śāstra (!) kṛtvā samāsena || sapakṣā vājinaḥ pūrvvaṃ sadā te vyomacāriṇaḥ | gandharvvaiś ca yathākāmaṃ, gacchanti ca samanvitāḥ || tān dṛṣṭvā javasaṃpannān nityadho (!) vāhanocitān || śakra provāca pārśvasthaṃ śālihotraṃ munīśvaraṃ || (fol. 1v1–4) End viprān vaidyān turagarakṣārthaṃ kārppāsakena sūtreṃṇākṣikāṇāṃ || nivāraṇaṃ suvṛttaṃ, nāti javasaṃ yathā paśyanti vājināṃ | sthānaṃ caiva pṛthak prāpta pṛthuraṃ rogiṇāṃ prayatnena || kuṣṭhī koṣṭhī jvarī yakṣī parasparaṃ dūṣayati | kṣaura kṛtārthaṃ vaṃdhaiś cakṣuṣā ca proktaṃ nīrājayet | aśvasyāṃge praliped-dharidrayā piṣṭyāṅgāni | maṅgalyāni yāni tvaṅgadoṣaghnair vvibhūṣayed aṃlaṃkāraiḥ (!) || (fol. 13v9–12) Colophon iti nakulacikitsita aśvaśālā kathanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśodhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || || śubham astu sarvvadā || || (fol.13v12)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo bhagavate jinaputrāya || sūryyaputra mahābāhoc-chāyāhṛdayanaṃdana turaṅga me kuru śānti revantāya namonamaḥ || śālihotra ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ nalarāja tu mātulaḥ |(!) bhojadevamatandṛṣṭvā saṃkṣepa kriyate ʼdhunā || pūrvvaśāstrārtham ādāya racitaṃ sārasaṃgrahaṃ | kudṛṣṭādaṃnadravyambā [bā]jisādhanam icchatā || vājināmmarmmatattvajño śreṣṭhaṃ prāgeya vājināṃ | ye damantimathākānti dhāvanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || (fol.1v1-4) End vayojñānaḥ ||(!) abhṛgrograkhurobibhaktacaraṇānyāsās thirāṅgaḥ sthiraḥ śasto vānara kesarībhavṛṣabhas te haṃsagāmī hayaḥ śreṣṭha ṣoḍaśābhird-dhanu śatamito mātrābhiretītarau, sa vēdvyā ca digaṣṭarasagāḥ syuryājanānāṃ kramāt || yāsau śirā prāṇadharo hayānāṃ nābheradhasthāvṛṣaṇe ca lagnā | prasāraṇāṃ kuñcanadhāvanebhyo, guṃjatyasaumāruta vegapūrṇṇā || gatyādhyāyaḥ || ❁ || śubhaṃbhūyāt || e ||(fol.20v7–21r3) Colophon samvat 763 āśvina śuklapañcamī anurādha (!), viskaṃbha, śkravāra thva kohnu likhitam iti saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || (fol.21r4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo revantāya || praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ bhaktyā śaṃkaraṃ sarvvadehināṃ || śivāya jagatām jātāṃ śivañcāpi viśeṣa[[ta]]ḥ | sukhāvabodha śabdārthagranthavistara varjjitaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vājidehasthaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa yathākramam || cikitsāṃ ca samāsena siddhauṣadhi samanvitā | muni proktāni śāstrāṇi samyagālokya vājināṃ || śrīmad vijayadattasya putreṇa kriyatedhunā || śrīmad vijayadattena vāhānām hitamicchatā || (fol.1v1-4) End śrīśālihotrādi muni praṇītaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāstra bahuvistarañ ca svalpaṃ subodhaṃ sakalaṃ yathārtha kṛtañ ca tad vai jayadattakena (fol. 48r11:48v1) Colophon mahāsāmanta śrījayadatta kṛtam aśvavaidyakaśāstraḥ samāptaḥ || (!) yādṛśaṃ pustaṃ dṛstvā (!) tādṛśaṃ likhitaṃ mama | (!) yadi suddhamasuddhaṃ (!) vā mama doṣo nadīyateḥ (!) || || jayadattanāma pustakaṃ śrī śrīhemantamalla varmanā svakarena likhitam idaṃ saṃpūrṃ || || samvat 807 phālguṇa māse śuklapakṣe navamyāṃ thithau rohinī (!) nakṣatre viskambhayoge vṛhaspativāsare thva kuhnu saṃpūrṇa yāṅādi juroṃ || śrī śrī śrī revantasuprasaṃnostu || śubham astu || (fol.48v1–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāye(!) namaḥ || śrījagadambāyai namaḥ || hy eṣā harṣita vigraho haykathā prastāva sānanda hṛt sādi vrāta suṣābhi[[lā]]ṣa damahāsaṃddhā nivaddhādaraḥ || kiñcit kuñcita kesarāgra turagas keṣābhisaṃsphālanaḥ || vyāvaltvvatkara paṃkajo ʼvatu haya grīvo hari sajjanān || 1 || (fol.1v1-4) End ehi bhātihnakī uṣadhī suni jauna muni vaina | so sajjanake hetu lagi kahe trivikrama sena || iti narapati trivkramena tripuraharapriyasevakena pustaṃ || harikula suṣahetave kṛtaṃ tad vilasatu san mukhapaṃkaje sadaiva || saṃvatsare nigamananda rasendu yukte vaiśāṣa (!) śukladaśamī sutīthāvapuri hammīrasena tanayena guṇojjvalena || śrīmattrivikrama nṛpeṇa hareḥ parikṣā (!) || ❁ || (fol.50v4-7) Colophon iti śrītrivikramasena viracite ʼśvaparīkṣaṇaṃ saṃpūrṇam || śubham astu || || || || rāma rāma || śrīkaṃṭho jayati jagatatrayaikabaṃdhuḥ || (fol.50v7-8)

Beginning jayaṃtī pāṇḍavā nātho dharmanidhi yudhirṣṭiro (!) nṛpatiḥ || praṇipatyevaṃ jagaddhitākāraṃ tugama svāmino jayati || 1 || (!) parikṣauṣadhayap-pathyaṃ piṇḍapānādi bheṣajam || aśvānām ca gajānāṃ ca śālihotre cikitsavaḥ || yat sīve coktam ādittya (!) mādittyekrāṃtapaśvināḥ || tapaśvibhyo surendrāṇāṃ surendre cokta pāṃḍavaiḥ || 3 || (!) (fol.2r1-2v2) End atha vāgbhedaḥ || prathame pūṣpadantī (!) || 1 || gokarṇi || 2 || tulā || 3 || tulādhṛtā nāgapīṃḍi pūṣpacaṃdri(!) || 6 || dhṛti || 7 || puṣṭi || 8 || ekahastā || 9 || dvihastā || 10 || yugma || 11 || gorana || 12 || iti vāgbhedaḥ || pulaṃ ca nābhimātreṇa vipulaṃ aṃgulatrayaṃ || vicitraṃ dīrghahasanā hṛdayaṃ aṃgulaṃ tathā || (fol.50v1-51r5) Colophon iti vāhāguṇa saṃpūrṇaṃ || (fol.51r5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || gaṇeśam ādau vidhivatpraṇamya vicārya śāstrodbhavam arthasāraṃ viracyate vājirahasyam etad gīrvāṇayuddhādimavikrameṇa || 1 || paihle vidhipūrvaka gaṇeśakana namaskāra gari. śālihotrādi savaiśāstra vicāragari sārasārabhayākā arthakana jhiki gīrvāṇayuddhavikrameṇa bhaṃnu. śrī 3 gīrvāṇayuddhavikrama sāha rājāle vājirahasya bhaṃnā graṃtha vanāuṃcha || 1 || (fol.1v1-5) End kāṃtavatī bhaṃnī mahārānīle raṇabahādura bhannā mahārājakā putra bhayākā śrī gīrvāṇayuddhavikrama sāha mahārjākana prāsūta janmāunu bhayāchan śrīmaṃta bhayākā kavi nāyaka bhayākā śrī mahārājāle i kāṃtipuranāmā saharamā rājagari I vājirahasyanāmā graṃtha banāuṃdā bhayā 100 (fol.21v2-6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo bhagavate vājina putrāya (!) || sūryyaputra mahābāhocchāyā hṛdayanaṃdanaṃ (!) | turaṅga me kuru śānti (!) revantāya namonamaḥ || śālihotra ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ nararāja (!) tu mātulaḥ | bhojadevamataṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃkṣepa kriyate ʼdhunā || pūrvvaśāstrārtham ādāya, cacitaṃ (!) sārasaṃgrahaṃ | kudṛṣṭād annadravyam vā, jīvasādhanam icchatā || vājinām marmmatatyaṅgo (!) śreṣṭhaṃ prāgeya vājināṃ | ye umanti(!) mathā kānti dhāvanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||(!) (fol.1v1–7) «Sub:Colophon:» iti vāhanasāre pramānādhyāyaḥ (!) || (fol.8v1–2) End purogākasaṃ yāvadaṃ garanaṃ sataṃ rayacchayānā kaccha yuśati, madhānāmaṣabhi dvitīyā ca tṛtīyake, bhavekṣetraphalapradā || prathamakṣatramubhave dvitīyaṃ sadāmuhataṃ tṛtīyaṃripakītti (!) ca, kaṃ ku kāka kudan tathā | paṃcama sacānambhavet || (fol.10r4–10v1)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || jayati sa pāṇdavanātho dharma nidhāno yudhiṣṭhiro nṛpatiḥ | bhīmārjunasahadevās tadanu ca ye vājiśāstratatvajñāḥ || 1 || dṛṣṭvā samyaṅkulaḥ śāstraṃ kṛtsnaṃ hi śālihotrīyaṃ | vrūte śāstram anaṃtaṃ śāstraṃ kṛtvā samāsena || 2 || sapakṣā vājinaḥ pūrvaṃ sadā te vyomacāriṇaḥ | gaṃdharvebhyo yathākāmaṃ gachaṃti (!) ca samanvitāḥ || 3 || tān dṛṣṭvā javasaṃpannān nityādho vāhanocitān śakraḥ provāca pārśvasthaṃ śālihotraṃ munīśvaraṃ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) End sthānaṃ caiva pṛthak prāpta (!) pṛthuraṃ (!) rogiṇāṃ prayatne vaiḥ | kruṣṭhī koṣṭhī jvarī yakṣmī parasparaṃ dūṣayaṃti || 7 || (!) kṣaurarakṣatārthaṃ vāṃdhaiś ca kṣurāś ca prākpirānirādipān | aśvasyāṃge praliṃpeta haridrayā viṣṭayāṃgān || 8 || maṃgalyā ca yāti tātvaṃgadoṣaghnair vibhūṣayed alṃkāraiḥ || 9 || (fol. 30v7–31r3) Colophon || iti nakulacikitsite śālihotraṃ samāptam || 16 || || || śrīśāke 1694 kārttikakṛṣṇcaturdaśyāṃ hastānakṣatre ravidine daivajñakīrttisiṃhena saṃpūrṇa (!) liṣkhitaṃ || śubham astu || śrīrāmakṛṣṇanārāyaṇavāsudeva gopālamādhavagoviṃdācyutanṛṣiṃha namonamaste || (fol. 31r3–5)

Beginning śrīganeśāya namaḥ || śrīvinatāpūtrāya (!) namaḥ || atha jānavarakai ilāja vāja jurrāku hivari || je jānavarakai sinā suṣijāya duvara hoya to kutākai māsukai tāmā deva yā suarakai māsukai tāmā devaḥ yā pahili rajasvalāi strikai kaparā dhoikai pāni deva, yā saṃtāvarikai jarikai rasana neka deva nika hoi || (fol. 1v1–3) End sorā dāru pisikai kaparākai thailimaha kasa āḍā varovari bāādhava vahi upara janāvara vaiṭhāi javale nika nahoi tave vādhava gadahi nika hoya || || (fol. 35r7–35v2) Colophon iti vājasālihotraḥ auṣadha samāptaṃ śubham bhūyāt || || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 35v1–2)

Beginning | | śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ || || yaṃ vedāntavido vadaṃti vibudhā brahādi devaṃ dayā sindhuṃ bandhum anekam ekam akhila prāṇipriyaṃ satkriyam heraṃbaṃ tam ibhānanaṃ prathamato natvā mayārabhyate rogānīkanivāraṇaṃ karaṭinaḥ satkautukaṃ nāmataḥ || 1 || tato himagireḥ sutāṃ sakalasiddhi saṃpatpradāṃ tatāṃ jagati sarvataḥ sadasi garvigārvacchidām hitāṃ hṛdayadhāriṇāṃ hariharātmabhūmistutāṃ namāmi paradevatāṃ sutasamṛddhi sampattaye || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End sad asad api yaduktaṃ mad girā vāraṇānāṃ abhinavakṛta śāstre tat kṣamadhvaṃ kṛtijñāḥ || dvijavarakṛtino ʼsmin drāg dadhatv ātmacetoḥ bhavatu parapraṇītaṃ kautukaṃ vāraṇānāṃ || 13 || || (fol. 53v8–54r1) Colophon || iti śrīkāyastha balabhadrātmajagopāladāsaviracite karaṭikautuke nakhataḥ sādhyā ʼsādhyanakhottamalakṣaṇa dvijamukhajātilakṣaṇāraṇyadantisādhukaraṇa hastivāhana hastisaṃkīrṇajātidaṃtidoṣakharaśītalīkaraṇa jalodgārajāṭharanāḍīsvaraviśeṣalakṣaṇa viṣacikitsā hasticakragajapraśaṃsā gajalūtākavacādikas tṛtīya ullāsaḥ | | samāpto ʼyaṃ karaṭikautukanāmā graṃthaḥ || || abde nāmgayugāṃgaśītakiraṇe 1648 taiṣetithau pakṣatau 1 kṛṣṇāyā minavāsare mṛgaśiraḥ sādhyollasat kaulave saṃpūrṇaṃ kṛtavān ayaṃ gajahitāyājñām avāpyāvanī pālādeḥ karikautukaṃ balisuto gopālanāmā ʼvanau || 1 || na sthāyi caṃcalaṃ varṣma tanujānām iha kṣitau cirasthāyyakṣaraṃ jñātvā ʼkarot karaṭikautukam || 2 || nindantu durjanāḥ sarve stutiṃ kurvaṃtu sajjanāḥ samam evāṃjaliṃ tebhyo badhvā ʼkāri dvipākṣaram || 3 || śubham || likhitaṃ jagannāthena śrīmad raṇabahādūrasenārthaṃ | śubhaṃ | (fol.54r1–9)

Beginning śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ | atha bājānāṃ caturjātilakṣaṇaṃ caturjātis tu vāja syād brāhmaṇakṣatriyas tathā vaiśyaśūdras tathā jñeyā śālihotramataṃ yathā | śvetas tu brāhmaṇo jñeyā (!) kṣatriya śvetaraktayaḥ (!) pītaśvetas tu vaiśyaḥ syād śyāma śūdra prakīrttitāḥ (!) 2 puṣpagamdhi bhavaed brāhma guḍagaṃdhī ca kṣatriya mīnagaṃdhī bhaved vaiśya madagaṃdhā ca śūdrayoḥ (!) 3 (fol. 1v1–4) End jīro○ camasūra ○ methi ○ kāgatiko rasa samagari lāvanu gadahi jā | nīlātutho sucā ṣayara haledo cūka sahita lāunu phālsāle veri rāṣanu cūkale bhijāuṃdai rahanu gadahi roga jā | sucāphik milāī lāunu siuniyāko niko ho java paṣeru cāro naṣāvata tasko upāya guggula āsāpuri morapucha kasturi samagari dhūpadinu rayālikana pāṣamā charidinu tava cāro ṣāva goḍā sisnu lāunu tava cāro ṣāva || || iti śubhaṃ || || ❁ || (fol. 10v8–11v3) Colophon navadalananagacaṃdrais 1729 saṃmite śrīśakābde dinakara kriyasaṃsthe kṛṣṇapakṣe navamyāṃ || suragurudivasesmin vājahotraṃ sugopyaṃ likhati śivanṛsiṃhaś caikadantaprasādāt śubhaṃ || (fol. 11v3–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || vinatāputrāya namaḥ || atha vājasālihotra || lakṣaṇāṃ-m auṣadhaṃ sāraṃ varṇam ākṛṣya liṣyate || kṛyate senapaṃjīyaṃ candrabhānena dhimatā(!) || 1 || ṣovarāki mati varṇi nahi vāja hu ki varni jāta || nānā virasiṃhamati bujhikai vesarālakṣaṇa bhāti || 2 || vesarāto jīya dosarā vujhaka jānai kohi || jahālai guṇavaṃta vesarā ṣyālakarai puni sohi || 3 || (fol. 1v1–4) End lavāga śamakaike pisava māṭikai vāsanamai peśāvase pakāiva choṭa vaḍa vujhikai māphika tāmā maha ghālike deva dina tina 3 ekāntakai rāṣava ima so ṣājāi || (fol. 9v3–5) Colophon iti vājaśālihotra samāptaṃ śubham bhūyāt || ||(fol. 9v5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || pālakāpyako dvitīya khaṇḍabāṭa utāreko hāttiko rogako lakṣaṇa ra cikitsāko bhāṣā ava prathamādhyāyamā vanaroga (!) kahiṃcha || || vama (!) ko lakṣaṇa || || vamana prakārako jānnu kapha, vāta, pitta 3 doṣabāṭa bhayako 1 ghāsamā pareko sarpaharu ra viṣālu kirā ṣānāle bhayāko āgaṃtuka 1 jaṃmā 2 || 2 || vāyubāṭa bhayako vana (!) ko lakṣaṇa || || nābhidekhi chātisamma āmāśayasthāna ho tesabāṭa saṃpūrṇa vamana utpanna huṃcha, vāyubāṭa bhayako vamanmā chātimā dāhine devre koṣāmā peṭamā pīḍā huṃcha pīḍīta bhayāko hātti jo cha phiṃja bhayako kālo raṅko kailo raṅko prasasta vamana garcha || || (fol. 1:1–12) End ṣudo hāleko madirā ṣāna dinu ghyuhāleko saṭhiyā bhāta ṣāna dinu vaṣat vaṣatmā naram ghāsa ṣāna dinu khādāmā pacadāmā tākata garāudāmā guliyai vaṣna jāne ṛtu ṛtumā hune phalaphula saṣarahāli ṣāna dinu vaṣat vaṣatmā tālima garī vasamā lyāune kāma garnu || ||(fol. 23v13–17) Colophon aṃgadeśakā rājāle śodhiyākā pālakāṣya ṛṣile vatalāyāko hastyāyurvedako pācau karmātinītādhyāya sidhiyo || || (fol. 23v18–20)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ tatrādau gajapraśaṃsā ucyate viṣṇudharmottare puṣkara uvāca kuñjarāḥ paramā śobhā śivirasya balasya ca āyataḥ kuñjareṣveva vijayaḥ pṛthivīkṣitāṃ (!) śiviraṃ gṛhaṃ teṣāṃ samarjane yalaṃ phalameva bhṛgūttamaḥ (!) yathāvannṛpatiḥ kuryāt gaṃdharvā kuṃjarā matāḥ tāvaṃtaś ca tathā dhāryā yāvaṃ (!) tāṃ poṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ kartuśakyaṃ na dhāryās te kṣudhitāḥ duḥkhitās tathā (fol. 1v1–4) End tanuvaṃśodaraś caiva tanuvyakta tanūruhaḥ dīrghajihvā viṣāṇaś ca dīrghagātras tathoravaḥ (!) pradhvastaromakarṇatvak parastāc cāpi saṃvṛtaḥ nipābhe gocaras thānaṃ śayyāyāṃ cāpya nirvṛttaḥ rupābhibhavasaṃkī ca nityam evān avasthitaḥ hrasvaśravaṇalāṃgūlo dīrghaṃ vikramate–(fol. 16v7–9)

Beginning dṛśyaṃte yāni liṅgāni grahadoṣeṇa vājināṃ | tāni samyak pravakṣāmi grahanā[[mā]]ni yāni ca || lohitākṣo virupākṣo harirvvālis (!) tathaiva ca | sa kāśī caiva vikhyātaḥ sa kāśī cāparaḥ smṛtaḥ || susaṃsthitaś ca kauveraṃ vaiśākhaś ca mṛdugrahaḥ | ūrdhvaś ca baruṇaś civa sadvidho (!) varuṇagrhaḥ || bṛhaspatiś ca somaś ca ta[[thā]]sūryyograhoparaḥ | ete proktā grahā pūrvve dāruṇā munisattamaiḥ || (fol. 75r1–4) End auṣadhaś ca nadātavyāḥ etāḥ śleṣmānvite haye | (!) vātike paittike cāpi vihitā śāstraśālibhiḥ || harītakyā mayā kalpaḥ praviṭkālavidhau smṛtaḥ || tenātra no vinirddiṣṭaḥ punar utkābhiśaṅkayā (!) || iti ra[[sāyana]]kalpādhyāyaḥ || || (fol. 83v1–3) Colophon śrīśālihotrādi munipraṇītaṃ dṛṣṭvā śāstrañ ca vahuvistarañ ca || (!) svalpaṃ subodhaṃ sakalaṃ yathārthaṅ kṛtś ca tad v-vai jayadattakena || (!) mahāsāmanta śrījayadattakṛtam aśvavaidyakaśāstraṃ samāptaṃ || || samvat 822 jeṣṭhaśuklapañcamī śukravāra thvakuhnu mohana siṃhana likhitaṃ || yathā dṛṣṭaṃ tathā likhitam idaṃ || (fol. 83v3–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ bhaktyā, śaṃkaraṃ sarvvadehināṃ | śivāya jagato jātaḥ śivaś (!) cāpi viśeṣataḥ | sūryyaputra mahābāhoc chāyāhṛdayanandanaḥ || turaṃgaṃ (!) kuru me śāntiṃ, revantāya namonamaḥ || oṃ namo revantāya || ataḥ palaṃgulaṃgānāṃ (!), kathyate vāhane vidhiḥ || yena te siddhim āyānti, karmmayogyā bhavanti ca || (fol. 1v1–4) End thvte smabhāga kurṣacchi 1 dhare tinajulo, cetaka titrana⟪na⟫hnayā vakhune, thva cekanana, yayāthiṃ ṅaghāraṃṅa ṅeva niścyana || śubham || || ṣvāse mamgayā, svakanāra cāvayā, ceknakhuneyā thva svaṃguli, vāsara, thvaguligraṃthayā maṣu || (fol. 9v2–4) Colophon || ❖ saṃvat 806 āṣāḍhaśukla saptamī śukravāra thva kuhnu, sohnemhavantā dvija śrīdevaśaṃkaraṇa (!), thva ṣaḍaṃśāstra (!) coya dhunakā dina joro śubham || revantāya namonamaḥ || || ○ || || saṃºº 902 phālguṇa śukla caturthī thva kuhnu śrīlakṣmīpati ju oṃ rāyā agnihotra mākasa śrīlakṣṃīśvarī agnihotrī sativana; thvana hṅāsati oṃ sivamadū(!) (fol. 9v4–8)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ bhaktyā, śaṃkaraṃ sarvvadehināṃ | śivāya jagato jātaḥ śivaś (!) cāpi viśeṣataḥ | sūryyaputra mahābāhoc chāyāhṛdayanandanaḥ || turaṃgaṃ (!) kuru me śāntiṃ, revantāya namonamaḥ || oṃ namo revantāya || ataḥ palaṃgulaṃgānāṃ (!), kathyate vāhane vidhiḥ || yena te siddhim āyānti, karmmayogyā bhavanti ca || (fol. 1v1–4) End || ghevā 3 gecchi sāvu, pāta 2 x alalahala cchonayāva, totilāhāta, thakāyamaphuyā, saranake, ṅeyiva kha || (fol. 18r1–2) Colophon ❖ varṣesmin vāṇacandravasau jeṣṭhaśukle navamyāṃ ravidine viprakulatilakasaroruha prakāśabhāṣkar eka kavicūḍāmaṇi rāgagītajña lokamānyakṛta dvijavaragaṇapatyātmajena śrībhavānīśaṅkareṇa śālihotraṃ nāma pustakaṃ likhitaṃ svārthena || śubham astu sarvvadākālam asmad vaṃśe || samvat 815 || revantanāma devayā smarana yāsyaṃ || (fol. 18r3–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇataye (!) || hvapām hāthi khedā, yākaṃtha, kisiyā varṇana kisiyā, bhiṅa, mabhiṅa lakṣaṇa || mattahāse o o guliyā nayā vicāla || khabhā o yā vicāla || hma saṃnyākanaṃ dyāla julasāṃ lyākhamayākayā hne layā || satvayā || kisiyāla hathālayā jyā || kisisa gonaviya pūjāyāya || kisiyā iṇgiita | kisiyā śānti || kisiyā vāsala || (fol. 1r1–5) «Sub: colophon:» iti śrījagaddhgarakṛte gajahotre jagotpattir nāma prathama uddeśaḥ || (fol. 2v2–3) End thva guli visama, vāyuyā vikāra siyadhaka, caṃpānagarayā aṃgarājāyā hva one pālakākhya ṛṣiśvaraṇa gajāyurvveda dhāyā guli vistāraṇaka sevijyāta || || (fol. 430r2–4) Colophon iti śrīpālakākhya gajāyurvvede mahāpravacane, śalyanāmnī tṛtīyakhyane (!) dantoddharaṇaṃ nāmāṣtāviṃśodhyāyaḥ || 28 || ❁ || ❁ || || ❁ || śubha || m astu sarvvadā || ❁ || || || (fol. 430r5–7) || samvat 850 caitrakṛṣṇa aṣṭamyāṃ tithau urdvabhadra(!) nakṣatra, siddhijoge dhanurāśi somavāla, thvakuhnu saṃpūrṇa yāṅā juro || śubha || || (fol. 430v1–2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || paihle hātti khedāgarnyā krama lekhinchan || hātikā varṇana || hāttikā śubha aśubha lakṣaṇa mada cuhyākā paihloko vicāra || svabhāvako vicāra || āṃgamā kṛmikīṭādile khāyi ṭoki ghāu bhayā pani namāṃnyāko vicāra || nidrāko vicāra || satvako vicāra || hāttiko vicāra || laḍāīmāko kāryya ||hāttilāī vidhipūrvaka sakuna gari maṃgalapūjā garnu || hāttiko iṃgita || hāttiko śāṃti || || hāttikā auṣadhi || eti savai karma gajahotramā kahaṃchan || || (fol. 1v1–6) End jaun hāttilaī nitya nitya pramāṇa sita khvāi rāṣyāko pāni ṣuvāī rāṣyāko aghikā ramāṇamā ghaṭibaḍhi bhayo bhanyā viṣama bhaṃnu || tyo visamavāyuko vikāra jāṃnu bhani caṃpānagarakā aṃgarājālāi pālakākhya ṛṣiśvarale gajāyurveda bhanyāko kathāhā vistāra sita kahadā bhayā || || (fol. 201r5–8) Colophon iti śrīpālakākhye gajāyurvede mahāpravacane śalyanāmni tṛtīya sthāne dantoddharaṇaṃ nāma aṣṭāviṃśodhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || || śubham astu sarva jagatām || || svasti śrīsaṃvat 1919 sāla miti kārttika śudi pūrṇimā śubham || || (fol. 201r8–10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo gaṇapataye || namo vāgdevyai || || athātaḥ kṣudrarogasthānaṃ dvitīyam ārabhyate || athavamathuḥ rogādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || aṃgo hi rājā campāyāṃ pālakākhyaṃ sma pṛchati (!) || vāraṇānāṃ va mathavaḥ saṃbhavanti kathaṃ mune || sādhyāsādhyaṃ cikitsāṃ ca tad vravīhi mahāmune || evaṃ pṛṣṭoṅgarājena, pālakākhyas tato vravīt || (fol. 1v1–3) End || iti vicyuta cikitsā || ❁ || kṣudraroga iti mayā yat te sthānaṃ prakīttitaṃ || (!) tat saptatibhir adhyāyaiḥ samāptaṃ sthānaniścayāt || ❁ || bhavati cātra ślokaḥ || ❁ || bhiṣag iha nu yathoktam etad evaṃ vidhim anusṛtya karoti yat cikitsāṃ || bhavati sa satataṃ nṛpeṇa pūjyo niyatamatir nṛparājyahastivaidyaḥ || ❁ || (fol. 115v 9–11) Colophon iti śrīpālakākhye mahāmunipraṇīte śrīgajāyurvvede mahāpravacane kṣudrarogasthāne dvitīye gātrarogo nāma dvisaptatitamo ʼdhyāyaḥ || ❁ || 72 || samāptaṃ kṣudrarogasthānaṃ śubham || śrīgajendravadanāyāmbikāsutāya namaḥ || || (fol. 115v11–116r2)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo mahābhairavāya || prāṇaṃ śaktimayaṃ mahārṇavayutaṃ ndadyāsane (!) drāvitaṃ kṣoṇīvahniṣu vāyuvījaracitaṃ arghāśapūrvvāvṛtaṃ | nābabhyendukalākalāpakalitaṃ devyā nirodhīkṛtaṃ, vande bhairava unmanaḥ kalimala (!) dhvaṃśāyamokṣāya ca || sarvveṣāṃ tatvato vyāpī natvārūḍhas tu māyayā | māyayāntarasaṃstīno prakāśayati bhāskaraḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) End ramamadhyaṃ samādāya okārāntena bhūṣitaṃ || khaphamadhyagataṃ varṇṇaṃ vindumastakabhūṣītaṃ elavandhugataṃ varṇṇaṃ ṭaṇavandhukṛtāsanaṃ (!) || bhayarandhraṃ samudhdṛtya (!) vindulāñchitaṃ priye || uvamadhyaṃ samādāya lathadhyakṛtāsanaṃ || ṭhahamadhya (!) tatodhṛtya krūra……………….||| (fol. 169v3–6) Colophon iti śrīmatottare śrīkaṇṭhanāthāvatārite candradvīpavinirgate yoginīguhye vidhyāpīṭhe śikhāsvacchandanirṇṇayo nāma dvādaśamaḥ paṭalaḥ || (fol. 114r6, v1–3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo gaṇeśāya || natvā kṛṣṇapadadvaṃdvaṃ brahmādisuravaṃditaṃ | guruṃ ca jñānadātāraṃ kṛṣṇanaṃdena dhīmatā || (tat tatraṃṭha (!)) gatā vākyān nānārthaṃn (!) pratipatya ca || saukāryyārthaṃ ca saṃkṣepāt taṃtrasāraḥ pratanyate || ucyate prathamaṃ tatra lakṣaṇaṃ guruśiṣyayoḥ || śāṃtādāṃtaḥ kulīnaś ca vinīta (!) śuddhaveśavān || suddhācāraḥ supratiṣṭhaḥ śucir ddakṣaḥ subuddhimān || āśramī dhyānaniṣṭhaś ca maṃtrataṃtraviśāradaḥ || nigrahānugrahe śakto gurur ity abhidhīyate || (fol. 1v1–2) End tad yathā || aṃ nivṛtyai namaḥ || āṃ pratiṣṭhāyai namaḥ || iṃ vidyāyai namaḥ || īṃ śāntyai namaḥ || uṃ ivikāyai namaḥ || ūṃ dipikāyai namaḥ || ṛṃ rocakāyai namaḥ || ṝṃ mocakāyai namaḥ || lṛṃ parāyai namaḥ || lṝṃ sūkṣmāmṛtāyai namaḥ || eṃ jñānāmṛtāyai namaḥ || oṃ āpyayinyai namaḥ || auṃ vyāpinyai namaḥ || aṃ vyomarūpāyai namaḥ || aḥ anamtarāyai namaḥ || śaktaś cet pratyekam āvāhya pādyādibhiḥ pūjayet || || tataḥ oṃ tādvaprāṃ (!) so vipanya vo jā gṛ- /// (fol. 18r9 and v1–2)

Beginning ❖ atha prāyaścittavidhirucyate || taduktaṃ liṃgāgame || śṛṇudevi(!) pravakṣāmi prāyaścittamanuttamam | tadisuddhirvidhiścaiva bhairaveṇā nibhāṣitam || guru tyāgakaraḥ śiṣyaḥ prāyaścittī bhaveddhruvam || lakṣaṃ śrī pādukā japtvā tasmātpāpādviśu dhyati (!) || mantratyāgakaraḥ śiṣyastatsaṃgaṃ naiva kārayeḍ(!) | lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ homa tarppaṇata śuciḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) End kapilāśva gajaṃ datvā yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ | tatphalā koṭI guṇitāṃ kaulikānāṃ prapūjane || kaulikaṃ nindayedyastu kulaśāstra parāyaṇaḥ | sa yāti narake ghore sadyaeva na saṃśayaḥ || tatprāyaścitta hīnānāmaśaktānāṃ kuleśvari divya vīrārccanaṃ teṣāṃ prāyaścittāya kalpate || || (fol. 5r7&v1–3) Colophon iti śrī rāghavabhaṭṭa viracite kālītatve prāyaścitta vidhau caturddaśatatvam || || ❖ || || (fol. 5v4–5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrītripurabhairavyai || namāmi tripurām ambāṃ tritribhedapurātanīṃ | parāditritribhedena vyāptasvātmapurutrayāṃ || praṇamya gurūm īśānaṃ bhaṭṭanāgaparābhidhaṃ | karomi ṭippaṇaṃ sārasamuccayaparasparaṃ || mantroddhāreṣu viṣamo grantho yaṃ sarvvasammataḥ | ataḥ tadartham evāsya udyamo ’nyatra leśataḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) End dhiyā japaḥ so ’tra svayaṃ nādo mantrātmā jappa (!) īdṛśaḥ || iti vijñānabhaṭṭārakanītyā punś cittaniveśanena pariśīlanarūpaḥ so ’tra vijayate || śrīmadgurūkaṭākṣapādavitriteṣu (!) vidapaścimajanmasu śivaprasādān nityaṃ sphuṭībhavatīti śivaṃ || (fol. 52r1–3) Colophon iti śrīmahāmaheśvarācāryyaśrīmacchaktīśvarānandanāthapādaśiṣyāmṛtānandakṛtaṃ śrītripurāsārasamuccayaṭippaṇaṃ smāpta (!) || || samvat 842 āṣāḍhakṛṣṇadvādaśī (fol. 52r6–7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo gaṇeśāya || natvā kṛṣṇapadadvandvaṃ brahmādisuravanditaṃ | guruñ ca jñānadātāraṃ kṛṣṇānandena dhīmatā || tattadgranthagatād vākyān nānārthaṃ pratipādya ca | saukaryyārthaṃ ca saṃkṣepāt tantrasāraḥ pratanyate || ucyate prathamaṃ tatra lakṣaṇaṃ guruśiṣyayoḥ | śānto dāntaḥ kulīnaś ca vinītaḥ śuddhaveśavān (!) || śuddhācāraḥ sapratiṣṭhaḥ śucir dakṣaḥ subuddhimān | āśramī dhyānaniṣṭhaś ca mantratantraviśāradaḥ | nigrahānugrahaśakto gurur ity abhidhīyate || (fol. 1v1–3) End evaṃ dhyātvā mānasaiḥ saṃpūjya bahiḥ pūjām ārabhet || apūjāyantraṃ || padmam aṣṭadalaṃ bāhye vṛttaṃ ṣoḍaśabhir ddalaiḥ | vilikhet karṇṇikāmadhye ṣaṭkoṇam atisundaraṃ || caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃm (!) evaṃ maṇḍalam ālikhet || tato dīkṣāpaddhatyuktakrameṇa saṃkhasthāpanaṃ kṛtvā sāmānyapaddhatyuktapīṭhapūjāṃ vidhāya pīṭhaśaktīḥ saṃpūjayet || tad yathā, pūrvvādikeśareṣu oṃ jayāyai, namaḥ evaṃ vijayāyai, aparājitāyai nityāyai vi/// (fol. 38r8–38v1) «Sub-colophon:» iti kṛṣṇānandavidyāvāgīśabhaṭṭācāryaviracite, tantrasāre prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ || || (fol. 28r9)

Beginning oṃ namo gaṇeśāya || kailāsaparvate ramye nānāratnopaśobhite || viparītaratāśaktā (!) caṃḍī papraccha śaṃkaraṃ || śrīcaṃḍikovāca || nirākāraṃ nirguṇaṃ ca stutiniṃdāvivarjitaṃ | sunityaṃ sarvakarttāraṃ varnātītaṃ (!) suniścalāṃ | saṃjñādirahitaṃ śāṃtaṃ kim ākāraṃ (!) pratiṣṭhitaṃ | tasmād utpattir deveśa kim ādhāreṇa jāyate || (fol. 1v1–3) End sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ saiva sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ | annadānena yat punyaṃ (!) homadānena yat phalaṃ | tat tat sarvaṃ gṛhasthasya nānyasya suravaṃdite || iti te kathitaṃ kāṃte caturāśramalakṣaṇaṃ | na vaktavyaṃ paśor agre sapatho me tvayi priye || ○ || (fol. 21r8–21v1) Colophon iti śrīnirvāṇataṃtre caturdaśaḥ paṭala (!) || 14 || ○ || (fol. 21v1)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrī3bhavānyai namaḥ || nirākārāgārā sakalaśrutisārā bhayaharā śiraśreṇīhārā vibhacayakārā bhayaharā || kṛpāpārāvārā pitṛgṛhavihārā †aśikarā† smṛtāhārāhārātararudhiradhārāsanaparā || || śrīpārvvaty uvāca || mahāvidyāṃ mahādeva kathayasva mama priyāṃ śubhravarṇṇā tu yā tārā bhāratī sā prakīrttitā sā kathaṃ nīlavarṇṇāśīt (!) smṛtā nīlasarasvatī || || ⟪sṛ⟫[[naṣṭaṃ]] sṛṣṭe mahādevī (!) naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame bṛhad aṇḍam abhūd ekaṃ sṛṣṭe (!) pūrvvaṃ mahattaraṃ tatra yajñe (!) svayaṃ viṣṇuś caturbhujasamanvita (!) tasya nābhau tato brahmā yajñe (!) sṛṣṭasya cākṣaye (fol. 1r1–8) End brahmā brahmatvam āpnuyāt nārāyaṇo[ʼ]pi lakṣmīśaḥ nīlakaṃṭhedum (!) avyaya (!) | itaḥ kiṃ phalabāhulyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate || jihvākoṭisahasrais tu vaktrakoṭiśatair api na śakyate mayā devi vaktuṃ nīlāmanophalaṃ (!) || || (fol. 23v2–5) Colophon iti śrīnīlataṃtre devīśvarasaṃvāde nīlasarasvatyā devadullaṃ nāma kavacaṃ ⟪‥‥‥‥‥⟫caturddaśaḥ paṭala (!) samāptaś cāyaṃ graṃthaḥ || śubhaṃ || (fol. 23v5–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīpratyaṃgirāyai || || saiṃhīṃ siṃhamukhīṃ varān trijagatāṃ protphullanetrotpalāṃ śūlaṃ sthūlakapālapāśaḍamaruṃ vyagogra(!)hastāmbujāṃ | daṃṣṭrākoṭiviśaṃkaṭāsyakuharām āraktanetratrayāṃ bhālendudviti(!)dīpitāṃ bhagavatīṃ pratyaṅgirāṃ bhāvayet || || asya śrīpratyaṅgirāmantrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ paṃktiś chandaḥ, śrīpratyaṅgirā devī devatā caturvarggasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || mandārasthaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ, bhagavantaṃ maheśvaraṃ | samupāgamya caraṇau, pārvvatī paripṛcchati || || śrīpārvvaty uvāca || bhāvayet paramāṃ vidyāṃ pratyaṅgirāṃ mahāvarāṃ | naranārīhitārthāya vīrāṇaṃ rakṣaṇāya ca | rājñāṃ māṇḍalikānāñ ca dīnānāñ ca maheśvari | viduṣāñ ca dvijātīnāṃ viśeṣāt sarvvasādhanaṃ | (fol. 10r3–6) End agneḥ śaityaṃ jalastambhaṃ gatistambhaṃ vivasvataḥ divārātrivyatyayañ ca vaśīkarttuṃ kṣamo bhavet | tāmbūlaṃ saghṛtaṃ dhānyaṃ tila†taṇḍulavaṃ† guḍaṃ javāpuṣpaṃ pa(dmā)śokaṃ sahasraikaṃ hunen niśi | ākarṣayat sadā rudre sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ tathā || pātālatalagañ cāpi kim alpabhūtale sthitaṃ || || (fol. 10r2–5) Colophon iti śrīkaraṅgiṇītantre umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde śrīpratyaṃgirādevīpaṭalaḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 10r5–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ śrīparamaśivaśaktiśrīśrīnātha-aśeṣapāraṃparyyakramasvagurupādāṃbujaṃ yāvat praṇaumi || yā †candre bhūtibhinnā† ravihavisadane gotracandraiś ca rudrair hṛnnābhau kandacakre tridahanakuhare dvādaśaikena saṃsthā | sṛṣṭisthairyyāntakarttī trikalakhakhayutā sarvvatattvaikavṛttiṃ tāṃ kālīṃ naumi nityaṃ paramapadamayīṃ satsadānandadātrīm || viśvamitraṃ vaśiṣṭhañ ca śrīkaṇṭhakuṇḍalīśvaraṃ | śrīkrodhaṃ mīnatālāṃkau vande śrīdharmadeśakān || praṇamya alakācāryapādapadmaṃ subhaktitaḥ || śrīvimalaprabodho[ʼ]ham akadaṇḍī śivātmakaḥ || samvīkṣya vidhivaj jñātvā pañcacāmaraśekharaṃ | pañcatriṃśatibhedāḍhyaṃ vakṣye śrīkālikārccanaṃ || (fol. 1v1–6) End nityanaimittikaṃ proktam uttarāmnāyasammataṃ | nirvighnaṃ siddhidaṃ puṃsāṃ bhaktānāṃ kālikātmanām || śrīmadānandaśaktyāakhyagurupādaniṣevinā (!) | prakāśaśaktinaptrā śrīdeśikenaiś(!) cātra guhyaṃ yad avatāritam | kālīkulamukhāmnāya (!) yatra lekhyaṃ hi pustaṃke (!) || svasty astu sarvajagatāṃ chidraṃ mābhūd akiñcana (!) | sā eva rakṣatu janān devadevīkaraṅgiṇī || || (fol. 66v3–67r2) Colophon paramahaṃsaparivrājakācāryaśrīśrīvimalaprabodhapādaviracitaṃ kālīkramārcanaṃ samāptam || || granthapramāṇam ity aṃkataḥ 700 || ❁ || ❁ || śubham astu || nepālahāyane jāte vyomavahni(surauṣadhe) || vaiśākheʼsita durgāyāṃ pūrṇṇaṃ tal likhitaṃ mayā || ❁ || (fol. 67r2–4)
