«Beginning:»' ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || || ināyakāyayā vidhi || || hṅathu kuhnu yāya vidhi || || ināyakolayātaṃ jhālejyāṅāvatāthe|| ekāplakābhūpasvāna akṣata || thvate duthāṅāva dayake salimelāsathāpuko puna taya || || pūjanaṃ || nyāsa || cetasi dhara jajamakā svāna taya || || gaṇapati mūlamantreṇa triyāñjali || 3 || dhūpadīpajāpastotra || || ināyakolasaṃ duthāṅāva taya || thvate hṅathu kuhnuyā vidhi || || santi kuhnuyā vidhi || (fol. 1v1–6) «End:» pūjā yāya paṃcopacālahnapāyātheṅa || dhūpa dīpa || jāpa stotra ||tvāya bhito cinake || vākya || sugrīvena ca rāmena mitrabandha purā kṛti | tathā prīti vivardhante yāvat candradivākarau || goya devastaṃ tayake || sākṣiyātaṃ viyake || ācārya sākṣi || thethe yi vithi viyācake || the the tvāya bhito dhāyake || samayacchā yāva || || mālakostaṃ samaya viya || || balivisarjana || || (fol. 16v1–5) «Colophon::» iti yinālite vidhi samāptaḥ || || śubham astu sarvadā || (fol. 16v6)

«Beginning:»' ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrī3 mahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || śrī3caṇḍikādevyai namaḥ || || atha kavaśisamahanina mahāstami navami daśamina ugracaṇḍā pañcopacāla devārcanavidhir likhyate || || devasnāna || vākya || ūkāraṃ vāyubījaṃ tad upari varuṇaṃ vajrapāṇiṃ tad ūrdhvaṃ | kāre varṇāntayuktaṃ tad upari paramaṃ vahnibījaṃ sahaṃsaṃ || induṃ binduṃ layāmtaṃ sitakamalavarakṣīradhārāsravantaṃ | dṛṣṭvā kūṭaṃ tu nityaṃ dahati kulamalaṃ merutulyaṃ hi pāpaṃ || || paṃcāmṛtasnāna || dudu || payasā payapūrṇaṃ ca pṛthivyāṃ pūta sarvvataḥ | kāmadhenuśravaṃ nityaṃ snāpayāmi śivājñayā || || dhali || (fol. 1v1–7) «End:» antaravākuhnuyā vākya || yajamāna mahāṣṭamīpārvvaṇyadevārccanapūjānimityarthaṃ karttuṃ kulamārttaṇḍamahābhairavāya arghaṃ namaḥ puṣpaṃ namaḥ || || mahānavamī kuhnuyā vākya || yajamānasya mahānavamī pārvaṇya(bhoga)devārccanapūjānimittyarthaṃ karttuṃ kulamārttaṇḍamahābhairavāya arghaṃ namaḥ puṣpaṃ namaḥ || || mahādaśamī kuhnuyā vākya || yajamānasya mahādaśamī pārvvaṇya balivisarjjanadevārccanapūjānimittyarthaṃ karttuṃ kulamārttaṇḍamahābhairavāya arghaṃ namaḥ puṣpaṃ namḥ || || śrī śrī jaya bhūpatīndramalladevasana thva saphuli dayakasa vijyātā juro || || samvat 831 bhādrapada vadi 13 thva kuhnu coya sidhayakā dina || || śubham astu sarvvadā || || || || (fol. 36r536v5) «Colophon::» iti ugracaṇḍadevārccanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || || (fol. 36r2–3)

«Beginning:» oṃ namaḥ śivāya || yo ‘bhyarcitaḥ suravarair varasiddhiheto cchettuṃ bhayānyatha kare paraśuṃ dadhānaḥ | devaḥ sa śambhudayitā paribarddhitaśrīr ]bighnān nivārayatu vāraṇarājavaktraḥ | vahan priyām aṅkagatā karāgre piyūṣapūrṇakalaśaṃ suśitaṃ dadhānaḥ | padmāsanastho khila candrahastaḥ prāleyakundendusudhāśitāṅgaḥ | brahmādimukhaiḥ suralokapālair abhyarcito yaḥ praṇataḥ stutaś ca | tvām eva taṃ bhairavam ādidevaṃ mṛtyñjayākhyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye || sa vyāpasavyabhujayor dadhad indubimbaṃ kuṃbhañ ca bhūri saudham abhrakaśubhrarociḥ | aṅke priyāṃ ca varadābhayapāṇir eṣa mṛtyuñjayo jayati sāñjaniśākarasthaḥ | piyūṣasindhulaharīśatasiktapadma- madhye sphurat tuhinaraśmimarīciśubhram | natvā maheśam amalaṃ kamalāsahāyaṃ abhyarcanaṃ vitanute ‘bhayamalladevaḥ | (fol. 1v1–5) «End:» tad yathā | oṁ jūṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ | iti saṃpūjya jātisvāhāntenāhutitrayaṃṃ datvā darbhamayaṃ kaṃkaṇaṃ devyā dakṣiṇakare bandhayed iti garbhādhānam | 1 | oṁ vyoṃ śirase namaḥ iti saṃpūjya sajātisvāhāntenāhutitrayaṃ dadyād iti puṃsavanam|| 2 || oṁ haṁ śikhāyai namaḥ | iti saṃpūjya sajātisvāhāntenāhutitrayaṃ sīmantonnayanam || 3 || vaktrakalpanā niḥsvāsaḥ sīmāgrīvādikalpanamathanena ca || 3 || oṁ hūṁ kavacāya namaḥ iti saṃpūjya sajātisvāhāntenāhutitrayaṃ dadyād iti jātakarmaḥ || 4 | oṁ jyoṁ netratrayāya namaḥ iti saṃpūjya | << scribe leaves few lines blank>> nmanā || itthaṃ ṣoḍaśāntathaḥ ṣoḍaśakalāntasthaḥ śivaḥ | paramīkaraṇādyavasare mūlamantrasyāmṛtarūpatvāt | candrakalātmakaś caiteṣāṃ vyāptiṃ kṛtvoccārayet dviraṣṭakakalopetaṃ praṇave yon a vindati | na so maṃtrī na cācāryo vṛthā kliṣyati karmasu | iti ṣoḍaśātmako mūlamantro vyākhyātaḥ || || śrīdevābhayamallena sadācāropadeśinā śrīmṛtyuñjayadevasya nityapūjāvidhiḥ kṛtaḥ || || (fol. 6r10–7v3) «Colophon::» ity amṛteśvarapūjanaṃ samāptam || || || || || (fol. 7v3)

«Beginning:»' ❖ oṃ gaṇādhipataye namaḥ || snātvā pūjāgṛhanikaṭam āgatya caturhastā bhubale sthitvā oṃ devi duprakṛtacittaṃ pāpākrāntam abhūn mama | tan nissāraya cittān me pāpaṃ phaṭ phaṭ te namaḥ || sūryyaḥ somo yamaḥ kālo mahābhūtāni pañca ca | ete śubhāḥ śubhasyeha karmaṇo na ca sākṣiṇaḥ | iti mantratrayena prāyaścittādyaniṣṭāni pāpāni dehānnisṛtāni vicintya || oṃ vajrodake hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti jalagrahaṇaṃ || || oṃ hrīṁ viśuddhadharma sarvvapāpāni śamayāśeṣavikalpān apanaya hūṁ svāhā iti pādaprakṣālanaṃ || || oṁ hrīṁ svāhā ityācamanaṃ || || (fol. 1v1–4) «End:» iti khaḍgaṃ || vāgīśvarīsahita brahmaṇe namaḥ || iti tanmuṣṭiṃ lakṣmīsahitāyā nārāyaṇāya namaḥ || iti tanmdhyaṃ || umāsahitamaheśvarāya namaḥ || iti tad agraṃ saṃpūjya oṁ khaḍgāya khalanāśāya śaktikāryāya tatparaḥ || paśucchedas tvayā śighraṃ khadganātha namo stu te || iti khaḍgam abhimantrya oṃ adya śrīdakṣiṇakālikāprītyartham amuṃ chāgaṃ agnidaivataṃ ahaṃ ghātayiṣye || iti saṃkalpya paśoḥ śiro dhṛtvā oṁ yajñārthe paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayameva svayambhuvā | atas tvāṃ ghātayiṣyāmi tasmād yajñe vadho ‘vadhaḥ || śivāyattam idaṃ piṇḍam atastvaṃ śivatāṃ gataḥ | udbudhyasva paśoḥ tvaṃ hi nāśivastvaṃ śivosi hi || iti bodhayitvā khaḍgam ādāya oṁ kraḥ astrāya phaṭ chindi chindi svāhā || iti mantreṇa mūlena ca paśuṃ cchedayet || vāmabhāge patite aśubhaṃ || ekaghātitena apatite pyaśubhaṃ || tat praśamanārthaṃ mūlena pañcādaśāhutir juhuyāt || tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇamya saṃhāramudrāṃ pradarśya saparivān svahṛdaye udvāmayet || tato mūlena śirasi nirmālyaṃ ghṛtvā naivedyaṃ bhaktebhyo datvā svayam api bhuñjīta || || (fol. 12r6–12v3) «Colophon::» ity ambikānityapūjābidhiḥ || || || (fol. 12v3)

«Beginning:»' ❖ oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya || nekasaṃ bhūmiśodhana yāye || yathāvidhina balipūjā na juroṃ || ācāḍa hāsyaṃ || bhūṃkhane rape || coyā lakṣaṇa soya || toyūcā brāhmaṇajāti || jyāṅū kṣatrī || trayū vaiśya || hākū śūdra || svādū || cākū brāhmaṇa || phākū kṣatri || pālu vaiśya || khāyū śūdya || gandha || mākūnaṃ brāhmaṇa || hinaṃ kṣatri || yoninā vaiśya || viṣṭhānā śūdra || jaṃtu || ṅā vyāṅa kāpaleṃ thvate lūkāle bhiṃgva | vī vicchu kakaḍe vitimācche bhuriṅā || thvate lukāle mabhiṃgva mṛtyu viyu || (fol. 1r1–4) «End:» atha viṣṇulakṣāhutividhir likhyate || tataḥ prātaḥsnānādinityakarma kuryāt || maṇḍapād bahir naiṛtye diśi yajamānena sūryārghādi ṛtvijadvayācāryyapādaprakṣālaṇaṃ(!) || naiṛtyadvārāgre ācāryo baliṃ dadyāṭ || kṣetrādigṛhanāmākṣareaṇavaṭukahetukādi asitāṅgādimātṛkādibhyo baliṃ dadet || oṃ ghṛtaṃ ghṛtapā || oṃ kṣauṁ narasiṃhāya baliṃ gṛhṇa 2 svāhā || oṁ viṣṇorarāṭaṃ || punar baliḥ || oṃ vviśveksenāya vau namaḥ || oṃ viṃ vāṃ hṛdayāya 2 || hṛdi || oṃ svakavisvāhā || śirasi || oṃ se vūṃ vaṣat || śikhāyāṃ || oṁ viśvak vai vauṣaṭ || (fol. 8v7–10 «Sub-colophon::» iti adhivāsanavidhiḥ || (fol. 8v7)

«Beginning:»' atha karmmācārya pādasthāpanayā pañcabalyārcanavidhiḥ || brāhmaṇasyaṃ kalaśārcanaṃ vā yajñamvā yācake || ācāryasyaṃ brāhmaṇasa javasa coṅā va pañcabali viya || bali pāṭa 4 bhevatagva 1 || puṣpabhājana || sūryyārgha || gurunamaskārādi || śikhānyāsa || jalārghapātrapūjā || bhūtaśuddhi | | ātmapūjā || || śrīsaṃvarttāna āvāhana || trideva 3 || || vaṃthu balipūjā || susāsanāya namaḥ || aiṁ 5 gāṃ gīṁ guūṁ gaiṁ gauṁ gaḥ gaṇapateśvarāya pādukāṃ || baliḥ || oṃ hūṁ ūrdhvakeśaṃ ca raktākṣaṃ kṣetrapāla vṛkodara ehi ehi 2 tutu 2 muru 2 kha 2 la 2 hana 2 paca 2 bighnabhairavarūpeṇa pādukāṃ || (fol. 1r1–4) «End:» thvanalīm brāhmaṇasyaṃ devalaṃ sole vaṃne || ācādane yajñayā javasa karmmathaṃḍili cosyaṃ hayāvate || iṣṭadevatāstaṃ ādina hola baliṃ mālakote || pūjana thava thava mantraṇa thaṇḍilisa lātasā karmmārcana yāya malātasā karmmapūjā juko yāya || dhūpa dīpa mohanī phaya naivedyādi japa stotraḥ || || thvanali brāhmaṇasa vonāpaṃthira hāre vaṃne || deśabali viya || || dakṣiṇā dhuna ṅāva || aṣṭabhairavabali cchoya || pūrvvādi īśānāntaṃ brahmāṇyādi aṣṭapīṭhasa || madhye bherusa || deśabali cchoya || karmmabali thāya 2 sa cchoya || jayamānamohanī svāna viya || thaṇḍile hlāya || || thānasa pūjā vane || iṣṭadevatāska māle māle 2 pūjā cchoya || (fol. 26v1–5) «Colophon::» thvate karmācāryayā devasthāpanayā aṣṭābhairavabalyārcanavidhiḥ samāptā || samvat 811 ṅārttika śukla navamī thva kuhnu śrīśrīsumatijayajitāmitramalladevasana dayakā juroṃ || || (fol. 26v6–7)

«Beginning:»' … mahākaulake yo netrāmṛtabhairavoktamatake vyāpyasthito duskṛtāt || 5 || tattu daśana (!)rūpato vibhutayā sā vāraṇatve sthito viśva bhuktaphalapradaika rasiko mṛtyuñjayo nityaśaḥ | kāruṇyāmṛtavārisecanatayā sāṃsārikān bodhayan ma+śrīgururūpavāraṇatayā devo ‘mṛtīśo ‘vatāt || 6 || jyotīrūpaṃ paramaṃ śāṃtam akṣaraṃ paramāmṛtaṃ | namasyāmi mahādevaṃ amṛtīśaṃ śriyā yutam || 7 || vāmotsaṅge mahādevīṃ śriyaṃ lokaikamātaram | udvahan paramānandacamatkāreṇa ghūñcitam | 8 | (fol. 1v1–4) «End:» bhairavasyāmṛtīśasya dīkṣāṭippaṇakaṃ sphuṭam | viśveśvareṇa racitaṃ sajjanāṃścarcayan tvidam || 8 || mātsaryamutsārya vicārya yuktyā sadbhiḥ sahālocya maheśadīkṣāṃ | viśveśvareṇa racitā vara deśikās tām samyak prabuddhamatinā khalu carccayantu || 9 || mayā svabhaktyullāsena kṛtaṃ dīkṣā suṭippaṇam | śarvaḥ sarvaṃ na jānāti tasmāt kṣamatha deśikāḥ || 10 || tathāpi || viśveśvaraḥ sakalatattvamahābhyagarbhaṃ devasya candraśirasaḥ khalu tattvamūrtteḥ dīkṣākramaṃ sakalaśaivamahārthaśāstraṃ jñānapra++matinā racitaṃ mayaitat || 11 || yo jānāti kulakramaṃ parapadaṃ śaivaṃ tathā gāruḍaṃ vaināyakyapadaṃ ca cāṇḍamatakaṃ sauraṃ ca viśveśvaraḥ | śrīcandrāmṛtabhairavasya vidhinā dīkṣākramaṃ tāttvikaṃ śambhor vaktrasamudbhavāgamadhiyā teneva tannirmitam || 12 || || (fol. 19r1–5) «Colophon::» iti śivasatasrotāgamagaṇābhiprāyād uddhṛṭāmṛtīśanetrodyotā ‘pratihatamahādīkṣā saṭippaṇakaṃ amāptam || || || || || (fol. 19c5–6)

«Beginning:»' etāṃ jñātvā yajen mantrī sukhamokṣamahāphalāṃ | vidyāratnaṃ pravakṣyāmi śrutvā karṇe vataṃsayā | māyādvayaṃ kūrccayugmam aitrāntaṃ modanatrayaṃ | māyāvindvīśvarayutaṃ dakṣiṇe kālike padaṃ || saṃhārakramayogenabījasaptakam uddharet | ekaviṃśatyakṣarādyas tārādyaḥ kālikā manuḥ || pūrvoktamantravat kuryāt sarvvapūjāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || iti kālitantre pñcamaḥ paṭalaḥ (exp. 2t1–4) «End:» khaḍgo bhinnendubimbasravad amṛtarasāplāvitāṅgī trinetrā savye pāṇau kapālā kulamasṛjamatho muktakeśī pibantī | digvastrābaddhakāñcīmaṇimayamukuṭādyair yutā dīptajihvā | pāyānnīlopalābhā laviśaśivilasat kuṇḍalālī tṛpādā(!) | japed viṃśatisāhasraṃ sahasraikena saṃyutaṃ ||| homayet tad daśāṃśena mṛddhapuṣpeṇa tarita(!) | trikoṇa (exp. 9:3–6) «Sub-colophon::» iti śrīkālītantre vīrasādhanapaṭalaḥ || || (exp. 6t5)

«Beginning:»' ❖ oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya || vārāhītantre || śrībhagavānuvāca || gītā japyavidhiṃ vakṣye yathāvat parameśvari | tīrthe vā oarvatāgre vā abhāve ca nadāntike || dhā +++gurūmūle vā viṣu rudragṛheṣu ca |\ nārāyaṇan namaskṛtya gaṇeśañ ca śivaṃ tathā || brahmāṇaṃ samarīciñ ca durgāṃ devīm sarasvatīṃ || hṛdi daur nnābhi pādeṣu 〈〈tarjjanyāditato nyaset〉〉 pāde vaktre tathā nyaset | vinyasya tu tato mantrī śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ || oṃkārañ ca nakārañ ca dvayam aṅguṣṭhayor nyaset | (śeṣe hastatalaṃ yāvat) tarjanyādi tathā nyaset || mokāraṃ vāmakaṭyāñ ca nākāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset | adhaścordhvañ ca hṛdaye pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭhatogrataḥ | dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ paścāt japet tat kavacaṃ budhaḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) «End:» dakṣiṇācārayogena bhukṣunāṃ paramā kalā | anyad ācārayogena āśu siddhiphalaṃ labhet | vaidikaiḥ dakṣiṇācāraiḥ kaivalyaṃ kevalaṃ phalaṃ | ata eva mahādevī praṃbrahmasvarūpiṇī | śabdabrahma vijānīhi sākṣād varṇāsvarūpiṇī | vindumālinī villekhā hṛllekhā śrīparākalā || ṣaṭkūṭā navakūtā ca lopāmudrā trikūṭikā || pañcamī pañcakāminyā vidyā śrīkāmarājakam || ṣoḍaśārṇā mahāvidyā sā vai śrīparamāparā || parāyuktā ca prāsādaḥ śāmbhavaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ || pañcasiṃhāsanaiḥ sevyā śrīmat tripurasundarī | sākṣāj jāgrat svarūpī ca vaiṣṇavī paradevatā || sarvasvarūpiṇī nityā prakṛtiḥ parameśvarī | sarvvajīvasvarūpā ca cidātmātmasvarūpiṇī || sarvvotpattihetubhūtā yonir ityabhidhīyate || siṃhāsanasvarūpāyā ūrdhvāmnāyaṃ mayoditaṃ || (exp. 51–5) «Colophon::» ity urdhvāmnāyavivaraṇaṃ || adhāmnāyaṃ (!) śṛṇu (exp. 5:5)

«Beginning:»' ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || || nakasa kuṇḍa hmuha thāyasa ācātana bali viyake || bhevata bali gvaḍa 1 || arghapātra voya || || laṃkhana hāya || ūkāraṃ vāºº || candanādi yāya || sūryārgha || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramallavarmaṇaḥ śrīº sveṣṭadevatāprītyarthaṃ pāṣāṇanirmitaprāsādopari śrīśrī umāmaheśvarasthāpana sahasrāhutuyajña agnikuṇḍapādasthāpana bhūmiśodhana bvalyārcanakarttuṃ kulamārtaṇḍamahābhairavāya arghaṃ namaḥ || varṇāntaṃ bījetyādi || || gurunamaskāraḥ || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalāºº || (fol. 1v1–7) «End:» thvanaenaṃ bali || || jayādi || śrījayādevīpādukāṃ || śrīvijayādevīpādukāṃ || śrī ajitādevīpādukāṃ || śrī aparājitādevīpādukāṃ || śrījambhanī devyai pādukāṃ || śrīstambhanī devyai pādukāṃ || śrīmohanīdevīpādukāṃ || śrī ākarṣanīdevī pādukāṃ || oṃ hūṁ sarvabighnakṛtebhyo sarvabhūtebhyo pādukāṃ || baliṃ gṛhna 2 svāhā || triyāñjali || aiṁ kāṁ kīṁ kūṁ keṁ kaiṁ koṁ kaḥ ▒ kalaṃkamahābhairavāya pādukāṃ || 3 || ṣaḍaṃga || hrāṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ || tyādi || bali || āvāhanādimudrāṃ || || tvāka mahābalina dhunake || bindutrayaṃ 3 || mudrāṃ || || dhūpa || divyagandhasa (fol. 2v5–11) «Colophon::» x

«Beginning:»' ❖ aiṁ krīṁ śrīṁ hsauṁ || oṃ ❖ hrīṁ namo bhagavati ugracaṇḍe ▒ trailokyatrāṇakāriṇi ▒ sarvvavṛndārakasvarūpiṇi aiṁ sarvasvarūpiṇi hrīṁ sarvamātṛbalapradāyini śrṁ prakṛtisvarūpi ▒ viṣṇumāye ▒ māhāmāye jaya2 sarvatkṛṣtasarvavyāpiṇi oṃ hūṁ saḥ mahāmṛtyuporasamaṇi ▒ sarvvadevaśarīriṇi oṃ durge 2 rakṣiṇi rāṁ svāhe hrīṁ māye dhruve vāṃ svadhe kīrtye jaṃ 3 jāgartti prameye śāśvate klīṁ vada 2 ▒ paro vāgvādini ▒ nityānande hūṁ sarvvaśatrudalani lāṁ vāṁ rāṁ yāṁ hrāṁ brahmaviṣṇurudraīśvarasadāśivapañcātmaka hrāṁ hrīṁ hūṁ hreṁ hroṁ hraṁḥ mahāpretāsanasthe caṇḍike yugānti bhrāmaya 2 mardda 2 kāmākarṣiṇi aiṁ klīṁ sauḥ tripure … (fol. exp. 3t1–3b5) «End:» klīṁ aiṁ strīṁ mahākṣobhakāriṇi bhagavati ugracaṇḍe ▒ ▒ ▒ ▒ ṅañaṇaname aghorāmukhi aghoreśvari mama sarvvaśatrūn mardda 2 rājyaṃ dhanaṃ dehi 2 āyuṃ barddhaya 2 sarvvastrīpuruṣarājavaśaṃ kuru 2 parabalaṃ kṣobhaya 2 sarvvasiddhiṃ me prayaccha 2 sarvvāṇi kāryyāni me sādhaya 2 prasīda 2 hrāṁ hrīṁ hrū ▒ ▒ aiṁ hrīṃ śrīṁ ▒ ▒ oṃ hrīṁ phaṭ 5 nama svāhā || (exp. 5b4–7t4) «Colophon::» x

«Beginning:»' … tyuktaṃ sarvvadevopi yo ruhā || āghrāṇaṃ sarvvadevānāṃ dhūpoyaṃ prati(gṛhyatām) || ++++ṣū bhagavān viśvarūpī maheśvarī | dhūpenānyena (!) deveśi suprītāṃ parameśvarī || || (dīpa) || suprakāśo mahātejaṃ sarvvatas timirāpahaṃ | śavāhyābhyantaraṃ(!) yoti(!) dīpoyaṃ pratigṛhyatām || jyoti daśytāmi(!) || || || naivedya || anna(ṃ) mahārasaṃ divyaṃ aśeṣa sarvvasamvitaṃ | mayā niveditā bhyāktyā(!) gṛhāna parameśvarī || (!) naivedya(ṃ) gṛhyatāṃ devi bhaktiṃ me acalāṃ kuru || apamṛtyuharaṃ devi paratre ca parāṃ gatiṃ || phala-puṣpa-tāmbūla-dhūpa-dīpa idaṃ naivedyaṃ namaḥ || || (fol. 1v1–7) «End:» atra gandhādi || || śāntir astu || || puṣṭir astu || supratiṣṭhā varadā bhavantu || visarjanaṃ || kaḥ astrāya phaṭ || || tāmbūlādi || || kalaṃka coya || || kaumāli sa || ekāneka || ambepūrvva || kuhmala bhujāyā yajamānastaṃ svāna viya || || kuhmalabhujā visarjjanaṃ || || sarvvamaṅgalamāṅgalye śive sarvārthasādhake (!) || śaraṇye tryambike (!) gauri nārāyaṇi namo stu te || || sākṣi thāya || || (fol. 151r 6–11) «Sub-colophon(s)::» iti vīrabhojya samāptaḥ || (fol. 150v11) iti kā(mā)rijāgārccaṇavidhi samāpta (!) || || (fol. 151r11)

«Beginning:»' sarvvatas timirāpahaṃ | sabāhyābhyantaraṃ jyoti dīpo yaṃ pratigṛhyatāṃ || || pratiṣṭha || pratisthitosi deva tvaṃ supratiṣthā bhuvanatrayam || (!) sāniddhyeṃ pratigṛhnāsi yajamānādi bṛrddhaye | (!) saṃ no stu dvipade nityaṃ saṃ noi rājyaṃ tathaiva ca | yajamāna subhūto yaṃ suputrapaśubāṃdhavaṃ | rakṣa tvaṃ sarvvakāreṣu deśaṇabhairava namo stu te || supratiṣṭhā varadā bhavantu || || hnaskarakene pūrṇṇacandranibhaṃ śubhraṃ darppaṇaṃ śatrudarppa hā || ātmabindudahraṃ yasya saṃprādāya jayāya ca || kumārīvisarjjana || || sākṣi thāya || thana mālako baliṃ kumāri cchoya || || (fol. 5r1–6) «End:» mānavā tanum āsṛtya pālitaṃ tan nṛmaṇḍalaṃ | arccito si mayā deva kṛtvā maṇḍalapūrvvakam | mayā kṛtasya yajñasya yathāśaktyānurūpitaṃ || idam indraya (!) kalaśaṃ tava bhāgyaviośeṣataḥ || saumānasena manasā gṛhyatāṃ vasudhādhipa || puraskāravihīnāya tatsarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ prabho || agni yāta agnikalaśaṃ taya || hotā yāta ūrdhvakalaśaṃ || topūyata aghakalasaṃ || jośio yata svastikakalasaṃ || ācātayatā aṃgālakalasa || ṛca diyatā vedikalasaṃ || jadurvvadiyātā vedikalasaṃ || śānvediyātā vedikalasaṃ || atharvvediyātā vrdikalasaṃ || || mālako upari kalasaṃ hlā || || ārati || suprakāśo mahāteja sarvvatas timirāpahaṃ || sabāhyābhyantaraṃ jyoti dīpo yaṃ pratigṛhyatāṃ || || … (fol. 37r4–37v1, ) «Colophon(s)::»

«Beginning:»' nā | cintāmaṇi tu sā śrīmān || dadau mātā kujeśvarī || trayāṃjali || aiṁ 5 ▒ ▒ aghorā rāṣṭra || bali || kuṃbha yoni mudrā || stotra || yā sā kāmāṅgadhenū śravati parokalābrahmanirvvāna(!)randhre || candrādityāgnimadhye prakaṭiguṇanidho pañcadravyādhikāri | raktā paṃcabhujāva vasati guhagrahe nādagadbhaṃramokṣaṃ sā devī divyarūpā dadatu mama sadā daṣṭa riddhipradātā (!) || atra gaṃdhādi || || tato vetīsi yoginī bali || aṁ caṇḍāyai bali gṛhna 2 svāhā || ghoṁ ghaṇṭātai baliṁ gṛhna 2 svāhā || raṁ mahānandāyai baliṃ gṛhna 2 svāhā || (exp. 2:1–6) «End:» bali || aṁ 5 hrīṁ gāyatrī ▒ ratnanāgalokagarbhagāminī nāgalokaamṛtasaṃcāriṇī nāgānandadevanāgāmbā catvārilakṣakoṭiyoginī 3 || || bali āvāhanādi || veśabalimudrā || stotra || seṣaraṃ sarvvavīryāni balavīryyavivarddhanaṃ | bhogyamokṣasadālakṣmī rudrarūpaṃ namo stu te || tataḥ sarev carupūjanaṃ || ādhāracakrāsanāya 3 || || dhyāna || syāmavarṇapratīkāśaṃ caturbbāḥu trilocanaṃ | (exp. 27b2–6) «Sub-colophon(s):» iti candradvīpāvatāre śrīkaṇṭhanāthavirtacitaṃ arddharātrīdīpajāgārcanaṃ samāptaṃ || || ❁ || || (exp. 12t5–6) iti svacchandastuti || || (exp. 12b5) iti arddharātrīdīpajāgārccanapratyārambhadevārccanavidhi samāptaṃ || || ❁ || || (exp. 14b3)

«Beginning:»' ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīkujeśvaramahābhairavāya || kujāgnividhir likhyate || tataḥ kalaśāeccanaṃ || yajamāna puṣpabhājanaṃ || adya māsa nakṣatra || sūryārgha || gurunamaskāra || nyāsa || 5 oṃ jūṃ saḥ astrāya phaṭ || 5 oṃ jūṃ saḥ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || (5 ) oṃ jūṃ saḥ tarjjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || 5 oṃ juṃ saḥ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ || 5 oṃ jūṃ saḥ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ || oṃ jūṃ saḥ astrāya phaṭ || karaśodhanaṃ || (exp. 3A1–13) «End:» ❖ śāntikamantraḥ || 5śāntir dyaur antarikṣe kṣitir api ca tathā śāntiratnauṣadhīś ca viśvedevā hi śāntir vidhir api pavano vahni rudro stu śāntiḥ | vānaspatyaḥ praśāntīravirajanikaras te ca ohaṃ ca sarvvfe śāntyāhutyā ca yeṣāṃ svagurukavidhinā śāntipūrṇākṛtena svāhā ºº || atha puṣṭiṅāhutiḥ || 5devo mṛtyuñjayākhyo harividhikamalāpārvvatī skandamātṛ jirṇūr herambanātho manasijaṅapavā maṅgalāṣṭauṣadhīśaḥ | te vaḥ kurvvantu puṣṭiṃ dhanasutavanitāsaṃyutāṃ sarvvadā hi puṣṭyāhutyā ca yajñe svagurukavidhinā puṣṭipūrṇāhutena svāhā ºº || || (exp. 52t1–7) «Colophon(s):» x

«Beginning:»' ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || śrī 3 vārāhīdevī namaḥ || || yajamāṇa puṣpabhājana || oṃ adyādi || vākya || yajamānasya śrśrī jaya bhūpatīndramallavarmaṇaḥ sveṣtadevatāprītyarthaṃ navagṛhapraveśanimittyarthaṃ śrīśrīśrīvārāhīdevī nimittyārthena pañcopacālapūjākarttuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || || śrīsaṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadanihitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā || sṛṣṭa n〉āyacatuṣkaṃ akulakulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ || catvāro pañcakoṇyaṃ punarapi caturaṃ tarttato(!) maṇḍala (!) saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaṃ || (fol. 1v1–2r1) «End:» vārāhī ghoraraktāṅgī raktakeśī mahodarī draṃṣtrākarālagaṃbhīrā bārārkatejarūpiṇī kapā(la)mārikāmālā vicitrapuṣpaśobhitā | mahāmahiṣam ārūḍhā jvalitāṅgīsamaprabhā mīnāṅkuśakatṛkādyā hādābharaṇabhūṣitā || trinetrajvaritaṃ dehaṃ duṣṭadaityavināśinī | jayantikṣatrasthāne nimbabṛkṣasamāsṛtā nāgapīṭhe sthitā nityaṃ korarūpī namo stu te || || svānamālako stā viya || || astramantrana balivisarjana yāya || no siya || balibhokapūya || || sākṣi thāya || (fol. 43v7–44r7) «Colophon(s):» iti komārivaiṣṇavīvārāhīpūjāparddhati samāptaḥṃ || || || (!) «Beginning:»' -śvosānā(!) śrīlalitārūpatayā ca dhyānaṃ kuryāt athavāmātṛkā bhūta navanātha navagraha ṣaṭtriṃśat tattva ṣoḍaśanityāghaṭikārrṇa rāśi śrīcakra tadbhagna ṣaṇnavatiśaktirūpadaśadevatānāṃ pratyekam ekaikarūpatayā sarvasvāsān anusandadhyāt dvi adhyā 432 vṛttitaḥ ssusvasiti daśa mitā mātṛkāḥ | khākṣivahnā (++) 4320 kṛtyā bhūtam abhrābhravidhikaraparā 2400vṛttito nāgra khādyāḥ vyomavyomarttu 600 saṃkhyāḥ khaśaraśucibhuvaḥ 1358? khartturāmāḥ 360 khakhāṣṭakṣoṇī 1800 vāṇākṣidoṣv a 225 stanigharaśamukhāḥ vṛttisaṃkhyāḥ krameṇa || kiṃ vā mātṛkādi daśakīyasaṃkhyayā proktayābhiruṇotthaśaṣekaṃ | svāsamānam akhilaṃ tato matam mātṛkādisaśarūpam ekaśaḥ | iti ca śvāsadevatādisaṃgrahaḥ iti prātaḥkṛtyaṃ || || (exp. 2:1–4) «End:» idaṃ ca nityakarma yadi ajñānato na kṛtaṃ sāt tadā śataṃ vidyājapaḥ kāryyaḥ jñānapūrvvakatyāge dviguṇaḥ asakṛttyāge pratinimittam iti nyāyena pañcatrīṃśad dināvadhi dinabṛddhyā śatasaṃkhyā bṛddhiḥ yadi tu ṣaṭtriṃśaddinātmakaikaparyāyam abhivyāpyoktanityakarmatyāgaḥ kenāpy asvāsthyādinimittena syāt tadā punaḥ pūrvoktābhiṣekapūrvakamuktarītīprāptasaṃkhyāviśiṣṭajapātmakaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhāya punar nityakarma samācared iti saṃkṣepaḥ || || iti śiṣyācāraḥ || yasyodyotamatī satī guṇavatī mātāpitomāpati nāma premanidhītipaṃtakulabhūḥ kūrmācalojanmabhūḥ sūpāsyaṃ kṛtavīryajācyutapadaṃ tasmād (asāvudratāṃ) śrīvidyoditanityakarmakamalā syān nirmalapremakṛt || || (exp. 33t13–33b5) «Colophon::» iti śrībhāradvājakulaprasūtapaṃthopanāmaka kūrmācalāśritaparaṃparapremanidhiśarmanirmitā śrītantrarājānumataśrīvidyānityakarmakamalā saṃpūrṇā || || saṃvat 1817 || (exp. 33b5–6)]

«Beginning:»' ❖ atha javodakavidhiḥ || mālako jiya kāva || yajamāna puṣpabhājana || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotra yajamānyā śrī3 anantavratodyāpanaābhyodakabṛddhiśrārddhakartuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || siddhir astu kriyārambhe bddhir astu dhanāgame puṣṭireṣu(!) śarīreṣu śāntireṣu gṛhe tava || sarvvabighnipraśamanaṃ sarvvaśāntikaraṃ śubham || āyuputrañ ca kāmañ ca lakṣmī santati barddhanaṃ (!) || yathā vānaprahārānāṃ(!) kavacaṃ bhavatu (!) vāriṇaṃ || tat tad vaiva vidhātrāṇāṃ śāntir bhavantu vāriṇaṃ || puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi (fol. 1r1–1v1) «End:» dhūpa || dīpa || oṃ dhūrasi || oṃ tejosi || oṁ yā phalanī || oṃ annapate || oṃ mano jūti || pratiṣṭhā || || japa || stotra || anantasaṃsāravimocanāya sarvātmane sarvaguṇapradāya namostvanantāya maheśvarāya trailokyanāthāya varapradāya || atra gandhādi || visarjjana yāṅāva || duthusa lakṣmīpūjāyā sagona tayāthāsatāthe || tavacapaḍisa mālako kalasādi voyāvatāthe || dharmunipani ekabhaktayāyamāla || || (fol. 12v1–7) «Colophon(s):» iti adhivāsanavidhisamāptaḥ || || (fol. 12v6–7)

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīmahābhairaya (!) || atha kaumārārccanavidhir llikhyate || yajamānapasyabhājanaṃ | adyādi || vākya || yajamānasya mānavagotra,śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevavarmmaṇaḥ śrī3ākāśamahābhairavaprītyarthaṃ rathapratiṣṭhā tadupari surṇṇakalaśadhvajāvalohanabhairavāgnisahasrāhuti, ahorātrayajñe patyārambha, komālijāgāccana,pūjānimityarthaṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāmi || || śrīsaṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadanihitānandaśaktisubhīmā, sṛṣṭaṃ nyāye catuṣkaṃ, akulakulagataṃ paṃcakaṃ cānya ṣaṭkaṃ || catvāraḥ pancake ʼnyaṃ, punar api caturaṃ, tattvato maṇḍaledaṃ, saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ, bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśa || || (fol. 1r1–v1) «End» stotra || dhumābhaṃ dīptaṃ netraṃ galitarucijaṭātrīṇinetraṃ karālaṃ | haste khaḍga (ttu)kartṝtapadadhṛtaṃ, tīkṣṇaśūlaṃ kapālaṃ || cekrānte matsamāṃsasasavarasavividhāmoditapretasaṃsthā | mātaṅ(gā)śrīsahaiva sagaṇaparivṛtā naimi ucchiṣṭhanāthaṃ || atra gaṃdhādi || śāntir astu || puṣṭir astu || supratiṣṭhāvaradā bhavantu || visarjjanaṃ || kaṃ astrāya phaṭ || tāmbūlādi || || || kalaṃka cchoya || || kaumārī(sa) || ekāneka || ambe pūrvva || kuhmalapūjāpā yajamānastaṃ svānaviya || || kuhmalapūjā visarjanaṃ || || sarvvamaṅgalamāṅgalye śive sarvvarthasādhake | śaraṇye tryambike gaurī, nārāyaṇi namo ʼstu te || || sākṣithāya || (fol. 16v2–7) «Colophon» thvate komārīyā vidhi || ❖ samvat 821 phālguṇakṛṣṇatrayodaśī thvakuhnu śrī3ākāśamahābhairavasa rathapratiṣthā śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevasana yāṅā dina julo || śubha || sahasrāhuti bhairavāgni ahorātrayajña yāṅāva || śubhaṃ || ❖ samvat 823 bhādrapadakṛṣṇanavami puṣyanakṣatra bṛhaspativāra thvakuhnu śrīgaṇabhalali devala hloṅāva pratiṣṭhā yāṅā śrī2jayabhūpatīndramalladevasana || sahasrāhutibhairavāgniahorātra yajña yāṅā dina || śubhaṃ || (fol. 16v7–9)

«Beginning:»' oṁ namaḥ śrī agastyāya || || vratodyāpanayā viśeṣasamidhahomavidhiḥ || hnapaṃ grahayā niviśeṣa samidha homaḥ || caru paṃcāmṛta || arghapātra laṃkhana hāya || catusaṃskāra || mūlagāyatrina japa lape 7 || āhutimantra || ▒ aiṁ hrīṁ kaḥ || śrī gautamāya svāhā || || samidha || volasi || || veda || oṃ aśvatthevo || 1 || (exp. 2A1–16) «End:» chatra upānatavastra alaṃkāra hotā viye || || dakṣiṇā || vāyaṇī dānapratiṣṭhārthasuvarṇam agni daivataṃ tubham ahaṃ dade || stotra || namaste muniśārdūra lokānugrahakārakaṃ || vratasya pūrṇam evāstu munirāja namo stu te || atra gandhādi || kṣamasva || (exp. 15A 14–15B9) «Colophon(s):» agastyavratayā viśeṣa thvate juroṃ || gva 6 || deva 1 brāhmaṇa 1 topu 1 kuṇḍa 1 josi 1 ācāryya 1 || (exp. 15B10–14)

«Beginning:»' janārddanaḥ kva taraṇiḥ kvendraḥ kva devāsurāḥ | kalpāntārabhatodbhaṭa pramuditaḥ śeīsiddhiyogeśvaraḥ krīḍānāṭakanāyakp vijayate devo mahābhairavaḥ || 8 || mahākālaṃ mahāraudraṃ mahākṛṣṇāṃjanaprabhaṃ | sthūlarūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ kartṛkāpāladhāriṇaṃ || khaḍgapheṭaka dharaṃ devaṃ trinetraṃ jvalanaprabhaṃ | nasmaste stu mahākāla śatrusaṃhārakārakaṃ || 10 || mārkaṇḍeyo dviṣadrūpa bhaktānugrahāyāvatāraṃ (!) cakre paśca pracurakiraṇo brahmavid brahmakalpaḥ daityocchedapramuditavadanaṃ stotragarvvaprabhāvaḥ(!) soyaṃ devyā bhavatu bhavatāṃ śreyase caṇḍikāyāḥ || 12 || (exp. 2:1–6) «End:» saṃketaḥ siṃhakaḥ proktaṃ ambā ca guhavāsinī | gṛhaṃ cadrapuraṃ proktaṃ bhedo manthā(na)bhairavaṃ || gotramamarikādevī (!) vāmamārge prakīrttitā | anvayaṃ pratyayaḥ sāre hyadhikāraś ca koṅkaṇe | janma brahmaśilā sthāne sthiti śrīkāmarūpake || kīrttiś ciñciṇibṛkṣe ca siddhiś caivātra sāgare || tuṣṭā tvaṃ tasya deveśi yo jānāti kulākramaṃ || ṣoḍaśādhārabhedena nyāsaṃ kūṭaṃ kraman tathā || pūjitaṃ siddhidaṃ bhadraṃ suśiṣyāya nivedayet || ○ || oṃ namo stu te mahāmāye sūkṣmadehe parāpare || ekāṅkini (!) viśuddhātmā nādākhye vindumālinī | (exp. 19:1–6) «Colophon(s):» x

«Beginning:»' || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ asya śrīpaṃcamukhīvīrahanumān(!) maṃtrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ śrīpaṃcamukhīvīrahanumān devatā mahattātmajaḥ iti bījaṃ aṃjanīsūnur iti śaktiḥ vāyuputra iti kīlakaṃ mama sakala caturvidhaphalasidhī dvārā hanumān prasādasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ oṃ hrāṃ sarvajñāya aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ hrīṁ nityatrayāya tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā oṁ hrūṁ anādibodhāya madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ oṁ hreṁ svataṃtrāya anāmikābhyām hrauṁ aluptaśaktaye karatalakarapṛṣthābhyāṃ maṣaṭ (!) evaṃ hṛdayādinyāsaḥ (fol. 1v1–6) «End:» asya śrībrahmāstaṃbhanahanumān mantrasya kālarudraṛṣiḥ gāyatrīchaṃdaḥ vairāṭasvarūpavāyuputro devatā maṃbījaṃ hrīṁ śaktiḥ glauṃ kīlakaṃ mama īṣṭārthasiddhyarthe jape vīniyogah(!) oṃ aṃºº hrīṁ taºº klīṁ maºº aiṁ aºº glauṃ kaºº hūṁ kaºº evaṃ hṛdayādi bhurbhuvasvaromīti digbaṃdha atha dhyānaṃ rāmabhaktaṃ mahābīraṃ ravikoṭisamaprabhaṃ rākṣasāntakamṛtyugraṃ rāmadūttaṃ(!) mahaṃ(!) bhaje 1 kecit pāṭhaḥ manuḥ oṃhrīṁ klīṁ aiṁ glauṃ huṁ yaṃ soṣaya 2 yaṃ grāhaya 2 yaṃ vīdāraya 2 yaṃ sthaṃ bhasmīkuru 2 yaṃ sphura yaṃ prasphura 2 yaṃ glauṃ hūṃ amukaṃ huṃ phaṭ svāhāḥ brahmāstra upasaṃhara (fol. 7r2–8) «Colophon(s):» iti śrīharagaurīsaṃvāde āṃjaneyāstra saṃpūrṇaṃ śrīhanumate namaḥ śrī (fol. 7r8)

«Beginning:» ❖ athānta agnikāryaṃ vakṣet (!) || kuṇḍa(+)bhipuraskṛtyottarābhimukham upaviśaṃ || kuṇḍasaṃskāraṇaṃ kṛtvā kuryād yathā || svāhā aṣṭrāya phaṭ || ṭāḍanaṃ 1 || prokṣaṇaṃ 2 || khananaṃ || 3 || udharaṇaṃ || 4 || secanaṃ || 5 || strīphreṃ kavacāya huṃ || samājanaṃ || 6 || lepanaṃ || 7 || pūjanaṃ || 8 || akṣavātanaṃ 9 || astreṇa trśū triveṣṭanaṃ || kuṇḍaṃ || 10 ḍāḍi kuṃḍasaṃskāra sodhayet || ○|| oṃ phreṃ hṛdayāya nama || kālī kuṇḍāya namaḥ || pūjanaṃ || visurāropanaṃ || homasiṃtaṃna || || kālīvāgeśvarīyaḥ āgaccha 2 || svāhā || dhyāna || (fol. 1v1–8) «End:» nāyakaṃ khecarīyuktaṃ nakāreṇasamanvitaṃ || layo sobhitaṃ kerāga 2 maṃ || 13 || śīta+madhyastho māṣikā ca mahākalā || 14 || brahmarandhrakaṃnthastrīkāraveṣṭitaṃ śubhraṃ svāminīkalitaṃ kuje || 15 || hāyaśobhitaṃ hāminīkalayānvitaṃ rūḍhaṃ śirasadhīmāsṭhitasodaśāntaṃ catupīṭhaṃ svapaṃcakaṃ || taṃ sthitaṃ vedanaṃvakaṃ lagnasthā tu bṛhitaṃ | sasthaṃ vedasmaśānaṃ sthaṃ ca grathordha śmasanesthitaṃ | kṣakāre vedacakrāṇi nābhimūle sikhākulaṃ tribhikā (fol. 8v9–13) «Colophon(s):» x

«Beginning:»' ❖ oṃ namaḥ hariharābhyāṃ || govindamādhamamukunda sre murāre śambho śiveśa śaśiśekharaśūlapāṇe || dāmodrācyutajanārdanavāsedeva || tyājyā bhaṭāya iti santatam āmananti || gaṃgādharāndhakaripu hara nīlakaṇṭha || vaikuṇṭhakaiṭavaripukamaṭhābjapāṇe || bhūteśakhaṇḍaparaśo mṛḍacaṇḍikeśa || tyājyā bhaṭāya iti santatamāmananti || viṣṇonṛsiṃhamadhusūdanacakrapāṇe || gaurīpategiriśaśaṃkaracandracūḍa || nārāyaṇāsuranibarhaṇaśārṅgapāṇē || tyājyā bhaṭāya iti santatamāmananti || mṛtyuñjayograviṣamekṣaṇakāmaśatro śrīkāntapītavasanāṃbudanīlaśaure | īśānakjṛttivasanatridaśaikanātha || tyājyā bhaṭāya santatamāmananti || lakṣmīpate madhuripo puruṣottamādya || śrīkaṇṭhadigvasanaśāntapinākapāṇe || ānandakandadharaṇīdhara padmanābha || tyājyā bhaṭāya iti santatamāmananti || (exp. 3t1–8) «End:» << MS contains the 12 different charts of the varṇa-yantra named such like: vajragahvara, amṛtasaṃjīvanīgahvara, mālinīnyāsagahvara etc. >> «Colophon(s):» x

«Beginning:»' ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya nama(!) || gurabhyau(!) nama ||(!) atha ṅāthā nayā urttara bali putha likhyate || panātiyā khāhoha coṅa kvāṭha pratiṣṭhāyānā dayakā || brāhmaṇa ācārya josi thvate neṃsthina hārāvava yāva || maṇḍapana pi urttara soyāya majina sā pūrvva soyaṃteva || pratiṣṭhā kuhnuyā velasa yāya || thvana hṅāonali dinapatiṃ rajasā rāsakarmmārccanayāya dhunaṅāva āya || (fol. 1v1–5) «End:» yajamānena laṃkhana (ycke) || adyādi || vākya || oṃ paśugṛhṇāśi deveśi prajñayā upavāsitaṃ | asyāpi svarggasaṃprāpti sihrinaayaccha me || || || mohāyakaṃ syāya || arghapātraṇa hāyāva śiradenakaṃ cchāya || || thvate dhuna ṅāva || ābharaṇa cetalāvali dakoskaṃ taya || samaya cchoya || vākya || namaḥ śrīnāthāya || namaḥ śrī siddhināthāya || namaḥ śrīkujeśanāthāya namo namaḥ || || … (fol. 22r6–23r2) «Colophon::» thvate sācayana urttarasa navarājapāṭhabalipūjā vidhiḥ samāptaḥ || ❁ || śubham astu sarvadā || samvat 828 jyeṣṭha vadi 9 saṃpūrṇaḥ || || saṃ 828 panātiyā khāhāsa coṅa kāṭhapratiṣṭhāyānā śrī3 jayabhūpatīndramalaadevasana dayakasya vijyākaḥ || maṃgalaṃ lekhakāñ ca pāṭhakānāñca maṅgalam || maṅgalaṃ lokakānāñca bhaumo bhūpatīmaṃgalaṃḥ || || ❁ || || (fol. 23r2–5)

«Beginning:»' ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ || agnikuṇḍapādasthāpanavidhi || vidhivat kalaśārcana || || kalaśayā livane kaṃcatapā cāḍākhikapilaṃ o ho pale pañcaratna ju 5 || phosi kila aṃ 12 || pu 36 || kākhipota || vāsura || nyāmugala || bali || hāmala || mvāca || māṭe || se || kṣilajā || ke || kuḍa || pūjā || asreṇa || oṃ akraṃ karma || dhūpa dia || jāpa || stuti || svarṇnakuḍārarūpastvaṃ bhūmikhanakarmaṇi || viśvakarmāyudhaṃ nityaṃ namos tu cāstramūrttaye || brāhmaṇapūjā || śāntika paṭhet || astreṇa kā kulavisarjanaṃ || || kuṇḍahmuya thāyasa || nṛvachanādi || dīpaliharakṣā || bhusa catusaṃskāra || nāsaka akṣata laṃkhana hāya || (fol. 1v1–5) «End:» oṃ bhadra karṇe || || oṃ jayāyai namaḥ || oṃ jāte rudraśivātanū || oṃ ṛktāyai namaḥ || oṃ ṛktāmayoḥ śilpe || oṃ pūrṇāyai namaḥ || oṃ pūrṇādarviparāpata || dhūpādi || atra gandhā || aṭapā visarjana || viśvakarmāpūjā || vaṃsuri ata viya || || suragnajura ṅāva svastika coyā va cālāya || lūṁ o hā padma pañcaratna taya || āgnyādina ata svane || || pūjana || nandādina 5 || || madhye samūlamantraṇa || hṛdayādi dhūpādi || atra gandhādi || sthilahāre || adyādi || oṃ hrāṁ nirbighnaṃ yajñakarmaṇi kuṇḍānāṃ pādane śubham || yāvat kāryakṛtaṃ karma tāvat tvañ ca sthiro bhava || oṃ sthirobhava viḍvaṅga || || maṅgalapaṭhet || || vedi ādina kalasa yātaṃ dānake māla || annasaṃkalpa || dakṣiṇādānaṃ || jayamānādibhiṣeka || candanādi āśirvvāda || || (fol. 2v1–6) «Colophon(s):» thvate kuṇḍapādasthāpanavidhi || || || || || || || (fol. 2v6)

«Beginning:»' ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || gurubhyo namaḥ || atha kaumārircanavidhir (!) likhyate || bhotayākvāṭhaptatisthā dayakā || yajamāna puṣpabhājana || adyādi || vākya || śrīsaṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadanihitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā || sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyan catuskaṃ akulakulagataṃ paṃcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ || catvāraḥ pañcakonyaṃ punar api caturaṃ tattvato maṇḍarena (!) || saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai nama(ta) guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaḥ (!) || śyāmā raktā trinetrā sṭaṇabhara(!)namitā martta(!) mātaṃgagāmi vimboṣṭhī cārunetrā pṛthutarajaghanā mekharā ratnaśobhe || devāṅge vastraśobhe varavarakusume varvvare keśabhāre || sā me śrīkubjikākhyā vitaratu tarasā jñānadivyaughamoghaṃ || (fol. 1v1–7) «End:» stotra || dhūmābhaṃ dīptanetraṃ galitarucijaṭā triṇi netraṃ karālaṃ | haste khaḍgaṃ tu karttṛtapadadhṛtaṃ tīkṣṇaśūlaṃ kapālaṃ || cakrānte matsamāṃsasamanasavividhā modita pretasaṃsthā || mātaṃgī śrīsahaiva sagaṇaparivṛtā naumi ucchiṣṭanāthaṃ || atra gaṃdhādi || śāntir astu || puṣṭir astu || (supratiṣṭhā varadā bhavantu ) || visarjanaṃ || kaṃ astrāya phaṭ || tāṃbūlādi || iti karaṃkapūjā || || karaṃka cchoya || kaumāri sa || ekāneka || ambepūrva || kuhmalapūjāyā yajamānastaṃ svāna viya || || kuhmalapūjāvisarjanaṃ || || sarvvamaṅgalamāṅgalye śive sarvārthasādhake (!) || śaraṇya (!) trambike (!) gaurī nārāyaṇi namo stu te || sākṣī thāya || vākya || (fol. 9v7–10r3) «Colophon(s):» thvate kaumārīyā vidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || samvat (828 ) caitrakṛṣṇa caturdaśī jīvavāra saṃpūrṇa saṃvat 828 śrīśrībhūpatīndramalladevasana bhūtayā kvāṭha pratiṣṭḥāyātā dayake se vijyāka || …(fol. 10r3–7)

«Beginning:» tarutthāya yo (!) liṅgaṃ bhaktyā pūjayate sadā || kapilānāṃ śataṃ dattvā yatpuṇyan tam avāpnuyāt || madhyaṃdinakare prāpte yop liṅgaṃ saṃprapūjayet || saṃpūrṇāṃ pṛthivīṃ dattvā yatphalaṃ tad avāpnuyāt || vāruṇīm āśrite sūrye yaḥ śivam anyagarcayet(!) || gavāṃ satasahasrasya dattasya phalam āpnuyāt || sarvvaṃ hatyā viśuddhyarthaṃ lakṣaliṃṅaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ || devālayasamāyuktaṃ livaliṅgaṃ prapūjanaṃ || (fol. 15r1–5) «End:» gomayaṃ gojalaṃ sarppi dadhi kṣīraś ca pañcamaṃ | praticyām(!) uttare yāmā pūrvvamadhe kṣipet kramāt || sadyojātena vāmena rūpitā puruṣena ca || iseneti yathāsaṃkhyān gomayādyabhimantrayet || pūrvvapurvva kṣited (!) agre mūlamantram udīrayan || kusodakan tu gāyatryā tena saṃhitayā thavā || paṃcagavyam iti proktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanaṃ || gomayaṃ mūlataṃ nīlā kapilāyā ghṛtaṃ yathā || surabher dadhiśu (fol. 33r1–5) «Colophon::» x

«Beginning:»' ❖ oṃ namo bhavānyai || prahvaprācīnabarhipramukhasuravarānīkakoṭīrakoṭī śliṣṭasyaṣṭendranīlāmalamaṇimadhupaśreṇi juṣṭhaṃ kṛṣīṣṭāṃ(!) śrīpādāmbhojayugmaṃ nakhamukhavilasad raśmikiṃjalkapuṃjaṃ siṃjan maṃjīrahaṃsīmukharitam aniśaṃ maṃgalaṃ vo bhavānyāḥ | bhaktyā bhavapayonidhisetuhetūn śrīpādapadmayugareṇukaṇān praṇamya | lambodaraṃ ca kathayāmi guropadiṣṭam ārādhanakramam idaṃ kulanāyikāyāḥ || snātvā yathāvidhi vidhautakarāvatāṃghrir ācamya samyagamasaṃvarayajñasūtraḥ | prāgānanādhinadadhidigvadanātha vāpi badhvāsanāgaṇapatiṃ ca guruṃ ca natvā | (fol. 1v1–4) «End:» sudhākareṇātha samarcya devīṃ nṛtyaiś ca gītaiḥ stutibhiḥ praṇamya | udvāsya mūlena gurūpadiṣṭa- kādambarīnirjuhūyān manasvī || janmādhāraguhodarād ajamukha praśnāntamātrāntarā vṛtyā ratnabhi śaktitantraniviḍasyūtākṣamālāyutāḥ | mantraścaladaśadigaḥ pratipadaṃ tatpratyagaśvamukhaṃ liṃgaṃ ca śiraśi svayaṃ vijayate nityaṃ japas traipuraḥ || (fol. 23v5–7) «Colophon::» iti śrīnāgabhaṭtaviracite tripurāsārasamuccaye daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ || || yad akṣarapadabhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnaṃ yadā bhavet | tatsarvaṃ kṣamyatām mātaḥ prasīda parameśvari || saṃvat 834 āṣāḍha śukla dvitīyāyāṃ śukravāsare sṃpūrṇam idaṃ || śubham astu sarvvadā || || (fol. 23v7–8)

«Beginning:»' śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ || bhairavo vāca || asaṃkhyā tripurā devī asaṃkhyātā ca kālikā || vāgīśvarī tathā saṃkhyā tat+tvakulākulā || mātaṅgī ca tathā pūrṇā vimalā caṇḍanāyikā | tripuraikajaṭā durgā jā (!) cānyā ca kuleśvarī || vaiṣṇavaṃ gāṇapatyaṃ ca masauramataṃ tathā || sauraśāṅkarajātaṃ ca jatkiṃcit bhūtasaṃbhavaṃ || catuḥṣaṣṭiś ca tantrāṇī(!) mātṛṇām uttamāni ca | mahāmāyāsaṃvaraṃ ca yoginījālasaṃvaraṃ || catuḥṣaṣṭiś ca tantrāṇiu mātṛṇām uttamāni ca || (fol. 1v1–4) «End:» adyaprabhṛti putrī tvaṃ kulapūjārcane ratā sukulājñāṃ samādāya jajyālasya vivarjjitā yathopadiṣṭavidhinā sāmarasyaṃ samāpayet ityanujñām guror labdhvā praṇamed daṇḍavad bhuvi trāhi nātha kulācāra padminī padmanāyaka tvatpādāmbhoruhacchāyāṃ mūrdhni dehi yaśodhane(!) para ??(!) gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt tāmbūlāruṇalocanā svakulaṃ paramīkṛtya yathoddiṣṭaṃ samācaret sāmāvaraṇapūjādau yadi na kṣamate kulaṃ tataḥ mūrdhni guruṃ dhyātvā kulāmṛtarasena tu tarppayitvā kulaṃ dhyātvā japen mantraṃ nirākulaṃ (fol. 6r4–6v2) «Colophon::» iti śrīkulacūḍāmaṇau dvitīyapaṭalaḥ 2 devyūvāca (fol. 6v1–2)

«Beginning:»' śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ oṃ namas tārāyai || rudropeṃdraviraṃcīnāṃ yata eva vapur bhidā vidvān api naiad vidvān naumi tat prākṛtaṃ mahaḥ 1 ālaṃbe gurupādābjaṃ karuṇārasaśītalam yatsaṃsargāt vilīyaṃte pāpatāpānuvṛttayaḥ 2 bhuvanavhuvam udārān vyomabimbaprakārān hṛtanikhilavikārāṃ nāramuṃḍālihārām munihṛdayavihārāṃ muktidānaikasārāṃ saha nija parivārāṃ naumi tāṃ ugratārāṃ 3 saṃpradāyādhvanā taṃtravacanāni vicinvatā śiṣṭasādhakatuṣṭyarthaṃ likhyate tāriṇīkramaḥ 4 (fol. 1v1–4) «End:» nānā jāti sudhīnāṃ viśvaṃ viśvasya mānasādhārā mama dayitāṃ hara dayitā bhavasaṃkaṭatāriṇī tārā 1 saṃśayasāgaramagnaḥ ko na hi lagnasya śāsane lagnaḥ yasya bhaved gurucaraṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ taraṇāya na sa punar bhagnaḥ 2 gaharavārakulakamalini bodhini rājani bhāti vikramadinamaṇi nāmani kṣitikaṃ tithamapi yāti 3 pārijātānaṃda nāmno methilasya dvijanmanaḥ kṛte tad guruṇā tārā pārijātaḥ prakāśitaḥ 4 śukadevanāmadheyo vikhyātaḥ kānyakubjajātīyaḥ kṛtavāṃstārāpūjām udāraṃ satphalādhāraṃ 5 mūlaṃ yasyāsti śūlāyudhaviśadavacaḥ saṃpradāyāḥ prabhedāḥ śākhāḥ sthūlālabālāpitavitatajapaḥ patritanyāsajālaḥ ceto bhṛgārttihāri kramayaji kusumo jāyaṃtāṃ pārijātā- naṃdasyānaṃdadāyōī vipulasukhaphalās tāriṇī pārijātaḥ 6 (fol. 71v4–72r2) «Colophon::» iti śrīvidvad upādhyāyaśukadevapaṇḍitaviracitas tāriṇīpārijātaḥ saṃpūrṇaḥ śubham astu || || || (fol. 72r2)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīgurave || no soya || hrāṁ ātmatatvāya svāhā || hrīṁ vidyātatvāya svāhā || hruṁ śivatatvāya svāhā || gurunamaskāra(!) || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākālaṃ vyātaṃ yena carācaraṃ | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || gurubhyo namaḥ || paramagurubhyo namaḥ || parameṣṭhīgurubhyo namaḥ || padmāanāya pādukāṃ || valisa || kurmāsanāya pādukāṃ || thavatā āsana || antarakāya phaṭ || svānajavakhavataṃne || huṁ phaṭ vajrapaṃjale svāhā ||(exp. 3b1–6) End ❖ padmāsanāya namaḥ || saptamaṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || triyāṃjali(!) || khpreṁ mahācaṇḍayogeśvari ambāpāda || 3 || thvanaṃvali || āvāhādi || yonimudrāṃ darśayet || thvate kāliyā || || tripurapūjā || padmāsanāya namaḥ || pañcapretāsanāya namaḥ || triyāṃjali(!) || ▒ ▒ ▒ pādukāṃ pūjayāmi || 3 || tarpaṇa 3 || āvāhanādiyonimūdrāṃ darśayet || thvatebhairavīyā || || thanāstotra(!) || añjanādinibhā⟨kā⟩kālī kotisūryyasamaprabhāṃ | traloke (exp. 11b1–6) «Sub-Colophon» iti saṃkṣepanityadevārccanam samāptaḥ || śrīśrīśrīdurggāprītir astu || śubha[ṃ] || || (exp. 11t5–6)

Beginning la || || tato devārcaṇaṃ kārayet || devārccanakrameṇāhutiṃ vratajvarasāvratadanake || vratapratiṣṭhā || tritatvana || tataḥ saṃkhyāhutiṃ || yavadhānyādi || ācāryapūjanaṃ || śāntika(!) || pustika(!) || rājadeśayajamāna || ācāryya || deśāpāṭi || deśavali || dakṣiṇādānaṃ || || tatra || gobhūmihiraṇyavastrādidānaṃ || || vācanaṃ gṛhya || vācanajaraṃ kalase nidhāya || ||saṃśravaghṛtaprāsanaṃ || upasparśanaṃ || pavitramocanaṃ || (exp. 2b1–15) End arghapātrapūjā || ātmapūjanādikubjikāṃ dhyātvā || kulapu‥kulanimittaṃ || jñānakhaḍga || oṁ 5 hrā hrīṁ hruṁ aghorāstrāya huṁ jñānakhaḍgāyai namaḥ || hrāṁ hṛdayāyai namaḥ || ityādi ṣaḍaṅgeṇa pūjā || āvahya dhenumūdrā || svasvamantranavali(!)|| jāpa || hrāṁ hrī hrūṁ svāhā || 27 || (exp. 25b7–14) «Sub-Colophon» iti jñānakhaḍgavidhiḥ || (exp. 25b14–15)

Beginning ❖ śrīgurubhyo namaḥ oṃ namaḥ śrīkubjikāyai || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ /// akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ jena(!) carācaraṃ | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || aiṃ 5 padmāsanāyapādukāṃ || aiṃ 5 kurmāsanāyapādukāṃ || aiṃ 5 arghapātrāsanāyapādukāṃ | aiṃ 5 kili 2 vicce koṅkaṇāyai hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || aiṃ 5 hūṃ phaṭ vajrapañjare svāhā || 3 || (exp. 4t1–6) End āvāhanādi || daṇḍa tarjjanī gajamudrāṃ darśayet || || tato(!) kalaśārccanaṃ || mṛtyuñjayanyāsaḥ || ādhāraśaktyetyādi || dhyāna || śuddhasphaṭisakāsaṃ(!) trinetraṃ candramaulinaṃ | varadābhayahastañ ca mudrāmālādharaṃ haraṃ || evaṃ dhyātvā mahāde/// ṣtakāmārthasiddhayet(!) dhyānapuṣpaṃ namaḥ || aghoravajratryaṃjali ///tyuñjayāya amṛtīśvaramahābhairavāya amṛta(lakṣmī)śaktisa (exp. 7b3–8) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya || śrī3nṛtyanāthāya namaḥ || || kathā pyākhanayā mūlasiddhividhiḥ || || hṅathu kuhnu adhivāsana mālakoyāya sakatāṃ jiyake || valahnithānāśvala samatā pūjāyāta vane || sakalasaṃ mālakosa +lusipāya vastra helr || nāśvala savāthele || || na ka saṃ akhāḍa samatāpūjā yāya svānakomakāse tāṭhe || naśvalasa pūjā +ṅāva vāne || || maṇḍapasamālakosakatāṃ hṅathu kuhnu jiyakāvātaya || || tataḥ puṣpabhājanaṃ || (fol. 1v1–6) End raṃ agnaye namaḥ || mūṃ yamāya namaḥ || kṣūṃ naiṛtyāya namaḥ || vūṃ varuṇāya namaḥ || yūṃ vāyave namaḥ || sūṃ kuverāya namaḥ || hūṃ īśānāya namaḥ || aṃ anantāya namaḥ || oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ || oṃ aśvatthāmāya namaḥ || oṃ balaye namaḥ || oṃ vyāsāya namaḥ || oṃ hanumate namaḥ || oṃ kṛpāya namaḥ || oṃ bhībhīṣaṇāya(!) namaḥ || oṃ parśurāmāya namaḥ || oṃ mārkkaṇḍāya (!) namaḥ || oṃ jūṃ pratipadādi tithibho namaḥ || oṃ jūṃ aśvinyādi nakṣatrebhyo namaḥ || oṃ jūṃ viṣkaṃbhādi yogebhyo namaḥ || oṃ (fol. 68r1–6) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || atha karmabalividhir likhyate || yajamānapuṣpabhājana || adyetyādi || vākya || yajamānasya mānavagotra śrīśṛījayabhūpatīndramallavarmmaṇaḥ śrī3sveṣṭadevatāprītikāmanayā navagṛhapraveśapratiṣṭhānimittyārthena(!) siddhāgni ayutāhutiyajñanimityarthaṃ karmmabalyārccaṇa(!)pūjānimittyarthaṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || || (fol. 1v1–6) End saṃtānabṛddhir astu yathāsāstrotra(!)phaladāyano(!) bhavanto || anyatra śaraṇaṃ nāsti tvameva śaraṇaṃ mamaḥ(!) || tasmāt kāruṇyabhāvena rakṣa rakṣa parameśvari || (!) tarppaṇa || ekāne || ambepūrvva || svānako kāya || mohanī kāyāva || svāna viya || mohanīticake || yajamāna ādina svāna viya mālastā || || maṇḍala coya || sākṣi thāya || balivisarjjana yāya || || || balicchoya thava thava thāyasa || || (fol. 75v1–6) Colophon iti karmmabalyārcanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || ❁ || || śubham astu sarvadā || śrī śrī jayabhūpatīndramalladevasana cūkacosadevapratiṣṭhāsiddhāgni aitā(!)hutiyajñayānāyā thva sāphuri || saṃ 825 bhādrapadaśukla daśamī mūla śaniścaravāra kuhnuḥ || śubha || (fol. 75v6–76r3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo guruve(!) || atha karmmabalithaṇḍilyārccanavidhiḥ(!) likhyate || sarjjātāthyaṃ mālako jiyake || thaṇḍila ūrdāla māya || || tritattvenācamya 3 || 5 hrāṃ ātmatattvāya svāhā || 5 hrīṃ vidyātattvāya svāhā || 5 hṛūṃ śivatattvāya svāhā || || gurunamaskārādi || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ▒ ▒ || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaraṃ || tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīguruve(!) namaḥ || gurur brahmā gurur viṣṇu gurur devo maheśvara || gurudevajagatsarvaṃ tasmai śrīguruve(!) namaḥ || 5 paramagurubhyo namaḥ || 5 parameṣṭhīgurubhyo namaḥ || 5 paramācāryagurubhyo namaḥ || (fol. 1r1–7) End ❖ ambe pūrvvagataṃ padaṃ bhagavati caitanyarūpātmako(!) || jñānecchā badhudhā hariharabrahmāmarīcitrayaṃ || bhāsvad + bhairavapaṃkajaṃ tadaru(!) śrīyoginī pañcakaṃ || candrārkā ca marīciṣaṭkavimalaṃ māṃ pātu nityaṃ śrīkuja(!) || || kvetāṅa svānakāyāva || jujuyatātaya || thvate dhuna ṅāva || sākṣi thāya || (fol. 126v1–4) Colophon iti karmmathaṇḍilyārccanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || ❁ || || … pūrṇnacandranibhaṃ śubhraṃ darppaṇaṃ śatrudarpahā | ātmavindudharaṃ yasya saṃpradāya jayāya ca || yajamāna hnasa kanakene || || thvate dhunaṅāva || balithāya thāya cchoya || || śubha || (fol. 125*v5–127v8)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || gurubhyo namaḥ || atha karmmabalivikhir likhete(!) || || yajamāna puṣpabhājana || adyādi || vākya || śrīsamvarttā || śyāmā raktā || utphullāṃ || vaiṣṇvīviṣṇumāyā || pūrvvandakṣiṇā || siddhir astu kriyārambhe yathā vāna || puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || laṃkhana hāya || ukāraṃ vāyubījaṃ || || ceta || śrīkhaṇḍacandanaṃ || siṃdhara || vīreśvarī mahā || || akṣata || akṣataṃ akṣatā || || yajaka || yajñopavītaṃ || || svāna || || nānā puṣpa || tritattvenācamya || sūryārgha || (fol. 1v1–5) End yajamāna abhiṣeka || ūkāraṃ vāyubījaṃ tyādi || ceta || śrīkhaṇḍacandanaṃ divyaṃ tyādi || siṃdhara || vīreśvarī mahāvīretyādi || || mohanī || trailokya mohaṇībhyāṃ tyādi || | svāna viya yajamānastāṃ || vaiṣṇavī viṣṇumāyāñca tyādi || || mālakāstāṃ ceta siṃdhara mohanīṃ svānaviya || || balivisarjana yāya || || sākṣi thāya || || balicchoya thāya thāyasa || dumāju || galāḍa || varchalā || nāśvara || irimā || jujumā || tvagaṇa || duthunāsvara || bhairava || kalaṃka || vaiṣṇavī || thvate balicchoya || || mālakocchoya || || (fol. 54r4–54v3) Colophon iti karmmabalyārvva(!)vidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || ❁ || || śubham astu sarvvadā || (fol. 54v4) ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāyai(!) namaḥ || atha karmmacakra uddhāravidhillikhyate || || (!) … ▒ ▒ ▒ … svasthānavāso bhavantu || hrīṃ ācamanīya svāhā || arghapātradvaṃdusthānasa vācaka || iti karmmacakrodhāravidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || ❁ || ||

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇeśāyai(!) namaḥ || brāhmaṇā ācārya josi thvate sanaṃ sthirahārā vavayāva || maṇḍapanavi uttara soya majire sāpūrvvaṃ soyaṃteva || gajulicchā kuhnuyā thva velasa yāya || thvana hṇāonali dinapatiṃ rajasārāsakarmmārcana yāya dhunaṅāva yāya || sā+rayā pāṭhana uttarasa || madhye sa balicchapātatayāva || ṅāpātana ṅūyakāva bali viya || pāṭhatavarāja(!) || || jalapātra || arghapātra || pañcabali || (fol. 1v1–6) End aṃbe pūrvvagataṃ padaṃ bhagavati caitanyarūpātmako || jñāneccvhābahulā tathā hariharau brahmāmarīcītrakaṃ(!) || bhāvs(d) bhairava(vaṃ)pañcakaṃ tadanu ca śrīyoginīpañcakaṃ || candrākā(!) ca marīcīṣaṭkam amalaṃ māṃ pātu nityaṃ kuja(!) || || bali visarjjana saṃhāramudrāna || balicchoya || pūrvvapāṭa kuvarāccha || dakṣiṇapāṭa duthunāsvara || paścimapāṭa varcchalā || uttarapāṭa turahṇelaṃṣu || dathupāṭa dhvākhāyināya || gorajāṃ || vaṭukadumāju || dvadvukodukhāpikhā || (fol. 27r5–10) Colophon thvate sacayanauttarasa tavarājapāṭhabalipūjāvidhi samāptāḥ (!) || ❁ || || ❁ | || śubham astu sarvvadā || ❖ śrīśrī jayabhūpatīndramalladevasa śrī3kaumārī skelupolalayāgajulicchāya tādayakā julo || samvat 827 bhādraśudi 13 || || śubha || (fol. 28r10–28v3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaścaṇḍikāyai || śrīparāparagurubhyo namaḥ || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ▒ ▒ akhaṇḍamaṇdalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaraṃ | tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || gurur brahmā gurur viṣṇu gurur devo maheśvaraḥ || gurur jagatra(!) sarvāṇī tasmai śrīgu(ra)ve namaḥ || śrīguruparameṣṭa śrīguruparamācārya śrīādevaṃ pādukāṃ pūjayāmi || (exp. 16b1–6) End yā sā suṃbhaniśuṃbhadaityajaraṇī yā devadevāśriyā sā devī mama (ra)kṣadakṣiṇabhuje | caṇḍī jaya rakṣatu || yasthā vāraṇa(!)prahārāṇāṃ kavacaṃ bhavatu vāraṇaṃ || tatra devo vidhātānāṃ śāntir bhavatu vāraṇaṃ || pacchimajyeṣṭhājyeṣṭhamahāmāyā śrīkubjikādevyai mūrttibyo nityakarmmadevārccanapūjānimittyārthena(!) || yathā śāstrokta tatpalabalaḍāyino bhavantu || prītipretātyādi(!) || aikāneka || deva āśrīrvvāda ambe pūrvva || ātmāśīrvāda || baliṃ visarjjana || balivā yathā pasa || (exp. 5b7–6t7) Colophon iti śrīpaścimajyeṣṭhājyeṣṭhamahāmāyā śrīkubjikādevyāḥ nityakarmabalyārccanapūjāvidhiḥ samāptaḥ || ❁ || śubham astu sarvadā || … (exp. 6t6–b1)

Beginning oṃ mahārājeśvarāya namaḥ || paṭīyān nādhyetuṃ navaśivagiraṃ dharttum api vā kva tad vyākhyā carcābhinavaracanāyāṃ kva tu kathā tathāpy etad bhāvāyad amṛtarasagraṃthasujanis tadā vācyo ʼvācyo nṛharicaraṇapremamahimā || 1 || tantrarājānusāreṇa naimittikamataḥ paraṃ kvamalā paddhatiḥ samyak prakāśayati sanmude || 2 || tadrādau gurūpūjārthaṃ maṃḍalaṃ darśayāmaḥ || pūjā ceyaṃ gurujanmotsavādiṣaṭparvasu vijātīye maṃḍale kāryā saptame tu pūrṇārūpe parvaṇi tato vilakṣaṇa eva maṃḍale sā tatrāpi gurau jīvati sati vijātīye sā anyāvasthāyāṃ tu vijī(!)tīye seti catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ saṃpannā ṣaṭparvapūjopayogi ca maṃḍalaṃ trividham iti saṃbhūya pa[ṃ]cavidhaṃ gurūpūjāmaṃḍalaṃ bhavati⟨ḥ⟩ || (fol. 1v1–5) End yasmin varṣe payaddeśe yā yā nityā pracarati sā sā nityā tattaddeśasvāmini bhavati caṃdrakakṣāyāṃ yā nityā yadvarṣe pracarati saiva nityā sakalakālasvāmini bhavati itthaṃ ca deśakālayor yasmin varṣe ekanityā svāmikatvaṃ bhavati tasmin varṣe tannityāpūjanaṃ svajanamdine svajanmamāsapaurṇamāsyāṃ ca karttavyaṃ etad uktanaimittkakarmaṇām aikaikasyāpy atikrame sahasrasaṃkhyayā mūlavidyājapo [ʼ]nuṣṭhātavyaḥ nimittāvṛttau naimittikasyāpy āvṛttir iti saṃkṣepaḥ || ❁ || yasyodyotamatī satī guṇavatī mātāpitomāpatir nāma premanidhīti pantakulabhūḥ kūrmācalo janmabhūḥ sūpāsyaṃ kṛtavīryajātyutapadaṃ tasmād asāv udyatā saṃpūrṇā kamalāsu nirmalapadā naimittike karmaṇi || (fol. 6v7–11) Colophon iti śrībhāradvājakulaprasūtapaṃthopanāmakakūrmācalāśritaparaṃparaḥ premanidhiśarmanirmitā śrītaṃtrarājānumataśrīvidyānaimittikakarmakamalā saṃpūrṇā || (fol. 6v12)

Beginning ❖ prītiḥ pretāsanasthā bhavabhayahalaṇo bhairavo mantramūrttiś cāṇḍicanḍāsanasthāpranatiphaṇiphaṇāḥ lokapālās phaṇin(!)drāḥ | yakṣā lakṣāś ca daityāḥ pitigaṇasakalāḥ māttalākṣetrapālāḥ yogīnyāḥ yogajuktāḥ jarajalakhacalāḥ prāṇavetat pivantu || pivantu devatā sarve sa rudrāś ca vināyakā | yogī(!)ṇīkṣetrapālāś ca mama deha vyavasthitā || || icchā jñānī kriyā sā suravaranamitā śā(!) śrī(!)yā maṃgalākhyā sā gaurī sā ca durgā bhagavati subhagā mātri(!)kā carmamuṇḍā || sā ca brahmā sā ca viṣṇu grahagaṇamanitā śriyā maṃgalākhyā sānekānekalupā vividhaguṇadayāyogini tvāṃ namāmi || || (!) (exp. 3a1–7) End pātāle(!)ta(la)vāsinyaḥ /// śa/// sarvvabhūtebhyo valiṃ gṛhṇa 2 // a/// rjana || puna(!) śuddhāgnirikṣanādicatuḥsaṃskāra(!) || hrāṁ hrīṁ hruṁ ghore aghore aghorāmukhī chhīṁ chhīṁ kini/// viccakohvanāyai hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || prokṣana/// hraḥ kavacāya huṁ || a/// rāgnaye namaḥ || (exp. 2b2–7) Colophon

Beginning kṛtvā sarvvam ekapātre kṛtvā aiśānyāṃ trikoṇavṛttacaturasramaṇḍalaṃ vilikhya tadupari saṃsthāpya pūjayet || aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ ucchiṣṭabhairava ehy ehi baliṃ gṛhṇa 2 svāhā eṣa balir ucchiṣṭabhairavāya namaḥ | iti kṛtvā || || tataḥ śaṃkhasthitapūjāvaśiṣṭajalena svātmānaṃ śaktisādhakāścābhiṣiñcan paṭhet || tataḥ śāntistotraṃ paṭhet || (exp. 2 ll. 1–5) End mūlamantraṃ sāṅgāṃ sāyudhāṃ savāhanāṃ saparivārāṃ sānucarāṃ śrīmahākāleśvarabhairavasahitāṃ śrīkāmakalākālīṃ tarppayāmi namaḥ svāhā | iti tarppaṇaṃ vidhāya || tato vidhivan naivedyaṃ gṛhītvā yathāsukhaṃ bhūjyāt || || tato balivisarjja (exp. 27b5–8) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīmahābhairavāya namaḥ(!) || || atha kaumārārccaṇavidhir llikhyate || || yajamānapuṣpabhājanaṃ || adyādi(!) || vākya(!) || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrīśrī jayabhūpatīndramalladevavarmmaṇa(!) śrīsveṣṭadevatāprītyarthaṃ navagṛhapraveśasiddhāgniyajñakaumārīja⟪jā⟫gārccananimityārthena(!) puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāmi || || śrī saṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadanihitānandaśaktisubhīmā sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ akulakulagataṃ paṃcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ || catvāraḥ pancake nyaṃ, punarapi caturaṃ tattvato maṇḍaledaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaḥ(!) || || (fol 1v1–2r1) End dhūmābhaṃ dīptanetraṃ gatitarucijaṭā(!) triṇi(!) netraṃ kalālaṃ(!), haste khaḍgaṃ (tukarttṝtapadadhṛtaṃ) tīkṣṇaśūlaṃ kapālaṃ | cakrānte matsa(!)māṃsasasavarasavividhā (!) māditaṃ pretasaṃsthā mātaṅgīśrī sadaiva sagaṇaparivṛtā naumi ucchiṣṭanāthaṃ || atra gandhādi || śāntir astu | puṣṭir astu || supratiṣṭhā varadā bhavantu || || visarjjanaṃ || kaṃ astrāya phaṭ || tāmbūlādi || || kalaṃkachoya || || kaumārīsaḥ || ekāneka(!) || ambapūrvva || kuhmālabhūjāyā, svāna,yajamānastaṃviya || || kuhmalapūjāvisarjjanaṃ || || sarvvamaṅgalamāṅgalye śive sarvvārthasādhike | śaraṇye tryambike gaurī(!) nārāyaṇi namo stu te || || sākṣithāya || || kṛtarmmasākṣiṇe śrīsūryyāya arghaṃ namaḥ || || || || (fol. 18v5–19r6) Colophon thvate kaumālījāgavidhi samāptaḥ || || śubham astu sadā sarvvadā || || (fol. 19r7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo mahābhairavāyaḥ(!) oṃ namaḥ kubjikāyai || namo stu te mahāśā(na)naṃ(!) svacchanda parameśvaraṃ || kubijāś ca samāyuktaṃ paramānandanaṇḍītaṃ(!) || bhairavabhairavī p(r)oktaṃ paramatattva layāgatā || (!) dīkṣā sārottaraṃ sāraṃ narānā(!) pāśachedanaṃ || parthamaṃ(!) samayadīkṣā dvitiyañ(!) ca vaśiṣṭhakaṃ || tṛtīyaṃ savvādhikāraṃ(!) nirvvānaṃ(!) bhedadīkṣayā || mānuṣānā(!) hitārthāya dīkṣākramāni muttamaṃ || (exp. 3t1–5) End ebhiḥ aṣṭasthāṇe(!) śikṣa(!) sodhayat(!) || tato hastapuṣpāñjali vadhālayet || svaśvadevī pūjayat ||triyāñjali || chhāya || ṣaḍagatyādi || dhūpa dīpa naivedya || japa 10 || sastotra || 2 akhaṇḍamaṇdarātyādi || māyākuṇḍalanityādi || tapasa || samaya cchoya || dakṣinā yāya || ekānekatyādi || visarjjanayāṅā va || kapālasa taya || svapnamatrakānya || oṃ hrīṃ li2 śūlapānaya || svāhā || kathākāṅāva tāthe || sāni kuhnuyā śubhāśubha ṅene || (exp. 9b6–10t3) Colophon samvat 801 (2)? jyeṣṭha śukla navami śrīharipatidevana coyā juro śubha | ❖ oṃ hrāṃ śrīṃ śrī citāma svāhā || || ❖ oṃ kāmarideśakaṃmacchādevi tāhā vathe annādi jogī(ke) pāśa hama gayā hamako kā diyā latālona diyā mithikhāna diyā gāyiko diyā vācchārājñā strī ko dīyā puru ko rājñā bhaiśā ko diyā vādā ko diyā sarijāsanasijāya manta || ||(exp. 10t3–10b4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namah śrī3 mahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || atha gṛhapraveśapūjāvidhillikhyate || patavāsana coya vāstusuddhā balimālako voya || || yajamāna puṣpabhājana || adyādi || vākya || śrī saṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadasahitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā || sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyaṃ catuṣkaṃ akura(!)kulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ || catvāro pañcakonyaṃ punar api caturaṃ stattvato maṇḍaledaṃ || saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaṃ || (fol. 1v1–5) End pratiṣthā || pratiṣthito (!) si deveśi supratiṣthā bhuvanatrayaṃ || (!) sānnidhyaṃ pratigṛhnāmi(!) yajamānādibṛddhaye || śanno stu dvipade nityaṃ śan no rājyas(!) tathaiva ca || yajamānasaṃbhūto yaṃ(!) suputrapaśubāndhavaḥ(!) || rakṣa tvaṃ sarvakālesu deśana(!) bhairava namo stu te || supratiṣthitā varadā bhavantu || kaumārapūjā cchoya || sarvvamaṅgalamāṅgalye śive sarvvārtha sādhake(!) || śaraṇyaye(!) tryambike(!) gaurī nārāyaṇī namo stu te || kaumārīdevyai svasthānavāso bhavantu || || sākṣi thāya pahnuto yajamāna ārogyaṃ ālasaṃ thva cchesa || || (fol. 117r1-6) Colophon iti gṛhapraveśaśāntibalyārcaṇa(!)vidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || samvat 820 naṣṭaāśvinaśudi 3 citranakṣatra brahmayoga budhavāra || thva kuhnu gṛhapraveśasāphuli saṃpūrṇa yāṅā || śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevasa jayapratāpavovalasa thva sāphuli dayakā juro || śubham astu || || || || ṅ || (fol. 117r6–117v2)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrī3 mahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || || atha gṛhapraveśapūjāvidhillikhyate || || patavāsana coya || balimālako voye || || yajamāna puṣpabhājana yācake || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrī3jayabhūpatīndramallavarmmaṇa śrī3sveṣṭadevatāprītyarthaṃ navagṛhapraveśapratiṣṭhāśāntibalyarccaṇakarttuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāmiḥ(!) || || śrī saṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadanihitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ tvakulakulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānya ṣaṭkaṃ catvāro pancakonyaṃ punar api caturaṃ statvato maṇḍaledaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvalaṃ bhairavaṃ śrī kujeśaṃ || || (fol. 1v1–2r1) End pratiṣthā || || pratisthitosi(!) deveśi supratiṣṭhā bhuvanatrayaṃ (!) || sānnidhyaṃ pratigṛhnāmi(!) yajamānādibṛddhaye | śan no stu dvipade nityaṃ śan no rājyas tathaiva ca || yajamānasaṃbhūto(!) yaṃ suputra paśubāndhavaḥ ||(!) rakṣa tvaṃ sarvakāreṣu(!) deśa bhairava namo stu te || supratiṣthā varadā bhavantu || kumbhara pūjā cchoya || sarvamaṅgalamāgalya(!) śive sarvārthasādhake(!) || śaraṇya(!) tryambike(!) gaurī nārāyaṇī namo stu te || komārī(!) devyai svasthānavāso bhavantu || || sākṣi thāya || pehnuto yajamāna ārogyaṃ ālasaṃ thvacchesa || || (fol. 130v1–7) Colophon iti gṛhapratiṣṭhāśāntibalyārcanavidhi samāptaḥ || || śubha || || (!) (fol. 130v7)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrī 3 mahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || atha (bhoṅayā kṣa)tha pratiṣṭhā patādayakā || || patavāsana coya vāstu suddhā bali mālako coya || || yajamāna puṣpa bhājana yācake || adyādi || vākya || mānava gotra yajamānasya śrī 2 jaya bhūpatīndra malla varmaṇa śrī 3 svaṣṭa devatā prītyarthaṃ śrī 3 caṇḍikādevyā navagṛhapraveśapratiṣṭhābalyarccana katuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmiḥ || || (fol. 1v1–5) End pratiṣṭhā || pratisthito si deveśi supratiṣṭhābhuvanatrayaṃ | sānidhyaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi yajamānādivṛddhaye || sanno stu dvipade nityaṃ sanno rājyas tathaiva ca | yajamānasya saṃbhūto yaṃ suputrapaśubā[n]dhavaḥ || rakṣa tvaṃ sarvakālekhu(!) daśanabhairava namo stu te || supratiṣṭhāvaradā bhavantu || || kuhnura pūjā choya || sarvvamaṅgalamāṅgalya(!) śive sarvārthasādhake(!) śaraṇye tra(!)mbike gauri nārāyaṇi namo stu te || komārīdevyai svasthānavāso bhavantu || sākṣithāya || || pehnuto yajamāna ārogyaṃ ālasaṃ thvacchesaḥ || (fol. 60v1–6) Colophon iti gṛhapratiṣṭhāśāntibalyārccanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || śubham astu sarvvadā || || || || (fol. 60v6–7)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇapataye || śrī3 gurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || atha gṛhe praveśapūjāvidhir llikhyate || patavāsana coya , vāstu suddhāvali mālako coya || || yajamāna puṣpabhājana || adyādi || vākya || śrīsaṃvarttāmaṇḍalāntetyādi || śyāmā raktā || utphullāmbujakarṇikopari gatā || || gārudmakadyutinibhāṃ garuḍāsanasthāṃ m(!) udbhinnapaṅkajamukhīn navayauvanāḍhyāṃ | śaṃkhāsicakragadayāṅkitacāruhastāṃ śrīvaiṣṇavīśaraṇato smi sadā prasannāṃ || || (fol 1v1–5) End pratiṣṭhā || pratisthi(!)to(!) si deveśi supratiṣṭhā bhuvanatrayaṃ sānnidhyaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi yajamānādivṛddhaya(!) | sanno stu dvipade nityaṃ sanno rājyas tathaiva ca | yajamānasaṃbhūto yaṃ suputrapaśubāndhavaḥ || rakṣa tvaṃ sarvvakāleṣu deśanabhairava namo stu te || supratiṣṭhāvaradā bhavantu || || kuhmala pūjā choya || sarvvamaṅgalamāṅgalya(!) śive sarvvārthasādhake(!) śaraṇya(!) traṃ(!)bike gauri nārāyaṇi namo stu te || kaumārīdevyai svasthānavāso bhavantu || || sākṣi thāya || || pehnuto yajamāna ārogyaṃ ārasaṃ thva chesa || || (fol. 89r5–89v4) Colophon iti gṛhapraveśaśāntibalyārccanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || || || ❖ samvat 839 vaiśāṣa śuklasaptamī budhavāra thva kuhnu cepagāla thātā kavalicā thātā chehnala yāṅā vadāṅā śrī2 jayabhūpatīndramalladeva sana chebaliviyadina || (fol. 89v4–7)

Beginning ❖ śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || || ṅ oṃ namaḥ śrīmaṅgalāyai namaḥ || || tati liṅgārccanavidhi || tritattvenācamya || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākālaṃ tyādi(!) || śrīgurupādekebhyo namaḥ || arghapātrāsanāya namaḥ || ātmāsanāya namaḥ || nyāsaḥ || aṃ astrāya phaṭ || ityādikarāṅganyāsaḥ || arghapātrapūjā || aṃastrāya phaḍityāṣaḍana pūjā || āvāhya || dhenumudrā || ātmane siṃcayet || ātmane canda(!) namaḥ || ātma śirase puṣpaṃ namaḥ || ātmamūrttaye namaḥ || iti ātmapūjā || (exp. 4b1–6) End mūlena karanyāsa yāya || saṃhārakrameṇa || mūlamantreṇa devyā tejasi dhyātvātmani līnaṃ hāṃ +++ || mūlaṃ ca sarvvaṃ ganapate juṃ si añjaliṃ kāyānāśa+ggaṇamūlamantraya līnaṃ kṛtvā || ṣaḍaṅga || || svasirasi ṅābhiyā mūlamantreṇa triyāñjali 3 || svaśirasi dhāryyate || mūlena daśa daśadhā japet 10 || mūlamantreṇa tridhā 3 pūjayet || || || … (exp.3b6–4t1) Colophon iti nityakarmavidhis samāptaḥ || saṃpūrṇaṃ || || (…. ) ❖ samvat 840 āśunā site cvayā saṃpūrṇaṃ || || (exp. 4t1–3)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīpratyaṅgirāyai || || tatrādau nityakarma kṛtvā, hastau pādau prakṣālya śucivastre paridhāya, kambalādimṛdvāsane upaviśya, uttarābhimukho bhūtvā, kuṇḍanirmmāya, āhutyānukrameṇa, khananotthānavistāraṃ kṛtvā, pañcamekhalayā virājamānaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā, apatitagomayopalipya tatra yakṣakarddamādisugandhenāsiṃcya, siṃdūrarajasā, caturasra(!),aṣṭāra(!),aṣṭadala(!),ṣaṭkoṇaṃ, trikoṇaṃ vilikhya puṣpaprakaraṇena (saṃ)chādya || (fol. 1r1–4) End yathā śaktyā devīṃ stutvā || ghṛtena vahnau punar yyathā śaktyā hutvā, vyāhṛtibhiḥ 27 punaḥ hrīṃ śrīṃ oṁ agnaye svāheti hutvā 27 || śruvaṃ gṛhītvā ghṛtapūrṇṇaṃ kṛtvā mūlena pūrṇṇāhutiṃ hunet || || tato devīṃ kuṇḍān svasthāne nilālambām (!) kṛtvā, visarjjayet || tato vahniṃ prapūjya, svakīyamūlādhārāgnau vahniṃ niyojya || kṣamasveti visarjjayet || || tato niśāyāṃ homānte, samayārthe carupañcakaṃ pūjya,(!) samayaṃ kārayet || || (fol. 11r1–5) Colophon iti kāli(!)kulākulasadbhāve, homavidhānaṃ samāptam iti || || (fol. 11r6)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ | śrīnāthādigurutrayaṃ gaṇapatiṃ pīṭhatrayaṃ bairavaṃ siddhaughaṃ baṭukatrayaṃ padayugaṃ dūtīkramaṃ maṃḍalaṃ | vīrādyaṣṭacatuṣkaṣaṣṭhīnavakaṃ vīrābalipaṃcakaṃ śrīmanmālini maṃtrarājasahitaṃ guror maṃḍalaṃ || 1 || asya śrīgurutrayamahāmaṃtrasya gāyatrīchaṃdaḥ haṃsasvarūpī śrīgurur devatā haṃbījaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ | so haṃ kīlakaṃ | śrīguruprasādasidhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | atha nāśsaḥ (!)| sāṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃºº sīṃ tarjanībhyāṃºº sūṃ madhyamābhyāṃºº saiṃ anāmikābhyāṃºº sauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃºº saḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃºº evaṃ hṛdayādi (fol. 2r1–6) End mukhastho labhate siddhiṃ karastha[ḥ] svalpajīvinaṃ | udāsīnaḥ kukṣisaṃsthaḥ pādastho duḥkhamāpnuyāt | pucchastha[ḥ] pīḍyate maṃtrī baṃdhanoccāṭanādibhiḥ | kūrmacakramidaṃ proktaṃ maṃtriṇāṃ siddhidāyakaṃ | kūrmacakram avijñāya yaḥ kuryāj japayajñakaṃ nāsti tasya phalaṃ ki(!)cit sarvānarthāya kalpate || || (fol. 4v10–11) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇapataye nama(ḥ) || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || atha gṛhapraveśaśāntibalyārccanavi(dhir)likhyate || patavāsana mārako coya || jāpūjā mārako coya || yajamāna puṣpabhājana yācake || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotra śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramallavarmmana śrīśrī svesta(!)devatāprītyarthaṃ navagṛapraveśapratiṣthāśāntibalyyācca(!)napūjānimittyārthena(!) puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || || śrīsamvattā(!)maṇḍalānte kramapadanihitānandaḥ(!)śaktiḥ subhīmā sṛṣṭaṃ nyāya(!) catuṣkaṃ akulakulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ catvāro pañcakonyaṃ punar api caturaṃ tattato(!) maṇḍalena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namati(!) guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśa(!) || || (fol. 1v1–2r2) End pratiṣṭhā || pratiṣthitosi(!) deveśi supratiṣthā bhuvanatrayaṃ || (!) sānnidhyaṃ pratigṛhnāmi(!) yajamānādibṛddhaye || sanno stu dvipade nityaṃ sanno rājyas tathaiva ca || yajamānasaṃbhūto yaṃ suputrapaśubāndhavaḥ(!) || rakṣatvaṃ sarvvakālesu deśana bhairava namo stu te || supratiṣthā varadā bhavantu || || kumbhalapūjā cchoya || sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalya śive sarvārthasādhake(!) śaraṇya tryambike(!) gaurī nārāyaṇī(!) namos tu te || kaumārī devyai svasthānavāso bhavantu || sākṣi thāya pehnuto yajamāna ārogyaṃ ārasaṃ thva cchesa || || (fol. 106v4–107r5 ) Colophon iti gṛhapraveśaśāntibalyārccana(!)vidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 107r5–6)

Beginning ❖ atha grahaṇapuraścaraṇavidhi (!) || tatra pūrvvadine kṣaurasnāna(!) vidhāya pāpamocanārtham aṣṭottarasahasram aṣṭottaraśataṃ vā gāyatrīṃ japet || tatra saṃkalpa || adyetyādi amukagotrasyāmukaśarmaṇo mama svaṣkarttavya rāḥugrastadivākare niśākare vā amukadevatāyā amukamantra grāsād vimuktiparyantaṃ japātmakapuraścaraṇakarmmani (!) jñātājñāta kṛtapāpakṣayapūrvvaka puraścaraṇādhikārārthe iyatsaṃkhyākāma amukadevatāgāyatrījapamahaṃ kariṣye || (exp. 3t1–6) End ityāvāhanādimudrāṃ pradarśya || tato mātṛkānyāsaprāṇapratiṣthāmūlanyāsaṃ ca śaktyaṃge vidhāya ṣoḍaśopacārair pañcopacārair vā pūjayet tad yathā || ❖ phreṃ ▒ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ śrīguhyaśaktinirvvāṇaśrīguhyakālyai tubhyaṃ śrīmatsiṃhāsanaṃ nivedayāmi namaḥ || ekaṃ krameṇa pūjayet || mūlena puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ vidhā(ya) (exp. 69b8-11) «Sub-colophon» iti śrīuttarāmnāyaśīnirvvāṇaśrīguhyakālyāpavitrārohanavidhi (!) samāpta || (exp. 69t2)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ sarvvasiddhiyoginībhyaḥ || vedāṅgārapratodaṃ pravararathataraṃ brahmaśīrṣaṃ samudya chitvā pāpau dadhānā tadanu ca sumat ghorakaṃkāravīṇāṃ | kālākālaprapātair avatu jagad idaṃ vādayantī sukāle | viṣṇo rudre tadīśe tad anu vasu śive kālane kālacaṇḍā || || atha śrīguhyakālīpūjā || tritatvenācamya || ekapuṣpenāgrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā || ekenāsanaṃ || ekena śiraśi dhāraṇaṃ || tataḥ || oṃ paramaśivaśaktinātha śrīśrīaśeṣanāthapāraṃparyakramasvagurupādāmbujaṃ yāvat praṇaumi || || candanākṣatam ādāya nyāsaḥ || (exp. 4t1–5) End samaya kāya || || dhunaṅāva devavisarjana yāya || prāṇāyama nyāsaḥ || tāla 3 || lathula 3 || saṃhārapudrayā puṣpam ānīya || gaccha gaccha paraṃ sthānaṃ svasthānaṃ parameśvari dehi me vipurān prīti punar āgamanāya ca || balivisarjjjaṇaṃ (!) puṣpam āghrāṇaṃ (!) kṛtvā kṣipet || īśānakoṇe maṇdalaṃ kṛtvā || nirmālya sthāpya pūjanaṃ || oṃ nirmālyanivāsinyai namaḥ || sākṣī thāya | oṃ hrāṃ sākṣiṇe śrīsūryāya arghaṃ namaḥ || puṣpaṃ namaḥ || || (exp. 19t2–5) Colophon iti śrīguhyakālyāḥ saṃkṣepapūjāpaddhatiḥ || || (exp. 19t6)
