Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrī 3 mahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || atha gṛhapraveśapūjāvidhi[r] likhyate || patavāsane coya vāstusu(!)ddhāvalimālakā voya || || yajamānapuṣpabhājana(!) || adyādi || vākya(!) || śrīsaṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadasahitānandaśaktisubhīmā sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ akla[kula]gataṃ paṃcakaṃ cāṇya[ṣa]ṭkaṃ | catvāro(!) paṃcako [ʼ]nyaṃ punar api caturaṃ statvato(!) maṇḍaledaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namataguruvaraṃ bhairavaḥ(!) śrīkujeśaṃ || || (fol. 1v1–2r2) End sanno [ʼ]stu dvipade nityaṃ sanno rājyas tathaiva ca | yajamāṇasaṃbhūto [ʼ]yaṃ suputrapaśūbāndhavaḥ || rakṣa tvaṃ sarvvakāleṣu daśanabhairava namo [ʼ] te || supratiṣṭhā varadā bhavantu || || kumbharapūjācchoya || sarvvamaṅgalamāṃgalye śive sarvvārthasādha(!)ke | śaraṇya(!) tryambike gaurī nārāyaṇī namo [ʼ]stu te || || kaumārīdevyai svasthānavāso bhavantu || || sākṣithāya || vākya || kṛtakarmaṇe sākṣiṇe śrīsūryyāya arthan namaḥ puṣpan namaḥ sākṣiṇe namaḥ || || || (fol. 171r1–171v4) Colophon iti gṛhapravesa(!)śāntivalyārccanavidhiḥ samātaḥ || || sipādīlayā gajalicchā gṛhe pratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ || || (fol. 171v4–5)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha khaḍgaparikṣā || aṃgaṃ rūpaṃ tathā jātir netrāriṣṭe ca bhūmikā || dhvanir mānam iti proktaṃ khaḍgajñānāṣṭakaṃ śubhaṃ || || tad yathā || abhinne dṛśyate yādṛk vibhidya ghaṛite tathā || yadaiva dṛśyate chihnaṃ tadaṃgaṃ saṃpracakṣyate || nīlakṛṣṇādikaṃ khaḍge rūpam ity abhidhīyate || te /// va yat pratītaṃ syāt tajjātir iti gadyate || aṃgādiriktaṃ cakrādi yanmāhātmyopasūcakaṃ || tan/// m iti jānīyāt khaḍge khaḍgaviśāradaḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) End niraṃgam atitīkṣṇaṃ ca gāḍhaṃ śāṇe vumet(!) kaṇaṃ || chinatyaṣṭavidhaṃ lauhaṃ vajrāṃgam iti tam vadet || 79 || kalāya puṣpasadṛśam amgaṃ bhūmiḥ sītāsitā || kalāya vajraṃ jājīyāt tatkṣate pāka ucyate || aṃgaṃ campakapuṣpābhaṃ bhūmiḥ kṛṣṇāsitā tathā || śikhāṃ śāṇe vame[c] chītāṃ tiktaṃ tasya jalaṃ bhavet || idaṃ campakavajraṃ syāt sarvatra vijayapradaṃ || 81 || aṃgaṃ valād alasamaṃ bhūmiḥ śuklā tatheta‥ || balāvajram idaṃ jñeyaṃ nānābhāvo bhaved drutaṃ || ity ayaṃ vātarogānān nāśane paramauṣadhaṃ || aṃgaṃ vaṭārohasamaṃ bhūmir vaṭadalachaviḥ || vaṭavajram idaṃ jñeyaṃ kha (fol. 7v510) Colophon

Beginning ❖ atha ṣoḍasopacālaphalaṃ || || tathā ca āgamasāre || dhūpaṃ dahati pāpāni dīpo mṛtyuvināsanaṃ || alakṣmī(!) nāsayet puṣpaṃ arghadusvapnanāśanaṃ || tilakaṃ nāsaye[t] śatru(!) naivedyaṃ kalināsa(!)naṃ || vighnaṃ ca tutiśabdena dhyānaṃ caiva mahātbhayaṃ(!) || jāpaṃ hā(!)kaṃ vinasyanti vyādhināsaṃ visarjjanaṃ || ghā‥na samayojena bhasmena putrado bhavet || pranāmaṃ(!) siddhisaṃprāptaṃ maṃtrai(!) naiva tu riddhidā | mudrāyā āyuvṛddhi[ḥ] syāt snānakāmam abhīṣṭhitā || ṣoḍaśe tān nireceta devyarccanam idaṃ mataṃ || || iti ṣoḍaśopacālavidhiḥ || || (fol. 1r1–4) End samūhaṃ yasya te maṃtrī dūraṃ gatvā prayatnataḥ || samūhe tu ahaṃ sākṣāt samūhas tu pitāmahaḥ || samūhaḥ keśavo devi samūhas tu puraṃdaraḥ || nārījanasamūhas tu svabhāvajaṃ tu suṃdari || tvayā sārddhaṃ(!)m ahaṃ devi viharāṃi yathepsayā || evaṃ stutvā tato maṃtrī kāyakleśena pūjayet || yathālābhānusāreṇa patrapuṣpaphalādibhiḥ | kanyājanasamūhe tu mahāsiddhir vyavasthitāḥ || tasya vārccnapuṇyaya lopam ādṛśyate kvacit || yas tv evaṃ pūjayed devi sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || ||(fol. 6v2–6) Colophon iti śrīhāhārāvatantre uttaramate guhyakāḷikāvidhāne devyotparttipaṭalaḥ || śrī || śrīdūrgā || (fol. 6v6)

Beginning || oṁ || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha khaḍgalakṣaṇam || || aṃgulaśatārddham uttamam ūnaḥ syāt paṃcaviṃśati ḥ khaḍgaḥ || aṃgulamāno jñeyaḥ samāṃgulastho [ʼ]vraṇaḥ śubhadaḥ || 1 || śrīvṛkṣavarddhamāna- patraśivaliṃgakuṃḍalābjānāṃ || sadṛśāḥ vraṇāḥ praśastā dhvajāyudhasvasthikānāṃ ca || 2 || kṛkalāsakākakaṃkakravyāda- kabaṃdhavṛścikākṛtayaḥ || khaḍge vraṇā na śubhadā vaṃśānugatāḥ prabhūtāś ca || 3 || sphuṭito hrasvaḥ kuṇṭho vaṃśa[c]chino nanṛmanonugataḥ || aśvanam iti cāriṣṭaḥ proktaviparyasytam iṣṭaphaladaḥ || 4 || (fol. 1r1–5) End vaḍavoṣṭakareṇudugdhapānaṃ yadi pānena sahate [ʼ]rthasiddhiṃ || jhaṣāpittamṛgāśvastadugdhai ḥ karihastasthitaye satālagarbhaiḥ || 24 || arkaṃ payohuḍuviṣāṇasakhīsametaṃ pārāsukhakṛtā ca yutaḥ pralepaḥ || śastratailamathitasya tato [ʼ]sya pānaṃ paścāsitasya ni śilāsu bhaved vighāta[ḥ] || 25 || kṣāre kadalyā mathitena yukte dinauṣite pāyitamāyasaṃyat || samyak sthitaṃ cāśmani naitibhaṃga(!) cacāla loheṣv api tasya mauḍhyaṃ || 26 || (fol. 3v1–5) Colophon iti varāhamihirakṛtau khaḍgalakṣaṇam samāptaṃ śubham || iti saṃvat || 1861 || phālguna śukla || 3 || lekhaka lālaḥ (fol. 3v5–6)

«Beginning of the root text» atrāṃtare masṛṇaromavaṃśād asīmani((ḥ))śvā((sa))niḥ sahamukhīṃ samupetya rādhām || savrīḍam īkṣitasakhīvadanāṃ dināṃtesānaṃdagadgadapadaṃ harir ity uvāca | 1 | vadasi yadi kiṃcid api dantaṃ rucirakaumudīharatidaratimiraghoramatighoram || sphuradadharasīdhave tava vadanacaṃdam ārocayati locanacakoraṃ | 1 | priye cāruśīl muṃca mayi mānam anidānaṃ | sapadi madanānalo dahati mama mānasaṃ dehi mukhakamalamadhupānam || || dhruvapadam ||(fol. 1r6–9) «Beginning of the commentary» || || śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ | | śauryyodāryyajuṣāṃ varyyo dhairyyadhīratnanīradhiḥ || śrīmadraṇabahādūraḥ senaḥ senaḥ parīkṣatām 1 atha priye cāru((śīla)) ity aṣṭapadyā bhāṣāṭippaṇī | | pūrvasargaviṣe mānavatī rādhikākana sakhīle bahutai prakāra garī samjhāudā dināṃta bhayo ra tasai rātrikā mukhamā śṛṃgārarasānukūladhīralalita(!) ((tatrāpi)) mānāvasthāmā prasādanānukūladakṣiṇa tyastā nāyaka śrīkṛṣṇarādhikākā samīpamā gaīkana māna chuṭāunākā pāṃca upāayamā uttama jo sāmopāya ho tyo artha bhayākā vadasītyādi vākyakana gānale bhanchan | (fol. 1r1–4) «End of the root text» smaragaralakhaṃḍanaṃ mama śirasi maṃḍanaṃ ⟪de⟫(dhe)hi padapllavam udāraṃ || jvalati mayi dāruṇo madanakadanāruṇo harau tadupahitavikāraṃ 7 iti caṭulacāṭupaṭucārumukhairiṇo rādhim adhivacanajātaṃ || jayati padmāpatīramaṇajayadevakavibhāratī bhaṇitam atiśā[ṃ]taṃ 8 (fol.4r5–6) «End of the commentary» ataḥ para jayadeva kavi vadasītyādi liikana haratu tadupahitavikāraṃ ñāhāparyaṃtakā gīdale sāmabhedadānanati eti upāya rādhāko māna chuṭāunākā nimitta śrīkṛṣṇale gari cukāyā bhani iti caṭula es gīdale bhanchan | uktaprakārale rādhikākana śrīkṛṣṇale ājñā garyākā cārarahrayakā vacana saba bhaṃdā ukṛṣṭa bhairahun | kastā vacan suṃdara ata eva sabakan piyārā lāgnyā ata eva catura tasmā pani komala akṣarale yukta hayākā | pheri kastā pdmānābha garyā ki pativratākā kāṃatabhayākā jo jayadeva kavi gun tanle śṛṃgārarasamā ucita ((bhayāki)) bhāratī vṛttile anuvāda garikana bhanyākā ata eva sunyākā kukhakana garnyā estā sāmayogya bhedayoga dānayoga natiyogya vacanasarvokṛṣṭa bhaī virājamāna havan bhani kaviko prārthanā cha| 8 | śubhaṃ bhūyāt | (fol. 4r9v4v4) Colophon nirmāya bhavadattena bhāṣāṭippaṇīsādaram || likhitā śramavettā tu bhūyāllālaḥ prabhuḥ param || ||(fol. 4v4–5)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīmanmahātripurasuṃdaryai namaḥ || mālāmaṃtraṃ pravakṣāymi mahārājñī mahodayaṃ || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa pūjāsiddhi[ḥ] prajāyate || 1 || tritārīpraṇavaṃ procya namas tripurasuṃdari || hṛdayād devi śabdāṃte śirodevīti kīrtayet || 2 || śīkhādevipadaṃ procya kavacād evi śabdataḥ || netradevyastradevītī kāmeśvarī bhageti ca || 3 || (fol. 1r1–7) End śakte mahāmahāgupte tataś caiva mahā mahā || jñepte mahāmahānaṃde tataś caiva mahā mahā || 45 || skaṃde mahā mahāśabdā dāśaye parikīrtayet || tato mahāśrīticakranagarāc ca tataḥ punaḥ || 46 || saṃrājñīpadam uccārya namas te tritayaṃ punaḥ || agnijāyāvilomena tritārīṃ ca prakīrtayet || 47 || mālāmaṃtro mahābhāga sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ || ekatriṃśatsahastrārṇas trilokīmihanakṣamaḥ || 48 || (fol. 6r6–6v6) Colophon iti khaḍgamāloddhāras samāptaḥ || ❁ || (fol. 6v6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāyai(!) namaḥ || || atha gavākṣasthāpanavidhiḥ || mālako jiyake || || yajamānapuṣpabhājana || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramallavarmaṇaḥ śrī3sveṣṭadevatāprītikāmanayā prāsādanirmitagavākṣasthāpanakalaśārcaṇa(!) balyārcaṇa(!)siddhāgniyajñe kattuṃ(!) puṣpabhājanaṃ smarpayāmi || || śrī saṃvattā(!)maṇḍalānte kramapadanihitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ akulakulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ | catvāraḥ pañcakonyaṃ punarapi caturaṃ tattvato maṇḍalena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namatu(!) guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśa(!) || (fol .1v1–2r2) End ekāre || ambepūrvva || svāna taya || malākostā viya || kaumārīvisarjjanaṃ || kiṇi 2 vicce kohvaṇāyai hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || tālatraya 3 || saṃhāramudrāna visarjjana || laṃkhaccha turute || no siya || || sarvvamaṃgara(!)māṃgale(!) śive sarvārthasādhake (!) | saraṇya(!) traṃbike(!) gauri nārāyaṇi namo stu te || kaumārī cchoya || sākṣi thāya || kṛtakarmmasākṣiṇe śrīsūryāya arghaṃ namaḥ puṣpaṃ namaḥ || || (fol. 118v3–119r1) Colophon iti śrīśrīśrīsiddhāgniyajñagavākṣasthāpanaskaumārārccanavidhiḥ samāptaṃ || || śubham astu || … naumi ucchistha(!)nātha || … (fol. 119r1–119v5)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || mālāmaṃtraṃ pravakṣyāmi mahārājñī mahodayaṃ || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa pūjāsiddhiḥ prajāyate || 1 || tritārīṃ praṇavaṃ procya namas tripurasundari || hṛdayād deviśabdānte śiro devīti kīrttayet || 2 || śikhādevīpadaṃ procya kavaca devīśabdataḥ || netra devyastra devīyaṃ kāmeśvari bhageti ca || 3 || mālinītipadaṃ nityaklinnepadam udīrayet || bheruṇḍe vahni vāśabdāt siniśabdo mahāpadaṃ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–7) End hṛtthayaś caiva hṛllekhā halī ca halikāmatā || sarasvatī ca sarvajñaḥ kamalākāṃtamarddanau || 81 || haranāthaḥ kāmaśivaḥ lalitā haravallabhā || lakṣmīś caiva lalajjihvo hiraṇyahṛdayeśvara || 82 || sarveśvarodhaśakalājananī lalitāmbikā || karuṇākarakāmeśa kāmakoṭiś ca tadvadhūḥ || 83 || līlāvatī ca lalitā kāmo lāvaṇyanāyakaḥ || hareśvarī hiraṇyā ca bāhus tadbhartṛśaṃkaraḥ || 84 || (fol. 11r9–11v6) Colophon iti khaḍgamāloddhāraḥ || (fol. 11v7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śīmaṅgalāyai || pehnu hṅava pīṭhapūjā cchoya || hṅathvakvahnu (+)lusiyāyā kṣūrakarmma yāya kharisnāna yāya pavitravastrana geya || nityakarmmayāya || cakroddhāra yāya || pañcalaṃṅana || devayākeśatabhṛndikā coya halalīnacchi yāya ṅāpā lūghāṅāvatāthe māla || kālīyā paddhatīna karmmārvvaṇa(!) yāya || samayādihaviṣya ekabhaktaḥ || || kālīyā gāyatrīṇa jāpa yāya sakala sana dolacchi yāya || yajñamaṇḍapasa || || (fol. 1v1–3) End ❖ atha caturthīkvahnuyā aṭapāpaṃyā(!)sa homayāya || kalaśapūjā || layāthividhithyaṃ dhunake || kalaśābhiṣeka || yajñavisarjana yāya || dīpajāgaṇa(!) || || santi kuhnu pratyārambha || || ❁ || ❖ atha ṣaṭmāse bhasmaṃ pravāhayet || yajñakuṇḍasa coṅa nalithaṃ kāyāva thālāsate || vibhāyalana kāvataya || caṇḍapūjā yāya || caṇḍayā gaṇa samaya cchoya dhunaṅāva nalinatulakāva, khosacūyabaliccha yāta viyāva thānasa vācake || khosacūyavākya || oṃ mayā pūrvvakṛtaṃ sthāpya nadyā pañcadevatā | suprītaṃ subhadañ caiva mayā adya visarjayet (!) || gaṅā tvaṃ paramā devi pavitraṃ pāpanāśani(!) | nirmmālyaṃ lehyacūrṇañ ca vāhayed yajñakalmaṣa(!) || || snāna yāya || || devasake matā pūjā yāya sagona kāya || samayakalaṃkacchoya || || (fol. 31r8–31v3) Colophon iti guhyakālīpratiṣṭhā ahorātrayajñaṃ samāptaṃ || || samvat 731 kārttikakṛṣṇa tṛtīyāyāntithau rohinī(!) nakṣatre budhavāra kvahnuṃ guhyakālīpratiṣṭhā yāṅā dina śrī upādhyā uddhavarājena sañcitam idaṃ pustakaṃ || caparitale satayā pratibhārapratiṣṭhāṃthama yāṅā || śubhaṃ || || saṃvat 746 caitra śukla navamyāntithau puṣyanakṣatre ādityavāsare śrī3guhyakālīpratiṣṭhālikhitadinaṃ śrīuddhavanāthaguro(!) prasādācchrīkālīdāsenalikhitam idaṃ pustakaṃ || śrīśrīśrīdevīprītir astu || tasmai gurave sadārādhane rato ʼhaṃ bhavāmi || || śubham astu sarvvadā bāndhavādīnāṃ || ❁ || (fol. 31v5–9)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaśrīgaṇeśāya 2 || || atha brahmagā(ya)trī ekākṣarīpraṇavasya śarīle(!) sthānam āha || taduktaṃ śrībrahmasaṃhitāyāṃ || bhruvayor nāsikāyuktaṃ praṇavaḥ cintate budhaiḥ || tasyābhraṃtarage prāṇa iḍāṃ ca piṃgalādiṣu || iḍānāḍisthitaḥ ścaṃdra piṃgalābhānuvāhini || suṣumnā haṃsarūpeṇa haṃśaśaṃbhusvarūpakaḥ || tasmāt praṇavaprāṇaṃ ca m(!)ekīkṛtya tad abhyaset || (fol. 1v1–4) End yo bhargaḥ sarvāṃtaryāmīśvaro naḥ asmākaṃ sarveṣāṃ sāsāriṇāṃ dhiyo buddhiḥ pracodayāt || dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu prerayati || || tena gāyatrīsvarūpaṃ āha || tat savitur vareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt || || ardhamātrāvivarjjitā ṇakāre yakārayuktaṃ tena caturviṃśati gāyatrī bhavati | anya praṇavādi bījaṃ vyāhṛti evaṃ mantraṃ guruvākyena gamanīyaṃ || || (fol. 3r5–9) Colophon iti gāyatrībheda saṃpūrṇaṃ || || ❖ atha bālāyā śāporddhāra(!) || || devyā śaptā kīlitā ca vidyeyaṃ tan na siddhidā | śāpoddhāram athotkīlaṃ vidhāya japam ācaret || … śāpoddhāre prakāro nyo yad vā yaṃ kīrttito budhaiḥ || || mantrārādhanadīpikāyāṃ || || (fol. 3v1–6)

Beginning asya śrīmad uttarāmnāyakulaguhyakālīśrīmat guhyamahāgaṇṭādevī mahāmantrasya vindunādasadāśivaṛṣiḥ avyakta bṛhatī chandaḥ kulaguhyakālīśrīmat guhyamahāghaṇṭādevī devatā gha ḥṛīṃ hūṃ ghaṇṭā▒ bījaṃ gha hrīṃ hūṃ śaktiḥ gha hrīṃ kīlakaṃ śrīmad uttarāmnāyākulaguhyakālīphalasiddhyarthaṃ śrīmat kulaguhyamahāghaṇṭādevīprasādasiddhyarthaṃ surāsuramānavādivaśīkaraṇārthaṃ śrīmatkulamahāghaṇṭāvādane viniyogaḥ (exp. 2t1–6) End vādanamantraḥ putrān dehi mahākālī sarvaiśvaryaṃ pradehi me rājyaṃ dehi mahāmāye paśūn dehi maheśvari ādhipatyaṃ ca devānāṃ sarveṣāṃ caiva dehi me tantrayantramahāmantramudrāsiddhiṃ ca dehi me āyur dehi yaśo dehi buddhiṃ dehi maheśvari jayaṃ dehi jaganmātaḥ kīrttiṃ caivātha dehi me dhānyaṃ dehi mahākālī sarvasiddhiṃ pradehi me namo namo mahākālī guhyakāli namo namaḥ (exp. 8t4–8b3) Colophon iti ghaṇṭāvādanaṃ tataḥ sāṅgaphalaprāptyarthaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt (exp. 8b3–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || devyuvāca || deva deva jagannātha bhaktānugrahakāraka || sarvvāpadbhyaḥ samāpnoti paritrāṇaṃ kathaṃnaraḥ || 1 || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi guhyād guhyataraṃ tathā || āpaduddhāraṇaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ || 2 || śatam aṣṭottaraṃ caiva japtvā dhyātvā ca kālikāṃ || indrajin bandhanānmuktaḥ purā devaḥ śacīpatiḥ || 3 || bhairavosya ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī devatā prabhuḥ || kālikā viniyogasya sarvāpadvinivāraṇe || 4 || (fol. 1v1–6) End na deyaṃ paraśiṣyebhyo bhaktyebhyo vā viśeṣataḥ || śiṣyebhyo bhaktiyuktebhyaś cānyathā mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 35 || spargghām uddhūyakamalā (kamalā) vāgdevī mandire sakhe || pautrāntaṃ sthairyam āsthā(ya) nivasatyeva niścitaṃ || 36 || idaṃ ṣoḍasanyāsaṃ jñātvā yo japed guhyakālikām || (!) śatalakṣaṃ prajaptvāpi tasya mantro na siddhyati || 37 || sadāstraghātam āpnoti so cirān mṛtyum āpnuyān || 38 || (exp. 8b4–9t3) Colophon iti śrīguhyakāliṣoḍasanyāsaḥ samāptamḥ(!) || śubham || śrīḥ (exp. 9t3)

Beginning pretoparī sthitā | mātrāṣṭasya madhyesthā siddhiyogini pūjitā || saumyāgrajaprabhāvena sādhakecchā samāsṛtā | dāritāsyā lelihānā jvālāpu(ṣpaṃ)ṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ jaga || ucchvāsocchvāsayogena (sā) cārayaṃt(!) kulaparvatā | kvacit haṃse kvacit kuṣyet kvacit saṃharate prajāḥ | kvacit sṛje kvacit pālya svataṃtrecchā pravarttate | (exp. 3t11–4) End dhyāna || dhyāt parāparāśakti viśvagāsaikalaṃpatāṃ | puṇṇimāpūritā jñeyā caritā sātvatā smṛtā || sāntyā parāparāśāntā śūnyātītā niraṃjanāḥ | mahātejomayī lakṣmī raśmikotyāyutopamā || nirmalā niḥkalā devī sakalā sthūravigrahā | pañcavaktrā daśabhujā tripañcanayanai yutā ||(!) śvetavarṇā mahādevī mahā (exp. 44t3–6) «Sub-colophon» iti nisārccanavidhiḥ || || (exp. 24t2–3)

Beginning iha sannirudhyasva || argha viya || aiṃ pādyaṃ namaḥ || hrīṃ arghaṃ svāhā || śrīṃ ācamanīyaṃ svadhā || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ snānaṃ namaḥ || pātrayā vindu ai taya || ▒ ▒ ānandabhairavāya surāśaktyai namaḥ || ceta svāna dhūpa dīpa naivedya || mūlanaṃ || kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ anaṅgakusumāśrīpādukāṃ || caṃ chaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ anaṃgamekhalāśrīpādukāṃ || ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ anaṃgamadanāśrīpādukāṃ || (exp. 2t1–6) End thanā pīṭhapūjā || oṃ uḍyānapīṭhāya namaḥ || jāṃ jālaṃdharapīṭhāya namaḥ || kāṃ kāmarūpapīṭhāya namaḥ || pūṃ pūrṇagiripīṭhāya namaḥ || lāṃ vāṃ rāṃ yāṃ hsauḥ paṃcapretāsanebhyo namaḥ || tattvaśodhana || dhyāna || pāṭalāvarṇarūpā sā chatraṃ vajra bhujadvaye || gajāsanagatā devī vindupātre rasāmṛtaṃ || āvāhanamudrā kene || śrīvajreśvari ihāgaccha 2 iha tiṣṭha 2 iha sannidhehi || (exp. 6b1–6) === Colophon ===x

Beginning svasti(ḥ) śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha kaulārṇavenoktam || merupṛṣṭhasukhāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ ca śaṃkaram || tryaṃbakaṃ paripṛcchāmi pārvvatīparameśvaram || 1 || śrīdevyuvāca || kīdṛśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ devaṃ (!) kīdṛśaṃ śaktipūjanaṃ || kīdṛśā ca śakti(!) proktā kīdṛśo vīra ucyate || śrīmahādeva uvāca || suśobhanā śaktipūjāñ lakṣaṇaṃ maṃḍalaṃ caiva vīraśaktisamaṃ priye || (!) pātrāṇi tatra saṃsthāpya tataḥ pūjanam ācaret || 3 || brahmāṃḍamaṃḍalākāraṃ pātraṃ naumi paraṃ śubham || surayā pūritaṃ sākṣād āyur vittaṃ prayaccha me || (vol. 1v1–5) End śrīśiva uvāca || macchamo satyavādīnāṃ pādārthaḥnāṃbhiṣevanaṃ(!) || yāgakāle vinā yatra mayā na kathitaṃ priye || 41 || kaniṣṭikānāṃ svaśiṣyāya dadyāt sociṣṭam(!) aṃvike || dadyāt sohena yonyabhya sa bhaved āpadā parām || 42 || śrīgurujyeṣṭhapūjānāṃ purataḥ kulanāyike || nopaviṣya pibed dravyaṃ miti(!) śāstrasya niścayam || 43 || pavartte yoginīcakre sarve varṇā dujātayaḥ(!) || nivartte yoginīcakre sarve varṇā pṛthak pṛthak || (fol. 9r5–9v1) Colophon iti śrīkaulārṇave mahāra(ha)sye umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde adhyāyaḥ || śrībhavānīśaṃbhyāṃ namaḥ || rāmaṃ satyā prāmātuḥ || śubhaṃ bhūyāt || saptaṣṭarasabhūsāke māse vaiśāṣameva ca || (fol. 9v1–2)

Beginning || atha grahaṇakālīnapuraścaraṇaṃ || tatra grahaṇapūrvvadine upavāsaḥ kāryaḥ kecid grahaṇadine evopavāsaṃ manyante tatra ca sākṣāt samudragāminyāṃ nadyāṃ nābhimātrajale sthitvā japaḥ kāryaḥ tadabhāve nadyabtare nade samudrasannihatyādau puṇyatīrthe yavanādinirmitajalāntare vā uddeśya(gata) liṅgasaṃkhyayor avivakṣitatvān nadasya nadīsaṅgamasya ca mukhyakalpatvamevetyapi vadanti | (exp. 3b1–4) End garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ jātakarma nāmakaraṇaṃ tapaniṣkramaṇaṃ annaprāśanaṃ cūḍākaraṇaṃ upanayanaṃ sahāvrata upaniṣat snānaṃ godānaṃ udvāhaś ca maraṇādi krūrakarmaṇi maraṇam api tato vahneḥ pitarau saṃpūjyātmani saṃyojya mūlāgra ghṛta(cyu) plutāpañcasamedho juhuyāt tatas tu tatkarmaṇi tat jihvāmaṃtrair namaḥ sthāne svāhā ++ḥ saptāhutir juhuyāt tataḥ pūrvokte rhadayor (!)I ṣaḍaṅgamantraiḥ svāhāntaiḥ ṣaḍāhutir juhuyāt svāhāntena svāhāntaraṃ tataḥ pūrvoktair vahnimūrttimantrair namaḥ sthāne svāhā yuktair aṣṭāhutir juhuyāt (exp. 8:5–10) === Colophon ===x

Beginning … aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ sarvvamantrāsanāya namaḥ || aiṃ kāmarūpapīṭhāya namaḥ || klīṃ pūrṇagiripīṭhāya namaḥ || sauṃ jālandharapīṭhāya namaḥ | aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ uḍyānapīṭhāya namaḥ || || thanā maṃci sere hūṃ hūṃ astrāya phaṭ maṃḍalasato || theke tane || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ khphreṃ rāṃ rīṃ rūṃ raiṃ rauṃ raḥ ▒ dharmapradadaśakalātmane agnimaṃḍalāya arghapātrāsanāya namaḥ || || (exp. 3t2–4t1) End oṃ phreṃ ṛgvedamuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ phreṃ yayurvedamuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ phreṃ sāmavedamuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ phreṃ atharvavedamyṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ phreṃ indramuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || ( oṃ agnimuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ ) oṃ phreṃ yamamuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ phreṃ naiṛtyamuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ phreṃ varuṇamuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || ( oṃ phreṃ vāyumuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ ) oṃ phreṃ kuberamuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ phreṃ īśānamu (exp. 9t1–b4) === Colophon ===x

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo mahāgaṇapataye namaḥ || atha gajaśāntimahābalividhānaṃ likhyate || vaṃsosyaṃ julā yaṃsosyaṃ julā yā kahmā conā caturasra yāṅā maṇḍapa gvaya || || vāthele || || atha bhūtabalividhi || ju || pūjā || tāya patavāsa || ghuna || itāla || jajamakā || pā+bali || arghapātra || nyākilipūjā || elkā palkā akṣata gulato bhukasvāna sāsa khi || (++) paṃcapatākā || phaiṅā cucope māla || thvate samastaṃ data ṅāva || || yajamāna puṣpabhājanayācake || oṃ adyādi || vākya || śrīsamvattā || (fol. 1v1–6) End thvanaṃ bali || tvākamahābali dhunake || āvāhanādimudrā || || dhūpa || dīpa || naivedya || stotra || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalā || śrīsamvattā || ucchiṣṭapūrvvakāś devīm mātaṅgī (!) sarvvasiddhidām | sarvvapāpaharāṃ devīṃ sarvvadoṣavivarjjitāṃ || yayā vijñātayā devyā kṣayaṃ gacchanti cāpadaḥ || sthāvaraṃ jaṅgalaṃ(!) caiva kṛtimaṃ(!) cāṅgajaṃ tathā || viṣaṃ jayati deveśi svaparāṅgasamāśritaṃ || atra gandhādi || śāntipuṣṭir bhavatu || || ekāneka || ambepūrvva || astrana visarjjana yāya || kalaṃka chhoya || tāmbūlaṃ dadyāt || || (fol. 212v6–213r4) Colophon iti sarvvotpātasarvāriṣṭagajasālāśāntikaumārijāgavidhis samāptaḥ || || … ❖ samvat 818 āṣāḍha śudi 15 śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramallasana saṃpūrṇa yāṅā || (fol. 213r5–213v7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ paradevāyai || āgamasaromarālīṃ śrutiśākhāvahiṇīṃ kālīṃ | ṣaḍdarśanakramanḍakīṃ paraśivasahakārakokilāṃ naumi || śrīgaṃgādharatanayā dharaṇīdhara eṣa vārendraḥ | viracayati guhyakālyāḥ pūjāvidhim adhikavistaraṃ ramyaṃ || natvā siṃhagrīva bhedaṃ purastān gallīnāthaṃ tatpareṇa praṇamya | ātmārāmaṃ jñānadevaṃ vibhāvya guhyānandaṃ mantrasiddheśvarañ ca || jyotirūpaṃ bhaṭtamadhyārjunākhyaṃ saṃsmṛtyaitāṃ paṃktim eṣāṃ gurūṇāṃ | teṣām evā ʼnugrahāt saṃhitāntāṃ abhyāsoccaiḥ śrīmahākālapūrvvakam(!) || bhīmātantraṃ vāmakeśaṃ ca tantraṃ | dṛṣṭvā cānyāḥ saṃhitā mantrarūpāḥ śuddhāṃ pūjāṃ paddhatiṃ guhyakālyā nyāsārccādyāṃ sapramāṇāṃ karomi | (fol. 81r1–5) End hrīṃ gandharvadevatāya candanānulepanāya hūṃ phaṭ iti pūrvvavat sarvvatra || śrīlakṣmīdevatāya(!) puṣpāya puṣpasraje patrāya patrasraje jalajāya sthalajāya sagandhāya nirgandhāya nānārūpāya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || iti puṣpasya || aiṃ vanaspatidevatāya dāruniryāsāṅgākārāya hūṃ phaṭ | iti dhūpasya || kṣauṃ raṃ vahnidevatāya ghṛtatailāktāya hūṃ phaṭ || iti dīpasya || klīṃ prajāpatidevatāyānnabalaye niṛtidevatāya māṃsabalaye(!) ḍākinīdaivatāya surābalaye hūṃ phaṭ || iti baliḥ || hrauṃ vidyādharadaivatāya rāgahetukāya tā (fol. 88v3–6) Colophon

Beginning phaṭ namaḥ svāhā || hrīṃ phreṃ glauṃ glūṃ sugaṃdhāyai phaṭ namaḥ svāhā || hrīṃ phreṃ glūṃ helāyai phaṭ namaḥ svāhā || hrīṃ phreṃ glūṃ sudhānujāyai phaṭ namaḥ svāhā || || tato dhyānaṃ || sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ candrakoṭisuśītalaṃ || aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ devaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanaṃ || amṛtārṇavamadhyasthaṃ brahma padmoparisthitaṃ || bṛṣārūḍhaṃ nīlakaṃthaṃ(!) sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaṃ || kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharaṃ ghaṇtādamaru(!)vādinaṃ || pāśāṅkuśadharaṃ devaṃ gadāmugara(!)dhāriṇaṃ || (exp. 3B1–5) End sarvvāsurakṣayakari khaḍgakhaṭvāṅgadhāriṇi || mahāghore mahārāve daityadarpanidūdani(!) || imaṃ paśubaliṃ devi gṛhītvā kālarātrike || prītā bhava mahācaṇḍe rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgataṃ || āyur dehi dhanaṃ dehi bhogyaṃ kīrttiṃ ca dehi me || striyaṃ dehi sugāṃ dehi sarvān kāmāṃśca dehi me | ugracaṇḍe praṇḍāsi pracaṇḍakaravāriṇi || mahācaṇḍogradorddaṇḍa viśveśvari namo stu te | rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāpannāṃ tvatpādārppitamānasām || (exp. 60:2–7) === Colophon ===x

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo śrīśrīśrīmahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīśrīgurubhyo namo namaḥ || || atha gajulikokāyayā balyārcanavidhiḥ || || vidhithyaṃ patavāsana coya || bhevata balipāta 1 || arghapātra taya || laṃkhana hāyāva candanādi || || yajamāna puṣpabhājana || adyādi vākya || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevavarmaṇaḥ śrīśrīśrīsveṣṭadevatāprītyarthaṃ śrī3sveṣṭadevatāyā jīrṇṇoddhārasuvarṇakalaśacāranaśāntikabalyārcanapuṣpabhājanaṇ samarpayāmi || (fol. 1v1–6) End icchā(jñānī) kriyā sā suravaranamitā sā śriyā maṅgalākhyā sā gaurī sā ca durggā bhagavati śubhadā mātṛkāścarmamuṇḍā || sā brahmā sā ca viṣṇu grahagaṇasakalā bhairavī kṣetrapālā || sānekānekarūpā vividhaguna(!)dayā yoginīstvāṃ namāmi || || pūrvvaṃ dakṣiṇapaścimittara śivā pūrvvādi vāmāśrikā kṣetreśā vaṭubhūtadurggaharaṇaṃ herambanāthāya (!) śmaśāneśvaramādide(!) bhujaḥ sokādidoṣapradā(!) nityānandamayo pramodita sadā balyādipūjāvidhiḥ || || yathā vā (fol. 14v2–7) === Colophon ===x

Beginning ❖ oṃ gurubhyo 2 || śrīkubjikāyai namaḥ || paṃcapraṇavanyāsa prathama || aṃ āstrāya phaṭ 4 || aiṃ kaniṣthāyai namaḥ || hrīṃ anāmikāyai namaḥ || śrīṃ madhyamāyai vauṣat || ▒ tarjjanyai hūṃ || ▒ aṃguṣṭhāyai vauṣaṭ || aiṃ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābyāṃ 2 || || aiṃ ūrdhvavaktrāyai namaḥ || hrīṃ pūrvvavaktrāyai svāhā || śrīṃ dakṣiṇavaktrāyai vauṣaṭ || (fol. 1v1–6) End jānāmi dharmman na ca me pravṛtti(!) jānāmyadharmman na ca me nivṛttiḥ | tvayā maheśāni hṛdisthayāhaṃ yathāniyuktāsmi tathā karomi || devī śrīguhyakālī tvaṃ dehānujñā maheśvari | prayatiṣya(!) nideśāt te yogakṣemārthasiddhaye || thvate anujñā kāyā va devatā ātmāsa jotirūpaśaśīrabhārape || (fol. 30v3–31r2) Colophon iti śrīguhyakālisa prātaḥkṛtyavidhi(!) samāptaḥ || || (fol. 31r2–3)

Beginning ❖ atha śrīdīpārādhanaṃ || asya śrīguhyakālīkuladīpalakṣmīmahāmantrasya mārttaṇḍabhairavaṛṣiḥ anuṣṭupchandaḥ | śrīguhyakālīkuladīpalakṣmīdevatā | hrīṃ bījaṃ khphreṃ śaktiḥ śrīkīlakaṃ || śṛiguhyakālīprasādasiddhyarthe dīpārādhane viniyogaḥ || hrāṃ mityādi ṣaddīrghena gulyādinyāsaḥ (!) || ▒ mityādi ṣaddirghe hṛdayādinyāsaḥ || (exp. 5b1–5) End iti mūladevyai ghṛtadīpaṃ dadyāt || ▒ śrīmahābhairavāya śrīguhyakālīpīṭhanivāsine mahāyogeśvarāya tubhyaṃ śivarātrīdīpaṃ amṛtajyotir nivedayāmi namaḥ svāhā || iti bhairavāya dīpaṃ dadyāt || punar anyadevatābhyas tatan(!) mantreṇa dīpaṃ dadyāt || ▒ rudraśaktikālyai kala2 dīpāyaṃ namaḥ || iti dīpaṃ nivedya jyotirmaya mahākālī guhyakālī kuleśvari | jñānajvālāguhyakāli guhyabhairavi te namaḥ || iti stutvā pañcamudrābhir nnasya(!) || iti śivarātridīpavidhiḥ (exp. 41b2–42t1) Colophon iti śrīuttarāmnāya nirvvāṇasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatsāhasrikāyāṃ mahādevaproktāyāṃ sārātsāratarāyāṃ sveṣṭadevatāyāḥ śrīmannirvvāṇaguhyakālyāḥ naimmittikahomasukharātriśivarātrividhiṃ vaḍavānalabhairavo vaḍavānalabhairavya kathayāmāseti ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ || || (exp. 43t2–6)

Beginning atha vaktrapūjā || ((jyotivaktre)) yāṃ uṃ tāṃ iṃ phreṃ yogeśvarīśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ || siṃhavaktre || evaṃ sāṃ iṃ hāṃ phreṃ siddhiyogeśvari śrī 9 || kapivaktre || yāṃ vāṃ kāṃ tāṃ phreṃ caṇḍayogeśvari śrī 9 || ṛkṣavaktre || bhāṃ lāṃ uṃ kāṃ phreṃ mahācaṇḍayogeśvarī śrī 9 || varāhavaktre || vāṃ rāṃ hāṃ phreṃ mahāśmaśānayoginīśrī 9 || (exp. 2t1–5) End … śrīnirvvāṇaguhyakālikāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi || iti pūjya || punaḥ || 1 guhyeśvaryai śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ || 1guhyayoginyai śrī9 || guhyayogeśvaryai 10 || 1 guhyacaṇḍayogeśvaryai 10 || guhyamahācaṇḍayogeśvaryai 10 || 1 guhyamahākālayoginyai 10 || 1 guhyamahāśmaśānakālyai 10 || 1 guhyamahāvīracaṇḍakapālinyai 10 || 1 guhyabhairavaguhyakālyai 10 || 1 guhyabhairavanirvvāṇaguhyakālyai 10 || 1 guhyamahākāmakalāmahākāmeśvara(brahma)guhyakālyai 10 || 1 guhyasiddhibhairavasiddhilakṣmīguhyakālyai śrī 9 || || iti pū- === Colophon ===x

Beginning atha paśubalidānavidhiḥ || (( prasaṃgā likitamadhikārī para )) (!) tatrādau chāgabaliḥ || sādhako pi mahādevi paśukālyai maheśvari | darśayitvā mahābhaktyā paśuṃ tubhyam idaṃ śive || ānītaṃ tava deveśi paśya 2 mahotsavaṃ | iti paśuṃ ānīya || adyādikaṃ paṭhitvā saṃkalpaṃ kāraretataḥ(!) || sāmarasya parabrahma nirvvāṇaguhyakālike || mama devyā ḥ guhyakālyāḥ guhyakālyāḥ prasādataḥ ||(fol. 1r1–5) End iti khaḍgena siracchedya baliṃ dadyāt || phreṃ astrāya phaṭ | iti siracchedya || oṃ iti sirasi dīpaṃ nidhāya oṃ śrīguhyakālyai idaṃ haṃsamuṇḍaṃ nivedayāmi namaḥ || iti muṇḍaṃ nivedya | punar bhaktādibhyuktaṃ tatmāṃsaṃ nivedya || stutiṃ kuryāt | tadyathā || ugracaṇḍā pracaṇḍāsi pracaṇḍakaracāriṇi | mahācaṇḍārggadorddaṇḍe viśveśvari namostu te || iti stutvā yathāsukhaṃ vihared iti haṃsabalividhiḥ || (fol. 20r1–6) Colophon iti śrīmaºº nirvvāṇaguhyakālyāḥ ((chāgamakha hi varāha mekha karkkaṭahaṃsa))balipradānaṃ baḍavānalabhairavo bhairavyai kathayāmāseti daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ || || (fol. 20r6–7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo mahābhairavāyaḥ(!) || kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ devaṃ tribhuvaneśvaraṃ | praṇamya śirasā devī pṛcchate kālikā haraṃ || oṃ namo bhagavate guhyakālike bhairavī śrīmarmmābhighātinī namo namaḥ || samarasasaṃsthitaṃ devaṃ bhairavaṃ pralayānalaṃ | pṛcchate kālikā devī marmmāvidyā tā/// +++bhairavo bhīṣma sadvetād vetasthāyanaṃ | yena yeṣāṃ tripatistas teṣām anu/// ++ adhyete nityabhāvataḥ | dvetan na vikalpayet adve katha/// + devi mahāguhyā pralayānalakālikā | (fol. 1v1–6) End oṃ namaḥ siddhacāmu///lāni rudha 2 dhara 2 phaṭ 2 spheṃṭaya 2 cūra 2 hana 2 pheṃ hūṃ pha/// khaḍgala guṭa vakravidhinnivāraṇī hūṃ truṭ 2 meghāna | staṃbhaya 2 /// +raya 2 hana 2 mahābhayāstarāṇi | hrīṃ 2 cchrīṃ 3 hrīṃ 3 pheṃ 3 phaṭ || vidyutkoṭitejadaṃḍe hana 2hūṃ 5 phaṭ 5 ṭha ṭha || tṛtāle tarjjanīkayā udakaṃ dhārayati | meghāna spheṃṭayati | jāpyena siddhyati | muṣalakā kalabhaktakoṭikā | udukhālā tulanī | saṃhāraṇī kayā | uṭtanā (fol. 42v1–6) === Colophon ===x

Beginning ❖ śṛīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīguru(!)ve namaḥ || || atha gaṇapatyādi umāma(2)heśvarasya, dhvajāvalohanavidhi(!) llikhyate || || vidhithyaṃ, vali, kalaśa mā(3)rako vasape || || tato yajamāna, puṣpabhājana || adyādi || vākya || mānava(4)gotra yajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūtīndramallavatmaṇaḥ śrīśrīśrīsvaṣṭadevatā(5)prītyarthaṃ, gaṇapatyādi umāmaheśvara, sthāpana varṣavaddhrana, kalaśārccana, ya(6)jña nimityāthena kartuṃ puṣpabhājana samarppayāmi || || (fol. 1v1–6) End sidhra || oṁ tvaṃyaviṣṭha || || ……….. || (4) oṁ dadhikrāpno || || āśīrvvāda || oṁ rājantama || || ārati || oṁ tejosi || || prati(5)maṅgara || || sūryya sākṣi thāya || || (fol. 37v3–5) Sub-colophons I(fol. 19v4)ti deśāpāṭanavidhi || || iti kālāpātanavidhi āhuti || || (fol. 20v3) iti ṛcaṃvācaṃ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 30r2) iti āppyāya samāptaḥ || (fol. 33r3) iti āsaṃśā samāptaḥ || || (fol. 36v6) Colophon iti gaṇapatyādi umāmaheśvarasthāpa(7)na varṣavaddhanavidhiḥ samāpta || śubha || (fol. 37v6–7)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || || atha cūlikāsthāpana (2) kalaśārccanavidhirlikhyate || || yajamāna puṣpabhājanaṃ || adyādi (3) vākya || jajamānasya mānavagotra śrī 2 jayabhūpatīndramallavarmmaṇaḥ (4) śrī 3 vārāhīdevyā jīrṇoddhāra prāsādopari cūrikāsthāpana kala(5)śārccana balyārccaṇa pujā kartuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāmi || || (fol. 1v1–5) End kvākāśa(5)ḥ kvasamīraṇa kvadahanaḥ kvāpaḥ kvaviśvambharā kvabrahmā kvaja(6)nārddanaḥ kvabhujagaḥ kvandu kvadevāsuraḥ kalpāntārabhaṭairnnaṭa(v1)ḥ pramuditaḥ śrīsiddhiyogeśvaraḥ krīḍānāṭakanāyako vija(2)yate devo mahābhairavaḥ || || purṇṇacandranibhaṃ śubhaṃ, darppaṇaṃ śa(3)tru darppada || ātma vindudharaṃ yasya saṃpradāya jayāya ca || || (4) komārī visarjjanaṃ || thāyasa choya || || sākṣi thāya || || (fol. 67r4–v4) Colophon iti cūlīkāsthāpana kalaśārccanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 67v5)

Beginning ❖ artha karmmācāryyayā cūlikāsthāpanayā ṣaṭvaktra balyārccanayā vidhā(2)na || brāhmaṇasyaṃ kalasārccanaṃvo yajñaṃvo kāraya || ācāda hāsya brā(3)hmaṇasa, javasa coṅāva bali ṣupātana ṅoyakāva, dathvasa bhevata (4) ṭayāva ṣaṭvaktra bali biya || laṃkhana hāya || ukāraṃ vāyu vījaṃ tadu(5)pari varuṇaṃ vajrapāṇiṃ taduddhaṃ kālaṃ varṇṇāntayuktaṃ tadupari para(6)maṃ vahni vījaṃ sahasaṃ | (fol. 1v1–6) End tarppana || prī(3)ta pretāsnasthā, bhavabhayaharanaṃ | bhairava mantramurtti caṇḍi caṇḍāsanasthā pha(4)ṇita phaṇīphanā lokapālā phaṇīndrā yakṣā rakṣā sutījñāḥ pitṛgaṇasaka(5)lā mātalā kṣetrapālā yoginyā yogayuktā jalacala khacalā pānameta(6) pivantu, pivantu devatāḥ sarvvaśva || rudrāścaiva vināyakāḥ yoginīḥ kṣe(7)trapālāśca mama dehī vyavasthitāḥ || vākya || namaḥ śrīnāthāya || namaḥ (8) śrīsiddhināthāya || namaḥ śrīkujeśanāthāya namo namaḥ || || (fol. 9v2-8) Colophon (fol. )

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || śrīcaṇḍikāi namaḥ || tataḥ prātasnā(2)nādi nityakarmmaṃ kuryyāt || || yajamāna puṣpabhājanaṃ || oṁ adyādi || vākya || mā(3)navagotra yajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevavarmmaṇaḥ śrī 3 sveṣṭadeva(4)tā prītyarthaṃ śrī 3 caṇḍikādevyā navagṛhapraveśapratiṣṭhā vighniharaṇa balyārccana(5) yajñārambha nimityarthaṃ karttuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāmi || || (fol. 1v1-5) «Extracts:» iti vighniharaṇabalyārccanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 16r1) iti mālinīdaṇḍakastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 28v6) iti kālāpātanavidhi || || (fol. 80r6) iti māṃsāhutividhiḥ || || (fol. 145r9) iti āsasāstotra samāptaḥ || || (fol. 156v10) End hnaskana kene || pūrṇṇacandra nibhaṃ śubhraṃ darppaṇaṃ(6) śatrudarppahā | ātmabimbadharaṃ yasya saṃpradāya jayāya ca || || sākṣī thāya || vā(7)kya || oṁ hrāṁ kṛta karma sākṣiṇe śrīsūryyāya arghannamaḥ puṣpannamaḥ sākṣiṇe namaḥ (8) || || thanā bali mālako choya || gaṇagogrāsa komārī dukhāpikhā dako sakatāṃ(9) choya juro || || (fol. 159v5–9) Colophon iti caṇḍikādevyāḥ gṛhapratiṣṭhādurggāgniyajñavidhiḥ samāpta(10)ḥ || || śubhamastu sarvvadā || || || (fol. 159v9–10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgurugaṇeśāya namaḥ || || arthaḥ dathuyā gulibali likhyate || brāhmaṇa ācāryya josi thvate senaṃ sthirahārāvava yāva || maṇḍapanapi urttarasāyamajirasā pūrvvasāyaṃteva || bali viya pāṭhayāya caṇḍi || || balipāta 1 dathusa pūrvvasapā 1 dakṣiṇapā 1 paścimasapā 1 uttarasapā 1 īśānasapā 1 || arghapātra || jalapātra || paṃcabali || gaṇavatuka(!) || thvate paṭavāsana coyāva jīyake || laṃkhana hāya || ūkālaṃ(!) vāyubījaṃ tadupari varuṇaṃ vajrapāṇi tadūrdhvaṃ | kālaṃ varṇāntayuktaṃ tadupari paramaṃ vahnibījaṃ sahaṃsaṃ || induṃ vinduṃ layānta sitakamalavaraṃ kṣīradhārāśravantaṃ | dṛṣṭvā kūṭaṃ tu nitya dahati kulamalaṃ merutulyaṃ hi pāpaṃ || || (fol. 1v1–2r1) End saṃhāramudrāṇa(!) balivisarjjana || sākṣithāya || || balicchoyavidhi || dathupāṭagalālalaṃkhu || (pūrvvapāṭha)balisapaṃmagāva || dakṣiṇa(pāṭha)bali bheraju || urttarapāṭha balipulako || īśānabali golajā dako sālāṅa || paścimapāṭhabali vaṭuka dumāju || parasekadakosakalaṃ dukhā pikhā cchoya || || (fol. 46v1-5) Colophon thvate dathupātacaṇḍīpāṭhabalipūjāvidhi(!) samāptaḥ || śubham astu sarvvadā || || || ❁ || (fol. 46v5–6)

Beginning svasti śrīmahāmaṃgalamūrttir vijayati|| || nṛsiṃhaguravaṃ vaṃde sākṣān nārāyaṇātmakaṃ|| cidānaṃdayanaṃ (!) pūrṇaṃ kāruṇyāmṛtasāgraṃ|| 1 || tad anugrahasaṃbhūtaṃ mādhaveṃdrasarasvatīṃ prakānaṃ dasanmātraṃ gurūttamam ahaṃ bhaje|| 2 ||<ref>pāda c is hypometrical.</ref> yad aṃghri sparśanād evabāladuṣṭākṣarāvalī|| śubhāya te bhaje taṃ śrīmādhaveṃdrasarasvatīṃ|| 3 || svaprakāśavimarśākhyavijāṃkuralatāṃ parāṃ|| śṛṃgāṭhapīṭhanilayāṃ vaṃde tripurasuṃdarīṃ|| 4 ||(fol. 1v1-4) <references/> End iti vāmānāmikāṃguṣṭhayogena dhārāṃ pātayan vighne[śam a]rpayet 3 kṣāṃ kṣīṃ kṣūṃ kṣaiṃ kṣauṃ kṣaḥ huṃ sthānakṣetrapāladhūpadīpādipiśitabalisahitaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇa 2 sarvavighnān nāśaya 2 huṃ phaṭ svāhā iti vāmakaniṣṭhikāṃguṣṭhayagena dhārāṃ pātayan kṣetrapālāyārppayet oṁ hrīṃ sarvayvighnakṛdhbhya[ḥ] sarvabhūtebhyo hūṃ phaṭ svāhā (fol. 43v4-7) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṁ siddhikālikāyai || sahasrārabjagāṃ devīṃ candrikopari saṃsthitāṃ | namāmi śirasā bhaktyā bhairavīṃ bhairavāsanāṃ || || atha prāta[ḥ] kṛtya || utthāya guruṃ namaskṛtya || snātvā tatra gāyatrīṃ daśadhā japet || oṁ siddhilakṣmī vidmahe navatyadhikadhīmahi tanno lakṣmī pracodayāt || 10 || ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vinyasya || oṁ hrāṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ || oṁ hrīṁ śirase svāhā || oṁ hruṁ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ || oṁ hraiṁ kavacāya huṁ || oṁ hrauṁ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ || oṁ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || navākṣareṇātmānaṃ jalenābhiṣiṃcya || devapitṛn saṃtarpya || khphreṁ 27 || oṁ 9 || nirucchvāsena smṛtvā mālāṃ smṛtvā saṃdhyāṃ vidhāya anupahatavāsasā paridhāya tripuṇḍatilakaṃ vidhāya vidyāpīṭhaṁ yāyāt || || (fol. 1v1–6) End khphreṁ siddhamahālakṣmīsāṅgaśrīpādaparāṅmukhārghaṃ vauṣaṭ arghaṃ datvā śrīpātre saṇḍaddho(!) varatrayaṃ nivedyārghaṃ devyā‥ sakalaparivāraṃ līnaṃ vibhāvya ātmānaṃ mahābhairavarūpaṃ saṃbhāvya khecarīmūdrayā khakāre līnaṃ vibhāvya kṣamasveti visarjjayet || yadvā khegatā bhagavatī akulagataśṛṅgāṭodaragatāṃ kṛtvā tenaiva mārggenādhāre vā visarjayet || ambe pūrvvagataṃ padaṃ bhagavagī caitanyarūpātmako(!) jñānecchā bahulā tathā hariharo brahmāmarīcitrayaṃ | bhāsvadbhiravapañcakaṃ tadanugataṃ śrīyoginīpañcakaṃ candrakkāgnimarīciṣaṭkam amalaṃ māṃ pātu nityaṃ śriyā || tataḥ pūjāsthānaṃ gomayenopalipya svecchayā viharet || || (fol. 25r6–25v2) Colophon iti śrījhaṃkāre karavīramahātantre aṣṭasāhasrikāyāṃ śrīcaṇḍakāpālinyāḥ saṃkṣepapūjāvidhiḥ || || (fol. 25v2)

Beginning ❖ śrī 3 gaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || || atha jalādhenupratiṣṭhākalaśārcaṇavidhi[r] likhyate || || yajamānapuṣpabhājana(!) || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrī 2 jayabhūpatīndramallavarmaṇa[ḥ] śrī 3 svestadevatāprītyarthaṃ jaladhenupratiṣṭhākalaśārcaṇapūjā kartuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi⟨ḥ⟩ || || śurddhaḥ(!) śāntaṃ śivetyādi || śaktipāśadharo nityaṃ jalarājo mahābalaḥ nimnagaḥ śuklarūaś ca namo ʼstu varuṇāya te || || siddhir astu kriyā(!)tyādi || || puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || || (fol. 1v1–6) End pitaraḥ saptagotrāś ca mātṛpaksāś ca sapta me | jaladānena tṛptantu(!) snānapānāvagāhanaiḥ || sāmānyaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo mayā darttam(!) idaṃ jalaṃ || ramantu sarvva(!) tāni snānapānāvahāhanaiḥ || || || gurutarpaṇa(!) || devatarpaṇayāya || pitṛtarpaṇamālako yāya || uparghaśanaṃ || || dakṣiṇādānavācana(!) || || vedācana yāya || || vidhithyaṃ kalaśārcanadhūnake || || yajamāna abhiṣeka(!) || āśī[r]vāda(!) || || sākṣīthāya || || (fol. 9r3–7) Colophon iti jaladhenupratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 9r7)

Beginning śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || iṣṭadevatābhyo namaḥ kuladevatābhyo namaḥ sarvebhyo bhrāhmaṇebhyo namaḥ mātāptṛbhyāṃ namaḥ || vakratuṃḍamahākāyetyādi paṭhitvā nūtanadhautavastradharo bhūṣaṇādyalaṃkṛtaḥ prasaṃnacetāḥ dūrvāyavākṣatajalāny ādāya adyetyādideśakālasaṃkīrttanāṃte amukagotrasya saparivārasya mama sakalābhiṣṭhasidhyarthaṃ cāmuṃḍāprītaye vārṣikaśāraktālikanavarātre adyaprabhṛti navamīparyaṃtaṃ śrīcāmuṃḍā[[yāḥ]]pūjanahomavalidānadīpadānakumārāpūjanādi yathasaṃbhavaṃ kariṣye (fol.1v1-6) End pūjāṃ caiva na jānāmi kṣamyatām parameśvari [[||]] punar ṛṣyādinyāsān kuryāt anayā pūjayā homabalidānakumārīpūjanapāṭhaśravaṇādinā ca śrīvaradevatā cāmuṃḍā prīyatāṃ kṛtaitat pūjanasāṃgatāsidhyartaṃ devīprītaye gurave brāhmaṇādibhyaś ca dakṣiṇāṃ dāsye dakṣiṇāṃ datvā kṛtaitat pūjanasāṃgatāsidhyarthaṃ brāhmaṇasuvāsanī(!) bhojanaṃ ca kariṣye iti saṃkalpa-abhiṣekapūrvakaṃ brāhmaṇāśiṣo gṛhṇīyāt yathāvakāśaṃ saṃkalpitabrāhmaṇasuvāsinībhojanaṃ ca kārayet || || (fol.11r4-10) Colophon iti śrīcāmuṃḍāpūjāpaddhatiḥ saṃpurṇā || śubham astu || (fol.11r10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrī3mahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || śrī3 kubjikā devī(!) namaḥ || || artha śrī3 talejuyā culikāsthāpana (yāya) sahasrāhuti yajñanavapīṭhiaṣṭamātri(!)kā ārādhana vidhi (!) likhyate || yajamānapuṣpabhājana yācake || || || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramallavarmaṇaḥ śrī3 sveṣṭadevatā prītyarthaṃ jīrṇoddhāracūlikāsthāpana navapīṭhi aṣṭamātri(!)kā ārādhana balyārccana pūjākarttuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmiḥ(!) || || (fol. 1v1–2v4) End aṭṭahāsamahākṣetre kadambabṛkṣavāsinī || tisthanti(!) pīṭhanaiṛtyā nārāyanī (!) namos tu te || || yathā vānaprahārānāṃ tyādi (!) || atra gaṃdhādi || || gvaya dakṣiṇā cchoya || namaskāla || samayacchoya || tarppaṇā || vākya || || deva āśirvvāda || ekā mūrttir anekadhātrityādi || || balivisarjjana || no siya || balibhokapūya || sākṣi thāya || (fol. 178v2–179v1) Colophon iti śrī3vaiṣṇavī pīṭhipūjā samāptaṃ || || ❁ || tato śrī3 vārāhīdevīpūjā || || no śiya || gurunamaskāra || aiṃ 5 akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākālaṃ tyādi (!) || || nyā (fol. 179v1–5)

«Beginning: » (śrīgaṇe)śāya namaḥ || || atha dakṣiṇakālīpūjāpaddhatir likhyate || || ādau yajamānācamya candanapuṣpabhūṣaṇaṃ || candanākṣatapuṣpajalaṃ gṛhītvā || adyādi || yajamānasyāmukasiddhyarthaṃ śrīdakṣiṇakālikārcanaṃ kartuṃ śrīsūryāya idam arghaṃ namaḥ puṣpaṃ namaḥ || puṣpabhājananamaskāraṃ kṛṭvā śrī ācāryāya dadet || punar ācāryena sūryārghaṃ kārayet || gurunamaskāraṃ || nyāsaṃ hrāṃ hṛdayādi ṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ kārayet || jalapātrapūjanaṃ || oṃ krīṁ gaṃgādisarvvatīrthebhyo namaḥ || || tīrthāvāhanaṃ || (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » mūlam uccārya śrīmad dakṣiṇakālikādevi kṣamasva iti saṃhāramudrayā svahṛdi devīṃ samānīyātmanobhūt || || arghapātrasthaṃ puṣpaṃ jalau nidhāya krīṁ caṇḍeśvarāya caṇḍeśvarīsahitāya namaḥ || tālatrayaṃ || astrāya phaṭ || saṃhāramudrayā balisthitāpuṣpāghrāṇaṃ kṣipet || aiṁ krīṁ caṇḍanāthāya hūṁ phaṭ svāhā || || ( āva mama rūpaṃ ? ) || || jaladhārāyā maṇḍalaṃ kṛṭvā pūjayet || oṁ satakarmaṇaḥ sākṣiṇe śrīsūryāyārgho namaḥ || āva mata viṣṇu 3 || || sarvebhya iṣṭe dadyāt || || kiṃcit naivedyaṃ svīkṛtya pādodakaṃ pītvā nirmālyaṃ śirasā vidhṛtya yathāsukhaṃ viharet || (fol. 17r2–17v1) «Colophon:» iti dakṣiṇakālikāyāḥ pūjāpaddhatiḥ samāptā || || śrīkālike prasīda || atha śāṃtistotraṃ || kulacūḍāmaṇau || … yāvan na dīyate vārghaṃ bhāskarāya nivedanam || tāvan na pūjayed viṣṇuṃ śaṃkaraṃ vā sureśvarīm iti || || śrīkālikā prasannā bhava || || yāte naipālikābde muniśaravivarāṅke site || (fol. 17v1–18v7)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrī(kā)li(kā)yai (na)maḥ || || atha kālikāyā viśeṣapūjāpaddhatir likhyate || || kṛpāṇaṃ kapālaṃ varābhītimudrāṃ bhujāgrair dadhānāṃ vasānāṃ ca kāṣṭhāṃ mahākālaraktāṃ mahāpānamattāṃ mahākālikām ambikāṃ tvām namāmaḥ 1 śrīmacchyāmāṅghriraktāmbujamadhuramadhusvādubhṛṅgāyamānas tasyā dṛkprāntapātā mita paramakṛpāprāptanepālarājyaḥ dāno drekātilubdhaḥ bhramarasama sadānekavidvatpraśastaḥ pṛthvīnārāyaṇeśo jayati nṛpaśikhā ratnanīrājitāṅghriḥ 2 tadīyasūnur adbhutaḥ pratāpasiṃha bhūpatiḥ ] kumāra eva kālikā padātiraktamānasaḥ sadāgamārthabhāvako dvitīyamanmatho rucā viśiṣṭadhīramaṇḍalī sabhāsadātimaṇḍanaḥ 3 tannideśavaśavarttipaṇḍitair dvitribhir vividhatantramārmikaiḥ tanyate ‘bhimatadakṣakālikā- pūjane vitatapaddhatiḥ śubhā 4 (fol. 1v1–2r4) «End: » yathā pūrvasthāpitabalipātrasyānnaṃ ekapātre kṛtvā pūjāgṛhād bahiḥ pūrvavan maṇḍalaṃ kṛṭvā tatra ucchiṣṭabhairava ehyehi baliṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūṁ phaṭ svāhā iti tad annaṃ tatra visṛjya kṛtāñaliḥ prajñācchidraṃ tapaś chidraṃ yaś chidraṃ pūjane mama sarvaṃ tad acchidram astu bhāskarasya prasādataḥ ityachidram avadhārya viśeṣārghaṃ cālayitvā tatra puṣpaṃ datvā ++9 (vāmahastakaniṣṭhayā māyāṃ vilikhya mūlāṃteyaṃ yaṃ spṛśāmi pādena yaṃ yaṃ paśyāmi cakṣuṣā sa eva dāsatāṃ yātu yadi śakrasamo bhavet || iti mantreṇa tilakaṃ kṛtvā yaṃtralepaṃ nirmālyaṃ śirasi dhṛtvā avaśiṣṭaṃ nirmālyaṃ śucideśe niḥkṣipya devīrūpam ātmānaṃ dhyāyet (fol. 48v4–49r4) «Colophon:» iti nityapūjāpaddhatiḥ samāptim agāt || || śubham astu || || ❁|| || ❁ || || ❁|| asya puraścaraṇaṃ lakṣaikajapaḥ || taccoktaṃ kālītantre || lakṣamekaṃ japed rātryāṃ haviṣyāśī divāśuciḥ rātrau tāmbūlapūrṇasya śayyāyāṃ lakṣamānataḥ || iti kālītantravacanāt || na caitad vacanāllakṣadvayajapa iti bhramitavyam || paśur gurumukhāllabdhvā vidyāṃ kālaghanaprabhāṃ pāśavena tu kalpena lakṣaṃ japyāt samāhitaḥ || divyagurumukhāllabdhvā kālikāṃ divyarūpiṇīm || lakṣmaṃ japyāt sadā mantrī vīrakalpena sādhakaḥ (fol. 49r4–8)

«Beginning: » oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ śrīdakṣiṇakālyai namaḥ || atha mahāpūjāvidhiḥ || trir ācamya || hrāṁ ātmatattvāya svāhā || hrīṁ vidyātattvāya svāhā || hrūṁ śivatattvāya svāhā || kuśajalam ādāya saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt || oṃ adyetyādi amukagotro ‘mukanāmadheyasyāmukakāmanāsiddhyarthe śrīdakṣiṇakālyā mahatīṃ pūjāṃ amukadvārāhaṃ kārayiṣye || devīdvārād bahiḥ sthitvā jalam abhimantrayet || oṃ vajrodake hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || trir ācamya vakṣyamāṇamantreṇa hastau pādau prakṣālayet || oṃ hrīṁ viśuddhasarvapāpāni samayāśeṣavikalapaṃ apanaya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || (fol. 1v1–7) «End: » sāṃgāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ sāyudhāṃ savāhanāṃ saparivārāṃ sumukhī devī śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ || 3 || ṣaḍaṃgena saṃpūjya prajapet || oṃ ucchiṣṭacāṇḍālini sumukhi devi mahāpiśācini hrīṁ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ ucchiṣṭabhairava ehyehi baliṃ gṛhṇa 2 hūṁ phaṭ svāhā || japaṃ 10 || stotraṃ || || siṃdūravarṇāṃ kucabhāranamrāṃ śavādhirūḍhāṃ smitapadmacakre || raktāṃvarāṃ khaḍgakapālahastāṃ mahāpiśācīṃ sumukhīṃ namāmi || || iti stutvā praṇamyocchiṣṭaṃ dhanurvāṇamudrayotsṛjyācamya yathāsukhaṃ viharet || (fol. 44v6–45r2) «Colophon:» iti śrīmahākālamerukumārītantrādiśyāmārahasyoktaṃ śrī ādyāmahatī pūjāpaddhati saṃpurṇaṃ || || yadakṣaraprabhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnaṃ ca yad bhavet || tatsarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ devi prasīda parameśvari || || śrīsaṃvat 1915 sāla miti phālguṇa śudi 2 ro 1 etaddine śrīkālīpūjāpaddhati(pustakaṃ) likhitaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || lekhakoyaṃ jitānandākhya jinajena || || śubham || || śrīkālīprasanno stu || || śubhaṃ || (fol. 45r3–7)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya nama(!) śrīdakṣiṇākālike(!) tubhyaṃ tava pūjārthasaṃgrahe || matallikāṃ matiṃ mahyaṃ dehi mātar namo namaḥ ( || ) śrīkṛṣṇāṃvitahākhyaṃ (!) bhūbhṛtānāṃ śiromaṇiṃ kuru kurukulānandītyatra(!)nuṣṭhānamātrata (!) prātar utthāya sejyāyāṃ(!) baddhapadmāsanaḥ kulabṛkṣaṃ praṇamet mūlādhārāt kuṇḍalinīṃ brahmarandhrānta(ṃ) vibhāvya śīrṣe sahasradale sva(gu)ruṃ dhyāyet mānasair upacāraiḥ saṃpūjya aiṁ hrīṁ sahaśrīṁ hasakhaphreṁ hasakṣamaravarayūṁ sahakṣamalavarayīṁ śrīō ahaṃ dakṣiṇakālikāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » ṛṣyādikarakhaḍaṃganyāsa(ṃ) vidhāya devyā vāmahaste guhyetimantreṇa japa(ṃ) samarpya devyagre puṣpāṃjaliṃ kṣipet | tato krīṁ siddhyai namaḥ iti paṃcākṣareṇa punar mālāṃ saṃpūjya rahasi sthāpayet | tatas stotrasahasranāmādikaṃ paṭhitvā sāmayakaiḥ saha pātravandanaṃ kuryāt | tataś culūkodakena iata(ḥ) pūrvaṃ prāṇabuddhidehadharmādhikārato jāgrat svapnasuṣuptyavasthāsu manasā vā cā karmaṇā hastābhyāṃ padbhyām udareṇa śiśnyā yas smṛtaṃ yad uktaṃ satkṛtaṃ tatsarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhavatu svāhā | māṃ madīyaṃ ca sakalaṃ dakṣiṇākālikāyai samarpayāmi oṃ tatsad brahmārpaṇaṃ bhavatu iti mantrenā(!)tmānaṃ samarpya svahṛtkamale saṃhāramudrayā devatām upasaṃhared iti | (fol.9r2–7) «Colophon:» iti śrīdakṣiṇākāli(kā)yārccanapaddhatiḥ | samāptā pūjakāya śubhaṃ bhavatu || || (fol. 9r7)

«Beginning: » -lātmane sūryamaṃḍalāya namaḥ aṃ ṣoḍaśakalātmane somamaṇḍalāya namaḥ || maṃ daśakalātmane vahnimaṃḍalāya namaḥ || saṃ (sa)ttvāya ºº raṃ rajase namaḥ || taṃ tamase || āṃ ātmane ºº aṃ aṃtarātmane ºº paṃ paramātmane hrīṁ jñānātmane ºº aṣṭadiṣku icchāyai || jñānāyai ºº kāminyai ºº kāmadīpanyai ºº ratyai ºº ratipriyāyai ºº ānaṃdāyai ºº madhye manonmanyai ºº || aiṁ parāyaiºº aparāyai ºº parāyai hsauṁ sadāśivamahāpretapadmāsanāya namaḥ || iti pīṭhanyāsaṃ kṛṭvā tatra iṣṭadevatāṃ dhyāyet | (fol. 9r1–3) «End: » tato hrīṁ siddhyai namaḥ iti paṃcākṣareṇa mālāmantreṇa punar mālāṃ saṃpūjya rahasi sthāpayet || tataḥ stotrakavacasahasranāmādikaṃ paṭhitā sāmayikaiḥ saha yathāvidhi pātravaṃdanaṃ kuryāt || tataś culūkodakena pūrvaprāṇabudhhidehadharmādhikārato jāgra(t)svapnasuṣuptāvasthāsu manasā vācā hastābhyām udareṇa śiśnā yat smṛtaṃ yad uktaṃ yat kṛtaṃ tatsarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ bhavatu svāhā māṃ madīyaṃ ca sakalaṃ śrī dakṣiṇakālikāyai samarppaye oṃ tat sad iti brahmārpaṇamantreṇātmānaṃ samarpya svahṛtkamale saṃhāramudrayā devatām upasaṃharet || || (fol. 15v1–4) «Colophon:» iti śrīmad vimalānandanāthena viracitā dakṣiṇakālikāpaddhatiḥ samāptā || || śubhama stu || … ityādi mahāvākyāni śrīgurudevatāyai samarpitam astu || || (fol. 15v4–7)

«Beginning: » ❖ śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyai namaḥ || || atha dakṣiṇakālyā ekākṣarīmantrasya pūjākramo likhyate || || atha kāmanayā vastradvayaṃ paridhāya strīvat tilakaṃ candanādinā kṛtvā yathoktasthānaṃ samāśritya || ( puṣpabhājanasaṃkalpaḥ candanādinivedanam ) oṃ vajrodako hūṃ phaṭ svāhā iti mantreṇa (savyena) jalam āniyāsanam abhyukṣya upaviśya || oṃ hrīṁ viśuddhasarvvapāpāni samayāśeṣavikalpam apanaya hūṃ ityanena mantreṇa hastau pādau ca prakṣyālya ( ācamanaṃ) || mūlānte oṃ ātmatattvāya svāhā evaṃ oṃ vidyātattvāyā svāhā oṃśivatatvāya svāhā ) oṃ hrīṃ svāheti ācamya || ( svavāme ) trikoṇavṛttacaturasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛṭvā || (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » ācamanīyapātrāmṛtena punar ācamaṇīyaṃ(!) datvā puratas trikoṇacaturasraṃ nirmāya naivedyapātraṃ maṇḍalopari saṃsthāpya tattvamudrayā saṃspṛśya balipātrāmṛtena mūlamantreṇa mahākālasaṃhitāyai amukadevyai naivedyaṃ nivedayāmīti naivedyaṃ tattvamudrayā punar ācamanīyaṃ datvā mahākālasahitāyai amuka devyai tāmbūlam idaṃ karpūrādi dhūpaṃ phaṭ iti saṃprokṣya namaḥ iti saṃpūjya gāyatrīmūlaṃ ca paṭhan nivedayet jayadhvani mantra mātaḥ svāhā || ++ tato madhudravyaṃ saṃmukhe dhṛtvā oṃ kāli 2 mahākāli hūṃ hūṃ amṛtam āsavaṃ vidhivat kuru 2 svāhā iti saptadhā (fol. 17r4–9) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyai namaḥ || praṇamya dakṣiṇāpadāravindam ādarāt || karoti kopi pūjakena prayogasaṃgrahaṃ budhaḥ || || tatra sādhakaḥ prātar utthāya śayyāyām eva baddhapadmāsanaḥ kulabṛkṣaṃ praṇamya śirasi śvetasahasradalakamalakarṇikāmadhyavartti candramaṇḍalāntargataṃ svaguruṃ dhyāyet || śvetaṃ śvetavilepamālyavasanaṃ vāmena raktotpalaṃ vibhūtyā priyatareṇa tarasā śliṣṭaṃ prasannānanāṃ | hastābhyām abhayaṃ varaṃ ca dadhataṃ śaṃbhusvarūpaṃ paraṃ hārālohitalocanotpalayugaṃ dhyāyecchirasthaṃ guruṃ || || iti mānasopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya || || (exp. 3t1–3b1) «End: » tataś cūlakodakenetaḥ pūrvaṃ prāṇabuddhidehadharmādhikārato jāgratsvapnasuṣuptāvasthāsu manasā vācā hastābhyāṃ mudareṇa śiśnā yat smṛtaṃ kad uktaṃ yat kṛtaṃ tatsarvaṃ brahmārpaṇam bhavatui svāhā || māṃ madīyam sakalaṃ śrī mamukadevyai samarpayet || oṃ tatsad iti brahmārpaṇamantreṇātmānaṃ samarpya svahṛdayakamale saṃhāramudrayā devatām upasaṃbhavet || || (exp. 45b5–46t2) «Colophon:» iti śrīkālīpaddhati samāptā || || sarvvamaṅgalamāṅgalye śive sarvvārthsādhike || śaraṇye tryambake gauri nārāyaṇi namo stu te || tathā ca bhūtabhairave || krodhīśaṃ kṣatajo rūḍhaṃ dhumrabhairavyalaṃkṛtaṃ || rudraḍākinisaṃyuktā vindusthā vāsinī smṛtaṃ || krodhīśaḥ kakāraḥ kṣatajaḥ vaphaḥ stadyuktaṃ dhumrabhairavī īkāra ityuktam || rudraḍākinīvindus tad yuktaṃ hrī iti bījaṃ || || lakṣam ekaṃ japen mantraṃ niyamena divā śuciḥ || aśuciś ca tathā rātrau lakṣam ekaṃ tathā japet || || || kālīkalpe || yasmin mantre yadācāras tatra dharmaś ca tādṛśaḥ || kṛtārthās tena jāyante svargaṃ vā muktim eva vā || viśuddhacitrotra bhavet siddhihānis tu jāyate || viśuddhacitrotrabhavet siddhiḥ syād apavargadā || etac ca tatkuśāt siddhiḥ vismayaṃ nāsti cāparam || vismitā vilayaṃ yānti paśavaḥ śastramohitāḥ || kulastrī vīranindāñ ca tad dravyam apahāraṇaṃ || strīṣu roṣaṃ prahāraṃ ca varjjayen matim ātmadā || || klīṁ hūṁ strīṃ hrīṃ phaṭ || dakṣiṇakālikādevyā kullukā maṃtraṃ || iti tu mantrasaṅgrahe || asya aghora ṛṣiḥ virāṭ chandaḥ kullukākālī devatā hrīṁ bījaṃ klīṃ śaktiḥ hūṁ kīlakaṃ || nyāsa || krāṃ krīṃ krūṃ kreṃ krauṃ kraḥ || dhyānapūjādikaṃ pūrvavad iti kālikāpakṣe kaulikaṃ niṃdayed yastu kulaśāstraparāyanaṃ (!) || sa yati nārake ghore satyam eva na śaṃsayaḥ || tad uktaṃ yāmale ||| tripurasundraryā kullukām āha || aiṁ klīṁ hrīṁ tripure bhagavatyai svāhā || iti caturmaṅgalasaṃgrahe || atha umādevyā mukhaśodhanamaṃtraḥ || krīṁ oṃ 3 krīṃ || 3 vāraṃ | … iti dakṣiṇakālīdevyā sahasrākṣarī vidyā samāptaḥ || (exp. 46t4–47b4)

«Beginning: » mūlādhāre manaḥ || saṃyojya dakṣiṇāguṣṭhena dakṣiṇanāsāpuṭaṃ dhṛtvā praṇavaṃ mūlādyabījaṃ vā ṣoḍaśavāraṃ japan vāmanāsayā vāyum āpūrya kaniṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ (..) vāmanāsāpuṭaṃ dhṛtvā catuḥṣaṣṭivāraṃ japan vāyuṃ stabhayitvā (catuḥṣaṣṭivāraṃ) || dakṣanāsayā dvātriṃśadvāraṃ japan || recayed ityekaḥ || punas tenaiva mānena dakṣiṇanāsāpuṭe prapūrya kuṃbhayitvā vāmena recared iti dvitīyaḥ || punarādyavart tṛtīyaḥ || mūlena ced ekena pūrakaṃ caturbhiḥ pūrakaṃ dvābhyāṃ recakam ity ekaṃ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ vidhāya bhūtaśuddhiṃ kuryāt || (fol. 17r1–17v5) «End: » ghorarūpāṃ mahāraudrīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīṃ || daṃturāṃ dakṣiṇavyāpi muktalaṃbakacoccayāṃ || śavarūpamahādeva hṛdayoparisaṃsthitāṃ || śivāgnir ghorarūpābhiś caturdikṣu samanvitāṃ || mahākālena ca samanyupaviṣṭaratāṃturāṃ || sukhaprasannanayanāṃ smerānanasaroruhāṃ || evaṃ saṃcintayet kālīṃ śmaśānālayavāsinīṃ || iti dhyātvā mānasair upacārair abhyarcya yathāśakti mūlaṃ japitvā samarppya praṇamet || tato yathoktavidhinā yantraṃ nirmāya pūrvvavarttinī pīthe nidhāya pūrvvavat pīṭhapūjāṃ kuryāt || atha kalaśasthāpanaṃ || svavāmabhāge ṣaṭkoṇāṃtargatavinduṃ vilikhya bāhyeva vṛttaṃ caturasraṃ ca kṛtvā sāmānyārghodakenābhyukṣya hrīṁ ādhāraśaktyādibhyo namaḥ || I (fol. 34v6–35v7) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ atha puraścaraṇavidhiḥ puraścaraṇadīpikāyāṃ sādhanaṃ mūlamantrasya puraśracaṇam ucyate viśudeśvere japahomau tarpaṇaṃ ca śeṣaḥ (kālikā) mārjjanabhojane paṃcāṃgopāsanaṃ loke puraścaraṇam ucyate yoginīhṛdaye śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi puraścaraṇasādhanaṃ yenānuṣṭhānamātreṇa vaśam āyāṃti devatāḥ tasmāj jaaṃ prakurvīta guruṃ vā kārayed budhaḥ guro bhāve vipraṃ vā sarvaprāṇihite rataḥ śuddhaṃ śāstram idaṃ maṃtraṃ nānā guṇasamanvitaṃ stiyaṃ vā svaguṇāpetāṃ (pu)putraṃ vā viniyojayet vārāhītantre puraścaraṇasaṃpanno maṃtro hi phaladāyakaḥ puraskṛtyā hi mantrāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ bījam ucyate (fol. 1v1–2r4) «End: » huṃkāraṃ prītināśena chedane māraṇe tathā uccāṭane ca vidveṣe vauṣaḍaṃgīkṛtā vaṣaṭ strīpuṃnapuṃsakatvena tridhā syur mantrajantavaḥ śastā strī tridhā maṃtrā śāṃtivaśyābhighārake atha tithinirṇayaḥ paṃcamī ca dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā saptamī tathā budhadevagururyetā śāṃtikarmaṇi pūjitā gurucandrayutā ṣaṣṭi caturthī ca trayodaśī navamī pauṣṭike śastā aṣṭamī ca viśeṣataḥ daśamyekādaśī caiva tathā śukraguṇānvitā vaśyākṛṣṭitvamāvāśyā saptamī pratipat tathā paurṇamāsī mandabhānuyutā vidveśkarmaṇi ṣaṣṭīcaturdaśī tadvat daśamī mandatārakā uccāṭane praśastā ca pradoṣe ca viśeṣataḥ caturdaśyāṣṭamīkṛṣṇa amāvāsyā tathaiva ca maṃdārkka (fol. 30r2–30v7) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha śrīdakṣiṇakālikāsaṃkṣepapaddhatiḥ | tatra śrīmat sādhakeṃdro brāhme muhūrtte utthāya muktaḥ svāpaḥ rātrivāsaṃ tyaktvā śayyāsane upaviśya śurasi sahasradala(kamala) karṇikāsthitaṃ svetavarṇaṃ dvibhujaṃ varābhayakaraṃ svetamālyānulepanaṃ svaprakāśasvarūpaṃ svavāmasthitasuraktaśaktyā svaprakāśasvarūpayāsahitaṃ ( guruṃ ) vibhāvya mānasopacārair ārādhayet || (fol. 1v1–6) «End: » phaṃ namaḥ | iti tābhir eva vāmapārśve | baṃ nāmaḥ tābhi pṛṣṭhe | bhaṃ namaḥ | iti tāsāṃguṣṭhā nābhau | maṃ namaḥ | sarvābhir udare | yaṃ namaḥ | iti talena hṛdaye | raṃ namaḥ iti sarvāṃgulibhiḥ dakṣiṇāṃśe || laṃ namaḥ | iti tābhiḥ kakudi | vaṃ namaḥ iti tābhireva vāmāṃśe śaṃ namaḥ | iti talena hṛdayādi dakṣiṇakarāṃtaṃ | (ata ūrdhvamūlayaiva mukhāṃtaṃ nyaset | ) ṣaṃ namaḥ | iti hṛdayādi vāmakarāṃtaṃ | saṃ namaḥ iti (fol. 13v4–10) «Colophon:» x

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ | atha śrī dakṣiṇākālikāpaddhatir likhyate | sādhakeṃdro rajanīṃ turyayāme viśuddhyāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā hastau pādau prakṣālya dhaute vāsasī paridhāyācamya svāsane samupaviśya svaśirasi sahasradalakamalakarṇikāyāṃ śretavarṇaṃ śvetamālyānulepanaṃ varābhayakaraṃ vāmāṅgagatayā devyā raktāmbarābharaṇabhūṣitayā vāmakaradhṛtalīlākamalayā dakṣabhujenāliṅgitāṃ śvetavastrābharaṇāṃ muktādāmādibhūṣitāṃ dvinetrāṃ suprasannāṃ śivaśaktyātmikaṃ guruṃ dhyātvā oṃ aiṃ krīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ gurave namaḥ | (fol. 1v1–6) End kaṃṭhe vā vāmabāhau vā kavacasya ca dhāraṇāt | bahvapatyājīvadvatsā bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | na deyaṃ paraśiṣyebhyo py abhaktebhyo viśeṣataḥ | deyaṃ śiṣyāya bhaktāya prāṇebhyopyadhikāya ca | abhaktebhyo pi śiṣyebhyo datvā mṛtyum avāpnuyāt | sparddhāmurūpakamalā(!) vāgdevīmukhamandire | pautrāntaṃ sthairyam āsādya nivasatyeva niścitaṃ | idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā yo bhajet kāli dakṣiṇāṃ | śatalakṣaṃ pra(ja)pto pi tasya vidyā na siddhyati | sa śastraghātam āpnoti socirān mṛtyum āpnuyāt || || (fol. 23v4-8) Colophon iti śrībhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde kālīkalpe śrījaganmaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 23v8)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ || natvā sravvagaṇeśaṃ svagaṇaparivṛtaṃ kārttikeya(ṃ) sasādhyaṃ khyātaḥ sarvvāpuraṃ sakalajaḍamati pronnatijñānakośaṃ | candīm bighṛsya hāntrin tribhuvana jayinī japyamālī surendrai ja(p)tvā ddhanvantaris tān prathitamunivarā śuśrutān atrijāmś ca || sūtram āha || prathamaṃ jalapānaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ laṃghanādikaṃ vamanaṃ ca tṛtīyañ ca caturthañ recanaṃ bhavet || pañcamaṃ nasyakarmeṣu svedaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhamaṃ bhavet || saptamaṃ dhūmrapānaṃ raktamokṣaṃ tathāṣṭakaṃ || vyañjanaṃ dhantadhāve ca navamaṃ ca prakīrttitaṃ || gaṇḍūṣa daśamaṃ proktaṃ pānam ekādaśaṃ bhavet || (exp. 3t1–7) «End: » vinā hatekamasvādyu na japet na smaret priye tasmād guhyā ca pītvā ca pūjayet parameśvarīṃ | he hastā sarvvadevānāṃ tṛypaṃtvāmṛtavāriṇā || tṛpyaṃtu kuṇḍa śaktim ucchiṣṭānandarūpiṇīṃ || yadyakṣara paribhrastaṃ mātrāhīṇaṃ ca jadbhavet || tatsarvaṃ kṣamyaṃtāṃ devī kasya vai niścalo manaḥ || evaṃ bhāvatḥ | || (!) (exp. 34t4–8) «Colophon:» iti vastrapuṣparatnādiviṃśatir yogasaṃṣeyā || 20 || (exp. 21b3) iti śrībhai(ra)vatantre tārākavacaṃ samāptam iti || ḥ || śubham astu sarvvadāḥ || (exp. 25b7–8) iti ṣoḍhācakrathitā tāropaḥ sarvvasiddidā || ❁ || (exp. 30t3–4) iti yoginīstava samāpta || mitiḥ || samvat 796 śrāvana sudi 2 rikhītiḥ śubham astu msarvvadāḥ ||

«Beginning: » || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ athādyāpūāpaddhatiḥ (( prātaḥkṛtyādi snānāṃtaṃ karma kṛtvā oṃ kulodake hūṁ phaṭ svāhā iti mantreṇa savye jalam ānīya hūṁ svāheti mantreṇādhārayet oṁ hrīṁ viśuddha sarvvapāpāni samayāśeṣavikalpam apanayahūṁ iti mantreṇa pādua prakṣyālya oṁ hrīṁ svāhā iti mantreṇācāmet tato gṛhaṃ praviśya svastivācanādi karma kuryāt )) svastivācana pūrvakaṃ sūryaḥ soma iti paṭhitvā saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt adyetyādi amukagotra amukadeva śarmāhaṃ amuka devatā prītaye pūjana karmāhaṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpa ((dipaṃ prajvālya)) dev ova iti paṭhitvā ghaṭasthāpanaṃ kuryāt (fol. 1v1–3) «End: » māṃ madīyaṃ sakalaṃ samyak śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyai samarpayet ityanenātmasamarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmaṃ ṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ ca kṛtvā śrījaganmaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paṭhet || tato homaṃ kuryāṭ tata āvaraṇadevatāḥ kṣamasveti āvaraṇadevatā devyaṅge vilāpya saṃhāramudrayā oṃ dakṣiṇe kālike kṣamasveti visṛjya tattejapuṣpeṇa svahṛdaye ānayet tato iśānyāṃ (!) trikoṇamaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tadupari oṃ citkalocchiṣṭacāṃḍālinyai namaḥ oṃ ucchiṣṭacāṇḍālinyai namaḥ iti mantreṇa nirmālyapuṣpadattanaivedyābhyāṃ pūjayet tataḥ pādodakaṃ nirmālyapuṣpacandanādikaṃ daśabhirmaṃtritaṃ gṛhṇīyāt || || (fol. 18r1–18r2) «Colophon:» iti dakṣiṇakālikāpūjāpaddhatiḥ samāpta || śubham astu || || saṃvat 1892 || miti mārgaśiramāse kṛṣṇapakṣe 5 || bhaumavāsare || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || … (fol.18v3–4)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha ṣoḍhānyāsaḥ || || śrīṃ aṃ śrīṃ aṃ śrīṃ aṃ namo lalāṭe śrīṃ āṃ śrīṃ āṃ śrīṃ āṃ namo mukhavṛtte śrīṃ īṁ śrīṃ īṃ śrīṃ īṃ namaḥ cakṣuṣi śrīṃ uṃ śrīṃ uṃ śrīṃ uṃ namo dakṣakarṇe śrīṃ ūṃ śrīṃ ūṃ śrīṃ ūṃ vāmakarṇe śrīṃ ṛṃ śrīṃ ṛṃ śrīṃ ṛṃ dakṣiṇa nāsāyāṃ śrīṃ Ṝṃ śrīṃ Ṝṃ śrīṃ Ṝṃ namo vāmanāsāyāṃ śrīṃ lṛṃ śrīṃ lṛṃ śrīṃ lṛṃ namo dakṣa gaṇḍe śrīṃ lṜṃ śrīṃ lṜṃ śrīṃ lṜṃ namo vāma gaṇḍe (fol. 1v1–4) «End: » viparītaratāṃ saktāṃ ghoradraṃṣṭrāṃ śivaiḥ saha bāgayajñopavītā ca candrārghakṛtaśrṣarāṃ || sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktāṃ muktāmaṇivibhūṣitāṃ mṛtahastasahastrais tu kṛtakāṃcī digambarāṃ || śivākoṭisahasrais tu yoginībhir virājitām raktapūrṇamukhāmbhojām madyapāna pramattikāṃ vahnyarkaśaśinetrāṃ tu raktavisphuritānanāṃ vigatāsu kisorābhyāṃ kṛtakarṇāvataṃśikāṃ kaṃṭhāvasaktamuṃḍālī galad rudhiracarccitāṃ śmaśānavahnimadhyasthāṃ brahmakeśavavanditāṃ sadyaḥ kṛttaśuśirukhaḍgavarābhītikarāṃbujām atra vāmordhvahaste kṛpāṇaṃ tad adhaḥ śiraḥ dakṣahastordhvam abhayaṃ tad adho varam iti boddhavyam || || (fol. 15v5–16r4) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » oṃ namo dkṣiṇakālikāyai || || atha pūjāvidhir likhyate || prathamam mūlamantreṇa hastau pādau prakṣālya ācamya sammohanīpūjām ārabhet || athāsanaṃ pūjayet || oṃ svastikāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ kūrmāsanāya namah || oṃ siṃhāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ pṛthivīti āsanaṃ dhṛtvā paṭhet || tatropaviśya || karakacchapikāṃ badhvā nimīlitākṣa ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥ śākham aśvatthaṃ ātmānaṃ dhyātvā yaṃ iti vāyubījena kukṣisthita pāpaṃ saśoṣya ram iti vahnibījena saṃdahya laṃ iti bhasmotkṣipya vam ityamṛtavṛṣṭyā plāvayet || pṛthivyādipañcabhūtaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā devīrūpam ātmānaṃ cintayet || || (fol. 1v1–6) «End: » tridhā vibhajya metraṃ (!) vai yatnāt sādhakam uttamah māṃsaṃ raktaṃ tilaṃ keśaṃ nakhabhaktaṃ ca pāyasaṃ || ājyaṃ ceti prayatnena sarvakāmārthasiddhaye | ev aṃ kṛtvā vidhānena bhajata siddhim uttamāṃ || yad yat prārthayata cite tad tadāpnoti nityaśaḥ devatvaṃ dānavatvaṃ ca siddhacāraṇatāṃ tathā sadā hutvā sam āpnoti nityameva matendritaḥ (!) ity alaṃ vistaraḥ atha stuti (fol. 8v5–9r2) «Colophon:» iti dakṣiṇakālīpaṭalaḥ samāpta mṛtakapakṣe vīrasādhanāvidhir likhyate mṛtakaṃ paṃcavarṣoparivayaskaṃ varṣoparivayaskam iti kecit sārdhapraharopari rātrau mṛtakānya taṃ nadītīre catuḥpathe vā mṛtakaṃ dhṛtvā hūṁ iti mṛtakāya namaḥ saṃpūjya huṃ iti svapanaṃ hūṁ ity upaveśanaṃ mṛtakopari vidhivaddevīṃ saṃpūjya balyādipaṃcakaṃ dadyāt tata sarvatrāyutaṃ japaḥ tadante chāgabalidānaṃ nāsmād aparetaraṃ kiṃcit satvaraṃ siddhidāyakaṃ munibhiḥś caiva deveśaiḥ kathitaṃ sādhakepsitaṃ nirbhayaś ca śuciś caiva akrodho vijitendriyaḥ mahābali dayāluś ca kathito yamavaṃkṣakaḥ ityavekṣakalakṣaṇaṃ || iti vīrasādhanā || (fol. 9r2–9v2)

«Beginning: » ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha dathuyāgulibali lirkhete || || panātiṃ yākhā hosa coṅa kvāṭhapratiṣṭhāyātā dayakā || || brāhmaṇa ācārya josi thvate sanaṃsthirahārāva vayāva || maṇḍapanapiṃ urttarasoya majirasā pūrvva soyaṃteva || baliviya pāṭha yāya caṇḍi || velā anukramana hṅāṃliṃteva thva yāya || o na hṅā onaṃ li dinapatiṃ rajasā sakarmmācana yāya dhunakāva baliviya || pāṭha yāya || balipāta 1 dathu || pūrvvapāta 1 || dakṣiṇapāta 1 || paścimasa pātaṃ 1 || urttarasa pāta 1 || īśānasa pāta 1 || arghapātra ||jalapātra || paṃcabali || gaṇavatuka || thvate paṭavāsana coyāva jiyake || || (fol. 1v1–7) «End: » ambe pūrvvagataṃ ( padaṃ ) bhagavati caitanyarūpā(t)mikā || jñānecchā bahu(lā) tathā hariharau brahmāmarīcitrakaṃ (!) || bhāsvad bhairavapañcakaṃ tad anu ca śrīyoginīpañcakaṃ || candrārkā (!) ca marīciṣaṭkavimalaṃ māṃ pātu nityaṃ śrīkuje (!) || saṃhāramudrayā balivisarjjana sāksī thāya || bali cchoyavidhi || dathu pāṭha galāla laṃkhu || pūrvvapātasa paṃmagāva || dakṣiṇapāta bheraju || urttarapāta pulako || īśānabali golajā dako ṣālāṅa || paścimapāta vaṭuka dumāju || paraseka dakoṃ dukhāpikhā cchoya || || (fol. 28v6–11) «Colophon:» thva te ṅāthānadathuyā sācayapāṭhabalipāṭhapūjāvidhi samāptaṃ || || panātiyā kvāṭhapratiṣṭhāyā || śubhaṃ (fol. 28v11–12)

«Beginning: » ❖ śrīnamas tasyai gaṇeśāya ca || yad romavivare kīṭā iva brahmāṇḍakoṭayaḥ | tad agādhakṛpāsindhūm apāraṃ samupāsmahe || natvā guruṃ paraguruñ ca parāparākhyaṃ || tasmāt parañ ca parameṣṭhīguruṃ praṇamya || niskṛṣya sāram akhilāgamaśāstrasindhoḥ || śrīmad ramāramaṇa eṣa samucciniti || vastūni dūratara dūratameṣu gatvā nānā vidhāny upacinoti janaḥ prayatnaiḥ || ekatra tāni militāni puro bhilabhyaḥ daivena ke ca sudhiyo vimukhī bhavanti || tatrādau samupāsya devatānirṇaye mantravicāraḥ pravarttate || atas taṃ nirṇayārthaṃ puro haracakrāmabhidhīyate || (fol. 1v1–4) «End: » svapnādīnā mantralābhe dīkṣoktakrameṇa kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya vaṭapatreṇa kuṃkumena likhitvā daśasaṃskāraṃ vidhāya guror mantragrahaṇaṃ kuryāt athavā taddevatokta sarvvacakravicāritamantrāntaraṃ gṛhṇīyāt upāsyasyaikamantratvāt svapnepi mantrakulena upāsyopadeśāt tanmantram api japet || bahumantravataḥ puṃsaḥ kā kathā śiva eva saḥ || ityādi puraskāraśravaṇād iti saṃkṣepaḥ || atha mantrasaṃskāraḥ || phetkāriṇītantre || jananaṃ jīvanaṃ caivaṃ tāḍanaṃ bodhanaṃ tathā || athābhiṣeko vimalīkaraṇā(pyāyanā)pyāyanaṃ tataḥ || tarppaṇaṃ dīpanaṃ caiva śodhanaṃ daśamaḥ smṛtaṃ || mantrāṇāṃ mātṛkāvarṇād uddhāro jajanaṃ (!) smṛtaṃ | mantravarṇaṃś ca pratyekaṃ praṇavāntaritān tathā || ( kṛtvā ca vajrarūpeṇa jī(vanaṃ) parikīrttitaṃ || ) mantravarṇā (fol. 7v4–8) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » vaḥ || aṃ bījaṃ śirasthāne || āṁ bījaṃ tāluke deyaṃ || iṃbījaṃ nāsikopari || īṁ bījaṃ paścime liṃge || uṃbījaṃ gudamadhyage || ūṃbījaṃ pṛṣṭhamadhyeṣu ṛṃ bījaṃ kaṭisandhiṣu || Ṝṃbījaṃ bṛṣanānteṣu || lṛṃbījaṃ pṛṣṭhamadhyata || lṜṃbījaṃ lambikāsthāne || yo jānāti sa deśikaḥ || aiṁ bījaṃ vyāpakaṃ dehe āpādatalamastake || aiṁkāraṃ vidhirekhāyāṃ trirejyā yonir ucyate | yonirekhāgataṃ vinduṃ yo jānāti sakālavit || yonir ityucyate śaktirekhābrahmāṇḍabhedinī || layaṃ cittālayaṃ dehe retā vindur iti smṛtaḥ || (fol. 2r1–5) «End: » iti devīṃ vijñāpya ghaṭe paṭalakrameṇa uktarītyā tāṃ pūjya samastacakracakreśī sarvapuṣpāyudhādibhiḥ sarvān pūraya me devi kāmān kāmeśvareśvari || iti prārthya aiṁ namaḥ kavacāya hūṃ iti damanakam avaguṇṭhya puṣpāntareṇāpi devīṃ pūjayet | tataś ca naivedyaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ ca nivedayet kāmaṃ prārthya damanena pūjayet tataḥ sādhakaiḥ saha jalakrīḍāṃ kṛṭvānnadānaṃ kuryād iti śivaṃ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 7r5–7v3) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » ❖ atha caitrādimāsapūjāvidhil likhyate || atha caitrādiṣu dvādaśamāseṣu pratimāsaṃ ravivāreṣu nityapūjānte raktakamalaiḥ prativāsaraṃ pūjayet || 1 || somavāreṣu kumudakusumaiḥ pūjayet 2 || bhaumavāreṣu raktotpalaiḥ pūjayet || 3 || budhavāresu nandyāvattaiḥ || 4 || guruvāre akahlāyaiḥ || 5 || bhṛguvāresu śvetakamaraiḥ || 6 || śaniśca(ra)vārṣu nīlotpalaiḥ pū(ja)yet || ○ || atra ravivārādiṣu naivaidyaviśeṣaḥ || tatra ravivāreṣu (a)pāyasaṃ || somavāre dadhiḥ || bhaumavāreṣu kadalīpharaṃ || budhavāreṣu navanītaṃ || guruvāreṣu piṇḍaśarkkarā || śukravāreṣu sikatābhidhā śarkkarā || śanivāreṣu ghṛtaṃ || (exp. 3tb–6) «End: » somāya namaḥ || vahnaye namaḥ || brahmaṇe namaḥ || nāgāya namaḥ || śikhidhvajāya namaḥ || suryyāya namaḥ || sadāśivāya namaḥ || viśvebhyodevebhyo namaḥ || iti gaṃdhādibhiḥ saṃpūjya || brahmaṇe namaḥ || viṣṇave namaḥ || īśānāya namaḥ || triṣu sūtreṣu trisūtraṃkṛteṣu pūjayet || tato granthiṣu kriyāyai namaḥ || pauruṣyai namaḥ || vīrāyai namaḥ || aparājitāyai namaḥ || jayāyai namaḥ || vijayāyai namaḥ || muktidāyai namaḥ || sadāśivāyai namaḥ || manonmanyai namaḥ || sarvvatomukhyai namaḥ || iti daśadevatāḥ saṃpūjya || || tato devīṃ sarvvopacārair yathāvidhiḥ saṃpūjya ṣoḍaśanityāḥ pavitreṣu samabhyarcya śrīvidyāṃ nyaset || tataś ca mūlavidyānte || klīṃ namaḥ śirase svāhā ityabhimantrya aiṃ namo hṛda (exp. 9b1–6) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » śrīganeśāya namaḥ || atha śrī saṃkṣiptadakṣiṇākālīsaparyāpūjāpaddhatiḥ | ādau ahate dhaute vāsasi paridhāya hastau pādau prakṣālya pūjāsthānam āgatya pūjāsāmagrīṃ sapādya śuddhāsane upaviśya dīpaṃ prajvālya guruṃpraṇamya iṣṭadevatāṃ ca praṇamya dikpālāṃś ca praṇamya ācāṃtaḥ | kuśahaste maunī pāpaśamanārthaṃ devi tvaṃ prākṛtaṃ cittam ityādi sūryaḥ soma ityādi ca śokadvayaṃ paṭhitvā sāmānyārghasthāpanaṃ | (fol. 1v1–4) «End: » prārthanā āvāhanaṃ na jānāmi na jānāmi visarjanaṃ | pūjāṃ caiva na jānāmi kṣamasva parameśvari | mūlam uccārya śrīdakṣiṇakālike kṣamasveti visarjya āvaraṇadevatāṃ devyaṃge vilāpya saṃhāramudrayā tat tejaḥ puṣpeṇa hṛdaye saṃsthāpayet tata aiśānyāṃ trikoṇaṃ vṛttaṃ catuirasraṃ vilikhya tad upari oṃ caṇḍeśvaryai namaḥ ucchiṣṭacānḍālinyai nama iti nirmālyanaivedyābhyāṃ saṃpūjya praṇamet deva nātha guro svāmin deśika svātmanāyaka | trāhi trāhi kṛpāsindhoḥ pūjāṃ pūrṇatarāṃ kuru | iti guruṃ saṃprārthya praṇamya sāmānyārghaṃ visṛjya pādodakanirmālyapuṣpacandanādikaṃ daśabhir mantritaṃ dhārayet ācamya yathāsukhaṃ viharet || (fol. 6r5–11) «Colophon:» iti saṃkṣepadakṣiṇakālikāpaddhatiḥ samāptāḥ || śubham astu || samvat 1950 mārgakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ likhitaṃ (fol. 6r11)
