«Beginning: » ❖ brāhmaṇa ācārya josi thvate sthira hālāvayāva || maṇḍapanapi uttarasoya majirasā pūrvva soyaṃteva || baliviya pāṭha yāya caṇḍī || gajaracchākuhnuyā velā(nukramena hṅāliṃtava) thva yāya || || o na hṅā ona ridinapatiṃ rajasā rāsa karmmārccana yāya dhunakāva baliviye pāṭha yāya || || balipāta 1 dathu saṃpūrṇa sapūrvasa pāṭa 1 dakṣiṇasa pāṭa 1 || paścimasa pāṭa 1 || uttarasa pāṭa 1 || īśānasa pāṭa 1 || arghapātra || jalapātra paṃcabali gaṇavaṭuka || thvate paṭavāsana coyāva jiyake || (fol. 1r1–4) «End: » anyatra śaraṇaṃ nāsti tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama | tasmāt kāruṇyabhāvena rakṣa rakṣa parameśvari || || tarppaṇa || || caṇḍīpustakapūjā || ugracaṇḍāmūlamantraṇa || caṇḍīpāṭha yāya || mālasā paśuyāga mūmālasā samaya cchāya || || prītapretātarppaṇa || dakṣiṇā || ekāne ºº ambepūrvva ºº || saṃhāramudrayā balivisarjjana || sākṣī thāya || || balicchoyavidhi || dathupātagalālalaṃkhu || pūrvvabali sapanamagāva || dakṣiṇabali bhelaju || uttarapulako || īśānabali || golajādakosālāṅasa || paścimabali vaṭukadako dumāju || palasaṃkadakosakalaṃ maṇḍapadevala ṅūyakaṃ hole || (fol. 22r5–22v3) «Colophon:» thvate dathuyā sāṭharccayapāṭhabalipūjāvidhi samāptā || || samvat 811 kāttika śukla navamī thva kuhnu śrīśrīsumatijayajitāmitramallasana dayakā juroṃ || śubha || (fol. 22v3–4)

«Beginning: » ❖ śrī3 paradevatāyai namaḥ || atha dathuyā guliyāli likhyate || brāhmaṇa ācāta jośi thvate sanaṃsthirehālāvayāva || maṇḍapaṃpi uttara śoya majilasā pūrvva soyaṃteva || bali viya pāṭhayāya caṇḍi || dinayā velā anukramaṇahṅāliṃteva thva yāya || o na hṅā o nail dinapratiṃ rajasālāsa karmmārccana yāya dhunakāva bali viya pātha yāya || || bali pāta 1 dathusaṃ pūrvvasa pā 1 dakṣiṇa pā 1 paścima pāta 1 uttara pā 1 īśāna pā 1 || (fol. 1v1–6) «End: » saṃhālamudrayā bali visarjjana || sākṣi thāya || || bali cchoya vidhi || dathu pāta galālalaṃkhu || pūrvvapāṭa balisa panamagāva || dakṣiṇapāta bali bhelaju || uttara pāta bali purako || īśānabali golajādako || sālāṅasa paścimapāta bali vaṭuka daṃko dumāju || parasekaṃdako sakalyaṃ maṃḍapadevala ṅūyakaṃ hole || (fol. 50v6–51r4) «Colophon:» thvate dathuyā sāthacayapāṭhabalipūjāvidhi samāptaḥ || || ❖ śrīśrī jayabhūpatīndramalla devasana cūkavāsadevapratiṣṭhā siddhāgni aitāhutiyajñayāṅāyā thva sāphuri || saṃ 825 bhādrapadaśukla daśamī mūla śaniścaravāra kuhnu || saṃ 825 || śubha || (fol. 51r4–51v–3)

«Beginning: » damanārohanavidhi liṣyate || pivane paṃñcabaliṃ || sāṅgaṇa karmmārcaṇaṃ kṛtvā || dhūpa dīpa || jāpa stotra || nityakarmmajukva damanapātrayātaṃ svastika coya || damanapātrataṃ || sijvala (bhu)cā || ( +++ ++ ) namo bhagavate hṛtkamalāyai hrāṁ śrīṁ hṛdayāya pādukāṃ || nirikṣaṇa || aiṁ 5 kini 2 vicce koṅkanāya hra astrāya phaṭ || prokṣaṇaṃ || aiṁ 5 ghore aghore aghorāmukhī bahurūpāyai || hrīṁ śrīṁ kavacāya hūṁ || (exp. 3A1–14) «End: » iti dhyānaṃ || tryaṃjali || cācīcū ▒ caḍanāthāya pādukāṃ || 3 || hṛdayādi || pavitrakaṃ || adyādi || kailāsapīṭhamadhyasthaṃ || hrīṁ blūṁ śrīkulacaṇḍanāthasarvvatattvādhipāya sarvvakāraṇapālitāya gandhapavitrakenapādukāṃ || hṛdayādi || mūlena baliḥ || dhūpa dīpa || jāpa || stotraṃ || bhagavan tvat prasādena pūjāphalam akhaṇḍitaṃ || mamāstu tat susaṃpūrṇaṃ tvatprasādāt prabho mama || atra gandhādi || astrana visarjjanaṃ || kvataṃ hayāva khvasa coya kalacchoya || khvāla śiya || tharuvane || kaumārīyāga || || (exp. 19A14–19B10) «Colophon:»

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇeāya namaḥ || samvat 816 bhādrapada vadi 11 daṃsadaṃśa hāneyā || śrīśrīkjayabhūpatīndramalladevasana dayakā juro || || endalā thva kathapūjā || thāpūjā na dayake meśahmaṃ 1 duguhmaṃ 2 hāsahmaṃ 1 śrī3 dumājustaṃ || duguhmaṃ 4 talejustaṃ || duguhmaṃ 1 cyāka bhavatistaṃ || ghela salai gvaḍa 4 sidhala taṃgra 3 || paṃcapatākā tava ca paḍi bhaṃdila yāke || dṛṣṭimālako vacyāyāke || (fol. 1v1–4) «End: » 1 mahaniyātaṃ || dāma viya thvate || moṭaṃ 4 śrī upādhyā ju viya moṭaṃ 4 upalamārako viya || ātaravānasādaṃ maṇḍakā 2 || moṭaṃ 12 x daṃma2 padma viya ātaravānasā moṭaṃ 3 ( ‥) || || moṭaṃ 32 kasta viya mādheyātā || torā 1 kastura karppūra torā 4 || daṃmaṭaṃkā 2 varirāmaviya || || moṭaṃ 18 cakvātha bhādila viya || || moṭaṃ 2 pāru daṃmaṭaṃkā 4 seyātā kāsirāma viya || || (fol. 31v4–7) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || dīkṣāprayogaḥ | atha dīkṣāgrahaṇapūrvvadine kṛtaikabhaktādiniyamayuto dīkṣādine prātaḥ kṛtanityakriyo vastrādyalaṃkṛtasaguruko hastau pādau prakṣālya dīkṣāmaṇḍapam āgatya sarṣāpadurvākṣatān vikiret tatra mantraḥ | ye cātra bighnakartāro bhuvi divyantarīṅṣagāḥ | bighnabhūtāś ca ye cānye mama mantre prasīdatu | mametat kīlitaṃ sthānaṃ parityajya vidūrataḥ | apasarpantu te sarve nirbighnaṃ siddhir astu me | tataḥ śuddhāsane upaviśya gurvājñayā nirbighnārthaṃ svastivācanaṃ paṭhitvā dīpaṃ prajvālya pūrvābhimukho bhūtvācamya pañcagavyena maṇḍapaṃ pavitrīkṛtya karmapātraṃ vidhāya saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt || (fol. 1v1–6) «End: » tataḥ sāmānyārghaṃ bhrāmayitvā nyubjīkṛtya tadupari saṃpūjya punar uttānaṃ kṛtvā acchidram astviti tadupari jalaṃ kṣipet | tato miṣṭānnapānādi(nā) brāhmaṇān kanyāś ca bhojayitvā guror āśīṣo gṛhītvā pādidakanirmālyapuṣpacandanādikaṃ daśabhir mantritaṃ dhārayet || tato yasya smṛtyeti paṭhitvā anena karmaṇā śrīmad iṣṭadevatā prītāstu tat sat | iti karmārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā ( ācamya ) guruśiṣyau bhuñjīyātām | taddine guruśiṣyayor upavāso niṣiddhaḥ | śaktaś ced homādikam api kuryāt | tataś caturthadine viśeṣeṇa devatārcanādi vidhāya gurvājñayā gṛhaṃ gacched (fol. 4v1–5) «Colophon:» iti dīkṣāvidhiḥ || || (fol. 4v5)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || dīpayāgavidhir likhyate || āmantraṇavidhiḥ || nimantraṇaṃ mahādevi sāṅgaṃ ca gurupūrvakaṃ | puṣpadhūpādikaṃ caiva sāmarasvaṃ prasannatā || vāhāhanam tu sarveṣāṃ śrīcakraṃ sagaṇan namaḥ || puṣpabhājana || gaṇavaṭukayoginī kṣatrabhairavī || thvate cakra vāmasakramāntaṃ thana vosyaṃ ha || || aiṁ hrīṁ strīṁ ▒ raktādhinandanavane udyānapīṭhisaṃsthitā | siddhināthasamāyuktaṃ nirmmitaṃ paramāmṛtaṃ || brahmakṣatriyaviṭcchūdravarṇam ekatvakāraṇaṃ | mahāyāgasamṛddhyarthaṃ śrīpātraṃ pratigṛhyatāṃ || sevitā marameśena brahmaṇā viṣṇunā purā | parampadam avāpnoti parāśakti namos tu te || || (fol. 1v1–6) «End: » alipiśitapurandhrī yogapūjāparo haṃ bahuvidhajanabhāraṃ rambhasaṃbhāvito haṃ | paśujananirato haṃ bhairavīm āśrito haṃ gurucaraṇaparo haṃ bhairavīm āśrito haṃ || || jayantikā || navamudrā || kṣamāstutiḥ || ajñānatimirāndho haṃ na jānāmi maheśvari | kṣamyatāṃ kṛpayā svāmin kṣamyatā kṣamyatā śive || vidhihīnaṃ mantrahīnaṃ dravyahīnaṃ pareśvari mama dīnasya dāsasya kṣamasya parameśvari || devatāgurunamaskāraṃ kṛtvā || svasvasthānaṃ viharet || (fol. 13v3–7) «Colophon:» iti śrīkulaśāsane ūrdhvāmnāyamate dīpayāgavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || (fol. 13v7)

«Beginning: » ❖ dīpayāgavidhiḥ || āmantranaṃ || āmantritosi yoginyā sagaṇaṃ gurupūrvakaṃ | puṣpadhūpādikaṃ caiva saumanasyaṃ prayacchatu || adya me pratigṛhṇantu nimantra parameśvari || puṣpabhājana || devārccana || paśuyāgaṃ || ācāryapūjā || śodhana || dinayā karma thvate || || tato rātriyā karma yāya || aiṃ 5 kṣīrārṇavasamudbhūtaṃ koṅkane yat prakāśitaṃ | sahajānandasandoha nirmmitaṃ paramāmṛtaṃ || varṇānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ ekīkaraṇamamurttamam || kulaśāsanāsirdhyarthaṃ annapātraṃ pragṛhyatām || (fol. 1r1–4) «End: » kalasābhiṣekaṃ || devasyāgre akhaṇḍa dhārayet || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalāra pītarajasāyuktaṃ rājāpuṣpākṣataṃ caiva jānubhyām bhūmisaṃsthitā || devyāsamārādhya āputrayaśaśriyam || bighnāntaṃ saṃpradā lakṣṃī maṅgalaṃ śiva sarvvadā || namaste bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ vīrarūpāvatārakam || vīreśī bhairavīyuktaṃ sarvvadeveṣu devatā || sāṃbhavī sagaṇā sarve vatāra parameśvarī || nyūnādhikaṃ yathā pūjā yacdi chidram achidrakam || saṃpūrṇaṃ sarvabhāvena kṣamyatāṃ parameśvara || gaccha gaccha gaṇāḥ sarve svasvasthānaṃ gataṃ layaṃ || rakṣa raklṣa maheśāni punarāvijayāya ca || || anyānyavīrajananamaskāraṃ || || tālatrayam || (fol. 8v2–6) «Colophon:» thvate dīpajāgaurttarayāmathaḥ || || (fol. 8v6–7)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || adya pūrvoccārita evaṃ gunaºº puṇyatithau samastapāpakṣayadvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ adyodayaprabhṛtti śvaḥ sūryodayaparyaṃtaṃ suśvāsaniḥsvāsasvarūpeṇa nityaṃ nityaṃ ṣaṭśatādhikaṃ ekaviṃśatisāhasraṃ ajapāgāyatrījapamahaṃ kariṣye || asya śrīajapāgāyatrīmaṃtrasya haṃsaḥ ṛṣiḥ avyaktagāyatrī chandaḥ paramahaṃso devatā || haṃ bījaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ sohaṃ kīlakaṃ mama svarūpasphūrtti pratibandhaka vidhi nivṛtyarthaṃ ajapāgāyatrī prītyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || (exp. 3t1–3b1) «End: » iti prāktanā ‘japājapaṃ nivedyaṃ sumukhaścetyādi deśakālau saṃkīrtya || adya sūryodayād ārabhya śvaḥ sūryodayaparyaṃtaṃ ahorātrayor jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyavasthātraye jñānato ‘ jñānato vā ṣaṭśatādhikaikaviṃśatisahasrasaṃkhyākocchvāsaniḥsvāśābhyāṃ sohaṃrūpābhyām eva gaṇeśabrahmaviṣṇumaheśajīvātmaparamātmaguruprītyarthaṃ yathāyathokasaṃkhyābhidhaṃ tattaddaleṣu tattaddevatā yathāyathāsthānaṃ haṃsamantreṇājapāgāyatrījapam ahaṃ kariṣye || ityajapājapasaṃkalpaṃ kuryāt || (exp. 11b2–11) «Colophon:» iti hiraṇyakeśīyāhnike || || || (exp. 11b11)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ ṛcaṃ vācaṃ prapadye mano yajuḥ prapadye sāmaprāṇaṃ prapadye cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ prapadye | vāgojaḥ sahau yo mayi prāṇāpānau || yan me cchidraṃ cakṣuṣo hṛdayasya manaso vāti tṛṇvaṃ bṛhaspatir me taddadhātu | sanno bhavatu bhuvanasya yaspatiḥ bhurbhuvaḥ svaḥ || kayānaścitra ā || || astvā satyo madānāṃ || abhīṣunaḥ sakhīnāṃ || || (exp. 2:1–4) «End: » atha jīvapratiṣṭhāmantrasya brahmāviṣṇumaheśvarāṛṣayaḥ gāyatrīchandaḥ jīvapratiṣṭhādevatā hṛdayabījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ jīvākareṣaṇe viniyogaḥ oṃ hraṁ śrīṁ aiṁ klīṁ glauṃ krauṁ ā prāṇa āgaccha svāhā ❖ java || cakra || gadā ❖ khava śaṃkha padma ❖ mādhavanārāyaṇasa rakṣaṇa (exp. 11B12–21) «Colophon:» iti dinayajñavidhi samāpta || svasti śreyostu saṃvat 696 pauṣa śudi 14 (exp. 11B4–5)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || śrīgurave namaḥ || dīpajāgavidhi likhete || || āgamasa marjjātātheṃ vasape || mahāpātrādikumbhasnāna || raktacandanādi catusramacetana lepapanayāyanabhiṃ || dhūpayitvā || kumbhathāne || varṇātoyaṃ || akhaṇḍaiḥ kalaśāṁ nāthaṃ karat paraśudhārinīṁ | svacchandasphuranāṁ mantraṁ nidehi kularūpinīṃ || || pātrapūranaṃ || brahmāṇḍakhaṇḍasaṃbhūtaṃ maśekharasasaṃbhavaṃ || (exp. 3t1–5) āpūritaṃ mahāpātraṃ pīyūṣarasamāpahaṃ || || (exp. ) «End: » aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ mayūrāsnāya namaḥ || 3 vāṁ vaṭukāye namaḥ || baliṃ || || 3 narāsanāye namaḥ || 3 kṣāṁ kṣetrapālāya namaḥ || baliṁ || 3 saivāsanāye namaḥ || 3 yāṁ yoginībhyo namaḥ || bali || || 3 pretāsanāya namaḥ || 3 yaṁ cāmuḍābhyāṃ namaḥ || baliṁ || 3 mūśāsanāye namaḥ || 3 gāṁ gaṇapataye namaḥ || bali || āvāhya pañcamudrā || carupātra hlāya stotra || jāpa stotraṃ pūrvavat || gauryā putraṃ kumāraṃ ca kṣetrapālaś ca yoginīṁ || caṇḍarūpāya cāmuṇḍā gaṇādhipataye namaḥ || thvate pañcabalipūjā || (exp. 8t1–4 ) thvate śikhāpūjā || || thvanali thava thavasa nityapūjā yāya || sūryārgha || prāṇāyāma || nyāsādi pūjāmālako || dhūpa dīpa jāpa stotra || mālako || thvate gaṇacokosaṃna nityakarmayākoṁ yāya || || yoginīyāke ājñā koya || prāthayāmi jaganmātā carupūjākramaṃ tathā | tava praśādād deveśi pañcayajñaṃ prapūjanaṃ || ājñā kāyāva caru (exp. 8b4–7) «Sub-Colophon:» iti divārccanavidhi samāptaḥ || || (exp. 3b3)

Beginning ❖ śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyai namaḥ || || atha dakṣiṇakālikādevyāḥ karmmārccaṇa(!)pūjāvidhir likhyate || || kāmanayā vastradvayaṃ paridhāya strīvattilakaṃ candanādinā kṛtvā yathōktasthānaṃ samāśritya puṣpabhājanasaṃkalpaḥ || cadanādini vedanaṃ || oṁ vajrodake hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || iti maṃtreṇa savyena jalam ānīyāsanam abhyukṣa upaviṣya || (fol. 1v1–4) End tryaṃjaliḥ || oṁ haṃ ▒ 2 siddhimātaṅgeśvarāya saṁ ▒ oṁ hlūṁ 2 siddhimātaṇgeśvarīdevīpādukāṃ || hṛdayādinā saṃpūjya || aiṁ kāṁ kīṁ kūṁ ▒ kalaṃkeśvaramahābhairavāya pādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ || baliḥ || oṁ hiri 2 ucchiṣṭamukhebhyo baliṃ gṛhna 2 svāhā || āvāhya mudrā || dhūpadīpajāpa (!) || hlūṁ svāhā 54 || stuti[ḥ] || dhūmānnam ityādi || namas te nīrmmalaṃ devaṃ siddhimānaṃgakeśvarī || sarvvavaktrāvaśeṣānām ānandamuditālayā || sarvvamātṛkriyāsiddhivāṃchitārthaphalapradā || sarvvasantoṣadā nityaṃ namas te mātaṅgeśvarī || vākyaṃ || kṣmāstutiḥ || tāṃbūlaṃ bhuktvā kalaṃke kṣipet visarjanaṃ || || (fol. 49r6–49v4) Colophon

«Beginning: » śrīrāmo jayati jāvat kule aśuddhātmā jñānī putro na jāyate || tāvat bhramati saṃsāre pitṛpiṇḍaṃ na vāñchati 1 adīkṣitasya ( martyasya ) pitṛpiṇḍaṃ na gṛhyate || rudaṃti pitaras tasya kākamāṃsaṃ nu bhakṣate 2 yadi gurur ddhāryate karṇe taraṃtyekottaraṃśataṃ tasya pūjanamātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet 3 svabhyo pi vāyasebhyaś ca bhramaṃti pitaras tathā gurumamtraṃ yadi prāptaṃ bandhaṃ muñcanti tatkṣaṇaṃ 4 (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » iti putrakanyājanmayaṃ vidhāne nīlacandre mahārūḍho śūnyaghaṭikāmadhye māsakanyā vidhavā bhavet || abhāve takaṃtakaṃ ghaṭikālagnaputrakanyāprathamaṃ || dvitīyañ ca phalaṃ nāsti tṛtīye śūnya viśiṣyate || ghaṭikābandhane lagne lagne sa kanyā vidhavā bhavet || putraṃ prati prītir vāsti sā kanyā kuṭilā bhavet || ghaṭikā amṛtaṃ lagne puruṣapantīṣu putratra phalamahā bhavet || dhanadhānyayaśaṃbṛddhi putrakanyāphalaṃ bhavet || iti vivāhalagnaghaṭikāphalaṃ bhaviṣyati || śūnyaṃ ca śūnyakāryeṣu kaṇṭakaṃ prāṇaghātakaṃ || bandhanaṃ bandhakāleṣu amṛtaṃ manasi sthitaṃ || (fol. 12r2–margin) «Colophon:» iti śivapatrikā samāptā || śubham || (fol. 12r margin )

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ || devy uvāca || siddhavidyā purā proktā maṃtrayaṃtrādikāni ca | nānābhāvaprabhedena saṃśayo jāyate prabho || bhāvabhedena kathaya lokanistārakāraka | sarvveṣāṃ taṃtramaṃtrāṇāṃ siddhāntaṃ viṣṇusammataṃ | (fol. 1r1–3) End tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kalāpūjāṃ samācaret || yonirūpākalādevi dakṣiṇaiva na saṃśayeḥ(!) | divyo vīro varārohe kalāpūjāṃ prakalpayet || paśubhāvāśrito maṃtrī kalāṃ naiva prapūjayet || kalā sā dvividhā pūjā guptāvyāktā kuleśvara || (fol. 4v6–8) Colophon

Beginning oṁ namaḥ siddhaṃ(!) śrīśivādigurubhyo namaḥ kārttā kārayitā kāryaṃ bhoktā bhojayitā bhuji jñātā jñāpayitā jñānaṃ tvam eva śiva nāparā 1 līlayā bhāvanāvṛtti(!) yat kāraṃ(!) tu hi śaṃkara yat kurvaṃ naiva †yānyonaṃ† dharmādharmādirakṣaṇaṃ atha tīrthaśodhanavidhir llikhyate atha sarvvaśṛṃgāraveśarūpadharaḥ tāṃbūlapūravadanaḥ siṃdūratilakaḥ (fols. 1v1–2r1) End evaṃ oṁ hrīṁ pāsau trāsanāya namaḥ dhenuyonimatsyamudrāṃ prdarśayet tatpātre mūlena pūrayet tataḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ japaṃ kuryāt tato visarjanaṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa viśālākṣī(!) yaddattaṃ sāṃprataṃ mayā apāre bhvasaṃsāre pāhi māṃ parameśvari iti visṛjyaḥ(!) tarppaṇaṃ daśāṃśasamītaṃ tarppaṇāṃtaraṃ sakalavastunivedanaṃ kuryāt tataḥ gurupātreṇa gurūn saṃtarppya oṁ gaṃ gurū paṃ paramaguru (fol. 9r4–8) Colophon x

«Beginning: » (oṃ) namo dakṣiṇakālikāyai || prakṣyālya pāṇipādau pūjāsthānam āgatyāca(mya) sāmānyārghasthāpanaṃ kuryāt || athāstreṇa pātraṃ prakṣālya nama iti pūrayitvā gandhapuṣpādi datvā tīrthamantreṃa tīrtham āvāhya praṇavena dhenumudrāṃ pradarśayet || tatostreṇa dvāraṃ prokṣya oṃ dvāradevatābhyo namaḥ iti saṃpūjya astramantreṇa vāmapādaghātatrayeṇa bhaumān bighnān utsārya astrādibhiś cāntarīkṣagān bighnān utsārya mūlamantrasaṃcitadivyadṛṣṭyā divyān bighān utsārya apasarpantviti paṭhitvā vikirān vikīrya dakṣiṇapādapurasaram aṅgasaṃkocanayāgamaṃḍapaṃ praviśya brahmaṇe vāstupuruṣāya namaḥ iti naiṛtyāṃ saṃpūjyāsanaṃ kuryāt || (exp. 3t1–3b3) «End: » kaṃ mama sariraśuddhyarthe viniyogaḥ || iti nibaddhāñjali || oṃ phreṁ cchreṁ khreṁ ssrāṁ khreṁ cchreṁ phreṁ || 10 || japa || 10 || oṁ iṁ caṀ chaṁ jaṁ jhaṁ ñaṁ īṁ śirase svāhā || tarjjanyo || oṁ uṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ ṇaṃ ūṁ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ || madhyamayo || oṁ aiṁ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ aiṁ kavacāya hūṁ || anāmikayo || oṁ auṁ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ auṁ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ kaniṣṭhayo || oṃ aṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ luṃ kṣaṃ astrāya phaṭ || ka (exp. 43:1–6) «Sub-colophon:» iti kālikāpūjāpaddhatiḥ samāptā || || || (exp. 15t1) iti mahākālakṛtaṃ karpūrastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || ❁ || (exp. 20b2) iti śana?saṃhitāyāṃ vanadurggāka(va)caṃ || śrī || || ( written in another hand )

«Beginning: » śrīmadgurucaraṇakamalebhyo namaḥ || śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyai namaḥ || praṇamya dakṣiṇāpādāraviṃdayugmamādarāt || karoti kopi pūjanaprayogasaṃgrahaṃ budhaḥ || 1 || ttara sādhakaḥ prātar utthāya śayyāyām eva baddhapadmāsanaḥ kulabṛkṣaṃ praṇamya || svaśirasi śvetasahasradalakamalakarṇikāmadhyavartticandramaṇḍalāntargataṃ svaguruṃ dhyāyet || śvetaṃ śvetavilepamālyavasanaṃ vāmena raktotpalaṃ || bubhratyā priyayetareṇa tarasā śliṣṭaṃ prasannānanaṃ || hastābhyām abhayaṃ varaṃ ca dadhataṃ śaṃbhusvarūpaṃ paraṃ hālālohitalocanotpalayugaṃ dhyāyecchirasthaṃ guruṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2v1) «End: » tatr saṃpūjya || śrīdakṣiṇe kālike pūjitāsi kṣamasveti mūlādhāre sthāpayet ||tata aiśānyāṃ jalena trikoṇa vṛtta caturasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ nirmāya saṃpūjay || tatra oṃ citkālocchiṣṭacāṇḍālinyai namaḥ || iti devī nirmālya jalākṣatapuṣpādinā naivedyāntam abhyarcya || śāṃtipāṭhaṃ paṭhitvā mūlena nirmālyaṃ svaśirasi dhṛtvā || śrīpātrāmṛtaṃ svapātre kṛtvā svīkṛtya bhūmau nyubjīkṛtya tad upoari puṣpaṃ dattvā pātraṃ prakṣālya saṃgopya tad amṛtasnigdhabhūmau māyābījaṃ vilikhya vāmahastakaniṣṭhāṅgulyā tat tilakaṃ || yaṃ yaṃ spṛśāmya pādena yāṃ yāṃ paśyāmi cakṣuṣā || sa eva dāsatāṃ yātu yadi śakrasamo bhavet || iti kṛṭvā natvā yathāsukhaṃ viharet || (fol. 60r4–61r1) «Colophon:» iti pūjanaprayogasaṃgrahaḥ samāptaḥ || || śubham astu || rāma || || || || (fol. 61r1–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || oṃ namaḥ śrīśrīśrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || astḥānasa pūjā yācake || basape vidhiḥ || patavāsana ṣaṭkoṇa coya || trikoṇa coya || bhavata bali yāta 1 coya || argha | arghapātra taya || jāpūjā voya gaṇavaṭukādina || arddhacandra sidharana coya || thvate vasape || asthānayā javakhāpācchayātiya māla || || atha yajamāna puṣpabhājana yācake || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotra yajamānasya durggaprāsādaśāntibalyārcanasvasainyarakṣaparasainyabhañjanārthaṃ śrī2 ugracaṇḍādevārccananimittyarthaṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || (fol. 1v1–2r1) End saṃhāramudrayā visarjjayet || aiṃ krīṃ śrīṃ ▒ ▒ ▒ ▒ śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ || svasthānavāso bhavantu || hrīṃ ācamanīya svāhā || || balicchoya || viyākaṃthana thava thava disasacchoya || mūlahanumantrabali jukka śantu yā bhūsaphale to vāṅāva svacakākāyāva hole bali śantu yānagara socakaṃtāthe || || laṃ holābali jukkva kvathaṅāyaṃke holake || || sākṣi thāya || || (fol. 47r4–47v3) «Colophons» iti gurggaprāsādabaliḥ samāptaḥ || || saṃvat 834 pratiṣṭhāyātaṃ śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevasana duvukvāthapratiṣṭhāyāṅā juro || || śubhaḥ || (fol. 47v3–5)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || lajjābījaṃ tridhā likhya vāgbhavaṃ ca trayaṃ trayaṃ || dharmabījaṃ tridhā dhrīṃ dhrīṃ netraṃ vahnisamāyutāṃ(!) || lajjātrayaṃ gaṇeśākhyaṃ grīṃ grīṃ grīṃ miti pūrvvavat || śāradāyai namasyānte siddhisārasvato manuḥ || 1 || strīṃ strīṃ strīm aiṃ aiṃ aiṃ dhrīṃ dhrīṃ dhrīṃ glīṃ glīṃ glīṃ śāradāyai namaḥ || || sarvoparitathoṃkārajapādvāgīśvaro bhavet || 1 || (exp 2t1–4) End oṃ adyetyādi amukagotrotpannomukadevatāśamārthakāmo mokṣaprāptikāmaḥ śrīmad amukadevatāyāmukamantragrahaṇāya amuka gotraṃ amukapravaravedādhyāyinaṃ amukadevaśarmāṇaṃ ebhiḥ pādyādibhir arccitaṃ bhavantaṃ gurūtvenāhaṃ vṛṇe || 2 || om adyetyādi amukagotro mukadevaśarmā mukagotrāmukaśarmakartṛkāmukadevatā mukamaṃtradīkṣākarmaṇi yathāsaṃbhavopacārair amukadevatāyāḥ pūjām ahaṃ kariṣye || 3 || oṃ adyetyādi || rāhugraste divākare niśākare vā amukagotromukadevatāyā mukamaṃtrasiddhikāmo grāsādvimuktiparyaṃtaṃ japarūpapuraścaraṇam ahaṃ kariṣye || (exp. 7t2–8) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrī3mahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurave namaḥ || || atha durggāprāsādagṛhepravesapratiṣṭḥābalyarccanavidhiḥ || || patavāsana coya vāstu suddhāvali mālako yātā khaṭtakūṇa(!) coya || || yajamānapuṣpabhājana yācake adyādi vākya || mānavagotra yajamānasya śrījayabhūpatīndramallavarmaṇā śrī3 svaeṣṭadevatāprītyarthaṃ durggāprāsādapratiṣṭhāśāntibalyarcanakarttuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || || saṃvarttā maṇḍalānte kramapadasahitānandaśaktissubhīmā sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyaṃ catuṣkaṃ tvakulakulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ | catvālo(!) pañcakonya(!) punar api caturaṃ statvato maṇḍaledaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvalaṃ(!) bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaṃ || (fol. 1v1–2r4) End pratiṣṭhā || pra(!)tiṣṭhitisi deveśi supratiṣṭhā bhuvanatrayaṃ(!) || sānnidhyaṃ pratigṛhnā(!)mi yajamānādibṛddhaye || śannos tu dvipade nityaṃ sanno rājya(!) (ta)thaiva ca || yajamāna saṃbhūtoyaṃ (!) suputrapaśubāndhavaḥ || rakṣa tvaṃ sarvakālekhu (!) deśanabhairava namo stu te || (!) supratiṣṭhā varadā bhavantu || || kubhara pūjā cchoya || sarvvamaṅgalamāṅgalya(!) śive sarvvārtha sādhake(!) || śaraṇya tryambike gori(!) nārāyaṇī namo stu te || kaumārīdevyaī svasthānavāso bhavantu || sākṣi thāya || || pehnuto śrīśrī yajamāna ārogyaṃ ālasaṃ thva cchesaṃ || || (fol. 133v2–134r3) «Colophons» iti gṛhe pratiṣṭhā śāntibalyarccanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || || yādṛṣṭaṃ puṣṭakaṃ(!) dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ liṣitaṃ mayā | yadi śurddha(!) maśubddhao(!) vā mama doṣo na dīyate || śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladeva prabhuthākurasana kvātha pratiṣṭhāyā śānibalyarccanavidhiḥ sāphuli dayakā juro || || śubhaṃ bhavatu sarvvadā || || || || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 134r3–134v2)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha durggāprāsādapratiṣṭḥābalyarccanavidhir likhyate || || asthāna ādina mālaka vāthelake || || vasape vidhi || pa(ṭa)vāsana ṣaṭkoṇa mālako coya || jāpūjā vope gaṇavaṭuka ādina pañcabaliṃ || hanubhairavabalisa karṇapatākā pañcapatākā dṛṣṭi aduvāla jajamakā svāna siṃdhura kume thvate vasape || || atha balyārccanaṃ || yajamāna puṣpabhājana || adyādi vākya || yajamānasya durggāprāsādasvasainya rakṣa parasainya bhañjanārthaṃ balyārccananimittyarthaṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || (fol. 1v1–7) End balivisarjjanaṃ || līnaṃ gaccha 2 svāhā || thalau jalākṣataṃ nidhāya || hraḥ hanurudrāya astrāya phaṭ || arghastha puṣpākṣataṃ balau kṣipet || oṃ hrāṃ hanurudrāya hṛdayāya namaḥ || hṛdātmalīnaṃ || saṃhāramudrayā visarjjayet || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīm ▒ ▒ ▒ ▒ śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ svasthānavāso bhavantu || hrīṃ ācamanīya svāhā || || bali cchoya || vidyā kaṇṭha laṃthava 2 disasa cchoya || mūla hanumantrabaliju kva śatruyā bhūsaphalae tā vāṅā va svakacakā kāyā va hole bali śatru yā nagara sācakaṃ tāthe || || asthānasaṃ balivisarjjana yāya || bali chhoya thava 2 disasa || || holāvali kvātha ṅūyakaṃ horake || || sākṣi thāya || || (fol. 78r3–78v3) «Colophons» iti durggaprāsādapratiṣṭhāta śāntibali samāptaḥ || || kvalapākvātha prathiṣṭhāyā saṃphili || || śubha || (fol. 78v3–4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha durggāprāsādapratiṣṭḥābalyarccanavidhir likhyate || || asthāna ādina mālaka vothelake || || vasape vidhi || patavāsana ṣaṭkoṇa mālako coya || jāpūjā coya gaṇavaṭuka ādina pañcabaliṃ || hanubhairavabalisa karṇapatākā pañcapatākā dṛṣṭi aduvāla jajamakā svāna siṃdhura kune thvate vasape || || atha balyārccanaṃ || yajamāna puṣpabhājana || adyādi vākya || yajamānasya durggāprāsādasvasainya rakṣa parasainya bhañjanārthaṃ śānti balyārccananimittyarthaṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || (fol. 1v1–2r1) End balivisarjjanaṃ || līnaṃ gaccha 2 svāhā || balau jalākṣataṃ nidhāya || hraḥ hanurudrāya astrāya phaṭ || arghastha puṣpākṣataṃ balau kṣipet || oṃ hrāṃ hanurudrāya hṛdayāya namaḥ || hṛdātmalīnaṃ || saṃhāramudrayā visarjjayet || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīm ▒ ▒ ▒ ▒ śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ svasthānavāso bhavantu || hrīṃ ācamanīya svāhā || || bali cchoya || vidyā kaṇṭha laṃthava 2 disasa cchoya || mūla hanumantrabaliju kva śatruyā bhūsaphale to vāṅā va svakacakā kāyāva hole bali śatruyā nagara sācakaṃ tāthe || || asthānasaṃ balivisarjjana yāya || bali chhoya thava 2 digasa sāyāvatāthe māla || || hārāvalī kvātha ṅūyakaṃ horake māra || || sākṣi thāya || || (fol. 93r1–93v3) «Colophons» iti śrīdurggaprāsādapratiṣṭhāta śāntibali samāptaḥ || || dubukvoṭha prathiṣṭhāyā saṃphiliḥ || || śubham astu sarvvadā || || || (fol. 93v3–5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīguruve(!) || atha deśabalividhir likhyate || || yajamāna puṣpabhājana || adyādi || vākya || śrīsamvattā(!) || śyāmāraktā || utphullāṃ || pūrvvandakṣiṇa || siddhir astu || yathā vānatyādi || || laṃkhana hāya || ūkāraṃ vāyubījaṃ tyādi || || ceta || śrīkhaṇḍacandanaṃ divyaṃ || || sindhūra || vīreśvarī mahāvīretyādi || || akṣata || akṣataṃ akṣayotyādi || || yajamakā || yajñopavītaṃ tyādi || || aduvāra a|| nānā vastra vici tyādi || || (caṅū māṭe | || chatraṃ cintāmanī(!) tyādi || svāna || nānā puṣpa tyādi || || karṇṇapatākā || śurddhaḥ(!) sindūravarṇābhā tyādi (!) || || pañcapata || patākāpañcavarṇātyādi(!) || || tritattvenācamya || sūryyārgha || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramallavarmmaṇa śrī2 sveṣṭadevatā prītyarthaṃ navagṛhapraveśasiddhāgniyajñadeśabalyarcanapūjānimittyarthaṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi (fol. 1v1–2r2 and margin) End sva ātmā āśīrvvāda || ambe pūrvvagataṃ padaṃ bhagavati caitanyarūpātmako jñānecchā bahulā tathā hariharau brahmāmarīci trakaṃ (!) | bhāsvad bhairavapañcakaṃ tadanu ca śrīyoginīpañcakaṃ candrārkkā(!) ca marīciṣaṭkam amalaṃ māṃ pātu nityāṃ kuje (!) || || velajulaṅā va astena bali visarjjana yāya || || sākṣi thāya || || balideśaṅūyakaṃ holake || vājana surddhā || || (fol. 86v1–5) «Colophons» iti śrīsiddhilakṣmīmate(!)prakāśe jayadrathavīdyāpīṭhe pratyaṅgīryākṣatrāvalīstava(ḥ) samāptaḥ || || (fol. 7r35) iti śrīśivaśaktisamarasatvaṃ mahāmāyāstotraṃ samāptaḥ(!) || || (fol. 73r1–2) iti śrīpīṭha+nyadevyāmate pīṭhāvatārastotraṃ samāptaḥ(!) || || (fol. 80r1–2) iti deśabaliḥ samāptaḥ || || ❁ || || śubhaṃ bhavatu sarvvadā || || (fol. 86v6–7)

Beginning oṃ atha pavitrārohaṇavidhi rikhete (!) || digapūjā || karmmāeccaṇaṃ || paṭuvāsanana svastika coya || pavitrakapūjanaṃ || catuskāra || pūjana || ṣaḍaṃgena || catriśītraya 3 || tritatva || aiṃ śivatattvādhikāre ▒ parāyai śirase pādukāṃ || ātmatattvādhikāre aiṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hraiṃ ṃūṃ hraḥ mhauṃ phaṭ parāyai hṛdayāya pādukāṃ || (exp. 9t1–9b3) End damanārohayāmyeṣa kṣamasva paripūrṇatāṃ || ratināthanamas tubhyaṃ gṛhasthārccaṇakāmadaṃ | gṛhṇantu damanārohaṃ caitrabighnaphalaṃ dahet || atra gandhādi arghasethavatākāya || dhūpa dīpa naivedya || jāpa || tuti || tappaṇa || paśutarppaṇa || rātrījāga || (exp. 8t28b3) Colophon iti damanārohanavidhi samāpta || (exp. 8b3–4)

Beginning adhunā daśavaktrāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ pravadāmi te | ekaikavaktreṇaikaikadevīrūpaṃ pradhāryate | tattadrūpeṇa devyās tu tattadvaktraṃ prapūjayet | mantroddhāra atho vacmi cetaḥ praṇihitaṃ kuru | ādau bījatrayaṃ bhinnabhinnaṃ sarvatra tiṣṭhati | tato nāmānyapi punar ddevyā devi pṛthak pṛthak | taiḥ svarūpapadasyāpi vigraho ṅentavān api | bhinnabhinnapadaiḥ śākaṃ vaktraśabdo pi vigrahī | (exp. 2t1–4) End sarvvānāvaśyakatvena vidadhyād deśikottamaḥ | eṣām ekam api nyāsam akurvan kṣiprakārakaḥ | niyojayatyaṅgahānyāpūjāṃ naimittikīm asau | tasmād yatnena kurvvīta nyāsān ekādaśā pi hi | śivaśktyāhvayan nyāsas thānaṃ mātṛkayā samaṃ | tasyaiva viparītaṃ hi kālīpañjara īritaṃ | mātṛkārā ʼṇṇā ʼnusāreṇa boddhavyaṃ jagadīśvari | tataḥ punaḥ karaṣaḍaṅganyāsaṃ vidadhīta vai | sāmānyapīṭhanyāsañ ca kurvvīta tad anantaraṃ | tato ʼ nu vai yogaratnapīṭhanyāsaṃ samācaret | etau nityatayā jñeyau devi naimittikārhaṇe | pīṭhanyāsaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ dvāvapi prāṇavallabhe | tato dehamaye pīṭhe cinyate (exp. 10b1–5) Colophon

(exp. 63B1–14) === Colophon ===x

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || śrī3(siddhi)lakṣmyai namaḥ || lakṣāhuti siddhāgni likhyate || dinasoyāṅā goyacchoya || ācāryya pithupūjā vane || pīthisa pūrvvasevā phukva puraścarana yāya || divasānukrameṇa yañjamaṇḍapa goya || ku 18 || adyadi vākya || yaja(mā)nasya mānavagotra śrīśrījayajitāmitramallavarmāhaṃ śrī3 sveṣṭadevatāprītipūrvaka yathāhutisiddhāgniyajñanrmirtyarthaṃ(!) puṣpabhājanaṃ smaarpayāmi |\ (fol. 1v1–4) End hrāṃ meghanāthabhairavāya namaḥ || hrāṃ somarājabhairavāya namaḥ || hrāṃ vidyārājabhairavāya namaḥ || indrādi || || vaktra mataṅga || || baliḥ || oṃ kṣetrāya kṣetrasandoha oṃ hūṃ haḥ sarvakṣetrapālāya gandhadhūpabalipūjāṃ gṛhna2 namo namaḥ || mūlamantra || trya(ṃ)jaliṃ || śakti || dhūpadīpaṃ || japaḥ || stutiḥ || akhaṇḍamaṇḍaletyādi || viśvaikarūpaviśvātman viśvasarvaikakāraṇam || paraprakāśavapuṣaṃ stumaḥ svacchandabhairavaṃ || prasaracchaktikallolajalāllahalikelaya || sarvasaṃpannidhānāya bhairavāmbudhaye namaḥ || || (fol. 348v1–5) «Colophons» iti śrī3siddhilakṣmīmate jayadrathe vidyāpīṭhe pratyaṅgiryyā kṣetrābalipīṭhastavaṃ samāptaṃ || (fol. 67v7) iti śrī3siddhilakṣmīsamayavidyā samāptaṃ(!) || || (fol. 85v4) iti śrī3siddhilakṣmīdeguli samāptaḥ || || (fol. 86r1) … iti dhvajāvarohana(!)varṣavarddhanavidhi(!) samāptaṃ || || (fol. 315r5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ glāṃ glīʼ glūṃ hastirājāya ugramūrttaye svāhā || || oṃ hūṃ vajranakhadraṃṣṭrāyudhāya mahāsiṃhāya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || || bhāṃ bhīṃ bhaṃ ▒ mahāvyāghrāya || || oṃ sāṃ sīṃ sūṃ ▒ unmatteśvarāya svāhā || (exp. 3t1–6) … asya sudarśanamantrasya ahirbudhnyaṛṣir virāṭachanda sudarśanarūpo mahāviṣṇur devatā hūṃ bījaṃ phaṭ śaktiḥ sahasrāreti kīlakaṃ īṣṭārthasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || || (exp. 9t1–4) End dathu mekhalāyā devane lājalapati thvayā yāsaparvvata || || kothu sadevane pūdevāṅayā sau phola || || yoni dathu jyāṅu paraśekhanārayā kovanetāṃ paṃcalaṃgayātātha 2 || || kuṇḍaduvane vaṃ (exp. 231 b3–6) «Sub-Colophons» iti śrīpadmapurāṇe prāhlada(!)māhātme(!) trayodaśodhyāyaḥ || || (exp. 5b1–2) tathā māṃ cchādayacchatra yuddhe dhvanigataṃ sadā || || saṃ 792 caitra śuddhi 10 thva paddhatina śrī3 yā kātisa pratiṣṭhāyāṅā || (exp. 10t2–4) iti khatapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ samāptaṃ || || || saṃ 770 caitra śuklapakṣa paṃcamī thva paddhatina vaidya harirāmana yānā śrīdevīdāsana || || (exp. 30t2–4) saṃ 792 caitra śuddhi 5 thva paddhatina śrī3yā kātisa sīkiṇi dhu sārddūrapratiṣṭhā yāṅā || śrīdevīdāsana || || (exp. 99b4–6) iti sudarśanacakrapūjā || || (exp. 134b5) iti tolaṇapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ samāpta(!) || || (exp. 154b1–2) iti vitānapūjā samāptā || || thva paddhatina śrī 3 yā kātisa lu ilāna pratiṣṭhā yāṅā || || sa 792 caitra śuddhi 10 bṛhaspativāla puṣpa nakṣatra || || || (fol. 175b1–5) iti vratabandhanasamāvarttanaṃ || oṃ hrīm vivāhāya + || madhuparkate || kuśatilakāyā va vākya || adyādi nirvāṇeśvarāya svarṇakalaśāya nirvāṇeśvarī tubhyam ahaṃ saṃpradade || (exp. 23t2–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaścaṇḍikāyai || || navarātrasone yathāvidhithyaṃ || ācāryya brāhmaṇa pehmaṃsyaṃ balipātacchidayakaṃ || vidhithyaṃ thvava 2 samarjjātathyaṃ || || mahāṣṭamīkuhnu thaṇḍili coya bhutemācidevane || hvavane dvandute bali || arghapātrate || || sūryyārgha || 5 akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāleṇa gurusmaraṇaṃ || siddhilakṣmīnyāsa coya || jalapātraarghapātrapūjā || bhūtaśuddhi ātmapūjā || śrī saṃvarttāna āvāhana || (fol. 1r1–5) End dakṣiṇā || svānadako kāyāva praseṣa co bali cona paṃkalaṃsacchoya || || svānate khaṃḍa hlāya || kuṃbhahlāya || thvate khaṃḍakṣepe yayā || || thva vidhiyaṃsa yāṅāyā || prāsana dvandu sa thane || khaeṃ dhari bhōyū malatāya guṃguliṅā || thvate prāsanate || || || raktā sindūravarṇā taḍitadyutinibhā dhakānti sutejā kaumārī vārarūpī prahasitavadanā bhūṣitāhārakaṃṭhaṃ || icchāsiddhipradātā duritabhayaharā sarvvakarmmapraśastā sā devī hyādiśaktir hyaturabhayaharā saṃpradā rājyalakṣmīṃ || (fol. 14v5–9) «Colophons» thva paddhati suna kenemate cakena sā siddhihāni gopanāyāta sā siddhi || śubhaṃ bhavatu || (fol. 14v10)

Beginning ❖ śrī namaḥ gurave || atha deśabalividdhi(!) likhyate || || jajamāna puṣpabhājana || adyetyādi || vākya || mānavagotrayajamānaśīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevavarmmaṇaḥ śrī3 sveṣṭadevatāprītyarthaṃ śrī3 sveṣṭadevatāyā jīrṇoddhārasuvarṇakalaśacārana deśabalyārcaṇakartuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāmi || || śrīsamvarttā || śyāmā raktā || utphullāṃ || pūrvvandakṣiṇa || siddhir astu kriyāraṃbhe || yathā vāṇa || puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || || laṃkhana hāya || ukāraṃ vāyubījaṃ || ceta || śrīkhaṇḍacandanaṃ divyaṃ || sindūra || vīreśvarī mahāvīre || akṣata || (fol. 1r1–7) End svānako kāya || ekā mūrttir aneka dhātri jagatī pūrṇeśvarī vāsave bhūteśī gagaṇo(!)pamā bhagavatī niḥśeśvarī dakṣiṇe jñānāgamya kujeśvarī kulaguṇāvāruṇyadig(!)nāyakā śrīvāmāṃ praṇamāmi viśvajananī darśeśvarī siddidā || ambe pūrvvagataṃ paraṃ bhagavatī (!) caitanyarūpātmikā jñānecchā bahulā tathā hariharau brahmā marīcitrayaṃ || bhāsvad bhairavapañcakaṃ taranu(!) ca śrīyoginīpañcakaṃ || candrākkau(!) ca marīciṣaṭkavimalaṃ māṃ pātu nityaṃ śrīkujā ||(!) || belajura ṅā va bali visarjjana yāyaḥ || deśaṅurakaṃ horake || vājanasudrāṃ(!) || || (fol. 94v–95r7) «Colophons» iti deśabalividhiḥ samāptaṃ (!) || samvat 826 phārguṇaśukra ekādaśi aṃgāvāra kuhnu saṃpūrṇa dina || śrīśrībhūpatīndramalla deva asana śrīśrīśrītaleju ske gajuri jīrṇoddhāra yāṅā deśabaliviyāyā thva sāphula || || śubhaṃ bhavatu sarvvadā || ❁ || ❁ || khaḍgasiddhir astu śubhaṃ || ❁ || (fol. 95r7, 95v1-4)

Beginning ❖ śrīgurave namaḥ || atha deśabalividhir likhyate || || jajamānapuṣpabhājanayācake || adyetyādi || vākya || mānavagotraśrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevavarmmāhaṃ śrī3 vārāhīdevyā jirṇoddhāraprāsādapratiṣṭhārthaṃ paripūrṇakalaśasacchatrapuṣpamālādhvajāvarohaṇaṃ deśabalyārccana karttuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmī || śrīsamvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadasahitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ tvakulakulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ | catvāro paṃcakonya punarapi caturaṃ statvato maṇḍaledaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśa(ṃ) || || (fol. 1v1–6) End yathā vāṇaprahārāṇāṃ kavacam bhavati vāraṇāṃ tadvadeva vidhātrānāṃ(!) śāntir bhavatu vāraṇaṃ | svasthānakṣatrapālāya brahmaṇyādi asitāṅgamahābhairavasahitāya gaṇavaṭukayoginīkṣatrapālāya sāṅgāya sagaṇas(!)parivārāya digavidigi indrādilokapālāya suprītā varadā bhavastu(!) || yajamānasya mānavagotra śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramarllavarmmaṇaḥ śrīśrīśrī vārāhīdevyā jīrṇoddhāraprāsādopari sacchatrasuvarṇakalaśadhvajāvalohana(!)bhairavāgniyajñakarmmanimityarthaṃ sagaṇasya nivārāṇāṃ āyurārogyam aiśvaryajanadhanalakṣmīsantatisantānabṛddhira(!) yathāśāstroktaphalabaladāyino bhavantu | anyatra śaraṇaṃ nāsti tvameva śaraṇaṃ mama | tasmāt kāruṇyabhāvena rakṣarakṣa parameśvarīḥ(!) || || samaya cchoya || tarppaṇa || prītapretātyādi || ekāneka ambepūrvva || (valajala)ṅāva balivisarjjana yāya || deśa ṅūya holake || vājanasuddhā || (fol. 55v5–56r5) «Colophons» iti deśabalividhiḥ samāpta(ṃ) || ❁ || || ❁ || (fol. 56r5–6)

Beginning atha tatkasā(!) uttamādiviśeṣam āha devīyāmale || kuṃḍodbhavāmṛtaṃ devi uttamottamam eva hi | uttamaṃ rajavīryāṇi madhyamaṃ kevalo rajaḥ || 1 || adhamaṃ pauruṣaṃ vīryaṃ tathānyaccādhamādhimaṃ(!) || iti || athaitad yāgapraśaṃsā devīyāmale || || īśvara uvāca || dūtīyāgavidhiṃ vakṣye kauladharmottamottamaṃ || yasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa svayaṃ brahmatvam āpnuyāt || 1 || santi nānā vidhā dharmā yaihikāmuṣmikāni ca | tatsāraṃ tu samālokya tathānyaṃ mantrasaṅgrahaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1r1–3) End āliṅganaṃ vinā devi kuṣṭir bhavati pārvvati || vinādantakṣataṃ devi loke bhavati ninditaḥ || 8 || paṃcamāṃ tu sakṛd dattvā sāvitrī jāyate sati || dvitīyena tu lakṣmī syāt tṛtīye pārvvatī bhavet || 9 || tato dadyāt sukhādhikyaṃ tasyā puṇyaṃ na ganyate(!) || āliṃgane haredrogaṃ dhanadhānyādi cuṃbane || 10 || nakhadantakṣatādyaiś ca tadā mokṣa prajāyate | sāyujyaṃ saṅgamena syāt satyam eva na saṃśayaḥ || 11 || ityādyalaṃ vistareṇa (fol. 3r10–3v1) === Colophon ===x

Beginning ❖ śrī namaḥ gurave || atha daśavalividhir llikhyate || || yajamāna puṣpabhājana || adyetyādi || vākya || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrī 2 jayabhūpatīndramalladevavarmmaṇaḥ śrī 3 sveṣṭhadevatāprītyarthaṃ pāṣāṇanirmmitaprāsādopari śrīśrī umāmaheśvarasthāpanasahasrāhuti(!) ahorātrayajñadaśavalyārcaṇapūjākartuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || || śrīsamvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadasahitā nandaśaktisūbhi(!)mā sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ akulakulagataṃ paṃcakañ cānyaṣāṭkaṃ | catvāro paṃcako [ʼ]nya punar api caturaṃ atattatvamaṇḍalena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namataguruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaṃ || || (fol. 1v1–6) End āśirvvā || anbe pūrvagataṃ paraṃ bhagavatī(!) caitanyarūpātmikā jñānecchā bahulā tathā hariharau brahmāmarīcitrayaṃ | bhāsvadbhairavapaṃcakaṃ taranu ca śrīyoginīpañcakaṃ candrā[r]kkā ca marīcaṣāṭkavimalaṃ māṃ pātu nityaṃ śrīkuja(!) || (!) kalaśalaṅāva valivisarjjanayāya || || sākṣiyhāya || vākya || deśaṅuyakaṃ valihokale || || vājanasuryyā || || (fol. 64v8–65r1) Colophon iti daśavalyārccanavidhih samāptaḥ || || || śubham astu sarvvadā || || (65r2)

Beginning ātma‥‥ || ātmane siṃcayet || ātmane caṃdanaṃ namaḥ || ātmaśirase puṣpaṃ namaḥ || atmāsanāya namaḥ || ātmamūrttaye namaḥ || || puṣpabhājanathiyāvataya || oṁ saptavyādhādaśāraṇya(!) mṛgākāraṃ care girau | cakravākā(!) śaradvīpe haṃso sarasi mānasī(!) || te [ʼ]pi jātā kurukṣetre brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ | prasthitā dūram adhyā(!)naṃ yūyaṃ tebhyo prasīdatha || śrāddhabhūmiṃ gayāṃ dhyātvā dhyātvā devaṃ gajādharaṃ | tāmbhyāṃ caiva namskāraṃ tataḥ śrāddhaṃ pravarttate || || (fol. 3r1–6) End navākṣareṇa agni[ṃ] gṛhītvā || oṁ hrīṁ huṁ hāṁ phreṁ kṣoṁ kroṁ namaḥ || || aiṁ 5 ▒ ▒ kuṇḍa inddhana yonyāṃ ṭṛdhā vṛrtuparibhrāmya || vākya || yathākāryyam uccārya || aiṁ 5 hūṁ aiṁ ▒ agnisthāpanaṃ sumuhūrtāstu agnisthāpanaṃ || oṁ hrāṁ rāṁ rīṁ rūṁ vahnicaitanyāya svāhā || ▒ ▒ śrīsamvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadasahitānandaśaktisubhīmā sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ akulakulagatāpañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ | catvāro pañcakonya puna || (fol. 32v2–7) Colophon

Beginning kākṣaraṃ | kādināntāsuvaikṣetrāgrāmavaitādināntāgā || yādimāntāḥ purāś caiva pīṭhā vāi yādi vātagāḥ | śādihāntāś ca nagarā ete nāmāḥ(!) prakīrttitāḥ || svarāḥ ṣoḍaḥ(!)śapīṭhākhyā dvīpākhyā vyañjanāni ca | kṣetragrāmapurasyeva lakṣayitvā nirākulaṃ || pālakasyākṣaraṃ yatra padena ca tadādimaṃ | na guruṃ nādimaṃ nānta na Madhya pīṭhasaṃyutaṃ || kevalaṃ tu yadā naiva pīṭhañ ca tad ādimaṃ || (!) (fol. 72r1–5) End śeṣam adbhūtarūaṃ tu kulacaṇḍam aḍhuhāsitaṃ | divbhujekamukhaṃ śyāmaṃ khaḍgotpalavidhāriṇaṃ || bhogātayānvitaṃ raudraṃ padmamadhye vicintayet | nirmālyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ śrīcanḍāya nivedayet || tasya mantra[ṃ] pravakṣāmi yena pūjaṃti mānavāḥ | tṛtīyapraṇavenāsau kulacaṇḍa[ṃ] samarcayet || bījaṃ dīrghodbhave naiva kulacaṇḍāya niveśayet | ādyaṃ putitaṃ (fol. 75v4–7) === Colophon ===x

Beginning oṁ namaḥ nāṭeśvarāya || navadurggādevyai namaḥ || atha navadūgā nāṭa(r1)kakrama liṣyate || || āṣāḍamaṃdalaṃ kālayate || nāṭeśvara paṃco(2)prahāra pūjāyuktona khāya || cūpe pūjā paśu tarppaṇa || tāraṇayā cakre (3) samaya biya || dakṣiṇā yācake || ceta siṃdhura || ekāneka || deva ā(4)śīrvvāda || ambe pūrvva svāna kvakāya || svāna biya || marjātāthyeṃ vali (5) bisarjana yāya || sākṣi thāya || devayā svāna yaṅāva pyakhana chesa deva (6) sone || iti ghughulisiddhividhi samāptaḥ || || (fol. 4r1-6) End daśamikuhnu(3) gaṇa bosyaṃ taya || jiyakāva chāyana tiyāva, pāyāta hṅyāṅa vaya deva hlā(4)ya koratoka hlāya || gaṇapyāṣana hluya tvāraśa || deva hlāyāva hṅyāṅa vana (5) vela śvayāva napārāya pāyāta || thvate dhunaṅāva cheśa laṃ śvayāva duṃtā ya(6)ne, thanā bira bhojana || thvate daśamikuhnu || || (fol. 36v2-5) Colophon iti na[va]durggānāṭaka saṃpūrṇṇa samāptaḥ || || dhyana || śubhaṃ bhasmavirapaṃ nṛśiraśrajadharaṃ huṃ bhavaṃ raudra veśaṃ, rūdrāṇīṣliṣṭa(r1)dehaṃ dhṛta śiraśi valī guhyamuṇḍārddhacandra | ekāsya agni netra vasudaśa ca (2) bhujaṃ tāndavaṃ yugmapāde, nṛtyantamakṣamālā ḍamaru triśūla dhṛka vāṇa(3)padmaṃ ca dhāryyaṃ || aṃkuśo vīṇa karttima bhaya ca sakalāṃ savyahastaṃ pradā(4)naṃ, vāmave kamuṇḍarū urapāśa śahitaṃ cāpapuṣṭāṃgadhārī | khaṭvāgaṃ (5) vīṇapātraṃ pradahati valadā nṛṭyedhāryyaṣu vāmaṃ, bhūyāsthi vyāghracarmmāmvara (6) vidhṛta tanuṃ naumi nṛtyādhipeśaṃ || || iti śrīsiddhinṛṭyeśvara dhyānasto(7)tra samāptaṃ || (fol. 37r1-7)

«Beginning: » śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || || atha pūjāvidhiḥ || vajrodake hūṁ phaṭ svāhā jalam ānīya | oṃ hrīṁ viśuddha sarvapāpāni samayāśeṣavikalpam apanaya hūṁ | pādau prakṣālya | oṃ svāhā ityācamya 3 || āsane upaviśya || sūryaḥ somo yamaḥ kālo mahābhūtāni pañca ca || ete śubhāśubhasyeha karmaṇo navasākṣiṇaḥ || devīpādagataṃ citraṃ pāpākrāṃntam abhūn mama || tanniḥsāraya cittān me pāpāṃ phaṭ phaṭ ca te namaḥ || iti saṃprārthya || bhūmau trikoṇaṃ vṛttaṃ svadakṣiṇe vilikhya || oṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ iti saṃpūjya || pātraṃ prakṣālya || ādhāre nidhāya || krāṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ iti śuddhatoyenāpūrya || kroṁ aṃkuśamudrayā tīrthānyāvāhya (fol. 1v1–6) «End: » gūḍharūpā guṇavatī gurvī gauravavarddhinī grahapīḍāharā guṇyā gandharvā gānavatsalā || 53 || gharmahantrī ghṛtavatī ghṛtatuṣṭipradāyinī || ghaṇṭāravapriyā ghorāghaughavidhvaṃsakāriṇī || 54 || ghrāṇatuṣṭikarī ghoṣā ghanānandāghanapriyā || ghātukāghūrṇitajalāghṛṣṭapātakasaṃtatiḥ || 55 || ghaṭakoṭipratītāyā ghaṭitā śeṣamaṅgalāṃ || ghṛṇātinirghṛṇatithir ghasmarādyūṣanādinī || 56 || ghūsṛṇāpiṃjaratanur ghargharīghargharasvanā || (exp. 24b4–7) «Colophon:» iti pūjāvidhi samāptā || (exp. 13b3) iti khaḍgapūjā śrīstu (exp. 21b1–2)

«Beginning» ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || hastapādau prakṣālyācamya devīkoṣṭhaṃ praviśya pradakṣiṇī kṛtya devīṃ paṃcamudrayā praṇamya tatropaviśya jalapātram ādāya phraḥ astrāya phaṭ iti jalaṃ prokṣya || phreṁ ▒ śoṣaṇaṃ || phreṁ ▒ dahanaṃ || phreṁ ▒ plāvanaṃ || trikoṇaṃ vilikhya tan madhye vphreṁ3 ti vījaṃ vilikhya || vphreṁ yogeśvaryai vidmahe śrīguhyakālyai dhīmahi tan naḥ siddhiḥ pracodayāt || (exp. 3t1-4) «End» phreṁ hrīṁ klīṁ śrīṁ śrīguhyakālī sālokyalakṣmīdvāraśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi tarppayāmi phreṁ namaḥ svāhā || phreṁ hrīṁ klīṁ śrīṁ śrīguhyakālī sāyujyalakṣmīdvāraśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi tarppayāmi phreṁ namaḥ svāhā || phreṁ hrīṁ klīṁ śrīṁ śrīguhyakālī sāmīpyalakṣmīdvāraśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi tarppayāmi phreṃ namaḥ svāhā || phreṃ hrīṁ klīṁ śrīṁ śrīguhyakālī sārūpyalakṣmīdvāraśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi tarppayāmi phreṁ namaḥ svāhā || (exp. 29t1-5) «Colophon» x

«Beginning» dyāṃ trivenisthāne so ʼhaṃ iti mānīya jātasūtakanivāraṇārthaṃ snānayitvā 3 || punaḥ 〈s〉tenaiva mārggen(!) haṃsaḥ iti mūlavidyāṃ sudhāsiṃdhor madhya(!) nitvā(!) antasūtakanivāraṇārthaṃ praṇāvena putitaṃ(!) kṛtvā saptadhā tarppayet || (fol. 10r1-4) «End» atha samid dhāraṇaṃ kuryyāt yathā || pūrvvavat kṛtāñjalitālatrayaṃ daśadigbandhanaṃ kṛtvā || mūlena prāṇāyāmaṃ || atha ṛṣyādi nyāsa[ḥ] || oṁ asya śrīsaṃmid sevanāmantrasya ānandabhairavaṛṣi[ḥ] || amṛtavirātac chandaḥ || śrītri (fol. 27v5-8) «Colophon» x

«Beginning» || śrīguragaṇapati iṣṭadevatābhyo nmaḥ || indivaranībhaṁ pītavastravīgrahaṁ ātmānaṃ vājāṁ śrīdakṣīṇāmurtviśaṁ guruṁ puje āraṃbhītaṃ kramaha || iti dhyānaṁ || trailokyacaitanamayādideva śrīnāthavīśno nitya kṛtaṃ dhyetava (priyārthaṃ) śarirajātrām anuvrata ikhe janāmī dharmaṃ na ca me pravartihi jāmāmī dharmaṃ na ca me niutihi || śrīdakṣiṇamurti hrīdīsthitenā jathā nijumto isthitā karomi (fol. 1v1-4) «End» samudramekhale devī paravatās thanamaṃḍale vīṣnapatanī namas tubhyaṃ pādāghāta kṣamasva me iti bhūmiprārthana || susāna ukāreṇa bhumau vikṣipyā || iti nārāyenānandapūtadhūrdhvamaheśānandanāthāya | tadacarṇadhūlitaṃ brahmānandapūtavardhaṃ jagadānandanāthāya mānasau viśrāmite guruṃ bhugtimukti tathā mokṣaṃ nīrguṇam āśrayet || (fol. 19r3-6) «Colophon» iti prātaḥ kṛtaṃ praṇamyahaṃ || iti śrīśrīśrīśrīśrī || jogarājenndrahīmagīradhāraṇālaṃkāranānājogendrasīromukuṭanānācakrateanta āmanāya varjitaṣaḍādhārayake nūha dhāraṇakṣatrachatreśvaralokalokānandanāmāṃ krītaṃ || ❁ (fol. 19r6-8)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || brāhme muhūrtte cotthāya nidrāṃ hitvā prasannadhīḥ || harir harir harir iti vyāhared vaiṣṇavaḥ pumān || 1 || grāhagraste gajendre ravati sarabhasaṃtārkṣyam āruhya dhāvan || vyāghūrṇan mālyaghoṣāvasanaparikaro meghagaṃbhīranādaḥ || āvibhrāṇo rathāṅgaṃ saram asim abhayaṃ śaṃkhacāpau sakheṭaṃ hastaiḥ kaumodakīm apyavatu harirasāvaṃhasāṃ saṃhater naḥ || 2 || iti dhyānapūrvakaṃ harir harir harir iti saptakṛtva uccārya jalena vā śrotreṇācamya || tasminneva śayaneya āsīno niyateṃdriyaḥ || trastanirvviṇṇahṛdayo vyarthaṃ vīkṣya gataṃ vayaḥ || 3 || tāpatyrayeṇa cākrāṃtaḥ tīvreṇādhyātmikādinā || dāvajenāgninālīvo bhrāmyanniva vane mṛgaḥ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » oṃ kṛtaṃ ca kariṣyāmi yogena karmaṇā bhagavaṃtam arcayiṣyāmīti saṃkalpya balamaṃtrānusaṃdhāya samaṃtrakamaṃtrakaṃ vā surūpāṃ pratimām iti śaunakoktān arcām anusandadhyāt || yathāśakti sanakādisādhya duḥṣśakasvānubhavaṃ bhavānevānubhāvayatvitvadhyavasya prāsādakhaṭvāparyaṅgannyāyena nāḍīpūritam iti pūritatam iti (!) puritati brahmaviśvātmanaḥ śayanam anusandhāya lakṣmīpariṣvaṃgavyaṃjakamādhavaśabdam uccaran bhagavaccaraṇāravindacaraṇayor nyasta śiraskaḥ śayīta nidrāvicchede dhyāyeta saṃkīrttayec ca kālāṃtare pyaikāgryasaṃbhave yogaḥ kāryaḥ mṛtakasūtakādi prāpteṣu saṃkīrttanena smaraṇena ca tatkālo yāpanīyaḥ aśaucasamaye pi mānasayāgamātram anumanyate oṃ kṛta ca kariṣ〉āmi yogena karmaṇā bhagavān vāsudeva prīyatām iti tṛptiṃ dadyāt punaḥ kāle ‘dhigamanādisaṃkalpaḥ (fol. 15r5–10) «Colophon:» iti śrīmat trimallaṃvināviracitaṃ śrīmadbhāṣyakārakṛtanityārādhanavidhivyākhyānaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ samāptaṃ śrīmate rāmānujāya na (fol. 15r10)

«Beginning: » oṃ namo maṃgalāyai || || oṃ paramaśivaśakti śrīśrīnātha aśeṣapāraṃparyāntama (!) śrīgurupādāṃbujaṃ śirasā praṇatosmi || oṃ gurunamaskāra || tataḥ svāsanamaṃtraṃ yathā || oṃ hrīṁ hūṁ chrīṁ phreṁ ātmāsanāya pādukāṃ || tato nyāsaḥ || oṃ phreṁ mahācaṇḍayogeśvari ślīṁ hūṁ astrāya phaṭ | 3 | oṃ mayakhaphala astrāyakaratalapṛṣṭābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ khphreṁ hrīṁ ▒ hrīṁ khphreṁ oṃ vāra 27 || niśvāse prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvā || oṃ khphrāṁ aṅguṣthābhyāṃ namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » guhyakālī śiraḥ pātu ḍāmarī hṛdayaṃ mama || kaṃṭhaṃ siddhikarālī ca siddhiyogeśvarīndriyaṃ || caṇḍakāpālinī bāhu pādau dvau muṇḍamālinī || aṭṭahāseśvarī vakṣaḥ kālācakreśvarī tanuḥ | pātūdaraṃ mahākālī sarvvamarmmāṇi caṇḍikā || vajrakāpālinī pātu sarvvāṅgāni ( ca ) sarvadā || namas te trijagan mātar māṃ rakṣa śaraṇāgataṃ || kṛtaṃ yathāśakti mayā tava naimittikārcane || nyūnātiriktājñānajanya doṣān kṣamasva me || iti śāṃtistotraṃ paṭhitvā daṇḍavad aṣṭāṅgair muhurmuhuḥ namaskuryāt || || (fol. 35r2–6) «Colophon:» iti mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīmajjvālāmālinarasiṃhaguhyakālyarccanapaddhatiḥ samāptā || || || atha daśāṃgāni saṃskāra kathyate (!) || gurukuṃḍadhyānaṃ vivāha || snānaṃ dvir āgamaḥ || saṃdhyāvandanaṃ saṃyogaḥ arghyadānaṃ garbhāśayaḥ || … tatrāpi āgneyāḥ vidyāḥ saumyāḥ (!) iti vivekaḥ tatrāgneyānāṃ vāmanāḍīpravāhaḥ svāpaḥ dakṣiṇanāḍī pravāho jāgaraḥ saumyānāṃ tu tadviparītam iti tatra jāgad avasthāyāṃ japaḥ evaṃ japtvā saṃkhyāpūrttaiḥ siddhiḥ || || iti tantroktaṃ sāmānyavidhiḥ || || || (fol. 35r6–35v9)

«Beginning: » śrīmavā – guhyakālikarālimūlakāmakale ihāgaccha ihāgaccha iha tiṣṭha iha tiṣṭha iha sannihitā bhava atrādhisthānaṃ kuru kuru mama pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa hūṁ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā || āvāhana mantraṃ || ṣaḍmudrāṃ pradarśayet || svāgataṃ || yasyā darśanam icchanti devāḥ svābhīṣṭasiddhaye || tasyai te parameśāyai duḥsthitaṃ susthitaṃ ca me || khphreṁ śrīmahānirvvāṇaguhyakālyai pādyaṃ namaḥ || khphreṁ śrīmahānirvvāṇaguhyakālyai idam arghyaṃ namaḥ (fol. 1v1–6) «End: » stutiṃ paṭhet || kāḷi kāḷi mahākāli caturvargaphalaprade || yogeśvari mahāmāye guhyakāli namo stu te || pratisṛtvā ghaṃṭāvādyaṃ || tato mūla ṛṣichaṃdādikaṃ nyasya bali visarjya || svahṛdi deviṃ vibhāvya || || nityaśuddhabuddhamuktasatyaparamānantānandaparabrahmanirvvāṇaśrīguhyakālyaham asmi || so haṃ so haṃ so haṃ hsaiṁ ātma nirvvāṇaguhyakālyau āvāhanādi gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyatāṃbūlaṃ namaḥ || || (fol. 6r1–7) «Colophon:» iti dīpārādhanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || śubham || || (fol. 6r7)

«Beginning: » ❖ śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaraṃ || tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || gurunamaskāra || || āsana namaskārayā mantra || || oṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ cchrīṁ phreṁ svātmāsanāya namaḥ || || atha nyāsa || oṁ phreṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ || siddhikarāli śirase svāhā || hrīṁ cchrīṁ hūṁ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | strīṁ phreṁ kavacāya hūṁ || namaḥ netratrayāya vaiṣaṭ || svāhā astrāya phaṭ || (exp. 3t1–6) «End: » japaṃ nivedya śivaṃ śivatamaṃ śāntaṃ śivātmānaṃ śivottamaṃ || śivamārgapraṇetāraṃ praṇamāmi sadāśivaṃ || namaskṛtya || mukhavādyaṃ kṛtvā || vāṇarāvaṇacaṇḍīśa naṃdibhṛgimṛḍādayaḥ | pārvatīśaprasādena sarve gṛhṇantu śāmbhavāḥ || nīlakaṇṭhapadāmbhoja pratisphurati mānasaḥ | śaṃbhoḥ pūjāphalaṃ dehi caṇḍeśvara namo stu te || iti puṣpākṣataṃ sarvaṃ caṇḍeśvarāya prakṣipya || bhgavan śiva pūjito si kṣamasva || iti visarjanaṃ saṃhāramudrayā || || (exp. 20b1–7) «Colophon:» iti pārthivapūjāvidhiḥ || (exp. 20b7)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha navapīṭha aṣṭamātṛkā ārādhanavidhi (li)khyate || || nakasaṃ pūjājāpakaṃ pūrvasevācchoya || kumāramisā thaṃkālina puṣpabhājana yācake || adyādi || vākya || yajamānasya amukasya vivāhoddeśena aṣṭamātṛkā ārādhana balyārcana pūjākarttuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || || śrīsaṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadanimitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā || sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ akulakulagataṃ paṃkañcānyaṣaṭkaṃ || catvāro pañcakonyaṃ punar api caturaṃ stattvato (!) maṇḍaledaṃ || saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata gurupadaṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaṃ || (fol. 1v1–7) «End: » śrīśrīsiddhāgnibhaṭtāraka yathāśāstroktaphaladāyino bhavantu || gogurubrahmaṇebhyaḥ śubhaṃ bhavatu || ācāryamantrasiddhilastu || rājā dharmavijayī bhavatu prajāḥ sukhinaḥ santu devaśa śubhodaryobhu(!) sarve satvvāḥ sukhino bhavantu paryyanyaḥ kāle varṣā bhavatu rāṣṭraḥ śubha śubhavatu || dvipadacatuṣpadānāṃ śāntir bhavatu puṣṭir bhavatu || asmat rājādhirāja parameśvaraparamabhaṭṭārakarāṣṭrādhipa (fol. 109v3–7) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ siddheśvaramahābhairavāya || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || || javapīṭhācāryayā vidhi likhyate || || gṛhe pratiṣṭhā devapratiṣṭhā deva pratiṣṭhāyātaṃ dayakā || || vidhithyaṃ patavāsana coya || mūlabaliyātaṃ saṭkoṇa aṣṭaśṛṇga || arghapātrayātaṃ trikona || jalapātrayātaṃ catiurasra || paṃcabali gaṇavaṭuka || || atha puṣpabhājana || adyādivākya || śrīsaṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadanihitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā || sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ akulakulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ || catvāraḥ pañcakonyaṃ punar api caturas tattvato maṇḍaledaṃ || saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namati (!) guruvaraṃʼ bhairavaḥ(!) śrīkujeśaṃ || (fol. 1v1–2r1) «End: » agrabali chhoyakātha || mūlapāṭhabalidathupāta galālasa javalāpātabalidulamājusa || khavalāpātabalina kiṃju āgama || iti balicchoyavidhiḥ || || sākṣithāya mūmāla dhunake kuhnutuni sākṣi thāya vākya kṛtakarmaṇe sākṣiṇe śrīsūryāya arghaṃ namaḥ || puṣpaṃ namaḥ || sākṣiṇe namaḥ || rājasasvānatala vāne || || (fol. 193r7–193v5) «Colophon:» iti navagṛhapraveśa aitāhutiyajñasvathānabalijapayā vidhi samāptaḥ || || (fol. 193v6–7)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāyai (!) namaḥ || atha navapīṭha aṣṭamātṛkā ārādhanavidhir likhyate || || yajamāna puṣpabhājana yācake || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramallavarmaṇaḥ śrī3sveṣṭadevatāprītyarthaṃ durgāprāsādapratiṣṭhābighiharaṇabalyārcanakarttuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || śrīsaṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadanihitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā || sṛṣṭiṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ akulakulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ || catvāraḥ pañcakonyaṃ punar api caturaṃ tattvato maṇḍaledaṃ || saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaṃ || || ( fol. 1v1–2r3) «End: » stotra || dhūmābhaṃ dīptanetraṃ galitarucijaṭā trīṇi netraṃ karālaṃ || haste khaḍgaṃ tu karttrī tadadhapa(ri)dhṛtaṃ tīkṣṇaśūlaṃ kapālaṃ || cakrānte matyamāṃsāsavarasavividhiṃ moditaṃ pretasaṃsthā mātaṅgī śrīsahaiva svagaṇaparivṛtā naumi ucchiṣṭanāthaṃ || || vākya || kalaṃkeśvarāya mūrttebhyo śāntir astu puṣṭir astu supratiṣṭhā varadā bhavantu || kalaṃkavācakaracchoya || dakṣiṇā || svānako kāya || ekā mūrrtiraṇe (!) ambepūrvva ºº yajamānayātā svāna viya || balivisarjana || balicchoya || garāḍaraṃ asa || gaṇadhvākhāyināyasa || vaṭukadumāju sa || sākṣithāya || vākya || || (fol. fol. 80v3–81r6) «Colophon:» iti pīthipūjāvidhi samāptaḥ || || (fol. 81r6)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrī3 mahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || || śrī3 anantavratodyāpana sahasrāhutiyajñe navapīṭhi aṣṭamātṛkā ārādhanavidhir likhyate || || yajamāna puṣpabhājana yācake || || || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotrayajamā(na) antato (!) vratodyāpanasahasrāhutiyajñe navapīṭhi aṣṭamātṛkā ārādhana bighniharaṇabalyārccaṇapūjānimityarthaṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || || śrīsaṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadasahitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā || sṛṣṭaṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ akurakulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ || catvāro pañcakonyaṃ punar api caturaṃ stattvato maṇḍaledaṃ || saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaṃ || (fol. 1v1–8) «End: » mohanī || trailikyamohanī syāṃmi ripukuladahanī bhañjanī sarvabighi bhūtapretāpiśācā bhayasukhaharaṇī dhvaṃsinī dākinīnāṃ || rakṣābhūtā narāṇāṃ śivasakalamukhā sarvvamaṅgalyayuktā sā devī mohanīyaṃ tripaṭhagatiyutā sarvvasaṃparttidāyu || || (!) svāna || namostu tasmai gaṇanāyakāya bighnānkaṃ tasya susiddhidāya | tripurāntakasyāntakasaṃharāya gajānanāyāṃ ca gaṇeśvarāya || || svānamālakostā viya || astramantrana bali thvaya || nośiya || || bali bhāka rūya || sākṣi thāya || || (fol. 22v2–7) «Colophon:» iti śrī3 gaṇeśapūjāpaddhati || || śrī3 anantavratayā gaṇeśapūjāvidhi saṃpūrṇa yāṅā juro || || śubham astu sarvvadāḥ || (!) (fol. 22v7–8)

«Beginning: » || || śrīgurukulebhyo namaḥ || || maṃtrakāṃḍaḥ || || śrīnāthādigurutrayaṃ gaṇapatiṃ pīṭhatrayaṃ bhairavaṃ siddhaighaṃ vaṭukatrayaṃ padayugaṃ dūvikramaṃ maṃḍalaṃ virādyaṣṭacatuṣṭaṣaṣṭhīnavakaṃ vīrāvalīpaṃcakaṃ dhīman mālinimaṃtrarājasahitaṃ vaṃde guror maṃḍalaṃ 1 oṃ asya śrīsvagurumahāmantrasya parabrahmaṛṣi gāyatrīchaṃda haṃsasvarūpi gurur devatā haṃ bījaṃ svāhā śakti sohaṃ kīlakaṃ śrīsvaguruprasādasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ sāmityādikaraṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ (fol. 1v1–4) «End: » asya śrīlaghuśyāmalāmahāmantrasya mahāmātaṃga ṛṣi paṃktichandaḥ laghuśyāmā devatā aiṁ bījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ hrīṁ kīlakaṃ laghu śyāmalāprasādasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ aiṁ aṃ º hṛ º namaḥ svarjja ºº śi ºº ucchiṣṭacāḍāli madhyaºº śiṣāºº mātaṃgī (!)(!) anā (!)(!) kavacaḥ sarvavaśaṃkarī kaniṣṭhā ºº netratrayāya svāhā karatala ºº astrāya dhyānaṃ smaret prathamapuṣpiṇīṃ rudhiravindunīlāmbarāṃ gṛhītamadhupātrikāṃ madavighūrṇanetrāṃcalāṃ svarasphuratu vallakī vimalaśaṃkhavāṭaṃkinī ghanastanabharālasāṃ galitacūlikāśāmalām aiṁ namaḥ ucchiṣṭacāṇḍālī mātaṅgī sarvvavaśaṃkarī svāhā laghu śyāmalāṃbā śrī ºº 143 || || aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ hsauṁ pūrvāmnāya samayavidyeśvaryaṃvā śrī ºº 144 || || (exp.11:1–6) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || pṛthvītyāsanaṃ || svavāme viṃdutrikoṇavṛttaṣaṭkoṇacaturasramaṇḍalaṃ kṛṭvā || hrīṃ ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ || tatrāstrakṣālitamādhāraṃ saṃsthāpya | aiṁ maṃ dharmaprada (da)śakalātmane agnimaṇḍalāya śrībālātripurasundaryāḥ kalaśāya namaḥ || tatra astrāya phaṭ | iti sukalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya | (fol. 1r1–6) «End: » mālāṃ mastake nidhāya ṛṣ〉ādi ṣaḍaṇgaṃ kṛṭvā | paṃcamudrābhi namaskṛtya | guhyātiguhyagoptrī tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmat kṛtaṃ japam | siddhir bhavatu me devi tvatprasādān maheśvari | anena śrībālātripurasuṃdarīmaṃtrajapena bālātripurasuṃdarīdevatā prīyatāṃ na mama || klīṃ tvaṃ māle sarvadevānāṃ prītidā śubhadā bhava | śubhaṃ kuruṣva me bhadre yaśo vīryaṃ ca sarvadā || paṃcopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya mālāṃ guhyantare nidhāya | astrāyapha(ṭ) ityanena kalaśaṃ āsanaṃ visṛjya | iti stra stotrapāṭhādikaṃ kṛṭvā || ❁ ❁ ❁ (fol. 10v4–11r5) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || ṣaḍākṣara(!)maṃtrasya rudraṛṣir gāyatrīchanda mama abhīṣṭārthe jape viniyogaḥ || || hriṃ hrīṃ hraṃ hraṃ hrauṃ hraḥ || pratyahaṃ aṣṭottarasahasraṃ japet | amukasya prāṇā gatā iti vadet || || oṃ || || asya śrīmṛtyuharalāṃgalamaṃtrasya kālāgnirudraṛṣir yamo devatā anuṣṭupchandaḥ aham eva kāla iti bījaṃ nāhaṃ kālasyeti śaktiḥ mṛtyupasthāne jape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) «End: » sakṛn maṃtraṃ japet | gāyatryaṣṭottarasahasraphalaṃ labhet || aṣṭabrāhmaṇabhojanaṃ dadyāt yaḥ kaścin na dadāti śvetakuṣṭī bhavati dīyamāno yon a gṛhṇāti sa andho bhavati mṛtyor āgamane ṣaṭsahasramantrajapena nāśo bhavati || anena maṃtreṇa brahmaviṣṇurudrāḥ prasannā bhavanti rudralokaprāptir bhavati || || oṃ || || aiṁ klīṃ ucchiṣṭacāṇḍālinī devī mahāpi(śā)cinī thaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā || oṃ parorajase sāvadoṃ || || śubham astu || || (fol. 1v7–2r3) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namḥ || asya śrībālāparameśvarīdevatāmaṃtrasya dakṣiṇāmūrtti(r ṛṣiḥ) anuṣṭup chandāḥ(!) bālāparameśvarī devatā aiṁ bījaṃ klīṃ kīlakaṃ sauṃ śaktiḥ mama caturvargasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ dakṣiṇāmūrttiṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi anuṣṭup chandase namaḥ mukhe bālāparameśvarīdevatāyai namaḥ hṛdi aiṃ bījāya namaḥ guhye klīṃ kīla(kā)yai namaḥ pādayoḥ sauṃ śaktaye namaḥ sarvāṅge || (exp. 2:1–8) «End: » ītī (!) dhyātvā manasopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya laṃ pṛthīvyātmakaṃ gandhaṃ samarapayāmī (!) haṃ ākāśātmakaṃ puṣpaṃ samarpayāmaḥ yaṃ vāyvyātmakaṃ dhūpaṃ samarpayāmi raṃ tejātmakaṃ dīpaṃ samarpayāma vaṃ amṛtātmakaṃ naivedyaṃ samarapayāmaḥ(!) daśavāraṃ mantrajapam kurīyāt (!) punaḥ rīṣyādī (!) nyāsadhyānādī kratvā (!) guhyāti guhyagatyātavaṃ(!) grahāṇāsma (!) kṛtaṃ sīdhīra (!) bhavatu me deva tvatprasādān mayā sthīrā īti maṃtreṇa japaṃ guruve (!) nivedya guṃ gurubhyo namaḥ (exp. 5b2–6t1) «Colophon:»

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || || atha pana || titā śrī3 brahmāyaṇīyāgajura chāyāniśibalyārccana likhyate || baliviya vidhi || || brāhmaṇa ācāryyana nehmaṃ sena bali viya || sani veta ṅāva || || nehmaṃ syanaṃ vothayāva napāṃ bali viya || || kvathoṇḍābalipāta || bhevata 1 digabalina maṇḍapa ṅūyake || || paṭavāsana coya || bali voya || arghapātra taya || || yajamāna puṣpabhājana yācake || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotra yajamānyā śrī2 viśvalakṣmīdevyā śrī2 brahmāṇī devyā jīrṇoddhāra prāsādopari śuvarṇakalaśadhvajāvarohana bhairavāgni sahasrāhuti yajñe niśibalyārccana nimityarthaṃ karttuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || (fol. 1v1–2r1) «End: » vaiṣṇavī viṣṇumāyāñca daityadurggāntanāśinī | haritaśyāmavarṇāṅgī garuḍoparisaṃsthitā || śaṃkhacakragadāhastā caturbāhuvibhūṣitā || ratnajvālā mahākrīḍā nānā ratnavibhūṣitā || haripuṣpañ ca gandhañ ca sadā harita dhāriṇī || svargge martte ca pātāle sthitirūpeṇa saṃsthitā || aṭṭahāsamahākṣetre kadamva (fol. 88v3–7) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » ❖ śrī3gaṇeśāya namaḥ punaḥ yajñsthāne śānti va kalaśārcanaṃ || yajamāna puṣpabhājanaṃ adyādi || vākya || mānavagotra yajamānyā śrī2 viśvalakṣmīdevyā śrī2 brahmāyaṇīdevījīrṇoddhāra prāsādoiparisuvarṇakalaśadhvajāvarohaṇa bhairavāgnisahasrāhuti yajñe ṛtvantare bhasmanadīpravāha balyārccananimittyarthaṃ karttuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || śrī saṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadanihitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā sṛṣṭiṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ akulakulagataṃ pañcakañ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ || catvāro pañcakonyaṃ punar api caturaṃ tattvato maṇḍaledaṃ || saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaḥ (!) || (fol. 1v1–2r2) «End: » āśīrvvāda || vādhācadāyake || || pūrṇacandra || pūrṇacandranibhaṃ śubhraṃ darppaṇaṃ śatrudarppahā || ātmāvindudharaṃ yasya saṃpradāya jayāya ca || || balivisarjjana yāya || sūryyasākṣīthāya || thāna thāna sa bali cchoya || dumāju || taleju || vacchalā || yātādeva || māneśvarī || utmartta(!)bhairava || cokugaṇeśa || thāṃnapāla bhairava || bhīmasena || harasiddhi || vāsukī || || kālikā || thānalaṃkhu || kalaṃka || kvocchu || dukhāpikhā dako || || yajñayāpūrṇākuhnuna khulāriva nail cūya || (fol. 60r5–60v4) «Colophon:» iti bhasmapravāhaḥ vidhi samāptaḥ || || || (fol. 60v5)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmahā(ga)ṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || atha panātiyā śrī3 brahmāyaṇīyā gajulikāccyāyākarmmabaliviyavidhiḥ || || yajamāna puṣpabhajana yācake || adyādi vākya || mānavagotra yajamānyā śrī2 viśvalakmṣīdevyā śrī2 brahmāyaṇīdevyā jīrṇōddhāra prāsādopari suvarṇakalaśadhvajāvarohaṇa bhairavāgni sahasrāhuti yajñe karmabalyārccanakarttuṃ pu(ṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi ) śrī saṃvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapadanihitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā sṛṣṭiṃ nyāyacatuṣkaṃ akulakulagataṃ pañcakañ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ || catvāro pañcakonyaṃ punar api caturaṃ tattvato maṇḍaledaṃ || saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaḥ (!) || (fol. 1v1–2r1) «End: » ambe pūrvvagataṃ padaṃ bhagavati caitanyarūpāitmikā || jñānecchā bahurā (!) tathā hariharau brahmāmarīcitrayam || bhāsvad bhairavapañcakaṃ tad anu ca śrīyoginīpañcakaṃ || candrārkau ca marīciṣaṭkam amalam māṃ pātu nityaṃ śrīkujaḥ || mohanī svānako kāya mohanīn te cake || yajamāna ādina svāna viya mālako staāṃ || maṇḍala ṅoya || sākṣī thāya || balivisarjana yāya || || bali taya kalacchoya || thava thava thāyasa cchoya || (fol. 77r6–77v6) «Colophon:» iti panātiyā śrīśrīśrī brahmāyaṇīyā gajuli cchāya karma valyārccaṇavidhi samātaḥ || || śubham astu sarvvadā || || || (fol. 77v6–7)

«Beginning: » śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ || || atha kṛtapūrṇābhiṣiktānāṃ japavidhir likhyate || mūlenācamya prāṇān āyamya sakalāniṣṭaparihārapūrvakaṃ śrimahāgaṇapatiprītaye śrīvidyāṃgatvena ca śrīmahāgaṇapatijapam ahaṃ kariṣye || iti saṃkalpya asya maṃtrasya gaṇakaṛṣiḥ nivṛdgāyatrīchandaḥ mahāgaṇapatir devatā gaṃbījaṃ svāhāśaktiḥ mahāgaṇapatimantrajape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » uttarāṅgabhūta hādividyā turīyakūṭavidyā anuttarāmnāyavidyā ūrdhvāmnāyavidyā nārāyaṇāṣṭārṇavidyā mahālakṣmīnārāyaṇavidyā śrīvaṣaḍarṇavidyā yathāśaktiṃ japed iti madhyamapakṣaḥ | atyāvaśyakas tu ṣaḍāmnāya ṣaḍāmnāyāṅgavidyā raśmimālānāmapārāyaṇapūrvakaṃ mūlasahasratriśataṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ vā japet || tadaṅgatvenahādividyā tu turīyakūṭavidyā anuttarāmnāyavidyā ūrdhvāmnāyavidyā nārāyaṇāṣṭārnavidyā mahālakṣmīnārāyaṇavidyā śivaṣaḍarṇavidyāṃ āvaśyakaṃ sakṛd sakṛjjaped iti śivasahasranāmaṃ || abhaktijananaṃ loke nityānāṃ kleśadāyakam iti tantrarājagauravāt || vistaratas taṃtrarāja vāmadevasaṃhitā dāśarathīsaṃhitāyāṃ draṣṭavyam iti dik || || (fol. 58v3–59v1) «Colophon:» iti śrīmannārāyaṇakṛtāvatāra paramakāruṇika śrīmannāgeśvarānandanāthacaradvandvopāsakaśrīmanmahārājādhirāja senopanāmaka śrīmattrivikramakṛtir brahmavidyopāsakānāṃ madhye kṛtapūrṇābhiṣekānāṃ brahmavidyābharaṇajapavidhiḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || śubham || || || || || || || (fol. 59v1–5)

«Beginning: » ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || || atha śāntikalaśā((rccana))balyārccanavidhi || || yajamāna puṣpabhājanaṃ || adyādi vākya || mānavagotra yajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevavarmmaṇaḥ śrīśrīśrīsveṣṭadevatāprītikāmanayā pāṣāṇanirmmita vāpīprāsāda suvarṇakalaśadhvalāvalohanasiddhāgni ayutāhutuyajñaśāntikalaśārccana balyārccana karttuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || || (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » rājyadāṃ dhanadāṃ devi mokṣadāṃ duḥkhanāśinī | pratyaṃgirā namaḥsyāmi siddhilakṣmī jayapradāṃ || suṣasarveṣāṃ bāndhavādīnāṃ sarvvadā kalyāṇam astu || || pūrṇacandranibhaṃ śubh(r)aṃ darpaṇaṃ śatrudarpāhā || ātmavindudharaṃ yasya saṃpradāya jayāya ca || kāmārivisarjanaṃ thāyasa cchoya || sākṣī thāya || vākya mānavagotra yajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevavarmmaṇaḥ śrīśrīśrī sveṣṭadevatāprītikāmanayā pāṣāṇanirmitavāpīprāsādasuvarṇakalaśadhvajāvalohanasiddhāgni ayutāhuti yajñaśāntikalaśārccana saṃpūrṇa karmaṇe sākṣiṇe śrīsūryāya arghaṃ namaḥ || || || (fol. 51r2–51v4) «Colophon:» iti bhasmanadīpravāhaśāntikalaśārccanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || śubhaḥ || (fol. 51r4)
