Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ gurave namaḥ || brāhmaṇa ācāryya josi, thvatesanaṃ sthira hārāva vayāva || maṇḍapana pi (2) uttara soya majirasā pūrvva soyaṃ teva, gajuli chākuhnuyā thva ve[[la]]sa yāya || thvanaṃ hṅāonali dinapa(3)tiṃ, rajasārāsa karmmārccana yāya dhunaṅāva || (fol. 1r1-3) End tarppaṇa || sānti(2)kādhyāya puṣṭakapujā || sāntikādhyāya pāṭha yāya || mālasā paśuyāgaḥ mumālasā samaya chāya || prī(3)tapretā || dakṣiṇā || ekāneka || bali visarjjana || pūrvvādikrameṇa aṣṭapīṭhasa choya || dathupātasa galaṃ(4)ḍa laṃkhusa || gaṇadhvākhā ināyasa || vaṭuka dumāju || dvaṃdu dako dukhāpikhā || sākṣī thāya || || thvate sānti(5)kādhyāyayā pāṭhavidhi || || (fol. 3v1-5) Colophon (fol. )

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīdakṣiṇāmūrttigurubhyo namaḥ || yatpādāmburuhaṃ dhyāyan kṣudro bhavati vākpatiḥ || tan naumi paramātmānaṃ gurum advaitarūpiṇaṃ || 1 || ekavīrāpadadvandvaṃ nidhāya hṛdi maṅgalam || kriyate tatprasādena lalitārcanapaddhatiḥ || 2 || tatrādau gṛhasthadharmāḥ || ṛtvikpurohitācāryaiḥ mātulātithisaṃśritaiḥ || bālabṛddhāturaiḥ vedyaiḥ jñātiḥ saṃbandhibāṃdhavaiḥ || 1 || mātāpitṛbhyāṃ jāmībhiḥ bhrātāputreṇa bhāryayā || duhitā dāsavargeṇa vivādaṃ na samācaret || 2 || (exp. 4t1–5) «End: » jyotsnāyai (11) haimavatyai 12 chāyāyai 13 pūrṇimāsyai 14 nityāyai 15 amāvāsyai nama itii saṃpūjya || 3 || oṃ āpo vā ida guṃ sarvaṃ viśvā bhūtānyāpaḥ prāṇā vā āpaḥ paśava āponnaṃ āpo mṛtam āpaḥ saṃsrāḍ āpo virāḍ āpaḥ svarāḍ āpaḥ chaṃdāṃsyāpo jyotīṃsyāpo yajuṃsyāpaḥ satyam āpaḥ sarvā devatā āpo bhur bhuva subarāpa om || oṃ hasakṣamalavarayūṃʼ ānaṃdabhairavāya vaṣaṭ sahakṣamalavarayīṃ surādevyai (a) vauṣaṭ iti mantrābhyāṃ caṃdrarūpaṃ jalaṃ abhimantrayed iti kalaśasthāpanaṃ || 1 || tataḥ devyā vāma (exp. 14:3–8) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || sudhārṇavāsanāt pūrvāt tava potāṃbujāsanaṃ || praṇamāmi karomyaba dvitīyāvaraṇārcanam 1 sarvāśāparipūrakaṃ tava śive cakraṃ tathā yoginīs tārais tryakṣarayā samarcya kusumairṅeṃtās tataḥ sasvarāḥ || śuklāḥ śuklavibhūṣaṇāḥ karalasat pāśāṃkuśādarśayuk pīyūṣāruṇapūrṇaratnakalaśās tāṃ arcayāmbike 2 śvetaṃ saśīlamuḍupatikalā- chaṃdasas tavat sudhāsāraṃ || tvat purataḥ prādakṣiṇyāt kāmākarṣaṇīṃ sāmādāya 3 (fol. 1v1–4) «End: » ko haṃ yatpadayugalaṃ smṛtvā jñātvā sukhaṃ pravicarāmi || tasmā(d) ajñātatamoghnāya śrīnāthabhāskarāya namaḥ || 1 || kāyavākcittajaṃ pāpaṃ(!) citta vākkāyasaṃbhavā || saṃkṣālanasamarthās tu pūjeyaṃ lalitāmbike 434 jayati paruśurāmaḥ kṣatriyāraṇyavahnir viditasakalatantro yaḥ svasūtraṃ cakāra || iyam api ( tu saparyā tadvatī ) saṃpradāyān manasi samuditāśrīsadguros taṃtramiśrāt 435 || (fol. 16r11–17v4) «Colophon:» iti śrīkāśīkṣetranivāsī rāmapaghaṭṭa(stha) śrīkṛṣṇaśāstrīviracitā śrīlalitāmānasapūjā || || ity eṣā manasīpūjā śrīvidyopāsakair vinā || yaḥ paṭhet prāpnuyād duḥkham iti satyaṃ vadāmyaham || 1 || (fol. 17v4–7)

«Beginning: » nārāyaṇa || śrīgurumūrttir jayati || || śrīnātheṃdraguruṃ natvā dakṣiṇāmūrttim avyayam || śrīśaṃkaraṃ guruṃ nārāyaṇapāśupatena vai || 1 || jñānārthaṃ cānumathane navanītasya piṇḍavat || lalitārādhanaṃ vakṣye saṃhitānumatād api || 2 || brāhme muhūrtte cotthāya śucirāsane upaviśya || prātar utthāya śirasi saṃsmaret padmam ujjvalaṃ || 1 || karpūrābhaṃ smaret tatra śrīguruṃ ///(ja)rūpiṇaṃ || suprasannaṃ lasadbhūṣḍāmaṇḍitaṃ śāntibhūṣitaṃ || 2 || (exp. 19t1–6) «End: » aṃ 16 atmatatvāya (!) ātmatattvātmane sarasvatīhiraṇyagarbhasahitāya sarasvatī hiraṇyagarbhasahitātmane ānav(!)malaśodhanārthaṃ sthūladehamādhāre ātmatattvena śodhayāmi || idaṃ tāpatrayodbhūtam ahaṃtā paramāmṛtaṃ parāhaṃtā maye vahnau juhiomi śivarūpataḥ aiṃ ātmatattvaṃ śodhyāmi namaḥ || 2 || ha 5 māyā kalā vidyā rāga kāla niyati puruṣakṃ 25 vidyātattvāya vidyātattvātmane ( taijasapuruṣātmane ) lakṣmīnārāyaṇasahitāya lakṣmīnārāyaṇasahitātmane kārmikamalaśodhanārthaṃ sūkṣmadehaṃ hṛdaye ++ (exp. 36t8–12) «Colophon:» iti śrīmahāpāśupata parivrājakācāryavaryaśrīgaṃgādharagurupāśupataśrīcaraṇāraviṃdadvandvevāsinā śrīmad ++kara nārāyaṇagurumahāpāśupatair nirū[pitāyāṃ śrī++++rānārṇava dakṣiṇāmūrttisaṃhitānusāreṇoddhṛtāyāṃ lalitārādhanapaddhatyāṃ śrīcakrapūjānirūpaṇaṃ nāma tṛtīyo padeśaḥ || ❁ || śrīgurumūrttir jayati || ❁ || (exp. 37t2–6)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ gurubhyo namaḥ || brāhmaṇa ācārya josi thvate sanaṃ sthirahārāvayāva || maṇḍanapiṃ uttara soya majirasā pūrva soyaṃteva || gajulicchaā kuhnuyā thva velasa yāya || thvana hṅā onali dinapatiṃ rajasā rāsakarmmārcanayāya dhunaṅāva || balipāṭa 1 madhyasa kṣetramūlana yāya || ṅuva balipūrvādikrameṇa brahmāṇyādina ṅūyake || pāṭhasāntikādhyāya || || arghapātra || jalapātra || paṃcabali || gaṇavaṭuka || balimārakostāṃ || thvate patavāsana coyāva jiyake || || laṃkhana hāya || ūkāraṃ vāyubījaṃ || candanādi svānacchāya || || yajamāna puṣpabhājanaṃ || adyādi || vāya || śrīsaṃvarttā || (fol. 1r1–6) «End: » tarppaṇa || prītapretā || dakṣiṇā || ekāne || ambepūrvva || saṃhāramudrā balivisarjana || sākṣithāya || || balicchoya vidhi || dathu bheraju || pūrvvādiyāṅā kāṭhana bali cchāya thava thava thāyasa || kalākhu || togana || jujumā || nāśvara || nivata || hanūmaṃta || rājakarāka || bhagavati || cāśvara || nāśvarayā vacchalā || tuparaju || vidyāpīṭha || vaṭuka dumāju || golajo dhvākhāyināya || dadudakā dukhāpikhā || (fol.5r2–6) «Colophon:» sāṭhacayavota varāja vo aṃtarasa yoginīvijayapāṭhabaliviyavidhi || || (fol. 5r6–7 )

«Beginning: » ❖ brāhmaṇa ācārya josi thvate sanaṃ thirahālāva vayāva || maṇḍapanapi uttara soya majilasā pūrva soyaṃteva || gajulicchākvahnuyā thva velasa yāya || thvana hṅāonali dinapatiṃ rajasā lāsa karmmārccana yāya dhunaṅāva ( dakṣiṇa ) balipāṭa madhyasa kṣetra mūlana yāya || ṅūva bali pūrvvādikramana brahmaṇyādina ṅūyake || pāṭha sāntikādhyāya || || arghapātra || jalapātra || pañcabali || gaṇavaṭuka || thvate paṭavāsana coyāva jiyake || || laṃkhana hāya || ūkāraṃ vāyubījaṃ tyādi | || śrīkhaṃḍaṃ candanaṃ tyādi || || vīreśvarītyādi || || svargamartyaikapātāletyādi || || (fol. 1r1–4) «End: » || || namaste devdeveśi siddhilakṣmī mahaujasā | pratyaṅgirā mahādevī rājyalakṣmī namo stu te || || pūrvaṃ dakṣiṇapaścimottara śivā pūrvādi vā māsikā kṣetreśo vaṭubhūtadurggaharaṇaṃ herambanāthāya ca || śmaśāneśvaram ādideva dvibhujaḥ śokādidośaprahā (!) || nityānandamayī pramodita sadā balyādipūjāvidhiḥ || || yathāvāṇaprahārāṇāṃ tyādi || tarppaṇa || prītapretā || || śāntikādhyāya pustakapūjā yāya || śāntikādhyāyapāṭha yāya || mālaśāpaśuyāga || mūmālasāsamayacchāya || prītapretā || dakṣiṇā || || ekāneka || balivisarjjana yāya || pūrvādikrameṇa aṣṭapīṭhasacchoya || dathupāṭajuko galaṃḍa laṃkhusa || gaṇadhvākhāyināyasa || vaṭukadumāju || || dvaṃdudake dukhāpikhā || sākṣī thāya || || «Colophon:» iti śāntikādhyāyabalipūjāpāṭhārccanaṃ samāptaṃ || || ❁ || || śubhaṃ || dakṣiṇadigayā bali || samvat 811 kārttikaśuklanavamī thva kuhnu śrīśrī sumatijayajitāmitramalladevasana dayakā juroṃ śubham astu || (fol. 18v5–6)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ paradevatāyai || atha śaktinyāsa ucyate || oṃ guptaprakaṭayogināthapādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śaktinyāsākṣareśvaraḥ | yena dehe niyuktena śktitulyo naro bhavet || yenāṃganyāsamātreṇa divyadevavṛtena ca | kopitaḥ kurute yogī traikokasya ca pātanaṃ || śaktinyāsayuto mantrī namaskāreṇa śaṅkari | sphoṭanaṃ kurute sākṣāt pāṣāṇapratimādiṣu || oṃ auṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vinyaset jānau || ( hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ nābhimaṇḍale || klāṃ klīṃ klūṃ bhruvor agre || hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ caraṇeṣu vai || sāṃ siṃ sauṃ kapālāgre || ) hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ karṇayo dvayo || drāṃ drīṃ draṃ kāmakaṃde ca || sauṃ srīṃ saḥ ścibukamūrddhani || akāra rājayā kuru haṃsamaṇḍale | satantavarān kuru deha jīvite || tadeva līlā kuru yatra vidyate | taṃ viddhi sākārakalāḥ sadāśrayāḥ || yathā dugdhe sthitaṃ sarppiḥ yathā tailaṃ tileṣu ca tathā sarveṣu varṇeṣu akārasthā kuleśvari | akāra kathyate loke mātṛkā vedamātṛkā akārādi kṣakārāntā yo jānāti sadāśivaḥ | oṃ asya śrīmahāśaktinyāsasya paramaśivaṛṣi atijagatīchandaḥ śrīparāśaktidevatā aiṃ bījaṃ śrīśaktiḥ sauḥ kīlakaṃ śrīvidyāṅgatvamahāśaktinyāse viniyogaḥ | śaktiṛṣyādikaṃ smṛtvā tritāradvirāvṛtyā ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ vidhāya || (exp. 2)

«Beginning: » oṃ namo devyai || śrīmahākāla uvāca || adhunā kathayiṣyāmi sarahasyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || śāradīyāṃ ca vāsaṃtīm arcāṃ nānāphalapradāṃ || manīṣiṇo vidadhati vicārān atra bhūyasaḥ || smṛtyaṣvacāriṇaḥ sarve kaulikāḥ sarva eva ca || traividhyamadhye kiṃ rūpā bhavatīyaṃ samarhaṇā || yasyā ‘karaṇataḥ pāpaṃ jāyate nityam eva tat || vidhānād yasya ca phalaṃ jāyate kāmyam eva tat || ananuṣṭhānato yasya pāpaṃ utpadyate na hi || vidhānārthaṃ phalaṃ cāpi tannaimittikam ucyate || iyaṃ yā śāradī pūjā kathyate sā kim ātimikā || (fol. 1r1–3) «End: » phalaṃ yacchāradārcāyā vaktuṃ yat kena śakyate | uparāge tu karttavyā pūjā naimittike yathā || naiva tasmin paśubalidānam vihitam īśvarī || na pātra svīkṛtir madhye na śaktiparipūjanaṃ || na ca nyāsādi bāhulyaṃ nāvṛtyarcanabhūritā || kālena tāvatī pūjā yāvaty eva samāpyate || tāvatyevaṃ vidheyātra nādhikā vai kadācana || grahamuktāvapi kṛtvā naimittiky ucyate na hi || nimittam rāhusaṃyogas tasmin vṛtte kathaṃ sa ca || tad avacchinnakālena proktā pūjoparāgikī || smārttānāṃ nādhikāro sti pūjāyāṃ śrāddhamantarā || grahe tu tad akurvāṇo niraye paripacyate || ityukte pūjane devi śāradīyauparāgike || īdṛśyeva hi vāsaṃtī pūjā kāryā madhau site || || (fol. 30r5–9) «Colophon:» iti śrīmahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ śāradīpūjāvidhiḥ || (fol. 30r9)

«Beginning: » ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || sādhaka pūrvamukhakṛṭya || mūlaṃ phaṭ pīṭhaṃ saśodhya aiṃ paraguruṃ ( gurubhyo namaḥ || paragurubhyo namaḥ || parāparagurubhyo namaḥ || parameṣthīgurubhyo namaḥ ) śrīpādukāṃ tyādi || glauṃ gaṇeśāyapāduºº || vāṃ vaṭukanāthāya pāduºº || yāṃ yoginīyo pādu ºº || mātṛbhyo pāduºº || iti namaskṛtya vāmapādapurassrara || || smasāne devapūjā || yathā || ye vātra saṃsthitā devā rākṣasāś ca bhayānakā || piśācasiddhayakṣāś ca gaṃdharvvāpsarasāṃgaṇā yoginyo mātaro bhūtā sarvvāśca kṣecaraḥ striya || (exp. 4b1–6) «End: » tataḥ stavakavacādikaṃ paṭhet || namaskṛtya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt || tata yuktapātrādikaṃ yathecchayā svīkṛtya paścān nirmālyavāsinīṃ pūjayitvā baliṃ visarjayet || sūryārghaṃ dadyāt || || yathāsukhaṃ viharet || ||(exp. 10t4–10b1) «Colophon:» iti vīrapuraścaraṇa saṃpūrṇaṃ || || śubha || (exp.10b1)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ nama hrīṃ kṛ svāhāḥ thva mantrana dhāra3cikaḍnajaparatha///nu bhara vara chūya || || ṅ oṃ hūṃ pañcacandraguruājñā sva///|| dhāra 7 || khalasu svaco uto hāka hnasatā thyāya || thyāya mantra || || ❖ oṃ hūṃ ta bhuḥ svāhā guruvāke hūṃ || dhāla śacānatiya vivadokāryācā nāvipatiṃ hṅāna kāva tiya///t vāṃ gaṃ coya || thva mantrana || (exp. 4t1–6) «End: » rā putranimistre urati pāratrirāguna rāvarikā /// añjāvatra sa u runiri āññā || thva strana bhatāyāju /// yuvākiccahmaṭṭhitāthe pehnu kuhnu nake āditevāra ///hnanake myācasa taya sūrjasake 12 dadaṃ otayāya sana///ravārasahnu tāthe cha paharasaneke mārasa mecavāra kuhnu tāthe āditevāra kuhnu lame juroḥ || || (exp. 5t1–6) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || raṃge ramaṃtam īḍe vyomamukhaṃ durni(rī)kṣyam api dīptyā || vividhā hi yakṣakinnara- bhūtāntikam īśavaram anādim || 1 || maṃtrāśeṣaviśeṣa- jñānaṃ yad gopitaṃ surair yatnāt || krodhīśabhairavoktaṃ tadvakṣye bhūtabhairavaṃ nāma || 2 || yadjñānena vinā balijapahomādyaṃ prayogabalidānam || ṣaṭkarmāṇy anadyatvaṃ mokṣajñānam sadā dhyānam || 3 || kaṣtena vīrasiddhir yāgādir abhojanena surabhaktim || indriyamanoviśuddhis tadā syādikaṃ vakṣye || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » yatra yakṣeśvaro maṃtra taṃtraivāsyaṃ pradhānataḥ || caṃḍikāyā abhāvetra vidyunnetrahṛdāsavaḥ || jyotiḥ kaparddinī khadyogrāsinī ca surāntakaḥ || vaivasvataḥ ketunāmā śikhī prāṇaprahāriṇī || kaṃpinyulkāmukhījālaṃdharī caṇḍayugāntakau || kiṃkarī pitrākṣīś ca kinnaraś ca manaoharī || dhvāṃkṣā vaitālikaṃ phetkāriṇīmūlapayodharau || caturviṃśatibījāni taṃtre syur yakṣaḍāmare yebhir aśeṣamantrāṇāṃ hṛnnetravadanāni ca || asavosya parijñeyā sarvatantreṣu gopivat (!) || || (fol. 11v4–12r4) «Colophon:» iti bījākṣaravidhi saṃpūrṇam || || || śubham || || || (fol.12r5)

«Beginning: » ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ asya śrīśatruvidhvaṃsinīstotramālāmaṃtrasya jvalatpāvakaṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śatruvidhvaṃsinī devatā śatruvidhvaṃsanārthe jape viniyogaḥ || || atha nyāsaḥ | śatruvidhvaṃsinyai aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ raudryai tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā || triśirāyai madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ || raktalocanāyai anāmikābhyāṃ huṃ || agnijvālāyai kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ || raudramukhyai karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ phaṭ || (exp. 4b1–5t4) «End: » atha dhyānaṃ || raktāṃgīṃ śavavāhanāṃ ca triśirāṃ raudrīṃ mahābhairavīṃ || dhūmrākṣīṃ bhayanāśinīṃ ghananibhāṃ nīlāmbarālaṃkṛtāṃ || khaḍgaṃ śūladharāṃ mahābhayaripudhvaṃsīkṛtāṃ tāṃ mahā- dīrghāṃgīṃ trijaṭāṃ vanānalanibhāṃ pinākīṃ ca tāṃ || || oṃ śatruvidhvaṃśinī raudrī triśirā raktalocanā agnijvālā raudrāyai namaḥ svāhā || ( oṃ śatruvidhvaṃsinyai svāhā || oṃ raudryai svāhā || oṃ triśirāyai svāhā || oṃ raktalocanāyai svāhā || oṃ agnijvālā(yai namaḥ svāhā ) || oṃ raudramukhyai namaḥ svāhā || oṃ ghoradraṃṣṭryai namaḥ svāhā || oṃ triśūlinyai namaḥ svāhā || oṃ digaṃbaryai namaḥ svāhā || oṃ muktakeśyai namaḥ svāhā || oṃ raktapāṇyai namaḥ svāhā || oṃ mahodaryai namaḥ svāhā || atha homadravyāḥ || śubhrasarṣapa 1 ( vicye2) bakāin 3 niṃbapatra 4 ulūkāpace pakṣa 5 pāṃca vastu(exp. 5b–6b2) «Colophon:» iti śatruvidhvaṃsinīvidyā śubham || || (exp. 6b2–3)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ paradevatāyai || ( praṇava oṃ ) vāgbhava aiṃ || māyā hrīṃ || lakṣmī śrīṃ || kāma klīṃ || pāśa āṃ || kalā hūṃ || gāruḍa hrauṃ || aṃkuśa hrāṃ || kālīṃ hrīṃ || siddha hrauṃ || varmma hraiṃ || jayā hraṃ || hayagrīva hūṃ || gaurī hraḥ || sādhya hraṃ || vadhū strīṃ || mahākrodha kṣūṃ || kṣetrapāla kṣauṃ || kūrcca hūṃ || prāsāda hrauṃ || śākinī phreṃ || caṇḍa phrāṃ || (fol. 1v1–4) «End: » kuṇḍalī ▒ || svādhiṣṭhāna ▒ || maṇipūraka ▒ || anāhata ▒ || viśuddha ▒ || ājñā ▒ || prāṇa ▒ || pauraṇa ▒ || naigama ▒ suṣumnā ▒ || īḍā ▒ || pāṇḍava ▒ || padma ▒ || bhauma ▒ || vīra ▒ || kapila ▒ || vāśiṣṭha ▒ || svapnāvatī ▒ || vaitālika ▒ || ugra ▒ || vāḍava || bṛhat ▒ || rathantara ▒ || jyeṣṭha ▒ || mahat ▒ || guhyā ▒ || jyoti ▒ || ṛka ▒ || yajuḥ ▒ || sāma ▒ || atharvva ▒ || prājāpatya ▒ || āṅgirasa ▒ || dhaumāvatya ▒ || prabhā ▒ || agnoṣṭoma ▒ || jyotiṣṭoma ▒ || agniṣṭoma ▒ || vājapeya ▒ || puṇḍarīka ▒ || ṣoḍaśī ▒ || sautrāmṇi ▒ || aśvamedga ▒ || rājasūya ▒ || sviṣṭikṛt ▒ || gorasa ▒ || mahāvrata ▒ || bahusumantu ▒ || viśvajit ▒ || brahmayajña ▒ || aśvakrāntā ▒ || rathakrāntā ▒ || viṣṇukrānta ▒ || sūryakrānta || gajakrānta ▒ || balamit ▒ || (fol. 12v–14v) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namo brahmane namaḥ || seṅa hloneyā vidhi || ❖ tato iṣṭaliṃgapracāraṇārtha yajñāvidhiḥ || || ❖ nakasa prārthanā stuti yāya || oṃ iṣṭaliṃgamidaṃ devas bhaktānyat sthāpayāmyahaṃ | asya coddharaṇe śāntīḥ syādityasti tavadvayaḥ || tasmād atra vidhānena māmadhiṣṭha maheśvara || thvate dhunaṅāva puṣpabhājana yācake || (exp. 3A1–12) «End: » śrīṃ hrīṃ kulaputravaṭukanāthāya pādukāṃ bali || 2 || aiṃ mukhāsanāya pādukāṃ || gāṃ gīṃ gūṃ glauṃ kulagaṇeśvarāya pādukāṃ || bali || 3 || āvāhanādi daṇḍa tarjjanī gajamudrāṃ darśayet || aghora vajravetiīsi hakāra sahāra nataṃne || pūjanaṃ baliḥṃ || || khavasa oīṭhiyātaṃ viye || lūṃ indrāya pādukāṃ || rūṃ agnaya || mūṃ yamāya || kṣūṃ naiṛtyāya || vuṃ varuṇāya || yuṃ vāyave || (exp. 16b1–7) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » dhomukhasahasra(dala)kamalaṃ nītvā tastrastha candramaṇḍalavigaladamṛtadhārayā raktayā akārādikṣakārānta mantramuccārya tāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ saṃtarpya vakṣyamāṇam ekasvarūpam ātmānaṃ ciraṃ dhyātvā punar ājñādikrameṇa mūlādhāraṃ nayet || tato malamūtrotsargadantadhāvanapūrvvakaṃ kṛtvā tatra mantraḥ || annodyāyavyūhadhvajaṃ somarājāya māgamat | sa me mukhe pramārjjate yaśasā ca bhagena ca || tataḥ svaśākhoktaṃ snānaṃ kṛṭvā vaiṣṇavasnānaṃ kuryāt | (fol. 2r1–5) «End: » choṭikāṃ matsyamudrāṃ ca dhenumudrāṃ pradarśya ca || śaṃkhamudrāṃ cakramudrāṃ garuḍākhyāṃ ca darśayet || śarāmīkṛtya yatnena tatra cāṣṭau manuṃ japet || tasya kiṃcij jalaṃ prokṣaṇīpātre nidhāya devasya mūrdhniṃ siṃcet pūjādravyeṣu cātmani | avekṣaṇam prokṣaṇaṃ ca vīkṣaṇaṃ tāḍanaṃ tathā arcanaṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ pāvanatvaṃ prakalpayet || pādārghadānārthaṃ madhuparkārtham apyatha || tathaivācamanīyārthaṃ nyaset pātracatuṣṭayam || arghapādyādipātreṣu saṃpūjya salilaṃ śubhaṃ | tatrārghapātre (fol. 18v2–6) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ asya śrījagatkṣobhaṇamahāmālāmaṃtrasya tatpuruṣeśvaraṛṣir jagatīchaṃdaḥ śarabheśvaro devatā oṃ bījaṃ prakṛtiḥ śaktiḥ pakṣirājāyeti kīlakaṃ śarabheśvaraprītyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || || tatpuruṣeśvarāya ṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi || jagatī chandase namo mukhe || śarabheśvarāya devatāyai namo hṛdaye || oṃ bījāya namo guhye || prakṛtyai śaktaye namḥ pādayoḥ || pakṣīrājāya kīlakāya namaḥ sarvāṅge || || atha nyāsaḥ || khāṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || khīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā || khuṃ madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ || khaiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ hūṃ || khoṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ || khaḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ phaṭ || || evaṃ hṛdayādi || (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » brahmarākṣasagrahaṃ bandhaya baṃdhaya jvālāgraha bandhaya bandhaya jvālāmukhagrahaṃ bandhaya bandhaya tāpasagrahaṃ bandhaya bandhaya tamohāragrahaṃ bandhaya bandhaya bhūcaragrahaṃ bandhaya bandhaya khecaragrahaṃ bandhaya bandhaya kūṣṃāṇḍagrahaṃ bandhaya bandhaya strīgrahaṃ bandhaya bandhaya vikramagrahaṃ bandhaya bandhaya vyutkramagrahaṃ bandhaya bandhaya pretagrahaṃ bandhaya bandhaya piśācagrahaṃ bandhaya bandhayāveśagrahaṃ bandhaya bandhayānāveśagrahaṃ bandhaya bandhaya kāṃ hāṃ troṭaya troṭaya praiṃ traiṃ bhauṃ śīghraṃ māraya māraya muñca muñca daha daha paca paca nāśaya nāśaya sarvaduṣṭān nāśaya nāśaya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || || (fol. 4r1–5) «Colophon:» iti ākāśabhairavakalpe śarabhamālāmantraḥ || || ālekhya vṛttaṃ bahir aṣṭaśūlaṃ madhye ca māyā triśikhāntarāle || sādhyāvṛtaṃ sarvajayopayogaṃ saṃkṣobhaṇaṃ cakram amogham etat || || śubhaṃ bhūyāt || (fol. 4r5–7)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || gajacarmanivāraṇaṃ || sābū paisā 1 bhāra | sohāgā paisā || bhāra | sohāgā pulāiye āge upar bhujie | phūle nīke kari | pīche mihikari pisie | ṭhīkarābhītara sābū thorā thorā pānīsūṃ sāthame laike mardiye | ṭhīkarā bhītara gāḍhā gāḍhā lūdā rākhiye | pāche suhāgā ghālike ghaḍi 4 hathelīsūṃ mardana kariye | 1 dādakūṃ jaṃgalake guiṭhāsetī khajuvāike upara ye auṣadha lagāiye diname jabahīṃ sukhījāya tava hī lagāvatehi rahiye | nīke jāike uparāṃta dina 21 lagāye | uhā pāṇīkā sparśa na kare | auṣadha bhitara thorā thorā pānī ghāle | sūkhaṇe na pāve || śrī || hukakā auṣadha || … gurukī śakti merī bhakti phuro maṃtra īśvarovāca || śrī || (exp. 2)

«Beginning: » || śrīḥ || sumukhaś caikadantaś ca kapilo gajakarṇakaḥ | lambodaraś ca vikaṭo bighnanāśo vināyakaḥ || 1 || dhūmraketur gaṇādhyakṣo bhālacandro gajānanaḥ | dvādaśaitāni nāmāni yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād api || 2 || vidyāraṃbhe vivāde ca praveśe nirgame tathā || saṃgrāme saṃkaṭe tasya bighnas tasya na jāyate || 3 || śuklāṃbaradharaṃ devaṃ śaśivarṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ || prasannavadanaṃ dhyāyet sarvabighnopaśāṃtaye || 1 || yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ | tatra śrīr vijayo bhūtir dhuvānīti matir mama || 2 || lābhas teṣāṃ jayas teṣāṃ kutas teṣāṃ parājayaḥ || yeṣām indīvaraśyāmo hṛdayastho janārdanaḥ || 3 || yaṃ || 4 || vakratuṃḍamahākāya koṭisūryasamaprabhaḥ || abighnaṃ kuru me deva sarvakāryeṣu sarvadā || 5 || … (exp. 3)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha śmaśānakālīpūjāvidhiḥ || tad uktaṃ kālītantre || vāṇīṃ māyāṃ tato lakṣmīṃ kāmabījaṃ tataḥ paraṃ kālike saṃpuṭatvena catuṣkaṃ bījam ālikhet || ekādaśārṇa deveśi caturvargapradāyinī || asyā mūlamaṃtram || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ kālike aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ || ekādaśākṣaroyaṃ maṃtraḥ || (fol. 1v1–6) «End: » asya puraścaraṇaṃ ekādaśalakṣajapaḥ || tathā ca || varṇalakṣaṃ japen maṃtraṃ taddaśāṃśena homayet || mamtrātaraṃ tatraiva || kāmabījaṃ samālikhya kālikāyai samālikhet || namontena ca deveśi saptāṛṇo manuruttamaḥ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ kālikā devyā anyat sarvaṃ tu pūrvavat || (fol. fol. 4r1–5) «Colophon:» iti śrīśmaśānakālikāpūjāvidhi samāptam || || svasti śrīsamvat 1965 sāla māgha śudi 3 roja 1 māgha 12 gate 1 dharmarājaśarmaṇaḥ likhitoyam svārthaṃ parāṛthaṃ ca || (fol. 4r5–4v2)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha śmaśānakālīpūjāvidhiḥ || ( asya śrīśmaśānakālīmaṃtrasya bhṛguṛṣi nivṛcchandaḥ śamaśānakālikā devatā aiṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ klīṃ kīlakaṃ śmaśānakālīprītaye mamābhīṣṭa sidhyarthe yathāsaṃkhyake jape viniyogaḥ | iti saṃkalpa ) trirācamya || gurunamaskārādi || prāṇāyāma || ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ || śirasi || bhṛguṛṣaye namaḥ || mukhe || nivṛcchandase namaḥ || hṛdi śmaśānakālikā devatāyai namaḥ || ( guhye aiṃ bījāya namaḥ ) pādayoḥ hrīṃ śaktaye namaḥ || sarvāṅge klīṃ kīlakāya namaḥ || || tataḥ karanyāsaḥ (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » asya puraścaraṇaṃ ekādaśalakṣajapaḥ || tathā ca || varṇalakṣaṃ japen maṃtraṃ taddaśāṃśena homayet || mamtrātaraṃ tatraiva || kāmabījaṃ samālikhya kālikāyai samālikhet || namontena ca deveśi saptāṛṇo manur īrītaḥ || ṣaḍaṃgaṃ kālikā devyā anyat sarvaṃ tu pūrvavat || iti siddhaṃ || || aikādaśārṇamaṃtroddhāraṃ || vāṇīṃ māyāṃ tathā lakṣṃīṃ kāmabījaṃ tataḥ paraṃ | kālike saṃpuṭatvena catuṣkaṃ bījam ālikhet || aikādaśārṇa deveśi caturvargapradāyinī || maṃtro yathā || aiṃ hrīṃ śrm klīṃ kālike klīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ || ekādaśārṇā mūlamaṃtraḥ || || (fol. fol. 5r1–5v5) «Colophon:» iti śrīśmaśānakālipūjāpaddhati || || (fol. 4v5–5r1)

( oṃ devasyatvā ) || candana || oṃ jadaṭṭakacavitrahaṃ (!) || siṃdūra oṃ tvaṃ javistadā || sagona | oṃ dadhikrāyanokhā(!) || āśirvvāda | oṃ śrīścate lakṣmī || oṃ dīpyāya svāyavarāya || śubha sarvekhāṃ bāṃdhavādīnāṃ savvadā kalyāna dīrghamāyur astu || vratadaṅapaniḥ āgaṇamaṭe hlāyamāra juro || pāraṇa yāya || || (exp. 11t5–11b4) «Colophon:» iti śuṭhāyīvrata samāptaṃ || śubham astu || ❁ || a || saṃvat 1808 pauṣa kṛṣṇa patipade (!) ādityavāra thva kuhnu śuṭḥāyai vrata likhitaṃ śubhaḥ || thva verasa makvāṃpura mahākumāraju śrījoganara (exp. 11b5–7)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ atha cakrānuṣṭhānapaddhatiḥ tatrādau yāgamaṇḍapadvāri gatvā hastau pādau prakṣālyācamya sāmānyārghyaṃ kṛtvā dvāradevatāḥ saṃpūjya bhūtāpasāraṇaṃ āsanaśuddhiṃ vidhāyāsane upaviśya vijayāṃ śodhayet tadyathā trikoṇavṛttacaturasramaṃḍalopari vijayāṃsaṃsthāpyāṃ(!) asya samvidosya mantrasya dakṣiṇāmūrrtiṛṣiḥ paṃ[k]tischandaḥ sadāśivo devatā samvitsānniddhāropaṇe viniyogaḥ (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » tataḥ śrīpātrāmṛtaṃ tridhā kṛtvā gurave svaśaktyai bhāgadvayaṃ datvā śeṣaṃ svīyacaṣake kṛtvā svīkṛtya bhūmau tatpātraṃ nyubjīkṛtya taduparijalaṃ dattvā puṣpaṃ nikṣipya prakṣālya gopayet tatas tatraiva sthāpane māyābījaṃ vilikhya vāmakaniṣṭhayā tanmṛdā ti[la]kaṃ kuryād anena mantreṇa oṃ yaṃ yaṃ spṛśāmi pādena yaṃ yaṃ paśyāmi cakṣuṣā | sa eva dāsatāṃ yātu yadi śakrasamo bhavet ity anena svīyalalāṭe tilakaṃ kuryāt anyebhyas tilakadāne oṃ yaṃ yaṃ spṛśati pādena yaṃ yaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā ityādi tathaitad vidhinā pānānantaraṃ sarve pi pātraṃ śītalaṃ kuryuḥ (fol. 29r2–29v1) «Colophon: » iti cakrapūjāpaddhatiḥ samāptāḥ (!) || ○ || oṃ tatsat śrīgurucaraṇe mamamastu(!) atha śrīcakradarśanaphalam samyak śatakratūn kṛtvā yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti kṛtvā śrīcakradarśanam … tīrthasnānasahasrakoṭiphaladaṃ śrīcakrapādodakam yattu kadācit bhairavīcakre labhec ciṃcārasaṃ yadi tadā nadyādisaṃpītvā suneruśṛṅgaroganaṃ(!) bhavatīti (fol. 29v1–7)

«Beginning: » śrīḥ || satyānaṇdaṃ guruṃ natvā svācārasya nirūpaṇaṃ || kāmānaṃdasya tanayaḥ pūrṇāndas tanoti tat || 1 || di(!)kṣiṇācārasyaiva nirūpaṇe karttavye adhikāriparatayā prasaṅgena vyavasthāṃ ca viśadayati || tatra trikūṭārahasye || sāmānyato ācāraṃ nirūpayati || śrībhairavovāca || athācāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sādhakasyeṣṭasiddhye || guhyaṃ paramaguhyaṃ ca maṃtrādapi maheśvari || 1 || anya maṃtrārcane śraddhām anyamantrasya bhāvanāṃ || manasāpi na kurvīta siddhihāniḥ prajāyate || 2 || (fol. 1v1–6) śrīgurupādukāmantrasya ānaṃdabhairavaṛṣiḥ gāyatrīchaṃdaḥ śrīgurur devatā aiṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ śrīṃ kīlakaṃ śrīguruprasādasiddhyarthe guru[[pādukā]]mantra jape viniyogaḥ iti saṃkalpya ānaṃdabhairavāya ṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi (exp. 18t fol.1v1–3 ) «End: » vande tām aṣṭavargottha mahāsiddhyaṣṭakeśvarīṃ || kāmapūrṇajakārādya śrīpīṭhāntar nivāsinīṃ || caturājñākośabhūtāṃ naimi śrītripurām ahaṃ || iti dvādaśabhiḥ ślokais stavanaṃ sarvasiddhikṛt || devyāstvakhaṇḍarupāyās stavanaṃ paṭhyate || toyatattvamayīvyāptir iti samyak samīritaṃ | asyā niphālanāc citte tat tattvaṃ svātmasātkṛtaṃ || (fol. 14r4–8) dorbhikārmukapāśabāṇaṣuśṛṇīn bibhrāṇamindoḥ kalāṃ nānā kalpavirājamānavapuṣaṃ kāmeśvaraṃ bhāvaye || iti dhyātvā ca pūrvavat mudrāḥ pradarśya mānasaiḥ saṃpūjya | oṃ hrīṃ karāīlahrīṃ hasakahalahrīṃ sakalahrīṃ namaḥ śivāya iti japet | puna ṛṣyādi vidhāya | guhyeti nivedayet || (exp. 26b,fol. 10v3–6) «Colophon: » iti tripurasundarīstotraṃ samāptaṃ || (fol. 14r8) iti saṃkṣepaśrī … śrīkṛṣṇa jośī rāmanagaravāle (exp. 26b, fol. 10v6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || śivaṃ guruṃ gaṇeśañ ca praṇamya paradevatāṃ | śrīcakrapūjanaṃ vakṣye saṃkṣepeṇa kramoditaṃ || || oṃ namaḥ śrīgurave || namste nātha bhagavān śivāya gururūpiṇe | vidyāvatārasaṃsiddhyai sīvkṛtānekavigraha[ḥ] || navāya navarūpāya paramārthaka(!)rūpiṇe | sarvvajñāya namo bhedabhānave cit(!)ghanāya te || svatantrāya dayāklṛptavigrahāya śivātmane | paratantrāya bhaktānāṃ bhavyānāṃ bhavyarūpiṇe || (fol. 1r1–4) End tathā dehamaye pīṭhe cintayet paradevatām iti yogapīṭhanyāsaḥ || || atha mūlamantra⟨ṃ⟩nyāsaḥ || tatrādau ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ || asyāḥ śrīvidyāyā dakṣiṇāmūrttiṛṣiḥ paṃktichaṃdaḥ śrīmahātripurasuṃdarīdevatā aiṃbījaṃ sauḥ śaktiḥ klīṃ kīlakaṃ samastapuruṣārthasiddhaye viniyohaḥ || iti smṛtvā nyaset || śirasi oṃ dakṣiṇāmūrttaye ṛṣaye namaḥ || mukhe oṃ paṃkticchaṃdase namaḥ || hṛdi śrīmahātri (fol. 3v6–9)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha pūjāprakāro likhyate || || ācamya prāṇān āyamya || āsanopaveśanabhūtaśuddhiprāṇapratiṣṭhāmātṛkānyāsān vidhāya || asya mantrasya kālāgnirudra ṛṣir jagatīchandaḥ śarabho devatā khaṃbījaṃ svāhāśaktiḥ jape viniyogaḥ || śirasi kālāgnirudrāya ṛṣaye namaḥ || mukhe jagatīchandase namaḥ || hṛdi śarabhāya devatāyai namaḥ || guhye khaṃbījāya namaḥ || pādayoḥ svāhā śaktyai namaḥ || kheṃ khāṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || oṃ khaṃ phaṭ tarjanībhyāṃ || prāṇagrahāsi 2 hūṃ phaṭ madhyamābhyāṃ || sarvaśatrusaṃhāraṇāya anāmikābhyāṃ || oṃ śarabhaśāluvāya kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ || oṃ pakṣirājāya hūṃ phaṭ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ || evaṃ hṛdayādi || (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » oṃ hrīṃ akṣamālāyai namaḥ || iti mālāṃ gandhādibhir abhyarcya || oṃ abighnaṃ kuru māle tvaṃ japakāle sadā mama || tvaṃ bījaṃ sarvamaṃtrāṇāṃ iṣṭasiddhikarī bhava || iti mālāṃ gṛhītvā śirasi guruṃ hṛdi iṣṭadevaṃ gurucaraṇayor ātmānaṃ ca dhyāyan || maṃtrārthagatacittaḥ hṛdayasamīpamālāṃ dhārayan japet japaṃ samāpya || tvaṃ māle sarvvadevānāṃ prītidā śubhadā mama || śivaṃ kuruṣva me bhadre yaśo vīryaṃ ca sarvadā || hrīṃ siddhyai namaḥ || iti śirasi sthāpya arghyodakam ādāya || guhyātiguhyagoptā tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmat kṛtaṃ japaṃ || siddhir bhavatu me deva tvatprasādāt tvayi sthitā || anena japena śarabhaḥ prīyatāṃ || iti devasya dakṣiṇe haste jalaṃ datvā pūrvavan mālāṃ saṃpūjya rahasi sthāpayet || tato nīrājanaṃ kṛtvā mūlena puṣpāṃjaliṃ datvā namaskṛtya visṛjya punar nyāsān kṛtvā namas kuryāt || (fol. 4r3–4v2) «Colophon:» iti gīrvāṇopamasāre śarabhapūjanaprayogaḥ samāptaḥ || || atha maṃtroddhāraḥ || tāraṃ prathamam uccārya kheṃ khāṃ phaṭ tad anantaraṃ prāṇagrahāsi dvitayaṃ 2 hūṃ phaṭ ca tad anantaraṃ sarveti padam uktvātha śatrusaṃhāraṇāya tu || śarabhaśāluveśāyeti pakṣirājāya ity api || hūṃ phaṭ svāheti maṃtro yaṃ dvicatvāriṃśad akṣaraḥ || prajaped varṇasaṃkhyāni sahasrāṇi sureśvari || daśāṃsaṃ tarpaṇaṃ homa śatāṃśaṃ dvijabhojanaṃ sahasrāṃśaṃ atho devi kramād evaṃ samarcayed iti yaṃtraṃ trikoṇaṃ vṛttadvayaṃ aṣṭadalaṃ vṛttaṃ dvādaśadalaṃ vṛttaṃ ṣoḍaśadalaṃ bhūpurayugmaṃ dvārayutam iti pūjāyaṃtraprakāraḥ samāptaḥ || || aiṁ hrīṃ śrīṃ namo bhagavate jvala prajvala asādhyaṃ sādhaya rakṣa rakṣa sarvaduṣṭebhyo huṃ phaṭ svāhā || || oṃ kheṃ khāṃ khaṃ phaṭ prāṇagrahāsi 2 hūṃ phaṭ sarvaśatrusaṃhāraṇāya śarabhaśāluvāya pakṣirājāya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || || śubham || || (fol. 4v2–7)

«Beginning: » oṃ namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇapataye || oṃ śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaram || tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || akathyam aśrutaṃ tattvaṃ vāṅmanotītagocaram || tat tattvaṃ yena saṃprāptaṃ tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || ajñānāndhasya lokasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā | cakṣur unmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || jñānaśaktisamāyuktaṃ tattvamālāvibhūṣitam | bhuktimuktipradātāraṃ guruṃ vande yathā śivam || (fol. 1v1–4) «End: » sarvacakreśvari sarvamantreśvari sarvavidyeśvari sarvavīreśvari sarvapīṭheśvari sarvavāge(!)śvarī sarvasiddhyeśvarī ⟪yaga⟫[[etad utpattimātṛkācakrāsanadevatāḥ samudrā sasiddhayaḥ sāyudhāḥ savāhanāḥ saparivārāḥ śrīmahātripurasundarī devī parayāparayā parāparayā ca sapa[[rya]]yā sarvopacāraiḥ sṃpūjitāḥ santu || sūryendubahnimayabhāsva[[ra]]pīṭhadehā svecchā[[gṛhīta]] śṛṇivāṇaśareṣu cāpān || bālendumaulimaṇikā[[gra]]lalāmanetrāṃ nityāṃ namāmi mahatīṃ mahanīyamūrttim || ⟪tejarāmamahāmaṇḍalikena idaṃ grantha(syadannam) ⟫ || iti pūrvapaścimauttaradakṣiṇatripurapūjayasveti || || (fol. 44r6–44v4) «Colophon: » iti ṣaḍāmnāyapūjāvidhiḥ || || || purātanatāḍapatrapustakād idaṃ pustakaṃ 1979 saṃvatsare śāradāvilāsaśarmadvārā śrīmadrājaguruhemarājapaṇḍitena likhitam (fol. 44v4–5)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmahākālyai || kālikulakrame ṣoḍhānyāso bhairavavallabhaḥ | yaḥ karoti mahārātrau tasyājñā bhuvanatraye || kālikulakrameṣoḍhānyāse mokṣāc chovo bhavet | tannāsti yanna siddhiḥ syān nigrahānugrahakṣamaḥ || na kuryāt praṇipātaṃ ca kālikramakulapriye | viriñcikeśavaśakras tadājñākāriṇo bhavet || || asya śrīkālikākramaṣoḍhānyasasya paramakrodhadurvāsāṛṣir bṛhatīchaṃdaḥ śrīpheṃ guhyakālipañcakramātmakaḥ paraśivo devatā ājñāsiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1r1–5) «End: » piṅgalāyāṃ || hū5 phaṭ5 || suṣumnārddhacāriṇī || mahākālākṣarau hrīṃ pheṃ hūṃ 6 phaṭ 9 nasaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ svāhā || sarvāṅge || hrīṃ śrīṃ cakrayogeśvarīcandrapīṭhe vyomakālimātaṅgī(!)ni bhīmakāli(!) kāmarūpiṇī siddhikālī pūrṇnagiri candrakāli(!) jālandhali(!) caṇḍakāli oḍiyāni raktakāli sarvvasamayalābhaṃ kuru 2 susiddha supurassara 2 śrī prasara2 haṃsaḥ khaḥ khaḥ hi hi hrīṃ hūṃ vāhi 2 kāhi 2 khāhi 2 kheṃ hūṃ lāṃ khāṃ khāṃ lāṃ cchāṃ hūṃ phāṃ vāṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hūṃ sauḥṃ hra ha hūṃ 2 hūṃ namaḥ svāhā śirasi || iti mantrasahasrākṣarī nyāsaḥ || || (fol. 8r5–9) «Colophon: » iti ṣoḍhānyāsaḥ || 6 || || divaḥ śataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ niśāyāṃ yo nyasen manuṃ | bhuktvā vāpyathavā bhuktvā dharma sā siddhim āpnuyāt || ājñāsiddhikaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvvāpad vinivāraṇāṃ | yan nāsti tan na siddhis tu kaule kālikramānvayāt || || iti durvvāsopāsitaṣoḍhā || || haṃsatantre uktaṃ || || || (fol. 8r9–8v2)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || vedārthasārthaviparītavilokanena prāyo bhavaed yajanalopam avekṣya śāstraṃ || tatkūṭam aṭṭaviśajī(!)karaṇena jāta- dānakṣamasva tava pādayugena yāce || sahasrāre mahāpadme tatopari rahasyavit || caraṇadvayasaṃbhūtau svecchāvigrahadhāriṇau || devadevyau tathā nāthā na svamaṃtrayutān smaret || guruñ ca gurupatnīñ ca devadevīṃ vibhāvayet || prātaḥprabhṛtisāyāntam ityādi || iti saṃprārthanāpūrvaṃ praṇamya gurupādukām || bahir nigacchet śuddhātmā puṇyadeśāntadūrataḥ kṛtvāvaśyakam āsthāya śaucācamanapūrvakaṃ || gaṇḍūṣaṃ dantakāṣṭhañ ca kṛtvā cācamya vāgyataḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) «End: » sarvvavyāhṛtisaṃsthāto bhūdevyā saṃbhuśaktayaḥ || namo nama manasi sthitā nāthāya yatkar(ma) kāryaparāya svāhā || caraṇaṃ pavitram ityādi vedāgamavacanam || śāṃbhavaṃ caraṇaṃ dhyātvā saccidānandalakṣaṇam | pavitraṃ paramaṃ sākṣāt purāṇaṃ paramāmṛtam || yena pūtā mahātmānaḥ kṣaṇāt saṃsārasāgarāt || samuttīrya parānandaṃ bhuñjante paraśāṃbhavam || tasmiṃścitte layaṃ kṛtvā tadrūpo ham iti smaret || ityānandaparaḥ sarve prāṇabuddhir layo bhavet || || (fol. 14r1–4) «Colophon: » iti ṣaḍnvayaśāmbhavaraśmipūjākramaḥ || || 1982 || āṣāḍhakṛṣṇa || ekādaśī || guruvāsare || śubham || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 14r4–5)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgurubhyo || vedārthasārthaviparītavilokanena prāyo bhavad yajanalopam avekṣaṇan tu | tatkūṭam aṭaviśajīkaraṇena jāta doṣa(!) kṣamasva tava pādayugena yāce || sahasrāre mahāpadme tatopari rahasyavit || caraṇadvayasaṃbhūtau svecchāvigrahadhāriṇau || devadevyau tathā nāthān svasvamantrayutān smaret ||guruñ ca gurupatnīñ ca devadevīṃ vibhāvayet || prātaḥprabhṛtisāyāntaṃ tyādi(!) || iti saṃprārthanā pūrvvaṃ praṇa[mya] gurupādukāṃ || bahir nnirgacchet suddhātmā punya(!)deśāntadūrataḥ || (fol. ka r 1–5 ) «End: » tataḥ paracaṇḍā bali tilakavat || caraṇaṃ pavitram ityādi vedāgamamam (!) eva ca || śāmbhavacaraṇaṃ dhyātvā saccidānandalakṣaṇaṃ || ye bhūtā ca mahātmānaṃ ⟨ya⟩ kṣaṇāt saṃsārasāgarāt || samuttīrya parānande bhuṃjate paraśāṃbhavaṃ || tasmin cittalayaṃ kṛtvā tadrūpohitī(!) smaret || ity ānanda yataḥ pūrvaṃ prāṇabuddhir(!) layo bhavet || (fol. da v 2–5) «Colophon: » iti ṣaḍanvayaśāmbhavapūjā || śrīnavātmāprītir astu || śibhaṃ (fol. da v 5)

«Beginning: » ❖ śrīgurave namaḥ || āvāhanaṃ na jānāmi na jānāmi visarjjanaṃ | pūjāṃ caiva na jānāmi tvaṃ gatiḥ śrīguro vibho | iti saṃprārthya pañcamudrābhiḥ praṇamet || yathā || 4 drāṃ sthāpana || 4 drīṃ caturasra || 4 klīṃ matsya || 4 blūṃ gomukha || 4 saḥ yonimudrā || iti paṃcamudrābhiḥ praṇamya || || hetave janatām eva saṃsārārṇavasetave | prabhave sarvavidyānāṃ śaṃbhave gurave namaḥ || evaṃ punarnnatvā karāṃjaliṃ badhvā || prātaḥprabhṛtisāyāṃtaṃ sāyādiprātar natataḥ yatkaromi jagannātha tad astu tava pūjanaṃ || punaḥ prāṛthayet || (fol. 1v1–4) «End: » śānti nogastisaṃjñaś ca pñcārthākhya gurus tataḥ | vidyācāryo vratācāryo durvāsā kauśiko mataḥ || jaigīśopi vratācāryyaḥ kauṇḍinyācārya eva ca | bhairavaṣṭakasaṃñañ ca aṅgārakagurus tatahā || viśvanātho tha someśo vaśiṣṭho viśvarūpakaḥ | gaṃgādharaguruś caiva śrīśaṃkaragurus tathā || nārāyaṇāpadāntena śrīmad vīrādyavigrahaḥ || guruśrīvimalānandā deśikendreti gīyate || teṣāṃ pādaprasādena rāmānandaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || gurupādaratas tasmād bhairavānandasaṃjñakaḥ || ete vai paripāṭyoktā pāśupatagurukramaḥ || teṣāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa pāpān dahati tatkṣaṇāt || śrīgurudevatāyai namaḥ || || (fol. 65v1–5) «Colophon:» iti śrīyogīndracūḍāmaṇisarvvaśāstraviśāradasakalavedādhyāyīsarvāgamanipuṇaśrīśāmbhavācārya śrīśrīśrīvidyānandanāthaśrīgirutaccaraṇakamalenivāsinā kāruṇyānandanāthena kṛtāyāṃ śrīśambhukramadīpikāyāṃ prathamaḥ prakāśaḥ śubhaṃ bhūyāḥ || (fol. 64v5–7) iti śrīvidyāpaddhatiparāprāsādaśāmbhavaprātaḥkṛtisnānasaṃdhyāvidhi samāptaṃ || || samvat 808 phālguṇa śuddhi 14 saṃpūrṇayāṅā divasa || (fol. 65v5–6)

«Beginning: » ❖ śrīgurumūrttir jayati || atha mahāṣoḍhānyāsaḥ || ays śrīparāprāsādamantrasya paraśambhuṛṣiḥ avyaktagāyatrīchandaḥ sarvamantreśvarī śrīparāmbādevatā hsāṃ bījaṃ hsīṃ śaktiḥ hsūṃ kīlakaṃ mama śrīgurudevatāprāsādasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || pañcabrahmamantrair agulīnyāsaṃ vidhāya hsāmityādityādinā ṣaḍaṅgaṃ kuryāt || || tadyathā || (exp. 2t1–3) «End: » aṃgulyādau tadagre ca nyaset pāṇitalepi ca || vāmabāhudaśasthāne nyased evaṃ krameṇa hi | āsane dakṣapādasya pādamūle tato pyadhaḥ || jānudeśe tatodhastāt tadadhaḥ prapadepi ca || aṃgulyādau tad agre ca nyaset pādatale pi ca || vāmapādadaśasthāne nyased evaṃ krameṇa hi | evaṃ vinyastagātre yaḥ sa sākṣād devatā samaḥ || mantrasiddhir bhavet tasya triṃśad vāreṇa maṇdalāt || iti guhyam idaṃ devi tāṃśaye kulanāyake || ityuktarītyā japtvā japaṃ śrīgurave nivedya || svadehaṃ mahāṣoḍhoktam akhilaṃ smare || śivoham iti niściṃtya ṣoḍaśārṇāṃ japet || (exp. 9b8–10t2) «Colophon:» iti śrīmaheśānandanāthaśrīcaraṇaparicaryāparāyaṇa śrīśaṃkarānaṃdanāthena viracitāyāṃ śivārccanadīpikoddhṛtāyāṃ śrīguruśāṃkaryāṃ nyāsakāṇḍe mahāṣoḍhānyāsanirūpaṇaṃ nāma caturthopadeśaḥ samāptaṃ || || (!) «Beginning» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrī3 siddhilakṣmīdevyai namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || || kautyāhutisiddhāgniyajñadinakṛtyavidhir likhyate || tritattvena ācamya sūryārghaṃ adyādi || vākya || varṇāntaṃṇ bījam udhṛtyetyādi arghaṃ namaḥ || puṣpaṃ namaḥ || hrāṁ hrīṁ hrū hreṁ hrauṁ hraḥ hrīṁ saḥ śrīkulamārttaṇḍamahābhailavāya prakāśaśaktisahitāya namaḥ || ▒ śrīmahāmārttaṇḍabhairavāya namaḥ || gurunamaskāra || aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ ▒ ▒ alkhaṇḍamaṇḍalākālaṃ tyādi (!) || gurur brahmā gurur viṣṇu gurudevamaheśvaraṃ | gurudeva jagatsarvaṃ tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) «End» sopvanāga (!) || oṁ jūṁ saḥ varuṇāya svāhā || bhujaṅgamaṇicūḍāya nānāratnavibhūṣiṇe || viśajjvālāvakīrṇāya tasmai nāgāya vai namaḥ || thaṇḍila || navākṣarīṇa (!) || utphullāmbujakarṇītyādi || || kṣetri āvāhana || navākṣarīṇa || śrīlakṣmī pratidehayogaparamānandāravindodbhavā || rāmāratnaśiromaṇiḥ khalu mahālakṣṃīr mahāmaṅgalā || madhye śaktipayodharā tribhuvanālaṅklārasaṃbandhitā || senduś candrakalādharāguṇarasā śrīkālikā yoginī || tataḥ saṃkhyāhutiḥ || ṛtvigjanena agnisūtraṃ paṭhet (!) || ṛtvigjanādi bhojanam kārayet || (fol. 81v3–82r1) «Colophon(s):» iti dinakṛtya samāptaḥ || || || ❁ || || || śubhaṃ || samvat 811 kāttikaśuklanavamī thva kuhnu śrīśrīsumatijayajitāmitramalladevasana dayakā juroṃ || śubham astu sarvvvadā || (fol. 82r1–2)

«Beginning» ❖ śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || || śrīdevy uvāca || ṣoḍhānyāsaḥ śrutas tvatto mahāsiddhir mahāphalaḥ || yatnena vidhṛtasyāpi mahābhaktipravīṇayā || trailokyamohanannāma kavacaṃ me dhunā vada || kavacena tvayā devī śivayogā svayaṃ mudrā (!) || tat kīdṛśaṃ hi bhavitā tatra kautūhalaṃ mama || yadi prasannāsmi (!) mayi tadehaṃ vadasyapraadṃ(!) || sarvvasyād adhikaṃ hy etat tvayaiva samudāhṛtaṃ || nityemāmuñca nityañ ca jāto mama tadāgrahaḥ || || (fol. 1v1–4) «End» vivāde mraṇe trāse mahāmārīgadādiṣu || duḥsvapne bandhane ghore bhūtāveśe grahoṅgatau || vicarad vahni rātrau ca nirbhayānāntarātmanā || ekāvṛtyā ‘ghanāśaḥ syād dvirāvṛtyāyur āpnuyāt || śatāvṛṭyā sarvasiddhiḥ sahasraiḥ khecaro bhavet || vallabhe ‘yutapāṭhena śiva eva na saṃśayaḥ || kiṃ vāde kiṃ vivacojānaiḥ(!) satyaṃ satyaṃ vravīmi te || catus trailokyalābhena trailokyavijayī bhavet || trailokyākarṣaṇo mantro trailokyavijayas tathā || trailokyamohanaṃ caiva trailokyavaśakṛn manuḥ || 5 || etat catuṣṭa (exp. 6b1–5) «Colophon(s):» x

«Beginning» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya || tato yogayāyamāla kohnuyā vidhi || oṃ namaḥ śrīśrīsiddhilakṣmyai || tataḥ siddhilakṣmīkrama arddharātridīpajāgavidhir likhyate || || prathame kāṃśasthālīsaṃskāra || carusādhanaṃ || || ācamya || khphreṃ ātmatattvāya svāhā || khphreṃ vidyātattvāya svāhā || khphreṁ śivatattvāya svāhā || sūryārgha || adyādi || vākya || kalikarukhakṛtāntaś caṇḍamārttaṇḍabhūmau || rajasakalakullālījñānasaukhyārccidātā || tithipaṭalamanūnāṃ tvaṃjanenārghahastā || kusumajalaphalārghas tvāṃ kulārkkan namāmi || arghan namaḥ puṣpaṃ namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–7) «End» atra gandhadhūpadīpayajñopra(!)vītaarccane pūjanavidhi tatsarvaṃ paripūrṇam astu || || candrasūryadvayakumbha yajamāna hlāya || varṇāntāgni harapavanajalakālabhūmāya saṃsthaṃ || sānusvāratribhuvanagu(rus) tumburu suprasiddhaḥ | ete maṃtraṃ vilikhitayā khyā(!)layiutvā tadūrdhve || bhuje akalakale (!) māsa yānti || (!) akhaṇaika(!) lasānanda kele paraśu dhānmani | (!) svacchandasphuraṇa mantra nidhehi kularūpiṇi || || (!) vira(!)jana anyonya namaskāra || yathāsukhaṃ viharet || || (fol. 82v8–83r5) «Colophon(s):» iti śrīkaravīrayāgasiddhilakṣmīmata (!) samāptaṃ || || ❁ || || thvate yogayāgamayā vidhānaṃ ṅaya svahnujurasā vīrajāgaguporakhāṅāva yāya māla || || yāgaśamapākvahnu bali juko dhāre viyamāla || niśibali || || śrīśrīśrī svaṣṭa(!)devatāprītir astu || || śubham astu || || ❁ || || (fol. 83r5–83v1)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ sādhakaḥ sukhāsanenopaviśya mūlenācamya oṃ vajra bhūme hūṁ oṁ medinivajrī bhava vajrabaṃdhavaṃ oṁ vajraprākāra bhruṁ khaṁ hūṁ oṁ gha gha ghātaya ghātaya sarvaduṣṭān hūṁ phaṭ oṃ kīlaya kīlaya sarvapāpāni hūṁ phaṭ ityanena bhūmirakṣāṃ kṛtvā oṁ sthānaṃ me rakṣa hūṁ oṁ ((yogaṁ me rakṣa hūṁ oṃ)) ātmānaṃ me rakṣa hūṁ ityanenātmarakṣā vidhāya prāṇāyamaṃ kuryāt (exp. 3t1–5) «End» iti nyāsān kṛtvā saptadaśamukhaṃ ṣaṭsaptatibhujaṃ śaktisahitaṃ dhyānoktarūpaṃ mahāherukaṃ dhyātvā mānasair upacāraiḥ saṃpūjya oṁ vajravailocanīye hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ svāhā iti śaktimūlamantraṃ yathāśakti saṃjapya oṃ śrīvajra heheruruka hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ ḍākinījālasaṃvarasvāhā iti mūlamaṃtraṃʼ yathāśakti japitvā mūlena japaṃ samarpyāca mya praṇamya visarjayet saṃpuṭa japet oṃ vajravairocanīye hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ svāhā oṁ śrīvajraheherurukahūṁ hūṁ phaṭ ḍākinījālasaṃvara svāhā oṃ vajravairocanī hūṁ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || iti mamtrasvarūpam (exp. 4b7–5t5) «Colophon(s):» iti saṃkṣepajapapaddhatiḥ śrīherukāya namaḥ śubham śubhaṃ (exp. 5t6)

«Beginning» vā ca brahmacaryena rātrau kuryād yathecchayā || vāmadakṣiṇayogena mahānyāsaṃ samācaret || sahasrāvarttanenaiva puraścaraṇam ucyate || tadeva saṃkṣapayā (!) devi ājñāsiddhim avāpnuyāt || ayutena khecaratvaṃ lakṣena bhairava(!) bhavet || melāpatvaṃ ca nirvvāṇaṃ dvilakṣaṇa bhaveddhuvaṃ || etat parataraṃ nāsti kaulike kulaśāsane || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || nānayā sadṛśī vidyā trṣu lokoṣu vidyate || (exp. 2t1–5) «End» anāhate || 4 paṃ 5 svarggacarīlakṣmī 8 9 bhaghaṃ vā ḍa ṣāṃ vārāhi ḍhaṃ ṣāṃ unmattabhairava || viśuddhau || 4 yaṁ 5 ṇiricarī lakṣmī aiṁ aiṁ kilikilyaṃ vā aiṁ śāṃ indrāṇī aiṁ śā kapālabhairava || ājñāyāṃ || 4 śaṁ 4 vanacarī lakṣmī oṁ auṁ kālarātryaṃ vācā muṇḍā oṁ vāgbhīṣaṇabhairava || bhāle || 4 luṁ kṣaṃ jaladdhilakṣmīparāmvā bhairavārādhitāyai 2 || vyāpakaṃ || (exp. 22b5–9) «Colophon(s):» iti triḍaśaḍāmale siddhilakṣm〉ā mahābari saṃpūrṇa || (exp. 22b9)

«Beginning» ❖ oṃ namo mahābhairavāya || śrīdevyuvāca || śrutā deva mayā śambhu āgamāni anekadhā || mukhadoṣagatā mantrā ajñānaiś ca vināśitā || asuddhā staṃbhitā bhinnā dhvaṃsitā jñānacetase | anena kāraṇārthena prastāraṃ vada śūline(!) || siddilakṣmī mahādeva paṃcācalavinirgatā || kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa bījabhūtā vyavasthitā || tam ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi tvatprasādāc ca bhairava || yadi tuṣṭo si me śambho bhrānticchedaṃ kuruṣva me || (fol. 1v1–3) «End» guhanāsājvālāvvāyai viḍālo ūhakās tathā || manodhyakṣā pracaṇḍā ca khaḍgālāphetakāriṇī || yathāpūrvakrameṇaiva ṣoḍaśāni prapūjayet || paścād vaṭukaṃ mahābhāge pūjayed devi cāgrataḥ | devīputrapadaṃ likhya vaṭukanāthapadaṃ punaḥ || ehyehi baliṃ likhya pūjāṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇeti ca hrīṁ śrīṁ mādi svāhānta ca vaṭukapūjā īme matā || (!) kṣetrapālāya saṃlikhya ehyehi padaṃ punaḥ || baliṃ gṛhna gṛhnoccārya oṃ kṣāṃ mādi svāhāntagaṃ || kṣetrapāla bali hyeṣāṃ sarvvabhūtabaliṃ śṛṇu |(!) devatebhyaḥ padaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvayoginibhyo caret || (!) baliṃ gṛhṇagṛhnoddhṛtya hrīṁ śrīṁ mādi svāhāntagaṃ | sarvvabhūtabalir hyeṣā kathitā bhrāntivarjjitā || dātavyāmīśadigbhāge sarvopadravanāśanī || || (fol. 9r6–9v3) «Colophon(s):» iti paṃcācalaprastāravinirgatā siddhalakṣmīmantrārcanavidhiḥ || ❁ || śrībhavānīprītir astu || || śubham astu sarvvadā || || (fol. 9v4)

«Beginning» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śīgurubhyo namaḥ || || śrīmahābhairavāya namaḥ || candrārkānalamaṇḍalāvṛtapade siṃhāsane saṃsthite dharmādharmapuṭākṣade navakalā vāmādisaṃbhūṣite | tasthaḥ somamarīcimaṇḍitajaṭaḥ somo mahābhairavaḥ || śrīmān śrīkramamātṛcakrasahitaḥ sa śrīguruḥ pātu vah || || athaḥ (!) prāta(ḥ)kṛṭyaṃ || śaktiḥ kunḍalinīti yāti ganitā(!) ā īmasaṃjñāyagan nirmāṇe śatatodyatāpraviraśat sauḍāminī saṃnibhā | śaṃkhāvarttanibhāṃ prasuptabhu(ja)gākāraṃ jaganmohinīṃ || tanmadhye paribhāvayed viśaratā tan būya menākṛtiṃ || || (fol. 1v1–6) «End» oṃ apasarpantu te bhūtā ye bhūtā bhuvi saṃsthitā || ye bhūtā bighnikarttā ca ste naśyantu śivājñayā || it paṭhitvā aiṃ 5 hraḥ astrāya phaṭ daśadiśi kṣipet || bhūmiṃ tāḍayet vāmapādena tālatrayaṃ || 3 || aiṃ 5 hraḥ astrāya phaṭ narācamudrayā digbandhanaṃ kṛtvā candanādibhiḥ saṃpūjya || stuti || namaste vīrabhadrāya vīrasiṃhāya te namaḥ || gaṇeśakṣetrapālāya vaṭukāya namāmyaham || gaṃgā ca yamunā caiva sarasvatyai namo nmaaḥ || dvārarakṣmyai śriyā devyai dvārarakṣāṃ kuruṣva me || atra gandhādi || vāmāṅgasaṃkocanaṃ kṛṭvā || maṇḍapaṃ praviśya || iti dvārapūjā || || (fol. 24v1–7) «Colophon(s):» iti śrī anantānantadevasya caraṇakamalayugalevāsina śrī ajitānandadevena saʼgrahasamuccaya kṛtaṃ śrīmahākramārcane paṃcamakalpaḥ || 5 (fol. 24v7–8)

«Beginning» ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || samvarttāmaṇḍalānte kramapathanihitānandaśaktiḥ subhīmā sṛṣṭinyāye catuṣkaṃ akulakulagataṃ pañcakaṃ cānyaṣaṭkaṃ catvāraḥ pañcakonya punar api caturas tattvato maṇḍaledaṃ saṃṣṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namatha guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaṃ sṃvarttāsūtrasyārthaṃ vyākhyāyate yathā || namatha iti kiṃ | śrīkujeśaṃ | kujāyāḥ īśa kujeśa kujāśabdena kuṇḍalinīśaktir ity abhidhīyate | īśa śabdena bhairava ucyate || tatsamāyogād kujeśaḥ | bhairava iti kiṃ bharaṇāt āpūrṇād taṃ bhairavam ucyate | (fol. 1v1–5) «End» pathadvayaṃ kiṃ | pathadvayaṃ uttaradakṣiṇaś ceti | uttaraśabdena somasthānaṃ || dakṣiṇaśabdena sūryasthānaṃ || iti ṣoḍaśadvādaśakalābhiḥ parivṛtadahanatāpanaśoṣaṇa iti dakṣiṇapathaḥ | somapathaḥ | ṣoḍaśakalāvyūhaparivṛtamaṇḍalākārarūpeṇa amṛtādhāravarṣamāṇa caturbhutagrāmajananapatipālanārthe pitṛyāna devayāna mahāyāna a āsvarādau sakalatāpūranaḥ khaḍgīśādibhiḥ paraṃ rūpaṃ kakṣayet | śeṣavarṇā yugmaṃ parādyāṃ kuṇḍalinī kuṇḍalākāradhvajinī adhaḥ pucchaśirākṛtiḥ halākārā paṃcāśdvarṇarūpiṇī | varṇān utpādayanti ṣaḍvarṇavidhātmaka iśravarṇam upajāyate || saṃkṣepeṇa mayā khyātaṃ saṃvarttāsūtranirṇayaṃ || vistareṇa nayā khyātaṃ lakṣapādādhike mate || sārāt sārataraṃ bhadre tadasnehaprakāśitaṃ || saṃvarttā ye na jānanti na te jānanti śrīmataṃ || śrīmatena vinā devi vṛthā jñānapariśramaṃ aprakāśyam paraṃ jñānaṃ itarāṇā na darśitaṃ || || (fol. 7v11–8r6) «Colophon(s):» iti śrīmatottare śrīkaṇṭhanāthāvatārite śrīkulālikāmate vidyāpīṭhe goginīguhye śrīsadgarbhasāranirṇaye saṃvartākramasūtranirṇayo nāma prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 1 || || (fol. 8r6–7)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha sāmānya homavidhir likhyate || || hastau pādau pakṣyālya praṇavena trir ācamya || oṃ gaṃge ceti jalapātraṃ saṃśodhya || gaṃgādibhyo namaḥ || oṃ āṃ āsanamantrasya merupṛṣṭhaṛṣiḥ sutalaṃ chandaḥ kūrmo devatā āsana upaveśane viśana viniyogaḥ || āsanādhaḥ maṃḍalaṃ likhitvā ādhāraśaktikamalāsanāya namaḥ || iti saṃpūjya āsanaṃ dhṛṭvā paṭhet || oṃ pṛthvī tvayā dhṛtā loketi saṃśodhya | upaviśya prāṅmukho vāpy udaṅmukhaḥ || (exp. 3t1–6) «End» nānā puṣpa taye || nānā puṣpa sugaṃdhāni māladyakusumodya || saubhāgye siddhidaṃ bhadre puṣpārohanam uttamaṃ || || sudhūsiṃdhūravarnābhā patākākarṇapūrvakā gṛhāna paramyasānā catukone caturbhujaṃ patākāpaṃcavarnābhā karnayoparo saṃbinī pamcabhutvamikā paṃca daityayaṃ chemanilūmalaṃ || sidhānaṃ dadhipāpanaṃ ca saganaṃ sapūrnacandrapramaṃ prāyono duritughanāsanakari ḥ (exp. 15t4–15b3) «Colophon(s):»

«Beginning» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīśrīśrīsiddhilakṣmīdevyai namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || || koṭyāhutisiddhāgniyajñadinakṛtyavidhir likhyate || tritattvena ācamya || khphreṁ hrāṁ ātmatattvāya svāhā || khphreṁ hrīṁ vidyātattvāya svāhā || khphreṁ hrauṁ śivatattvāya svāhā || sūryārghaṃ adyādi || vākya || varṇāntaṃ bījam uddhṛtya tasyopari śivaṃ nyaset || ādimadhyāvasāneṣu agnitraya(vi)bhūṣitaṃ || marmmaṇā dīpitaṃ kṛtya sāvitryāparabhūṣitaṃ || eṣa kūṭavaraṃ sreṣṭhaṃ mahāmārttaṇḍabhairavaḥ || arghaṃ namaḥ || puṣpaṃ namaḥ || (fol. 1r1–7) «End» kṣetri āvāhana || oṁ hrīṁ hūṁ hāṁ phreṁ ksoṁ kroṁ namaḥ svāhā || śrīlakṣṃī pratidehayogaparamānandāravindodbhavā || rāmā ratnaśiromaṇiḥ khalu mahālakṣmīr mahāmaṅgalā || madhye śaktipayodharā tribhuvanālaṃkārasambandhitā || senduś candrakalādharā guṇarasā śrīkālikā yoginī || tataḥ saṃkhyāhuti || || ṛtvigjanena agnisūtraṃ paṭhet || ṛtvigjanādibhojanaṃ kārayet || || (fol. 132r7–131v1) «Colophon(s):» iti dinakṛtyavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || (fol. 132v1)

«Beginning» oṃ namaḥ śrīgurave || aiṁ klīṁ sauṁ bālāvidyā || || hsauṁ hsīṁ hsauṁ bhairavīvidyā || || ▒ ▒ ▒ paṃcadaśīvidyā || || hrĩṁ śrĩṁ oṃ sauṀ aiṁ klīṁ sauṁ ▒ ▒ ▒ haṃsaḥ || sauṁ krīṁ aiṁ sauṁ ṣiḍaśīvidyā || aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ hsauṁ sauṁ aiṁ + +aiṁ śrĩṁ mahānirvvāṇeśvarānandanāthaīśvarīsahitāya sarvvādhikāro siddhāntodbhava hsauṁ aiṁ śrīṁ pādukāṃ namaḥ || sarvvādhikāramokṣavidyā || || aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁaiṁ krīṁ kāmeśvarī kāmeśvari aiṁ hrīṁ klīṁ ▒ vajreśvarīśrīpādukāṃ namaḥ || vajreśvarīvidyā || || aiṁ hrīṁ sauṁ ▒ bhagamālinīśrīpādukāṃ namaḥ || bhagamālinīvidyā || || (exp. 3b1–4t4) «End» yā devī navajīvanaṃ ++++ baṃdhūkakālīnibhāṃ śrīmukuṇḍa caiva kuṇḍayoḥ (!) śaktistvāṃ navatāriṇīṃ trinayanīṃ jhaṃkārabījodbhavāṃ tārkṣathāṃ bṛṣavāhinīṃ bhagavatīṃ śrīcaṇḍayogeśvarīṃ pāyād vaḥ parameśvarīṃ bhagavatīṃ śrīdevījhaṃkeśvarīṃ ||(!) kṣetrāṇāṃ kṣetranāthaṃ tribhuvananamitāṃ danturaṃ bhairaveśaṃ bhūtānāṃ nātha rudraṃ kili kilitaravaṃ cāṣṭakṣetro pravṛndaṃ (!) || sarvajñāṃ sarvabhāvaṃ sakalaguṇanidhiṃ sarvaśatrukṣayaṃ ca || kṛṣṇaṃ caivākuleśaṃ jagatabhayaharaṃ naumi jhaṃkeśvareśaṃ || mahāmāyā saṃvarttā yathāśakta(!)stuti (!) || (exp.19t1–19b4 ) «Colophon(s):» iti rudrayāmale kūṭamantranirvvāṇādikathanaṃ nāma śrī umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde samarase mantrakhaṇḍaḥ samāptaḥ || (exp. 19b4–5)

«Beginning» (saptamaṃ)? || thvanaṃ bali || aghoramantrena śiṣāpūjanaṃ || mūlasa nirvvānamantrana | balivisyaṃ haṃ || aiṃ 5 sarvapīṭhopapīṭhāni dvāropadvārameva ca || kṣetropakṣetrasaṃhāḥ sarvadigbhāsasaṃsthitā || yoginī yogavīredrā sarvaḥ tatra samāgatā || ida parva mahācakra śrīnātho varado mama || 5 bhaktāḥ sāsane devī gurupādārcane rate | sarvasiddhiprasādo me devī tekhāṃ bhavet sadā || (exp. 2:1–5) «End» 5 ā āmādyai payadvayapādukāṃ || 5 phaṇikhisavāmapārśve pādukāṃ || ṣalambodaryai udare pādukāṃ || 5 acchagaṇḍaṇḍapṛsṭavaṃse pādukāṃ || 5 kṣaḥ + hārinyai nābhimadhye pādukāṃ || 5 ruddhiraṇḍanābhimadhye pādukāṃ || 5 maṃ mahākālyai nitrambapādukāṃ || 5 maṃ mahākālahṛdayamadhye pādukāṃ ||5 śakusudhāmājudhāyai guhyapādukāṃ || 5 yavalisatvaramadhye pādukāṃ (exp. 13b4–8) «Colophon(s):» x

«Beginning» || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || vāsasī paridhāya tūṣṇīṃ dvir ācamya tilakaṃ vidhāya vaidikasaṃdhyottaraṃ tāntrikasaṃdhyāṃ kuryāt | sā caturvidhā | tatra prātaḥ saṃdhyā yathā | prathamakūṭam uccārya | ātmatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | dvitīyakūṭam uccārya vidyātatvāṃ śodhayāmi svāhā tṛtīyakūṭam uccārya śivatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | samasta vidyām ucccārya sarvatattvaṃ śodhayāmi svāhā | ity ācamya | prakṣālitadakṣiṇahastakuśair vāmahastapādau śiraś cābhyukṣa | tarjanyaṃguṣṭhayogena spṛśen nāsāpuṭadvayaṃ | madhyamāṃguṣṭhayogena spṛśe((n netradvayaṃ tataḥ | aṅguṣṭḥasvānāmikāyāyogena śravaṇe spṛśet | kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayogena spṛśe))t skandhadvayaṃ tataḥ nābhiṃ ca hṛdayaṃ tadvat spṛśet pāṇitalena tu | saṃspṛśec ca tathā śīrṣamayam ācamane vidhiḥ | (fol. 1v1–2r3) «End» taṃtrarāje nityātikramadoṣāṇāṃ śāṃtyai vidyāṃ śataṃ japet | anyatrāpi snānasaṃdhyārcanālope japed aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ iti | na kuryāt patitāṃ saṃdhyāṃ patite śatadhā japet || pūrvasaṃdhyāmanu paścāt tat tat saṃdhyāmanuṃ japet | etatvakamataḥ | kāmato dviguṇaṃ iti saṃkṣepaḥ || || ācāryaciṃtāmaṇineyam uddhṛtā śrīrājarājeśvarīdevatāyaḥ || saṃdhyāvidhānakramacandrikeyaṃ śubhāya bhūyād vijitāridikpateḥ || 1 || || (fol. 9r4–9) «Colophon(s):» iti saṃdhyācatuṣṭayavidhānaṃ || || (fol. 9r9)

«Beginning» ❖ mālāmantraṃ siddhilakṣmyāḥ śrīmataḥ parameśvari | śreṣṭheyaṃ sarvvamantrāṇāṃ daśonātriśatākṣarī | anayā ‘ rādhitā rājyalakṣmī rājyaphalapradā | (!) ataḥ paraṃ prayatnena gopanīyaṃ phalārthibhiḥ | praṇavaṃ hārddamantrau ca sarvvasiddhipadaṃ tataḥ | nyasantāṃ yoginīm uktvā hṛnmantrāt sarvasiddhyapi | (fol. 1r1–4) «End» jvalitasya ca te varṇṇe tathā pañcaśatī gatā || nirmale hūṁphaḍante ca saṃpūrṇā ṣaṭśatī priye || ḍāmareśvari me varṇṇe saptaśaty agaman tathā || rāvarṇṇe rāsabhānanyā samāptāṣṭaśatī manoḥ | saṃkarṣiṇyas tathā kārṇṇe navaśatyagamat punaḥ | pūrṇaṃ sahasraṃ varṇānāṃ svāhānte parameśvari | siddhilakṣṃyā iti mayā sahasrākṣariko manuḥ || jāmalādr viniskṛṣya mayā te pratipāditaḥ | syūḥ saṃkhyā viṣayāḥ siṃdhāḥ kadācicchikadā api | kadāpi naitasya guṇās tridaśānām api priye | idānīm ayutākṣaryyāḥ samuddhāraṃ niśāmaya | pratyagṅirāsiddhilakṣmyā reka (fol. 6v5–7r3) «Colophon(s):»

«Beginning» ❖ saṃti kvahnuyā vidhiḥ || || ācāryyana ināya alinikāya karacchoya || || thvate vāsape || || brahmā aṣṭakalaśa nāgapva yakṣā yakṣaṇī śrīlakṣṃī balipāta 4 gaṇa gogrāsa kaumāli dukhāpikhā ke vo thvate vosape || || thaṃkādisyaṃ yavodaka yāya vidhithyaṃ yāya || || ināya alinithena ṅāva cākaphaniṃ tapaṃ mūladvārasa lam soya || || nṛrmacchana yāya || oṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ balagahanaṃ vaiṣṇavīmidamahantaṃ bbalagamutkirāmi yamme niṣṭyoyamamātyo nicakhānedamahantaṃ balagamutkirāmi yamme sajāto yamasajāto nicakhānotkṛtyāṅkirāmi || ( fol. 1v1–6) «End» oṃ asuraghnamindrasadyaṃ samutsubṛhadyaśonāvamivāruhema | aho mucamāṃgirasaṃ gayaṃ ca svastyā aiyaṃ manā sā ca tājyaṃ prayatapāṇiḥ śaraṇaṃ prapadya svasti saṃvāde svabhayaṃ no ‘stu || || laṃsārāvathaṃ tāyane || || phanina kvaṭasyaṃ tāthe || || phanina vajinake || vepakalaṃkhacchoya || || (fol. 8r5–8) «Colophon(s):» thvanaṃli guruna vidhithyaṃ yācake || || || (fol. 8r8)

«Beginning:» ❖ saṃsārasāgarasamuttaraṇaplavasya sadya strivargaphalasambhava lagnakasya | naimittikārccanavidheḥ paripūraṇāya mātah karomi tava pārvvaṇa naktam arccāṃ || tato ‘kṣataṃ gṛhītvā sapasarpantu vetālā guhyakā vāmabhāgagāḥ | pretāḥ piśācāḥ naśyantu bhūtāḥ dakṣiṇabhāgagāḥ || rakṣāṃsi yakṣā nāgāś ca naśyantu purataḥ sthitāḥ || asurā dānavā daityā pṛṣṭhasthā yāntu ca kṣayaṃ | khecarā ye mahā raudrā raudrakarmaṇi yojitāh jṛmbhakāḥ ghoṇakāḥ sarve kṣayaṃ yāntūrdhvagāminaḥ || (exp. 2:1–6) «End:» ādhāre || tataḥ puṣpākṣatam ādāya oṃ + viśvabhūtadhātriviśvaṃbhave pātrādhāraṃ dhāraya 2 hūṁ phaṭ namaḥ || anena bhūmiṃ saṃpūjya hrīṁ phreṁ trilokīsaṃbhavāyai tripādikāyai namaḥ || iti tripādikāṃ prakṣālya sthāpayet || klīṁ svargalokāya namaḥ || (( klīṁ martyalokāya namah )) klīṁ pātālalokāya namaḥ || aiṁ āṁ uṁ māninyamapane yāmye nāmi dhunomi svāhā || iti prakṣālya phreṁ khphreṁ mūlapātram āmodayāmyabadhūnayāmi svāhā || iti saṃdhūpya || oṁ chrīṁ strīṁ mūlādhāraṃ dhara 2 svāhā || iti sthāpayitvā || oṃ naktaṃ carebhyo namah || (exp. 3:37–43) «Colophon:» sadāśivakuḍalinīnaktapūjāmantranyāsa (exp. 3:43)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmīdevyaiḥ || || devy uvāca || bhagava(n) bhāṣitaṃ sarvaṃ guhyaṃ paramadurllabhaṃ | idānīṃ śrotum icchāmi tato nāmasahasrakaṃ || siddhilakṣm〉ā mahādevyāḥ sarvadevasudurllabhāṃ | prasīda kathyatāṃ tattvaṃ deva deva jagatpate || || śrīśiva uvāca || siddhilakṣmyā mahādevyāḥ śṛṇu nāmasahasrakaṃ || yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa śivaḥ sākṣād bhaven naraḥ || (fol. 1v1–2r1) «End:» ‘śraddhāya bhaktihīnāya nindakāya varānane || saubhāgyaṃ bha(r)tṛhartāñ ca rūpañ ca yauvanaṃ tathā || putrān api varārohe yoṣidāpnotyaśaṃsayaḥ || imam stotraṃ maheśāni gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || śiṣyāya bhaktiyuktāya dātavyaṃ stavamuttamaṃ || yadi dadyād abhaktāya śraddhāya ca sureśvarī || tadā mṛtyum avāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyahaṃ || 161 || || || (!) (fol. 24v1–25r2) «Colophon:» iti śrīrudrayāmale devī īśvarasaṃvāde śrīsiddhilakṣmyāḥ sahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ ḥ || || || śubha || (fol. 25r2–3)

«Beginning:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha saṃtānavidhiprāyaścittam | caturdhā jāyate baṃdhyā pūrvakarmavipākataḥ | garbhaṃ na dhatte yā nārī mahābandhyā prakīrttitā || 1 || ekaputraikakanyā ca kākabaṃdhyā ca sā smṛtā | mṛtaputrā mṛtakanyā mṛtavatsā tu sā smṛtā || 2 || tathā ca garbhapātādeḥ pūrarbho na jāyate | paṃcamī sā samākhyātā pūrvakarmavipākataḥ || 3 || ādau strīpuṃsayor janmapatrikāto vinirṇayaḥ || tadabhāve tu praṣṇād (!) vā vijñeyaṃ pātakaṃ tayoḥ || 4 || (exp. 2:1–6) «End:» iti strīprasūtāyāḥ prāyaścittam | atha māṣasuvarṇasya saphalaṃ dvādaśāṅgulam || sūtraṃ triguṇitaṃ kāryaṃ kāṃsyapātrasamanvitaṃ || homāṃte ca pradātavyam imaṃ mantraṃ prakalpayet || yanmayā pakṛtaṃ pūrvam ākheṭage nago vadhe || ajñānena vanoddeśe tatpāpaṃ pātu dānataḥ || sthiraṃ garbhaṃ tu me deva vāsudeva mahābala || kuru tvaṃ paromodāra(!) pāpaṃ me nāśaya drutam || || (exp. 3: 36–41) «Colophon:» iti garbhaśrāviṇīprāyaścittam || śrīśivāya namaḥ || (exp. 3: 41)

«Beginning» ❖ brāhmaṇa ācārya josi thvate sanaṃ sthirahārāva vayāva || maṇḍapanapi uttara soya majirasā pūrvva soyaṃte va || gajulicchā kuhnuyā thva velasa yāya || thvana hṅā o nail dinapatiṃ rajasā rāsakarmmārccana yāya dhūnaṅāva yāya || sāṭha caya pāṭhana uttarasa || madhyasa balicchapāta tayāva || pātana ṅuyakāva bali viya || tavarāja || || arghapātra || jalapātra || pañcabali || gaṇavaṭuka || thvate vanavāsana coyāva jiyake || || (fol. 1v1–2r1) «End» dakṣiṇā || ekāneka bhavanti mūrrti jagati pūrṇeśvarī vāsave bhūteśī gagaṇopame bhagavati niḥśeśvarī dakṣiṇe || jñānāgamyakujeśvarī kulagaṇe varuṇyadiṅnāyikā śrīvāmāṃ praṇamāmi viśvajananīṃ darśeśvarī siddhidā || aṃbe pūīrvvagataṃ padaṃ bhagavati caitanyarūpāimakā jñānecchā bahulā tathā hariharau brahmāmarīcitrakaṃ (!) | bhāsvad bhairavapaṃcakaṃ tad anu ca śrīyoginīpañcakakaṃ || candrārkā ca marīiṣaṭkam amalaṃ māṃ pātu nityaṃ kujā || || saṃhāramudrā balivisarjjanam || bali cchoya || pūrvapāṭa kūparācche || dakṣiṇa dathunāśvara || paścima vacchalā || uttara turahṅarāṣu || dathu dhvākhāyināya gorajā || vaṭuka dumāju dvaṃdu dakādupikhā ||(fol. 50v–51r1) «Colophon(s):» thvate sācayanauttarasa tavarāja pāṭha balipūjāvidhi || || ❖ samvat 824 vaiśāṣa śukla pakṣa tṛtīyā kuhnu śrī2 jaya bhūpatīndra malaa mahārājādhirāja sana siddhāgni ayutāhuti yajña yāṇā va galālacchapratiṣṭhā yāṅgā dina julo || śubha || (fol. 51v1–4)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmyai || asya śrīmahāṣoḍhānyāsamahākavacamantrasya śrīmahā(deva) paramātmā ṛṣi jagatī chanda (!) khphreṁ rājamātā śrīpratyaṅgirā rājeśvarī devatā sarva(śa)truvināśārthaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe viniyogaḥ || || hrīṁ hsauṁ hrīṁ || prāṇāyāmañ ca mahāṣaḍaṅgaḥ || oṁ hrīṁ hūṁ chrīṁ ▒ ▒ kāli 2 hrāṁ mahākāli hrīṁ māṃsaśoṇitabho(jani) raktakṛṣṇamukhīṃ devī māṃ mā paśyantu śatravaḥ śrīkālikāhṛdayadūtīśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ || hṛdaye || || (!) «Beginning:» śāna kubjike virūpe viśvarūpe dvibhuje caturbhuje aṣṭādaśabhuje śatabhuje sahasrabhuje sahasrābdabhuje sahasrābdakoṭibhuje varamālādhare nakṣatramālādhare vidyujjihve vidyutkoṭisannibhe mahā+śaṃkhamālādhale kabandhamekhalābhūṣite bhujaṃgakaṃkanabhūṣite mahārudrakubjike mahogramahākālikāsvarūpe dakṣiṇasiṃhāsanasthite dakṣiṇācāranindike vāmācālārccaṇapriye kulāmnāye kulācālapriye kulakaulike bhajālaye kuṇḍagolapriye kulāṣṭakaśaktirūpe sahasrābdakoṭipurṇṇābdalakṣādityanibhe kulakubjike unmattabhairavī bījamaye … (exp. 2:1–7) «End:» siddheśvarī mahāsiddhisiṃhāsanasthite sarvvasiddhiḥprade mahā(si)ddhayoginīvṛndamadhye siṃhāsanasthite paścimasiṃhāsanakramapūjite bāhyādivāmāvarttakramapūjakopāsakapriye pañcamakārasvarūpe pañcakakārakramapūjite pañcahakārakramapūjite pañcasakārakramapūjite mahāśavapriye mahākubjike varṇnatattve sarvvavarṇamaye āṁ phreṁ āṁ īṃ phreṁ kaṃ phreṁ aiṁ phreṁ jaṃ jhaṃ phreṁ jhṛṁ aiṁ phreṁ ao aiṁ phreṁ oṃ aṃ phreṁ aṃ aḥ phreṁ aḥ kaphreṁ 2 khaphreṁ 2 gaphreṁ 2 ghaphreṁ 2 (exp. 10b3–8) «Colophon:» x

Beginning ❖ śrī 3 mahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha niśivalyārccanavidhir likhyate || || snāna(!) || ūkā(2)raṃ vāyuvījaṃ tadupari paramaṃ vajrapāṇiṃ tadurddhaṃ kālaṃ varṇṇāntayuktaṃ tadupari para(3)maṃ vahnivījaṃ sahaṃsaṃ | induṃ vinduṃ layāntaṃ śitakamalavarakṣīradhārāśravantaṃ, dṛ(4)ṣṭvā kūṭantra nityaṃ dahati kulavaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśaṃ || || (fol. 1v1-4) «Middle» iti tridaśaḍāmare kanavīre śrīsiddhināthāvatāritaḥ śrīsiddhila(6)kṣmīmahāmāyāstavaḥ dvāviṃśatitamaḥ patalaḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 26r5-6) iti hārāvarāvatantre navākṣarī(fol. 29r5)stotra samāptaḥ || || End ātma āśīrvvāda || ambe pūrvvagataṃ padaṃ bhagavatī caitanyarūpātmikā, jñāne(2)cchā bahulā tathā hariharau brahmā marīcitrayaṃ | bhāsvad bhairavapaṃcakaṃ tadanu ca (3) śrīyoginīpaṃcakaṃ, candrārkkau ca marīci ṣaṭkam amalaṃ māṃ pātu nityaṃ kujā || || yajamānādina mālakostaṃ svāna biya || vācana laṃkhana hāya || ūkāraṃ vāyu(4)vījaṃ || ceta || śrīkhaṇḍaś candanaṃ divyaṃ || siṃdhra || vīreśvarīmahāvīra || svāna biya (5) || utphullāṃ || mālakostā biya || || astramantrana bali visarjjana yāya || no(6)siye || || bali bhokaluya || || sākṣī thāya || || bali choya || || (fol. 36v1-6) Colophon iti śrī(1)śrīśrīsiddhilakṣmīdevyai niśibalyārccanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || śubham astu || (fols. 36v6-37r1)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || lalitabhairava aghoraḥ mahāśāntividhiṃ vakṣye || oṃ akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākālaṃ vyāptaṃ jena carācaraṃ | tatpadaṃ drśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || gurunamaskāraṃ || oṃ padmāsnāya namaḥ oṃ kūrmāsnāya namaḥ || sva ātmāsanaṃ kṛṭvā || tato nyāsaḥ || oṃ rudrarūpebhyaḥ śāntyātītāya astrāya kalatalāya phaṭ || kalaśodhanaṃ || oṃ aghorebhyo nirvṛttiḥ aṃguṣthāya nama || oṃ thaghorebhyo pratiṣṭā tarjjanyaṃ namaḥ oṃ ghoraghorata(re)bhyaś ca vidyā madhyamāyai vauṣaṭ oṃ sarvataḥ sarvasarvebhyo śānti anāmikāya hūṃ oṃ namaste oṃ jūṃ saḥ kaniṣṭāye (!) vaṣaṭ || oṃ rudrarūpebhyaḥ sāntyātītāya astrāya phaṭ || iti karanyāsaḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) «End:» idaṃ gandhadhūpadīpārghaṃ bali gṛhna 2 sānti kuru 2 svāhā || ai 5 hu 3 laṃkeśvaraprathamabhūṭebhyaḥ idaṃ gandhadhūpadīpārghabali gṛhna 2 sānti kuru 2 svāhā || ai 5 hu 3 mahāvijayeśvaraprathamabhūtebhyaḥ idaṃ gandhadhūpadīpārgha bali gṛhna 2 sānti kuru svāhā || ai 5 hū 3 mahāvijayeśvara prathamabhūtebhyaḥ idaṃ gandhadhūpadīpārghabali hṛgna 2 sānti kuru 2 svāhā || ai 5 hū 3 amogheśvaraprathamabhūṭebhyaḥ idaṃ gandhadhūpadīpārghabali gṛhna 2 sānti kuru 2 svāhā || ai 5 hūṃ 3 mahāsmahāneśvaraprathamabhūṭebhyaḥ idaṃ gandhadhūpadīpārghabali gṛhna 2 sāntui kuru 2 svāhā || iti bhūṭabali || || (fol. 39v1–6) «Colophon:»

«Beginning» ❖ śṛīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || || athaḥ (!) śrī3 siddhilakṣmyādidevīsthāpanavarṣavarddhanadhvajāvarohana devyārcaṇāvidhir likhyet (!) || pithu saṃvāthere duthusaṃ patavāsana coya || || jāpūjā mālako voya || || pithu saṃpañcāyanapikāya || gaurī lakṣmīnārāyaṇa nirmarcchana yāya || ekā , plakāna gāle |\ oṃ jūṁ phaṭ anantaśakti astrāya phaṭ || 3 || bali viya || bhūtā ye vividhākālā bhūmidivyāntarīkṣagā || pātāletalavāsinyā te naśyanti (!) śivājñayā || baliṃ gṛhṇa 2 svāhā || || (fol. 1v1–5) «End» āvāhanādi || dhenumudrāṃ || gāyatrī || oṃ paśupāśāya vidmahe viśvakarmāya dhīmahi tamn no paśu pracodayāt || arkapātra sathu ṅāva samayana ke || kelaṃkha kāya taya || adyādi || vākya || paśu gṛhṇāmi deviśi prajñayā upavāsitaṃ || asyāpi svarggasaṃprāpti siddhilakṣmī prayaccha me || || mūhāyake || syāya || samaya cchoya || smaya kāya || || kalaśayā abhiṣeka || candanādi || āśirvāda || sākṣī thāya || vīrabhojya || kalaṃkāṃtaṃ || || (fol. 66r–66v2) «Colophon(s):» iti śrīsiddhilakṣmyādidevīsthāpanavarṣavardhanadhvajāvarohaṇa devāvārcaṇavidhiḥ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 66v3)

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ namo rudrāya || oṁ hrīṃ mahācaṇḍayogeśvarī jvalitamukhī jvālājihvājihvodarī bhīme mahābhīmabhāṣaṇi laṃbodarī viśvāntakī kālagrāsani kālanisūdani hā 4 sini mahābhairavi mahāśmaśānabhīmavāsini hruṃ caṇḍamukhimahācaṇḍayogeśvari hrīṃ ▒ ▒ phaṭ 5 mahāhajjubharuṭṭimahārāvinihaṃsiniglāhiṇīmāriṇī mohinīhuṃjāḥ2 svāhi2 vidrāviṇijaḥ jāhiḥ ▒ mahābhairavotsaṃgavasinimāhāmāṃsāsini nuda2 nṛuṭa2 he2 mahākāli thrīṃ dhrīṃ hrīṃ pāśadaṇḍadhāriṇi khorvvārimāhāmāribrahmāṇi māheśī kaumārī vaiṣṇavī vārāhī yāmye caṇḍamukhī āgneyī vāruṇi vāyavye kālamukhi…(fol. 1r1-4) «End» aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ gaṃ glūṃ gaṇapatināthaballabhā saha baliṃ gṛhna2 sarvvavighnān nāśaya2 huṃ phaṭ svāhā || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vaṃ plūṃ vaṭukanāthavallabhā saha baliṃ gṛhna2 savvavighnān nāśaya2 huṃ phaṭ svāhā || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kṣuṃ kṣlūṃ kṣetrapālavallabhā saha baliṃ gṛhna2 sarvvavighn(ā)n nāśaya2 huṃ phaṭ svāhā || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ pāṃ pluṃ sarvvayoginībhyo baliṃ gṛhna2 sarvvavighnān nāśaya2 huṃ phaṭ svāhā || śaṃkha (fol. 18r6-18v1) «Colophon» x

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīgurupādukebhyo namaḥ || śrī3 kubjikāsiddhilakṣmyai namaḥ || tato siddhilakṣmīkrama ardharātridīpajāgavidhi(r) likhyate || || atha kāṃśasthālīsaṃskāra(ḥ) || catuḥsaṃskāra || khvalājigolaṃ || thālaṃ || kumbhaṃ || || tritatvenācamya || sūryyāgha || adyādi || vākya || kalikaluṣakṛtāntetyādi || mārttaṇḍayā mantra || gurunamaskāra || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalātyādi(!) || (fol. 1v1-3) «End» catu(r)vidyā bhavet śaktī sādhako dīyate pada(!) || prakāśe śamaśāne(!) vā jaramadhyavanātare(!) || kārakkukuṭa(!)vīrasya tathārūpabhayaṃkaraṃ || bhojapatre likhebhakti(!) dāhināvāhumūlake(!) || sarvvasāntrakavirāṇāṃ jihvāgre vīra-āgate(!) vīraprākarmmasāmarthaṃ niścayaṃ dīyate sudhiḥ || (fol. 7v9-11) «Colophon» iti śrī-ugracaṇḍeśvarītantre mohinīvasaṃvāde(!) śrīvetālakavacaṃ samāpta(m) || || huṃ phaṭ mahāvīravetālāya vidmahe bhairavāsanāya dhīmahī tan no vīra(ḥ) pracodayāt (fol. 7v11)

«Beginning» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgurucaraṇārvvindābhyāṃ (!) || samvat 776 āśvini māse kṛṣṇapakṣe navamyāṃ tithau puṣya nakṣatre sādhye(!) yoge bṛhaspativārasare (!) tulārāśigate savitari karkkaṭarāśigate candramasi taddine ṛkṣatārambhaṃ || śivaṃ || īśādiṣaḍavaktrais tu ṣaḍāmnāye pravarttakaṃ | ādināthaṃ guruṃ vande jagatkāraṇaśaṃkaraṃ || (( natvā śivaṃ parānandaṃ brahmavidyāpravarttakaṃ || gurupaṃktistavaṃ vakṣye śiṣyānāṃ jñānahetave || )) śivaḥ ādau guru(ḥ) proktah tato viṣṇu prakīrttitaḥ || tato brahmāvaśiṣṭhaś ca tataś śakti parāśaraḥ || vyāsaḥ śuko gauḍapādo govindākṣaḥ guruḥ paraḥ || tataḥ śrīśaṃkarācāryā virūpācaryya eva ca || 3 || (fol. 1v1–2r1) «End» kuṇḍalanīṃ manoddanda(!) mudrayā manipure mathanaṃ kṛtvā kūrcabījena utthāpya || mūlādhārasvādhiṣthānamanipūrakānāhataviśuddhājñākhyā ṣaṭcakrakramena svayaṃbhuvāna itarākṣe liṅgatrayaṃ bhītvā (!) sahasradalakarṇikāntargatasthitaparamaśivopari paramaśive haṃsaḥ iti saha saṃjojya sāmarasaṃ vibhāvya || tara drūtāmṛtena lolībhūtāṃ tadudbhavamahāvi (fol. 9v3–8) «Sub-colophon(s):» iti gurukramaṃ || (fol. 9r7)

«Beginning» ❖ śrīmahācaṇḍikāyai || || atha śrīvidyāṣoḍhānyāsa(!) || oṃ asya śrīṣoḍhānyāsamantrasya śrīādiprakṛtiṛṣiḥ sirasi || mahatīcchandaḥ mukhe || śrīmahātripurasundarīdevatāḥ hṛdi || oṃ aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ 5 aiṁ ▒ tatsavitur variṇiyaṃ (!) bharggodevasya dhīmahi dhyo yona(ḥ) pracodayāt || paro rajasi(!) sāvado(m) | 5 bījaṃ || ((nābhau)) || oṁ aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ 5 klīṁ ▒ jātavedase sunavāma somamarātī yato nidadāti vedaḥ sa naḥ parṣadani durggāṇi viśvānā(ṃ) devasiṃdhuṃ duritātyagniḥ iti śakti guhye || … mama śrīgurudevatāprītyartheṃ (!) jape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1v1–2r3) «End» sarvasaṃkṣobhiṇyādimudrāṃ pradarśayet || punar mānasair upacāraiḥ saṃpūjya || śrīpañcamīr ārādhya punar prāguktavidhinā dhyātvā || upasaṃharet || śrīcakra(ṃ) catuḥṣaṣṭyo(!)pacāraiḥ saṃpūjya || japadaśāṃśena homayet || trilakṣapuraścaraṇaṃ kuryāt || siddho mantro bhogamokṣaphalapradaḥ || aṇimādisiddhayontarālatvenāsvarcyate || ityatra kimārścarya milamiti (!) prasaṃgena || lalitānandayogīndraracitā paddhatiḥ śubhā || sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya lalitāprītaye stu sā || (fol. 33v5–34r5) «Colophon(s):» iti lalitāmate iti saubhāgyanyāsapustakam idaṃ śubhaṃ || || śrīādiśaktir uvāca || atha vakṣye mahādevaṃ śrīvidyāyā anukramaṃ | ādyaṃ śrībījabhedākhyaṃ māyābījaṃ tṛtīyakaṃ || tṛtīyañca tathā kāmaś caturthaṃ vāgbhavaṃ smṛtaṃ || parādi pañcamaṃ proktaṃ tārādi ṣaṣṭhamāyutaṃ (!) || īśvaryādi tathā saptaṃ ramādyaṣṭaprabhedataḥ || śivādi navamaṃ proktaṃ daśamaṃ madanodbhavaṃ || śaktyā ekādaśaṃ jñeyaṃ dvā(da)śaṃ vāmaṣoḍaśī || vāgādi trayodaśañ ca ratyādīñ ca caturddaśaḥ || pañcadaśan brahmavidyā paraṃ brahmātmaṣoḍaśa (!) | etāḥ ṣoḍaśabhedāni ṣoḍaśīmantranāmakaṃ || iti ṣoḍaśīvidyāvidhiḥ || (fol. 34r5–34v5)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namo mahābhairavāya || senābhañjanayā basape vidhi || thāyayā anukramana pañcopahāra pūjā ju 1 | ḍola gvala 1 du neku tyā x, byā(2) ku 1, goḍa 1, du, ne ku 2 byā ku 1x || pyanthi gvala 1 du ku 14 || sukhahle pāta 12 || bhevata mālakva, vali kvatanā(3) ṣāla, dvandu, myālā naivedya, bhujāvana, navavali mālakva, ārathi, carapati, yajña yātasā homa ju 1, sirithi byālasiṃ, valasiṃ | phari(4)ṇilā cetakasiṃ, calasa lā, kañca lā, kañca ṅā, jiriphola, tāya, patavāsa, dhūni yitāla, cekana, dhūpavāsa, sindhra taṅgala 1 || (exp. 2r1–4) «Extracts:» iti hanurudrakalpa parisamāpta || (exp. 4r4) End kaumārārccaṇa kalaṃkāntaṃ || pehnuna hṅā hāthāra ṅāyake māla || bhagavatīsa pañcopacāra pūjā yā(6)va ceta svāna samaya || hṅavayā lenakan tayā || hyāṅu akṣata vāsara, sastrayā vāsara biya || hmaṃyā vāsaraṇa⟨ ⟩yele || ājāājina sakalastaṃ || thvate biyā(7)va hāthāla hṅyācake || akṣatana chuyake || cetana tecake vāsaraṇa yele, balā ādina sastra astrasa bole, hāthāla cākvasaṃ māla || (exp. 14b5–7) Colophon iti hanubhairavasenā(8)bhañjanavidhi samāpta || || ❖ saṃvat 747 caitravaddi 2 śukravāsare saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || śrīguroḥ prasādāt || śrīkālidāsena sañcitam || || (exp. 14b7–8)

Beginning śrī rāmāya namaḥ || || asya śrīśrīhanumatpañcākṣaradvādaśākṣara mālāmaṃtrāṇāṃ | śrīrāmacandra ṛṣirgāya ādi nānāchandāṃsimahā hanumāndeva(exp.1b1)tā mārutātmeti vījaṃ aṃjanīsunuriti śakti śrīrāmabhakta itihaṃ prāṇo śrīrāmalakṣmaṇānandakara iti hrā hrī hru iti jīvaḥ mama sarvadā nānā(2) vidhepsita kāryasiddhyarthe viniyoga || End hari markaṭa markaṭa maṃtranibhaṃ yadi likhyati likhyati bhūmitale || yadi narapati vāmakare(exp 5r1) yadi muṃcati muṃcati śṛṅkhalikā || || iti śrisudarśanasaṃhitāyāṃ hanumatkalpa samāptaḥ || Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama || atha svarṇākarṣaṇabhairava pūjā prayoga || || atha maṃtra || daridrai sādhakai sādhya sva(fol. 2v1)rṇākarṣaṇabhairava || oṁ aiṁ klīṁ klīṁ klūṁ hāṁ hrīṁ hruṁ sa vaṁ āpaduddhāraṇāya ajāmalabaddhāya lokeśvarāya (2)svarṇākarṣaṇabhairavāya mama dāridrya vidveṣaṇāya oṁ mahābhairavāya nama || iti mūlamaṃtra || End hrīṁ vījaṃ saha śaktirityabhihitaṃ (fol. 4r4) tasmaiva taṃtrātmakaṃ || stotraṃ dhyānapura saraṃ sahamanuṃ vrūmo vayaṃ pratyaham || iti śrīsva(5)rṇākarṣaṇabhairavasya pūjāprakaraṇam || śubham || bhūyāt || ………. «Illustration» svarṇākarṣaṇabhairavasya pūjāyaṃtraṃ || (exp 5 left margin) ( IllUSTRATION OF YANTRA )

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāyanamaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || śrīśrīśrī hanubhairavāya namaḥ || || yajamā(fol. 1v1)na puṣpabhājana yācake || oṁ adyādi || vākya || śrīsaṃvarttāmaṇḍalāntekrama padasahitānaṃda(2)śakti subhīmāsṛṣṭaṃ nyāya catuṣkaṃ akura kulagataṃ paṃcakañcānyaṣaṭkaṃ | catvāro paṃcako(3)nyaṃ punarapi caturaṃ statvato maṇḍaledaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkukṣeśaṃ || iti karaṃnyāsaḥ || || (fol. 6r4) iti ṣaḍaṅganyāsa || || (fol. 6r5) iti vakraṃnyāsa || || (fol. 6r7) i(fol. 9r3)ti mālinīstava samāptaḥ || || iti paṃcavalyārccanaṃ || || (fol. 10v6) iti tvākama(fol. 14r4)hāvali || || iti śrīśivaśakti samarasatvaṃ mahāmāyā stotraṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 17r7) iti śrīhalāyudhaviracitaṃ śrīhanubhairavastotraṃ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 21v7) iti cupi pujāvidhiḥ || || (fol. 22v6) End vācana laṃkha kāyāva taya || mohanī taya || || laṃkhana hāya || hukāraṃ (fol. 23r5) || ceta || śrīkhaṇḍa || sidhara || vīreśvarī || mohanī || trailokyamonī || svāna taya || namaste hanuru(6)drāyatyādi || svānamāla koytrā biya || || vali visarjjana yā || || nośiya || vali bhokaluya(7) || || sākṣi thāya || || Colophon iti śrīśrīśrīhanubhairavapūjāparddhati saṃāptaḥ || || śubhaḥ || (fol. 24v1) ❖ adyādi || vākya || mānavagotra yajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndra mallavarmāṇaḥ śrī 3(2)ṣvaṣṭadevatā prītyarthaṃ navagṛhapraveśa aśvasālā pratiṣṭhārthaṃ śrī 3 hanubhairava paṃco(3)pacārapūjā nimityarthaṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāmi || ||

Beginning ❖ oṁ namo hanubhairavāya || oṁ hrūṁ hrīṁ haṁ haṁ hsaṁ phaṭ || oṁ hrūṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ || oṁ hrīṁ śirase svāhā || oṁ haṁ śikhāyai co(fol. 1v2)ṣaṭ || oṁ ha kacacāya hūṁ || oṁ 5 hsīṁ netratrayāya vaṣaṭ || oṁ phaṭ astrāya phaṭ || || (fol. 1v1–2) End iti kukkutavalidānaṃ || || tryaśraṃ paṃcaṣāḍa(6)sraṃ trivṛtaparayutaṃ nāgapadmāṣṭakoṇaṃ tadvāhye ṣoḍaśāraṃ jalajadalayutaṃ bhūtavṛttānavāsraṃ | (7) || padvārakāṣṭhaṃ pitṛcanavipinaṃ saṃvṛtādyaṣṭayuktaṃ kāvandhaṃheti mālā sakayalayutaṃ sthā(8)payen madhya kālī || || (fol. 3v5–8) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṁ bhairavāya namaḥ || oṁ haḥ phaṭ astrāya namaḥ || karaśodhanaṃ | oṁ kṣaṁ īśānāyanamaḥ | oṁ yaṁ tatpuruṣāya namaḥ | oṁ raṁ aghorāya namaḥ || oṁ vaṁ(fol 1r1)vāmadevāya namaḥ || oṁ laṁ sadyojātāya namaḥ || aṅguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhānta nyāsaḥ || End śvacchanda devarccanavidhi samāptaḥ || || tato dhyānaṃ || pañcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ, tripañcanayano jvalaṃ | kapa(fol 4v5)rdda bālacandrārddhaṃ | śvetābhaṃ sarvvabhuṣaṇaṃ, śūlaṃ ḍamaru padmaṃ ca, śaktimālākṣame vaca | pāśā bhayaṃ varadaṃ ca, vīja khaṭvāñga vāmadhā || mahātejo maheśā(6)raṃ sarvvasatvaika kāraṇaṃ || ||

Beginning ❖ śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ || sudhāsukta || samudramathyamānena, kṣāraṃ sāgarasaṃbhave | tatrotpatnā surādevī, kanyakārūpadhāriṇī || mandilaṃ ceṣṭa(exp 1t1)yitvā tu, pheṇalāvartta bhīṣaṇa || trinetrāṃ dīrghatatvāṅgāṃ, kālāgnisadṛśa prabhāṃ || aṣṭādaśabhujādevī, raktaṃ cāyatalocanaṃ | śaṃkha khaḍgaṃ dhanuścaiva(2) kapāla muśalaṃ tathā || iti sudhāsukta || || (exp 2b5) End 3 oṁ aiṁ ka 5 klṁ ha 6 sauḥ sa4 (exp 4 : 7)sarvvatatvaṃ śodhayāmiṁ svāhā || iti tatvaśodhanaṃ samāptaḥ || || iti saṃśodhya mūlādhāre anādivāsanārūpaṃ dhanaprajvālita mālāgraṃ dha Colophon

Beginning oṃ namo gaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya namaḥ || śriyaṃ sarasvatīṃ gaurīṃ gaṇeśaṃ skandaṃ īśvaraṃ || brahmāṇaṃ vahnim indrādīn vāsudevaṃ namāmy ahaṃ || naimiṣe harim īyānā(!) ṛṣayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena svāgataṃ sūtaṃ abruvan || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || sūta tvaṃ pūjito smābhiḥ sārāt sāraṃ vadasva naḥ || yena vijñātamātreṇa sarvajñatvaṃ prajāyate || || sūta uvāca || sārāt sāro hi bhagavān vi(ṣṇ)uḥ sargādikṛtprabhuḥ || brahmāham asmi taṃ jñātvā sarvajñatvaṃ prajāyate || || dve brahmaṇī vyeditavye(!) sabdabrahma paraṃ ca yat || dve vidye vyeditavye(!) hi iti cārthavvaṇī(!) śruti(!) || ahaṃ śukaś ca pailādyā gatvā ca ṛṣisattama || vyāsaṃ natvā pṛṣṭavantaḥ so smān sāram athābravīt || || vyāsa uvāca || śukādeḥ śṛṇu sūta tvaṃ vaśiṣṭho māṃ yad abravīt || brahmasāram hī(!) pṛcchantaṃ munibhiś ca parāparaṃ || || vaśiṣṭha uvāca || dve vidye brahma vakṣyāmi śṛṇu vyāsākhilānugaṃ || athārgnir(!) māṃ purā prāha munibhir ddaivataiḥ saha || (fol.1v1-7) Beginning san prabṛddhamanasā(!) sandhyāpi ca dvijottamāḥ | tata sarvvān samadano mohayitvā punaḥ punaḥ || yathendriyavikārās te prāpus tān akarot tathā | udīritendriyo dhātā vikṣāṃ cakre yadāgatāṃ || tadaikanyūnapañcāśad bhā jātāḥ śarīrataḥ || viśvāvādyās tathā hāvā(!) yatuḥ ṣaṣṭī tathā kalā | kandarppe śaraviddhāyāḥ sandhyāyāju(!) bhava dvijāḥ || (fol. 5r1–2) End snāti lauhitya gaṅgeṣu, sa yāti brahmaṇaḥ padaṃ | caitraṃ tu sakalaṃ māṃsaṃ, śuciṃ prayatamānasaḥ || lauhityatī(!) dheyaḥ snāyāt, sa kaivalyam āpnuyāt | iti te kathite rājan, mad arthayā ca taṃ purā || hastī dhīro rājamadagdho(!) yasmād vā krurakarmmakṛt || (fol. 395v6–7) Colophon iti kālikāpurāṇe jamadagny upākhyāne || 80 || (fol. 394v2–3)

Beginning vaṃkakuschatanayā(!) jātā citrāṃgadā tadā || damsī ca bhūtā sā venatā eva tyā(!) vivāritā aruṇā(!)pyalamatyu(!)-/// munivarā śubhā || tau ca putrau mahābhāgau mahākāryyaṃ kariṣyataḥ | iti te kathite rājan yathā citrāṃga/// kakuschasya(!) sutā sādhvī prastutaṃ śṛṇu sāmprataṃ || (fol. 170r1–3) End śrutvemaṃ sagaro rājā maṃtrakalpādikaṃ punaḥ | viśeṣāny pari prachan ī(!)tyādīnāṃ mahāmuniṃ || || sagara uvāca || payā nītyā prayoktavyaḥ svātmāpi pāthava(!) | teṣāṃ viśeṣaiḥ sahitaṃ sadācāraṃ vadasva me || argha uvāca || || || || (fol. 316v9–10) Colophon iti kālikāpurāṇe argha(!)sāgarasaṃvāde kāmarūpayāṃvanirṇaye lauhityava(!)raśurāmotpattiḥ || || (fol. 316r9–10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaś caṇḍikāyai || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || yad yogibhir bhavabhayārttivināśayogyam āsādya vanditam atīva viviktacittaiḥ | tad vaḥ punātu haripādasarojayugmam āvirbhavatkramavilaṃghita bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ || sā pātu [vaḥ] sakalayogijanasya citte vidyātamiśrataraṇir bhuvimuktihetuḥ | yā cānya jantunivahasya vimohanīti māyāvidher jjagati śuddhasubuddhihantrī || (fol. 1v1–4) End niveśya vaiṣṇave kāye, śaṃkhacakragadādhare | tataḥ śau nirmmahātejāḥ kāyaṃ tat pāṃcabhautikaṃ || śaṃkhacakragadāśārṅgavarāsidharam acyutaḥ | svaśatyāsaṃ jahārāśu sāram ādāya sarvvataḥ | nirādhāraṃ nirākāraṃ niḥsatvaṃ niravagrahaṃ | ānandadvayamam(!) advaitadveetahīnāviśeṣanaṃ(!) sunandadvayam advaitadvaitahīna na-/// (fol. 20v5–7) Sub-colophon iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe kāmavākyaṃ || 7 || (fol. 25v6) Colophon iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe || 23 || (fol. 16r3–4)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāya || oṁ kāśīpataye namaḥ || nārayaṇaṃ namaskṛtya, narañ caiva narottamaṃ | devīṃ sarasvatīñ caiva, tato jayam udīrayet || tan manmahe maheśānaṃ, maheśānapriyārbhakaṃ | gaṇeśānaṃ karigaṇe,śānānanam anāmayaṃ || bhūmiṣṭhāpi nayātra bhūs tridivato py uccair adhaḥ sthāpitā, yāvad dhātuvimuktidā syur amṛtā yasyāṃ mṛtā jantavaḥ | yā nityaṃ trijagat pavitrataṭinīṭī(!)re suraiḥ sevyate, sā kāśī tripurārirājanagarī pāyād apāyāj jagat || (fol. 1v1–3) End śṛṇuyād dūradeśe ʼpi, yaḥ kāśīkhaṇḍam uttamaṃ || sa kāśīvāsapuṇyasya, bhājanaṃ syāc chivājñayā | etac chravaṇataḥ puṃsāṃ, sarvvatra vijayo bhavet | saubhāgyaṃ vāpi sarvvatra, pāpnuyān nirmmalāśayaḥ || yasya viśveśvara[ḥ] tuṣṭas, tasyaitac chravaṇe matiḥ | jāyate puṇyayuktasya, mahānirmmalacetasaḥ || sarvveṣāṃ maṅgalānāñ ca, mahāmaṅgalam uttamaṃ | gṛhe ʼpi likhitaṃ pūjyaṃ, sarvvamaṅgalasiddhaye || || (fol. 354v8–355r1) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe kāśīkhaṇḍe anukramaṇikādhyāyo nāma śatatamo ʼdhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || 100 || || pitur ājñāṃ samādāya, mū[r]ddhni puṣpāñjalīm iva | cchatrasiṃhasuto dhīmān, vyaliṣat pustakaṃ varaḥ || || yādṛśī(!) pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā, tādṛśī(!) likhitaṃ mayā | yadi śuddham aśuddhaṃ vā, mama doṣo na dīyate || || samvat 816 kārttikaśuddi 3 || The following lines are written in Newari language: ❖ samvat 819 mārggaśiraśudi pañcamī ādityavāra thvakuhnu yāccheṭolapā cukuṭi pādune hmavākāyasena śrīnandalāla o ṛyāke, kāśīkhaṇḍa vyākhyāna ṅeṅāva śrīrāmacandraprīti na thva puthi śrībālakṛṣṇa bhāju yātā dāna viyājaro || śubha || || grahe lebhaśāke gate ʼbdesu naipālike mārggaśukle ʼrkkaghasre 3 hi tithyāṃ | mudā kāśi⟪ka⟫khaṇḍaṃ kṛtī pāḍunāmā, hyadā dvālakṛṣṇāya nāma pratuṣṭyai || || || (fol. 355r1–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāya || oṃ kāśīpataye namaḥ | nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya, narañ caiva narottamam | devī sarasvatīñ caiva tato jayam udīrayet || tan manmahe maheśānaṃ, maheśānaṃ priyārbhakaṃ gaṇeśānaṃ karigaṇeśānānanamanāmayaṃ || bhūmiṣṭhāpina yātra bhus(!) tridivato py uccair adhaḥ sthāpiyā(!), yāvad bhā bhuvi muktidā syur amṛtā yasyāṃ mṛtā jantavaḥ || yā nityaṃ trijagatpavitrataṭinītīre suraiḥ sevyate sā kāśī tripurārirājanagarī pāyād apāyāj jagat || (fol. 1v1–3) End candramaulim avalokya yāsyataḥ kasya siddhir inoparisphuret(!) | varaṃ hi kāśyāṃ tṛṇagulmavṛkṣakāśya(!) caranti cānyataḥ /// prathamaṃ dhig astunā(!) vārāṇasī lagha(!) vihāya pāsaḥ | asiṃhyayaspṛśya punaḥ punar bhuniḥ prāsādamālāṃ parito vilokayan || uvāca netre sabale prapaśyataṃ kāśīpurīṃ -/// || (fol. 173v8–9) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe kāśīkhaṇḍe daśāśvamedhikan nāma dvipaṃcāśattamo dhyāyaḥ || 52 || (fol. 170v1)

Beginning ❖ oṁ nama⟨ḥ⟩ś caṇḍikāyai || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || yad yogi⟪r⟫bhir bhavabhayārttivināśayogyam, āsādya vanditam atīva viviktacittaiḥ | tad vaḥ punātu haripādasarojayugmam, āvirbhavat krama⟨pi⟩[vi]laṃghitabhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ || sā pātu vaḥ sakalayogijanasya citte, ʼvidyātamiśrataraṇir bhuvi muktihetuḥ | yā cānya jantuvi(!)vahasya vimohanīti, māyāvidher jjagati śuddhasubuddhihantrī || īśvaraṃ jagatām ādyaṃ, praṇamya puruṣottamaṃ | nityajñānamayaṃ vakṣye, purāṇaṃ kālikāhvayaṃ || (fol. 1v1–3) End pradhānapuruṣau yasya, prapaṃcau yogināṃ hṛdi | yaḥ purāṇādhipo viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu sanātanaḥ || yo hetur ugraḥ puruṣaḥ ⟪‥⟫[[pu]]rāṇa- kṛd veda purāṇakebhyaḥ | paraḥ parebhyaś ca purārirūpo dhya(!)yaṃ ca tannāma purāṇaśeṣe ||<ref>pāda b is unmetrical.</ref> iti sakalajagad bibhartti yā sā mu(!)dhuripumohakārī namo ʼstu tasyai | vahati ca vapuṣā maheśvaro yāṃ praṇamata prāṇihitāṃ śivān tāṃ || ○ || (fol. 216v3–5) <references/> Colophon iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe sāmāptā(!) dhyāyaḥ || 99 || || ❖ sa⟨ṃ⟩mvat 8⟪‥⟫18 vaiśāṣakṛṣṇa 10 || saṃpūrṇṇam iti || ❁ || ○ || śubham || || śrīśrīśrīkālikā prītir astu || ○ || śubham astu sarvvadā || || (fol. 216v5–6)
