Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ namo bhagavate indrāya || indrāṇyai namaḥ || oṃ asya śrī-indrākṣīstotramantrasya purandara-ṛṣir anuṣṭupchandaḥ śrī-indrākṣīdevatā lakṣmībījaṃ bhuvaneśvarīśaktir māheśvari(!)kīlakaṃ indrākṣīprasādasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || śirasi puraṃdarāya ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe anuṣṭupchaṃdase namaḥ || … dhyānam || indrākṣīṃ dvibhujāṃ devīṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitāṃ || prasannavadanāṃ dhyāyet pītavastradvayānvitam || devī susaumyavadanāṃ pāśāṃkuśavarapradām || trailokyamohinīṃ durgām indrākṣīnāmakīrttitām || 3 || evaṃ dhyātvā tato devīṃ vāṃchitārthasya siddhaya(!) || pūjanīyā prayatnena stotrapāṭhapuraḥsaram || 4 || (fol. 1v1–3v4) End cauravyāghrabhayaṃ tatra manasāpi na cintayet || āyur ārogyam aiśvaryam jñānaṃ vittaṃ yaśobalam || 10 || trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhet martyo(!) labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || śatam āvartayed yas tu mucyate vyādhibandhanāt || 11 || āvartayet sahasraṃ tu vāṃchitaṃ labhate phalaṃ || rājānaṃ vasam āpnoti ṣaṇmāsān nātra saṃśayaḥ || 12 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyām idaṃ stotra[ṃ] paṭhen naraḥ || pa‥tas tasya naśyaṃti vighnasaṃghātakārakā(!) || 13 || raktavastraiś ca puṣpaiś ca raktacaṃdanacarcitaiḥ || dhūpai[r] dīpaiś ca naivedyai[ḥ] prasannā bhavati dhruvam || 14 || prātar utthāya paṭhanāt ṣaṇmāsāt siddhyate naraḥ || saṃvatsaram upāśritya sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 15 || nābhimātrajale sthitvā sahasraparisaṃkhyayā || japet stotram idaṃ maṃtra(!) vācāṃ siddhir bhaved dhruvaṃ || 16 || kārāgṛhe yadā baddho madhyarātre yadā japet || paṭhen māsatrayeṇaiva mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 17 || anena vidhinā bhaktyā maṃtrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || saṃtuṣṭā ca bhaved devī pratyakṣaṃ sā prajāyate || 18 || (fols. 5r5–6v4) Colophon iti śrī-indrākṣīproktaṃ iṃdrākīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || śubham || samvat 1930 sālam itī(!) śrāvaṇa(!) || (fol. 6v4–5)

Complete transcript śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || indra uvāca || indrākṣīnāma sā devī daivataiḥ samudāhṛtā || gaurī śākaṃbharī devī durgā nāmnīti viśrutā || 1 || kātyāyanī mahādevī candraghaṃṭā mahātapāḥ || sāvitrī sā ca gāyatrī brahmāṇī brahmavādinī || 2 || nārāyaṇī bhadrakālī rudrāṇī kṛṣṇapiṃgalā || agnijvālā raudramukhī kālarātrī tapasvinī || 3 || meghasvanā sahasrākṣī viṣṇumāyā jalodarī || mahodarī muktakeśī ghorarūpā mahāvalā || 4 || acyutānandadā bharttā rogaharttā śivapriyā || indrāṇī indramātā ca indraśaktiparāyā(!)ṇī || 5 || śivadūtī mṛḍānī ca mṛtyuś ca parameśvarī || vārāhī nārasiṃhī ca bhīmā bhairavanādinī || 6 || śrutismṛtir dhṛtir medhā vidyālakṣmī sarasvatī || anantā vijayā pūrṇā mānastokāparājitā || 7 || bhavānī pārvatī durgā haimavaty aṃvikā śivā || etair nāmapadair divyaiḥ stutā śakreṇa dhīmatā || 8 || śatam āvarttayed yas tu mucyate vyādhiba[[n]]dhanāt || āvarttānāṃ sahasreṇa labhate vāṃchitam [[phalam]] || 9 || iti śrīindrākṣistotraṃ saṃpūrṇam śubhaṃ || (fol. 1v1–2v4)

Complete transcript indrauvāca || īṃdrākṣīnāma nama śā devi detvaṃtai samudāhṛtā || gaurī śākambhari devi || durgānām nāmartiviśuti || 1 || kātyāyeni mahādevi caṃdraghaṃṭā māhātapā || śāvitri śā ca gāyetri || brahmani brahmavādini || nārāyani bhadrakā || rudrāṇi kṛṣṇapiṃgolā || agnijvolā rudramuṣI || kālarātris tapaḥśvini || meghasvanā sahaśākṣi || vikaṭāṃgi jaḍodariḥ || mahodari muktkesiḥ || ghorarūpā mahābalāḥ || ajitā bhadradānaṃ caḥ || tarohani sivapriyāḥ || śivaduti karāli caḥ | prata a parameśvariḥ īdrāniṃ īdrarūpā caḥ || īdraśaktiparāyaṇaḥ || sadā samohini deviḥ || suṃdari bhuvanesvari vārāhi nārasiṃhi caḥ || bhīmā bhairavanādiniḥ || śrutisamartidhṛtimedhāḥ || vidyālakṣmi sarasvatiḥ || anaṃtā vijayā puṇāḥ || mānastokāparājitāḥ || bhavāni pārvati durgāḥ || haimatyaṃ aṃbikā śivāḥ || etair nāmapadair devyai stutā śakrena dhimatāṃḥ || āyur ārogyem aisvaryaḥ || jñānavikraṃ jasvabalaṃḥ || śatam āvartated yes tu mucyate vyādhibaṃdhanātḥ || āvartena sahaśreṇa labhyete vāṃchitaṃ phalamḥ || iti śrī-īṃdrākṣistotraṃ saṃpurṇaḥ samāptaḥ || subhaḥ subhāṃ || || (fol. 1r1–v4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ asya śrī-i(!)drākṣīstotramantrasya purandara-ṛṣir anuṣṭupchanda indrākṣīdevatā lakṣmībījaṃ bhuvaneśvarīśakti[r] māheśvarīkīlakaṃ indrākṣīprasādasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || atha ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ śirasi purandara-ṛṣaye namaḥ | mukhe gāyatrīchandase namaḥ || hṛdaye indrākṣīdevatāyai namaḥ || guhye śrīṃ bījāya namaḥ … dhyānam || indrākṣīṃ dvibhujāṃ devīṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitām prasannavadanāṃ dhyāyet pītavastradvayānvitām || 1 || vāmahaste vajradharāṃ dakṣiṇe ca varapradām prasannavadanāmbhojam apsarogaṇasevitām || 2 || devīṃ susaumyavadanāṃ pāśāṃkuśavarapradām || trailokyamohinīṃ durgām indrākṣīnāmakīrttitām || 3 || (fols. 1v1–3v4) End śrutiḥ smṛtir dhṛtir mmedhā vidyālakṣmī sarasvatī || anaṃtā vijayā pūrṇā mānastokāparājitā || 7 || bhavānīpārvatīgaurīhaimavattyaṃbikāśivāḥ etair nnāmapadair ddivyaiḥ stutā śakreṇa dhīmatā || 8 || śatam āvarttayed yas tu mucyate vyādhibandhanāt || āvarttena sahasraṃ tu labhate vāṃchitaṃ phalam || 9 || (fols. 4v5–5r5) Colophon iti indrākṣīstutisamāptam śubham || || śrījagadambikārppaṇam astu ||(fol. 5r5–6)

Beginning oṃ namaś caṇḍikāyai | oṃ asya śrī-indrākṣīstotramantrasya purandara-ṛṣir anuṣṭupchandaḥ śrī-indrākṣīdevatā śrīṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktir bhavānīkīlakaṃ mama sarvābhīṣṭasiddhyarthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ || oṃ indra-ṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi oṃ anuṣṭupchaṃdase namo mukhe oṃ iṃdrākṣīdevatāyai namo hṛdi oṃ śrībījāya namo guhye oṃ hrīṃ śaktaye namaḥ pādayoḥ oṃ bhavānīkīlakāya namaḥ sarvāṅge | … dhyānam || oṃ indrākṣīṃ dvibhujāṃ devīṃ pītavastravibhūṣitām || vāme vajradharāṃ devīṃ savyahaste bhayapradāṃ || 1 || sahasranetrāṃ sūryābhāṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitāṃ | prasannavadanān nityam apsarogaṇasevitāṃ | [|| 2 ||] śrīdurgāṃ saumyavadanāṃ pāśāṃkuśadharāṃ parām | trailokyamohinīṃ devīṃ bhavānīm praṇamāmy aham || 3 || (exp. 2, ll. 1–9) End āyur ārogyam aiśvaryam jñānaṃ vittaṃ yaśobalaṃ | śatam āvarttayed yas tu mucyate vyādhibandhanāt | āvarttānāṃ sahasreṇa labhate vāṃchitaṃ phalaṃ | rājā vaśyam avāpnoti sarvam eva na saṃśayaḥ | 10 || lakṣam ekaṃ japed yas tu sākṣād devī bhaviṣyati || trikālaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ dhanan dhānyaṃ ca saṃpadaḥ | 12 | rājadvāre sabhāmadhye gṛhamadhye gṛhāṃgaṇe | vidyāvāde vivāde ca devī rakṣatu sarvadā | 13 | arddharātrau paṭhen nityaṃ mucyate vyādhibaṃdhanāt | aindrastotram idaṃ puṇyaṃ japet tu phalabarddhanaṃ | 1(‥) || vināśāyāti rogāṇām alpamṛtyuharāya ca | rājyārthī labhate rājyaṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanaṃ | 14 | icchākāman tu kāmārthī dharmārthī dharmam akṣayaṃ | vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ mokṣārthī paramam padaṃ | 15 | | (exps. 2, ll. 15–3, ll. 3) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmalataṃtre umāmaheśvarasamvāde śrīṃdrākṣīstotraṃ | | aśāpitam idaṃ stotram akīlitam idaṃ dhruvaṃ | paṭhed vā pāṭhayed vāpi sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt | prātaḥ kāle ca madhyāhne pradoṣe cārdharātrake | catuḥ sahasrāvarttena bhuvanaṃ vaśam ānayet | sarvarogāt pramucyarthaṃ śatam āvarttayed dhruvaṃ | | (exp. 3, ll. 3–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ asya indrākṣīstotramantrasya purandara-ṛṣir anuṣṭupchanda indrākṣīdevatā lakṣmīr bījaṃ bhuvaneśvarīti śaktir bhavānīkīlakaṃ mama sarvābhīṣṭasiddhyarthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ || śirasi purandara-ṛṣaye namaḥ mukhe anuṣṭupchandase namaḥ … dhyānam indrākṣīṃ dvibhujāṃ devīṃ pītavastravibhūṣitām || vāmahaste vajradharāṃ dakṣiṇena varapradām || indrākṣīṃ yuvatīṃ dhyāye[n] nānālaṅkārabhūṣitām || prasannavadanāmbhojām apsarogaṇasevitām || 1 || anyac ca dvibhujāṃ saumyavadanāṃ pāśāṅkuśadharāṃ parām || trailokyamohinīṃ devīm indrākṣīnāmakīrttitām || (fol. 1v1–2v7) End sadā saṃmohinī devī sundarī bhuvaneśvarī || etair nāmapadair divyaiḥ stutā śakreṇa dhīmatā || 9 || śatam āvartayed yas tu mucyate vyādhibandhanāt || āvṛttena sahasreṇa labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam || 10 || lakṣam ekaṃ japed yas tu sākṣād devī bhaviṣyati || trikālaṃ yaḥ paṭhen nityaṃ tasyādhīnāś ca sampadaḥ || 11 || āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ jñānaṃ buddhir yaśobalam || prāptam indreṇa sarvasvam indrākṣyāś ca prasādataḥ || 12 || rājā ca vaśam āpnoti ṣaṇmāsān nātra saṃśayaḥ || raṇe rājakule dyūte sarvatra vijayī bhavet || 13 || kṣayāpasmārakuṣṭāditāpajvaranivāraṇam || etat stotraṃ japen nityaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam || 14 || (fol. 4r2–v5) Colophon iti śrīmatpurandaraviracitam i[n]drākṣīstotraṃ samāptam || || śubham || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 4v5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ asya śrī-indrākṣīstotramantrasya purandara-ṛṣir anuṣṭupchandaḥ śrī-indrākṣīdevatā lakṣmībījaṃ bhuvaneśvarīśakti[r] māheśvarīkīlakaṃ indrākṣīprasādasiddhya[r]the jape viniyogaḥ || … atha dhyānam indrākṣīṃ dvibhujāṃ devīṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitām || praśannavadanāṃ dhyāyet pītavastradvayānvitām || 1 || vāmahaste vajradharāṃ dakṣiṇe ca varapradām | praśannavadanāmbhojām apsarogaṇasevitām || 2 || devīṃ saumyavadanāṃ pāśāṃkuśavarapradām || trailokyamohinīṃ durgām indrākṣīnāmakīrttitām || (fol. 1v1–12) End āvarttayet sahasran tu labhate vān(!)chitaṃ phalam | rājānāṃ vaśam āpnoti ṣaṇmāsān nātra saṃśayaḥ || 16 || aṣṭamyāñ ca caturdaśyām idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhen naraḥ paṭhatas tasya naśyanti vighnasaṃghātakārakāḥ || 17 || prātar utthāya paṭhanāt ṣaṇmāsā[t] siddhyate naraḥ || saṃvatsaram upāśritya sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 19 || nābhimātrajale sthitvā sahasraṃ parisaṃkhyayā || jape[t] stotram idaṃ maṃtraṃ vācāsiddhir bhaved dhruvam | 20 | kārāgṛhe yadā baddho madhyarātre tadā japet | paṭhen māsatrayeṇaiva mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | 21 | anena vidhinā bhaktyā maṃtrasiddhiḥ prajāyate | saṃtuṣṭā ca bhaved devī pratyakṣaṃ sā prajāyate || 22 || (fol. 2r9–v2) Colophon iti śrī-indraproktaṃ indrākṣ⟨i⟩īstotra[ṃ] sampūrṇam || atha mūlamaṃtraḥ || oṃ hrīṃ śrī-indrākṣī hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ svāhā || śubham || samāpto jātaḥ || || (fol. 2v2–3)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca || āryāstavaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathoktam ṛṣibhi[ḥ] purā nārāyaṇīṃ namasyāmi devīṃ tribhuvaneśvarīṃ [[1]] tvaṃ hi siddhir dhṛtiḥ kīrtti śrīr vidyā sannatir matiḥ | saṃdhyā rātriḥ prabhā nidrā kālarātris tathaiva ca [2] āryā kātyāyanī devī kauśikī brahmacāriṇī || jananī siddhasenasya ugracārī mahātapāḥ 3 jayā ca vijayā caiva puṣṭiś ca tvaṃ dayā kṣamā jyeṣṭā yamasya bhaginī nīlakauśeyavāsasī 4 bahū(!)rūpā bahutapā[ḥ] ca anekavidhacāriṇī<ref name="ftn1"> Pāda a is unmetrical. </ref> parvatāgreṣu ghoreṣu nadīṣu ca guhāṣu ca || 5 || (fol. 1v1–7) End rakṣa māṃ sarvapāpebhyaḥ prasādaṃ va(!) <ref name="ftn2"> May be ca. </ref>kariṣyasi || imaṃ cāryāstavaṃ divyam iti vyāsaprakalpitaṃ || yaḥ paṭhet prātar utthāya śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ || kāṃkṣitaṃ ca tribhir māsai[ḥ] phalaṃ vai śaṃprayacchati satyaṃ brahma ca daivaṃ ca dvaipāyanavaco yathā nṛṇāṃ baṃdha<ref name="ftn3"> For baṃdhuvadhaṃ </ref>vadhaṃ ghoraṃ putranāśaṃ dhanakṣayaṃ vyādhimṛtyubhayaṃ caiva pūjitā śamaye(!)ṣyasi mohayitvā ca taṃ kaṃsa⟨ṃ⟩m ekā tvaṃ bhokṣyase jagat || aham †apyān† manovṛtti(!) vidhāsye †goṣagopavat† || svavṛddhyartham ahaṃ caiva kariṣye kaṃsagopanaṃ || evaṃ tu sa samādiśya gato [ʼ]ṃtardhānam īśvaraḥ sā cāpi taṃ namaskṛtya tathāstv iti ca niścitā || (fol. 3v7–4r7) Colophon iti harivaṃśe sva⟪‥⟫garbhasaṃvidhāno nāmādhyāyaḥ [[yoganidrākavacaṃ saṃpu(!)rṇaṃ]] || (fol. 4r7–8)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śivāya || || skanda uvāca || || niścaleṣupaviṣṭeṣu teṣu yogiṣu śaṃkaraṃ | vyājahārātha deveśaṃ kuvero yogisattamaḥ || 1 || kuvera uvāca || || devadeva mahādeva mahāpuruṣasattama (kā)ṇimādiguṇair yukta jñānavijñānasāgara || 2 || yadi māṃ sarvadā śaṃbho skaṃdād anyaṃ na manyase || mama kāruṇyabhāvena yat pṛcchāmi tad ucyatāṃ || 3 || tvatprasādopapannena rājyena parameśvara || rājasaḥ śrīmadāṃdho [ʼ]haṃ tvāṃ na jānāmi tatvataḥ || 4 || ko bhavān kim idaṃ sarvaṃ jagad etac carācaraṃ || kathyā(!)tām iti me yena protsared āśu durmatiḥ || 5 || prakāśaṃ satatātmānaṃ paraṃ saṃvitsamāśrayaṃ || yair nāmabhir upāsyo [ʼ]si yathārthena vada prabho || 6 || || (fol. 1v1–5) End ya tvaṃ karoṣi sa brahmā sa candraḥ sa ca bhāskaraḥ || surāsuramayī deva tava śaktir jagattraye || 22 || kṣarākṣaramayaṃ devaṃ śivaṃ śivakalātmakaṃ || api brahmā na jānāti tvāṃ vai jānāty anugrahāt || 23 || manasām apy agamyas tvaṃ vacasām apy agocaraḥ | ataḥ śivaśiveśānety ucyate vāgvilepanaiḥ || 24 || śaṃbho maheśvara vibhartti sadā tripuṃḍraṃ sadmanā saliladhautalalāṭapaṭṭaḥ || yo [ʼ]nukṣaṇaṃ śivaśiveti japaty asau vā lokatrayopari sadāśiva(!) te priyo [ʼ]stu || 25 || śivo dātā śivo bhoktā śivo bhuktivarapradaḥ || śiva eva tu sarvaṃ hi jagad etat pralīyate || 26 || || 146 || || (fols. 7v5–8r1) Colophon iti śrīskaṃdapurāṇe himavat khaṃḍe śivaproktaṃ īśvarasahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || śrīśāke 1557 phālgunavadi 14 gurau likhitaṃ śrīmadanaṃtaśarmaṇā ḍaṃvarasāhipāṭhārtham iti || || ❁ || || (fol. 8r1–3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaś caṇḍikāyai || namo [ʼ]stu te mahādurgge caṇḍike caṇḍavikrame | viśve[[śva]]rijagaddhātristhitisaṃhārakāriṇī || 1 || sarvasiddhikarī devi(!) jayarūpāvatāra(!)ṇi(!) | durjjayārijitaṃ (!) bhadre mahāvairivināsa(!)ni || 2 || tvaṃ śrī(!) tvam īśvarī tvaṃ hrī(!) tvaṃ jananī parā | prakṛtis tvañ ca sarvvasya guṇatrayavibhāviṇI || 3 || oṃkārañ ca layā devi hrīṃkāraṃ paramātmaṇi(!) | hrūṃkārañ ca akārañ ca ukāraṃ bindusaṃyutaṃ || 4 || (fol. 1r1–v1) End mahāsaṃgrāmajananī vipakṣadalanāmanī | tvaṃ durggā rakṣaṇī devī mahālakṣmyāvatāriṇī || 15 || †yuddhitoccā† mahotpāte †mahātecata† puṣkare | mahāvane śmaśāne vā mahādāvāgnikeṣu ca || 16 || raṇe rājakule dyūte vivāde sa jayī bhavet | smaraṇās tāriṇī devī mucyate sarvvapātakaiḥ || 17 || caṇḍīkāṣṭakagaṇāvṛttarudracaṇḍādikādibhiḥ | mahādurggeśvarī devī saṃgrāme bhayanāsa(!)nī || 18 || śatrusaṃtāraṇī devī ugracaṇḍīṃ namo [ʼ]stu te || || (fols. 1r1–3r4) Colophon iti śrīugracaṇḍīmantrādistotraṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 3r5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaś caṇḍikāyai || pūrvve sthitā bhagavatī mama rudracaṇḍā pītāmbarā trinayanā varapīnadehā | vajrādimāyudhadharā ca dviraṣṭahastā kalyā namāmi dadatu daityavināśakārī || 1 || (!) †grāsādiyā† dahanakoṇanivāsinī yā śaktyā diśāyudhadharā vararaktavarṇṇā | māheśvarīti ditā munibhiḥ samastaiḥ (!) devārināśanakarī śubhadā pracaṇḍā || 2 || (fol. 3v1–5) End iśānadivyarivibhūṣitakāntidehā yā padmakāntijananī ati caṇḍakāntā | śūlosicakraśaraśaktigadādihastā bhaktyā namāmi śirasā bhuvaneśvarīṃ tāṃ || 8 || yā śrīsvayaṃ bhagavatī paramātmadehā sṛṣṭisthitipralayaviśvamayātmadehā | saṃhāramohitatamā taruṇaiḥ samastā śrīmān dadātu mama vāṃchitarājalakṣmīṃ || 9 || || || (fol. 5r1–5)

Beginning ❖ mārkkaṇḍeyo(!) vipadasahatān grahāyāvatāraṃ cakre yasya pracūrṇṇaniṣaṇo(!) brahmavidbrahmakalpaḥ | daityocchedapramuditaśirastotragarbbhaḥ prabhāvā so [ʼ]yaṃ devyā bhavatu bhavatā śrīśraye caṃḍakāyāḥ || || yā devī madhukaiṭabhapramathanī yā caṇḍamuṇḍārddinī yā †mādyā† mahiṣāsurakṣayakarī yā raktavījāśrayā | yā sā śumbhaniśumbhadaityadahanī yā devidevāśrayā sā devī mama rakṣa dakṣiṇabhujaiś caṇḍī jayo rakṣatu || || (fols. 5v1–6r1) End yā devī mahiṣāsuramathanī dhūmrākṣavidhvaṃsinī yā devī madhukaiṭabhapramathanī krūrasya sādhāraṇī | yā devī niśumbhaśumbhadahanī raktākṣavīrakṣayā yā candrā(ga)kṛtacaṇḍamuṇḍadahanī sā caṇḍikā pātu vaḥ || || yāṣṭamyām adhivāsinī bhagavatī śrīrudracaṇḍādibhir brahmāṇī pramukhā jayādisakalā ṣaḍyoginī vanditā | puṣpaiś candanadhūpadīpapaśubhir valyādigamyocitā saṃprāpte daśamī prayāti sakalā sā caṇḍikā pātu vaḥ || || (fol. 6r4–v5)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ asya śrīmaducchiṣṭagaṇeśakavacasya || gaṇakaṣiḥ (!) || gāyatrīcchandaḥ || śrīucchiṣṭagaṇeśo devatā || gaṃ bījaṃ || svāhā śaktiḥ || klīṃkīlakaṃ || sarvāṇganyāsaviniyogaḥ || … atha kavacaṃ || deva deva jagannātha sṛṣṭisthitilayaprabho vinā dhyānaṃ vinā mantraṃ vinā prema vinā japaṃ || 1 || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa labhyate cāśucinvitaṃ || tad eva śrotum icchāmi kathayasva jagatprabho || 2 || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi guhyād guhyataraṃ mahat | ucchiṣṭagaṇanāthasya kavacaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ || 3 || (fols. 1v1–3v8) End paṃcānanaś caturvaktraḥ ṣaḍānanagaṇeśvaraḥ || mayūravāhanaḥ pātu pātu mūṣakavāhanaiḥ || 45 || pātu māṃ devadeveśaḥ pātu mām ṛṣipūjitaḥ || pātu māṃ sarvadā devo devadānavapūjitaḥ || 46 || trailokyapūjito devaḥ pātu māṃ ca vibhuḥ prabhuḥ || raṃgasthaṃ ca sadā pātu sāgarasthaṃ sadāvatu || 47 || bhūmiṣṭhaṃ ca sadā pātu pātālasthaṃ sadāvatu || antarasthaṃ sadā pātu ākāśasthaṃ sadāvatu || 48 || catuṣpathaṃ sadā pātu tripathasthaṃ sadāvatu || bilvasthaṃ ca vanasthaṃ ca pāhi māṃ nagarasthitaṃ || 49 || rājadvārasthitaṃ pātu pātu māṃ śīghrasiddhidaḥ || bhavānī pūjitaḥ pātu brahmāviṣṇuśivārcitaḥ || 50 || idaṃ tu kavacaṃ devi paṭhanāt sarvasiddhidaṃ || || (fol. 10v8–12r4) Colophon iti śrīuºº gaºº kavacaṃ sampūrṇam || || (fol. 12r4–5)

Beginning ///-dadhi mahodadhi krāmo madhyāso mūlabhedakaḥ || smerāsyotiprasaṃmāsya sadrūpannyalalāṭikaḥ || 127 || aniṣidhyo niṣidhyoktir varjitotpavaṃdika || grahārtihāridaivajñyo [ʼ]naṃtasa(!)ktisurādijā || 128 || viśvopakārī kulabhakali darpaharoharaḥ || amātṛmātṛko tāta(!) pī(!)tṛko pakṣapakṣadā || 129 || adhārkṣadasiddhikarakṛpājur akhilo [ʼ]ṣṭadaḥ || vidyā pradātā sarvajño guṇāguṇavivarjitaḥ || 130 || (fol. 13r1–4) End bhuktimuktilokavasyaṃḥ (!) dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ dharāsuṣaṃm || yad yad vāṃchati tat sarvaṃ prāpnoteva na sasaṃsaya || 156 || idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mayā proktaṃ sikhidhvaja || sarvathā gopaniyaṃ te na pprakāsyaṃ kadācana || 158 || na pāpakarmaṇe putra na deyaṃ brahmaṇadviṣe || adhāyuktāya sāntāya niścayaṃm || 160 || (fols. 14v7–15r3) Colophon iti śrīnaṃdyāvarte mahātantetre(!) harakārtikeyasaṃvāde śrīmadekākṣaragaṇe[śa]sahasranāmastotraṃma(!) saṃpurṇaṃ subha || subham astu || || (fol. 15r3–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśaṃ vande || || atha śrīhanumadekādaśamukhīkavacaṃ || || oṃ āpadāśrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ āpadām bhayahartāhaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām || guṇābhirāmaṃ śrīrāmam ‥‥‥ namāmy aham || 1 || ārtānām ārtitāraṃ bhītānā(!) bhayanāśanam || dviṣatāṃ kāladaṇḍañ ca rāmacandraṃ namāmy aham || 2 || namaḥ kodaṇḍahastāya saṃdhīkṛtaśarāya ca || daṇḍitākhiladaityāya rāmāyā (!) patnivāriṇe || || 3 || agrataḥ pṛṣṭataś caiva pārśvataś ca dhanurdharau || ākarṇa pūrṇadhanvānau rakṣetāṃ rāmalakṣmaṇau || 4 || (fols. 1v1–2r1) End ekādaśamukhahanumān māṃ rakṣa 2 śāṃti(!) kuru 2 tuṣṭiṃ kuru 2 mamārogyaṃ kuru 2 abhayaṃ kuru 2 avighna(!) kuru 2 mahāvijayaṃ kuru 2 saubhāgyaṃ kuru 2 sarvatravijayaṃ kuru 2 mahālakṣmī(!) dehi 2 huṃ phaṭ svāhā || atha phalaśrutiḥ || ity etat kavacaṃ divyaṃ śivena parikīrtitam || yaḥ paṭhet prayato bhūtvā sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt || trikālam ekakālam vā trivāraṃ yaḥ paṭhen naraḥ || rogān śatrūn kṣaṇāt jitvā saḥ puṃmāṃ labhate śriyam || madhyāhne ca lale sthitvā caturvāraṃ paṭhed yadi || kṣayāpasmārakuṣṭāditāpatrayanivāraṇam || yaḥ paṭhet kacaṃ (!) divyaṃ hanumaddhyānatatparaḥ manorathāḥ prasidhyanti tasya sarve na saṃśayaḥ || gurumabhyarcya vidhivat kavacaṃ prapaṭhet tataḥ triṃśat†kvatvā† yathājñānaṃ so ʼpi puṇyavatāṃvaraḥ || devam abhyarcya vidhivat puraścaryyāṃ samācaret || ekādaśaśataṃ japtvā daśāṃśaṃ havanādikaṃ tataḥ siddhir bhavet tasya p(!)raścaryyā(!)vidhānataḥ || gadyapadyamayī vāṇī tasya vaktrāt prajāyate (fol. 8v3–9v3) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale ekādaśamukhahanumatkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam śubham ❁ (fol. 9v3–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha ekādaśamukhīhanumatkavacaprārambhaḥ || oṃ śrīsamāya jaganmaṃgalātmane namaḥ || śrīdevy uvāca || śaivāni gāṇapatyāni śāktāni vaiṣṇavāni ca || kavacāni ca sarvāṇI saurāṇI cānyāni yāni tāni ca || 1 || (!) śu(!)tāni devadeveśa tvadvaktrābhiḥ sṛtāni ca || kiṃcid anya tu devānāṃ kavacaṃ yadi kathyate || 2 || śrīīś(!)vara uvāca || śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ vadhāraya (!) || hanumatkavacaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 3 || etad guhyatamaṃ loke śīghrasiddhikaraṃ param || jayo yasya prasādena lokatraya(!) jito bhavet || 4 || (fol. 1v1–7) End ekādaśīvīrahanumān māṃ rakṣa rakṣa śāṃtiṃ kuru 2 tuṣṭiṃ kuru 2 puṣṭIṃ kuru 2 mamārogyaṃ kuru 2 abhayaṃ kuru 2 avighnaṃ kuru 2 mahāvijayaṃ kuru 2 saubhāgyaṃ kuru 2 sarvatravijayaṃ kuru 2 mahālakṣmī(!) dehi 2 huṃ phaṭ svāhā || atha phalaśrutiḥ || 11 || ity etat kavacaṃ divyaṃ śivena parikīrtitam || yaḥ paṭhet prayato bhūtvā sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt || 1 || trikālam ekakālam vā trivāraṃ yaḥ paṭhen naraḥ || rogān ripun kṣaṇāt jitvā saḥ puṃmāṃ llabhate śriyaḥ || 2 || madhyāhne ca vale sthitvā caturvāraṃ paṭhed yadi || kṣayāpasmārakuṣṭāditāpatrayanivāraṇam || 3 || yaḥ paṭhet kavacaṃ divyaṃ hanumaddhyānatatparaḥ || triḥ sakṛd vā yathājñānaṃ so [ʼ] puṇyavatāṃvaraḥ || 4 || devam abhyarcya vidhivat puraścaryyāṃ samārabhet || ekādaśaśataṃ japtvā daśāṃśahavanādikaṃ tataḥ siddhaṃ hi kavacaṃ puṇyātmā paramopamaḥ || maṃtrasiddhir bhavet tasya puraścaryyāṃ vidhānataḥ || 6 || gadyapadyamayī vāṇī tasya vaktraṃ prajāyate || brahmahatyādipāpebhyo mucyate nātra śaṃ(!)sa(!)yaḥ || 7 || (fols. 6v1–7r6) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde ekādaśamukhīhanumaddivyakavacamālāmantrastotram sampūrṇam || || śubh(!)m || || iti samvat 1956 sālam iti kārttikaśudi 10 roja 1 śubh(!)m || idaṃ pustakaṃ dharmarājatṛpāṭhidvijahastena likhitam svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca || || (fol. 7r6–v3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kastūrīkuṃkumāktāgurusitakiraṇānāndravair liptagātrīṃ vidyotadraktapaṭṭāmvaram abhidadhatīṃ nāsikāmauktikāḍhyām || ratnair añcatkirīṭāṃ ruciramaṇilasatkuṇḍalodyatkapolaṃ | vibhrājadhemamuktāmaṇiracitamahābhūṣaṇair bhūṣitāṃgīm || 1 || ratnaśreṇīvicitrāvanitalavilasatkalpavṛkṣasya mūle ratnadvipasya madhye sphuradamalamaṇispaṣṭasaṃliṣṭapīṭhe svāstīrṇe sadvitāne trisaraparimite koṇavarge manojñe devādevābhivaṃdye ruciraśavahṛdambhoruhe rājamānām || 2 || visphūrjadratnkāṃtisphuradamalatulākoṭiyuktāṃghripadmāṃ hṛtpadmāntarvibhāvyārcanavidhivihitābhyarcanair arcanīyām || muktāratnapravālaprakaraṇigaṇaprollasatkaṃcukīṃ tāṃ naumyādyāṃ brahmamūrttiṃ hariharavidhibhiḥ pūjitāṃ sarvadātrīm || 3 || (fols. 1v1–2r3) End bhūpālaśreṇibhūpo bhavatu raṇabahādurasāhas tadīyā- rirnāśaṃ yātu jīvyādayamathasaradāṃ tvatprasādāt sahasram || bhūdevān devidānais tava padakamalaṃ tatsaparyāvidhānair mānair bandhūnvitānair akhilasuravarāṃs tarpayan sarvakālam || 28 || āyu(!)ddīrghaṃ dayārdraṃ hṛdayam anudinaṃ dīnavargo ṣu(!)bhargo bhaktiḥ śaktiḥ sadaiva pratibhaṭadalane garva urvīśvareṣu prītir dharme pratitir guruvacasi guṇiṣ vādaro [ʼ]bhīṣṭasaṃpat syād devi tvatprasādān nṛpatiraṇabahādurasāhasya śaśvat || 29 || (fols. 7v6–8r5) Colophon iti śrīmanmahārājādhirājamahārāje(!)raṇabahādurasāhabahādurasamseraja..devājñaptaśrīvācaspatimiśraviracitaṃ kastūrīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 8v5–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ vaṃde gajeṃdravadanaṃ vāmāṃkārūḍhavallabhāśliṣṭaṃ || kuṃkuma⟨ma⟩parāgaśoṇaṃ kuvalayinījārakorakāpīḍaṃ || 1 || sa jayati suvarṇaśailaḥ sakalajagaccakrasaṃghaṭitamūrttiḥ || kāṃcananikuṃjavāṭī- †kaṃdaladamarīprapaṃcasaṃgītaḥ† || 2 || harihayanairṛtimāruta- haritām aṃteṣv eva sthitaṃ tasya || vinumaḥ sānutritayaṃ vidhiharigaurīśaviṣṭapādhārāṃ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–4) End śīrṣāṃbhoruhamadhye śītalapīyūṣavarṣiṇīṃ bhavatīṃ || anudinam anuciṃtayatām āyuṣyaṃ bhavati puṣkalam avanyāṃ || 9 || madhurasmitāṃ madāruṇa- nayanāṃ mātaṃgakuṃbhāvakṣojāṃ || caṃdrāvasinī tvāṃ savidhe paśyaṃti sukṛtinaḥ kecit 10 lalitāyās tava ratnaṃ lalitapadābhiḥ praṇītam āryyābhiḥ || pratidinam avanau paṭhatāṃ phalāni vaktuṃ pragalbhate saiva || 11 || (fols. 11v10–12r4) Colophon iti sāryyāvidhar(!) āyye stutim āryāḥ paṭhati(!) ye || upari patati teṣām utpalanayanākaṭākṣakallolāḥ || 11 || || || ❁ || || ❁ || (fol. 12r4–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya naḥ(!) atha kātyān[ītaṃtroktaḥ] sa[pta]śatīpāṭhaprakāraḥ karaḥ †kāmpolikhata† || tatrādau puraścaraṇaprakāraḥ || pratiślokam ādyatayā praṇavaṃ datvā japeḥ | mantrasiddhiḥ || 1 || sapraṇavam anulomavyāhṛtitrayam ādau datvā aṃte ca vilomatadityevaṃ (!) mahāstotraṃ paṭhen maṃtrasiddhiḥ | 2 | praṇavaṃ vyāhṛtiślokādau paṭhitvā maṃtra(!) japen maṃtrasiddhiḥ | 4 | saptavyāhṛtipūrvakaṃ ślokaṃ kṛtvā mahāstotraṃ paṭhen maṃtraḥ | 5 | saptavyāhṛtikāṃ(!) gāyatrīm ādāv aṃte ca kra(!)tvā ślokaṃ paṭhen maṃtrasiddhiḥ | 6 | (fol. 1v1–8) End home āhuti saṃkhyā | brahmaiko bhagavān eko mārkaṃḍeyās tu mārgaṇā | devāḥ †paṃcaṛṣastriṃśa† devī dvādaśakaṃ tathā || vaiśyadūto punar dvau dvau rājovāceti vargataḥ | śco(!)kāśacurasī(!)tiś ca punaḥ paṃcaśatāni ca | arddhāni pūrvaparayoḥ punaḥ ṣoḍaśaṣoḍaśad uttarārdhāni sakṛd ve(!)ca adhyāyāś ca trayodaśa | evam āhutayaḥ saptaśatyāḥ syus tarpaṇasya ca | 1 |1 | 5 | 5 | 31 | 12 | 2 | 2 | 4 | 16 | 7 | 1 | 13 | evaṃ 700 (fol. 11v7–11) Colophon iti caṃḍīvidhānaṃ samāptaṃ || (fol. 11v12)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || upamanyur uvāca || || jaya śaṃkarapārvatīpate mṛḍaśaṃbho śaśikhaṃḍamaṃḍana || madanāṃtakabhaktavatsalapriyakailāsadayāsudhāṃ budhe || 1 || sadupāyakathāsu paṃḍito hṛdaye duḥkhaśareṇakhaṃḍitaṃ || śaśikhaṃḍamaṃḍanaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi śaraṇyam īśvaram || 2 || mahataḥ paritaḥ prasarpataḥs tamaso darśanabhedino bhide || dinanātha iva svatejasa hṛdaye vyomni manāgu dehinaḥ || 3 || na vayaṃ tava carmacakṣuṣaḥ padavīm apy upavīkṣitu(!) kṣamaḥ || kṛpayā bhapadena cakṣuṣā sakaleneśavilokayāśu naḥ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–4) End labdhāvaraṃ tu kaunteyaḥ me na vijayamātmanaḥ || āruroha tataḥ pārtho rathaṃ paramasaṃgatam || 19 || kṛṣṇārjunāv ekarathe divyau śaṃkhau padadhmatuḥ || ya idaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ kalpam utthāya mānavaḥ || 20 || yakṣa rakṣa piśācebhyo na bhayaṃ vidyate sadā || na cāpi ripavas tebhyaḥ sarpādyāye ca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ || 21 || na bhayaṃ vidyate tasya sadā rājakulād api || vivāde jayam āpnoti baddho mucyate baṃdhanāt || 22 || durgaṃ tarati cāvaśyaṃ tathā caurair vimucyate || saṃgrāme vijayen nityaṃ lakṣmīm āpnoti kevalaṃ || 23 || ārogyabalasaṃpanno jīved varṣaśataṃ tathā || etad vṛttaṃ prasādāt tu mayā vyāsasya dhīmataḥ || 24 || mohā(!) tv etair na jānaṃti naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī (!) || tava putrā durātmānaḥ sarve manyuvasānugāḥ || 25 || prāptakālam idaṃ vākyaṃ kālapāśena guṃṭhitā || dvaipāyano nāradaś ca kaṇvo rāmas tathā nabhaḥ || 26 || avārayaṃs tava sutaṃ na cāso(!) tad gṛhītavān || yatra dharmo dyutiḥ kīrtir yatra hriḥ śrīs tathāmatiḥ || 27 || yato dharmas tataḥ kṛṣṇo yataḥ kṛṣṇas tato jayaḥ || || (fol. 2v11–3r5) Colophon iti śrībhīṣmaparvaṇi kātyāyanistavasamāptaḥ || || śubhaṃ bhūyāt sādhakānām || || || || || || || || || || || (fol. 2v5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca || āryāstavaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathoktam ṛṣibhiḥ purā⟨ḥ⟩ || nārāyaṇīṃ namasyāmi devīṃ tribhuvaneśvarīṃ || 1 || tvaṃ siddhiḥ śrīr dhṛtiḥ kīrttir hrīr vidyā sannatir matiḥ || saṃdhyā rātriḥ prabhā nidrā kālarātris tathaiva ca || 2 || āryā kātyāyanī devī kauśikī brahmacāriṇī || jananī siddhasenasya ugracāramahātapāḥ || 3 || jayā ca vijayā caiva tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ kṣamā dayā || jyeṣṭā yamasya bhaginī nīlakauśeyavāsinī<ref>For nīlakauśeyavāsasī</ref> || 4 || bahurūpā virūpā ca anekavidhacāriṇī || virūpākṣī viśālākṣī bhaktānāṃ parirakṣaṇī || 5 || (fols. 1v1–2r1) End pravāse rājabaṃdhe ca śatru(!)ṇāṃ ca marddane ||<ref>Pāda a is unmetrical.</ref> prāṇātyayeṣu sarveṣu tvaṃ hi rakṣā(!) na saṃśayaḥ || 27 || tvayi me hṛdayaṃ devīṃ<ref>Should be vocative case ending.</ref> tvayi cittaṃ manas tvayi || rakṣa māṃ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ praśādaṃ ca kuruṣva me || 28 || idaṃ devyā stavaṃ puṇyam itihāsasamanvitaṃ || yaḥ paṭhet prātar utthāya śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ || 2 || tribhir māsair kāṃkṣitaṃ hi phalaṃ vai saṃprayacchati || ṣaḍbhir māsaiḥ variṣṭhaṃ tu varam ekaṃ prayacchati || 30 || arcitā navabhir māsai[r] divyacakṣuḥ prayacchati || saṃvatsareṇa siddhiṃ tu yathākāmaṃ prayacchati || 31 (fols. 5v1–6r2) Colophon iti harivaṃśe āryyāstotraṃ saṃpūrttim agamat || śubham || || (fol. 6r3)

«Complete transcript:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ asya śrī-āyu[r]vṛddhistotrasya śrīkṛṣṇa ṛṣi[ḥ] paramātmā devatā āyurvṛddhiḥ (!) pāṭhe viniyogaḥ || devy uvāca || trailokyapu(!)jite devi kamale viṣṇuvallabhe || yathā tvam acalā kṛṣṇe tathā bhavati<ref name="ftn1"> Incorrect case ending </ref> vistarāt || 1 || sa mucyate mahāghorair mṛtyurūpair durāsadaiḥ || yasyāṅgasthā mahāvidyā taṃtrasārā śivoditā || 2 || aṃmṛtaṃ tat bhavet sarvaṃ mṛtyu[r] nāsti kadācana⟨ḥ⟩ || tripuraś ca mayā dagdha imāṃ vidyāṃ ca bibhratā || 3 || paṭhitā pāṭhitā devi sarvasiddhikari(!) smṛtā || taṃtrasāroktaṃ āyuvṛddhistotram samāptam || liṣitaṃ chavilālasarmmaṇaḥ(!) śubham ||

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ sargasthityapahārāṇāṃ [[yo]] viśvasyaikakāraṇaṃ || mahāgaṇapatiṃ stoṣye paṃcāvaraṇasaṃyutaṃ || 1 || krīḍāsakt⟪ā⟫agaṇādhīśakara⟪śī⟩⟩[[sī]]karapūritaṃ || aikṣavāṃbhonidhiṃ vaṃde taraṃgakulasaṃkulaṃ 2 tasya madhye dvīpavaryaṃ naumi ratnaśilātalaṃ sevāgatāmarādhīśadaityasiddhasamākulaṃ 3 pārijātakasaṃtānamaṃdāraharicaṃdanāt sakalpavṛkṣāṃs tatrasthān naumy abhīṣṭaphalapradān 4 (fol. 1v1–7) End catuścatvāriṃśatparigaṇitapadyair viracitaṃ gaṇeśastotraṃ yaḥ paṭhati niyatāt māsa(!) [[hi]] labhet dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ putrān trya(!)ja[[na]]nṛpavaśatvaṃ ⟪‥‥‥‥⟫[[ca vasudhāṃ]] <ref name="ftn1"> Pāda c is unmetrical. </ref> cirāyuḥ sadvidyāṃ vipulatara⟪|⟫kīrttiṃ śivapadaṃ 45 catuścatvāriṃśatparigaṇitapadyair viracitaṃ japed aṣṭadravyair gaṇapatisamārādhanaparaḥ catuścatvāriṃśaddivasam atha japtvā sa labhate svakṛtsnān iṣṭārthān api japadineṣv eva sakalān || 46 || nārikelakadalīphalalājān modakān pṛthukasaktatilekṣūn sa⟨ṃ⟩nnivedya paritarpya gaṇeśaṃ maṃtram etadubhayaṃ prajapec ca || 47 || (fols. 5v8–6r8) Colophon iti triṃśatpīṭhikāyām āvaraṇastavo(!) ṣaṣṭama(!)pīṭhikāḥ(!) || śloka(!) 48 (fol. 6r8–v1)

Beginning oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya nama[ḥ] || || oṃ asya śrīkar(!)ttavīryyārjunakavacamaṃtrasya dattātreya-ṛṣir anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ śrīkārttavīryyārjuno devatā āṃ bījaṃ krīṃ śaktir[[⟨r⟩ viśucikādisakalarogopaśānti¬pūrvakadīrghāyurārogyābhivṛddhyarthaṃ]] yathoktaphalaprāptaye śrīkārttavīryaprītaye pāṭhe viniyogaḥ oṃ dattātreya-ṛṣaye namaḥ sirasi oṃ anuṣṭupchaṃdase namo mukhe śrīkārttavīryā[r]juno devatāyai namo hṛdaye āṃ bījāya namo guhye … dhyānaṃ avyāt sarvabhayāt prabhākaranibhaḥ pradyotano dyotitaḥ svarṇaśrakparivītakaṃ dharadharo raktāṃśukoṣṇīṣavān nānākalpavibhūṣitaḥ karasahasrārddhāttavāṇāśano vāṇāñ cārddhasahasrā(!)bāhur aniśaṃ bhūvallabhonaprabhūḥ 1 (fols. 1v1–2r6) End tasmāt sarvvaprayatnena kavacaṃ dhārayet sudhi(!) dhāraṇa(!)t kavaca(!) cāsya manobhīṣṭam avāpnuyāt 63 kārttavīryyakhaladvai(!)ṣī kṛtavīryyasuto valī sahasrabāhuśatrughno raktavāsādhanurddhara[ḥ] 64 raktagaṃdho raktamālyo †rājāsmarttur† abhīṣṭada[ḥ] dvādaśe(!)tāni nāmāni kārttavīryasya yaḥ paṭhet 65 saṃpada[s] tasya jāyyaṃte janā[s] tasya vase sadā 66 (fol. 17v1–7) Colophon iti śrī-uḍāmareśvara⟪saṃvāde⟫taṃtre umā-/// (fol. 17v6)

Beginning śrīmanmaṅga(la)mūrttaye namaḥ oṃ asya śrīkārttavīryārjunakavacasya dattātreyaṛṣir anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrīkārttavīryyārjuno viṣṇuś cakravarttī devatā śrīkārttavīryārjunadevaprītyarthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ avyāt sarvabhayāt prabhākaranibhaḥ pradyotano dyotanaḥ svarṇasrakparivītaka⟪‥⟫[[ndha]]radharo raktāṃśukoṣṇīṣavān|| nānāratnavibhūṣitaṃ karasahasrārddhāntavāṇāsano vāṇāntārddhasahasrabāhur aniśaṃ bhūvallabho naḥ prabhuḥ 1 śrīdevy uvāca devādhideva sarvajña sarvalo[ka]hite rataḥ kena rakṣā bhaven nṛṇāṃ bhītānāṃ vividhāpadi 2 (fol. 1v1–5) End sahasrabāhu śatrughno raktavāsādhanurddharaḥ raktagandho raktamālyo rājāsmartur<ref name="ftn1"> For raktaśmaśrur </ref> abhīṣṭadaḥ || 165 dvādaśaitāni nāmāni kārttavīryasya yaḥ paṭhet || sampadas tasya jāyaṃte janās tasya vaśe sadā || 166 (fols. 10r3–5) Colophon iti śrīmadumāmaheśvarasaṃvāde kārttavīryakavacamālāmaṃtraṃ samāptaṃ || (fol. 10r5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || ❁ || ācamya prāṇān āyamya pūrvāsaṃkalpam uktā(!) evaṃ guṇaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭhāyāṃ puṇyatithau mama śrīkārttavīryaprasādapūrvakaśatrunāśadvārā śatrukṛtopadravopaśamanapūrvakābhimatārthasiddhyarthaṃ kārtavīryaviṃśatyakṣarātmakamaṃtrasya gāyatryāś cāṣṭottaraśatavāraṃ japapūrvakaṃ śrīkārtavīryārjunakavacastotrāṣṭottaraśatanāmnāṃ ca pātham ahaṃ kariṣye || … atha dhyānam avyāt sarvabhayāt prabhākaranibhaḥ pradyotana(!) dyotanaḥ svarṇasrakparivītakaṃdharadharo raktāṃśukoṣṇīṣavān || nānākalpavibhūṣitaḥ karasahasrārddhāttavāṇāsano vāṇāṃtārddhasahasrabāhur aniśaṃ bhūvallabho naḥ prabhuḥ || 1 || (fols. 1v1–5 and 2v8–3r3) End [[ānayaty āśu durasthaṃ kṣemalābhayutaṃ śriyaṃ [[3]] | kārtavīryamahābāho sarvaśatrunivarhaṇa | sarvatra sarvadā tiṣṭha caurān nāśaya pāhi māṃ [[4]] | sahasrabāhuṃ saśaraṃ sacāpaṃ raktāṃbaraṃ raktakirīṭakuṃḍalaṃ | caurādiduṣṭabhayanāśanam iṣṭadattaṃ dhyāyen mahā hai .. .. kārttavīryam || 5 || ]] sahasrāvartanād devi śudrādyair na śrutaṃ yadi || akhilaṃ sādhayen maṃtrī †tvanāyāsan† na saṃśayaḥ || 67 || || (fol. 17r6–7) Sub-colophon [[iti śrīuḍḍāmala(!)taṃtre kārtavīryasya kavacaṃ samāptam ||]] (fol. 17r4) Colophon ity uḍḍāmarataṃtre umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde kārtavīryārjunastotram || saṃpūrṇam śubham (fol. 17r7–8)

«Beginning of the root text:» oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīmadgurave māhiṣmatīpataye sahasrārjjunāya namo namaḥ || devy uvāca || devādhi(!)deva sarvajña sarvalokahite rata || kena rakṣā bhaven nṛṇāṃ bhītānāṃ vividhāpadi || 1 || rājacaurādipīḍāsu śastrāgniviṣapātane || mārīduḥsvapnapīḍāsu graharogabhayeṣu ca || 2 || (fols. 1v5–8) «Beginning of the commentary:» /// (kārtta)vīryārjunakavacamaṃtrasya bhagavān dattātreyaṛṣir anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ śrīkārttavīryārjuno viṣṇuś cakravarttidevatā krauṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ chrīṃ avyāhatām iti kīlakaṃ mama sakalaśatrukṣayārthe mamābhīṣṭasiddhyarthe jape vinī(!)yogaḥ || || śirasi dattātreyaṛṣaye namaḥ || mukhe anuṣṭupchaṃdase namaḥ || hṛdaye kārttavīryārjunaviśṇucakravarttidevatāyai namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) «End of the root text:» sahasrabāhuḥ śatrughno raktavāsādhanurddharaḥ || raktagandho raktamālyo raktaśmaśrur abhīṣṭadaḥ || [1]65 || dvādaśaitāni nāmāni kārttavīryyasya yaḥ paṭhet saṃpadas tasya jāyante janās tasya vaśe sadā || 166 || sahasrāvarttanād devi śudrādyair na śrutaṃ yadi || akhilaṃ sādhayen maṃtrī tv anāyāse na saṃśayaḥ || 167 || (fols.25r3–6) «End of the commentary:» tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kavacaṃ dhārayet sudhīḥ || yaśasyaṃ svargam āyuṣyaṃ putrapautrapravarddhanaṃ || || ānapatyā tu dūrasthaḥ kṣemalābhasutaṃ priyaṃ || kārttavīryamahābāho sarvaśatrunibarhaṇaḥ || sarvatra sarvadā (tiṣṭha) duṣṭātmābhayapāhi mām || || oṃ oṁ klauṁ hlīṁ klīṁ bhlūṁ śrāṁ hrīṁ kroṁ śrīṁ huṁ phaṭ kārttavīryārjjunāya namaḥ oṃ namo bhagavate bho bho kārttavīryyārjjuna oṁ oṁ namaḥ hṛdaye duṣṭaṃ dāraya 2 duritaṃ hana 2 pāpaṃ matha 2 ārogyaṃ kuru 2 hāṃ hāṃ huṃ huṃ phaṭ hana dviṣaḥ oṃ namo bhagavate śrīvāsudevāya namaḥ || || (fols. 24v6, 25r1–2 and 8–9) «Colophon of the root text:» ity uḍḍāmare umāmaheśvarasamvāde kārttavīryyārjjunakavacaṃ sampūrṇam || ❁ || || (fol. 25r7)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || asya śrīkārttavīryyaaṣṭottaranāmastotrasya dattātreya ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup cchaṃdaḥ kārttavīryārjuno viṣṇuś cakravarttī ca devatā śarīrarakṣārthaṃ sarvvakāryasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || avyāt sarvabhayāt prabhākaranibhaḥ pradyotano dyotitaḥ svarṇasṛkparivītakuṃḍaladharo<ref name="ftn1"> For svarṇasrak </ref> raktāṃśukoṣṇīṣavān || nānākalpavibhūṣitaḥ karasahasrodbhūtavāṇāsano, vāṇopetasahasrabāhur aniśaṃ śrīvallabho naḥ prabhuḥ || (fols. 1v1–6) End sarvvarogaprapīḍāsu, tridhā vā paṃcadhā paṭhet | sarogamṛtyuvaitālabhūtapretair vimucyate || 32 || gopanīyaṃ prayatnena, śivasya vacanaṃ yathā || subhaktāya suśiṣyāya, dadyāt sarvvasvadāyine || 33 || sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya yad uktaṃ candramaulinā | kārttavīryasya stavanaṃ, yad uktaṃ vai mayā tava || 34 || tena saṃrakṣito devi, kālenāpi na jīyate | tasmāt sarvvaprayatnena, stavanaṃ dhārayet sudhīḥ || 35 || || (fol. 4v1–6) Colophon iti śrīḍāmareśvaratantre kārttavīryārjunakalpe, kārttavīryārjunastotraṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || || (fol. 4v6–7)

Beginning of 1. Kārttavīryārjunastotra śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṁ asya śrīkārttavīryārjjunakavacasya dattātreyaṛṣir anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrīkārttavīryārjuno viśṇuś cakravarttī devatā śrīkārttavīryārjunaprītyā mamābhīṣṭasiddhyarthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ | avyāt sarvabhayāt prabhākaranibhaḥ pradyotano dyotana(!) svarṇasrakparivītakaṃdharadharo raktāṃśukoṣṇīṣavān || nānāratnavibhūṣitakarasahasrārddhāntavāṇāsano vāṇāntārddhasahasrabāhur aniśaṃ bhūvallabho na[ḥ] prabhuḥ | kārttavīryārjunacaraṇābhyāṃ namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–4; 1st foliation) End of 2. Kārttavīryārjunastotra viṣame vipine ghore dāvāgnau girikaṃdare || saṃgrāme sastrasaṃpāte siṃhavyāghraniṣevite || 56 || gahvare sarvasaṃkīrṇe saṃdhyākāle nṛpālaye || vivāde vipulāvartte samuddre ca nadītaṭe || 57 || paripaṃthijanākīrṇe deśe dasyugaṇāvṛte || sarvasvaharaṇe prāpte (fol. 6r4–6; 2nd foliation) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīkārttavīryāya namaḥ || asya śrīkārttavīryakavacastotramahāmaṃtrasya ///ttātreyaṛṣir anuṣṭup chandaḥ kārttavīryārjuno mahāviṣṇur ddevatā phrauṁ bījaṃ hrīṁ śaktiḥ avyāhatām iti kīlakaṃ mama śatrukṣayārthe jape viniyogaḥ || dattātreyapriyatamāya klāṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || māhiṣmatīnāthāya klīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā || … dhyānam || sahasrabāhuṃ saśaraṃ sacāpaṃ raktāmbaraṃ raktakirīṭakuṃḍalaṃ ///ṣtabhayanāśanam iṣṭadaṃtaṃ dhyāyen mahābhayavijṛṃ(bha)takārttavīryam || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4 and 8–2r1) End sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya yad uktaṃ caṃdramaulinā || kārtavīryasya kavacaṃ tad uktaṃ vai mayā tava (|| 67 ||) yena saṃrakṣito dehaḥ kālenāpi na jīryate || tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kavacaṃ dhārayet sudhīḥ || 68 || (fol. 13r6–7) Colophon ity uḍḍāmarataṃtre umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde kārtavīryā[r]junaaṣṭottaraśataṃ nāma kavacaṃ samāptaṃ śubham ❁ (fol. 13r7–8)

Beginning ❖ oṃ śrībhavānyai || || devādhideva sarvvajña⟨ḥ⟩ sarvalokahite rata⟨ḥ⟩ | kena rakṣā bhaven nṛṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ vividhāpadi || 1 || rājacaurādipīḍāsu śastrāgniviṣapātane || mārīduḥsvapnapīḍāsu graharogabhayeṣu ca || jvarāpasmārapīḍāsu siṃhavyāghranipātane || rākṣasāsuravetālapiśācapretapātane || (fol. 1v1–5) End yena saṃrakṣito devī(!) kālenāpi na jīryyate || kārttavīryyakhaladveṣī kṛtavīryyasuto baliḥ | sahasrabāhu śatrughno raktavāsādhanurddharaḥ || raktagaṃdho raktamālyo rājāsmarttur<ref name="ftn1"> For raktaśmaśrur </ref> abhīṣṭadaḥ || dvādaśe(!)tāni nāmāni kārttavīryyasya yaḥ paṭhet || saṃpadas tasya jāyaṃte janās tasya vaśe sadā || 165 || (fol. 12v5–8) Colophon iti śrīuḍḍāmaheśvarataṃtre kārttavīryyārjunastotraṃ samāptaṃ || ❁ || śrīsaṃvat 1720 cāndramāse, caitraśuklapaṃcamī(!) likhitim(!) iti saṃpūrṇaṃ śubhaṃ || (fol. 12v9–10)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama śrībhairavāya namaḥ || oṁ tīkṣmādaṃṣṭreti prārthanaṃ bhairavasya || yaṃ yaṃ || ghaṃ jaktirūpaṃ dasāṃ dāṃsavāṃsatamṛsikaṃ yājamānaṃ || saṃ saṃ saṃtyaṃ hānayurti siramukuṭajaṭāḥ sokharaṃ caṃdrabiṃbaṃ || daṃ daṃ daṃ daṃ dīrghkājaṃ vikṛtanasramukhaṃ urdharo yaṃ karālaṃ paṃ paṃ paṃ pāpanāśapramatasatataṃ bhairavaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End bhairavāsṭakam idaṃ puṇyaṃ sa ye māsaṃ ya paṭhe naraḥ sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraṃḥ || (9) || (fol. 3r4–5) Colophon iti śrīkāśikhaṃḍe kālabhairavastotraṃ saṃpurṇaṃ || || || || (fol. 3r5–6)

«Beginning» ❖ śrīḥ || aiṃ namas te śivānande nirāstave nirākule | susambikṣaraṇātīte bhāvābhāvavivarjite || susvarūpe ca cidbhūte ciccetarūpabhāvane || kulākulajagadbhāse vibhave ca madāpahe || jyotīsvarūpape pare śānte nādarūpanirāmaye vindumadhye gate śū.. bālāgrasatakalpite || tejorūpapare vyomni nānākāravyavasthite || muktāphalamanākāre kuṭile cārddhacandrike || tuṣārakaṇikābhāse dvādaśānte vyavasthite || candrabimbanibhākāre kalāṣoḍaśasaṃsthite || niddhūmāṅgāre saṅkāse kūṭasthena vyavasthite || jalabuddhadasaṃkāse kṣīradhārāpariplute || (fol. 1r1–4) «End» vāmam vāmacaritram iśvaram ahaṃ hansasvarūpaṃ tanau nāvajanmasamudrataraṇe durjñeyarūpam paraṃ | ākāśamvaramadhyaghoraduritadha(!)mmaikadakṣaṃ mahā kāruṇyāśayam eva naumi satataṃ vārāṇasībhūpatiṃ || sadyojātam ahaṃ haraṃ śubhakaraṃ sarvvaprakārākṛtiṃ nirbha(!)dam bhava bhedanaṃ guṇanidhiṃ śrīpañcavaktraṃ sūraṃ | viśvekābharaṇaṃ samastaphaladaṃ jyotiḥsvarūpaṃ śraye śaktyāliṅgitavigrahaṃ hitakaraṃ vārāṇasī- (fol. 2v6–8) «Colophon» iti kramastuti samāptā || || || (fol. 2r5)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kalpadrumavane ratya ratnasiṃhāsanopari || umayā sahitaṃ devaṃ papraccha nandikeśvaraṃ || 1 || nandikeśvara uvāca || || devadeva jagannātha pṛcchāmi parameśvara⟨ḥ⟩ || kena kāvyakarībuddhiḥ prakāśayati niścitaṃ || 2 || śrīrudrovāca || śṛṇu vatsa māhāprājña guhyād guhyataraṃ mahat || catuślokīti vikhyātaṃ vadāmi dhyānapūrvakaṃ || 3 || (exp. 2, ll. 1–4) End yaḥ idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ catuḥślokī ca vedavit || vāṃchitārtha(!) prapadyeta kavir bhavati niścitaṃ || 9 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturddaśyāṃ saṃkrāntau grahaṇeṣu ca || bhaumavāre paṭhed yas tu jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ || 10 || idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || deyaṃ śiṣyāya bhaktāya nābhaktāya kadācana⟨ḥ⟩ || 11 || (exps. 3t, l. 8–4, l. 3) Colophon iti śrīkulācāracaṃdrodaye kālikāyā[ś] catuślokīstavendra(!) samāptam || || (exp. 4 ll. 3–4)

Beginning svasti śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ namo bhagavate kārttavīryārjunāya || || devy uvāca || || devādhideva sarvajña sarvalokahite ratah || kena rakṣā bhaven nṛṇāṃ bhītānāṃ vividhāpadi || 1 || rājacaurādipīḍāsu śastrāgniviṣapātane || mārīdu[[ḥ]]svapnapīḍāsu graharogabhayeṣu ca || 2 || jvarāpasmārapīḍāsu siṃhavyāghranipātane || rākṣasāsuravetālapiśācapretapātane || 3 || (fol. 1v1–3) End gopanīyaṃ prayatnena śivasya kavacaṃ yathā || subhaktāya suśiṣyāya dadyāt sarvasvadāyine || 157 || sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya yad uktaṃ candramaulinā || kārttavīryasya kavacaṃ tad uktaṃ vai mayā tava || 158 || yena saṃrakṣito devi kālenāpi tīryate || tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kavacaṃ dhārayet sudhīḥ || 159 || || (fols. 10r1–10r5) Colophon iti śrīmaduḍḍāmaratantre śrīkārttavīryā[r]junakavaca[ṃ] samāptam || || || || śrīśāke viyadagninaga .. .. dīdhitiparimitena māse īśānatithau nāgarkṣe māheyadine daḥ(!) kavacam .. .. durgānāthaśarmābhijñaḥ || || (fol. 10r5–7)

Beginning oṁ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || stavarājaṃ śṛṇu rāma kālikāyā manoramaṃ || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa kālikā sṃprasīdati || 1 || madbhakto yadi vāsi tvaṃ bhṛguvaṃśasamudbhava⟪m⟫ḥ || gopanīyaṃ prayatnena paṭhanīyaṃ parātparam || || 2 || (fol. 1v1–6) End rajasvalābhagaṃ spṛṣṭvā japtvā kālīmahāmanuṃ || stavenānena saṃstutya sādhakaḥ kin na sādhayet || 20 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā yonim āmantrya maṃtravit || japitvā<ref name="ftn1"> For japtvā </ref> ca mahāmaṃtraṃ kālīrūpo na saṃśayaḥ || 21 || || (fol. 4v2–6) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale kālikāstavarājaḥ samāpta[ḥ] || || (fol. 5v1–2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || pārvaty uvāca || vinā pūjāṃ vinā dhyānaṃ vinā jāpyena meśvaraḥ || vinā baliṃ vinā yaṃtrair vinā maṃtreṇa siddhyati || 1 || tad brūhi deva deveśa kālī yena pratuṣyati || etat kathaya me svāmin kṛpāṃ kṛtvā maheśvara⟨ḥ⟩ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End gadyapadyamayī vāṇī, bhavet gaṃgāpravāhavat || muktir bhavet sarvvajñānī devavat sadṛśo bhavet || 18 || kim atra bahunoktena, siddhilābho na saṃśayaḥ || sarvakaṣṭavināśāya, japet stotram idaṃ śubhaṃ || 30 || (fol. 5r6–5v4) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale kālīaṣṭottaraśatanāmasamāptaḥ || śubham || || samvat 1840 sālamiti mārgavadi 13 śaniścaravāre likhitaṃ vidyāvāhādūreṇa śubhaṃ bhūyāt || (fol. 5v4–6)

«Beginning» ❖ oṃ namaḥ caṇḍikāyai || kaṃkārī(!) kālarūpī triguna(!)guna(!)mayā || muṇḍamālābhihārī cāmuṇḍā pretasas(!)thāpi bhavananilayā || kālikā bhairavītvaṃ || nirmmāsā koṭarākṣī tri(na)yaṇa(!)vikaṭida(!)ṣṭradhārī maheśī sā devī devā devi(!) tribhuvaṇa(!)jananī kāri(!)kā smarāmi || || saṃsārthaṃ prasiddhā tridaśabhayaharāt pālinā(!) devatāyān vāme pātrārīpūrṇṇam amṛtaśirayaṃ dakṣiṇe vidu mudrāḥ tad urddhvahastakhaḍgaṃ tridaśabhayaharām ūrddhavāme niścalaṃ sā devī devadevī || tribhuvanajananī kālikāṃ sasmarāmi ||❁ || (fol. 1r1–v2) «End» yā devī subhadā mamāstu subhadaṃ || yā bhairavikārī(!)nī || yā śrīkāmasvarūpiṇī || bhagavati yā bhadrakālī śriyā || yā lakṣmībhuvimaṇḍale || tripaṭhagā yā devatā devati(!) || sā devi /// rakṣatu sadā śrīkālikā bhairavi(!) || 10 || idaṃ stotraṃ mahādevyāḥ kālikāyā(!) śubhapradaṃ || māhāśāntikaraṃ nityaṃ || kālamṛtyuvināśanaṃ || (fol. 3r6–v4) «Colophon» iti śrīkārī(!)devyā stotraṃ samāpta(!) || || (fol. 3v4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīdakṣiṇakāli[[kā]]yai namaḥ || || śrīdevy uvāca oṃ devadeva jagannātha bhaktānugrahakāraka || sarvāpada(!) samāpnoti paritrāṇaṃ kathaṃ naraḥ || 1 || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi guhyād guhyataraṃ param || āpaduddhāraṇaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam || 2 || (fols. 1v1–4) End devīṃ hṛdi samārādhya paṭhitvāṣṭādhikaṃ śatam || khaḍgādibhir avadhya syād bandhanān mucyate kṣaṇāt || 15 || guruvaktrāt samāsādhya lakṣaṃ yaḥ prapaṭhec chuciḥ || parituṣṭāṃ tadā kāli tasya pratyakṣatāṃ vrajet || 16 || || (fols. 3v4–4r2) Colophon iti śrīkālīkalpe dakṣiṇakālikāyā⟨ṃ⟩ āpaduddhārakavacaṃ samāptaṃ śubhaṃ bhavatu sarvadā⟨ḥ⟩ || || || || || || (fol. 4v2–3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kailāsaśikhare ramye sukhāsīnaṃ sadāśivaṃ || praṇamya śirasā nāthaṃ pārvatī paryyapṛcchataḥ || 1 || pārvaty uvāca || tvattaḥ śrutaṃ purā deva gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ || nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ saccitraṃ gakārādika⟨ṃ⟩m iṣṭadaṃ || 2 || guhyād guhyataraṃ loke sarvvābhiṣṭārthasādhakaṃ || tan me vadasva deveśa yady ahaṃ vallabhā tava || 3 || (fols. 1v1–5) End na deyaṃ kṛpaṇāyātha śaṭhāya guruvidviṣe || datte ca bhraṃśam āpnoti devatānāṃ prakopataḥ || 84 || iti śrutvā mahādevād devī vismitamānasā || pūjayāmāsa vidhivad gaṇeśvarapadadvyayam || 185 || (fol. 18v1–4) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde gakārādimahāgaṇapatisahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śubham || śrīr astu || vikramābdagate 1851 pauṣakṛṣṇacaturthyāṃ tithau ravivāsare liṣatim<ref name="ftn1"> For likhitam . </ref> idaṃ śrīuttamarājopādhyāyaśarmmaṇā || asya gurupāśupatapatrālaye mudrita(!) kāṃtipū(!)rato(!)la⟪ṭhaṃ⟫ hi(tprā)pano .. śubhaṃ (fol. 18v4–7)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgaṃgādevyai namaḥ || || samṛddhaṃ saubhāgyaṃ sakalavasudhāyāḥ kim api taṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ līlājanitajagataḥ khaṇḍaparaśo(!) || śrutīnāṃ sarvasvaṃ sukṛtam atha mūrttaṃ sumanasāṃ sudhāsaundaryaṃ te salilam aśivan taḥ(!) śamayatuḥ(!) || 1 || daridrāṇāṃ dainyaṃ duritam atha durvāsanahṛdāṃ drutaṃ dūrīkurvan sakṛd upagato dṛṣṭisaraṇim || api drāgāvidyādu(!)madalanadīkṣā gurur iha pravāhas te cārāṃ śriyamayapārāṃ diśatu naḥ || 2 || †udaśvat† mātsaryasphuṭakapaṭaherambajananī kaṭākṣavyākṣepakṣaṇajanitasaṃkṣobhanivahā bhavantu †stuṃ†gaṃto haraśirasi gaṃgātanubhuvas taraṃgāḥ prottuṃgā duritabhayabhaṃgāya bhavatām || 3 || (fol. 1v1–6) «End» vibhūṣitālaṃ(!)garipūttamāṅgāsadyaḥ smṛtān ekajanārtibhaṅgāḥ manoharotturaṅgajalāvibhaṅgā gaṃgā mamā[ṃ]gāny amalīkarotu 52 imāṃ pīyūṣalaharī(!) jagannāthena nirmitām yaḥ paṭhet tasya sarvatra jāyante sarvasaṃpadaḥ 53 rājyaṃ yadi tribhuvanasya dadāsi jahoḥ kanye tathāpi tad ahaṃ na tṛṇāya manye †pacinta† kevalam umāpatimaulisaṃge gaṅge tavāmalacalatkaruṇākaṭākṣim 54 yadi ced upekṣase tvaṃ ge(!)tihīnaṃ sarvatonirasabhyām vada karuṇavati gaṅge katamo viṣayas tavāsikaruṇāyāḥ 55 (fol. 5v2–5) «Colophon» iti śrīja gann āthaviracitā gaṃgālaharī samāptā likhitaṃ śivadattaśarmaṇā śākaḥ 1724 śubham mokṣāya | (fol. 5–6)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || bhāgīrathī tridaśasevitapādapadmā abjābhayāmṛtakarīr avarāḍhyahastā || muktā vibhūṣaṇavirājitacārudehā pāpaṃ vināśayatu me sukṛtapravāhā || 1 || durgārāmam ahaṃ praṇamya pitaraṃ goviṃdarāmātmajaṃ sāhityālayaraṃganāthatanayaṃ śrīkṛṣṇabhaṭṭaṃ guruṃ || ṭīkāṃ bālamude karomi viśadāṃ gaṃgālaharyyāḥ parāṃ tuṣyaṃtu pratibhā juṣaś capalatāṃ vīkṣāʼrbhakasya sphuṭāṃ || 2 || (fol. 1r1–7) «End» idānīṃ stotranāmasvanāmaniba[ṃ]dhanapūrvakaṃ stotrapaṭhanaphalam āha || imām iti || imāṃ uktalakṣaṇāṃ pīyūṣalaharīṃ pīyūṣasya amṛtasya la[ha]rīnopamānaṃ jagannāthena jagannāthanāmnā kartrīnirmitāṃ kṛtāṃ yaḥ pumān paṭhet tasya puṃsaḥ sarvatra sarvakālaṃ jayasaṃpadaḥ jāyaṃte sarvotkarṣasaṃpadā udpadyaṃte iti śivaṃ || 53 || || saṃvad vedarasadvida[ṃ]takumi[te] varṣe śubhe mādhave māse kṛṣṇadale śaśāṃkadivase śrīdvāaśī(!) sattithau durgārātanūjanirddalapatir gaṃgālaharyā stuteṣ ṭīkāṃ bālavibodhinīṃ saniramād bhāgīrathīprītaye || (fol. 31v3–11) «Colophon» iti śrīdurgārāmasūrisūnudalapatirāmaviracitā gaṃgālaharīṭīkā bālavibodhinī nāmnī samāptā || śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇam astu || (fol. 31v11–12)

muktā vibhūṣaṇavirājitacārudehā pāpaṃ vināśayatu me sukṛtapravāhā || 1 || durgārāmam ahaṃ praṇamya pitaraṃ govindarāmān mataṃ sāhityā(jaya)raṅganāthatanayaṃ śrīkṛṣṇabhaṭṭaguruṃ || ṭīkā bālam «Beginning» «Beginning of the root text:» || śrīgaṃgāyai namaḥ || sadekā nirdhūtadvayanikhilamohāmṛtasukhā samastavyastātma(sthi)racaravikalpaikanilayā || nirīhā nirlepā niravadhiparabrahmasubhagā tvam eva tvatkīrtyai suradhuni mano me spṛhayati || 1 || aśeṣair doṣais tvaṃ jananiguṇajātaiś ca rahitā- ʼviśeṣāʼsāmānyā paramamahimānaṃ gatavatī || samastādyair hīnā nikhilajanasaṃtāpahariṇī(!) stutā sadeketyādisvarūpā tvam eva satī cāsāv ekā ca sadekā satī kālatrayā bādhyā ekā sajātīyavijātīyadvitīyarahitā tathā nirddhūtau dvayanikhilamohau yayā dvayaṃ kāryaṃ moho māyāʼvidyābhedena dvidhā prakṛtiḥ tathāʼmṛtasukhā mokṣasukharūpā tathā samastavyastau samaṣṭivyaṣṭī ātmāsvarūpasya īdṛśaḥ sthiracaravikalpaḥ sthiracarau ātmānau yasya sa sthiracarātmakas tādṛśo vikalpaḥ †āsyān† mukhād udgatāʼpūrvāsadgaṃgālaharī gaṃgāstutirūpā svasaṃgavaśataḥ atra loke śaṃkalyāṇaṃ tanotv ity anvaya iti śivam || 54 || || (fol. 16v11 17r1–2, 8–9) «Colophon» «Colophon of the root text:» Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha gaṃgādhyānam || caturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ ca sarvāvayavaśobhitām || ratnakumbhasitāṃbhojavaradābhayasatkarām || 1 || śvetavastraparīdhānāṃ muktāmaṇivibhūṣitām || evaṃ dhyāyet susaumyāṃ ca candrāyutasamaprabhām || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End sarvān kāmān avapnoti pretya brahmaṇi līyate || imaṃ stavaṃ gṛhe yas tu lekhayitvā vinikṣipet || 18 || nāgnicaurabhayaṃ tatra pāpebhyo pi bhayaṃ na hi || || || oṁ namo bhagavatyai daśapāpaharāyai gaṃgāyai nārāyaṇyai revattyai śivāyai dakṣāyai amṛtāyai viśvamukhyai tārāyai viśvāyai vṛhatyai naṃdinyai namo namaḥ || || (fol. 3r1–4) Colophon iti śrīskaṃdapurāṇe gaṃgāstotram || || rāmarttuśailabhūśāke kulīre taraṇau gate || likhitaṃ dhavale pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ budhe śubham || || śubhaṃ (fol. 3r4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || gaṃgākā tīramā upavāsa garikana rahyākā parikṣit nāmā rājākana śukadeva ṛṣi kahaṃchan he mahārāja parikṣit saṃpūrṇa parvatamā śreṣṭha bhayāko kṣīrasamudrale berhiyāko cālīśa hajāra kośa algo bhayāko bahutai suṃdara esto trikuṭa nāuṁ garyāko kohi eka parvata cha || 1 || | (fol. 1v1–5) End arjunkā nāti candravaṃśī mahārāja janamejaya rājālāi kahyākā bhāgavatapurāṇamadhye gajendramokṣaṇa pani kastā tarahaje bhayo ausara bāṁki cha bhanyā ājñā bhayā sundā huṁ bhanī parīkṣita mahārājale vinti gardā lau suna bhani gajendramokṣaṇa kahiyāko svai vistāra sampūrṇa bhayo śubham astu || || (fol. 22r1–5) Colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe aṣṭamaskandhe gajendropākhyāne caturtho dhyāyaḥ 4 || || śrīśāke vidhuśailameghabhuvi yad rājendrabhūmaṇḍale nepālendrapade bhṛtau harasutaprakhyas tithau lekhitam (fol. 22r5–7)

Beginning [[karoti śyāmalāṃ bhūmiṃ hari]]nmarakatāśmabhiḥ 4 siddhacāraṇagadhaṃ(!)vavidhādharamahoragaiḥ kinnnarair apsarobhiś ca krīḍadbhir juṣṭakaṃdaraḥ 5 (fol. 2r1–2) End śṛṃgānī(!)māni dhiṣṇyāni brahmaṇo me śivasya ca kṣīrodaṃ me priyaṃ dhāma śvetadvīpaṃ ca bhāsvaraṃ 18 (fol. 12v5–6) Sub-colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe āṣṭamaskaṃdhe gajendramokṣaṇaṃ nāma tṛtīyo ʼdhyāyaḥ || || (fol. 10v2–3) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgu[[ru]]bhyo namaḥ || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || || śuka uvāca || āsīd girivaro rājaṁs trikūṭa iti viśṛutaḥ || kṣīrodenāvṛtaḥ śrīmān yojanāyutam ucchritaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End yad gandhamātrād dharayo gajendrā vyāghrādayo vyālamṛgāḥ sakhaḍgāḥ || mahoragāś cāpi bhayā[[d]] dravanti sagaurakṛṣṇāḥ ⟪sa⟫[[śa]]rabhāś camaryaḥ || 21 || vṛkā varāhā mahiṣarkṣaśalyā gopucchaśālā vṛkamakaṭāś ca || (fol. 2v7–9) Colophon
Beginning End Colophon

Beginning duḥsvapnādyupaśaṃtaye || 15 || idam āha hari[ḥ] prīto gajendraṃ kurusattama || śṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtamayo vibhuḥ || 16 || (fol. 12r1–2) End ye mā[ṃ] stuvaṃty anenāṅga pratibudhyā(!) niśātyeye || teṣāṃ prāṇāyate<ref name="ftn1"> for prāṇātyaye </ref> cāhaṃ dadāmi vipulāṃ<ref name="ftn2"> vimalāṃ is more suitable. </ref> ma (fol. 12v6–7) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīśuka uvāca || || āsīd girī(!)varo rājaṁs trikūṭa iti viśṛutaḥ || kṣīrodenāvṛtaḥ śrīmān yojanāyutam ucchritaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End śrīśuka uvāca || || ity ādiśya ṛṣīkeśaḥ pradhmāya jalajottamam || harṣayan vibudhānīkam āruroha khagādhipam || 26 || || || (fol. 12v5–6) Colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe aṣṭamaskandhe gajendropākhyāne caturtho ʼdhyāyaḥ || || (fol. 13r1–2)

«Beginning of the root text:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śukadeva deva uvāca || āsīd girivaro rājaṁs trikūṭa iti viśrutaḥ || kṣīrodenāvṛtaḥ śrīmān yojanāyutam ucchritaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v4–5) «Beginning of the translation:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || gaṃgākā tīramā upavāsa garī kana rahyākā parikṣita nāma rājākana śukadeva ṛṣi khahaṃchan || he mahārāja parikṣit || saṃpūrṇa parvatamā śreṣṭha bhayāko kṣīrasamudra le berhiyāko || … (fol. 1v1–2) «End of the root text:» śrīśuka uvāca || ity ādiśya hṛṣi(!)keśaḥ pradhmāya jalajottamaṃ || harṣayan vibudhānīkam āruroha khagādhipaṃ || 26 || (fol. 19r4–6) «End of the translation:» pāṃcajanyā nāmā śaṃkhakā śabdale saṃpūrṇa devatākana haṛsa garāī pakṣiviṣe śreṣṭha bhayākā garuḍaviṣe savāra bhai vaikuṇṭhamā calyā || 26 || (fol. 19r7–8) «Colophon of the root text:» iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe aṣṭamaskandhe gajeṃdramokṣaṇaṃ nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || (fol. 19r6) «Colophon of the translation:» iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe aṣṭamaskandhe gajeṃdramokṣaṇaṃ nāma bhāṣāyāṃ [[ca]]turtho dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || śrīśāke 1771 śrīsaṃvat 1906 jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇaṣa‥yāṃ caṃdravāsare || || (fol. 19r8–9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || tatrāpi jajñe bhagavān hariṇyāṃ harimedhasaḥ || harir ity āhṛto yena gajendo mocito grahāt || 1 || rājovāca || vādarāyaṇi etat te śrotum icchāma(!) he vayam || harir yathā gajapatiṃ grāhagrastam amūmucat || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End śrīśuka uvāca || ity ādiśya hṛṣīkeśaḥ pradhmāya jalajottamam || harṣayan vibudhānīkam āruroha khagādhipam || 26 || || (fol. 12v1–3) Colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe aṣṭamaskaṃdhe gajeṃdramokṣaṇaṃ nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ || 4 || saṃpūrṇaṃ || śubham || (fol. 12v3–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamaṃ || deviṃ(!) sarasvatīṃ caiva tato jayam udīraya(!)t || śrīśuka uvāca || āsīd girivaro rājaṃs trikūṭa iti viśrutaḥ || kṣīrodenāvṛtaḥ śrīmān yojanāyutam ucchritaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End śrīśuka uvāca || || ity ādiśya hṛṣīkeśaḥ pradhmāya jalajottamaṃ || harṣayan vibudhānīkam āruroha ṣagādhipam || 26 || (fol. 12r7–12v1) Colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe ʼṣṭamaskaṃdhe gajendropākhyānaṃ bhagavat(!)vibhūtikathanaṃ nāma caturtho ʼdhyāyaḥ || 4 || || samāptaṃ || || śrīśāke 1799 śrīsamvat 1934 sālamiti āṣāḍhaśudi 10 roja 6 || śubham || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 12r1–5)

Beginning svasti śrīgana(!)pataye ⟨n⟩ namaḥ || śuka uvāca || āsīd girivaro rājaṃs trikūṭa iti viśrutaḥ || kṣīrodena(!)vṛtaḥ śrīmān yojanāyutam ucchritaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End śuka uvāca || evaṃ svasvāgato ʼgastyo bhagavān nṛpasānugaḥ || iṃdradyumno pi rājarṣir diṣṭaṃ tad upadhārayan || 11 || āpannaḥ kauṃjarīṃ yonim ātmasmṛtivinā (fol. 8v6–7) Colophon

Beginning tritaiḥ || nānādrumalatāgulmair nirghoṣair nirjharāṃbhasāṃ || 3 || sa cāvanijyamānāṃghriḥ samantāt payaūrmibhiḥ || karoti śyāmalāṃ bhūmiṃ harin marakatāsmabhiḥ || 4 || (fol. 2r1–3) End śrīśuka uvāca || ity ādiśya hṛśīkeśaḥ pradhmāya jalajottamam || harṣayan vibudhānīkam āruroha khagādhipam || 26 || ❁ || (fol. 15r1–3) Colophon iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe aṣṭamaskandhe manvantarānuvarṇane gajendropākhyāne gajendramokṣaṇan nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ || śubham ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ (fol. 15r3–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || mātaḥ śailasutāsapatni vasudhāśṛṃgārahārāvali svargārohaṇavaijayaṃti bhavatīṃ bhāgīrathīṃ prārthaye tvattīre vasatas tvadaṃbu pibatas tvadvīciṣu preṃkhatas tvannāma smaratas tvadarpitadṛśaḥ syān me śarīravyayaḥ 1 (fol. 1v1–4) End gaṃgāṣṭakaṃ paṭhati yaḥ prayataḥ prabhāte vālmīkinā viracitaṃ śubhadaṃ manuṣyaḥ prakṣālya gātrakalikalmaṣapaṃkam āśu mokṣaṃ labhet patati naiva naro bhavābdhau 9 (fol. 3v2–4) Colophon iti śrīvālmīkinā viracitaṃ gaṃgāṣṭakaṃ saṃpūrṇam || || śubham || || (fol. 3v4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṁ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya || || śrīśuka uvāca || || āsīd girivaro rājaṃs trikūṭa iti viśrutaḥ || kṣīrodenāvṛtaḥ śrīmān yojanāyutam ucchritaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End ity ādiśya hṛṣīkeśaḥ pradhmāya jalajottamam || harṣayan vibudhānīkam āruroha khagādhipam || || 26 || (fol. 11r6–11v2) Colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe aṣṭamaskandhe manvantarānuvarṇane rājendropākhyāne caturtho ʼdhyāyaḥ || 4 || puruṣottamāya namaḥ || || acyutāya namaḥ || || gurubhyo namaḥ || yad akṣarapadabhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnaṃ tu yad bhavet || tat sarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ deva prasīda puroṣottama || samvat || || 1918 sālamiti kārttikavadi 9 roja 1 || śubham āgad ayaṃ(!) gajendramokṣaṇam (fol. 11v2–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || | śrīśuka uvāca || āsīd girivaro rājan trikuṭa iti viśrutaḥ || kṣīrodenāvṛtaḥ śrīmān yujanāyutam ucchritaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1) End ity ādiśya hṛṣīkeśaḥ pradhmāya jalajottamam || harṣayan vibudhānīkam aruroha khagādhipam || 26 || || (fol. 6v4–5) Colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe ʼṣṭamaskandhe gajendropākhyānaṃ nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ || || (fol. 6v5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīviṣṇave namaḥ || || śatānīka uvāca || mayā hi devadevasya viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ || śrutāḥ saṃbhūtayaḥ sarvāḥ gadatas tava suvrata || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End Bhaktimān puṃḍarīkākṣe gajo duḥkhād vimocitaḥ || tathā tvam api rājendra prapadya śaraṇaṃ harim || 84 || vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ prāpyate parmāṃ gatim || 85 || (fol. 5r6–7) Colophon iti śrīviṣṇudharme śaunakaśatānīkasaṃvāde gajendramokṣaṇaṃ nāma stotraṃ samāptam || || || śrīvāsudevāya namaḥ idam iha vilikhitvā<ref name="ftn1"> For vilikhya </ref> cārpitaṃ stotrasāraṃ karadhṛtakamalenānekapendreṇa gītaṃ || śaraṇagakṛpaṇānāṃ mādṛśāṃ duḥkhaśāṃtyai kṣitivitaraṇaśīlaśrīmahārājatuṣṭyai || 1 || śāke 1762 caitraśudi 13 roja 1 (fol. 5r7–10)

«Beginning of the Gajendramokṣaṇa:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || tatrāpi jajñe bhagavān hariṇyāṃ harimedhasaḥ || harir ity āhṛto yena ja[je]ndro mocito grahāt || 1 || (fol. 1v3–5) «Beginning of the Gajendramokṣaṇabhāṣā:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || tatreti || parīkṣit mahārājāprati śukadeva ṛṣi vistārakanagardachan tāmasa nāuṃ garyākā caturtha manvaṃtaramā pani harimedhā deṣi hariṇī nāuṃ garyāko patnīmā hari bhanikana prakhyāta bhayāko śrībhagavānko avatāra huṃdo huṃthyo ujan harile grāhako gṛaṣa garyāmā gajendralāī mokṣagarāyā || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2 and 6–7) «End of the Gajendramokṣaṇa:» ity ādiśya hṛṣīkeśa pradhmāya jalajottamam || harṣaya[n] vibudhānīkam āruroha khagādhipam || 26 || || (fol. 28r3–5) «End of the Gajendramokṣaṇabhāṣā:» … vaikuṃṭhamā jānānimitta paṃchiviṣe śreṣṭha bhayākā garuḍamā savāra huṃdā bhayā || 26 || || (fol. 28r8–9) «Colophon of the Gajendramokṣaṇa:» iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe ʼṣṭamaskandhe gajendramokṣaṇān nāma caturthā ʼdhyāyaḥ || 4 || || saṃpūrṇam || śubham || (fol. 28r5–7) «Colophon of the Gajendramokṣaṇabhāṣā:» iti aṣṭamaskaṃdhe gajeṃdramokṣaṇaṃ nāma caturtho dhyāya samāpta⟨ṃ⟩[ḥ] || śubham (fol. 28r9)

Beginning oṁ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śatānīka uvāca || || mayā hi devadevasya viṣnor amitatejasaḥ || śrutāḥ sambhūtayaḥ sarvā jagatas tava suvrata || 1 || (fol. 1v1) End bhaktimān puṇḍarīkākṣe gajo duḥkhād vimocitaḥ | tathā tvam api rājendra prapadya śaraṇaṃ harim | vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ prāpsyase paramāṅ gatim (fol. 4v6–7) Colophon iti viṣṇudha[r]meṣu gajendramo(kṣaṇaḥ) [samāptaḥ] (fol. 4v7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīśuka uvāca || || āsīd girivaro rājaṃs trikūṭa iti viśrutaḥ || kṣīrodenāvṛttaḥ śrīmān yojanāyutam ucchritaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End śrīśuka uvāca || || ity ādiśya hṛṣīkeśa[[ḥ]] pradhmāya jalottamam<ref name="ftn1"> For jalajottamam </ref> || harṣayan vibudhānīkam āruroha khagādhipam || 26 || || (fol. 8v8–9r2) Colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe ʼṣṭamaskandhe gajendramokṣaṇan nāma caturtho ʼdhyāyaḥ || || śubham astu || || (fol. 9r2–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || rājovāca || vādarāyaṇa etat te śrotum icchāmahe vayam || harir yathā gajapatiṃ<ref name="ftn1"> For jagapatiṃ </ref> grāhagrastam amumocat<ref name="ftn2"> For amūmucat </ref> || 1 || tatkathā sumahat puṇyaṃ dhanyaṃ svastyayanaṃ mahat || yatra yatrottamaśroko<ref name="ftn3"> For ººśloko </ref> bhagavān ⟪‥⟫[[gī]]yate hariḥ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End Śrīśuka uvāca || ity ādiśya hṛṣīkeśaḥ pradhmāya ⟪‥ ‥⟫[[jalajottamam]] || harṣayaṃ ⟪vya⟫[[vi]]budhānīka⟪ṃ⟩⟩m āroroha ṣagottamaḥ<ref name="ftn4"> For khagottamaṃ </ref> || 26 || (fol. 16r5–6) Colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pa(!)ramahaṃsyā[ṃ] saṃhitāyāṃ aṣṭamaskandhe gajendramokṣaṇaṃ nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ || 4 || śubham || (fol. 16r6–16v2)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namo gaṇapataye || gaṇapatiṃ ca heraṃbaṃ, vighnarājaṃ vināyakaṃ || devīputraṃ mahātejo, mahābalaparākramaṃ || (fol. 1r1–2) End nāma dvādaśakaṃ caiva, trisaṃdhyā yaḥ paṭhet naraḥ || vidyāraṃbhe vivāhe ca, pravāse durggame pi vā | saṃgrāme saṃkaṭe caiva, vighna⟨ṃ⟩[s] tasya na vidyate || (fol. 1v1–2) Colophon iti skandapurāṇe gaṇapatidvādaśanāmastotraṃ samāptam || || (fol. 1v2–3)

Beginning ❖ oṁ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || jaima(!)ni uvāca || yad asti guhyaṃ paramaṃ, sarvvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇāṃ | tan me brūhi viśeṣeṇa, (tāta) nātaḥ paraṃ paraṃ || 1 || śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca || śṛṇu vatsa mahāprājña, rahasyaṃ sarvvakāmadaṃ | dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ, dā(!)ridasamanaṃ paraṃ || 2 || (fol. 1r1–2) End brāhmaṇebhyas tapaśvibhyo, daridrebhya[[ḥ]] (sta)vottamaṃ | deyaṃ duḥkhābhibhūtebhyaḥ kṛtajñabhyo †vibhāṣamaḥ† || 147 || (fol. 5v3) Colophon iti śrīmārkaṃḍeyapurāṇe śrīmahādevakṛtaṃ gaṇapatisahasranāma⟨ṃ⟩ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 5v3–4)

Beginning ❖ gaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha kathārambhaḥ || dūrvvākṣatam ādāya kathāṃ śṛṇuyāt || || bhāradvāja uvāca || nirvvighnena /// kāryyāni, kathaṃ siddhyanti sūtaja | arthasiddhi⟨ṣ⟩[ḥ] kathaṃ nṝṇāṃ, putrasaubhāgyasampadaḥ | (fol. 1v1–2) End namo namaḥ suravarapūjitāṃghraye, namo namo nirupamamaṅgalātmane | namo namo vipulasadaikasiddhaye, namo namaḥ karikalabhānanāyate || 209 || || (fol. 18v3–5) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale gaṇeśakumārasamvāde śrīmahāgaṇapatināmasahasrakaṃ stotraṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 18v5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || devy uvāca || bhagavan devadeveśa sādhakānāṃ ca siddhaye || vakratuṃḍagaṇeśasya pūjā ca kathitā tvayā || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End itīdaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvasvaṃ śubhaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasrakaṃ || duṣṭāgre naiva vaktavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 50 || (fol. 10r8–9) Colophon iti śrīgaṃdharvataṃtre vakratuṃḍagaṇapatisahasranāma saṃpūrṇaṃ || śubhaṃ bhūyāt || saṃ. 18||59 || ā. Śukla śrī || || śrī || || śrī || (fol. 10r9–10v2)
