Beginning śrīheraṃbāya namaḥ || deva tvadīyamadavārimahaughasiktā vāgvallarī prasarati prasabhaṃ rasādraṃ || nāhaṃ karomi bhavataḥ stavanaṃ mahimnaḥ pāraṃgato sti bhuvane nahi ko pi vidvān || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End stotraṃ ṣaḍakṣaragaṇādhipater vicitraṃ ye viṣṇunā viracitaṃ niyataṃ paṭhaṃti || te vāgvilāsacaturāḥ kṣitipālakalpāḥ lakṣmīnivāsacaturāḥ puruṣā bhavaṃti || 8 || (fol. 3r4–7) Colophon iti śrīmahāviṣṇuviracitaṃ gaṇapatistotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || ❁ || saṃºº 1948 māghaśuºº ‥ maṃgalavāra || (fol. 3r7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ gauri(!)putraṃ vināyakam || bhaktyā yaḥ saṃsmaren nityaṃ tasya siddhir[r] na dūrataḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End aṣṭānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca likhitvā yaḥ samarpayet || tasya vidhyā bhavet sarvā gaṇeśasya prasādataḥ 8 (fol. 2v1–3) Colophon iti nāradapurāṇe gaṇapatistotraṃ samāptaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śubham yad akṣara[ṃ] pada[ṃ] bhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhi(!)naṃ ca yad bhavet || tat sarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ deva prasi(!)da parameśvara⟨ḥ⟩ || śrīsamvat 1935 (fol. 2v3–9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ oṁ asya śrīmahā[[gaṇa]]patikavacasya kabandhabrahmāviṣṇudevatāsamvāde<ref name="ftn1"> for ººbrahmaºº </ref> nāradaprokte śrīmahāgaṇapatimahāvidyātattvavidhānoktakarmapūjāvidhim ahaṃ kariṣye gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ (fol. 1v1–4) End mama śatrūn hana hana<ref name="ftn2"> aiṣa ( ārṣa ) prayoga </ref> mahāvighnanivāraṇ kuru kuru mamābhīṣṭasiddhiṃ dehi dehi mahāsiddhigaṇapate namas te names te namas te || || ❁ || (fol. 6r7–6v2) Colophon iti ākāśabhairavakalpe mahāgaṇapatimālāmaṃtrakavacam samūrṇam śubham || || śrīśāke 1815 śrīsamvat 1950 sāla āśvinakṛṣṇa 4 roja 6 svārthaparā[rtha]yor dharmārthaṃ likhitam idaṃ gaṇeśakavacaṃ śubham astu || || ❁ || ❁ ❁ (fol. 6v2–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || dhyāyet siṃhagataṃ vināyakam amuṃ digbāhumāghe yuge tretāyāṃ tu mayūravāhanam amuṃ ṣaḍbāhukaṃ siddhidaṃ || dvāpāre tu gajānanaṃ yugabhujaṃ raktāṃgarāgaṃ vibhuṃ tiṣye tu dvibhujuṃ sitāṃgaruciraṃ sarvārthadaṃ sarvadā || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End anenāsya kṛtā rakṣā na bādhāsya bhavet kvacit [[rākṣasā suravetāladaityadānavasaṃbhavā[ḥ] ||]] || 25 || (fol. 3v4) Colophon iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇ⟨o⟩e [[uttarakhaṃºº]]ktaṃ gaṇeśakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || [[adhyāyaḥ || (85) || śubham astu || || ❁ || || pustakam idaṃ ⟪‥ ‥ ‥ ‥ ‥⟫ śrīkṛṣṇajośī bhādraśukle caturthyāṃ tu śaśivāre ca vāyubhe || siṃhalagne paṃcaśubhagrahayukto bhavat sutaḥ || (fol. 3v4–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ [[tatrāpi jajñe bhagavān hariṇyāṃ harimedhasaḥ || harir ity āhṛṭo yena gajendro mocito grahāt || 1 ||]] rājovāca || vādarāyaṇa etat te śrotum icchāmahe vayam || harir yathā gajapatiṃ grāhagrastam amūmucat || ⟪1⟫[[2]] || (fol. 1v1–2) End śuka uvāca || ity ādiśya hṛṣīkeśaḥ pradhmāya jalajottamam || harṣayan vibudhānīkam āruroha khagādhipam || 26 || (fol. 20v3–5) Colophon iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe aṣṭamaskaṃdhe gajeṃdramokṣaṇaṃ nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ || 4 || śubham || (fol. 20v5–21r1)

«Complete transcript:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha paṃcadevatānāṃ krameṇa prātaḥsmaraṇam || || prātaḥ smarāmi gaṇanātham anāthabaṃdhuṃ siṃdūrapūrapariśobhitagaṃḍayugmaṃ || uddaṇḍavighnaparikhaṇḍanacaṇḍadaṇdam ākhaṇḍalādisuranāyakavṛndavaṃdya⟨ḥ⟩[ṃ] || 1 || prātar namāni caturānanavaṃdyamānam iṣṭānukūlam akhilaṃ ca varaṃ dadhānaṃ || tan tuṃ dilaṃ dvirasanā⟨ṃ⟩dhipayajñasūtraṃ putraṃ vilāsacaturaṃ śivayo śivāya || 2 || prātar bhajāmi sukhadaṃ khalu lokaśoka- dāvānalaṃ gaṇavibhūm varakuṃjarāsyaṃ || ajñānakānavināśanahavyavāham utsāhavarddhanaparaṃ sutam īśvarasya || 3 || ślokatrayam idaṃ puṇyaṃ sadā sā⟨ṃ⟩mrājyadāyakam || prātar utthāya satataṃ yaḥ paṭhet prayataḥ pumān || 4 || iti gaṇeśaḥ || || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || ❁ (fol. 1v1–2r3)

Beginning śrī[[ga]]ṇeśāya namaḥ || raṇatkṣudraghaṃṭāninādābhirāmaṃ calattāṃḍavo dvaṃdadoḥpadmatālaṃ || lasattuṃga(tuṇḍaṃ) parivyālahāraṃ gaṇādhīśam īśānasūnuṃ tam īḍe || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End gaṇeśastavaṃ prātar uthāya bhaktyā paṭhed yas tu tāṃs tāl labhet sarvakāmān || gaṇeśaparasādā(d tu) sidhyaṃti vāco gaṇeśe vibhau durlabhaṃ kiṃ prasanne || 10 (fol. 2r8–10) Colophon iti śaṃkarācāryaviracitaṃ gaṇeśabhujaṃgastotraṃ samāptaṃ || ❁ || (fol. 2r10)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śatānīka uvāca || || mayā hi devadevasya viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ || śrutāḥ sambhūtayaḥ sarvā jagatas tava suvrata || 1 || yadi prasanno bhagavān anugrāhyo smi vā yadi || tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi nṝṇāṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End Bhaktimān puṇḍarīkākṣe gajo duḥkhād vimocitaḥ || tathā tvam api rājendra prapadya śaraṇaṃ harim || 83 || vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ prāpsyase paramāṅ gatim || 84 || || (fol. 15v1–4) Colophon iti viṣṇudharmeṣu gajendramokṣaṇastavaḥ || samāptaḥ || (fol. 16r1–2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama||ḥ śrīgaṇeśāsahasranām(!) liṣi(!)te || bhirava ū(!)vāca⟨ḥ⟩ || śṛṇu devi rahasyaṃ me yat purā sūcitaṃ mayā || tava bhaktyā gaṇesasya vakṣe(!) nāmasahasrakam || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End śṛṣṭikartā jagaddhartā viśvabhartā †jagaddhanīddhi† || †patipītannisāṃgāraktākṣo lohītāṃ varaṃ || 10 || (fol. 2v5–6) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || gurubhyo namaḥ || deva pūrvaṃ purā rātiḥ pura⟨s⟩trayajayodyame || anarcanād gaṇeśasya sarvavidyākulaṃ kila || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End ṭakārasphāṭisaṃ †tā ca† ṭaṃkārimaṇinūpuraṃ || thadvyaṃ vallavāṃtastha sarvatastha vimucyate || 89 || (fol. 10r6–10v1) Colophon iti śrīgaṇeśasahasranāmastotraṃ samāptam || || śubham (fol. 10v2)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ | devaḥ pūrvaṃ purā rātiḥ puratrayajayodyame | anarcanād gaṇeśasya jato vighnākulaḥ kila || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End anyathā śaraṇaṃ nāsti tvam eva śaraṇaṃ mama | tasmāt kāruṇyabhāvena rakṣa rakṣa gaṇeśvara || 14 || yad akṣara[ṃ] pada[ṃ] bhraṣṭaṃ svaraṃ vyaṃjanavarjitaṃ | tat sarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ deva prasīda gaṇanāyaka || 15 || (fol. 12r11–13) Colophon iti śrīpadmapurāṇe mahāgaṇapatisahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || ❁ || śrīmahāgaṇapati[ḥ] prīyatāṃ || ❁ || || || || || || (fol. 12rv1–2) śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || (the latter veneration formula seems to have been added later)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīdevy uvāca || bhagavan devadeveśa sādhakānāṃ ca siddhaye || vakratuṇḍagaṇeśasya pūjāṃ ca kathitā tvayā || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End baṃdhane ca tathā duḥkhe devi saṃgrāmasaṃkaṭe || sarvatra jayam āpnoti gaṇeśasya prasādataḥ || 69 || (fol. 6r1–2) Colophon iti śrībhairavadhāraṇagaṇapatiśatanāmastotraṃ || śubhaṃ || (fol. 6r2)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namo vighneśvarāya || karmmanā manasā vācā, prapanno smi vināyaka | te taranti mahāghoraṃ saṃsārakāmavarjitaṃ || oṃ namo gaṇapataye || brahmovāca || bhagavān śrotum icchāmi, vistareṇa yathā tathā | stavarājasya māhātmyaṃ svarūpañ ca viśeṣataḥ || (fol. 1r1–4) End stavarājasya māhātmyaṃ svarūpañ ca viśeṣataḥ || vaktum arhasi kiṃ brahman, kiṃ bhuyaḥ śrotum icchati || (fol. 14r4–5) Colophon iti bhaviṣyapurāṇe caturthīkalpe ṣaṣṭhā[ṃ]śe aṣṭādaśo dhyāyaḥ stavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || 107 || || || ❖ śrīśrījaya bhūpatīndrama⟨r⟩lladeva sena cuka cāsa deva pratiṣṭhā si⟨r⟩ddhāgni a itā huti yajñā yāṅā yā thva sāḍhuni || saṃ 825 bhādrapadaśukladaśamī mūla śaniścara vāra kuhnuḥ || śubha || (fol. 14r5–14v2)

«Beginning of the Gajendramokṣaṇa:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīśuka uvāca || āsīd girivaro rājaṃs trikūṭa iti vi⟨r⟩śrutaḥ || kṣīrodenāvṛtaḥ śrīmān yojanāyutam ucchritaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v3–4) «Beginning of the Gajendramokṣaṇabhāṣā:» ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || gaṃgātīramā upavāsa garī kana rahyākā parikṣit nāmā rājākana śukadeva ṛṣi kahanchan he mahārāja parikṣit saṃpūrṇa parvatamā śreṣṭha bhayāko cālisa hajāra kos algo bhayāko kṣīrasamudrale … (fol. 1v1–2 and 5) «End of the Gajendramokṣaṇa:» śuka uvāca || ity ādiśya hṛṣīkeśaḥ praddhmāya jalayo(!)ttamaṃ || harṣayan vibudhānīkam āruroha khā(!)gādhipam || 26 || (fol. 24r3–4) «End of the Gajendramokṣaṇabhāṣā:» Śukadeva yogī rājā parikṣitkana kahanchan he mahārāja estā prakārale gajendralāī āñā garī kana indriyakā īśvara bhayākā nārāyaṇa jo chan pāṃcajanyanāmā śaṃkhakā śabdale saṃpūrṇa devatākana harṣa garāī vaikuṃṭhamā jānā nimitta paṃkṣiviṣe śreṣṭha bhayākā garuḍamā caḍhḍā bhayā vaikuṃṭhamā calyā || 26 || || (fol. 24r2 and 6–7) «Colophon of the Gajendramokṣaṇa:» iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe ʼṣtamaskaṃdhe gajendramokṣaṇe caturtho ʼdhyāyaḥ samāpta⟨ṃ⟩[ḥ] śubham || || (fol. 24r5) «Colophon of the Gajendramokṣaṇabhāṣā:»

Beginning śrīgabhavān uvāca || ye māṃ tvāṃ ca saraś cedaṃ girikaṃdarakānanam || vetrakīcakaveṇūnāṃ gulmāni surapādapān || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End ye māṃ stuvaṃty anenāṃga pratibudhya niśātyaye || teṣāṃ prāṇātyaye cāhaṃ dadāmi vimalāṃ matim || 9 || || (fol. 2r5–6) Colophon śubham || || || || (fol. 2r6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīśuka uvāca || || āsīd girivaro rājaṃs trikūṭa iti viśrutaḥ || kṣīrodenāvṛtaḥ śrīmān yojanāyutam ucchritaḥ || 1 (fol. 1v1–4) End ity ādiśya hṛṣīkeśaḥ pradhmāya jalajottamam || harṣayan vibudhānīkam āruroha khagādhipam || 25 || || (fol. 21v4–22r1) Colophon iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe aṣṭamaskandhe caturtho dhyāyaḥ || || śake 1769 jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇadaśamyāṃ likhitam idaṃ || (fol. 22r2–5)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīgaṇapataye || || karmmaṇā manasā vācā, prapanno smi vinayakaṃ | te taranti mahāghoraṃ, saṃsāraṃ kāmavarjjitaṃ<ref name="ftn1"> probably for kāmavarjitāḥ </ref> || śrībrahmovāca || bhagavan śrotum icchāmi, vistareṇa yathārthataḥ | stavarājasya māhātmyaṃ svarūpaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || || (fol. 1v1–3) End vināyakasya māhātmyaṃ pratiṣṭhārccanayor vvidhiḥ | prasaṃsābrahmagāyatryāḥ kalpaṃ tasyāstu śobhanaṃ || stavarājasya māhātmyaṃ, svarūpaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | vaktum arhasi tad brahma na kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi || || (fol. 13r4–6) Colophon iti bhaviṣyapurāṇe caturthākalpe [[ṣa]]ṣṭhāṃśe aṣṭādaśo dhyāyaḥ stavarāja[ḥ] samāptaḥ || ❁ || (fol. 13r6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || asya śrīsaṃkaṭahara⟨t⟩stotramaṃtrasye(!) śrīkanda-ṛṣis trī(!)ṣṭup chaṃdaḥ || śrīgaṇapatir devatā vakratuṇḍagaṇapatipri(!)tyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End rājāna[s] tasya bhṛtyā ñ ‥vayuvatikulaṃ dāsavat sarvadā te lakṣmi(!) sarvatra ⟨y⟩yuktā bhajati ca sadanaṃ kiṃkarā sarvalokā[ḥ] || putrā[ḥ] pautrā[ḥ] prapautrā ra⟨r⟩ṇabhu(!)mivijayai[r] dyutakārye pravi(!)⟨r⟩ṇe yasyāyaṃ vighnarājaṃ(!) nivasati hṛdayabhaktibhājāṃ prasannām || 10 || (fol. 2r7–10) Colophon iti śrīgaṇpatistotra[ṃ] sampūrṇam || śubham || ❁ || iti samvat 1917 sālamiti jyeṣṭhaśudi 7 orja 7 tasmin dine [li]ṣitam kṣe(!)myetām (fol. 2r10–11)

Beginning svasti śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ gauri(!)putraṃ vināyakam || bhaktyā yaḥ saṃsmaren nityam āyuḥkāmārthasiddhayat(!) || 1 || (fol. 1r1–2) End aṣṭānāṃ brahmaṇānāñ ca likhitvā yaḥ samarpayet || tasya vidyā bhavet sarvā gaṇeśasya praśādataḥ || 8 || (fol. 1r9–1v2) Colophon iti śrīnāradapurāṇe gaṇapatistotraṃ samāptaṃ (fol. 1v2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṁ asya śrīmā(!)hāgaṇpatistotramaṃtrasya dvādaśanāmasya(!) nārada ṛṣiḥ || mā(!)hāgaṇapati[r] devatā triṣṭup chaṃdaḥ || mahāgaṇpatiprītyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || oṁ praṇamya śirasā devaṃ gaurīputraṃ vināyakaṃ || bhaktyā vyā<ref name="ftn1"> for yaḥ </ref> saṃsmare[n] nityaṃ āyuḥkāmārthasiddhidaṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2r2) End aṣṭānāṃ brahmaṇānāṃ ca likhitvā [yaḥ] samarpayet || tasya vidyā bhavet sarvā gaṇeśasya prasādataḥ || 8 || (fol. 3r4–3v1) Colophon iti śrīnāradi(!)purāṇe gaṇapatistotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || || || || (fol. 3v1–3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || nārada uvāca || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ gaurīputraṃ vināyakam || bhaktyā yaḥ saṃsmare[n] nitya⟨ṃ⟩m āyuḥkāmārthasiddhaye || 1 || (exp. 4t1–2) End aṣṭānāṃ brahmaṇānāñ ca likhitvā ya[ḥ] samarpayet || tasya vidyā bhavet sarvā gaṇeśasya praśādataḥ || 8 || (exp. 4b5–6) Colophon iti śrīnāradapurāṇe gaṇeśastotraṃ samāptam || śubham || rama || vakratuṇda mā(!)hākāya koṭisuryasama⟨ḥ⟩ prabho || avighnaṃ kuru me deva sarvakāryeṣu sarvadā || 1 || (exp. 5 ll. 1–3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || vighneśvarāya namaḥ karmmaṇā manasā vācā, prapanno smi vinayakam te tara[n]ti mahāghoraṃ sa⟨n⟩[ṃ]sārakarmmavarjjitaṃ 1 oṁ namo gaṇapataye namaḥ brahmovāca bhagavan śrotum icchāmi vistareṇa yathātathaṃ stavarājasya māhātmyaṃ svarūpaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ (fol. 1v1–4) End vināyakasya mā[hā]tmyaṃ pratiṣṭhārccanayo[r] vidhiḥ prasa[ṃ]sā brahmagāyatryāḥ kalpaṃ tasyā<ref name="ftn1"> A 475/1 reads tasyāstu </ref> śobhanaṃ stavarājasya māhātmyaṃ, svarūpaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ vaktum arhasi taṃ brahma<ref name="ftn2"> A 475/1 reads tad </ref> n[a] kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi (fol. 10r3–5) Colophon iti śrībhaviṣyapurāṇe caturthi(!) || || (fol. 10r5)

Beginning oṁ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ śuklāṃbaradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaśivarṇaṃ caturbhujam || prasannavadanaṃ dhyāyet sarvavighnopaśāntaye || 1 || abhiprītyarthasiddhyarthaṃ pūjoto yaḥ surair api || sarvavighnahare(!) tasmai śrīgaṇādhipataye namaḥ || 2 || (1r1–4) End putrārthī labhate putraṃ mokṣārthī paramaṃ padaṃ || gaṇeśvaraprasādena labhate śaṃkaraṃ padam || 11 || (fol. 2r1–2) Colophon ityādipurāṇe gaṇeśastotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ samāptam || || || || || || (fol. 2r2–3)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ gaurīputraṃ vināyakam || bhaktyā yaḥ saṃsmaren nityaṃ putrakāmārthasiddhaye || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End aṣṭānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca likhitvā yaḥ samarppayet || tasya sarvā bhaved vidyā gaṇeśasya prasādataḥ || 8 || || (fol. 3v1–3) Colophon iti śrīnāradapurāṇoktagaṇapatistotraṃ sampūrṇaṃ || (fol. 3v3–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || (praṇamya śirasā) devaṃ gaurīputraṃ vināyakaṃ || bhaktyā yaḥ saṃsmaren nitya⟨ṃ⟩m āyu[ḥ]kāmārthasiddhaye || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End aṣṭānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca likhitvā ya samarppayet || tasya vidyā bhavet sarva(!) gaṇeśasya prasādataḥ || 8 || (fol. 2r4–5) Colophon iti [śrī]nāradapurāṇe gaṇapatistotraṃ sampū[r]ṇaṃ śubham || (fol. 2r5)

Beginning śrīgaṇādhipataye namaḥ || || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ gaurīputraṃ vināyakaṃ || bhaktyā ya saṃsmaren nityam āyuḥkāmārthasiddhaye || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End aṣṭānāṃ brāhmaṇānāñ ca likhitvā yaḥ samarpayet || tasya vidyā bhavet sarva⟨ṃ⟩(!) gaṇeśasya prasādataḥ || 8 || || (fol. 1v7–8) Colophon iti śrīphaladāyakagaṇeśastotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śubham || || kāyena vāceti samarpayet śālaḥ 1899 māsa 5 (fol. 1v8–9)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namo gaṇapataye || karmmaṇā manasā vācā, prapanno smi vināyakaṃ | te taranti mahāghoraṃ, saṃsāra[ṃ] kāmavarjjitaṃ<ref name="ftn1"> probably for kāmavarjitāḥ </ref> || brahmovāca || bhagavaṃ śrotum icchāmi, vistareṇa yathātathaṃ, stavarājasya māhātmyaṃ, svarūpañ ca viśeṣataḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) End vināyakasya māhātmyaṃ pratiṣṭhārccanayor vvidhiḥ | praśā(!)sā brahmagāyatryāḥ kalma(!)s tasyāstu śobhana⟨ḥ⟩[m] || stavarājasya ma(!)hātmyaṃ, svarūpaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | vaktum arha[si] tad bra[hma]n kim bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi || || (fol. 20r4–20v1) Colophon iti bhaviṣyapurāṇe (caturthīkalpe ṣaṣṭhyāṃśe aṣṭādaśo dhyāya stavarājaḥ samāptaḥ) || || (fol. 20v1–2)

Beginning oṁ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṁkāram ādya[ṃ] pravadaṃti saṃto vacaḥ śrutīnām adhipaṃ gṛṇaṃti || gajānanaṃ devagaṇānatāṃghriṃ bhaje ham arddheṃdukṛtāvataṃsaṃ [[|| 1 ||]] || pādāraviṃdārcanatatparāṇāṃ saṃsāradāvāna[[la]]bhaṃgadakṣaṃ || niraṃtaraṃ nirgatadānatoyais taṃ naumi vighneśvaram aṃbudābhaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–2r1) End vighnārgalānāṃ vinipātanārthaṃ yan nārikelaiḥ kadalīphalaughaiḥ || pratārayaṃto madavāraṇāsyaṃ prāpur nnaro bhiṣṭam a⟨ṃ⟩haṃ bhajāmi || yajñair anekair bahibhis tapobhir ārādhyam ādyaṃ gajarājavaktraṃ || stutyānayā ye vidhinā stuvaṃti te sarvalakṣmīnilayā bhavaṃti || || || (fol. 6r2–6v1) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ gaurīputraṃ vināyakam || bhaktyā yaḥ saṃsmaren nityam āyuḥkāmārthasiddhaye || 1 || prathamaṃ vakratuṇḍañ ca hemadraṃṣṭraṃ dvitīyakam || tṛtīyaṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgākṣaṃ gajavaktraṃ caturthakam || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End aṣṭānāṃ brahmaṇānāṃ ca likhitvā yaḥ samarpayet || tasya vidhyā bhavet sarvā gaṇeśasya prasādataḥ || 8 || (fol. 2r4–5) Colophon iti śrīnāradaviracitaṃ gaṇeśastotraṃ samāptam || ❁ || || (fol. 2r5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || sarve ūcuḥ || parabrahmarūpaṃ cidānaṃdarūpaṃ pareśaṃ guṇeśaṃ guṇābdhiṃ guṇeśaṃ || guṇātītam īśaṃ mayūreśam ādyaṃ natā smo natā smo natā smo natā smaḥ || 1 || jagadvndyam ekaṃ paroṃkāram ekaṃ guṇānāṃ paraṃ kāraṇaṃ nirvikalpaṃ || jagatpālakaṃ hārakaṃ tārakan taṃ mayūreśam ādyaṃ natā smo natā smaḥ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End sarvatra ⟪‥⟫ jayam āpnoti śriyaṃ paramadurlabhāṃ || putravāṃ dhanavāṃś caiva vaśatām akhilaṃ nayet || 18 || brahmovāca || evam uktvā hy anujñātāḥ sādhv ity uktvā yayuḥ surāḥ || mayūreśo gaṇair yukaḥ⟨o⟩ svadhāma pratyapadyata || 19 || (fol. 3r6–8) Colophon iti śrīgaṇeśapurāṇe uttarakhaṃḍe siṃdhudaityavadhe gaṇeśāṣṭakaṃ saṃpūrṇam || adhyāyaḥ 123 || gajānanārpaṇam astu || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || liḥ śrīkṛṣṇajośīrāmanagaravāle || saṃvat 1947 śrāvaṇaśukle 14 budhe tṛtīyaprahare dine likhitaṃ || ❁ || (fol. 3r8–3v4)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ vighneśvarāya pāṇau yasya ca modakākṣavimalaṃ, dantā<ref name="ftn1"> probably for dantaṃ </ref> kuthā(!)rāyudhaṃ, candrābhaṃ madamattanāgavadanaṃ vyā⟨ro⟩[lo]pavītojvalaṃ yakṣandrāsurakinnarair muninaraiḥ devaiḥ sadā vanditaṃ vighneśaṃ satatan namāmi śirasā kāmārthasiddhipradaṃ 1 karmmanā(!) manasā vācā prapanno smi⟨n⟩ vinayakaṃ te taranti mahāghoraṃ saṃsārakarmmavarjjitaṃ 2 (fol. 1v1–5) End vināyakasya ma(!)hātmyaṃ pratiṣṭhārccanayo[r] vidhiḥ prasa[ṃ]sā brahmagāyatryāḥ kalpya<ref name="ftn2"> for kalpaṃ </ref> tasyāstu śobhana⟨ḥ⟩[ṃ] stavarājasya ma(!)hātmyaṃ, svarūpaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ vaktum arhasi taṃ<ref name="ftn3"> probably for tad </ref> brahma n[a] kiṃ bhuye<ref name="ftn4"> for bhūyaḥ </ref> śrotum icchasi (fol. 14v5–15r1) Colophon iti śrībhaviṣyapurāṇe caturthi(!)kalpe ṣaṣṭhāṃge aṣṭādaśo dhyāyaḥ satavarāja[ḥ] samāptaḥ (fol. 15r1–2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || samastāghahāriprabhutvaṃ murāre[ḥ] cyutaṃ †gaṃḍayugmāvada† svedarūpaṃ || tvadīyaṃ jalaṃ ye spṛśaṃti praśastaṃ śubhaṃ gaṃḍakī(!)<ref name="ftn1"> it should be vocative case </ref> prāṇinas te hi dhanyāḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End bhujaṃgaprayātaṃ paṭhed yastu bhaktyā dhruvaṃ gaṃḍakīgaṃgayoḥ snānapuṇyaṃ || labhet pādapadme samādhāya cittaṃ murāreḥ praśannaṃ prapannārttiharttuṃ(!) || 14 || || (fol. 4v2–5) Colophon iti śrīśaṃkarācārja(!)viracitaṃ gaṃḍakīstotraṃ samāptaṃ || || śrīsaṃvat 1807 || śubhaṃ || likhitaṃ muralīdharaśarmaṇā || || (fol. 4v5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || yasyās tattvaṃ jalānāṃ hariharavidhayo ʼnveṣayaṃto nimagnā nāpus tepus taps te yadupalatanavaś cakriṇo lajjamānāḥ || āsīt tat te papobhir vapuṣi naraharer bījam ādyaṃ nadīnām apbinduḥ sarvatāpaṃ haratu harisarit gaṇḍakī puṇyatoyā⟨ḥ⟩ 1 yaḥ khedaḥ prādurāsīn muradanujaripos taptagaṃḍāt tapogner yc cānaṃdātmanityaṃ niravadhivimalaṃ nirguṇaṃ brahmatatvaṃ | āvirbhūtaṃ jalāṃtarhimagiriśikhare jyotir udyatkṛśānos tat sarvaṃ teʼṃba rūpaṃ diśatu kim api śaṃ kālarogāturāṇām 2 (fol 1v1–6) End chatraṃ śailādhirājaḥ śitatalaśikate cāmare cārughoṣo viprāśīrvādanādo laharikalakalo hṛdyavīṇāninādaḥ ājñācakrañ ca cakraṃ duritacayacamūccāṭane śailanadyaḥ senās tvaṃ brahmarājñī vihara mama manovāṭikāyām ajsram || 8 || yaḥ pathet snānadānādau gaṇḍakyāḥ stavanāṣṭakaṃ || †mukhevāsī† gṛhe lakṣmīḥ karasthās tasya siddhayaḥ || 9 || || (fol 2v6–3r1) Colophon iti śrīmanmakavānibhūpālacūḍāmaṇiśrīmanmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādattasenadeva-kumāraśrīraṇabahādū(!)rasenakṛtaṃ gaṇḍakīstotraṃ samāptam || || śubham || || || || (fol 3r1–3)

«Complete transcription:» oṁ namo bhagavate garuḍāya || || suparṇaṃ vainateyaṃ ca nāgāriṃ nāgabhūṣaṇam jitāntakaṃ viṣāriṃ ca ajitaṃ viśvarūpiṇam || 1 || garutmantaṃ vayaḥśreṣṭhaṃ tārkṣyaṃ kāśyapanandanam || dvādaśaitāni nāmāni garuḍasya mahātmanaḥ || 2 || yaḥ paṭhet prātar utthāya snāne vāśane pi vā || viṣaṃ na kramate tasya na ca hiṃsanti hiṃsakāḥ || 3 || saṅgrāme vyavahāre ca vijayas tasya jāyate || bandh⟨a⟩[ā]n muktim āpnoti yātrāyāṃ siddhir eva ca || 4 || || iti śrīgariḍastotraṃ samāptaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śubham bhūyāt sadā || || || || || || || || || śrīsamvat 1924 vaiśāṣa(!)māse kṛṣṇapakṣe 30 vāsare śanaiścaraḥ || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || || (fol. 1v1–2r)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || sāṃbāya namaḥ || śrīgāyatryai namaḥ || oṁ carācarajagatsarve(!)layalīlāvidhāyinīṃ || vedānāṃ mātaraṃ vaṃde stuve ca śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 1 || gāyatrīṃ karuṇā⟨ṃ⟩viṣṭāṃ viśiṣṭamatidāyinīṃ || brahmakalpalatāṃ nityāṃ bhogamokṣaphalā⟨ṃ⟩vahāṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End idaṃ nāmāṣṭakaśataṃ yaḥ paṭhec chṛṇuyāc ca(!)va || acirād asya gāyatrī sarvā[ṃ] siddhi[ṃ] praya[c]chati || brahmavidbhir dvijair etat kīrtanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || māṃgalya[ṃ] svargyam āyuṣyaṃ dhanyasiddhipradaṃ śubhaṃ || 21 || (fol. 2v4–7) Colophon iti śrībrahmayāmale gāyatryaṣṭottaranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || śrīgāyatryai [a]rpaṇam astu || śubhaṃ bhava⟨ṃ⟩tu || (fol. 2v7–9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīrāmacandra uvāca || || viśvāmitra mahāprājña⟨ḥ⟩ gādhisūta mahavratā(!) || śatam aṣṭottaraṃ nāma gāyatryā brūhi mokṣadam || 1 || viśvāmitra uvāca || || sādhu sādhu mahāprājña śṛnu tattvena rāghava⟨ḥ⟩ || śṛṇvatāṃ pātakaharam ajñānatimirāpaham || 2 || gāyaṃtaṃ trāyate tasmād gāyatrī sā vidhīyate || tataḥ kuru mahārāja sarvān kāmān avāpsyasi || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End vrahmahatyādipāpebhyo mucyate nātra sa[ṃ]sayaḥ || dine dine paṭhed yas tu gāyatryā stavam uttamam || sa naro mokṣam āpnoti punarāvṛttivarjjitaḥ || putrapradam aputrāṇāṃ dā(!)ridrāṇāṃ dhanapradām || 22 || rogināṃ rogasa(!)manaṃ sarvaiśvaryaphalapradam || kim atra bahunoktena stotraṃ bahuphalapradām(!) || 23 || (fol.2v9–3r4) Colophon iti viśvāmitrasaṃhitāyāṃ viśvāmitrarāmacandrasa[ṃ]vāde gāyatryā [a]ṣṭottaraśatanāmastotram || ○ || ○ || ○ || ○ || ○ || ○ || ○ || ○ || ○ || ○ || ○ || ○ || ○ || ○ || ○ || śubham (fol. 3r4–5)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgāyatrīsahasranāma likhyate || śrīnārada uvāca || bhagavan deva deveśa sarvaśāstraviśārada || śrutismṛtipurāṇānāṃ rahasyaṃ tvanmukhāc chrutaṃ || 1 || sarvapāpaharaṃ deva kena syād brahmavarcasaṃ || kena vā brahmavijñānaṃ kin nu vā mokṣasādhanaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End mokṣaprada[ṃ] mumukṣūṇāṃ jñānadaṃ jñānam icchatāṃ || rogārtte mucyate rogād baddho baṃdhād vimucyate || 160 || brahmahā vā surāpo vā suvarṇasteyakṛn naraḥ || gurutalpagato vāpi paṭhanān mucyate naraḥ || 161 || idaṃ rahasyam amalaṃ mayoktam ṛṣisattama || paṭhanād brahmasāyujyaṃ pāpnuvaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 162 || || (fol. 8v6–9) Colophon iti śrīviṣṇuyāmale sṛṣṭipraśaṃsāyāṃ gāyatryaṣṭottarasahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || ❁ || lekhakapāṭha[ka]yoḥ śubhaṃ bhavatu || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 8v9–9r1)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya || oṁ gāyatrīhṛdayamantrasya prahlāda ṛṣi[ḥ] gāyatrī chandaḥ sūryyanārāyaṇo devatā ahaṃ bījaṃ oṁ śaktiḥ yaṃ kīlakaṃ idam ānasya<ref name="ftn1"> probably for yajamānasya </ref> sarvvābhiṣṭasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1r1–2) End dakāraṃ jambukaṃ varṇṇaṃ, kṛṣṇena ca sadārccitaṃ | nānāvidhikṛtaṃ pāpaṃ, dakāro dahate kṣaṇāt || 24 || (yāt)kāraṃ binduvarṇṇañ ca śivena ca sadārccitaṃ | merumaṇḍalakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ, yātkāṛo dahate kṣaṇāt || 25 || || (fol. 5v2–3) Colophon iti gāyatrīkalpaṃ gautamena kṛtam iti || || (fol. 5v3)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || tvaṃ māye[[le]] sarvadevānāṃ prītīdā śubhadā bhava || śivaṃ kuruṣva me bhadre yaśovīryyaṃ ca sarvadā || 1 || asya śrīgāyatrīkavacasya brahmā(!)viṣṇumaheśvarā ṛṣayaḥ ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṇi chaṃdāṃsi parabrahmasvarūpiṇī gāyatrī devatā bhūḥ hrāṃ bījaṃ bhuvaḥ hrīṃ śaktiḥ svaḥ hūṃ kīlakaṃ jape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1v1–6) End brahmāstrādīni sarvāṇi tadaṃgasparśanāt tataḥ || na deyaṃ paraśiṣyebhyo hy abhaktebhy viśeṣataḥ śiṣyebhyo bhaktiyuktebhyo hy a[[nya]]thā mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 23 || (fol. 3v4–6) Colophon iti śrī-agastisaṃhitāyāṃ brahmanāradasaṃvāde gāyatrīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ samāptaṃ (fol. 3v6–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha gāyatrīkavacaprārambhaḥ || || yājñavalkya uvāca || svāmin sarvajagannātha saṃśayo ʼsti mahān mama || catuḥṣaṣṭikalānāṃ ca pātakānāṃ ca tad vada || 1 || mucyate kena puṇyena brahmarūpaṃ katham bhavet || dehaś ca devatārūpaṃ mantrarūpaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 2 || kramataḥ śrotum icchāmi kavacaṃ vidhipūrvakam || (fol. 1v1–4) End sahasra[ṃ] japtvā sā devī hy upapātakanāśinī || lakṣyajāpye tathā tac ca mahāpātakanāśinī || 49 || koṭijāpyena rājendra yad icchati tad āpnuyāt || na deyaṃ paraśiṣyebhyo hy abhaktebhyo viśeṣataḥ || śiṣyebhyo bhaktiyuktebhyo hy anyathā mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 50 || || (fol. 5r3–6) Colophon iti śrīmadvasiṣṭasaṃhitāyāṃ gāyatrīkavacaṃ sampūrṇam || || śubham astu || || (fol. 5r6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṁ ṛgvedāya svāhā || oṁ yajurvedāya svāhā || oṁ sāmavedāya svāhā | oṁ atharvavedāya namaḥ || oṁ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ tat savitur vareṇyam bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt oṁ | iti gāyatryā śikhāṃ badhvā || aṅguṣṭhena mukhamārjanam | vāk | praṇaḥ 2 | cakṣuḥ 2 | śrotram 2 | skandhayoḥ | nābhau | hṛdaye | kaṇṭhe | śirasi | śikhāyām | bahubhyāṃ yaśo balam puṇḍarīkākṣāya namaḥ | pṛthvīti merupṛṣṭa ṛṣiḥ sutalacchandaḥ pṛthivī devatā nijāsane viniyogaḥ | (fol. 1v1–6) End ya idaṃ paramaṅ guhyaṃ bādhāśatanivāraṇam | catuḥṣaṣṭikalāvidyāsakalaiśvaryasiddhidam | japādau hṛdayañ ca[iva] japāntai(!) kavacam paṭhet | strīgobrahmavadhān mitradrohād akhilapātakaiḥ | sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyeta paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || (fol. 8v5–7) Colophon iti agastyatantre brahmanāradasaṃvāde gāyatrīkavacaṃ samāptaṃ | kāśyāṃ smṛtyādividhinā svasūktoktavidhinā ca likhitam idam pustakam bindumādhavasamīpe 1934 sāla | ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ || śrīgurucaraṇābhyān namaḥ | jaya rāma sītārāma (fol. 8v7–9)

Beginning oṁ gaṇapataye namaḥ || || oṁ asya śrīgāyatrīkavacamahāmantrasya brahmā(!)viṣṇumaheśvarā ṛṣayaḥ ṛgyajuḥsāmāni chaṃdāṃsi parabrahmasvarūpiṇī gāyatrī devatā oṁ bījaṃ bhargaḥ śaktiḥ dhiyaḥ kīlakaṃ dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ gāyatrīprasādasidhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || || (fol. 1v1–3) End puṣpāṃjaliṃ ca gāyatryā mūlenaiva paṭhet sakṛt || śavarṣasahasrāṇi pūjāyāḥ phalam āpnuyāt || 16 || bhūrjapatre liṣi(!)tvā tu svarṇasthaṃ dhārayed yadi || śikhāyāṃ dakṣiṇe bāhau kaṇṭhe vā dhārayed budhaḥ || 17 || trailokyaṃ kṣobhayet sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ dahati kṣaṇāt || || (fol. 3r8–3v2) Colophon iti śrīgāyatrīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || || (fol. 3v2)

Beginning śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ || oṁ asya śrīgāyatrīkavacamaṃtrasya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarā ṛṣayaḥ ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṇa(!) chaṃdāṃsi brahmarasasvarūpiṇī gāyatrī devatā reṃ bījaṃ ṇi yaṃ śaktir (yāt) kīlakaṃ gāyatrīprasādasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || oṁ gāyatrī pūrvataḥ pātu sāvitrī pātu dakṣiṇe || brahma priyātu me paścād uttaraṃ me sarasvatī || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End japāraṃbhe ca gāyatryā japāṃte kavacaṃ japet || gobrahmastrīvadhaś caiva drohādyakhilapātakam || 14 || mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || || (fol. 2r9–2v2) Colophon ity agastyasaṃhitāyāṃ brahmanāradasaṃvāde gāyatrīkavacaṃ sampūrṇam || || || || || || || || || || || || || || || || (fol. 2v3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ || || karmmaṇā manasā vācā prapaṃno smi vinayakaṃ || || te taraṃti mahāghoraṃ saṃsāra⟨ṃ⟩ kāmavarjitaṃ<ref name="ftn1"> probably for kāmavarjitāḥ </ref> || 1 || || brahmovāca || || bhagavan śrotum icchāmi vistareṇa yathākathaṃ || stavarājasya ma(!)hātmyaṃ svarūpaṃ ca viśekha(!)taḥ || || (fol. 1v1–5) End vināyakasya māhātmyaṃ pratiṣṭhārccanayor vidhiṃ || 131 || praśaṃsāṃ brahmagāyatryāḥ kalpan tasyāstu śobhanaṃ || stavarājasya māhātmyaṃ svarūpaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 132 || vaktum arhasi tad brahma ⟨(bha⟩) kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi || 133 || (fol. 24v5–25r3) Colophon iti śrībhaviṣyapurāṇe catu[r]thākalpe ṣaṣṭhaśa<ref name="ftn2"> probably for ṣaṣṭhyāṃśe </ref> aṣṭādaśo dhyāye śrīgaṇeśastavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || || ślokasaṃkhyā(ṅka) || 233 || ❁ || saṃvat 1964 || roja 5 || (fol. 25r3–6)

Beginning śrīmadhdhāmne namo namaḥ || oṁ asya śrīgāyatrīkavacasya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ṛṣayaḥ | ṛgyajuḥsāmāni caṃdāṃsi | parabrahmasvarūpiṇī gāyatrī devatā | oṁ tadbījaṃ | bhargaḥ śaktiḥ | dhiyaḥ kīlakaṃ | brahmātmaikyabhāvanārthe jape viniyogaḥ | oṁ tat savitur brahmātmane aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | (fol. 1v1–3) End catuṣṣaṣṭikalāvidyā sarvaiśvaryapradāyakā japāraṃbhe ca hṛdayaṃ japāṃte kavacaṃ paṭhet | 14 | gostrībrahmavadhān mitradrohādyakhilapātakāt mucyate sarvapāpebhyo paraṃ brahmādhigacchati 15 || || (fol. 2r12–14) Colophon iti vasiṣṭhasaṃhitāyāṃ vasiṣṭhapārāśarasaṃvāde gāyatrīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || śrīrāma || (fol. 2r14)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha gāyatrīhṛdayam || namaskṛtya bhagavataṃ yājñavā(!)lkaṃ svayaṃbhu(!)vam || paripṛcchati tvaṃ brūhi brahman || gāyatryām utpattiṃ śrotum icchāmi ||<ref name="ftn1"> pāda d is unmetrical. </ref> tattvajñānotpatya(!)ṃ prakṛtiṃ ca paripṛcchāmi || brahmovāca || brahmajñānotpatya(!)ṃ prakṛtiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || ko mahāpuruṣa[s] tenāṃgulyāt mathyamānāt salilaṃ bhavati || salilāt phenaṃ bhavati || (fol. 1v1–4) End nāśam āyānti te sarve [[ve]]damātaḥ prasādataḥ || na deyaṃ paraśiṣyebhyo hy abhaktebhyo viśeṣataḥ || 19 || śiṣyebhyo bhaktiyuktebhyo nānyathā mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 20 || (fol. 5r5–6) Colophon iti śrīagastismṛtisaṃhitāyāṃ brahmanāradasamvāde gāyatrīkavacam samāptam || sampūrṇam || śubham || || || || || || || || || || (fol. 5r6–7)

Beginning ///śāya namaḥ || atha brahmagāyatrīkavacaṃ likhyate || oṁ asya śrībrahmagāyatrīkavacasto///maṃtrasya brahmā(!)viṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ṛṣayaḥ | ṛgyaju[s]sāmātharvvāṇi chandāṃsi | parabrahmasvarūpiṇī gāyatrī devatā || oṁ tad bījaṃ | bhargaḥ śaktiḥ | dhīyaḥ kīlakaṃ | gāyatrīprasādasidhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || oṁ bhūḥ savitu[s] trailokyavyāpiṇī aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || (fol. 1r1–4) End catuḥṣaṣṭhikalāvidyā paramaiśvaryasiddhidaṃ | japāraṃbhe tu hṛdayaṃ japānte kavacaṃ paṭhet || gostrībrahmavadhā(!)mitradrohādyakhilapātakaiḥ | mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || || (fol. 2r6–2v1) Colophon iti śrībrahmanāradasaṃvāde smṛtibhidiṇḍikāyāṃ gāyatrīkavacaṃ samāptaṃ || || ❁ || (fol. 2v1–2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīgāyatryai namaḥ || || oṁ asya śrīgāyatrīkavacamaṃtrasya brahmā(!)viṣnumaheśvarā ṛṣayaḥ ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṇaś(!) caṃdāmsi parabrahmasvarūpiṇī gāyatrī devatā oṁ tad bījaṃ bhargaḥ śaktiḥ śrīyaḥ kīlakaṃ gāyatrīprasādasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || atha dhyānam || (fol. 1v1–4) End catuṣṣaṣṭikalāvidyā paramaiśvaryasiddhidam || japāra[ṃ]bhe tu hṛdayaṃ japānte kavacaṃ paṭhet || 15 || gostr⟪i⟫ībrahmavadhān mitradrohādyākhi[[la]]pātakāt || mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || 16 || || (fol. 3r4–6) Colophon iti śrībrahmanāradasaṃvāde smṛticandrikāyāṃ gāyatrīkavacam || || samāptaṃ śubham (fol. 3r6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ uṣaḥ kālagamyām †udātaḥ† svarūpām akārapratiṣṭhām udārāṃgabhūṣāṃ ajeśādivaṃdyā⟨ṃ⟩m ajārddhāṃgabhājaṃ hy anupamyarūpaṃ bhajāmy ādisaṃdhyāṃ 1 sadāhaṃ sayānāṃ sphuradraktavastrāṃ varābhītahastāṃ mṛgāmnāyarūpāṃ sphurat sphāṭikām akṣa(malāṃ) ca ku[ṃ]bhaṃ dadhānām ahaṃ bhāvaya(!) pūrvasaṃdhyāṃ 2 (fol. 1r1–7; exp. 2 ll. 1–7) End itīdaṃ bhū(!)jaṃgaṃ paṭhed yas tu bhaktyā samādhāya citte sadā śrībhavānīṃ trī(!)saṃdhyāsvarūpāṃ trī(!)lokaikava[ṃ]dyāṃ sa mukto bhavet sarvapāpair ajasraṃ 13 (exps. 5b6–6 l. 1) Colophon śrībrahmatāntrike brahmānāradasaṃvāde gāyatrī(!)bhūjaṃga[ḥ] samāptaḥ (exp. 6 ll. 2–3)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ | asya śrībrahmaśāpavimocanasya maṃtrasya kāmadhudughā gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ | nigrahānugrahakarttā prajāpati ṛṣiḥ brahmānugṛhītā gāyatrī śaktir devatā | bra[[hma]]śāpavimicanārthe jape viniyogaḥ | (fol. 1r1–2) End aho devi maho devi śivāyai satataṃ namaḥ ajare amare devi brahmayoni namo stu te | iti maṃtraṃ japet 8 | 10 paścād gāyatrīmaṃtraṃ japitvā śriyai namaḥ kāmeśvaryai namaḥ | japāṃte aṣṭamudrāṃ pradarśayet | tarpaṇaṃ kuryāt | (fol. 1v13–15) Colophon iti gāyatrīkīlakaṃ sampūrṇaṃ śubhaṃ bhūyāt śrī | śrī śrī śrī śrī (fol. 1v15)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrī-ekavīrādevyai namaḥ || atha sarvadevatātmā(!)naḥ sarvaśakteḥ sarvabhāsakatejomayasya paramātmanaḥ sarvātmakadyotanārthaṃ sarvātmakabrahmapratipādakagāyatrīmantrasyopāsanaprakāraḥ prakāśyate || (fol. 1v1–3) End yat satyajñānādirūpaṃ || no smākam ananyasiddhaye | pracodayāt prerayatu || yo devaḥ savitāsmākaṃ dhiyo dharmādigocaraḥ || prerayet tasya yad bhargas tad vareṇyam upāsmahe || || (fol. 2v13–15) Colophon iti śrīmajjagadgurupūjyapādaśrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryaśrīmacchaṃkarācā-ryaviracitaṃ gāyatrīvivaraṇaṃ sampūrṇam || ❁ || śrīr astu || oṁ || (fol. 2v15)

Beginning śrīśrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atho vakṣyāmi gāyatrīṃ tattvarūpāṃ trayaī⟨ṃ⟩m ahaṃ ||| yayā prakāśyate brahma saccidānandalakṣaṇaṃ || 1 || praṇavādyā vyāhṛtayaḥ sapta ‥‥tat padādika[m] || caturviṃśatyarātmā gāyatrī śirasānvita(!) || 2 || sarvavedo[d]dhṛtaḥ sāro maṃtro yaṃ samudāhṛtaḥ || brahmā devyādi†patri†paramāṭmā samīritāḥ(!) || 3 || (fol. 1r1–3) End brahmahā ca surāpo vā suvarṇasteyakṛn naraḥ | gurutalpagato vā pi paṭhanān mucyate sakṛt || idaṃ rahasyam amalaṃ mayoktaṃ ṛṣisattama || paṭhanād viṣṇusāyujyaṃ pāpnuvaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 50 || (fol. 16v2–4) Colophon iti śrīviṣnuyāmale sṛṣṭiprasaṃge brahmāviṣṇusaṃvāde nāradapraśne gāyatryaṣṭottarasahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || śrīgāyatrīsāvitrīsarasvatyaḥ prīyaṃtāṃ || || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 16v4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṁkāram ādyaṃ pravadaṃti saṃto vācaḥ śrutīnām api yaṃ gṛṇaṃti, gajānanaṃ devagaṇānatāṃghriṃ bhaje ham arddhendukṛtāva[[taṃ]]saṃ || 1 || pādāraviṃdārcanatatparāṇāṃ saṃsāradāvānalabhaṃgadakṣaṃ || niraṃtaraṃ nirgatadānatoyais tan naumi vighneśvaram aṃbujākṣaṃ || 2 || kṛtāṃgarāgaṃ navakuṃkumena mattālimālāṃ madapaṃkalagnāṃ nivārayaṃto nijakarṇatālaiḥ ko visamaret putram anaṃgaśatroḥ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End śaṃbhoḥ samālokya jaṭākalāpe śaśāṃkakhaṃḍaṃ nijapuṣkareṇa || svabhagnadaṃtaṃ praviciṃtya maugdhyād ākraṣṭukāmaḥ śriyam ātanotu || 19 || vighnārgalānāṃ vinipātanārthaṃ yan nārikeraiḥ kadalīphalaughaiḥ || pratārayaṃto madavāraṇāsyaṃ prāpur narābhīṣtam ahaṃ bhajāmi || 20 || yajñair anekair bahibhis tapibhir ārādhyam ādyaṃ gajarājavaktraṃ || stutyānayā ye vidhivat stuvaṃti te sarvalakṣmīnilayā bhvaṃti || 21 || || (fol. 4v1–6) Colophon iti gaṇeśastavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || śubham astu || (fol. 4r6)

Beginning śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ || || śrīnārada uvāca || || bhagavan sarvadharmajña sarvaśāstrārthapāraga || śrutismṛtipurāṇānāṃ rahasyaṃ tvanmukhāc chrutam || 1 || sarvapāpaharaṃ deva kenāvidyā nirvarttate || kena vā brahmavijñānaṃ kena vā mokṣasādhanam || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End rogārtto mucyate rogād baddho mucyeta baṃdhanāt || brahmahatyāsurāpānasvarṇasteyī ca yo naraḥ || 159 || gurutalpagato vāpi paṭhanāt mucyate sakṛt || idaṃ rahasyam amalaṃ mayoktaṃ ṛṣisattama || paṭhanād brahmasāyujyaṃ saṃprāpnoti na śaṃsayaḥ || 160 || || (fol. 10r6–8) Colophon iti viṣṇuyāmale sṛṣṭipraśaṃsāyāṃ gāyatryaṣṭottarasahasranāmastotraṃ || || suśīlaḥ surūpaḥ śaraṇyo vadānyaḥ sadā devavīraśravo dattacittaḥ || kumāro pi saṅgrāmacarcāprasakto varīvarttiloke bahādūrasāhaḥ || 1 || śāke 1697 (fol. 10r8–10)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīnārada uvāca || || bhagavan sarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada⟨ḥ⟩ śrutismṛtipurāṇānāṃ rahasyaṃ t[v]anmukhāc chrutam 1 sarvapāpaharaṃ deva yena vidyā pravarttate || kena vā brahmavijñānaṃ kiṃtu vā mokṣasādhanaṃ 2 (fol. 1v1–4) End asatpratigrahāc caiva bhakṣābhakṣād viśeṣataḥ pāṃṣaṃḍānṛpamukhyebhyaḥ paṭhanād eva mucyate 53 idaṃ rahasyam amalaṃ mayoktaṃ padmajodbhavaḥ brahmasāyujyadaṃ nṛṇāṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ 54 (fol. 14r3–6) Colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe dvādaśaskaṃdhe gāyatrīsahasranāmastotrakathanaṃ ⟨nāma⟩ ṣaṣṭho dhyāyaḥ śubhaṃ (fol. 14r6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ saṃtoṣaṃ ca guruṃ vaṃde paraṃ savitṛdāyakaṃ || śāṃtaṃ si[ṃ]hāsanārūḍha⟪ṃ⟫m ānandamṛtadāyakaṃ || yadaṃghriṃ kamaladvaṃdvaṃ dvaṃdvātāpanivāraṇaṃ [[|]] tārakaṃ dvipadaṃ vaṃde śrīguruṃ praṇamāmy ahaṃ || 1 || brahmā⟨ṃ⟩straṃ brahmadaṃḍaṃ śirasi śikhamahābrahmaśīrṣaṃ namoṃtaṃ sūktaṃ pārāyaṇoktaṃ praṇavaparamahān vākyasiddhāṃtamūlaṃ || tūrīyaṃ trīṇi dvitīyaṃ prathamamanumahān vedavedāṃtasūktaṃ nityaṃ smṛtyānusāraṃ niyamitacaritaṃ mūlamaṃtraṃ namoṃtaṃ || 1 || (fol. 1r1–7) End śaṭkū(!)kṣiḥ pīṭhasaṃsthaṃ⟨s⟩ tadupari vilasat somasūtraṃ sabiṃduṃ tanmadhye nādasaṃjñaṃ praṇavaparivṛttaṃ biṃdunādau punaś ca || ī(!)tthaṃ saṃciṃtya yogī dvividhamanumayaṃ tārakaṃ vyomasaṃsthaṃ sarvādhāraṃ maheśaṃ sakṛd api manasā ⟨māṃ⟩ dhyāyate yas sa muktaḥ || 25 || (fol. 5r10–5v4) Colophon iti śrīviśvāmitrakṛtaṃ stavarājaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || śrīnāthārpaṇam astu || śrī || (fol. 5v4–5)

Beginning ❖ || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || bhairava uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi gāyatrītattvam uttamaṃ || stotramaṃtramayaṃ devyāḥ sarva[[taṃ]]treṣu gopitaṃ || 1 || (fol. 1r1–2) End la⟨l⟩kṣmīṃ japed yaḥ paravargabhītaḥ smaśānabhūmau śiva[va]veṣadhārī || tasyaiva vaśyā kamalākarasthā yā viṣnupatnī kamalākarasthā || 14 || (fol. 2r2–5) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ āśvalāyana uvāca devadeva trilokeśa sarvadeva namaskṛta yenāhaṃ siddhim ānomi tan me brūhi pitāmaha 1 brahmovāca sādhu sādhu mahāprājña buddhimāna asi suvrata yena kāryāṇi sidhyaṃti [[taṃ vakṣye hi]]ta kāmyayā 2 (fol. 1v1–5) End dāsās tasya nṛpāḥ sarve dāsyo mṛgavilocanāḥ bahunātra kim uktena tasya lokatrayodbhavaṃ 31 yaṃ yaṃ prā⟪pno⟫rthayete ⟪putras⟩⟩[[kāmaṃ]] taṃ taṃ prāpnoti ciṃtitaṃ || gaṃgātaraṃgapricuṃbitamaulibhālaṃ vidyotamānaśaśikhaṃḍitabhūṣaṇāya †padapaṃkajamānaṃ dattarākalāya namo stu tasmai† 32 (fol. 5v1–6) Colophon iti śrībrahmāśvalāyanasaṃvāde gaṇapatistavarāja[ḥ] samāptaḥ ❁ ❁ || (fol. 5v6–7)

«Beginning of 1. Gāyatrīhṛdaya:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrītripadāgāyatryai namaḥ || || atha gāyatrīhṛdayaṃ likhyate || || oṁ ⟨n⟩namaskṛtya bhagavān yājñavalkyaḥ svayaṃbhuvaṃ paripṛcchati || tvaṃ brūhi brahman gāyatryā utpattiṃ śrotum icchāmi || brahmajñānotpattiṃ prakṛtiṃ paripṛcchāmi || || brahmovāca || || praṇavena vyāhṛtayaḥ pravarttante || (fol. 1v1–5) «End of 2. Gāyatrīkavaca:» oṁ janaḥ dhiyaṃ sarveśvarīṃ kane(!)ṣṭhikābhyān namaḥ || oṁ tapaḥ yo naḥ satyaṃ pracodayāt sakalāmṛtatāriṇīṃ karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyān namaḥ || || eva[ṃ] hṛdayādi || || atha dhyānam || || (fol. 10r2–5) «Colophon of 2. Gāyatrīkavaca:» yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ likhitaṃ mayā || yadi śuddho(!)m aśuddho(!) vā mama doṣo na di(!)yate || (fol. 10r5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrītripadāgāyatryai namaḥ || atha gāyatrīhṛdayaṃ likhi(!)te || oṁ ⟨n⟩namaskṛtya bhagavān yājñavalkyaḥ svayaṃbhuvaṃ paripṛcchati || tvaṃ brūhi brahman gāyatryā utpattiṃ śrotum icchāmi || brahmajñānotpattiṃ prakṛtiṃ paripṛcchāmi || brahmovāca || praṇavena vyāhṛtayaḥ pravarttante || tamasas tu paraṃ jyotiḥ kaḥ puruṣaḥ svayaṃbhūr viṣnur iti || (fol. 1v1–4) End ṣaṣṭir gāyatryā śatasahasralakṣaṃ japtvā phalāni bhava[n]ti || aṣṭau brāhmaṇān samyag grāhayet || atha siddhir bhavati || ya idan nityam adhīyāno brāhmaṇaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ || sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate brahmaloke mahīyata ity āha bhagavān brahmā || || (fol. 5v5–7) Colophon iti gāyatrīhṛdayam || || samāptam || (fol. 5v7–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīsāvitryai namaḥ || oṁ asya śrīgāyatri(!)hṛdayastotramaṃtrasya brahmā(!)viṣṇumahesvarā ṛṣayaḥ gāyatrī chando agnir devatā akāro bījaṃ ukāra śakti[r] makāra[ḥ] kīlakaṃ gāyatrī prītaye viniyogaḥ || vasiṣṭhaḥ || athāto vasiṣṭhaḥ svayaṃbhuvaṃ paripṛcchati || pṛcchāmi tvāṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ gāyatrīṃ tāṃ bho⟨ḥ⟩ nu brīhīti || brahmovāca || brahmajñānotpattiprakṛttiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) End sarvatīrthasnāto bhavati | sarvavedajñātā bhavati | sarvakratuyajvā bhavati | abrahmacārī sabrahmacāri(!) bhavati | sahasralakṣagāyatrī-ājapyamānāyāḥ phalāni bhavanti || aṣṭau brāhmaṇān grāyahitvā brahmaloke mahīyate || || (fol. 10r1–3) Colophon iti gāyatrīhṛdayaṃ sampūrṇam abhūt || || (fol. 10r3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya [namaḥ] || oṁ hariḥ oṁ namaskṛtya bhagavān yājñavalkyaḥ svayambhu[vaṃ] paripṛcchati tvaṃ brūhi brahman gāyatryā utpattiṃ śrotum icchāmi brahmajñānotpatti⟨ṃ⟩prakṛttiṃ paripṛcchāmi || brahmovāca || praṇavena vyāhṛtayaḥ pravarttante tamasas tu praṃ jyotiḥ kaḥ puruṣaḥ svayambhūr vviṣṇur iti, hantā(sva sva)ṅgulyā manthayate, mathyamānāt pheno bhavati phenād budbudo bhavati budbudād aṇḍaṃ bhavati aṇḍād ātmā bhavati ātmana ākāśo bhavati ākāśād vāyur bhavati ... (fol. 1r1–3) End atha siddhir bhavati | idaṃ nityam adhīyāno brāhmaṇaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ | sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate brahmaloke mahīyate brahmaloke mahīyata iti || (fol. 3r8–9) Colophon iti gāyatrīhṛdayaṃ || (fol. 3r9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || yājñavalkya uvāca || svāmin sarvaja[ga]nnātha saṃśayo sti mama prabho || catu[ṣ]ṣaṣṭikalābhiś ca pātakād yogavidvaraḥ || 1 || mucyate kena puṇyena brahmarūpaḥ kathaṃ bhavet || dehaś ca devatārūpo maṃtrarūpi viśeṣataḥ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End aṣṭau brāhmaṇān sa samya[g] grāhayitvā tasya siddhir bhavati || ya idaṃ niyam adhīyāno brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate iti || brahmaloke mahīyate || ity āha bhagavān yājñavalkyaḥ || (fol. 16v10–17r3) Colophon iti gāyatrīhṛdayaṃ samāpta⟨ḥ⟩[m] || || saṃvat 1845 bhādrapdakṛṣṇa 11 budhau taddine kāśīpurīrājadhānīśrīviśveśvarasannidhyaśrīgaṃgāmahātīrthe pustaka samāptaḥ || śṛīḥ || || śrīḥ || || hastākṣara sakhā haribālāpurakarabhāradvājena likhitaṃ || vaidyanāthabhaṭṭaloropanāmakasya śubhaṃ bhavatu || śrīr astu || (fol. 17r3–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṁ namaskṛtya bhagavān yājñavalkyaḥ svayaṃbhuvaṃ paripṛcchati tvaṃ brūhi brahman gāyatryā utpattiṃ śrotum icchāmi brahmajñānotpattiṃ prakṛtiṃ paripṛcchāmi praṇavena vyāhṛtayaḥ pravarttaṃte || tamasas tu paraṃ jyotiḥ kaḥ puruṣaḥ svayaṃbhūr viṣṇur iti haṃtā svapsv aṃgulyā maṃthayate mathanāt pheno bhavati phenād budbudo bhavati budbudād aṃḍaṃ bhavati aṃḍād ātmā bhavati ātmā(!)na ākāśo bhavati (fol. 1r1–5) End sarvatīrthasnānaphalam āpnoti pratigrahapāpaṃ nāśayati mithyālāpāt pūto bhavati akṣaralokaṃ tiṣṭhati || (fol. 20r6–7) Colophon iti śrīyajurvidhāne gāyatryupaniṣat saṃpūrṇ⟨aṃ⟩[ā] || || gāyatryopaniṣadpāṭhāt tuṣyanti sarvadevatā[ḥ] | koṭijanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ haṃti caturvargaphalaṃ labhet || || śubham || || (fol. 20r7–9)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namo nārāyaṇāya || īśvara uvāca || kārttike māsi yā nārī, gṛhaṃ liptvā ca gomayaiḥ | saṃlikhya pītavāsena, maṇḍalaṃ svastikaṃ tathā || gandhaṃ padmaṃ tathā puṣpaṃ, siṃdurapravirājitaṃ | dhūpair ddīpais tathā lājaiḥ, puṣpair ākīrya sarvvataḥ || (fol. 1v1–2) End viśeṣeṇa jagaddhātuḥ keśavasya niveśane || †yandhāmūkāni† śrutāni nirvvivekā, hīnās tais taiḥ sādhane vipracaryyāḥ | tais tair ddīpāḥ sādhu lokapradattā, devāgārād anyato vipraṇītāḥ || || (fol. 6v5–6) «Sub-colophon:» iti kārttikamāhātmye dīparadāno dhyāyaḥ samāpta⟨m⟩[ḥ] iti || || (fol. 3v5–6) Colophon iti viṣṇudharmmeṣu dīpadānavidhir nnāma⟨ḥ⟩ || || śubhaṃ || (fol. 6v6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama[ḥ] || || pāṇau yasya ca modakākṣavimalaṃ dantaṃ kuthā(!)rāyudhaṃ candrābhaṃ madamattanāgavadanaṃ vyālopavītojvalaṃ || yekṣendrāsurakinnarair mmunivarair nāgaiḥ sadāvaṃditaṃ vighneśaṃ satataṃ namāmi śirasā kāmārthasiddhipradaṃ || 1 || karmmaṇā manasā vācā prapanno smi vināyakaṃ || te taraṃti mahāghoraṃ saṃsāraṃ kāmavarjitaṃ<ref name="ftn1"> probably for kāmavarjitāḥ </ref> || 2 || (fol. 1v1–6) End evaṃ te kathitāṃ hy ete krameṇa varipṛcchati vināyakasya māhātmyaṃ pratiṣṭhārccanayoḥ vidhiḥ 34 prasaṃśā brahmagāyatryāḥ kalpas tasyāstu śobhanaḥ || stavarājasya māhātmyaṃ svarūpaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ 35 vaktum arhasi tad brahman kuṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi 136 || (fol. 18r2–6) Colophon ī(!)ti śrībhaviṣyapurāṇe caturthīkalpe ṣaṣṭhyāṃśe ʼṣṭadaśe ʼdhyāye gaṇeśastavarājaḥ samāpta⟨m⟩[ḥ] || śubham || (fol. 18r6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || sarveṣu yena kāleṣu puṇye vā samayāntare || sarvadā vājapeja(!)s tu stavarājaṃ stavottamaṃ || yatphalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva caturmukham(!) || gaṃgāpravāhāvarttasya vāstṛti vijṛṃbhate ||<ref name="ftn1"> pāda d is numerical and not make a sense. </ref> (fol. 1v1–3) End vināyakasya ma(!)hātmya[ṃ] pratiṣṭhārccanayo[r] vidhi[m] || prasaṃbho(!) brahmagāyatryā[ḥ] kalpa⟨s⟩[ṃ] te(!)syeti sobhanāt || stavarājasya ma(!)hātmyaṃ śṛuta[ṃ] sarvem(!) aśeṣata[ḥ] || vaktuṃ me bhasi ta brahmana bhi bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi<ref name="ftn2"> probably for: vaktum arhasi tad brahman kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotum icchasi </ref> || || (fol. 9v2–4) Colophon iti bhaviṣyapurāṇe catū(!)rthi(!)kalpe ṣāṣṭotte (!) aṣṭamo(!)daśo dhyāya[ḥ] stavarāja⟨ṃ⟩[ḥ] samāpta⟨m⟩[ḥ] (fol. 9v5)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || śrīgurubhyho namaḥ || kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ caṃdrakhaṃḍavirājitaṃ || papraccha vinayād bhaktyā gaurī natvā vṛṣadhvajam || 1 || śrīdevy uvāca || || bhagavan sarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada || kenopāyena ca kalau lokānāṃ sadgatir bhavet || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End yatra gehe sahasraṃ ca nāmnāṃ ca pratipūjitam || śrīguroḥ kṛpayā śiṣyo bra[[hma]]sāyujyam āpnuyāt || (fol. 11v3–4) Colophon iti śrīsaṃmohanataṃtre īśvarapārvatīsaṃvāde śrīgurusahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || || ❁ || śrīsāmbasadāśivārpaṇam astu || (fol. 11v5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || navāṃbudānīkamanoharāya praphullarājīvavilocanāya || veṇusvamānoditagokulāya namo stu gopījanavallabhāya || 1 || kirīṭakeyūravibhūṣitāya graiveyamālāmaṇiraṃjitāya || sphuraccalatkāṃcanakuṃḍalāya namo stu gopījanavallabhāya || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End ādau devaki devagarbhajananaṃ gopīgṛhe varttanaṃ māyāpūtanajīvitāpaharaṇaṃ govarddhanoddhāraṇaṃ || kaṃśacchedanakauravādimaraṇaṃ kuṃtīsutāpālanam etad bhāgavataṃ purāṇakathitaṃ śrīkṛṣṇalīlāmṛtam || 9 || || (fol. 2v5–3r3) Colophon iti [śrī]macchaṃkarācāryaviracitaṃ gopījanavallabhastotram || || samāptam || || śubham || (fol. 3r3–4)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || gopikā ūcuḥ || jayati te ʼdhikaṃ janmanā vrajaḥ śrayata indirā śaśvad atra hi | dayita dṛśyatāṃ dikṣu tāvakās, tvyi dhṛtāsavas tvāṃ vicinvate || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End na pāraye haṃ niravadyasaṃyujāṃ, sasādhukṛtyaṃ vibudhāyuṣāpi vaḥ || yā yā(!)bhajan drujjaragehaśṛṃga(!)lāṃ, saṃvṛścya tad vaḥ pratiyātu sādhutā || || (fol. 3v1–3) Colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe daśamaskaṃdhe rāsakrīḍāyāṃ dvātriṃśo dhyāyaḥ || || śrīrāmabhadra || || (fol. 3v3)

Beginning śrīguruprasādo ʼstu || †śrīgurusarvajñakrayānidhe† nijaguroḥ nirvāṇasaṃsiddhidaṃ || nityānaṃdamayaṃ niraṃtaragalatpi(!)yūṣadhārādharaṃ | nityaṃ nirmalam uj[j]valaṃ śaśikalāsaśītalaṃ suprabhaṃ ⟪‥⟫śubhrāṃbhojavane svamūrddhni satataṃ tvatpādayugmaṃ bhajet || 1 ||<ref>pāda a is unmetrical.</ref> (fol. 1v1–4) End śrīvidyānaṃdanāthaḥ paraśivasadṛśo viśvavikhyātakīrttis tacchiṣyenātmaśaktyā gurupadavibhavaṃ stotram etad variṣṭhaṃ || nityānaṃdena bhaktyā paṭhitum anudinaṃ nirmitaṃ yaḥ prabhāte śiṣyodhi(!)teha nityaṃ ⟨daṃ⟩[ta]dupari karuṇā syād gu⟪ru⟫roḥ sarvathaiva || 12 || (fol. 3r8–3v4) <references/> Colophon iti śrīgurustutiḥ || saṃvat 1768 phālguṇaśudi 14 likhitaṃ rāmanāthena (fol. 3v4–5)

Beginning ❖ śrīgurave || kara(!)traṃ dhanaṃ putrapautrādi sarvvaṃ, gṛhaṃ bāndhavān sarvvam etad vijātaṃ || guror aṃghripadmaṃ manaś cen na d⟨r⟩ttaṃ, tataḥ kiṃ tataḥ kiṃ tataḥ kiṃ tataḥ kiṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End gururo aṣṭakaṃ yaḥ paṭhet puṇyadehi(!), yati[t] bhūpati[r] brahmacārī ca gehī || labhed vāñchitārthaṃ padaṃ brahmasaṃjñaṃ, guror uktavākyaṃ mano yasya lagnaṃ || 9 || (fol. 2r4–6) Colophon iti śrīśaṅkarācāryaviracitaṃ guro[r a]ṣtakaṃ stotraṃ samāptaṃ || śubhaṃ || (fol. 2r6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇādhipataye namaḥ || || śrīmadgopālāya namaḥ || || kailāśaśikhare ramye gaurī pṛcchati śaṃkaraṃ brahmāṇḍākhilanāthas tvaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End kṛtvā pūjāṃ paṭhen maṃtro bhakti(māyaḥ)stava sadā || viśeṣataḥ śani⟨r⟩dine pīḍā tasya vinaśyati || 20 || janmalagnasthite vāpi gocare stu †rasaśige† || daśāśucagate śaurau (fol. 12v8–9) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ gopya ūcuḥ jayati te dhikaṃ janmanā vrajaḥ śrayata iṃdirā śaśvad atra hi dayita dṛśyatāṃ dikṣu tāvakās tvayi dhṛtāsavat tvāṃ vicinvate 1 (fol. 1v1–2) End yat te sujātacaraṇāṃburuhaṃ staneṣu bhītāḥ śanaiḥ priya dadhīmahi karkaśeṣu tenāṭavīm aṭasi tad vyathatena kiṃsvit kūrpādibhir bhramati dhīr bhavadāyuṣān naḥ 19 (fol. 4v2–4) Colophon iti śrīmadbhāgavate daśamaskaṃdhe rāsakrīḍāyāṃ gopikāstutiḥ ❁ (fol. 4v4)

Beginning śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ || gopya ūcuḥ || jayati te dhikaṃ janmanā vrajaḥ śrayata indirā śaśvad atra hi || dayita dṛśyatāṃ dikṣu tāvakās tvayi dhṛtāsavas tvāṃ vicinvate || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End yat te sujātacaraṇāṃburuhaṃ staneṣu bhītāḥ śanaiḥ priya dadhīmahi karkkaśeṣu || tenāṭavīm aṭasi tad vyathatena ki[ṃ]svit kūrpādibhi[r] bhramati dhīr bhavadāyuṣa naḥ || 19 || (fol. 5v2–4) Colophon iti śrībhāgavatamahāpurāṇe daśamaskaṃtha ekatrīśo dhyāyaḥ (fol. 5v4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || gopya u(!)cuḥ || jayati te dhikaṃ janmanā vrajaḥ || śrayata iṃdirā śasvad atra hi || dayita dṛśyatāṃ dikṣu tāvakās tvayi bhṛtāsavas tvāṃ vicinvate || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End yat teṣu jātacaraṇāṃburuhaṃ staneṣu bhītā śanaiḥ priya dadhīmahi karkkaśeṣu || tenāṭavīm aṭasi tad vyathatena kiṃsvit kūrppādibhir bhramati dhī[r] bhavadāyuṣāṃ na[ḥ] || 19 || (fol. 4v2–4) Colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe daśamaskaṃddhe(!) rāśakri(!)ḍāyāṃ gopikāstutigīta ekatriṃśo dhyāyaḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ śubham likhitaṃ gaṃgādharaśarmmaṇā saṃvat || 1894 sāla vaiśāṣavadi 6 roja 4 karakṛtam aparādha[ṃ] kṣaṃtum arhaṃti ‥ || || || || || || ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ (fol. 4v5–5r4)
