Beginning bhava bohonasa || thvanali saṃphuḍi tāla khiṃ pogā balī coṅana pūjanaṃ || vidhāna theṃ || saṃpradāya pūjā yāṅāva bā(2)jana hlāya bohona || jathā saṃbhava samaya || dakṣiṇā || āśirvvāda || thvate pvagāna ghāya bohoṇa biye vi⟪ya⟫dhi || (3) ۞ || atha yiṇāya thāna kāya vidhiḥ || nakasa nāṭeśvara pūjā || (exp. 4:1–3) End thvate dhunaṅāva nāṭeśvara hlāye kalaśa gvaḍa 3 || hṅava taṃṅe yāṭrāsa || jalaśibali no || thvate dhunaṅā(11)(va) nāṭeśvaraṭoṃ pūjā yāṅāva kalaśa śvagvaḍaṃ hlāyaṭoṃ || yātā dhunaṅāva yi(ṇā)ya laṃ sosyaṃ thava che dute sagvana biye || pu(12)(jā) maphiseṃ pyākhana huyamāla ||(exp. 6b10–12) Colophon iti siddhividhāna samāpta || ۞ || tālapatisa duṃthane bhujapatrasa coye (13) .. gorocanana || mūlamantrana pātranāma śaṃyuktaṃ rakṣa 2 siddhi 2 huṃ namaḥ || ikārayaṃguṃ sata pvasya akṣata rakṣā (exp. 6b12–13)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīguhyakālikā devyai || atha piśācacaturdaśīmahāpārvvaṇya vidhi || duṃthusa baṃ thele māla || ghaṇṭha ḍaluthi dā(2)ko buyake piṃbiye || dasaprati cavadaśa yāṅa tako samastaṃ, nebhāra mabivara, dhunake māla || duṃthuyā lava cavadaśa(3)yā jā pūjā dāko, ṅoyāva pitaṃ te || (fol. 1r1–3/exp. 7) (fol. ) «Extracts:» atha ugracaṇḍā deguli yāya || nityakarmmasa, dhyāna jukona taṃne || bali biye, cavasathi yogini bali || (fol. 5r1/exp. 5) End «Out of focus» Colophon (fol. )

«Beginning:»' yogīṃdro visargaśaktyā svarūoātmavijñānapadasthaḥ sa jñātā karttā cāvagantavyaḥ tadā cāsya heyaṃ tuchatāṃ (pu)nar upādeyatām āsādayatī(ti) vyācakṣate || etac ca na naḥ pratibhāti padārthasaṅgater nācicāritvāt pratisūtraṃ cedṛśo vyākhyākramastha(!) sahasraśo darśayituṃ praśakyatvāt asya ca || 29 || svaśaktipracayo sya viśvam || yato yaṃ śivatulya uktas tathā yathāśaktasyo sya jagatkṛt svaṃ ityāmnāyadṛṣṭyā śivasya viśvaṃ svaśaktimayaṃ tathāsyāpi svasaṃvedātmanaḥ śakteḥ pracayaḥ kriyāśaktisphuraṇarūpo vikāśo viśvam || (fol. 45r1–7) «End:» soyam āgamasaṃvādaspaṃdasaṃgatisundarā | vṛttiḥ saiva rahasyārthe śivasūtreṣu darśitā || śivarahasyanidarśanasaṃstavan navanavāmṛtasārarasolvaṇāṃ | sukṛtino ramayantu bhavd vide sphuṭam imāṃ śivasūtravimarśinīm || iyam arocakīnāṃ cucibarddhinī pariṇatiṃ tanute paramāṃ mateḥ | rasanamātra sa eva sudhaughavan mṛtijarājananādibhayāpahṛt || dehaprāṇasukhādibhiparimitāhantādibhiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ | caitanyaṃ cinute nijaṃ na sumahan māheśvaraṃ svaṃ janaḥ | madhye bodhasudhā (fol. 55v2–8) «Sub-colophon:» iti śrīśivasūtravivṛtāvāṇavopāyaprakāśanaṃ nāma tṛtīya unmeṣaḥ || (fol. 55v1–2)

«Beginning:»' oṃ namaḥ śivāya || vande devaṃ purāṇaṃ śivam amaraguruṃ bhūtalasthena mūrdhnā nityaṃ śāṃtaṃ susūkṣmaṃ tribhuvananamitaṃ sarvvasarvaikanāthaṃ | nissaṃgaṃ nirvvikāraṃ prajananamaraṇaṃ kleśadoṣair vimuktaṃ yogābhyāsaikavedyaṃ triguṇavirahitaṃ na prasajyasvarūpaṃ || nirvvyāpāraṃ susūkṣmaṃ kṣitijaladahanākāśavātair vimuktaṃ pratyakṣādipramāṇaiḥ kṛtibhir aviditaṃ hetudṛṣṭāntaśūnyaṃ || rūpādīnām abhāvāt avayavavikalādindriyair aprameyaṃ pratyātmajñānagamyaṃ paṭubhir api girā niḥprapañcasvabhāvaṃ || śāstrasyādipraṇetāraṃ sanakaṃ munipuṃgavaṃ || namaskṛtyvā(!) pravakṣyāmi saṃhitāṃ dharmaputrikāṃ || (fol. 1v1–4) «End:» ity ete ṣoḍaśa proktā upoyā (!) yogasādhanāḥ tān samyag yo vijānāti sa yogītyabhidhīyate || ālokyātyantaguhyārthaśāstraṃ sanakanirmitaṃ || vastumātraṃ samādāya dharmaśīlasya sūnunā || sukhāvabodhā bālānāṃ grathitā saṃhitā mayā || nirūpye dātum arhanti doṣān tyaktvā manīṣiṇaḥ || ye cittāni sutṛṣṇayaiva satataṃ kliṣyanti ye cāpare svāmyājñaśravaṇaspṛhād anudinaṃ tiṣṭhaṃti rājāṅgare | ye cānye madirāsavādi vividhā svādena saṃmūrcchitā-s tair yāgasya phalaṃ satāṃ bahumataṃ nāsvādyate tanmukhaṃ || || (fol. 14v6–15r2) «Colophon(s):» iti dharmaputrikāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ siddhyupāyo nāma ṣoḍaśamaḥ(!) paṭalaḥ samāptaḥ || 16 || asyānukramaḥ || prathamaḥ śivadharmo nāma || || dvitīyaḥ śivadharmottaro nāma || || tṛtīyaśivadharmasaṃgraho nāma || || caturtha umāmaheśvarasaṃvādo nāma || pañcama śivopaniṣannāma || ṣaṣṭha uttarottarasaṃvādo nāma || || saptama bṛṣasārasaṃgraho nāma || || aṣṭama dharmaputrikānāma || śivadharmonāma mahāśāstram iti || ❁ || || (fol. 15r2–5)

«Beginning:»' śrībighnarājāya namaḥ śiva uvāca ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pratyayaṃ cāmṛtopamam dadhadhānāhataṃ nādaṃ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakam 1 ciṇīti prathamaṃ śabdaṃ ciñciṇīti dvitīyakam cirśabdaṃ tṛtīyaṃ syāc chaṃkhaṃ(!)śabdaś caturthakaḥ(!) 2 paṃcamaṃ tantranirghoṣaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca ra(ṇa)van tathā saptamaṃ kāṃsyatālaṃ ca meghaśabdaṃ tathāṣṭamam 3 navamaṃ vārinirghoṣaṃ daśamo dundubhiḥ dhvaniḥ navaśabdān parityajya daśamo mokṣadāyakaḥ 4(fol. 1v1–4) «End:» kṣaṇam ardhakṣaṇārdhaṃ vā samādhiṃ yodhigacchati ājanmajanitaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati 59 eṣā sā khecarā(!) mudrā saiṣā vidyāpi śāṅkarī mahāmudrā ca saivā(!) trayaciṃtāsahitaṃ manaḥ (!) 60 alpāhāro mahāyāsaḥ prajalpovyasanāgrahaḥ dānatvaṃ janatāsaṃga tyājyāṣṭaḥ yoginā amī 61 jīvo yaṃ yadi jāgartti tāvan mṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ yadi mudrānvito nityaṃ jīvo nidrā sadāsyate 62 yāvad vāyusthiro dehe tāvat mṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ yāvan mudrāsanābaddhas tāvad vāyuḥ kva gacchati 63 ālasyaṃ mahatiṃ nidrā manaś ca kapi cañcalam tribhir etai bhaven mṛtyuḥ sddhye kṣedetra yo mataḥ 64 yāvad vindu sthirā dehe tāvan mṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ yāvan mudrāsanā baddhas tāvad viṃduḥ kva gacchati 65 pade śūnye nirālambe cittaṃ carati yasya vai sa eva brahmacārī syāt sat u nārī na barjjitaḥ 66 aprāpya rājyaṃ na dhanaṃ na vidyāṃ kāntā na kāntāṃ suhṛdo na hṛdyā vāṃchāmi kiṃtv ekam agaṇyalābhaṃ nityaṃ samīhe paramātmatattvaṃ 67 (fol. 5r6–5v3) «Colophon(s):» iti śrīyogaśāstre śrīpārvvatīśvarasaṃvāde nādānusandhānaṃ saṃpūrṇam ❁ ❁ ❁ (fol.5v3–4)

«Beginning:»' śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || parabrahmaṇe namaḥ || oṃ namaḥ paramadevatāyai namaḥ || || śrīnandikeśvara uvāca || || atha tantrānusāreṇa ṣaṭkacakrādi kramodbhutaḥ (!) || ucyate paramānanda ṇirvvaṇa(!) prathamāṅkuraḥ || meror bāhyapradeśe śaśimihiraśive savuadakṣe niṣaṇṇe madhye nāḍī suṣumnā tritayaguṇamayī caṃdrasūryāgnirūpāḥ || dhattūrasmerapuṣpaprathimataravapuḥ kandamadhyā chirasthā(!) vajrākhyā merudeśācchirasi parigatā madhyame yāj jvalantī || 2 || tanmadhye citriṇī sā praṇava vilasitā yoginī yogagamyā || lūtātantūpameyā sakulaśirasijā merumadhyāntarasthā bhitvā dedīpyate tad grathanaracanayā śuddhabuddhaprabodhāḥ tatrāntar brahmanāḍī haramukhakuharād ādirephāntasaṃsthā || 3 ||(fol. 1v1–5) «End:» jñātvaitat kramam uttamaṃ yatamanā yogopamādyair yutaḥ śrī(dī)kṣāgurupādapadmayugalā modaprabodhodayāt || saṃsāre na hi janyate hi (na) kadā saṃkṣīyate saṃkṣaye pūrṇānadaparaṃparāprauditasvāntasukāmāgraṇī || 55 || yo dhatte niśisaṃdhyayor atha divā yogi svabhāvasthito mokṣaṃ jñānanidānam etad amalaṃ śuddhaḥ suguptaṃ kṛtaṃ śrīmacchrīgurupādapadmayugalālabdhoyatāntar manās tasyāvaśyam abhīṣṭadaivatapade ceto narīnṛtyate || 56 || (fol. 5v7–10) «Colophon(s):» iti śrīpūrṇānandaparamahaṃsaviṣaye viracite tattvacintāmnaṇau (pradukta)kramayogavivarṇan nāma ṣaṣṭaḥ paṭalaḥ || śubh 2 (fol. 5v10–11)

«Beginning of the Root Text:»' || atha yogānuśāsanaṃ || 1 || yogaś cittavṛttinirodhaḥ || 2 || tadā draṣṭuḥ svarūpe ‘vasthānam || 3 || (fol. 1v8 and 2r7) «Beginning of the Rajamārttaṇḍa:»' śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ namaḥ paramātmane || dehārdhayogaḥ śivayoḥ saśreyāṃsi tanotu vaḥ | duḥprāpyam api yatsmṛṭyā janaḥ kaivalyam aśnute || 1 || trividhānyapi duḥkhāni yad anusmraṇān nṛṇāṃ | prayānti sady vilayaṃ taṃ stumaḥ śivam avyayam || 2 || pataṃjalimuner uktiḥ kāpy apūrvā jayaty asau | puṃprakṛtyor viyogo pi yoga ityudito yayā || 3 || jayantu vācaḥ phaṇibharttur āntaraṃ sphurat tamaḥ stoma niśākaraviṣaḥ || vibhāvyamānāḥ satataṃ manāṃsi yāḥ satāṃ sadānandamayāni kurvvate || 4 || … anena sūtreṇa śāstrasya saṃbandhābhidheyaprayojanāni vyākhyāyaṃte || athaśabdo adhikāradyotako maṅgalkārthaś ca || (fol. 1v 1–3, 7, 9) «End of the Root Text:» kṛtārthānāṃ pariṇāmasamāptir guṇānāṃ || 31 || kṣaṇaṃ pratiyogīpariṇāmā parāṃta nirgrāhyaḥ kramaḥ || 32 || puruṣārthaśūnyānāṃ pratiprasavaḥ kaivalyaṃ svarūpapratiṣṭhā vā citi śaktir iti || 33 || (fol. 24r7–9) «End of the Rājamārttaṇḍa:» atītādiṣv addhvasu dharmāṇāṃ sadbhāvam upapādya vijñānavādaṃ nirākṛtya sākāravādañ ca pratiṣṭhāpya puruṣasya jñātṛtvam uktvā cittadvāreṇa sakalavyavahāraniṣpattim upapādya puruṣasiddhau pramāṇam upadarśya kaivalyanirṇayādaśabhiḥ sūtraiḥ krameṇa upayogino rthān abhidhāya śāstrāṃtareṣv etad eva kaivalyam upapannam ity upaṃpādya kaivalyasvarūpaṃ nirṇītam iti vyākṛtaḥ kaivalyapādaḥ || 4 || sarve yasya vaśāḥ pratāpanṛpateḥ pādāntasevā nati- prabhrasyan mukuṭesu mūrddhasu dadhaty ājñāṃ dharitrī bhṛtaḥ yadvaktrābjam avāpya garvam asammam vāgdevatāpi śritā saśrībhojapati phaṇādhipateḥ (!) sūtreṣu vṛttiṃ vyadhāt || 1 || (fol. 25v14–26r4) «Colophon of the Pātañjalayogasūtra:» iti śrīpā(taṃ)jalayogaśāstre kaivalyapādaś caturthaḥ || (fol. 24r9) «Colophon of the Rājamārttaṇḍa:» iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracitāyāṃ rājamārttaṇḍābhidhāyāṃ pātañjalayogaśāstrasūtravṛttay kaivalyapādaś caturthaḥ || 4 || || || || miti māghaśuddha 15 samvat 1914 śake 17(79) || || kāśirājāśritasya śrīkṛṣṇaśāstrī jyotirvidaḥ pustakam idam iti jagaj jānātu || (fol. 26r4–5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya || oṃ namaḥ śivāya || śrīguruṃ paramānandaṃ vande ānadavigrahaṃ | yasya sānnidhyamātreṇa cidānandāyate tanuḥ || antarniścalitātmadī[[pa]]kalikā svādhārabaṃdhādibhir yo yogī yugakalpakālakalanā tatvaṃ ca yo gīyate | jñānāmodamahodadhiḥ samabhavad yatrādināthaḥ svayaṃ vyaktāvyaktā(!)guṇādhikatvem(!) aniśaṃ śrīmīnanāthaṃ bhaje || (fol. 1v1‒3) End vyomavijñānam ānandamuktisopānamārgataḥ | prakaṭitaṃ paramārthaguntha(!)guhyātiguhyatāṃ || 102 || sakṛd etat paṭhanīyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti prabodhakaḥ | sa bhavati bhavitavyaṃ bhājanaṃ muktiśāṃtaye || 103 || (fol. 19v1‒2) Colophon iti gorakśanāthaviracitaṃ vivekamārttaṇḍo nāma gorakṣaśatake yogaśāstraṃ samāptaṃ || || ❁ || kṛṣṇāya namaḥ || || (fol. 19v2‒3)

«Beginning:»' śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīgurupādukābhyo namaḥ || atha taṇtrānusāreṇa ṣaḍcakrādikramoddhataḥ || ucyate paramānandanirvāhaprathamāṃkuraḥ || meror bāhyapradeśe śaśimihiraśire savyadakṣe niṣaṇne madhye nāḍī suṣumnā tritayaguṇamayī candrasūryāgnirūpā dhattūrasmerapuṣpāgrathitatamavapuḥ kandamadhyāt śirasthā vajrākhyā merudeśe śirasśi pariṇatā madhyame syo jvalantī || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) «End:» lākṣābhaṃ paramāmṛtaṃ paraśivāt pītvā punaḥ kuṇḍalī pūrṇānandamahodayāt kulapathān mūle viśet sundarīṃ | tad divyāmṛtadhārayā sthiramatiḥ saṃtarppayed daivataṃ yogī yogaparaṃparāsu viditaṃ brahmāṇḍabhāṇḍasthitaṃ || 54 || jñātvaitat kramam uttamaṃ yatamanā yogī samādhau sthitaḥ śrīdīkṣāgurupādapadmayugalā(nanda)modaprakāśodayāt || saṃsāre na hi jāyate na hi punaḥ saṃksīyate saṃkṣaye pūrṇānadaparaṃparāsu muditas cāste satām agraṇī yo dhīte niśi saṃdhyayor api divā yogī svabhāvasthito mikṣajñānanidānam etad amalaṃ śuddhaṃ suguptaṃ kramaṃ || śrīmat śrīgurupādapadmayugalā laṃbī rasaṃ tattvato jñātvā cāsya paraṃ svadaivatapade ceto narīnṛtyate || 55 (fol. 6v2–7) «Colophon:» iti śrīpūrṇānadaviracite cintāmaṇi samāptaḥ || || ṣaṭcakrabhedaḥ | (fol. 6v8)

«Beginning:»' śrīgmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ śrīgurucanaṇāravindebhyo namaḥ avyaktaparamātmane namaḥ oṃ oiṇḍo dhāraṇam padārthaṃ taṃ chāsttrārthaṃ tadyogakarmma likhyate karmmakhaṃḍaṃ jñānakhaṇḍaṃ | tattvakhaṇḍaṃ | niraṃjanaṃ caturvidhaṃ | aṣṭāṃgayogaḥ (!) na brahmā naiva viṣṇuḥ paśupati surapau no surāḥ naiva pṛthvī naivāpo nāpi vāyu na ca gaganatalaṃ no diśo naiva kālaḥ no vedāḥ naiva buddhir na ca raviśaśinau no vidhir naiva kalpaḥ sadyoti satyam ekaṃ jayati tava padaṃ saccidānandamūrtte 1 (fol. 1v1–7) «End:» anekabṛkṣavallīgulmatṛṇāni jaṃghāyāṃ romasthāne vasaṃti aneka kṛmikoṭipataṃgā puri vasaṃti yatsukhaṃ tatsvargaṃ tadduḥkhaṃ tan narakaṃ yatkarma tadbandhanam nirvvikalpaṃ nirvimuktidaṃ svasvarūpaṃ nidrādau jāgrataḥ svapnasuṣuptyādyavasthā ca catuṣṭayaṃ evaṃ sarvadeheṣu viśvarūpaparameśvaraḥ akhaṃditā(!) paripūrṇaḥ svasvabhāvena ghaṭe ghaṭe citprakāśasvarūpas tiṣṭhati evaṃ piṃḍasamatir bhavati (fol. 17v3–6) «Colophon:» iti śrīnityanāthasiddhaviracitāyāṃ siddhasiddhāntapaddhikāyāṃ piṇḍasamatir nāma tṛtīyopadeśaḥ || || samāpraś cāyaṃ granthaḥ || || ❁ || khaṣaṭ iṃdvātmake āke vibhavābdde ca phālgune || tithau pratipadi some hṛdayarāmo vyalīlikhat || || catvāro vihitā loke puruṣārthā svayaṃbhuvā kāraṇaṃ cānupūrveṇa yatteṣām antagodhikam || jñātvā pṛthvīpati rājā kāraṇaṃ mokṣasādhanam || sāṃkhyāpātañjalenoktaṃ yogaṃ saṃyuktavān svayaṃ || atas tasya vinodāya kiṃcid arthapradarśakam || likhitaṃ tuṣyatāṃ devau siddhidau dhanadau hi tau || || sītāpataye namaḥ || (fol. 18r1–8)

«Beginning of the Root Text:»' śrīguruṃ paramānandaṃ vande svānandavigrahaṃ || yasya sānnidhyamātreṇa cidānandāyate tanuḥ || 1 || antar niścalitātmadīpakalikāsvādhārabandhādibhir yo yogī yugakalpakālakalanā tattvañca jegīyate || jñānāmodamahodadhiḥ samabhavad yatrādināthaḥ svayaṃ- vyaktāvyaktaguṇādhikantam aniśaṃ śrīmīnanāthaṃ bhaje || 2 || (fol. 2r, 2v6–9) «Beginning of the commentary:»' śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || āphnā śīrṣamahāsahasradalamā tatkarṇikāmadhyamā tejomūrtti virājamāna samajhī gorakṣakā pādukā śrīgorakṣagurukṛpāśraya dharī nānā haṭhagranthako siddhāntārtha bharī duvai śatakamā ṭīkā apūrvai kahuṃ || 1 || es saṃsāramahā anekamatakā jañjālamā sāra ho yogābhyāsa bhanī mahāmunīharu siddhānta bāṃdhi taryā || śrīgorakṣaguru prasanna manale prajñā bahrun yogakī śrīkarṇail raṇavīramaṃtrighaṭamā yo dhyāi bhāṣā banyo || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End of the Root Text:» yoni madhye mahākiṅgaṃ paścimābhimukhaṃ sthitaṃ || mastake maṇivad vimbaṃ yo jānāti sa yogavit || 19 || taptacāmīkarābhāsaṃ taḍillekheva visphurat || trikoṇaṃ tatpuraṃ vahner adho medhrāt pratiṣṭhitaṃ (fol. 8v6,9) «End of Commentary:» tas trikoṇakā madhyamā suṣumṇādvārakā sanmukha bhairahyākā svayaṃbhunāma bhayākā mahāliṅga chan || liṅgakāśiramā maṇi jhaiṃ dedīpyamāna vimba cha || vindusvarūpakuṇḍalinī tinai hun bhanī yo dui tattva jāndacha tyo yogaśāstrābhyāsakana jānyā ho || 19 (fol. 8v7–9) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning:»' payamita kṣiptaṃ viśuddhiṃ vrajet || garttanyastapayobhisaṃbhṛtadaṭām(!) atropari sthāpitaṃ vāmas sarvvavanopalaiś ca puṭitaṃ saṃśuddhim etīti vā 6 rase svāduruktaḥ kaṭus tveka pāke mato gaṃdhakaḥ kuṣṭakaṃḍvādi hārī || viśuddho varā mākṣikājyena śāṇāḥ paraṃ vṛṣya āyuḥprado syāti tebhyaḥ 7 meṣīpayobhir daradair tathāmlair vibhāvitaṃ citraśikhaṃḍi7vāraṃ || viśuddhim āyāti nirūpayāmas tato rasākarṣaṇa siddhayatnam || 8 || (fol. 22r1–4) «End:» tutthamākṣikaśiloṣahenāḥ śa(ṃ)khagairikasitāvarayuktāḥ | cūrṇitāstu madhunāṃjanator mas tāvakā ca timirādi jayaṃti 34 dakṣāṃḍavalkalaśilājatuśaṃkhasindhū- śītaiḥ kṛtāñjanavidhiḥ kusumārmahārī piṣṭaṃ phalaṃ tu madhunā katakasya kiṃcit karpūrayuktam uditaṃ nayanaprasādi 35 atigūḍhā budhalakṣmaṇanirmitāvupāyānayanārttiṣviti yogacaṃdrikāyāṃ | śravaḥ śūlaśāṃtyai mataṃ vasta mūtraṃ kaduṣṇaṃ samiṃdhūtyamekaṃ niṣikta | sudhātaṃta śrīrāmāya namaḥ || rāmā (fol. 57v8–11) «Colophon:»

«Beginning of the Root Text:»' śrīḥ || || atha yogānuśāsanam 1 yogaś cittavṛttinirodhaḥ 2 tadā (dra)ṣṭuḥ svarūpe vasthānam 3 vṛttisārupyam itaratra 4 vṛttayaḥ paṃtayyaḥ kliṣṭā akliṣṭāś ca 5 pramāṇaviparyyayavikalpanidrāsmṛtayaḥ 6 (fol. 1v5, 2r5) «Beginning of Commentary:»' śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ|| || patañjaliṃ namaskṛtya yoginonyāṃś ca yoginaḥ bhavadevena tatsūtravyākhyānaṃ kriyate dhunā 1 maṃgalaṃ kurvvann eva śiṣyāvadhānāya pratijānīte atheti atra keśavārthakatayā ‘kāro śabdaś ca māṃgalika ityanena maṅgalācaraṇaṃ kiṃ ca atha yogopadeśayogyaśiṣyāgamanād anantaraṃ aniśiṣya praśnādaṃnupaścāt yogasya vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇasya śāsanaṃ upadeśatathā bhidhānaṃ ityarthaḥ 1 (fol. 1v1–3) «End of the Root Text:» kṣaṇapratiyogī paeriṇāmāparāntanirgrāhyaḥ kramaḥ || 32 || puruṣārthaśūnyānāṃ guṇānāṃ pratiprasavaḥ kaivalyaṃ svarūpapratiṣṭhā vā cicchaktir iti || 33 || (fol. 37r5–6) «End of commentary:» atha kaivalyasyāsādhaṇaṃ svarūpam āha puruṣārtheti svargāpavargādeḥ saṃpannatayā kṛtakarttavyatayā karttavya puruṣārthaśūnyānāṃ guṇānāṃ pratiprasaḥ pratilopapariṇāmasyāpi samāptau vikārānanubhavaḥ kaivalyaṃ svarūpapratiṣthā svarūpe ‘khaṇḍānande pratiṣṭhitā vikārā nanubhavena tanmātraviṣayitā paryavasannāc chaktiḥ caitanyapuruṣātmādi paryāyikāyā saiva vā kaivalyaṃ taduktaṃ vāśiṣṭhe svarūpāvasthitir muktis tad braṃśo baṃdha ucyate iti ānandabrahmaṇo rūpaṃ tac ca mokṣe pratiṣṭhitam ityādi śrutir apītyarthaḥ || 33 || (fol. 37r2–4, 7–8) «Colophon:» evaṃ caturthe caraṇe kaivalyaṃ pratipāditaṃ pataṃjalimunīṃdreṇa yena tan bhāvayāmyaham || imāṃ patañjaler vyākhyāṃ kalpayitvārpayāmyahaṃ || śriyā hṛdikṛte śrīmat padāṃbhoje śriyaḥ pateḥ || || (fol. 37r8–9)

«Beginning:»' śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha yogānusāśanaṃ sūtravyākhyā prāraṃbhaḥ || || śrīṅṛṣṇaṃ saccidānandaṃ natvātha kriyate mayā || yogasūtreṣu vyākhyānaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa na vistarāt || 1 || iha khalu śrutismṛtītihāsādyakhilavāṅmayaprasiddhadharmārthakāma(mokṣa) puruṣārthacatuṣṭayeṣu tāvan mokṣaḥ paramapuruṣārthaḥ sa ca śravaṇa manananididhyāsanasādhyas tatrāpy akhilādhikṛtasyāsādhāraṇa kāraṇībhūtasyāṣṭāṅgayogeṇa (!) prāyeṇa kavalīkṛtasya tasya samādheḥ yathāyatham aṇimādisiddhaye ca bhagavān pataṃjaliḥ samādhi tatsādhanavibhūtikaivalyākhyapādacayuṣṭayātmakaikādhyāyaparimitāni sūtrāṇi cakāra | teṣu ca sūtreṣv atra bhagavān bādarāyaṇo bhāṣyañ cakāra tad upari ca sarvatantrasvatantrāvācaspatimiśrāḥ ṭīkāṃ cakruḥ || … sūtrārthabodhinī vṛttir ārabhyate | tatredam ādimam sūtram atha yogānuśāsanam || 1 || (fol. 1v1–8) «End:» ghaṭadivac ca citte buddhau (na) pratisaṃkramaḥ | apariṇāmitvāt kintu sūryasya jale pratibimvavat citte buddhe pratibimvite sati buddhau cidākāratāpattau svasya bhogyāya buddheḥ saṃvedanaṃ bhavati cicchāyā bāhyatvasaṃbandhe ced uparakte citte cid dehyatvam ityarthaḥ apratisaṃkramāyāś cittes sāṃniddhyāt tasyāśś citter ākāra chāyā yatra śamāpattau(!) satyāṃ svabhogyabuddhisaṃvedanam iti yojanā nanu cittād atirikta ātmā kathaṃ tarhi cittātmeti bhramo lokaviśeṣāṇāṃ ityāśaṃkya cittasya sarvārthasāmarthyaṃ eva bījam āha || draṣṭṛ dṛśyoparaktā sarvārthaḥ || 23 || draṣṭā dṛś〉aṃ prapaṃco cetanaṃ tatsarvaṃ cetanā … (fol. 20v9–14) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning:»' ❖ śṛīgurusahajavinayakāya namaḥ || || śrī ādināthāya namo stu tasmai yenopadiṣtā haṭhayogavidyā virājate pronnata(rāja)saudham āroḍhum icchur adhirohiṇīva || 1 || praṇamya śrīguruṃ nāthaṃ svātmārāmeṇa yoginā kevalaṃ rājayogāya haṭhavidyopadiśyate || 2 || bhrāṃtā bahumatadhvāṃte rājamārgam ajānatāṃ | haṭhapradīpikāṃ dhatte svātmārāmaḥ kṛpākaraḥ || 3 || haṭhavidyo hi matsyeṃdra gorakṣādyā virājate(!) | svātmārāmo tha vā yogī jānīte tatprasādataḥ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–4) «End:» dṛṣṭisthirā yasya vinaiva dṛśyāt vāyusthiro yasya vinā payatnāt | cittaṃ sthiraṃ yasya vināvalambanāt sa eva yogī sa guruḥ sa sevyaḥ || praveśe nirgame vāme dakṣiṇe cordhvam apyadhaḥ | na yasya vāyur vahati sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ || sarve haṭhalayopāyā rājayogasya siddhaye | rājayogasamārūḍhaḥ puruṣaḥ kālavañcakaḥ || iti sakalayogaśāstrasindhoḥ parimathitād avakṛṣya sārabhūtaṃ | anubhavata haṭhāmṛtaṃ yamīndrāḥ yadi bhavatā majarāmaratvavāṃchā || || || (fol. 29r2–29v1) «Colophon:» iti śrīsadgurusvātmārāmayogeṃdrapravararacitāyāṃ haṭhapradīpikāyāṃ caturthopadeśaḥ || || || śrīsahajasadguru ātmārāmārpaṇaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || gururraṃ salalaṃ dānaṃ patraṃ malayasaṃbhavaṃ (fol. 29v1–2)

«Beginning:»' ❖ oṃ namaḥ īśvarāya || || atha yogānuśāsanam || yogaścittavṛttinirodhaḥ || tadā draṣṭuḥ svarūpe vasthānam || vṛtti sārūpyam itaratra || vṛttayaḥ pañcatayyaḥ kliṣṭā ‘ kliṣṭāḥ || pramāṇaviparyayavikalpanidrāsmṛtayaḥ || pratyakṣānumānopamāḥ pramāṇāni || viparyayo mithyājñānam atadrūpapratiṣṭham || (fol. 1v1–5) «End:» tataḥ kleśakarmmavinivṛttiḥ tadāsarvāvaraṇamalāpaṃ tasya jñānasyānantyājñeyam alpam || tataḥ kṛtārthānāṃ pariṇāmakramaparisamāptir guṇānām || kṣaṇapratiyogīpariṇāmāparāntanirgrāhyaḥ kramaḥ || puruṣārthaśūnyānāṃ pratiprasavaḥ kaivalyaṃ svarūpapratiṣṭhā vā citiśaktir iti || || (fol. 10v6–11r4) «Colophon:» iti pātañjale kaivalyapā(da)ś caturthaḥ samāptaḥ || || ❁ || || (fol. 11r4–5)

«Beginning:»' śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrī ādināthaṃ natvātha śrīnivāso mahāmatiḥ || haṭharatnāvalīm dhatte yogināṃ kaṇṭhabhūṣitāṃ || 1 || vede vedāntaśāstre phaṇipatiracite śabdasāstre svaśāstre || tantre prābhākarīye karayugavihete nyāyaratnārṇavenduḥ || sāṃkhye sārasvatīye vividhaśrutimate tattvacintāmaṇijñaḥ || tigmajyotir vidagre śaravaratanujo rājate śrīnivāsaḥ || 2 || haṭhavidyāṃ gorakṣamatsyendrādyā vijānate ātmārāmopi jānīte śrīnivāsas tathā svayaṃ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End:» rudragranthiṃ tato bhitvā sarvvapḍāvivarjjitaḥ || niṣpanno vaiṣṇavaḥ śabdaḥ kvaṇātītakṣaṇaṃ bhavet || ity ārambhādiyoge ca yogasthānanirūpaṇam || dṛṣṭisthirā yasya vinaiva śaktyā vāyusthiro yasya vinā prayatnāt || cittaṃ sthiraṃ yasya vināvalambāt sa caiva yogī sa guruḥ sa sevyaḥ || tattvaṃ bījaṃ haṭhaṃ kṣetraṃ audāsīnyaṃ jalaṃ tribhiḥ | unmanīkalpalatikā sadya eva phalisyati || vedaśāstrapurāṇānīti || ekaṃ sēṣṭimayaṃ bījaṃ ekā mudrā ca khecarī eko devo nirālambo ekāvasthā manonmanī mano yatra vilīyante (fol.36v1–5) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning:»' muner vivṛtir mayeya(m) prātanyate budhajanapratibodhahetuḥ || atha yogānuśāsanam || anena sūtreṇa śāstrasya saṃbandhābhidheyaprayojanāny ākhyāyante | athaśabdo ‘dhikāradyotako maṅgalārthaś ca | yuktir yogasamādhānaṃ anuśiṣyate vyākhyāyate lakṣaṇabhedopāyaphalair yena tadanuśāsanam yogasyānuśāsanam yogānuśāsanam | tadā śāstraparisamāpter adhikṛtaṃ boddhavyam ity arthaḥ tatra śāstrasya vyutpādyatayā yogasamādhānaḥ saphalobhideyaḥ(!) tadvyutpādanaṃ ca phalam vyutpāditasya yogasya kaivalyaṃ phalaṃ | śāstrābhidheyayaoḥ pratipādyapratipādakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ (fol. 2r1–6) «End:» hānam upadarśyātītānāgatādi sudharmāṇāṃ sadbhāvam upapādya vijñānavṃ nirākṛtya sākāravādaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya puruṣasya jñātṛtvam uktvā cittadvārā sakalavyavahāraniṣpattim upapādya puṣasiddhau pramā upadarśya kaivalyanirṇayāya daśabhiḥ krameṇopayogino arthān abhidhyayaya(!) śāstrāntareṇaitadeva kaivalyam upapannam ītyabhidhāya(!) kaivalyasvarūpam nirṇītam iti vyākṛtaḥ kaivalyapādaḥ (exp. 30t 3–7) «Colophon:» itiśrī(dhū)reśvaviracitāyāṃ pātañjalayogaśāstravṛttau kaivalyapādaś caturthaḥ 4 saṃvat 1920 li❁khā va||nā❁rasa ||mai śu❁bham || || miti mārga śudi 7 roja 5 śubham (exp. 30t7–30b2)

«Beginning:»' ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīguruṃ paramānandaṃ vande ānandavigrahaṃ || yasya sānnidhyamātreṇa cidānandāyate tanuḥ || 1 || antarniścalitātma(dīpa)kalikāsvādhārabandhādibhir || yogī yo yugakalpakālavijayī tattvañ ca yo gīyate || jñānonmādamahodadhisamabhavad yatrādināthaḥ svayaṃ || vyaktāvyaktaguṇānvitantam aniśaṃ śrīmīnanāthaṃ bhaje || 2 || namaskṛtya guruṃ bhaktyā gorakṣo jñānam uttamam || abhīṣṭaṃ yogīnāṃ brūte paramānandakāraṇaṃ || 3 || śrīgorakṣaśatakaṃ vakti yogīnaṃ hitakāmyayā || dhruvaṃ yasya prabodhena yāyate(!) paramaṃ padaṃ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End:» hetudṛṣtāntanirmuktam manobuddhir agocaraṃ || vyomaviñānam ānandan attvan tattvavido viduḥ || 99 || virajaṃ parmākāśam ajarātmā mahāmatiḥ || stutis tutyam ahorātran tattvan tattvavido viduḥ || 100 || yathā ghṛte ghṛtaṃ kṣiptaṃ ghṛtam eva hi jāyate || kṣīre kṣīran tathā yogī tattvam eva hi jāyate || 101 || dugdhakṣīraghṛte sarpir agnau vahnir ivārpitaḥ || tanmayatvaṃ vrajatyeva yogī līna pade pade || 102 || bhavabhayaharan nṛṇāṃ muktisopānasaṃjñakam || guhyād guhyataran guhyaṃ gorakṣeṇa prakāśitam || 103 || iti gorakṣaśatakayogaśāstraṃ janaḥ paṭhet sarvvapāpavinirmmukto yogasiddhiṃ labhed dhruvaṃ || yogaśāstraṃ paṭhe (!) nityaṃ kim anyaiḥ śāstravistaraiḥ || 1 || yatsvayaṃ cādināthasya nirggataṃ vadanāmbujāt || snātan tena samastatīrthasalile dattā ca pṛthvī dvijaiḥ yajñānānñca hutaṃ sahasram ayutaṃ devāś ca saṃ(tarpitāḥ) (fol. 14v1–7) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ namo gaṇeśāya || dikkālād(!)yavaccinnā,nandaciṇ(!)mātramūrttaye | svānubhūtyaikamānāya(!) namaḥ śāntāya tejase || 1 || boddhāro matsaragrastāṣ(!) prabhavaḥ smayadūṣitāḥ | abodho ʼpahatāś cānye jīrṇam aṃge subhāsṣitaṃ || 2 || (exp. 4t ll. 1–3) «Sub-colophon» iti bhartṛhariyogīndraviracitāyāṃ subhāṣitaratnāvalyāṃ nītiśatake mānaśauya(!)paddharir nnāma tṛtīyaṃ daśakaṃ || (exp. 8t l. 8–8b l. 1) «End» yasyāti vittaṃ sa naraḥ kulīnaḥ sa paṇḍitaḥ sa śrutavān sa dhīraḥ | sa eva vakta(!) sa ca darśanīyaḥ sarvveguṇāḥ kāṃcanam āśrayanti || 2 || daurmantyān (!) nṛpatir vinaśyati yataiḥ saṃgāt suto lālanād vipro ʼnadhyayanāt kulaṃ kutanayā(!) chīlaṃ khalopāsanāt | hrīr madyād anavekṣanād api kṛṣiḥ snehaḥ pravāśrayān(!) mai // (exp. 8b ll. 4–8) «Colophon»

«Beginning:»' ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīguruparmātmane namaḥ || || śrīgurum iti || || śrībhannu śrīṣṭisthitisaṃhārakākāraṇa bhayākā āphumā āphai bhaera paramānanda bhayākā śrīgurukana namaskāra garchu kastā guru bhanaulā ta jauna gurukā sambandhalke garī śiṣya pani ścidānaṃda hoijānchan bhaṃnyā yastā goraṣanāthakā yuktile garī ambaragira yogī pani namaskāra garchan || 1 || aṃtariti || yastā aṃtakarṇamā ātmā rūpi niścala diyo cha jaskā yo kalikālamā sva unai gurukā ādhāra gariyo | yogī cārai yuga deṣi kalpakalpāntakāle gari raciyākā manuṣyamā tattvajñānale gari jo gāuṃdachan (fol. 1v1–6) «End:» yo yogaśāstra bhanyāko kasto ho bhanaulā ta saṃpūrṇa tīrthādimā snāna garnāle ra brāhmaṇa lāī pṛthvī dāna garnāle tastai hajjāra āyurtta homa garnāle ra esyai karma saṃga devatākā pūjā garnāle pheri pītṛkana sāco māni arpaṇa garyākā yastāmā eka mana bhai garyāko puṇyale gari svargamā puryāuṃdacha eka kṣaṇa brahmavicāra garnyā puruṣa jo chan so pāmanako dhairyakana prāpta hunāle gari janmamṛtyudeṣi mokṣe hoījānchan || 200 || || (fol. 20r5–9) «Colophon:» īti gorakṣasatakaṃ yogaśāstrabhākhā saṃpurṇam śubham ||(fol. 20r9)

«Beginning:»' ❖ || || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || yastyaktvā rūpamādyaṃ prabnhavati jagato nekadhānugrahāya prakṣīṇakleśarāśir viṣamaviṣadharo nekavaktraḥ subhogī | sarvajñānaprasūtir bhujagaparikaraḥ prītaye yasya nityaṃ | devo hi saḥ sa vo vyāt sitavimalatanur yogado yogayuktaḥ || atha yogānuśāsanaṃ || athetyayaṃ adhikārārthaḥ yogānuśāsanaṃ śāstram adhikṛtaṃ veditavyam | yogaḥ samādhiḥ sa ca sārvvabhaumaḥ cittasya dharmaḥ kṣiptaṃ mūḍhaṃ vikṣiptam ekāgraṃ niruddham iti cittabhūmayaḥ || tatra vikṣipte cetasi vikṣeposarjjanībhūtaḥ samādhir na yogapakṣe varttate | (fol. 11v1–5) «End:» tat kaivalyaṃ yaṃ kaṃcit puruṣaṃ prati pradhānasya mokṣaḥ svarūpapratiṣṭhā puruṣasya vā mokṣa ity āha svarūpeti asti hi mahāpralaye pi svarūpapratiṣṭhā citiśaktiḥ na cāsau mokṣa ity ata āha punar iti sautra iti śabdaḥ śāstra parisamāptau || mūktyarha cittaṃ paraloka me yajñasiddhayo dharmadhanaḥ samādhiḥ || dvayī ca mukṣiḥ pratipāditāsmin pāde prasaṅgāt api cānyad uktam || nidānam tāpānāṃ uditam atha tāpāś ca kathitāḥ sahāṃgair aṣṭābhir vihitam iha yoga dvayam api || tato mikter adhvā guṇapuruṣabhedaḥ sphuṭataro viviktaṃ kaivalyaṃ parigalitatāpā citir asau || || ❁ || || (fol. 119r1–5) «Colophon:» iti śrīvācaspatimiśraviracitāyāṃ pātañjalabhāṣyavyākhyāyāṃ kaivalyapādaś caturthaḥ samāpta iti || || śubhaṃ bhavatu || || ❁ || || śubhamastu || |||| śubhaṃ bhavatu || || kalyāṇam astu || || (fol. 119r5–6)

«Beginning:»' oṃ siddhi śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha vairāṭapurāṇa pravakṣyāmi || piṃḍabrahmāṃḍa viseṣitaṃ pañca tattva pacīsa prakṛti triśunyaḥ paṃca devatā || triyaguṇaḥ triyo devatā || saptapātāla caturddaśa bhuvanaḥ || sapta brahmāṇḍa ekaviṃśa svarga || ekavīṃśa brahmāṃḍaḥ || nava kulī nāga aṣṭa parvataḥ navalāṣa tārāmaṇḍala + madhye candrasūrya devatā || aṭhāraha bhāra vanaspati || navaṣaḍasaptadīpāvatī prathimi saptasāgaraḥ nava saina vāsī nadī || sāta vāraḥ satāvīsa nakṣatra (fol. 1v1–6) «End:» sukṣama āhāraṃ alpanidrā samasarīca sādhanaṃ || ṣaḍamāsāntareṣu ṣaḍacakrakaṃ || vāśīramati urdhvamaṇḍaleḥ suṣamanā mārgeṣu bhave pavanaṃ ṣaḍamuṣa asteṣu prāptaṃ || tatra paścāt caḍhata pavanaṃ meruparvataṃ ca garjite || aikavīsa purīmadhye svāsaṃ gagana maṇḍalaṃ ca prāptaṃ || paramasunyaṃ ramite yogī parabrahma yatra gatālayaṃ || dhyāna samādhimayaṃ yogī satyaṃ satyaṃ ca pārvvatī || aneka yugagatās tatraḥ syaṃ bhūdhyanaṃ ca +ścalaṃ || śuṇo devi pārvatī || iśvaro kathaṃta mahājñānaṃ || (fol. 23r2–23v2) «Colophon:» iti śīmahādevapārvatīsaṃvāde vairāṭapurāṇe yogaśāstre ṣaṣṭamo paṭala || 6 || itī śrīkūmārīpāvī racitaṃ paṭhate hartte pāpaṃ śutvā mokṣi dāyakaṃ yogāraṃbhaṃ bhave siddhaṃ āvāgavananṛvarttate || aṭhasatīrtha bhave punyaṃ gaṃgāsnānaṃ dine dine || svāsā ko pramān || vaiṭhe aṃgula 12 bolate aṃgula 14 mathanu karate aṃgula 48 calate aṃgula 64 sovate aṃgula 100 || iti svāsā ko pramāṇa || mayā sudhaṃ asudhaṃ vā mama doṣo na dīyate iti vairāṭapurāṇe saṃpurṇaṃ śvabha mastu || ❁ || (fol. 23v223r3)

«Beginning:»' śrīgaṇeāya namaḥ || śrīnāthāya namaḥ || pārvaty uvāca || nātha nātha kṛpāsindho śrotum icchāmi saṃhitā | bhosaṃhitā mahābhāga gorakṣasya māhātmanaḥ || 1 || kathaṃ gurupadaṃ taya kathaṃ gorakṣanāmataḥ | kasya putra(!) bhaved yogī karṇaccheda(!) kathaṃ bhavet || 2 || kiṃ deva ka śiṣyan te (!) mamānugraha kurvate (!) || brūhi bho likanāthaṃ te jānīhi (!) taṃ mahātmanaṃ || 3 || śrīmahādeva uvāca || oṃ asya śrīgirakṣanāthotpattikalpadrumasaṃhitāyā mahāmūlamantrasya śrīmahākālaṛṣi sārdūlachhandaḥ śrīgorakṣanātha devatā nādabījaṃ daṇḍaśaktiḥ kūmakaṃkolakīlakaṃ manepsitakāmanā siddhyarthe caturvidhapuruṣārthasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) «End:» sahasranāma paramaṃ stotraṃ sahasraguṇasaṃyutam || sahasrajñānasaṃyuktaṃ sahasrasiddhisaṃyutam || 223 || sahasravidyāsaṃyuktaṃ sahasratuṇḍaleśvari || ciṃtāmaṇi bhaved bhaktajanā ānanda kāritā || 224 || (!) gorakṣatulyo bhavati nānā mamtraprakāśakaḥ || nityaṃ trikāle paṭhati trir āvṛtti maheśvari || 225 || candrasūryasya parveṣu sparśamokṣānta paṭhyataḥ || gatasaṃkhyā kṛtā vipraṃ bhojanaṃ sādhakair dade || 226 ||(!) iti gorakṣanāthasya aṅgapūrita bho pṛye(!) || śrīgorakṣa prasanno stu asmākaṃ dṛśyata tribhiḥ || 227 || paścāt siddhiṃ dadātithya bhuvaneśī prasannatā || || (fol. 23v4–8) «Colophon(s):» iti kalpadrumavivekinyāṃ yogābhyāse haragaurīsaṇvāde śrīgorakṣotpattidharmapariāmo nāma gorakṣaguṭikāyāṃ prathamas taraṅgaḥ || || (fol. 2v3–4) iti kalpadrumavivekinyāṃ yogābhyāse haragaurīsaṇvāde śrīgorakṣadvādaśanāmastotraṃ gorakṣaguṭikāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || 2 || (fol. 3r1–2) iti kalpadrumavivekinyāṃ yogābhyāse haragaurīsaṇvāde gorakṣanāthakavacaṃ nāma guṭikāyaṃ tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || 23 || (fol. 4v1–2) iti kalpadrumavivekinyāṃ yogābhyāse haragaurīsaṇvāde gorakṣaguṭikāyāṃ śrīgorakṣanāthahṛdayaṃ nāma caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ || 4 || (fol. 8r1–2) iti kalpadrumavivekinyāṃ yogābhyāse haragaurīsaṇvāde pūjāvyākhyāne gorakṣaguṭikāyāṃ śrīgurugorakṣanāthakīlakoddhāraṇaṃ nāma paṃcamas taraṅgaḥ || 5 || (12r5–7) iti kalpadrumavivekinyāṃ yogābhyāse haragaurīsaṇvāde gora(kṣa)guṭikāyāṃ śrīgorakṣanāthaguṭikāyāṃ śrīgorakṣanāthapaṃcaratnastavarājaṃ nāmastotraṃ ṣaṣṭhas taraṅgaḥ || 6 || || (fol. 13r2–3) iti kalpadrumavivekinyāṃ yogābhyāse haragaurīsaṇvāde gorakṣaguṭikāyāṃ rakṣāṣṭakastotraṃ saptamas taraṅgaḥ || 7 || (fol. 13v2–3) iti kalpadrumavivekinyāṃ yogābhyāse haragaurīsaṇvāde gorakṣaguṭikāyāṃ paṃcāṅgapūraṇārthaṃ śrīgorakṣanātha aṣṭottaraśatanāmastotram aṣṭamas taraṅgaḥ || 8 || || (fol. 14v6–7) iti kalpadrumavivekinyāṃ yogābhyāse haragaurīsaṇvāde gorakṣaguṭikāyāṃ śrīgorakṣanāthasahasranāmastotraṃ nāma navamas taraṅgaḥ || 9 || (fol. 23v8–9)

«Beginning:»' śrīgaṇeśāye(!) namaḥ || nivṛtti(!)tarṣair upagīyamānād bhavaiṣadhācchrotramanobhirāmāt || ka uttamaślokaguṇānuvādāt pumān virajyaita vinā paśughnāt || 1 || sūta uvāca || praṇamya daṇḍavad bhūmau stutvā cārucaritrakam || arcitaṃ ca tataḥ sarveḥ puna praśnaṃ karoti ca || 2 || catur yohas tvayā khyātaḥ kaṣṭāt kaṣṭataraṃ mahat || kadācit prāpyate mṛtyuḥ punarjanma bhaved dhruvam 3 nānā yonigataḥ paścād uttametara janmani || naro nārāyaṇo bhūtvā kaivalyaṃ brahmaśāśvatam 4 (fol. 1v1–6) «End:» sūta uvāca || ṛṣisiddhagaṇāḥ sarve sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇamaṃ(!) stute kṛtārtho haṃ kṛtārtho ham ahaṃbhāvavivarjitaḥ || 33 || tvatprasādena prāptavyaṃ sākṣātkārātmarūpakam || darśitaṃ tava netreṣu anirvāco bhavāmyaham || 34 || muhur muhur mukhe stotraṃ harṣeṇa gadagadaḥ svaram || sa muktaḥ sarva likyeṣu(!) brahmasāyujyam āpnuyāt || 35 || rājarājeśvaraṃ yogaṃ śeṣamārgaṃ praśasyate || yeḥ(!) paṭhet bhaktiyuktena sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ || 36 || 236 || (fol. 19v6–20r4) «Colophon:» iti śrīpadmapurāṇe sioddhāṃtasāre kapila ṛṣi siddhasaṃvāde rājarājeśvarayogaka kathanaṃ paṃcamo dhyāyaḥ || 5 || rāma || rāma || rāma || rāma || rāma || rāma || rāma || rāma || na jñānaṃ bhakṣate māṃsaṃ paradārāgamanaṃ bhavet na jñānaṃ corakarmaṃ ca madyapānaṃ tathaiva ca || 1 || (fol. 20r4–7)

«Beginning:»' oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāya || śrī ādināthāya namo stu tasmai yenopadiṣṭā haṭhayogavidyā || virājate pronnatarājasaudham āroḍhum iccho adhirohinīva || 1 || praṇamya śrīguruṃ nāthaṃ svātmārāmeṇa dhīmatā || kevalaṃ rājayogāya haṭhavidyopdiśyate || 2 || bhrāntyā bahumatadhvāṃte rāgayogam ajānatāṃ || haṭhapradīpikāṃ dhatte svātmārāmaḥ kṛpākaraḥ || 3 || haṭhavidyāṃ hi matsyeṃdra gporakṣādyā vijānate || ātmārāmo thavā yogī jānīte tatprasādataḥ || 4 (fol. 1v1–7) «End:» praveśo norgame vāme dakṣiṇo cordhvam,adhyagaḥ || na yasya vāyur vahati sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ || sarva layahaṭhābhyāsā rājayogasya siddhaye rājayogasamārūḍaḥ puruṣaḥ kālavaṃcakaḥ || iti tu sakalayoga(sāra)śāstrārthasiṃdhoḥ parimathitād avakṛṣṭa sārabhūtaṃ || anubhavatu haṭha(!)mṛtaṃyamīṃdrā yadi bhavatā madgurāmarāmaratvavāṃcha(!) || || (fol. 38r1–5) «Colophon:» iti śrī ātmārāmamunīṃdraviracitāyāṃ haṭhayogapradīpikāyāṃ caturthopadeśaḥ iti śrījñānahaṭhapradīpikā jogamārgenaḥ (!) samāptaḥ (fol. 38r5–7)

«Beginning:»' || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ || yastyaktvā rūpam ādyaṃ prabhavati jagati nekadhānugrahāya prakṣīṇakleśarāśir viṣamaviṣadharo nekavaktraḥ subhogī || sarvajñānaprasūtir bhujagaparikaraḥ prītaye yasya nityaṃ devo hi saḥ sa vo vyāt śitavinmalatanur yogado yogayuktaḥ || 1 || atha yogānuśāsanaṃ || athetyayam adhaikārārthaḥ | yogasyānuśāsanam śāstram adikṛtaṃ veditavyam | yogaḥ samādhiḥ | sa ca sārvabhaumaḥ cittasya dharmaḥ || kṣiptaṃ mūḍhaṃ vikṣiptam ekāgram niruddham iti cittabhūmayaḥ | tatra vikṣipte cetasi vikṣepopasarjanībhūtaḥ samādhir na yogapakṣe varttate || (fol. 1v1–6) «End:» guṇādhikārakramaparisamāptau kaivalyam uktaṃ tatsvarūpam avadhāryate || puruṣārthaśūnyānāṃ guṇānāṃ pratiprasavaḥ kaivalyaṃ svarūpapratiṣtḥo vā citiśaktir iti || || kṛṭtabhogāpavargāṇāṃ puruṣārthaśūnyānāṃ yaḥ pratiprasavaḥ kāryakāraṇātmanāṃ guṇānāṃ tatkaivalyaṃ svarūpapratiṣṭhā punar buddhisatvān abhisaṃbandhāt puruṣasya citiśaktir iti citiśaktir eva ke(va)lā tasyāḥ sadā tathaivāvasthānaṃ kaivalyam iti || 33 || (fol. 63r1–11) «Colophon:» iti śrīmat pātañjalayogaśāstre sāṃkhyapravacane vedavyāsabhāsye kaivalyapādaś caturthaḥ śubham astu || kāśipurāyāṃ yogabhāṣya likhita (m ayam ) svapaṭhanārthaṃ sapūrṇa(!) (fol. 63r11–12)

«Beginning:»' || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrī ādināthāya namos tu tasmai yenop[adiṣṭā haṭhayogavidyā || virājate śaittatarājayogam āroḍhum iccho adhirohiṇīva || 1 || praṇamya śrīguruṃ nāthaṃ svātmārāmeṇa yoginā || kevalaṃ rojayogāya haṭhayogopadiśyate || 2 || bhrāntyābahumatadhvānte rājayogam ajānatāṃ || haṭhapradīpikāṃ dhatte svātmārāmaḥ kṣamākaraḥ || 3 || haṭhavidyāṃ hi matsyendra gorakṣādyā vijānate || svātmārāmo thavā yogī jānīte tatprasādataḥ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End:» pravese nirgame vāme dakṣiṇe cordhvamadhyataḥ || na yasya vāyur vahati sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ || 89 || citta na suptaṃ nā jāgraṃ smṛtivarṇaṃ ca nyānyathā (!) || nāstameti na codeti yascāsau mukta eva saḥ || 90 || svaṣvojāgrad avasthāyāṃ suptaḥ sadyovatiṣṭhati || niḥsvāsochāsa(!)hīnastu niścitta mukta yeva saḥ (!) || 91 || dṛṣṭisthirā yasya vinaiva dṛśyaṃ vāyu sthiro yasya vinā prayatnāt || cittaṃ sthiraṃ yasya vināvalaṃbaṃ sa eva yogī sa guruḥ sa sevyaḥ || 92 || vidyātīrthe jagati bibudhāḥ sādhavaḥ satyatīrthe gaṃgātīrthe malinamanaso yogino jñānatīrthe || dhārātīrthe dharaṇipatayo dānatīrthe dhanasthāḥ || lajjātīrthe klayuvatayo (!) pātakaṃ kṣālayaṃti || 93 || (fol. 22v8–23r2) «Colophon:» iti śrīsahajanāthacel;akena śrīsvātmārāmayogīviracite haṭhadīpikāyāṃ sidhāntamuktāvalyāṃ aturthopadeśaḥ śubham astu || prāṇakuṇḍalī yogagraṃtha || … iti śrīmiśrīnāthasūtradhāre matamahāpurāṇe siddhanamiśrīmāṇa kuṃḍalīyogaśāstrasmā śiva || 14 || śrīśivāya namaḥ || (fol. 23r2–23v9)

«Beginning:»' śrīsaccidānandamūrttaye namaḥ || vāmadeva uvāca || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ vāmadevaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ || jīvanmuktipadopāyaṃ kathayasveti pṛcchati || 1 || īśvara uvāca || paraṃ jñānam ahaṃ vacmi yena tattvaṃ prakāśate || yena saṃchidyate sarvam āśāpāśādibandhanaṃ || 2 || ādhārādiṣu cakreṣu suṣūmṇādiṣu(!) nāḍiṣu prāṇādiṣu samīresu paratattvaṃ na tiṣṭhati || 3 || tatra yogaratāḥ kecit keciddhyānavimohtāḥ || japena kecit kliśyanti naivajānāti tārakaṃ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End:» amanaskaṃ sthiraṃ susthaṃ śiṣyasaṃkramyendriyajaṃ sukhaṃ(!) | nivārayaṃti te vaṃdyā guravo nye pratārakāḥ || guruṇā darśite tattve darśanāt tanmayo bhavet | vimuktaṃ manyam ātmānaṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 48 || yathā siddharasasparśāt tāmraṃ bhavati kāṃcanaṃ | gurūpadeśaśravaṇā (!) śiṣyas tattvamayo bhavet | tasmād upāsito samyak(!) sahajaṃ prāpyate guroḥ | anāyāsena satatam ātmābhyāsarato bhavet || 50 || vi(vi)kte vijane deśe pravitretimanohare | samāsane sukhāsīnaḥ paścāt kiṃcit samāśritaḥ | (fol. 9r5–11) «Colophon:» x

«Beginning» svasti śrīśivagurugaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha haṭhapradī(pi)kā prāraṃbhaḥ || śrī ādināthā(ya) namo stu tasmai yenopadiṣṭā haṭhayogavidyā || virājate pronnatarājayogam āroḍhum icchor adhirohiṇīva || (++) praṇamya śrīguruṃ nāthaṃ svātmārāmeṇa yoginā kevalaṃ rājayogāya haṭhayogaḥ pradṛśyate (!) || 2|| bhrāntyā bahumatadhvānmte rājayogam ajāmatām || haṭhapradīpikāṃ dhatte svātmārāmaḥ kṣamākaraḥ || 3 || hathavidyāṃ hi matsyendragorakṣādyā vijānate || svātmārāmo thavā yogī jānīte tatprasādataḥ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End» svastho jāgrad avasthāyāṃ suptaḥ sadyo vataiṣṭhate || nisvāsocchvāsataś caiva niścalaṃ mukta eva saḥ || 25 || sarve haṭhalayopāyā rājayogasya siddhaye || rājayogaṃ samārūḍhaḥ puruṣaḥ kālavaṃcakaḥ || 26 || vidyātīrthe jagati vibudhāḥ sādhavaḥ satyatīrthe gaṃgātīrthe malinamanaso yogino jñānatīrthe || dhārātīrthe dharaṇipatayo dānatīrthe dhanādyāḥ lajjātīrthe kulayuvatayaḥ pātakaṃ kṣālayaṃti || 27 || iti sakalayogaśāstrasiṃdhoḥ parimathitādavakṛṣṭasārabhūtaṃ || anubhavata haṭhāmṛtaṃ tamīśa yadi bhavatām ajarāmaratve vāṃchā || ye yogīṃjñe jota manekājaratva amaratvapaṇānī vāṃchā (!) || 129 || (fol. 20v9–21r4) «Colophon» iti śrīsadgurusvātmārāmayogīṃdraviracitāyāṃ haṭhapradīpikā(yāṃ) samādhilakṣaṇaṃ nāma caturtha upadeśaḥ samāptam(!) || || samvat 1920 sāla miti māgha śudi 6 budhavāsare sarasvatītaṭe bālakhilyesvarapriyatāṃ gaḍhī me śrīmahantapadmapurike haveli me lekhyā he likhitaṃ brahmānandabrahmacāri nepāli sva ātmapaṭhanārthaṃ śubham || ❁ || saṃkhyā śloka 418 liṃgamadhye smarecchakti śaktimadhye sadāśivaṃ || śivaśaktimayaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṃgamaṃ || (fol. 21r4–8)

«Beginning:»' tvā sarvacintāvivarjjitaḥ || gurūpadiṣṭamārgeṇa yogam evaṃ samabhyaset || 15 || atyāhāraprayāsaś ca prajalpo niyamāgrahaḥ || janasaṃgaś ca laulyañ ca ṣaḍbhir yogo vinaśyati || 16 || utsāhān niścayād dhairyāt tattvajñānasya darśanāt | janasaṃgaparityāgāt ṣaḍbhir yogas tu siddhyati || 17 || haṭhasya prathamāṃgatvād āsanaṃ pūrvam ucyate || kuryāt tadāsanaṃ tasmāt ārogyaṃ cāṃgapāṭavaṃ || 18 || (fol. 3r1–5) «End:» avadhyaḥ sarvaśastrāṇāṃ avadhyas sarvadehināṃ || agrāhyo mantrayantrāṇāṃ yogīyuktasamādinā || 105 || praveśe nirgame caiva dakṣiṇe cārdhamadhyataḥ || na yasya vāyur vahati sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ || 106 || cittaṃ na suptaṃ no jāgrat smṛtivastu na cānyathā || nāstameti na codeti yathāsa mukta eva sa ḥ || 107 || dṛṣṭi (fol. 44v2–6) «Colophon(s):» x

«Beginning:»' oṃ namaḥ śrī gurubhyo namaḥ śrījānakīrāmāya namaḥ śrīguruṃ paramānandaṃ vande ānandavigrahaṃ || yasya sāṃnidhyamātreṇa cidānandāyate tanuḥ || 1 || antarniścalitmadīpakalikā svādhārabaṃdhādibhir yo yogī yugakalpakālakalanā tattvaṃ yo gīyate || jñānāmodamahodadhisamabhavad yatrādināthaḥ svayaṃ || vyāktāvyaktaguṇādhikatvam aniśaṃ śrīmīnanāthaṃ bhaje || 2 || namaskṛtya guruṃ bhaktyā gorakṣo jñā(na)m uttamam || abhīṣṭaṃ yogīnāṃ vrūte paramānandakārakam || 3 śrīgorakṣaśataṃ vakti yogiṇāṃ hitakāmyayā || dhruvaṃ yasyāvabodhena jāyate paramaṃ padaṃ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–6) «End:» iti gorakṣaśatakaṃ yogaśāstraṃ janaḥ paṭhet sarvapāpavinirmukto yogasidhyaṃ (!) labhet dhruvaṃ 100 yogaśāstraṃ paṭhen nityaṃ kim anyaiḥ śāstravistaraiḥ || yat svayaṃ cādināthasya nirgataṃ vadanāṃbujāt 1 snātaṃ tena samastatīrthasalile dattā ca pṛthvī dvije | yajñās tenāṃ(!) ca bahutaṃ (!) sahasram ayutaṃ devāś ca santarpitāḥ || satyaṃ tena sutarpitāś ca pitaraḥ svargaṃ gatā ye punaḥ || yeṣāṃ brahmavicāraṇe kṣaṇam api prāpnoti dhairyaṃ manaḥ || (fol. 16v6–17r3) «Colophon(s):» iti śrīgorakṣaśatakaṃ saṃpūrṇam śrīrāmānujāya namaḥ vārṣaki muṇi jāti śubhaṃ || || rāma || kṛṣṇa || || ātmā jāyate putra iti śrute || || iti śrīgorakṣaśatakaṃ jogaśāstre saṃpūrṇa śubhaṃ bhavatūmān || (fol. 17r3–5)

«Beginning:»' oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ || aṃhaḥ saṃharad akhilaṃ sakṛd udayād eva sakalalokasya || taraṇir iva timirajaladhiṃ jayati jaganmaṅgalaṃ harer nāmaḥ || 1 || kāruṇyāmṛtanirjharaḥ surasarij janmākaraḥ śrīvadhū- nīlābjaṃ vrajakāminīkucataṭī kastūrikāsthāpakaḥ || uttaṃsaḥ surayoṣitāṃ munumano ramyauṣadhīpallavo yasyāṃghrisuravallabhaḥ sa jayati śrīpuṇḍarīkapriyaḥ || kararuhakuliśair dviṣatāṃ caraṇāṃbujaṃ nakharakāntibhi bhajatāṃ hṛdayagranthīn bhindan manasi nṛsiṃhaḥ samullasati (fol. 1v1–4) «End:» || api ca || svapādapaṅkeruhaśīkarasya nimajya māhātmyamahārṇave yaḥ || dadhau punas taṃ svayam eva maulau sa no gurus tat kuladaivatan naḥ || yadaṃghrinakhamaṇḍalād vigalitasya pūrvvaṃ punar yadīyakavarībhavārṇavam upeyuṣaḥ pāthasaḥ | aśeṣajagadaṃ hasāṃ kim api nāma nirsojanaṃ (!) padāmṛtamahāmbudheḥ kimuta nāma tasyaiva naḥ || nādhāya kiṃcid apanīya na kiṃcid atra svātmaiva yena sukhasindhur gādharodhaḥ | āviskṛtā karuṇayā karavai kimasya tan nāmni magnam idam eva mano stu pūjā || jhagiti jagatāmaṃha(!) sthalīn dahan dahano mahān daha ca dhvānta dhvāntadhvaṃsaṃ nayan nabhaso maṇiḥ | kiraṇalaharī cāndrī cetaḥ cakoracamatkṛtir bhavatu bhavatāṃ nāma jyotir mude madana ihaḥ || || (fol. 29v8–29r1) «Colophon(s):» iti śrīmad anantānanda raghunāthaparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryyapādapadmopajīvinaḥ śrīmannṛsiṃhasūnoḥ śrīlakṣmīdharasya kṛtau śrībhagavannāmakaumudyāṃ nāmasaṃkīrttanasyaiva puruṣārthatvapratipādakanāma tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ samāptaḥ || 3 || (fol. 29r1–3)

«Beginning» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrī gurave || tataḥ śrīsiddilakṣmīkramathaṇḍilārccanaṃ || marjjātārthe vasape || thaṇḍilihṅa vane hnasakanatayāva cchāyāsanāna yāya || tritattvanācamanaṃ || khphreṁ hrāṁ ātmatattvāya svāhā || khphreṁ hrīṁ vidyātattvāya svāhā || khphreṁ hrūṁ śivatattvāya svāhā || thaṇḍilisa gurunamaskāra || aiṁ 5 akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākālaṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaraṃ || tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–6) «End:» yajamānasya mānavagotra śṛīśrījayabhūpatīndramallavarmmaṇaḥ śrīśrīśrīsveṣṭadevatāprītyarthaṃ yathāprāsādapratiṣṭhā tadupari suvarṇakalaśa dhvajāvarohaṇa yogyaadhivāsanakarmaṇi thaṇḍilārcana nimityārthena yajamānasya sagaṇas parivārāṇāṃ āyur āyugyam aiśvarya janadhanalakṣmī santatisantānabṛddhir astu yathāśāstroktaphalabaladāyano bhavantu || || (!) anyatra śaraṇaṃ nāstu tvameva śaraṇam mama || tasmāt kāruṇyabhāvena rakṣa rakṣa parameśvari || ||(!) atra gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpayajñopavītaarcane pūjā vidhānaṃ tatsarvaṃ paripūrṇam astu || || tarppaṇa || prītapretāsanasthā bhavabhayaharaṇo bhairavo manmtramūrttiś caṇḍīcaṇḍāsanasthā gaṇaguruvaṭukā lokapālāḥ phaṇīndrāḥ | rakṣā yakṣāsutīrtho pitṛgaṇa sakalāḥ mātaraḥ kṣetrapālāḥ || yoginyo yogayuktāḥ jalacalakhacalāḥ pānam etat pibantu || pibantu devatāḥ sarveḥ sarudrāḥ sagaṇādhipāḥ || yoginyaḥ kṣetrapālāś ca mama dehe vyavasthitāḥ || vākya || namaḥ śrīnāthāya || namaḥ śrīsiddhināthāya || namaḥ śrīkujeśanāthāya namo namaḥ || || (fol. 268v4–269v7) «Colophon» iti śrīthaṇḍilārccanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 269v7)

«Beginning» ❖ mūlācārya arghapātra joṅā va devāgrasa vane || 1 ❖ atha śodhanavidhiḥ || devaṃ gajuli thajuli || tritattvenācamya 3 || hmapaṃ thamani nyāsa yāya || oṃ haṃ namaḥ dīptodīptaprabha astrāya phaṭ || 4 || kalaśodhanaṃ || oṃ hrāṃ namaḥ haṃsaḥ suviśado aṃguṣṭhāya 2 || oṃ hrīṁ namaḥ parabrahmaṇe tarjjanyai 2 || oṃ hūṁ namaḥ pradyutani madhyamāya 2 || oṁ haṁ namaḥ śāśvaddhiraṇya anāmikāya 2 || oṃ hāṁ namaḥ prakāśaprajvara kaniṣṭhāya 2 || oṁ haṁ namaḥ dīptodīptakaratapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ 2 || iti karanyāsaḥ || (exp. 3A1–3B5) «End:» iti tatpuruṣakalā || oṀ hrīṁ saḥ manase 2 || mūrddhni ūrdhve || 3 mohāya 2 || hṛdaye || 3 kṣamāyai 2 || grīvāyāṃ || 3 niṣṭhāyai || śrotre || 3 vyādhaye 2 || nābhi || 3 mṛtyave 2 || jaṭhare || 3 kṣudhāyai 2 || pṛṣṭhe || 3 tṛṣṇāyai || ūru || iti agholakalā || oṃ hrīṁ saḥ rajase 2 || guḍe || 3 raktāyai 2 ||liṃge || 3 rattaye 2 || dakṣiṇoru || 3 pālyai || vāmorū || 3 kāmāyai 2 || dakṣiṇa jānau || 3 sāmanyai 2 || vāmajānau || 3 kriyāyai 2 || dakṣiṇa jaṃghe || 3 bṛdhāyai 2 || vāma jaṃghe || 3 carmmāyai 2 || dakṣiṇa phīcce || 3 rātryai 2 || vāma phicce || 3 bhrāmaryai 2 || kaṭyāṃ || 3 mohanyai 2 || dakṣiṇa pārśve || 3 jvālāyai 2 || vāma pārśve || 13 || iti vāmadevakalā || oṁ hrīṁ saḥ siddhāyai 2 || dakṣi(ṇa) pāqśrve || 3 ṛddhā (exp. 28A8–28B 19) «Colophon» ?x

«Beginning» vāmapārśve oṃ hrīṃ ajñānāya namaḥ || nābhau oṁ hrīṁ avairāgyāya namaḥ || dakṣāpārśve oṃ hrīṁ anaiśvaryāya namaḥ || punar hṛdi || oṃ hrṁ ānandakandāya namaḥ || oṁ hrīṁ padmāya namaḥ || oṁ hrauṁ saṃvintālāpa(!) namaḥ || oṁ hrṁ prakṛtimayapatrebhyo namaḥ || oṁ hrīṁ vikāramaya kesarebhyo namaḥ || oṁ hrīṁ tattvarūpakarṇikāyai namaḥ || oṁ hrīṁ anantāya namaḥ || oṁ aṃ arkamaṇḍalāya dvādaśakalātmane namaḥ || oṁ somamaṇḍalāya 2 ṣoḍaśakalātmane namaḥ || (fol. 3r1–5) «End:» oṁ tat sat || ityātmasamarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā āvaravatā devyaṅge vilāpyya saṃhāramudrayā oṁ uttare śikhare jāte saumye parvatavāsini || brahmayonisamutpanne gacchadevi mamāntaraṃ || śrīmaddakṣiṇakālike kṣamasveti puṣpeṇa saha tatejo nāsayā svahṛdayam ānīya aiśānyāṃ trikoṇamaṇ ḍalaṃ kṛtvā tatra oṁ ucchiṣṭacāṇḍālinyai namaḥ || iti nirmālyena saṃpūjya tannaivedyaṃ ca kiṃcid dattvā kiṃcit svīkṛtya pādodakaṃ pītvā naivedyaṃ sādhakāya dattvā yathāsukhaṃ vihared (fol. 14v3–7) «Colophon» iti śyāmāpūjāpaddhatiḥ samāpta(!) || (fol. 14v7)

«Beginning» ❖ śṛīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha śrīkalaśasthāpanaṃ || svadakṣabhāge bhūmau śaṃkhavāriṇā astrena sprokṣa tad upari trikoṇāṣṭadalacaturasraṃ saṃlikhya || phreṃṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ hlīṁ kalaśādhāraśaktikamalāsanaśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi hūṁ namaḥ svāhā || ityādhāraṃ pūjya || ▒ tripādikāṃ sthāpayāmi namaḥ || iti astrakṣālitatripādikāṃ sthāpya || (exp. 3t1–3b2) «End:» iti triḥ saṃtarpya || 1 hasoṃ 6 śrīguhyabhairavaṃ tarpayāmi namaḥ || iti triḥ || 1 bphreṁ hasṁ 6 śrīguhyabhairavaśrīguhyakālīn tarpayāmi namaḥ || iti sakṛt || oṁ iti svasirasi sakṛt || punaḥ padmakalaśadvayadhenuliṁgayonimudrāṃ padarśya || bphreṁ kavacāya hūṁ miti kavacenācchādya || bphraḥ astrāya phaṭ iti astreṇa saṃrakṣa || puna śrīkalaśasthāmṛtavinduṃ bphreṃ iti pātre nikṣipya || pūjānte astramantre(ṇa) saṃhāramudrayā visarjayed (exp. 11b2–12:5) «Colophon» iti srīpātrasthāpanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || śrī2 bhūpālendramallasya manorathasiddhir bhavatu || (exp. 12:5–6)

«Beginning» … sūryārgha || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotra yajamānyā śrī2viśvalakṣmī devyā śrī2 brahmāyaṇīdevī jīrṇoddhāra prāsādopari suvarṇakalaśadhvajāvarohaṇa bhaioravāgnisahasrāhuti yajñe ṛtvantare bhasmanadīpravāha bhogabalyārccana pūjā nimityarthaṃ karttuṃ kuramārttaṇḍabhairavāya arghyaṃ namaḥ puṣpaṃ namaḥ || varṇnāntaṃ bījam uddhṛtya tasyopari śivaṃ nyaset | ādimadhyāvasāne tu agnitraya vibhūṣitaṃ || (exp. 74t7–74b6) «End:» adyādi || oṁ hrāṁ mayā pūjā vasūsthāpya nandādyāḥ pañcadevatā || suprītamanasā yānti mayā adya visarjayet || pūjitaṃ caṇḍanirmālyaṃ bhakṣitaṃ calitaṃ tvayā | caṇḍeśvarāya devāya suprīta sumano bhava || || astreṇa vāhayet baliṃ || hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || || snānādi yāya || || (exp. 3:1–4) «Colophon» thvatī bhasmanadī pavāha vidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || śubha || (exp. 3:5)

«Beginning» ❖ atha śrīpātrasthāpanaṃ | asya śrīkapāleśvarīpūjāmantrasya surābhāṇḍeśvaraṛṣiḥ | virāṭ chandaḥ madhumattamahāśmaśānakapāleśvarī devatā oṃ bījaṃ hrīṁ śaktiḥ hūṁ kīlakaṃ || śrīśmaśānakapāleśvarīprasādasiddhyarthe viniyogaḥ | oṁ hrīṁ hūṁ mahākapā(le)śvari aṃºº | jvala 2 mahāmāye taºº || prajvala 2 mahāśmaśānavāsinī maºº || mahāmadyaṃ piba 2 duṣṭān kaṃpaya 2 aºº || dhama 2 mahājvālājihve ka ºº || vahnijvālāmālājvalitadraṃṣṭrākarālabhīṣaṇi hūṁ phaṭ svāhā karaºº || evaṃ hṛdayādinyāsaḥ || (exp. 2:1–7) «End:» ▒ ▒ karāli 2 sphreṁ mahākarāli 2 sphreṃ siddhikarāli 2 ▒ mahāsiddhikarāli 2 ▒ mahājvālāsiddhikarāli 2 ▒ jvālāsiddhikarāli 2 ▒ kāli 2 ▒ mahākāli 2 ▒ bhadrakāli 2 ▒ mahācaṇḍapīṭheśvari 2 ▒ siddhiguhyakāli 2 , 1 hṛtpuṇḍarīkamahāpīṭhani || || iti ratnamālāmantraḥ || 1 kālasaṃkarṣini 2 kālarātri 2 ātmajyotiguhyakāli 2 aṃtarātmajyotiguhyakāli 2 paramātmajyotiguhyakāli 2 nirvvāṇaguhyakāli 2 namaḥ svāhā || (svarūpasaptatī ) (exp. 27b3–28t3) «Colophon» ity āha bhagavān mahādevyai mahādevotharvvaṇaśikhāyāṃ śrīpātrasthāpanavidhiḥ || || prasaṅgāllikhitaṃ || || (exp. 4t6–7) iti mahārahasyātirahasyatamamahāyoginīkulārṇṇavavaktranyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ || || (exp. 13b2–4) iti śrīmad uttarāmnāya nirvvāṇasaṃhitāyāṃ upaniṣat pramānībhūtāyāṃ (!) ṣaṭtriṃśat sāhasrikāyāṃ mahādevaproktāyāṃ sārāt sāratarāyāṃ dīkṣāprakaraṇe sveṣṭadevatāyāḥ śrīnirvvāṇaguhyakālyāḥ śrīma + + + + + + + + manthānavaḍavānalabhairavo vaḍavānalabhairavyai kathato sati tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || (exp. 28t3–7)

«Beginning» ❖ brāhmaṇa ācārya josi thvate sanaṃ sthirahārāvavayāva || maṇḍapanapi uttaraya majirasāpūrvva soyaṃ teva || gajulicchā kuhnuyā thva velasa yāya || thvana hṅā ona li dinapatiṃ rajasā rāsa karmmārccana yāya dhunaṅāva yāya || sāṭhacayapāṭhana urttarasa || madhyasa baliccha pātatayā va || pātana ṅūyakāva bali viya || tavarāja || arghapātra || jalapātra || pañcabali || gaṇavaṭuka || thvate patavāsana coyāva jiyake || || laṃkhana hāya || ūkāraṃ vāyubījaṃ tadupati varuṇaṃʼ vajrapāṇiṃ tadūrdhvaṃ || kāla(ṃ) varṇnāntayuktaṃ tadupari paramaṃ vahnibījaṃ sahaṃsaṃ || induṃ binduṃ layāntaṃ sitakamalavaraṃ kṣīradhārāsravantaṃ || dṛṣṭvā kūṭaṃ tu nityaṃ dadhati kulamalaṃ merutulyaṃ hi pāpaṃ || (exp. 4t1–4b2) «End:» ekāneka bhavanti mūrtti jagati pūrṇeśvari vāsave || bhūteśī gagaṇopamā bhagavaniḥrśaśvarī(!) dakṣiṇo (!) jñānāgamya kujeśvarī kulagaṇe vāruṇyadig nāyakā (!) śrīvāmā praṇamāmi viśvajananī darśeśvarī siddhidā || (!) ambe pūrvvagataṃ padaṃ bhagavati caitanyarūpoātmako(!) jñānecchā bahulā tathā hariharau brahmāmarīcitrakam (!) bhāsva(d) bhairavapañcakaṃ tad anu ca śrīyoginīpañcakaṃ || candrārkā ca marīciṣaṭkam amalaṃ māṃ pātu nityaṃ kuja || (!) saṃhāramudrayā balivisarjjanaṃ || balicchoya || pūrvvapāṭa kūparācche || dakṣiṇa dathunāśvara || paścime vacchalā || uttara turahṅerāṣu || dathu dhvākhā yināya gorajā || vaṭuka dumāju dvaṃdudako dukhāpikhā || || (exp. 44b1–45t4) «Colophon» iti śrī3 siddhilakṣmīmate prakāśe jayadrathe vidyāpiṭhe patyaṃgīryā(!) kṣetrābali pīṭhastavaṃ samaptaṃ || (exp. 10b7–11t1) iti mahābali samāptaṃ (exp. 33b7) iti śivaśaktisamarasatvamahāmāyāstotraṃ || || (exp. 41b1–2) thvate sācayana uttarasa tavarājapāṭhabali pūjāvidhi || || śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladeva sana cūkavāsadevapratiṣṭhā siddhāgniayutāhutiyajñayāṅāyā thva saṃphuli || saṃ 825 bhādrapadaśukladaśamī mūla śaniścaravāra kuhnu || śubha || (fol. 42, exp. 45:4–7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsiddhikṣmyai(!) || || vākya || asmat śrīsiddhi(2)lakṣmyārādhana caturddaśīmahāparvvani balyārccaṇani(3)mityarthaṃ, kulamārttaṇḍamahābhairavāya arghan namaḥ || ||(4) atha pañcabalin dadyāt || || oṃ mayūrāsanāya pādu(5)kāṃ || oṃ narāsanāya pādukāṃ || oṃ siṃhāsanāya pā(exp. 4t1)dukāṃ || oṃ śavāsanāya pādukāṃ || oṃ pretāsanāya pā(2dukāṃ || || pūjan baliñ ca || (exp. 3b1-4t2) End stotra || oṃ gaurjyāputraṃ kumāraṃ gaganatanabhi(2)taṃ sevitaṃ yogibhiṇ ca, cāmuṇḍācaṇḍamuṇḍādviritapa(3)timukhaṃ vighnahārī gaṇeśaṃ | puṣpādyā dhūpadīpāsava(4)madhubalibhiś carccitā bhūṣitāṃgī, cakreśaṃ pūjyakā(5)nāṃ vinihatu sakalaṃ bhuktimuktipradātā || || (exp. 8t1) pañcabalyārcanavidhe tat sarvvaṃ paripūrnnam astu || || (exp. 7b1-8t1) Colophon iti pañcabalividhis samāptaṃ || || (exp. 8t2)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo nāṭeśvarāya || nṛtyārambhayā vidhānaparipāthi || nakasa nāṭeśvarapūjā yāya || naṭeśva(2)rapūjana juko || guru namaskārādi || nyāsaḥ || aiṃ 5 oṃ hūṃ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || karasodhanaṃ || aiṃ (3) 5 oṃ hrāṃ kaniṣṭakāya namaḥ || oṃ hrīṃ anāmikāya namaḥ || oṃ hrūṃ madhyamāya namaḥ || oṃ hreṃ ta(4)rjjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || oṃ hroṃ aṃguṣṭhāya namaḥ || oṃ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || iti kalaṃ nyāsaḥ || || (fol. 1v1-4) «Extracts:» iti nāṭe(fol. 6v8)śvarastuti || || i(fol. 7v8)ti pali goya vidhiḥ || || iti dīgapūjā vidhi || || (fol. 10r1) thvate ghāgharaṇa cecakeyā vidhāna || || (fol. 14r5) End divyābaraparīdhānaiḥ sarvvābharanabhūṣitai | tad agre ca pranṛtī caḥ bhṛṃgīkārrya su(5)sobhi sā || pūnaḥ prāṅyadhyatote ca, dīptāṃgā saumyabhupikā | vikṛtātīṣyanāsā ca, cūrājyā(6)dipradā kramāt || yathākasya bhaved rupā, cādimadhyātasaṃsthitā || harā caiva bhaved yuyā, sthāne(7)sthāne phalapradā || || totra || tripuraṃ matha rudraṃś candragaṅgāhimauliḥ pramuditaśita bhupo nṛ(8)tyahaste susobhaṃ | patiracimiriyāyāḥ pātu vā kāmarājo, navarasarasabhāvo naumi tasmai (9) suresaḥ || || ṣubha || || śrīśrīśrīnāṭeśvara prītir astu || (fol. 37v4-9) Colophon (fol. )

Beginning tya iti prasiddhaṃ, skaṃdaśvarārigaṇakānanadhūmaketuṃ | gaurīsutaṃ śaktim ujvalitā (2) dadhānā, pāyātsa raktavasamā śikhivāhano vaḥ || sindūra sāndra madamūrcchita raktaku(3)mbhā nirjjiṭya nāghana payodhara dehalakṣmīḥ || vitratkuthāravaramodaka sākṣi(4)sutraṃ, pāyādvayaṃ gaṇapatiṃ sakalārtha dātā || (exp. 3t1-4) End atha mūla tale vane, liṅgārccaṇayā sakaleṃ, triyāñjali tannemāla(2) kvasaṃ stotra julasaṃ khāṅāva palape māla bāpāsa || atra gandhādi || || batīsīnyāsa yā(3)ṅāva, khalu jopāva duhāvane, mālakvasaṃ triyāñjali chāya || || kvahā vayāva sūryya soya(4)māla || || śrīsūryyāya namaḥ || oṃ dhātābhagavatyai namaḥ || oṃ ākṛṣṇe || || (exp. 14,ll.1-4) Colophon iti śrī(5)nityakarmmavidhis samāptaṃ || || śrīnityakarmmadeva[[tā]] prītir astu sarvvadāḥ || śubham astu || (exp. 14b4-5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || atha pratipadyāṃ prātarnnivartta nityakṛtyāgrahāvaras thi(2)rodaya prāṅmukho vā (pyu)daṅmukho vā, upaviṣṭaḥ yajamāna kuśahaste nācamya, saṃkalpaṃ kuryyāt || (3) oṃ adyetyādi || devīpurānokta, devīpūjāvihita phalaprāptakāmo, kalasthāpanapurvvaka, gandhapuṣpa(4)dhūpadīpanaivadyādibhir bhagavatyāḥ śrīdurggāyāḥ śāradīyapūjām ahaṃ kariṣye, saṃkalpa siddhir astu(5) || (exp. 3b1-5) «Extracts:» iti mahāṣṭamī, sūkṣmapatiḥ samāpta(exp. 15b4)ḥ || || End aṣṭamiyā || luṃtesurasvāna, patāpa, toyu, selā, kasti, myāla, naivedya, bolajā(6) kholopamāḍhe, phala kimase, vrīhi, palakā, dakṣiṇā, hera, dhūpa, setahlāsa || aticaṇḍikāyā || (7) || 8 || || navamīyā || bhoyusvāna, patāpa, nānā, nugola,lā, jhamalase, ti, myāla, naivedya, bhojā, pa(8)kvanna, nānā, dakṣiṇā mūti, vrīhi techo, dhūpa, nānā || ugracaṇḍāyā || 9 || || (exp. 16b5-8) Colophon (fol. )

Beginning ❖ śrīsvesṭadevatāyai namaḥ || || nosiya || aiṃ ātmatatvā(2)ya svāhā || hrīṃ vidyātatvāya svāhā || śrīṃ śivatatvā(3)ya svāhā || || thana gurumaṃḍala salāyisa svāna chā(4)ya || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hsphreṃ hsauṃ akhaṇḍa maṇḍalākālaṃ vyā(5)ptaṃ yena carācaraṃ tat padaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgu(6)rave nama || || āsana svāna taya || padmāsanāya (7) namaḥ || patrāsanāya namaḥ || kurmmāsanāya namaḥ || (exp. 4b1) || 5 (exp. 4t1-b1) End nosi(4)ya 3 || balisa coṅa svāna kokāya || || saṃhāramudrā(5)na salāyiṃ baliṃ thvasyaṃ svāna kokāya || || ⟪lisa⟫ (6) arghāsa coṃ lāṣaṃ arghaṃpātrasa coṃ lāṣaṃ salāyisaṃ ba(7)lisaṃ taya || || lāṣana maṃḍala dayake || nityakarmade(8)vārccana saṃpurṇṇārthaṃ sākṣiṇe arghaṃ namaḥ puṣpaṃ namaḥ (9) akṣataṃ namaḥ || || thvate nitya yāya māla || śubha || (exp. 3b3-9) Colophon (fol. )

Beginning namaḥ || oṃ pheṃ anantamuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ pheṃ brahmamuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ pheṃ sṛṣṭimuṇḍāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ pheṃ saṃhāramuṇḍāsanāya nama(2)ḥ || oṃ pheṃ brahmapretāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ pheṃ viṣṇupretāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ pheṃ rudrapretāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ pheṃ īśvarapretāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ (3) pheṃ sadāśivapretāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ pheṃ mahābhairavāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ pheṃ śrīṃ huṃ phreṃ mahāśivāsanāya namaḥ || thvate pīṭhapūjā || || (fol. 5r1) «Extract:» iti śrīguhyakālyā(fol. 14v8)mahāmāyāstavaṃ samāstaṃ || || iti durvvāsākṛtagu(fol. 15v6)hyakālīpūjāpaddhatiḥ samāptā || || ۞ || || iti śrīnetrajñānārṇṇavapañcamakrame kālikāstavaṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 17v2 ) asya krīḍārtham akhilaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ kaṇḍai kāyate | tāṃ kālagrā(fol. 19v3)sarasikāṃ kālasaṃkarṣaṇīn namaḥ || 2 || || śubha || || iti haṃsatantre ṣoḍhānyāsaḥ samāptaḥ || || ۞ || || (fol. 29r3) iti saṃkṣepanityadevārccanaṃ samāptaṃ || || ۞ || || (fol. 33v6) End aṁḥ asitāṅgabhairavapādukāṃ (6) iṁ rurubhairavapādukāṃ || uṁ caṇḍabhairavapādukāṃ || ṛṁ krodhabhairavapādukāṃ || ḷṁ unmattabhairavapādukāṃ || eṁ kapālīśabhaira(7)vapādukāṃ || oṁ bhīṣaṇabhairavapādukāṃ || aṁ saṃhārabhairavapādukāṃ || āṁ brahmāṇīpādukāṃ || īṁ māheśvarīpādukāṃ || ūṁ kaumārī(8)pādukāṃ || ṝṁ vaiṣṇavīpādukāṃ || ḹṁ vārāhīpādukāṃ || aiṃ indrāṇīpādukāṃ || auṁ cāmuṇāpādukāṃ || aḥ mahālakṣmīpādukāṃ || ā vā (fol. 34v5-8) Colophon (fol. )

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīkubjikāyai || atha dīpajāgavidhi likhyate || devasake vasa(2)rape dhunake || || netyakarmma yāye || || yajamānana, akṣatra, dvāphala bi(3)ya || gurusyaṃ āmantrana vākya paṭhet || yoginyādi || gaṇacokostaṃ || aiṃ 5 (4) āmantrinosi yoginyā, sagaṇaṃ gurupūrvvakaṃ | puṣpa durvvakṣataṃ caiva, sauma(5)nasantu prayaccha me || adya me gṛhna prītyarthaṃ, nimantraṇa karomy ahaṃ || || (exp. 9t1-5) End stotra || aiṃ 5 akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākālaṃtyādi || (3) śrīsamvarttā || yā sā śakti || santānasūtra || mahāmāyā || vande sadā || ukāro(4) brahmāṇī || madhyatrisā || māyākuṇḍalanī || yathāvāna || atragandhādi || || (5) samaya || tarppaṇa || aṣṭāviṃśatyādi || avināśo || ācamanaṃ || ekā(6)neka || deva āśīrvvāda || gaṇacokosa, bali thoya || gurumaṇḍala deva(7)sake taṃne deva jope || baṃ puya || sakaleṃ nocāyake || || || (exp. 8b2-7) Colophon (fol. )

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīdaivya namaḥ || nosiya || aiṃ ātmatatvāya svāhā || (2) krīṃ vidyātatvāya svāhā || sauṃḥ śivatatvāya svāhā || || gu(3)ru namaskāraṃ || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ, vyāptaṃ jena carācaraṃ |(4) tat padan daśṛtaṃ jena, tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ || akṣata kāyā(5)va || apasavantute bhūtā, ye bhutā bhūvi saṃsthitā | ye bhutā(6) vighnakarttāra, ste nasyantu śivājñayā || diga hore || (exp. 2,ll.1-6) «Extracts:» aiṃ tripurādevi vidnahe klī kāmeśvarī dhī mahī(exp. 3b5), sauḥ tannau pracodayāta || || śrīmahātripurasundaridevyai pādyārghā ca ma(exp. 4b5)snānaṃ namaḥ || End khavasa maṇḍala dayake || the de(4)vayā svāna te || ke taṃne || nirmmālyavāsinī namaḥ || svāna kā(5)yāva chuye || laṃkha ke kāyāva balisa te || arghapātrasa coṅa (6) svāna te || 3 || tāla 2 ra thura 2 || bali thiyāva thava hṛdaya(exp. 7t1) thiye || saṃhāra mudrāna bali thoye || adya pātrana ruye || javasa(2) maṇḍalasa || śrīsūryāya arghan namaḥ puṣpaṃ namaḥ || || (exps. 6b2-7t2) Colophon (fol. )

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrimannirmalabuddhivaibhavakṛte vācāṃ ca saṃvṛddhaye lokātītaguṇaṃ vibhaktirahitaṃ tatvaikavīraṃ padam kvāpi kvāpi gabhīrabhāvagahanaṃ ṣaḍdarśanīsaṅgrahamvyākartuṃ racayāmi kalpalatikāṃ ṭikām abhīṣṭārthadām || 1 || tatra tāvad vaiśeṣikādiśāstrāṇāṃ cchātrair ativistaratayādhigaṃtum aśakyatvāt tadanugrahāya tattacchāstrasaṅgrahaṃ cikīrṣur atisthūlatayā buddhisthatvād vaiśeṣikaśāstrasāram eva tacchāstrapratipādyeṣṭadevatānamaskāralakṣaṇaṃ | pūrvaṃ pratijānīte || śrīśaṃbhuṃ bhuvanodbhavasthitilaye hetuṃ paraṃ tattvataḥ sarvajñaṃ bhavasāgalaikataraṇiṃ natvā gurūṇāṃ gurūm |vakṣye samyag avekṣya vistarayutaṃ vaiśeṣikaṃ darśanaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa tadīyasāram ucitaṃ padyaiḥ suvidyepsitaṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–7) End na caivaṃ saty avidyātatkāryānyataratvaprasaṃgena mokṣe py avidyānuvṛttiprasaṅgād iti śaṅkanīyam || avidyāḥ(!)tatkāryānyataratvasya nivartyatvopādhyadhīnatvāt || avidyāstamayasya ca nivartakāsaṃbhavān nivartyatvābhāvāt || tataḥ sadādiprakāravilakṣaṇatvābhyupagame py avidyāstamayasya noktadoṣa iti siddhaṃ | evaṃ nirūpitaṃ matam upasaṃharati || iti gadito vedāntavādaḥ sphuṭa iti || iti śrīkavikairavenduśrījāṣarājaviracitāyāṃ kalpalatikāyāṃ vedāntamatasaṃgrahavyākriyā | idānīm asya ṣaḍdarśanīsaṃgrahaprakaraṇasya praṇetā śiṣṭācāraparaṃparāprāptaviśiṣṭavaṃśaprabhavasvanāmakīrtanamukhena svakṛtim upaślokayati || āsīd viṣṇumahīpatiḥ kṣitipatiḥ pratyagrasaṃgrāmabhū (!) bhīmaḥ śrīmahimānubhāvasubhago dhanyo vadānyottamaḥ ||dhīras tattanayo nayocitaguṇaḥ śrījāṣarājābhidho bhūpālaḥ kavikairavendur akarot ṣaḍdarśanīsaṃgrahaṃ || spaṣṭo ’rthaḥ | atra ca āsīd viṣṇumahīpatir ityanena śrī⟪jā⟫dhāmaprasiddhavaṃśavarṇanam upalakṣayati || etc. (fol. 99r3–v4) Colophon tasyāpi dvijavaryapūjanaparasyāsīd dvijātivrajā- ʼnekāśīrvacanādhilabdhamahimā prājyādhirājyodayaḥ || śrīviṣṇuḥ śrutivit pavitracaritaśreṇīṣu cūḍāmaṇiḥ śrīmadviṣṇupadābjapūjanaparo dharmaikadhuryaḥ sutaḥ || 3 || tatrāpy abhūvann atha jāṣarājaḥ śrībhairavo viṣṇur amī pavitrāḥ || putrās trayaḥ śāstravidaḥ pumarthā dharmārthakāmā iva sādhuvṛtteḥ || 4 || tatra śrīnijavaṃśapāvanaguṇālaṅkārasaṃśobhinā nānāsādhujanānubhaṅgarucinā śāstrāṇi sarvāṇy api || ābhāsena vinā viśuddhamatinā saṃgṛhya sāraiṣiṇā cakre bhūpatijāṣarājakavinā ṣaḍdarśanīsaṃgraha iti || 5 || || nānāgamāpāragabhīrasiṃdhor āloḍanena prakaṭīkṛtā sau || jejīyatāṃ kalpalatā hitāryasaṃprārthanāpūrakasatphalāḍhyā || || || iti śrīkavikairavenduśrījāṣarājaviracitā kalpalatikā samāptā || || || (fol. 100r1–8)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīmatsyendranāthāya namaḥ || mahāyogimatsyendranāthaprasādās tvadīyātmadīyām anasthādyaḥ saṃghāḥ | vinaṣṭāpraṇaṣṭānikaṣṭāṃ niśiṣṭān yato rāsanaṃ cāpalaṃ karttum īhe (!) || 1 || vipa(?)janaṃ rañjanaṃ sajjanānāṃ karotyañjanaṃ moham andejjalānāṃ | saraṃkaṃjanaṃ yojayed bhūribhogai (drutaṃ gañjanaṃ) bhaktaśatroḥ karotu || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) «End» matsyendrapadyaśatakaṃ katakaṃ mano ʼmbho mālinyavāraṇavidhau puruṣārthahetu ācāryyasiddhasutanīlakaṇṭhodgataṃ sukṛtino ʼharaha paṭhantu || 101 || (fol. 15r2–4) «Colophon» śrīvikramāditya śake (kṛtāgnyatyaṣṭhi) pramāṇe (1734 mukhaṃnandaṇai leḥ 797) nepālaśāke pramite cakāra śrīnīlakaṇṭhaḥ śatakaṃ vudhendraḥ || 102 || iti śrīmadācāryyasiddhesvarātmaja nīlakaṇṭharacitaṃ śrīmatsyendranāthapadyaśatakaṃ saṃpūrttim ajīgamat || śrīmatsyendranāthāya namaḥ || śrī śrīnivāsamallamahārājasya nityādayos tu || (fol. 15r4–7)

Beginning (commentary:) śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ āviṣkarotu vibudhair abhivandanīyāṃ vācaṃ sa ko pi mama vallavasārvabhaumaḥ vaṃśo pi yatparigṛhītatayā bibhartti vācālatāṃ tribhuvanaikavimohayitrīm 1 adhigatakalām akhilām agrabhvād veṃkaṭādriyajvaguroḥ vacanair anatiprakṣurair vyākurve śāstradīpikāṃ viśadaṃ 2 vibudhāḥ praṇamya mūrdhnā bahudhātvaḥ prārthaye kṛtāvasthāṃ arpaya tad apāṃ sūkṣmāṃ nidaṃta (!) vā parato bhinaṃdata vā 3 (fol. 1v1–3) (mūla:) āmnāyasya kriyārthatvād ānarthakyam atadarthānāṃ tasmād anityam ucyate athāto dharmajijñāsetyatra pramāṇasvarūpasādhanaphalaiḥ sābhāsair dharmo jijñāsyatvena pratijñātaḥ tatrāsminn adhyāye pramāṇaṃ nirupyate kiṃ pramāṇaṃ dharme iti tena yad eva kiṃciddharmapramāṇanirūpaṇaṃm (!) arthavādama(!)smṛtināmadheyādigocaraṃ tatsarvam atraiva saṃgata (!) na hy atra codanāprāmāṇyasādhanaṃ lakṣaṇārthaḥ || (fol. 1v8–9) End (commentary:) na yatra sandoho nāsti tatra na sāmarthyenaiva vyavasthā kalpanīyā tathā ca darśapūrṇamāsādividherekādaśe ca vakṣyamāṇanyāyena sarvāṃgaviśiṣṭakarmaviṣayatayā niścitasya sāmarthyānusāreṇādhapaṃgvādiṣu śakyamātrāṃgaviṣayatayā saṃkocakalpanā na prasajyata iti na tiryagadhikaraṇavirodhaḥ anenaivābhiprāyeṇa vidher idānīm ityadhikaraṇādyavākye saṃdigdhārthanirṇaya ity uktam iti dhyeyam śiṣyabuddisaukaryāyaitadadhyāyārthaṃ dvitīyādyādhyāyārthajātaṃ ca kārikayā saṃgṛhṇāti nāmārthavādeti || (fol. 64r12–15) (mūla:) tatrāviśeṣaśravaṇād aniyamapratibhāyām uttaram ucyate aśakyārthavidhyasaṃbhavāt avaśyaṃ vidhāyakasya śaktiḥ sahakāriṇīty aṃgīkarttavyaṃ tasmāc chaktisahāyo vidhir eva yathāsāmarthyaṃ vidheyaṃ vyavasthāpayati dravādiṣu sruvādīnāṃ vyākośasya ca saktuṣu arthāpati(!)vaśāt tasmād vyavasthaivety avasthitam nāmārthavādavidhimaṃtrayutaś ca vedas tadvat smṛtiś ca caritaṃ ca nirastadoṣaṃ dharmapramāṇam iha siddham ataḥ paraṃ tabh (!) deda(!)prakāraviniyogaphalādicintā || || (fol. 64r7–9) Colophon (commentary:) iti śrīviṭṭhalakulatilakasūrabhaṭṭamahopādhyāyatanūbhavasya veṃkaṭādrigurucaraṇānujasya somanāthasarvatomukhayājinaḥ kṛtau śāstradīpikāvyākhyāyā (!) mayūkhamālikāsaṃjñitāyāṃ prathamādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ samāptaḥ || (fol. 64r15–16) (mūla:) ityupādhyāyapārthasārathiśra(!)viracitāyāṃ śāstradīpikāyāṃ prathamādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pāda (!) || iti prathamo dhyāyaḥ samāpta || (fol. 64r9–10)

(9) tarutalaṃ caṃḍāśur (!) ujjṛṃbhate caṃḍāṃśor niśi kā kathā raghupate caṃdro ʼyam unmīlati | vatsyaitad viditaṃ kathaṃ nu bhavatā dhatte kuraṃgaṃ ya(10)taḥ kvāsi preyasi hā kuraṃganayane caṃdrānane jānaki | atra śrutakuraṃgasaṃbaṃdhinas tannayanasya smaraṇāt tatsadṛśasītānaya(11)nasmṛtiḥ tatsaṃbaṃdhisītāsmṛtiś ceti | kiṃ tv eṣā vyaṃgyāʼlaṃkāryabhūtā ca tad vyāvṛtyartham avyaṃgyatvaviśeṣaṇaṃ atyuccā(ṃ) pari- (fol. 26v2–11) «Sub-colophons:» iti citra (!) granthāraṃ(12)bhaprakaraṇaṃ | (fol. 3v11–12) iti citramīmāṃsāyām upamāprakaraṇī (!) || (fol. 21v10) ity ana(3)nvayaprakaraṇaṃ || (fol. 26v2–3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīguhyakālyai namaḥ || yā vyāpya śaktyā nijayā jaganti viṣṭavya bhūtāni tathākhilāni || varvvartti sarvopati citprakāśā sā guhyakālī paripātu viśvaṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End muktikāmas tu labhate muktuṃ nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ || āvaśyakam idaṃ stotraṃ guhyakālyārpitātmanāṃ || 34 || etat stotrānvitā pūjā sahasraguṇitā bhavet || 35 || || (fol. 9r4–9v2) Colophon iti śrīmadādināthamahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ śrītripuraghnakṛtaṃ śrīmacchrīśrīguhyakālyāḥ stotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || ❁ || śrīśrīśrīmahāguhyakālīdevī satataṃ prasanno stu || śubhaṃ (fol. 9v2–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ || mātar nīlasarasvati praṇamatāṃ saubhāgyasaṃpatprade pratyālīḍhapadasthite śavahṛdi smerānanāṃbhoruhe || phullendīvaralocane trinayane kartrīkapālotpale khaḍgaṃ cādadhatī tvam eva śaraṇaṃ tvām i(!)śvarīm āsra(!)ye || 1 || (exp. 4t1–4) End labhate kavitāṃ vidyāṃ sarvaśastrarthavid bhavet || †lakṣmi manasvarāṃ† prāpya bhuktvā bhogyan(!) yathepsitām || 10 || kīrttiṃ kāṃtiṃ ca nairujyaṃ sarveṣāṃ priyatāṃ bhajet || vikhyātiṃ cāpi lokeṣu prāpyeti mokṣam āpnuyāt || 11 || || (exp. 7t5–b1) Colophon iti ni(!)lataṃtre tārāṣṭakastavaṃ || || i(!)śvarī || || i(!)śvarī || || i(!)śvarī || || i(!)śvarī || || (exp. 7b1–2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīguhyakālyai namaḥ || yā vyāpya śaktyā nijayā jaganti viṣṭasbhya bhūtāni tathākhilāni || varvvartti sarvvopari citprakāśā, sā guhyakālī paripātu viśvaṃ || 1 || sṛṣṭisthitipralayakarttur api kṣaṇena, sṛṣṭisthitipralayakartti(!)tayā matā yā || vedāgamā viditatattvatanusvarūpā, sā naḥ sadāvatu jganty api guhyakālī || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End prakāśito varārohe tasmāt pāṭhyaḥ prayatnataḥ || vidyāṃ prāpnoti vidyārthī, dhanārthī dhanam āpnuyāt || 33 || muktikāmas tu labhate, muktiṃ nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ || āvaśyakam idaṃ stotraṃ, guhyakālyārppitātmanāṃ || 34 || etat stotrānvitā pūjā, sahasraguṇitā bhavet || (fol. 5v5–6r1) Colophon iti śrīmahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ tripuraghnakṛtaṃ siddhitattvanāmaśrīguhyakālīstotraṃ sampūrṇam || || || bhuvanaśaragajābjais sammite vikramābde, dinakṛdahani durgāyās thithau rādhaśukle || gaṇapatiguruvāṇīpādukā bhāvayitvā, tribhuvananaranāthaprītaye ʼlīlikhad avai || śubhaṃ bhūyāt || || || || || (fol. 6r1–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśaṃ vande || || mahākāla uvāca || acityākaaraśaktisvarūpā prativyaktyadhiṣṭhānasatyaikamūrttiḥ | nirākāranirdvaṃdvabodhaikagamyā tvam ekā paraṃ brahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 1 || śrīgotrākṛtitvād anaikāntikatvād alakṣāgamatvād aśeṣākaratvāt || prapaṃcālayatvād anā⟪kāraṇāvā⟫ [[raṃbhakatvā]][t] tvam ekāºº (fol. 1v1–6) End mahākālarudroditaṃ stotram etatat sadā bhaktibhāvena yo dhyāti(!) bhaktaḥ || na pāpaṃ na rogo na śoko na mṛtyu(!) bhavet siddhir aṃte ca kaivalyalābhaḥ || 25 || iti te kathitaṃ divyaṃ sudhādhārāhvayaṃ stavaṃ | etasya satatābhyāsāt siddhikaratare(!) sthitā || 26 || (fol. 5v3–7) Colophon ity ādināthaviracitāyā(!) mahāsaṃhitāyā(!) mahākāra(!)proktaṃ guhyakālyā(!) sudhādhārāhvayaṃ stotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || (fol. 5v7–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīguhyakālikāyai namaḥ || vijetuṃ pratasthe yathā kālike yān daśāsyo ʼsurān pūjyamānapravāhān || ⟪1⟫ || tathā guhyakālī †satuṣṭāvavāgīr† jjgīṣu mṛte bāhuvīryyeṇa savān || 1 || (fol. 1r1–4) End na śokaṃ na pāpaṃ na vā duḥkhadainyaṃ na mṛtyur na rogo na bhītir na cāpan(!) || dhanaṃ dīrgham āyuḥ sukhaṃ vṛddhirā(!)gyo yaśaḥ sadya bhogā striyo yon a va(śyaḥ) || 15 || striyo maṇḍalaṃ buddhisatsāhasādyā na yaḥ śarmavidyā bhaven muktir aṃte || (exp. 8t2–8b1) Colophon iti śrīvāmakeśvarata[n]tre rāvaṇakṛtaṃ guhyakālyābhuja[ṅ]gastotraṃ || (exp. 8b1–2)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmīdcevyai || tvaṃ devīṃ sarvvavyāpīṃ, tribhuvananamitāṃ pañcavaktrātriṇe(!)ntrāṃ, sarvvaśvetāṅgarūpā[ṃ], sphaṭikamaṇinibhā[ṃ] candrakoṭiprakāśāṃ | vāme dakṣasusobhāṃ, bhujadaśakayutāṃ ⟪||⟫ śatrusa[ṃ]hārakārīṃ, tāṃ devī[ṃ] siddhilakṣmīm, abhimataphaladāṃ, mokṣasiddhipradātrīṃ || 1 || (fol. 11r1–4) End kuru me tvaṃ nu(!)grahaṃ pūjya(!) tava bhāvoda(!)krame | na tantre bhāvam āpannaṃ, kṣamaśva parameśvarī || 22 ||<ref>pāda a and b are unmetrical.</ref> (fol. 18r1–3) <references/> Colophon iti śrīguhyakālistotraṃ samāpta[m] || ❁ || (fol. 18r3)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || namaḥ śrī-āryatārāyai || bālārkālokatāmrapravarasuraśiraś cārucūḍāmaṇiśrī sampat saṃparkarāgān aticiraracitālaktakavyaktabhaktī || bhaktyā pādau tavārye karapuṭamukuṭāṭopabhugnottamāṅgas tāri sayāpac (!) charaṇye navanutikusumasragbhir abhyarcayāmi || 1 || (fol. 1v1-3) «End» tvat strotrābhyaḥ pavitrīkṛtamanasi mayi śreyasaṃsthānam ekaṃ | dṛṣṭaṃ yasmād amoghaṃ jagati tavaguṇās totramātraṃ prajānām || 36 || saṃstutyat tvad guṇaughāvayavamaniyate yattam āptaṃ mayā yat puṇyaṃ puṇyārhavāñchāphalamadhurarasā svādam ābhuktibhogyam || lokas tenāryyalokeśvaracaraṇatalasvastikasvasticihno mahnāyāyam(!) prapāyā sugatamahīṇ tāṃ sukhāvatyuvāsyām(!) || 37 || ❁ || (fol. 9v4-10r2) «Colophon» ity āryyatārābhaṭṭārikāyāḥ śragdharāstutisamāptam || ❖ || ❖ || śubham || ❖ || ❁ || ❖ || ❖ || (fol. 10r3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ | pratyakṣopajīvakatvāt pratyakṣānaṃtaraṃ bahuvādisaṃmatatattvād (!) upamānā(2)t prāg anumānaṃ nirūpyate | tatra vyāptiviśiṣṭapakṣadharmatājñānajanyaṃ jñānam anumitiḥ tatka(3)raṇam anumānaṃ | tac ca liṃgaparāmarśo na tu parāmṛśyamāṇaṃ liṃgam iti vakṣyate | athānumā(4)naṃ na pramāṇaṃ || (fol. 1v1–4) End jātamātrasya pravṛttinivṛttihetv anumitijanakavyāptijñānaṃ tarkaṃ vinaivāto ʼnavet cet | tahi (!) vyabhicārāt tarkko pi na vyāptigrahahetuḥ | na ca tadbudhāvāṃtarajātir asti sāmānyapratyāsatyāsarvopasaṃharād avinābhāvagrahaḥ | sāmānyarūpatā ca na sakṛddar⟨ś⟩śana-(exp.20t 6–8) Colophon
