61r6–7, exp. 66) «Sub-Colophon» iti śrīsaccidānandagaṇeśapañcastotraṃ sampūrṇam || (fol. 64v2, exp. 69) «Sub-Colophon» iti śrīrudrayāmalatamtre devīrahasye mahāgaṇaptiḥ stotrākhyāna nāma tri[ṃ]śatpaṭalaḥ || || || || || (fol. 64v8–9, exp. 69) «Sub-Colophon» iti śrīskanadapurāṇe pratyakṣasiddhiprade mahāgaṇapatistotraṃ samāptam || ||(fol. 66v5, exp. 70) «Sub-Colophon» iti śrīrudrajāmalatantre gaṇeśanāmasahasrastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || || śubhaṃ || (fol. 14v6–7, exp. 86) «Sub-Colophon» iti śrīrudrayāmale devīrahasye śrīmahāgaṇaptimaṃtroddhāravidhir nāma ṣāḍviṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ saṃpūrṇa[ṃ] || || śubham || || (fol. 9v3–5, exp. 95) «Sub-Colophon» iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe śrīmahādevabhāṣitaṃ || śrīgaṇeśasahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam samātam || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ ||(fol. 18r5–7, exp. 113) «Sub-Colophon» iti śrīpadmākaratantre śivapārvatīsamvāde vasusaṅgrahe pañcavaktragaṇeśakavacaṃ samāptam || || śubham || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 12v6–13r1, exp. 126) Colophon iti śrīmaṅgalāgaurītantra pañcamukhīgaṇeśastotraṃ sampūrṇam || || || śubham || || || (fol. 13v6–7, exp. 127)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā surathaḥ sa narādhipa[ḥ] || praṇipatya muniṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhaktyā praṇatakaṃdharaḥ || 1 || praśnaṃ karoty asau rājā bījapūrvvārcanaṃ prati || rājovāca || śrutaṃ gopyaṃ tvayā proktaṃ mane(!) dhyānārcanaṃ mayā || 2 || idānīṃ śrotum icchāmi sugopyaṃ devatārcanaṃ bhagavan kena jāpyena arcanena vidhānataḥ || 3 ||(fol. 1v1–5) End svaiḥ svair bījaiḥ prapūjyātha tathā vaiṣṇavaśaktayaḥ || śākaṃbharī yadā pūjyā bījarājena kevalaṃ || 21 || tenaiva bījarājena ekavīrāṃ prapūjayet || bhrāmarīṃ viṣṇubījena pūjakaṃ nṛpasattamam || 22 || evaṃ bījakrameṇaivaṃ pūjanaṃ saṃprakīrttitaṃ || pūrvoktaṃ maṇḍalaṃ yantravidhānaṃ samudīritaṃ || 23 || pūjanaṃ tac ca vijñeyaṃ sarvasidhiḥ pradāyakam || 24 || || (fol. 3v1–5) Colophon iti mārkaṇḍeyapu[rā]ṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devīmānātmye maṃtrarahasyan nāma saptadaśo ʼdhyāyaḥ || || rājovāca || || tisṛ (fol. 3v5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || prāgdehastho yadāsan tava caraṇayugaṃ nāśrito nārcito ʼhaṃ tenādyā kīrtivargair jaṭharajaḍahatair bādhyamāno baliṣṭhaiḥ || śritvā janmāntaran no punar iha bhavitā kvāśrayaḥ kvāṣi sevā kṣānttavyo me ʼparādhaḥ prakaṭitavadane kāmarūpe karāle || 1 || bālye bālābhilāṣair jaḍitajaḍamatir bālalīlāpraśakto natvā jānāmi mātaḥ kalikaluṣaharāṃ bhogamokṣaikadātrīṃ || nācāro naiva pūjā na ca yajanakathā na smṛtir naiva sevā kṣantavyo me ʼparādhaḥ prakaṭitavadane kāmarūpe karāle || 2 || (fol. 1v1–6) End tvaṃ kālī tvaṃ ca tārā tvam asi girisutā sundarī bhairavī tvaṃ tvaṃ durgā chinnamastā tvam asi ca bhuvanā tvaṃ hi lakṣmī śivā tvaṃ || dhūmā mātaṅginī tvaṃ tvam asi ca vagalā maṃgalā hiṃgulākhyā kṣantavyo me ʼparādhaḥ prakaṭitavadane kāmarūpe karāle || 15 ||(!) stotreṇānena devīṃ paricarati jano yaḥ sadā bhaktiyukto duḥkīrttiṃ durgasaṃghaṃ pariṇayati samudvignatā nāśam eti || nādhirvyādhiḥ kadācid bhavati yadi punaḥ sarvadā sāparādhaḥ sarvaṃ tatkāmarūpātribhabhuvanajananī kṣyāmayet putrabudhyā || 16 || jetā vaktā kavīśo bhavati dhanapatir dānaśīlo dayātmā niṣpāpo yoniḥ kalaṃkaḥ kulapatikulavāt satvavān dhārmikaś ca || nityānando dayāluḥ paśugaṇavimukhaḥ satpathe dhyānaśīlaḥ saṃsārāddhiṃ sukhena pratarati girijā pādapadmāvalambāt || 17 || (fol. 4r4–4v6) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale aparādhabhaṃjanaramaṇīyastutiḥ saṃpūrṇā || (fol. 4v6)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || rudrayāmale || atha yaṃtraṃ pravakṣāmi śṛṇuṣva harava[l]labhe || trikoṇaṃ vinyasyet(!) padmaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ pariveṣṭhitaḥ || aṣṭapatraṃ mahāyaṃtraṃ tritatvaṃ ca tataḥ paraṃ || bhūsuratritayaṃ dadyāt vasuśūlasamanvitaṃ || (fol. 1v1–4) End juhuyāt trimadhusaṃyuktaṃ bilvapatraṃ savajrakaiḥ || aṣṭottarasahasraṃ ⟨s⟩tu saṃtraiḥ secayed imaṃ || śāntimantrīḥ samabhyarchya dhārayed yatamānasaḥ yad yad vāṃchati tatsarvvaṃ prāpnoty atra na saṃśayaḥ || iti nigaditam ādyaṃ tāriṇīvarmadivyaṃ kavacaṃ api saguptaṃ dhārayed yas tu bhaktyā || śivabhaya(!) udagīśo brahmatārāprasādāti(!) bruvan ajayalakṣmīs tasya hastasthitaiva || (54r4–55r1) Colophon iti tta(!)ragandharvatanurārākalpa(!) trailokyavijayanto(!) saṃkavacaṃ sampūrṇaṃ || śubham || (55v1–2)

Beginning svasti śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ śrīnārada uvāca⟨ḥ⟩ bhagavan sarvadharmajña sarvaśāstrārthapāraga śrutismṛtipurāṇānāṃ rahasyaṃ tvanmukhāc chrutaṃ 1 sarvapāpaharaṃ deva kenāvidyā nivarttate kena vā brahmavijñānaṃ kena vā mokṣasādhanaṃ 2 brāhmaṇānāṃ gatiḥ kena kena vā mṛtunāśanaṃ aihikāmuṣmikaphalaṃ kena vā padmasaṃbhvaṃ 3 vaktum arhasy aśeṣeṇa sarvaṃ nikhilam āditaḥ (fol. 1v1–5) End jape kṛte homapūjāṃ kṛtvā japaviśeṣataḥ yasyai kasmai na vaktavyaṃ gāyatryaṣṭasahasrakaṃ 155 subhaktāya suśiṣyāya bhaktavyaṃ bhūsurāya vai idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ hugyatamād api 156 putrapradam aputrāṇāṃ daridrāṇāṃ dhanapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ mumūkṣuṇāṃ kāmināṃ sarvakāmadaṃ || 157 rogārto mucyate rogād badho mucyate baṃdhanāt brahmahatyāsurāpānasvarṇas te pī(!) ca yo naraḥ 118 gurutalpatago vāpi paṭḥanāṃ mucyate sakṛt idaṃ rahasyam amalaṃ mayoktam ṛṣisattamaḥ 159 paṭḥanād brahmasāyujyaṃ saṃprāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ || || (fol. 20r4–5) Colophon iti śrīviṣṇuyāmale sṛṣṭiprasaṃsā(!)yāṃ gāyatryaṣṭottarasahasranāma śubham (fol. 20v on the side)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama[ḥ] oṁ guhyakālyai nama[ḥ] sadāśiva uvāca oṁ namas tribhuvaneśāya brahmaṇe viśvarupiṇe īś(!)varāya pareśāya gurave śivarūpiṇe 1 yasyāḥ prasādād devo ʼpi sarvajñaḥ sa śivo bhavet tāṃ naumi parameśānī sarvavyāpi śiveśvarī 2 brahmāṇḍakoṭilakṣāṇi bhasmam ākurute jayo tāṅkāragrāsanaratāṃ guhyakālī namāmy ahaṃ 3 (fol. 1v1–5) End brahmāṃḍakoṭilakṣāṇi bhasmasāt kuru tejasā tāṃ kālagrāsanaratā kālakīlī namāmy ahaṃ 29 naumi kālī mahadrūpāṃ pradhānāvalibhakṣaṇī krīḍārthaṃ yā karā citrāṃ brahmāṃḍārbudamālinī 30 aṃjanādrinibhāṃ kālī koṭisūryyaśataprabhāṃ trailokyarakṣaṇaratā[ṃ]maṃgalāṃ praṇamāmy ahaṃ 31 guhyakālī maṃgalā ca siddhikālī jayeśvarī carccikāṃ tripureśī ca kāliṃ ca bhuvaneśvarī 31 śrīmaṃgalā mahākālī nirvāṇe padadāyinī mokṣadāṃ rājyadāṃ nityāṃ navavaktrāṃ parāṃ bhaje 204 (fol. 19v3–20v2) Colophon iti śrīhārāvataṃtre ṣaṭtriṃśatisāhasre mahārtharvaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ śivapārvatīsāmarahasye śrīguhyai kālikādevyā sahasranāmastutirahasya[ṃ] samāptā(!) iti samvat 1957 sāla jyeṣṭamāse su(!)klapakṣe navamyāṃ likhitaṃ śubhaṃ(fol. 20v2–5)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīguhyakālīdevyai || || asya śrīguhyakālyā aṣṭottaraśatanāmamahāmantrasya siddhiguhyabhairava ṛṣiḥ atibṛḥatīcchandaḥ śrīparabrahmanirvvāṇaśrīguhyakālī parameśvarī devatā 1 bījaṃ paramahaṃsa kṣraṁ śaktiḥ paramahaṃsa ▒ kīlakaṃ paramahaṃsa virvvāṇapara brahma śrīguhyakālīprasādapūrvvakaṃ dharmmārthakāmamokṣasidhyarthaṃ paramahaṃsanirvvāṇaparabrahmaśrīguhyakālīsālokyasāmīpyasārūpyasāyujyasidhyarthaṃ jape viniyogaḥ || (exp. 2t1–2b1) End īśānabhairavī śāntī bhausā kālī prabhāvatī || mahāghoraguhyakālī surāsuraṃ supūjitā || 19 anākhyā kālikā caiva mahāsaṃhārakālikā || sthiticanḍamahākālīsphaṭikālī śivaṃ karī || 20 || paraṃ jyotiṣparaṃ brahma guhyakālīti kīrttitā || vinivṛtya kṛpāṃ prātar japed aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ || 21 atiguhyataraṃ divyaṃ sarvvāmnāyeṣu gopitaṃ || sārāt sārataraṃ badre vedatantreṣu kīrttitā || 22 sakṛjjaptvā guhyakālyāś caturvvarggaphalaṃ labhet || (fol. 5b3–6t5) Colophon iti śrīguhyakālyā aṣṭottaraśatanāmamantraṃ samāptaṃ || śrīguhyakālīdevīprīṇātu || śubha samvat 883 māghakṛṣṇatṛtīyā ravivāsara etasmin dine likhitvā rājñe dattam iti || 5 (exp. 6b3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || ‥ ‥ ‥ ‥ ‥ || || kubjā yoniṣu mathanā svarasanā jātaś ca aṃ daṃ śivaṃ maṇḍaṃ ke[śa]vanābhinālasahitaṃ padmeṣu padmāsanaṃ || tasyā[ś] cordhar adhaś ca radhva(!)mahimā radhaś(!) ca pāṇaṃ pala ādyā śaktir aṇādiliṃgavaśano ityāha saḥ pātu māṃ || 1 || nama ‥ cakreśvarī devī sṛṭisamhārakāriṇī || aruṇāruṇasaṃkāśaṃ triśūlamālikādharāṃ || 2 || (fol. 19v1–5) End nāgakuṇḍaladakṣiṇai(!) vāmakarṇaiś ca maṇḍale || raktāṃvaradharī mātas tvatpādacaraṇaṃ bhaje || 4 || naracarmmadharī devī vyāghracarmma(!) sadā dharam || tvatpādacaraṇāṃ biṃduyācakaḥ yā ahaṃ sadā || 5 || cakreśvarī mahāmātas tvatpādacaraṇaṃ bhajet || brahmenduviṣṇurudreṇa tvatpādacaraṇaṃ bhajet || 6 || idaṃ stotraṃ pravakṣāmi sarvvapāpaṃ pramucyate || manasā kāmanāsiddhaṃ śivaloke mahīyate || 7 || || (fol. 20r2–20v2) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale mahātantre rahasyapaṭale śrīcakreśvarīdevīstotraṃ samāptam || || śubham || || || || || (fol. 20v2–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīśiva uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣāmi kubjikāstotram uttamaṃ || yena maṃtraprabhāvena caṇḍijapaśubhaṃ bhavet || 1 || na karma nargalāstotraṃ kīlakaṃ na rahsyakaṃ || na śūktaṃ(!) nāpi dhyānaṃ ca na nyāsaṃ na ca arcanaṃ || 2 || kubjikāpāṭḥamātreṇa durgāpāṭḥaphalaṃ labhet || atiguhyaṃtaraṃ devi devānām api durllabhaṃ || 3 ||(fol. 1v1–5) End aṁ kaṁ caṁ ṭhaṁ taṁ paṁ yaṁ śaṁ vidurā vimardaya 2 haṁ kṣaṁ malayī jāgra jāgra 2 troṭaya 2 dīptaṃ kuru 2 svāhā || pāṁ pāṁ pārvati(!) pūrṇā khāṁ khīṁ khūṁ khecarī tathā || sāṁ sīṁ saptasatisiddhaṃ kuru svajapamātrakā || 11 || sa tu kubjikāstotraṃ maṃtrajāgratahetave || abhakte na ca dātavyaṃ gopayet bha‥ pārvati || 12 || vihīnaṃ kubjikā devi yas tu saptasatiṃ paṭhet || na tasya jāyate siddhi(!) araṇe hṛdi tā(!) sadā || 13 ||(fol. 2v4–3r4) Colophon iti śrīkubjikāstotraṃ samāptam || || śubham || || (fol. 3r4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīśiva uvāca || || namaste śaraṇye śive sānukampe namaste jagadvyāpike viśvarūpe || namaste jagadvandyapādāravinde namaste jagattāriṇi trāhi durge || 1 || namaste jagaccintyamānasvarūpe namaste namaste mahāyogināṃ jñānarūpe || namaste namaste sadānandarupe namsate ºº || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End tam bhaktyā na cārādhitam || vedabrahmaṣaḍaṅgasāṅgam akhilaṃ nādhītam adhyāpitaṃ kṣantavyo janani tvayāham asite mūḍhoparādhākulaḥ || 5 || (fol. 3v1–3) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale sāmbasadāśivapañcavaktravinirgataśrīmadaparādhabhañjanastotram sampūrṇam || || || || || || śubham astu || || (fol. 3v3–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrī iś(!)vara uvāca || || deva deveśi sarvajña sarvalokaikaśāṃkarī || tan me brūhi mahādevī lokānāṃ hitakārakaḥ || 1 || śrīpārvaty uvāca || sakhi bhadre tava prokto lokalajjāpahārakaṃ || sadhitva(!) loke viditāya tvayāhaṃ prabodhinā || 2 || etad vijāpita(!) saṃ(!)bho purārathāmahomayā || kenopāyena deveśa naro duḥkhād vimucyate || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End arddhasaṃkhyād vijānīyā samāyāntu svaśaktita[ḥ] || svayaṃ vā brāhmaṇadvārā paṭhe[t] stotram ananyadhī || 23 || gṛhe tīrthe vane vāpī vācayed devasannidhau || vas(!)yāriṣṭaphalaṃ nāsti grahadoṣādisaṃbhavaṃ || 24 || yoginīnāṃ daśāṃ janamnāriṣṭa(!) jāyate kvacit || nākāle maraṇaṃ tasya nāgnī caurabhayaṃ bhavet || 25 || etat te kathitaṃ devī yoginīgrahaśāntida || tava snehān yayākhyātaṃ nākhyāyaḥ yasya sa kvacit || 26 || (fol. 3v3–4v1) Colophon iti śrīkāmadhenutaṃtre śrīīśvaraśrīīśvarīsaṃvāde astayoginīgrahamātṛkāstotraṃ samāptam || || śubham || (fol. 4r1–2)

Beginning ānandabhairavadhyānam || || sūryyakoṭipratikāśaṃ candrakoṭisusī(!)talaṃ || aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ devaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanaṃ || 1 || amṛtārṇavamadhyastham brahmapadmoparisthitaṃ || vṛṣārūḍhaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sarvvābharaṇabhūṣitaṃ || 2 || kapālakhaṭvāṅadharaṃ ghaṇṭāḍamaruvāḍinaṃ || pāśāṅkuśadharaṃ devaṃ gadāmuśaladhāraṇaṃ || 3 || (fol. 1r1–5) End ānandabhairavīdhyānaṃ || || bhāvayec ca surā devī candrakoṭyayutaprabhām || himakundendudhavalāṃ pañcavaktrāṃ trilocanīm || 1 || aṣṭādaśabhujair yuktāṃ sarvvānandakarodyatām || prahasantī viśālākṣī devadevasya saṃmukhiṃ || dhyānaṃ || ▒ sudhādevyai namaḥ || || iti maṃtra[ḥ] || || || || (fol. 1v2–6) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || namaste śaraṇye śiveśānukampe namaste jagadvyāpike viśvarūpe || namste jagadvandyapādāravinde namaste jagatāriṇi trāhi durge || 1 || namste jagaccintyam ānandarūpe namaste mahāyogavijñānarūpe || namaste namaste sadānandarūe namasteºº || 2 || (fol. 1v1–2r1) End idaṃ stotraṃ mayā proktam āpadduddhāram aṣṭakam || trisandhyam ekasandhyaṃ vā paṭhanād ghoranāśanam || 10 || svarge rasātale caiva triṣu lokeṣu vidyate || sarvaduḥkhaharam proktam prāpnoti paramaṃ śubham || 11 || paṭhanāt tasya deveśi kin na sidhyati bhūtale || stavarājam idaṃ devi saṃkṣepāt kathitam mayā || 12 || || (fol. 3v4–4r5) Colophon iti śrīsiddheśvaratantre haragaurisamvāde āpaduddhārastotraṃ sampūrṇam || śubham astu || ||(fol. 4r5–4v2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || ambāmahāmāyāstotraṃ || || jagadaṃbe mahāmāye sthitisaṃhārakāriṇī || mahāśūnyāṃtarālasthe viśvacaitanyarūpiṇī || 1 || praṇamāmi parāśaktidivyajñānaprakāśinī || vindunādakalāvarṇāsarvvavyādhivivarjitā || 2 || jagadālhādinī nityā jagadāmodinīkṛtā || krodhodvegadayāśāṃtārūṇasarvve hṛdi sthitā || 3 || ādhāre nābhihṛtkaṇḍe bhūmadhye parameśvarī || tvam ekā jagato vyāptā rūparekhām agocarī || 4 || (fol. 54v1–554r2) End viśveśvariṃ viśvam anantaśaktyā prāṇāgnirūpā sthitiviśvavyāpinī || agocaraṃ aṃtar anādimadhya antar bahiḥ pūrakam ādirūpiṇī || 11 || kiṃ varṇayāmi tava dhyānarūpā brahmāsurendrair na hi śaknuvanti || yadā tadā janmani me bhavā⟨ṃ⟩nyā[s] tadā dṛḍho ʼhaṃ tava bhakticetanā || 12 || || (56r1–5) Colophon iti śrīśaktiyāmale urddhamahāmāyāstotram || || (fol. 56v1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha tripurasundarīśatanāmavidhi[ḥ] || dhyānam || hrīṁ bījaṃ klīṁ kīlakaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ || brahmāṇī caṃḍikā caṃḍī gaurī nārāyaṇī śivā || vārāhī- āsuri(!) durgā †malamaṃca† mahodarī † || || 1 || sāvatrī ca mahākālī kālikā ca kapālinī || kiṃtānī ca mahāgaurī kālarātrī vasundharā || 2 || śivadūtyā mahātejā viśvarūpā ca pārvatī || mohinī rohiṇī caiva rudrāṇī rukmiṇī kṣamā || 3 || (fol. 1r1–5) End aṣṭamī navamī caiva caturddaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || paṭhed vā pāṭhayed vāpi sarvakāmaphalaṃ bhavet || 11 || vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanaṃ || putrārthī labhate putrān mokṣārthī mokṣam āpnuyāt || 12 || || (fol. 1v13–5) Colophon iti śrītripurasundarīśatanāmastavarāja[ḥ] samāpta⟨m⟩[ḥ] || || śubham || (fol. 1v5)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrītripurāyai || || (tasyā[ḥ] paṃcāṅgam āha) || devy uvāca || bhagavan sarvvavettā tvaṃ jagatām upakārakaḥ || devādideva[ḥ] deveśa[ḥ] trailokyābhayadāyaka[ḥ] || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End sāraṃ tripurasundaryā rakṣaṇīyaṃ svaputravat || guptaṃ guhyatamaṃ gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 47 || || (fol. 9r1–2) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre devi(!)bhairavasaṃvāde tripurasundaryārahasyapaṭalaḥ samāpta⟨ṃ⟩[ḥ] || || || śubham astu || || || || (fol. 9r2–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama[ḥ] oṁ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai oṁ asya śrītripurasuṃdaryyā aṣṭottaraśatanāmastotramaṃtrasya dakṣiṇāmūrtti-ṛṣi[ḥ] gāyatrī chanda[ḥ] śrītripurasundarī devatā dharmmārthakāmamokṣārthy(!)e jape viniyogaḥ (fol. 1v1–3) End nāmnām aṣṭottaraśataṃ devyā dhyānasamantrikam paṭhed yaḥ śatatam bhaktyā tasya lakṣmī sthiro<ref name="ftn1"> for sthirā </ref> bhavet 14 (fol. 3r4–5) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale umāmaheśvarasamvāde śrītripurasundarī-aṣtottaraśatadivyanāmā(!)smṛtistotraṃ samāptaṃ śubham 1947 sala māghakṛṣṇanavami(!)maṃgalavāsare samāpti(!) (fol. 3r5–7)

Beginning śrīsundaryyai namaḥ || || devy uvāca || bhagavan bhāsitāśeṣaviśeṣakaruṇānidhe || devyās tripurasundaryyā maṃtranāmasahasrakaṃ || 1 || śrutvā dhārayatu deva †jñānasthā†varttate [ʼ]dhunā || kṛpayā kevalaṃ nātha tan mākhyātum a⟨r⟩ha[[rni]]si || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End aṣṭāṅgam yogam uddiṣṭaṃ parampātrasya lakṣaṇaṃ || pāśāṅkuśeṣu cāpān prasarahastāṃ cārukarakamalāṃ || ambām apāyakaruṇām vaṃde haṃ tripurasundarīn nityaṃ || 134 || (fol. 21r4–21v1) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale śrītripurasundarīdivyasahasranāmastotraṃ || || samāptam || || śubham || || idaṃ pustakaṃ śrībhairavarājadevajujuśarmmaṇaḥ(!) likhitaṃ śrīrājavaṃśīyasubbārāmabhaktasya nityapaṭhanārthe dattaṃ || śubham || ❁ || || rāmaḥ rāmaḥ rāmaḥ || rāmaḥ rāmaḥ || rādhāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ || rāmaḥ rāmaḥ rāmaḥ rāmaḥ (fol. 21v1–5)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrīmahātripurasundaryyai namaḥ || || ikṣukodaṇḍapuṣpeṣupāśāṅkuśacaturbhujām || udyatsūryyanibhāṃ vande mahātripurasundarīṃ || 1 || śrīdevy uvāca || || bhagavan bhāṣitāśeṣa viśeṣakaruṇānidhe || devyās tripusundaryyā maṃtranāmasahasrakaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End tathaiva strīpadaṃ naiva dīkṣayā sa[ṃ]skṛtā śive || dīkṣitari bhaktitaḥ kāryyā strīśūdraiś ca mahesvarī || 2 || sālagrāmaṃ vāṇaliṅgam pūjanāt siddhidam bhavet || || adīkṣitena dośaḥ pūrvvoktam etat || || śrīśivāya namaḥ || 146 || || (fol. 25r1–25v1) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale tripurasundarīsahasranāmastotraṃ samāpta⟨ḥ⟩[m] || ❁ || śubham astu || || strīśūdrābhyāṃ sparśamānaṃ tu adīkṣitapadam iti || || taduktam bhūtaḍāmaratantre || dīkṣayā sa[ṃ]skṛto devī(!), śūdrattvaṃ naiva vidyate || mahāmantraprabhāvena(!), śūdro vaiśyattvam āpnu[yāt] (fol. 25v1–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṁ asya śrītripurasundaryyā sahasranāmamantrasya īśvara ṛṣir anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrīmahātrpurasundarī devatā aiṁ bījaṃ sauṁ⟨ḥ⟩ śaktiḥ klīṁ kīlakaṃ tatprasādārthe amukapuṣpaiḥ sahasrasaṃkhyākanāmamantreṇārcane viniyogaḥ || || atha dhyānam || || ikṣukodaṇḍapuṣpañ ca pāśāṅkuśacaturbhujām || udyatsūryyanibhām vande mahātripurasundarīm || || (fol. 1v1–2r3) End tripurāyai 2 || 21 || śriyai 2 || 22 || trijananyai 2 || 23 || bhairavyai 2 || 24 || tripurasundaryyai 2 || 25 || || iti nāmāvalī || || pāśāṅkuśekṣucāpām prasrahastāṃ cārukarakamalāṃ || ambām āpāyakaruṇāṃ vande haṃ tripurasundarīm nityam || || || (fol. 41v2–42r1) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmaloktaśrīmahātripurasundaryyā sahasranāmāvalyaḥ maṃtrāḥ samāptā jātā śrīmahātripurasundarī prītāstu || || vāṇavāṇanavacandrasaṃyute vikrame ʼdhikasite ʼṣṭamītithu || āśvine śaradi bhārgave dine pustakaṃ janakanāma(!) prālikhat || 1 || śrītripurasandarīdevyā(!)rpaṇam astu || || || || śubham astu sarvadā || (fol. 42r1–42v2)

«Beginning of the 1. Tripurasundarīstuti:» ❖ śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || || ādhāre taruṇārkkabimbaruciraṃ hemaprabham vāgbhavaṃ bījaṃ manmatham indragopasadṛśaṃ hṛtpaṅkaje saṃsthitaṃ || randhre brahmapadasthaśaktim aparaṃ somaprabhaṃ bhāsvaraṃ ye dhyāyanti padatrayaṃ tava śive te yānti mokṣam padaṃ || 1 || || (exp. 3t1–4) «End of the 2. Kāmarūpakāmākhyapīṭha:» pañcamānāṃ drutaṃ siddhir amānāṃ naiva jāyate || tad yuktyā hyādimādīnāṃ siddhikālo(!)pagamyatāṃ || 3 || śrīvidyāyās tu mūlaṃ tan māsi māsi kṣared rajaḥ || kulasiddhasya lope tu rajastmbham prajāyate || 4 || || iti || || (exp. 4b3–5) «Colophon of the 1. Tripurasundarīstuti:» iti tripurasundarīstutiḥ || || samāptaḥ(!) || || (exp. 4t4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ atha tripurāsahasranāmaṃ(!) || || kailāsaśikhare ramye nānāratnopaśobhite || kalpapāda[[pa]]madhyasthe siddhagandharvvasevite || 1 || maṇimaṇḍapamadhyasthe nānāpuṣpopaśobhite || taṃ kadācit sukhāsīnaṃ bhagavantaṃ jagadguruṃ || 2 || (fol. 26v1–4) End tatkoṭiguṇitaṃ puṇyaṃ sakṛj japtvā labhen naraḥ || śrutvā mahābalaṃ putraṃ putravat sarvvasampadaḥ || 75 || dehānte paramaṃ sthānaṃ yat surair atidurllabham || sa yāsyati na sandehaḥ stavarājaprakīrttanāt || 76 || (fol. 53v1–4) Colophon iti śrīvāmakeśvaratantre skandaśaṅkarasamvāde sundarīsahasranāmastotraṃ samāptam || || śubham || || (fol. 53v4–5)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrīmahātripurasundaryyai namaḥ || || ikṣuko daṇḍapuṣpeṣupāśāṅkuśacaturbhujām || udyatsūryyanibhāṃ vande mahātripurasundarīṃ || 1 || śrīdevy uvāca || || bhagavan bhāṣitāśeṣa viśeṣakaruṇānidhe || devyās tripurasundaryyā maṃtranāmasahasrakaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End aṣṭāṅgayogam uddiṣṭaṃ param pātrasya lakṣaṇaṃ || [[|| 44 || ||]] paśāṃkuśeṣucāpām prasarahastāṃ cārukarakamalāṃ || ⟪143⟫ ambām āpāyakaruṇām vande haṃ tripurasundari(!)n nityaṃ ⟪|| 142 ||⟫[[|| 145 || ||]] (fol. 23r5–23v3) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale śrītripurasundarīsahasranāmastotraṃ samāpta⟨ḥ⟩[m] || || śubhaṃ bhūyāt sarvvadākāle śubha || ❁ || || || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 23v3–5)

Beginning śrīvaradamūrttiṃ vande || || śrīvidyāyai namaḥ || oṁ tisraḥ puras tripathā viśvacarṣaṇīr yatrākathā akṣarāsanniviṣṭā || adhiṣṭhāyai nāma jarāpurāṇī mahattarā mahimā devatānām || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End iyaṃ mahopaniṣat tripurāyāyām akṣaraṃ parame gīrbhir īḍe || eṣarjyajuparame tacca sāmevāyam atharveyam anyāyavidyom || 16 || ya evaṃ vedety upaniṣat || śrītripurasundaryāḥ śam (fol. 3v5–6) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ dvinetraṃ karuṇānidhiṃ || varābhayaṃ karam va[n]de śrīguruṃ śivarūpiṇaṃ || 1 || bhaktājñānatamo bhānuṃ murddhni paṅkajasaṃsthitaṃ || sadāśivamayaṃ nityaṃ śrīguruṃ praṇamāmy ahaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End divyacandanaliptāṅga sadā viṃśativārṣikaḥ || sa bhuṃkte sakalā⟨ṃ⟩[n] bhogān devaloke naraḥ sadā || 21 || tasmād etat paraṃ stotraṃ tripurāhṛdayaṃ śubhaṃ || japed yaḥ satataṃ bhaktyā bhavet sākṣāt sadāśivaḥ || 222 || (fol. 29v1–4) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale śrīmattripurasundarīhṛdayastotraṃ sampūrṇam || śubha⟨ṃ⟩m || tripurā prīnātu || || (fol. 29v4–5)

Beginning śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || || śrīmātas tripure trāhi, paraṃ nirvvāṇadāyinī(!) || śṛīguroś caraṇāmbhoja,siddho [ʼ]smi tvatpraśādataḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End antaścaraṇabhūtānāṃ, draṣṭṛttvaṃ parameśvari || devā(!) dātā ca bhoktā ca, devaḥ sarvvam idaṃ jagat || 6 || devo jayati sarvvatra, yo devaḥ sa maheśvaraḥ || || (fol. 2r3–5) Colophon iti kṣamāpana(!)stutiḥ || ❁ (fol. 2r5)

«Beginning of the 1. Tripuradevīhṛdayastotra:» oṁ śrītripurāyai namaḥ || [[lṛṁ oṁ śrīṁ trīṁ lṛṁ ▒ aiṃ klīṁ (dhauṁ) || dhyānaṃ || bālārkkamanḍalābhāṣāṃ caturbbāhutrilocanāṃ || pāśāṅkuśaśarāś(!) cā⟪‥⟫[[pāṃ]] dhārayantīṃ śivām bhaje<ref name="ftn2"> The Saptaśatīcaṇḍī reads: pāśāṅkuśavarābhītīrdhārayantīṃ śivām bhaje </ref> || 1 || || śrībhairava uvāca ||]] || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi hṛdayaṃ paramādbhutaṃ || kasyacin naiva cākhyātaṃ śrūyatāṃ naganandini || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) «End of the 2. Gaṇeśastotra:» pāṇau yasya ca modakākṣayugalaṃ dantaṅ kuṭhārāyudhaṃ || candrābham mada[[kā]]ttanāgavadanam vyālopavī(tyu)jjvalaṃ ⟨|| 1 ||⟩ yakṣendraiḥ surakinnarair munivarair devaiḥ sadā vanditāṃ || vighneśaṃ satatan namāmi śirasā kāmārthasiddhipradam || 2 || || (fol. 5v2–5) «Colophon of the 2. Gaṇeśastotra:» iti śrīgaṇeśastotraṃ sampūrṇam || || || maṅgalam astu sarvvadā || || (fol. 5v5–6)

«Beginning of the 1. Tripuradevīhṛdayastotra:» oṁ śrītripurāyai namaḥ || [[lṛṁ oṁ śrīṁ trīṁ lṛṁ ▒ aiṃ klīṁ (dhauṁ) || dhyānaṃ || bālārkkamanḍalābhāṣāṃ caturbbāhutrilocanāṃ || pāśāṅkuśaśarāś(!) cā⟪‥⟫[[pāṃ]] dhārayantīṃ śivām bhaje<ref name="ftn2"> The Saptaśatīcaṇḍī reads: pāśāṅkuśavarābhītīrdhārayantīṃ śivām bhaje </ref> || 1 || || śrībhairava uvāca ||]] || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi hṛdayaṃ paramādbhutaṃ || kasyacin naiva cākhyātaṃ śrūyatāṃ naganandini || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) «End of the 2. Gaṇeśastotra:» pāṇau yasya ca modakākṣayugalaṃ dantaṅ kuṭhārāyudhaṃ || candrābham mada[[kā]]ttanāgavadanam vyālopavī(tyu)jjvalaṃ ⟨|| 1 ||⟩ yakṣendraiḥ surakinnarair munivarair devaiḥ sadā vanditāṃ || vighneśaṃ satatan namāmi śirasā kāmārthasiddhipradam || 2 || || (fol. 5v2–5) «Colophon of the 2. Gaṇeśastotra:» iti śrīgaṇeśastotraṃ sampūrṇam || || || maṅgalam astu sarvvadā || || (fol. 5v5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || devy uvāca || bhagavan sarvvadharmmajña sarvvaśāstrārthapāraga⟨ḥ⟩ || triśaktirūpālakṣmyāś ca kavacaṃ yat prakāśitam || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End bra⟨ṃ⟩hmāstrādīni śastrāṇi naiva kṛntati tattanum || etat kavacam ajñātvā yo japet parameśvarī[m] || 23 || dāridryaṃ paramam prāpya so cirān mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 24 || (fol. 5r5–5v3) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale triśaktyāḥ sarvvārthasādhanaṃ nāma kavacaṃ samāptaṃ || iti tripurāṭā(!)kavacaṃ || || śrītriśaktiḥ devyārpaṇam astu⟨ḥ⟩ || || śubhaṃ || bhūyāt || (fol. 5v3–5)

Beginning śrīpārvatyai namaḥ || || parisphuritatejasāṃ nicayasundare nirmmale mṛgotthamalayodbhavaṃ dravacitāṃ suratnodayāṃ || gṛhāṇa maṇipāduko †manupamāṃ† surendrārccitāṃ mahātripurasundarīprakaṭakiṃkiṇīsṛṃjitāṃ || 1 || paṃcapretamayoccamantracaraṇaṃ dharmādipādānvitaṃ || caṃcatkāṃcanahīranīraghaṭitaṃ śrīkhaṇḍapaṃkāṃkitaṃ || sū(!)trāmāgnimarunniśācarayamāṃbhodhīśasadmeṃdubhiḥ samyak pūjitam ullasan maṇimayaṃ bhadrāśanaṃ gṛhyatāṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–2r2) End vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgaśaṅkhapaṭahadhvānair vipaṃci(!)kvaṇaiḥ stālānaddhatatādivādyasahitais tauryyatrikaiḥ nartakaiḥ || gītaiḥ kiṃnaranāradāditanitair †vidyādharīṇā† śive śrīmātas tava sarvadā kalakalo raṅgāṅgaṇe ʼstv ā(!)ṃbike || 24 || ebhiḥ caturvimśatibhiḥ padyaiḥ stoṣyati yo [ʼ]mbikāṃ || sarvvopācārajaṃ puṇyaṃ sa prāpnoti mahāyaśāḥ || 25 || (fol. 8r3–8v3) Colophon iti śrīsundaryyā mahākarmārcanapaddhatyāṃ upacārasaparyyāvidhir nāma tripurāmānasopacārasotraṃ sampūrṇaṃ⟨m⟩ śubham || || śrīparāmbādevyārppaṇam astu⟨ḥ⟩ || || ❁ || || (fol. 8v3–5)

Beginning śrīlalitabhairavāya namaḥ || || pārvvaty uvāca || || bhagavan devadeveśa sṛṣṭisthitivināśakṛt || kathitaṃ bhavatā samyak sundaryāḥ paramottamam || 1 || pūjāvidhiṃ tathāṅgāni tathā kāmyakriyāṇi ca || idānīṃ śrotum icchāmi laliteśasya śaṅkara || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End devi bhaktirasa†māvita†vṛtteḥ prīyatāṃ yadi kuto pi labhyate || tatra laulayamatisatphalam ekaṃ janmakoṭibhir apīha na labhyaṃ || 18 || etaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ padyair upacāropakalpitaiḥ || yaḥ parāṃ devatāṃ stauti sa teṣāṃ phalam āpnuyāt || 19 || (fol. 7r4–7v2) Colophon iti śrīvāmakeśvarataṃtre tripurasundarīmānasīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || ❁ || atra tripurasundarīti padena kevalaṃ sundarīmatam uktāṃ(!) sarvvasādhāra[ṇa]tvenaivoktaṃ bhavatīti jñeyam || śubhaṃ || samāptam || ❁ || (fol. 7v2–5)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ tripurādevyai || aiṁ klīṁ sauṁ || || jaya tvaṃ trpurādevī(!) nirmmale jyotirūpiṇī(!) || candrārkkavahnimadhyasthe divyāmṛtasvarūpiṇī(!) || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End liṃgamu(dryā) na nirbhidya nirgatāṃ parameśvarī || bhairavena(!) namaskṛtya kāmahlādena sundarī || suṣumn(!)pathamārgeṇa nirgatāṃ tripureśvarī || 9 || || (fol. 3v2–4) Colophon iti śrītripuraśuṃdarī-āvāhanatripurāmālinīdaṃḍakaṃ samāptam śubham || || bhūyāt sadā || ❁ || śṛīmantripurasundarī prīṇātu || ❁ || śubham || || (fol. 3v4–5)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrītripurāyai || || aiṁ klīṁ sauṃ⟨ḥ⟩ || || jaya tvaṃ tripurādevī nirmale jyotirrūpiṇī || candrārkkavahnimadhyasthe divyāmṛtasvarūpiṇī || 1 || jananī viśvavyāpī tvaṃ kuṇḍalākārarūpiṇī || mātas tripathagā devī trāhi māṃ tripureśvarī || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End kṣamasveti parādevī jananī viśvavyāpinī || liṅgam udyānanirbhidya nirgatā parameśvarī || 3 || bhairaveṇa namaskṛtya kāmāhlādena sundarī || suṣumṇāpathamārgeṇa nirgatā tripureśvarī || 4 || || (fol. 5r2–5v1) Colophon iti śrītripurāmālinīdaṇḍakaṃ sampūrṇam śubham || || || || || || (fol. 5v1–2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīdevy uvāca || || oṁ bhava sarvva maheśāna niḥśeṣakaruṇānidhe || mahātripurasundaryyā vada nāmasahasrakam || 1 || mantrabharbbhaṃ vibho deva kalām īpsitadaṃ nṛṇām || śrutvā dhārayituṃ devam avācyaṃ vartte [ʼ]dhunā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End sarvvasampatkaraṃ devi sarvvadāridryanāśanam || sarvvarogaharam puṇyaṃ sarvvopadravanāśanam || 64 || ai(!)tena mantrarājena sahasrākhyastavena ca || madhunā māṃsanaivedyaiḥ pūjayed yas tu sundarīm || 65 || tasya devi kalau bhūmau sarvvam vaśya[ṃ] bhaved dhruvam || 65 || || (fol. 35v5–36r2) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmalatantre umāmaheśvarasamvāde śrīmahātripurasundarīmantragarbhasahasranāmastotraṃ sampūrṇam || || śubham bhūyāt sadā sarvvadā || || viśveśvari viśvam anantaśaktyā prāṇāgnirūpā sthitiviśvavyāpinī || agocaraṃ antararādimadhyā antarbbahiḥ pūrakam ādirūpiṇī || 11 || kim varṇayāme(!) tava dhāmarūpā brahmāsurendrai[r] nahi śakra(!)vanti || yadā tadā janmani me bhavāṃ(!)nyā tadā dṛḍho haṃ tava bhakticetanā || 12 || || yad akṣara[ṃ] pada[ṃ] bhraṣṭam mātrāhīnaṃ ca yad bhavet || kṣantum arhasi me devi, kasya vai niścalam manaḥ || 1 || || iti śrīsamvat 1974 sāla vaiśākhavadī 3 roja 3 caitra 29 gate kā dina mīrasubbārāmabhaktale nepāladu⟪ga⟫vahīṭola 7 nambarako gharamā lekheko 71 varṣako umeramā samvatsaraśuklanāma thiyo śubham || || || || || || (fol. 36r2–36v6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha tārāṣṭakaprāraṃbha[ḥ] mātar nīlasarasvati praṇamatāṃ saubhāgyasaṃpatprade pratyālīḍhapadasthite śivahṛdi samerananāṃbhoruhe || phulleṃdīvaralocanatrayayute †kartrī†kapālotpale khaḍgaṃ cādadhatī(!) tvam eva śaraṇaṃ tvām īśvarīm āśraye || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End kīrttiṃ kāṃtiṃ ca nairujyaṃ sarveṣāṃ priyatāṃ vrajet || vikhyātiṃ cāpi lokeṣu prāpyāṃte mokṣam āpnuyāt || 11 || (fol. 2v5) Colophon iti nīlataṃtre tārāṣṭakaṃ saṃpū[r]ṇam || yādṛsaṃ pusta[[ka]]m dṛṣṭvā tādṛsaṃ likhitam mayā || yadi suddham a[śu]ddho(!) vā mama doṣo na dīyate || 1 || yad akṣara[ṃ] padaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhi(!)naṃ ca ye(!)t bhavet || tat sarva[ṃ] kṣami(!)tāṃ devī(!) prasi(!)da parameśvarī(!) idaṃ pustakaṃ likhitaṃ jānakīprasādasarmaṇā || śrīśāradāyai namaḥ || śubham (fol. 2v6–7)

Beginning śrīṁ paradevatāyai namaḥ || || oṁ aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ (hphreṁ) (hmauṁ)⟨ḥ⟩ || kiṁ kiṁ duḥkhaṃ sakalajananī(!) kṣīyate na smṛtāyāṃ kā kā kīrttikulakamalinī(!) prāpyate na smṛtāyāṃ⟨ḥ⟩ || kiṁ kiṁ saukhyaṃ suravaranute prāpyate na smṛtāyāṃ kaṁ kaṁ yogaṃ tvayi na cinute cittam ālambitāyāṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End japo jalpaḥ śilpaṃ sakalam api mudrāviracanaṃ gatiḥ prādakṣiṇyakaramaṇam adanādyāhutividhiḥ || praṇāma[[ḥ]] saṃveśaḥ sukham ahilam ātmārppaṇadṛśā[ṃ] saparyyā paryyāyas tava bhavatu yan me vilasitaṃ || 10 || (fol. 5r3–5) Colophon iti śrītripurasundarīmahākarmārcaṇa(!)paddhatyāṃ sundaryyāḥ aparādhakṣamastutiḥ nāgojībhaṭṭakṛto(!) yaṃ || śubham || ❁ || (fol. 5r6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīdevy uvāca || śrīmattripurasundaryyāḥ śatam aṣṭottaraṃ śiva || nāmnāṃ tvayā puroddiṣṭaṃ tad idāni(!)ṃ prakāśāya || 1 || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu devi varārohe paramānandavigrahe || sāraṃ samastataṃtrāṇāṃ nāmnām āṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End prātaḥ prātaḥ paṭhed yas tu stavaṃ ciṃtāmaṇiṃ priye || karasthāḥ siddhayas tasya mukhe tiṣṭhati bhāratī || 17 || āyur ārogyam aiśvaryyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ yaśaḥ kulam || samastaṃ varddhate tasya paḥ paṭhet stotram anvaham || 18 || || (fol. 2v6–3r1) Colophon iti śrīyāmale tripurasundaryā aṣṭottaraśatanāmastotram sampūrṇam || || || || || śrītripurasundaryyai namaḥ || || || || || || || || || || || (fol. 3r2–3)

Beginning śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || || sarasacandanakuṃkumalepitaṃ surakirīṭa[[su]]nirdhanabhāsvaraṃ || vividhavṛddhikaraṃ sukhadaṃ nṛṇāṃ tripuramālini ratnasupādeke || 1 || śrīśāṃbhavo(!) prītikaraṃ manojñaṃ brahmādibhir vanditapādapīṭhe || ratnottamaiḥ kāṃcanam ujjvalaśrī- siṃhāsanaṃ gṛhṇa mayā pradattaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End bherīmarddalaśaṃkhaviṇuninadair viprais tu vedadhvaniṃ śrīmannāradatumburuprabhṛtibhi⟨ḥ⟩r ge(!)gīyamānaṃ sadā || nṛtyaṃ tasya raso mudāramanasā kolāhalaṃ śrūyate || deveśi tripure trilok⟨y⟩aja[na]nī(!) tvatpādapūjārccane || 16 || (fol. 5r5–5v3) Colophon iti śrīsundarīdevyā ṣoḍaśopacārastava⟨ṃ⟩[ḥ] || śubhaṃ || || sa⟨ṃ⟩mpūrṇam || śrīsundarīśaraṇa⟨ḥ⟩[m] || || (fol. 5v3–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || lṛṁ oṁ śrīṁ trīṁ lṛṁ ▒ aiṁ klīṁ sauṁ⟨ḥ⟩ || bālārkkamaṇḍalābhāsāṃ caturbbāhuṃ trilacanāṃ || pāśāṅkuśaśara⟨ś⟩cāpā⟨ṃ⟩[n] dhārayantīṃ śivām bhaje || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End sarvatīrthasamaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvayogaphalaṃ tathā || ekāvṛtyādipāṭhena sarvvasiddhir bhaved dhruvaṃ || 29 || (fol. 6v1–3) Colophon iti śrīdevīyāmalataṃtre tripurādevyā hṛdayaṃ saṃpūrṇam || śubham || śrīmacchrīśrīmadrājavaṃsīyasubbārāmabhaktasyārthe śrībhairavarājajujuśarmaṇā likhitaṃ || || (fol. 6v3–5)

Beginning śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || || devendrādibhir arcitaṃ suragaṇai⟨ḥ⟩r ādāya siṃhāsanaṃ cañcanasañcayābhirasitaṃ<ref name="ftn1"> possible reading: cañcaccandanasañcayābhiracitaṃ </ref> cāru prabhaṃ bhāsuram || etac campakakeṭa(!)kīparimale tailaṃ tathā nirjalaṃ gandhodvarttanam ādareṇa taruṇīdattaṃ gṛhāṇāṃbike || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End etaiḥ ṣodaśabhiḥ padyair upacāropakalpitaiḥ || yaḥ parāṃ devatāṃ stauti sa teṣāṃ phalam āpnuyāt || 19 || (fol. 6r5–6v1) Colophon iti śrīvāmakeśvarataṃtre tripurasuṃdarīmānasīstavaṃ sampūrṇam || atra tripurasuṃdarītipadena kevalaṃ sundarīmatam uktā(!)ṃ sarvvasādhāra[ṇa]tvenaivoktaṃ bhavatīti jñeyam || || śrīmaddūrddhāmnāyarājarājeśvarīparadevatātripurasuṃdarīdevyā(!)rppaṇam astu || || śrī(!)yo stu⟨ḥ⟩ || || sadā⟨ḥ⟩ || || (fol. 6v1–4)

«Beginning of 1. Triśaktidevīstotra:» śrīgaṇeśāya nama[ḥ] || || oṁ namaś caṇḍī(!)kāyai || || varāha uvāca || || śṛṇu cānyad varārohe tasyā devyā mahāvidhiṃ || yā sā triśaktir uddiṣṭāḥ śivena parameṣṭhinā || (fol. 1v1–3) «End of 2. Rudramāhātmya:» yaś cārodhayate tās tu tasya rudro pi tuṣyati || siddhānte tās tadā devyā maṃtriṇī nātraśaṃsayaḥ || (❁) || (fol. 8v3–4) «Colophon of 2. Rudramāhātmya:» ī(!)tyādivarāhapū(!)rāṇe rudramāhātmyaṃ samāpta[m] || ❁ || samvat (1935) sālamiti śrāvaṇamāsya(!) kṛṣṇapakṣe (dvā)dasī roja ‥ śukravāra(!) liṣī(!)tam || śubham || (fol. 8v4–6)

«Beginning of 1. Triśaktidevīstotra:» śrīgaṇeśāya nama[ḥ] || || oṁ namaś caṇḍī(!)kāyai || || varāha uvāca || || śṛṇu cānyad varārohe tasyā devyā mahāvidhiṃ || yā sā triśaktir uddiṣṭāḥ śivena parameṣṭhinā || (fol. 1v1–3) «End of 2. Rudramāhātmya:» yaś cārodhayate tās tu tasya rudro pi tuṣyati || siddhānte tās tadā devyā maṃtriṇī nātraśaṃsayaḥ || (❁) || (fol. 8v3–4) «Colophon of 2. Rudramāhātmya:» ī(!)tyādivarāhapū(!)rāṇe rudramāhātmyaṃ samāpta[m] || ❁ || samvat (1935) sālamiti śrāvaṇamāsya(!) kṛṣṇapakṣe (dvā)dasī roja ‥ śukravāra(!) liṣī(!)tam || śubham || (fol. 8v4–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṁ brahmādayaḥ stutiśatari api sūkṣmarūpāṃ jānaṃti naiva jagadādim anādimūrttim || tasmād vayaṃ kucanatāṃ tava kuṃkumābhyāṃ sthūlāṃ stumaḥ sakalavāṅmayamātrarūpām || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End ya stuvaṃti jaganmātaḥ ślokair dvādaśabhiḥ kramāt || tvām anuprāpya vāksiddhiṃ prāpnuyus ta(!)parāṃ śriyam || 15 || ❁ || (fol. 4v1–2) Colophon iti śrītripurabhairavīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ samāptam śubham || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 4v2–3)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || turīyākhyaṃ sahasrānāma sundaryyā[ḥ] parikathyate || || śrīdevy uvāca || samadhyuparamaṃ kānta,m ekadā vijane mudā || pramānandasandoha,tundi⟨ra⟩[la]ṃ prāha pārvvatī || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End āsvādam asyā yo veda,⟨s⟩ tasya (vasyāsthito) jagat || āhlādasundarīdhyānā,t sundarīnāmakīrttanāt || 210 || sadānandāsyā sa yāyāt sadā na prajāyate<ref name="ftn1"> unmetrical </ref> || || (fol. 21r1–4) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale turīyāsahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 21r4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyai namaḥ || brahmā śa⟨ṃ⟩krādivaṃdyaḥ śaśadharakamalālaṃkṛtāṃghris trimūrttiḥ sarvajñaḥ sendukhaṇḍo madhumathanasamāliṅgito śaudi(!)mūrttiḥ haṃse sānāviṇāgrī vidhurati valitau dakṣiṇe kālike tvāṃ bhūyas te sarvasiddhyai sadahanalalanāsaṃgatāṃ prodgṛṇaṃti 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End mahākālasukhād<ref name="ftn1"> for ºº mukhād </ref> vāṇī niḥsṛtā jagatītale || stavarājeti vikhyātā dakṣiṇāyāḥ sadā paṭhan || 16 || śra[d]dhāsaṃtatisaṃyukto dhandhānyasamanvitaḥ || bhagavatyāḥ kaṭākṣeṇa kṣamāpālasamo bhavet || 17 || (fol. 4r4–6) Colophon iti śrīmahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ dakṣiṇakālikāyāḥ stavarāja[ḥ] samāpta⟨ṃ⟩[ḥ] śubham (fol. 4r6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || dhyānaṃ || || aiṁ (5) tumveśvarī[ṃ] mahādevī[ṃ] namāmi ripughātinī[m] || dāḍimīpuṣpasaṅkāśā[ṃ] jvalanmadhye vicantayet || 1 || (exp. 2t1–2) End brahmāṇyādhyā mātṛvṛnde pūjanīyā maheśvarī || dhyāyamānaḥ sadā durggā[ṃ] namāmi sarvvadevatā[m] || 7 || || aiṁ (5) ▒ tumveśvarī[ṃ] mahādevī[ṃ] śrīpā[ṃ] pūjayāmi || 3 || || || || (exp. 2b3–5) Colophon

Beginning ❖ śrī[ḥ] || || rudracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍogrā caṇḍanāyikā⟨ṃ⟩ || caṇḍā ca caṇḍavatī caiva caṇḍarūpā ca caṇḍikā || 1 || || || (fol. 1v1–2) End oṁ hrīṁ rājaprade khphreṁ ugracaṇḍe ripumarddanī(!) hūṁ phreṁ sadā rakṣa 2 tvāṃ māṃ jūṁsa mṛtyu[ṃ] hara namaḥ svāhā || || ugracaṇḍāyā mūla[m] || || || āṁ kroṁ hrīṁ khphreṁ kṣrīṁ śrīṁ phreṁ svāhā || 9 || kumārī(!)yā mūla[m] || || || || || || || || || || || (fol. 3v2–5) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha trailokyamohanakavacaṃ || || śrīdevy uvāca || śrīmantripurasundaryyā yā yā vidyā[[ḥ]] suvallabhāḥ || kṛpayā kathitā[[ḥ]] sarvvā[[ḥ]] śrutvā cādhigatā mayā || 1 || (fol. 10v1–3) End nalakṣaṃ prajaptvāpi tasya vidhyā na siddhyati || śastraghātam avāpnoti daridraśrīm<ref name="ftn1"> probably for draridraśriyam </ref> avāpnuyāt || 54 || || (fol. 18r3–5) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde mahātripurasundaryyātrailokyamohanakavacaṃ samāptam || || (fol. 18r5–18v1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṁ nama[ḥ] dakṣiṇakālikāyai || || devy uvāca || devadeva mahādeva saṃsāraprītikāraka || mahāvidyeśvarīvidyā[ṃ] mayi tvaṃ kathaya prabho || 1 || || śrīśiva uvāca || śṛṇu devi mahāvidyāṃ sarvavodyottamottamā[m] || sarveśvarīmahāvidyāṃ sarvadevaprapūjitāṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End gurumaṃtraṃ samaṃ jñātvā yo japet kavacottamaṃ || tasya vidyā bhavet siddhā satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane || 64 || ya⟨ḥ⟩<ref name="ftn1"> According to a stanza from the Pratisaṃskṛtasiddhāntakaumudī Sandhi-rule should be followed in the verse form. saṃhitaikapade nityā nityā dhātūpasargayoḥ nityā samāse vākye tu sāvivakṣāmapekṣate || ślokasyābhyantare nityā gadyavākye nijeccchayā ... </ref> idaṃ kavacaṃ divyaṃ prakāśya śiva hā bhavet || bhaktāya jyeṣṭhaputrāya śaivakāya prakāśayet || 65 || ❁ || (fol. 7v1–3) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale devīsvarasaṃvāde trailokyamohanaṃ nāma kālīkavacaṃ samāptam || || iti samvat 1931 sāla sauramānena bhādrapadamāse dina 23 gate ādityavāsare likhitaṃ samāptam || ❁ || (fol. 7v3–5)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || || devy uvāca || †īśvarodbhāṣitāśeṣaḥ† viśeṣakaruṇānidhe || devyā[ḥ] tripurasundaryyā mantranāmaśataṃ diśa || 1 || || īśvaro(!)vāca || kalyāṇī tripurā bālā māyā tripurasundarī || sauṁ⟨ḥ⟩ sundarī bhāgyavatī klīṁ kālī sarvvamaṅgalā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End trikoṇamadhyanilayā ṣaṭkoṇapuravāsinī || navakoṇapurāvāṇaḥ bindusthānasamanvitā || 13 || nāmnām aṣṭottaraśataṃ devyā sthānasamantrakaṃ || paṭhed ya[[ḥ]] śatatam bhaktyā tasya lakṣmī sthiro(!) bhavet || 14 || || (fol. 2v4–7) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale umāmaheśvarasamvāde śrīmanmahātripurasundaryyā [a]ṣṭottaraśatanāmastotraṃ samāptam || || śubham || || (fol. 2v4–8)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmyai || || oṁkārarūpā[ṃ] himaśuddhadehāṃ pañcānanā[ṃ] pañcadaśāyatākṣīṃ || virājamānāṃ daśabhiḥ karābjaiḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmīm praṇamāmi nittyam || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End hariharamukhapadmān niḥsṛtaṃ sidddhilakṣmī⟨ḥ⟩- stavam iva ⟨m⟩atiguhyaṃ rājitaṃ mantrarājaiḥ || paṭhati bhuvi sadā yaḥ kṣīṇavitto pi martyaḥ sa bhavati naranāthaḥ sarvvarājendrasevyaḥ || 10 || || (fol. 3r4–3v2) Colophon iti śrīmahā[r]ṇavatantre navākṣarastotraḥ || || || || || || || || || yad akṣra[ṃ] pada[ṃ] bhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnaṃ ca yad bhavet || kṣantum arhasi me devi kasya vai niścalam manaḥ || 1 || || kṣamasva jananī(!) kṛpāṃ kuru || || || (fol. 3v2–5)

«Beginning of 1. Āpaduddhārastotra:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || namas te śaraṇye śive śānukampe namas te jagadvyāpike viśvarūpe || namas te jagadvaṃdyapādāravinde namas te jagattāriṇi trāhi durge || 1 || (fol. 1r1–2) «End of 2. Pañcavaktrastotra:» etāni vaktrakamalāni maheśvarasya ye kīrttayanti manujāḥ satataṃ prabhāte || sa⟨n⟩[ṃ]sārasāgarbhayāt sahasā vimuktā yāsyanti te śivapadaṃ rucirair vimānaiḥ || 7 || || (fol. 2v10–12) «Colophon of 1. Āpaduddhārastotra:» iti śrīsiddheśvaratantre haragauri(!)saṃvāde a(!)paduddhārastotraṃ sampūrṇam || || śubham astu || (fol. 2r5) «Colophon of 2. Pañcavaktrastotra:» iti śrīpañcavaktrastotraṃ samāptam || || śubham || || (fol. 2v12)

«Beginning of 1. Āpaduddhārastotra:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || namas te śaraṇye śive śānukampe namas te jagadvyāpike viśvarūpe || namas te jagadvaṃdyapādāravinde namas te jagattāriṇi trāhi durge || 1 || (fol. 1r1–2) «End of 2. Pañcavaktrastotra:» etāni vaktrakamalāni maheśvarasya ye kīrttayanti manujāḥ satataṃ prabhāte || sa⟨n⟩[ṃ]sārasāgarbhayāt sahasā vimuktā yāsyanti te śivapadaṃ rucirair vimānaiḥ || 7 || || (fol. 2v10–12) «Colophon of 1. Āpaduddhārastotra:» iti śrīsiddheśvaratantre haragauri(!)saṃvāde a(!)paduddhārastotraṃ sampūrṇam || || śubham astu || (fol. 2r5) «Colophon of 2. Pañcavaktrastotra:» iti śrīpañcavaktrastotraṃ samāptam || || śubham || || (fol. 2v12)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || namas te draupadī devī sundarī<ref name="ftn1"> Should be in vocative form. </ref> subhr[ū]locane || su-aṅgiṇī bhīmapatnī draupadī tvaṃ namo stu te || [1] (fol. 1v1–2) End idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhed⟨d⟩ ādau cānte bhīmavṛkodara⟨ṃ⟩[ḥ] || pūjanīyaḥ pratnena phalaṃ prāpnoti mānava[ḥ] || 16 || (fol. 4r4–5) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale draupadībhīmabhairavīstotraṃ || (fol. 4r5)

Beginning oṁ namo dhanadāyai || || || śrībhairavy uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi dhanadākavaca[ṃ] śubhaṃ || kathayāmi tava snehād sāvadhānāvadhāraya⟨t⟩ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End sukhinīva bhavaṃntīra(!) mandrāramālikā yathā || ī(!)daṃ kavacam ajñātvā dhanadā[ṃ] prabhajet tu yaḥ || 11 || satalakṣaprajapto pi tasya vidyā na siddhyati || (fol. 2v2–5) Colophon iti śrīrudrajā(!)malataṃtre dhandālakṣmīkavacaṃ samāptam || śubham || || || oṁ hanubhairavāya vidmahe śatrusaṃhārāya dhi(!)mahi tan no raudra pracodayāt || 108 japagāyatri(!)paṃcaktrako || saṃvat 1873 sāla bhādravadi 5 roja 3 || śubham (fol. 2v5–8)

«Beginning of 1. Navagrahakavaca:» śrīgaṇeśam vande || || śrīkārttikeya uvāca || || devadeva mahādeva jagad ⟨d⟩e⟨ca⟩[tac] carācaraṃ || grahāṇāñ ca katham proktaṃ śāntimuktiḥ katham bhavet || 1 || || śrīrudra uvāca || śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi tava prītyam ahaṃ sadā || devāsurair †abadhyante† rogaśokavināśanam || 2 || (fol. 1 "1 st foliation"r1–4) «End of the 2. Prajñāvarddhanastotra:» aṣṭāviṃśatināmāni madīyāni ca yaḥ paṭhet || pratyuṣe<ref name="ftn2"> for pratyūṣe </ref> śraddhayā yukto mūko vācaspatir ⟨bh⟩[b]bhavet || 5 || mahāmantramayānīti mama nāmānukīrttanāt || mahāprajñām avāpnoti nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā || 6 || || (fol. 2 "2 nd foliation"v5–8) «Colophon of 2. Prajñāvarddhanastotra:» iti prajāvarddhanastotram || || śubham bhavatu || || || || || || (fol. 2 "2 nd foliation"v8)

«Beginning of 1. Navagrahakavaca:» śrīgaṇeśam vande || || śrīkārttikeya uvāca || || devadeva mahādeva jagad ⟨d⟩e⟨ca⟩[tac] carācaraṃ || grahāṇāñ ca katham proktaṃ śāntimuktiḥ katham bhavet || 1 || || śrīrudra uvāca || śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi tava prītyam ahaṃ sadā || devāsurair †abadhyante† rogaśokavināśanam || 2 || (fol. 1 "1 st foliation"r1–4) «End of the 2. Prajñāvarddhanastotra:» aṣṭāviṃśatināmāni madīyāni ca yaḥ paṭhet || pratyuṣe<ref name="ftn2"> for pratyūṣe </ref> śraddhayā yukto mūko vācaspatir ⟨bh⟩[b]bhavet || 5 || mahāmantramayānīti mama nāmānukīrttanāt || mahāprajñām avāpnoti nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā || 6 || || (fol. 2 "2 nd foliation"v5–8) «Colophon of 2. Prajñāvarddhanastotra:» iti prajāvarddhanastotram || || śubham bhavatu || || || || || || (fol. 2 "2 nd foliation"v8)

Beginning oṁ namas tārāyai oṁ asya śrī-ugratārānāmāṣṭottaraśatanāmamaṃtrasyā ʼkṣobhya ṛṣir anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrī-ugratārādevatā hūṁ bījaṃ phaṭ śaktiḥ hrīṁ kīlakaṃ dharmmārthakāmamokṣārthe jape viniyogaḥ oṁ tārā ekajaṭā nīlā nīlotpalakarā tathā kharvā khagendragā khaṇḍaparaśukhaḍgendradhāriṇī || (!) (fol. 1v1–5) End haryyādidevatā meśā (!) gaṃgādisaritas tava vedādikā mamaivāṃśās taṃtram eva hi (!) ahaṃ brahmā hariś cāhaṃ tāriṇī cāsmi tanmayaḥ nityavijñānam ānandas cinmayas tāriṇīmayaṃ ity ātmānaṃ bhāvayed yogaṃ maṃtrāgamaparāyaṇaḥ jīvanmukta sa vijñeyo dehāṃte tāra(!)ṇītanuḥ (fol. 5r4–5v3) Colophon ī(!)ti śrīrudrayāmale śivapārvatīsamvāde tārāyā sto(!)ttaraśatanāma samāptam ❁ śubham bhu(!)yāt maṅgalaṃ bhatuḥ(!) (fol. 5v4–5)

«Beginning of the 1. Pañcamīstavarāja:» ❖ oṁ śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || seve sindūrasandohasundaṃ rasāṅgabhāsurāṃ karuṇa(!)pūrṇapīyūṣakapa(!)kṣāṃ kulanāyikāṃ || 1 || dvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ | śāntaṃ guruṃ padmāsanasthitaṃ | yogapīṭhasamāsīnaṃ namāmi śirasi sthitaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1r1–2) «End of the 1. Pañcamīstavarāja:» ākāśe śvaprakāśe sakalaguṇamayīṃ sundarīraktanetrāṃ nityā[ṃ] padmāsanasthāṃ taruṇaravinibhāṃ raktacanda(!)prabhābhāṃ | ātmānaṃ sarvvabhāvaiḥ sakalaguṇamayīṃ sarvvadā yo hi paśyet sākṣād devaḥ śivo vā madanadahanakṛt khecaro jāyate saḥ || 44 || idaṃ tripurasundaryā stavarājaṃ manoharaṃ || rakṣāmaṃtraṃ ca śubhadaṃ śivena parikīrttitaṃ || ⟨1⟩ 45 || || (fol. 5r10–5v1) «End of the 2. Ṣoḍaśopacāramantra:» mātar bbhaktivasabhāvitavṛtte kriyatāṃ kuto pi labhyate || tatra laulyam api sat phalam ekaṃ janmakoṭibhir apīha na labhyaṃ || 17 || etaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ padyair uapacāropakalpitaiḥ || yaḥ parāṃ devatāṃ stauti sa teṣāṃ phalam āpnuyād iti || || (fol. 6v2–4) «Colophon of the 1. Pañcamīstavarāja:» iti śrīrudrayāmale pañcamīstavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || || (5v1–2)

Beginning śrī⟨ḥ⟩ || oṁ namo hanumataye(!) oṁ asya śrīpaṃcamukhīhanumatkavacamaṃtrasya śrīrāmalakṣmaṇasītā-ṛṣaya anuṣṭuptriṣṭupjagatyaś cchandāṃsi paṃcamukhīhanumān devatā hrīṁ bījaṃ huṁ śakti[ḥ] phaṭ kīlakaṃ mama sarvakāryasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || śiraśi || oṁ ramalakṣmaṇasītā-ṛṣibhyo namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–3) End gopanīyaṃ gīpanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || viṣṇubhaktāya śaivāya śāṃtāya daṃbhavarjite<ref name="ftn1"> for ºº varjitāya </ref> || darśayen nāma deveśī(!) anyathā śivahā bhavet || ḍāmaroktaṃ mahātaṃtraṃ sarvakāryaphalapradam || (fol. 4v2–4) Colophon iti śrīmaḍḍāmarataṃtre umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde hanumatkalpe paṃcamukhīhanumatkavacam samāptam śubham || haraye namaḥ || śrīśāke 1815 sālamiti āśvinavadī(!) 8 roja 3 śrījyotiṣibhavahariśarmaṇo haste likhitam || śrīrāmacandradūtāya paṃcamukhīhanumataye(!) śaramāgato haṃ caraṇāraviṃdayugalebhyo namaḥ || śubham astu || (fol. 4v4–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṁ hanumate namaḥ || oṁ asya śrīpa⟨ṃ⟩ñcamukhe(!)hanumanmatrasya śrīrāmacandra ṛṣir hanumān paṃcamukho devatā || anuṣṭup chanda[ḥ] || oṁ hanumān iti bījaṃ vāyuputra iti śakti[ḥ] || oṁ aṃjanīsuta iti kīlakaṃ || śrīrāmacandrahanumatprasādasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || atha nyāsa[ḥ] || oṁ aṃjanīsutāya aṃgiṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) End ekādaśavā[raṃ](21) paṭhen nityaṃ sarvasi[ddhi]r bhaven naraḥ kavacasmaraṇenaiva mahāsamanvitaṃ<ref name="ftn1"> This stanza is unmetrical. </ref> (fol. 3v2–3) Colophon iti sudarśanasaṃhitāyāṃ paṃcamukhīkavacaṃ sa[m]pūrṇaṃ śubham pāṭha[ṃ] trikālaṃ kuryāt dina 27 (athavāra)29 samvat 1913 salamitī(!) vaisākhaśudi 8 roja 2 śubham rāmāya nama[ḥ] hanumate nama[ḥ] || (fol. 3v3–5)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrītripurasundaryyai || || śrīdevy uvāca || tripurā tripureśī ca sundarī puravāsinī || śrīm[[ā]]linī ca siddhāmbā mahātripu[ra]sundarī || 1 || prakaṭādyās tathā guptā tathā guptatarā parā || sampradāyāḥ kulāḥ kaulā nigarbbhā virahasyagā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End japapūjārccanā homo abhicārāya kalpate || eta[t] stotram paṭhitvā tu sāṅgatām ānayed dhruvam || 26 || || (fol. 3v3–4) Colophon iti śrītantracūḍāmaṇau śrīparānityāstavarāja[ḥ] samāpta⟨m⟩[ḥ] || || || || || (fol. 3v4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || || kiṃ kiṃ duḥkhaṃ sakalajanani kṣīyate na smṛtāyāṃ kā kā kīrttiḥ kulakamalini prāpyate nārccitāyāṃ || kiṃ kiṃ saukhyaṃ suravaranute prāpyate nārccitāyāṃ kaṃ kaṃ yogaṃ tvayi navinute<ref name="ftn1"> for vitanute </ref> cittam ālaṃbitāyām || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End anena devatāṃ stutvā tattaddevastavena vā || puṣpāñjaliṃ tato datvā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatya ca || 14 || || (fol. 3r3–4) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale sapādalakṣagranthe śivabhavānīsaṃvāde parāpuṣpāṃjalistotraṃ samāptam || || samvat 1953 sāla śrāvaṇaśuklasaptamyāṃ śaniścaravāsare likhitam || śubham || || || (fol. 3r4–3v1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīpratyaṃgirādevyai namaḥ || || oṁ asya śrīpratyaṃgrāstotramaṃtrasya bhairava ṛṣir anuṣṭup chaṃda śrīkauśikīpratyaṃgirā devatā hrīṃ bījaṃ⟨ḥ⟩ hūṁ śaktiḥ krīṃ kīlakaṃ mama śatrukṣayārthe viniyogaḥ || || oṁ bhairavāya ṛṣaye namaḥ śirase || (fol. 1v1–4) End mahājvaro bhavet tasya tāmrasya ca⟨ḥ⟩ śalākayā⟨ḥ⟩ || gudadvāre pravinyasya saptāhān māraṇaṃ dhruvaṃ⟨ḥ⟩ || ❁ || (fol. 15r3–4) Colophon iti śrīcaṃḍesvaraśūlapāṇimahātaṃtre haragauri(!)saṃvāde śrīpratyaṃgirāstavarājaṃ samāptaṃ śubham || ❁ || saṃvat 1955 sāla adhika āśvinakṛṣṇasaptamīguruvāsare ⟨ṇa⟩ liṣitaṃ śubham (fol. 15r4–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ dvinetraṃ karuṇānidhiṃ || varābhayakaram vande śrīguruṃ śivarūpiṇaṃ || 1 || bhaktājñānatamobhānum mūrddhni paṅkajasaṃsthitaṃ || sadāśivamayaṃ nityaṃ śrīgurūn praṇamāmy aham || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End divyacandanaliptāṅgaḥ sadā viṃśativārṣikaḥ || sa bhuṃkte sakalān bhogān devaloke naraḥ sadā || 21 || tasmād etat paraṃ stotraṃ tripurāhṛdayaṃ śubhaṃ || japed yaḥ satatam bhaktyā bhavet sākṣāt sadāśivaḥ || 22⟨2⟩ || || (fol. 21v2–4) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale śrītripurasundarīhṛdayastotraṃ sampūrṇam || || || (fol. 21v5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīdevy uvāca || devadeva mahādeva lokānugrahakāraka⟨ḥ⟩ || yat sūcitam purā nātha kim arthaṃ na prakāśitaṃ || 1 || rājarājeśvarīdevyās tripurāyāḥ śubhāvahaṃ || kavacaṃ yadi me prītiḥ kathayasva vṛṣadhvaja || 2 || || (fol. 1v1–3) End deyaṃ śiṣyāya śāntāya gurubhaktiparāya ca || sarvvalakṣaṇayuktāya yantramantraparāya ca || 108 || || (fol. 12r3–5) Colophon iti śrīśivatantre umāmaheśvarasamvāde śrīrājarājeśvarīśrīmahātripurasundarīparāprāsādākhyakavacaṃ samāptam śubham || || || || || || || || || || || || || || || || (fol. 12r5–7)

«Beginning» śrīgaṇēśāya namaḥ || || athāśvalāyano bhagavantaṃ parameṣṭhinaṃ parisametyovāca || adhī hi bhagavan brahmavidyāṃ variṣṭhāṃ sadā sadbhiḥ sevyamānāṃ nigūḍḥāṃ yathādhiyā sarvapāpaṃ vyapohya parātparaṃ puruṣaṃ yāti vidvān || tasmai sahovāca pitāmahaś ca śraddhābhaktidhyānayogādavabhinanna(!) karmaṇā na prajayā dhanena tyāgenaike amṛtatvamānasuḥ pareṇa nākaṃ nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ vibhrājate yadyatayo viśaṃti || vedāntavijñāna suniścitārthāḥ sanyāsayogādya tapaḥ śuddhasatvām || 1 || (exp. 1a:1-6) «End» tridhā roravīti maho devo martyāṃñ āviveśa || 2 || tridhā hitaṃ paṇibhir guhyamānaṃgavidevāso ghṛtamanna vindan || indra ʼeka gūṃ sūrya ʼekaṃ jajānavvenka svadhayāniṣṭatakṣuḥ || yo devānām prathamaṃ purastādviśvādhiyorudro maharṣiḥ || hiraṇyagarbhaṃ paśyatajāyamāna gūṃ sanodevasyubhayāsmṛtyā saṃpuna (exp.47b1-4) «Colophon» x

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kailāśasyottare śṛṅge śuddhasphaṭikasannibhe || tamoguṇavihīne tu jarāmaraṇavarjite || 1 || sarvārthasampadāghorasarvajñānakṛtālaye || kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā sukhālinaṃ sadā śivam || 2 || papra[c]cha praṇato brahmā jānubhyām avanīṃ tataḥ || kenopāyena deveśa cirāyur lomaśo bhavat || 3 || tan me brūhi mahādeva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || hitakāraṇalokānāṃ trailokyasacarācare || 4 || (fol. 1v1–7) End atyāsannantare kāle śataikāvartate kṛte || mṛt punar jāyate tasya rogasraṃtra(!) vimuñcati || 44 || pañcamyāṃ vā daśamyāṃ vā paurṇamāsyām(!) athāpi vā || śatam āvarttayo(!) pras(!) tu śatavarṣam apy iti api || 45 || idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ devasya haṃsayoginaḥ || dusvapnanāśanaṃ puṇyaṃ cārvāriṣṭavināśanam || 46 || susvapnavarddhanaṃ nityaṃ sarvaduṣkṛtanāśanam || sarvapāpavinirmuktaś śivaloke sa ga[c]cchati || 47 || śatavarṣaṃ sannidhe tu putraputrapratiṣṭhitaḥ || uttamottamavipraḥ syād uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ si(!)vaḥ || 48 || mṛtyuñjayena[ja]ptena cīrakālaṃ sa ji(!)vati || saptajanmakṛtāt pāpāt mucyate nātra saṃśaya[ḥ] || 49 || (f0l. 6r5–6v6) Colophon iti śrīparameśvaratantre catur aśitiśā(!)hastre mṛtyuñjayastavarājaṃ saṃpūrṇam || śāke 1808 samvat 1943 traihā ā(!)cītatī(!)thi(!) vadī 8 roja 3 śubham (fol. 48v6–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ purākailāsa(!)śikhare tārā papraccha(!) śaṃkaraḥ guptabhāvena deveśi kathayasva tam ādara(!) 1 || śrītārovāca asti guhyataraṃ hy etan niḥsṛtaṃ makharparjarāt(!) idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ kathayāmi mayā prabho 3 śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānena kavacaṃ manmukhāśrutaṃ madhukaiṭabhayor yuddhe kathitaṃ padmajanmani 4 (fol. 1v1–5) End caraṇau me pātu nityaṃ vidyāṃntakaṃ samāhūya tāro me pātu satataṃ aṣṭāṃgaṃ parameśvarī 23 idaṃ kavacaṃ devakathitaṃ manmukhāt sṛjaṃ prasādād yadi deveśa yatra kutra prakāśyate 23 yiginīs tu [sa]dā hantu paṃcavadhakāriṇī yadi bhāgyavasāl labdhaṃ kenacit sādhakena vai 24 tadā tasya mahāsiddhiṃ vapraṣyaṃ(!) jāyate dhruvaṃ nisid(!)dhebhyo na dātavyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ kadācana 25 yadi dadyān nisiddhebhyos tathāha vadhakariṇī dadyāc chāntāya śiṣyāya taṃtramaṃtrayutāya ca 26 gurūbaktipu(!)jā caiva tadā siddhir anuttamam ārahasyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ anantaphaladāyakaṃ 27 gopitavyaṃ tvayā deva na prakāśyaṃ kadācana ❁ (fol. 3r4–3v4) Colophon iti śrīyoginitaṃtre vajrayoginīkavacaṃ samāptam ❁ (fol. 3v5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || pārvaty uvāca || devadeva mahādeva saṃsārapriyakāraka[ḥ] || paṃjaraṃ vaṭukasyāsya kathanīyaṃ mama prabho || 1 || śrīśiva uvāca || pūrvaṃ bhasmāsuratrāsāt bhayavihvalataḥ svayam || paṭhanād eva me prāṇā rakṣitāḥ parameśvari || 2 || sarvaduṣṭavināśāya sarvaroganivāraṇam || duḥkhaśāṃtikaraṃ devi hy alpamṛtyubhayāpaham || 3 || rājñāṃ vaśyakaraṃ caiva trailokyavijayapradam || sarvalokeṣu pūjyaś ca lakṣmīs tasya gṛhe sthirā || 4 || (exp. 2b1–6) End vajrapaṃjaranāmedaṃ ye śṛṇvaṃti varānane || āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ kīrtilābho sukhaṃ jayaḥ || 25 || lakṣmī manoramā buddhis teṣāṃ gehe vyavasthitā || suśīlāya sudāṃtāya gurubhaktiparāya ca || 26 || tasya śīghraṃ ca dātavyam anyathā na kadācana || gopanīyaṃ prayatnena sarvagopyamayaṃ bhavet || 27 || yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ na dātavyaṃ kadācana || rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ na deyaṃ bhairavākṣaram || 28 || ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ paṭhate naraḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto śivena saha modate || 29 || || (exp. 5t3–b1) Colophon iti śrīśaktirahasyoktavaṭukabhairavapaṃjarakavacaṃ samāptam || || || (exp. 5b2)

Beginning śrīvaṭukabhairavāya namaḥ || śrībhairava uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣāmi bhairavasya mahātmanaḥ || baṭūkasya śataṃ nāma aṣṭottaram anuttamam || 1 || āpaduddhārakaṃ tv edaṃ(!) sarvakṣatranivarhaṇam || apamṛtyuharaṃ divyam ādhivyādhivināśanam || 2 || viśeṣā(!)vasya jananaṃ vivāde vijayapradam || mārībhaye caurabhaye vātāgnijalaje bhaye || 3 || sakṛtpaṭḥanamātreṇa sarvopadravanāśanam || dhanasaṃpattijananaṃ putrapautravivarddhanam || 4 || (fol. 1v1–4) End āpaduddhārajanakaṃ vaṭukasya prakīrtitam || etac ca śṛṇuyād brūyāj ji(!)raved vāsthāpayed gṛhe || 33 dhārayed vā gale vāhau tasya sarvasamṛdhyate || na tasya duritaṃ kiṃcin na cauranṛpajaṃ bhayam || 34 || na cālyamṛtyudoḥ satyo(!) ḍākinībhyo bhayaṃ na hi || kuṣmāḍṇādigrahādibhyo nāpaṛtyur na ca jvarāḥ || 35 || māsam ekaṃ trisaṃdhyāṃ ca śucir bhūtvā paṭḥen naraḥ || sarvadāridryanirmukto nidhiṃ paśyati bhūtale || 36 || māsadvayam adhīyāś ca pādukāsiddhim āpnuyāt || añjanaṃ guṭhikāsiddhaṃ dhātuvāḍaṃ rasāyanam || 37 || sārasvataṃ ca vetālaṃ vāhanaṃ vīrasādhanam || kāryasiddhir maṃtrasidhir maṃtraṃ caiva samīhitam || 38 || varṣaṃ māsaṃ ca adhiyāt prāpnuyāt sādhakottamaḥ || iti te kathitaṃ devi sārāt sārataraṃ param || 39 || kālasaṃkarṣiṇītaṃtre kalikalmaṣanāśanam || [[sarvavighnaharaś caiva vāñcitārthasya dāyakaḥ || 4]] (fol. 3r4–3v4) Colophon iti śrīkālasaṃkarṣiṇitaṃtre mahāvaṭūkabhairavaśatanāmastotram samāptam śubham || || || || (fol. 3v4–5)

Beginning svasti śrīparabrahmaṇe namaḥ || avinayam apanaya viṣṇo damaya manaḥ samaya viṣayamṛgatṛṣṇāṃ || bhūtadayāṃ vistāraya tāraya saṃsārasāgarataḥ || divyadhūnimakaraṃde parimalaparibhogasaccidānande || śrīpatipadāravinde bhavabhayakhedacchide vande ||(fol. 1v1–4) End yān yān kāmayate kāmān stāṃ stāṃ prāpnoty aśaṃsayam || aprakāśyaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 64 || satkulīnāya śāṃtāya ṛjave daṃbhavarjite || dadyāt stotram idaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradaṃ || 65 || iti śrutvā tato devī nāmāṣṭaśatam uttamam || jajāpa parayā bhaktyā sadā sarveśvareśvarī || 66 || saṃtoṣaṃ paramaṃ prāpya bhairavasya prasādataḥ || bhairavo ʼpi prasanno ʼbhūt sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ || 67 || (fol. 9r3–9v1) Colophon ī(!)ti śrīrudrayāmale umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde āpadudhāraṇaṃ nāma bhairavastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam śubham || śāke 1780 samvat 1915 phālguṇaśukla 28 nandā tithi ‥manakṣatre vaidhṛtiyoge guruvāśa(!)re kauḍiṃnyagotra ‥ ‥ ‥ krena(!) padmalālena likhitaṃ pustakaṃ samāptaṃ saṃpūrṇam śubham || rā rā rā (fol. 9v1–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kailāsaśiṣare ramye devadeva jagadguruṃ || papra[c]cha pārvatī śaṃbhuṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaraṃ || 1 || pārvaty uvāca || || deva deva mahādeva sarvatra sukhasaṃbhavaḥ || āpaduddhara daridrādipīḍitānāṃ nṛṇāṃ vibho || 2 || yaddhitaṃ sukhasampattidhanadhānyakaraṃ sadā || viśeṣato rājakule śāntipuṣṭipradāyakaṃ || 3 || bālagrahādiśamanaṃ nānāsiddhikaraṃ nṛṇāṃ || coktaṃ pūrvaṃ tu yan nātha dhyānapūjāsamanvitaṃ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–2r3) End bhūmikāmo bhūtikāmaḥ ṣaṇmāsaṃ ca japet sudhīḥ || patikṛtyā vināśārthaṃ japet triśatam uttamaṃ || 83 || māsatrayeṇa sarveṣāṃ vighnānāsaṃtako bhavet || māsam ekaṃ japed devi niraśvaramānasaḥ || 84 || dhanam putraṃ tathādārāṃ prāpnuyān nātra saṃśayaḥ || mahākārāgṛhe baddhaḥ piśāvaiḥ parivāritaḥ || 85 || nigaḍaiḥ śṛṃkhalābhiś ca yaṃ dhanaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || paṭhanāc ca divārātrau sarvāṃ kāmān avāpnuyāt || 86 || śatam āvarttayed yas tu puraścaraṇam ucyate || yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnoti niścitaṃ || 87 || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || sarvakāmaprado devī sarvajñaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ || 88 || satkulīnāya śāṃtāya ṛjuve satyavādine || stotradānāt saḥ prahṛṣṭe bhairavo ʼbhūn maheśvara || 89 || ❁ || (fol. 30r1–30v6) Colophon iti śrīuḍḍāmarataṃtre umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde vaṭukabhairavasahasranāma samāptāḥ(!) || ❁ || 1941 sāla śrāvaṇa kṛṣṇa 2 roja 5 śubhaṃ (fol. 30v6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama[ḥ] || || oṁ merupṛṣṭe sukhāśīnaṃ devadevaṃ jagadguruṃ || śaṃkaraṃ pariprapaccha pārvatīparameśvaraṃ || 1 || || śrīpārvaty uvāca || || bhagavan sarvadharmajña sarvaśāstrāgamādiṣu || āpaduddhāraṇaṃ maṃtraṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇāṃ || 2 || sarveṣā[ṃ] caiva bhūtānāṃ hito yaṃ vāṃchito mayā || viśeṣatas tu rājñā vai śāṃtipuṣṭipraśādhanaṃ || 3 || aṃgaṃ nyāsakaraṃ nyāsadehaṃ nyāsasamanvitaṃ || vaktum arhasi deveśa mama harṣavivarddhanaṃ || 4 || || (fol. 1v1–5) End nigaḍaiś ca nibaddho ʼyaṃ kārāgṛhanipātitaḥ || śṛkhalābaṃḍhanaṃ prāptaṃ paṭḥet stotraṃ divāniśaṃ || 73 || yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmī paḥet stotraṃ divāniśaṃ || taṃ taṃ kāmam avāpnoti sādhakasiddhi[r] eva ca || 74 || aprakāśyaṃ paraṃ guhyṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || satkulīnāya śāṃtāya ṛjabhe daṃbhakāya ca || 75 || dadyāt stotram idaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || iti śrutvā tato devī nāmāṣṭaśatam uttamaṃ || 76 || jajāpa parayā bhaktyā sarvasarveśvareśvarī || saṃtoṣaparamaṃ jāpya bhairavasya praśādata[ḥ] || 77 || bhairavo ʼpi praśamo ʼbhūt sarvalokamaheśvara || 78 || || (fol. 11v4–12r4) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale viśvasārodhāre umāmaheśvarasamvāde śrī[r]rudrayāmale viśvasārodhāre umāmaheśvarasamvāde śrī āpaduddharavaṭukabhairavastotra⌠ṃ⌡ sampūrṇam || || yad annaṃ baktimātreṇa patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalaṃ || nivedayāmi deveśa tvadgṛhāṇānukaṃpaya || āvāhanaṃ na jānāmi na jānāmi visarjanaṃ || maṃtrapūjā na jānāmi kṣamasva parameśvara || aparādha bhavaty eva sevakasya pade pade || kāmara(!) sahate loke kevalaṃ svāminaṃ vinā || || iti samvat 1960 sāla vaiśākha kṛṣṇa aṣṭamisomavāsare samāpti (!) || || namo bhairavadevāya sarvabhūtāya te namaḥ || namaḥ trailokyanāthāya nātha nāthāya vai namaḥ || || vārānasyāṃ bhairavo devo saṃsārabhayanāsa(!)naṃ || || ne(!)kajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ smaraṇād eva naśyati || || mūlamaṃtraḥ || huṃ huṃ phaṭ || || gāyatrī || oṁ huṁ phaṭ mahāviravetālāya vidmahe bhairava(!)pāsanāya dhimahi tan no vīra pracodayāt || || iti pāṭḥaśatakaṃ kṛtvā sarvakāmajayaḥ sarvasa(!)truvināśanaḥ rajasa(!)trusakāsajapaḥ dharmakāmamokṣa artha caturvargasiddhaṃ jāyate || (fol. 12r4–12v8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha pratyaṃgirāmūlamaṃtraḥ || oṁ kṣaṁ bhaṁ kṣaṁ tvaṁ lāṁ ji hvaṁ kaṁ rāṁ laṁ daṁ ṣṭra pratyaṃgira(!) rakṣedi(!) phaṭ || iti viṃśatyakṣarimaṃtraḥ || catuṣaṣṭisahasraṃ saṃkhyaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā daṃśośa(!) tarpaṇaṃ daśāṃhomaṃ paścāt prayogavidhiḥ || oṁ hrīṁ namaḥ kṛṣṇavāsase śatasāhasrakoṭisiṃhāśane sahsravadane aṣṭādśabhuje mahāvalaparākrame ajite aparājite pratyaṃgirase aṃnye parakarmavidhvaṃśini paramaṃtroccāṭini paramaṃtrotsādini sarvabhūtadamanikaṃ so preṁ hrīṃ krauṁ māṁ sarvvopadravebhyaḥ sarvāpadhyā rakṣa 2 (fol. 1v1–6) End oṁ namaḥ viparītapratyaṃgirāyai vidhārājñī trailokyavaśaṃkarī tuṣṭipuṣṭikarī sarvabhītyapahāriṇī sarvarakṣāṃkāriṇī sarvābhayavināśinī || sarvamṃgalamāṃgalyaṃ śive sarvvārthasādhinī || mohinī paraśāstrāṇāṃ tatkṛtaṃ karitaṃ tanmastake nipātinīḥ sarvahiṃsām ākarṣiṇī ahitānāṃ ca nāśinī duṣṭātmanāṃ ca nāśinī yatkaroti yatkiṃcit kariṣyati virūpakaṃ kāra itṣyati ā anumodayati vā karmaṇā manasā vācā ye devāsurarākṣasās tiryak pretasarvahiṃsakāvirūakaṃ kurvaṃti mama maṃtrataṃtraviṣacūrṇasarvaprayogādināmātmahasena vā yaḥ karoti kariṣyati kārayiṣyati vā tān sarvān aneṣāṃ nivarttitvā patati mastāṃ || 24 || iti śrībhairavataṃtre śrīviparītapratyaṃgirādevatāstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || śubham || iti saṃvat 1921 sāla miti pāguṇavadī 10 roja śubham astu śubham || || (fol. 5r2–5v4) Colophon iti śrībhairavataṃtre śrīviparītapratyaṃgirādevatāstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || śubham || iti saṃvat 1921 sāla miti pāguṇavadī 10 roja 3 śubham astu śubham || || (fol. 5v5–6)

Beginning oṁ namo bhagavate nṛsiṃhāya || || śrīlomaśa uvāca || || anyo ʼpi niyamas tasya śrūyatām atidurllabhaḥ(!) || nārāyaṇaṃ trikālaṃ sa saṃpūjayati nityaśaḥ || 1 || puṣpāṇāṃ ca sahasreṇa vikacena sugandhinā || vedayuktaṃ vidhānena viṣṇudhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 2 || viṣṇoḥ saṃprītaye vipraḥ kurute karma cā ʼkhilam || dadhīcivaradānāt sa saṃjāto varavaiṣṇavaḥ || 3 ||(fol. 1v1–5) End caturṇāṃ sāṃgavedānāṃ trir āvṛtya ca yatphalam || tatphalaṃ labhate stotram adhīyānaḥ sakṛn naraḥ || 95 || akṣayaṃ dhanam āpnoti strīṇāṃ bhavati ṣallabhaḥ || pūjāṃ viṃdati loke ʼsmin śraddhayā saṃsmaran stutim || 96 || sarvadā saṃpadāyukto vipadaṃ naiva paśyati || gobhir na hīyate stotraṃ nityaṃ yaḥ pūjayen naraḥ || 97 || alakṣmīḥ kālakarṇī ca duḥsvapnaṃ durvicintitam || sadyo naśyati bhaktānām etat saṃśṛṇvatāṃ sadā || 98 || prātar utthāya yo ʼdhīte śucir viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ || akṣayaṃ labhate saukhyam iha loke paratra ca || 99 || devadyutipraṇītaṃ viṣṇuprītakaraṃ śivam || viṣṇuprasādajananaṃ viṣṇudaśanakāraṇaṃ || 100 || yogasāram idaṃ nāma stotraṃ paramapāvanam || yaḥ paṭḥet satataṃ bhaktyā viṣṇulokaṃ sa ga[c]chati || 101 || iti te kathitaṃ stotraṃ guhyaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || 102 || oṁ || || (fol. 9v3–10r5) Colophon iti śrīpadmapurāṇottarakhaṇḍe māghamāhātmye vaśiṣṭhadilīpasamvādāntargatalomaśavedanidhisaṃvāde devadyutipraṇītaṃ yogasārastotraṃ śubham || śāke 1768 caitraśudi rāmanavamyāṃ gurau śrīchavilālaśarmaṇā likhitam(fol. 10r5–10r7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ namo bhagavate mṛtyuṃjayāya || śuddhaṃ śvetāvadātaṃ vṛṣaharigamanaṃ jā‥mālāṃ triśūlaṃ dhāryantaṃ kumbhahastaṃ varam abhayakaraṃ śaktiyuktaṃ trinetram || pūjā jāpyādimaṃtrair valikusumayutair dhūpadīpādisarvair natvā mṛtyuṃ jayākhyaṃ mṛtibhayaharaṇārthaṃ stavai(!) vai paṭhiṣye || 1 || kailāsasyottare śṛṅge śuddhasphaṭikasannibhe || tamoguṇavihīne tu jarāmṛtyuvivarjite || 2 || sarvārthasampadādhāre sarvajñānakṛtālaye || kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā sukhāsīnaṃ sadāśivam || 3 || (fol. 1v1–6) End idaṃ rahasyaṃ paraman devasy(!) ahaṃ sayoginaḥ duḥsvapnanāśanaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvāriṣṭavināśanam || 45 || susvapnavarddhanaṃ nityaṃ sarvaduṣkṛtanāśanam || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 46 || śatavarṣaṃ sa jīvet tu putrapautrapratiṣṭḥitaḥ || uttamottamavipraś cāpy uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ śubhaḥ || 47 || mṛtyuṃjayena japtvena ci(!)rakālaṃ sa jīvati || saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 48 || || (fol. 5r4–5v2) Colophon iti pārameśvarataṃtre mṛtyuṃjayastotraṃ samāptam || ❁ || śubham || ❁ || || (fol. 5v1)

Beginning śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || || devy uvāca || ❁ || deva deva mahādeva bhaktānugrahakāraka || kavacaṃ param ambāyāḥ sūcitaṃ na prakāśitam || 1 || yad yad kathayeśāna yatas snehaṃ priyā matā || śrīśiva uvāca || śṛṇu devī paraṃ gopyaṃ kavacaṃ kathayāmi te || 2 || āpādamastake dehe pārthivaṃ yad vinirmitaṃ || ādyā kāmeśvarī nityā tatrasthā pātu sarvadā || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End tripurāśrīti vikhyātā viśuddhākhyasthalasthitā || jarodhavabhayāt pātu pāvinī parameśvarī || 7 || ājñācakrasthitā devī tripurā mālinīti yā || sā mṛtyubhītito rakṣāṃ vidadhātu sadā mama || 8 || lalāṭam ambasaṃsthānā siddhā yā tripurādya gā || sā pātu puṇyasaṃbhūtibhītisaṃghāt sureśvarī || 9 || tripurāmbeti vikhyātā śiraḥ padme susaṃsthitā || sā pāpabhītito rakṣāṃ vidadhātu sadā mama || 10 || ye parāṃ vā padasthānagane vighnasaṃcayā || tebhyo rakṣatu yogeśī sundarīsakalārtihā || 11 || udghāṭanākhyaṃ kavacaṃ mayoktaṃ yat sureśvarī || devyāḥ prasādarodhodghāṭanānandakārakam || 13 || ity udghāṭanākhyaṃ kavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || (fol. 5r2–5v5) «Sub-Colophon» iti śrīyogīhṛdayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ sampūrṇam || ❁ || (fol. 4r4) Colophon ity udghāṭanākhyaṃ kavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || (fol. 5v5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya nama[ḥ] || śrībhairava uvāca || adhunā kathayiṣyāmi vidyānnāmasahasrakaṃ || bhogadā moṣadā loke lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te || 1 || devy uvāca || bhagavan karuṇāmbhodhe lakṣmīnārāyasya me || bhogāpavargadan divyam vadan nāmasahasrakaṃ || 2 || sarvamantramayan tatvaṃ sarvapūjāphalapradaṃ || sarvvāgamarahatyāḍhyaṃ sarvadevaikavanditaṃ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End rogināṃ rogaśamanaṃ sarvvaduṣkṛtanāśanaṃ || vaiṣṇavānāṃ priyataram muktānāṃ paramārthadaṃ || 165 || adātavyam aśrotavyam anyaśiṣyāya pārvvati || vinā dānan na gṛhīyān na dadyād dakṣiṇām vinā || 166 || datvā gṛhītvāpy ubhayoḥ siddhihānir bhaved dhruvaṃ || idan nāmasahasran tu lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya te || 167 || tava bhaktyā mayākhyātaṅ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || 168 || (fol. 16v2–6) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale devīrahasyatantre lakṣmīnārāyaṇasahasranāmākhyānan nāmaikonacatvāriṃśat paṭala[ḥ] || (fol. 16v6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namḥ || || kṣamasva bhagavaty aṃbe kṣamāśīle parātpare || śuddhasatvasvarūpe ca kopādiparivarjite || 1 || upame sarvasādhvīnāṃ devīnāṃ devapūjite || tvayā vinā jagat sarve(!) mṛtatulyaṃ ca niṣkalaṃ || 2 || sarvasaṃpatsvarūpā tvaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvarūpiṇī || rāseśvaryadhidevi tvaṃ tvatkalāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ || 3 ||(fol. 1v1–5) End putrapautravtiṃ(!) śuddhāṃ kulajāṃ komalāṃ varāṃ || aputro labhate putraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ cirajīvināṃ || 13 || paramaiśvaryayuktaṃ ca vidyāvaṃtaṃ yaśasvinaṃ || bhraṣṭarājyo labhed rājyaṃ bhraṣṭaśrīr labhate śriyaṃ || 14 || hatabaṃdhur labhed vaṃdhu(!) dhanabhraṣṭo dhanaṃ labhet || kīrtihīno labhet kīrtiṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca labhet dhruvaṃ || 15 || sarvamaṃgaladaṃ stotraṃ śokasaṃtāpanāśanaṃ || harṣānaṃdakaraṃ śaśvad dharmamokṣasuhṛtpradaṃ || 16 || (fol. 3v1–6) Colophon iti śrīdevakṛtalakṣmīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || (fol. 3v6)

«Beginning of the root text» aindrasyeva śarāsanasya dadhatī madhye lalāṭaprabhāṃ śauktīṃ kāṃtim anuṣṇagor iva śivasyātanvatī sarvataḥ || eṣāsau tripurā hṛdi dyutir ivāṣṇāṃśoḥ sadāha sthitā chiṃdyān naḥ sahasā padais tribhir aghaṃ jyotir mayī vāṅmayī || 1 || yā mātrā trapusī latātanulasan taṃ tūtthiti syarddhinī vāgvīje prathame sthitātavasadā tāṃ manmahe te vayam || śaktiḥ kuṃḍalinītiviśvajananavyāpāravad yodhya māṃ jñātvetthaṃ punaḥ spṛśaṃti jananī garbherbhaka tvaṃ narāḥ || 2 || (fol. 5r6–8) «Beginning of the commentary» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kevalākṣarabudhyartham arthamātraṃ pratīyate laghustavamayī vṛttīr uddhṛtājñānahetutā || 1 || akṣarārthakathanaṃ eṣāsau tripurātribhiḥ padair vakṣyamāṇaiḥ aiṁkāraprabhṛtis tribiḥ athavā padaiḥ sthānaiḥ lalāṭaśirohṛdadrūpaiḥ sahasā jhaṭiti svavalepanavāvoyuṣmākaṃ aghaṃ pāpaṃ dāridyaṃ maraṇaṃ ca chiṃdyād apanayet eṣāsau tripurāparā idānīṃ sthānatritaye dhyānatritayam āha kiṃ kurvatī madhye lalāṭaṃ lalāṭasya madhye pāre madhye ṣaṣṭhyā vety avyayībhāvaḥ bhūmadhye aiṃdrasyeṃdrasaṃbaṃdhinaḥ śarāsanasya dhanuṣaḥ prabhām iva jagadvaśyārthaṃ rūpam āraktaṃ dadhatī (fol. 1v1–6) «End of the root text» boddhavyā nipuṇaṃ budhaiḥ stutir iyaṃ kṛtvā manas tadgataṃ bhāratyās tripurety ananyamanaso yatrādya vṛtte sphuṭam || ekadvitripadakrameṇa kathitas tvatpādasaṃkhyākṣarair maṃtroddhāravidhr viśeṣasahitaḥ satsaṃpradāyānvitaḥ || 20 || sāvadyaṃ niravadyam astu yadi vā kiṃ vā na yāciṃtayā nūnaṃ stotram idaṃ paṭhiṣyati jano yasyāsti bhaktis tvayi || saṃciṃtyāpi laghutvam ātmani dṛḍhaṃ saṃjāyamānaṃ haṭhāt tvadbhaktyā mukharīkṛtena racitaṃ yasāmn mayāpi dhruvam || 21 || || (fol. 27v5–7) «End of the commentary» kiṃ cānyo bālako hi yathā mātuḥ pura uttuṃgaśṛṇgārī svekṣayā lapan api pratyuta bhūṣaṇī yo bhavati tathā mahājñānaśiromaṇir api nijasahajalīlayā stavanadoṣeṇāparādhabhājanaṃ kiṃ tu dūṣaṇam uddhṛtyātulyasaṃjalpasudhāpravāhaiḥ prīṇayitvā ca pramāṇapadavīm adhyāropaṇīyasakalakalyāṇamayo bhaviṣyāmītyekaviṃśativṛttārthaḥ || 21 ||(fol. 30r8–12) «Colophon of the root text» iti laghustavaṃ sampūrṇam || || || (fol. 29v7) «Colophon of the commentary» iti yathāmativiracitā laghustavaṭīkā samāptā || || śubham astu || śrītripurāyai namaḥ || (fol. 30v12)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīpārvaty uvāca || bhagavan deva deveśa sṛṣṭisthitivināśakṛt || kathitaṃ bhavatā samyak sundaryāh paramottamaṃ || 1 || pūjāvidhis tathā hāni[s] tathā kāmyakṛtāni ca || i(!)dāniṃ śrotum icchāmi laliteśasya śaṅkaraḥ || 2 || kavacaṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca suṃdarīprītikārakam || vinā rudreṇa hy akalākathitaṃ bhavatā mayi || 3 || (fol. 1v1–4) End mokṣasiddhiṃ ca labhate sveccāmṛtyur na saṃśayaḥ || siddhayo ʼṣṭau tasya haste bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 18 || anyāsāṃ kṣudrasiddhīnāṃ kā kathā bhūtajānitnāṃ || guhyam etaṃ mahādevī tatvāt tatvaṃ parāt param || 19 || sarvasvaṃ tripurādevyā [ḥ] sundarīsiddhidāyakam || adātavyam abhaktā ca anyaśiṣyāya pārvatī(!) || 20 || idaṃ ⟨ka⟩kavacam ajñātvā sundarī bhajate ʼdhamaḥ || pade pade tasya hāni[ḥ] koṭyābdān taṃ na sidhyati || 21 || śastraghātam avāpnoti so ʼcirān mṛtyum āpnuyāt || (fol. 3r2–6) Colophon tatsad iti śrīrudayāmale taṃtre lalitabhairavakavacaṃ śubham samāptaḥ || ❁ ||(fol. 3v1)

Beginning śrītripurādevyai namaḥ || || ḷṁ oṁ śrīṁ trīṁ ḷṁ▒ aiṁ klīṁ sauṁ || dhyānaṃ || oṃ bālārkkamaṇḍalābhāsāṃ caturbbāhuṃ trilocanāṃ pāśāṅkuśaśaraś cāpaṃ dhārayantīṃ śivāṃ bhajet || śrībhairavo(!)vāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣā(!)mi hṛdayaṃ paramādbhutaṃ || kasyacit naiva cākhyātaṃ śrūyatāṃ naganandinī || 1 || śrībhairavīkavaca || kiṃ phalaṃ kena racitaṃ kathyatāṃ jagadīśvaraḥ || kim arthaṃ ca samutpannaṃ kathaṃ pāṭhaṃ kramo bhavet || 2 || śrībhairavo(!)vāca || sarvvapāṭhaphalaṃ cāsya mayā pūrvakṛtastavaḥ || kālakūṭe samutpanne jānīhi racitaṃ tadā || 3 || pāṭhakramaḥ śmaśāne vā śūnyāgāre śivālaye || catuṣpāṭhe mahāraṇye puṇyatīrthe paṭhec chive || asya śrītripurāhṛdayastotramaṃtrasya bhūteśa ṛṣiḥ śarkkvarīcchandaḥ śrītripurā devatā oṁ bījaṁ taṁ śaktiḥ so ʼhaṃ kīlakaṃ mamābhiṣṭasidhyarthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1v1–2r5) End ataḥ paraṃ śṛṇuṣvedaṃ sarvāghasya vināśakaṃ || mahāduḥkhādiharaṇaṃ sarvvadā saukhyakārakaṃ || 22 || dharaṇārthaṃ subhaṃ yaṃtraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakaṃ || bhūrjapatre likhitvā tu saṃpūjya vidhipūrvakaṃ || 23 || trikoṇam aṣṭapatraṃ ca ṣoḍaśaccha[ṃ]dasaṃyutaṃ || aṣṭapatraṃ bhūgṛḥaṃ ca yaṃtraṃ sarvārthasādhakaṃ || 24 || maṃtroddhāraṃ pravakṣāmi śṛṇuṣva kamalānane || praṇavaṃ taṃtrayatrīṁ (!) trīṁ tripurādevī tato vadet || 25 || so ʼhaṃ hiraṇyakaṃ daṇḍo maṃtroddhāram itīritaḥ || hṛdayaṃ tripurādevyās triṣu lokeṣu durllabham || 26 || dhāraṇīyaṃ prayatnena bhogamokṣaphalapradam || bahunātra kim uktena jhaṭiti phaladāyakaṃ || 27 || sarvayajñaphalaṃ bhadre sarvadānaphalaṃ tathā⟨ḥ⟩ || sarvatīrthasamaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvayogaphalaṃ tathā || 28 || ekāvṛtyādipāṭḥena sarvasiddir bhaved dhruvam || 29 || (fol. 4v3–5v4) Colophon iti śrīdevīyāmale bhairavabhairavavīsaṃvāde tripurādevīhṛdayaṃ yaṃtroddhrāmaṃtroddhārakathanaṃ nāmaḥ(!) || sampūrṇam || śubham || (fol. 5v4–5)

Beginning anāthasya dīnasya tṛṣṇāturasya bhavārttasya bhītasya baddhasya jantoḥ || tvam ekā gatir devi nistārakartrī namasteºº || 3 || araṇye raṇe dāruṇe śatrumadhye jape prāntare dustare rājagehe || tvam ekā gatir devi nistārahetur namasteºº || 4 || apāre mahādustaretyantaghore vipatsāgare majjatāṃ dehabhājān || tvam ekā gatir devi nistāranaukā namasteºº || 5 || (fol. 2r1–2v5) End mokṣasiddhiñ ca labhate svecchāmṛtyur na saṃśayaḥ || sidhyāṣṭau tasya haste bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 18 || abhyāsāṃ kṣudrasiddhīnāṃ kā kathā bhūtajātinām || guhyam etan mahādevi tattvātatvaṃ parāparam || 19 || sarvvasvan tripurādevyāḥ sundarīsiddhidāyakam || ādātavyam abhaktāya anaśiṣyāya pārvati || 20 || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā sundarīṃ bhajate ʼdhamaḥ || pade pade tasya hāniḥ koṭyabdāntān na sidhyati || 21 || śastraghātam avāpnoti so ʼcirān mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 22 || (fol. 4r2–4v4) Colophon ⟨i⟩iti śrīrudrayāmale śrīśrīśrīśrīśrīśrīlalitabhiravakavacaṃ śubhaṃ (fol. 4v4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || devy uvāca || || bhagavan devadeveśa bhaktānām prītivarddhanam || sūcitaṃ yanmahādevyāḥ kavacaṃ kathayasva me || 1 || śrīmahādeva uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣāmi kavacaṃ devadurllabham || aprakāśyaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ sādhakābhiṣṭasiddhidam || 2 || kavacasya ṛṣir devi dakṣiṇāmūrttir avyayaḥ || chandapaṅtisamuddiṣṭaṃ devītripurasundarī || 3 || dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaṃ ca śaktibījaṃ maheśvariḥ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–2r2) End jale pātu mahāmāyā pṛthivyāṃ sarvamaṅgalā || ākāśe pātu varadā sarvvatra bhuvaneśvarī || 13 || idan tu devyāḥ kavacaṃ devānām api durllabham || yaḥ paṭḥet prātar utthāya śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ || 14 || nādhayoḥ vyādhi(!)yas tasya na bhayaṃ ca kvacid bhavet || na ca mārīyan tasya pātakānāṃ bhayaṃ na hi || 15 || na dāridryaṃ vaśaṃ gacchet tiṣṭen mṛtyu(!)vasena ca || gacchec chivapuran devi satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmy aham || 16 || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā śrīvidyā yojayet sudhīḥ || sa nāpnoti phalan tasya prāpnuyāt chastraghātanaṃ || 17 || (fol. 3r4–4r1) Colophon iti śrīdevīyāmalatantre śrīvidyākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || || śubham || śrītripurā prīṇātu || || oṁ aiṁ klīṁ sauṁ ▒ ▒ ▒ ▒ oḍiyānapīṭḥe ṣaṣṭīsanāthātmi[[ke]] brahma cakre vṛndevśamandirāsanasthitāyai śrīmantripurāmbā yā du kāṁ aiṁ klīṁ sauṁ ‥ || iti smaraṇāt || (fol. 4v1–5)

Beginning śrīmanmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ || || śrīparāyai namaḥ || || karpuraṃ rephapūrair virahitam amalam bījam ādyan tavedaṃ yeṣāṃ citte niviṣṭaṃ tritayaguṇamaye varṇabījaikarūpe || teṣāṃ gehe sadā vai madakalitagajāndokanodbhūtaramyo ghaṇṭārāvo virāvo na bhvati ca paśāśvoc ca heṣā sametaḥ || 1 || devendram madhyam āntyaprathamahalavihīnan tu tadvījarūpaṃ ye vai nityaṃ japanti smaraharasadṛśā sarvvato mānyabhūtā || teṣām baktrāravinde kṛtanijagasatir bhāratī mānavānāṃ nityaṃ gīrvāṇavāṇīṃ navarasamadhurāṃ kāvyarūpaṃ tanoti || 2 || (fol. 1v1–2r4) End vāmām vāmavidheyakāmalalitāṃ kāmeśvarāṅgasthitām pañcabrahmasuratnakhacite siṃhāsane śobhitām || bhrāmyadbhṛṅgaḥ gaṇālimoditadiśā kādambarī sevitāṃ ye dhyāyanti sadaiva karpuram imaṃ teṣān na mṛtyor bhayaṃ || 11 || hayagrīvagariproktā karpūrakalikām imām || pūjānte darśayed yo vai tasya pūjā susiddhidā || 12 || || (fol. 5r4–5v4) Colophon iti śrīhayagrīvasaṃhitāyāṃ lalitākarpūrastava[ṃ] || || || sā 66 varṣa 63 || || (fol. 5v4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīmātre || 1 || śrīmahārājñyai || 2 || śrīmatsiṃhāsaneśvaryyai || 3 || cidagniguṇḍasaṃbhūtāyai || 4 || devakāryasudyatāyai || 5 || udyadbhānusahasrabhāyai || 6 || caturbāhusamanvitāyai || 7 || rāgasvarūpapāśābdhyāyai || 8 || krodhakārāṃkuśojvalāyai || 9 || manorūpekṣukīdaṇḍāyai || 10 || paṃcatanmātraśāyakāyai || 11 || nijāruṇaprabhāpūramaṃjñabrahmāṇḍamaṇḍalāyai || 12 || caṃpakaśokapunnāgasaugandhikalasatkacāyai || 13 || kuru vindamaṇiśreṇikanatkoṭīramaṃḍitāyai || 14 || (fol. 1v1–5) End jñānajñeyasvarupiṇyai 80 yonimudrāyai 80 trikhaṇḍeśyai 82 triguṇāmbāyai 83 trikoṇāgāyai 84 anādyāyai 85 adbhutacātritrāyai 86 vāṃchitārthapradāyinyai 87 abhyāsātiśayajñātāyai 88 ṣaḍadhvātītarūpiṇyai 89 avyājakaruṇāmurtyai 90 ajñānadvāntadīpikāyai 91 ābālagopaviditāyai 92 sarvvālulladhyaśāsanāyai 93 śrīcakrarājanilayāyai 94 śrīmanttripurasundaryai 95 śrīśivāyai 96 śivaśaktyai 97 ekāyai 98 arūpiṇyai 99 lalitāmbikāyai namaḥ 100 | 1000 | (fol. 55r1–5) Colophon iti brahmāṇḍapurāṇe uttarakhaṇḍe lalitopākhyāne rahasyasahasranāmastotraṃ sampūrṇam || || iti samvat 1877 sālamiti jyeṣṭavadi 7 roja 6 śubham || || rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma rāma (fol. 15r5–7)

Beginning śrīparadevīmūrttaye namaḥ || || devy uvāca || || deva deva mahādeva bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ || kavacaṃ param ambāyāḥ sūcitaṃ na prakāśitam || 1 || tad adya kathayeśāna yata[ḥ] snehaṃ priyā matā⟨ḥ⟩ || śiva uvāca || śṛṇu devi paraṃ gopyaṃ kavacaṃ kathayāmi te || 2 || āpādamastake dehe partivaṃ yadvinirmitam || ādyā kāmeśvarī nityā tatrasthā yātu srvvadā || 3 || (fol. 1v1–2r1) End manobudhyāhaṃkārāṇāṃ vṛttir yā sukhadāyinī || tāṃ dadhātu dayāsindhurūpiṇī sundarī mama⟨ḥ⟩ || 18 || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā yo japet tripurāṃ parām || na tasya jāyate siddhir vignasaṃgha pade pade || 19 || kavacaṃ yogihṛdayaṃ pūjānte yaḥ paṭḥen naraḥ (fol. 4r3–5r1) Colophon iti śrīyogihṛdayan nāma kavacaṃ samāptaṃ saṃpūrṇam || || śubham || 1 || śrīparā devī supraśanno ʼstu || oṁ aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ ▒ hyauṁḥ ▒ ▒ ▒ ▒ śrīṁ matmahātripurasundarī devī parabrahmātmaśaktiḥ śrīpādukāṃ || iti maṃtraḥ || aṣṭāviṃśativāraṃ smaret || ❁ || (fol. 5v1–5)

Beginning śrīsundaryai namaḥ || devy uvāca || || devādhideva deveśa cakreśvaryāḥ purā prabho⟨ḥ⟩ || kavacaṃ sūcitaṃ yat tat kathayasva sureśvara⟨ḥ⟩ || 1 || śiva uvāca || śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ kavacaṃ bhuvi muktidaṃ || surāsuroragādīnām alabhyaṃ bhuvanatraye || 2 || mūlādhāre shitā devī tripurā cakranāyakā || tṛṭjanmabhītirakṣārthaṃ sāvadhānā sadāstu me || 3 || svādhiṣṭhānākhyacakrasyātripureśītiviśrutā || tṛṭjanmabhītirakṣārthaṃ sāvadhānā sadāstu me || 4 || maṇipūrasthitā devī sundarī tripurādigā || śokabhītiparitrastaṃ pātu māṃ ⟨m⟩aghanagā sadā || 5 || (fol. 1v1–2r4) End ājñācakrasthitā devi tripurā mālinīti yā || sā mṛtyubhītito rakṣāṃ vidadhātu sadā mama || 8 || lalāṭapadmasaṃsthānā siddhā yā triuprādyagā || sā pātu puṇyasaṃbhūti bhītisaṃghāt sureśvarī || 9 || tripurāmbeti vikhyātā śiraḥ padmesu saṃsthitā || sā pāpabhītito rakṣāṃ vidadhātu sadā mama || 10 || ye parāṃ vādapadasthānagamane vighnasaṃcayā || tebhyo rakṣatu yogeśī sundarī sakalārttihā || 11 || udghāṭanākhyaṃ kavacaṃ mayoktaṃ yat sureśvarī || devyāḥ prasādarodhotthodghāṭanānandakārakam || 12 || (fol. 2v2–3r5) Colophon iti śrī udghāṭanākhyaṃ parākavacaṃ samāptam || | ❁ | 2 || (fol. 3r5)

Beginning śrīgurucaraṇakamalebhyo namaḥ || || agastya uvāca || || aśvānanamahābuddhe sarvaśāstraviśārada || kathitaṃ lalitādevyāś caritaṃ paramādbhutam || 1 || pūrvaṃ prādurbhavo mātus tataḥ paṭṭābhiṣecanam || marāḍā(!)sudhadhaś caiva vistareṇa tvavoditaḥ || 2 || varṇitaṃ śrīpuraṃ cāpi mahāvibhavavistaram || śrīmatpañcadaśākṣaryā mahimā varṇitas tathā || 3 || ṣoḍhānyāsādayo nyāsā nyāsākhaṇḍesamīritāḥ || antaryāgakramaś caiva bahiryāgrakramas tathā || 4 || mahāyāgakramaś caiva pūjākhaṇḍe prakirttitaḥ || puraścaraṇakhaṇḍe tu japalakṣaṇam īritam || 5 || (fol. 1v1–5) End yo bhakto lalitādevyāḥ sa nityaṃ kīrttayed idam || nānyathā prītaye devī kalpakoṭiśatair api || 13 || tasmād rahasyanāmāni śrīmātuḥ prayataḥ paṭḥet || iti te kathitaṃ stotraṃ rahasyaṃ kuṃbhasaṃbhavaṃ || 14 || nāvidyāvedine brūyān nābhaktāya kadācana || yathaiva gopyā śrīvidyā tathā gopyam idaṃ mune || 15 || paśutulyeṣu na brūyāñ janeṣu stotram uttamam || yo dadāti vimūḍhātmā śrīvidyārahitāya ca || 16 || tasmai kupyanti yoginyaḥ so ʼnarthaḥ sumahān smṛtaḥ || rahasyanāmasāhastraṃ tasmāt saṃgopayed idam || 17 || svatantreṇa mayā noktaṃ tavāpi kalaśīsuta || lalitāpreraṇād eva mayoktaṃ stotram uttamam || 18 || kīrttanīyam idaṃ bhaktyā kumbhayoninirantaram || tena tuṣṭā mahādevī tavābhīṣṭaṃ pradāsyati || 19 || sūta uvāca || ity uktvā śrīhayagrīvo dhyātvā śrīlalitāmbikām || ānandamagnahṛdayaḥ sadyaḥ pulakito ʼbhavat || 20 || (fol. 19v4–20r3) Colophon iti śrībrahmāṇḍapurāṇe uttarakhaṇḍe lalitopākhyāne rahasyasahasranāmastotraṃ sampūrṇam paphāṇa || || || su(!)bham astu sarvadā || su(!)bham || || rāmo rājamaṇi sadā vijayete rāmaṃ rameśaṃ bhaje rāmenātihatā niśācaracamū rāmāya tasmai namaḥ || rāmāṃ nāsti parāyanaṃ mama paraṃ rāmasya dāso ʼsmi haṃ(!) rāme cittaḥ layaḥ sadā bhavatu me he (rāma) mām uddharaḥ(!) || śrīrāmacandrāya namaḥ || śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ || rāma rāma rāma || (fol. 20r3–6)
