Beginning śrīḥ || athottarasya caruvidhānam || raktaśālipiṣṭaṃ trikadukamiśraṃ vāruṇīmadhumarditam | tena dīpāna (!) nirmāya | tatra si(ddha)bhagurukarpūrakastūrīm (!) arbhitaṃ mahiṣachāgena vā tato raktena raktavartikāṃ kārayet | (2) pratimāṃ surasamarditān || pañcadalapadmoparisaṃsthāpya goghṛtena parirodhya | (fol. 1v1–2) End tata arhodakena niyamavidyayā saṃprokṣa (!) guggulena dhūpayet || tataḥ sarvāṅgaṃ dhunite sati niyamapūjitaṃ śastrakaṃ pāde vyādaghāt (!) || trailokya(11)tyarthaśarīraṃ taṃ jīvaṃ divyadeham || (fol. 3r10–11) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || tatvatrayatrivaham (!)atriguṇa (!) triliṇgaṃ, kālatrayatribhuvanatripurīśarīraṃ | netratrayatripathagā hi pavitragātraṃ pu(2)trī triśūlabhṛtam īśam ahaṃ praṇamya || (!) āgamebhyaḥ samākṛṣya, kuryyāl lakṣaṇasaṃgrahaṃ | ṛjuṃ saṃkṣepasaṃpūrṇṇaṃ, sarvvasthāpanasaṃkulaṃ || (fol. 1v1–2) End yāvac chrīmān a[na]ntā dharati vasumatī †muddhrim† ātāraśaktā | yāvat saptāṃtarīyārṇṇavavṛtathṛthivīmadhyato (!) merur asti || yāvac candrārkkatā(7)rāgaṇaptibhir idaṃ bhrājate suvrata subhram ambhaḥ || (!) tāvad vairocanīyāṃ (!) jagati ciram iyaṃ śvaccharūpās tu kīrttiḥ || || (fol. 152v6–7) Colophon iti śrīpratiṣṭhātantre vairocanī(8)yaṃ (!) lakṣaṇasārasamuccaye saṃhitāyāṃ pavitrārohaṇa (!) dvātriṃśatimo (!) vidhis samāptaḥ || || samvat 800 vaiśāṣaśukladvādaśī, śukravāra kuhnu sampūrṇṇa (9) yāṅā juro || liṣiti (!) vidyāpīṭḥīyā karmmācāryajayasiṃha (!) || śubham bhavatu sarvvadā || śrīcakrarājaupādhyāna, saṃgraha yāṅā juro || ❁ || (fol. 152v7–9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śaṃkarācāryebhyo namaḥ avighnam astu || akacaṭatapādyaiḥ saptabhiḥr vvarṇavargair (viracita)(2)mukhavyāhā pādamadhyā(suhṛktā) || sakalajagad adhīśā śāsvatā viśvayonir vitaratu pariśuddhiṃ ceta++(3)radāvaḥ || (fol. 1v1–3) End itthaṃ mūlaprakṛtyakṣararavikṛtalipivratetagra(8)harkṣatrādyāvaddhabhūtindriyaguṇaratricaṃdrāgnisamprate rūpaiḥ | (!) maṃtrais tad devi prakṛtisvabhā(1)vato (!) vibhinnabhāvadivasam (!) utthitaujasaḥ || jaganti puṣyaṃti ravindu vahnyo namos tu (2) tasmai paripūrṇatejase || (fol. 164v7–8, 165r1–2) Colophon || iti śrīmat paramahaṃsaparivrājakācāryyagovinda(3)bhagavatapūjyapādaśiṣyaparamahaṃnaparivrājakācāryyaśrīmatśaṃkarabhagavataḥ (4) (!) kṛtau prapañcasāre ṣaṭtrīṃśaḥ paṭalaḥ samāptaḥ || samāptaś cāyaṃ graṃthaḥ || || śubham || (5) || iti samvat 1954 sāla miti caitraśudi 7 roja 3 tad dine jirṇṇa uddhāra liṣita(6)m || || ❁ || || (fol. 165r2–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || prapañcabhuvanaṃ, mūrtiṃ mantradaivatamātaraḥ | mahāṣoḍhāhvayoḥ nyāsaḥ sarvvanyāsottamottamaḥ || atradau parameśāni, prapañcanyāsa ucyate || oṃ asya śrīmahāṣoḍhānyāsasya paramabrahma ṛṣir jagatīcchandaḥ śivaśakti (!) sadāśivo devatā mama siddhisādhanadharmmārthakāmamokṣārthe mahāṣoḍhānyāse viniyogaḥ || mahādevaṛṣayaḥ namaḥ || lalāṭe || jagatīcchandase namaḥ || jihvāyāṃ śivaśaktiśaktātmasadāśivo(!)devatāyai namaḥ || hṛdayaḥ || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ (hkauṃḥ) īśānāya hṛdayāya namaḥ || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ (hkauṃḥ) tatpurikhā(!)ya śirase svāhā || (exp. 2t: 1–6) End aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ (hkauṃḥ) haṃsaḥ so haṃ aṃ āṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ uṃ (!) ṛṃ ṝṃ ḷṃ ḷṃ eṃ aiṃ oṃ auṃ aṃ aṃḥ(!) kaṃ khaṃ gaṃ ghaṃ ṅaṃ caṃ cchaṃ jaṃ jhaṃ ñaṃ ṭaṃ ṭhaṃ ḍaṃ ḍhaṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ paṃ phaṃ baṃ bhaṃ maṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaṃ mātṛbhairavaśabda-adhipāyai prāmbādevyai namaḥ || iti hṛdaye vyāpakaṃ || || (exp. 14t: 3–6) Colophon iti śrīkulārṇave mahāṣoḍhānyāsaḥ samāptaḥ || śūbha (!) || bhādrapada śuklatrayodaśī budhavāra thva kuhnu dhuna kāmahā ṣoḍhāsapaśeccheyā kaviratnayā putra śrīśivapati ⟪dvija⟫ vipraḥ coyā dhunakā juroṃ saṃvat (724) || śrībhavāṇi(!)prītir attu (!) || (exp. 14t:6–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha nityotsavayauvano (!) tṛtīyollāsaprāraṃbhaḥ || natvā śrībhāsurānaṃdanāthapādāṃbujadvayaṃ || yunakty umānaṃdanātho yauvanollāsam udbhavaṃ || 1 || mahātripurasuṃdaryā mato[ʼ]tra yajanakramaḥ || kīrtyaṃte gaṇapatyādikramā yadupajīvinaḥ || 2 || iha saptaprakaraṇāny āhnikena samaryayā || homamudrānyāsajapanaimittikasamarcanaiḥ || 3 || (fol. 1r1–3) End naimittikārcanamukhyagauṇakālātikrame mūlavidyāsahasraṃ japaḥ prāyaścittam āmnātaṃ tantrarāje || naimittikātikramaṇe sahasraṃ prajapet tatheti || iti paṃcaparvārcanavidhiḥ || taṃtrāntarekeṣu yugamanvādiṣu viśeṣadivaseṣv api śrīdevyarcanam abhyudayāyaiva || sūtrakāreṇa kāmyahomasyaivoktatvāt pūjānuktir iti śivaṃ || iti yauvanollāse naimittiprakaraṇaṃ || yathāmati mayākāri seyaṃ śrīkramapaddhatiḥ bhramapramādaskhalitaṃ kṣamayantv iha sādhavaḥ || (fol. 40v11–41r4) Colophon iti śrībhāsurānaṃdanāthacaraṇāraviṃdamiliṃdāyamānasenomānaṃdanāthena viracite kalpasūtrānusāriṇi nityotsave nibaṃdhe yauvanollāsa(smṛtīyaḥ) saṃpūrṇaḥ || || || idaṃ pustakaṃ devasthalyupanāmakadhuṃḍhirājātmakagaṇeśasūriṇā kṛṣṇabhaṭṭasutalakṣmīnārāyaṇena likhitaṃ kive ityupanāmakasya rājā bhāu yasya gṛheṃduragrāmamadhye likhitaṃ svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca || (fol. 41r4–8)

Beginning śrīgurudattātreyāya (!) namaḥ || svastir (!) nirvighnam astu || śrīdevy uvāca || namas te stu mahādeva sarvvavidyāsvarūpiṇe || pañcāgamānāṃ maṃtrān me tattadhyānapuraḥsaraṃ (!) || aṃganyāsena ṛṣyādīn sāram uddhṛtya saṃvada || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu vakṣye viśālākṣi mahābhāge mama priye || mama prāṇādhike devi sarvvalokasukhaprade || (fol. 1v1–3) End ekamaṃtraparijñānād āgaeṣu maheśvari | saubhāgyād ida (!) saṃprāpya dehāṃte mokṣam āpnuyāt | ekasya vā parijñāne tasya janmāṃtaraṃ na hi || tasmād dīkṣāṃ vidhānena śṛṇuyāt sādhakottamaḥ || || || (fol. 7r6–7) Colophon iti śrīmahālakṣmīkalpe umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde śaṃkareṇa viracite pratyakṣasiddhiprade śrīmahālakṣmīratnakoṣe paṃcāmnāyamaṃtravivaraṇaṃ nāma ṣaḍaśītitamo dhyāyaḥ || || śrīdattatreyārpaṇam (!) astu || (fol. 7r7–8)

Beginning śrīgurave namaḥ mohāndhakāramagnānāṃ janānāṃ jñānaraśmibhiḥ kṛtam uddharaṇaṃ yena tan naumi śivabhāskaraṃ 1 kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaraṃ gaṇasiddhasamākīrṇaṃ munisṃghanisevitam (!) 2 tadutsaṃgagatā devī pārvatī pativallabhā || anugrahārthaṃ lokānāṃ papracha (!) parameśvaram 3 (fol. 1v1–3) End guhyād guhyataraṃ guhyaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || na deyaṃ pāpaśīlāya krūrakarmaratāya ca || anāstikāya bhaktāya sādhudviṣṭikarāya (!) ca || gurubhaktāya śāntāya satyavrataparāya ca || dātavyam, etad deveśi śāstraṃ paramadurllabhaṃ || siddhaḥ ku[[va]]layākhyo yaṃ bhaktimān vṛṣabhadhvaje || tena svarodayaṃ śāstraṃ martyaloke vatāritaṃ || || (fol. 50v5–8) Colophon iti yuddhajayārṇṇavataṃtre prakīrṇādhikāro nāmaḥ (!) daśama[[ḥ]] paṭalaḥ samāptaḥ || 10 || śubham || || (fol. 50v8–9)

Beginning ❖ śrīvighnavallīvidārakāya namaḥ || bhvānīpatim ānamya vaidikānaṃdadāyinīṃ | ślokair vakṣyāy ahaṃ rudrapaddhatiṃ mugdhabodhanīṃ (!) || 1 || himādriśikharāsīnaṃ naṃdinaṃ viśvanaṃdinaṃ | bhaktyā praṇamya śirasā śatānaṃdo [ʼ]bravīd idaṃ || 2 || śatānaṃda uvāca || bhagavan śrotum icchāmi rudrākhyānaṃ suvistaraṃ || kathaṃ rudratvam asyāsīt katidhā rudrasaṃbhavaḥ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–3) End vilāsinaṃ smeravaktraṃ saumyaṃ vai hṛdi bhāvaye || guhyamuṣkoruyugmeṣu jānujaṃghāṃyuge(!) sphijoḥ (!) || 18 || kaṭyāṃ pārśvadvaye vāmaṃ kalā nyasyet (!) trayodaśa (!) || prathamā vāmadevā⟪sya⟫ya namo ṃte syād rajaḥkalā || 19 || syāj jyeṣṭāya (!) namo rakṣā dvitīyā parikīrttitā || syād u/// (fol. 55v8–10) «Sub-colophon:» iti śrīmahārudrakalpe śatānaṃdanaṃdikeśvarasaṃvade kalaśarudraprakaraṇaṃ samāptaṃ || || || (fol. 11r3–4) iti bahirmātṛkānyāsaprakaraṇaṃ || (fol. 49r2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || idānīṃ śāktopāyaḥ prakāśyate || || tatra śaktir maṃtravīryasphārarūpeti prathamonmeṣāṃtasūtritatatsvarūpavivecanapuraḥsaram unmeṣāṃtaram ārabhamāṇo maṃtrasvarūpaṃ tāvan nirūpayati || cittaṃ maṃtraḥ || cetyate vimṛśyate anena paraṃ tattvam iti cittaṃ pūrṇasphuranttā satattvaprāsādapraṇavādimaṃtrāḥ vimarśarūpaṃ saṃvedanaṃ || (fol. 1v1–4) End ataḥ satatam ukyuktaḥ spaṃdatattvaviviktaye || jāgrād eva vijṛṃbhāvam acireṇādhigacchati ity evaṃ cittaṃ maṃtraḥ || iti ataḥ prabhṛtimaṃtravīryamudrāvīryānusaṃdhipradhānaṃ || uccārarahitaṃ vastu cetasaiva viciṃtaya(!)t || yaṃ samāveśam āpnoti śāktaḥ sotrābhidhīyate ity āmnātaṃ śāktopāyaṃ vivicya avadhānāvaliptaṃ pratividyāsaṃhāre tadutthasvadarśanam iti sūtreṇaitad anuṣaṃgenā(!)ṇavopāyapratipādanasyāvakāśo datta iti śivaṃ || || (fol. 11r1–5) Colophon iti śrīśivasūtravṛttau śāktopāyaprakāśanaṃ nāma dvitīyonmeṣaḥ || 2 || (fol. 11r5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāyai maṃgalāyai || navātmā(!)nyāsaḥ || tritatvenācamya || aiṃ 5 aṃ astrāya phaṭ || 4 || karaso(!)dhanaḥ (!) || (hsaṃ) aṃguṣṭhāya namaḥ || (kṣmaṃ) tarjjanyānyai (!) svāhā || lvaṃ madhyamāya vauṣaṭ || ryaṃ anāmikāyai hūṃ || ūṃ kaniṣṭhāyai vaṣaṭ || aṃ astrāya karatalāya phaṭ || (fol. 1v1–4) End abhaye bhayahāriṇi, anadye adyanāśini (!) adīne dainyakhaṇḍini, acintye cintānodini amugve māhāpanayini, ajaḍe jāḍyahāriṇi amāye māyādāhini abandye bandhañthadini (!), arāge rāgonmūlini, anugrāhike janmamaraṇabhayabhedini, alakṣaṇīye lakṣaṇadāyini/// (fol. 88v2–5) Colophon iti ekajaṭāmūlamantra (!) samāpta (!) || (fol. 59v5)

Beginning oṃ namo durgāya (!) namaḥ || || kailāsaśikhare ramye nānāratna(!)paśobhite || papraccha parayā bhaktyā bhairavaṃ parameśvaraṃ || caṇḍikovāca || tripurāpūjanaṃ nātha svarṇaratnai (!) vibhūṣaṇaiḥ || kalikāle svarṇaratnas taptabhāvas tathā maṇiḥ || kenopāyena deveśa svarṇaratnādi labhyate || tad vadasva viśeṣeṇa yathā ratnādikaṃ bhavet || (fol. 1v1–4) End nipakta(!)maṇipādukāniyamitādyuṃ(!)kolāhalaṃ sphurakti(!)śalarāruṇa(!)nakhasamullasaccandrakam || parāmṛtasarovaroditasarojamadrocitam || bhajāmi śirasi sthita(!) gurupadāravindadvayam || 6 || pādukāpaṃcakastotraṃ paca(!)vaktrād vinirgatam || ṣaḍāmnāyadalopetaṃ prapaṃce cātidurllabham ||7 || || (fol. 34v3–6) Colophon iti mātṛkābhedataṃtre sarvataṃtrottamottame pārvatīparameśvarasaṃvāde śrīśivavaktrād vinirgataṃ śrīmadgurupādukāstotraṃ samāptam || ❁ || śbham || ❁ || bhūyāt (fol. 34v6–8)

«Beginning of the root text:» || śrīdevy uvāca || bhagavan deva deveśa sarvajña karuṇānidhe || mālāmaṃtrān samācakṣva kādividyāsamudbhavān || 1 || (fol. 1v4–5) «Beginning of the commentary:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || atha mālāmaṃtroddhāralalitāpariśiṣṭagatasya paṭaladvayasya vyākhyāprāraṃbhaḥ ṛbhukṣarudrayutprajācyutādayo pi ye vṛtter (!) vaśaṃvadā na⟪taḥ⟫[[tāḥ]] striyaḥ suvāsinīpadaspṛ⟪haḥ⟩⟩[[hāḥ]] | maheśvarasya mṛtyudyusmarasya sākṣIṇī tu yā sumaṃgalīr iyaṃ vadhūr imāṃ sameta (!) paśyatu || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3 and 6–7) «End of the root text:» śrīvidyopāsako mālāmaṃtrān etān na vetti yaḥ || na tasya phalatopāsā (!) bhasmanīva hutāhutīḥ (!) || 76 || tasmād avaśyaṃ vijñeyā etāḥ paṃcadaśasrajaḥ || aprakāśyā api śive tvatprītyaiva mayoditāḥ || 77 || (fol. 29r3–7) «End of the commentary:» aprakāśyā api adhikāriṇo pi bhaktirahitāya tvatprītyaiva tanniṣṭhāṃ bhaktiṃ jñātvaiva mayety anena svasya śivasyāpi tadupāsatve sati mālāmaṃtrabhaktiṃ matvā dvatupadeṣṭum adhikāraḥ sūcitaḥ tenānyo pi bhaktiṃ parīkṣaivopāsakāya upāsako dadyād ity upadeśo dhvanati ti sarvaṃ śivaṃ || 77 || (fol. 28v9–29r9) «Colophon of the root text:» iti śrīlalitāpariśiṣṭatantre mālāmaṃtroddhāro dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 29r7–8) «Colophon of the commentary:» iti śrīgaṃbhīrādhvanitanujanur bhāskarabudho ʼgnicinnirdiṣṭāyām iha gurukalānāmani kṛtau samarthā yā mālā maṇipiṭhakakīloddhṛtividhau lipeḥ saṃkhyoddhāraś caramapaṭalaḥ paryavasitaḥ 1 iti śrīlalitāpariśiṣṭataṃtre mālāmantroddhāravyākhyāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ saṃpūrṇaḥ || śrīḥ || || || (fol. 29r9–29v3)

Beginning ❖ tato devārccanaṃ || oṃ namaḥ śivāya || mṛtyuñjayanyāsaṃ pūrvvavat || tena mantraṃ (!) arghapātrapūjā || āvāhanādidhenumudrā || oṃ juṃ saḥ amṛtīśāya vidmahe mṛtyuṃjayāya dhīmahe (!) tan no tetra pracodayāt || (fol. 1r1–2) End stotra (!) || śubhrāṅgaṃ bhasmarāgaṃ himakanikanibhā (!) bhūtakarppūrakānti(!), ekāsyaṃ ca trinetraṃ caturabhujadharaṃ (!) dānahastaṃbhayañ (!) ca pūrṇṇaṃ kumbhañ ca hastaṃ śaśikaradhṛtaṃ(!). dakṣavāme tiśobhaṃ, so yaṃ mṛtyuṃjayīśo (!) sakalabhayaharaṃ. pātu mṛtyuṃjayeśa (!) || atra gaṃdhādi || namaskāraṃ kṛtvā || || || (fol. 3r5–7) Colophon (fol. )

Beginning oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ hauṃ oṃ jūṃ saḥ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ tryaṃbakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhim puṣṭivarddhanam || urvārukam iva baṃdhanān mṛtyor mukṣīya māmṛtāt || bhūr bhuvaḥ svar auṃ jūṃ saḥ hauṃ oṃm (!) || (fol. 1v1–3) End hastāṃbhojayugasthakuṃbhayugalād uddhṛtya toyaṃ śiraḥ siṃcaṃtaṃ karayor yugena dadhataṃ svāṃke sakuṃbhau karau || akṣasragmṛgahastamaṃbujagataṃ mūrddhasthacaṃdrasravat pīyūṣonnatanuṃ(!) bhaje sagirijaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ tryaṃbakam || 1 || || || śubham astu || || || || (fol. 2v2–4) Colophon (fol. )

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha yaṃtraciṃtāmā(!)ṇyupayogiyaṃtrāṇi likhya(!)te || snānaṃ kṛtvā śucir bhūtvā pūjayet kuladevatām || 1 || lekhanīyaṃ prayatnena ekānte yaṃtram uttamaṃ || yasya kasya prayogasya vidhir eṣaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || dinatrayaprayogena(!) pūjābhogavidhānataḥ || trirātrabhūmiśayī syā(!) brahmacaryarataḥ śuciḥ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–3) End tadyaṃtraṃ pūjayitvā tu vahamāne ʼṃbhasi kṣipet || tadaṃbhapakva‥nnena bhojanaṃ tasya kārayet || evaṃ kṛte tṛtīye ʼhni mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || vivarastho ʼvaru ‥ ‥ vimucyate || || iti yaṃtram || 79 || deva hrīṁ data || || 79 || (fol. 35v5–7) Colophon iti yaṃtracintāmaṇiḥ samāptāḥ(!) || śubham (fol. 35v7)

«Beginning» ❖ akhaṃḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ || aiṁ 5 dhyātvādau martyasa⌠ṃ⌡sthit(!) varuṇaravinibhaṃ vedasa⌠ṃ⌡staṃ trinetraṃ khaḍgakhaṭvāṃgadakṣe phalakadharadharaṃ kādyakaṃ vāmahaste || tadvāmorusthe ca devīm aruṇitakarāṃ pātravinduṃ dvihastaṃ naumi śrīdvāramadhye sthitakaruṣaharaṃ kṣetranāthaṃ ca devīṃ || kṣetra⌠ṃ⌡ || ārūḍhaṃ meghanādaṃ vaṭukakulasutaṃ caktabaṃdhūkavarṇṇaṃ vahnijvālaugranetraṃ caturakaradhṛtaṃ dvādadakṣeṣu sa⌠ṃ⌡sthaṃ || śaktiṃ mālākhyahastaṃ punar api vidhṛtaṃ †vīna†vādyādihastaṃ naumi śrīvālarūpaṃ kanakamaṇinibhaṃ siddhibhāvapradānaṃ || vaṭuka || vighneśaṃ ṣaṭvīhastaṃ śivasutaviditavācondurusthaṃ trinetraṃ bhāsvantaṃ śāntabhāvaṃ śi(!)takarasamabhāṃ dvāravāmeṣu sa⌠ṃ⌡sthaṃ || śūbhradantaṃ ca mūlaṃ paraśukaradharaṃ mudgalaṃ laḍḍupātraṃ vande śrīkuṃjarāsyaṃ vividhabhayaharaṃ kārmyasiddhipradaṃ ca || (fol. 1r1–1v1) «End» tālusthe tu mahādevī sud(!)dhadrava namo ʼstu te | kodaṇḍadharamadhyasthe vindhyābrahmasamūrddhage || 10 || brahmadvārasthitā devī vāyvākhe(!) ca namo ʼstu te śṛ(!)ktirūpage nityaṃ sthitirūpe namo ʼstu te || 11 || (!) saṃhāracakrage devi anākhe(!) tu namo ʼstu te | kandasthānagate nityaṃ kuṇḍalākhe(!) mahābhare || 12 || mattagandhakavāhasthe pārarūpe namo ʼstu te | ṣāḍvaktrapañcake krānte cakrānteśī namo ʼstu te || 13 || ṣoḍaśādāranirmukte ādhārānte namo ʼstu te | trilakṣānte alakṣasthe ‥kṣe ca namo ʼstu te || 14 || vyomabhāvakalātīte vyaktāvyakta(!) namo ʼstu te | piṇḍarūpapadātīte rūpāṃteśī namo ʼstu te || 15 || jāgratsvapnasusvap(!)tānte turyānteśi namo ʼstu te sarvve sarvveśvarī śānte nirābhāse niri⌠n⌡dra(!)ye || 16 || avyakte amṛte randre paramaṃ viśvarūpage | (fol. 3v1–7) «Sub-Colophon» iti śrīkriyākalpatarau kumārīvaṭukayāgasya śubhāśubhaṃ || || || (fol. 2v1)

«Beginning» mi || prāṇāhutīr ddatvā āpāśanaṃ datvā || ▒ śrīguhyakālīn tarppayāmi namaḥ || ▒ śrīguhyabhairavaṃ tarppayāmi namaḥ || 3 || hruṁ ātmaguhyakālīṁ tarppayāmi 2 || iti tarpya || ṣaḍaṃgaṃ kṛtvā ▒ daśadhā japtvā japaṃ mame‥ || parameśvaryāṃ yatheṣṭhaṃ bhuktaṃ naivedyaṃ samarppitaṃ || (exp. 1t1–2r1) «End» hrāṁ hṛdaya(!)ya namaḥ | ityādiṣaḍaṃgaṃ vidhāya || mūla(!) || pādyaṃ namaḥ adyeº || ācamanīyaṃ 2 | madhuparkka(!) svadhā || punarācamanīya⌠ṃ⌡ 2 | snānīyaṃ 2 | punarācamanīyaṃ 2 | vastra(!)laṃkārārthe akṛtaṃ namaḥ | †śaṃdha†raktacandanasindūraṃ 2 | puṣpaṃ 2 || dhūpādiśo‥ || bhairavamantreṇa evaṃ pūjya || pūpaṃ 2 | dīpaṃ 2 idaṃ naivedyaṃ nivedayā (exp. 14t4–14b5) «Colophon»

«Beginning» ❖ atha nityaṃ || phraḥ astrāya phaṭ | iti jalaṃ prokṣa || oṁ ▒ śodhaṇaṃ || ▒ oṃ †dihaṇaṃ† || phreṁ krīṁ pṛṣataṃ || phreṁ ▒ oṁ tripuraḥ prāja(!) || gaṃdhādi datvā phreṁ kṣoṇī trir ābhimantrya || dhenuliṃgayonimudrāṃ pradarśya || phreṁ hrāṁ ātmatatvāya svāhā || phreṁ krīṁ vidyātatvāya svāhā || phreṁ hrīṁ (śi)vatatvāya svāhā || (exp. 2t1–2b1) «End» siṃhebhakolakapi ṛ(!)kṣaturaṃgatārkṣa- yogeśvarīmakaramānavapaṃkticakrāṃ | śūlāṃkuśābjaparaśumudgarayāgapātra- khaṭvāṅgabālakaśirāṃkitapāṇipadmāṃ || iti dhyātvā paṃcamudrābhinamya || khphreṁ mahācaṇḍayogeśvari ▒ || e‥ yathāśakti japtvā japaṃ samarpyya || guhyātiguhyagoptṛtvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japaṃ | siddhir bhavatu me devi guhyakāli namo ʼstu te || iti || kāli 2 mahākāli caturvvargaphalaprade | yogeśvari mahākāli guhyakāli namo ʼstu te || astreṇa visarjjati nityavidhiḥ (3b2–4t5) «Colophon»

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || anādyaṃto ʼparādhīnaḥ svādhīnabhuvanatrayaḥ || jayaty avirato vyāpta viśvakālo vināyakaḥ || 1 || || trīdevy uvāca || bhagavan sarvataṃtrāṇi bhavatoktāni me purā || nityānāṃ ṣoḍaśānāñ ca navataṃtrāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ || 2 || teṣām anyonyasāpekṣāj jāyate mativibhramaḥ || tasmāt tu nirapekṣaṃ me taṃtraṃ tāsāṃ vada prabho || 3 || || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu kādimataṃ taṃtraṃ pūrṇam anyān apekṣayā || gopyaṃ sarvvaprayatnena gopanaṃ tantra coditam || 4 || (fol. 1v1–4) End etad uktaṃ bhavati || mūlādhārahṛdayabrahmaraṃdhreṣu anyatame nityasaparyayoktacakrasthāṃ tatrasthābhir aṇimādibhiḥ parivṛtāṃ vibhāvya pūjayan iṣṭaphalaṃ labhata iti || prāgjanyādyaiś ciraṃtanābhir(!) durvāsanābhir māsaṃ māsaṃ pratiratnam ekaikamāsaṃ pāpaughaiḥ saṃkocabhāvaś cakṣuṣā ity u[n]manasānubhavasiddha(!) kathayati || pāpakṛtyādiduḥkhaiḥ svakīyā ʼvivekaiḥ kṛtyāduḥkhair arātibhiḥ duḥprayogotthābhiḥ kṛtyādibhir ādiśabdena yaṃtracūrṇauṣadhanikṣepā(!) ucyate || taiś ca janitair duḥkhair ity arthaḥ || devīrūpam ityādinā ślokena ākhaṇḍaviśvarūpa(!) || devatābhāvanānāḍīvan muktarūpaṃ paripūrṇaṃ phalam upadiśati ta(!) || tatra cakraṃ sakaladevatāvāsabhūtaṃ śrīcakraśaktir āvaraṇaśaktyādyaṃtata⌠ḥ⌡ sakhyātmaśaktiviṣayaiḥ śabdādirūpais tanmayo bhavet || tad ahaṃkārasvāhaṃkāraraṃ? vilāpayed ity arthaḥ || || (fol. 38v10–39r3) Colophon iti śrīṣoḍaśanityāta[ṃ]treṣu śrīkādimatādimatākhyasya paripūrṇasya taṃtrasya prapraṃcasārasiṃharājaprakāśābhidhānena śubhagānanṃdanādhena viracitāyāṃ manoramākhyāyāṃ vyākhyāyāṃ ṣoḍaśa⟨śa⟩nityā(!)naimityakakāmyārcanaprakāśanaḥ ṣaṣṭaḥ paṭalaḥ paripūrṇaḥ parāmṛṣṭaḥ || 6 || graṃthasa⌠ṃ⌡khyā ṣaṣṭe yaṃtrāṇi saptatyu(!) vyākhyāgra⌠ṃ⌡thaḥ śatāt paraṃ | (saṅgī)pādās triṣaṣṭir ti tasya ku samīrita(!) || || || samvat || 970 miti jyeṣṭhaśudi || 14 || roja || 1 || śubham || (39r3–7, exp. 161b)

Beginning kas tat⟨tprat⟩pratyayādhīnapratyayakaś ca || asau tu naivaṃ || astu vā parān adhīnatvaṃ svādhīnatrilokīka⟪ṃ⟫tvaṃ tu nāsya jaḍatvāt saṃbhāvitaṃ na tu adhīnaṃ bhuvanatraye yasyety avaśyābhyupeyavahubrīhiṇaivoktavivakṣitārthalābhena svapadam anatiprayojanakam iti cet evaṃ tarhi susamyagādhir yatrety evaṃ bhūtaṃ svāmy aparaparyāye itaṃ śrutaṃ va bhuvanatrayaṃ yenety evam astu vigrahaḥ || uktārthas tv aparādhīna ity asyevāpare adhīnāyasyeti vigrahasyāpi parādhīna iti vibrahsye va vivakṣitatvāc chakyate (fol. 2v1–4) End ṣoḍaśenety ādi uktarūpeṇa caramasya sakārasya paṃcavarṇāḥ prāthamikāḥ paṃcadaśatame yaṃtre caramakoṇan vṛttadvayāṃtarālīyacaturdikṣu likhanena ca viniyuktāḥ śeṣāḥ susasṛprabhṛtaya ekādaśavarṇās teṣāṃ madhyādisthāneṣṭak(!)tarītyā vinyāsena sampāditena ṣoḍaśatamena yaṃtreṇa sābhiṣekaṃ bhūrjapatre likhitvā dhṛtenānena yaṃtreśā sarveṣām adhikapremapātratāṃ bhartuḥ sāstrībhajed ity arthaḥ || 99 || ekaṃ sābhiṣekaṃ bhūrjapatre likhitvā dhṛtenānena yaṃtreśā sarveṣām api martyānā(!) na tu puṃsām eva strīṇām eva vā sarvadā sarvadā sarvabhayakālena tu yat kiṃcid bhaya eva rakṣā bhavati ādinā bhūtapretādityagrahaḥ || 100 || sparśatatvety ādi vyākhyātaprāyaṃ || sākṣā[c]chrīpatikāntaṃ vīryyakaruṇākaraṇākalpadrumodyatpule vidvatpremanidhiprasiddhidhiṣaṇarāṃapriyāsaṃbhave anvarthābhdhataṃtrarājaviṣama aślokārthasaṃdarśanānvarthāṅhyānasudarśanetrapaṭalo pūrvagatokonmitaḥ || śrīkārttavīryyārjunāya namaḥ || || śrīkārttavīryyapadato vividhaiś ca yoge goyīpi(!) te hṛdi nije vividhaiś ca yogaiḥ yo nīyate svahṛdayasvahitāya yasminn ādhī (fol. 167v4–12) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ śrīkālikāyai namaḥ parāpara pareśāna mahādeva jagatpate tvatpraśā(!)dāt śrutaṃ sarvaṃ kālikāpūjanaṃ mahat 1 nyāsajālaṃ mantrajālaṃ prayogaṃ śavaśādhanaṃ prāṇeśa kin tu kavacaṃ sūcitaṃ na kathaṃ tvayā 2 tat kim apy agopyante prāyaśaḥ parameśvara brahmāṇḍagolake kiṃcid īdṛśaṃ na hi vidyate 3 (fol. 1v1–5) End gadyapadmātmikā vāṇī bhave gaṃgā pravāhayet kamalā niścalā tasya grahe svajanavallabhaḥ 34 indro [ʼ]pi dāsatāṃ yānti(!) satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ṣaṭkarmasiddhir bhavati kavacasya prasādataḥ 35 sa yonicandanāṣṭagandhasaṃpeṣyamātrataḥ bhurja(!) saṃlikhya kavacaṃ dhāraye[d] dakṣiṇe bhuje 36 sarvaiśvaryyayuto bhutvā bhaved bhuvanādhipaḥ yaṃ yaṃ kāma[ṃ] hṛdi dhyātvā kavacaṃ devi dhārayet 37 taṃ taṃ kāṃam avāpnoti īśvarasya vaco yathā ayutaṃ kavacaṃ devi śaratkāla(!) mahāniśi paṭhanīyaṃ prayatnena caturvargaphalāptaye 38 ajñātvā kavacaṃ yas tu kālīpūjāṃ kariṣyati pratijñātaṃ mahādevi sa me badhyo bhaviṣyati (fol. 5v1–*6r5) Colophon ī(!)ti śrīhāhārāvatantre śrīdakṣiṇakālikavacaṃ samāptam (fol.*5r1–6)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namo ʼgastyāya || devy uvāca || ataḥ paraṃ samācakṣva, kārttavīryasya bhūpateḥ || cakravarttipadasthasya, kiṃ vṛttāntaṃ maheśvara || śrībhairava uvāca || śrūyatāṃ devi vṛttāntaṃ kārttavīryyasya bhūpateḥ vindhopakaṇṭhavipine, tapasyantañ ca haihayaṃ, pitaraṃ draṣṭukāmo ʼsau jagāma kṛtavīryasūḥ | tapovanaṃ samāsādya pitroḥ pādāmba(!)jārccaṇaṃ || kṛtvā tatraiva tasthau tu harṣanirbharamānasaḥ | dattātreyamuniś cāpi, tadā tatrāśrame sthitaḥ || (exp. 2r1–3) End ity agastyamukhāc chrutvā brahmādyās tridivaukasaḥ | prahṛṣṭamānasāḥ sarvve yayur lokaṃ yathāyathaṃ || ity etat kathitaṃ vatsa, kumbhayonisamudbhavam | vyākhyānaṃ rogaśokāgni,bhayaduḥkhanivāraṇaṃ || || kārttavīrya uvāca || bhagavan tvanmukhodgīrṇa,m agastyasya mahāmune || śrutaṃ śreṣṭhasukhopākhyānaṃ(!)|| mahāpuṇyaphalapradam || <ref>Pāda c is Hypermetrical.</ref> aham apy ācariṣyāmi, kumbhayonivrataṃ guro | i[ty u]ktvā taṃ namaskṛtvā dattātreyaṃ mahāgurum | nijarājyaṃ yayau ----ja dharmmato mahīm || etat te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ kaumbhasambhavaṃ | yan na kasyacid ākhyātaṃ, tava snehavasān mayā || || (exp. 5b4–7) <references/> Colophon iti kulālikāmnāye mahātantre ʼgastyavratakathā⟨ḥ⟩ samāptā || || || śubham astu⟨ḥ⟩ || ❁ || ❁ || (exp. 5b7)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namo nārāyaṇāya || athāgastyakathā likhyate || dharmmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ dāyine kumbhayonaye | sarvvadevasvarūpāya jagato gurave namaḥ || || devy uvāca || ataḥ paraṃ samācakṣva kārttavīryyasya bhūpateḥ | cakravarttipadasthasya kiṃ vṛttāntaṃ maheśvara || || śrībhairava uvāca || śrūyatān devi vṛttāntaṃ kārttavīryyasya bhūbhujaḥ | vindhyopakaṇṭhavipinaṃ tapasyantaṃ ca haihayaṃ || pitaraṃ draṣṭukāmo ʼsau jagāma kṛtavīryyasūḥ || tapovanaṃ samāsādya pitroḥ pādāmbunā(!)rccanaṃ || kṛtvā tatraiva tasthau sa harṣanirbharamānasaḥ || dattātreyo muniś cāpi tadā tatrāśramasthitaḥ | (56r1–6) End kārttavīryya uvāca || bhagavaṁs tvanmukhodgīrṇaṃ agastyasya mahāmuneḥ | śrutaṃ śreṣṭham upākhyānaṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradṃaṃ | aham apy ācariṣyāmi kumbhayonivrataṃ guro || ity uktvā taṃ namaskṛtvā dattātreyaṃ mahāguruṃ || nijarājyaṃ yayau so tha bubhuje dharmmato mahīṃ || īśvara uvāca || etat te kathitaṃ devi mahātmyaṃ kāṃbhasaṃbhavaṃ | yan na kasya cidākhyātaṃ tava snehavaśān mayā || ○ || (fol. 62v5–4) Colophon iti śrīkulākalikāmnāye mahātantre ʼgastyakathā samāptā || ❁ || śubham astu || saṃ 796 kārttikamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe girijātithau śubhadine manoharātmajaśrīviśvambharabhūdevo vyalikhad idaṃ || śubham astu sadāsmākaṃ || (fol. 62v5–6)

Beginning ❖ tato dehalīdvārasthāpana || pithipūjā || vighniharaṇa valyārccanādi || pañcagavya sādhana || arghapātra sādhana || bhūtaśuddhiḥ || hotā sarvvālaṃkāraṇa || śi(2)vahasta || jñānakhaḍga sādhana || maṇḍapa sodha || śivaśakti calāsana || pūrvvadvāra || bhramaṇa || sthirāsana || indrādi kalaśārccana || sthaṇḍilyārccana || valyārccanā(3)ntaṃ || siddhāgni pratiṣṭhākrameṇa vidhithyaṃ yajña yāya || caru sādhana || ghṛtāhuti || tilāhuti || kalaśa pratiṣṭhā || saṃkhyāhutitvaṃ || || yathākarmmasa || kha(4)siṃ laṃsoya || nirmmaṃchanādi dīpaloha rakṣā || yajñamaṇḍapasya īśāne || vidhivat snāna yāya || dṛṣṭi biyake || candanādi sagona āśīrvvāda sephā (5) ārati || (fol. 1r1-5) iti (fol. 2v3) dehalīdvārasthāpanavidhiḥ || || ۞ || End thvanaṃliva brāhmaṇasavo nāpaṃ thīrahāla (6)vana || dakṣiṇā vali choya || bhevata ṅu[[ya]]kā dondu sakaleṅa thānalakhusa || bhevata vali bhairavasa || thvanali karmmavali choya || yajamāna mohanī svāna biya || || (7) thānasa haṃsapūjā vane || Iṣṭadevatāske māle 2 pūjā choya || thvate karmmācāryyayā dehalīdvārasthāpana yāṅana pañcāsa kṣetrapāla vali biyayā vidhiḥ || || (fol. 6v5-7) «colophon:» samvat 811 kārttika śukla navamī thvakuhnu śrīśrīsumatijayajitāmitra malladevasana dayakā juroṃ || || || śubha || (fol. 6v8)

Beginning ❖ śrīcaṇḍīkāyai namaḥ || atha brāhmānīdhyāna || || rocanā hemaśaṃkāsaṃ dvādaśaṃ bhujabhūṣitā | vajrakhaḍgatathāsūraṃ salam aṃkūśapāśakaṃ || dakṣihaste dharā devī vāmasthe karaśobhitā | pāśakaṃ phenakaṃ hastaṃ pātraṃ ca na pinākīni || (fol. 1r1–4) End pāśakamaṇḍalaṃ ṇeṣṭā abhayabhayanāśiṇī || siṃhārūdhaṃ māhādevī iśānādi kapālakaṃ || aticaṇḍā tu vikṣānā lakṣmī sampūjatā bhavet || śaṃ śmvryū aticaṇdikādevyai pūṣpa namaḥ || || || śubha sarvvadā || śrī śūrjjanārāyanaṃ liṣiti || (fol. 6r1–5) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ ugratārāyai || prakaṭakikaṭahastā ghorarūpā trihāsā, narasirakṛtamārā mevaṇṇā triravarṇṇā tribhuvanajapadātṛ triṃ hastavinasestakarṇṇi | (fol. 1r, 1–2) End kapālike mahāvaktre mahāgho mahāsure | jāḍyaṃ nāśaya me devī kālikāli namo stu te || 17 || iti śivaśāsa || || (fol. 3v, 5–7) Colophon

Beginning athogratārāstotram || || ghorarūpe mahārāve sarvaśatrukṣayaṃkarī || bhaktebhyo varade devi trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgataṃ | 1 || surāsurārcite devi siddhaṃ gaṃdharvasevite || jāḍyapāpahare devi trāºº || 2 || jaṭājūṭasamāyukte lolajihvendhakāriṇi || drutavṛddhikare devi trāhiºº 3 (fol. 1r, 1–3) End pīḍāyām api saṃgrāme jāpyadāne tathābhaye || ya idam paṭhati stotraṃ śubhaṃ tasya na saṃśayaḥ || 12 || || iti ugratārāstotram || || || || || (fol. 1v, 3–4) Colophon

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || mātar nnīlasarasvatī praṇamatāṃ saubhāgyasaṃpatprade pratyālīḍhapadasthite śavahṛdi smerānanāmbhoruhe || sphulendīvaralocane trinayane karttrikapālotpale khaḍgaṃ cādadhatī tvam eva śaraṇaṃ tvām īśvarīm āśraye || 1 || (fol. 1r1–3) End kīrttikāṃti(!) ca nairujyāṃ sarveṣāṃ priyatāṃ bhajet || vikhyātiṃ cāpi lokeṣu prāpyaṃte(!) mokṣyam āpnuyāt || 11 || || || (fol. 2v4–5) Colophon iti śrīnīlataṃtre ugratārāstotram samāptaṃ jātam iti || || śrīpitāṃvarāyai namaḥ || || || ❁ || (fol. 2v5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrītārāyai || || oṃ ghorarūpe mahārāve sarvvaśatrukṣayaṃkari | bhaktebhyo varade devi, trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgataṃ || surāsurārcite devi, siddhagandharvasevite | jāḍyapāpahare devi, trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgataṃ || (exp. 1t1–4) End tasya śatruḥ kṣayaṃ yāti, mahāprajñā ca jāyate || pīḍāyā vāpi saṃdhāne, jāpye dāne tathābhaye | ya idaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ śubhaṃ tasya na saṃśayaḥ || || (exps. 5b3–6t2) Colophon iti śrīdevīpurāṇe śrīugratārāstotraṃ samāptaṃ || || śrīśubha || (exp. 6t2–3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ hrī phat hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hraiṃ hrauṃ hruṃ oṃ tāre ture tāra u huṃ svāhā, oṃ vajre ghore mahāmahima viśuddhasatva oṃ ugratāre chrāṃ phaṭ 2 jāhi 2 (exp. 2t1–2) End śāntiṃ kuru 2 drāvaya 2 juṣṭhaya 2 krāmaya 2 sa sāṃ sṛ sai sā sa prasīda parameśvarī ugratārā vajrapuṣpaṃ pratīccha 2 namāmi sinha 3 phat 5 svāhā || (exp. 4t5–4b1) Colophon iti tārāsahasrākṣarī samāpta || || (exp. 4b1)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrītripurādevyai || aiṃdrasyaiva sarāsanasya dadhatī madhyalalāṭe prabhāṃ, sauḥ klīṃ kāntim anuṣṇagaurī vaśī ca syā tanvati sarvataḥ || eṣā sauḥ tripurā hṛdi dyutir ivoṣṇāṃśoḥ sadā bhasthitā | chindyād va sahasā padais tripurayaṃ jyotirmayī vāṅmayī || 1 || (exp. 4b2–4) End ❖ idaṃ stotraṃ pathed yas tu satatarahasya ca tasya śantu kṣaryayānti mahāpīṅgaś ca jāyate || pīḍāyām avisaṃ jāpyavāna bhave tathā jadidaṃ pathate stotraṃ śubhaṃ tasya na śaṃsaya || (exp. 8b3–5) Colophon iti śrīdevīpurāṇe ugratārāstotraṃ samāpta || (exp. 8b5–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo mahāgaṇeśāya || śrībhagavān uvāca || na tirthin(!) na ca nakṣatraṃ †nopavāme† vidhīyate yatheṣṭaceṣṭayā mantraḥ sarvakālaphalapradaṃ || sarvāvasthāgataṃ kalpam ucchiṣṭaṃ mantranāyakaṃ || na siddhādi(!) nirūpyātra lakṣam ekaṃ japed budhaḥ || (fol. 1v1–3) End sarvatrātra yoṣinniyamavān †anācāntā† dhikāre japet || tais taiḥ viśeṣaiḥ valī(!) dadyāt, saṃdhyāsu ca viśeṣataḥ || || oṃ ❖ gaṃ hastipiśo likhe(!) svāhā || 10 || (fol. 8v2–4) Colophon iti śrīucchiṣṭagaṇeśapaddhati(!) samāptaṃ(!) || || (fol. 8v4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ sumukhīdevī namaḥ śrīcāṇḍālinyai || caṃpakalikāgauracauraṃ cittebhyaḥ ekajanatāyāḥ || vihasattejakṣmau raṃ pauraṃ dhuṃ dehe mīśitu naumi || (fol. 17r2–3) End āgamavipinamayūrī †mādyāmantarvvitrāveye† gaurī || ❁ || (fol. 17v5–6) Colophon iti śrīśaṃkaracāryaviracitāyāṃ ucchiṣṭacāṇḍālinyāṃ daṃdakastotra(!) samāptaṃ || ○ || (fol. 17v7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ sumukhīdevī namaḥ śrīcāṇḍālinyai || caṃpakalikāgauracauraṃ cittebhyaḥ ekajanatāyāḥ || vihasattejakṣmau raṃ pauraṃ dhuṃ dehe mīśitu naumi || (fol. 17r2–3) End āgamavipinamayūrī †mādyāmantarvvitrāveye† gaurī || ❁ || (fol. 17v5–6) Colophon iti śrīśaṃkaracāryaviracitāyāṃ ucchiṣṭacāṇḍālinyāṃ daṃdakastotra(!) samāptaṃ || ○ || (fol. 17v7)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ ulkāyai namaḥ || vaśiṣṭa uvāca || kathaṃ duḥkhe nimagno si kimarthaṃ malinaṃ mukhaṃ || mamāgre kathyatāṃ duḥkham upāyaṃ vacmi sāṃprataṃ || 1 || hariścandra uvāca || rājyabhraṃśo mahāñjāto vanavāsādikaṃ tataḥ || patnyādīnāṃ kathaṃ prāptir yuktaṃ tūrṇaṃ vada prabho || (fol. 1v, 1–4) End gurubhaktāya śāṃtāya devībhaktiparāya ca || deyaṃ ca stotrarājaṃ ca satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 15 || (fol. 3r, 1–2) Colophon iti meruśrītantre kailāsakaṇḍe śrīulkādevyāḥ stotraṃ samāptam aprāṇīt || || svasti śrīsaṃvat 1837 bhādrakṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ likhitaṃ śubhaṃ (fol. 3r, 2–3)

(exp. 33b7–8) Colophon samvat 1949 sāla ... (exp. 33b11)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || gurunamaskāra || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāpta (!) jena (!) carācaraṃ || tatpadaṃ darsitaṃ (!) jena (!) tasmai śrīguruve (!) namaḥ || || dvārapūjā || oṃ dvāradevatāyai namaḥ || devīsthānaṃ gatvā || trir ācamyaṃ (!) || aiṃ ātmatatvāya svāhā || || (exp. 2t1–3) End sākṣī thāya || virabhoja yāya || iti komārī jāgārcanavidhi samāpta || || (exp. 29b2–3) Colophon samvat 1943 miti sāla bhādra vadi 8 ro 1 tadine likhitaṃ devīdharavatā suśubham || (exp. 29b9)

«Complete transcript:» ❖ atha bhūtaśuddhi || pādādijānuparyantaṃ, pṛthivīsthāmaś caturasaṃpītavarṇṇaṃ brahmadaivataṃ || tanmadhye vaṃ bījaṃ dhyāyet || || nābhyādihṛdiparyantaṃ tejasthānaṃ trikoṇākāraṃ raktavarṇaṃ tanmadhye raṃ bījaṃ dhyāyet || hṛdyādikaṃthaparyantaṃ vāyusthānaṃ ṣaṭkoṇākāraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇṇaṃ maheśvaradaivataṃ tanmadhye yaṃ bījaṃ dhyāyet || kaṇṭhādilalāṭaparyantaṃ ākāśadhyānacaturākāraṃ dhūmravarṇṇaṃ sadāśivadaivataṃ madhye haṃ bījaṃ dhyāyet || (exp. 29b3–8) Colophon samvat 1943 miti sāla bhādra vadi 8 ro 1 tadine likhitaṃ devīdharavatā suśubham || (exp. 29b9)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ namaḥ śrīulkāyai namaḥ || vaśiṣṭovāca || kathaṃ duḥkhe nimagno si kimarthaṃ malinaṃ mukhaṃ || mamāgre kathyatāṃ duḥkham upāyaṃ vacmi śāṃprataṃ || 1 || hariścandra uvāca || rājyabhraṃśo mahāñjāto vanavāsādikaṃ tataḥ || patnyādi(!)nāṃ kathaṃ labhya(!) yukti(!) tuṇām<ref name="ftn1"> For tūrṇaṃ . </ref> vada prabho || (exp. 1, 1–5) End gurubhaktāya śāṃtāya devībhaktira(!)parāya ca || deyaṃ ca stotrarājaṃ ca satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 15 || (exp. 2, 25–26) Colophon iti meruśrītantre kairā(!)saā(!)gamane ulkādevyā stotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ (exp. 2, 26–27)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīmad ekajaṭānīlogratārābhyo namaḥ || devīṃ vicintayet || || trir ācamya || vāmādidevatābhyo namaḥ || oṃ asya śrīekajaṭānīlogratārāmahāmaṃtrasya akṣobhyaṛṣir bṛhatīchandaḥ ekajaṭādi devatā, huṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiṃ strīṃ kīlakaṃ mama sakalapuruṣārthe jape viniyogaḥ || (exp. 1, 1–7) End śatadhā paṭhanenaiva tārāpīṭhe śivālaye || sādhayet sarvvakāryāṇi tārāsāyujyam āpnuyāt || || iti tārābhaktitaṃtre īśvaraproktaṃ tārāsahasrākṣarīmālāmaṃtrastotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || (exp. 6 top, 8–9–exp. 6 bottom, 1–3) Colophon

Beginning atha stotraṃ || śrītārāyai namaḥ || śrīśivauvāca || kailāśaśikhare pūrvve deviṃ prītyā śivoditaṃ || hitārthaṃ sarvvalokānāṃ tāriṇyā śatanāma hi || sarvvaṃ maṃtramayaṃ stotraṃ divyānaṃdakaraṃ paraṃ || sarvvakāmārthadaṃ nāma paṭhet tārāpraśīdati (!) || || (exp. 18b, 3–9) End saṃpūjyate tadā devīṃ sarvvasiddhim avāpnuyāt || aṃte sāyujyapadavīṃ sādhako nātra saṃśayaḥ || iti || || (exp. 20b, 4–7) Colophon śrīkulasarvvasvataṃtre sadāśivaproktaṃ tārāśatanāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || (exp. 20b, 4–7)

Beginning atha tārāstotrāṇi paṃcāṃgavidhiḥ || deveśīyogiṇi (!) tārā yogadā vajradhāriṇī || yogamāyā ghorahāsā mahādevī jaṭādharā || tāriṇī śāṃkarī caiva bhagavatīpūrṇarūpiṇī || japāṃte ca idaṃ nāma stotrādau praṇataḥ paṭhet || (exp. 6b, 3–7) End likhitaṃ yasya gehe tu kavacaṃ bhairavoditaṃ || na tasya durgatiḥ kācij jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | sarve grahāś ca tuṣyaṃti vaśaṃ gacchanti bhūmijāḥ || yad deśe kavacajñāsti jāyate taṃtramaṃtrayaḥ || etat te sarvvam ākhyātaṃ dharmārthaṃ vacanaṃ śubhaṃ || iti bhairavārṇavamahārahasyataṃtre śivapārvvatīsaṃvāde śrīmatnīlogratāraikajaṭāmahākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || śubham astu sarvadā || (exp. 12b, 1–8) Colophon

Beginning atha stavaṃ || || śrītārāyai namaḥ || || śrīśiva uvāca || || śṛṇu bhadre kuleśānibhujaṃgākhyaprayātakaḥ || divyaṃ stavaṃ tu tārāyāḥ bhairavena vinirmitaṃ || devyuvāca || kasmin kāle kṛtaṃ stotraṃ kasyārthaṃ kena hetunā || brūhi me parameśāna yogyaṃ cec chruyatedhunā || (exp. 16t, 5–10) End suśāṃtāya pradātavyaṃ kaulācāraparāya ca || sarvvatra jayam āpnoti prāpnoti vipulaṃ sukhaṃ || || (exp. 18t, 9–exp. 18b, 3) Colophon iti śrīuḍḍāmalataṃtre (!) haragaurīsamvāve tārābhujaṃgaprayātastavaṃ saṃpūrṇam|| || śubhaṃ || || (exp. 18t, 9–exp. 18b, 3)

Beginning atha tāriṇyāścāṃgapūraṇārthaṃ kramena (!) takārādi sahasranāmapāṭhaṃ kuryyāt || tadante || bālārkākhya stutiṃ paṭhet || || śrītārāyai namaḥ || (exp. 20b, 8–10) End lokas tenāryyalokeśvaracaraṇatale svastikasvasticihnām ahnāyāyaṃ prayāyāt sugatasutamahīn tāṃ sukhāvatyupākhyām || 37|| (exp. 33b, 3–6) Colophon iti sarvvajñamitrajayanācāryyakṛtaṃ mahogratārāstavaṃ sampūrṇaṃ || śubham astu || (exp. 33b, 6–8)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || brāhmme mūha///4 ya kuladevatāṃ ca smṛtvā pādau prakṣyālya mukhaprakṣe///4 sasīparidhāya mārjanaṃ kṛtvā bhasmo dhṛtya svāsane āsīno mūlena trivāraṃ bhasmam abhimaṃtrya || īśānāya namaḥ || iti śirasi || tatpuruṣāya namaḥ iti mukhe || (fol. 1v1–5) End aṃ āṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ ūṃ ṛṃ ṝṃ ḷṃ ḷṃ eṃ aiṃ oṃ auṃ aṃ aḥ || ātmatatvāya ātma || ❁ || śrī ❖ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || śrī || ❖ || śrī śrī vākā tripurasuṃdaryyai namaḥ || śrī śrī gurucaraṇakamalebhyo namaḥ || ❁ || śrī || ❁ || (fol. 20r2–5) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || ❁ || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || ❁ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || ❁ || śrīśaṃkarasundarībhyāṃ namaḥ || ❁ || śrīguruṃ gaṇapatiṃ durgāṃ baṭukaṃ śivam acyutaṃ || brahmāṇaṃ girijāṃ lakṣmīṃ vāṇīṃ vaṃde vibhūtaye || 1 || śrīśaṃkaraguruṃ vaṃde śāṃkarīṃ hṛtamānasaṃ || yatpādasparśanād eva bhāladurvarṇasaṃhṛtiḥ || 2 || taṃ śaṃkaraguruṃ natvā nārāyaṇapuraḥsaraṃ || taṃnyate śivarāmeṇa siddhāṃtasārapaddhatiḥ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–3) End śrīmahāgaṇapatināthaḥ puṣṭidevyaṃ vā śrī○ || oṃ gaṃ svāhā ekākṣaragaṇanāthaśrīṃ oṃ guṃ○|| hareṃ va gaṇanāthaśrī○ || oṃ vīra 2 gaṇapateśvara 2 dasarvajanaṃ meva śamānaya○ || vīragaṇanāthaśrī○ || oṃ hrīṃ gaṃ vīra 2 gaṇapate vara 2 dasarvajanaṃ mevaśamānaya○ || oṃ hastituṃḍāyalabodarāya uchiṣṭamahātmane oṃ ktiṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ uchiṣṭāya svā○ || uchiṣṭagaṇapa○ || (fol. 191v8–10, exp. 586) Colophon

Beginning ○ || śrīvedavyāsāya namaḥ asmat śrī śrī śrī kṛṣṇanaṃdanātha śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi, oṃ śuddhaśaktimālāmaṃtrasya upastheṃdriyādhiṣṭhāyāṃ varuṇāsi sapta ṛṣīḥ || gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ || (fol. 1v1–3) End ekabhagaṇanārūpā vedavedāṃtagocarā || sarvāgamarahasyārthā smaraṇāp (!) tāpanāśinī || lalitāyā maheśāni sarvaduḥkhakṣayaṃkarī || (fol. 65r6–9) Colophon iti śrīśrīsaubhāgyahṛdayākhyaṃ paṃcadaśamālāmaṃtramaṃḍalaṃ samāptaṃ || ❁ || (fol. 65r9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrībhairavyuvāca || devadeva mahābāho bhaktānāṃ sukhavarddhanaṃ || kena siddhi dadāty āśu kālī trailokyamohinī || tan me vada dayāpāra sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhaye || kṛpāṃ kuru jagannātha vada devavidāṃ vara || 2 || (exp. 1t, 1–5) End japaṃ kṛtvā paṭhed yas tu tasya siddhiḥ karo (!) sthitā idam kavacam ajñātvā kālīṃ yo bhajate naraḥ || naiva siddhir bhavet tasya vighna (!) tasya pade pade || 28 || (exp. 7t, 1–4) Colophon iti śrī gaṃdharvatantre mahākālakavaca samāptam || || (exp. 7t, 1–4)

Beginning śrīdevyuvāca || devadeva mahādeva bhaktānāṃ prītivarddhanam || kālikākavacaṃ divyaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ na prakāśitaḥ || śrīmahādeva uvāca || lakṣavārasahasrāṇi vāritāsi mayā punaḥ || strīsvabhāvān mahādevi punas tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || (exp. 7t, 5–7b, 4) End gurau ca kavace yantre mantre devīṃ vibhāvayet || gurus trātā mahādevi kavacaṃ yaḥ prayachati (!) || (exp. 13t, 3– 13b, 2) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale kālīkalpe śrīdaṇakālīkākavacaṃ (!) samāptam || || || śubham || (exp. 13t, 3– 13b, 2)

Beginning śrīsadāśiva uvāca || || śṛṇu devi jagadvaṃdye stotram etad anuttamam paṭhanā (!) chravaṇād yasya sarvasiddhiśvaro (!) bhavet || (exp. 13b, 2–4) End śatanāmastutim imām ādyākālīsvarūpiṇīṃ || paṭhed vā pāṭhayed vāpi śṛṇuyā (!) chrāvayed api || sarvapāpavinimukto (!) brahmasāyujyam āpnuyāt || 46 || (exp. 23t, 4– 23b, 3) Colophon iti śrīmahānirvāṇataṃtre śrīmad ādyāśivasaṃvāde kakārādiśatanāmastotram sampūrṇam || || (exp. 23t, 4– 23b, 3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāye (!) namaḥ || || javākusumasaṃkāśaṃ kāśyapeyaṃ mahādyutiṃ || tamoriṃ sarvepapaghnaṃ praṇatosmi divākaraṃ || 1 || dadhiśaṃṣatuṣārābhaṃ kṣīdārṇavasaṃbhavaṃ (!) || namāmi śaśinaṃ devaṃ śaṃbhor mukuṭabhūṣaṇam || 2 || (exp. 1b, 1–4) End sūryaṃ ca caṃdramā bhaumo budhajīvasitārkajāṃ || rāhuḥ saketukaś caiva tebhya (!) nityaṃ namo nama (!) || 14 || (exp. 3t, 1–4) Colophon iti śrīvyāsoktasūryyādinavagrahastuti saṃpūrṇaṃ śrīrāmāya nama śrīrāmacandrāye nama || śrībhavānyai namaḥ || || śrīnārāyaṇāye nama (!) śrīsadāsīvāye (!) namaḥ || || || || || || (exp. 3t, 1–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrī 3 kālyai namaḥ || || atha kakārādisahasranāma || || kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādevagaṇāvṛte || nānāvṛkṣalatākīrṇe nānāpakṣiravair yute || 1 || caturmaṇḍalasaṃyukte śṛṃgāramaṇḍapasthite || samādhau saṃsthitaṃ śāntaṃ krīḍantaṃ yoginīpriyaṃ || 2 || (exp. 4t, 1–5) End śatalakṣaprajatyāpi (!) tasya vidyā na siddhyati || saśāstraghātamādya (!) socirān mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 38 || (exp. 9t, 1–5) Colophon īti (!) śrībhairavataṃtre kālīkalpe śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyā jaganmaṃgalālayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ samāptam śubham astu || || || || || || || (exp. 9t, 1–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīkālyai namaḥ || kailāsaśikhare ramya (!) nānādevagaṇāvṛte || nānāvṛkṣalatākīrṇe nānāpakṣiravair yute || 1 || catur maṇḍalasaṃyukte śṛṃgāramaṇḍapasthite || samādhau saṃsthitaṃ śāṃtaṃ krīḍaṃtaṃ yoginīpriyaṃ || 2 || (exp. 10t, 1–4) End iti gaditam aśeṣaṃ kālivarṇarūpaṃ ya (!) paṭhati yadi bhaktyā sarvasiddhīśvara syāt || abhinavasukhakāmaṃ sarvavidyābhirāmaṃ bhavati sakalasiddhiḥ sarvavīrā samṛddhiḥ 400 54 (exp. 70t 5–70b 1) Colophon iti śrīmahādinānāthaviracitāyāṃ kālīkālasaṃvāde suṃdarīvaradānākhyaṃ kakārasahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || samvat 1938 śrāvaṇasya śite pakṣa tṛtīyāṃ guruvāsare || deśe kumārikākhaṇḍe naipāle nagaresthita likhaka ṭaṃkadhvajapāḍrā kṣetrī śubham astu bhūyāt śubham bhavatu || || || (exp. 70b, 1)

Beginning ///kṣiṇarekhikā || adhorekhā bhaved rudromā.. sākṣāt sarasvat⟨i⟩ī || kuṇḍalī-aṅkuśākārā madhyaśūnyaptarāśim kadambagolakākāraṃ kakāraṃ bhāvayan sudhīḥ || kakara--- va---rdevāsekatvāt sacarācarākhilabrahmo †drayy†āpteyam iti || pralaye brahmādayo devāḥ sthāvarajaṃgamādyāś ca sarve mahākāle līnā bhavanti taṃ kālam asau saṃgrahasya kāli(!)ti || (fol. 10r, 1–5) End iti ⟨ti⟩ gaditam aśeṣaṃ kālikāvarṇarūpaṃ prapaṭhati yadi bhaktyā sarvasiddhi(!)śvaraḥ syāt abhinavasukhakāmaṃ sarvavidyābhirāmaḥ bhavati sa[ka]lasiddhiṃ sarvavīrāsamṛddhiḥ sarvavīrāsataṃtreṇa sa[r]vādhī(!)keti yāvat evaṃ bhūtā samṛddhi[ḥ] bhavati⟨d⟩iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ kim anyat śrotum ichā⟪t⟫si || 50 || (fol. 62v, 2–7) Colophon iti śrīkālītaṃtre īśvarapārvatīsaṃvāde suṃdarīvaradānākhyamedhāsā/// svasti śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || (fol. 62v, 7–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīkālyai namaḥ || kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādevagaṇāvṛte || nānāvṛkṣalatākīrṇe nānāpakṣiravair yute || 1 || caturmaṇḍalasaṃyukte śṛṅgāramaṇḍape sthitam || samādhau saṃsthitaṃ śāṃtaṃ krīḍantaṃ yoginīpriyaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v, 1–3) End iti gaditam aśeṣaṃ kālivarṇarūpaṃ prapaṭhati yadi bhaktyā sarvasiddhīśvaraḥ syāt || abhinavasukhakāmaḥ sarvavidyābhirāmo bhavati sakalasiddhiḥ sarvavīrāsamṛddhiḥ 46|4 (fol. 38v, 2–4) Colophon iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṅ kim anyac chrotum icchasi 455 iti śrīmad ādināthaviracitāyāṃ mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ harakālīsaṃvāde sundarīvaradānākhyannāmakālīsvarūpasahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || || śrīkālikāyai namaḥ (fol. 38v, 4–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ namaḥ śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyai || karpūraṃ madhyamāṃtyasvarapararahitaṃ seṃduvānekṣiyuktaṃ || bī⟨d⟩jaṃ te mātaraṃ tat tripuraharavabhū triḥkṛtaṃ ye japaṃti || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasanty eva vācaḥ || svachaṃdadhvāṃtadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānāṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End kuraṃgākṣīvṛndaṃ samanusarati premataralaṃ || vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhiḥ || ripuḥ kārāgāraṃ kalayati ca tat kelikalayā || ciraṃjīvan mukta[ḥ] prabhavati subhaktaḥ pratijanuḥ || || 22 || (fol. 5v6–6r2) Colophon iti śrīvīrataṃtre paramarahasye mahākālakṛtaṃ śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyāḥ karpūrastotraṃ samāptam śubham || śubham || śubham || śubham || (fol. 6v, 2–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīkālikāyai namaḥ || || karpūraṃ madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ senduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījan te mātaretat tripuraharavadhu triḥkṛtaṃ ye japanti || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasanty eva vācaḥ svacchandaṃ dhvāntadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānām || 1 || (exp. 1t, 1–4) End kuraṃgākṣīvṛndaṃ tamanusarati premataralaṃ vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhiḥ || ripuḥ kārāgāraṃ kalayati ca tat kelikalayā || ciraṃjīvanmukta (!) prabhavati sabhaktaḥ pratijanuḥ || || 22 || (exp. 6t, 5–6b, 2) Colophon iti te kathitaṃ stotraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam || etaj jñātvā dakṣiṇāntāṃ paraṃ jānāti nānyathā || 23 || iti śrīvīratantre paramarahasye svarūpākhyaṃ śrīkālīstotraṃ samāptam || śubham || (exp. 6b, 2–4)

«Beginning of the Karpūrastotra :» śrīkālikāyai namaḥ || śrīmahākāla uvāca || || karpūraṃ madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ senduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījan te mātar etat tripuraharavadhu(!) triḥkṛtaṃ ye japanti || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasanty eva vācaḥ svacchandaṃ dhvāntadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānām || 1 || (fol. 1v, 9 and fol. 2r, 7) «Beginning of the Karpūrastavadīpikā :» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ śrīkālikāyai namaḥ gaṇeśam ādyāṃ govindaṃ guruṃ natvā samāsataḥ raṅganāthaḥ prakurute karpūrastavadīpikāṃ 1 iha khalu bhagavān mahākālo dvāviṃśatyakṣaramahāvidyāmahātmyaṃ prakaṭayiṣyan tadghaṭakāvayavānām api pṛthag manurūpatayā vakṣamāṇaprayogasādhanakṣamatvasūcanāya bhinnaphalanirdeśapūrvakaṃ yathākramaṃ tadavayavān viśiṣṭarūpaṃ ca prakāśayan stavam ārabhate karpūram ityādi (fol. 1v, 5–7) «Beginning of the #Karpūrastavadīpikāṭīkā :» ādyāyai namaḥ namāmi haramāninīrucirapādapāthorūhaṃjanālibhir abhiṣṭutaṃ lalitagadyapadyādibhiḥ śirobhir abhivaṃditaṃ suramaheṃdra-ṛṣyādibhis trikālam adhipūjitaṃ jalajayonisiddhādibhiḥ 1 karpūravarttikādīpaḥ karpūrastavadīpikā prakāśyate yathā śrīmadveṇunārtharasena hi 2 asyāṃ prati mahākālasyoktastutiḥ karpūram iti ihādau stotre mahākālena karpūrapadavinyāsāt karpūrasya dhavalatvād budhair yaśaso pi tādṛśavarṇanāt tayo⟨ḥ⟩s tādātmyaṃ (fol. 1v, 1–3) «End of the Karpūrastotra :» kuraṃgākṣīvṛndaṃ tam anusarati premataralaṃ vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhiḥ ripuḥ kārāgāraṃ kalayati paraṃ kelikalayā ciraṃ jīvanmuktaḥ sa bhavati ca bhaktaḥ pratijanuḥ 22 (fol. 13v, 9 and fol. 14v, 6) «End of the Karpūrastavadīpikā :» vārāhītaṃtre ādhāre sthāpayitvā tu pustakaṃ vācayet tataḥ hastasaṃsthāpanā devi(!) bhaved arddhaphalaṃ yataḥ na svaya(!) likhitastotraṃ nābrāhmaṇalipiṃ paṭhet pustake vācanaṃ śastaṃ sahasrād adhikaṃ yadi tato nyūnasya tu bhaved vācanaṃ pustakaṃ vinetyādy anyatra vistara iti śivam 22 graṃthagauravabhītyeyaṃ kṛtā saṃkṣepato mayā tenaiva tuṣyatu ciraṃ deveśī kālikā⟨m⟩ api 1 (fol. 14v, 11–13) «End of the #Karpūrastavadīpikāṭīkā :» kālīpūjopakaraṇaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahuḥ kṛtvā vittānusāreṇa brahmaloke mahīyate kukarmī kusaṃjī kubuddhiḥ kudāsaḥ sadācārahīnaḥ kadācāralīnaḥ kudṛṣṭiḥ kuvākyaṃ sadāhaṃ bhajāmi gatis tvaṃ matis tvaṃ tvam ekā bhavānīti bhavaṃ jīvanarūpaṃ jalaṃ āpyānayati(!) jīvayatīti bhavānīti = 4 śubham (fol. 13v, 16–17) «Colophon of the Karpūrastotra :» iti te kathitaṃ stotraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam || etaj jñātvā dakṣiṇāyā[ḥ] stavaṃ jānāti nānyathā iti mahākālaviracitaṃ karpūrastotraṃ samāptaṃ iti śrīgaṃdharvarājataṃtre kālikalpe karpūrastotraṃ sampūrṇaṃ śubham (fol. 14v, 6–8) «Colophon of the Karpūrastavadīpikā :» iti śrīmadvidvatkulamukuṭamaṇinīrājitagirirājarājendrapūjitapādapadmaśrīpaṃḍitarāja­vrajanāthasūrisūnuraṃganāthavidvannirmitā karpūrastavadīpikā samāptā grantha 1000 jyā (fol. 14v, 13–14)

Beginning śrīkālikāyai namaḥ || karpūraṃ madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ senduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījan te mātar etat tripuraharavadhu⟨s⟩ triḥkṛtaṃ ye japanti || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ja(!) mukhakuharād ullasanty eva vācas svacchandaṃ dhvāntadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānām || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End kuraṃgākṣīvṛndaṃ tam anusarati premataralaṃ vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhi[ḥ] || ripus(!) kārāgāraṃ kalayati ca tat kelikalayā ciraṃ jīvanmukta[ḥ] sa bhavati subhaktaḥ pratijanū(!) || 22 || (fol. 3v2–4) Colophon iti mahākālakṛtaṃ syāmārahasyaṃ karpūrākhyaṃ stotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ (fol. 3v4)

«Beginning of the root text:» karpūraṃ madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ senduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījaṃ te mātar etat tripuraharavadhu triḥkṛtaṃ ye japanti || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasanty eva vācaḥ svacchandaṃ dhvāntadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānām || 1 || (fol. 1v, 8–9) «Beginning of the commentary:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīkālikāyai namaḥ gaṇeśam ādyāṃ govindaṃ guruṃ natvā samāsataḥ || raṅganāthaḥ prakurute karpūrastavadīpikāṃ || 1 || iha khalu bhagavān mahākālo dvāviṃśatyakṣaramahāvidyāmāhātmyaṃ prakaṭayiṣyan tadghaṭakāvayavānām api pṛthak manurūpatayā vakṣamāṇaprayogasādhanakṣamatvasūcanāya bhinnaphalanirdeśapūrvakaṃ yathākramaṃ tadavayavān viśiṣṭasvarūpaṃ ca prakāśayan stavam ārabhate karpūram ityādi (fol. 1v1–3) «End of the root text:» supuṣpair ākīrṇaṃ kusumadhanuṣo mandiram aho puro dhyāyan dhyāya⟨n⟩ñ japati yadi bhaktaḥ stavam amum sa gandharvaśreṇīpatir iva kavitvāmṛtanadī na dīnaḥ paryante paramapadalīnaḥ prabhavati 17 rāmaḥ (fol. 9v5–6) «End of the commentary:» atra viśeṣābhidānād ayutasaṃkhyaivaprayogo bodhyaḥ tattvaṃ tu mūlādhārasthaṃ trikoṇaṃ dayādipūrvoktapuṣpair vyāptam iti bhāvanāprakāraviśeṣo pīti bodhyam 17 śrīrāmāya sānujāya namo namaḥ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ (fol. 9v9–10)

«Beginning of the root text:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || karpūraṃ madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ senduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījaṃ te mātar etat tripuraharavadhu triḥkṛtaṃ ye japanti || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasanty eva vācaḥ svacchandaṃ dhvāntadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānām || 1 || (fol. 5r, 3–5) «Beginning of the commentary:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || anādyāyākhilādyāya bhāyine gatanāyine || arūpāya sarūpāya dakṣiṇāmūrttaye namaḥ || 1 || na jānāmi tīrthaṃ na jānāmi yogaṃ na jānāmi muktyālayam vā kim etat || na jānāmi bhaktiṃ vrataṃ cāpi mātar gatis tvaṃ matis tvaṃ tvam ekā bhavānī || 2 || kālikāṃ sakalalokapālikāṃ lohitāktagalamuṇḍamālikām || bhāvayāmi kavitāpraṇālikāṃ dehakāṃtijitameghamālikām || natvā viśveśvaraṃ devaṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā || kāśīnāthaḥ pratanute karpūrastavadīpikāṃ || (fol. 1v, 1–5) «End of the root text:» kuraṃgākṣīvṛṃdaṃ tam anusarati premataralaṃ vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhiḥ ripuḥ kārāgāraṃ kalayati tataḥ kelikalayā cirañ jīvanmuktaḥ sa bhavati subhaktaḥ pratijanuḥ || 22 || (fol. 20r, 4–5, 20v, 4–5) «End of the commentary:» saṃgacchati paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devī vyavasthiteti || paraśivaḥ kālīpūjopakaraṇaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu | kṛtvā vittānusāreṇa brahmaloke mahīyate || || || kukarmī kusaṃgī kubuddhiḥ kudāsaḥ sadācārahīnaḥ kadācāralīnaḥ || kudṛṣṭiḥ kuvākyaṃ(!) sadāhaṃ bhajāmi gatis tvaṃ tvam ekā bhavānī bhavānīti | bhavaṃ jīvanarūpaṃ jalaṃ ānayati jīvayatīti bhavānī || 22 || || (fol. 20v, 7–8, 21v, 1–2) «Colophon of the root text:» iti śrīkarpūrastotraṃ samāptam || (fol. 20v, 5) «Colophon of the commentary:» iti śrībhaṭṭopanāmaka jayarāmabhaṭṭasutavārāṇasīgarbhasaṃbhavadakṣiṇācāramatapravarttaka­kāśīnāthabhaṭṭaviracitā karpūrastavadīpikā samāptā || || śubham astu sarvadā || || || saṃvat 1887 māghaśuklapaṃcamīdine likhitam idaṃ pustakaṃ vijayānaṃdena || śrī gurvarpaṇam astu || (fol. 21v, 3–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || athāsya puraścaraṇaṃ || || karpūrākhyam idaṃ stotrai yad uktaṃ bhavatā purā || ṣaṭkarmmasādhanaṃ tasya prayogaṃ vada śaṃkara || 1 || śrīśiva uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi karppūrastavasādhanaṃ || sakṛt kṛte pi deveśi kālī tuṣṭā bhavet sadā || 2 || (fol. 1v, 1–3) End trāsotpanne maheśāni rogaśokabhaye tathā || paṭhet stotraṃ mahākalpāḥ sarvaśāṃtiṃ prayachatiḥ (!) || 8 || kumārīpūjanaṃ cāṃte karttavyaṃ susamāhitaḥ || evaṃ kṛte maheśāni samyak siddhir bhaved dhruvaṃ || 9 || śubhaṃ (fol. 1v, 8–9)

Beginning śrījaganmaṃgalakavacasthamaṃtrāṇāṃ pramāṇāṃtarāṇi tatrādau kālītantre kālīhṛdayavidyāṃ ca siddhavidyāṃ mahodayāṃ purā yena yathā japtvā siddhim āpur divaukasaḥ kāmākṣaraṃ bahisaṃstham indirānādabindubhiḥ maṃtrarājam imaṃ devi durlabhaṃ pāpacetasāṃ (exp. 2b, 1–2) End caturdaśākṣarī māhākālībījaṃ samuddhṛtya kūrvaṃ māyāṃ tathaiva ca || dakṣiṇākālike ceti svabījaṃ kūrcabījakaṃ || mayā svāhāpadaṃ devi caturdaśākṣarī śubhā || (exp. 2b, 12–13)

Beginning śrīmahākālikāyai namaḥ || karpūram madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ senduvāmākṣiyuktam bījan te mātar etat tripuraharavadhu triḥkṛtaṃ ye japanti teṣāṅ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasanty eva vācaḥ svacchandadhvāntadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṅ gatānām 1 (fol. 1v, 1–5) End kuraṅgākṣīvṛndan tam anusarati premataralaṃ vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhi[ḥ] || ripuḥ kārāgāraṃ kalayati ca tat kelikalayā ciraṃjivanmuktaḥ prabhavati subhaktaḥ pratijanu[ḥ] || 22 || ❁ || (fol. 7v, 1–4) Colophon iti śrīmahākālakṛtaṃ karpūrastotraṃ śamāptaṃ śubham || || (fol. 7v, 5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || karpūram madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ senduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījaṃ te mātaretat tripuraharavadhu triḥkṛtaṃ ye japaṃti teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasanty eva vācaḥ svacchandadhvāṃtadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānām 1 (fol. 1v, 1–5) End kuraṅgākṣīvṛṃdaṃ tamanusarati premataralaṃ vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhi || ripuṃ kārāgāraṃ kalayati ca taṃ kelikalayā ciraṃjivanmuktaḥ prabhavati sabhaktaḥ pratijanuḥ || 22 || ❁ || (fol. 8v, 6, 9v 1–3) Colophon iti śrīkarpūrastava samāptaḥ || śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtigurubhyo namaḥ || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || (fol. 9v, 4–5)

«Beginning of the root text:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || karpūraṃ madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ senduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījaṃ te mātaretat tripuraharavadhūḥ triḥkṛtaṃ ye japaṃti || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasanty eva vācaḥ svacchandaṃ dhvāntadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānām 1 1 1 1 (fol. 3v, 6, 4r 4–5) «Beginning of the commentary:» ///tmikā hrasvadīrghaplutarūpā arddhamātrā vyaṃjanarūpā mātrātrayamakārokāramakārātmakam tadūrdhvam ardhamātrā tatra mātrātrayam jāgratsvapnasuṣuptyabhimānī viśvatejasaprājñābhidheyam arddhamātrā tu vedāṃtavākyārthabhūtanityamuktaturīyābhidheyā (fol. 3r, 1–3) «End of the root text:» kuraṅgākṣīvṛndaṃ tamanusarati premataralaṃ vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhiḥ ripuḥ kārāgāraṃ kalayati ca tat kelikalayā cirañjīvanmuktaḥ prabhavati sabhaktaḥ pratijanuḥ || 22 || 22 || 22 || || (fol. 14r, 6–7) «End of the commentary:» kukarmī kusaṃgī kubuddhiḥ kudāsaḥ sadācārahīnaḥ kadācāralīnaḥ || kudṛṣṭiḥ kuvākyaṃ sadāhaṃ bhajāmi gatis tvaṃ matis tvam tvam ekā bhavānī || 1 || bhāvānīti bhavaṃ jīvanarūpaṃ jalaṃ ānayati jīvayatīti bhavānī || (fol. 14v, 1–3) «Colophon of the commentary:» iti śrīmadbhaṭṭopanāmaka jayarāmabhaṭṭasutavārāṇasīgarbhasaṃbhavadakṣiṇācāramatapravarttkakāśīnāthaviracitā karpūrastavadīpikā samāptā || śubham || || || (fol. 14v, 3–5)

«Complete transcript:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || asya śrīkarpūrastotramaṃtrasya mahākālabhairavaṛṣir anuṣṭupchandaḥ dakṣiṇakālidevatā hrīṃ bījaṃ hūṃ śaktiḥ krīṃ kīlakaṃ dakṣiṇakālikāprasādasiddhaye jape viniyogaḥ || oṃ ghorarūpe dakṣiṇe siddhiṃ kuru kuru kālike mamābhīṣṭaphalaṃ śīghraṃ dehi draviṇasampadam || dhyāyet || sadyaś chinnaśiraḥ kṛpānam abhayaṃ hastair varaṃ vibhratīṃ ghorāsyāṃ śaśiśekharāṃ trinayanāmunmuktakeśāvalīm || sṛkkāsṛkpravahāṃ śmaśānanilayāṃ śrutyoḥ śavālaṅkṛtīṃ śyāmāṅgīṃ kṛtamekhalāṃ śavakarair devīṃ bhaje kālikām || 1 || || iti śāpamocanavidhi || (fol. 1v–2v)

«Beginning of the root text:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || karpūraṃ madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ senduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījaṃ te mātaretat tripuraharavadhūḥ triḥkṛtaṃ ye japaṃti || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasanty eva vācaḥ svacchandaṃ dhvāntadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānām 1 1 1 1 (fol. 2r, 6–7) «Beginning of the commentary:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || namāmi haramāninī rucirapādapāthoruhaṃjanālibhir abhiṣṭutaṃ lalitagadyapadyādibhiḥ || śirobhir abhivaṃditaṃ suramahendraṛṣyādibhis trikālam adhipūjitaṃ jalajayonisiddhādibhiḥ || 1 || karpūravarttikādīpaḥ karpūrastavadīpikā || prakāśyate yathā śrīmad veṇunārtharasena hi || 2 || (fol. 1v, 1–3) «End of the root text:» vaśīlakṣaṃ maṃtraṃ prajapati haviṣyāśanarato divā mātar yuṣmac caraṇakamaladhyānanirataḥ || paraṃ naktaṃ nagno nidhuvanavinodena ca manuṃ jano lakṣaṃ sa syāt smaraharasamānaḥ kṣititale 20 idaṃ stotraṃ mātas tavamanusamuddhāraṇamanu- svarūpākhyaṃ pādāṃbujayugalapūjāvidhiyutaṃ || niśārddhe vā pūjāsamayam athavā yastu paṭhati pralāpas tasyāpi prasarati kavitvāmṛtarasaḥ || 21 || (fol. 8v, 5–7) «End of the commentary:» karpūram iti svarūpam ākhyā yasya tat svarūpākhyaṃ athavā ūrddhaṃ vāme kṛpāṇam ityādyetatsvarūpamākhyā yasmin tat svarūpākhyaṃ punaḥ kiṃ bhūtaṃ tava pādāṃbujayugalapūjāvidhiyutaṃ pādavirāṃbuje tayor yugalṃ tasya pūjāvidhis tena yutaṃ yuktaṃ || 21 || (fol. 8v, 12–13) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || karpūram madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ seṃduvāmākṣiyuktam bījaṃ te mātar etat tripuraharavadhu triḥkṛtaṃ ye paṭhaṃti || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasaṃty eva vācaḥ svacchaṃdadhvāntadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṅ gatānām || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End kuraṅgākṣīvṛṃdaṃ tamanusarati premataralaṃ vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhi || ripuḥ kārāgāraṃ kalayati sakṛt kelikalayā ciraṃjīvanmuktaḥ sa bhavati subhaktaḥ pratijanuḥ || 22 || (fol. 9r5–9v2) Colophon iti śrībhairavataṃtre mahākālaviracitaṃ karpūrastotraṃ || || śubham || bhūyād bhā kamalāntaraikakuhare kādyekalollāsinī kālākālavighaṭṭanod bhaṭataḍitkoṭiprabhā ṭiṭṭibhā || varṇadhvāntarajāntaraṃ taratayā līnā kṣayānte kṛśā nityaṃ bheda kalātmakasya sahasā chedāya sā karttarī || 1 || yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭā (!) tādṛśaṃ likhitaṃ mayā || yadi śuddham aśuddhaṃ vā mama doṣo na dīyate || 2 || śāke || 1756 || caitre māse kṛṣṇapakṣe || 14 || trailokyanāthena likhitam avehi || śubham (fol. 9v2–10v5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || asya śrīkarpūrastotrasya mahākālaṛṣir uṣṇikchandaḥ śrīdakṣiṇakālikādevatā hrīṃ bījaṃ hūṃ śaktiḥ krīṃ kīlakaṃ śrīdakṣiṇakālikādevatāprasādasiddhaye pāṭhe viniyogaḥ || || śirasi mahākālaṛṣaye namaḥ || mukhe uṣṇik chandase namaḥ || hṛdi śrīdakṣiṇakālikādevatāyai namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) End kuraṃgākṣīvṛndaṃ tamanusarati premataralaṃ vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhiḥ || ripuḥ kārāgāraṃ kalayati paraṃ kelikalayā ciraṃjīvanmuktaḥ sa bhavati ca bhaktaḥ pratijanuḥ || 22 || || iti śyāmā stotram || || (fol. 5v1–3) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || karpūram madhyamāṃtyasvarapararahitaṃ seṃduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījan te mātar etat tripuraharavadhu triḥkṛtaṃ ye japaṃti || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasaṃty eva vācaḥ svacchaṃdaṃdhvāṃtadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānām || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End kuraṅgākṣīvṛndaṃ tamanusarati prema...... ........ kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhi || ripuḥ/// (fol. 7v3–7) Colophon

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīcaṇḍikāyai || kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādevagaṇāvṛte || nānāvṛkṣalatākīrṇṇe nānāpakṣiravair yute || 1 || caturmmaṇḍalasaṃyukte śṛṃgāramaṇḍapasthite || samādhau saṃsthitaṃ śāṃtaṃ krīḍantaṃ yoginīpriyaṃ || 2 || tatra maunadharaṃ dṛṣṭvā devī pṛcha (!) śaṃkaraṃ || || kiṃ tvayā japyate nātha kiṃ tvayā syapyati (!) sadā || 3 || (fol. 1v1–4) End iti gaditam aśeṣaṃ kālikāvarṇṇarūpaṃ prapaṭhati yadi bhaktyā sarvvasiddhīśvaraḥ syāt || abhinavasukhakāmaṃ sarvvavidyābhirāmaṃ bhavati sakalasiddhiḥ sarvvavīrāsamṛddhi || 442 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ nāmasāhasrakaṃ phalaṃ || prakāśitaṃ purā devyā kim anyac chrotum icchasi || 443 || (fol. 41r5 – 41v, 7) Colophon iti śrīādināthaviracitāyāṃ mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ kālīkālasaṃvāde sundarīvaradānākhyaṃ kakārādisahasranāmastotraṃ sampūrṇṇam || || yadakṣarapadabhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnaṃ tu yad bhavet || tatsarvvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ devi mahākālī prasīda me || adṛṣṭabhāvo na ca yā ca vibhrat padārthahīnaṃ likhitaṃ mayātra | tatsarvvam etat parisodhanīyaṃ kopaṃ na kuryāt phalalekhakasya || śubham || samāptaścāyaṃ kakārātmakasahasranāmam || || śrīrāmarāmarāmarāmarāmo jayati śubhaṃ || ❁ || || || || || || (fol. 41r5 – 41v7)

Beginning śrīkālikāyai namaḥ || || śrīdevyuvāca || devadevajagannātha bhaktānugrahakāraka || sarvāpadbhyo samāpnoti paritrāṇaṃ kathaṃ naraḥ || 1 || śrīīśvara uvāca || śrṇu devi pravakṣyāmi guhyād guhyataraṃ paraṃ || āpaduddhāraṇaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ || 2 || śatamaṣṭottaraṃ caiva japtvā dhyātvā ca kālikāṃ || indrajidvaṃdhanānmuktiṃ purā devī śacīpati || 3 || (exp. 12 top, 1–5) End guruvaktrāt samāsādya lakṣa yaḥ prapaṭhecchuchiḥ || parituṣṭā tadā kālī tasya pratyakṣatāṃ vrajet || 16 || (exp. 13 top, 2–3) Colophon iti śrīkālīkalādakṣiṇakālikāyā āpaduddhāraṇaṃ kavacaṃ samāptaṃ || saṃvat 967 sā miti jyeṣṭa va di 2 roja 4 śubhaṃ śrīdakṣiṇakālīsuprasaṃnostu lakṣmīvṛddhir astu || || (exp. 13 top, 4–6)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ kṛtyābhakṣaṇī guhyakāli || || kṛtyābhakṣaṇi maṃtra yathā || || oṃ phreṃ krīṃ ṭhrīṃ hrūṃ strīṃ hrkṣmryūṃ phreṃ jvala jvala kāli kāli prajvala prajvala uti phauti dva mahākāli prajvālaya kālāgni guhyakāli garja garja hasa hasa mānmudiśyāsmadvairī prayuktamaṃtrataṃtrayaṃtravidyākṛtyān sthāvara jaṃgama viṣamudrāṃ kṛtyābhicārādi prayogān hana hana daha daha paca paca grasa grasa ghāṭaya ghāṭaya māraya māraya bhakṣa bhakṣa khāhi khāhi bhasmī kuru kuru (exp. 62b 1–7) End oṃ sahasrāre mahāpadme karpūradhavalo guruḥ || vāmorusthitatachakti sarvatra sarvadāvatu || 1 || paramākṣe guruḥ pātu parāparagurus tathā || parameṣṭhī guru(!) pātu divyaḥ siddhaś ca mānavaḥ || (exp. 64b, 6–8) Colophon

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīkālikāyai || || skaṃda uvāca || || kailāśaśīkhare raṃmye devadevaṃ jagatprabhuṃ|| kena budhyā kālavaśyaṃ brūhi me parameśvara || 1 || śrīīśvara uvāca || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā skanda gopyādgopyataraṃ tvidaṃ || mama priyatvād vaktavyaṃ tūttamottamaṃ || 2 || (exp. 13t, 6–9) End smaret prathama puṣpiṇī rudhirabiṃdunīlāṃ varāṃ gṛhītamadhupātrikāmadavi ghūrṇanetrāṃcalāṃ || ghanastanabharānattāṃ galitanīdhikāṃ śyāmalāṃ karasphuritavallarīviśadaśaṃkhatāṭaṃkinīm || 18 || iti dhyātvā || || || || (exp. 17t, 7– 17b, 1–6) Colophon iti kāliprastāre īśvarapārvatīsaṃvāde puṣpiṇīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ śubhaṃ || svayaṃbhupuṣpalocanamaṃtra || krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ raja svahā krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ svāhā || dhā || 3 || ❖ || 10 || 21 || japo || (exp. 17t, 7– 17b, 1–6)

Beginning śrīkālikāyai || oṃ namaḥ śivāyai paramāmṛtarūpiṇyai saccidānandarūpāyai namaḥ || oṃ atha haināṃ brahmarūpiṇīm āpnoti subhagā triguṇitā, muktā sugampā kāmarindirāsanasṛṣtirūpiṇī metantriguṇitāmādau || (exp. 18 top, 1–3) End oṃ oṃ satyaṃ nānyaprakāreṇa siddhir bhavatīha vai kālikā oṃ oṃ manor vātārā || manor vetti tripurā manor vā sarvasya durgamanor vetti oṃ oṃ || (exp. 21 top, 7– 21 bottom, 1–3) Colophon ity atharvaṇavede sarvasaubhāgyakāroḍa śrīādyākālikopaniṣad, samāptaṃ śubhaṃ śrīkālikāyai || (exp. 21 top, 7– 21 bottom, 1–3)

Beginning atha śatanāmastotraṃ || asya śrīkālikāśatanāmastotrasya bhairava ṛṣiḥ ranuṣṭup chandaḥ śrīdakṣiṇakālikādevatāśatanāmamaṃ(!)pāṭhe viniyogaḥ || karālinī mahātejā lokadhātrī aruṃdhatī || sarasvatī viśālākṣī prajñā vidyeśvarī tathā || 1 || || (exp. 21b, 4–7) End te sarvve nāśam āyānti mahādevavaco yathā || || (exp. 23b, 1–3) Colophon iti śrīkālīkulasarvvasvadakṣiṇakālikāyā aṣṭottaraśatanāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || (exp. 23b, 1–3)

Beginning śrī || dakṣiṇakālikāyai || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīkālikāyai namaḥ || || kailāsaśikhare raṃye devadevajagadguruṃ || uvāca pārvatī devī bhairavaṃ parameśvaram || śrī pārvatyūvāca(!) || devadevamahādeva sṛṣṭisthitilayātmakam || kiṃ tad brahmamayaṃ dhāma śrotum icchāmi tatvataḥ || 2 || (exp. 23b, 3–7) End mahādevyai ca vidmahe viṣṇupatnī ca dhīmahi tannaḥ lakṣmī pracodayāt || 5 || oṃ krīṃ 3 hūṃ 2 hrīṃ 2 dakṣiṇe kālike oṃ krīṃ 3 hrūṃ 2 hrīṃ 2 svāhā || || 20 || veda || oṃ saha nau catu saha nau mūla krū saha vīryyaṃ karavāhave || tejasvīnā madhītaṃ mastu || 6 || (exp. 50t, 1–3) Colophon iti śrībrahmavidyāyāṃ catusahasralakṣagraṃthe śrīādyākālikāyāṃ karpurakavacaṃ navame dvitīyapaṭalasamāptaṃ || ❁ || śrīśāke saṃvat 1769 sāla śrāvaṇa śu di 15 roja 5 śrīgovindacaraṇaupādhyāyena liṣita idaṃ puṣṭakaṃ śubham || śrīkālikā suprasaṃnostu || vikramābda 1904 || naipālasaṃvat 967 śrīkālikāyā prasādena idaṃ puṣṭakaṃ likṣitaṃ śubham (exp. 50t, 3–7)

Beginning oṃ gurur brahmā gurur viṣṇu gurudeva maheśvara guru(!) sākṣāt parabrahma tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 1 || akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaraṃ tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 2 || ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanasalākayā || cakṣur unmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 3 || (exps. 52b 6–53t 3) End aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ sakrau tau grahaṇe śubhe || bhaumavāre ravau vāre jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ || (exp. 55b, 5–7) Colophon iti śrīkālikācatuślokīstotraṃ sampūrṇam || (exp. 55b, 5–7)

Beginning || yaṃtraśodhanamaṃtra rudrayāmale || oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ devīyaṃtreśvarī klīṃ śrī hrīṃ oṃ yaṃtraṃ śodhaya raḥ hraḥ straḥ klaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ ṭha svāhā || 100 || gāyatrī || oṃ yaṃtrarājāya vidmahe mahāyaṃtrāya dhīmahi tanno yaṃtra pracodayāt || 100 || (exp. 56b 1–4) End sadācāra ratāye ca nirjitāśeṣaśaṃkaraḥ || (exp. 62t, 6–7) Colophon iti śrīyoginītaṃtre īśvarapārvatīsaṃvāde sarvarogaharaṇakālīkavacaṃ || śubhaṃ (exp. 62t, 6–7)

«Beginning of the root text:» karpūram madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ senduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījan te mātar etat tripuraharavadhūs(!) trikṛtaṃ ye japanti teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasanty eva vācaḥ svacchaṃdadhvāntadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānām 1 (fol. 1r, 7–8) «Beginning of the commentary:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ karpūrastavarājasya mahākālakṛtasya ca sphuṭārthaṃ prakaroty enāṃ vyākhyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇapaṇḍitaḥ 1 karpūram iti karpūram iti tryakṣaraṃ padaṃ madhyamākṣaraṃ pakāras tena rahitaṃ tathā ca antyasvaraḥ tasyaiva pādalagna-ukāras tena rahitaṃ tadanantaram akṣaraṃ rakāras tena ca rahitaṃ kṛtvā kakāramātrarephamātraṃ cāvaśiṣyate tad eva sendraṃ kuryāt binduśiraskaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ (fol. 1r, 1–3) «End of the root text:» kuraṃgākṣīvṛndaṃ tam anusarati premataralaṃ vaśās tasya kṣauṇī⟪talavi⟫patir api kuverapratinidhiḥ ripuḥ kārāgāre kalayati ca taṃ kelikalayā⟨ṃ⟩ ciran(!) jīvanmuktaḥ prabhavati sa bhaktaḥ pratijanuḥ 22 (fol. 6v5–7) «End of the commentary:» kāmatulyaś ca nārīṇāṃ arīṇāṃ ca yamopamaḥ tasya pādāmbujadvaṃdvaṃ rājñāṃ kirīṭabhūṣaṇam ity ādi || ❁ jyotir vijayarāmeṇa niyuktaḥ kṛṣṇapaṇḍitaḥ kālīstavaprakāśañ ca cakre saṃyamināṃ mude || 1 || 22 || ❁ || || ❁ || (fol. 6v9–10) Colophon iti śrīmahākālakṛtaṃ śrīdakṣinākālikāyā karpūrastavaṃ sampūrṇam || (fol. 6v6–7) iti śrībhaṭṭaśrīkṛṣṇaviracitā karpūrastavarājaṭīkā samāptāḥ likhitaṃ rāmadayālugiriṇā kāśīkṣetre samvat 1867 (fol. 6v10)

Beginning śrīkṛṣṇaprabhānaṃdanāthasvagurave namaḥ || || karpūraṃ madhyamāṃtyasvarapararahitaṃ sveṃduvāmā[[kṣi]]yuktaṃ bījaṃ te mātar eta(!) tripuraharavadhū triḥkṛtaṃ ye japaṃti, teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād u⟨r⟩llasaṃt[y] eva vācaḥ svacchaṃdadhvāṃtadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānāṃ 1 (fol. 1v, 1–2) End kuraṃgākṣīvṛṃdaṃ tam anusarati premataralaṃ vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuberapratinidhiḥ ripuḥ kārāgāraṃ kalayati ca tat kelikalayā ciraṃ jīvanmuktaḥ prabhavati sa bhaktaḥ pratijanuḥ 22 || || Colophon iti śrīgaṃdharvataṃtre mahākālakṛtaṃ karpūrākhyaṃ stotraṃ samāptaṃ || || || (fol. 3v, 5)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || karppūraṃ madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ sendrarevākṣiyuktaṃ || bījate (!) mātar etat tripūraharavadhū triḥkṛtaṃ ye japanti | teṣāṅ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasanty eva vācaḥ svacchandadhvāntadhārādhararucīrucire sarvvasiddhiṅ ganānāṃ || 1 || (exp. 3t (fol. 12v), 2–4) End japaṃs tvat pratyekaṃ manupatitavadhyān naniratāḥ mahā⟪ri⟫kālisvairaṃ sa bhayati dharitrī parivṛdha || gṛhe sammārjjanyā parigalitabījaṃ hi kusumaṃ | samūlaṃ madhyāhne vitarati cūtāyāṃ kūjadine | samūccāryya premnā/// (exp. 4 (fol. 15v), 8–9)

Beginning ///hnir yamaś caiva naiṛto varuṇas tathā | aniruddho bharadvājo dakṣiṇāmūrttir eva ca || vaṭukaḥ kūlapaś caiva vāṇagaṃgā sarasvatī | dhrī śeṣapramarhaś ca unmarha kūlabhairava || kṣetrapālotha hanumān dakṣo garuḍa eva ca | śukadevaś ca pralhādo rāmo rāvaṇa eva ca || (exp. 1(fol. 12r), 1–2) End japapūjārcanaṃ homo, abhicārā(!) ekalpate(!) | etat stotraṃ paṭhitvā ca sāṅgatām ānaya dhruvaṃ || (exp. 2t (fol. 12v), 1–2) Colophon iti śrītantracūḍāmaṇau nityāstava samāpta || ❖ || ○ || (exp. 2t (fol. 12v), 1–2)

«Beginning of the root text:» karpūraṃ madhyamāṃtyasvarapararahitaṃ seṃduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījaṃ te mātar etas(!) tripuraharavadhu triḥkṛtaṃ ye paṭhaṃti || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasaṃty eva vācaḥ svacchaṃdaṃ dhvāṃtadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānāṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v8, 2r8) «Beginning of the commentary:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || ajādibhir abhiṣṭutaṃ hṛdikṛtaṃ mahendrādibhir namaskṛtam ahardivaṃ †vitayato† munīndrair api || trikālam aham arcita⟨ṃ⟩manujamānave sādibhir nato smi jagadaṃvikālalitapādapaṃ ruhaṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) «End of the root text:» kuraṃgākṣīvṛṃdaṃ tam anusarati premataralaṃ vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhiḥ || ripuḥ kārāgāraṃ kalayati sakṛt kelikalayā ciraṃ jīvanmuktaḥ sa bhavati subhaktaḥ pratijanuḥ || 22 || (fol. 6v, 5–7) «End of the commentary:» sa janaḥ ciraṃ dīrghakālaṃ jīvanmuktaḥ kīrtimān dhanavān dharmavāṃś ca bhavatīty arthaḥ pratijanur janmani janmani śobhano bhakto bhaktaśreṣṭho bhavati || 22 || (fol. 6v8–10) «Colophon of the root text:» iti śrībhairavataṃtre mahākā[la]viracitaṃ karpūrastotraṃ samāptaṃ śubhaṃ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || (fol. 6v, 5–7) «Colophon of the commentary:» iti śrīlakṣmaṇaviracitā karpūrastavasya ṭīkā samāptā || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || (fol. 6v8–10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo devyai || śrīdevy uvāca || bhagavan sarvvadharmmajñaḥ kacacaṃ yat prakāśitaṃ | trailokamaṃgalannāma kṛpayā kathaya prabho || śrībhairava uvāca || śṛṇu vakṣyāmi deveśi kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ | atiśuddhataraṃ tattvaṃ brahmamandroghavigrahaṃ (!) | (fol. 1r, 1–2) End ihāmutra phalaṃ nāsti mṛte ca narakaṃ vrajet || anekajanmabhāgyena viṣṇubhaktiḥ prajāyate || tatrāsya bhāgyena gaurībhakti sudurlabhā || (fol. 1r, 12–13) Colophon iti brahmaviṣṇuśivasamvāde vījatantre mātākavacaṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 1r, 13)

Beginning śrīdurggā || īśvara uvāca || stava....mahā.... sarvvasamptkaraṃ śubhaṃ || namo devyai mahādevyai cchinnāyai satatan namaḥ | nābhau śubhrāravindaṃ tadupari kamalaṃ maṇḍalañcaṇḍarasmaiḥ saṃsārasyaikasārāṃ tribhuvanajananīṃ dharmmakarmmodayāya | (fol. 1r13–1v1) End idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ brahmaṇā bhāṣitaṃ purā || sarvvasiddhipradaṃ sākṣān mahāpātakanāśanaṃ || yaḥ paṭhet prātar utthāya devyāḥ sannidhigopi vā | tasya siddhir bhaved āśu vāñchitārthapradāyinī || dhanam putran tathā jāyā hayaṃ hastīnam eva ca | || masundharām mahāvidyām aṣṭau siddhir bhaved dhruvaṃ || (fol. 1v10–12) Colophon iti brahmaṇā bhāṣitaṃ devīstotraṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 1v12)

Beginning atha stavaṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇā nirmmitaṃ purā | taṃ śṛṇuṣva maheśāni vidhānaṃ suradurlabhaṃ || nābhau śubhrasarojaraktavilasanvandhūkapuṣpāruṇaṃ | bhāsvad bhāskaramaṇḍalāntam udare yadyogacakraṃ mahaṃ (!) || tanmadhye viparītamaithunaratapratyudgatā kāminī || dṛṣṭasthāṃ tarunārkkakoṭivilasat tejasvarūpāṃ śivāṃ || (fol. 1v12–2r1) End niśāyām pūjayed devīṃ kumārīm parvvatātmajāṃ | tadā bhavati mantreṣṭhā skandamā (!) sarasvatī || kāmādyāmbājaped vidyāṃ lakṣmyādyāmbā japet sadā || sarvvadā sarvvakāleṣu lakṣmyādyā sarvvasiddhidā | santoṣyavidhinā nārī pūjayitvā kumārikāṃ || tadyonau prajaped vidyāṃ śatasahasraṃ dine dine || na doṣo vidyate tatra brahmaṇā bhāṣitam purāḥ (!) | ācārāṣṭakarūpeṇa siddhirūpanna saṃśayaḥ || kimannyat tu mahādevī kathitavyam ataḥ paraṃ || || (fol. 6v, 5–7) Colophon iti viśvasāratantre pracaṇḍacaṇḍikādevyāḥ sahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 6v, 8)

Beginning ❖ oṃ nama śrīkubjikāyai || ❖ || devy uvāca || himādrīśikhare ramye ramye sukhāsīnaṃ trilocanaṃ | santrayitvā mahāraudre tapobhi na te saṃbhavet || 1 || sarvvajñabhaktisurabhā śaraṇāggatavatsara | vinā nyāsena tapasā vinā dhyānajapādibhiḥ | 2 || kathaṃ tuṣṭā bhavet kubjā kulākulavibhedinī || aneka rakṣā bhave nṛṇāṃ sādhakānāṃ viśeṣata || 3 || (fol. 1r1–4) End sarvvakāmapradaṃ devi sarvvamaṇgaradāyinīṃ | sarvvavasya kare devī sarvvavyādhinivārinīṃ || 122 || paścimāmnāyakūbjityaṃ bhaumamokṣapradāyakaṃ || (fol. 9v3–4) Colophon iti merutantrepy uktaṃ paścimāmnāyā pra praskāra śrīkubjikākavacamālāmantra samāptāyaṃ || || saṃkhyā || 123 || śubhaḥ || (fol. 9v4–5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīpratyaṃgirāsiddhilakṣmīdevyai || oṃ asya śrīsiddhilakṣmīsahasrākṣarīmālāmantrasya nārada ṛṣiḥ gāyatrīchandaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmīdevatā khraiṃ bījaṃ kṣaṃ śaktiḥ ||hrīṃ kīlakaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye (!) sādhare (!) jape viniyogaḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End sarvvamātṛmukhe mahānandajanani kṣmkhyuṃ kṣmkhyuṃ ve nitya nitya bhogapriyeṃ kriṃ kruṃ kreṃ krauṃ pheṃ khreṃ hmkhyeṃ hmphyeṃ rjrlūṃ kṣmrūṃ kṣrhrīṃ kṣrhrīṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ svāhāḥ || (fol. 3r5–6) Colophon iti śrīkālānalatantre siddhilakṣmīsahasrākṣarī samāptam (!) || || śubham || || (fol. 3r7)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrītripurasundaryai || || mandare śikharāsīnaṃ tuṣārakaraśekharaṃ || badhvāṃjalir namaskṛtya paripraṣṭa (!) cha (!) pārvvati (!) || śrīpārvvaty uvāca || yadi prasanno deveśa yadi vānugraho mayi || vālāyāḥ kavacaṃ brūhi sarvvasaubhāgyasaukhyadaṃ || 2 || (fol. 25v3–5) End paśubhiḥ saṃgamenaiva na kūryyāt kulasaṃgamaṃ || sarvvadā surate pūhā nindā caiva kadācana || 25 || bhagaliṅgāmṛte pūjāṃ pūjayec ca kumārikāṃ || vṛddhāpi nātrā ciṃtakāsākṣāt tripurasundarī || 26 || guruṃ saṃtoṣya yatnena yatnataḥ stoṣayet striyaṃ || sarvvaṃ siddhyati deveśi mamaiva vacanaṃ yathā || 27 || (fol. 27r3–5) Colophon iti śrībālātripurasundaryyā kavacaṃ samāptam || || || (fol. 27v6)

Beginning oṃ namaś caṇḍikāyai || || ghorā lolāgrajihvā vikaṭitavaśanā jvāraktā (!) trinyatrā (!) piṅgabhūnīlavaktrā aparaśikhinibhā śūkṣmakālāgniraudrāḥ (!) || śūkṣmā (!) kuṇḍed (!) varāṇḍagrā (!) paramaparagatā mālinī viśvadevī sā devī viśvabhogā paśupatisahitā rakṣa māṃ bhadrakālī || 1 || (fol. 27r6–27v1) End oṃ āṃ krāṃ krīṃ saḥ brahma khakhakhakhakhacarī bhumiṣu sarvvavyāpi haṃ hūṃ pālavānīmisya nivṛtita caraṇe raktaṃ vaktrā trinetrī hūṃkārāya pradīptaṃ vikaṭitadaśane ghargharārova ghoraiḥ kṣāṃ kṣīṃ hūṃ haṃ sa kaṇṭhe hahahahahasite rakṣa māṃ bhadrakālī || 9 || nīlayognichandādinatavayūpuruṣā (!) rātrinārisvarūpāṃ dhā mūle ca jīve raṃ saṃ taṃrasate pṛthvitoyāgnivāyuḥ ākāśaṃ sūṣmasuryyaśaśinayanaphani śivāmrātammūvyāhūsaṃdhyā (!) vāraṃ kaumārajau vāpi vidhirūpadharā pātu mā (!) raudramātā || 10 || || (fol. 28v3–7) Colophon iti mantrāṣṭakabhadrakālistotraṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 28v7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha vīparītapratyaṃgirāsādhanamūlamantraḥ || kṣaṃ bhaṃ kṣaṃ jjvāṃlājihvakalāladaṃṣṭrāpratyaṃgire raṃ kṣaṃ hrīṃ hūṃ phaṭ || || iti viṃśaty akṣarimaṃtraḥ || || catuḥṣaṣṭisahasrasaṃkhyaṃ 64000 japaṃ kṛtvā daśāṃśatarppaṇam 6400 taddaśāṃśa 640 homaḥ pañcāt prayogavidhiḥ || || hrīṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇavāsase śatasahasrakoṭisiṃhāsane sahasravadane aṣṭādaśabhuje mahāvalaparākrame ajite aparājite pratyaṇgire pratyaṇgirase anye parekarmmavidhvaṃsini paramantroccāṭini paramantrotsādini sarvvabhūtadamanikaṃ sopneṃ hrīṃ krauṃ māṃ sarvvopadravebhyaḥ sarvvopabhyā (!) rakṣa 2 (fol. 28v7–29r5) End virūpakaṃ kārayiṣyati || vā anumodayaṃti vāk karmaṇā manasā vācā vā ye devāsurarākṣasāḥ || stiryyakpretasarvvahiṃsakā (!) virūpakaṃ kurvvanti mama || mantrataṃntrayaṃtraviṣacūrṇasarvvaprayogādināmanyeṣāṃ yat kṛtaṃ kāritaṃ tanmastake nipātinī sarvvahiṃsamākarṣiṇī ahitānāṃ ca nāśinīm ātmahastena vā yaḥ karoti kariṣyati || kārayiṣya[ti] vā tān sarvvān anyeṣāṃ nivantitvā patantiri pramastake || 21 || (fol. 31v1–4) Colophon iti śrīmahābhairavatantre viparītapratyaṃgirā samāptam || || śubham || || (fol. 31v4–5)

Beginning oṃ eiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ khphāṃ hlkhpheṃ sphkhphīṃ hskrīṃ mahāpratyaṃgirāyai evaṃ tra japaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhā || śubham || oṃ namaḥ kṣaṃ bhaṃ kṣaṃ jvaraṃ lāṃ jiṃ hvaṃ kaṃ lāṃ radraṣṭāpratyaṃgirā kṣaṃ hrīṃ phaṭ || oṃ nahaḥ śrīkubjikāyai || || śrīdevyovāca (!) || himādrīśikhare ramye sukhāsīnaṃ trilocanaṃ || santayitvā (!) mahāreta ta yebhi ratiduś caret || 1 || sarvvajabhaktisurabhai śaraṇagenātavatsare || vinānyāsena tapasā vinādhyānajapādibhi (!) || 2 || kathaṃ tuṣṭā bhavet kubjā kulākulavibhedinī || anekarakṣābhavenṛṇāṃ (!) sādhakānā (!) viseṣata (!) || 3 || (fol. 31v5–32r2) End mahārakṣākaraṃ devī mahābhayavināsinī || mahājvaranivāraṇyaṃ mahāripuprasamanaṃ || 120 || mahāgrahanivāranyaṃ mahādaridranāsanaṃ || sarvvapāpavinimuktaṃ sarvvaiśvaryyapradāyakaṃ || 121 || sarvvakāmapradaṃ devī sarvvamaṃgaladāyinīṃ || sarvvavasyakare devī sarvvavyādhinivārinī (!) || 122 || paścimāmnāye kubjikābhyaṃ bhogamokṣapradāyakaṃ || 123 || || (fol. 38r1–4) Colophon iti śrīmerutantrepy uktaṃ paścimāmnāyādya prasmāre śrīkubjikākavacatārāmantra samāptaṃ || ||❁ || || śubham || (fol. 38r4–5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmīdevyai || oṃkārāsanamārūḍhā śrutirūpā sanātanī || paraṃbvrahmaparā (!) nityāṃ sāvitrī (!) praṇamāmy ahaṃ || hrīṃ viśvarūpiṇi sāṃtā (!) cidrūpā prāṇarūpiṇī || akalākalamadhyasthā bhuvaneśī namāmy ahaṃ || 2 || (fol. 3v1–2) End na yasyā kriyate devī līlābhuvanamālinī || yasyājñāyā (!) pravarttante kāre (!) saṃkrarṣanī (!) namaḥ || 8 || mokṣarūpā brahmāpā (!) liṃgākhyā rūpavarjjitā || sarvvasvarūpā sarvveśī naumi pratyaṃgirā śivā || 9 || navākṣaram idaṃ stotraṃ sadāśivaprakāsitaṃ (!) || dhāranāt (!) paṭhanād vāpi vācā siddhiṃ labhe (!) dhruvaṃ || 10 || (fol. 3v7–4r1) Colophon iti śrīmahārāvītantre navākṣarīsiddhilakṣmīstava samāptam || || śubham || || (fol. 4r1–3)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmīdevyai || || śrīdevyuvāca || śruta (!) sarvvarahasyaṃ ca tvatprasādān maheśvara || idānīṃ śrotum ichāmi (!) varmmapratyaṃgirābhidaṃ || 1 || vajrapaṃjaravarmmesuḥ (!) sāra (!) yat paṃjaraṃ mat (!) || abhedya (!) sarvvamaṃtrāṇā (!) vinivāraṇaṃ || 2 || (fol. 4r3–5) End mārgaṃ rakṣen mālinī ca svapneśvarī tathā || kṛtvābhicāraśamanaṃ devī pratyaṃgirāvatu || 49 || iḍā pātūgracaṇḍī ca piṃgalāṃ pātu vaiṣṇavī || suṣumnāṃ prakṛti pātu sarvvāgaṃ (!) rakṣa caccikā (!) || 50 || raṇe rājakule dyute vivāde śatruśaṃkaṭe (!) || siddhilakṣmīḥ (!) pātu nityaṃ sarvvavyāpi maheśvarī || 51 || paṃcapretāsanā devī sarvvāgaṃ (!) rakṣa sarvvataḥ vane durge parvvatāgre pātu me vindhyavāsinī || jale payodhau nadyā (!) ca sadā rakṣatu bhairavī || 52 || ity etat kavacaṃ proktaṃ dharmmakāmārthasādhanaṃ || paṭhanāt sarvvapāpāni sadyaḥ pratyayakārakaṃ || 53 || sakṛd eva paṭhed etat kavacaṃ viṣṇunirmmitaṃ || sa sarvvayajñasya phalaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 54 || saṃgrāmeṣu jayechatrūn (!) mātaṃgān iva keśarī || dahen nṝṇāṃ yathā vahnis tathā maṃtraṃ dahet sadā || 55 || vyādhis tasya na jāyeta na ca duḥkhaṃ kadācana || parapraṇītā yā pīḍā sarvvapraśamaṃ jāyate || 56 || anekajanmajanitaṃ puṇyaṃ tat kacāllabhet (!) || nātaḥ parataro lābho vidyate bhuvanodare || 57 || yonyaḥ satkavacaṃ puṇyaphala (!) matat || sarvvavyādhivinirmmukto rūpavān guṇavān bhavet || 58 || tasya vighnā (!) na jāyatte (!) vighnaughā (!) naśyate dhruvaṃ || rogāsta (!) na jāyante śatrubhir nobhibūyate (!) || 59 || sarvva (!) tasya vaśaṃ yānti prāṇinaś ca caturvvidhāḥ || varṣam ekaṃ paṭhed bhaktyā kaca (!) viṣṇunirmmitaṃ || 60 || śatrūn sarvvāni (!) nijitya (!) rājarājo bhaved dhruvaṃ || tasyān (!) sarvvaprayatnena pathanīyaṃ (!) ca sādaraṃ || 61 || (fol. 7v1–8r4) Colophon iti śrījayadrathayāmale siddhilakṣmīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || || śubham || || (fol. 8r4)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrījagadiśvarīdevyai || || śrīdevyauvāca || śrīmaṃtrīpurasūṃdaryyā pāpādivyā suśobhitāḥ || kṛpayā kathitāṃ sarvvā śrutāś cādhiśataṃ mayā || 1 || skṛpayā kathityaṃ prānanātha dhūnā brūhi kavacaṃ mantravigrahaṃ || trailokyamohanaṃ devi nāmatṛkathitaṃ purā || 2 || idānī śrotum ichāmī sarvvārthakavacāt ya caḥ || prakāsaya mahādevī yadi sneha pravvarttate || 3 || (fol. 8r5–7) End yotsyānī kusumānyeva suṣadānī bhaventī hī || spardvā mṛdbhūbhavenena lakṣmi vāṇī vase mūkhe || idaṃ kavacaṃ mayā jñātvā yo yapyat sundarī parā || na va laḥkṣa japekopi tasya vidyā tasiddhyateḥ || śasastra dyātam āpnoti socārā mṛtyum āpnuyāt || || (fol. 11r1–3) Colophon iti śrītripurasuṃdarīmāhākavacaṃ samāptam || || śubham || || (fol. 11r4–5)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || || śrīdevy uvāca || devadeva mahādeva bhaktānāṃ prītivarddhanaṃ || sūcitaṃ tripurādevyāḥ kavacaṃ kathayasva me || 1 || śrī īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kavacaṃ devadurllabhaṃ || aprakāśyaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhidaṃ || 2 || (fol. 19r5–6) End na dāridryavasaṃ (!) gachen (!) nāpamṛtyuḥ kadācana || gachecchivapuraṃ (!) devī satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmy ahaṃ || 16 || guruṃ saṃpūjya vidhivt kavacaṃ prapaṭhed yadi || sarvvasiddhim avāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane || 17 || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā śrīvidyāṃ yojayet priye || samāpnoti phalaṃ tasya prāpnuyācchastraghātakaḥ || 18 || (fol. 20r3–5) Colophon iti śrīsiddhayāmale śrītripurasundarīdevyā maṃtrakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || ||❖ || (fol. 20r5–6)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || || eiṃ ānāndasāndraparamāgamadīvyamānāṃ svacchandakāntīṃ (!) sphuritamaṃtrataraprakāśī (!) || devīṃ dayārdrahṛdayaṃ hṛdayaṃ rahasya (!) śrīsundarī śivakarī śaraṇaṃ śrayāmi || 1 || (fol. 20r6–7) End āṃ krauṃ klīṃ dhyānarūpī asurabhayakarī ātmanā pāpaśoṣī pratyakṣī pīṭhamaulī pralayajaladharī brahmaviṣṇusvarūpī || śuddhātmī śuddharūpī suragaṇamunayaḥ kṣobhināṃ kṣobhaśakte sṛṣṭisthityantamūrttiḥ tripuraharamayī ghorarūpīṃ namāmi || 6 || || (fol. 21r1–3) Colophon iti śrītripurasundarīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || ||❖ || (fol. 21r4)

Beginning pārvaty uvāca || devādidevasarvvajña (!) vasirmmānavasaṃjñakaḥ (!) || proktas tvayā hi kaṭhino devatātṛptikārakaḥ || tadabhāve phalaṃ tadvat kathaṃ syāt tad vadasva me || sahasrābdamahāmāyā saṃtuṣṭā jāyate yathā || || śiva uvāca || kālajñatvāt kukkutoyaṃ balirmmānavarūpakaḥ || vidhinā mānuṣasyeva cakraśodhanapūrvvakaṃ || (fol. 21r4–6) End cakrākṣarāṇi saṃsmṛtya namonta gopayet tanuṃ || saṃśuddhe kukkuṭe devi chūrikm abhimaṃtrayet || durgayā tvaṃ dhṛtā devi sarvvadaityāntakārake || atas tvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi kukkuṭasya valiṃ hara || kārajñānāya vidmahe kukkuṭatvāya dhīmahi || tanno valiṃ pracodayāt || karṇṇe gāyatrīṃ prajapya balir ddeyaḥ || || (fol. 21v1–3) Colophon iti kukkuṭavaliḥ samāptaḥ || ||❖ || (fol. 21v3–4)

Beginning atha saṃvic chodhanam || eiṃ saṃvide brahmasaṃbhūte brahmaputrisadanaghe || bhairavānāṃ ca tṛpty arthaṃ pavitrā bhava sarvvadā || oṃ brahmapāyai (!) namaḥ || svāhā iti maṃtreṇābhimaṃtrayet || oṃ siddhimūlakriye devi hīnabodhaprabodhini || rājāprajāyaśakari śatrukaṇṭhe triśūlini || (fol. 21v4–6) End mūlamaṃtraṃ saptavāraṃ japet || āvāhanādimudrāṃ dhenuyonimudrāṃ pradarśayet || choṭikābhis tālayeṇa ca digvaṃdhanaṃ || divyadṛcyā pārṣṇighātena ca viprān vadyānayet || tatvamudrayā sahasrāre guruṃ tarppayet || brahmaraṃdhre mūladevī saptadhā tarppayet || eiṃ vada vada vāgvādini mama jihvāgre sthirī bhava sarvvasatvavaśaṃkari svāhā || || iti śrīmaṃtreṇa mukhe juhuyāt || || (fol. 22r3–6) Colophon iti jayāśodhanam samāptam || ❖ || (fol. 22r6)
