Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || || śrīdevy uvāca || śrīmat tripurasundaryyā yā yā vidyāḥ sudurllabhāḥ || kṛpayā kathitāsarvvāḥ śrutāś cādhigatā mayā || 1 || prāṇanāthādhunā brūhi kavacaṃ mantravigrahaṃ || trailokyamohanaṃ ceti nāmataḥ kathitaṃ purā || 2 || idānīṃ śrotum ichāmi (!) sarvvārthaṃ kavacasya ca || prakāśaya mahādeva yadi sneho pravarttate || 3 || (fol. 22r6–22v2) End śuddhāśuddhaya bhuvane lakṣmī vāṇī vaset tataḥ || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā yojayet sundarīparāṃ || 54 || navalakṣaprajaptvāpi tasya vidyā na siddhyati || sa śastrāghātam āpnoti socirān mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 55 || (fol. 25r7–25v2) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale devīīśvarasaṃvāde (!) mahātripurasundarī trailokyamohanakavacasamāptam || || || (fol. 25v2–3)

Beginning rdda○ || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ namaḥ śrīkubjikāyai || pārvvaty uvāca || bhagavan bhāṣitāśeṣaviśeṣakaruṇānidhe || kubjikārūpadevyā yā mantranāmasahasrakaṃ || 1 || purā kailāśaśikhare prāha yo mantrasaṃhitā || devadīrghadayāpūrṇā devadarśittasatyadhā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End sarvvarogaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvvapāpavināśanaṃ || etair ye stuvatā devi pūjayitvā sumadhyame || 127 || siddhyanti sakalānekā mānasampadākāmarūpiṇī | āyuñ ca varddhate tasya vidyā lakṣmīḥ supuṣkalāṃ || 128 || prabho tteyaḥ stentir vvidvāna divyām imātmikāṃ japet || || (fol. 6v7–9) Colophon iti śrīmeruāgame kailāsakhaṇḍe śrī umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde ekādaśapaṭala śrīkubjikānāmasahasrakaṃ samāptam || || ❁ || (fol. 6v9–10)

Beginning eiṃ 5 namo mahāmāyāyai || śyāmā raktā trinetrā stanabharanamitā mandamātaṅgagāmī bimbauṣṭhī cārunetrā pṛthutarajaghanā mekhalā ratnaśobhā || devāṅger vvamtraśobhā (!) varavarakusume varvvarā keśabhārā sā me śrīkubjikākhyā vitara (!) satataṃ jñādivyaughamoghaṃ || 1 || (exp. 65b4–66t1) End ity ete dvādaśa sūtrāḥ kaulikājñāvinirggatāḥ | trikāraṃ paṭhate yas tu tasyājñā saṃpravarttate || ekānte vijane ramye udyāne vā guhāntare | nadīsaṃgamatīre vā śrīśrī revā catuspathe || ekaliṅgetha vā deva girau guha manorame | krameṇa paṭhate yo vai ekacintaḥ samāhitaḥ | ṣaṇmāsābhyantarodājñā paṭhanād api varttate | na kriyā kiñcid vahulā kramasaṃpūjya līlayā || siddhyate nātra saṃdeha ityājñā pārameśvarī || (exp. 69t2–69b1) Colophon iti śrīcaturvviṃśatisāhasre kubjikāstavaḥ samāptaḥ || || ❁ || || samvat 829 kārttikamāse śuklacaturddasi (!) parapūrṇamāsyāṃ tīthau (!) revati nakṣatra vajrayoge ādityavāsare tasmin divase likhitaṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || śrīlalitapaṭṭnāvasthite śrīmāṇigalā naiṛtye sthāne brahmapure śrī thaṃ vuśalake śrī vakhani hmaṃ khālā cche gṛhe vāstavya śrīvīreśvarena (!) likhitaṃ || samvat 824 vaīśāṣa śu ddhi dvitīyān tithau kṛrttikāpararohiṇī natre śaubhanayoge somavāsare || śrī 3 āgama bhujyayā ahlo ṅā sthā parāyā hā dina śrī śrī nāthana yā pitā pūrṇṇānandaśarmmanā devajñāna thva yā karmmayā ṅa śrīvireśvara na tha va mātṛ rudrāya śrīlakṣmī devīmṛtyuhetunā tasyārthena suvarṇṇanirmmita śrī 3 cāmuṇḍāpi thū sajirṇṇau dhāna yā ṅa sthāpanā yāṅā dina thva kū hnūṃ juro śubhaṃ || samvat 785 phālguṇa śukla tṛtī thau revati nakṣatre śuklayoge śukravāsare devasiṃhadevasya mātṛ phi ku lakṣmīdevī udesva na thva dina kūhnū suvarṇṇanirmmita śrī 3 mūlasthāna śivaśaktipratimāpratiṣṭhā yā ṅā yā vā sādhana yā ya thva saṃ phari ca | juro śubhaṃ || thva saṃ phūri tha ca jukoke ne te me va ka se sa teva śubhaṃ || || (exp. 69b1–70b5)

Beginning atha kubjikādhyānaṃ || nīlaṃ paṃcānano nityaṃ mūrdhnapañcakasaṃsthitaṃ | dviraṣṭavarṣadeśīyo ratnasayyāsthicarccikā (!) | vahninābhisthitāmbhoje kṛtvāṃguṣṭhati (!) bhairava | kaṭṭārālānta vyāghrāṇḍa kāñcīkaṭis tu hāsyavān | vibhracchūlaṃ cakradhvajo dānaṃ ca dakṣabāhubhiḥ | pārijātajāpyamālā pustakābhayakaṃ kare | (exp. 2 (fol. 1v) 1–3) End pītavarṇṇā bhavet stambhe vaśye kuṃkumasannibhaḥ | uccāṭe dhūmravarṇṇābhā vidveṣe bhaitvavac (!) chaviḥ | mohaṇe yatra vajjñeyo maṇivaiśasane mata | indranīlanibhaḥ sarvvaṃ ....rmmaṇe ca na viśvaraṃ | śītaḥśvetāmūktiyarthe śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaṃ | raktaśauraśriyaḥ proktaḥ padmavarṇṇas tu kṣaubhake | cintayet parameśā/// (exp. 2 (fol. 1v) 8–10) Colophon

Beginning pūjanaṃ || eiṃ 5 hrūṃ aśitāṅgabhairavāya pādukāṃ || eiṃ 5 hrūṃ rurubhairavāya pādukāṃ || eiṃ 5 hrūṃ caṇḍograbhairavāya pādukāṃ || eiṃ 5 krodhabhairavāya pādukāṃ || eiṃ 5 hrūṃ pnmattabhairavāya pādukāṃ || eiṃ 5 hrūṃ kapālībhairavāya pādukāṃ || (exp. 3b1–2) End nīlaṃ jīmūtavarṇṇaṃ sakalaśivamayaṃ bhairavaṃ bhīmarūpaṃ raudraṃ rudrāvatāraṃ jvalati śikhiśikhā vahnikeśaṃ sudīptaṃ | bhīmāṅgaṃ bhīmanādaṃ kinikinisabalaṃ bajrapādas trilokaṃ | jvālāmālākalālaṃ (!) mama haratu bhayaṃ bhairavaṃ taṃ namāmi || || (exp. 3t8–10) Colophon iti gaṃdharvvatantre mahākālapūjanavidhi || || (exp. 3t10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ kullukāyai || oṃ rudra uvāca || pūrvvasyāṃ kāmadā pātu dakṣiṇe kāmarūpiṇī | kāmākhyā paścime pātu uttarasyām tu kāminī || 1 || kāmarūpiṇy avatv agnau naiṛtyāṃ kāmavariṇī (!) || kāmamātā tu vāyavye eiśānyāṃ kāmanāyikā || 2 || ūrddvaṃ pātu mahāmudrā yogamudrā dhruvaṃ diśaṃ | siddhimudrā śiraḥ pātu raudramudrā tu cakṣuṣī || 3 || (fol. 1r1–4) End te sarvve vilayaṃ yānti nityaṃ kavacadhāraṇāt | strīṣu vallabhatāṃ yāti pūrṇṇakāmo mahābalaḥ || 10 || śavarūpā mahogrā ca yatra tiṣṭhati sarvvadā | labhet kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 11 || || (fol. 1v2–4) Colophon iti śrīmatsyasūkte mahogratārākalpe kallūkākavacaṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 1r4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāye (!) namaḥ || || oṃ namo mahākaumārīdevyai namaḥ || || śrī devy uvāca || devādhidevadeveśa hṛdayaṃ stotrādhikaṃ śrutaṃ || ekākṣarāya kṣarātmā mantrajñānamaheśvaraṃ || kaumāryyā stotrasāhasraṃ śatanāmaśrutaṃ purā || śrūyate kavacaṃ nātha yogyo (!) cet kathayat (!) prabho || 2 || śrī isvarauvāca (!) || śṛṇu bhadre mahāścaryyā kavacaṃ paramādbhūtaṃ || mahāyāṃ paprasamanaṃ (!) sarvaiśvaryyapradāyakaṃ || 3 || maṃtrasiddhikaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ṣaṭkarmeṣu susiddhidaṃ || kathayāmi varārohe sāvadhānaṃ kuru priye || 4 || (exp. 2, l. 1–5) End pāṭhamātreṇa deveśi daśadikṣu palāyayet (!) || sarvayajñaphalaṃ caiva sarvadānaphalādhikāṃ || 21 || labhate nātra saṃdeho satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditaṃ || pustakaṃ liṣitagehe (!) yasya santi maheśvarī || 22 || tena rākalpavṛkṣasyārddhana (!) dhaṃnya varānane || ity evaṃ stotrarājāṣyaṃ (!) kimannyacchotumichasi (!) || 23 || (exp. 4t9–4b2) Colophon iti śrīmerutaṃtre śivapārvatisaṃvāde (!) śrīmahākaumārīdevyā kavaca (!) samāptaṃ || || (exp. 4b2–3)

Beginning śrī bhūtesa (!) uvāca || || śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi mahāguhyottamottamaṃ || sahaśranāmakaumāryyāś caturvargaphalapradaṃ || 1 || purā nāgeru (!) nāsāya (!) sutrakena (!) kṛtastavaṃ || gopanīyaṃ prayatnena nimaya (!) sureśvarī || 2 || (exp. 4b3–5) End na deyaṃ nindakebhyo hi na deyaṃ garvvasayuti (!) || deyaṃ śiṣyāya bhaktāya gurubhaktiparāya ca || jñānayuktāya dhīrāya dātavyam iti niścayaṃ || gopanīyaṃ suyatnena gopanīyaṃ sadā bhavet || gopanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonīr iva pārvvatī || || (exp. 18, l. 1–3) Colophon iti śrīmerutaṃtre śivapārvvatīsaṃvāde śrīmāhākaurīdevyākakārādīaṣṭottaraśahasranāma (!) samāptaṃ || śubham || liṣitam karmmācāryya meheramāna svahastena idaṃ pustaka saṃpūrṇa krīyate || yādriṣṭaṃ (!) pustakaṃ dṛṣṭā (!) tādṛṣṭaṃ (!) liṣitaṃ mayā || yadī (!) śuddhro (!) maśuddhro (!) vā mama doṣa nadīyate || 1 || || ❁ || || || ❁ || || || ❁ ||(exp. 18, l. 3–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ kailāsaśikhare ramye sukhāsīnaṃ trilocanaṃ | praṇamya śirasā nāthaṃ pārvatī paryapṛcchata || 1 || pārvaty uvāca || tvattaḥ śrutaṃ purā deva gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ || nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ saccitraṃ gakārādikaniṣṭadaṃ || 2 guhyād guhyataraṃ loke sarvābhīṣṭārthasiddhyakaṃ || tanme vadasva deveśa yady ahaṃ vallabhā tava || 3 || (fol. 1v1–7) End gayāmayo gayākṣetraṃ gayākṣetranivāsakṛt || gayāvāsis tu bhogāya madhuvratalasatkaraḥ || 1019 || gāyako gāyakaṣaro gāyakeṣṭaphalapradaḥ || gāyakapraṇayīgītā gāyakābhayadāyakaḥ || 1020 || gāyakapravaṇasvāṃto gāyaka (!) prathamaḥ sadā || gāyakodgītasaṃprīto gāyakotkaṭavidmahā || 102 || (exp. 20v1–7)

Beginning śrībhairava uvāca śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śiva uvāca || śṛṇu devi rahasyaṃ me yat purā kīrtitaṃ mayā || tava bhaktyā gaṇeśasya vakṣye nāmasahasrakaṃ || devy uvāca || bhagavanāṇanāthasya varadasya mahātmanaḥ || śrītuṃ nāmasahasraṃ me hṛdayaṃ cotsukāyate || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End sarvatra jayam āpnoti gaṇeśasya prasārataḥ itīdaṃ puṇyasarvasvaṃ mantranāmasahasdrakaṃ || mahāgaṇapate gopyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayatnavat || 35 || (fol. 18v1–3) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale mahārahasye śrīvaradagaṇeśasahasranāmāmṛta saṃpūrṇaṃ || ||❖ |||| || ❖ || || ❖ || vārāṇasyāṃ gaṇeśena likhitaṃ puṣpasaṃnidhau || sahasranāmam idaṃ stotraṃ pāvanaṃ paramaṃ śubhaṃ || 16 || (fol. 18v3–7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo gaṇapataye || gaṇapatiṃ ca herambaṃ vighnarājaṃ vināyakaṃ | devīputraṃ mahātejo mahābalaparākramaṃ || mahodaramahākāyaṃ ekadaṃtaṃ gajānanaṃ || śvetadarṇṇaṃ mahādīptiṃ trinetraṃ gaṇanāyakaṃ || (exp. 2, l. 1–3) End akṣamālāṃ kheṭakaṃ ca dakṣiṇena vidhāriṇaṃ | pūrṇṇamodakapātraṃ ca vāmahaste vidhāriṇaṃ || nānāpuṣparataṃ devaṃ nānāgandhānulepanaṃ | nāgayajñopavītāṅgaṃ nānāvighnavitāraṇaṃ || devāsuramanuṣyaiś ca siddhagaṃdharvvavanditaṃ | trailokyavighnaharttāraṃ bhāsvvāsuraṃ namāmy ahaṃ || (exp. 2, l. 3–6) Colophon iti gaṇapatistotraṃ samāptaṃ || (exp. 2, l. 6)

Beginning svasti śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ || || karpūram madhyamāntyasvarapararahitaṃ seṃduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījaṃ te mātar etat tripuraharavadhu trikṛtaṃ ye japaṃti || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasaṃty eva vācaḥ svacchaṃdaṃ dhvāṃtadhārādhararucirucire sarvasiddhiṃ gatānām || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End kuraṅgākṣīvṛṃdaṃ tam anusarati premataralaṃ vaśas tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhiḥ || ripuḥ kārāgāraṃ kalayati ca tat kelikalayā ciraṃ jīvanmuktaḥ sa bhavati subhaktaḥ pratijanuḥ || 22 || (fol. 5v1–3) Colophon iti śrīmahākālaviracitaṃ karpūrastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || ❖ || śrī namaḥ śrīkālikāyai || || śrībhairavyai namaḥ || (fol. 5v3–4)

Beginning svasti śrīharasūnave namaḥ || || skanda uvāca || yad vastu paramaṃ guhyaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ nṛṇā (!) || tan me brūhi viśeṣeṇa nātaḥ parataraṃ śubham || 1 || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu vasa mahāprājña rahasyaṃ sarvakādam || dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ mahādāridryanāśanam || nāmnā sahasraṃ divyānām ekākṣaragaṇeśituḥ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End yad ya (!) vāṃchati tat sarvaṃ prāpnoty eva na saṃśayaḥ || idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mayā proktaṃ śikhidhvaja || 158 || sarvathā gopanīyante na prakāśyaṃ kadācanaḥ (!) || na kṛtaghnāya dātavyaṃ nābhaktāya kadācana || 159 || na pāpakarmaṇo putra na deya brāhmaṇādviṣe || śraddhāyuktāya śījñāya (!) deyaṃ bhaktāya nīśritaṃ || 160 || || || || (fol. 11v1–4) Colophon iti śrīnandyāvartte mahātaṃtre harakārttikeyasamvāde śrīmad ekākṣarātmaka gaṇapatisahasranāmastotraṃ sampūrṇam samāptam śu || bha || ma || stu || liṣitam pustakaṃ chavilālabrāhmaṇa śuddho vā maśuddho vā mama doṣo na dīyate iti samvat 1862 sāla miti caitra kṛṣṇa 14 roja śubham || || || || || || || rā || ma || || rā || ma || || rā || ma || || rā || ma || || rā || ma || || rā || ma || || rā || ma || || rā || ma || || rā || ma || || rā || ma || śivaśivaśivaśivaśivaśivaśivaśivaśivaśivaśivaśivaśivaśivaśivaśivaśi (fol. 11v5–12v3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || ❁ || atha gāyatrīpañcāṅga prārambha || ❁ || śrīnārada uvāca || ❁ || sadācāravidhirddeva bhavatā varṇita (!) prabho || tasyāpy atulamāhātmyaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam || 1 || śrutaṃ bhavanmukhāṃbhojacyutaṃ devīkathāsmṛtam || vratāni yāni coktāni cāndrāyaṇamukhāni te || 2 || (exp. 3t1–6) End yatra kutra jale magnaḥ sandhyāmajjanajaṃ phalam || labhate nātra saṃdeha satyaṃ satyaṃ ca nārada || 28 || śṛṇuyād yopi tad bhaktyā sa tu pāpāt pramucyate || pīyūśāṣadṛśaṃ (!) vākyaṃ saṃdhyoktaṃ nāraderitam || 29 || (exp. 16b7–11) Colophon tsat (!) śrīdevībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe dvādaśaskandhe gāyatrī stotraṃ nāma pañcamodhyāya || ❁ || śrīśāke 1842 samvat 1977 māghamāse site pakṣe pratipat bhaumavāsare || dāvalenubhū grāme likhitaṃ buddhimohana || ❁ || śubham || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || rāmarāmeti rāmeti rame rāme manorame || sahasranāmatattulyaṃ rāmanāmavarānane || ❁ || gaṅgāgaṅgeti yo brūyāt yojanānāṃ śatair api || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || ❁ || sitārāma (!) || oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya (exp. 16b11–17t8)

Beginning || 90 || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ caṃdrakhaṃḍavirājitataṃ || papraccha vinayā bhaktyā gaurī natvā vṛṣadhvajaṃ || 1 || śrīdevy uvāca || bhagavan sarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada || kenopāyena vai loke lokāḥ prayāṃti sadgatiṃ || 2 || tan me vada mahādeva yadi testi dayā mayi || śrīmahādeva uvāca || asti guhyataraṃ hy etat jñānaṃ tvekaṃ sanātanaṃ || 3 || atīva sugopyaṃ priye kathituṃ naiva śakyate || atīva me prīyāsīti kathayāmi tathāpi te || 4 || (fol. 1v1–6) End brahmāviṣṇumaheśānāṃ niṃdā (!) kurvaṃti ye sadā || darśanāc caiva sarveṣāṃ devādīnāṃ ca sarvadā || 60 || pāpaṃ vinaśyate sarvaṃ stotrasyāsya prasādataḥ || ity evaṃ stavarājaṃ hi tava snehāt prakāśitaṃ || 61 || (fol. 7v4–6) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale paramahaṃsarahasye gaurīkalpe umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde śrīgurustavarāja (!) samāptam || (fol. 7v6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīmahāgaṇapatiprīty arthaṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kariṣye tatrastha śrīprāṇapratiṣṭhāmaṃtrasya brahmāviṣṇumaheśvarā ṛṣaya gaṇapatidevatā parāprāṇaśaktir devatāyai hṛdayai ṛgyajuḥsāmārthavaṇichaṃdasi mukhe | oṃ bījaṃ guhye | hrīṃ śaktiḥ pādayoḥ || krauṃ kilakaṃ sarvāṅge mahāgaṇapatiprīty arthaṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāpane viniyogaḥ | (fol. 1r1–5) End na bhaktesadṛśaṃ (!) jñānaṃ na bhaktesadṛśaṃ (!) tapaḥ || na bhaktesadṛśaṃ (!) tīrthaṃ tasmād bhaktiṃ samācara || 55 || idaṃ sadgurumāhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ tava nārada || ya[j]jñātvā labhate jaṃtu (!) paramaṃ padam avyayaṃ || 56 || na deyaṃ paraśiṣyāya nābhaktyāya śaṭhāya ca || na dhūrttāya kṛtaghnāya na paradveṣakāriṇe || 57 || svaśiṣyāyāpi duṣṭāya na deyaṃ ṛṣisattama || bhaktāya śuddhacittāya dāṃtāya niyatacetase || 58 || na deyaṃ ʼnyasya (!) kasyāpi goptavyaṃ mātṛjāravat || ya idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ naro niścalamānasaḥ || 59 || kīrttivān dhanavāṃś caiva putravān jāyate naraḥ || aṃte muktim āpnoti ca gurusānidhyam (!) eva ca || 60 || || (fol. 14v2–15v3) Colophon iti śrīviṣṇuyāmale gurumāhātmyakathanaṃ nāma dvitīyodhyāyaḥ || 2 || 170 || śrīgurodevārpaṇam astu || ❖ || || yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ likhitaṃ mayā || yadi śuddham aśuddhaṃ vā mama doṣo na lipyate || 1 || līkhītaṃ (!) paranupakārārthaṃ (!) śivāśrameṇa nāradaghaṭe || saṃvat 1790 samaya phālguna śuddha 2 dvitīyā śubhaṃ mastu (!) || ❖ || || ❖ || (fol. 15v3–7)

Beginning ❖ śrīguhyakālyai namaḥ || yā sāntakāgnivivarotthitatejarūpā (!) candrārkkapāvakavadeṣu pralīnarūpā || dhyānaikaniṣṭhaparamātmapralīnatejā | svābhāvatejanilayāṃ praṇamāmi nityāṃ || vajrapaṃjaradivyaṃ ca kavacaṃ sarvvakāmadaṃ | śarīre nyastamātreṇa bhairavo bhavati kṣanāt (!) || paramantrābhicārāni kṛtvā duṣṭagrahāni (!) ca | dākinībhūtavaitāla vidhvaṃsayati tatkṣaṇāt || (fol. 1r1–4) End evaṃ nyastaśarīre tu kavacena maheśvarī | ājñāsiddhimantrasiddhi bhaved bhairavavat svayaṃ || siddhyaṣṭakam avāpnoti sahaprāvarttanena vai | yaṃ yaṃ cintayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnoti niścitaṃ || satyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevi nātra kāryya (!) vicāranāḥ (!) || (fol. 2r7–2v2) Colophon iti śrīkaravīrayoge ṣaṭsāhasrike guhyakālīkavacaṃ samāptaṃ || 2 || (fol. 2v2–3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || mahākāla uvāca || acintyā ʼmitākāraśaktisvarūpā prativyaktadhiṣṭhānasatvaikamūrttiḥ || nirākāranirdvaṃdvabodhaikagamyā tvam ekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 1 || agotrākṛtitvād anaikāntikatvād alakṣāgamatvād aśeṣākaratvāt || 2 || prapaṃcālasatvād anārambhakatvā (!) tvam ekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End mahākālarudroditaṃ stotram etat sadā bhaktibhāvena yodhyeti bhaktaḥ || na pāpaṃ na rogo na śoko na mṛtyur bhavet siddhiraṃte ca kaivalyalābhaḥ || 25 || iti te kathitaṃ divyaṃ sudhādhārāhvayaṃ stavam || etasya satatābhyāsāt siddhiḥ karatale sthitāḥ || 26 || (fol. 5v2–5) Colophon ity ādināthaviracitāyāṃ mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ mahākālaproktaṃ guhyakālyāḥ sudhādhārāhvayaṃ stotraṃ sampūrṇam || || śubham || śrīguhyakālīprītayestu || (fol. 5v5–6v2)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmaṅgalāyai || || yāsānte kāgnikūhalosthiti bhāśvarūpā | somārkkavahnitṛpaṭhedaramadhyasaṃsthā | citcetacittaviṣayāṣevirinabhāvā | svābhāvabhāvitripalāṃ pranamāmi kālī || || vakrapañjaraṃ divya ca kavacaṃ sarvvakāmadaṃ | śarīre nyastamātrena bhairavo bhavati kṣaṇāt || (fol. 1r1–4) End Colophon iti karavīrayāge ṣaṭsāhaśrike guhyakālikāvajrapañjalakavacaḥ samāptam (fol. 2v8–9)

Beginning athātharvvaṇarahasyaṃ tāpinyāṃ śrīguhyakālīnirvvāṇasaṃdarbhe sakaladevatāmayanirvvāṇaturyyātītaparabrahmātmakacaturddaśamahāvaktragrasitalokamahāguhyakālīmahādhyānarahasyaṃ māhākrodhabhairavabhairavyai kathayāmāseti sūtraṃ || (fol. 1r1–4) End dharmārthakāmamokṣānāṃ prāptaye pratanusthitaḥ | sādhakaḥ parayā bhaktyā kīrtayet parameśvari (!) || iti dvādaśanāmastotraṃ || || vaibhavātra || svānubhāve svayaṃ vedye sāyujyaṃ bhajate naraḥ | tataḥ kṛtārthatām eti satyam eva na śaṃśayaḥ || prāpnoti punar ātṛptiṃ na kadāpi mahītale || (fol. 15v6–16r2) Colophon ity atharvvaṇavedarahasyatāpinyāṃ śrīguhyakālīnirvvāṇasaṃdarbhe sakaladevatāmayamahāturyyātītaparabrahmātmakacaturddaśamahāvaktragrasitalokamahāguhyakālīmahādhyānarahasyaṃ mahākrodhabhairavabhairavīsaṃvādarahasyaṃ samāptaṃ || (fol. 16r2–6)

Beginning atha dhyānaṃ || devy uvāca || ugrakṣakarapārvatīpate mṛḍaśastośaśikhaṇḍamaṇḍana | madanāntakabhaktabhaktavatsala priyakailāsadayāsudhāmbudhe | śivaśaṃkararudreśa mahādevāmbikāpate | harikeśavirūpākṣa namaste candraśekhara | (exp. 8b1–5) End muktāhāraśatairdivyai (!) bhavyasaṃlagnanāyakaiḥ | divyaratnaprabhāyuktaiḥ hemamālāsahasrakaiḥ alaṃkṛtamahākaṇṭhe kabandhaśatadāmaṇiḥ | dūrāsadaṃ sapatnānāṃ dehaśoṇitamāṃsakaiḥ | carccitaṃ dvija/// (exp. 12b2–5) Colophon

«Complete transcript:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || ātmattvāya namaḥ || vidyātattvāya svāhā || śivatattvāya svāhā | sarvatatvāya namaḥ | asya śrīkālyā tryakṣarīmaṃtrasya bhairavaṛṣir uṣṇik chaṃdaḥ kālikādevatāmaṃtrasiddhipūrvaka sarvābhīṣṭasiddhaye jape viniyogaḥ | bhairavaṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi | uṣṇik chaṃdase namo mukhe | kālikādevatāyai nama hṛdi || krāṃ aṃguṣṭābhyāṃ namaḥ | krīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā || krūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ | kraiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ hūṃ | krauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ vauṣaṭ | kaḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭābhyāṃ phaṭ || krāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | krīṃ śirase svāhā | krūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | kraiṃ kavacāya huṃ | krauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | kraḥ astrāya phaṭ | maṃtreṇa sarvāṃgaṃ dhyānam | śyāmāṃ caturbhujāṃ khaḍgamuṃḍābhītivarapradāṃ | muktakeśīṃ muṃḍamālāṃ dhyāyechrīkālikāṃbikām | iti dhyātvā mānasopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya japet || guhyāti guhyaṃ goptrītvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japaṃ | siddhir bhavatu me devi tvatprasādāt sureśvari | iti nivedayet praṇamet | guruṃ devatāṃ ca || tata (!) stotrapāṭhādikaṃ paṭhet || (exp. 1–2)

Beginning śrīkubjikādevyai namaḥ || atha saha/// pārvvaty uvāca || bhagavan bhāṣitaḥ sarvvaḥ viśeṣakaruṇānidhe | kubjikārūpadevyā yā mantranāmasahasrakaṃ || purā kailāśaśikhare prāha yā mantrasaṃhitā | devadīrghadayāpūrṇṇā vedadarśitasantyadhā || śrutvā dhārayituṃ devi mamoktā varttate ʼdhunā || kṛpayā kaivalaṃ nātha tasmān mokṣānumarhasi || || (exp. 3t1–4) End tridivā tridiveśāni niṣṭhā tripuravāsinī | tridhāmnī tridaśā tryājyā trighnī tripuramālinī || trivarggā triprabhā tryambā trimātrā vidhigāminī | tricakravidyātribhagā traimātrā tryamālinī || tripurāḥ śrīḥ trijananī bhairavī kubjisundarī || 1000 || iti śrīkubjikādevyā mantranāmasahasrakaṃ || kathitaṃ tava deveśī rahasyaṃ sarvvakāmadaṃ || sarvvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvvatīrthaphalapradaṃ || sarvvasaṃpatkaraṃ devī sarvvadāridranāśanaṃ (!) || sarvvarogaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvvapāpavinaṃśanaṃ | etena yamtu (!) veddevī (!) pūjayītvā (!) sumadhyame || siddhyanti sakalāṃ (!) kāmān saṃpadākāmarūpiṇīṃ | āuś ca varddhaet tasya vidyālakṣmīḥ supuḥṣkarān (!) || prabhāte yaḥ stuti (!) vidvān divyāmīmāṃtmikāṃ (!) japet || 131 || (exp. 10b1–3) Colophon iti meru āgame (!) kailāsakhaṇḍe umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde/// (exp. 10b3–8)

Beginning avyavasthitāḥ || akadyava (!) na varṇānāṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraṃ | ....................jñena tṛpyantu || mūlena preduṃ ca sundarī tṛpyantu/// (exp. 2, l. 1–2) End iti śrīkubjikādevyā mantranāmasahasrakaṃ | kathitaṃ tava deveśī rahasyaṃ sarvvakāmadaṃ || 127 || sarvvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvvatīrthaphalapradaṃ || sarvvasaṃpatkaraṃ devī sarvvadā nidranāśanaṃ || 128 || sarvvarogaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvvapāpavināśanaṃ | ete nayamtu veddevī pūjayitvā sumadhyame || 129 || siddhyanti sakalāṃ kāmān sampadā kāmarūpiṇī | āyuś ca varddhate tasya vidyālakṣmīḥ supuṣkarān || 130 || prabhāte yaḥ stuti vidvān divyāmimātmikāṃ japet || (exp. 6t1–5) Colophon iti śrīmelūāgame kailāśakhaṇḍe śrīumāmaheśvarasamvāde ekādaśapaṭala śrīkubjikānāmasahasrakaṃ samāptaṃ || ❁ || ❁ || śubham astu sarvvadāṃ (!) || ❁ || ❁ || (exp. 6t5–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrībhairavāya namaḥ || || asya śrīvaṭukabhairavanāmāṣṭaśatakasyāpaddhārastotrasya | bṛhaddāraśvakaṛṣiśirasi || anuṣṭupcchando mukhe || āpaduddhārabhairavo devatā hṛdi || aṣṭabāhuṃ trinayanam iti bījaṃ || dhaṃ śaktiṃ hrīṃ sīlakaṃ caturvvidhapuruṣārthasiddhaye samārādhane viniyogaḥ || (exp. 3b1–5) End bhairavopi prahṛṣṭobhūt sa svayaṃ ca maheśvaraḥ †sya laśva ja† parameśvarīṃ | evaṃ śṛtvā tato devī nāmāṣṭaśatam uttamaṃ || saṃtoṣaṃ paramaṃ prāpya bhairavasya mahātmanaḥ | jajāpa parayā bhaktyā sadā sarvveśvareśvarī || || (exp. 16b2–4) Colophon iti śrīviśvasāroddhāre rudrayāmale pmāmaheśvarasaṃvāde āpaduddhārakaṃ vaṭukabhairavastavarājaṃ samāptaḥ (!) || 22 || ❖ oṃ hrīṃ vaṭukāya āpaduddhāraṇāya kuru kuru vaṭukāya hrīṃ oṃ vacad bhūve svāhā || || (exp. 16b4–17t2)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ asya śrīkārttavīryyārjjunasahasranāmastotrasya dattātreya ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭupchandaḥ śrīkārttavīryyārjjuno devatā || phroṃ bījaṃ klīṃ śaktiḥ āṃ kīlakaṃ kārttavīryyārjjunaprasādasiddhārthe jape viniyogaḥ || || (exp. 17b1–4) End vidyākīrttipradaṃ rājyapradaṃ dharmmātmajapradaṃ | sarvvam anyat parityajya nityam evam ūdīrayet || etat te sarvvam ākhyātaṃ yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi | sahasranāmastotrākhyaṃ kārttavīryyasya bhūpateḥ || kavacaṃ pūrvvam evoktaṃ mayā te parameśvari | sahasranāmastotrañ ca sāṃprataṃ parikīrttitaṃ || || (exp. 42b3–43t2) Colophon ity uḍḍāmareśvaratantre umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde kārttavīryyasahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || samvat 876 pauṣavaddhi 10 budhavāra kūhnū co yasidhakā juro || || śubha || (exp. 43t3–5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ ścaṇḍikāyai (!) || namostu vīracāmuṇḍī namostu parameśvarī | jananī sarvvalokānāṃ sarvvasaṃlakṣakāriṇī || caṇḍamaṇḍalasamākīrṇā varadāṅgī maranāsinī (!) | nānārūpadharī devī amalāṅgī saumyarūpiṇī || (exp. 43b1–4) End ya imāṃ paṭhate nityaṃ sadā bhavati mānavaḥ | yaccitte tatphalaṃ divyaṃ labhate dhīmatā śubhaṃ || ity uktena tu puṇyena sarvvasatyasukhāvahaṃ | mātāpitṛś ca sarvvāṅgaṃ bhaviṣyanti śivapradaṃ || || (exp. 51t1–4) Colophon iti śrīvīracāmuṇḍīstotraṃ samāptaṃ || (exp. 51t4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīkubjikāyai || || śrīpārvvatyuvāca || || bhagavan bhāṣītāśeṣaviśeṣakaruṇānidhe | kubjikārūpadevyā yā mantranāmasahasrakaṃ || purā kailāśaśiṣare (!) prāha yo mantrasaṃhitā | devadīrghadayāpūrṇṇā devadarśitasatyadhā || śrutvā dhārayituṃ devi mamoktā varttatedhuhā | kṛpayā kevalaṃ nātha tasmān māṃ kṣāṃtum arhasi || || (exp. 51b1–5) End kathitaṃ devadeveśi rahasyaṃ sarvvakāmadaṃ || sarvvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvvatīrthaphalapradaṃ | sarvvasampatkaraṃ devi sarvvadāridranāśanaṃ (!) | sarvvarogaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvvapāpavināśanaṃ || etena stuvatān (!) devī pūjayitvā sumadhyame | siddhyanti sakālān (!) kāmān sampadā kāmarūpiṇī || āyuś ca varddhate tasya vidyālakṣmīḥ supuṣkarān | prabhāte yaḥ stu (!) vidvān divyām imātmikāṃ japet || || (exp. 66t1–66b1) Colophon iti śrīmeruāgame kailāśākhaṇḍe śrīumāmaheśvarasamvāde ekādaśapaṭale kubjikānāmasahasrakaṃ samāptaṃ || || taruṇaravinibhāsyāṃ siṃhapṛṣṭhoparisṭhāṃ kucabharaṇamitāṃgīṃ sarvvabhūṣābhirāmāṃ | abhayavaradahastām ekavaktrāṃ trinetrāṃ madamuditamukhābjāṃ kubjikāṃ cintayāmi || || (exp. 66b1–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || varṣe vāsaravāraṇamite bhādre ʼvadāte tithau vahnau bhāskarabhesurejyadivase sādhyākhyayoge ʼkhilān devān vipramukhān prapūjya vidhivat prāsādamāse canaṃ prādāt prājñajapaprakāśanṛpatiḥ kaumārikāprītaye || 1 || tatrādau mahadutsave tu bhavatā kaumārikārccāvidhau vighneśo varedo ʼrccitas suravarair ādyas sadā pūjitaḥ | bhaktānāṃ bhayabhañjanaḥ paśupatiḥ kṣetrādhinātha svadhā guhyeśī gurudevamaṃtramilitair bhāvais tvayā bhāvitā || 2 || (fol. 1r1–6) End rājan rāmasahāyavān hi hanumān bhadrāvatāraḥ svayaṃ yasted vārivarā ʼbhayārppitakaro darvvarttivīrāśanaḥ | ity ante bhavatārccitāḥ suragaṇā nepālapīṭhe sthitā dadyur bhaktaja prakāśanṛpateḥ pūrṇṇā manovaṃchitaṃ || 8 || kumārikārccanaṃ puṇyaṃ prakāśena prakāśitaṃ | varṇṇitaṃ bhūmidevena bhūmidevena cchaṃdasā || 9 || stotram etat paṭhet prātar yo naro bhūmikāṃchyayā | kumārī varadā tasmai dadyāt bhūmivaraṃ varaṃ || 10 || (fol. 2r4–2v2) Colophon iti śrīharṣadvijaviracitaṃ kumārikārccanaṃ stotraṃ samāptaṃ || śubham || śrīśāke 884 || āṣāḍhe likhitaṃ || 4 || śrīkumārikāyai namaḥ || (fol. 2v2–3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namostu te mahāgauri raktāṃgī raktavāsinī | prātarvvāninirūpā ca madhyāhne yauvanī smṛtā || saṃdhyāyāṃ vṛddhā rūpā ca jagadvyāpi namostu te | kālarātri tvam evāsi viṣṇumāyā tvam eva hi || tvam eva devi prakṛtiḥ viśvaṃ vyāpya vimohitā || sarvvavyāpini tvaṃ devi parāparamikā (!) śive || (exp. 4t1–3) End śyāmā raktā śaktihastā mayūrā brahmacāriṇī | kaumārībālarūpī ca namastestu pare śive || aparādhasahasrāṇi kriyate [ʼ]harnniśaṃ mayā | dāśoyam iti māṃ matvā kṣamasva parameśvarī || sarvvamaṃgalamaṃgale || (exp. 5t5–8) Colophon iti rudrajāmale (!) kumārīmahāmāyāstotraṃ samāpta (!) || (exp. 5t8)

Beginning ///vimetvaṃ timraḥ (!) pīṭhaṃ lalāṭe eiṃ evaṃ vyāptaṃ samastāsthitiḥlayajananī rudraśakti……|| iti japtvā devadevī akulakulamayā nedadhātrī svataṃtrā oṃ sarvvajñā biṃdubhūtā/// (exp. 2, l. 1–2) End duḥkhasokajarāmārī (!) bhayapāṭhakanāśani || khaḍgasiddhikari devī lakṣmīśrīśubhadāyini || 27 || anudinabhaktibhāvaiḥ ye paṭhanti tu ti narā kāryasiddhiphalaṃ yatyā śubhā ānandabhāṣitaṃ || 28 || (exp. 13b3–5) Colophon iti mātṛkāvijayasūtra (!) samāptaḥ (!) || ❁ || (exp. 13b5–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaścaṇḍikāyai || siddhiṃ parāparamayī vilināti devī yā seṣamaṃtrajananīmabhulaprabhāvā | tāṃ naumi māti bhubhajāparabodhadhāhe vidhaṃtahārdvatimihasiddhilakṣmī || 1 || (exp. 18t1–2) End evaṃ stutā mahādevī bhairaveśaṃ mahātmanā tato liṃgaṃ vinirbhidya nirggatā parameśvarī || (exp. 22b3–4) Colophon iti mālinīstavaḥ samāptaḥ || ❁ || (exp. 22b4–5)

Beginning /// sadātana viśvadhyānanimīlanaśobhamānanayanānanakamalakhaḍgakhaṇḍitākhilasvacchamlecchakulakṣīrāmbudhimadhyavirājamānaphaṇīśaphaṇaśayānaśaṃkhacakragadāpadmasadmacatuḥśayaśuddhasatvamayakṣaṇam api dayā dayāmayi dayāmayāsibhūyāya tohaṃ bhavāṃbhodhibhūyo bhavanmajjanatrasta cetāvijetārivarggaṃ bhavannirvṛtaḥ san bhavantaṃ smarāmi || phaṇīśe śayānaṃ patatrīśayānaṃ samāsāditaśrīmatānekamānaṃ | bhajajjīvajīvātu nirvvāṇadānaṃ sadā naumi nārāyaṇaṃ puṇyabhālaṃ || 1 || (exp. 2, l. 1–6) End devatvaṃ manuje suratvam amare cendratvam itthaṃ paraṃ sarvvatrāstinare sure tvaditarasmin kinnarādāv api tan na kvāpi vibhāvyate paśupate yastvāṃ samutkarṣayed itthaṃ vastu ca vāstavaṃs tavavidhau kaste samarthas tvataḥ || 8 || (exp. 20t6–20b2) Colophon śākedṛk śaratarkkacandragalite śrīnīlakaṇṭhāṣṭakaṃ śrīmanmallajagajjayāvanipatir vyācaṣṭa pṛṣṭvā śivaṃ | etasmin paṭhite śrūte ca manujo jāyeta divye pade modetāpi ciraṃ paraṃ pariṇatau syāt tasya bhūpaḥ śivaṃ || || || iti nikhiladarśanavicāryamāṇapadārthasārthaniṣṭhāvijñānaparamacāturyyavāryyamāṇavividhabudhān adarpyasvarūpajitakandarpya śastrāstrapracāranaipūṇyāt kṛtākhilarājanyavaryyaparamaiśvaryyaśauryyodāryyadhūryyavitatayaśaḥ sudhākarasaṃgītādikalākalāparipūṇavaranepālādidharaṇīdharaparamadevodaya śrīśrīmanmallajagajjayaparamabhaṭṭārakaracitaṃ śrīmatkṛpāvannemunipradarśitavirūpākṣatīrthayātrāgatakrameṇa śrīmatkuśeśvaraprabhṛticatuḥṣaṣṭhiśivaliṅgānāṃ tathā śrīmataḥ paśupateḥ śrīmatyā bhagavatyā guhyeśvaryyās tathā śrīvajrayoginyā nīlakaṇṭhādeś ca varṇṇanaṃ samapūribhūri śubhadam idam astu pāṭhakānā || || ❖ || || || śrīman nepālapāla tvadamitabalador ddaṇḍacaṇḍapratāpas phūryyad vahnipratapte tvadahitanikare padmadāsī davehi | tatratyaṃ kīrttidugdhaṃ samuditam apatat prāñchalad bhatrabhūmau magnaṃ tejaḥ sudagdhaṃ payasi ca bhavataḥ kīrttihaṃsī papau tat || 1 || deva tvatkhaṇḍitākhaṇḍalabalavilasat kāṇḍako daṇḍanirjjā ccaṇḍāṃśūddāmadāroditavitatayaśaś candrapāraṃ śuvṛndaiḥ || viśvaṃ dīptaṃ tadetajjanapadajanuṣāṃ preyasīnāṃ śiro yad vāsaḥ śūnyaṃ tadīyāhitagatakuyaśāṃ sīva kinna vyanaktiṃ || || śrīviśvambharabhūsurendratanūyo nepālanākālayo bhāradvājakulārṇṇave sumudito vidyākalānānnidhiḥ | yatkīrttityujvalakaumudīspharatibhir ddigbhibhipaṣṭīkṛto yo mūrddhāstidhṛtaḥ prakāśanṛpateḥ rudrāvatārasya vai || kṣutkṣāmadvijatācakorasukhadodānāmṛtādyaiskarair hṛtyarkṣeḥ smitasammukessahaśataḥ kṣaiśyaṅkadharttāripau || svāhlādaṃ taruśrīmukheṣu nihitā śītāṃśavomadvidhau bhāti śrīdvijarāja eṣatitarāṃ devādinandā/// (exp. 20b2–22, l. 5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgurave || agastya uvāca || kārttike yā tvayā proktā guhyeśī dakṣiṇe taṭe | vāgmatyāḥ saritaḥ śrīmān nepālapīṭhasattame || sāṃprataṃ śrotum icchāmi tasyā nāmasahasrakaṃ | brūhi deva mahābhāga lokānugrahakāṃkṣayā || || skanda uvāca || purā śrutaṃ mayā śaṃbhoḥ sakāsād dvijasattama | tat tehaṃ saṃpravakṣāmi sarvvapāpaharaṃ paraṃ || (fol. 1v1–4) End śivadā śivarūpā ca śivopari niṣēduṣī | śāṃbhavī śaṃbhurūpā ca śāśvatī ca sarasvatī || śāntā śāntādarī śāntā śāntiḥśāntipradāyinī | śāradā śaradā jyotsnā śāradīyā śanātanī || śrīmantāśāvinīśā ca sāmaśīmaprakāśinī | śāmeśvarī sanātanya śatānandāti naṃditā || (fol. 12v5–8) Colophon ❖ saṃ 882 śrāvaṇaśuklapūrṇṇimā luhnu śrīmūṇiyā upākarmmasāśrī sirahmakāyana śrīguhyeśvarīyā sahasranāma śrībrāhma yāta dānaviyā juro śubhaṃ || || (exp. 2, 1–2)

Beginning ❖ nāteśvarayā (!) || ānandaśaktiparimaṇḍitamantraśabhaṃ (!) tat kena rūpam akhilārthavidhānahetuṃ | aṣṭāṅgasādhanakaraṃ parameṇa mūrttiṃ nāṭeśvaraṃ sakalasiddhikaraṃ namāmi || (exp. 6t3–6) End yā śrī svayaṃ bhagavatī paramātmadehā sṛṣṭisṭhitipralayaviśvamayātmadehā | saṃsāramohitatamā tarunai samastaṃ śrīmānadeśatu mame vāṃcchitarājyalakṣmī || || darpyāluśyadilūśyakṛta…………….nīraktaraktabījasa.. rasanihate …………………………………………………………|| (exp. 12t2–12b1) Colophon iti śrī aṣṭacaṇḍistavaḥ samāptaḥ || || || (exp. 12b2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || ullasad danujavṛndakhedinī bhūriduḥkhabhavabhītibhedinī || kaṇṭhalambitakapālamālikā maṃgalaṃ mama karotu kālikā || 1 || śoṇitādragajacarmmavāsinī (!) mattabhairavamahāṭṭahāsinī || daityabāhukṛtakāś ca śālikā maṃgalaṃ mama karotu kālikā || 2 || (exp. 1left, t 1–7) End rājase sakalasargasajane sātvikī ca jagatām sulakṣaṇe || nāmasiṃhajagatāṃ surolikā maṃgalaṃ mama karotu kālikā || 7 || bhaktinamramuniyakṣadevatā siddhakinnarasamūhasevitā || śuṃbhadaityamakarandarolikā maṃgalam mama karotu kālikā || 8 || (exp. 1right, b 5–11) Colophon iti śrīkālidāsaviracitaṃ kālikāstotram sampūrṇam || śrīkālikāyai namaḥ || bhuvaneśvaryai namaḥ || samvat 1888 sāla miti phālguṇa śu di 9 roja 1 likhitaṃ chavilālavipra/// (exp. 1left, b11–16)

Beginning oṃ guhyakālyai namaḥ śrīsadāśiva uvāca oṃ namastribhuvaneśāya brahmaṇe viśvarūpiṇe īśvarāya pareśāya gurave śivarūpiṇe 1 yasyāḥ praśādād (!) devopi saravajñaḥ saśivo bhavet tāṃ naumi parameśānīṃ sarvavyāpinim īśvarīṃ 2 brahmāṇḍakoṭilakṣāṇi bhasmasāt kuruteñjasā tāṃ kālagrāsaniratāṃ guhyakālīṃ namāmy ahaṃ 3 (fol. 3r9–3v2) End krīḍārtha yā karocitrāṃ brahmāṇḍārbudamālinīṃ añjanādrinibhāṃ kālīṃ koṭisūryyasamaprabham 200 guhyakālīṃ maṃgalāṃ ca siddhiṃ kālīṃ jayeāvarīṃ carccikāṃ tripureśīṃ ca kāṃcalī bhuvaneśvarī 201 śrīmaṃgalāṃ mahākālīṃ nirvāṇapadadāyinīṃ mokṣadāṃ rājyadāṃ nityāṃ daśavaktrāṃ parāṃ bhajet 202 (fol. 12v1–4) Colophon iti śrīhāhārāvataṃtre ṣaṭtriṃśatasahasre matharvaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ śivapārvatīsaṃvāde śrīguhyakālīdevyāḥ sahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam śubham || || 1722 (fol. 12v4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśo jayatu || || śrīguhyakālyai namaḥ || || śrīsadāśiva uvāca || || oṃ namas tribhuvaneśāya brahmaṇe viśvarūpiṇe || īśvarāya pareśāya gurave śivarūpiṇe || 1 || yasya prasādād devopi sarvvajñaḥ saśivo bhavet || tāṃ naumi pareśānīṃ sarvavyāpimaheśvarīṃ || 2 || brahmāṇḍakoṭilakṣāṇi bhasmasāt kurute (!) yayā || tāṃ kālagrāsaniratāṃ guhyakālīṃ namāmy ahaṃ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End aṃjanādrinibhāṃ kālī (!) koṭisūryasamaprabhāṃ trailokyarakṣaṇaratāṃ maṃgalāṃ praṇamāmy ahaṃ 201 guhyakālīṃ maṃgalāṃ ca siddhikālījapeśvarīṃ carcikāṃ tripureśi ca kālī ca bhuvaneśvarīṃ 202 śrīmaṃgalāṃ mahākālīṃ nirvāṇapadadāyinīṃ mokṣadāṃ rājyadāṃ nityāṃ daśavaktrāṃ parāṃ bhajet 203 (fol. 18r1–5) Colophon iti śrīhāhārāvataṃtre ṣaṭtriṃśati sāhasre mahāʼ tharvaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ śivapārvatisāmarasya (!) śrīguhyakālidevyāḥ sahasranāmaśrutirahasyaṃ sampūrṇam śubham samvat 964 nepāla mārgaśiraśukla 6 somavāra 2 joganarasiṃ naṃ coyā julo (fol. 18r5–7)

Beginning śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ || || śrīmahākāla uvāca || || sudhādhārābhidhāṃ stotram ekam anyac ca varttate || tadapāṭhena deveśi vyarthaṃ naimittikārcanam || 1 || tripurārirahaṃ cāpi stotrasyaitasya pāṭhakau || bhūtvā samarcayā vastāṃ sarvajñatvasamīhayā || 2 || devy uvāca || kīdṛśaṃ tanmahat stotraṃ yad yuvāṃ paṭhataḥ sadā || yasya nāma sudhādhārā sudhāsadṛśam eva tat || 3 || (fol. 1v1–4) End mahākālarudroditaṃ stotram etat sadā bhaktibhāvena yodhyeti bhaktaḥ || na cāpannaśoko na rogo na mṛtyur bhavet siddhir ante ca kaivalyalābhaḥ || 29 || iti te kathito devi sudhādhārāhvayaḥ stavaḥ || etasya satatābhyāsāt siddhiḥ karatale sthitā || 30 || etat stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ gadyaṃ tritayam apyadaḥ || paṭhanīyaṃ prayatnena naimittikasamarhaṇe || 31 || ❁ || (fol. 5v4–6v3) Colophon iti mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ mahākālamahākālīsaṃvāde naimittikārcanabaliprakaraṇapaṭale guhyakālikāyāḥ sudhādhārāhvayā stavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || ❁ || śubham bhūyāt || ❁ || || saṃvatsaraḥ || 19 ||| 21 ||| ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 6v3–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrībhairava uvāca || || athāto dakṣiṇeśvaryā yogeśvaryās tathaiva ca || sāmarasya mahādhyānam pravakṣāmi (!) samāsataḥ || 1 || acāpi (!) dvividhaṃ dhyānaṃ nirguṇaṃ saguṇan tathā || tatrādau nirguṇam vacmi saguṇan tu tataḥ param || 2 || hṛtpadme vā bhruvor madhye sahasradalapaṅkaje || dhyāyej jyotirmayīn devīṃ kālīrūpadvayātmikām || 3 || (fol. 1v1–6) End ekasyā api māhātmyam varṇituṃ varṣakoṭibhiḥ || śakyate naiva deveśi tayor eikāsya (!) kim punaḥ || 73 || koṭijanmārjjitaiḥ puṇyair labhyate vā na labhyate || nirvāṇabrahmavidyeyaṃ trailokyepi sudurllabhā || 74 || paramaiśvaryyalābhepi prāptepi prāṇasaṃkaṭe || eṣā brahmamayī vidyā na prakā (!) rūpā kadācana || 75 || vinā gurūpadeśan tu na dhyāyen na japed api || tasmād gurumukhād vidyāṅ gṛhṇīyāt sarvasiddhaye || 76 || || (fol. 9v3–10v2) Colophon iti śrīvāḍavānalīye mahātantre koṭivaktrādhyānarahasyam samāptam || || samvat 1852 śubham || (fol. 10v2–3)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha dvitīyanyāsaḥ || hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ hūṃ phreṃ khhauṃ hrīṃ khhreṃ aṃ vīreśvarabrahmabhairavavīrabrahmamahāguhyakālībhyāṃ namaḥ svāhā aṃ khphreṃ hrīṃ khhrauṃ phreṃ hūṃ klīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ || hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ hūṃ phreṃ khhauṃ hrīṃ khphreṃ āṃ jvālā vīreśvarabrahmabhairevajvālā vīrabrahmamahāguhyakālībhyāṃ namaḥ svāhā āṃ khphreṃ hrīṃ khphrauṃ phreṃ hūṃ klīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ || (fol. 17v1–5) End hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ hūṃ phreṃ hrauṃ hrīṃ khphreṃ kṣaṃ hākāreśvarabrahmabhairavahākārabrahmamahāguhyakālībhyāṃ namaḥ svāhā kṣaṃ khphreṃ hrīṃ khphrauṃ phreṃ hūṃ klīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ || hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ hūṃ phreṃ khphrauṃ hrīṃ khphreṃ aṃ āṃ ity ādi kṣaṃ mūlaṣoḍaśākṣareśvarabrahmabhairavaṣoḍaśākṣarabrahmamahāguhyakālībhyāṃ namaḥ svāhā kṣaṃ ity ādi aṃ khphreṃ hrīṃ khphrauṃ phreṃ hūṃ klīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ || vyāpakaṃ || (fol. 24r5–24v2) Colophon iti paramānaṃdaparabrahmamahābhairavayoginīkumālāratnanyāsā (!) dvitīya (!) || || (fol. 24v2–3)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha tṛtīyanyāsaḥ || śrīṃ hrīṃ phreṃ hrauṃ bhaṃ hūṃ phkhśrīṃ hrīṃ aṃ akārākṣaramahācakrāsanamahāmaṇḍalamadhyasthakāmanūpamahāpīṭhanilayakāmamaṅgalamahābhairavāya akārākṣaramahābhairavyai kāmamaṅgalādevyai parāparatatvaparabrahmanirvvāṇaguhyakālikāyai hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā aṃ hrīṃ phkhśrīṃ hūṃ bhaṃ hauṃ phreṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ || (fol. 25v1–5) End pañcāśanmahāpīṭhasthamahāmaṅgalabhairavāya mahāmaṅgalabhairavī pūjitaparabrahmanirvvāṇaguhyakālīśrīpāduke māṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā kṣaṃ laṃ haṃ saṃ ṣaṃ śaṃ vaṃ laṃ raṃ yaṃ maṃ bhaṃ vaṃ phaṃ paṃ naṃ dhaṃ daṃ thaṃ taṃ ṇaṃ ḍhaṃ ḍaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭaṃ ñaṃ jhaṃ jaṃ chaṃ caṃ ṅaṃ ghaṃ gaṃ khaṃ kaṃ aṃḥ aṃ auṃ oṃ eiṃ eṃ lṝṃ lṛṃ ṝṃ ṛṃ ūṃ uṃ īṃ iṃ āṃ aṃ phahavaśarīṃ hūṃ bhaṃ hauṃ phreṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vyāpakaṃ || (fol. 40v2–7) Colophon iti kulākulamahāmaṅgalabhairavamahāmaṅgalabhairavīdivyamahāpīṭhanyāsaḥ || (fol. 40v7)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha paṃcamanyāsaḥ || hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ hrūṃ chrīṃ strīṃ khphreṃ aṃ āṃ anantaśatakoṭimahābhūtegaṇaparivāritāsitaṃgabhairavakulapūjitavanditabhāvitasaṃstutāṃgabhairavabrahmavatīguhyakālikāśrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi || śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ hūṃ hauṃ phreṃ haṃ kṣaṃ || asitaṃgamahābhairavabrahmavatīparabrahmanirvvāṇaguhyakālībhyāṃ hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā khphreṃ strīṃ chrīṃ hūṃ klīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ || dakṣapādāṃguṣṭhe || (fol. 46v1–6) End śrūguhyakālikābhyāṃ śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi kṣaṃ laṃ haṃ saṃ ṣaṃ śaṃ vaṃ laṃ raṃ yaṃ maṃ bhaṃ vaṃ phaṃ paṃ naṃ dhaṃ daṃ thaṃ taṃ ṇaṃ ḍhaṃ ḍaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭaṃ ñaṃ jhaṃ jaṃ chaṃ caṃ ṅaṃ ghaṃ gaṃ khaṃ kaṃ aḥṃ aṃṃ auṃ eiṃ eṃ lṝṃ lṛṃ ṝṃ ṛṃ ūṃ uṃ īṃ iṃ āṃ aṃ khphreṃ strīṃ chrīṃ hūṃ klīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ || vyāpakaṃ || (fol. 56v1–3) Colophon iti sāmarasyakulayoginīmahādevatānyāsaḥ pañcamaḥ || || śubham astu || (fol. 56v3–4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo ....kāyai || śrīsadāśiva uvāca || oṃ namas tribhuvaneśāya brahmaṇe viśvarūpiṇe || īśvarāya pareśāya gurave śivarūpiṇe || yasya prasādād devopi sarvvajñaḥ saśivo bhavet || tāṃ naumi pareśānīṃ sarvavyāpimaheśvarī || brahmāṇḍakoṭilakṣāṇi bhasmasāt kurute (!) yayā || tāṃ kālagrāsaniratāṃ guhyakālīṃ namāmy ahaṃ || (exp. 3t1–5) End guhyakālīṃ maṃgalāṃ ca siddhikālījapeśvarīṃ carcikāṃ tripureśi ca kālī ca bhuvaneśvarīṃ || śrīmaṃgalāṃ mahākālīṃ nirvāṇapadadāyinīṃ mokṣadāṃ rājyadāṃ nityāṃ daśavaktrāṃ parāṃ bhajet (exp. 28t1–4) Colophon iti śrīhāhārāvataṃtre ṣaṭtriṃśati sāhasre mahāʼ tharvasaṃhitāyāṃ śivapārvatīsāmarasya śrīguhyakālidevyāḥ sahasranāmaśrutirahasyaṃ sampūrṇam (exp. 28t5–28b2)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīguhyakālyai || śrīsadāśiva uvāca || oṃ namas tribhuvaneśāya brahmaṇe viśvarūpiṇe || īśvarāya pareśāya gurave śivarūpiṇe || 1 || yasyāḥ prasādād devopi sarvvajñaḥ saśivo bhavet || tān naumi pareśānīṃ sarvavyāpimaheśvarī || 2 || brahmāṇḍakoṭila.................. yayā || tāṃ kālagrāsanilatāṃ (!) guhyakālīṃ namāmy ahaṃ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–3) End trailokyarakṣaṇaratā maṃgalāṃ praṇamāmy ahaṃ | guhyakālīṃ maṃgalāñ ca siddhikālījapeśvarīṃ || 199 || carcikāṃ tripureśiñ ca kālīñ ca bhuvaneśvarīṃ || śrīmaṃgalā mahākālī nirvāṇapadadāyinī || 200 || mokṣadāṃ rājyadāṃ nityāṃ navavaktrāṃ parāṃ bhajet (fol. 11v4–6) Colophon iti śrīhāhārāvatantre ṣaṭtriṃśatisāhasre mahāʼ tharvasaṃhitāyāṃ śivapārvatīsāmarasya śrīguhyakālikādevyā (!) sahasranāmaśrutirahasyaṃ sampūrṇam (fol. 11v6–7)

Beginning ///......lā medhā mahāśaṅkarī ca yoginī yogavanditā || kīlīnī kulakalpā ca ............jayā || sāvitrī vedajananī gāyatrī jagatālayā || (exp. 2, l. 1–3) End oṃ asya śrīguhyakālīsahasranāmastraṃ asya śrītripuraghnaṃ maṣinanuṣṭupcchandaḥ ekavaktrādiśatavaktrāntaśrīvījaṃ guhyakālīdevatā hkṣmlvryūṃ vījaṃ hmkṣmarvlyūṃ śaktiḥ hmkṣmlrvyūṃ kīlakaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayasādhanapūrvvakaṃ śrīcandrayogeśvarīprītyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || oṃ tat sat || oṃ hrūṃ karālī cāmuṇḍā caṇḍayogeśvarī śivā durggā kātyāyanī siddhivikarālīmanojavā | ulkāmukhī hanurāvā bhīṣaṇā bhairavāsanā || kapālinī kālarātrī gaurī kaṃkāladhāriṇī | śīśānavāsinīpremāsanāraktādadhipriyā || yogamātā mahārātriḥ pañcakālāsanasthitā | rudrānī rudrarūpā ca rudhiradvipacariṇī || muṇḍamālādharā caṇḍī calaccaṃca// (exp. 18t6–18b7) Colophon

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīgurave || || agastya uvāca || kārttikeya tvayā proktā guhyeśīdakṣiṇe taṭe || vāgmatyāḥ saritaḥ śrīmān nepālapīṭhasattamaḥ || 1 || sāṃprataṃ śrotum icchāmi tasyā nāmasahasrakaṃ | brūhi deva mahābhāga lokānugrahakāṃkṣayā || 2 || (exp. 2b, 1–4) End yaḥ paṭhet pāṭhayed vāpi śṛṇuyād vāpi yo naraḥ || prātaḥkāle ca madhyāhne sāyaṃkālethe vā punaḥ || 210 || niśīthe vāpi paṭhanāt guhyeśī sa prasīdati || iti guptataraṃ devyāḥ śivavaktrād vinirggataṃ || 211 || yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ kadācana || atyantaśivabhaktāya dāntāya satyavādine || 212 || bhaktiyuktāya dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇāya viśeṣataḥ || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturddaśyāṃ navamyāṃ bhaumavāsare || 213 || etasya paṭha/// rudratulyo bhaven naraḥ || 214 || || (exp. 22t1–7) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāṇe hi/// śrīguhyeśvarīsahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || || (exp. 22t7–22b1)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo maṃgalāyai || śrīsadāśiva uvāca || oṃ namas tribhuvaneśāya brahmaṇe viśvarūpiṇe || īśvarāya pareśāya gurave śivarūpiṇe || 1 || yasyāḥ prasādād devopi sarvvajñaḥ saśivo bhavet || tāṃ naumi pareśānīṃ sarvavyāpiṇīm īśvarīṃ || 2 || brahmāṇḍakoṭilakṣāṇa (!) bhasmasāt kurute yayā || tāṃ kālagrāsaniratāṃ guhyakālīṃ namāmy ahaṃ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End trailokyarakṣaṇaratāṃ maṃgalāṃ praṇamāmy ahaṃ || guhyakālīṃ maṃgalāñ ca siddhikālījayeśvarīṃ || carcikāṃ tripureśiñ ca kālīñ ca bhuvaneśvarīṃ || śrīmaṃgalāṃ mahākālīṃ nirvāṇapadadāyinīṃ || mokṣadāṃ rājyadāṃ nityāṃ navavaktrāṃ parāṃ bhaje || || (fol. 19r5–19v1) Colophon iti śrīhāhārāvamahātantre ṣaṭtriṃśatisāhasre mahātharvasaṃhitāyāṃ śivapārvatisāmarasya (!) śrīguhyakālikādevyāḥ sahasranāmaśrutirahasyaṃ sampūrṇam || śubham astu || || śrīguhyakālīdevyāḥ prītir astu || || śubhaṃ || ❖ || śubhaṃ || ❖ || śubhaṃ || ❖ || (fol. 19v1–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || ullasad danujavṛndakhedinī bhūriduḥkhabhavabhītibhedinī || kaṇṭhalambitakapālamālikā maṃgalaṃ mama karotu kālikā || 1 || śoṇitārdragajacarmmavāsinī mattabhairavamahāṭṭahāsinī || daityabāhukṛtakāś ca śālikā maṃgalaṃ mama karotu kālikā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–2v2) End rājase sakalasargasajjane sātvikī ca jagatām sulakṣaṇe || nāmasiṃhajagatāṃ surolikā maṃgalaṃ || 7 || bhaktinamramuniyakṣadevatā- siddhakinnarasamūhasevitā || śuṃbhadaityamakarandarolikā maṃgalaṃ || 8 || (fol. 4r2–4v3) Colophon iti śrīkālidāsaviracitaṃ kālikāstotraṃ || śubhaṃ (fol. 4v3–5v3)

Beginning kavarttata (!) kurute .... saṃśayaḥ || ........midaṃ viśvaṃ yatkiṃcit paridṛśyate || (fol. 23v, 1) End ..........na pradātavyaṃ mānayosuravandite || gopraṃ dhīśyaṃ mandakebhyaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ va...... || || (fol. 23v, 5–6) Colophon iti śrīmahākālasaṃhitāyā guhyakālīsahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || marāyane (!) || || śubham astu || (fol. 23v, 6–7)

Beginning ///..nā brahmaṇe dadau brahmaṇā ca vaśiṣṭhāya vaśiṣṭho manave dadau || 7 || manunā rājyakāmena sadā tasyaikamānasā || yayādhimekhalīpṛthvī śaśāsa manurekarāṭ || 8 || vinā vrataur vvinā dhyānair vvinā pūjā japais tapaiḥ vīrasādhanahomādivināśighraphalaṃ pradaṃ || 9 || ... oṃ asya śrīguhyakālīdevīmantranāmasahasrasya śrīmadāśeramadhiḥ śrīguhyakālidevatā nhuṃ bījaṃ haṃ śaktiḥ hrīṃ kīlakaṃ brahmavedopariniyāgraḥ (!) || (exp. 2, 1–3, 6–3t1) End varṇṇāsuranihendrīṃ caṇdā.. ścandradhāriṇī | brahmakaṃkālasaṃlagnā viṣṇukaṃkārabhūṣitā || 125 || mahāmantrakārikā ca mahābhīṣaṇakālikā | kundapuṣpapriyamdhāmā/// (exp. 12b, 6–7) Colophon

Beginning yaduktāṃ bhayatāpūrṇā ............................... sahasradevyāstu tad idānīṃ yadapratā || || ................. || atiprītāsi deveśī tayāhaṃ vacasā purā || (fol. 1v, 1–3) End paṭhitavyam manasyante pāṭhanīyāś ca bāndhavāḥ || bhaktebhyaś ca pradātavyaṃ mānayoḥ suravandite || gopanīyaṃ nindakasya satyaṃ satyaṃ vaco mama || (fol. 22r5–22v2) Colophon iti śrīmahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ guhyakālyāsahasranāma samāptaṃ || || śrīguhyakālyai namaḥ || śubha || (fol. 22v2–3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīmahākāla uvāca || acintyāmitākāraśaktisvarūpā prativyaktadhiṣṭhānasatvaikamūrttiḥ nirākāranirdvaṃdvabodhaikagamyā tvam ekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 1 || agotrākṛtitvād anaikāntikatvād alakṣāgamatvād aśeṣākaratvāt || 2 || prapaṃcālasatvād anārambhakatvāt tvam ekā parabrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End mahāghorakālānalajvālajālā- hitātyaktavāsā mahāṭṭāṭṭahāsā || jaṭābhārakālā mahāmuṃḍamālā viśālā tvam īdṛṅ mayādhyāyasemva || 20 || tayo naiva kurvan vapuḥ khedayāmi vrajan nāpi tīrthaṃ padesvañjayāmi || paṭhan nāpi vedaṃ janiṃ pāvayā/// (fol. 3v5–8) Colophon

Beginning śrīmahākāla uvāca || acintyā ʼmitākāraśaktisvarūpā prativyaktyadhiṣṭhānasattaikamūrttiḥ (!) || guṇātītanirdvaṃdvabodhaikagamyā tvam ekā paraṃbrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 1 || agotrāʼ kṛtitvād anaikāntikatvād alakṣāgamatvād aśeṣāʼ karatvāt || 2 || prapaṃcālayatvād anāraṃbhakatvāt tvam ekā paraṃbrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End mahākālarudroditaṃ stotram etat sadā bhaktibhāvena yodhyeti bhaktaḥ || na cāpannarogo na śoko na mṛtyur bhavet siddhirante ca kaivalyalābhaḥ || 25 || iti te kathito divyāḥ sudhādhārāhvayaḥ stavaḥ || etasya satatābhyāsāt siddhiḥ karatale sthitā || 26 || || (fol. 6r5–6v3) Colophon ity ādināthaviracitāyāṃ mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ guhyakālyāḥ sudhādhārāhvayaṃ stotraṃ || śubham astu || (fol. 6v4–5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namas tasyai || || śrīmahākāla uvāca || acintyā ʼmitākāraśaktisvarūpā prativyakti adhiṣṭhānasattyaikamūrttiḥ || nirākāranirdvaṃdvabodhaikagamyā tvam ekā paraṃbrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 1 || agotrā ʼkṛtitvād anaikāṃtikatvād alakṣāgamatvād aśeṣā ʼkaratvāt || 2 || prapaṃcālayatvād anaraṃbhakatvāt (!) tvam ekā paraṃbrahmarūpeṇa siddhā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–6) End mahākālarudroditaṃ stotram etat sadā bhaktibhāvena yodhyeti bhaktaḥ || na cāpannarogo na śoko na mṛtyur bhavet siddhirante ca kaivalyalābhaḥ || 25 || iti te kathito divya (!) sudhādhārāhvayaṃ stavaṃ || etasya satatābhyāsāt siddhiḥ karatale sthitā || 26 || (fol. 5v6–6r4) Colophon ity ādināthaviracitāyāṃ mahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīguhyakālyāḥ sudhādhārāhvayastotraṃ samāptaṃ || iti saṃ t (!) 1857 sāla āṣāḍha va di roja likhitaṃ śrīvajrayoginīsaṃnikaṭakṣetre śramaṃ | (fol. 6v4–5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīguhyakālikāyai || khphre namostute jaganmāte mahāmāyāsvarūpini | yo sānta (!) kāgnikuharā dusthitā tejarūpiṇi || phetkāranirayā devi phetkārarāvarūpiṇi | phetkapajvalanāsastha tataḥ phetkāramātara || (exp. 3t1–2) End brahmāṇḍakoṭilakṣāṇi bhasmasāt kurute yayā | tāṃ kālagrāsarasikāṃ guhyakālīṃ namāmy ahaṃ || naumi kālīṃ karālāsyā pradhānā valibhakṣaṇiṃ | krīḍārthaṃ yā karoc cittrāṃ brahmāṇḍorvvadamālikāṃ (!) || (exp. 4, l. 1–3) Colophon iti guhyakālyā mahāmāstavaṃ (!) samāptaṃ || || iti ........ tantre samāptam iti || athānta saṃpravakṣāmi || jvalitāgnau dagnaśavaṃ śṛgālolūkabhairavaṃ | vetālakākacaitya[dhaligadharāṣṭaśāśāṣṭa]kaṃ || (exp. 4, l. 3–5)

Beginning śrīmahākālikāyai namaḥ || || ullasad danujavṛndakhedinī bhūriduḥkhabhavabhītibhedinī || kaṇṭhalambitakapālamālikā maṃgalaṃ mama karotu kālikā || 1 || śoṇitārdragajacarmmavāsinī mattabhairavamahāṭṭahāsinī || daityabāhukṛtakāś ca śālikā maṅgalaṃ mama karotu kālikā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–2r3) End rājase sakalasargasajjane sātvikī ca jagatāṃ sulakṣaṇe || nāmasiṃhajagadaṃtamālikā maṃgalaṃ mama karotu kālikā || 7 || bhaktinamramuniyakṣadevatā- siddhakinnarasamūhasevitā || śuṃbhadaityamakarandarolikā maṃgalaṃ mama karotu kālikā || 8 || (fol. 3v3–4r4) Colophon iti śrīkālidāsaviracitaṃ kālikāstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || anena stotrapāṭhakarmaṇā kālikā prītāstu śubham || || (fol. 4v1–3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || prātar yasyāt kumārī kumudakalikayā jāpamālājapaṃtī madhyāhne prauḍharūpāvikasitavadanā cārunetrā viśālā || saṃdhyāyāṃ vṛddharūpā galitakucayugāruṃḍamālāṃ vahaṃtī sā devī devadevī tribhuvanajananī caṃḍike pātu yuṣmān || 1 || (fol. 1v1–4) End dṛṣṭvā raudre mukhe ʼsmin tava viśati jagad devi sarvaṃ kṣaṇārdhāt saṃsārasyāttakāle nararudhiravasā saṃplave dhūmadhūmre || kālī tvaṃ pālinī vai suśayanaratā yoginī yogamudrā raktā ṛjvā kumārī śaraṇabhayaharā tvaṃ śivā caṃdraghaṃṭā || 8 || (fol. 2v6–9) Colophon iti taṃtrakaumudyāṃ kālyaṣṭakam || || (fol. 2v9)

Beginning ///muktiṣu || 8 || yoṣitāka karṣaṇe caiva viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || śiro me kālikā pātu krīṃkāraikākṣarāparā || 9 || krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ me lalāṭaṃ ca kālikā khaḍgadhāriṇī || pātu netrayugmaṃ [[hrūṃ hrūṃ]] hrīṃ hrīṃ pātu śruti mama || 10 || (fol. 2r1–4) End pautrāṃ tasthaur yam āsthāya nivasat yeva niścitaṃ || idam kavacam ajñātvā yo japet kāli dakṣiṇāṃ || 36 || śatalakṣam japtvāpi tasya vidyā na siddhyati || śaśastrapātam āsādya acirān mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 32 || || (fol. 4v3–6) Colophon iti śrībhairavitaṃtre śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyā jaganmaṃgalaṃ nāmakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || || rāmāya rāmabhadrāya rāmacaṃdrāya vedhase || raghūnāthāya nāthāya sītāyā pataye (!) namaḥ || goviṃdāya namon namaḥ || || (fol. 4v6–8)

Beginning oṃ namaś caṇḍikāyai || jayantī maṅgalākālī bhadrakālī kapālinī | durgā kṣamā śivā dhātrī svāhā svadhā namostute || 1 || madhukaiṭabhavidrāvi vidhātre varade mama | rūpaṃ dehi jayaṃ dehi jaśo (!) dehi dviṣo jahi || 2 || (fol. 1r1–3) End patnīṃ manoramāṃ devi manovṛttānusāriṇīṃ | tāriṇīṃ dūrggasaṃsārasāgarasya kulodbhavāṃ || 22 || idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhitvā tu mahāstotraṃ paṭhen naraḥ | sā (!) ca saptasatīṃ saṃkhyāṃ varam āpnoti saṃpadaṃ || 23 || (fol. 2v3–3r1) Colophon ity argalāstutiḥ || || || (fol. 3r1)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaś caṇḍikāyai || viśuddhajñānadehāya trivedīdivyacakṣuṣe | śreyaḥprāptinimittāya namaḥ somārddhadhāriṇe || 1 || sarvam etad vinā yas tu mattā śāmayiki--- | sopi kṣamam avāpniti satataṃ jāpyatatparaḥ || 2 || (fol. 3r2–4) End śanais tu japyamānosmiṃ stotraṃ sampattiruccakaiḥ | bhavaty eva samagropi tataḥ prārabhyam eva tat || 13 || eiśvaryaṃ yatprasādena saubhāgyārogyasaṃpadaḥ | śatruhāniḥ paromokṣam bhūyate sa na kiṃ janaiḥ || 14 || (fol. 4v2–5) Colophon iti śrībhagavatyā kīlakastutiḥ samāptā || || (fol. 4v5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīguhyakālikāyai || ataśca devyā śṛṇu ghorarūpāṃ yogañ ca deveṣv api dullabhatvaṃ (!) | nairātmike sūnyapadenyajātā (!) diṣaṭkaviśrāmapade (!) praviṣṭā || 1 || ṣaṭvaktrapadmeṣv avilīnarūpā rūpair vvimuktā bahucitrarūpā | kaivalyamārgeṣv aviśuddhadehe dhyāyanti saṃhārakariñ ca kālīṃ || 2 || (fol. 1r1–3) End kakhagaghaṅapadādyā devi kāmeśvarī tvaṃ cachajajhañapadādyā modinī mohinī tvaṃ | ṭaṭhaḍaḍhaṇapadāntā nirmmalā devatā tvaṃ tathadadhanapadādyā devi dīptārūṇā tvaṃ || 24 || paphababhamapadādyā jelā śīlāṇḍabhā tvaṃ yaralavapadarūpā devi sarvveśvarī tvaṃ | śaṣasahapadavarggā kaulinī kṣānta devī tvam asi varaaādyā (!) karṣaṇī devatā tvaṃ || 25 || iti bhagavati tubhyaṃ guhyakālītrinetrāṃ tribhuvanalayamūrttinnirmmitaṃ stotram etat | paṭhati paramabhaktyā śraddhayā yaḥ śṛṇoti sa bhavati nṛpapālo bhuktimuktiprabhāgī || 26 || || (fol. 2v8–3r3) Colophon iti śrīnirvvāṇakālīkrame śrīguhyakālīstavaṃ || || (fol. 3r3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ oṃ namaḥ śrīsāmarasya śrīguhyakālyai śrīvaḍavānalabhairavyuvāca namo namaste bhagavan mahābhairavayogine nīlakaṃṭhāya nityāya caṃdra - ṣāvataṃsine daṃṣṭrāṃ kuru subhīmāya trinetrāya triśūline aśeṣamantradehāya nirguṇāya parātmane (fol. 1v1–5) End sādhakopi parāṃ kālyaḥ | guhyakalyāṃ stutiṃ sadā || caturvvarggaphalākāṃkṣī | paṭhet kalatraye śive || guhyabhairavasaṃśliṣṭāṃ candraleṣāvataṃsinīṃ || aśeṣaduḥkhanirhaṃtrī | sadhamaṅgaladāyanī || cintayet prātar utthāya | guhyakālīṃ sureśvarīṃ || sarvvaduḥkhopaśāṃtyarthaṃ | hṛdayāṃbujamadhyagāṃ brāhme muhūrtte utthāya guhyakālīṃ prasīda me || || (fol. 8r3–8v1) Colophon iti śrīmahānirvāṇasaṃhitāyāṃ mahānirvāṇa śrīguhyakālīstotraṃ sampūṇam (!) || ❁ || śubham || || (fol. 8v1–2)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namo guhyeśvaryyai || yogina ūcu || oṁ bhava brahmavandyāṃ bhavadbhū(2)tanandāṃ bhaveśādibhiḥ pūjitaṃ bhavyarūpāṃ | svakīyaiḥ pra(3)bhābhillasad bhīmadehāṃ bhaveśīṃ bhavānīṃ subhadrāṃ bhajehaṃ || (4) 1 || mahākālarātrisvarūpākṛśāṅgīṃ svaguhyākhya kṛṣṇā (5) karālā bhavaktrāṃ | prakāsyābhakāmīṃ kumārāpi kāryyāṃ (b1) bhaje bhadrakālī makārādirūpāṃ || 2 || (exp. 1t2-b1) End paṭheṭ bhaktiyuktaḥ śi(exp.3b5)vāgre śivān sā sadā dharmakomān manovāṃchitārthaṃ | prabhutvaṃ ca muktiṃ ja(exp.4t1)yaṃ sarvvasiddhi labhen nātra kāryyaṃ vicārotradhīraḥ || 11 || (exp. 3b5-4t1) Colophon iti(exp. 5t2) śrīskandapurāṇe himavatkhaṃḍe śrīguhyeśvaryyāṣṭakaṃ samāpta ||

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmīdevyai || tvaṃ (!) devīṃ sarvvavyāpīṃ tribhuvananamitāṃ pañcavaktrā (!) trinetrāṃ sarvvaśvetāṅgarūpā sphaṭikamaśinibhā candrakoṭiprakāśāṃ | vāme dakṣasusobhāṃ (!) bhujadaśakayutāṃ || śatrusaṃhārakārīṃ tāṃ devī (!) siddhilakṣmīm abhimataphaladāṃ mokṣasiddhipradātrīṃ || 1 || (fol. 11r1–4) End evaṃ siddhisvavasupatitaṃ (!) prāptaiva vāṃcchan phalaṃ nātīrtha (!) ca samastakṣatragamanaṃ nāsti samo tatphalaṃ | yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate ca kāmasaphala (!) bhuktiś ca muktipradā tat sarvvaṃ phaladāyiṇī (!) vijayate śrīsiddhilakṣmī (!) namaḥ || 9 || (fol. 12v6–8) Colophon iti śrīsiddhiaṣṭasiddhistava samāptaḥ || (fol. 12v8)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīkālikādevyaiḥ (!) || khphre (!) namostute jatmāte (!) māhāmāyāsvarūpiṇi | jāsānta kāgnikuharā dūnthitā tejarūpiṇi || 1 || phetkāranirayā devi phetkāra rāvarūpiṇī | phetkārajvalanāsasthā tataḥ phetkāramātala || 2 || sūkṣmadehe nirārambe parāparapare śive | ekākinī viśvamāte (!) namā (!) nirvvāṇadāyine || 3 || (fol. 13r1–5) End tāṃ kālagrāsaratmikā (!) guhyakāli (!) namāmy ahaṃ || tā (!) kālagrāsarasikāṃ kālakāli (!) namāmy ahaṃ || 30 || naumi kālī (!) karālāsyā (!) yadhā (!) nāvanibhajyani (!) | krīḍārthaṃ yā karārccitāṃ (!) brahmāṇḍārvvūdamālikā || 31 || (fol. 15v5–16r1) Colophon iti māyāstavaṃ guhyakālikāstotraṃ samāptaḥ (!) || || (fol. 16r1)

Beginning ❖ śrībhairavāya || namaste devadevesa mahākāli namostu te | mahāraudreśvarī gamya jñānadehe namostu te || 1 || ājñārūpeśvare gardda (!) ṣoṣaśānte namostu te | icchārūpe svabhāvasthe bhairaveśī namostu te || 2 || jñānagamyamahājñāne jñeyarūpe namostute || kṛpārūpe svabhāvasthe viśvarūpe namostu te || 3 || (fol. 16r2–5) End ahaṃ tyatpadaśaṃśaktā (!) pādapādāṃkitaṃ prabhu | jñānāñjine mahādevi | tvatpādasaraṇaṃ (!) sadā || 21 || kuru me tvaṃ nugrahaṃ (!) pūjye tava bhāvodakrame | tatas te bhāvam āpannaṃ kṣamaśva parameśvarī || 22 || namostu devadevesi madhya devī namostu te || || (fol. 17v7–18r3) Colophon iti śrīguhyakālistotraṃ (!) samāpta (!) || || (fol. 18r3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīguhyakālyai namaḥ || yā vyāpya śaktā nijayā jagat kiṃ viṣṭabhya bhūtāni tathā vilāni | varvvartti sarvvopari citprakāśā sā guhyakālī paripātu viśvaṃ || 1 || sṛṣṭisthitipralayakantu na piñjalena sṛṣṭisthitipralayakartritayā matāyā | vedāgamāviditatattvatanusvarūpā sā naḥ sadā ca bhujaganty api guhyakālī || 2 || (exp. 12b1–5) End yaṃ yaṃ prārthayateva kāmasaphalaṃ bhuktiś ca muktis tadā tatsarvvaṃ phaladāyiṇīṃ (!) vijayate śrīsiddhilakṣmī (!) namaḥ || 9 || (exp. 20t6–20b2) Colophon śrīsiddhiaṣṭasiddhistava samāpta || || (exp. 20b2)

Beginning ///ati guhyamahākārī (!) || daśaktātrirocanī (!) || kṛṣṇavarṇṇā mahātejā a/// bāhutanuddharī (!) || 1 || nānāvarṇṇamukhadevī sūryyā tu vomakaṃsamet (!) vyāghracarmmaparidhānā hāḍābharanabhūṣitā (!) || 2 || (exp. 2, l. 1–3) End citakārikulamadhe (!) jotirūpe (!) nikevale (!) nirvvāṇaṃ paramaṃ padye bhāvātitaṃ (!) bhavaṃti ca || 5 || (exp. 2b6–3t1) Colophon iti guhyeśvaridhyāna (!) || || (exp. 3t1–2)

Beginning phreṃ siddhikalāli (!) hrīṃ cchrīṃ hrūṃ strīṃ phe nama svāhāḥ (!) || || 3 || totra (!) || oṃ namo mahābhairavāya || (exp. 3t2–3) End vijñānasiddhibala caṭkijalaprasiddhā (!) /// ālaṃbakhecalaparāpalamapracaṇḍā (!) /// cakrakrame gaditamantramārthave/// satsaṃgayoginiratākṣalasiddhidātā (!) svābhāvabhāvaka⟨pa⟩⟪ka⟫parāṃ pranamāmi (!) kālī || 5 || (exp. 4b2–4) Colophon iti stutipranaṃmya (!) guhyeśvarīyāḥ (!) || || juro śubhaṃ || (exp. 4b5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīguhyakālyai namaḥ || yā vyāpya śaktyā nijayā jaganti viṣṭavyabhūtāni tathākhilāni || varvvartti sarvopari citprakāśā sā guhyakālī paripātu viśvaṃ || 1 || sṛṣṭisthitipralayakarttur api kṣaṇena sṛṣṭisthitipralayakarttṛtayā matā yā || vedāgamāviditatattvatanusvarūpā sā naḥ sadāvatu jaganty api guhyakālī || 2 || (fol. 1v1–2r1) End paṭhitavyaḥ prayatnena tasmād eṣaḥ stavottamaḥ || stavoyaṃ tripuraghnena lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 32 || prakāśito varārohe tasmāt pāṭhya (!) prayatnataḥ || vidyāṃ prāpnoti vidyārthī dhanārthī dhanam āpnuyāt || 33 || muktikāmas tu labhate muktiṃ nāty atra saṃśayaḥ || āvaśyakam idaṃ stotraṃ guhyakālyārpitāt panāṃ (!) || 34 || etat stotrānvitā pūjā sahasraguṇitā bhavet || 35 || (fol. 9r1–9v2) Colophon iti śrīmad ādināthamahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ śrītripuraghnakṛtaṃ śrīmacchrī śrīguhyakālyāḥ stotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || ❁ || śrī śrī śrī mahāguhyakālīdevī satataṃ prasannostu śubhaṃ (fol. 9v2–5)

Beginning ❖ cchinnamastāyai namaḥ || || kārttikeya ūvāca (!) || kāmarūpamahāsthāne yoginīgaṇasevitā | mātur aṅge samāsīno gaurī pṛcchasi ṣaṇmukhaḥ || khaṇmukha (!) ūvāca (!) || || kathaṃ mātarmmahābhadre bhadrakālī⟪kapāli⟫kapālinī | cchinnamastā tvayā jātā kadā vā kena hetunā || tat sāmpratam idaṃ mataḥ kathayasva mamākhilaṃ || yadi snehosti me mātaḥ sarvvaṃ vaktum ihārhasi || || (fol. 1v1–6) End satyaṃ satyaṃ samantāt prakathitam adhunā nāsti saṃsārabhītiḥ yeṣāṃ stotrasya pāṭhaḥ śravanapathagato (!) durggatis tasya na syāt || || nātaḥ paraṃ stotrabhūtaṃ bhāvitaṃ vac ca naḥ || śiṣyāya śraddadhānāya prakāśyaṃ na samuccaret || anyaprakāśanād deva krūddhā bhavati śāṅkarī || yaśohāniddānahānis sānidhyaṃ (!) tyajati śivā || || (fol. 16v1–5) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale śrī 3 cchinnamastāsahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 16v6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo guhyakālyai || bījaṃ yatkāmasaṃjñaṃ samuditam uditaṃ caikadārādhyadevyā sevyaṃ ced yasyakasyāpi ca bhuvi guruṇā sopadiṣṭaṃ śiśubhyaḥ tāvat saṃśrutya karṇe tvatikati (!) bhavati tritvam ādau vidhātrāj (!) labhyaṃ jāyet sulabhyaṃ kim aparam adhikaṃ siddhayastāḥ śayasthāḥ 1(fol. 1v1–4) End vādī mūkaturaṃkatu (!) kṣitipatir vvahniḥ samutsāmyatu krodhī ca prativāsaraṃ nu sahasā bhraśyatv adho gachatu (!) śatrur naśyatu saṃprataṃ vikalatām āpyaiva guhyeśvari tvatpādāmbujamaṃgalena bhavane sanmaṃgalaṃ varddhatām 16 mātaḥ kṛpātas tavalakṣaśāṃtaṃ prāpsye punaḥ kālavaśena satyaṃ saṃpratyaho durjjanasaṃḍaleṣu sadravyabhavyaṃ na kuto dadāsi (fol. 5v2–6) Colophon iti maithilapaṃḍitaśrīrāghaveśvaraviracitaṃ śrīguhyakālīstavarājaḥ || || (fol. 5v7)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ jānakīdevyāḥ stotraṃ tad uktaṃ siddheśvarataṃtre || || lakṣmaṇa uvāca || devadevajagaṃnātha (!) kathayasva mahāprabho || nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ jānakyāḥ śrotum ichā (!) tattvataḥ || 1 || śrīrāma uvāca || kathayāmi bhavatprītyā śṛṇu lakṣmaṇa bhaktitaḥ || asya śrījānakīdevyāḥ sahasranāmastotramaṃtrasya śrīvāgīśvarīdevatāsarvakāmārthasiddhaye viniyogaḥ || jānakī kamalā vidyā siddhividyāmahātmajā || nirmalā bhāminī bhavyā sarvamaṃgalarūpiṇī || 2 || (fol. 1v1–6) End yaḥ paṭhet prā[[ta]]r utthāya śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ || yaś cāpi śṛṇuyān nityaṃ naro niścalamānasaḥ || 125 || ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ || 126 || tejasvī balavān śūraḥ śokarogavivarjjitaḥ || yaśasvī kīrttīmān (!) dhanyaḥ subhago lokapūjitaḥ || 126 || vidyānāṃ pārago vipraḥ kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet || vaiśyas tu dhanalābhā .. śūdraḥ sukhaṃ samaśnute || 127 || putrārthī labhate putrān dhanārthī vipulaṃ dhanaṃ || ichākāmāṃs (!) tu kāmārthī dharmārthī dharmam akṣayaṃ || 128 || (fol. 8v4–9v1) Colophon iti śrīsiddheśvarataṃtre jānakīsahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || śubham astu || || śrī śāke 1623 ūrjje māsi site pakṣe paṃcamyāṃ bhānuvāsare || likhitaṃ pustakam idaṃ pradyumnasudhiyā (!) dhruvaṃ || bhagnapṛṣṭikaṭigrīvā bhagnadṛṣṭir adhomukha (!) yatnena likhitaṃ graṃthaṃ yatnenaiva ca rakṣaṇaṃ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || ❖ || (fol. 9v1–4)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śivāya || || namaste nirmalaṃ devaṃ namaste jñānarūpiṇam || namaste jyotirūpañ ca niṣkalañ ca namostu te || 1 || ādhāre tiṣṭhate jyotiḥ sūryamaṇḍalabheditam | somacakraṃ tadūrdhvañ ca tadūrdhvañ ca śivārcanam || 2 || (fol. 1v1–2) End valiṃ dadyāt pañcabhūtam ātmapūjāṃ tathā punaḥ || dhyātvātmāpañcapretāni bhuktiṃ deyā hutāśanam || 35 || śṛṇu devi mahājñānaṃ caitanyaṃ sarvaśāśvatam || yasya hṛdi pravartante tasya jñānaṃ viniścayam || 36 || adyāpi śaraṇaṃ devi tvam eva śaraṇaṃ mama || yatkāmaṃ prārthayen nityaṃ dehi dehi maheśvarī || 37 || (fol. 2v4–6) Colophon iti jyotiṣānandastavaḥ samāptam || śubham || || (fol. 2v6)

Beginning ///taḥ || 6 || tadāprabhṛtitanmaṃtrājjagatsthāvarajaṃgamaṃ || sṛjāmi saṃhariṣyāmi rakṣāmi ca divāniśaṃ || 7 || asmāt maṃtraprabhāvena prāptam eiśvaryam uttamaṃ || jvālāmukhī jaganmātā saiva syāt triguṇātmikāḥ (!) || 8 || sattvena sṛjyate viśvaṃ rajasā caiva pālyate || tamasā jīryate yasyā guṇatrayavibhāvataḥ || 9 || (fol. 2r1–4) End paṭhen nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ tu jvālāmukhyāḥ sudurllabham | anaṃtaphaladaṃ gopyaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhet sudhīḥ || 116 || aṇimādivibhūtīnām īśvaro bhavet || arddharātre (!) samutthāya śūnā (!) gehe paṭhed idam || 117 || nāmnāṃ sahasrakaṃ devi trivāraṃsī (!) ca kottamaḥ (!) || karmaṇā manasā vācā jvālāmukhyāḥ suto bhavet || 118 || madhyāhne pratyahaṃ gatvā pretabhūmiṃ vidhānavit || naramāṃsaṃ valiṃ dattvā paṭhen nāmnāṃ shasrakam || 119 || divyadehadharo bhūttvā vicare dhruvam || śanivāre kuje ʼṣṭaṃmyāṃ (!) paṭhen nāmnāṃ sahasrakam || 120 || dattvā kṣīravaliṃ tasya karasthā sarvasiddhayaḥ || vinā naivedyamātreṇa na rakṣyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ || 121 || kujavāre sadā devi dattvā vidhivaliṃ tataḥ || paṭhet sādhaka evāśu labhed darśanam uttamaḥ || 122 || śanivāre sadā vidyāṃ japtvā daddyād valiṃ priye || kapotasya maheśāni paṭhen nāmasahasrakam || 123 || tadgṛhe varddhate lakṣmī gokarṇam iva nityaśaḥ || śatāvartte cared rātrau sādhako darśanaṃ labhet || 124 || vaṃdhyā vā kākavaṃdhyā vā kuṃkumena likhedidam || (fol. 28v14–29r9) Colophon

Beginning ⁅gaṇeśāya namaḥ⁆ || pīṭhe ma .. dalaṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet | vindobhūpari maṃ maṃdūkāya namaḥ | evaṃ kaṃ kālāgnibhadrāya namaḥ | mūṃ mūlaprakṛtyai namaḥ | āṃ ācāraśaktaye namaḥ | aṃ anantāya namaḥ pṛṃ pṛthivyai namaḥ | sudhāsindhave namaḥ || ratnadvīpāya namaḥ || maṇimaṃḍapāya namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–3) End gaccha gaccha paraṃ sthānaṃ svasthānaṃ parameśvarī | yatra brahmādayo devā nāveduḥ paramaṃ padam || mūlena skanti (!) nītvā | manasā saṃpūjya tadā tā (!) tayā sukhī vihared iti nityapūjāvidhiḥ || (fol. 3v17–18) Colophon

Beginning śrī || devyuvāca || tārāpūjāśrutānātha vidyāś ca sakalāstavaṃ || sāṃprataṃ śrotum ikṣāmi kavacaṃ maṃtravigraham || 1 || trailokyaṃ mohanaṃ nāma sarvāpadvinivāraṇaṃ || puraivaṃ sūcitaṃ nātha kripayā me prakāśayaḥ (!) || 2 || bhairava uvāca || devadānavavidyādṛkpūjite prāṇavallabhe || traklokyamohanaṃ nāma kavacaṃ śrūyatāṃ mama || 3 || (fol. 1v1–4) End puṣpaṃjalyāṣṭakaṃ datvā mūlenaivaṃ paṭhet sakṛt || pañcavarṣasahasrāṇāṃ pūjāyā (!) phalam āpnuyāt || 34 || bhūrjye vilikhya guṭikāṃ svarṇesthaṃ dhārayed yadi || puruṣo dakṣiṇe bāhau yoṣitā vāmatat sadā || 35 || sarvasiddhiyuto nityaṃ vicared bhairavo yathā || tadgātram prāpya śastraṇi brahmāstrādini (!) bhairavī || 36 || mālyāni kusumāny evaṃ bhavaṃti sukhadāni ca || tasya gehe sthitā lakṣmīr vāṇī vaktre sthiraṃ dhruvaḥ || 37 || idaṃ kacasam ajñātvā tārā yo bhajate sadā || alpāyunirdhano mūrṣo (!) na bhavetyeva saṃśayaḥ || 38 || (fol. 3v7) Colophon iti bhairavataṃtre tārākalpe trailokyamohanaṃ nāma tārākavacaṃ śubhaṃ || śrīśāke 1806 śrījyotirvidakṛṣṇadattopādhyābhaṭṭarāihastelikhitaṃ (!) (fol. 3v)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || mātaḥ śrītripure devī tvattaḥ sarvvāḥ prakāśitāḥ | kālānta adhunā mātas tvam ekaiva bhavaty api || pūrvve ca unmanī devī dakṣiṇe ca niśeśvarī | paścime kubjikā mātā uttare guhyakālikā || (fol. 5r5–5v1) End samāmanañ ca jahyād viśvajñ uhomi juhomi sarvvaśuṣumnāntavartte | tattvendriyādhīśavṛttir nityaṃ sa eva bhūyāntu vaneśvarosau || 100 || tritālañ caiva tari (!) | di brā lā (!) mūlaṃ samuccaret | śivoham iti mūccāryya (!) pūrṇṇāṃ stutiṃ jahāmy ahaṃ || || (fol. 25v3–6) Colophon iti śrīśaṅkarācāryyaviracitaṃ taruṇiśatakaṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 25v6)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ tārāyai || kailāsaśikhare ramye mahādevaṃ maheśvaraṃ | bhavānī rarhasi (!) prītyā papraccha varadāyakaṃ || śrīdevyuvāca || katham īśāna sārvvajñaṃ labhante siddhim uttamāṃ | sādhakāḥ sarvvadāsena tan me kathaya suprabho || || īśvara uvāca || vinā pūjāṃ vinā dhyānaṃ vinā jāpyaṃ valiṃ vinā | labhante yena kalyāṇi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || (exp. 4t1–4) End na deyaṃ devadeveśi gopyaṃ sarvvāgame sadā || paṭhanīyaṃ sadā devi sarvvāvathāsu sarvvadā || yaḥ stotraṃ kulanāmakaṃ pratidinaṃ bhaktyā paṭhen mānavaḥ sa syād vittacayair dhaneśvarasamo vidyābharair vākpatiḥ || saundaryeṇa ca mūrttimān manasijaḥ kāntyā ca śītadyutiḥ śaktyā śaṅkara eva sauryyavibhavai bhūmipatir nānyathā || || (exp. 12t4–6) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale tāriṇyāḥ sahasranāmnaḥ stotraṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || || (exp. 12t6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || aṣṭakau (!) uvāca || kimartha (!) sādhakā loke maṃtraṃ sādhitum+++ || ++ prantaṃ sādhakā bhūtvā tanme brūhi tapodhana || 1 || vasiṣṭhovāca || na jānanti paraṃ mūḍhā kavacaṃ brahmanirmmitaṃ | mriyante sādhakās tena sadā hūṃkārasaṃyutāḥ || mantreṇa mriyate yogī kavacaṃ rakṣate yataḥ || tasmāttu kavacaṃ nityaṃ mantriṇāṃ trāṇakāraṇaṃ || 3 || tad viddhi praṇipātena paripṛṣṭhena sevayā || upadiṣyaṃti kavacaṃ mantriṇaḥ sarvvadarśinaḥ || 4 || (exp. 2, l. 1–4) End kiṃ pu[na]rmānavā lokāḥ siddhagandharvvacāraṇāḥ | devatvam amaratvaṃ ca gandharvvatvaṃ ca bhairavi || 25 || yakṣavidyākṣaratvaṃ ca tathānyatvaṃ prayacchati | iti te kathitaṃ samyak kavacaṃ brahmanirmmitaṃ || 26 || naitad deyam aśiṣyāya nābhaktāya ca durjjane | śiṣye bhakte mahāśuddhe satyaṃvādini paṇḍite || 27 || kuline subhage mitre priyaṃvade dṛḍhavrate | mahātmani sadā deyaṃ putre ca suparīkṣite || 28 || (exp. 3b5–4t1) Colophon iti brahmasaṃhitāyāṃ tārākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || || (exp. 4t1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || aṣṭakau (!) uvāca || kimartha (!) sādhakā loke maṃtraṃ sādhitum+++ || ++ prantaṃ sādhakā bhūtvā tanme brūhi tapodhana || 1 || vasiṣṭhovāca || na jānanti paraṃ mūḍhā kavacaṃ brahmanirmmitaṃ | mriyante sādhakās tena sadā hūṃkārasaṃyutāḥ || mantreṇa mriyate yogī kavacaṃ rakṣate yataḥ || tasmāttu kavacaṃ nityaṃ mantriṇāṃ trāṇakāraṇaṃ || 3 || tad viddhi praṇipātena paripṛṣṭhena sevayā || upadiṣyaṃti kavacaṃ mantriṇaḥ sarvvadarśinaḥ || 4 || (exp. 2, l. 1–4) End kiṃ pu[na]rmānavā lokāḥ siddhagandharvvacāraṇāḥ | devatvam amaratvaṃ ca gandharvvatvaṃ ca bhairavi || 25 || yakṣavidyākṣaratvaṃ ca tathānyatvaṃ prayacchati | iti te kathitaṃ samyak kavacaṃ brahmanirmmitaṃ || 26 || naitad deyam aśiṣyāya nābhaktāya ca durjjane | śiṣye bhakte mahāśuddhe satyaṃvādini paṇḍite || 27 || kuline subhage mitre priyaṃvade dṛḍhavrate | mahātmani sadā deyaṃ putre ca suparīkṣite || 28 || (exp. 3b5–4t1) Colophon iti brahmasaṃhitāyāṃ tārākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || || (exp. 4t1)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrītripurabhairavyai || mūlādhāre catuṣke kramaśakalapade śaktim ādhārakande trikoṇe tasya madhye sphuritaravinibhā śaktisinduravalye | svādhiṣṭhānāntaliṅge ṣaḍadalavidite śuddhibhede ca .. . ūrṇṇā tantusthitāsau sa jayati tripurā bhairavī maṃgalākṣī || 1 || (fol. 1r1–3) End yā sā raudrī ca sarvvaṃ kulapuruṣanibhaṃ gahvaraṃ mantrabījaṃ siddhaṃ sāṅgaṃ sudiddhaṃ na ca bhavati ca sā bhrāntaṃ bhedair vikalpaiḥ | ebhi vyāptaṃ ca sarvvaṃ sa ca sakalam idaṃ jīvayantī dūpānāṃ (!) sohaṃ haṃsāvilakṣaṃ sajaya || 13 || śaktistotraṃ paṭhen niṃ (!) dṛḍham anusudhiyo bhāvamuktaṃ stutīṃ (!) vā bhaktyā caikatra cittaṃ guruvacana sadā nityam eva smaranti | yakhyām (!) ante sarantī bhavabhayarahitā bhuktimuktipradātām ity evaṃ bhairavākṣīṃ sa jayati tripurā bhairavī maṃgalākṣī || 14 || (fol. 2v5–3v1) Colophon iti śaṅkaraviracitaṃ tripurabhairavīstotraṃ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 3v2)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namas tārāyai || jvalat pāvakajvālajālātibhāsvac citāmadhyasaṃsthāṃ sukharvvāṃ supuṣṭāṃ || śavaṃ vāmapādena kaṇṭhe nipīḍya sthitāṃ dakṣiṇenāṃghriṃ nipīḍya || 1 || bṛhallambamānodarīṃ meghavarṇṇāṃ samuttaṃgapīnastanābogaramyāṃ | javārāgarāgapravyattaṃ trinetrāṃ lalajjihvayā daṣṭrayā bhīṣaṇāsyāṃ || 2 || (fol. 1r1–4) End suraśreṇimauliprabhāṃ raṃjitāṃghriṃ tato śeṣadoṣāpahāmiṣṭadātriṃ | madīyaprasādād idaṃ viśvajātaṃ janaḥ prāptavanmodate sarvvadetiṃ || 11 || sadainaṃ stavaṃ yaḥ paṭhedekacittāṃ yaśas tasya lokebhaved atra nūnaṃ | tadāriḍyapāpair nnavā durmmatiḥ syāl labhetāpi mokṣaṃ tathā dharmmakāmau || 12 || (fol. 2r4–2v2) Colophon iti śrīśaṃkarācāryyaviracitaṃ mugratārāstotraṃ (!) samāptaṃ || || || (fol. 2v1–2)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ kālikāyai || jayajaya kāli, kālarātrikalālī | pari(2)gatadaśakālī, guhyakālī sukālī | calavaladalakālī, paktiva(3)ktaika kālī, vilulitakalakālī, kālakālāntakālī, mṛta śi(4)śūvaradhārī, muṇḍamālāṃbhīhārī || (exp. 14t1-4) End ka kha ga gha ṅa padyā devīkāmeśvarīstvaṃ, ca cha, ja, jha (4) ña padākhyā modinīstvaṃ, ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa padāntā nimalādevatāstvaṃ ta tha da dha (5) na padyādi devadīptārunāstvaṃ, pa pha va bha ma padākhyā kretraśīcāśubhāstvaṃ (6) ya ra la va padarupā devīsarvveśvarīstvaṃ, śa ṣa sa ha padavarṇṇākolinī(exp.17t1) kṣāntadevī, tvamasi parama a ā 16 tyākarṣaṇi devatāstvaṃ || 15 || || (exps. 16b3-17t1) Colophon iti bhagavatibhutyaṃ guhyakālī trinetre, tribhuvanalaya bhūte nimitye stro(3)tametat || paṭhati paramabhaktyā sardapāvaḥ śṛnoti, sa bhavati nṛkapālo bhu(4)ktimukti prabhāgī || || iti śrīguhyakālikāyāḥ stotraṃ samāptaḥ || (exp. 17t2-4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo vagalāmukhyai || calat kanakakuṇḍalollasitacārugaṇḍasthalīṃ lasat kanakacampakadyutimad indubimbānanāṃ | tadā hatavipakṣakāṃ kalitalolajihvāñcalāṃ smarāmi vagalāmukhīṃ vimukhaman manastambhinīṃ || 1 || pīyūṣodadhimadhyacāruvilasad raktotpale maṇḍape ye siṃhāsanamaulipātitaripu pretāsanādhyāsinīṃ | svarṇṇābhāṃ karapīḍitārirasanāṃ bhrāmyadgadāvibhramām itthaṃ dhyāyati yānti tasya sahasā sadyotha sarvvāpadaḥ || 2 || (fol. 1r1–5) End vidyāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarvvasaubhāgyam āyuḥ putraiḥ pautraiḥ sarvvasāmrājyasiddhiṃ | mātaṃbhogauvaśyatārogyasaukhyaṃ prāptaṃ tasmai bhūtalesmin vareṇa || 11 || etat †cchātaṃ japasannohaṃ† gadituṃ parameśvari | duṣṭāya nigrahārthāya taṃ gṛhāṇa namos tu te || 12 || (fol. 2v4–6) Colophon iti śrīrudrajāmale vagalāmukhīstotraṃ samāptaṃ || (fol. 2v6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrītripurabhairavyai || atha tripurabhairavīpūjā || asya mantrasya dakṣiṇāmūrttiṛṣiḥ paṃkticchandas tripurabhairavī devatādyabhīṣṭasiddhau viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1r1–2) End akṣasrakpustakābhīti varadādyakarāṃ kūjāḥ || iti pūjāpradīpe bhairavīpūjā || || brahmāṇiṣṭathurājñayā lājā māheśvarī tathā | vījayā vījakaumārī mudgaṃ ca vaiṣṇavī tathā || ākhaṃ caiva vārāhī īndrāṇī ca nakaṃ tathā || cāmuṇḍā kālamākhaṃ ca mahālakṣmī surā tathā || bhairavo māṃsamityevaṃ tailatu bhairavī tava | (fol. 5v4–6) Colophon

Beginning ❖ namostu te mahāvidye ajite tejamālini | sāṃkhyayogodbhave vīre varade devapūjite || 1 || tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvvabhūtānām avyaktavyaktarūpiṇi | kālarātrīr mahārātri kālakṣayakarī dhruvā || 2 || jvalitolkāmukhājvālā jvalitārccirmmahādyutiḥ | jvālābharaṇadīptāṅgī jvālājvalitalocanā || 3 || (fol. 1r1–3) End śivena brahmaṇe proktaṃ brahmaṇā cā (!) ca viṣṇave viṣṇuḥ provāca somāya somaḥ provāca mṛtyave || 162 || hutāśāya hutāśāc ca samāgamya tataḥ paraṃ | mayāpi kathitaṃ tubhyaṃ niruktaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ || 163 || purāṇaṃ pāvanaṃ divyaṃ devadevena bhāṣitaṃ ||⟪ityā⟫ || (fol. 12r2–4) Colophon ity ādyadevīrahasyapurāṇe tārādevyā (!) stavarāja (!) samāptaḥ || || ❖ || (fol. 12r5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namas tārāyai || purā kailāsaśikhare tārāṃ papraccha śaṅkaraḥ guptabhāvena deviśi ⁅kathayasva⁆ tu sādaraṃ || 1 || kenopāyena sahasā śarīraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ bhavet | kathaṃ vā siddhir atulā tava mantravidāṃ priye || 2 || tārovāca || atiguhyataraṃ hyetat niḥsṛtaṃ vaktrapaṃkajāt | idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ kathayāmi tvayi prabho || 3 || (fol. 1r1–4) End niṣiddhebhyo na dātavyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ kadācana yadi dadyān niṣiddhebhyas tadāhaṃ vadhakāriṇī 25 dadyāc chāntāya śiṣyāya taṃtramaṃtramayāya ca gurubhaktiyutāyaiva tadā siddhir anuttamā 26 rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvvam anantaphaladāyakaṃ || gopitavyaṃ tvayā deva na prakāśyaṃ kadācana ||27 || (fol. 3v1–5) Colophon iti śrīyoginītaṃtroktaṃ śrītārākavacaṃ tāroktaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śiva || || ❖ || || (fol. 3v5)

Beginning ///tvate || || śrīgaṇeśa uvāca || brahmarṣir ggāyatrīcchandas tārādevatā mahātārākavacaṃ || pāṭhe viniyogaḥ || || oṃ durgge devi vedamātaḥ kṛpayā mayi namostu te || 10 || brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ sṛṣṭikartṛvaraprade | pāhi māṃ sarvvato devi sarvvasaubhāgyadāyini || 11 || (fol. 2r1–4) End idaṃ śivamukhāt śrutvā brahmaviṣṇusurādhipāḥ | paṭhitvā kavacaṃ yatnāt sarvvasiddhibhujo bhavet || 34 || śrutvedaṃ devadevasya mukhato nāradādayaḥ | mūrttitrayaṃ vidadhatīṃ saṃpūjya ca subhaktitaḥ || 35 || kavacasyāsya pāṭhena mantras teṣāṃ susiddhidaḥ | devī varapradā śīghram abhavat kāmadāyinī || 38 || (fol. 4v3–5v2) Colophon iti śivavaktravinirggataṃ guptātiguptataraṃ mahātārākavacaṃ samāptaṃ || || ❖ || || ❖ indra (!) pṛcchati cāṇḍālīṃ kiṃ tvayā pacyate †bhṛsī† kākanāsaṃ surāsiktaṃ kapālena citāgninā || devabrāhmaṇavittāni balād api haranti ye | teṣāṃ pādargajo (!) bhītvā carmmaṇā pihitaṃ mayā || (fol. 5v2–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ jagadguruṃ | pārvatī paripapraccha sādhakānugrahecchayā || 1 || kenopāyena tapasā kena vā karmaṇā punaḥ | vināpi sevayā deva labhyate sarvamaṃgalaṃ || 2 || kathayasva mahābhāga yadi sneho mayi prabho || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmaphalapradaṃ || 3 || kavacaṃ tārakādevyāḥ saṃsārataladurllabham || naro yatpāṭhamātreṇa mūrkho bhavati paṃḍitaḥ || 4 || (fol. 1r1–5) End gopanīyaṃ sadā devi prakāśyaṃ na kadācana || anyaprakāśanad devī kruddhā bhavati śāṃkarī || 26 || yasmāt parataraṃ nānyat triṣu lokeṣu vidyate || pāṭhamātreṇa †saghadā niṃdratvam† upajātavān || 27 || tārā devyās tu kavacaṃ yaḥ paṭhen niyataḥ sadā || na tasya durllabhaṃ kiṃcit satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmi te || 28 || (fol. 3r4–3v2) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale haragaurīsaṃvāde śaṃkaraproktaṃ tārādevyāḥ kavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || śubham || || || dorbhyāṃ (!) eṇbhyāṃ (!) ca jānubhyāṃ murasā (!) śirasā dṛśā || manasā vacasā ceti praṇāmoṣṭāṃga īritaḥ || (fol. 3v2–4)

Beginning ❖ śrīkālikāyai namaḥ || || karpūraṃ madhyamāṃtyasvarapararahitaṃ seṃduvāmākṣiyuktaṃ bījaṃ te mātaretat tripuraharavadhun trīḥkṛtaṃ (!) ye japaṃtī (!) || teṣāṃ gadyāni padyāni ca mukhakuharād ullasaṃty eva vācaḥ svacchaṃdaṃ dhvāṃtadhārādhararucirucire sarvvasiddhiṃ gatānāṃ|| 1 || (exp. 16b3–5) End idaṃ stotraṃ mātas tavamanusamudhāraṇajapan svarūpākhyaṃ pādāṃbujayugalapūjāvidhiyutaṃ niśārdhaṃ vā pūjāsamayavidhi vā yas tu paṭhati pratāpas tasyāpi prasarati kavitvāmṛtarasaḥ || 21 || kuraṃgākṣīvṛndaṃ tam anusarati premataralaṃ vaśaṃs (!) tasya kṣoṇīpatir api kuverapratinidhiḥ || ripuḥ kārāgāraṃ kalayati ca tat kelikalayā ciraṃjīvan muktaḥ sa bhavati subhaktaḥ pratijaniḥ || 22 || (exp. 19t4–8) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmalataṃtre umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde dakṣiṇakālitantre dakṣiṇaprastāre karpūrastotraṃ saṃpūrṇṇam || śubham astu || || (exp. 19t8–19b1)

Beginning ❖ jayanti devyā harapādapaṃkajaṃ prasannavāsāsṛtatṛptidāyakam | anantasaṃsāragatipramodakaṃ namāmi kaṣṭāṣṭakayoginīgate || yoginīcakramadhyasthaṃ mātṛmaṇḍalaveṣṭhitaṃ | namāmi śirasā nāthaṃ bhairavaṃ bhairavīpriyam || (exp. 13b7–14t1) End nandantu sādhakāḥ siddhāḥ nandantu kulayoginī (!) | nandantu sādhakācāryyā ye cānyakuladīkṣitaḥ (!) || dehinaḥ sukhinaḥ santu .. svāsthāḥ (!) santu dehinaḥ | prasādāntu (!) sadācāraṃ caraṇaṃ jīvadhā⁅ra⁆ṇaṃ || || adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ gatiḥ | ⁅adya⁆ me saphalaṃ jñānaṃ adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ || (exp. 14t5–14b1) Colophon iti kulasadbhāvatantrokta (!) sāntistava (!) samāptaḥ || śubham astu sarvvadā kalyāna || (exp. 14b1)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ paramātmane || mūḍha jahīhi dhanāgamatṛṣṇāṃ kuru nijabuddhiṃ manasi vitṛṣṇāṃ | yal labhase nijakarmmopāttaṃ vittaṃ tena vinodaya cittaṃ || 1 || artham anarthaṃ bhāvaya nityaṃ nāsti tataḥ sukhaleśaḥ satyaṃ | putrād api dhanabhājāṃ bhītiḥ sarvvatraiṣā vihitā nītiḥ || 2 || yāvad dravyopārjanaśaktas tāvan nijaparivāro raktaḥ | tadanu ca jarayā jarjjaradehe vārttāṃ kopi na pṛcchati gehe || 3 || (exp. 19b1–5) End kurute gaṃgāsāgaragamanaṃ vrataparipālanam athavā dānaṃ | jñānavihīne sarvvamatena muktiṃ na bhavati janmasatena (!) || 12 || dvādaśapa .. ti kābhīraśeṣaḥ śiṣyānāṃ kathitopy upadeśaḥ | eṣā naiva karoti vivekaṃ te pacyante narakam aśeṣaṃ || 13 || (exp. 20t5–20b1) Colophon iti śaṃkarācāryyaviracitaṃ mohamudgaraṃ samāptaṃ || ○ || ❁ || (exp. 20b1)

Beginning ❖ atha pracaṇḍacaṇḍikāstotraṃ || nābhau śuddhasarojamadhyavilasat baṃdhūkapuṣpāruṇaṃ bhāsvad bhāskaramaṇḍalaṃ tadudare yad yonicakraṃ mahat | tanmadhye viparītamaithunarataḥ pradyumnatatkāminī pṛṣṭhasthāṃ taruṇārkkakoṭivilasat tejaḥsvarūpāṃ śivāṃ || 1 || (exp. 20b2–4) End idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ brahmaṇā bhāṣitaṃ purā | sarvvasiddhipradaṃ sākṣāt mahāpātakanāśanaṃ || 8 || yaḥ paṭhet prātar utthāya devyā saṃnihito pi vā | tasya siddhir bhaved devi vāṃchitārthapradāyinī || 9 || dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutaṃ jāyāṃ hayaṃ hastinam eva ca | vasuṃdharāṃ mahāvidyām aṣṭau siddhir bhaved dhruvaṃ || 10 || vaiyāghrājinaraṃjitasujaghane ramye pralambodare kharvvānīrvvacanīyaparvvasubhage (!) muṇḍāvalīmaṇḍite | kartrī kuṇḍaruciṃ vicitracaritāṃ jñānaṃ dadhāne padaṃ mātar bhaktajanānukalpinimahāmāyestu (!) tubhyaṃ namaḥ || || (exp. 21t8–21b5) Colophon iti pracaṇḍacaṇḍikāstotraṃ samāptaṃ || || || (exp. 21b5)

Beginning ❖ śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || hrīṃ hrīṃ hṛdyaikabīje śaśirucikamale kalpavityaṣṭaśobhe bhavye bhavyānukūle kumativanadave viśvavaṃdyāṃghripadme | padme padmopaviṣṭe praṇatajanamano modasasyādayitri protyūṣṭājñānakūṭe harinijadayite devi saṃsārasāre || 1 || (exp. 21b5–8) End pakṣe pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ guruvārasamanvi⟪tā⟫taṃ | tasyāṃ bhaktyā paṭhed yas tu sarvvaśāstravisāradaḥ (!) || 8 || pakṣe dvaye pi yo bhaktyā trayodaśyaikaviṃśatiṃ | śuklāmbaradharaṃ devīṃ śuklābharaṇabhūṣitāṃ || 9 || vāṃcchitaṃ phalam āpnoti sa loke nātra saṃśayaḥ || (exp. 22b4–6) Colophon iti sarasvatīstotraṃ samāpta (!) || || (exp. 22b6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya || visphūrttrimūrttimukhamaṃmṛtabhādyabiṃbaṃ (!) ṣaṭanetravedacaraṇaṃ (!) haranaṃ (!) dirūḍhaṃ (!) | sindūrabhasmaracitaṃ yugāṅgarūpaṃ prātaḥ smarāmi śivaśaktimukhāraviṃdaṃ || 1 || bhrūcāpacaṃcalaiṣaṭ (!) śarakāmaśubhraṃ gaṇḍasthalaṃ lalitamauktikayuktahāraṃ | śubhraṃ jaṭāśiraśikeśavirājamānaṃ prātaḥ smarāmi || 2 || (exp. 23t1–4) End vedādiśāstramaṇimantramagamyagamyaṃ cidbrahmavyāpakajagatañcajananījayaṃ (!) ca | bhaktir bhaje ca bhayabhaṃjanatadvadiṣṭaṃ prātaḥ smarāmi || 10 || nityaṃ paṭhet stavam idaṃ varayugārūpaṃ (!) trailokya (!) yasyatitaraṃti (!) varaṃ bhavanti | siddhir bhavati bhagavān dhruvaṃ ca dvisthaṃ prātaḥ smarāmi || 11 || (exp. 23b8–24t3) Colophon iti śrīśaṅkarācāryyaviracitaṃ śivaśaktistotraṃ saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || śubham astu || (exp. 24t3–4)

Beginning ❖ śrīsiddhigaṇeśāya namaḥ || || yogina ūcu (!) || viṣṇau ʼcyuta (!) hare śaure rudrasthāṇau bhaveśvara | durgge gauri śive kāli namostu te hi pāhi māṃ || sarvvair naḥ prahaśāpendra (!) pāpamṛtyuhareśvara | mṛtyubhavahare devi namostu te namo namaḥ || namaḥ sthityudbhaveśāya namaḥ saṃhārahāriṇe | sṛṣṭisthitivināśinyai icchāśaktyai namostu te || (exp. 24t5–8) End śaṃkhacakragadāpadmaiḥ śūlādibhis tadāyudhaiḥ | khaḍgacarmmāṅkuśaiś cānyair vviṣame pātu māṃ śive || yo brūyād bhaktitaḥ stotraṃ purataḥ satataṃ budhaḥ | harer ddevyāḥ sadā śaṃbho sarvvapāpair vvivarjjitaḥ || rakṣati devatā taṃ vai vipattau viṣame ʼśubhe | grahabhūtapiśācārtte ante brahmapadaṃ vrajet || (exp. 24b5–8) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāne (!) himavatkhande (!) hariharadevīnāṃ stotraṃ samāptaḥ (!) || (exp. 24b8–9)

Beginning ❖ śrīguhyeśvarīdevyai namo namaḥ || yogina ūcu (!) || || oṃ bhavabrahmavandyāṃ bhavodbhūtanandāṃ bhaveśādibhiḥ pūjitāṃ bhavyarūpāṃ | svakīyaiḥ prabhābhir llasadbhīmadehāṃ bhaveśīṃ bhavānīṃ subhadrāṃ bhajehaṃ || 1 || (exp. 25t1–3) End paṭhed bhaktiyuktaḥ śivāgre śivātmā sadā dharmmakāmān mano vāṃchitārthaṃ | prabhutvaṃ ca muktiṃ jayaṃ sarvvasiddhiṃ labhen nātra kāryyā vicāro ʼtra dhīraḥ || 11 || || (exp. 25b7–26t1) Colophon iti śrīskandapurāne (!) himavatkhaṇḍe guhyeśvarī stotraṃ samāptaḥ || || (exp. 26t1–3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīvāgvatyai || || piśāca uvāca || || nābhikuṇḍasamudbhūte rudrakaṇṭhād viniḥsṛte | vāgvatīti śrutā devi jalamūrtyai namostu te || 1 || rudracūḍāmaṇer bhūte yogeśvari prapāvani | maṇimatīti vikhyātā jalamūrtyai namostu te || 2 || (exp. 26t2–4) End madyapānapare dravyāgamyāgamanakilviṣaiḥ| mukhadoṣodbhavaiḥ pāpair grathate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 16 || nanūttaraprayāgena samaṃ tīrthaṃ na vidyate | triṣu lokeṣu siddhārthaṃ viśeṣeṇa kalau mataṃ || 17 || (exp. 28t1–3) Colophon iti śrīskanḍapurāṇe (!) himavatkhande (!) nepālamahātmye (!) vāgvatīstava (!) samāptaḥ || (exp. 28t3­–4)
