Beginning -hāṃt mayā khyātaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit | bhūgṛhaṃ guṇa⟪re⟫rekhā ca vedadvāraṃ ca śobhitaṃ || trivartta ṣoḍaśadalaṃ tathāṣṭadalakarṇṇikā || śakrakoṇaṃ digdhruvañ ca vasūtrikoṇavaindavaṃ || evam etat mahācakraṃ mahāśrītripurāmayaṃ || śive sindūrasaṃdohaḥ svāṅgasundarabhāsurāṃ | karuṇāpūrṇṇakallolaḥ kaṭākṣaṃ kulanāyikāṃ || yā vidyā paramā śaktiḥ jagaccaitanyakāriṇī || tān namāmi mahādevīṃ pañcamīm ātmarūpiṇī || yasyā sarvvasamutpannam yasyām adyāpi tiṣṭhati | layam eṣyati tām eva paṃcamīṃ praṇamāmy ahaṃ || (exp. 2,1–5) End chatrṃ mūrddhni sahasrapatrakamalaṃ rakṣāmṛtaṃ varṣaṇaḥ divyastrīparicaryyamānam akhilaṃ ātmānam (!) evaṃ sadā || dhyāyet mānasapaṃkaje bhavatīṃ (!) raktāṃ mū (!) pūrvāsane svāhaṃ yastu samastam āṇḍa (!) labhate rājyāspadaṃ bhūtale || ākāśe svaprakāśe sakalaguṇamayīṃ sundarīṃ raktanetrāṃ nityaṃ padmāsanasthā (!) taruṇaravinibhāṃ raktacandraprabhābhāṃ || dhyātvaivaṃ sarvvabhāvaiḥ sakalaguṇayutāṃ sarvvādā (!) yo hi paśat (!) || sā savo (!) vāmadena salahaḥ (!) khecaro jāyate sa (!) || idaṃ stripurasadaryyāḥ (!) stavarājaṃ maṇohara (!) rikṣamantra ca śubhadaṃ śivena parikīrttitaṃ || (exp. 11, 2–6) Colophon iti śrīrudrajā[[ma]]le śrīśivabhāṣitaṃ daśamaḥ sahitāyāṃ (!) śrītripurasundaryyā krame pañcamīstavarājañ samāpta || śubham astu sarvvadā || 112 || ❖ oṃ namaḥ paradeva || (exp. 11, 6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || ānandam ānandakaraprasannaṃ jñānasvarūpaṃ nijabhāvayuktaṃ || yogīṃdramīdyaṃ bhavarogavaidyaṃ śrīmadguruṃ nityam ahaṃ namāmi || 1 || guruṃ gaṇapatiṃ durggāṃ baṭukaṃ śivam acyutaṃ || brahmāṇaṃ girijāṃ lakṣmīṃ vāṇīṃ vedavibhūtaye || 2 || śrīnāthādigurutraye gaṇapatiṃ pīṭhatrayaṃ bhairavaṃ siddhibhyo baṭukatrayaṃ padayugaṃ dyutikramaṃ maṃḍalaṃ || 3 || hetave jagatām eva saṃsārārṇavasetave || prabhave sarvavidyānāṃ śaṃbhave gurave namaḥ || 4 || (exp. 2t1–6) End atyantaṃ rogayukto yaḥ yadi devīṃ prapūjayet || samyag vā ślokam ekaṃ vā sadyo rogāt pramucyate || 149 || mohanaṃ staṃbhanā karmmaṃ maraṇoccāṭanaṃ tatyā || kalpanād eva jāyante sarvvasiddhis tadā bhavet || 150 || idaṃ tripurasundaryyā stavarājaṃ manoharaṃ || rakṣāmaṃtraṃ ca subhadaṃ (!) śivena parikīrttitaṃ || 151 || chatrṃ mūrddhni sahasrapatrakamalaṃ rakṣāmṛtaṃ varṣaṇaṃ divyastrīparicaryyamānam aniśaṃ caimānam (!) ekaṃ sadā || dhyāyen mānasapaṃkaje bhagavatīṃ raktā ca pūrvāsane sāhaṃ yastu samastam astu labhate rājya sphuṭaṃ bhūtale || 152 || ākāśe svaprakāśesu kalaguṇamayīṃ sundarīṃ raktanetrāṃ nityaṃ padmāsanasthāṃ taruṇaravinibhāṃ raktacaṃdraprabhāṃ tāṃ || ātmānaṃ sarvvabhāvaiḥ sakalaguṇayutāṃ sarvvadā yo hi paśye (!) sākṣād devaḥ śivo vā madanadahanakṛt khecaro jāyate saḥ || 153 || || || (exp. 6b3–10) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale mahāstotre pañcamīstavarāja (!) samāptam iti || || yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ likhitaṃ mayā || yadi śuddham aśuddham vā mama doṣo na dīyate || śubham astu || || śrir astu || || (exp. 6b11–12)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyai || śrīdevy uvāca | deva deva jagannāthaḥ bhaktānugrahakāraṇaḥ || mahāpa(2)dbhusamāpnoti paritrātuṃ kathan naraḥ || 1 || śrī īśvarovāca || śṛṇu devī pravakṣāmi guhyā[d]guhyataraṃ paraṃ || ā(3)paduddhāraṇaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ || śatam aṣṭottaraṃ caiva japtvā dhyātvā ca kālikāṃ | īndrajit(!) bandhanān mu(4)ktaḥ purā devī sacīpatiḥ || 3 || (exp 2, ll. 1–4) End guruvaktrā samāsādya lakṣa yaḥ prapaṭhed bhuviḥ (!) || parituṣṭā tadā (3) kāli tasya pratyakṣatāṃ vrajet || 16 || asvamedhasahaśrasya (!) phalaṃ bhavati mānavaḥ || gosahasraphalaṃ (4) dānaṃ pāṭhakānāṃ maheśvarī || 17 || (exp 3b2–4) Colophon iti śrīdakṣiṇakālikā ulkāharaṇa āpaduddhāraka(5)vacaṃ samāptaṃ || 2 || śubham || (exp 3b4–5)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīvagalāmukhkīdevyai || śrīdevyauvāca (!) || deva deva mahādeva bhaktānugrahakārakaṃ || suraiva(7)śudinaṃ nātha bhagatāṃ (!) jagad īśvara || 1 || śrīmacchrījagataḥ mukhyāḥ stavarājam iti prabho || sāṃprataṃ (1) śrotum icchāmi kṛpayā vada me vibho || 2 || (exps. 3b6–4t1) End paṭhanād devasarvebhyo bhayebhyo mucyate nnaraḥ (!) || stavarājam idaṃ bhadre na deyaṃ (7) yatrakurracit || 24 || śiṣyāya gurubhaktāya devībhaktiratāya ca || dadyān na ced varārohe devī krū(1)ddhā bhaved dhruvaṃ || 26 || yatasya (!) pāṭhamātreṇa sarvvasiddhyanti (!) bhūtale || khadkarmmasiddhidaṃ (!) stotraṃ nātra (2) kāryyā vicāraṇā || 27 || (exp. 6t6–6b2) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale devīśvarasaṃmvāde (!) śrīmanvagalāmukhīdevyā(3)ṣṭottaraśatanāmastavarājaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || śubham || || || (exp. 6b2–3)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīdakṣiṇakālikādevyai || || bhairava uvāca || mahākāli pravakṣāmi devyām aṣṭottaraṃ śubham || yadguhyaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvvakaṣṭavināśanaṃ || 1 || mahatī cetanā māyā mahādevī maheśvarī || mahābuddhir mahācaṇḍī mahākāli mahākali || 2 || (exps. 6b3–6) End nākāle maranaṃ (!) tasya kadācit saṃbhaviṣyati (!) || yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāma (!) taṃ taṃ prāpnoti nityaśaḥ || 24 || bahunā kim ihoktena sarvvasiddhipradaṃnnṛṇāṃ || 125 || (exp. 8, ll. 1–2) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale bhairavabhairavīsamvāde śrīmanda[kṣi]ṇakālikā aṣṭottaraśatanāmastotra samāptaṃ || śubham || || ||śubham || (exp. 8, ll. 2–3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || namāmi sadguruṃ śātaṃ (!) pratyakṣaṃ śivarūpinaṃ | śirasā yogapīṭhasthaṃ muktikāmārthasiddhaye || 1 || yā nityā pramā śaktir ⟪śakti⟫ paraccaitanyarūpiṇī | tān namāmi mahādevīṃ pañcamī ātmarūpiṇīṃ yasyāṃ sarvvasamutpannaṃ yasyām adyāpi tiṣṭhati | layam eṣyati tām eva pañcamīṃ pranamāmy ahaṃ || 2 || (exp. 2,1–4) End atiduḥkhālaye gore bhīme nigarabandhane | tatra yas tu pathe bhaktyā dhruvaṃ mucceta (!) bandhanā (!) || 134 || yatra tatra ⟪tra⟫ sthitaṃ cāpi sūcir vvāpy athavā sūci | devyā stotra (!) pathitvā (!) tu dhruvaṃ mūcceta bandhanāt || 135 || atyaṃtarogayukto vā yadi devī (!) prapūjayat (!) | samyarkka (!) prokam ekaṃ vā satyarogāt pramucyate || 136 || mohanastambhanākarṣa māraṇoccāṭanaṃ tathā | kalpanād evajāyaṃte sarvvasiddhim upālabhet || 137 || idaṃ tripurasuṃdaryā stavarājaṃ ⟪su⟫ manoharaṃ | rakṣāmantraṃ ca śubhadaṃ śivena parikīrttitaṃ || 138 || (exp. 18b1–19,2) Colophon iti śrī rudrajāmale śivabhaktavinirggate daśamasaṃhitāyāṃ pañcamīstavarāja samāpta || || samvat 818 kāka vadi 12 śrīśrī jayabhūpatīndramalladeva sanadaya kā || śrī śrī jaya raṇajinmaṇḍalaṃ || (exp. 19,2–4)

Beginning ❖ namo yute kūkārākhyaṃ dvātriṃśākṣaramārikāśigavati tvaṃ vikā devī trikonākārasaṃsthitā | ▒ mantrātmike nityaṃ maṇḍalākāla ca /// kubjikā yiti vikhyātā kuṭilāt kālayasthitā || hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ mantravyāptaṃ sarvvacalācalaṃ | (exp. 4t1–4b2) End ekāṃ naikatribhedena sāmtravad yavasaṃsthitaṃ | tvam eva sarvvaṃ satvānāṃ tvam eva duritāpahā || mantrāḥ dvātriṃśākṣarayutaṃ bhuktimuktiya paṭhataṃ | pāthaṃ kaṃcūkamūcataṃ tvam eva jñanavṛddhayet || (exp. 6b2–7t2) Colophon iti śrīpaścimabālakubjikāstutimūlayuti samāptaḥ || (exp. 7t3)

Beginning ///pisyarā/// niyoga/// atimantre vi/// dūriti bhasma ja/// (exp. 2t1–4) End vasubhyo namaḥ ||/// harāya namaḥ || caṃ saṃthāla || saṃ bha /// sarvvāṃge paramātmane namaḥ || hastaprakṣālaḥ || (exp. 3b1–4) Colophon iti vibhūtimantraḥ || (exp. 3b4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ .. .. .. .. .. .. || yetuṃ yaḥ tripureśa haṃtu hariṇā byājaṃ bilaṃ bandhanāt śṛṣṭaṃ vāri bhavā bhuvena bhavikā śeṣeṇa .. staṃ dharā || pārvvatyā mahiṣāsuraḥ pramathayet siddhādibhir muktaye dhyātuḥ paṃcaśareṇa lokavijayī pāyāt sa nāgānanaḥ || namos tu gurave tasmai parabrahmasvarūpiṇī | yasya vākyāmṛtaṃ hanti viṣasaṃsārasṃjñakaṃ || (exp. 3b1–6) End ākāśe svaprakāśe sakalaguṇamayīṃ sundarīṃ raktanetrāṃ nityāṃ padmāsanasthāṃ taruṇaravinibhāṃ raktanetraprabhābhāṃ | ātmānaṃ sarvvabhāvai sakalaguṇayutāṃ sarvvadā yo vipaści (!) devaiḥ kauvā śivo vā madanadahanakṛt khecaro jāyate saḥ || rakṣa yaḥkṣatu dākinītva ca gatā raktaṃ sthitā rākinī lākinyāmikhasaṃsthitāsi tava tā medasthitā kākinī | pūrṇṇāntasthitasākinī parijanā śākinyayo mantrikāḥ śukrayaḥ savijājinīparigatāṃ śrībhairavo jīvitaṃ || 190 || (exp. 29t2–29b3) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale aparabhogaumāmaheśvarasaṃvāde śivavaktravinirgatāyāṃ pañcamīstavarājaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ samāptaṃ || || (exp. 29b3–5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śambhuśaktaye || śrīṃ bījenādavindīdvitīyaśaśikalāḥ kālarūpasvarūpe mātarmme dehi ṛddhi (!) jahi jahi mṛdutāṃ pāhi māṃ dīnanātho | añānadhvāntanāśaṃ kṣamarucirarūciprollasarpādapadme (!) brahmesādyaiḥ (!) sūrendraiḥ suragaṇasahitaiḥ santu tāṃ tvāṃ namāmiḥ (!) || 1 || (exp. 29b6–30t3) End ity evaṃ ṣodaśārṇṇā prathitamanucarasvarggamokṣaikahetuḥ siddhir aṣṭau rabhaṃte ya idaṃ manūvare (!) shreṣṭham etaṃ bhajante || 16 || pūjayitvā vidhidhāne nasahaṃti purasūndarī | idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhitvā tu devīsāyujyam āpnuyāt || 17 || (exp. 35b2–5) Colophon iti rudrayāmale śivavaktrāmbujavinirgatamakarandasārastava samāptaḥ || || (exp. 35b5–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrītripurabhairavyai || mūlādhāre catuṣke kramaṇakalapade śaktimādhārakande. trikoṇe tasya madhye sphuritaravinibhā śaktisiṃdūramaṇyaiḥ || svādhiṣṭhānāntaliṅge ṣaḍadalavidite śuddhibhede ca sūkṣmaiḥ ūrṇṇā tantu sthitāsau sa jayati tripurā bhairavī maṃgalākṣī || 1 || (exp. 42t2–5) End yā sā raudrī ca sarvvaṃ kulapuruṣanibhaṃ śakvaraṃ santabījaṃ | siddhaṃ sāṅka (!) susiddhaṃ na ca bhavati ca sā bhānti bhedair vvikalpaiḥ || ebhir vyāptaṃ ca sarvvaṃ sa ca sakalam idaṃ jīvayantīdūpānāṃ (!) so haṃ haṃso vilakṣaṃ sa jayati tripurā bhairavī maṅgalākṣī || 13 || śaktiṃ stotraṃ paṭhanti dṛḍhamanasudhiyo (!) bhāvamuktaṃ stutīṃ vā bhaktyā caikatracittaṃ guruvacanasadā nityameva smarantīṃ || yasyām ante sarantīṃ bhavabhayarahitā bhuktimuktipradātām (!) ity evaṃ bhairavākṣī sa (!) jayati tripurā bhairavī maṃgalākṣī || 14 || (exp. 45b1–46t2) Colophon iti śaṃkaraviracitaṃ tripurabhairavīstotraṃ samāptaḥ || || (exps. 46t2–3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || śrīdevy uvāca || tripure tripureśī ca sundarī puravāsinī | śrīmālinī ca siddhāmbā mahātripurasundarī || 1 || prakaṭādyā tathā guptā tathā guptatarāparāḥ | saṃpradāyāḥ kulākaulā nirgartātirahasyagāḥ || 2 || parāparasahasyāstās tathā kāmeścarī śubhā | bhagamālinī tathā klinnā bhairuṇḍā vahnivāsinī || 3 || mahāvidyeśvarī dūtī tvaritākūlasundarī || nītyānīlapatākā (!) ca vijayā sarvvamaṃgalā || 4 || jvālāmālinī citrā ca vāsinīśubhagokulā | pūrṇṇākṣā ca tathā vatsa kāmeśīmodinī tathā || 5 || (exp. 46t3–46b5) End prātaḥ kāle śuci bhūtvā prasīdāmi kulapriye | aṇḍacirdvānirolaṃ cā sahālakṣe kulāntaka || 23 || cakrasaṃketakaṃ vtsa gurusaṃketakastathā || nāmasaṃketakaṃ caiva mantrasaṃketakaṃn (!) tathā || 24 || samayācarasaṃketam ajñātvā yaḥ pravarttate | jayapūjārccanaṃ homo abhicārāya kalpate || 25 || etatstotraṃ paṭhitvā tu saṃgatāmānaye dhruvaṃ || 254 || (exp. 49t1–6) Colophon iti śrītantracūḍāmaṇau nityāḥ stavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || || (exps. 49b1)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyaiḥ || mātaḥ śrītripure devī tvattaḥ sarvvaprakāśite || kālānte adhunā mātas tvamekaiva bhavaty api || 1 || pūrvve ca unmanī devī dakṣiṇe ca niśeśvarī || paścime kubjikā devī uttare guhyakālikā || 2 || vajravairocanī devī adhāmnāyaḥ dhareśvarī | ūrddhaṃ śrībrahmarūpā ca parā śrītrirāṃbikāṃ || 3 || (exp. 46b2–6) End sarvvatra sarvvadā mātas tvadbhaktiṃ yācadahaṃ (!) || 13 || tvatpādacaśāmbhoje jivendriyanimajjatu | gurau bhaktiḥ parā śaktiḥ parā śaktiḥ kṛpādṛṣṭiḥ sadā mayi | kūlāgame sadā śaktau janmāntare śive || 14 || (exp. 51t1–4) Colophon iti śrījagadānandaviracitaṃ śrītripurasundaryyāstavaḥ samāpta || || māyākuṇḍālinīkriyāmadhūmatī kalī kalāmālinī māta gī (!) vijayā jayā bhagavavi (!) devī śivā sāmbhavī | śaktiḥ śaṅkaravallabhā triṇayanī vāgvādinī bhairavī hrīṃkārī tripurā parā parakalī mātā kumārīty asiḥ || || śrī 3 paradevatāpritiprabhu || śubha || (exp. 51t4–51b2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrītripurasundarīcaraṇakamalebhyo namaḥ || || kāṃtāḥ kacattavayapuṣpasugaṃdhigaṃdhar (!) nnubrabhramar (!) bhramarakarburakaṃdarāryā || gaṃdharvayakṣasurasiddhakirīṭakoṭi saṃghaṭṭaduṣṭacaraṇāya namaḥ śivāya || 1 || namāmi sadguruṃ śāṃtaṃ pratyakṣaṃ śivarūpiṇaṃ || śirasā yogapīṭhasthaṃ muktikāmārthasiddhaye || 2 || śire siṃdūrasaṃdohajagaccaitanyakāriṇī | tāṃ namāmi mahādevīpaṃcamīm ātmarūpiṇīṃ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–3) End gaṃdharvarūpavān bhūtvā saṃpūjyam amareśvarī || rakṣāmaṃtraṃ paṭhitvā tu durllabhaṃ labhate dhruvaṃ || 141 || ati duḥkālaye ghore bhīmeni ivaṃdhane || tatra yastu phaṭhed bhaktyā dhruvaṃ mucyeta baṃdhanāt || 142 || attyantarogayuktau vā yadi devīṃ prapūjayet || samyag vā ślokam ekaṃ cāsadyo rogātpramucyate || 143 || mohanastaṃbhanākarṣamāraṇoccāṭanaṃ tathā || kalpanād eva jāyaṃte sarvasiddhi pāmuṃ (!) labhet || 144 || idaṃ tripurasuṃdarjyā (!) stavarājamanoharaṃ || rakṣāmaṃtraṃ ca śubhadaṃ śivena parikīrttitaṃ || 145 || chaṃtraṃ mūrddhni sahasrapatrakamalaṃ vaktraṃ sudhāvarṣaṇaṃ divyastrīparipāyyamānamamidaṃ cātmānamevaṃ sadā || dhyānayetmālayaṃ bhaje bhagavatīṃ ratnāmapūrvāsane stotraṃ yastu samastam āsu labhate rājaspadaṃ (!) bhūtale || 146 || (fol. 8r4–10) Colophon iti śrīpaṃcamīstavarājam idaṃ samāptaṃ || || śubhaṃ || || śubhadinapustakalikhitamiti || (fol. 8r10)

Beginning || śrī .. .. sauṃdaryyai namaḥ || || asya śrīpaṃcamīstavarājastotrasya rudrayāmalācāryya ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ śrītripurā devatāṃ namāmi śrīguruṃ iti bījaṃ yā vidyā paramā śaktir iti śaktiḥ | yasyāṃ sarvvaṃ samutpannam iti kīlakam || sarvamānorathasidhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | śailasiṃdurasaṃdohasauṃdaraṃ svāṃgabhāsuraṃ || karuṇāpūrṇakallolakaṭākṣaṃ kulanāyakam || 1 || namāmi śrīguruṃ śāṃtaṃ pratyakṣaśivarūpiṇam || śirasā yogapīṭhasthaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End mohanaṃ staṃbhanākarṣamāraṇoccāṭaṇaṃ tathā || kalpanādeva jāyaṃte sarvasiddhim upālabhet || .. .. .. .. daryā stavarājamanoharam || rakṣāmaṃtraṃ ca śubhadaṃ śivena parikīrttitam || chatraṃ mūrddhni sahasrapatrakamalaṃ raktasudhākarṣaṇaṃ divyaśrīparicāryamānam aniśaṃ cātmānam evaṃ sadā || dhyāyan vaganasaṃkaje bhagavati raktāṃ raktāṃ cupūrvotane stotraṃ yastu samastamāsalabhate rājyāspadaṃ bhūtale ||/ prakāśasakalaśubhamayīsuṃdarīraktanetrāṃ nityaṃ padmāsanasthāṃ taruṇaravinibhāṃ / ṣāṃ || dhyāyet tāṃ sarvabhāvaiḥ sakalaguṇayutaṃ sarvade ye hi paśyet sākṣāt ddevaḥ śivo vā / khecaro jāyate saḥ || (fol. 12v2–7) Colophon śrīrudrayāmale kāṃḍe vadgarūpāṣṭakaṃ paṃcamī stavarājastotra / saṃvat 1656 .. .. caitra va di paṃcami (fol. 12v7–8)

Beginning śrīsahajānaṃdāyai namaḥ || || pārvaty uvāca || oṃ asyāṃ deva mahādeva vidyāyām anudīritaḥ || dvāviṃśaty akṣarī vidyā bahudhā bhedataḥ kathaṃ || 1 || kāṃ vidyā kvanugātre tu rakṣāṃ kuryāvasādhakaḥ | ekākṣarādim ārabhyaṃ tryakṣarī ca ṣaḍakṣarī || 2 || sāṃgā saparivāvārādyā tathā saptadaśākṣarī || aṣṭākṣarī ca triguṇā tathā ca daśamākṣarī || 3 || (fol. 1v1–4, exp. 3t) End prajapet koṭilakṣaṃ tu na siddhyati varānane || maṃtraṃ gurumukhā (tredhā) datvā tasmai tu dakṣiṇāṃ || 20 || tenājñapto japen maṃtraṃ tadā siddhyati vai punaḥ || anyathā stotrarājo yaṃ na siddhyati varānane || 21 || pūjanāt pṭhanādhyānā satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane || 22 || (fol. 12v2–4, exp. 14t) Colophon iti śrīkālīkulārṇavoktamahājaganmaṃgalakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 1 || || (fol. 12v4–5, exp. 14t)

Beginning bhairava uvāca || dakṣiṇakālikāyā bhogadakavacasya śrīmahākālabhairavaṛṣis triṣṭupchaṃdaḥ śrīdakṣiṇādevatā || kālīyāḥ bhogadakavacapāṭhe viniyogaḥ || kapālaṃ pātu cāmuṃḍā keśaṃ rakṣatu kauśikī || śrutiṃ pātu vṛṣārūḍhā netraṃ rakṣatu kālikā || 1 || (fol. 36r5–36v2, exp. 36b–37t) End paṭhe (!) chivagṛhe (!) vāpi kavacaṃ manmukhoditaṃ || 7 || sarvakāryyārthasiddhiḥ syān nātra kāryyā vicāraṇāt (!) || paṭhanīyaṃ prayatnena sarvvakāryam abhīpsubhiḥ || na deyaṃ paraśiṣyāyāsādhakāya durātmane || 9 || (fol. 37r1–3, exp. 37b) Colophon iti kālīkalpe dakṣiṇakālikāyāḥ bhogadaṃ kavacaṃ || 10 || (fol. 37r3–4, exp. 37b)

Beginning vīrabhadra uvāca || kālikākavacasyāsya ṛṣir bhairava ucyate || chaṃdonuṣṭup samākhyātaṃ devī dakṣiṇakālikā || 1 || śakti dvāviṃśa vījāni (!) viniyogas tu rakṣaṇe || 1 || (fol. 37r4–6, exp. 37b) End ajñātvā kavacaṃ yas tu pūjayed aṃvikāṃ naraḥ || yāvajjīvaṃ bhaved rogī svalpaṃ bhavati jīvitaṃ || 15 || bhaktyā dhārayate yastu sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt || 16 || (fol. 38v1–2, exp. 39t) Colophon iti vīrabhadrataṃtre kāḷīkavacaṃ samāptaṃ || 11 || (fol. 38v3, exp. 39t)

Beginning bhairava uvāca || siddhikālī śiraḥ pātu lalāṭaṃ pātu dakṣiṇā || kālī mukhaṃ sadā pātu kapālī pātu cakṣuṣī || 1 || kubjā gaṃḍau sadā pātu daśanau kuru kubjakā || virodhinyadharau pātu cibukaṃ vipracintikā || 2 || śmaśānavāsinī karṇau nāsā pātu digaṃvarā || aṭṭahāsā pātu kaṃṭhaṃ aṃsau pātu sureśvarī || 3 || (fol. 38v3–6, exp. 39t) End kālikākavacaṃ divyaṃ yaḥ paṭhet prayataḥ śuciḥ || bhūtapretapiśācādyā ye pākhaṃḍāś ca rākṣasāḥ 12 || tasya dūrāt palāyaṃte satyaṃ styaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || kṛtvā tu kulamārgeṇa pūjā devyāś ca uttamāṃ || 13 || yaḥ paṭhet kavacaṃ divyaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyate || kulamārgād bahirbhūtaḥ kālikāṃ pūjayet tu yaḥ || 14 || na vidyāphalam āpnoti viparītaphalaṃ labhet || 15 || (fol. 39v2–6, exp. 40t) Colophon iti kulasāre dakṣiṇakālīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 12 || (fol. 39v6–40r1, exp. 40t–b)

Beginning kailāśaśikhare ramye nānācitravicitrite || kālikāṃ pratipapraccha bhairavo lokanāyaka || 1 || bhairava uvāca || kālikāyā mahāvidyā kathitā bhuvi durllabhā || tathāpi hṛdaye śalyam asti devi kṛpāṃ kuru || 2 || kavacaṃ tu mahādevi kathayasvānukaṃpayā || yadā na kathyate mātar vimuṃcāmi tadā tanuṃ || 3 || (fol. 40r1–4, exp. 40b) End hiṃsrebhyaḥ sarvadā pātu sādhakaṃ ca jalādikāt || dakṣiṇā kālikā devī vyāpakatve sadāvatu || 14 || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā yo japet ghoradakṣiṇaṃ || na pūjāphalam āpnoti vighnas tasya pade pade || 15 || kavacenāvṛto nityaṃ yatra yatraiva gacchati || tatra tatrābhayaṃ tasya na kṣobho vidyate kvacit || 16 || (fol. 41r2–5, exp. 41b) Colophon iti śrīkālikākavacaṃ taṃtrāṃtaroktaṃ || || || (fol. 41r5–6, exp. 41b)

Beginning śrīpārvaty uvāca || adhunā devadeveśa kavacaṃ vajrapaṃjaraṃ || kālyā (!) kṛpākaṭākṣormikīrmīritadṛśaṃ bhṛśaṃ || 1 || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tavāgre kavacottamaṃ || yasmi smṛte bhavaty eva śrīkālīṃ tanayo naraḥ || 2 || vināmunā na siddhiḥ syād dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇānanā || tataḥ kavacinā bhāvyaṃ sādhakeṃdreṇa siddhaye || 3 || (fol. 41r6–41v3, exp. 41b–42t) End bhūtapretapiśācapannagavarapratyarthisenāṃ bhaye- raṇyeraṇyatarakṣubhīṣu ca tayā cānyeṣvabhīṣṭaṃ sphuṭaṃ || smṛtvainaṃ manumuttaṃ gatabhayo jāyeta vīrottamo viśvāpaṃcakasādhayed anudinaṃ svāṃte dadhat sādhakaḥ || 9 || (fol. 42v2–4, exp. 43t) Colophon iti kālīkalpe vajrajaṃjaranāmakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 13 || || (fol. 42v4–5, exp. 43t)

Beginning śrīdevy uvāca || devīyaṃ katham īśāna pradur āsīj jagatpateḥ || tan me brūhi mahādeva yadi snehos ti māṃ prati || 1 || īśvara uvāca || kailāśaparvatāsīnaṃ bhagavaṃtajaṃgadguruṃ (!) || papracha (!) sādaraṃ gaurī vinayāvanatas thitā || 2 || kāmārādhya mahādeva bhavatā japamālikā || kiyaṃti devadeveśa yadi snehaḥ pravarttate || 3 || (fol. 42v5–43r2, exp. 43t–b) End nava vāraṃ jitāhāro viṣṇugehe ca bhaktitaḥ || tadā svayaṃ mahākālīṃ paśyati premavāṃchitaḥ || 33 || bhūmiśayyaḥ kuśenaiva paṭhec ca tritayaṃ yadi || tadā rātrau mahākālī varadā dakṣiṇāparā || 34 || haviṣyāśīyatāhāro yadi syād bhaktibhāvataḥ || paṭhec chivagṛhe vāpi kavacaṃ manmukhāchyutaṃ || 35 || tasya sarvārthasiddhiḥ syān nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā || 36 || (fol. 45v3–46r1, exp. 46t–b) Colophon iti śrīkālītaṃtre kālikākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 14 || (fol. 46r1–2, exp. 46b)

Beginning śrī devy uvāca || bhagavan brūhi kavacaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ || trailokyamohanaṃ nāma kṛpayā me jagadguro || 1 || śiva uvāca || śṛṇu devi varārohe kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ || yad dhṛtvā paṭhanād brahmā sṛṣṭikarttā bhaved bibhuḥ || 2 || (fol. 46r1–4, exp. 46b) End kaṃṭhe vā dakṣiṇe vāhau aṣṭasiddhir bhaved dhruvaṃ || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā yo japet kālidakṣiṇāṃ || 33 || śatalakṣaprajapto pi na maṃtaraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ || 34 || (fol. 48v6–49r1, exp. 49t–b) Colophon iti rudrayāmale mahātaṃtre kālikākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 14 || (fol. 49r1–2, exp. 49b)

Beginning oṃ namo gurubhyo gurupādukābhyo namaḥ parebhyaḥ parapādukābhyaḥ ācārasiddheśvarapādukābhyo namostu aṃbāpatipādukābhyaḥ || || śrībhairavy uvāca || kālīpūjā śrutā nātha bhāvāś ca vividhāḥ prabho || idānī (!) śrotum ichāmi (!) kavacaṃ pūrvasūcitaṃ || 1 || (fol. 49r2–4, exp. 49b) End idaṃ kavacaṃ ajñātvā yo japet kālidakṣiṇāṃ || 36 || śatalakṣaprajaptāpi (!) tasya vidyā na siddhyati || sa śastraghātam āsādya so cirān mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 37 || tasmāt sarvaprayatnena etat dharmapuraḥ saraṃ || saṃjaptā siddhidā kālī sādhakāya bhaved dhruvaṃ || 38 || (fol. 52r5–52v2, exp. 52b–53t) Colophon iti śrībhairavatantroktaṃ bhairavībhairavasaṃvāde śrīmaddakṣiṇakālīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 16 || (fol. 52v2–3, exp. 53t)

Beginning śrībhadrakālyai namaḥ || || bhavaduḥkhamahodvighnaṃ saṃtaptān karuṇārṇava || tvāṃ tu yā ceham īśaikaṃ trātum arhasi vāgjalaiḥ || 1 || kathitaṃ kālikādevyāḥ kāmadaṃ kavacaṃ mahat || rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ brūhi kasmaicin na yad īritaṃ || 2 || prayogasaṃghair bhavatā sādhako vimukhīkṛtaḥ || sādhanāt tad idānīṃ me pratyakṣīkaraṇaṃ vadā (!) || (fol. 52v3–6, exp. 53t) End rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ maṃtro rahasyaṃ kavacastutiḥ || rahasyakavacaṃ dhyānaṃ devyā vetti sasiddhibhāk || 66 || rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ vidyā rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ dhanaṃ || rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ jñānaṃ rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ kulaṃ || 67 || rahasyaṃ tiṣṭha kavacaṃ so kutaścid bhayaḥ sudhīḥ || jarāmaraṇanirmuktaḥ śāpānugrahakṛd bhavet || 68 || (fol. 58v1–4, exp. 59t) Colophon iti śrīkālīrahasye kālikākavacaṃ jagadrakṣākaraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 17 || (fol. 58v4–5, exp. 59t)

Beginning śrīdevy uvāca || prāṇabaṃdho dayāsiṃdho guhyaśāstravicārakaḥ || kālikākavacaṃ divyaṃ śatrusaṃhāradāruṇaṃ || 1 || kathayasva samāsena yena me prītir uttamā || || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu vakṣāmi kavacaṃ sarvaśatruvidāraṇaṃ || 2 || sarvaśāṃtikaraṃ sākṣāt mahāpātakanāśanaṃ || sarvavyādhipraśamanaṃ sarvasaṃpatpradāyakaṃ || 3 || (fol. 58v5–59r2, exp. 59t–b) End likhitvā dhārayed yas tu gurūṇāṃ ca maheśvari || dhyānadhāreṇa yogena dhārayed yas tu bhaktitaḥ || 52 || acirat tasya siddhiḥ syān nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || vādī mūkati yoṣitas tavayati yakṣmā varo dāsyati || 53 || garvaṃ kharvati sarvaviśva jaḍati vaiśvānaraḥ śītati || ācāryyāṣṭakasiddhirāpaparamaṃ siddhāṣṭakaṃ tad bhaje || 54 || tāṃ vahne bhavatītibhaṃjanakarīṃ kālīṃ girīśapriyaṃ || 55 || (fol. 63v1–5, exp. 64t) Colophon iti viśvasārataṃtre dakṣiṇakālikākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 18 || (fol. 63v5–6, exp. 64t)

Beginning devy uvāca || deva deva mahādeva saṃsārapratikāraka || sarvavidyeśvarī vidyā kavacaṃ kathaya dhruvaṃ || 1 || śrī śiva uvāca || śṛṇu devi mahāvidyāṃ sarvavidyottamottamāṃ || sarveśvarīṃ mahāvidyāṃ sarvadevaprapūjitāṃ 2 || yasyāḥ kaṭākṣamātreṇa trailokyavijayī haraḥ || babhūva kamalānātho vibhur brahmā prajāpatiḥ || 3 || (fol. 12v5–13r3, exp. 14t–14b) End iha loke mahāduḥkhī pare ca narakaṃ vrajet || guru maṃtrasamaṃ jñātvā yo japet kavacottamaṃ || 61 || tasya vidyā bhavet siddhiḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane || ya idaṃ kavacaṃ divyaṃ prakāśet śivahā bhavet || 62 || bhaktāya jyeṣṭhaputrāya sādhakāya dadāti ca || 63 || (fol. 18r5–18v2, exp. 19b–20t) Colophon iti śrirūdrayāmale haragaurīsaṃvāde trailokyamohanaṃ nāma dakṣiṇakālīkavacaṃ samāptaṃ || 2 || (fol. 18v2–3, exp. 20t)

Beginning śrībhairavy uvāca || kathitā bahudhā maṃtrā yaṃtrarccā ca tathā mayi || kālīkavacam ācakṣva yena kālī prasīdati || 1 || bhairava uvāca || sādhu sādhu mahādevi sādhu pṛṣṭosmy ahaṃ tvayā || kathayāmi prasādena saṃvādaṃ śivarāmayoḥ || 2 || kailāśaśikharāsīnaṃ pārvatyā sahitaṃ haraṃ || praṇamya bhaktyā papracha (!) praṃjalī reṇukāsutaḥ || 3 || (fol. 63v6–64r3, exp. 64t–b) End śrībhairava uvāca || etat te kathitaṃ devi kathitaṃ rudrayāmale || yaḥ paṭhed dhāraye (!) devi kavacaṃ kavacīkṛtaṃ || 54 || tasya pūjāphalaṃ pūrṇaṃ japahomaphalaṃ tathā || jāyate nātra saṃdehaḥ saṃdehe sati niḥphalaṃ || 55 || kim anyad adhikaṃ vakṣye mohanoccāṭanādikaṃ || api siddhyaṃti nidhayaḥ karasthāne ca siddhayaḥ || navagrahāś cāpi krūrā na tasyāniṣṭakāriṇaḥ || 58 || (fol. 68v4–69r1, exp. 69t–b) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde bhagavatyāḥ kālikāyāḥ kāmadaṃ kavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 19 || (fol. 69r1–2, exp. 69b)

Beginning virūpāṅṣa uvāca || namāmi gurum akṣobhyaṃ maṃtraśaktisamanvitaṃ || prasannaṃ jñānaviñānahetuṃ buddhiprakāśakaṃ || 1 || gajendravacanaṃ naumi raktaṃ vighnavidārakaṃ || bhairavaḥ sarvadā pātu ṛṣir me śirasopari mukhe chaṃdā sadā pātu triṣṭup ca vijayātmaka || 2 || (fol. 69r2–5, exp. 69b) End prāṇān rakṣa yaśo rakṣa putradāradhanaṃ sadā || sarvakāle sarvadeśe pāhi dakṣiṇakālike || 49 || yaḥ saṃpūjya paṭhed rakṣāṃ divā vā saṃdhyayos tathā || avāpya mahatīṃ prajñāṃ sarvakāmāṃs tato labhet yad yat prārthayate citte tat tad āpnoti kā kathā || svayaṃ lakṣmīr vased gehe muktiḥ karagatī punaḥ || 51 || (fol. 73r5–73v2, exp. 73b–74t) Colophon iti śrīvirūpākṣaviracitaṃ kālikākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 20 || (fol. 73v2, exp. 74t)

Beginning śrīgurave namaḥ || sumeroś cottare śṛṃge devaṃ devaṃ jagadguruṃ || uvāca parayā bhaktyā devī natvā vṛṣadhvajaṃ || 1 || pārvaty uvāca || deva deva mahādeva sarvaśāstrārthapāraga || kālikākavacaṃ deva sūcitaṃ na prakāśitaṃ | 2 | jānāmi kavacaṃ tasyāḥ kenopāyena he prabho || tasmān me kathayasāsya yady ahaṃ prāṇavallabhā 3 || (fol. 73v2–6, exp. 74t) End gadyapadyamayī vāṇī jāyate vaktragahvarāt || śrīrāma iti vīryyeṇa sūryasyaiva hi tejasā || 74 || krodhe gamasamānaḥ syād dhane dhanapatir yathā || sauṃdarye kāmatulyosau raṇe - - - satsaropamaḥ || 75 || satyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevi satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || etat stotraṃ ca yo vetti sohaṃ sohaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 76 || kālikākavacaṃ medvi (!) kālabhairavanirmitaṃ || 76 || (fol. 80r1–5, exp. 80b) Colophon iti śrīsumerottare śṛṃgasthitakālabhairavanirmitaṃ kālikāmaṃtrakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 23 || (fol. 80r5–6, exp. 80b)

Beginning dakṣiṇakālīkavacasya mahālālabhairava ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ śmaśānakālikādevatā || sarvakāryārthasādhane jape viniyogaḥ || oṃ śmaśānakālikā pātu pūrvasyāṃ diśi māṃ sadā || dvāviṃśat parṇarūpā ca bhaktavaśyā digaṃvarā || 1 || bhadrakālī tathāgneyyāṃ pāyān nityaṃ jaganmayī || rudrakālī mahākālī kaladvaṃdvā svarapriyā || 2 || (fol. 80r6–80v3, exp. 80b–81t) End vadet ślokaṃ sahasrāṇī bhavec chrutidharas tathā || likhitaṃ tasya gehe tu kavacaṃ bhairavoditaṃ || 49 || na tasya durgatiḥ kācit jāyate pāpadūṣaṇaṃ || grahāś ca sarve tuṣyaṃti vaśaṃ gachaṃti bhūmipāḥ || 50 || yadrājye kavacajño sti jāyate tatra netrayaḥ || etat te sarvam ākhyātam abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ śubhaṃ || 51 || || (fol. 84v5–85r2, exp. 85t–b) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmaloktaṃ kālabhairavaviracitaṃ dakṣiṇakālī abhedyakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 24 || (fol. 85r2–3, exp. 85b)

Beginning kailāsaśikharārūḍhaṃ bhairavaṃ caṃdraśeṣaraṃ (!) || vakṣasthalasamāsīnā bhairavī paripṛchati (!) || 1 || bhairavy uvāca || deveśa parameśāna lokānugrahakāraka || kavacaṃ sūcitaṃ pūrvaṃ kim arthaṃ na prakāśitaṃ || 2 || yadi me mahatī prītis tavāsti kulabhairava || kavacaṃ kālikādevyāḥ kathayasvānukaṃpayā || 3 || (fol. 85r3–6, exp. 86b) End niṃdakāya kuśīlāya dāṃbhikāya ca suṃdari || yo dadāti niṣiddhebhyaḥ kavacaṃ manmukhoditaṃ || 79 || tasya naśyaṃti deveśi vidyāyur dhanasaṃcayaḥ || te hiṃsaṃti tadā devi yoginyo mātṛmaṃḍitā || 80 || pare narakam āpnoti koṭijanmaśatāni ca || deyaṃ śiṣyāya śāṃtāya gurubhaktiparāya ca || 81 || sarvalakṣaṇayuktāya tat tan maṃtrayutāya ca || 82 || (fol. 92r1–4, exp. 93b) Colophon ity uttarataṃtre kālīprastāve kālībhairavasaṃvāde dakṣiṇakālikāguṭikākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || 25 || (fol. 92r5–6, exp. 93b)

«Complete transcript:» yajñakālīśikhāṃ pātu hṛdayaṃ pātu sanātanī || pādau pātu dadā bhadrā sarvarakṣā ca mādhavī || 1 || idaṃ tu kavacaṃ divyaṃ yaḥ paṭhen mānavaḥ sadā || sarvatīrthābhiṣekena gayāśrāddhena yatphalaṃ || 2 || tatphalaṃ tasya sakalaṃ yaḥ paṭhed ekatatvataḥ || yeṣām ārādhane śraddhā ye tu sādhanam udyatāḥ || 3 || teṣāṃ kṛtārthaṃ sarvāṅgaṃ gatir ddevī padālayaṃ || 4 || || iti aghorayāmale kālikākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 25 || (fol. 92r6–92v4, exp. 93b–94t)

«Complete transcript:» oṃ namaḥ sarvasiddhiyoginībhyaḥ oṃ namaḥ sarvasiddhimātṛkābhyaḥ oṃ namaḥ uditānaṃtāyai oṃ namaḥ sakalakulacaṃdrikāyaiḥ (!) namo bhagavatyai caṃḍamālinyai namo namaḥ paramahaṃsanirvāṇamārgādiviṣamopallavanāśini sakaladuritāriṣṭa kleśadamani sarvopadravanāśinī mamaśatrun marddaya khādaya khādaya triśūlena bhiṃdhi bhiṃdhi chiṃdhi chiṃdhi khaḍgena tāḍaya tāḍaya chedaya chedaya paramakāriṇi bhairavarūpadhāriṇi tridaśavaranamite sakalamātarm mātaḥ praṇatajanavatsale devi kālike kālikeśini krīṃ hrūṃ hrīṃ phaṭ svāhā || śatadvayaṃ tu varṇānāṃ nāmnā trailokyamohinī || ya yenāṃ dhārayen nityaṃ trailokyavaśam ānayet || 26 || iti kālikāpurāṇe trailokyamohanaṃ nāma maṃtrakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 25 || || (fol. 92v4–93r5, exp. 94t–b)

Beginning sukhasthitaṃ jagannāthaṃ kailāśe girijaikadā || āliṃgy āha kathaṃ vāsaṃ datvārddhāṃge tha vaṃcase || 1 || majjatiṃ kāntikāṃ prāhur brahmādyās tattvadarśinaḥ || jñātāsannāṃ kathaṃ kasmai kena vādya prasīdati || 2 || śrutveti kavacanaṃ devyā vismitotphullalocanaṃ || uvāca prahasan devas tanmano naṃdayann iva || 3 || (fol. 93r6–93v3, exp. 94b–95t) End mohanoccāṭanādīni yāni karmāṇī cechati (!) || tāni siddhyaṃti manasā japan maṃtraṃ stavaṃ sadā || 48 || parameśvarasaudaryāparamārcāparāyaṇaḥ || parameśṭhīpadaṃ prāpya parameśitvam ṛchati (!) || 49 || vipulapulakayukta evam aṃtrī yadi bhavati sadā maharddhisiddhiṃ || sa bhavati naradeva ekavaṃdyaḥ sakalasukham avāpya mokṣam eti || 50 || (fol. 97v4–98r1, exp. 99t–b) Colophon iti kulācāracaṃdrodaye paramasiddhāgame kālīrahasye kālīstavaḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ (!) || 25 || || (fol. 98r1–2, exp. 99b)

Beginning namāmi sadguru (!) śāṃtaṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajaṃ || vāmoruśaktisaṃyuktaṃ jñānabuddhiprakāśakaṃ || 1 || gajavaktra (!) sadā naumi raktābhaṃ vighnanāyakaṃ || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sādhakaḥ siddhim āpnuyāt || 2 || śrībhairava uvāca || hṛtpadme paramāṃ devīṃ kālikāṃ śavasaṃsthitāṃ || taptakāṃcanavarṇābhāṃ padmarāgamaṇiprabhāṃ || 3 || (fol. 98r2–6, exp. 99b) End śavopari samāsīnāṃ raktāṃvarapariṣkṛtāṃ || raktālaṃkārasaṃyuktāṃ guṃjāhāravibhūṣitāṃ || 38 || ṣoḍaśād viṃśayuvatīṃ pinonnatapayodharāṃ || kapālakartṛkāṃ hastāṃ paraṃjyotiḥsvarūpiṇīṃ || 39 || || (fol. 101r4–6, exp. 102b) Colophon iti śrīmātaṃgītaṃtre śrīkālikāstavarājaḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || (fol. 101v1, exp. 103t)

Beginning iṃdīvaradalalalitaṃ sasmitam īśāṃkasaṃrūḍhaṃ || vigalitakuṃtalabaṃdhaṃ kim api mahaḥ kālite kalaye || 1 || śrīmahākālabhairava u ° || stavarājaṃ śṛṇu rāma kālikāyā manoharaṃ || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa kālikā saṃprasīdati || 1 || (fol. 101v1–3, exp. 103t) End tasya dehe sadā kālī vasaty eva na saṃśayaḥ || pūjājapavihīnāya strīsurāniṃdakāya ca || 23 || sanmārgatiraskṛtāya gurubhaktivihīnāya śṛṇu vatsa prayatnena stavam enaṃ na darśayet || 24 || pramādād darśayed vāpi tasya siddhir bhaven na hi 25 || || (fol. 103v1–4, exp. 105t) Colophon iti śrtīmahākālaparaśurāmasaṃvāde kālikākalpe kālikāstavarāja (!) saṃpūrṇaṃ || 27 || (fol. 103v4–5, exp. 105t)

Beginning śrībhairava uvāca || || kā kālī kamalā kālī kāmasiddhā mahodarī || pratyakṣā bhava cāmuṇḍe bhaktyā kavacapāṭhataḥ || 1 || kusuṃbha kusumāśīrṣaṃ pāyāt kamalalocanā || lalāṭaṃ pātu cāmuṇḍā kaṃṭhaṃ rakṣatu kālikā || 2 || (fol. 18v3–5, exp. 20t) End viṣamajvarasṃdāhavedanākalitaṃ sadā || āturaṃ saṃspṛśan japtvā sadyo rogāt pramucyate || 22 || kāśyādi tīrthayātrāṃ tu prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvas tathā || gaṃgāsnānasahasrasya tulyaṃ kavacapāṭhataḥ || 23 || (fol. 20v1–3, exp. 22t) Colophon iti śrīkālīkalpe kālīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 3 || (fol. 20v3, exp. 22t)

Beginning bhairava uvāca || asya śrīmahāghoramaṃtrasya aghora ṛṣiḥ triṣṭup chaṃdaḥ || mahāghoro devatā vaṃ vījaṃ vaṃ vyaṃjanāni svarāś ca śaktayaḥ || aghorasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ oṃ śivaḥ || || atha prāṇāyāmaḥ || oṃ hrīṃ sarvāṃgaśodhanīṃ eiṃ svāhā || saṃ iti astrāya phaṭ || haṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ || saṃ sarvāstrāya phaṭ || (fol. 103v5–104r2, exp. 105t–b) End maṃtroddhāraḥ || ādyaṃ mokṣākṣarī vījaṃ lakṣmīvījam adhas tathā tad adho nāmasaṃyuktaṃ śivaḥ kāmaś ca vāgbhavaṃ sarvāpaṭhaḥ (!) svāhā dhruvād yaḥ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ soyaṃ ghorātmake maṃtraḥ sarvakāmavarapradaḥ || || (fol. 104v4–6, exp. 106t) Colophon iti ghorātmakaṃ yajñakālīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || (fol. 104v6, exp. 106t)

«Complete transcript:» kālīkātyāyanī kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇāṃgī kṛṣṇarūpiṇī || śyāmavarṇā ca kaumārī muktakeśī bhayānakā 1 || raudrī ca bhairavī bālā kālarātrir janeśvarī || bhadrakālī mahākālī triśūlī trikapālinī || 2 || vaṃdī mokṣakarī devī sarvasiddhipradāyinī || dvāviṃśaty api nāmāni kālikāyās tu yaḥ paṭhet || 3 || prāpnoti paramaṃ saukhyaṃ kālikāyāḥ prasādataḥ || 4 || || iti gaurīyāmale kālikāyā (!) stavaḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 28 || (fol. 104v6–105r5, exp. 106t–b)

Beginning atha brahmagāthāstutiḥ || namāmi kṛṣṇarūpiṇīṃ kṛśāṃgayaṣṭirūpiṇīṃ samagratattvasāgarāṃ || apārapāragahvarāṃ || śivāṃpravālakādharāṃ sphurachaśāṃkaśekharāṃ (!) || lalāṭanetrabhāsurāṃ jvalatpradīpasojvalāṃ (!) || maheṃdrakaśyapārcitāṃ sanatkumārasaṃstutāṃ || surāsureṃdravaṃditāṃ yathārthanirmitādbhutāṃ atarkyacāruceṣṭitāṃ vikāradoṣavarjitāṃ || mumukṣubhi (!) viceṣṭitāṃ || viśeṣatattvaśobhitāṃ (fol. 105r5–105v3, exps. 106b–107t) End bhavaṃty amoghavāṃchitāḥ | sadaiva te bhavādhipe || naraḥ paraṃ śivedhunā praśādhi māṃ karomi kiṃ || atīva mohitātmano vṛthā viceṣṭitasya me kuru prasādam ucyate | yathā sṛjāmy ahaṃ jagat || imāṃ stutiṃ mayoditāṃ paṭhaṃti kālisādhakāḥ na te punaḥ sudustare pataṃti mohasāgare || || (fol. 106r5–v2, exps. 107b–108t) Colophon iti brahmagāthāstutiḥ || || (fol. 106v2, exp. 108t)

Beginning krīḍābalena kalitādivacaḥprasūtir oṃkāravedajanadevagaṇān gṛṇīte || brahmākṣaraṃ tava mano prathame tribījaṃ manyeham eva sakalasya nidānam etat || 1 || bāhuṃ stavāṃbayugabhāgyabhujo bhajāmi yatrāgraḥ (!) prabhavati pratipakṣaśāṃtiḥ || yad dhūmralocanabale prathitaṃ mahadbhir vyāsādibhir munibhir arṇayugaṃ manusthaṃ || 2 || (fol. 106v2–6, exps. 108t) End krameṇāyaṃ maṃtraddharaṇajapahomādikalito bhavadbyaktiśraddhāstim iti hṛdayaiḥ sādhakavaraiḥ || stuto vā prakhyāta stavajanani nityaṃ stavavaro bhaveyus te mukhyā pracuradhanināṃ cāpi viduṣāṃ || 10 || (fol. 107v6–108r2, exps.109t–b) Colophon iti śrībhairavayāmale dakṣiṇakālīstavaḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 29 || (fol. 108r2, exps.109b)

Beginning rajasvalāmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpair vyapohati || saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ ca kurute rājasūyādikaṃ phalaṃ || 1 || tasyā sparśanamātreṇa labhen muktiṃ caturvidhāṃ || tasyāḥ saṃgamamātreṇa trailokyotpāṭane kṣamaḥ 2 || śraddhayā pūjayet tasyāḥ bhagaṃ sarajaśobhitaṃ || nyāsaṃ kṛtvā svadeheṣu kalābhiḥ kāmaṣoḍaśaiḥ || 3 || (fol. 108r3–6, exps.109b) End stotrapāṭhaprabhāvena (!) sṛṣṭisthitir bhaved dhruvaṃ || tasmāt sarvaprayatnena devi gopyakaraṃ śubhaṃ || 17 || smaret prathamapuṣpiṇīṃ rudhiraviṃḍanīlāṃvaraṃ gṛhītamadhupātrikāṃ madavighūrṇanetrāṃcalāṃ || 18 || ghanastanabharānatāṃ galitanīvikāṃ śyāmalāṃ karasphuritavallarīviṣaḍaśaṃkhatāṭaṃkinīṃ || 19 || iti dhyātvā || || (fol. 109v1–4, exps.111t) Colophon iti kālīprastāve īśvarapārvatīsaṃvāde puṣpiṇīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 30 || asya śrīkālikāgāyatrīmaṃtrasya kṛṣṇa ṛṣiḥ gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ śivaśaktisvarūpā kālikādevatā sarvapāpakṣayārthe jape viniyogaḥ || kṛṣṇa ṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi gāyatrī chaṃdase namo mukhe || śivaśaktisvarūpāyai kālikādevyai namaḥ hṛdaye || || dhyānaṃ || || śmaśāne tu mahākālīṃ devī (!) dhyāyed digaṃvarāṃ || daṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ muṃḍamālāvibhūṣaṇāṃ || dakṣiṇerddhi dhanur dhatte vāme caiva tathā śarān || adhaḥ pāśaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca tatkramāt parikīrttitaṃ || caturlakṣaṃ japaḥ || raktāktair vilvapatrair daśāṃśena homaḥ || || śubham || gurvarpaṇam astu || (fol. 109v4–110r5, exps.111t–b)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ praṇipatya jagadguruṃ || papracha (!) pārvatīnāthaṃ vinayānamrakaṃ dharā || 1 || devy uvāca || deva deva parabrahma saṃsārārṇavatāraka || kena siddhir bhavec chīghraṃ kālikāmaṃtram uttamaṃ || 2 || (fol. 20v4–6, exp. 22t) End paṭhanān maṃtrasiddhiḥ syād dhāraṇāc ca na saṃśayaḥ || yasya gehe sthitaṃ cedaṃ caṃdanena vileritam (!) || 29 || kamalā niścalā tatra sadā tiṣṭhati pārvati || 29 || yaḥ śṛṇoti nirāhāraḥ śucis tadgatamānasaḥ || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ tasya siddhiḥ kare sthitā || 30 || (fol. 23r3–6, exp. 24b) Colophon iti śrīkālīkulāmṛte kālīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 4 || (fol. 23r6, exp. 24b)

Beginning śrībhairavy uvāca || deva deva mahādeva bhaktānāṃ sukhavarddhanaṃ || kena siddhiṃ dadāty āśu kāliṃ trailokyamohiniṃ || tan me vada dayāpāra sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhaye || kṛpāṃ kuru jagannātha vada me parameśvara || 2 || (fol. 23r6–23v2, exp. 24b–25t) End yatra yatra bhayaṃ prāpte sarvatra prapaṭhen nara (!) || tathā yadi trāṇaparo bhavaty eva na saṃśayaḥ || 26 || vāmapārśve samānīya śobhitāṃ varakāminīṃ || japaṃ kṛtvā paṭhed yas tu tasya siddhiḥ kare sthitā || 27 || idaṃ kavaca ajñātvā yo kālī (!) bhajate naraḥ || naiva siddhir bhavet tasya vighnaḥ syāc ca pade pade || 28 || || (fol. 25v2–5, exp. 27t) Colophon iti śrīgaṃdharvatantre bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde śrīmāhākālakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || || 6 || (fol. 25v5–6, exp. 27t)

Beginning śrīgurave namaḥ || || śrīdakṣiṇāyai namaḥ || || oṃ asya śrīkālīkacacasya bhairava ṛṣir anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ dakṣiṇakālīdevatā śrīkālīkavacapāṭhe viniyogaḥ || || dhyāyet kālīṃ karālāsyāṃ daṃṣṭrābhīmavilocanāṃ || sphuracchavakaraśreṇīkṛtakāṃcīdigaṃvarāṃ || 1 || vīrāsanasamāsīnāṃ mahākāloparisthitāṃ || śrutimūlasamākīrṇṇasṛkkaṇīṃ caṃḍanāḍinīṃ || 2 || (fol. 25v6–26r4, exp. 27t–b) End siddhayoṣṭau kare tasya maheśa iva cāparaḥ || rūpeṇa smaratulyosau kāminīnāṃ priyo bhavet || 25 || tasmād etat tu kavacaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || bhaktiyuktāya śāṃtāya dānaśīlāya dhīmate || 26 || yo dadāti ca śiṣyebhyo vaśyaṃ tasya jagad bhavet || guhyād guhyataraṃ guhyaṃ kālabhairavabhāṣitaṃ || 27 || yasya kaṃṭhagataṃ tasya karasthāḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ || 28 || (fol. *28r2–6, exp. 29b) Colophon iti śrīkālikākulasarvasve viśvamaṃgalaṃnāmakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 7 || (fol. *28r6–*28v1, exp. 29b–30t)

Beginning bhairava uvāca || devi te taṃtramaṃtrasya dhyānasaya ca vijānataḥ || kṣipraṃ prajāyate siddhiḥ prayogapūjanaṃ vinā || 1 || iti niścitya manasi kathitaṃ mayi sādarāt || tat kathaṃ dhyānamātreṇa na hi siddhyaṃti sādhakaḥ || 2 || (fol. 29v1–3, exp. 30t) End ekavāraṃ paṭhed yas tu pūjāyāś ca phalaṃ labhet | mokṣārthī labhate mokṣaṃ dhanārthī dham āpnuyāt | 25 || rājyārthī rājyam āpnoti kavacaśravaṇā (!) chiva (!) || idaṃ kavacajṇānaṃ vai maduktaṃ snehabhāvataḥ || 26 || tvayā guptataraṃ kāryaṃ prakāśe siddhirodhakṛt || 27 || (fol. 31v3–5, exp. 32t) Colophon iti śrīśāṃbhavīsaṃhitāyāṃ dakṣiṇākaṃvaṃcaṃ (!) sampūrṇam || (fol. 31v5–6, exp. 32t)

Beginning namaḥ śrīkālikāyai || || skaṃda uvāca || kailāśaśikhare ramye devadevaṃ jagatprabhuṃ || kena buddhyā kālavaśyaṃ brūhi me parameśvara || 1 || īśvara uvāca || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā skaṃda gopyād gopyataraṃ tvidaṃ || mama priyatvāt ṣaḍvaktra vaktavyaṃ tūttamottamaṃ || 2 || kavacaṃ kālikāyās tu kālavaṃcanam uttamaṃ || kālikākālikānāmapaṭhatāṃ sarvadā jayaḥ || 3 || (fol. 31v6–32r3, exp. 32t–b) End sadā prasanna tvayā śaṃbho sādhane śaktidakṣiṇā || ity aṣṭakīlanamaṃtroddhārapūjāvidhayaḥ || kruṃ kruṃ klīṃ ruṃ ruṃ ūṃ ūṃ hūṃ hūṃ krīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ḍaṃ vrīḍāṃ śrīṃ śrūṃ hrūṃ hrūṃ klīṃ kliṃ hrūṃ hrūṃ oṃ oṃ dhuṃ dhuṃ hnauṃ śāṃ śrūṃ śraṃ tvaṃ tvaṃ lī praṃ ṣāṃ ṣūṃ yāṃ trāṃ klīṃ khlīṃ krīṃ krīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ chahaka hlīṃ hrauṃ krāṃ krīṃ hrīṃ hlaṃ klīṃ klīṃ śūṃ śrī klūṃ klīṃ klaṃ hlīṃ hmāṃ sauṃ śrīṃñchrīṃ klīṃ kluṃ ha haṃ krīṃ kṣīṃ haṃ kālikāyai namaḥ || || (fol. 34v1–5, exp. 35t) Colophon iti kālikākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 9 || (fol. 34v6, exp. 35t)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīdevy uvāca || deva deva jagannātha bhaktānugrahakāraka || sarvāpadbhyā (!) samāpnoti paritrāṇaṃ kathaṃ naraḥ || 1 || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi guhyād guhyataraṃ paraṃ || āpad uddhāraṇaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ || 2 || (fol. 34v6–35r2, exp. 35t–b) End sarvapriyatamo bhūtvā sarvaiśvaryam avāpnuyāt || lohapaṃjaramadhyasto galayad (!) baṃdhanair dṛḍhaṃ || 14 || devīṃ hṛdi samārādhya paṭhitvāṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ || khaḍgādibhir abadhyaḥ syād baṃdhanān mucyate dhruvaṃ || 15 || guruvaktrāt samāsādya lakṣaṃ yaḥ prapaṭhec chuciḥ || parituṣṭā tadā kālī tasya prayakṣatāṃ (!) jagat || 16 || (fol. 36r2–4, exp. 36t) Colophon iti kālīkalpe dakṣiṇakālikāyā āpaduddhāraṇaṃ kavacaṃ samāptaṃ || 9 || (fol. 36r5, exp. 36b)

Beginning .............. || .................. || || tārāmārabhayaṃkarīsuravarī saṃpūjitā sarvadā || lokānāṃ bhayahāriṇī jayati sā mātaiva sā rakṣiṇī || kāruṇyena samākulā bahuvidhā saṃsārabhiruṃ janāt || tāstrīn bhaktimato vibhāti jagatāṃ nityaṃ bhayadhvaṃsinī || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3, exp.2t) End atha maṃtra || || oṃ eiṃ kaṭuke kaṭukapatre śubhage āsurī raktavāsase atharvaṇasya duhite aghorakarmmakārake mama sarvopadravā yakṣa 2 amukasya gatiṃ daha 2 upaviṣṭasya aṃgaṃ daha 2 suptasya mano daha 2 prabuddhasya hṛdayaṃ daha 2 hana 2 paca 2 daha 2 matha 2 tanuṃ daha 2 paca 2 tāvad yāvan me vasam (!) āyāti hruṃ phaṭ svāhā || pūrvvasevā ayutaṃ japet || daśānsena pūrvvavat karttavyaḥ || tataḥ siddhāntinānyathā || amoghaḥ || madhye nadīparvvate tiṣṭhatiḥ (!) || tadā na siddhyati || (fol. 10r4–9, exp.10b) Colophon iti śrīraktacāmuḍā āsurīkalpapaṭalaḥ ||| (fol. 10r9, exp.10b)

«Complete transcript:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || cāmuṇḍā caṇḍikā caṇḍi caṇḍiṃ caṇḍāṃsudhāriṇī || caṇḍāṭṭahāsacaṇḍākṣi pracaṇḍā caṇḍanādinī || daṃṣṭrākarālaraktāṃgī piṃgakeśī mahodarī || kṛṣṇāṃgī bhīṣaṇī kālī jihvālalanbhīṣaṇī || mahāpretāsamārūḍhā catvārihastaśobhitāṃ || asī ca muṇḍahastā ca varadābhayaśobhitāṃ || hāḍābharaṇasarvvāṃgīṃ (!) śmaśānālayavāsinīṃ || sahasrasūryyasaṃkāśaṃ romakūpe pratisthitaṃ (!) || kākagṛddhā śivāpretā svānavāyusamādise || bhūtavetālaḍākinyaḥ parivārā ca rākṣasāṃ || dakṣiṇāṃ kālikāṃ raudri aśvatthavṛkṣavāsinī || || (iti ḍakṣiṇakālīstotraṃ) || || (śubhaṃ) || || (fol. 10v1–6, exp. 11)

Beginning śrī mahākālyai oṃ namo dakṣiṇakāliyai (!) || || śrīmahākāla uvāca || mahākautūhalastotra (!) hṛdayākhyaṃ mahottamaṃ śṛṇu priye mahāgopyaṃ dakṣiṇāyā sugopitā || avācām api vakṣyāmi tava prītyā prakāśitaṃ || anyeṣāṃ kṛtagopyaṃ ca satya (!) satyaṃ ca śailaje || || (fol. 1v1–5) End paṭhet stotraṃ kuleśāni jīvanmukta (!) sa ucyate || rajasvarābhagaṃ (!) dṛṣṭvā paṭhed ekāgramānasaḥ || labhate pamaṃ sthānaṃ devī loke varānane || mahāduḥkhamahāroge mahāśaṃkaṭake (!) dine || mahābhaye mahāghore paṭhet stotraṃ mahottamaṃ || satyaṃ satya (!) puna (!) satyaṃ gopayan mātṛjāravat || || (fol. 8r1–8v1) Colophon iti śrīkālikāṃ (!) kulārṇave dakṣiṇakālyā hṛdayaṃ samāpta śubham || || śubhaṃ bhūyāt || (fol. 8v1–2)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || jetuṃ yat tripuraṃ hareṇa hariṇā vyājād vali (!) badhnatā | praṣṭaṃ vāribhavad bhavena bhuvanaṃ śevena dhartuṃ dharā | pārvvatyā mahiṣāsurapramathanaṃ siddhādibhi (!) mūktaye | dhyāta (!) paṃcaśareṇa lokavijayapāyāt sanāgānanaḥ || namos tu gurave tasmai | parabrahmasvarūpiṇī | yasya vākyāmṛtaṃ hanti viṣasaṃsārasaṃjñakaṃ | rātriśeṣaguruṃ dhyātvā prāta (!) mūtrapurīṣayoḥ || utsṛjyācamanaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā ca dantadhāvanaṃ || (fol. 1r1–1v2) End ākāśe suprakāśe sakalaguṇamayīṃ sundarīṃ raktanetrāṃ nityaṃ padmāsanasthāṃ tanūnaratinibhāṃ raktacandraṃ śubhābhāṃ | dhyātvaivaṃ sarvvabhāvaiḥ sakalaguṇayutāṃ sarvvadā yo hi paśyet | sākṣād devo śivo vā madanasamanahaḥ khecaro jāyate saḥ || idaṃ tripurasundaryyā stavarājaṃ manoharaṃ rakṣāmantraṃ ca śubhadaṃ śivena parikīrttitaṃ || || 161 || (fol. 20v1–21r1) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale śrīśivabhākhitaṃ (!) daśamasaṃhitāyāṃ śrītripurasundaryyā krama | praṃcamīstavarājaḥ samāptaṃ || || || 7 || ❖ śivasya niḥprapaṃcasya paramārthaśarīriṇaḥ | cidullāsātparājānā (!) pañcānāṃ mātṛrūpiṇī || || māyākuṇḍalanī kriyā madhumatī kālī kalāmālinī | mātaṃgīvijayā bhagavatī devī śivā śāmbhavī | śaktiḥ śaṅkaravallabhā trinayanī vāgvādinī bhairavī hrīṃkārī tripurāpalāparamayī mātā kumārīty asiḥ || || anyatra śaraṇaṃ nāsti tvam eva saraṇaṃ (!) mamaḥ (!) | tasmāt kāruṇyabhāvena rakṣa rakṣa parameśvarī || || samvat 770 ākhāḍha śu di 5 āditavārakohnū rikhiti sūryarāma manakāmanāsiddhir astu || jana dhanas tata śrī snatānavyadhīrastuḥ || śubham astu || || (fol. 21r1–21v5)

«Complete transcript:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ śrīśiva uvāca brahmaraṃdhrasarasīruho hare biṃdulagnam avadātam adbhutaṃ | kuṃḍalīvivaraśuṃḍamaḍitaṃ dvādaśārasarasīrūhaṃ bhajet || 1 || tasya puṃḍalitapūrṇikāpuṭe klṛptarekhamaputhā hiraṇyakaṃ | śreṇalakṣahalamakṣakoṇakaṃ bhāvalakṣamamalālayaṃ bhaje || 2 || tatpuṭe paṭutaḍitkaḍarim asya rddhamāṇamaṇipīṭhamaṃḍalaṃ | saṃvidā savajharīmaraṃdhrayor dvandvam indumakaraṃdaśītalaṃ || 3 || ūrddham asya hutabhuk śikhāśikhaṃ tadvilāsaparibṛṃhanāspadaṃ | bhānukoṭikiraṇāvalīyakaṃ devavṛṃdamunivṛṃdasevitaṃ || 4 || mānasaṃ smarati maṇgalāspadaṃ viśvapargharamahotsaṭotkataṃ || vyāmṛṣāmi yugamādihaṃsayos tatra nāthacaraṇārabiṃdayoḥ || 5 || niṣiktamaṇipādukāṃ niyatoghakolāhalaṃ sphuratkiśalayāruṇaṃ nakhasamullasat caṃdraptaṃ || parāmṛtasarovarohitasarojamātmāśritaṃ namāmi śirasaṃsthitaṃ gurupadārabindadvayaṃ || 6 || parāmṛtasarovaro iti śrīpādukāstotraṃ paṃcavaktravinirgataṃ || paṃcāmnāyaphalaprāptaṃ prapadyagatidurlabhaṃ || 7 || iti śrī rudrayāmale śivaviracitaṃ gurupādukāstotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || || (exp. 2 ll. 1–9)

Beginning uṃ cchaṃ cchāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ 2 phaṭ sarvvatra vasaṃ (!) kuru svāhā || parasiddhibandhanaṃ paścāj jāpena || uṃ kanda svāhā || japa anavāna (!) nyūne siddhipradaṃ || hrīṃ prajñā śrī baṃdhanāya kūṃ 3 phaṭ svāhā || vāmavat tena bandhanaṃ dakṣiṇāvat tena tyāgaḥ || (exp. 26t3–5) End haṃtākṣaṃ khodaduḥkhaṃ (!) samitabhavabhaye sarvvavighnāntaye gāṃ gīṃ guṃ gaiṃ ṣaḍaṃge gagaṇagatiyute siddhisarvvārthadāye | oṃ gluṃ mudrāgajākhyai gamapavanagate ākhuyā naikadaṇḍe uṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ gāṃ gaṇeśe dviradamukhagaṇe vighnanāthe namaste || devtāṣṭakaṃ tu yo devi paṭhate ca samāhitaḥ | tasya siddhir bhavecchīghraṃ yoginīnāṃ prasādataḥ || kathitaṃ yoginīstotraṃ nityā tantre varānane | olitraye (!) pi sāmānyaṃ surāṇām api durllabhaṃ || (exp. 34b2–7) Colophon iti śrī darppaṇaśiṣāyāṃ (!) siddhasārasaṃgrahe caturosīti sāhasre devyāṣṭakaṃ || || (exps. 34b1–35t1)

Beginning ❖ amṛteśvarabhairavāya namaḥ || śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāsaṃ ūṇḍeṇḍu (!) himasaṃnibhaṃ | śutramuktāvalihāraṃ śitacandanabhūkṣitaṃ || somamaṇḍalasaṃdhyasthaṃ ekavaktrā trilocanī | svetapadmāsanasthaṃ (!) tu baddhapadmopari sthitā || caturbhujā visālākṣaṃ varadā bhūpapānina || pūrṇṇacaṃdranibhaṃ śutraṃ amṛtenaiva pūritaṃ || dakṣahaste tu kalasaṃ vāme vai candramaṇḍalaṃ | vame (!) rucchagatā (!) devī ekavaktrā trilocanī || svetavarṇṇā mahādīptī varadā bhūpapāninī (!) | (exp. 14b1–6) End viśvādhīśvaraballabhe vijayase mānvaṃ (!) niyantyātmikā | bhūtānāṃ puruṣāyūṣā vadhikarī (!) prāptapradāṃ karmmināṃ tāṃ yāce bhavatīṃ kimapyavirataṃ yo madvirodhī janas tasyāyūrmmamavāṃcchitāvadhibhaven māta surair ājñayā || 7 || mātaḥ samyagupāsituṃ yatamatis tvāṃ naiva śaknomy ahaṃ yadyapyaṇchitadesikāṃghriyugalaṃ nukrośaprāntasya (!) me | yan tu kaścana cintayendyakuśalaṃ yan tasya tad vaiśaśaṃ (!) bhūyād devivirodhināṃ vitanute yan svalpadā ..vasā || (exps. 17b2–18t1) Colophon iti nigrahāṣṭakastuti || ○ || (exp. 18t1)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīharasiddhidevyai || ākāśe varṇṇarūpī varayati capalā prāṇamārgge praṇamya bhedantī tābhi cakre ahigatikuṭilā arddhanārīśadehe | aśūlyā kāmarūpā tripathagatiyutā brahmadaṇḍasulīnā sā sūkṣmā sūkṣmarūpā gaganaśivagatāḥ pātu māṃ viṣṇuśaktiḥ || ākāśe varṇṇadehā ahiarigamanā kharggakādyaṃ (!) gadādhṛk bindutrikṣekavaktraṃ ṣaṭakikūlabhavo gacchate gatyapīṭhe | saumye vargge ca jhasāhare (!) siddhiśvarūpā aṭṭahāse kadambe viśvaṃ vyāpyam avāpyaṃ praśamata satataṃ pātu māṃ viṣṇuśaktiḥ || harasiddhi || ○ || (exp. 3t1–7) End vidyutkoṭiprabhāsā dinakaravapuṣāṃ candrabimbā sutejā bhāṣṭā (!) devyāsanasthā tribhuvananamitā pātu vo rudraśaktī || ghoraṃ ghorāṭṭahāsāṃ ghūrighūritaravāṃ ghoradaṣṭrākarālāṃ (!) kṛṣṇāṅgī raktanetrā nararudhiravasā pūrṇṇakāpālahastā | saumyā pūrṇṇenduvaktrā saradaśaśibhā sarvvamāṃgalyayuktā ekānte mārggasaṃsthā hariharanamitā pātu vo rudraśaktī || || (exp. 13t1–6) Colophon

Beginning ❖ śyāme komalacubukastanataṭī cāruprabālāṃgade daṃṣṭrā bālamṛgāṃkamukhe nitye nirastāhave | haṃro (!) ghūrṇṇahale gṛhītamūśale saṃdhyāruṇāṃbhoruhe tvān devī tripure varāhavadane vande ⟨va⟩varan dehi me || 1 || padme pretāsanasthā sumuditaravibhā kālavaktrā trinetrā haste yasyā prakāsaṃ halamuśalamahāśaṃkhayaṣṭipradānaṃ | divyālaṃkāravastrai maśigaṇa śirase mālayā bhūṣitāṇgī devī trīpaṃcamīyaṃ dadatu mama sadā sampadaṃ rājyalakṣmī || 2 || (exp. 18t1–7) End iti te kathitaṃ guhyaṃ kālikāmantra[[bhe]]dataḥ | yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvvasiddhiṃ labhe dhruvaṃ || puraścaryyā kṛtaṃ yena ṣodaśārṇṇan tu śraddhyā | iha loke sukhī bhūtvā pretyāmāṅkam avāpnuyāt || jīvahīno yathā deho bhūṣitopi na śobhate | puraścaraṇahīnan tu tathā mantraṃ na saṃsayaḥ || puraścaryyām akṛtvā tu na tu mantraṃ prayojayet | vimukhī bhavate tasya kālikā kālabhakṣiṇī || (exp. 23t3–7) Colophon samāptam idaṃ stotraṃ guhyakālyā (!) || ○ || (exp. 23t7)

Beginning ❖ nṛtyeśvarāya namaḥ || pāṇau brahmakapālam ujjvalatanuṃ kaṇṭhe murārer vapuḥ sarvvāṃgeṣu tuṣārahāradhavalā devāsthimālādharaṃ | viṣṇur bbījam iva prasāditabhujo bhūyo pi saṃbhūtaye pāyāduḥ (!) pralayāvasānasamaye kāpālikaḥ śaṃkaraḥ || 1 || krodhādhvastamanobhavāndhakaripu vāmāṅgaśaktiḥ prabhuḥ sṛṣṭiṃ rakṣakasaṃharaṃ jagad idaṃ helā vasā nirmmitaṃ | dhyānāśaktanimīlalocanavibhur yogānvitaṃ siddhidaṃ kāleśo kulanāyako vijayate devo mahābhairavaḥ || 2 || (exp. 23t1–6) End hemābhāsāddhyajihvā triguṇitavilasad vāmahastāṃgulīkā tadvakṣāṃtarnnighāṭasṛtiruṣitalasad rakṣahastā bhavāniṃ | dhyātavyā sādhakendrair jjvalad analalasat keśayālolasantī (!) vārttālīnām adheyā sakalajanamanovṛtti saṃstaṃbhayanti || hrīṃ namo vārāhi ghore svapnaṃ vada svāhā || || mālāyate | trīllokām (!) iva rikṣituṃ vahati yo visphuryya dakṣotrayaṃ (!) sastrai (!) gunchaparicchado vijayate devas triśūlāyudhaḥ || 8 || (exps. 25b4–26t2) Colophon iti śrībhairavāṣṭakaṃ samāptaṃ || || (exp. 26t2–3)

Beginning ❖ nṛtyeśvarāya namaḥ || pāṇau brahmakapālam ujjvalatanuṃ kaṇṭhe murārer vapuḥ sarvvāṃgeṣu tuṣārahāradhavalā devāsthimālādharaṃ | viṣṇur bbījam iva prasāditabhujo bhūyo pi saṃbhūtaye pāyāduḥ (!) pralayāvasānasamaye kāpālikaḥ śaṃkaraḥ || 1 || krodhādhvastamanobhavāndhakaripu vāmāṅgaśaktiḥ prabhuḥ sṛṣṭiṃ rakṣakasaṃharaṃ jagad idaṃ helā vasā nirmmitaṃ | dhyānāśaktanimīlalocanavibhur yogānvitaṃ siddhidaṃ kāleśo kulanāyako vijayate devo mahābhairavaḥ || 2 || (exp. 23t1–6) End hemābhāsāddhyajihvā triguṇitavilasad vāmahastāṃgulīkā tadvakṣāṃtarnnighāṭasṛtiruṣitalasad rakṣahastā bhavāniṃ | dhyātavyā sādhakendrair jjvalad analalasat keśayālolasantī (!) vārttālīnām adheyā sakalajanamanovṛtti saṃstaṃbhayanti || hrīṃ namo vārāhi ghore svapnaṃ vada svāhā || || mālāyate | trīllokām (!) iva rikṣituṃ vahati yo visphuryya dakṣotrayaṃ (!) sastrai (!) gunchaparicchado vijayate devas triśūlāyudhaḥ || 8 || (exps. 25b4–26t2) Colophon iti śrībhairavāṣṭakaṃ samāptaṃ || || (exp. 26t2–3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaś caṇḍikāyai || brahmāyanyai (!) namaḥ || brahmāṇī brahmaśāvitrī brahmaṇatvavideyinī | caturbhujā caturvaktrā caturvvedaparāyaṇī | caturddaśadiso vyāptā caturyugaparāyaṇī | haṃsayuktavimānasthā saumyarūpā pitāmahī | pustakajapamālāya varadābhayapāṇinī | pītapuṣparatān (!) devī pītāṃgīpītavāsasā | pītopahārasaṃtuṣṭā pītagandhānulepīṇī | uduṃbaratalāvasthā prayāgan kṣatravāsinī | pūrvvapī[[ṭhe]] sthitā nityaṃ brahmaśakti namostu te || 1 || (fol. 1r1–5) End ekakālan dvikālam vā trikālaṃ yaḥ paṭhen naraḥ | śatam āvartta[[ya]]dyastu prāpnoti śubham uttamaṃ || nāśayed bhayadāridraṃ nāsayed ripusantati | nāśayed agnicaurāṇI nāsayed rājakrodhajaṃ || nāśayet saviṣarghoraṃ nāsayed abhicārakaṃ | nāsayel lokadoṣāṇI nāśayetsarvvapātakaṃ || āyurārogyam aiśvaryaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ vivarddnaṃ | dharmmārthakāmakokṣāṇāṃ yaśaḥ saubhāgyasādhanaṃ || riddhisiddhiṃ (!) śriyaṃ lakṣṃī vidyājñānasutīnvitaḥ | buddhiprajñāṃ sumitraṃ ca vandaṃnte (!) ca dine dine || nākāle maraṇan tasya utpātan nāśayet sadā | sarvvalokaiḥ prasasante (!) dīrghāyur api labhyate || (fol. 8r1–8v3) Colophon iti śrīpīṭhāvatārastutiḥ samāptaḥ (!) || || hṛdayaṃ ❖ ānandasānandaparamaughamadīpyamānāṃ svacchandaklīsphuradam antataraprakāśāṃ | devīṃ dayārdrahṛdayaṃ harasya | śrīsundarīṃ śivakaīṃ caraṇaṃ śrayāmi || tripurayā || || sarvvālaṃkāradehā urasi śavaśiro hāramālāvalambī jihvā lolāyamānā rudhiram anudinaṃ svādusaṃtuṣṭamānā | yā (fol. 8v3–6)

Beginning ❖ brahmāyaṇī brahmasāvitrī brahmatatvaṃ vivedinī (!) caturbhu[[ja]] caturvvaktra caturvvedaparāyaṇī || haṃsajuktavimānasthā saumyarūpī pitāmahī | pustakaṃ upamārāś (!) ca varadābhayadhāranī | pītapuṣparatān devī pītāṅgi pītavāsasā pītopahārasaṃtuste (!) pītagandhānurūpiṇī || utumbatarāvaṣṭhā prayogakṣatravāṇinī | pūrvvapīṭhaṣṭhito nityaṃ brahmaśakti namostu te || 1 || (exp. 2t1–5) End āyurārogya aiśvaryyaṃ dhanadhānyavivarddhanaṃ dharmmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ jasasaubhāgyasādhanaṃ (!) riddhisiddhiśiyālakṣmī vidyājñānasutāmbi te buddhiprajñāsumitrañ ca baddhateje dine dine || nākāre malaśantasya utpāta nāśayet sadā sarvvalokaṃ praśasanti dirghāyur api labhyate || (exp. 11b1–5) Colophon iti śrīpīṭhāvatārastutiḥ samāptaḥ (!) || || (exp. 11b5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ ścaṇḍikāyai || brahmāṇī brahmasāvitrī brahmatattvanivedīnī catubhujaṃ catuvaktraṃ caturvvedaparāyanī | haṃsayuktavimānasthā saumyarūpī pitāmahī || pustakaṃ jāpyamālāñ ca va varadābhayapāṇinī | pitapuṣparatā devī pītāṅgī pītavāsanī pītopahārasaṃtuṣṭā pītagandhānulepinī | udumbalatalāvasthā prayagakṣatravāsi || 1 || (fol. 1r1–6) End ekakālaṃ dvikālam vā trikāla yaḥ paṭhen naraḥ | śatam āvarttayet sopi prāpno śubham uttamaṃ || nāśayecchā kavintāni nāśaye vighnadevatā | nāśayet kalahān rogān nāśaye duḥkhaduddharaṃ || nāśaye bhayadāridraṃ nāśayendriyusantatiṃ nāśayet saviṣughoraṃ nāśayed abhicārakaṃ | nāśaye loka dvaināśayed agnivaṃśāṇi nāśayed rājakrodhakaṃ 1 tāye haviṣvāṅgaka ghāraṃ nāsadabhicārakaṃ ṣānīśayet sarvvapātakaṃ || āyur ārogyam aiśvaryyai dhanadhānyavivarddhanaṃ | dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ yaśasaubhāgyasādhanaṃ || riddhisiddhiśrayā lakṣmī vidyājñāna sutānvitaḥ | buddhiprajñāsumitrañ ca barddhante ca dine dine || nākāle maraṇan tasya utpātaṃ nāśayet ma | sarvvalokaiḥ prasaṃsanti dīrghāyur api labhyate || (fol. 8r2–8v6) Colophon iti pīṭhāvatārastutiḥ samāptaḥ || 65 || || (fol. 8v6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || brahmāṇī brahmasāvitrī brahmatattvanivedanī (!) catubhujaṃ catuvaktraṃ caturvvedaparāyanī || 1 || caturbhujaṃ vilaṃ vyāpi caturbhagaparāyaṇī | haṃsayuktavimānasthā saumyarūpi pitāmahī || 2 || pustakaṃ jāpyamālaṃ ca varadābhayabhūṣitā | pitapuṣparatāṃ devī pītāṅgī pītavāsanī || 3 || pītopahārasaṃtuṣṭā pītagandhānulepinī | udumbalatalāvasthā prayagekṣatravāsinī || 4 || (fol. 1r1–1v2) End mekālaṃ dvikālam ca trisaṃdhe yaḥ paṭhe naraḥ | śatam āvattayed yena prāpnoti śūnyam uttamaṃ || 1 || nāśayet śokacintānāśayet vidhnadevatā | nāśayet kalahaṃ rogān nāśayet duḥkhabhājanaṃ || || nāśaya bhayadāridraṃ nāśayed ripusattama nāśayed agnicaurānāṃ nāśayet rājabodhakaṃ || 3 || nāśayet savipaṃ ghoraṃ nāsayec cābhikārakaṃ || nāśayet lokadhyākṣāmi nāśayet sarvvapātakaṃ || 4 || māyurārogyasaṃpatti dhanadhānyavivarddhanaṃ | dharmmārthakākamokṣānāṃ yasasaubhāgyamuttamaiḥ || 5 || ṛiddhiṃ siddhiśriyaṃ lakṣmī vidyājñānaśrutāni ca | buddhiprajñāsumitraṃ ca varddhante ca dine dine || 6 || nakāke malanaṃ tasya mutpātaṃ nāśaye sadā | sarvvalokapaṇḍaśyanti dīrghamāyu ca labhyate || 7 || (fol. 9r1–9v5) Colophon iti śrīpīṭhāvatārastotraṃ samāptaḥ || 65 || || (fol. 9v5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || īśvara uvāca || || devāsurāṇāṃ saṃgrāme jayārthaṃ ṣaṇmukhasya ca || kavacaṃ proktavān asmi bhaktānāṃ ca hitāya vai || 1 || tat te haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ rahasi priye || yathāvat dhyānayogena kavacaṃ prathamaṃ paṭhet || 2 || paścāt pūjāṃ prakurvīta japaṃ deśikasattamaḥ || vinā kavacapāṭhaṃ yaḥ kurute pūjanādikam || 3 || tatsarvaṃ niḥphalaṃ jñēyaṃ kṛtaṃ ced brahmaṇā svayam || prācyām indreśvarī pātu dakṣiṇasyāṃ yameśvarī || 4 || (fols. 1v1–2r4) End śatrūṇāṃ kaṣṭadā bhūyād aṣṭabhairavapūjitā || pretān pretāsanā pātu bhayebhyo vīravallabhā || 18 || pānapā pāśahastebhyaḥ paśubhyaḥ paśukāriṇī || sarvatra sarvadā pāyād rājarājeśvareśvarī || 19 || putrān pītāṃgaṇagāme bhāryāṃ bhairavapūjitā || śakunī śakunānāme (!) phalaṃ bhūri prayacchatu || 20 || vidyāṃ vidyādharī pāyā (!) chatrūn dahatu huṃ phaṭ || iti devyā mahādevyā vagalāyām ayātava || 21 || kavacaṃ kathitaṃ nityaṃ paṭhataḥ sarvasiddhidam | khecarī prāpnuyān mudrāṃ yogīnī cakram īkṣate || 22 || devatā vaśam āyāti kiṃ punaḥ sarvadevatāḥ || yo mohān nāma gṛhṇāti devatāyā adīkṣitaḥ || 23 || viparītaṃ phalaṃ tasya sarvathā jāyate śive || idaṃ kavacam atyugraṃ sarvathā śatrunāśanam || 24 || sarvarogaharaṃ svargyaṃ sarvakāmasamṛddhidam pītavāsāḥ pītavāso japāt kāmān samaśnute || 25 || pūjāṃ kuryān na vā kuryāj japaṃ naiva karotu vā || kavacenāvṛto nityaṃ sādhakaḥ siddhim aśnute || 26 || kāminī vaśam āyāti śatrūn śātayati kṣaṇāt || yathoktapūjāsāphalyaṃ kavacenaiva jāyate || 29 || pūjāṃ japaṃ baliṃ kurvan siddhir bhavati nānyathā || niśāyāṃ dhārayan nityaṃ niśāyāṃ kavacaṃ japet || 28 || saṃyoge viprayoge ca puraścaraṇam ucyate || iti śrutvā tadā devī santoṣaṃ paramaṃ yayau || 29 || (fols. 4r2–5v4) Colophon iti śivataṃtre siddhirahasye pītāṃbarākavacam samāptam || || śubham || || 1919 || sāla miti śrāvaṇa śu di 7 roja 7 śubham || (fol. 5v4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha puraścaraṇavidhiḥ || puraścaraṇakāle vihitāniyamā (!) raktāṃvaraṃ raktagaṃdhaṃ raktamālyānulepanaṃ || raktāsaneṣu saṃveśya yavabhuk vā haviṣyabhuk || striyaṃ na gachan (!) niyataṃ brahmacārī bhavet sadā || brahmacaryaṃ ratot siddhir jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || śubhe dine śubhe parigrahaṃ kṛtvā || puraścaraṇadināt prāk tṛtīyadivase kṣaurādikaṃ vidhāya yekaṃ (!) bhuktaṃ kuryāt || (fol. 1r1–5) End adya pūrvoccarita evaṃ guṇa°° amuka gotromuka (!) śarmaṇaḥ śarīre utpannotpatsyamānavātapittakaphodbhavakāśanānākaraṇanimittajvarakṣayapāṃḍukuṣṭhaśūlādisāradhātukṣayabraṇamedabhagaṃdarāryādīnām anekasamastāmayanidānabhūtapāpanivṛttidvārākṣi ārogyadīrghāyuḥ prāptaye hariharabrahmātmakasya mitrādi dvādaśanāmātmakasya rūpiṇaḥ dvādaśavarṇasahitasya traimūrte bhagavataḥ śrīsavitāsūryanārāyaṇaprītyarthaṃ ādityapurāṇokta tṛcā (!) kalpavidhinā arghiṇī saṃkhyāka aurjyamasā saṃpūrṇaṃ kariṣye (fol. 2r1–7) Colophon

(exp. 2:1-6) iti śrīchinnama(exp. 5b5)stā stotra || || oṃ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai || «End:» isthaṃ trīśyapi (3) mulavāgbhava mahāśrīkāmarājasphura, chaktyākhyāni catuḥśrūti pra(4)kaṭitānyūtkṛṣṭha kūṭānite | bhūtartu śrūti saṃkhyavarṇṇaviditānyā(5) raktakānte śive, yo jānāti sa eva sarvvajagatāṃ sṛṣṭisthitiṃ dhvaṃ(6)sakaḥ || nityaṃ ya stava mātṛkākṣara sakhīṃ śaubhāgyavidyāṃ jape || saṃ(7)pūjyākṣara cakrarājanilayāṃ sāyanānāgniprabhāṃ | kāmākhyaṃ śi(exp. 14b3-7) «Colophon:»

«Beginning» no || yāmya pīṭho..tāni...ñ ca namostute || kṣobh...ñ ca kaumā(2)rīdevyāṣṭaka namostute ......|| (3) āṃ krāṃ aiṃ hrīṃ kumārī kaha kaha mā khala 2 .. viyā...jñā..śīṣa(4) kuru kuru sa...śrīmate caṇḍa guhyā..khyā...vera śīva (5) ājñā turādhe..kāntara trima... ya ta paśupa...namaste || || (exp. 9:1-5) «End» svāna biya, yajamānastaṃ || siṃdhramuṅa lavahlāya || kuhmalapūjā choya || (b1) sākhi thāya || kaumārīpūjāyā samaya cepana thiya || śikhāpūjā yāya || (2) āgamajusake duṃhāvane || ācāryyapūjā yāya || vīrabhojya yāya || ka(3)laṃka choya || duvaneyā pañcabali choya || (exp. 14t7-b3) «Colophon» thvate kaumārījāgārccanavidhi samāptaḥ || (4) ۞ || || epāchesa yāyayātā || || ۞ || (exp. 14b3-4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || pārvaty uvāca || oṃ asyā devamahādevaḥ vidyāyām anudīritaḥ || dvāviṃśatyakṣarī vidyā bahudhā bhedataḥ kathaṃ || 1 || kāṃ vidyāṃ kva nu gātre tu rakṣaṃ (!) kuryyā (!) ca sādhaka || ekākṣarādim ārabhyaṃ tryakṣarī ca ṣaḍakṣarī || 2 || sāṃgā saparivārādyā tathā saptadaśākṣarī || aṣṭākṣarī ca triguṇā tathā ca daśamākṣarī || 3 || ekādaśī mahāvidyāṃ (!) tathā ca dvādaśākṣarī || trayodaśākṣarī vidyā yogināṃ (!) mokṣadāyinī || 4 || (fol. 1v1–4) End ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ || niśāyāṃ ca viśeṣena śaktyā saha paṭhet sudhī (!) || 12 || sarvakāmam avāpnoti ciraṃjīvī bhaven naraḥ || apasmāre bhave kuṣṭe jvare grahe sadāruṇe || 13 || [[|| nadyāḥ paścimavāhinyāḥ nābhimātrodake sthitaḥ || maṃḍalān muktim āpnoti kālī bhaktiprasādataḥ || 14 ||]] bhūtapretamahāsaṃghe ḍākinī pīḍite pi ca || paṭhitvā nāśam āyāti na ca pīḍā karoty alaṃ || 15 || liṣitaṃ (!) tiṣṭhate yatra na ca duḥkhaṃ kaciḍ (!) bhavet || sarvaduḥkhavinimukto (!) devī putropamaḥ svayaṃ || 16 || devatāgurubhāvena gurudaivasya bhāvataḥ || daivataṃ vaṃcayad yas tu guruḥ paramadaivataḥ || 17 || alpāyuś ca bhavet satyaṃ kālīkavacam uttamaṃ || ajñātvā kavacaṃ devi jaganmaṃgalasaṃjñakaṃ || 18 || prajapet koṭilakṣaṃ tu na siddhyati varānane || maṃtraṃ gurumukhāl labdhvā datvā tasmai tu dakṣiṇāṃ || 19 || tena jñapto japen maṃtraṃ tadā siddhyati vai punaḥ || anyathā stotrarājo yaṃ na siddhyati varānane || 20 || pūjanāt paṭhanā (!) dhyānā (!) satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane || 22 || (fols. 6v4–7r2) Colophon iti śrīkālīkulārṇavokta mahājaganmaṃgalakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 1 || (fol. 7r2–3)

«Complete Transcript:» siddhakālī śiraḥ pātu lalāṭaṃ pātu dakṣiṇā || kālī mukhe sadā pātu kapālī pātu cakṣuṣī || 1 || kullā gaṃḍau sadā pātu daśanau kurukullukā || virodhiny adharau pātu cibukaṃ vipracittakā || 2 || śmaśānavāsini karṇau nāsā pātu digaṃvarā || aṭṭahāsā pātu kaṃṭhaṃ aṃsau pātu sureśvarī || 3 || ghorarāvā karau pātu hṛdayaṃ pātu kālikā || ghorarūpā pātu pṛṣṭaṃ pārśvake muṃḍamālinī || 4 || karakāṃcī pātu nābhiṃ liṃgaṃ pātu ratipriyā || śivapriyā nitaṃbe dve urū daṃṣṭrākarālinī || 5 || mahākālapriyā pātu vikaṭā pātu jaṃghake || śmaśānakālikā pātu sarvāṃge parameśvarī || 6 || kā[[ma]]bījatrayaṃ pātu nābhitaḥ pādam eva ca || kūrcabījadvayaṃ pātu galato nābhim eva ca || 7 || śaktibījadvayaṃ pātu brahmaraṃdhrād gale punaḥ || tathā sarvāṇi marmāṇi dakṣiṇe kālike padaṃ || 8 || kāmabījatrayaṃ pātu pūrvasyāṃ disi (!) sarvadā || kūrcabījadvayaṃ pātu dakṣiṇasyāṃ tathaiva ca || 9 || śaktibījadvayaṃ pātu praticyāṃ sarvadā śubhaṃ || vahnijāyā cottarasyāṃ diśi pātu ca māṃ sadā || 10 || vidyā rājñī ca sarvāṃge aniruddha sarasvatī || kālikākakavacaṃ (!) divyaṃ yaḥ paṭhet prayataḥ śuciḥ || bhūtapretapiśācādyā ye pākhaṃḍā ca rākṣasā || 12 || tasya dūrāt prajāyaṃte satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || kṛtvā tu kulamārgeṇa pūjā devyāś ca uttamāṃ || 13 || yaḥ paṭhet kavacaṃ divyaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyate || kulamārgād vahirbhūta kālikāṃ pūjayet tu yaḥ || 14 || na vidyāphalam āpnoti viparītaphalaṃ labhet || 15 || iti kulasāre dakṣiṇakālīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 10 || (fol. 15v9–16v4)

«Complete Transcript:» kailāsaśikhare raṃmye (!) nānācitravicitrite || kālikāṃ paraipapracha (!) bhairavo lokanāyakaḥ || 1 || || bhairava uvāca || kālikāyā mahāvidyā kathitā bhuvi durllabhā || tathāpi hṛdaye śalyam asti devi kṛpāṃ kuruḥ (!) || 1 || kavacaṃ tu mahādevi kathayasvānukaṃpayā || yadā na kathyate mātar vimuṃcāmi tadā tanuṃ || 2 || || devy uvāca || śaṃkāpi jāyate vatsa tava snehāt prakāśyate || na vaktavya (!) na draṣṭavyaḥ mitiguhyataraṃ (!) mahat || 3 || kālikā jagatāṃ mātā śokaduḥkhavināśinī || viśeṣata kaliyuge mahāpātakahāriṇī || 4 || kālī me purataḥ pātu pṛṣṭhātaś (!) ca kapālinī || kullā māṃ daviṇe (!) pātu kurukullā tathottare || 6 || virodhinī śiraḥ pātu vipraciṃttā ca cakṣukhī (!) || ugra me nāśikāṃ pātu karṇau vāgne (!) prabhā matā || 7 || vadanaṃ pātu diptā me nīlā ca cibukaṃ sadā || ghanā grīvāṃ sadā pātu valākā vāhuyugmakaṃ || 8 || mātrā pātu karadvaṃdvaṃ vakṣo mudrā sadāvatu || mitā pātu stanadvaṃdvaṃ yoni maṃḍaladevatā || 9 || brāhmī me jaṭharaṃ pātu nābhiṃ nārāyaṇī tathā || ūrū māheśvarī nityaṃ cāmuṃḍā pātu liṃgakaṃ || 10 || kaumārī ca kaṭiṃ pātu tathaiva jaṃghayugmakaṃ || aparājitā ca pādau me vārāhī pātu cāṃgulī || 11 || saṃdhisthānaṃ nārasiṃhī yatrasthā devatāvatu || rakṣāhīnaṃ tu yat sthānaṃ varjjitaṃ kavacena tu || 12 || tat sarvaṃ rakṣa me devī kālike ghoradakṣiṇe || ūrddham adhas tathā dikṣu pātu devī svayaṃ vapuḥ || 13 || hiṃsrebhyaḥ sarvadā pātu sādhakaṃ ca jalādikāt || dakṣiṇākālikā devī vyāpakatve sadāvatu || 14 || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā yo jape ghoradakṣiṇāṃ || na pūjāphalam āpnoti vighnas tasya pade pade || 15 || kavacenāvṛto nityaṃ yatra yatraiva gachati (!) || tatra tatrābhayaṃ tasya na kṣobho vidyate kvacit || 16 || || iti śrī kālikākavacaṃ taṃtrāṃtaroktaṃ || 11 || (fols. 16v4–17r9)

«Complete Transcript:» adhunā devadeveśa kavacaṃ vajrapaṃjaraṃ || kālyā kṛpākaṭākṣormi kirmīritadṛśaṃ bhṛśaṃ || 1 || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tavāgre kavacottamaṃ yasmin mṛte bhavaty eva śrīkāliṃ tanayo naraḥ || 2 || vinā pūjā na siddhiḥ syād dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇānanā || tataḥ kavacinā bhāvyaṃ sādhakeṃdreṇa siddhaye || 3 || ṛṣir asya smṛtaḥ śaṃbhuḥ chaṃdaḥ sukṛtir uttama || devatāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dhyātvā kālī pratyakṣaraṃ nyaset || 4 || aṃbhodaḥ śyāmalāgī (!) mativikaṭadaṃtī lolajihvāṃ jatālāṃ (!) muṃḍaṃ vāme dadhānāṃ karakamalatale dakṣiṇe caṃdrahāsaṃ || sṛkkvadvaṃdvāstradhārādharamukhakamalāṃ pretador baddhakāṃcīṃ mādhvī konmattanetrāṃ śavahṛdayagatāṃ naumi kālīṃ karālīṃ || 5 || krāṃ bījaṃ mūrttigaṃḍadvitayam anu punas tad vayaṃ hraṃ dvayaṃ tu netradvaṃdveva lajjā yugalam api muhuḥ karṇayor ninyasec ca || nāsādvaṃdve ca rakṣir adanavasanayor ṇecakādaṃ tapaṃktyor (!) like bhrū dvadgrade ca tritayam api punac (!) bījam ādyaṃ nyasec ca || 6 || bāhuṃ dvaṃdve ca hbhūṃ hbhūṃ caraṇayugalake śaktibījadvayaṃ ca svāhā sarvatra dehe viśasatarapatir vinyaset vyāpakena || evaṃ nyāsaṃ vidhāya tribhuvanavalayakhyātakīrttikaviṃdro vajrāgojīvaloke jayati bahujanaḥ sādhakaṃ siddhamaṃtraḥ || 7 || krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ devi huṃ huṃ kahakaha hahahe hehi hrīṃ hrīṃ hahāhā daṃdaṃdaṃ dakṣiṇekaṃ kakakaka kalite kālike kālapatnī || krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ yoni hūṃ hūṃ hahahaha mahile kāli hrīṃ hrīṃ hariśe svāhā sāhe śanetre bhabhabhabha bhavatī bhūtaye vo bhae tu || 8 || bhūtapretapiśāca pannagavarapratyarthisenābhaye raṇye raṇyatarakṣu bhīṣu ca tathā cānyeṣvabhīṣṭaṃ sphutaṃ smṛtvainaṃ manumuttamaṃ gatabhayo jāyeta vīrottamo viśvāpaṃcakasādhayed anudinaṃ svāṃte dadhat sādhakaḥ || 9 || || iti kālīkalpe vajrapaṃjaranāmakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 12 || (fols. 17r9–18r5)

«Complete Transcript:» śrī devy uvāca || devīyaṃ katham īśāna prādurāsij jagatpate || tan me brūhi mahādeva yadi snehos ti māṃ prati || 1 || śrī īśvara uvāca || kailāsaparvatāsīnaṃ bhagavaṃta jagadguruṃ || papracha (!) sādaraṃ gaurī vinayāvanatasthitā || 2 || kām ārādhya mahādeva bhavatā jayamālikāṃ || kiyaṃtī devadeveśa yadi snehaḥ pravarttate || 3 || lakṣavārasahasrāṇi pṛṣṭā pṛchasi (!) pārvatī || yac chrutvā ca maheśāni prasādas te bhaviṣyati || 4 || īśvara uvāca || śrutvā taṃ ca maheśāni pārvatī priyavatsalā || āliṃgya sarvabhāvena punar āha ca śaṃkaraṃ || 5 || arddhāṃga vasatī devyāḥ kathaṃ vaṃcasi śaṃkara || yadi snehānubaṃdhaḥ syāt tadā tan me prakāśaya || 6 || mama mātā jagaddhātrī tamogunasamanvitā || satyajo viśṇur eva syād rajoguṇasamudbhavaḥ || 7 || pitāmahaś ca saṃjātas tasmān me jananī parā || tāṃ saṃciṃtya devesi sṛṣṭikarttā tv ahaṃ vibhuḥ || 8 || yasyās tu jayamāleyaṃ śṛṇuṣva parameśvari || tasyās tu kavacaṃ devi paṭhamānasya nityaśaḥ || 9 || mama saṃjāyate buddhiḥ śṛṇu karttuṃ varānane || kavacasya prabhāvena mama mātā yaśasvinī || 10 || māmeyaṃ līyate dehe tuṣṭā kavacapāṭhataḥ || mama garbhaprasūtā sā mama mātā priyaṃvade || 11 || mayi guptā mahāmāyā ādau mātā bhavatpriya || ādau mātā tathā guptā nabho vidur vidhīyate || 12 || tuṣṭā tuṣṭātmikā devī mātā mātṛtvam āgatā || iti bruvati bhūteśe punaḥ prāha priyaṃvada || 13 || kiṃcid nāmne mahādevī kiṃrūpā bhaktavatsalā || tatvaṃ brūhi dayābhāra tadā jīvāti śaṃkaraṃ || 14 || pārvatyā gadite śaṃbhuḥ punaḥ prāha priyaṃvadāṃ || tvam eva sarvabhūtānāṃ jananī sarvamohinī || 15 || satvaṃ rajas tamo māyārūpam āsādya putriṇī || brahmaviṣṇuśivatvāc ca brahmasthā rūpinī (!) parā || 16 || īśāne bruvatī prāya ākāśe duṃdubhisvanaḥ || kavacaṃ śṛṇu mātṝṇāṃ brūte gagaṇabhāratī || 17 || asya śrīkālīkavacasya bhairava ṛṣir anuṣṭupchaṃdo dakṣiṇākālidevatākavacapāṭhe viniyogaḥ || 18 || kapālaṃ pātu cāmuṃḍā karau rakṣatu kauśikī || śrutiṃ pātu rathārūḍhā netraṃ rakṣatu kālikā || 19 || liṃgadeśe ratnakaṃṭhā daśapatraṃ sumaṃgalā || ghrāṇaṃ rakṣatu kaumārī daṃtā rakṣatu carccikā || 20 || oṃ (!) ṣṭhau (!) dharau pātu nityaṃ pārvatī cibukaṃ parā || grīvāṃ rakṣatu bheruṃḍā dakṣiṇāṃsaṃ haripriyā || 21 || vāmāṃsaṃ hiṃgulā pātu pṛṣṭaṃ rakṣatu suṃdarī || guhyaṃ rakṣatu raktāṃgī liṃgaṃ rakṣatu bhīṣaṇā || 22 || pādau rakṣatu lolāṃgī maṃgalā hṛdayāṃbuje || datāṃn (!) rakṣatu daṃtogrā piṃgalāṃ śaṃbhuvallabhāṃ || 23 || suṣumṇāṃ subhagā pātu cittaṃ citrasvabhāvajā || ādhāraṃ pātu me caṃḍī caṃḍogrā nābhimaṃḍalaṃ || 24 || hṛdāṃbujaṃ padmamukhī kaṃṭhṃ rakṣatu caṃḍikā || lalāṭaṃ lalanā pātu rājadhānīṃ ca maṃḍalā || 25 || alaṃvuṣāṃ padmanetrā kuhnuṃ rakṣatu mātṛkā || karṣiṇī pātyaparā syāt hastijihvā carātmikā || 26 || yaśasvinī yaśo vāmā pūrṇāṃ rakṣatu vargadā || ity evaṃ kavacaṃ devī paṭhanīyaṃ surāsurai (!) || 27 || gaṃdharvair yakṣanāgaiś ca kiṃnarair mānavair api || bhogadaṃ kavacaṃ devi muktidaṃ dhanadaṃ priye || 28 || āyurārogyadaṃ devi kavacaṃ śatrumarddanaṃ || rājadvāre bhayaharaṃ bhūtapretanidāraṇaṃ || 29 || kavacaṃ durllabhaṃ devi triṣu loke sukhāvahaṃ || trisaṃdhyaṃ paṭhanād devi vāṃchitaṃ phalam āpnuyāt || 30 || kuṣṭarogāt pramucyeta viṣamajvaradāhataḥ || mahotpātabhayāt trāti kavacaṃ girije priye || 31 || śatam āvarttanād devi baṃdhanān mucyate dhruvaṃ || sahasrapaṭhanād devi mahāśatrunivāraṇaṃ || 32 || navavāraṃ jitāhāro viṣṇugehe ca bhaktitaḥ || tadā svayaṃ mahākālīṃ paśyati premavāṃchitaḥ || 33 || bhūmiśayyaḥ kuśe naiva paṭhec ca tritayaṃ yadi || tadā rātrau mahākālī varadā dakṣiṇā parā || 34 || haviṣyāśīyatāhāro yadi syād bhaktibhāvataḥ || paṭhe chivagṛhe vāpi kavacaṃ manmukāchyutaṃ || 35 || tasya sarvārthasiddhiḥ syān nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā || 36 || || || iti kālītaṃtre kālikākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 13 || || (fols. 18r5–19v8)

«Complete Transcript:» śrī devy uvāca || bhagavan brūhi kavacaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ || trailokyamohanaṃ nāma kṛpayā me jagadguro || 1 || śiva uvāca || śṛṇu devi varārohe kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ || yad dhṛtvā paṭhanād brahmā sṛṣṭikarttābhavad vibhuḥ || 2 || kṛṣṇo durvādalaśyāmo devakīgarbhaśaṃbhavaḥ || hṛtpadme kālikāṃ dhyātvā tataḥ kṛṣṇatvam āptavān || 3 || kālikāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dhyātvā ṛddhisiddhiphalapradāṃ || sarvāḥ śyāmāḥ bhavatyetā janārddanavibhūtayaḥ || 4 || evaṃ devagaṇāḥ sarve sarvaiśvaryyam avāpnuyuḥ || śiṣyāya śivabhaktāya sādhakāya prakāśayet || 5 || yo dadātyanyaśiṣyāya śaṭhāya paśurūpiṇe || paṃcatvaṃ jāyate tasya cāthavā cātulo bhavet || 6 || kavacasyāsya subhage yogirudro muniḥ svayaṃ || virāṭ chaṃdo nigadito devī dakṣiṇakālikā || 7 || dharmmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ me śiraḥ pāru bhalaṃ netrayugaṃ tathā || 8 || hūṃ hūṃ va śrotrayugalaṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ nāsāpuṭadvayaṃ || dakṣiṇe kālike pātu sajihvaṃ mukham eva ca || 9 || bhujayugmaṃ sadā pātu krīṃ krīṃ krīṃ akṣarātmikāḥ || hūṃ hūṃ rakṣatu me kaṃṭhaṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ cibukam eva ca || 10 || svāhāvatu brahmaraṃdhraṃ dvāviṃśatyakṣaro manuḥ || krīṃ hrūṃ krīṃ dakṣiṇe paścāt kālike padam eva ca || 11 || krīṃ huṃ krīṃ hṛdayaṃ pātu huṃ krīṃ hrīṃ pārśvam eva ca || hrīṃ hrūṃ krīṃ nābhikamalaṃ krīṃ hrīṃ huṃ pṛṣṭham eva ca || 12 || krīṃ huṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇe paścāt kālike padamīritaṃ || dviṭhāṃ tam udaraṃ pātūruyugmaṃ tryakṣarī punaḥ || 13 || dakṣiṇe kālike guhyaṃ svāhāṃto manunāyakaḥ || urū saptākṣarī pāyātyādau me ṣoḍaśākṣarī || 14 || krīṃ hrūṃ hrīṃ dakṣine paścāt kālike padam eva ca || hrīṃ hruṃ krīṃ hruṃ phaḍaṃte ca svāheti parikīrttitaṃ || 15 || ekākṣarī mahāvidyā sarvāṃgaṃ me sadāvatu || prācyāṃ rakṣatu me kālī tathāgneyyāṃ kapālinī || 16 || kullā tu dakṣiṇe rakṣe kurukullā ca nairṛte || praticyāṃ virodhinī pātu vāyavye vipracittikā || 17 || ugrā rakṣed udīcyāṃ caiśānyām ugraprabhāvatu || dīptā rakṣatvadhobhāge nīlā caivorddhvadeśake || 18 || ghanā me purataḥ pātu valākā pṛṣṭadeśake || mātrā tu dakṣiṇe rakṣed vāme mudrā sadāvatu || 19 || putramitrakalatrādi mitā rakṣatu sarvadā || iti te kathitaṃ devi sarvamaṃtrau dyavigrahaṃ || 20 || trailokyamohanaṃ nāma kavacaṃ brahmarūpiṇaṃ || braṃhme sa pramukhādīsa nārāyaṇamukhācyutaṃ || 21 || kavacaṃ kālikā devyāḥ yaḥ paṭhet prayato naraḥ || sa sarvasiddhim āpnoti satyam eva na saṃsayaḥ || 22 || gānena tuṃburuḥ sākṣad dānena vāsavo yathā || dattātreyasamo jñāne gaṃgeva malanāśakaḥ || 23 || kāmadevasamas trīṇāṃ gaṃdharva śvarūpabhāk (!) || śatrunāśe yamaḥ sākṣād vane dhanapatir yathā || 24 || sa bhavet sādhakaḥ śreṣṭaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditaṃ || nihaṃnyate gati (!) tasya vāyor iva nabhastale || 25 || śatam aṣṭottaraṃ cāsya puraścaryāvidhismṛtaḥ || havanādīn daśāṃśena kṛtvā tatsādhayed dhruvaṃ || 26 || yadi cet siddhikavacaṃ śivatulyo bhavet svayaṃ || paṭhanād dhāraṇāt sarvā pṛthvī kāśīpurī samā || 27 || yatra yatra vipannopi vārāṇasyāṃ mṛto bhavet || na maṃtraṃ nauṣaddhaṃ tasya nākālamaraṇaṃ tathā || 28 || bhavaty eva maheśāni kavace hṛdi śaṃsthite (!) || aśvamedhasahaśrāṇi (!) vājapeyaśatāni ca || 29 || mahādānāni yāny eva prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvas tathā || kalāṃ nārhaṃti tāṃn yeva sakṛd uccāraṇād ataḥ || 30 || puṣpāṃjalyaṣṭakaṃ datvā mūlenaiva paṭhed yadi || daśavarṣasahaśrāṇāṃ pūjāyāḥ phalam āpnuyāt || 31 || bhūrje vilikhya vidhivad gaṃdhacaṃdanakuṃkumaiḥ || śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japtvā svarṇasthaṃ dhārayad (!) yadi || 32 || kaṃṭhe vā dakṣiṇe vāhau aṣṭasiddhir bhaved dhruvaṃ || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā yo japet kālidakṣiṇāṃ || 33 || śatalakṣaprajaptopi na maṃtraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ || 34 || || iti rudrayāmale mahātaṃtre kālikākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 14 || || (fols. 19v8–21v1)

Beginning śrībhadrakālyai namaḥ || bhavaduḥkhamahodvighna saṃtaptān karuṇārṇava || tvāṃ tu yāce ham īśaikaṃ trātum arhasi vāgjalaiḥ || 1 || kathitaṃ kālikā devyāḥ kāmadaṃ kavacaṃ ma[[ha]]t || rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ brūhi kasmai cintayadīritaṃ || 2 || prayogasaṃghair bhavatā sādhako vimukhīkṛtaḥ || sādhanāt tad idānīṃ me pratyakṣīkaraṇaṃ vada || 3 || yat syā (!) devatāpratyakṣe na tatkarmaśatair api || vada tattadupāyaṃ me yena syād iṣṭadarśanaṃ || 4 || devatābhajanaṃ samyak yo na jānāti tattvataḥ || ruṣtotyarthaṃ sa kiṃ kuryāt tuṣṭo vā saṃsṛtau prabho || 5 || śiva uvāca || kathidā na mayā proktaṃ kavacaṃ kāmadaṃ śive || tathāpi na nivṛttis te praśne giribhuvaḥ kimāḥ (!) || 6 || (fol. 21v1–6) End dadyād advaitabhāvāya parastrīsvāratāya ca || viśuddhāya kulīnāya niḥsaṃdahahṛ (!) ʼdviṣe (!) || 62 || ṣaḍgeheṅgesti likhitaṃ bhurjje kavacam adbhutaṃ || rocanālaktasiṃdūra mṛgīṃdu (!) kuṃkumadravaiḥ || 63 || cauradasyugrahārāti jalādhivyādhivaṃhnibhīḥ || na tasya jāyate kvāpi svayaṃ śrīr nivaśaty api || 64 || yatphalaṃ labhate martyo devasaṃdhārcane ʼvanau || kālikā kavacanyāsāt tatphalaṃ syā (!) na saṃśayaṃ || 65 || rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ maṃtro rahasyaṃ kavacastutiḥ || rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ dhyānaṃ devyā vetti sa siddhibhāk || 66 || rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ vidyā rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ dhanaṃ || rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ jñānaṃ rahasyaṃ kavacaṃ kulaṃ || 67 || rahasyaṃ tiṣṭhati kavacaṃ so kutaścid bhayaḥ sudhīḥ || jarāmaraṇanirmuktaḥ śāpānugrahakṛd bhavet || 68 || (fol. 24r6–24v3) Colophon iti śrīkālīrahasye kālikākavacaṃ jagadrakṣākaraṃ saṃpūrṇam || 15 || (fol. 24v3)

Beginning śrī devy uvāca || prāṇabaṃdho dayāsiṃdho guhyaśāstravicārakaḥ || kālikāvacanaṃ divyaṃ śatrusaṃhāradāruṇaṃ || 1 || kathayasvāsamāsena yena me śaktiruttamā || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu vakṣyāmi kavacaṃ sarvaśatruvidāraṇaṃ || 2 || sarvaśāṃtikaraṃ sākṣāt mahāpātakanāśanaṃ sarvavyādhipraśamanaṃ sarvasaṃpatpradāyakaṃ || 3 || caturvargapradaṃ sākṣāt mahāpāṭakanāśanaṃ || || oṃ asya śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyāḥ kavacasya śrībhagavān mahākālaṛṣiḥ anuṣṭupchadaḥ ādyā śaktiḥ śrībhagavavatī devatā hrīṃ bījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ sarvasamṛddhaye viniyogaḥ || klīṃ pātu mastake devī śikhāyāṃ krīṃ maheśvarī || 4 || bhrūmadhye klīṃ maheśāni pātu māṃ cakṣuṣor dvayoḥ || huṃ pātu nāśikāraṃdhre huṃ jihvāyāṃ maheśvarī || 5 || hrīṃ pātu tālumūle ca hrīṃ pātu oṣṭayugmakaṃ || dakṣiṇe kālike pātu sarvāṃge kālasauṃdarī || krīṃ pātu nāsikādvaṃdvaṃ krīṃ pātu karṇayugmakaṃ || krīṃ pātu jihvāmūlaṃ ca huṃ pātu vadane punaḥ || 7 || (fols. 24v4–25r2) End na jāyate vyādhis tasya duḥkhaśokabhayaṃ kvacit || gorocanākuṃkumair vā raktanaṃdanakair api || 48 || pāvakair vā maheśāni likhed yas tu viśeṣataḥ || aṣṭamyāṃ maṃgaladine caturdaśyāṃ mathāpi (!) vā || 49 || yuddhe vā devadeveśi likhed deśikasattamaḥ || maghāyāṃ śravaṇāyāṃ vā revatyāṃ vā viśeṣataḥ || 50 || siṃharāśau gate caṃdre karkaṭastho divākara || mīnarāśau guru gate vṛścikasthe śaniścare || 51 || likhitvā dhārayad yas tu gurūṇāṃ ca maheśvarī || dhyānadhāraṇayogena dhārayed yas tu bhaktita (!) || 52 || acirāt tasya siddhi (!) syān nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || vādī mūkaṭiyoṣitastapayatīḥ pakṣmāvaro śasyati || 53 || garvī (!) kharvati sarvavic ca jaḍati vaiśvānaraḥ śītati || ācāryāṣṭakasiddhirūpaparamaṃ siddhāṣṭakaṃ tadbhaje || 54 || tāṃ vahne bhavabhītibhaṃjanakarīṃ kālī girīsapriyaṃ (!) || 55 || (fol. 27r1–7) Colophon iti viśvasārataṃtre dakṣiṇakālikākavacaṃ śaṃpūrṇam || 16 || (fol. 27r8)

Beginning śrībhadrakālyai nama (!) || bhairava uvāca || sādhu sādhu mahādevī sādhu pṛṣṭosmy ahaṃ tvayā || kathayāmi prasādena saṃvādaṃ śivarāmayoḥ || 2 || kailāśaśidharāsīnaṃ parvatyā (!) sahitaṃ haraṃ || praṇaṃmya (!) bhaktyā papracha (!) prāṃjalī reṇukāsutaḥ || 3 || parasurāma uvāca || namas te viśvanāthāya namas te viśvatejase || namas te viśvarūpāya namas te viśvakāriṇe || 4 || prasīda bhagavan śaṃbho brūhi me paramārthataḥ || yarcāj (!) jayaprāṇāyāmādikaṃ (!) vinā || 5 || aganyāsakaraṃ (!) nyāsau vinā kālī prasīdati || yathāvidhānavidyo haṃ kṣatriyān haṃtum utsahe || 6 || īśvara uvāca || sādhu sādhu ciraṃjīva parśurāmaśubhāsayā || sādhu pṛṣṭosmi bhavatā sādhakāṇāṃ sukhāvaha || 7 || (fol. 27r8–27v5) End dūtiyāgavidhānena kriyate yajanādikaṃ || rajaḥśakatiḥ śivo biṃdur iti miśritam arpayet || 51 || kāmanāsiddhim ādadyāj japtvādhītastavo jana || paraśurāma uvāca || sādhu sādhū mahādeva devadeva prasīda me || 52 || iti jñātijitāḥ sarve kṣatriyā iti manyate || śrībhairava uvāca || etat te kathitaṃ devi kathitaṃ rudrayāmale || 53 || yaḥ paṭhed brādaye (!) devi kavacaṃ kavacīkṛtaṃ || tasya pūjāphalaṃ pūrṇaṃ japahomaphalaṃ tathā || 54 || jāyate nātra saṃdehaḥ saṃdehe sati niḥphalaṃ || kim anyadadhikaṃ vakṣye mohanoccāṭanādikaṃ || 55 || api siddhyaṃti nidhayaḥ karasthā navasiddhayaḥ || navagrahāś cāpi krūrā na tasyānivṛkāriṇaḥ (!) || 56 || || (fols. 29v8–30r4) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde bhagavatyāḥ kālikāyāḥ kāmadaṃ kavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 17 || (fol. 30r4–5)

Beginning virūpākṣa uvāca || namāmi gurum akṣobhyaṃ maṃtraśaktisamanvitaṃ || prasannajñānavijñānahetuṃ buddhiprakāśakaṃ || 1 || gajeṃdravadanaṃ naumi raktaṃ vighnavidārakaṃ || bhairavaḥ sarvadā pātu ṛṣir me śirasopari || 2 || mukhe chaṃdā sadā pātus triṣṭup ca vijayātmaka || guṇatrayamayī śaktiḥ paraśaktis turīyakā || 3 || brahmasvarūpinī pātu [[hṛdaya mama kālikā bījasvarūpiṇī pātu]] hrīṃkārī śaktirūpiṇī || hūṃ śaktiḥ sarvadā pātu sarvarakṣāsvarūpiṇī || 4 || krīṃ kīlakaṃ sadā pātu sarvasiddhipradāyakaṃ || viniyogaḥ sadābhīṣṭasaṃsiddhyai patu siddhidaḥ || 5 || mahākālaḥ sadā pātu mahābhīmaparākramaḥ || sadā pātu mama kāmān sarvasiddhīśvaro yataḥ || 6 || (fol. 30r5–30v1) End ugratāreti tāreti śivety ekakate (!) ti (!) ca || lokottareti bāleti gīyate kṛtibhiḥ sadā || 45 || yathā kālī tathā tārā tathā chiṃnnā ca kullukā || ekamūrttiś caturbhiś ca devi tvaṃ kālikāvarā || 46 || ekadvitrividhā devī koṭidhānaṃtarūpinī || aṃgāṃgakair nābhabhedaiḥ kāliketi pragīyate || 47 || śaṃbhuḥ paṃcamukhenaiva guṇān vaktukṣamo na te || cāpalyair yatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kṣamasva varadā bhava || 48 || prāṇān rakṣa yaśo rakṣa putradāradhanaṃ sadā || sarvakāle sarvadeśe pāhi dakṣiṇakālike || 49 || yaḥ śaṃpūjya paṭhed rakṣāṃ divā vā saṃdhyayos tathā || avāpya mahatī pajñāṃ (!) sarvakāmās tato labhet || 50 || yad yat prārthayate citte tattad āpnoti kā kathā || svayaṃ lakṣmīr vased gehe muktiḥ karagatī (!) punaḥ || 51 || (fol. 32r7–32v4) Colophon iti śrīvirūpākṣaviracitaṃ kālikākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 18 || (fol. 32v4–5)
