Beginning śrīgurave namaḥ || || sumero cottare śṛṃge devadevaṃ jagadguruṃ || uvāca parayā bhaktyā devī natvā vṛṣadhvaja || 1 || pārvaty uvāca || devadeva mahādeva sarvaśāstrārthapāraga || tasmān me kathayasvādya yady ahaṃ prāṇavallabhā || 2 || īśvara uvāca || dhṛṣṭāsi kiṃ mahādevī yan māṃ pṛchasi sāṃprataṃ || satyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevī kathitaṃ naiva suvrate || 3 || pārvaty uvāca || śṛṇu deva prāṇanātha nāhaṃ hi tavavallabhā || sadbhaktajanavātsalyād asatām aśī (!) śobhana || 4 || kālikā kavacaṃ divyaṃ punaś ca kathayasva me || anyathā prāṇamaṃnyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃsayaḥ || 5 || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu devī varārohe kathaṃ tatpravadāmi te || tathāpi kathayiṣyāmi yatas tvaṃ prāṇavallabhā || 6 || jānāmi kālikāṃ devīṃ saccidānaṃdarupiṇīṃ || kulakaṃḍalinīrūpāṃ pramattāṃ jñānagahvaraṃ || 7 || (fols. 32v5–33r2) End paṃḍitāya ca bhaktāya taṃtramaṃtrayutāya ca || nāstikāya kuśīlāya niṃdakāya tathaiva ca || 68 || yo dadāti mahāvidyāṃ tasya pāpaphalaṃ śṛṇu || māsādurdhvaṃ mahādevi raveḥ sutagṛhaṃ vrajet || 69 || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā yo japet kālikāmanaṃ || tasyāṃgaṃ bhakṣayet kālī yogīṃnyaḥ sarvadā tathā || 70 || vāṃdhavebhyo na vaktavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ kadācana || kalpāyutasahasraṃ tu niḥkṛtiḥ tasya nāsti hi || 71 || evaṃ tu kavacaṃ devi trailokyamohanaṃ mahat || maṃtraṃ va (!) kavacaṃ devi samam eva na saṃśayaḥ || 72 || trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhed devi sarvadā sarvasiddhidaṃ || gadyapadyamayī vāṇī jāyate vakravahvarāt (!) || 73 || śrīrāma iti vīryya (!) na (!) sūryyasyaiva hi tejasā || krodhe gamasamānaḥ syā dhane dhanapatir yathā || 74 || sauṃdarye kāmatulyo sau raṇe matsamopana (!) || satyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevi satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 75 || etat stotraṃ ca yo vetti sohaṃ sohaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || kālikākavacam etadhi kālabhairavanirmitaṃ || 76 || (fols. 35v6–36r4) Colophon iti śrīsumerottare śṛṃgasthite kālabhairavanirmitaṃ kālikāmaṃtrakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 19 || (fol. 36r4–5)

Beginning śrībhairava uvāca || kā kālī kamalā kālī kāmasiddhā mahodarī || pratyakṣā bhava cāmuṇḍe bhaktyā kavacapāṭhataḥ || 1 || kusuṃbhakusumāśīrṣaṃ pāyāt kamalalocanā || lalāṭaṃ pātu cāmuṇḍā kaṃṭhaṃ rakṣatu kālikā || 2 || hṛdayaṃ pātu kālāṃgī nābhiṃ rakṣatu pārvatī || jaṭharaṃ pātu bhīmākṣī savyaṃ rakṣatu carcikā || 3 || ūrū me pātu lolākṣī kāmasthānaṃ śivāṃganā || jaṃghāyugmaṃ bhadrakālī pādāgra pātu bhīṣaṇā || 4 || kaṃṭhaṃ rakṣatu sarveśī pṛṣṭaṃ dakṣiṇakālikā || grīvāṃ rakṣatu krodhāṃgī netraṃ rakṣatu bhīṣaṇā || 5 || pārśvadvayaṃ lolajihvā stanau rakṣatu vaṃśinī || bhujadvayaṃ lalāṭākṣī śravau rakṣatu śaṃkhinī || 6 || gaṃḍau me pātu vimalā nāsikāṃ vijayāvatu || mano rakṣatu mā raktadaṃtā daṃtarāśiṃ cikuraṃ kusumāyudhā || 7 || (fol. 7r3–9) End raṇe jayapradaṃ devi duṣṭadaityanivāraṇaṃ || dyūte jayapradaṃ devi śūlaroganivarhaṇaṃ || 21 || viṣamajvarasaṃdāha vedanākalitaṃ sadā || āturaṃ saṃspṛśan japtvā sadyo rogāt pramucyate || 22 || kāśyādi tīrthayātrāṃ tu prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvas tathā || gaṃgāśnānasahasrasya (!) tulyaṃ kavacapāṭhataḥ || 23 || (fol. 8r1–4) Colophon iti śrīkālīkalpe kalīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 2 || (fol. 8r4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || dakṣiṇakālīkavacasya mahākālabhairavaṛṣiḥ anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ || śmaśānakālikādevatā || sarvakāryyārthasādhane jape viniyogaḥ || || oṃ śmaśānakālikā pātu pūrvaśyāṃ diśi māṃ sadā || dvāviṃśatparṇarūpā ca bhaktavaśyā digaṃvarā || 1 || bhadrakālī tathāgneyyāṃ pāyān nityaṃ jaganmayī || rudrakālī mahākālī kaladvaṃdvāsvarapriyā || 2 || vāgeśvarī pātu yāmyāṃ bhayabhītivināśinī || vadadvaṃdvaṃ vāgvādinī vahnijāyāsvarūpiṇī || 3 || (fol. 36r5–9) End sarve tasya vaśaṃ yāṃti bhūtagrāmāś caturvidhāḥ || nityaṃ paṭhati ye bhaktyā kavacaṃ haranirmitaṃ || 46 || soham eva mahādevo mahākālī ca mātṛkāḥ || dharmmārthakāmamokṣāś ca tasya nityaṃ karaṃ sthitāḥ || 47 || anyasya varadaḥ sopi nityaṃ bhavati paṃḍitaḥ || kavitvaṃ satyavāditvaṃ satataṃ tasya jāyate || 48 || vadet ślokaṃ sahaśrāṇi (!) bhavec chrutidharas tathā || likhitaṃ yasya gehe tu kavacaṃ bhairavoditaṃ || 49 || na tasya durgatiḥ kācit jāyate pāpadapraṇe (!) || grahāś ca sarve tuṣyaṃti vasaṃ gachaṃti bhūmipā (!) || 50 || yadrājye vattvacajñosti jāyate tatra netrayaḥ || etat te sarvamākhyatam abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ śubhaṃ || 51 || (fol. 38v1–6) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmaloktaṃ kālabhairavaviracitaṃ dakṣiṇakālī abhedyakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 20 || (fol. 38v6–7)

«Complete transcript:» śrībhairava uvāca || yajñakālī śikhāṃ pātu hṛdyaṃ pātu sanātanī || pādau pātu sadā bhadrā sarvarakṣāramādhavī (!) || 1 || idaṃ tu kavacaṃ divyaṃ yaḥ paṭhen mānavaḥ sadā || sarvatīrthābhiṣeke gayāśrāddhana (!) yatphalaṃ || 2 || tatphalaṃ tasya sakalaṃ yaḥ paṭhed ekatattvataḥ || yeṣām ārādhane śraddhā ye tu sādhanam udyatāḥ || 3 || teṣāṃ kṛtārthaṃ sarvāṃgaṃ gatir ddevīpadālayaṃ (!) || 4 || iti aghorayāmale kālikākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 21 || (fols. 38v7–39r1)

«Complete transcript:» oṃ namaḥ sarvasiddhayoginībhyāḥ || oṃ namaḥ sarvasiddhimātṛkābhyaḥ || oṃ namaḥ uḍitānaṃtāyai || oṃ namaḥ sakalakulacaṃdrī[[kā]]yaiḥ (!) || oṃ namo bhagavatyai caṃḍamālinyai namo namaḥ || paramahaṃsanirvāṇamārgādiviṣamopaplavanāśini sakaladuritāriṣṭakleśadamani sarvopadravanāśinī mama śatrūn marddaya khādaya triśūlena bhiṃdhi bhiṃdhi chiṃdhi chiṃdhi khaḍgena tāḍaye (!) 2 chedaya 2 paramakāriṇi mahābhairavarūpadhāriṇi tridaśavaraṇamite sakalamātarmmātaḥ praṇatajanavatsale devī kāli keśini krīṃ hūṃ hrīṃ phaṭ svāhā || śatadvayaṃ tu varṇānāṃ nāmnā trailokyamohinī || ya enāṃ dhārayen nityaṃ trailokyaṃ vaśam ānayet || || iti kālikāpurāṇe trailokyamohanaṃ nāma maṃtrakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 22 || (fols. 39r1–39r7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīgurucaraṇakamalebhyo namaḥ || sukhasthitaṃ jagaṃnnāthaṃ (!) kailāse girijaikadā || āliṃgyāha kathaṃ vāsaṃ dattvārddhāṃgetha vaṃcase || 1 || majjaniṃ kāntikāṃ pāhur (!) brahmādyās tatvadarśitaḥ || jātāsannā kathaṃ tasmai kena vādya prasīdati || 2 || śrutveti vacanaṃ devyā vismito phullalocanaṃ || uvāca prahasaṃ devas tanmanonaṃdayanti ca || 3 || īśvara uvāca || lakṣmaṇe śarasaṃbhinne vilapaṃtaṃ raghūttamaṃ || caturvargātmikā kālī prādurbhūtāṃ janaprabhā || 4 || harṣayaṃtī tamūcemuṃ (!) caturvarṇātmakaṃ manaṃ || rāmagṛhānasaḍbhaktyā trailokyavijigīṣayā || 5 || rāma uvāca || mātaś cen me prasannāsi kālike kālanāśinī || rahasyaṃ kṛpayācakṣva japāmyarcāmyahaṃ sadā || 6 || tathā vārcā japadhyānā mātṛkābhūtaśodhanaiḥ || valitarppaṇahomādyaiḥ prasīdes tadvinā vada || 7 || (fol. 39r7–39v5) End stotraṃ vā dhārayed aṃge puṣṭakaṃ (!) vārgṛherccayet (!) || avyāhatājño niḥpāpaḥ satkaviḥ subhagaḥ sukhī || 44 || dhārmikaḥ śatrujichūraḥ kamanīyo dhanī bhavet || strīṇāṃ vadhyādidoṣeṣu śiśor bālagrahādiṣu || 45 || daurbhāgye duṣṭakṛd doṣe dhāraṇaśubhadaṃ sadā || vanojjuṭaśmaśānādau yaḥ kāliṃ vidhivaj japet || 46 || aiśvaryaṃ śivavan prāpya bhaven mṛtyujarātigaḥ || mohanoccāṭanādīni yāni karmāṇi cechati (!) || 47 || tāni siddhyaṃti manasā japan maṃtraṃ stavaṃ sadā || parameśvarasaudaryā paramārcyaparāyana || 48 || parameśṭhīpadaṃ prāpya parameśitvamṛchati || vipulapulakayukta evamaṃtrī (!) yadi bhavati sadā maharddhisiddhiṃ (!) || sa bhavati naradeva ekavaṃdyaḥ sakalasukham avāpya mokṣam eti || 50 || (fol. 41v1–7) Colophon iti kulācāracaṃdrodaye paramasiddhāgame kālīrahasye kālīstavaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 23 || (fol. 41v7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || namāmi śadguru (!) śāṃtaṃ praśannamuṣapaṃkajaṃ || vāmoruśaktiśaṃyuktaṃ jñānabuddhipradāyakaṃ || 1 || gajavaktra sadā naumi raktābhaṃ vighnanāyakaṃ || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sādhakaḥ siddhim āpnuyāt || 2 || bhairava uvāca || hṛtpadme paramāṃ devīṃ kālikāṃ savasaṃsthitāṃ || taptakāṃcanavarṇābhāṃ padmarāgamaṇiprabhāṃ || 3 || japākusumaśaṃkāśāṃ dāḍimīkusumopamāṃ || vaṃdhūkakusumābhāsāṃ siṃdūrāruṇaśaṃnibhāṃ || 4 || śaratkoṭiṃduvadanāṃ vaṃdhūkādharapallavāṃ lākṣārasapratīkāśāṃ kālikā (!) tāṃ namāmy ahaṃ || 5 || mālatīvāṃgacaturāṃ siṃdūratilakojjvalāṃ || tilapuṣpasunāsāṃ ca kālikāṃ tāṃ namāmy ahaṃ || 6 || (fols. 41v8–42r4) End śṛṃgārake pitṛbhuvi śūnyāvāse ca prāṃtare || idaṃ ca stavarājaṃ ca niśīthe yaḥ smaren naraḥ || 34 || matiś cet tvaritaṃ nṛṇāṃ bhagavatyā padāṃbuje || vidyoccāraṇamātreṇa vilīyaṃte mahāpadaḥ || 35 || śrīguror dhyanamātreṇa devī saṃnnihitā bhavet || bhogamokṣaprasūyeteyaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyinī || 36 || kṛtāyate stutir viśva bhairavena (!) ca dhīmatā || dhyānam asyāḥ pravakṣāmi yathā vā jagadīśvarī || 37 || savopari samāsīnāṃ raktāṃvarapariṣkṛtāṃ || raktālaṃkārasaṃyuktāṃ guṃjāhāravibhūṣitāṃ || 38 || ṣoḍaśād viṃśayuvatiṃ pīnonnatapayodharāṃ || kapālakartṛkāṃ hastāṃ paraṃjyotisvarūpiṇīṃ || 39 || (fol. 43r7–43v3) Colophon iti śrīmātaṃgītaṃtre kālikāstavarājaḥ saṃpūrṇa (!) || 24 || || || (fol. 43v3–4)

«Complete transcript:» śrībhairava uvāca || asya śrīmahāghoramaṃtrasya aghoraṛṣiḥ triṣṭupchaṃdaḥ || || mahāghoradevatā || vaṃ vījaṃ vaṃ vyaśanāni ca || svarāś ca śaktayaḥ || agho[[ra]]śirdhye jape viniyogaḥ || oṃ śivaḥ || || atha prāṇāyāmaḥ || oṃ hrīṃ sarvāṃgaśodhinīṃ eiṃ svāhā || saṃ iti atrāya (!) phaṭ || haṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ || saṃ sarvāstrāya phaṭ || jaṃ karatalakarapṛṣṭābhyāṃ namaḥ || trir natvā || oṃ hrīṃ śirasi || oṃ eiṃ hṛdi || oṃ śrīcaraṇayoḥ || tataḥ sūryyābhimukhaekena padā tiṣṭhana durddhvavāhuḥ || oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hra oṃ śrīṃ prakāśāya svāheti maṃtra ekaviṃśativāraṃ japet || ghorā siddhiprakāśakaṃ || || atha kavacaṃ || yajñakālī śikhāṃ pātu śanātanī || caraṇau tu sadā bhadrā sarvaṃ rakṣatu māvatī || || oṃ dhrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hrāṃ klāṃ iṃdravajrāya svāhā || iti maṃtra (!) saptavāraṃ paṭhannāvaset || yakṣāptatakuśāsanopari paścimābhimukhas tiṣṭhan tadā kāṃśyapātre siṃdūraṃ kṛtvā || oṃ klīṃ śrīṃ dhyāṃ oṃ klīṃ śrīṃ dhyāṃ || oṃ hrīṃ kāmadughāya svāheti maṃtreṇa kuśāgreṇa amṛtāṃgulīkābhyāṃ trikoṇṃ yaṃtraṃ dakṣajānorūpari likhet || || atha maūlamaṃtraḥ || oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ghorāṃ huṃ klīṃ eiṃ sarvakāmāpaṭhaḥ (!) svāhā || maṃtroddhārā || ādyaṃ mokṣākṣarī bījaṃ lakṣmībījam adhas tathā || tadadho nāmasaṃyuktaṃ śivaḥ kāmaś ca vāgvacaṃ || sarvakāmāpaṭhaḥ svāhādyupādyaḥ (!) ṣodaṣākṣaraḥ (!) || soyaṃ ghorātmako maṃtra sarvakāmavarapradaḥ || || iti ghorātmakaṃ yajñakālīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 25 || || (fols. 43v4–44r5)

«Complete transcript:» śrīgurubhyo nama (!) || kālīkā pāyanīkṛṣṇā kṛṣṇāṃgī kṛṣṇarūpiṇī || śyāmavarṇā ca kaumārī muktakeśī bhayānakā || 1 || raudraiva bhairavī vālā kālarātrir janeśvarī || bhadrakālī mahākālī triśūlī trikapālinī || 2 || caṃdī maokṣakarī devī sarvasiddhipradāyinī || dvāviṃśatyapi nāmāni kālikāyās tu yaḥ paṭhet || 3 || prāpnoti paramaṃ saukhyaṃ kālikāyāḥ prasādataḥ || 4 || iti gaurīyāmale kālikāyā (!) stavaḥ saṃpūrṇa (!) || 26 || (fols. 44r5–44r9)

«Complete transcript:» namāmi kṛṣṇarūpiṇīṃ kṛśāṃgayaṣṭirūpiṇī samagratatvasāgarāṃ apārapāragahvarāṃ || śivāṃ prabālakādharāṃ sphurachaśāṃkaśeṣarāṃ | lalāṭanec ca bhāsurāṃ jvalat pradīpaśojvalāṃ || maheṃdrakaśyapārcitāṃ śanatkumārasaṃstutāṃ || sureṃdravaṃditāṃ yathārthanirmitāhnatāṃ (!) || atarkyavāruceṣṭitāṃ vikāradoṣavarjitāṃ || mumukṣubhi (!) viceṣṭitāṃ viśeṣatatvaśobhitāṃ || narāsthinirmitasrajaṃ mṛgeṃdravāhanāgrajāṃ || praduṣṭatatvabhīṣaṇāṃ sadā digaikalakṣaṇāṃ || sulakṣaṇāṃ vilakṣaṇāṃ bhujaṃgahārahāriṇīṃ || kapālakhaḍgadhāriṇīṃ sudhārmikopakāriṇīṃ || sureṃdravairighāṭiṇīṃ kuṭhārapāsacāpiṇīṃ || kṛtāṃtakāmaghāṭiṇīṃ dvijyeṃdravṛddhatāriṇīṃ (!) || sahasrasūrya sojvalāṃ dhanaṃ jayaikavatsalāṃ || aśuddhakālacaṃcalāṃ sunṛtyavṛṃdavaṃjulāṃ || pratāpinīṃ prajāvatīṃ namāmi tāṃ sarasvtīṃ || sukarmakāriṇe gatiṃ he priyāṃ ca pārvatīṃ || anaṃtaśaktisaṃyutāṃ yaśaḥ subhuktimuktidāṃ || namostu te ca kālike śive bhajeta vāṃghrike || jayeśvarī trilocane prasīda devi pāhi māṃ || japaṃti ca stuvaṃṭi ca smaraṃti mīdṛśāḥ śubhāḥ || bhavaṃtyamoghavāṃchitāḥ sadaiva te bhavāsi ye || naraḥ paraṃ śivedhunā prasādhi māṃ karomi kiṃ || atīvramohitātmano vṛthā viceṣṭitasya me || kuru prasādam ucyate yathā sṛjāmy ahaṃ jagat || imāṃ stutiṃ mayoditaṃ paṭhaṃti kālisādhakāḥ || na te punaḥ suduṣṭare (!) pataṃti mohasāgare || || iti brahmagāthāstuti || 27 || (fols. 44r9–45r3)

«Complete transcript:» krīḍābalena kalitā divaḥ ca prasūtir oṃkoravedajanadevagaṇān gṛṇīte || brahmākṣaraṃ tava mano prathame tribījaṃ manyeham aṃśakalasya nidanam etat || 1 || bāhuṃ stavāṃvayugabhāgyabhujo bhajāmi yatrāgraḥ prabhavati pratipakṣaśāṃtiḥ || yad dhūmralocanabale prathitaṃ mahadbhir vyāśādibhir munibhir arṇayugaṃ manusthaṃ || 2 || hrīm ity udāramahimātulaśaktirekā śaṃbhoḥ kalatram iti tatvavido vadaṃti || yatrāyateṃvakalanādaghasaṃghataḥ syān bījadvayaṃ tava matau tad avaimi mātaḥ || 3 || bījāny amūni purataḥ parato pi śapta syā (!) dakṣiṇe yadamatho yadi kālike ca || madhye manau hutabhujo dayitā tadaṃte maṃtra svadāhyadhikavaṃśativarṇaśaṃsvaḥ || 4 || dīkṣāvidhānam adhigamya guroḥ sakāsāt lunvāmanuṃ japati lakṣamitaṃ divāyaḥ || rātrau haviṣyabhugamatsarakāmakopa- lobhādyacaṃcalamanāḥ sa tu sādhakeṃdraḥ || 5 || lakṣaṃ niśi svavanitā suratāvasāne nagnā vimuktacikuras tvayi dattacittaḥ || tāṃbūlapūrṇavadanaḥ kusumānulepa bhūyo jayan bhavati siddhimanur manuṣyaḥ || 6 || nāsty atra kālaniyamo na ca nāmabheda (!) siddhā viśuddhir api nāśramavarṇaniṣṭhā || śrīmadguroḥ karuṇayaiva bhavet prasanno maṃtras taveti gaditaṃ kila bhairaveṇa || 7 || hutvā gurur jayadaśāṃ śamitaṃ payonnaiḥ saṃskṛtya vaṃhnim atha taṃtravidhiḥ pravaṇaḥ (!) || mandhājyasvaṃtu vihitair api śuddhatoyaiḥ saṃtarpasiddhim upayāti hutā daśāṃśaṃ || 8 || tatroditena vidhinā viṃprinā prayogān kurvītaḥ sādhakavarojvalite citāgnau || vāṇiṃ driraikanijamaṃdiratām upetya bhūyāt kṣitau sakalalokasamarcitāṃghriḥ || 9 || kramenāyaṃ maṃtroddhāraṇajapahomādikalito bhavadbhaktiśraddhāsti miti hṛdayaiḥ sādhakavaraiḥ || stuto vā prakhyātas tava janani nityaṃ stavavaro bhaveyus te mukhyā pracura dhanimāṃ cāpi viduṣāṃ || 10 || iti śrībhairavayāmale dakṣiṇakālīstavaḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 28 || (fols. 45r3–45v9)

«Complete transcript:» rajasvalāmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpair vyapohati || saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ ca kurute rājasūyādikaṃ phalaṃ || 1 || tasyā (!) sparśaṇamātreṇa labhen muktiṃ caturvidhāṃ || tasyāḥ saṃgamamātreṇa trailokyotpāṭane kṣamaḥ || 2 || śraddhayā pūjayet tasyāḥ bhagaṃ śarajaśobhitaṃ || nyāsaṃ kṛtvā svadeheṣu kalābhiḥ kāmaṣoḍaśaiḥ || 3 || mātṛkā nyasya deheṣu anulomavilomataḥ || śivarūpaṃ viciṃtyaṃ svaṃ bhapūjāṃ samācaret || 4 || koṭijanmārjitaiḥ puṇyair bhaktā yaiḥ pūjitaṃ bhagaṃ || viśeṣaiḥ pūjitā yoni puṇyaśaṃkhyā (!) na vidyate || 5 || mahāyatnena deveśi puṣpavaṃtī sulakṣaṇāṃ || pūjyate devatābudhyā piśitālisu saṃyutāṃ || 6 || navapātraṃ tu vidhivat svayaṃ bhaktyā yathechayā || pibed divyaṃ surājyoti jāḍyatāṃ harayed dhruvaṃ || 7 || brāhme bhūte svayaṃ bhaktyā nirvikalpena cetasā || puṣpībhūtaṃ bhagaṃ pūjya liṃgamadhye praviṃnyaset || 8 || mahāpīṭhasya mathanaṃ kriyate japapūrvakaṃ || yāva (!) iti sukhaṃ bhūyat tāvajapyā (!) sureśvarīṃ || 9 || visarjane ca pūjāyāḥ punaḥ pātraṃ pibec chubhaṃ || evaṃ kṛte tu vīresaḥ (!) śivatulyo bhave (!) dhruvaṃ || 10 || atyaṃtaṃ gopayed devi svayonim apare yathā || na prakāśyaṃ kuputrāya gopyād gopyakṛtaṃ śubhaṃ || 11 || pramādāc ca prakāśyati sadyo mṛtyuṃ na saṃśayaḥ || nṛloke durllabhaṃ devi gopyapūjāphalaṃ mahat || 12 || bhaktyā ca paṭhate vīraḥ pūjāṃte stavam uttamaṃ || ṛtukāle viśeṣeṇa śivatulyo bhaven naraḥ || 13 || iti dvādaśabhiḥ ślokaiḥ stavaṇaṃ (!) paramādbhutaṃ || rajasvalāsamīpe tu paṭhyate sarsiddhikṛt || 14 || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || sapuṣpabhagapūjātra brahmaloke pi durllabhā || 15 || asya stotrasya mahātmyaṃ (!) mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate || viriṃcidmavā viṣṇu paṭhate ca niraṃtaraṃ || 16 || stotrapāṭhaprabhāvena śṛṣṭisthitir (!) bhaved dhruvaṃ || tasmāt sarvaprayatnena devī gopyakaraṃ śubhaṃ || smaret prathamapuṣpiṇīṃ rudhirabiṃdunīlāṃ carāṃ gṛhītamadhupātrikāṃ nadavighūrṇanetrāṃ calāṃ || ghanastanabharānatāṃgalitanīvikāṃ śyāmalokarasphuritavallarī viśadaśaṃkatāṭaṃkinī || 18 || iti dhyātvā || iti kālīprastāre īśvarapārvatīsaṃvāde puṣpiṇīstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || 29 || (fols. 45v9–46v8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || kailāśaśikharāsīnaṃ praṇipatya jagadguruṃ || papracha (!) pārvatīnāthaṃ vinayānamrakaṃ dharā || 1 || devy uvāca || deva deva parabrahma saṃsārāṇavatāraka || kena siddhir bhavec chīghraṃ kālikāmaṃtram uttamaṃ || 2 || bhairava uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣāmi kālīkavacam uttamaṃ || yasya saṃkīrttanā (!) chīghraṃ (!) maṃtrasiddhiḥ prajāyate || 3 || (fol. 8r4–7) End iti te kathitaṃ devi kālikākavacaṃ śubhaṃ || naitad deyaṃ manuṣyāya nābhaktāya na matsare || 28 || paṭhanān maṃtrasiddhiḥ syād dhāraṇāc ca na saṃśaya (!) || yasya gehe sthitaṃ cedaṃ caṃdanena vilepitam || 29 || kamalā niścalā tatra sadā tiṣṭhati pārvatī || yaḥ śṛṇoti nirāhāraḥ śucis tadgatamānasaḥ || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ tasya siddhiḥ kare sthitā || 30 || (fol. 9r9–9v3) Colophon iti śrīkālīkulāmṛte kālīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 3 || (fol. 9v3–4)

Beginning śrīdakṣiṇāyai namaḥ || oṃ asya śrīkālīkavacasya bhaivara ṛṣir anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ dakṣiṇakālīdevatā śrīkālīkavacapāṭhe viniyogaḥ || dhyāyat kālīṃ karālāsyāṃ daṃṣṭrābhīmavilocanāṃ || sphurachavakaraśreṇī (!) kṛtakāṃcīdigaṃvarāṃ || 1 || vīrāsanasamāsīnāṃ mahākāloparisthitāṃ || śrutimūlasamākīrṇa (!) sṛkkvaṇīṃ caṃḍanāḍinīṃ || 2 || muṃḍamālāgalad rakta carcitāṃ pīvarastanīṃ || madirāmoditāsphāla kaṃpitākhilamedinīṃ || 3 || vāme muṃḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca dhāriṇī dakṣiṇe kare || varābhayayutāṃ ghoravadanāṃ lolajihvikāṃ || 4 || śakuṃtapakṣasaṃsakta vāṇakarṇavibhūṣitāṃ || śivābhipheruvācābhisevitāṃ ghanaroditāṃ || 5 || (fol. 9v4–9) End bhairava uvāca || itīdaṃ kavacaṃ divyaṃ sādhakānāṃ sudurllabhaṃ || 31 || maṃtrasiddhikaraṃ sākṣāt kālabhairavabhāṣitaṃ || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā yor cayet kālikām anuṃ || 22 || śatalakṣaṃ prajaptvā pi tasya vidyā na siddhyati || sahasraghātam āsādya śo (!) cirān mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 23 || maṃtreṇa mṛyate yogī rakṣayet kavacaṃ yataḥ || trisaṃdhyaṃ paṭhanād asya kavacasya tu pārvatī || 24 || siddhayoṣṭau kare tasya maheśa iva cāparaḥ || rūpeṇa smaratulyo śau (!) kāminīnāṃ priyo bhavet || 25 || tasmād etat tu kavacaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || bhaktiyuktāya śāṃtāya dānaśīlāya dhīmate || 26 || yo dadāti ca śiṣyebhyo vaśyaṃ tasya jagad bhavet || guhyād guhyataraṃ guhyaṃ kālabhairavabhāvita || 27 || yasya kaṃṭhagataṃ tasya karasthāḥ sarvasiddhayaḥ || 28 || (fol. 10v4–11r1) Colophon iti śrīkālikākulasarvasve viśvamaṃgalanāmakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇam || 4 || (fol. 11r1)

Beginning bhairava uvāca || devi te taṃtramaṃtrasya dhyānasya ca vijānataḥ || kṣipraṃ prajāyate siddhiḥ prayogapūjanaṃ vinā || 1 || iti niścityā manasi kathitam api sādarāt || tat kathaṃ dhyānamātreṇa na hi siddhyaṃti sādhakaḥ (!) || 2 || śrī devy uvāca || asyāḥ dhyānasamāyuktaṃ naraṃ paśyati devarāṭ || svayaṃ suragaṇaiḥ sādha (!) śacīpriyam (!) ivāparaṃ || 3 || iti dhyānaṃ yathā tasyāḥ yaḥ kuryāt sādhakottamaḥ || tathā karoti deveśa savājradharo (!) raṇe || 4 || haṃti sādhakam evāsya vātulaṃ (!) vā karoti saḥ || || (fol. 11r2–5) End sarvāṃgaṃ rakṣayed akṣi kūrmayugmaṃ punaḥ puna (!) || māyāyugmaṃ hi rasanāṃ pātu jāḍyavināśinī || 22 || vahni priyā sadā pātu sādhakānāṃ hi vigrahaṃ || tatsarvaṃ tāriṇī rakṣed dharmatripurasuṃdarī || 23 || bhayād rakṣākaraṃ puṇyaṃ kavacaṃ sarvadā paṭhet || maṃtrasiddhikaraṃ sākṣān mahāpāṭakanāśana (!) || 24 || [[ekavāraṃ paṭhed yas tu pūjāyāś ca phalaṃ labhet mokṣārthī labhate mokṣaṃ dhanārthī dhanam āpnuyāt]] rājyārthī rājyam āpnoti kavacaṃ śravaṇā (!) chiva (!) || idaṃ kavacarājaṃ vai yad uktaṃ snehabhāvataḥ || 26 || tvayā guptataraṃ kāryaṃ prakāśe siddhiroddhakṛt (!) || 27 || (fol. 12r1–5) Colophon iti śrīśāṃbhavīsaṃhitāyāṃ dakṣiṇākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 5 || (fol. 12r5–6)

Beginning namaḥ śrīkālikāyai || skaṃda uvāca || || kailāśaśikhare raṃmye (!) devadevaṃ jagatprabhuṃ || kena budhyā kālavaśyaṃ bruhi (!) me parameśvara || 1 || iśvara (!) uvāca || saṃdhu (!) pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā skaṃda gopyād gopyattaraṃ tvidaṃ || tam apriyatvāt ṣaḍvaktra vakakravyaṃ tūttamottamaṃ || 2 || kavacaṃ kālikāyās tu kālavaṃcaṃnam (!) uttamaṃ || kālikā kālikā nāma paṭhatyaṃ (!) sarvadā jayaḥ || 3 || oṃ namaḥ kālīhṛdayakalaprakāśajñānamayapradīpāya || || atha kīlakakavacaṃ || asya śrīkālikākavacavajrapaṭalasya śrīmahārudraṛṣimahākālīdevatā anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ śrīṃ klīṃ krīṃ bījāni kurṃ krāṃ saṃ śaktayaḥ | klīṃ uṃ hruṃ bījāni kā[[la]]vaṃcane viniyogaḥ || (fol. 12r6–12v2) End japa maṃtraḥ || oṃ krīṃ klīṃ slīṃ śruṃ hluṃ svāhā || || nyāsaḥ || krāṃ śirasi gaṃḍe karṣāyor nasi mukhe jihvāṃ daṃtahṛtnābhau kaṭiliṃgamūlajaṃghāsaṃdhim adhyātala dakṣabhujāgrabhujavāmabhujāgrabhujamūrddhni sarvāṃge || || iti bījai nyaset || || brahmāṃḍamṛtyupātāle paścān maṃtrabījamaṃtreṇa kīlanaṃ || sadā prasannatvayā saṃbho sādhane śaktidakṣiṇā mama bhakta (!) priyaṃ vadāmi maṃtresmin siddhisādhanaṃ || bhūtaṛṣimaṃtrasya śāpamocanadakṣiṇā || || ity aṣṭakīlanamaṃtrodhārapūjāvidhayaḥ || kraṃ kraṃ klīṃ ruṃ ruṃ uṃ uṃ hūṃ hūṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ḍaṃ ḍīṃ ḍāṃ śrīṃ śrūṃ hrūṃ hrūṃ klrīṃ klrīṃ hlūṃ hlūṃ ḍoṃ ḍoṃ bhruṃ bhruṃ hlauṃ hlauṃ śrūṃ śrūṃ jvaṃ jvaṃ līṃ praṃ pāṃ puṃ grāṃ grāṃ glīṃ krīṃ krīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ kahakaha hlīṃ strīṃ oṃ krāṃ krīṃ hrīṃ hruṃ klīṃ klīṃ śrūṃ śrīṃ hlūṃ hlīṃ hlāṃ hlauṃ śrīṃ chrīṃ klīṃ klūṃ hraṃ haṃ krīṃ śrīṃ haṃ kālikāyai namaḥ || || (fol. 13v1–7) Colophon iti śrīkālikākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || 6 || (fol. 13v7–8)

«Complete Transcript:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrī devy uvāca || deva deva jagannātha bhaktānugrahakāraka || sarvāpaḍnyāsam (!) āpnoti paritrāṇa kathaṃ naraḥ || 1 || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi guhyād guhyataraṃ paraṃ || āpadduddharaṇaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ || 2 || śatam aṣṭottaraṃ caiva japtvā dhyātvā ca kālikāṃ || iṃdrajidvaṃdhanān (!) muktaḥ purā devī sacīpati || 3 || bhairavosya ṛṣiś chaṃdo gāyatrī devatā prabhuḥ || kālikā viniyogo sya sarvāpadvinivāraṇe || 4 || oṃ śiro me kālikā pātu krīṃ mādyāṅge yutā natiḥ || lalāṭaṃ caṃḍikā pātu kaṃṭhaṃ pātu parāṃbikā || 5 || cāmuṃḍā hṛdayaṃ pātu nābhiṃ maṃgalacaṃḍikā || ugracaṃḍā śiraḥ pātu pracaṃḍā pātu padyugaṃ || 6 || bhairavī tvaritā durgā cāmuṃḍā caṃḍanāśikā || jayadurgā viśālākṣī bhadrakālī kapālinī || 7 || śivadūtīti tāḥ pātu daśadikṣu ca māṃ sadā || tārā kālī śivā svāhā jayaṃti maṃgalā svadhā || 8 || yoginī yoganiṃdrā ca chinnamastā ca ḍākinī || rājadvāre jale vaṃnye saṃyoge saṃkaṭe grahe || 9 || rājñaḥ khaḍganipāṭe (!) ca kārāgārādibhīṣaṇe || iti sarvatra rakṣaṃtu sadā maṃ paramāyudhaiḥ || 10 || idaṃ ca kathitaṃ devi kavacaṃ brahmarūpiṇaṃ || āpaduddhāraṇaṃ nāma sarvāpadvinivārakaṃ || 11 || asyāpi dhāraṇād devi sarvāpannāśayet kṣaṇāt || devyai puṣpāṃjaliṃ datvā kavacaṃ prapaṭhet sakṛt || 12 || sarvāpan nāśayat satyaṃ tatkṣaṇān nātra saṃśayaḥ || trivārapaṭhanāt satyaṃ nāśayitvākhilāpadaṃ || 13 || sarvapriyatamo bhūtvā sarvaiśvaryam avāpnuyāt || lohapaṃjaramadhyastho galayad vaṃdhanair dṛḍhaṃ || 14 || devīṃ hṛdi samārādhya paṭhitvāṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ || khaḍgādibhir avadhyaḥ syād vaṃdhanāt mucyate dhruvaṃ || 15 || guruvaktrāt samāsādya lakṣaṃ yaḥ prapaṭhec chuciḥ || parituṣṭā tadā kālī tasya prayakṣatāṃ jagat || 16 || iti kālīkṛtye dakṣiṇakālikāyā āpadduddhāraṇaṃ kavacaṃ samāptaṃ || 7 || || (fols. 13v8–14v4)

«Complete Transcript:» bhairava uvāca || dakṣiṇakālikāyā bhogadakavacasya śrīmahākālabhairava ṛṣis triṣṭupchadaḥ (!) śrīdakṣiṇā devatā kālīyāḥ bhogadakavacapāṭhe viniyogaḥ || || kapālaṃ pātu cāmuṇḍā keśaṃ rakṣatu kauśikī || śrutiṃ pātu vṛṣārūḍhā netraṃ rakṣatu kālikā || 1 || liṃgadeśe raktakaṃṭhā daśapatre hṛdaṃbujā || pādau rakṣet tu lolākṣī sarvagā hṛdayāṃbuje || 2 || idāṃ rakṣatu daṃtogrā caṃḍogrā nābhimaṃḍale || suṣumnā bhogadā pātu tta (!) pātu svabhāvajā || 3 || ādhārā pātu bheruṃḍā aparṇā pātu piṃgalā || ity eva kavacaṃ devi paṭhanīyaṃ surāsuraiḥ || 4 || gaṃdharvai rākṣasair yakṣaiḥ kiṃnarair mānavair api || bhogadaṃ kavacaṃ devī bhuktidaṃ dhanadaṃ priye || 5 || āyurārogyadaṃ devi kavacaṃ śatrumarddanaṃ || kavacaṃ durllabhaṃ devi triṣu loke śubhāvahaṃ || 6 || haviṣyāśīyatāhāro yadi syād bhaktibhāvitaḥ || paṭhec chive gṛhe vāpi kavacaṃ manmukhodidaṃ (!) || 7 || sarvakāryyārthasiddhiḥ syān nātra kāryyā vicāraṇāt (!) || paṭhanīyaṃ prayatnena sarvakāryam abhīpsubhi || 8 || na deyaṃ paraśiṣyāyā sādhakāya durātmane || 9 || iti śrīkālīkalpe śrīdakṣiṇakālikāyāḥ bhogadaṃ kavacaṃ || 8 || || (fols. 14v4–15r4)

«Complete Transcript:» vīrabhadra uvāca || kālikākavacasyāsya ṛṣir bhairavam (!) ucyate || chaṃdonuṣṭup samākhyātaṃ devī dakṣiṇakālikā || 1 || śakti dvāviṃśabījāni viniyogas tu sakṣaṇe (!) || śirasi nayanabhāle bhrūyuge karṇakaṃḍe (!) || 2 || vadanaradanajihvā skaṃdhadeśe gale ca || bhujahṛdayasapārśve pṛṣṭanābhau ca rudre || 3 || kaṭigraddjalarapāde (!) sarvato maṃtravarṇā || guṇaṃ bījaṃ yugaṃ māyā lajjāyugmaṃ ca yādhana (!) || 4 || guṇamāyā trayā vahni vallabhāṃtāḥ kramād iha || śāstravāde mahā ghore śastrasaṃvādasaṃgame || 5 || maṃgalāsaṃnnakāryyeṣu staṃbhane mohane tathā || māraṇādau tathā kārye nirvighnaṃ me prajāyate || 6 || yadi vāśuddhanigade sabhāyāṃ vādi durgame || śuddhaṃ tad iti jānaṃ (!) tu sarvatra haravallabhe || 7 || mahāpretāsanaṃ pātu śivā me rakṣatāṃ sadā || rasanā me nṛpakarajā muṃḍmālā sadāvatu || 8 || abhayaṃ varadaṃ caiva khaḍgo muṃḍaś ca rakṣatu || śavadvayaṃ tathā karṇe ghoradaṃṣṭrā tathāvatu || 9 || muktaś ca cikurāḥ saṃtu mama vighnavināśakā || dakṣiṇā kālikā pātu śmaśāne yā ca saṃsthitā || 10 || bhadrakālī sadā pātu caṃḍamuṃḍavināśinī || cāmuṃḍā sarvataḥ pātu pātālatalavāsinī || 11 || mahākālaḥ sadā pātu bījabhūṣitamastaka || itīdaṃ kavacaṃ yas tu kālikāyāḥ paṭhen nara || 12 || maṃtravit prayataḥ śrīmān sa prāpnoti manogataṃ || bhūrjapatre suvarṇe vā rājake paṭṭake thavā || 13 || likhitvā dhārayed yas tu yatra kutrāpi maṃtravit || tasya smaraṇamātreṇa vādino vilayaṃ gatāḥ || 14 || sarva (!) manogataṃ tasya karanīropamaṃ bhavet || ajñātvā kavacaṃ yas tu pūjayed aṃvikāṃvaraḥ || 15 || yāvaj jīvaṃ bhaved rogī svalpaṃ bhavati jīvitaṃ || bhaktyā dhārayate yas tu sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt || 16 || || iti vīrabhadrataṃtre kālīkavacaṃ samāptaṃ || 9 || || (fol. 15r4–15v9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha pṛthvirāmeśvarārccanaṃ || dvārasamaṇḍaladayakāva kṛrttimukhapūjā || || tatrādau nosiya || cetasvāna chuye cetasvāna akṣatajonāvacote || adyādi || asmatśrīpṛthvīrāmeśvarārccananimityarthaṃ kartuṃ śrīsūryyāyārghaṃ namaḥ || puṣyaṃ namaḥ veda || oṃ ākṛṣṇe || guru namaskāra || oṃ akaṇḍamaṇḍaleti || prāṇāyāmanyāsaṃ kārayet || (exp. 6t1–5) End oṃ hrauṃ netratrayāya vaṣaṭ || oṃ hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || || saṃhāramudrānavalithoye || || nirmālya iśānakoṇasachoye pūjā || oṃ caṃ caṃdamūrttahe namaḥ || sūryasākṣi iti ācamanaṃ || || mahādevathānanapihā vayā dohacāpūjāyānā valivāye uttaradvāra pūjā || pūrvadvārapūjā || dakṣiṇadvārapūjā || paścimadvārapūjā || || āgaṃchesaduhāvanāvajyālayā kosapūjā || (exp. 8t1–5) Colophon iti pṛthvirāmeśvaranityārccanaṃ || || (exp. 8t1–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || kālīrahasye || vinā pītvā surāṃ bhuktvā māṃsaṃ gatvā rajasvalām || yo japed dakṣiṇāṃ devīṃ tasya duḥkhaṃ pade pade || iti vacanād idam āvaśyakam || rajasvalāmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvvapāpair vyapohati || saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ ca kurute rājasūyādikaṃ phalam || 1 || tasyāḥ sparśanamātreṇa labhen muktiṃ caturvvidhām | tasyāḥ saṃgamamātreṇa trailokyotpāṭane kṣamaḥ || 2 || śraddhayā pūjayet tasyā bhagaṃ sarajaśobhitam || nyāsaṃ kṛtvā svadeheṣu kalābhiḥ kāmaṣoḍaśaiḥ || 3 || mātṛkāṃ nyasya deheṣu anulomavilomataḥ | śivarūpaṃ vicintya svaṃ bhagapūjāṃ samācaret || 4 || koṭijanmārjitaiḥ puṇyair bhaktyā yaiḥ pūjitaṃ bhagam | viśeṣaiḥ pūjitā yoniḥ puṇyasaṃkhyā na vidyate || 5 || (fol. 1r1–6) End satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || sapuṣpabhagapūjā ca brahmalokepi durllabhā || 15 || asya stotrasya māhātmyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate || viraṃcir maghavā viṣṇuḥ paṭhate ca niraṃtaram || 16 || stotrapāṭhaprabhāveṇa sṛṣṭisthitir bhaved dhruvam || tasmāt sarvvaprayatnena devi gopyakaraṃ śubham || 17 || smaret prathamapuṣpiṇīṃ rudhirabiṃdunīlāṃvarāṃ gṛhītamadhupātrikāṃ madavighūrṇanetrāṃcalām || 18 || ghanastachabharonnatāṃ galitacolikāṃ śyāmalāṃ karasphuritavallakīṃ viśadaśaṃkhanāṭaṃkinīṃ || 19 || (fol. 1v4–9) Colophon iti śrīkālīprastāre īśvarapārvvatīsaṃvāde puṣpiṇīstotram || catuḥpathādau arddharātraṃ prayoge ca oṃ padme padme mahapadme padmādhanimāye svāhā || siddhasārasvate || eiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ hraṃ hmauḥ [[sauḥ]] shauḥ vada vada vāgvādini trāṃ trī trīṃ nīlasarasvati eiṃ eiṃ eiṃ kāhi kāhi kalaṃkī svāhā || 34 || maṃtraḥ || (fol. 1v4–9)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo gaṇeśāya || pārvaty uvāca || pracaṇḍacaṇḍikā vidyā pūrvvoktā sarvvasammatā | tasyā nāmasahasran tu maheśaṃ kathayasva me || kailāśaśikhare ramye nānāpātrasamanvite | siddhate parvvasarvvaiś ca sevite parvvatottame || 2 || nānādhātusamākīrṇṇe pāvane kānanottame | gaṅgānirmmanapāśāne (!) śīkarāmbukaṇāvṛte || 3 || dhyānāṃ (!) paratam āsīnaṃ prasannamukhapaṅkajaṃ | vivyucchaṭābhinayanaṃ trinetraṃ śūladhāriṇaṃ || 4 || kapālaṃ paraśur vvīṇāṃ mṛgapātaiś ca bhūṣitaṃ | ḍamaruṃ pāśakaṃ śaṅkhaṃ yogibhiḥ parimaṇḍitaṃ || 5 || (fol. 1r1–4) End tadā bhavati santuṣṭā skandamātā sarasvatī | kāmākhyān vā jayed vidyāṃ lakṣmyādyāḥ sarvvasiddhidāḥ || 185 || uṣpoṣya vidhinā dhīmān pūjayitvā kumārikāṃ || tadyonau pūjayed vidyāṃ ṣaṭsahasraṃ dine dine || 186 || na doṣo vidyate tatra brahmaṇā bhāṣitaṃ purā || ācārāṣṭakarūpeṇa siddhirūpo na saṃśayaḥ || 187 || (fol. 8v1–3) Colophon iti śrī pracaṇḍacaṇḍikāḥ sahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || ❖ pūrvvapāṇṇārddhakarṇikāmbhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ caṇḍarociṣaḥ | javākusumaṃ saṃkāśaṃ nava vandhūkasannibhaṃ || tanmadhye yonisaṃkāśaṃ trimārggam abhidhīyate || tasyā madhye mahādevī cchinnamastām avasthitāṃ || karakacchapikāyuktaṃ madhye padmāsanasthitāṃ || yoganidrāsamāyuktāṃ hṛdayaṃ sthitalocanāṃ || pīnavakṣojayugalāṃ dhyānaṃ vāniḥ (!) karaṃ smṛtaṃ || dhyeyam avajaṭīnāntu gṛhasthānāṃ niśāmaye | antare svaśarīrasya nābhinīlajasaṅgatāṃ || nirllepā nirgguṇā prañā bālacandrasamaprabhāṃ || samādhimātragamyāntāṃ guṇatritayaveṣṭitāṃ | kalātītaguṇātītāṃ muktimārggapradāyinīṃ || || samvat 805 pauṣaśukla 13 saṃpūrṇṇa || || (fol. 8v4–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ | atha pratyaṃgirā mālāmaṃtraḥ | sapādaśatākṣaraḥ || asya śrīpratyaṃgirāmālāmaṃtrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ | anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ pratyaṃgirādevatā || oṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ || parakṛtyānāṃ nāśe viniyogaḥ || brahmaṇe ṛṣaye namaḥ || śirasi | anuṣṭupchaṃdase namaḥ mukhe | pratyaṃgirāyai devatāyai namaḥ hṛdaye | oṃ bījāyai namaḥ guhye | hrīṃ śaktaye namaḥ pādayoḥ || (fol. 1r1–6) End māyādivarṇṇatritayaṃ śatror netre śrutīmukhaṃ pratyekaṃ tu niruṃdhānaṃ ciṃtayet sādhakottamaḥ || 7 || varmasaṃkṣobhitaṃ (!) tvastraṃ (!) riporādhāradeśataḥ || utthāpya vahniṃ taddehe pradahat samanusmaran || 8 || evaṃ varṇān smaran maṃtrī japen maṃtraṃ sahasrakaṃ | maṃḍalabhitayādarvāṅnārayetyeva (!) ciddiṣāṃ (!) || 9 || yaḥ kurute karmaprāṇāyāmajapādibhiḥ || saṃśodhayitvā svātmānaṃ svarakṣāyai hariṃ smaret || (fol. 3v5–10) Colophon iti pratyaṃgirākāmyaprayogaḥ || || (fol. 3v10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ siddhipadmāyai || śrīdevyuvāca || śrutaṃ sarvvaṃ rahasyaṃ me tvatprasādān maheśvara || idānīṃ śrotum icchāmi varmmapratyaṅgirābhidhaṃ || vajrapañjaramadhye tu bhāvayet pañjaraṃ mahat || abhedyaṃ sarvvaśastrāṇāṃ kavacaṃ suradurllabhaṃ || abhedyaṃ sarvvaśastrāṇāṃ kavacaṃ suradurllabhaṃ || yena saṃnapta(!)rāmeṇa rāvaṇo nihato raṇe || tadvarggaṃ kathaye śārtaṃ(!) yadi yogyo si dhāraṇe || tvatprasādāc ca sakalaṃ kavacaṃ saṃśrutaṃ mayā || tathāpi śrotum icchāmi savīryyaḥ bhavatādhṛtaṃ || || (fol. 1r1–5) End yo nyaset kavacaṃ divyaṃ śṛṇu punyaṃ mahatphalaṃ || sarvvavyādhivinirmmukto nṛpāvān guṇavān bhavet || tasya vidyā na jāyante vighnādyā tasya te dhruvaṃ || na rāgās tasya jāyante na vyādhi paribhūyate || sarvvan (!) tasya vaśaṃ yānti prāṇinaś ca caturvvidhān || varṣam ekaṃ paṭhed bhaktyā kavacaṃ viṣṇunirmmitaṃ | sa tu sarvvān vinirjjitya rājarājo bhaved dhruvaṃ || tasmāt sarvvaprayatnena paṭhanīyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ || || (fol. 5v4–8) Colophon iti devīyāmale pratyaṅgirākavacaṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 5v8)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ | śrīsiddhilakṣmai devyai || || śrī devyūvāca || śrūtaṃ rahasyaṃ me deva tvatprasādāt mahiśvara | idāṃni śrotum ichāmi varmmapratyaṃṅgirābhidaṃ || 1 || vajraḥpañjaramadhyaṣu sāraṃ yatpañjaraṃ mahat || abhedya varvvamantrāṇāśastrāṇāṃ vinivāraṇaṃ || 2 || sarvvavarmmeṣu yacchreṣṭaṃ bhavatā viṣṇūnā dhṛtaṃ || sārāt sārata divyaṃ kavacaṃ suradurllabhaṃ || 3 || yema saṃtajya divyena kavacenaṃ maheśvaraḥ abhedyaṃ ca mahāviryya yadi yogyosmi dhāraṇe || 4 || (fol. 1v1–6) End nātaḥ parataraṃ lābhaṃ vidyate bhuvanodare || 68 || yo nyaset kavacaṃ divyaṃ śṛṇu puṇyaphalaṃ mahat || vyādhiduḥkhavinirmmukto rūpavān gunavān bhavet || 69 || tasya vighno na jāyat te vighno dhātrasya te dhruvaṃ || 70 || rogās tasya jāyate śatrubhir nābhibhūyate || sarvvaṃ tasya vasaṃ yānti prāṇīnaś caturvvidhān || 71 || varṣamyakaṃ paṭhet bhaktyā kavacaṃ viṣṇunirmmitaṃ || śatru sarvvān vinirjjitya rājarājo bhaved dhruvaṃ || 72 || tasmāt sarvvaprayatnena pathaniyattusādaraṃ || 73 || (fol. 8v2–8) Colophon iti śrīmāhālakṣmīvratakathā samāpta 1 śubhaṃ || || || || (fol. 8v8)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrītripurāyai || || kailāsaśikharāsinaṃ(!) devadevaṃ jagadguruṃ | śaṃkaraṃ paripapraccha parvatī parameśvarī || pārvvaty uvāca || bhagavan sarvvadharmmajña sarvvaśāstrāgamādiṣu | āpaduddhāraṇaṃ mantraṃ sarvvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇāṃ || 2 || sarvveṣāṃ ścaiva tu tārāṃ hitārthaṃ vāñchitaṃ mayā || viśeṣatas tu rājñā vai śāntipuṣṭiprasādhanaṃ || 3 || (exps. 24b6–25t3) End jāpyaṃ śāntikaraṃ vatsa satvārthapratisādhakaṃ | nāstikāya na dātavyaṃ devadrākṣara(!) nindite || gurubhaktyā ktāyāyādatavyaṃ(!) nānyaketyo(!) ʼdhikaṃ tathā || prātar ādityakīrtyan tu sarvvapāpapranāśanaṃ(!) | goghnaś caiva kṛtaghnaś ca mucyate sarvvapātakai(!) | trikāla(!) saikakālaṃ vā yaḥ paṭhed ravisannidhau || sobhīṣṭaphalam āpnoti nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā || || (exp. 29t5–8) Colophon iti śivokte mahāmantre sūryyāvatāre sūryaśāntiḥ samāpta(!) || (exp. 29t8–9)

Beginning ❖ atha annapūrṇṇākavaca || śrī devyuvāca || || kathitāś cānnapūrṇṇāyā yā yā vidyāḥ sudurllabhāḥ | kṛpayā kathitāḥ sarvvāḥ śrutāś cādhigatā mayā || || śrī īśvarūvāca || śṛṇu pārvvati vakṣyāmi sāvadhānāvadhāraya | brahmavidyāsvarūpaṃ ca madaiśvaryakārakaṃ || paṭhanād dhāraṇān martyas trailokyaiśvaryabhāg bhavet | trailokyarakṣaṇasyāsya cchaṃdo vinā annapūrṇṇā devatā sarvvasiddhidā | (exp. 36t1–4) End iti te kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ trailokyamaṃgalaṃ paraṃ | yad dhṛtvā paṭhanaṃ ddevā vāḥ sarvvaiśvaryam avāpnuyuḥ || brahmā viṣṇuś ca rudraś ca paṭhanād dhāraṇād yataḥ || sṛjaty avati haṃti ca kalpe kalpe pṛthak pṛthak || puṣpāṃjalyaṣṭakaṃ devyai mūlenaiva paṭhet tataḥ || yugāyutakṛtāyās tu pūjāyāḥ phalam āpnuyāt | vāṇī vaktre vaset tasya satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || aṣṭottaravidhiṃ cāsya pūraścaryyāvidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | sūryye vilikhya guṭikāṃ svarṇasthāṃ dhārayed yadi || kaṃṭhe vā dakṣiṇe vāhau sopi sarvatapomayaḥ || brahmāstrādīni śastrāṇi tadā taṃ prāpya pārvvatī || mālyāni kusumanyeva bhavaṃtyeva na saṃśayaḥ || || (exps. 36b3–9) Colophon iti śrīannapūrṇṇākavaca samāptaṃ || (exps. 36b9)

Beginning ❖ śrī devyūvāca || kailāsaśikhalāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ maheśvaraṃ | pārvvatī parayā prītyā prapaccha śaśisekharaṃ || pārvvaty uvāca || katham īśāna sarvvajña lokeśa su[[kha]]m uttamaṃ || labhaṃte mānavā nityaṃ bādhyaṃte pīḍayā na ca || dāridryahatacintānāṃ na buddhiḥ pratibhāti hi | alasāḥ karmahīnāś ca na jāpyate prapiḍanāt || kathaṃ sāmrājyasaukhyan te labhante niścalaṃ vibhu | tan me kathaya deveśa yadi snehosti māṃ prati || (exp. 37t1–4) End bāhau śirasi kaṃṭhe vā saṃpūjya dhārayed yadi || bhaktā bhogān yathā kāmān aṃte divyāṃgaṇo bhavet || tasya syur vvaśagā bhūpā lokavaśyaṃ prajanti hi || śatravo nāśamāyāṃ[[nti]] mitrānāṃ vardhate sukham || yāni cecchaṃti kāmāni haṭhastāni labhen naraḥ || bhūtapratapiśācāś ca rākṣasā dānavāś ca ye || na draṣṭum api śaktās te dhṛtaṃ yena mahāstavaṃ || sarvvatra caṃ[[ca]]lā lakṣmī niścalā tasya maṃdire | vāṇī tasya vased vaktre devīṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhitvā tu yatra santeva gacchati || tatra tatra labhen nityaṃ vijayaṃ bhogam uttamaṃ || || (exp. 45t3–8) Colophon iti śra rudrayāmale umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde annapūrṇṇāsahasranāmastotraṃ samāptam || || || (exp. 45t8–9)

Beginning ❖ śrī devyūvāca || kailāsaśikhalāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ maheśvaraṃ | pārvvatī parayā prītyā prapaccha śaśisekharaṃ || pārvvaty uvāca || katham īśāna sarvvajña lokeśa su[[kha]]m uttamaṃ || labhaṃte mānavā nityaṃ bādhyaṃte pīḍayā na ca || dāridryahatacintānāṃ na buddhiḥ pratibhāti hi | alasāḥ karmahīnāś ca na jāpyate prapiḍanāt || kathaṃ sāmrājyasaukhyan te labhante niścalaṃ vibhu | tan me kathaya deveśa yadi snehosti māṃ prati || (exp. 37t1–4) End bāhau śirasi kaṃṭhe vā saṃpūjya dhārayed yadi || bhaktā bhogān yathā kāmān aṃte divyāṃgaṇo bhavet || tasya syur vvaśagā bhūpā lokavaśyaṃ prajanti hi || śatravo nāśamāyāṃ[[nti]] mitrānāṃ vardhate sukham || yāni cecchaṃti kāmāni haṭhastāni labhen naraḥ || bhūtapratapiśācāś ca rākṣasā dānavāś ca ye || na draṣṭum api śaktās te dhṛtaṃ yena mahāstavaṃ || sarvvatra caṃ[[ca]]lā lakṣmī niścalā tasya maṃdire | vāṇī tasya vased vaktre devīṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhitvā tu yatra santeva gacchati || tatra tatra labhen nityaṃ vijayaṃ bhogam uttamaṃ || || (exp. 45t3–8) Colophon iti śra rudrayāmale umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde annapūrṇṇāsahasranāmastotraṃ samāptam || || || (exp. 45t8–9)

Beginning -dapi | ādityaṃ hṛdayaṃ nityaṃ jāpyaṃ tac chṛṇu pāṇḍava || oṃ asya śrī ādityahṛdayastotramantrasya śrīkṛṣṇa ṛṣiḥ śrīsūryyanārāyaṇo devatā anuṣṭupjagatīśchandaḥ haritahasanathaṃ(!) divākaraṃ ghṛṇir iti bījaṃ oṃ namo bhagavate jite vaiśvānara jātavedase nama iti śaktiḥ oṃ namo bhagavate ādityāyeti kīrakaṃ (!) mama sakala⟪kāla⟫kāmaprāptyarthaṃ jape viniyogaḥ || || (exp. 4t1–5) End namo dharmmavidhānāya namaste kṛtaśākiṇe || namaḥ pratyakṣadevāya bhāskarāya namo namaḥ || udayagiri⟪muri⟫mupetaṃ bhāskaraṃ padmahastaṃ sakalabhuvananetraṃ ratnaratnopadheyaṃ || timirakari⟪rakari⟫mṛgendraṃ bādhakaṃ padminīnāṃ | suravaram abhivande sundaraṃ viśvadīpaṃ || padmāsanaḥ padmakaraḥ padmagarhasamadyutiḥ | saptā(!)svaraḥ | saṃsthaś ca dvibhuja syāt sadā raviḥ || ādityasya namaskāraṃ tye (!) kurvvanti dine dine | jatmāntara(!)sahasreṣu dāridryaṃ naiva jāyate || || (exp. 17b1–6) Colophon iti śrībhaviṣyottarapurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇārjjunasaṃvāde ādityahṛdayaṃ nāma stotraṃ samāptam iti || || śubha(!) || || (exp. 17b6–7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namas tasyai || śrī devy uvāca || śrutaṃ sarvvarahasyaṃ me tvatprasādāt maheśvara || idānīṃ śrotum icchāmi varmmaṃ(!) pratyaṃgirābhidhaṃ || vajrapañjaramadhye tu sāraṃ yasya jaraṃ(!) mahat || abhedyaṃ sarvvamantrāṇāṃ śastrānāṃ(!) vinivāranaṃ || sarvvavarmmeśu(!) yācchreṣṭaṃ(!) bhavatā viṣṇunā dhṛtaṃ || sārāt sārataraṃ divyaṃ kavacaṃ suradurllabhaṃ || (exp. 18t1–4) End tasya vighnā na jāyante vighnaughān naśyate dhruvaṃ na rogās tasya jāyaṃte na vyādhiparibhūyate || 69 || sarvvaṃ tasya vaśaṃ jāti(!) prāṇinaś ca caturvvidhān varṣam ekaṃ paṭhed bhaktyā kavacaṃ viṣṇunirmmitaṃ || 70 || śatrūn sarvvān vinirjjitya rājarājo bhave(!) dhruvaṃ tasmāt sarvvaprayatnena paṭhaniya(!) sadā budhaiḥ || 51 || (exp. 24b1–5) Colophon iti devīyāmale pratyaṃgilākavacaṃ(!) samāptaṃḥ (!) || || ❁ || || (exp. 24b5–6)

Beginning ///bhaṃ vidyate bhuvanodare || yo nyaset kavacaṃ divyaṃ śṛṇu puṇyaphalaṃ maha/// nirmmūkto rūpavān dhanavān bhavet || tasya vighnā na jāyante vighnau dhyaṃ na /// rogās tasya na jāyante śatrubhir nābhibhūyate || (exp. 2t1–3) End ity etat kavacaṃ proktaṃ dharmmakāmārtha/// syaṃ paramaṃ tvidaṃ sarvvārthasādhakaṃ || 54 || paṭhanāt sarvvapāpāni/// hṛdeva paṭhed e[[va]]tat kavacaṃ viṣṇunirmmitaṃ || 55 || sa sarvvayajñasya laṃla/// saṃgrāmeṣu jayec chatrūn mātaṅgān iva keśarī || 56 || dahe/// drān dahet sadā || vyādhayaś ca na jāyante na ca duḥkhaṃ kadācana ||/// ḍā sarvvaṃ pretyūpajāyate | anekajanmajanitaṃ puṇyātntu kavacaṃ labhet (exp. 8b1–5) Colophon

Beginning śrīḥ || traivarṇikānām api kalāvāgamoktamārgamatyaṃ sā taduktaṃ varāhapurāṇe | alābhe vedamaṃtrāṇāṃ paṃcasatrodito vidhiḥ || kiṃ ca āgamoktānāṃ savīryatā °° prapaṃcasāre || kṛte śrutyuktamārgāt pras tretāyāṃ stutibhāvataḥ || tvāpare syāt purāṇoktāḥ kalā vāgamasaṃbhavāḥ || aśūdrāḥ śūdrakalpā hi brāhmaṇāḥ kalisaṃbhavāḥ || (exp. 3t1–4) End bhuktau muktau tathā kṛṣṭau madhvamāyāṃ japet sudhīḥ aṃguṣṭānāmikābhyāṃ ca japaṭhantarakarmaṇi || tarjanyaṃguṣṭasaṃyogād vidveṣoccāṭane japaḥ || kaniṣṭāṃguṣṭasaṃyogāj japen māraṇakarmaṇi || japānyakālet tāṃ mālāṃ pūjayitvā tu gopayet || nānyamaṃtraṃ japet tatra yadīcchec chivim ātmanaḥ || guruṃ maṃtraṃ tatopi mālāṃ mudrāṃ gopayet | bhūtavetālādayo haraṃti yasmāt tasmād guptaṃ japet | jīrṇe sūtre sūtrānyaṃ yojayitvā japet śataṃ || pramādāt yati tte yathoditaṃ prakṣālya śataṃ japet || iti mālāprakaraṇam | (exp. 13, 4–10) Colophon

Beginning oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya || oṃ namo hanumate mahābalaparākramāya asya paṃcamukhīhanumatmaṃtrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ gāyatrī chaṃdaḥ paṃcamukhīvidaṛṣiḥ hanumānadevatā hrīṃ bījaṃ śrīṃ śaktiḥ krauṃ kīlakaṃ krūṃ kavacaṃ hrauṃ astrāya phaṭ | iti digbaṃdhaḥ || īśvara uvāca || atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvāṃgasuṃdarī yatkṛtaṃ devadevesī (!) dhyānaṃ hanumatapriyaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ mahābhīmaṃ tripaṃcanayanair yutaṃ bāhur daśabhir yuktaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhidaṃ pūrvaṃ tu vānaraṃ vaktraṃ koṭisūryyasamaprabham daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukuṭikuṭilekṣaṇam asyaiva dakṣiṇaṃ vaktraṃ nārasiṃhaṃ mahadbhutaṃ atyugratejavapuṣaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ bhayanāśanaṃ (fol. 1r1–11, exp. 3left) End oṃ ūrddhvamukhāya hayagrīvāya aṃjanīsutāya vāyuputrāya mahābalāya rāmeṣṭaphālguṇasakhāya sītāśokaduḥkhanivāraṇāya lakṣmaṇaprāṇarakṣakāya daśagrīvaharaṇāya śrīrāmacandrapādukāya mahāvīryyāya brahmabrahmāṃḍanāya kāyapaṃcamukhīvīrahanumaṃtāya namaḥ bhūtapretapiśācabrahmarākṣasaśākinīdākinīaṃtarikṣagrahaparayaṃtraparataṃtrasarvagrahauccāṭanāya sakalaśatrusaṃhāraṇāya paṃcamukhīhanumānasakalavaśīkaraṇāya sakalalokopakārakāya paṃcamukhīhanumānavaraprasādakāya mahāsarvarakṣakāya jaṃ jaṃ jaṃ jaṃ jaṃ svāhā idaṃ kavacaṃ paṭhitvā tu mahākavacaṃ paṭhen naraḥ ekavāraṃ paṭhet stotraṃ sarvaśatrunivāraṇaṃ dvivāraṃ tu paṭhen nityaṃ putrapautrapravarddhanam trivāraṃ ca paṭhen nityaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ śive catuvāraṃ paṭhen nityaṃ sarvaroganivāraṇam paṃcavāraṃ paṭhen nityaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ ca vaśa (!) nayet ṣaṣṭavāraṃ paṭhen nityaṃ sarvadevavaśīkṛtam saptavāraṃ paṭhen nityaṃ sarvasaubhāgyadāyakaṃ aṣṭavāraṃ paṭhen nityaṃ iṣṭakāmārthasiddhidaṃ navavāraṃ trisaptakena trailokyajñānadarśanāt kavacaṃ smaraṇenaiva mahālakṣmīsamanvitam guhyādiguhyagoptṛtvaṃ gṛhāṇasmat kṛtaṃ ca yat siddhir bhavatu me deva tvatprasādān maheśvaraṃ || || (fols. 4v7–5v3, exps. 6 left–7 left) Colophon iti śrīrāmacandraproktaṃ hanumatkavacaṃ sampūrṇam || (fol. 5v4, exp. 7 left)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ oṃ hariḥ oṃ yo kalpayaṃti norayaḥ krūrāṃ kṛtyāṃ vadhūm iva tāṃ brahmaṇā pānirṇughdraḥ pratyakartāram ṛcchatu || 1 || śīrṣaṇvatīṃ karṇavatīṃ vi[[ṣṇu]]rūpāṃ bhayaṃkarīṃ yaḥ prāhiṇod ihādyatvāṃ vitaṃtvaṃ yojayāsubhiḥ 2 yenādiṣṭeha vadasi pratikūlamadhāyini tam eveto nivarttās tvam āsmān ṛcche anāgasaḥ 3 abhivartasvakarttāraṃ nirastāsmābhir ojasā āyurasya nikṛntasva prajāṃ ca puruṣādinī 4 (fol. 1v1–5) End ye te jahyaṃ jasān javo mahyam agne sadā dhiyo durmadā anagrāsaḥ āvidhyaināṃ chociṣāvidhya taṃtūn vaivasvatasya sadanaṃ yasya 43 yenorapiṃ duṣcaritāso agne jahumartyāso anṛtaṃ vadantaḥ teṣāṃ vapūṃṣyarciṣā jātavedaḥ śuṣkaṃ na vṛkṣam abhisaṃdahasva 44 yo na svoñjaraṇo yaś ca niṣṭhayo jijhāṃsati devās te sarve dhūrṣatuṃ brahma varmayamāntaraṃ śarma varma mamāntaram 45 ava brahma dviṣo jahi aṃgirā anuṣṭup ugrakṛtyā khaṭpaṭ jahi mahākṛtye vidhūmāgni samaprabhe jahi śatrūṃs triśūlenakṛn dhāsye piba śoṇitaṃ 46 kuvaraṃ te mukhaṃ raudraṃ naṃdimānaṃ dimāvaha jvaraṃ mṛtyubhayaṃ ghoraṃ viṣaṃ nāśayate jvara 47 eko maṃtraprayogāya ava brahma dviṣo jahi (fol. 5v6–6v2) Colophon ity ekapādamaṃtraḥ samāptam śubham ❖ (fol. 6v2)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || deśakālau saṃkīrtya amukagotrotpannasyāmukaśarmaṇo yajamānasya abhiṣṭa(!)siddhyarthaṃ pratyaṃgirāstotrapāṭham ahaṃ kariṣye || atha pratyaṃgirāstotramaṃtrasya aṃgirā ṛṣiḥ || anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ || pratyaṃgirādevatā vāṃchitasiddhyarthe stotrapāṭhe viniyogaḥ oṃ krān namaḥ aṃguṣṭābhyā°° oṃ krīṃ namaḥ tarjanībhyā°° oṃ krūṃ namaḥ madhyamā°° oṃ krauṃ namaḥ kaniṣṭhikābhyā°° oṃ kraḥ namaḥ karatalakara°° evaṃ hṛdayādi || (fol. 1r1–1v3) End śrīś ca kubjī mahākubjī kālikā guhyakālikā || tripurā caritā nityā trailokyavijayā tathā || 3 || jitā parājitā devī jayaṃtī bhadrakālikā || siddhalakṣmīr mahālakṣmīḥ kālarātrir namos tu te || 4 || kālī karālavikrāṃte kālike pāpahāriṇi || vikarālamukhe devī jvālāmukhi namos tu te || 5 || ādāv aṃte ta chaṃyorāvṛṇīmahe(!) iti daśavāraṃ spṛṣṭvā japet || ta(!) chaṃyorāvṛṇīmahe(!) gātuṃ yajñāya gātuṃ yajñapataye daivī(!) svastir astu naḥ svasti maniṣebhyaḥ(!) || ūrddhvaṃ jigātu bheṣajaṃ || śanno astu dvipadaṃ śaṃ catuṣpade || oṃ m(!) śāṃtiḥ śāṃtiḥ śāṃtiḥ (fol. 7r2–7v2) Colophon

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ asya śrīpratyaṃgirāstotramaṃtrasya aṃgirāṛṣir anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ pratyaṃgirādevatā manovāṃchitasiddhyarthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ | oṃ krāṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ || oṃ krīṃ tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā || oṃ krūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ | oṃ kraiṃ anāmikābhyāṃ huṃ | oṃ krauṃ kaniṣṭhikābhyāñṃ vauṣaṭ | oṃ kraḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭābhyāṃ phaṭ | oṃ krāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃ krīṃ śirase svāhā | oṃ krūṃ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | (fol. 1v1–6) End śrīś ca kubjī mahākubjī kālikā guhyakālikā | tripurā tvaritā nityā trailokyavijayā jayā | jitā parājitā devī jayaṃtī bhadrakālikā | siddhalakṣmīr mahālakṣmīḥ kālarātri namos tu te | kālī karālavakrāṃte(!) kālike pāpahāriṇi | vikarālamukhe devi jvālāmukhi namos tu te || yāṃ kalpayaṃti norayaḥ krūrāṃ kṛtyāṃ vadhūm iva | tāṃ brahmaṇā apa nirṇūhmaḥ(!) pratyak karttāram ṛcchatu || (fol. 4v2–7) Colophon iti pratyaṃgirāstotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || (fol. 4v7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ asya śrīpratyaṅgirāstotramaṃtrasya mahādevaṛṣir anuṣṭupchandaḥ pratyaṅgirādevatā hūṃ bījaṃ svāhā śakti(!) mamābhiṣṭasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || śrīkubjikā uvāca || mandarasthaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ bhagavantaṃ maheśvaraṃ || samu[[pā]]gamya caraṇau pārvatī paripṛcchati || 1 || devy uvāca || dhāriṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṅgirā mahottamā || naranārīhitārthāya bālānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 2 || rājñāṃ maṇḍalikānāṃ ca dīnānāṃ ca maheśvarī || viduṣāṃ ca dvijātīnāṃ viśeṣād dharmmasādhinī || 3 || (fols. 1v1–2r2) End ye mamāvidyākarmakurvaṃti tesāmavidyāstaṃbhaya 2 sthānaṃ kīlaya 2 grāmaṃ kīlaya 2 maṃḍalaṃ kīlaya 2 deśaṃ kīlay 2 sarvasiddhimahābhāge mamasādhakasya saparivārakasya sarvato rakṣāṃ kuru 2 svāhā oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ raṃ raṃ raṃ raṃ raṃ laṃ laṃ laṃ laṃ laṃ vaṃ vaṃ vaṃ vaṃ vaṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ phaṭ svāhā oṃ pratyaṅgirā mama sādhakasya sarvato rakṣāṃ kuru 2 svāhā oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā oṃ namo bhagavati duṣṭacāṃḍālini triśūlavajrāṅkuśadhāriṇī rudhiramadyamāṃsabhakṣiṇi kapālakhaṭvāṅgajaṭāsidhāriṇi cheda 2 daha 2 hana 2 paca 2 matha 2 dhama 2 pramathaya 2 sarvaduṣṭānāsa 2 piba 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ śākarālini kaumāri mama taṃtra maṃtra yantra viṣacūrṇadevatāstra sara ābhicārasarvopadravādikaṃ yena kṛtaṃ kāritaṃ kurute kārayati kariṣyati vā tān sarvān hana 2 oṃ pratyaṅgire (fols. 5v5–6v5) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ asya śrīpratyaṅgirāstotramaṃtrasya mahādeva ṛṣir anuṣṭupchandaḥ pratyaṅgirādevatā hūṃ bījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ mamābhiṣṭasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || śrīkubjikovāca || mandarasthaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ bhagavantaṃ maheśvaraṃ || samupāgamya caraṇau pārvatī paryyapṛcchata || 1 || śrīdevy uvāca || dhāriṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṅgirā mahottamā || naranārīhitārthāya bālānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 2 || rājñāṃ maṇḍalikānāṃ ca dīnānāṃ ca maheśvarī || viduṣāṃ ca dvijātīnāṃ viśeṣād dharmmasādhinī || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End vilvaṃ vā pūjayed devīṃ japed aṣṭasahasrakaṃ || sahasraṃ labhate svarṇaṃ na daridro bhavet tataḥ || śālibhiḥ svarṇalābhaḥ syād godhūmaiḥ puṣṭisaṃpade || yavahomena dhānyaṃ syād ikṣubhiḥ caturaṃgulaiḥ || kumudair janavātsalyaṃ vakulai caturāṃ śriyaṃ || aśokaiḥ putralābhaḥ syāt pāṭalībhiḥ śubhāṃganāḥ || māṣahomena kaphaḥ syāt kodravair vyādhito bhavet || phalair ve(!) bhainakair bhrānto mriyate śālmalīhūtāt || kaṭutailena vidveṣaḥ staṃbhaḥ pītaprasūnakaiḥ || vāyuvegāt patatpatrair homenoccāṭanaṃ ripoḥ || homo nyeṣāṃ padārthām aṣṭo- (fols. 5v5–6v5) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha kṛtyā pratiruṇāḥ || tasya ca sarvasyāpi smayānyataḥ śakra ṛṣiḥ || kṛtyā dūṣaṇa śakra devatā || atijagatīśakkvaryyau sarvāṇi chaṃdāṃsi ca chaṃdāṃsi | yatra sarvāṇi chaṃdāṃsi iti vakṣyāmas tatra tatra gāyatryādi jagatyaṃtaṃ saptachaṃdāṃsi prakṛtāni vijānīyād iti || (fol. 1v1–6) End etat pratyaṃgirāstotraṃ ye paṭhaṃti dvijottamāḥ || śṛṇvaṃtaḥ sādhayaṃtaś ca teṣāṃ siddhipradā bhavet || śrīś ca kubjī mahākubjī kālikā guhyakālikā || tripurā tvaritā nityā trailokyavijayā jayā || jitā parājitā devi jayaṃtī bhadrikālikā || siddhalakṣmīr mahālakṣmī kālirātrir namos tu te || iti caturtha puṣpāṃjaliḥ || kālī karālavikrāṃte kālike pāpahāriṇi || vikarālamukhe devi jvālāmukhī namos tu te || iti paṃcapuṣpāṃjali || iti pratyaṃgirā (fol. 22v2–9) Colophon

Beginning hrūṃ krīṃ iti ācamya | kālyai nama iti praṇamya | [[kapālinyai nama iti mukhaṃ saṃmārjya |]] kurukullāyai nama iti mukhe | virodhinyai nama iti dakṣiṇanāśāyāṃ | vipracittāyai nama iti vāmanāśāyām | ugrāyai nama ugraprabhāyai iti dvayor netrayoḥ | dīptāyai namaḥ nīlāyai namaḥ iti netrayoḥ | ghanāyai namaḥ iti nābhau || balākāyai namaḥ iti hṛdaye || mātrāyai namaḥ iti śirasi | (exp. 2, ll. 1–4) End evaṃ dhyātvā manasi guruṃ devatāṃ smṛtya manasy upacāraiḥ saṃpūjya mālāṃ gṛhītvā guruṃ praṇamya japet | japānte mālāśirasi dhṛtvā krīṃ kālyai nama iti ācamya oṃ hrīṃ krīṃ svāhā iti prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā puna ṛṣyādinyāsaṃ kṛtvā gurudaivatamaṃtrāṇāmaikyaṃ vibhāvya kare jalaṃ gṛhītvā | guhyād guhyataraṃ guhyaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam | siddhir bhavatu me devi tvatprasādāt sureśvari | ity anena japaṃ samarpya bhūmau praṇamya krīṃ kālyai nama ity ācamya stotraṃ paṭhet || || (exp. 3, ll. 2–7) Colophon iti paṃcākṣaraḥ śyāmāmaṃtraḥ || || śubhaṃ bhūyāt || || (exp. 3, l. 7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīkālaskiṇyai || śrī īśvara uvāca || ⟪na khu⟫ namastu te mahāmāye dehātīte niraṃjane | pratyaṃgirā jagaddhātri rājalakṣmī namas tu te || varṇṇadehā mahāgaurī sādhakecchāpravattaka | pade pade mahārambhā parā siddhisamusthitā || tattvadehāsthitā devi sādhakānugrahā smṛtā | mahākuṇḍalinī bhitvā sahasradalabhedinī || (fol. 1r1–4) End yaṃ yaṃ cintayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ siddhyati nānyathā || satyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevī kārike (!) tatsamo na hi || addharātre (!) samutthāya dīpaprajvālite niśi | paṭhyate stotram etan tu sarvvacintitasiddhidaṃ || puraścaryyāvinenaiva stotramātreṇa siddhyate | maṇḍale pratimāgre vā maṇḍalāgre paṭhed yati | idaṃ mahāstavaṃ proktam acintitārthasiddhidaṃ | nānyad eva ratāyān tu na deyan tu kadācana dātavyaṃ bhaktijuktāya kuladikṣāratāya ca | anyathā patanaṃ yānti ity ājñā parameśvarī || (fol. 5r4–5v4) Colophon iti śrītridaśaḍāmare pratyaṃgirādevyā māhā[mā]yāstava samāptaḥ || || oṃ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmyai || aisāvācyate vijayate saṃpūrṇṇakāmapradā | saṃsārānnavapātabhāvapalamāṃ (!) sarvvābhihantā śivā || śrīsarvvaṃ navadhṛtyamaṃgalagatā sānandasiddhi (fol. 5v4–7)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīpratyaṃgirāyai namaḥ || oṃ asya śrīpratyaṃgirāstotramaṃtrasya aṃgirā ṛṣir anuṣṭupchandaḥ śrīpratyaṃgiro devatā oṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ brahmā kilakaṃ mamābhīṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ jape viniyogaḥ || śirasi sṃgirā ṛṣaye namaḥ || mukhe anuṣṭupchandase namaḥ || hṛdaye śrīpratyaṃgirodevatāyai namaḥ || guhye oṃ bījāya namaḥ || pādayoḥ hrīṃ śaktyai namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) End jītā parājitā devī jayanti bhadrakālikā || siddhalakṣmī mahālakṣmī kālarātṛ(!) namos tu te || kālī karālavaktrānte kālike pāpahāriṇi || vikarālamukhe devī jvālāmukhi namostu te || idaṃ pratyaṇgirāstotraṃ yaḥ paṭhen niyataḥ śuci(!) || tasya sarvārthasiddhi(!) syān nātra kāryā vicāraṇāt || śatravo nāsamāyānti mahanaiśvaryavān bhavet || idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ nāsayaṃ yasya kasyacit || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sadyaḥ pratyayakārakam || gopanīyaṃ prayatnena sarvakāmaphalapradam || ❖ || (fol. 4r1–7) Colophon iti śrī atharvaṇarahasye pratyaṃgirāstotraṃ samāptaṃ sampūrṇaṃ śubham || ❖ || śrī devyai namaḥ śubham bhūyāt || ❖ || ❖ || (fol. 4r7–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ asya śrīpratyaṅgirāstotrasya mahādeva ṛṣi (!) pratyaṅgirādevatā hrūṃ bījaṃ svāhā śaktir mamābhīṣṭasiddhaye pāṭhe viniyogaḥ || kubjikovāca || mandarasthe sukhāsīnaṃ bhagavantaṃ maheśvaraṃ || samupāgamya caraṇau pārvatī paripṛchati (!) || 1 || devy uvāca || dhāriṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṅgirā mahottamā || naranārīhitārthāya bālānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 2 || rājñāṃ māṃḍalīkānāṃ ca dīnānāṃ ca maheśvaraḥ || 3 || viduṣāṃ ca dvijātīnāṃ viśeṣād dharmasādhinī || (fol. 1v1–6) End oṃ staṃbhinī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn staṃbhaya [staṃbha]ya svāhā oṃ mohinī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn mohaya mohaya svāhā | oṃ kṣobhinī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn kṣobhaya kṣobhaya svāhā || oṃ drāviṇī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn drāvaya drāvaya svāhā | oṃ jṛṃbhṇī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrū jṛṃbhaya jṛṃbhaya svā[hā]| oṃ bhrāmiṇī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn bhrāmaya bhrāmaya svāhā || oṃ raudriṇī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn raudraya raudraya svāhā | oṃ saṃhāriṇī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn saṃhāraya saṃhāraya svāhā | oṃ śoṣiṇī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrū[n] śoṣaya śoṣaya svāhā | yaśmāṃ(!) dhārayed vidyāṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ vāpi yaḥ paṭhet sopi daṃṣṭāṃtako devi hanyāc chatrū[n] na saṃśayaḥ || 30 || sarvato rakṣayed vidyā mahābhayavipattiṣu | mahābhayeṣu ghoreṣu na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || 31 || (fols. 6v1–7r3) Colophon iti śrīkubjikāmate caṇḍograśūlapāṇivadananirgate mahātaṃtre pratyaṅgirāśiddhimantrastavodhāra samāptaḥ || ṭaṃ kaṃ kapālaṃ ḍamaruṃ triśūlaṃ saṃvibhratī caṃdrakalāvatāṃsā || piṃṅgorddhakeśī sitabhīmadaṃṣṭrā bhūyā vibhūtyai mama bhadrakālī || || iti saṃvat 1890 śubham (fol. 7r3–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || pratyaṃgirā⟨ā⟩yai namaḥ || oṃ asya śrīpratyaṅgirāstotrasya mahadeva ṛṣir anuṣṭupchandaḥ śrīpratyaṅgirādevatā hūṃ bījaṃ svāhā śaktir mamābhiṣṭa (!) siddhyarthe yape viniyogaḥ || kubjikovāca || mandarasthaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ bhagavantaṃ maheśvaraṃ samupāgamya caraṇau pārvatī paripṛchati || devy uvāca || dhāriṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṅgirā mahottamā || naranārīhitārthāya bālānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || (fol. 1v1–7) End oṃ staṃbhi[[nī]] sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn staṃbhaya 2 svāhā oṃ sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn mohaya 2 svāhā | oṃ kṣobhinī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn kṣobhaya 2 svāhā oṃ drāviṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn drāvaya drāvaya svāhā | oṃ jṛṃbhiṇi mama śatrūn jṛṃbhaya 2 svāhā oṃ bhrāmiṇī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn bhrāmaya bhrāmaya svāhā || oṃ raudriṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama [[śatrūn]] raudraya 2 svāhā | oṃ saṃhāriṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn saṃhāraya 2 svāhā | oṃ śoṣiṇī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn śoṣaya śoṣaya svāhā | ya imāṃ dhārayed vidyāṃ triśaṃdhyaṃ vāpi yaḥ paṭhet sopi duṣṭāṃtako devi hanyāc chatrūn na saṃśayaḥ || sarvato rakṣayed vidyāṃ mahābhayavipa[[tti]]ṣu | mahābhayeṣu ghoreṣu na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || iti ku[bji]kāmate caṃdrograśūlapāṇīvadananirgatamahātaṃtre pratyaṃgirānāmamaṃtroddhāraḥ smāraṃ smāraṃ bhāratipādayugmaṃ kāraṃ kāraṃ sadgurubhyo namas (ca[[ṇḍi]]) graṃthasyādau vighnarājaprasādāt †svalpāraṃbhāṃñjamakarājavaṃnditi† (fol. 5r3–5v5) Colophon śrīpratyaṃgirāstotraṃ samāptaṃ || subhaṃ(!) || (fol. 5v5–6)

Beginning yasyāṃgasthā mahāvidyā pratyaṃgirā śivoditā || 15 || siddhidā siddhavidyānāṃ vidyeyaṃ paramā smṛtā || śrīmatā ghorarūpeṇa bhāvitā ghorarūpiṇī || 16 || pratyaṃgirā sadā proktā ripuhanyān na saṃśayaḥ || haricaṃdanamiśreṇa rocanākuṃkumena ca || 17 || likhitvā bhurjapatre tu dhāraṇīyā sadā nṛbhiḥ || puṣpair dhūpair vilvapatrair nānā valyupahārakai || 18 || (fol. 3r1–7) End śaktyākhya kramaśo yojyāḥ śatrupakṣe niyojitāḥ || dhāritā sādhakendreṇa sarvaśatruvināśakāḥ || oṃ tuṣṭini sphreṃ sphreṃ mamopari tuṣṭiṃ kuru 2 mama manoratha pūraya 2 oṃ eiṃ hrīṃ pratyaṃgire namo namaḥ || oṃ staṃbhini sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn staṃbhaya 2 oṃ mohini sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn mohaya 2 oṃ kṣobhini sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn jṛṃbhaya 2 oṃ bhrāmiṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn bhrāmaya 2 || oṃ raudrīṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn tāpaya 2 || oṃ saṃhāriṇī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn saṃhāraya 2 || oṃ pratyaṃgirā oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ pratyeṃgire vikaṭadaṃṣṭre (fol. 7v1–7) Colophon

Beginning yasyāṃgasthā mahāvidyā pratyaṃgirā śivoditā || 15 || siddhidā siddhavidyānāṃ vidyeyaṃ paramā smṛtā || śrīmatā ghorarūpeṇa bhāvitā ghorarūpiṇī || 16 || pratyaṃgirā sadā proktā ripuhanyān na saṃśayaḥ || haricaṃdanamiśreṇa rocanākuṃkumena ca || 17 || likhitvā bhurjapatre tu dhāraṇīyā sadā nṛbhiḥ || puṣpair dhūpair vilvapatrair nānā valyupahārakai || 18 || (fol. 3r1–7) End śaktyākhya kramaśo yojyāḥ śatrupakṣe niyojitāḥ || dhāritā sādhakendreṇa sarvaśatruvināśakāḥ || oṃ tuṣṭini sphreṃ sphreṃ mamopari tuṣṭiṃ kuru 2 mama manoratha pūraya 2 oṃ eiṃ hrīṃ pratyaṃgire namo namaḥ || oṃ staṃbhini sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn staṃbhaya 2 oṃ mohini sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn mohaya 2 oṃ kṣobhini sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn jṛṃbhaya 2 oṃ bhrāmiṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn bhrāmaya 2 || oṃ raudrīṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn tāpaya 2 || oṃ saṃhāriṇī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn saṃhāraya 2 || oṃ pratyaṃgirā oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ pratyeṃgire vikaṭadaṃṣṭre (fol. 7v1–7) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmyai || namas te devadeveśi siddhilakṣmīmahaujase | pratyaṃgire mahādevi rājyalakṣmi namos tu te || yoginī siddhirūpā ca karuṇāmayarūpiṇī | sānekānekarūpā ca mātṛkāṣṭakamadhyagā || jaganmāteśvarī devī jagatsaṃharate kṣaṇāt | jagatsthitikarī devī jagadānandakāriṇī || (fol. 1v1–5) End pūjayed vividhākārair gandhamālādipuṣpakaiḥ | dhūpayet pūrakarppūraṃ kastūryyā ca samāyutaṃ || ārādhitā jagatsarvvaṃ trailokyaṃ mayi pūjitaṃ | ajāśvamahiṣac chāgā gāvaś caiva tu varddhayet || ekā pratyaṃgirā rājā jayet sarvvaṃ sadā budhaiḥ || bahunātra kim uktena acintitārisiddhayet || smaraṇāt tu sadā devī duḥkhadāridryanāśinī || namas te stu mahādevi namas te viṣṇurūpiṇī || namas te jagatāṃ mātaḥ siddhilakṣmiṃ(!) namos tu te || (fols. 5v3–6r4) Colophon iti śrīpratyaṃgirāstavaḥ || (fol. 6r4)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha pratyaṅgirā stotram || || oṃ adyehetyādi śatrūpadravaśāṃtipūrvakāyurārogyāvāptaye śrīpratyaṅgirāmālāmaṃtrapuṭitam adyārabhya yathākālaparyaṃtaṃ yathāsaṃkhyākāvṛttipāṭhaṃ kariṣye iti || || [[ācamya]] oṃ asya śrīpratyaṅgirā mālāmaṃtrasya bhairava ṛṣir anuṣṭupchandaḥ śrīpratyaṅgirādevatā hūṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ klīṃ kīlakaṃ mama śatrukṣayārthe jape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1v1–3) End oṃ [[aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ]] namo bhagavati bhrāmiṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn bhrāmaya bhrāmaya svāhā || oṃ [[kphreṃ]] namo bhagavati raudriṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn saṃtāpaya saṃtāpaya svāhā | oṃ [[aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ]] namo bhagavati saṃhāriṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn saṃhāraya saṃhāraya svāhā | oṃ [[kphreṃ]] namo bhagavati śoṣiṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūñ choṣaya śoṣaya svāhā | oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ hraṃ śrīṃ sphreṃ pratyaṅgire svāhā || ekādaśākṣari vidyā sādhakānāṃ śubhāvahā | oṃ mama śatrūṇāṃ mūrchāpaya mūrchāpaya mama śatrūṇāṃ kaṃpaya kaṃpaya mama śatrūṇāṃ pachaya pachaya mama śatrūṇāṃ daha daha mama śatrūṇāṃ māraya māraya | mama śatrūṇāṃ utsādaya utsādaya | mama śatrūṇāṃ chedaya chedaya | mama śatrūṇāṃ mohaya mohaya | mama śatrūṇāṃ bhrāmaya bhrāmaya | mama śatrūṇāṃ sarvāṇi marmāṇi rava rava ravāhi ravāhi tiṣṭa tiṣṭa baṃdha baṃdha hana hana amṛte hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || yadūmāṃ dhārayed vidyāṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ vāpi yaḥ paṭhet sopi duḥkhāṃtako devi ripūn hanyān na saṃśayaḥ || 41 || sarvato dhārayed vidyāṃ mahābhayavipattiṣu || mahābhayeṣu sarveṣu na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || (fols. 5v5–6r4) Colophon iti śrīkubjikāmate caṇḍograśūlapāṇīvadanavinirgatamahātaṃtre śrīpratyaṅgirāstotram samāptam || golocakuṃkumena bhūrjapatre likhitvā aṃdhādibhiḥ saṃyujya baliṃ datvā kaṃḍe bhuje vā dhārayet | para yaṃtra maṃtra taṃtra abhicārādikān nāśayati bindutrikoṇaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vasupatreṇa saṃvṛtaṃ bhūpureṇa samāyuktaṃ yaṃtraṃ pratyaṃgirātmakam | iti pūjāyaṃtram (fol. 6r4–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ asya śrīajapāgāyatrīmaṃtrasya brahmaṛṣir avyaktagāyatrīchandaparamahaṃso devatā haṃ bijaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ sohaṃ kīlakaṃ gaṇeśabrahmāviṣṇumahārudrajīvātmaguruparamātmabhyo brahmaṇo mokṣārthe viniyogaḥ || oṃ haṃ haṃsāya vidmahe paramahaṃsāya dhīmahi sohaṃ haṃsaḥ pracodayāt || hakāreṇa bahir yāti sakāreṇa viset punaḥ || haṃsa ittyeva maṃtraṃ ca jīvo japati sarvadā || asya saṃkalpamātreṇa punarjanmo na vidyate || atha sūryodayam ārabhya sūryodayaparyantocchvāsaniśvāsāttmakamajapāgāyatryāḥ ṣaṭśatottaraikaviṃśatisahasraṃ ajapāgāyatrīmaṃtram ahorātrayo⟨ḥ⟩r ahaṃ kariṣye || asya śrī ajapāgāyatryāḥ ṣaṭśataṃ tu gaṇeśasya ṣaṭsahasraṃ prajāpateḥ ṣaṭsahasraṃ gadāpāṇeḥ ṣaṭsahasraṃ pinākinaḥ || sahasram ātmanaś caiva guroś caiva sahasrakam || paramātmanaḥ sahasraṃ ca yathāvidhi nivedayet || (fol. 1v1–3r2) End ākāśaṃ biṃdusaṃyuktaṃ bhṛgusargasamanvitaḥ | maṃtrarājas tv ayaṃ devi sarvasiddhiphalaprada || 16 || sarvakāleṣu siddho sau sarvamaṃtreṣu durllabhaḥ | yojanātiviśeṣeṇa mucyate janmabaṃdhanāt || 17 || ity etat kavacaṃ devi kathitaṃ devadurllabhaṃ || gopanīya⟨ṃ⟩m idaṃ bhadre prāṇabuddhiprayatnataḥ || 18 || yaḥ paṭhed bhaktibhāvajñaḥ sarvakāleṣu sarvadā || na tasya duḥkhasaṃghātaṃ yamasyāpi kuto bhayam || 19 || prātaḥ kāle snānakāle pūjākāle viśeṣataḥ || aṇimādir bhavet tasya maṃtrasiddhi na saṃśayaḥ || 20 || aśucir vā śucir vāpi gacchat bhuñjāna eva vā || manasā yaḥ smared yas tu mucyate bhavasāgarāt || 21 || (fol. 6v1–7v1) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale haragaurīsaṃvāde parārddhe paramahaṃsakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ samāptam śubham (fol. 7v1–3)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśojjatiḥ atha pratyaṃgirā adyetyādi amūkagotra amūka śarmāhaṃ mama sarvāriṣṭaśāṃtiśatrupadravanāsapūrvvakaśatrukṣayakāmaśrīpratyaṃgirāmālāmaṃtrastotre putitārthavanoktanavavargga krac pārtham ahaṃ kariṣyeti saṃkalpaḥ tatas trikoṇagarbhāṣṭadalapadmaṃ vilikhya devīṃ pūjayet (fol. 1v1–3) End oṃ namo bhagavati caṇḍī sphre sphreṃ mama śatrūn caṇḍaya 2 svāhā oṃ namo bhagavati saṃhāriṇī sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrūn saṃhāraya 2 svāhā oṃ hrīṃ pratyaṃgire sphre vikaṭadaṣṭre oṃ huṃ huṃ kāli 2 sphreṃ 2 kāli mama śatrūn chedaya 2 sarvvaduṣṭān māraya 2 khadgena chindhi bhindi 2 kili 2 piba 2 rudhira sphreṃ 2 kili 2 kāli 2 namaḥ oṃ āṃ hrīṃ yastvimā dhārate vidyā trisaṃdhyaṃ vāpi yaḥ paṭhet sopi duḥkhārṇavaṃ tītvā siddhimāpnoty asaṃśayaḥ || pathitā pāṭhitā vāpi yaḥ paṭhec caiva yaḥ paṭhet tasya śatru kṣayo nityaṃ jāyate nātra śaṃsayaḥ sarvvato rakṣayed vidyāṃ mahābhayavipattiṣu jale sthale cāṃtarikṣe na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || || (fols. 7r2–7v1) Colophon iti śrīcandrograśūlapāṇin nanāviracitaṃ pratyaṃgirāstotra samāptaṃ śubhaṃ || || (fol. 7v1)

Beginning ❖ śrīpratyaṃgirādevyai namaḥ || || oṃ namaḥ sarvasiddhiyoginībhyo namaḥ sarvasiddhimātṛkobhyo namo nidyoditānandananditāyai sakalakulacakranāyikāyai ..gatādyai .. ṇḍakapāli tad yathā | oṃ hūṃ krūṃ hāṃ phreṃ ksauṃ krauṃ namaḥ paramahaṃsinī .. ṇamārgadevi viṣamopaplavapraśamani sakaladuritāriṣṭakleśadalati sarvāpadābhodhitaraṇi sakalaśatrupramarddani devi āgacha 2 hasa 2 vaṃja 2 nararudhirān tu vasābhakṣaṇi mama svaśatruṃ marda 2 khāhi 2 truśūlena ninda 2 chinda 2 khaḍgena tāḍaye 2 chedaya 2 tāvadyāvan mama sakalamanorathān sādhaya 2 paramakāruṇike bhagavati mahābhairavarūpadhāriṇi tridaśavaranamite sakalamaṃtramātaḥ praṇata janavatsale devi mahākāli kālanāśini hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ prasida madanāture kuru 2 surāsurakanyake hrīṃ śrīṃ krauṃ svāhā || || (fols. 1v1–2r4) End oṃ eiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vidrāvini khphreṃ khphreṃ mama śatruṃ vidrāvaya vidrāvaya oṃ eiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ jṛṃbhini khphreṃ khphreṃ mama śatruṃ jṛṃbhaya jṛṃbhaya oṃ eiṃ hrīṃ śrī bhrāmini khphreṃ khphreṃ mama śatruṃ bhrāmaya bhrāmaya oṃ eiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ raudri khphreṃ khpgreṃ mama śatruṃ santāpaya santāpaya oṃ eiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ saṃhāriṇi khpgreṃ khphreṃ mama śatruṃ saṃhāraya saṃhāraya bhrāmaṇī bhrāmaṇī raudri tathā saṃhāriṇiti ca staṃbhinī mohiṇī caiva kṣobhani drāvaṇī tathā sarvatra dhāraya vidyāṃ mahābhayavipattiṣu || mahābhaye/// bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || || (fols. 5r3–5v2) Colophon iti śrīcandrograviracitaṃ śrīpratyaṅgirāstotra śubham astu sarvadākāle || śrīśāke 1734 āsvinaśukla/// kṛṣṇapati ca pāṭhayet || || dirgha/// (fol. 5v2–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha ṣaṭcakra liṣyete ⟪a⟫ asya śrīajapānāma gāyatrīmaṃtrasya haṃsa ṛṣi avyaktagāyatrīchandaḥ paramahaṃso devatā haṃ bijaṃ (!) saḥ iti śaktiḥ sohaṃ iti kilakaṃ (!) amuka gotra amukavarmanasya mama paramānandapṛtyārthepsitasitasiddhyārthe (!) jape viniyogaḥ || vāk 3 cacchu (!) 3 śrota 3 ghrāna 3 || atha karanyāsaḥ oṃ haṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ saḥ tarjanibhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ saḥ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ oṃ ha sa anāmikābhyā namaḥ oṃ haḥ karatalakarapṛṣṭābhyāṃ namaḥ || atha hṛdayādinyāsa || oṃ hmauṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ oṃ staṃ sirase svāhāḥ oṃ hrauṃ sikhāya vauṣaṭ oṃ haṃ kavacāya hauṃ oṃ ha sau astrāya phaṭ || (fol. 1v1–2r2) End romakupe (!) sadānanda tvaṃ ca pātu parātmaka || jagadeka varmmapātu bhāsame bhavapālakaṃ || 6 || rudhiraṃ pātu kālātmā majjyān me sarvabhāvakṛt || meda (!) me pātu sarvajña .... sthi me duḥkhanāṣaka || 7 || jiva pātu sa saṃrvātmā sarvāge sarvavyāpaka || rātrau pātu vinandāo divā me jyoti sarūpaka || iti rakṣākaraṃ devī maṃtra (!) sasya (!) śṛṇu prīyata || ākāsaṃ biṃndusaṃyuktaṃ (!) bhṛgusarvasamaṃvitaṃ (!) || 9 || maṃtraṃ jaṃtra stvayaṃ devī sarvasiddhīphalapradaṃ (!) || sarvakāleṣu sidhyāsau sarvamaṃtreṣu dullabhaṃ (!) || 10 || yo nāti viseṣenaḥ (!) mucyate janmabandhanāt || ittyetatkathitaṃ devī kavacaṃ devadurllabham || 11 || gopaniyaṃ (!) midaṃ (!) bhadre prāṇāpraṇavṛddhiprayatnata || yayaghaṃṭetbhaktibhāvajña sarvakāleṣu sarvadā || 12 || na tasya duḥkhasaṃghātaṃ mamasyapi (!) kuto bhayaṃ || prātakāle snānakāle pujākāle (!) viseṣita || 13 || annya māṃ nirbhayaṃ tasya maṃtrasiddhir na saṃsayat (!) || aśucir vā śucir vāpi gachata bhuṃjānāyayā || mānavā manasā yasmared yes tū mucyete bhavasāgarāt || 15 || (fol. 8r3–8v7, exp. 9b–10) Colophon iti śrīrudrajāmale (!) haragaurīsaṃvāde parāddhe (!) paramahaṃsakavacaṃ samāptaṃ śubham || (fol. 8v7, exp. 10)

Beginning ❖ oṃ nre (!) parāyai || bindau tridhāmasadanae paraśaṃbhuśakter udyānapīṭhavaragāṃ saturīyakhaṃṇḍaṃ || śrīpādukāṃ sthitilayodbhavakāraṇāyāḥ saṃpūjayāmi paramāmṛtasārabhūtāṃ || 1 || vidyutkoṭipra[[kā]]śāṃ vaśagatapavanonnītadantāgrasūkṣmāṃ raktāṃ bhitvā (!) triliṃgāt paramaśivasudhāpāśacaitanyamudrāṃ | nidyānandasvarūpāmṛtarasavirasaiḥ plāvayantīṃ trilokiṃ cidgamyā ṣoḍaśārṇṇākṣarama[[ya]]vapuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśīṃ tāṃ bhajāmi || 2 || (fol. 1r1–4) End lakṣmi śaktisvarūpāṃ smaramayavapūṣāṃ vāgvibhūtipradātrīṃ śaktīṃ vai vedayoniṃ tribhuvanajananīṃ viṣṇumāyāsvabhāvā | vākkāmāṃ śaktirūpāṃ bhagavati saparāṃ yonitatvatvavācyāṃ (!) kāmākhyāṃ tvāṃ pareśīṃ praṇamata śirasā bodhijā sevyapādāṃ || 12 || vande nimādicaturaśragatā (!) maheśī kāmeśvarī prabhṛti paṃcadaśī ca nityāṃ | śrīcakramaṇḍalagatāṃ bahuśaktiyuktāṃ śrīnāthapādakamalāni vimuktiheto || 13 || stotraṃ ye ye paṭhanti tribhuvanajananīṃ pūjayitvātmaśaktyā te te lakṣmīṃ kavisvaṃ surapuravanitā kṣobhanaṃ prāpnuvanti | tatvajñānaṃ vivāde jayam ativibhavaṃ dīrghajīvī tvam ambā dhyānād ānandasiṃdhu kulakamalapadaṃ kāmarājaprasādāt || 14 || (fol. 2v3–3r2) Colophon iti śrīrudrajāmale (!) parāmayūṣāstavaḥ || || (fol. 3r3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || devy uvāca || kavacaṃ devadeveśa sarasvatyā manoramaṃ || kathayasva mamedānīṃ sneho me yadi tiṣṭhati || śrīmahādeva uvāca || atyaṃtagopyaṃ guhyaṃ ca siddhividyāmayaṃ paraṃ || tathāpi kathayāmy etat prītyā tava varānane || kavacasyāsya deveśi ṛṣir nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || paṃktichaṃdo devatā ca vāksvarūpā sarasvatī dharmarthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || aiṃ pātu mastakaṃ nityaṃ devī caikakṣarī parā || hṛdayaṃ pātu me sā ca vāgrupā (!) tryakṣarī parā || vada vada vāgvādinī svāhā || (fols. 1v1–2r2) End gurubhaktivihīnāya duṣṭāya ca durātmane || lokahiṃsāratāya ca kṛtaprāya maheśvari || bhedajñānāya pāpāya niṃdakāya kadācana || na dātavyaṃ na dātavyāṃ na dātavyaṃ maheśvari || śiṣyebhyo bhaktiyuktebhyo vaiṣṇavebhyo viśeṣataḥ || dātavyaṃ kavacaṃ bhadraṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabhaṃ || || || (fols. 3v3–4r1) Colophon iti śrīnīlasārasvatataṃtre sarasvatyāḥ kavacaṃ || (fol. 4r2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīsītārāmāya namaḥ || śrījānakīkevyāḥ sahasranāmastotrasya tad uktaṃ siddheśvarī taṃtre || lakṣmaṇa uvāca || deva deva jagannātha kathayāmisva (!) mahāprabho nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ jānakyāḥ śrotum ichāmi tatvataḥ || 1 || śrīrāma uvaca || kathayāmi bhavatprītyā śṛṇu lakṣmaṇa bhaktitaḥ asya śrījānakīdevyāḥ sahasranāmastotrasya vāgīśvarīdevatāḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye jape viniyogaḥ || jānakī kamalā vidyā siddhavidyāmahātmajā || nirmalā bhāvinī vidyā sarvamaṃgalarūpiṇī || (fols. 1v1–2r4) End śreyāṃsi labhate nityaṃ niścalāṃ ca śubhāṃ śriyaḥ | sarvaduḥkhavinirmukto lobhakrodhavivarjitaḥ || 30 || vidyānāṃ pārago vipra kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet || vaiśyas tu dhanalābhādyā śūdrās (!) tu sukham aśnute || 31 || putrārthī labhate putrān dhanārthī vipulaṃ dhanaṃ || icchākāmāṃs tu kāmārthī dharmārthī dharmam akṣayaṃ || 132 || (fols. 20v3–21r2) Colophon iti siddheśvarītaṃtre jānakīsahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || śrīr astu || śubham astu || saṃvat 1836 māghaśuklapaṃcamī guruvāre (fol. 21r2–4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmyai || śrībhairavy uvāca || kathayasva mahādeva siddhilakṣmyā samuttamaṃ | kavacaṃ sarvvasiddhīnāṃ dāyakaṃ paramaṃ śubhaṃ || sarvvamantramayaṃ sarvvabhītirakṣākaraṃ paraṃ | sarvvavyādhiharaṃ caiva sarvvamantreṣu gopitaṃ || śrībhairava uvāca || kathayāmi va[[rā]]rohe śṛṇu sarvvajñakāraṇaṃ | trailokyamohanaṃ nāma kavacaṃ suravanditaṃ || (fol. 1r1–4) End kumārībhojanaṃ cānte kāraṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || tataḥ sarvvāpadas tasya naśyanti tatkṣaṇāc chive || dāsavac ca varārohe siddhayāṣṭau bhavanti hi || saṃgrāme jayam āpnoti vipulaṃ bhogam āpnuyāt || bhurjjapatre likhitvā tu dhāraṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || aputro labhate putraṃ daridro labhate dhanaṃ || taṅ gotraṃ prāpya deveśi vajraṃ ca puṣpasannibhaṃ || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā siddhilakṣmīṃ bhaja[[n]]tu yaḥ || tasya pūjādikaṃ sarvvaṃ niphalaṃ(!) nātra saṃśayaḥ || tasmāt sarvvaprayatnena parthitavyaṃ(!) samohitaḥ | sarvvabhāgam avāpnoti cānte mokṣam avāpnuyāt || (fol. 2v3–8) Colophon iti haṃsamāheśvarītantre bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde trailokyamohanaṃ nāma śrīsiddhilakṣmīkavacaṃ samāptaṃ || || || (fol. 2v, right-hand margin and top)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ siddhipadmāyai || bhagavan bhāṣāitā sarvaṃ guhyaṃ paramadurllabhaṃ | idānīṃ śrotum icchāmi brūhī(!) nāmasahasrakaṃ || 1 || siddhilakṣmyā mahādevyāḥ sarve devasudurllabhāṃ prasīda kathyatāṃ tattvaṃ sa(!)sīda kathyatāṃ tattvaṃ devadevo jagatpate || .. .. || śrīsadāśiva uvāca || siddhilakṣmyā mahādevyāḥ śṛṇu nāmasahasrakaṃ | yena smaraṇamātreṇa śivaḥ sākṣād bhaven naraḥ || (fol. 1r1–4) End ekaliṃge vahnimadhye jalamadhye tathaiva ca | vanamadhye ca saṃyāme tathā prāṇasya saṃśaya || 152 || śodhanakṣaye ca kalahe jātidhvaṃsa tathaiva ca | japtvā maṣṭa(!)sahasraṃ ca paṭhen nāmasahasrakaṃ || 153 || tasya tuṣṭā bhaved devī siddhilakṣmyāḥ sureśvarī | āyadaś(!) ca kṣayaṃ yānti grahapīḍāś ca dāruṇā || 154 || iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya cānte dyāti(!) parāṃ gatiṃ | bhūrjjapatre samālikhya kuṃkumāgurucandanaiḥ || 155 || dhārayaṃ dvariṇe(!) haste na tasya ripujaṃ bhayaṃ | na ca mārībhayaṃ tasya rāja (fol. 15v1–6) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ siddhikamalāyai || devy uvāca || bhagavan bhāṣitā sarvaṃ guhyaṃ paramadurllabhaṃ | idanī(!) śrotum icchāmi llabho(!) nāmasahasrakaṃ || 1 || siddhilakṣmyā mahādevyā sarvvadeveṣu durllabhaṃ | prasīda kathyatāṃ tatvaṃ devadevo jagatpate || 2 || śrīsadāśiva uvāca || siddhilakṣmyā mahādevyāḥ śṛṇu nāmasahasrakaṃ | yena smaraṇamātreṇa śivaṃ sākṣād bhaven naraḥ || 3 || nātaḥ parataraṃ kiṃcit stotrarakṣākaraṃ bhavet || kalau mahāvīryyavantaṃ sadya pratyayakārakaṃ || 4 || nyaset prathamato devi tato dhyāyan mananyadhī(!) | iti dhyātvā japen mantraṃ paścāt stotraṃ paṭhen naraḥ || 5 || || oṃ asya śrīmahālakṣmyā sahasranāmastotrasya viśvāmitraṛṣir anuṣṭupchandaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmī devatā klīṃ bījaṃ hrīṃ śaktiḥ hruḥ kīlakaṃ mama puruṣārthacatuṣṭayasiddhaye paṭhe(!) viniyogaḥ || || (fol. 1v1–5) End śaṭhāya bhaktihīnāya nindakāya varānane || saubhāgyaṃ bhartṛihārddaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca jauvanan(!) tathā || 158 || putrān api varārohe yoṣid āpnoty asaṃśayaḥ | imaṃ stotraṃ maheśāni gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 159 || śiśyāya bhaktiyuktaya dātavyaṃ stavam uttamaṃ | yadi dadyād abhaktāya śaṭhāya ca sureśvari || 160 || tadā mṛtyum avāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmy ahaṃ || .. .. .. .. || || ❁ || || (fol. 8r2–4) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale tantre śrīdevīśvarasaṃvāde śrī śrī śrī siddhilakṣmyāḥ sahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || śrī 3 siddhilakṣmīdevī jayati || śubham astu || || samvat 812 kārttikaśuklatrayodaśī revatī nakṣatre vajrayoge śanaiścaravāra thvakūhnū rājadaivajñavṛṣadhvajena saṃpūrṇṇayāṅā juro || śrī 3 parameśvarī prītir astu || (fol. 8r5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīśvetakālyai namaḥ || śrīmahādeva uvāca || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi guhyād guhyataraṃ param | śvetāyāḥ kālikāyās tu nāmnām aṣṭottaraṃ śatam || 1 || kim anyaiḥ stotravistārair japahomārcanādibhiḥ || stotrasyaitasya paṭhanāt kālī sadyaḥ prasīdati || 2 || śvetakālī mahākālī kalikā kālanāśinī | kāleśvarī kālarātrī kāleśvarī kālarātrī kālanāthaṃ prapūjitā || 3 || kamanīyatarā kāmyā kalyāṇī sarvakāmadā | cāmuṇḍā caṇḍikā caṇḍī caṇḍeśī caṇḍavikramā || 4 || pracaṇḍā caṇḍamuṇḍaghnī cintanīyapadāmbujā | acintyacaritā cāruvadanā cintitapradā || 5 || (fols. 1v1–2v1) End pālinīṃ purataḥ kṛtvā divyair etais tu nāmabhiḥ || caturthyantair nnamoktaiś ca pratyekaṃ yas tu pūjayet || 23 || athavā vahnijāyāntair homayet saṃskṛtenale tasya tuṣṭā mahāmāyā prayachati (!) manorathaṃ || 24 || idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit gopanīyam abhaktebhyo deyaṃ bhaktāya kevalaṃ || 25 (fol. 5r2–5v1) Colophon iti śrīsiddhāntasaṃgrahe siddhasārasvatoktaśrīśvetakālyaṣṭottaraśatanāmastotraṃ samāptam || || śrīśvetakālīprasannā bhavatu || || ||| || śubham astu || ❖ || (fol. 5v1–4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ siddhikamalāyai || śrīpadmāyai namaḥ || || ṛṣir uvāca || nāmnām aṣṭasahasraṃ hi brūhi gāṃge mahāmune | siddhilakṣmyā mahādevyā dṛśā vācyā mitaṃ prabho || || gāṃgeya uvāca || sanatkumāra sānandā dvādaśadityasannibhaṃ | apṛcchan yoginaḥ sarvvaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradaṃ || || yogīśvara uvāca || bhagavan kiṃ prakāreṇa bhuktimuktir bhaviṣyati | tan me brūhi mahādeva prasādaṃ karttum arhasi || (fol. 1r1–4) End nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ kathitaṃ tava putra mayākhilaṃ | naro nāmasahasreṇa stuvad vighnavināyakaṃ || prīnā(!)ti devān akhilān vighneśaḥ sarvvakāmadaḥ | paṭhen naro bhidhānānāṃ sahasraṃ vighnabhūpate || yatphalaṃ labhate putra tad idāniṃ niśāmayaḥ || aputra putram āpnoti dhanam āpnoti nirddhana || ❁ || || (fol. 19v6–8) Colophon

Beginning sya maheśi tu || skandhasthitā mahādevi trailokyaiśvaryyadāyinī || mātṛkāṣṭakamadhyasthāṃ paṃcapretāparisthitaḥ || || oṃ asya śrīpratyaṅgirākavacasya nārāyaṇaṛṣi gāyatrīcchandaḥ pratyangirāsiddhilakṣmīdevatā hrīṃ bījaṃ hruṃ tilakaṃ mama sarvvarakṣārthe jape viniyogaḥ || || (fol. 1r1–4) End idaṃ stotraṃ maheśāni na deyāt paraśiṣyake || śaṭhāya bhaktihīnāya nindakāya varānane || saubhāgyaṃ .. .. .. .. ñca rūpaṃ ca pīvaran (!) tathā || putrān api varārohe yoṣid āpnoty aśaṃsaya || 142 || || idaṃ stotraṃ maheśāni śaṭhāya ca sureśvari || tathā mṛtyum avāpnoti satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmy ahaṃ || || (fol. 22r4–22v3) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale devīśvarasaṃvāde siddhilakṣmīsahasranāmastotraṃ samāptam || || śubham astu śaṃ || || (fol. 22v3–4)

Beginning śrīnīlalohita uvāca || ādyā cicchaktirūpā prakṛtimahadahaṃkāratanmātrahīnā | nistraiguṇyā nirīhā layanilayakarī śuddhacaitanyarūpā | pratyakjyotir vivarttaprakaṭitaparamānandasaṃdohadhārā sā devī siddhilakṣmīr apanayatu mama dvaitabhāvaṃ bhavāṇī(!) || 1 || yasyā mohaṃ samastaṃ jagad idam adhikaṃ pratyayātītabudhyā yasyāṃ cec chinnabhinnaṃ sapadi bhavati hi bhrāntisūtropacārāt | dvaitākāre parās te vidhayi guṇamahā pañcabhūte niraste kaivalyānantamūrttiḥ sphurati hṛdi sadā kevalaṃ siddhilakṣmīḥ(!) || 2 || (fol. 1r1–4) End pretāsane pherupotakṛtahaste ṣoḍaśahaste yute śivapadadāyini naramāṃsakhādini akṣarabhakṣa bhakṣaṇi trailokya pāpanāśini lelihānarasanākarālini asuradāriṇi dhūmralocanahāriṇi raktabījasūdini śumbhacchedini niśumbha cchrīṃ phreṃ phrīṃ prīṃ trīṃ thrīṃ drīṃ dhrīṃ dhrīṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ krīṃ eiṃ oṃ īṃ ūṃ kṣmūṃ kṣīṃ crīṃ vlūṃ klauṃ krīṃ khrauṃ skīṃ vkrīṃ vkṣīṃ siddhilakṣmi kālakālivajrakāpālini vārāhiva viśveśvari nārasiṃdi(!) narasiṃhi narasiṃhimparipātāleśvari guhyakāli kāmakalālikaivalyadāyini iḥ(!) khakhaṇḍini jagatkāriṇi (fol. 16r2–7) Sub-colophon iti trailokyalohitīye kālānalatantre śrīsiddhilakṣmyāḥ sahasranāmastotraṃ kathanaṃ nāma paṃcaviṃśatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ || || (fol. 15r6–7) Colophon

Beginning oṃ namaś caṇḍakāpālinyai siddhilakṣmyai || nārada uvāca || sarvajña karuṇāsiṃdho devadeva jagatpate | siddhilakṣmyā mahādevyā vidhānaṃ siddhidāyakaṃ || maṃtraprayogadhyānārcānyāsācārasamanvitaṃ | trailokyamohanaṃ cāpi śrutaṃ kavacam uttamaṃ || amṛtākhyaṃ stavaṃ cāpi viśeṣeṇa śrutaṃ mayā | idānīṃ jāyate nātha śuśrūṣā mama bhūyasī || nāmnāṃ sahasre trividha mahāsaṃkaṭahāriṇi | śrutena yena deveśa jīvanmukto bhaven naraḥ || (fol. 1r1–4) End ugrā caṇḍeśvarī vīrā jananī vīrasundarī | ugrarūpā yaśodākhyā devakī devamānitā || 85 || nirañjanā citradevī krodhinī kuladīpikā || kulavāgīśvarī jvālā mātṛkā drāvaṇī dravā || 86 || yogeśvarī mahāmārī bhrāmarī biṃdurūpiṇī | dūtī prāṇeśvarī goptā vahūmā ḍāmarī prabhā || kubjikā jñāninī jyeṣṭā bhūṣuṇḍī prakaṭātithiḥ | drāvaṇī gopaṇī kāmyā kāmabījeśvarī kriyā || 88 || śākaṃbharī (fol. 6v6–9) Colophon

Beginning ❖ na ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsiddhikālikādevya || oṃ krīṃ trailokyāyai namaste tribhuvananamite kālike viśvacaṇḍe vāmānte vāmasasve tridaśavaranute naumi te pādayugme | hrasve dīrghe visarge akacaṭatapaṇe kṣaḥpraśāntāntarasthe | muṇdasthe krūṃ svarūpe neti parasarade śeṣanāgottarīye || (fol. 21r1–5) End yā vīre vīravandyā ṛṣigamanayato yogapīṭheyapīṭhaṃ śrutvā tvaṃ tasya nityaṃ vitaravarṇṇe kāmarūpāvatīrṇṇaṃ || nāmnā kṣatrāvalayaṃ paṭheta śubhayasaṃ maṃtrasiṃhaṃ praṇītaṃ | divyā divyābhivighnā prabhavam iha bhave devadevī prasādāt || (fol. 23r3–7) Colophon iti śrībhairavatasi śiracchede vidyāpīṭhe jayadrathajāmale viśvalakṣmīkrame siddhilakṣmīdevyā kṣatrāvalistavaṃ samāptaḥ || || || tra || || (fol. 23r7–23v3)

Beginning ❖ śrigaṇeśāya namaḥ || || bhairava uvāca || sahasranāmataḥ pūrvvam paṭhanīyan tu yad bhavet | tad ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi divyaṃ kavacam uttamam || 1 || kavacasyasya (!) deveśi mutpādyāḥ pūrvvavan matāḥ || viśeṣaḥ sarvvarakṣāyai viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || 2 || śiro me pātu cāmuṇḍā lalāṭaṃ kālikāvatu || trinetrā netrayugalaṃ ghrāṇaṃ pātu mamāṃbikā || 3 || kapolau pātu kalyāṇī karṇṇau me kāmadāvatu | mukhaṃ muktipradā pātu bhogadā dantavāsīnī (!) || 4 || (fols. 1v1–2r1) End yaḥ svarṇaguṭikāṃ kṛtvā likhitaṃ vāgrajanmanā | pūjayitvā vidhānena maṃtrasaṃskārapūrvvakaṃ | kaṇthe dakṣabhuje vāpi dhārayet sādhakottamaḥ | pūjānte kīrttayec cāpi kīrttayec cāpi nityaṃ bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 15 || sa bhavet sarvasiddhīśo nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā | na tasya durllabhaṃ kiṃcin nāsādhyaṃ vā carācare || 16 || vidyate para[[me]]śāni tasmād yatnena sādhayet | etatkavacamajñātvā yo japet śvetakālikāṃ || 17 || śatakoṭiprajaptopi maṃtras tasya na siddhyati | tasmāt sarvvaprayatnena kavacaṃ pariśīlayet || 18 || || (fol. 3r4–4r1) Colophon iti śrīvāḍavānalīye mahātaṃtre śrīśvetakālīkavacaṃ samāptam || ❖ || oṃ || ❖ ❖ ❖ ❖ ❖ ❖ ❖ ❖ ❖ || (fol. 5v1–4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo devyai || aiṃ namos tu te mahāmāyā dehātīte nirañjane | pratyaṃgire jagaddhātri rājalakṣmi namos tu te || varṇṇadehā mahāgaurī sādhakecchāpravarttikā | padadehā mahāsthāne mahāsiddhisamutthitā || tattve dehāsthitā devī sādhakānugrahā smṛtā | mahākuṇḍalinī bhitvā(!) sahasradalabhedinī || īḍāpiṃgalamadhyasthā vāyubhūtā khagāminī | mṛṇālatanturūpeṇa suṣumnāmadhyacāriṇī || (fol. 1v1–5) End satyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevi kaulike tatsamo nahi || arddharātre samutthāya dīpaḥ prajvālite niśi || paṭhyate stotram etan tu sarvvaṃ siddhyate cintitaṃ || puraścaryyāṃ vinānena stotrapāṭhena siddhyati || maṇḍalapratimāgre vā maṇḍalāgre paṭhed yadi || idaṃ proktaṃ mahāstotram acintitārthasiddhidāṃ anyad eva ratānān tu na deyan tu kadācana || dātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktāya kuladīkṣāratāya ca || 51 || (fol. 6r4–v3) Colophon iti śrīdaśaḍāmare karavīre śrīsiddhināthāvatāritaḥ śrisiddhilakṣmīmahāmāyāstavaḥ samāptaḥ || || siddhilakṣmī prasannāstu || || (fol. 6v3–4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaś caṇḍikāyai || yā devī madhukaiṭabhapraśamanī yā māhiṣonmūlanī | yā dhūmrākṣaṇacaṇḍamuṇḍamathanī yā raktabījāśanī | sā śaktiḥ śumbhaniśumbhadaityadalanī yā raktabījāśanī yāvyaktā navakoṭiśaktisahitā māṃ pātu sā kālikā || 1 || (fol. 1r1–4) End viṣṇūrūpasya siṃhasya pṛṣṭhasthāṃ jagadīśvarīṃ | ekaśaktiṃ dvidhā bhūtvā rājamāteti gīyate || 9 || siddhicaṇḍī mahāmāyā khaḍgaśūlaṃ ca pūjayet | āpadārṇṇavatārantīṃ paraṃ nirvvāṇadāyinīṃ || 10 || duḥkhatrayaharāṃ nityāṃ siddhilakṣmīṃ namāmyahaṃ || || (fols. 2v4–3r3) Colophon iti śrītridaśaḍāmare mahāyoge siddhicaṇḍīstavaṃ samāptaṃ || || (fol. 3r3)
