Beginning ❖ oṃ namo nārāyanāya || praṇamya śirasā viṣṇustrairokyā adhipati prabhuṃ | nānā śāstradhṛtaṃ vakṣa rājaniti samurccarya || trailokyayā adhipati ….. (2) tvaṃ namaskāla yāṅava nānā sāstrasa, pikāsyaṃ rājaniti muṃṅa tayā khaṃ jena hlāya || || (fol. 1r1–2) End asāropi hi saṃsāle sārameta catustayaṃ || kāsyāṃha vāsa satāṃ saṃgo gaṃgāmbu śambhupūjane || (7) || aśāra saṃsārasa thva petā sāra juraṃ chuchu dhārasā kāsivāsa vane satya puruṣava saṃga yāya, gaṃgālaṃkhana śrīmahā(8)deva pūjā yāya, thva petā sāla juraṃ || 300 || (fol. 16v6–8) Sub–colophon iti cānakyanitisārasaṃgrahe, prathama satakaṃ samāapta || o || (fol. 5v6) iti cānakyanitisārasaṃgṛhya, dviti(3)ya satakaṃ samāpta || ۞ || (fol. 11r2–3) iti cānakyanitisārasagṛhya, tṛtiya sa[ta]kaṃ samāpta || śubha || ۞ || (fol. 16v8)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśaṃ bhaje || chaṃdasāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yena śrutamātreṇa buddhyate || tad(!) ahaṃ kathaiṣyāmi (!) śrutabodha(2)m avistaram || 1 || saṃyuktādyaṃ dīrghaṃ sānusvāraṃ visargāsaṃmiśram(!) || vijñeyam akṣaraṃ gurupādāṃta(3)sthaṃ vikalpena || 2 || yasyāḥ prathame pāde dvādaśamātrās tathā [[tṛ]]tīye pi || aṣṭādaśadvitīye (4) paṃcada[[śa]]caturthake sāryyā || 3 || (fol. 1v1–4) End catvāro yatra varṇāḥ prathamam alaghavaḥ ṣaṣṭha(7)yaḥ (!) saptamo pi dvau tāvat ṣoḍaśādyau mṛgamadatilake ṣoḍaśāṃtyau tathāṃtyau || raṃ(8)bhāstambhorukāṃte munimunimunibhi (!) yatra kāṃte virāmo bāle vaṃdaiḥ kavīṃdraiḥ su(5v1)dani (!) nigaditā sragdharā sā prasiddhā || 42 || (fol. 5r6–5v1) Colophon iti śrīkālidāsaviracitau (!) śru(2)tabodha (!) samāptāḥ || śrī || 5 || likhitaṃ vireśvarajośī (!) || saṃvat 1867 phālgu(3)ṇamāse śuklapakṣe 7 bhṛguvāsare pustakaṃ samāptaṃ || śubham || ❁ || 49 || amaye āṣāḍha śudi 1 bhṛgudine śivarkṣe likhitam iti || || śubham astu || || || ❁ || || (fol. 6r3-5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || chaṃdasāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yena śrutamātreṇa buddhyate tam ahaṃ ra(2)cayiṣyāmi śrutabodham avistaraṃ || 1 || saṃyuktādyaṃ dīrghaṃ sānusvāraṃ visargasaṃmiśraṃ || (3)vijñeyam akṣaraṃ gurupādāṃtasthaṃ vikalpena || 2 || ādimadhyāvasāneṣu bhajasā yāṃ(4)ti gauravaṃ || yatatā lāghavaṃ yāṃti manau tu gurulāghavaṃ || 3 || yasyāḥ pāde prathame dvādaśa(5)mātrās tathā tṛtīye pi || aṣṭādaśadvitīye caturthake paṃcadaśa sāryā || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) End catvāro yatra varṇāḥ prathamamalaghavaḥ saptago pi (!) (6r1) dvau tāvat ṣoḍaśādyau mṛgamadamudite śoḍaśāṃtyau tathāṃtyau || raṃbhāstaṃbhorukāṃte (2)munimunimunibhir dṛśyate ced virāmo bāle āṃdye (!) kavīnṃdraiḥ sutanu nigaditā sragdharā sā prasiddhā || 42 || (fol. 5v7–6r3) Colophon iti śrīkavicakravarttikālidāsaviracitaṃ śru(4)tabodhan(!) nāma chandolakṣaṇaṃ samāptaṃ || || śrīśāke 1581 samaye āṣāḍhasudi 1 (5)bhṛgudine śivarkṣe likhitaṃ iti || || śubham astu || || ❁ || || (fol. 5v1–3)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || vaṃde viśveśvaraṃ devaṃ vācaspatimukhān gurūn mātaraṃ pitaraṃ natvā nirvighnepsitasiddhaye || 1 || na(2)tvā bhavānīcaraṇāravindaṃ mano hareṇa kri[[yate vicā]]rya | mānikyamalakṣitipālatuṣṭyai (!) subodhanīyaṃ śrutabodhaṭīkā || 2 || i(3)ha kavivastunirdeśātmakaṃ maṃgalācaranaṃ(!) kaṭākṣayan śrotripratipatidvārā (!) saprayojanaṃ cikirṣitaṃ (!) pratijānīte cha(4)ndasām iti || ahaṃ taṃ śrutabodha(!) racayiṣyāmi kariṣyāmi kīdṛśaṃ taṃ avistaraṃ na vidyate ativistāro (!) yasmin sa ativi(5)staras taṃ ativistaraṃ | (fol.1r1–5) End he śālaṃkārī (!) yadi (6)sānandākrāṃtāt (prītyajati)rahitā atye (!) bhavā aṃlyā saptavarṇātmakā (!) yā yatis tayā rahitā tyaktā bhavati || alaṃkāreṇa ābha(7)raṇena saha varttamānā sālaṃkārā tasyāḥ saṃbodhanaṃ || 18 || atha dodhakavṛttaṃ || ādyacaturtham iti || nanu he prakaṭasmarasāreta- (fol. 4v5–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || chandasāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yena śrutamātreṇa buddhyate || tam ahaṃ racayiṣyāmi śrutabodham a(2)vistaraṃ || 1 || saṃyuktādyaṃ dīrghaṃ sānusvāraṃ visargāsaṃmiśraṃ (!) || vijñeyam akṣaraṃ gurupādāṃtasthaṃ vika(3)lpena || 2 || ādimadhyāvasāneṣu bhajasā yānti gauravaṃ yaratā lāghavaṃ yāṃti manau tu gurulāgha(4)vaṃ || yasyā (!) pāde prathame dvādaśamātrās tathā tṛtīye pi || aṣṭādaśadvitīye caturthake pañcadaśa sā(5)ryyā || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) End catvāro yatra varṇāḥ (7)prathamalaghavaḥ ṣaṣṭhagaḥ saptago pi dvautāvat ṣoḍaśādyau mṛgamadamudite ṣoḍaśāmtyau (5r1)tathāntyau || raṃbhāstaṃbhorukānte munimunimunibhir dṛśyate ced virāmo bāle ādyaiḥ kavindraiḥ (!) (2)sutanu nigaditā sragdharā sā prasiddhā || 41 || (fol. 4v6–5r2) Colophon iti śrutabodhapustakaṃ samāptaṃ || subham astu || (3)atha hoḍācakraṃ || || cu ce co la aśvinī 1... (5v1)1664 śāke || (2)saṃvat 1799 || vāre 2 tithau 2 nakṣatra (!) 17 māse 7 likhitaṃ kāsirāmaśarmaṇāḥ tulasisthāne śuklā(3)nikaṭe tanahugrāme || śubhaṃ || ||... (fol. 5r2– 5v3)

«Beginning» ❖ oṃ namo mahābhairavāya || prathamaṃ caṃdrakuryākhyaṃ śulhanāthaṃ dvitīyakaṃ | tṛtīyaṃ śubhadeyaṃ ca kalpāsākhyaṃ caturthakaṃ | paṃcamaṃ caṭapuryākhyaṃ virājaṃ ṣaṣṭham eva ca | (va)yāśaṃ saptamaṃ caiva kāṃśālākhyaṃ tu cāṣṭamaṃ || navamaṃ bhogadevaṃ ca daśamaṃ divi viddhi mā || ekādaśāś(!) ca khaḍgākhyai dvādaśaṃ rudram eva ca || dharāśivaṃ trayodaśyaṃ mudrāsphoṭaṃ caturdaśaṃ | vaṃkāparaṃ paṃcadaśaṃ rajasphoṭaḥ ṣaḍ ucyate || ṣoḍaśaite mahāsiddhāṃ kāṃkaṇe hy adhikāriṇaḥ viprā(!) ṣaḍ kṣatriyo(!) dvau praṣṭasyaiva satā smṛtāḥ || (fol.1v1–3) «End» pradakṣiṇaśataṃ kuryāt sāṣṭāṃgaṃ ca namaskāraṃ | kṛtam āraṃbhaśāstrasya vyākhyālekhanakeṣu ca || ye samāptaṃ varārohe kṛtvā siddhiprado bhavet | athavā na kṛte devi vilopāt maraṇam bhavet || paṭhyate niraye ghore yāvad ākhya(!) mama(!)ṣṭakaṃ | idaṃ rahasya(!) kālāgamo gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || gopanā(!) siddhyate sarvaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ idānīṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ caturviṃśasahasrakaṃ || kulatantre catuḥproktam aṣṭāviṃśaṃ sahasrakaṃ || ❁ || (fol. 221v1–3) «Colophon» iti śrīmahāmaṃthānabhairavayajñaśtakoṭipraviṣtīrṇa anvaye navakodyāvatāre śrīcaturviṃśatisāhasre taṃtrābhidhāne namaskārāśīrvādavarṇano nāma trinavatimaḥ (!) paṭalaṃ || samāptaṃ śrīśrīmat (bhaṭṭārakaṃ) saṃpūrṇṇaṃ || ❁ || saṃvat 339 māghaśuklapratipada(!) || rājādhirājaparameśvaraparamabhaṭṭārakaśrīmadarimalladevavijayarājye likhitam idaṃ pustakam || ❁ || sva(!)bham astu || ❁ || (fol. 221v3–5)

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai | devy uvāca | deva deva mahādeva paripūrṇaprathāmaya | vāmakeśvaratantresminn ajā(!)tārthās tv anekaśaḥ || tāṃs tān arthān aśeṣeṇa vaktum arhasi bhairava || || śrībhairava uvāca || śṛṇu devi mahāguhyaṃ yoginīhṛdayaṃ paraṃ | tvatprītyā kathayāmyadya gopitavyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || karṇnāt karṇṇopadeśena saṃprāptam avanītale | na deyaṃ paraśiṣyebhyo nāstikebhyo na ceśvari || nāśuśrūṣāratānāñca naivānarthapradāyine | parīkṣitāya dātavyaṃ vatsarorddhoṣitāya ca || etaj jñātvā varārohe sadyaḥ khecaratāṃ vrajet | cakrasaṃketako mantrapūjāsaṃketakan tathā || trividhaṃ tripurādevyāḥ saṃketaḥ parameśvari | yāvad etan na jānāti saṃketaṃ trayam uttamaṃ | na tāvat tripurācakre param ājñāparo bhavet || (fol. 1v1–4) «End» etat te kathitaṃ guhyaṃ śaketa(!)trayam uttamaṃ | gopanīyaṃ prayatnena svaguhyam iva suvrate || cuṃbake jñānalabdhe vā na prakāśyaṃ tvayānaghe | anyāyena na dātavyaṃ nāstikānāṃ maheśvari || evaṃ tvayāham ājñaptaḥ madicchānurūpayā prabho | anyāyena tu yo dadyāt tasya pāpaṃ bhaviṣyati || saṃketaṃ yo vijānāti yoginīnāṃ bhavet priyaḥ | sarvvepsitaphalaprāptiḥ sarvvakāmaphalāśrayaḥ || yatoʼpi dṛśyate devi kathaṃcin na vicintayet || || (fol. 19v1–3) «Colophon» iti śrīyoginīhṛdaye pūjāsaṃketako nāma tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || (fol. 19v3)

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ namaḥ uḍīśvarāya || athāto uḍīsaṃbhāṣitavyā bhavati (dhyāse) tatra garakaraṇaṃ || sasyavināsanaṃ || gṛhabhajanaṃ || grāmoccāṭane || śalyakaraṇe || vadhirīkāaṇe(!) | bandhīkaraṇe || piśācīkaraṇe || ity evam ādīni karmāni(!) bhavanti || tatra garakaraṇaṃ || raktakañcukayā nārī raktaprāvaraṇaḥ pumān | naṭadārakasaṃyuktaṃ parkatādyāpasāṭayet || (fol. 1v1–4) «End» †uktadradhṛra ugasadanīū śikhā jārī pukhāgovāyukanyakā || jaṭākrātā jaśumatarkkakhaḍhusābhittamoha pānā ajakjraī || cīvīśita ubhimaraja saha devī magṛra śikhā tataṃja sarayuṃṣasya khāradhute malatā, rudaṃtī kudmari jayamāsa aparādā‥‥‥‥naṭītāyāṃbukā ye jahru || ❁ || ru ||† (fol. 73v1–6) «Colophon»

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ namas tripurasundaryai || gaṇeśagrahanakṣatrayoginīrāśirūpiṇīṃ | devīṃ mantramayīṃ naumi mātṛkāpīṭharūpiṇīṃ || 1 || praṇamāmi mahādevīṃ mātṛkāṃ parameśvarīṃ | kālahalo halollolakalanāśamakāriṇīṃ || 2 || yadakṣare(!)kamātrepi saṃsiddhe sparddhate naraḥ | ravitārkṣyendukandarpaśaṅkarānalaviṣṇubhiḥ || 3 || yadakṣaraśaśijyotsnāmaḍitaṃ bhuvanatrayaṃ | vande sarvveśvarīdevīṃ mahāśrīsiddhamātṛkāṃ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) «End» śabdasparśādayo vāṇāma‥‥‥‥‥baddhakaḥ || 341|| (vipratīti) janakāḥ śapta(ṣaṭcatuḥkoṇagāḥ || pūrvvapaścimayordvārau prāṇāyā(mā)tmakau sthitau | ka(lya)mārutabhṛtāni nava cakrāṇy anukramāt || 342 || (fol. 40v1–3) «Colophon»

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ siddhiḥ || bhairavāya namaḥ || oṁ hrīṃ śrīṃ aiṃ hreṃ hraṃ hlīṃ klīṃ kṣaḥ | praṇipatya anādināthaṃ anāthabhūtau dyām (nirgathanaṃ) | satanānanditamanasaṃ sa surāsuravaṃditāṃ hyayugaṃ || || śrīkubjikā uvāca || śivācittābjasaṃghātad urvvikā sā vikāsine | sadoditapraśāntāya namaḥ namaḥ śrīnāthabhānave | veṣṭitā devadeveśa ajñānapaṭalair ahaṃ | vāmadakṣiṇasiddhāntaiḥ sāṃprataṃ varttate kudhīḥ | yat tat kulakramāyātaṃ kulālītanutāṃ gataṃ | sūtrasaṃgrahanirmmu(ktaṃ) kalpasatvavivarjitaṃ | (fol. 1v1–4) «End» ādivaktrāntarā devī paścimānvapūjitāḥ | granthānāṃ rakṣaṇā proktā pāraṃparyākramāgatā | puroktaṃ yan mayā devi ādivaktrodbhavaṃ mahat | granthānān tu śataṃ sārddhaṃ teṣāṃ samyag varānanā || ❁ || nirgūḍhajñānasadbhāve divyodyatkubjikā mate | samāptedaṃ kujeśāni sārāt sārataraṃ paraṃ || ❁ || (fol. 68v3–6) «Colophon» oṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ aiṁ hreṁ hraṁ hlīṁ klīṁ kṣaḥ | aiṁ aghore hrīṃ paramaṃ ghore hlaṃ ghora vūporhāṃ ghorāmṛtīṣaṇe ca macamapivapivahehe ra ra ra ra ru ru ru ru hraṁ hraṁ hraṁ ha hraṁ hyoṁ ai || nigūḍhaṃ samāptaṃ || ❁ || paṇḍitaśrīmahādevena likhitaṃ | (fol. 68v5–6)

«Beginning» ❖ śrī ādināthapādukebhyo namaḥ || śrīmanmahendrācale ramye khaṭvāṭaśikhare sthitaṃ | sarvajñaṃ sacaraṃ vīraṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇaṃ | upasaṃgamya vidhinā devadevaṃ jagadguruṃ | praṇipatya maheśānī pṛcchati sma maderaṃ (!) | siddhāntaṃ caiva ḍāmaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ caiva gāruḍaṃ | bhūtatantrañ ca deveśa kulaśāstrāṇy aṇe(!)kadhā | mayā śrutāni śrīnātha tvayā nigaditāni ca | idānīṃ śrotum icchāmi kulamūlāvatārakaṃ | ūrddhasṛṣṭim adhaḥsṛṣṭim akhādhaḥ (!) sṛṣṭir eva ca | kathayasva praśā(!)dena yat tv ahaṃ tava vallabhā || śārīnātho(!)vāca | sādhu sādhu varārohe śrūyatāṃ kamalekṣaṇe | kathayāmi mahādevi kulamūlāvatārakaṃ | (fol. 1v1–4) «End» saṃgrahopagrahādisvaś(!) ca caturvviṃśasahasrakaṃ | pañcāṣṭādaśaśataṃ caturviṃśasahasrakaṃ | etat prakāsitaṃ tubhyaṃ tvamanyena yathā ruciḥ | kambalādicatuṣkan tu mālāvidyākalodbhavaṃ | yāgastobhakarāstā(!) tu pīṭhasiddhāntagopitaṃ || ❁ || (fol. 9v3–4) «Colophon» iti siddhapañcāsikāyāṃ candrapīṭhavinirgatāyāṃ mūlanāthāvatāritāyāṃ divyājñāguṇaprakāśikāyāṃ kulālītantramūlagatāyāṃ pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ samāptaś ceyaṃ śrīsiddhapañcāsikā iti || ❁ || śrīmahādevena likhitaṃ || (fol. 9v4–5)

«Beginning» mamottiṣṭhe(!) yad icche(!) siddhir uttamā | visarjanaṃ tataḥ kuryād arghaṃ dattvā yathārthataḥ | ya kṛṣṇā(!)yāgavaraṃ hy eta(!) mucyate bhavabandhanāt | anena yoginīsiddhā sakṛtpūjāvimanataḥ(!) | sarvvayāgādhike hy etha(!) maṃḍalaṃvaravarttini | kathitaṃ sarahasyaṃ te sadya(!)śreyaskaraṃ paraṃ | anena vidhinā devi yojayet saptabhir edinaṃ sadā sarvva(!) pravarttate siddhakhecari(!)melakaṃ | dvisaptāhād varārohe siddhiś ca samatāṃ vrajet | tṛ(!)śa(!)ptāhasya yajanad(!) asya yāgasy ubhair api ajaro hy amaraś caiva khecaryā saha modati(!) | aṇimādiguṇopetā bhairavas ru tathā hi sahaḥ(!) ruḍriḥ saha samāyukto(!) krīḍate sādhakottamaḥ (fol. 99v1–4) «End» ā❁❁❁❁❁cārya mama yajñaś ca sādhakaḥ putrakas tathā | pūjanīyā prayatnena bhairavaṃ tu pati-jā (!)| kathitaṃ te samāsena sārātsārajaganvike | naṃdayaṃ durvvinīṣṇa(!) na māyācchdmacāriṇe | kapaṭine lobhasaṃpanne mithyācānupāśake | dātavyaṃ jñānasadbhāvaṃ mahābhaktā(!) na tu cetasā | gurubhaktasamopetaṃ samayavratapālakaṃ | dātavyaṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ sarvvapāpaharaṃ śubhaṃ || ❁ || (fol. 161r4–116v2) «Colophon» iti lakṣapādādhike mahāsaṃhitāyāṃ dvādaśasāhasre vidyāpīṭhe matasāre trayoviṃśatitamaḥ paṭalaḥ || ❁ || matasāraṃ samāptaṃ || ❁ || maṃgalaṃ mahāśrī (fol. 161v2–3)

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ namaḥ śivāya || kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ bhairavaṃ vigatāmayaṃ | caṇḍanandimahākālagaṇeṣa(!)(vṛṣabhṛdgibhiḥ) || kumārendrayamādityabrahmāviṣṇupurassaraiḥ || stūyamānaṃ (maheśānaṃ) gaṇamātṛniṣevitaṃ || sṛṣṭisaṃhāraka⌠ñ caiva⌡ sthitivila⌠⌠ya⌡⌡kārakaṃ || anugrahakaran devaṃ praṇatārttivināśanaṃ | muditaṃ bhairavaṃ dṛṣṭvā devī vacanam abravīt || yat tvayā kathitaṃ mahyaṃ svacchandaṃ parameśvaraḥ | śatakoṭipravistīrṇṇabhedānantavisarppitaṃ || catuṣpīṭham mahātantraṃ catuṣṭayaphalodayaṃ | namaskurvanti manujā alpavīryaparākramāḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) «End» bhairaveṇa samākhyātā śaktayas tu varānane | anyāś ca siddhayaś citrā apsaromadhyamottamāḥ || anyatantra(!) samucchāyā sādhayanti na saṃśayaḥ || evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ prokta(!) melakan tu varānane satatābhyāsayogena dadanti varukaṃ svakam || yasya saṃprāsanād devi vīreśasadṛśo bhavet || tasmād dhyānārcanaṃ homaṃ japaś ca varavarṇṇini || kartavyaṃ bhāvitātmena (!) tataḥ siddhyanti mantriṇaḥ || ❁ || (fol. 161v2–4) «Colophon» iti svacchandalalitabhairave mahātantre mantrapīṭhe chomādhikāro nama pañcādaśamaḥ(!) paṭalas trisahasrapañcaśatādhikaṃ samāptam iti || ❁ || samvat 198? śrīmahārājanāgārjunadevasya rājñi | kulajaśrīmādhavasiṃhasya pustakaṃ lekhakakulodbhavabhīmasiṃhena likhitam iti || ❁ || (fol 161v4–5)

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ namaḥ paramaśabdadharāya | vyāptaṃ yena samastaśāmbhavapadaṃ ājñākramaṃ sarvvadā | divyādivya adivyaśūnyakhacaraṃ saṃvarttaviśvālayaḥ | jñānānanda ca saṃkulāghanamṛtaṃ pītvā tu somodayaṃ krīḍantī ravisomavahnibhuvana ājñā japetrottalā || śrīśrīkaṇṭha uvāca || śrutaṃ devi mayā sarvvaṃ tava nityābhidhānakaṃ | adyāpi saṃśayo devi trottalākramanirṇṇayam || (fol. 1v1–4) «End» śrīmān śrīśakaleṃdu(!) bhāti vimalā śrīkośaśāntipradā viśvātmā bharityaikaviśvajananī jāgrādibodhātmakā (!) | kāruṇyāmṛtavāriṇā vilaśitaṃ(!) siñcanti sārāvalī kānāmṛtupravañcakā (!) vijayite(!) śaṃśāraśārapradā (!) || 3 || (fol. 11v2–4) «Colophon» śrīśiddhilakṣmīmantrodhā(!)rato(!)tra (!) samāpta (!) || ❁ ❁ || (fol. 12r1)

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ namo mahābhairavāyaḥ(!) || atha māraye kṣipraṃ śakraṃ vai niścitān mavān(!) | apakāraśatair yuktaṃ kṛtaghnaṃ duṣṭacetasaṃ | kapānadvitayagṛhṛnāmaṃ(!) śatro samālikhet (!)| kapālamastakastantuṃ viṣāṅgāreṇa bhāvitāṃ | rudhireṇa samāyuktaṃ (rudrāreṇa) vidarbhitaṃ | mahāpretavanaṃ gatvā svatsandaṃ(!) pūjayet tataḥ | kṛṣṇamālyopahāraiś ca tataḥ karmma samārabhet | vijñāpya bhairavaṃ devaṃ śatrūṇ(!) cāhaṃ nipātayet | anujñātas tu devena gṛhītvā tu giradvayaṃ | tantuṃ gatvā mahādevi kapālāsanasaṃsthitaḥ | (fol.1v1–4) «End» kapālamāta(!)bharaṇaṃ prahasantaṃ vicintayet | āgneyāraktavarṇṇābhaśaktihastaṃ sadā maret (!) | daṇḍahastaṃ smṛtaṃ yoʼsya kṛṣṇavarṇṇaṃ subhīṣanaṃ (!) | nīlam ī(!)ndīvarābhāsaṃ naiṛtyaṃ khaḍgahastakaṃ | vyomavahniś (!) ca digbhāge pāśahastāṃ (!) vicintayet | dhūmrasāmīradigbhāge dhvajahastā sucañcalā | utta (fol. 9r5–7) «Colophon»

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ namas tripurāyai || vidyutpuñjanibhāṃ namāmi satataṃ prāgbhārasūṣmāṃ(!) girāṃ mūrtyābhagnamṛṇālatantunibhayā nirbhidyaliṅgatrayaṃ | prāpyordhvañ ca visarggabhāgamukulaṃ pīyūkhadhārārasaṃ pītvā vidgatacuddrumadravamayīṃ śaktiṃ parāṃ kālikāṃ || surāsurabhujaṅgādyair munīndraiḥ siddhakinnaraiḥ | pādāṅgam arccitaṃ yasyāḥ tāṃ nityāṃ sarvva⌠⌠dā⌡⌡ namaḥ || aikārāsanam ārūḍhāṃ vyomavibhramamālinīṃ | nityānandaparādevīṃ nityānityavarapradāṃ || (fol. 1v1–5) «End» ṣe(!)carī bhūcarī caiva tṛtīyā khecarī tathā | dadate sādhaken(drāṇāṃ) iti devi na śaṃsayaḥ(!) || aṣṭasiddhiṃ prayacchanti tasyaiva kuladevatāḥ | etat te kathitaṃ devi bhuktimuktiphalapradaṃ || ayogyasya na dātavyam ityājñā pārameśvari || iti ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ ||❁ || (fol. 15r1–3) «Colophon» iti rudrajā(!)male sapādalakṣagranthe vidyāpīṭhāvatāre uttarabhāgini(!)tyuktaṃnaprakaraṇe ṣaṣṭividyāpraśamsāyām uttaraṣaṭkaṃ samāptam iti || ❁ || likhitam iti tapodhanaśrīviśveśvareṇa yuvarājaśrījayāryuṇadevasyārthena likhitaṃ alpagranthakāreṇa (vistaraḥ) saṃ 479 śrāvaṇakṛṣṇadaśamī śivaṃ bhavatu || (fol. 15r3–6)

«Beginning» ❖ oṁ namo mahābhairavāya | kalpāntānalakalpakalpitam adhaḥ sādāśivākhyāvadhiṃ | prodbhityordham adhoditodayaparānande prayāntī layaṃ | bāhyāntapratibhāgaḥ śuddhi(visamā) śbdānuvṛttiṃ parāṃ | śaktiḥ śktimato ʼvatāt tribhuvane bhāvodbhavāṃ kaulikīṃ || praṇamāmi catuḥpīṭhaṃ devīṃ kubjikāñ ca sāsvatīṃ (!) śrīmitrādisiddhaḥ pādāñ ca ājñāsiddhāmahodayāṃ || devy uvāca || yat tvayā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ kubjikāmatam uttamaṃ | tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi prasādaṃ kuru bhairavaḥ || bhairava uvāca || kulākaulānusāreṇa dīkṣitāya pradāpayet | dīkṣitā tvaṃ mayā pūrva śktivedhena sundari | (fol. 1v1–4) «End» yā sā śrīpaścimākhye dvi(ṣakaya)sumukhaṃ lākinī dūrayatvaṃ | yaḥ prāle⌠⌠ye⌡⌡nduśaṃkhaṃ dyutir amṛtavalā pāsahastāruṇākṣī | dhūmrajvālāsphuliṅgaiḥ kahakahahasitaiḥ trāsayantī trilokaṃ | nānāstrakakhādagrantī pitṛvananilaye kṛtyamānā niśāyāṃ | yā sā śrīciciñnisaḥ kramabhajanaripuḥ kākiṇī bhakṣaya tvaṃ | yā sā santapajaś ca nadarucirucirā daṇḍahastā pracaṇḍā | huṃkā (fol. 5v4–6) «Colophon»

Beginning yam āsādya nivarttante vikalpāḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ | tasmai vai dehaśūnyāya .. .. .. .. .. .. .. .. | .. .. .. .. .. .. .. .. (vakṣye dī)kṣāvidhin tathā | pavitrārohaṇañ caiva pratiṣṭhāñ ca pracakṣmahe || śeṣā kramena nityādikarmasmaraṇapaddhatiḥ | bhavābdhim uttitīrṣūṇāṃ nā(vā) naur iva nirmmitāḥ (!) | atha nityakarmavidhin (!) tatra prātar utthāya kāvaśyakaṃ | ekapā mṛdā liṅgaṃ vāmahastañ ca prakṣālya tisṛbhir gudaṃ daśabhir vvāmahastam ubhau ca saptabhiḥ | prakṣālya gandhalepāpanodena ⟪naṃ⟫ bhāvaśuddhyā vā śaucam vidhāya | sakṛ⁅nmṛ⁆dā pādau hastau ca prakṣālya | jaṃbvāmrādikāṣṭhena dvādaśāṅgulena kaniṣṭhāṅgulīyapariṇāhena dantaśuddhiṃ vidhāya snāyāt | (fol. 1v1–5) End jīrṇṇaliṅgādikam uddhṛtya sthāne tanmayaṃ tatpramāṇaṃm alaṃkṛtaṃ anyaliṅgādikaṃ (śāstro)ktavidhinā pratiṣṭhāpayeti || ○ || saiṣā kramena nityādikarmasmaraṇapaddhatiḥ | bhavābdhim uttitīrṣūṇāṃ nā(vā) naur iva nirmmitāḥ | yad viprakīrṇṇam ativistṛtam asphuṭārthaṃ nityādikarmma kathitaṃ parame⁅śva⁆〇reṇa | tatsaṃgataṃ ca laghu cāpy aparisphuṭañ ca śrībhojadevajagaṭpatinā bhyadhāyi || ❁ || iti mahārājādhirājaśrībhojadevaviracitāyāṃ siddhāntasārapaddhatau jīrṇṇoddhāravidhiḥ samāptaḥ || (fol. 71r1–4) Colophon saṃvat 100 90 7 kārttikakla(!)divātṛtīyāṃyāṃ (!) somadine likhitam iti || ❁ || śubham astu || (fol. 71r4–5)

«Beginning» hakaṃ || tasmān nityaṃ prakarttavyaṃ kaulābhyāṃ saṃvarāṇane | bahiḥ pūjā mahādevi śaivoktavidhinā priye || nādākṣaṃ paramaṃ bījaṃ sarvvasatvesv avasthitaṃ | taṃ viditvā mahādevi sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || (fol. 3r1–2) «End» pitṛdevāgni(bhaktaś) ca †asaṃtoṣī jagad (vitaḥ)† || śivoktaśāsane raktagurubhaktadṛḍhavarataḥ || ahaṃkāraparityaktaḥ saṃvitbhaktabahuśrutaḥ || eṣa devi mayā proktaṃ saucācāreṣu brāhmaṇā | vadisyāmi varārohe trayā(‥)raṃ punaḥ priye || antakaule niyan proktaṃ a(bhyā)maṃ sarvadā priye || nāḍīcakreṣu yat proktaṃ proktaṃ yad vaṃsanirṇṇaye | piṇḍapadādivijñāne (fol. 12v3–5) «Colophon» The colophon is lost since the text runs up to fol. 12.

«Beginning» oṁ namaḥ śivāya . yo (jattāṃ) jananaṃ sthitiṃ sanilayāṃ saṃrakṣaṇānugrahau kurvvāṇo na virajyate na ca pare vyāhanyate (truṭyate) | natvānādimalojjhitaṃ śivam amuṃ śrutvā mataṃ deśikāt pūjāhomapavitradāmavidhiṃ mādṛsmṛtau kurmmahe || yuktaṃ dīkṣāpratiṣṭhābhyāṃ ⌠⌠ratnābhyāṃ⌡⌡ bādhavāridheḥ | svacchāgādhāpārabhīmamṛdugūḍhārthavarṇanaḥ || smṛtvā vāgeṣa(!)siddhāntatābhiḥ(!) śiṣyābjabodhakam | āryadharmaśivācāryasūryam ācāryamārjakam || athotthāya rajanyante śucir vvāpy aśuciḥ sadā || prāṇāyāmādyaṣṭāṅgayogaccha‥‥‥‥hapadmamadhyagaṃ | haṃsaṃ dhyāyet paraṃ jyotir ekāgraṃ sūkṣmam akṣaram | aṅguṣṭhaparvvamātraṃ vā sthūlaṃ vācyaṃ sadāśivaṃ || (fol. 1v1–5) «End» kvacid uktoʼnyadevānāṃ vidhiś cāpi niveśane || astreṇa vā svamantreṇa sahasaṃ juhuyāt tataḥ || jīrṇṇadvāraḥ punaḥ prāgvad vidheyaḥ siddhim icchatā || jīrṇṇadhāmasamuddhāre khaḍgaṃ vinyasya tanmanūn || yajet prāsādasiddhārthaṃ liṅgaṃ ‥‥ na pālayan || siddhe dhāmny aṅgasaṃyogaṃ kuryād ākṛśya khaḍgataḥ || pūrvvākhyakhaḍgamo jīrṇṇam taddravyaṃ tatpramāṇakaḥ || (śreṣadavāmagaḥ śeṣāṅgi‥‥‥) (fol. 143v4–6) «Colophon»

«Beginning» (purodhāṣṭa) || oṁ namo gurupādukebhyaḥ || aiṃ paraṃ prakāśam ānaṃdam ovalitrayabṛṃhitaṃ | ṣaṭprakāraṃ mahāsphāraṃ tattvaṃ vaṃde (kvaṃdhvaraṃ) || ādau parārṇṇa‥sāmānyā‥‥‥tra kṛtvā || aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ kuṇḍamālinī avvāpāpta || 3 icchāśakti (!) avvāpāpta || 3 jñānaśakti(!) avvāpāpta || 3 kṛ(!)yāśakti(!)avvāpāpta || 3 varṇṇamālinī avvāpāpta || svāsane trikoṇaṃ saṃciṃtya koṇatraye tathā madhye upari pūjyaṃ || || aiṃ (ā)sāśaktir bhagākhyā tripathagatiyutā tryakṣatriprakārāṅgī tasyā(!) śrī uḍḍiyāṇaṃ(!) parakalasahitaṃ madhyasaṃsthaṃ sudīptaṃ | śrīṃ tacchrījālaṃ dharākhyaṃ prakaṭitanilayaṃ dakṣiṇe caiva koṇe | khphruṃ vāme śrīpūrṇṇapīṭhaṃ paśubhayajanakṛt pūritaṃ yena viśvaṃ || (fol. 1v1–5) «End» iti catuḥṣṣṭhi (!) devatā catuḥṣaṣṭhi(!)dale agrakoṇād ārabhya vāmāvarttakrameṇa///ṇā vartteṇa pūjyāḥ || praticakre (brahmādi) cakreśvaryāṣṭakam ya(!) sthitaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyārabhya prati aṣṭadale tatraiva navamī pūjyā || iti ka///ṣṭāṃte cakreśvaryyaikaikā pūjyāḥ || madhye bhagavatī bhūrivarṇṇacakreśvarī pūjyāḥ || ❁ || ataḥ paraṃ bāhyacatuḥṣaṣṭyāre daśamama/// śītimaṃḍalāni agrād ārabhya vāmāvarttakrameṇa pūjyāḥ || || (fol. 50r3–6) «Colophon» iti nityanaimittikavidhiḥ samāptāḥ(!) || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 50r6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsarasvatyai || praṇamya śirasā viṣṇu, trailokyādhipatiṃ prabhuṃ | nānā (2) śāstrodhṛtaṃ vakṣye rājanītisamuccayaṃ || 1 || trailokyayā adhipati juraṃ śrīnā(3)rāyaṇaṭoṃ namaskāra yāṅāva nānā śāstrasa piṃkāsyaṃ tayā rajanī(4)ti muṃṅa tayā khaṃ je[[na]] hlāya || o || (fol. 1r1–4) Sub-colophon iti cānakyasārasaṃgrahe prathamaśataka samāptaṃ || ۞ || (fol. 29v5) iti cānakyasārasaṃgrahe dvitīyaḥ śataka samāptaṃ || ۞ || (fol. 57r6) End asārepiha saṃsāre sā(6)rameva catuṣṭayaṃ | kāśyāṃ vāsaḥ vatāṃ saṃgo gaṅgāmbhaḥ śambhupūja(84v1)naṃ || 100 || asāra saṃsārasa thva petā sāra juraṃ chuchu dhārasā (2) kāśīvāśa satpuruṣa saṃga yāya gaṃgālaṃkhana śṛīmahādeva pūjā (3) yāya thvate sāra juraṃ || || (fol. 84r5–84v3) Colophon iti cānakyasārasaṃgrahe tṛtī(4)yaśatakaḥ samāptaṃ || o || śubhamastu sarvvadā || samvat 720 (5) vaiśāṣa śuddhi 1 śuklavāra thva puthi coya dhuṅa dina juroṃ || caukvātha(6)śa vandi yāṅāva talaṅāsyaṃ keśavana coyā juroṃ || śubhaṃ || (fol. 84v3–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ sarvvajñāya || pranamya śirasā burddha trailokyādhipatiṃ prabhuḥ nānā śāstadhṛtaṃ vakṣa rājaniti samuccaye || || trailokyayā thākula na(2)rmmaskāra yāṅāva nānā śāstrasa pikāsyaṃ tayā kha jena hlāya || 1 || (fol. 1r1–2) End asā(10)lyapihi saṃsāraṃ pārabbhakaccatuṣṭayaṃ kāśyāṃ vāsa śaṃkāsaṃ śrīgaṃgā busya bu pujanaṃ || || asāra saṃsālasa sāra ca(11)ta thvate kāśivāśa satpuruṣava pasaṃga yāya gaṃgā laṃkhana mahādevasa māna yāya thūti sāra data || 100 || (fol. 23v9–11) Colophon iti cāna samāpta || ۞ || (fol. 23v11) Sub-colophon iti cānakesārasaṃgrahe prathamaśataṃkaṃ sa(10)māpta || o || ۞ || (fol. 8v9–10) iti (9) cānakesārasaṃgrahe dvitiyaśataṃkaṃ samāptaḥ || ۞ || (fol. 16r8–9)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ sarvvajñāya || namaskāra thajura sarvvajña dhāyā īśvarastaṃ īśvarasa nāma chu nimitina dhārasā (2) sarvva jānātīti sarvvajña bhūta bhavikṣa varttamāna svarga matya pātāla trilokayāṃ catri seraṅāna gatheṃṭoṃ jursā (3) narapatilokana thava duṃlāsa coṃgva ratnajāti malatvaṃ nirmmalanoṃ seraṅāna sarvvajña dhāraṅā thvatena sarvvajña (4) dhāyā iśvaraṭoṃ namaskāra strailokyayāvu pāpa haraṇa thatheṃ sarvva dhāyā tathāgatasa nāmavu ṭevakha || || (exp. 1:1-4) iti kuśopadeśe nītisāre sugrīvāṣtaka samāpta || (exp. 6t7) iti kuśopadeśē nītisāre tārādevyā ślokāṣṭakaṃ samāptaṃ || (exp. 9t2) iti kuśopadeśe nītisāreṅgaḍakumāraḥ ślokā(2)ṣṭakaṃ samaptaṃ || ۞ || bhādrapada śuddi dvitīyākuhnu coyā juro || (exp. 12:1-2) End avajñānādrājño bhavati matihīnaḥ parijanas tatas tat prādhānyād vra(4)jatinasamipe budhajanaḥ | budhais tyakte rājya bhavati hīnītina hinī guṇavatī vipannāyān nītau sakala(5)m eva saṃsīdati jagat || avajñānādrājño bhavati hīna parijana dhāya ajñāni rājā parijana bhṛtya lā(6)ka (!) matihīna juyu | tatas tat prādhānyārd vrajatinasamīpe budhajana dhāye | pradhānye lokasa samīpasa budhajana (7) jñāṇilokasa thva rājasa pāśaśa mavaṃgva mavara | jñāṇihmaṃ pāsa madvātaṅāva rājā aniti juyu ku(exp. 12:1)mantrī jusyaṃ lokayā mati jesyaṃ loka samaṣṭavu ṭākva || (exp. 11b3-12:1) Colophon «Written in second hand:» varāṭakonāṃ daśakadvayaṃ yat sā kākinī tāścatasraḥ panaḥ | teṣo ḍaśa dramma ihāva gamyo drammaistathā ṣoḍaśabhiśca niṣkaḥ ||

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ sāradāyai || nāgo bhāti madena kaṃ jalaruhaiḥ pūrṇṇendunā śarvvarī, śīlena pramadā javena turago nityotsavair mandiraṃ | vāṇī vyākaraṇena haṃsamithunair nnadyaḥ sabhā paṇḍitaiḥ satputrreṇa kulaṃ tvayā masumatī lokatrayam viṣṇunā || 1 || bhāti śobhate, kosau, nāgo hastī, kena madena, harṣālaṅkāreṇa, athavā mattasvabhāvena || tathā bhāti, kin tat, kaṃ jalaṃ , kaiḥ jalaruhaiḥ, padmotpalādibhiḥ | (fol.1v1-2r2) End karkkoṭakasya nāgasya damayantyā nalasya ca | ṛtuparṇṇasya rājarṣeḥ smaraṇāt kalināśanaṃ || vehalaḍasiṃkosa, vane sapaṃḍayethva, vehala ḍasiṃko sa cone mateva, puṇyakṣaya juyuva || ❁ || || śubhaṃ || (fol. 30r3-30v1) Colophon iti kuśopadeśanītisāre lokāṣṭakas tṛtīyaḥ || (fol. 30r1) saṃvat 812 vaiśāṣavadi 4 thva kunhu śrībhūpatīndramalladena dayakā dina || || śubham astu || (fol. 30v2-3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsarasvatyai || praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuṃ, trailokyādhipatiṃ prabhuṃ | nānā śāstroddhṛtaṃ (2) vakṣye rājanītisamuccayaṃ | trailokyayā adhipati juraṃ nārāyaṇatvaṃ namaskāra yā(3)ṅāva nānā śāstrasa piṃkāṃsyaṃ tayā rajanīti muṃṅa tayā khaṃ jena hlāya || 1 || || (fol. 1v1–3) Sub-colophon iti cānakyesārasaṃgrahe prathamaḥ śatakaḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 22r3) iti cā(3)nakyasārasaṃgrahe dvitīyaḥ śatakaḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 38v2-3) End asāre(4)pīha saṃsāre sārameva catuṣṭayaṃ | kāśyāṃ vāsaḥ satāṃ saṃgaḥ gaṅgāmbhaḥ śambhupūjana || a(5)sārasa thva petā sāra juraṃ kāśīvāsa sajjanao saṃga yāye gaṅgālaṃkhva mahādeva pūjā yāya thva(6)te sāra dataṃ || 99 || || (fol. 53v3–6) Colophon iti cānakyesārasaṃgrahe tṛtīyaśatakaḥ samāptaḥ || || (7) śrīśrīsumatijaya jitāmitramalladevasana thva pustaka dayakā || bhāgirāma palamānayā velasa || samvat 810 (8) kārttika śuddi 9 śubhaṃ || (fol. 53v6–8)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāye namaḥ || oṃ namaḥ śrīsarasvatyai || praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuṃ, trailokyādhipatiṃ prabhu || (2) nānā śāstrodhṛtaṃ vakṣyā(!) rājanīti samuccayaṃ || 1 || trailokyayā adhipati juraṃ śrīnārāyaṇaṭoṃ na(3)maskāra yāṅāva nānā śāstrasa pikāsyaṃ tayā rājanīti muṃṅa tayā khaṃ hlāya || || (fol. 1v1–3) End sadambhaśca hato dharmma krodherneva hataṃ tapaḥ | adṛṭaśca hataṃ jñā(4)naṃ pramādena hataṃ śrutaṃ || 96 || ahaṃkāri juraṅāva dha[[rmma]] moyu, krodhī juraṅāva (5) tapa moyu, pramādi juraṅāva ṅeṅā sāstra phola juyu || || adīpte ggau hato (6) homo, hatā bhukti rasākṣīkāḥ | upajivyā hatā kanyā svārthe pākakriyā (fol. 22v3–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || nāgo bhāti madena kiṃ jalaruhai(!) pūrṇendunā sarvarī, śīlena pramadā javena turago nityotsavā(!) mandiraṃ || vāṇī vyākaraṇena haṃsamithunai(!) nadhyaḥ sabhā paḍita(!) satputreṇa kulaṃ tvayā vasumati(!) lokatrayaṃ viṣṇunām(!) || || asyārtha(!) || kiskindhyā nagarīkā rājā sugrīvale śrīrāmacandrakā putra lavakuśabhanyākākana rājanīti śikāudābhayā || he mahārāja kuśakumāra matta bhairahyāko hāti śobhā huṃcha || (fol. 1v1-6 ) End śrīrāmacandra putra kuśakumārakana dharma upadeśa diyā || jo yo kuśopadeśa abhyāsa garlā mūrkhabhayā pani jñānī holā || jñānī bhayāpachi parameśvarako bhakta huṃcha, bhakta bhayāpachi mukta huṃcha || ❁ || (fol. 11v2-4 ) Colophon iti kuśopadeśanītisāre aṃgadāṣṭakaṃ tṛtīyasamāptaṃ || || śubham || || śrīrāmakṛṣṇāye(!) namaḥ || || (fol. 11v4-5 )

Beginning na chedanaiḥ | tathā puruṣamapyavaṃ kulaśīlena karmmaṇā || 71 || gathyaṃ lu chusyaṃ dāsyaṃ tokadhyeṅa(2)na, parikṣā yātaṃ athyaṃ kula svabhāva karmmaṇa, puruṣa parikṣā yātaṃ || || (exp. 2t1–2) End ācāryyaphate dharma, mācāryya (8) pharate dhanaṃ | ācāryya phalamāpnoti, hyācāro hata lakṣaṇaṃ || 93 || dharma phalarapiva ā(9)cāryyaṇa rakṣaṇa phalarapiva babu jura || || bhojyaṃ bhojana śaktiśca, ratiḥ śakti varastri(10)yaḥ | vibhavo dāna śaktiśca, nālpasya tapasa phalaṃ || 94 || nake phavahmana, nake thakheta (exp. 4t7–10)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ sarvvajñāya || taṃtrākhyānakathāṃcaiva buddhipadma pravodhinī | ādityadīdhitimevuṃ tāni (2) dhāsyāmi yatnataḥ || taṃtrākhyāna dhāyā khaṃ thva, buddhi hātaṅā pare hoyakava ādityasa kiraṇavo u(3)thiṃga thva khaṃ, cho yatnanaṃ dhararape māla || rakṣatavyaṃ sadā vākyaṃ vākyaṃ bhavati nāśanaṃ | haṃsyāṃ(4)bhyāṃ gīvamānnasya, kūrmmasya patanaṃ yathā || sadā vacana rakṣarapaṃ yane māla, velakāla maso(5)syaṃ hlāyā vacanana nāśa juphuvakha, haṃsa nehmaṃsyaṃ boyakaṃ yaṃle vacana hlāṭolana, kāpare tā(6)ka theṃ tāya yevakha || thvayā upākhyāna || (fol. 1r1-6) End rātrau svastidine, svastisvastī madhyestu sarvvadā || svasti bhuyātvenni(fol. 43r7)bhyaṃ svastī sarvvata sarvvadā || thva taṃtrākhyāna ṅeṅayā naṃ, hlākayā naṃ, thva tatva dhararape mālakha dhāraṅā || || trisa naṃ dinasa naṃ madhyāṃnasa naṃ (fol. 43v1) kalyāna juraṃ, sarvvadā kālaṃ śubhamaṃgala kalyāna thajura || jitarāja bhārokasya hṛdaya kamala yāṅana thva taṃtrākhyānayā gatheṃ buddhi dvā(2)taṃ atheṃ kalyāna buddhivaṃta thajura || (fol. 43r6-43v2) Colophon (fol. 43v2) iti taṃtrākhyāna samāpta || samvata 638 pauṣa śuddhi 8 śubhamastu sarvvadā || ۞ : ||

Beginning śrīḥ || mitravān sādhayet kāryaṃ duḥsādhyam api vai yataḥ | tasmān mitrāṇi kurvīta sāmānye ca śriyātmanaḥ | 1 | sapūrṇenāpi kartavyaṃ mitram abhyudayaṃ mithaḥ | udadhiḥ paripūrṇepi svātyodakam apekṣate | 2 | yo mitraṃ kurute mūḍha ātmano(!) sadṛśaṃ kudhīḥ | hīnaṃ cābhyadhikaṃ cāpi hāsyatāṃ yātyasaujane | 3 | tāvat sthīti(!) bhavelloke yāvad dānaṃ pradīyate | vatsaḥ kṣīrakṣayaṃ dṛṣṭvā parityajati mātaraṃ | 4 | (fol. 1r1–5) End aṃdhakaḥ kubjakaś caiva hāntestanī rājakanyakā | anayopi nayaṃ yāti yathā teṣāṃ babhūvaha | 6 | pṛṣṭhadeśastanasparśād kukuśaṃ jalatāṃgataḥ | daivānukūlyāt sarvatra kalyāṇaṃ saṃprapadyate | 7 | laghurapi mahatāṃ vaisastave nāti vaṃdyaṃ paramapadam udāra viṃdate labdhabhāgyaḥ tṛṇagaṇam api tāvat paśya gagatiragā (!) kalitalalitadehaṃ prāsanāsti yadabdhiṃ 1 maṇirāmakṛti (fol. 15r13–15v2)

Beginning ❖ śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ, śāṃkarīṃ śaṃkarātmajaṃ | ajñānadhvāntanāśāya, kriyate nītidīpikā || 1 || nānā granthān samālokya, dhīraiḥ saha vicāry-ya ca | kṛteyaṃ sāram uddhṛtya, sarvvaloka hitaiṣiṇī || 2 || caturāśītilakṣeṣu, śarīreṣu śarīriṇāṃ | na mānuṣyaṃ vinānyatra, tattvajñānaṃ tu labhyate || 3 || atra janmasahasrāṇāṃ, sahasrair api niścitaṃ | kadācil-labhyate jantur, mānuṣyaṃ punyasamcayāt || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) End nāsti jñāna samaṃ tīrthaṃ, nāsti jñānasamaṃ tapaḥ | nāsti jñānasamo yajñas, tasmāta (!) jñānaṃ samabhyaset || 118 || deve bhāskara mallesmin jyojānīsvaratāṃgate | nītiśāstreṇa nepālaṃ, samutpālitum udhyate || 119 || śuciyugmagajesaṃkhye, gate nepāla sammate | divyarātrau paraṃdhīrā, sampūrṇṇā nītidīpikā || 120 || (fol. 64r3–6) Colophon || ○ || || iti nītidīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhamodhyāyaḥ || ❖ || śubha samāptaṃ (!) || (fol. 65v1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ śāṃkarī śaṃkarātmajaṃ || ajñānadhvāntanāśāya kriyate nītidīpikā || 1 || nānā granthān samālokya dhīraiḥ saha vicāryya ca || kṛteyaṃ sāram uddhṛta sarvalokahitaiṣiṇī || 2 || caturāśītilakṣeṣu śarīreṣu śarīriṇāṃ || na mānuṣyaṃ vinānyatra tatvajñānaṃ tu labhyate || 3 || atra janmasahasrāṇāṃ sahasrair api niścitaṃ || kadācil-labhate jaṃtur mānuṣyaṃ puṇyasaṃcayāt || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) End nāsti jñānasamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti jñānasamaṃ tapaḥ || nāsti jñāna samo yajñas tasmād jñānaṃ samabhyaset || 18 || muhūrttam api jīveta naraḥ śuklena karmaṇā || nakalpam api jīvet lokadvaya virodhinā || 19 || kaḥ kālaḥ kāni mittāṇi ko deśaḥ ko (!) vyayāgamau || kaś cāhaṃ kā ca me śaktir iti ciṃtā mumuhuḥ(!) || 20 || (fol. 75r5–75v4) Colophon || iti śrīnītidīpikākāyāṃ ṣaṣṭodhyāya (!) || 6 || || iti śrīśāke || 1766 śrīśamvat 1901 adhikaśrāvaṇakṛṣṇapakṣe tithayaḥ 5 vāre 3 nakṣatre 15 yogye (!) || iha kāntīpūranagare liṣitaṃ śamāptaṃ || śubham astu || rāmāya namaḥ || acyutāya namaḥ || || || || || || || || || || || || || || (fol. 75v4–76r2)

Beginning oṃ namo śrīgaṇeśāyaḥ (!) || || sarasvatīm ahaṃ vaṃde sabhāṣyā nītimaṃjarī | dyādvivedasya vājñasya mukhesṭhitvā(!) kṛtā yayā 1 vyākhyāya paṃcameślikān itihāsapuraḥsarān mukundakulajoyād vaḥ ṣaṣṭetha vyāvikīrṣati (!) adharme matiṃ na kuryād ityartha āha || ||(fol. 1r1–3) End vatsāram ādyaśuklādā(!)vakārādyā tithivimāṃ (!) | aṃkānāṃ vāmao gatir ityuktatvāt viṃduśaraśari | kanāṃkarāṇi | tanasaṃvat apaṃcadaśapaṃcāśe saṃvatsāra duṃdubhināmni māghaśuklādotithau pratidyād dviveda imāṃ nītimaṃjarīṃ sabhāṣyām akarot || sarasvatīm ahaṃ vaṃde sabhāṣyā nītimaṃjarī | dyādvivedasys cājñasya mukhe ṣvitvā kṛtā yayā || (fol. 24r1–5) Sub-colophon iti dyādvivedaviracite nītimañjarībhāṣye vedārthaprakāśe caturthāṣṭake nītivākyāni [[vyā]]khyātāni || || (fol. 18r2–3) tadartheyakṛka | prastoka inviti | tatra kathā | evaṃ vāraśikhāṃ jitvā prastokas sāñjaryo mṛdhe | bhāradvājāya gurave vividhā dakṣIṇā dadau | tā gṛhītvā gṛhācāvan nindraṃprati yadaba… (fol. 15v8–9) Colophon iti dyādvivedaviracite aṣṭamāṣṭāke nītivākyāni darśitāni || || śubhaṃ bhavatu || śrīḥ gaṇeśāmbikāyāḥ prasādāt śubhaṃ bhavatu || 2 || || 6 || || śrīḥ || || ❁ || ❖ || (fol. 24r5–7)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || sabhādīpadānaṃ || ( dānāślokasaṃgraha evaṃ ) śvābaṇyāṃ śravaṇe ṛkṣe sabhāyāṃ agnisannidhau || putrān dehi dhanaṃ dehi avaidhavyaṃ ca dehi me || 1 || atyaṃtasujvalaṃ dīpaṃ ajñānāndhanivāraṇaṃ || saubhāgyārogyasiddhiṃ ca sabhādīpa prayaccha me || 2 || agnijyoti ravijyotisś caṃdrajyotis tathaiva ca || uttamaḥ sarvajyotīnāṃ dīpo yaṃ pratigṛhyatāṃ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–6) «End: » ityuktvā viprakare sajalapucchaṃ datvā yajñasādhanabhūtāya viśvasyāghapraṇāśanī || viśvatāpadharo deva prīyatāṃ anayā gavā || 1 || ghṛtakṣīrapradā gāvo ghṛtaṃ yonyo ghṛtodbhavā || ghṛtanagho ghṛtāvartā tā me santu sadā gṛhe || 2 || ghṛtaṃ me hṛdayaṃ nityaṃ ghṛtaṃ nābhyāṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ || ghṛtaṃ me sarvataś caiva ghṛtaṃ manasi vai ghṛtaṃ || 3 || gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāva pṛṣṭhata eva ca || gāvo me sarvataś caiva gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham || 4 || (dve)ti vasiṣṭhoktamaṃtrānya(saṃ)paṭhet || iti goprārthanā madanaratne || ( devasyatvāºº ) || pari … +++ (fol. 11v2–8) «Colophon:» x

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ sabhāyāḥ kavir bhūmipālasya nītiḥ suputraḥ kulānāṃ satāṃ satyavāṇī śrutir brāhmaṇānāṃ trapā kāminīnāṃ yaśaḥ sarvalokasya sad bhūṣaṇaṃ syāt 1 vṛthā mandiraṃ sundarīnāsti yeṣāṃ vṛthā jīvanaṃ sādhubhir ninditānām vṛthā sevanaṃ nirvivekasya rājñovṛthā sanmanohāriṇī yā na vidyā 2 niśā kiṃ niśānāthahīnā saraḥ kiṃ sarojair vihīnaṃ gṛhī kiṃ daridraḥ mahī kiṃ mahīnāthahīnā kaviḥ kiṃ kavīnāṃ manohāripadyair vihīnaḥ 3 (fol. 1v1–2r1) End naśīlāt paraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ dharmatonyat sumitraṃ na pāpāt paro naiva śatruḥ na ca śrīmahādevatonyaḥ śaraṇyo na vairāgyato vidyate bhāgyam anyat 20 nirmitā kavitākāntā harivaṃśa dvijanmanā nītibuddhipradā kaṇṭhe vidagdhānāṃ lagiṣyatu 21(fol. 4v5–5r2) Colophon iti kaviharivaṃśakṛtaṃ nītibhujaṃgaprayātam samāptam śubham astu (fol. 5r2–3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ sarasvatyai || manave vācaspataye, śukrāya parāśarāya sa sutāya ca | cānakyāya ca (2) viduṣe namostu nṛpaśāstrakarttṛbhyaḥ || munusataṃ bṛhaspasataṃ śukrasataṃ parāśarasataṃ vyāsa(3)sataṃ cānakya prabhṛti rājanīti dayakava munilokasataṃ, namaskāra thajura || || (fol. 1v1–3) End vanasa chaguḍi dahayā tīrasa hutra yuddha khanā hvatra (76r1) nehmaṃ thethesyaṃ moṅāna prahāra yāle moḍa mahī hāyāva bhūmīsa padarapra (2) svayāva gauchino nibuddhi jaṃbuka chalana hoḍa thethe yāṅa chāyā verasa (3) thva hī pheya yāṅa vananyāsyaṃ antarasa lāṅāva thva hoḍa nehmaṃsyaṃ jaṃbukayā(4)kenyāna prahāra yāṅāva thva prahāraṇa jaṃbuka sika || || (fol. 75v6–76r4) «Sub–colophon:» iti samāptam idaṃ mitralābhanāma prathama taṃ(54r1)traṃ || || ۞ || || thvanaṃli ava suhṛdbheda (2) nāma neguḍi taṃtra āraṃbha yāṅa he || || ||(fol. 53v6–54r2) Colophon (fol. )

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || athataṃtrākhyānakathā || taṃtrākhyānakathā bhanyāko kastā ho bhanyā kathāmā śreṣṭha ho jasto śrīsūryyakā kiranale savai prakāśa garāuṃcha tastai vuddhi prakāsa garcha || 1 || rakṣitavyaṃ sadā vākyaṃ vākyād avati (!) nāsanam || haṃsābhyāṃ niyateṇasya (!) kurmanase (!) patanaṃ yathā || 2 || vacana boldā sambhāra (!) gari bolnu || vacanale āphnu nāśa huṃcha jastai haṃsale kachuvālāi boki laijādā jasai bolothyā tahi ṣasi maryo ||(fol. 1:1–6) End rātrisvasti divāsvasti svastimadhe (!)dinas tathā svāsti bhuyā (!) bhavet nityaṃ svasti sarvatra sarthā (!) || || kaso ho bhanyā hito upadeśa taṃtrākṣana kathāhā sunyālāī kahanyā lāī saṃgraha gari rāṣanyā rāī (!) rātridina madhyāna sadā kalyāna holā || (fol. 47r6–9) Colophon iti taṃtrākṣa(!)kathā samāptaṃ || || samvat 1017 sālamiti mārgasila śudi 14 roja 3 yatat(!) dine saṃpurṇaṃ || śubham || || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ ||(fol. 47r9–10)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || manave vācaspataye śukrāya parāśarāya śuśrutāya || cāṇakyāya ca viduṣe namostunayaśāstrakartṛbhyaḥ || 1 || sakalārtha śāstrasāraṃ jagati samālokya viṣṇu śarmedaṃ || taṃtraiḥ paṃcabhir atulaṃ cakāra sumanoharaṃ śāstraṃ || 2 || tadyathānuśrūyate || || astidāṇiṇātye janapade mahilārupyaṃnāma nagaraṃ (fol. 1v1–4) End uktaṃ ca yataḥ na devā daṃdam ādāya rakṣaṃti paśupālavat || yaṃ hi rakṣitum ichaṃti budhyā saṃyojayaṃti taṃ tathā ca śastram ādāya nighnaṃti na devā ripuvakrudhā (!) || nihaṃtuṃ jaṃtum ichaṃti budhyā saṃyojayaṃti taṃ || buddhau balaś ca bhūtānāṃ vināśe samupasthite amanayopi tayor bhāti sarveṣām eva dehināṃ || (fol. 119r8–11) Colophon || samāptaṃ cedaṃ kākolūkīyaṃ nāma tṛtīyaṃ taṃtraṃ || || 3 || || ❁ || || ❁ || śrīmanmahāgaṇādhipataye namaḥ || ❁ (fol. 119r11–119v1)

Beginning ❖ śrībhavānīśaṃkarābhyāṃ namaḥ || praṇamya girijānandaṃ girijāṃ girijāpatiṃ | bālānāṃ-m upakārāya pramodāya vipaścitāṃ, || ajñānavyādhidagdhānāṃ, narāṇāṃ sāram auṣadhaṃ, | vyavahārapathaprāpti, sukhasādhanam uttamaṃ, || cān(!)akyādimuni prokta, nānāśāstramahodadheḥ | uddhṛtya saṃgrahaś cakre, jagajjyotir m-mahībhṛtā, || nepāla sammate jāte, vyomaṃ vāṇasvarāṃkite | pauṣorākātithāveṣa saṃ-mpūrṇṇo nītisaṃgrahaḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) End pustaka likhana (!) pariśramavettā vidvajjano nānyaḥ | sāgalalaṃghanakhedaṃ (!), hanuṃān ekaḥ paraṃ vetti, || pustikā kaṭhinīrāmā, parahasta gatāgatā | yadi daivāt samāyāti, mliṣṭāghṛṣṭā ca dharṣitā, || (fol. 44v1–3) Colophon || iti mahārājādhirāja śrīśrījagajjyotirmmalladevaviracito nītisaṃgrahaḥ samāptaḥ || || samvat 750 kārttikaśukla paṃcamyāṃ tithau, muraṇakṣatra (!) śubhajoga, āditya vārasa, dvija śrīdhanarāja devaṇa, likhitam saṃpūrṇṇaṃ, || śubhamastu || sadā sarvvadā, || idaṃ pustakaṃ svapāṭhārthaṃ likhitaṃ || nepālavatsare jāte vyomakhādahayāmite kārtikasya site pakṣe paṃcamyām ca tithau dine mūle vā śubhamyoje ca ravivāreṇa saṃyute vipraśrīdhanarājena likhyate nītisaṃgrahaḥ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 44v3–45r1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ namo manubṛhaspativyāsavālmīkiprabhṛtibho mahākavibhyo namaḥ manave vācaspataye śukrāya parāśarāya sasutāya cāṇakyāya ca viduṣe namonamo nītiśāstrakartṛbhyaḥ sakalārtha śāstra sāraṃ jagati samālokya viṣṇu śarmedaṃ taṃtraiḥ paṃcabhir etac cakāra sumanoharaṃ śāstraṃ tad yathānuśrūyate asti dākṣiṇātye janapade mahilārāpyaṃ nāma nagaraṃ (fol. 1v1–3) End rājaputrā ucuḥ ācārya bhavatprasādā drājyavyavahārāṃ gaṃjñā (!) naṃ tatsukhino bhūtā vayaṃ yadhy evaṃ tathāpīdam astv iti viṣṇuśarmovāca darpaṇatulyaṃ hy etatśāstraprāyeṇasarvaśāstrahitaṃ yo vetti tasya loke kiṃ nāmam (!) asyānsuduḥprāpyaṃ etat śrutvā śāstrarājasutān krameṇa saṃvodhya ṣarāmā (!)sābhyaṃ tarataś cakre nikhilārthaśāstrajñāna (!) rājāpi tasya harṣād athoktavān satpratijñosi bhogair vibhāgam atulaṃ kṛtavānuruvibhava paryaṃtaṃ || || (fol. 17v9–11) Colophon iti viṣṇuśarmaṇākṛte paṃcataṃtrākhye nītiśāstre aparikṣā kāritaṃ nāma paṃcama taṃtraṃ samāptam saṃvat 1863 śāke 1728 māgaśuklapaurṇimāyām (!) śubham || (fol. 17v11–12)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ sarvvajñāya || taṃtrākṣānakathā śreṣṭāṃ, buddhipadma prabodhini, ādityadidhiteravaṃ, tāni dhāsyāmi yatnataḥ || 0 || taṃtrākhyā(2)na dhāyā kha tho, buddhi prakāsa yāṅā, paresvāna, ho'otheṃ, sūryayā teja prakāsatheṃ, tho kha chu jatna[[yā]]naṃ, dhararape māra || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End pūrva virorddha śatruo, mitrapannana orasā, viśvāsa mateo, pūrva viroddha koṣana, mitrapannana oṅāo, imā dakoṃ, mina daha(2)rapayakāo, mocakaṃ tāthā du, thoyā upākṣāna, gochinaṃ thāyasa, simāsa, saṃdhyākārasa, koṣa dakoṃ muṅaṃ conana, ciraṃjīvi dhāya, (3) koṣana dhāra, bho chi koṣapani, thaniyā rātrīsa, imā dakoseṃ, jhijhi dako mocakīo dhāva, vātta kuvāsaṃ oyā, tho(4)yā chu upakāra yāhuna dhāra, opani, vacanana yāṅā śatru, pūrvakārasa, paṃkṣilokayā, rājā madayāo, gurichinaṃ dhāra, gṛ(5)ḍha rāja yāya dhakaṃ, gurichinaṃ dhāra, jivaṃjīva rājā yāya dhakaṃ, gurichinaṃ dhāyā, hmosakhā rājā yāya dhāra, gurichina, imātao jñā(6)navanta, imā rājā yāya dhakaṃ, niścaya yāṅaṃ, rājābhiṣeka biya yāṅaṃ tarena, jhijhisa thaje, cakrarocana dhāyā kokhana, amo rājā(fol. 36v1) yāya, jepani bodha majuyā || amo thiṃhma rājā yāya, amo tamacāraṅāo, amoyā, ṣvāra gathe śvaya dhakaṃ, vipara chuyāo, rā(2)jā mayācaku, thathe vacanana yāṅā, śatru dhakaṃ kana, thesa dubuddhi koṣana dhāra, amo imāpani śatru dako, mocakeyā upā(3)ya, jena yāya dhakaṃ, thava sarīḍasa, po puyā, thao sariḍa bibhatsarapāo, imā coṅā simāsa, pura oṅāo dhāra, bho(4) chi imāloka, cheskarasta guṇa kha hloṅā nimistina, je thava jāti koṣapanisena, je thathe śāsti yāṅāo hayā(5)o, cheskaraske sarana oyā, je rakṣā yāhune dhāyāo, thesa imāpani, pattika juyāo, pośarapāo tara, lithe tho koṣayā (6) pā buyā śariḍa sāmartha juyāva, mipu hāyāo, imāyā so pati, mi tao, imā dakoṃ mocaku juro || thotina, hṅapāyā vai(fol. 37r1)li, mitrapannana orasāṃ, viśvāsa yāya mateva dhakaṃ || 44 || (fols. 36r1–37r1) Colophon (fol. 37r1) iti tantrākṣāṇa parikathā samāptaḥ || ۞ ||

Beginning bhatuna dhāyā, khuṃ voro, dāvo ḍhevo, syāvo, dhakaṃ, anega, chidra vacana bisyaṃ dhālaṅāva, ṛṣisyaṃ, a(2)sādhuṭhāya bhārapāva, opadaṃṅa, vaṃṅāva, deśa duhaṃ vānaṅāsyaṃ bhatu posalapāva tayā khaṃṅāva, viśrāma(3) yāya sādhujanayā cheṃ bhālapaṃ conaṅāsyaṃ, 24 thvahmaṃ bhatuna dhāyā, rājāṭoṃ khaṃṅāva, bho rāje(4)ndra, āpuruvana, the bijyāṅā rājepanisana ṛṣāśrama pavitra yāya juroṃ, bho ṛṣibālaka(5) rājendrastaṃ, āsana te dhāsyaṃ dhālaṅāva, rājāṭoṃ, ati kautuka cāsyaṃ, gaṭhiṅa kautuka jurāne, bha (fol. 1r1–5) End ṭhākulana co⟪ma⟫ne majiva, dhāsyaṃ, kokha chahmaṃna paṃṭhana pilusyaṃ hayā dha(ka)va…taya..vaṃṅāva..li (2) jhaṃgalayā, so mā mā[[cā]]syaṃ uli[[dā]]kva mena dahalapāva, mocakaṃ tāthāva, besyaṃ vava juro || thvatena purvva vi(3)rodhi śatruvo mitrapanana valasataṃ, viśvāsa yāya mateva dhālaṅā || 45 || rātru svasti (4) dine svasti, svasti madhedine sthite, svasti phuyāt bhavet nītyaṃ, svasti sarvvatra sarvvadā || thva taṃtrā(5)khyāna ṅeṅayānaṃ, hlākayānaṃ || rātrisaṃ dinasaṃ madhyānasaṃ, sarvvadā kalyāna juvakhe || (fol. 24v1–6) Colophon iti taṃtrākhyā(fol. 24v6)na samāpta || saṃmvat 773 pauṣamāsa cā 3 sarvvadā śubha || ||

Beginning ❖…… namaḥ sarvvajñāya || tatrākhyāna kathāṃ caiva, buddhipadma pravedhinī | ādityadīdhitiṃ medaṃ tā nivvo(2)dhāsyāmi yatnataḥ || tatākhyāna dhāyā khaṃ thva, buddhi hātaṅā pele hoyakava ādityasa kilanava uthiṃga (3) thva khaṃ chu yatnanaṃ dhararape māla || (fol. 1v1-3) End rātrau svasti dine svasti svasti madhye dine sthite | svasti bhūyad bhave (3) nityaṃ svastī sarvvatra sarvvadā || thva traṃtrākhyāna ṅēgayā naṃ hlākayā naṃ thva ta..tva dhararapuyāna rātrisa naṃ dinasa noṃ ma(4)dhyānasa noṃ kalyāna juroṃ sarvvadā kālaṃ śubhanaṃgala(!) , kalyāna thajura || (fol. 33r2-4) Colophon iti taṃtrākhyāna samāptaṃ || || śubhamastu || samvat 779 śrāvaṇakṛṣṇa śaṃkaranārāyaṇana tatarākhyāna saṃpurṇṇa yāṅā || śubha || mastu || || māheśvarī namo bhavenmagala || namo nāraya || namo bhavānyai || rudrāya namaḥ || (fol. 33r4-)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha taṃtrākhyānakathā likhyate || taṃtrākhyānakathā śreṣṭhā buddhpadma pravodhinī || ādityadīdhiter eva tāni vakṣyāmi yatnataḥ || 1 || yo taṃtrākhyāna kathā bhanyāko kasto ho bhanyā saṃpūrṇa kathāmā śreṣṭha bhayāko || jasto ādityakā kiraṇale savai prakāśa garāuṃchan || tastai buddhiprakāśa garchaṃ || rakṣitavyaṃ sadā vākyaṃ vākyād bhavati nāśanam || haṃsābhyāṃ nīyamānasya kūrmasya patanaṃ yathā || 1 || (fol. 1v1–5) End tasartha aghi prīti nabhayākāsaṃga prītigaryā nāśa garcha || tasartha taṃ sita maile prīti garnuchaina bhani musāle birālā cheu bhanyo ra dulābhitra pasyo || 46 || rātrau svasti divā svasti svasti madhyaṃ dine tathā || svasti bhūyād bhave nityaṃ svasti sarvatra sarvathā || taṃtrākhyāna kathāṃ śrutvā smṛtvā kāryaṃ karoti yaḥ || sa kadācin na cāpadbhir bādhyate buddhimān naraḥ || || (fol. 32r8–32v3) Colophon || iti taṃtrākhyāna kathā saṃpūrṇam || || śrīrāmāya rāmacaṃdrāya namaḥ (fol. 32v3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ śāṃkarīṃ śaṃkarātmajaṃ || ajñānadhvāntanāśāya krīyate nītidīpikāṃ || nānā granthāt samālokya dhīraisaha vicāryya ca || kṛta yaṃ sāram udhṛtya, sarvvaloka hitaiṣiṇī || caturāśīti lakṣeṣu śarīreṣu śarīriṇāṃ || na mānuṣyaṃ vinā netraṃ, na svajñānaṃ tu labhyate || atra janmasahasrāṇāṃ, sahasrair api niścitaṃ || kadācit labhate jantu mānuṣyaṃ puṇya saṃcayāt || (fol. 1v1–5) End nāsti jñānasamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti jñānasamaṃ tapaḥ || nāsti jñānasamo yajña stasmājjñānaṃ samabhyaset || deva bhāskara mallpasmin dyājānī(!)svaratāṃ gate | nītiśāstreṇa nepālaṃ, samun(!) pālitu mudhyate || śuviyugma gaje saṃkhye, gate nepāla sammate || divyarātrau paraṃdhīrā saṃmpūrṇṇā nīti dīpikā || 120 || (fol. 54v7–55r3) Colophon || || iti nītidīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhamo(!)dhyāyaḥ || || śubham astu sarvvapākānnaṃ bhavatu || sasvat (!) 869 śrāvaṇakṣṇa, pratipadā, śravaṇanakṣetra (!) āyuṣyamānayoga, budhavāra thva kunhu ṣāyadhunakāmiti || lekhata śyāmānaṃda || || śubha || (fol. 55r4–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || sabhāyāḥ kavir bhūmipālasya nītiḥ suputraḥ kulā[[nāṃ]] satāṃ satyavāṇī || śrutivr brāhmaṇānāṃ trayā kāminīnāṃ yaśaḥ sarvalokasya sad bhūṣaṇaṃ syāt || 1 || vṛthā maṃndiraṃ sundarī nāsti yeṣāṃ vṛthā jīvanaṃ sādhubhir n-ninditānām || vṛthā sevanaṃ nirvivekasya rājño vṛthā sanmanohāriṇī yā na vidyā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End na śīlāt paraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ dharmatonyat sumitraṃ na pāpāt paraṃ naiva śatruḥ || na ca śrīmahādevatonyaḥ śaraṇyo na vai rājato vichate(!) rājam anyat || 20 || nirmitā kavitākāṃtā harivaṃśa dvijanmanā || nītibuddhipradā kaṃṭhe vidagdhānāṃ lagiṣyatu || 21 || (fol. 3v74r3) Colophon || iti śrīharivaṃśakavikṛtau nītibhujaṃgaprayātaṃ samāptam || || śrīśāke 1773 caitraśuklāṣṭamyāṃtithau budhavāsare likhitam idam pustakaṃ viṣṇudattaśarmaṇā || || śubham astu || || śrīrastu || || śrībālagovinda sahāyostu || (fol . 4r3–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīmato dhārādhīśasya rājño bhojasya prabaṃdho likhyate || yathā || ādau dhārāyāṃ rājye siṃdhulasaṃjño rājā suciraṃ prajāḥ pālitavān || tasya vṛddhatve bhoja iti putro ʼbhūt || sa yadā paṃcavarṣas tadā pitā ātmano maraṇasamayaṃ viditvā mukhyāmātyān āhūya anuja muṃjaṃ mahābalam ālokya putraṃ bhojaṃ ca bālaṃ vīkṣya vicārayāmāsa || (fol. 1v1–3) End yaḥ saṃtāpam apākaroti jagatāṃ yaś copakārakṣamaḥ sarveṣām amṛtātmakena vapuṣā prīṇāti netrāṇI yaḥ || asyāpyunnatimaṃvudasya sahase yan natvam etāvatā varṇe naivaparaṃmarāla dhavalaḥ kṛṣṇaś caritrair asi || 1 || kailāśīyati kairavīpatilasatkarpūra puṃjīpati kṣīrodīyati mauktikīyati nabho gaṃgā taraṃgīyati || haṃsau ghīyati mānasīyati śaran meghaṃyati kṣoṇibhṛn nārthīyatyamṛtīyati kṣititale devatvadīyaṃ yaśaḥ || 2 || (fol. 45r3–6) Colophon || iti paṃḍita vallāla viracito bhojaḥ pravaṃdhaḥ samāptaḥ || || (fol. 44v7) śrīśāke 1615 saṃvat 1750 || caitravadi 11 ravau graṃthasaṃkhyā 1453 || rāmāya namaḥ || karakṛtamaparādhaṃkṣaṃtu marhati saṃtaḥ || śubham astu ||… (fol. 45r6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīmato dhārādhīśasya rājño bhojasya prabandho likhyate || || ādau dhārāyāṃ rājye siṃdhulasaṃjño rājā suciraṃ prajāḥ pālitavān || tasya vṛddhatve bhoja iti putrobhūt || sa yadā paṃcavarṣopi tadā pitātmama[ra]ṇasamayaṃ viditvā mukhyāmātyān āhūyānūjam muṃjaṃ mahābalam ālokya putraṃ bhojaṃ ca bālaṃ vīkṣya vicārayāmāsa || (fol. 1v1–4) End kailāsīyati kairavīyati lasat karpūrapuṃjīyati kṣīrodīyati mauktikīyati nabho gaṃgā taraṃgīyati || haṃsau ghīyati mānasīyati saran medhīyati kṣoṇibhṛn nāthīyatyamṛtīyati kṣititale deva tvadīyaṃ yaśaḥ || 2 || (fol. 61r10–61v2) Colophon samāptoyaṃ graṃthaḥ || (fol. 61v2) || iti pamḍita vallālaviracite śrībhojapravaṃdhaḥ samāptim asedhīt || (fol. 61r3)

«Beginning» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrībhṛgeśvarāyaḥ || oṃ namaḥ śivāya || namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya || siddhi sādhya śatām astu, prasādāt tasya dhūrjjateḥ | jāhnaviphenalekhyava, ya(2)t muddhri śaśiḥna kalā || || siddhikalyāṇa thajura gathya gaṃgāyā phenathyaṃ candrakarāna śobhāmāna yāṅa śirasa chusyaṃ bijyāka, thathiṃgva(3) parameśvara śrīmahādevayā varaprasādana sādhusatpuruṣayā sādharapā kāryyasiddhi rāka thajura || || śruto hetopadeśroyaṃ, pāṭavaṃ śaskṛ(4)toktiṣu | vācā sarvvatra vaicitryreṃ, nītividhyāṃ dadāti ca || || sarvvatra thāyasaṃ, vicitra kathāna, saṃjukta yāṅaṃ tayā, thva hitopadeśa, dhāyā śāstra(5) gvahma puruṣana ṅena thvahmana samasta lokayāta nītiśāstra sayakaraṃ || || (fol. 1v1-5) «End» viṣṇu śarmmā uvāca || tathāpa paramam idam astu || || sandhiḥ sarvvamahībhṛtāṃ (6) vijayināṃm astu pramodaḥ sadā || śantaḥ santu nirāpadaḥ sukṛtināṃ kīrttiś ciraṃ varddhatāṃ || nītivilāsinī ca satataṃ, vakṣasthare sasthi(7)tā | vaktraṃ cumbatu mantriṇāmaharaharṣabhuyātmahānutsavaḥ || || thvanaṃlī, viṣṇuśarmmāna, rājaputrapanista, āśiṣā biraṃ || || (8) bho rājaputra thva hitopadeśa, dhāyā śāstrasa, abhyāsa yāṅā mātrana, samasta rājāpani, thithiṃ mana prīti juyamāra, sadākāraṃ harṣamā(1)nana, prajāpani, pratipāra yārayā kathā jura, samasta sarjjana, mahātmāpanisa, sukṛtina varddhamāna yāṅaṃyā kaṃtha jura, āpadā vi(2)partti samastaṃ, nāsa juyamāra, hanoṃ, bārakapanisaṃ, thva nītiśāstra, abhyāsa yāṅā mātrana, virā samānana, krīḍā yāṅāva, thva nītijñā(3)na, citta thīra juyamāra, hanoṃ mantrīpanisyanaṃ, thva śāstrasa, abhyāsa yāṅā mātrana, premabhāva jusyaṃ, sadāṃ, svāmiyāke sevāna, rājya(4) vṛddhimāna yāṅāva, ānandana, utsāhā juyamāra, rājalakṣmīnaṃ, paripurṇṇa juyamāra dhakaṃ āśiṣā biraṃ || 0 || anyac cāstu || pāleyā(5)dreḥ sutāyāḥ praṇayinivasatiś candramauliḥ sa yāvad yāval lakṣmī murāre jarada iva daḍitmānase(!) visphurantī | yāvat svarṇṇācaroyaṃ dava(6)dahanasamo, yasya sūryyaḥ sphuriṃgaḥ tāva nārāyaṇena pracaratu racitaḥ saṃgrahoyaṃ kathānām iti || ۞ || || (fols. 209v5-210r6) «Sub-colophons» iti śrīhitopadeśe, nītisārasaṃgrahe, mitrarābhonāma, prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ samāptam iti || ۞ || śubham astu sarvvajagatāṃ || (3) āyūvṛddhir astu || e || (fol. 62v2-3) iti hitopadeśe nītisārasaṃgrahe suhṛdbhedonāma, dvitiyaḥ kathāsaṃgraha saṃpūrṇṇa samāptaḥ || (3) || || śubham astu || || (fol. 118v2-3) iti hitopa(8)deśe nītisārasaṃgrahe, vigrahonāma, tṛtīyaḥ kathāsaṃgraha samāptam iti || 7 || || śubha || (fol. 169v7-8) iti hitopadeśe, nī(7)tisārasaṃgrahe, caturtha sandhināma kathāsaṃgraha samāptaṃ || || ۞ || (fol. 210r6-7) «Colophon» dvīpanetravasuvarṣa, hemante harimāsare catuddaśī ca jeṣṭhā(8)yāṃ, vṛddhati ravivāsarai, tat dīnai riṣitaṃ pūrṇṇai, lalītasya samāpatāṃḥ || || samvat 827 mārggaśirakṛṣṇa, catudaśyāntithau, jyeṣṭhā(1)nakṣatre, vṛrddhatiyoge, ādityavāsare, dhanurāsi gate savitari, virccharāsi gate candramasi, thvakuhnu, śrīkittīpulayā kvāṭhanāya(2)ka, rakṣmīsiṃha bhāyāta, karaṇa kāeṣṭha lalītasiṃhana, saṃpūrṇṇa yāṅaṃ siddhayakāva biyā juro || || yā dṛṣṭaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā tā dṛstaṃ(3) riṣitaṃ mayāḥ | jati surddham asudham vā mama doṣa na dīyateḥ || śubham astu sarvvadā kalyāṇa śrīviṣṇuprītir astu, sadā sukhadāṃ bhava || (fols. 210r6-211v3)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || siddhisādhyaḥ (!) satām astu prasādāt tasya dhurjjaṭeḥ | jāhnavī phenarekheva, yan murddni śaśinaḥ kalā || śruto hitopadeśoyaṃ, pāṭavaṃ saṃskṛtoktiṣu | vācāṃ sarvvatra vaicitryaṃ, nīti vidhyāṃ dadāti ca || ajarāmaravat prājño, vidyāmarthañ ca cintayet | gṛhīta iva keśeṣu mṛtyunā dharmmam ācaret || sarvvadravyeṣu vidyaiva dravyam āhur anuttamaṃ | ahāryyatvād anarghatvā, dakṣayatvāc ca sarvvadā || (fol. 1v1–4) End prāleyādreḥ sutāyāḥ praṇayini vasatiś candramaulau sa yāvat | yāvallakṣmīr m-murārer jalada iva taḍit mānase visphurantī || yāvat svarṇācaloyaṃ, davadahana samo yasya sūryyas phuliṃgas tāvan nārāyaṇo ʼyaṃ pracaratu caritaḥ samgraho ʼyaṃ kathānāṃ || aparaṃ ca || śrīmān dhavalacandro ʼsau, jīyān māṇḍaliko ripūn | yenāyaṃ saṃgrahoyatnāllekhayitvā pracārataḥ (!) || (fol. 99v4–7) Colophon iti hitopadeśa sandhir n-nāma caturthasaṃgrahaḥ samāptaḥ || ○ || lipir vaidya kṛṣṇadevasya || samvat 780 || śrīsadāśiva kṛpā bhūyāt || ○ || (fol. 99v7–8)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo mañjunāthāya || pra(na)mya śilaśā buddhai (!) trailokyā ʼdhipatiṃ [[pra]]bhuṃ || nānāśāstraṃ(!)dhṛtaṃ vakṣye rājanittīsamucayaḥ (!) || 1 || traikokyayā, adhipati tvaṃ burddha (!) jura jura, tvaṃ namaskārayāṅa va, nānāśāstrasa, piṃkāsyaṃ tayā, rājanīti maṅanatayā, khajina hlāya || 1 || adhīte⟪yaṃ⟫ midaṃ (!) śāstraṃ nalo (!) jñāsyati tatvata, dharmmopadeśavinayaṃ, kāryyā kāryaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ || ○ || (fol. 1v1-4) «Sub: colophon:» iti śrīcānakyasārasaṃgraha (!) prathamaḥ śatakaṃ samāptaḥ (!) || || ❁ || (fol. 25r5) End || lālaya (!) bahavo dokhā, tālaya (!) bahavo gunā (!), tasmā (!) putraṃ ca si ʼṣyaṃ (!) ca, tālaya (!) natu rālayeta (!) || ○ || tha va sukhana coṃyāna, anega dokhana, tādarayaṃ tayāna, anega (!) dokhana maṃdayā va guṇa, thvatina thavakāyaṃ tha jule, śiṣya paniṃ, tha jure tādarayā mālakha lāraye (!) mateva || 22 || ruci abhyāsayā syātā, yajñāyā kiṃ prayojanaṃ, tāvubhau jadi (!) na syātā prajñayā kiṃ prayojanaṃ || ○ || gvanaṣu puruṣkhayā, vidyāsyane lacira, thvariva juro abhyāsaṃṅga yuva juro, abhyāsam ṅāvaṃḥ /// (fol. 73r1–5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || siddhiḥ sādhye satām astu, prasādāt tasya dhurjaṭe, jānhavī phenalakheva, yan munhi (!) śaśinaḥ kalā || || siddhi kalyāna juva tha jura, satāyuva, tha jura, parameśvara dhurjaṭe mahādevasa, prasādana, mahādevatvaṃ, gathiṃṅa dhārasā, jānhavīgaṃgā, thona, sirasobhāna, saṃjukta, puna, hano, arddhacandrana, saṃjuktana, śvabhāyamāna, thathiṃgva, mahādevasyaṃ, rakṣāyāṅaṃ ta o juro || (fol. 1v1–3) End anayac cāstu, pāleyādre (!) || sutāyāḥ praṇayini vasatiś candramauliḥ sapāva sa yā vadyā yā vallabhaḥ śrīmurāre, jalada iva ṅaḍit(!) mānase visphurantaṃ, yāvatsvarṇṇacaro yaṃ davadahara samo, yasya sūryyas phuliṃgaḥ tāvan nārāyaṇena pracaratu racitaḥ saṃgraho yaṃ kathānām iti || (fol. 171r6–171v1) Colophon iti hitopadeśa, nītisāra, saṃgrahe, ścaturtha, saṃdhināma kathā saṃgraha samāpta || || bhimasenoraṇyabhaṃgamunināṃ ca ma‥‥‥ jadi śudha ⟪‥⟫ maśudhaṃ vā ma svadhanīya maharvuyī(!) || || || saṃvat 857 pauṣamāse, kṛṣṇapakṣa, pratidāyāṃ tithva, … budhavāra --------- || jura māṃ yajñagā (!) devisihaju yāna cosyaṃ viyā juto śubha || || (fol. 171v1–5)

Beginning [❖ oṃ namaḥ sarasvatyai || praṇamya śirasā viṣṇu, trailokyādhipatiprabhuṃ nānāśāstro dhṛtaṃ vakṣye, rājanīti samuccayaṃ || 1 || trailokyayā adhipatijuraṃ nārāyaṇa ṭoṃ namaskārayāṅāva nānāśāstra, sapiṃkāsyaṃtayā, rājanīti muṃṅatayā khaṃjura lhāya || || adhītyaiva midaṃ śāstraṃ, naro jñāsyati tatvataḥ | dharmmopadeśa vinayaṃ, kāryākāryaśubhāśubhaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1r1-5 ) … hitayāya kāmanāna janahlāya gvanaṣu manaṣyana (!) thva śāstra dharayaṃ sayāmātraṇa ṅeṅa hmayā māmana hitayāṅā thyaṃ thva śāstrana hitayā tatvaṃ || || (fol. 1v1–2) End kaṅaṃvatiṃ duka, vilva, sajja, cūta, cuṃbaka, nāgakeśara, sarala, chāyādruma, pakṣādi, anekadhāraṃ, dāthuha, kapiṃjaladi pakṣi aneka, varāhayutha, kapisṭhata (!) vyāghra, gavaya, gaṇḍa, siṅāṭivana, śleṣmāntavana thayā madhyasano gendadītaṃ, nāginiyā pri… (fol. 65v5–8) Colophon || iti cānakyasārasaṃ he (!) prathamaḥ | taka (!) samāpta ||(!) (fol. 19r8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīmadgurucaraṇāraviṃdebhyo namaḥ || || pūrveṣā ʼmanupūrvaṃ puruṣāṇā asmadādīnām || ārādhyā mama sādhyā kācid īrṣa sadābhīṣṭhā || 1 || āśi (ḥñ) pūrvaka ⟪bhāsi⟫ rāśiḥ prakāśya mat pūrvapuruṣāśīḥ || ayaṃ rāmaprabaṃdhaḥ prabadhyate rāmasaṃbaṃdhaḥ || 2 || upagītivṛtaṃ || || mad vṛddhaḥ mapitāmaho(!) arjjuna iti prāmāṇya puṇyārjjanaḥ kāruṇyārṇava atmajanya karaṇaḥ puṇyaikapaṇyāśramaḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) End vaṃśastha vṛttam || rāmaḥ || tavānukaṃpā yadi ced ananyayā nairguṇyaṃ brahmaṇyāpi sā dadīsā || aṃtas tvadīyā ʼ ṣacatiḥ prapaṃcitā prapaṃcakṛta paṃcaśūtā || 86 || vaṃśasthavṛttam || oṃ kṛtyavākyaṃ pratikṛtya siṃdho rājñāṃ tadīyāṃ parikalpamūdhā (!) || ājñāpayāmāsa suhṛllikāse tuṃ (!) pratisparśana ja sa rāmaḥ || 87 || (!) upajādi(!)vṛttam || || sākṣāt svabhaktaṃ hanumate –(fol. 10r1–4)

Beginning –lahaḥ priyaḥ | āture sarvabhakṣai ca naraḥ śīgraṃ vinaśyati || 19 || manuṣyana, āyamasosyaṃ, vayayāta ṅāva, rājā madūdeśa śalvāya yalaṅāva, royasa, niṃṅa maniṅa, naya eraṅāva, thva mhyaṃ manuṣya, śīghranaṃ moyu || || (exp.2a:1–3) «Sub-colophon:» iti śrīcānakyesārasaṃgrahe dvitīyaḥ satakaḥ samāptaḥ || || ❁ || (exp. 22b:5) End vauhityaṃm aśvavānikyaṃ, rājasevā tapovanaṃ | dhīrā catvari kurvvanti, kātarāḥ kṛṣīvāhakāḥ || 25 || votavavanijāla, śalaṃvanijāla, rājasevā, tapovana, thva yetā dhīrajñānīpanisyaṃ yāyu, kātarapanisyaṃ, mhyojyā yāyu || || brajaddhanārthā vānijyaṃ, vidyārthī ca vahuśru–(exp. 29:3–6)

Beginning || śrīgaṇapati sartha (!) || praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca jagad guruṃ || viṣṇuṃ praṇamya śirasā vakṣyehaṃ śāstram uttamaṃ || 1 || cāṇakyena svayaṃ proktaṃ nītiśāstra samuccayaṃ || tad ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi narāṇāṃ buddhibarddhanaṃ || 2 || atorthaṃ paṭhyate śāstraṃ kīrtti lokeṣu jāyate || kīrttin yujyate loke paratre ca mānavaḥ || 3 || (!) palī(!)palita kāyopi kartavyaṃ stutisaṃgrahaḥ || na tatra dhaniyo yāṃti yatra yāṃti bahuśrutāḥ || 4 || (fol. 1r1–3) End nityaṃ brahma yathā smaraṃti munayo haṃsā yathā māna⟪vaṃ⟫saṃ sāraṃgā ja[[la]]dāgamaṃ vanagajā dhyāyaṃti revaṃ yathā || yuṣmad darśanalālasā pratidinaṃ puṇyān smarāmo vayaṃ dhanyaḥ kopi sa vā savoṇi bhavatā yātrā(!) dvayo saṃgamaḥ || 103 || dagdhaṃ khāṃḍavam arjunena hi vṛthā divyadrumai(!) bhūṣitaṃ dagdhā vāyusutena hemanagarī laṃkāpurī svarṇabhūḥ || dagdhaṃ ⟪sarava⟫ sarvasukhaṃ hareṇa madano(!) kiṃ tena yuktaṃ kṛtaṃ dāridryaṃ janatāpakārakam idaṃ kenāpi dagdhaṃ nahi || 104 || (fol. 11r2–6) Colophon iti rājanītiśataślokī samāptaḥ || ||

Beginning śukranīti śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śukranītau yāni yāni tāni tāni vruve purā kāryāṇi rājñaḥ sāmānyaṃ bhūmimānaṃ thaiva ca || 1 || nagaryādi pratiṣṭhānaṃ gṛhādi kṛtikalpanaṃ || ādyādhyāyasthitaṃ hyetat parādhyāyasthitaṃ vruve || 2 || yuvarājaprakṛtyādi lakṣaṇaṃ kṛtyam eva ca || āyavyayādikaṃ lekhyaṃ bhṛtyānāṃ bhṛtikalpanaṃ || 3 || tṛtīye sarvalokānāṃ nyāyena parivartanaṃ || caturthe suḥrdādīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ daṃḍa kalpanaṃ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–6) End dvātriṃśat pramitair hastair dīrghā ʼrdhā vistṛtā ʼadharma (!) || uttamādiguṇā madhyā sārdhamānā yathārhata ḥ || 20 || kuṭuṃba samsthiti samā na nyūnāṃ(!) nādhikāpi na || grāmād bahir vaseyus te ye ye tvadhikṛtā nṛpaiḥ || 21 || nṛpakārya(!) vinā kaścin na grāme sainiko viśet || tathā na pīḍayet kutra kadāpi grāmavāsinaḥ || 22 || (fol. 80r20–25) Colophon iti śukranītau nītiśeṣaprakaraṇa (!) nāma paṃcamaḥ || 5 (fol. 80r25)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ svasti śrīmahārājādhirājasya bhojarājasya pravandhaḥ kathyate ādau dhārārājye siṃdhulasaṃjño rājā ciraṃ prajñāḥ paryapālayat tasya vṛddhatve bhoja iti putras samajani sa yadā paṃcavārṣikaḥ tadā pitā hy ātmano jarāṃ jñātvā mukhyāmātyān āhūya anujaṃ mūṃjaṃ mahāvalam ālokya putraṃ ca bālaṃ vīkṣya vicārayāmāsa (fol. 1v1–5) End śloka adhyadhārā sadādhārā sadālaṃvā sarasvatī paṃḍitā maṃḍitās sarve bhojarāje bhuvaṃgate tato bhojas tam āliṃgya praṇamya dhārānagaraṃ prati yayau śailaṃ śailaviniścalaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ muṃjasya tasminkṣaṇe bhoje jīvati harṣasaṃcayasudhā dhārau budhau majjati strībhiḥ śīlavatī bhireva sahasā kartuṃ tapas tatvare muṃje mauṃcati rājyabhāram abhajat tyāgaiś ca bhogair nṛpaḥ…….. (fol. 104v5–105r2) Colophon śrībhojacaritaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śrīkāśiviśvanāthāya namaḥ (fol. 105r2–3)

Beginning śrīmatodhārādhīśasya rājño bhojasya prabaṃdho likhyate yathā ādau dhārāyāṃ rājye siṃdhulasaṃjño rājā suciraṃ prajā pālitavān tasya vṛddhatve bhoja iti putrobhūt sa yadā paṃcavarṣas tadā pitā ātmano maraṇa samayaṃ viditvā mukhyāmātyān āhūya anujaṃ muṃjaṃ [[ca]] mahābalam ālokya putraṃ bhojaṃ ca bālaṃ vīkṣya vicārayāmāsaḥ (fol. 1v1–4) End sarveṣām amṛtātmakena vapuṣā prīṇāti netrāṇi yaḥ tasyāpyunnatimaṃbudasya sahase [[ yatnātvam etāvatā varṇer eva paraṃ marāladhavalaḥ kṛṣṇaś caritrair asi 254 kailāsīpati kairavīpati lasat karpūrapuṃjīpati kṣīrodīpati mauktikī ]] pati nabho gagaṃgātaraṃgīpati haṃsaughīpati mānasīpati śaran meghīpati kṣoṇibhṛn nāthīpatyamṛtīpati kṣititale deva tvadīyaṃ yaśaḥ 255 (fol. 50r1–4) Colophon || iti śrīpaṃḍita vallāla viracito bhojapravaṃdhaḥ samāptaḥ | (fol. 49v7–8) samāptoyaṃ bhojapravaṃdhaḥ | idam anucitam akramś ca pūsāṃ yad api jarāsu ca mānmathā vikārāḥ || tad api ca na kṛtaṃ nitambinīnāṃ stanapatanāvadhi jīvitaṃ rataṃ vā 256 samāptaṃ śubhamastu. saṃmata 1859 phālguḥ yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ… (fol. 50r4–8)

Beginning || śrīgaṇādhipataye namaḥ || śrīmatodhārādhīśvarasya rājño bhojasya prabaṃdhaḥ kathyate || ❁ || ādau dhārā rājye siṃdhulasaṃjño rājā ciraṃ prajāḥ pālitavān | tasya vṛddhatve bhoja iti putro ʼbhūt | sa yadā paṃcavarṣīyas tadā pitātmano maraṇaṃ jñātvā mukhyān amātyān āhuyānuja muṃjaṃ mahābalam ālokya putraṃ ca bālaṃ vīkṣya vicārayāmāsa | (fol. 1v1–4) End haraśirasi śirāṃsi yānirejur hara hatānir luṃṭhaṃti gṛdhrapādaiḥ | tato rājā tadālokya tutoṣa | tato rājā dhārānagaram āsā[[dya]] svabhavanam āgataḥ | evaṃ krameṇa mahīmaṃḍalaṃ śaśāsa dhārā dhīnātho bhojaḥ || karṇakalpatarukāmadhenavaḥ karṇakalpatarukāmadhenavaḥ | eka eva bhuvi bhojabhūpatiḥ karṇakalpataru kāmadhenavaḥ || 1 || || ❁ ||(fol. 56r2–5) Colophon || iti śrībahukavikṛtau dhārādhīśa rāja śrībhojayaśo vitata rājyalakṣmyā ugaṇitabudhakavi saṃjana sevitasya śrībhojabhūpateḥ pravaṃdhaḥ samāptaḥ || || śrī || || śubhaṃ bhavatu lekhaka pāṭhakayoḥ || śake 1485 rudhirodgārī saṃvatsare vaiśāṣa śuddha 12 śanau kamalākareṇa liṣitaṃ(!) || ❁ || (fol. 56r5–9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || nārada uvāca || || kaccid (!) arthāś ca kalpaṃ te dharme ca ramate manaḥ || sukhāni cānubhūyaṃte manaś ca na vihanyate || 1 || kaccid (!)ācaritāṃ pūrvai naradeva pitāmahaiḥ || varttase vṛttim akṣudrāṃ dharmmātha sahitāṃ triṣu || 2 || kaccid (!) artheṇa vo dharmmaṃ dharmmeṇārtham athāpi vā || ubhau vā prītisāreṇa na kāmena prabādhase || 3 || kaccid (!) arthaṃ ca dharmmaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca jayatāṃ varaṃ || vibhajya kāle kālajñaḥ samaṃ varada sevase || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) End yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || evaṃ kariṣyāmi yathā tvayoktaṃ prajñā hi me bhūya ivāti vṛddhāḥ || utkā(!) tathā caiva cakāra rājā lebhe mahī sāgaramekhalāṃ ca || 111 || || nārada uvāca || evaṃ yo varttate rājā cāturvarṇyasya rakṣaṇe || sa vihatyeha susukhī śakrasya iti salokatām || 112 || (fol. 9r8–9v3) Colophon iti śrīmahābhārate sabhāparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhiraṃ prati nāradoktaṃ rājanitaṃ (!) śubham || || śrīśāke 1659 || (fol. 9v3–4)

Beginning –savisyaṃ tasyaṃ, śirāphura savisyaṃ śirāphura savīślāmayāsyaṃ, rājaputratvaṃ lheḍa o otvaṃ juro, thya sayāśasa,, vānaraco gva, thva sandedana ḍeṅa rājaputrayā ʼvvālasa, bhojinī jujuyaṃ thva, thva savānarana, hetiyanena, bhojini ʼkhyākhyāpana punarvvārahanaṃ, jutava yāva vānara u sasyaṃ,, rājaputrayā khvvārasa, juṅa coṅa bhojini,, vānarana, lohakāyāva lohana cioṃtvaṃ juro, (fol. 3r1–4) End || thvayāupākhyāna || gvachinaṃ deśayā, jyātha sikaramiyā, mha camo, nyāsya atiśudarī, parapuruṣa o, rataju o, thva sikramiyā, heti hetāna thvayā mha camova yā o,, veherana svayamaphayāva, kṣamha camhayā,,atikucarita juro, mārasā kudumasanādānayā hune dhāsyaṃ, vāravāraṃ hāṅāva,, svava makhu… (fol. 22v5–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīvindumādhavo jayati || || śrīmato dhārādhīśasya rājño bhojasya prabandho likhyate || || yathā ādau dhārāyāṃ rājye sindhula saṃjño rājā suciraṃ prajāḥ pālitavān || tasya ca vṛddhatve bhoja iti putro ʼbhūt | sa yadā paṃcavarṣas tadā pitā ātmano maraṇasamayaṃ viditvā mukhyāmātyān āhūyā ʼnujaṃ muṃjaṃ ca mahābalam ālokya putraṃ ca bālaṃ vīkṣya vicārayāmāsa | (fol. 1v1–5) End ambhodhiḥ sthalatāṃ sthalaṃ jaladhitāṃ dhūlilavaḥ śailatāṃ merur mṛtkaṇatāṃ tṛṇaṃ kuliśatāṃ vajraṃ tṛṇaprāyatāṃ vahniḥ śītaḥ(!)latāṃ himaṃ dahanatām āyāti yasyechayā (!) līlādurlalitādbhūtavyasanine daivāya tasmai namaḥ | 25 | tato vaṭavṛkṣapatradvamādāyaikena puṭīkṛtvā nijajaṃghāmiṣachurikayā chitvā tatra puṭake raktam āpya tṛṇenā ʼparasmin patre kimapi likhitavān. likhitvā vatsarājaṃ prāha. mahābhāga etat patraṃ nṛ… (fol. 7v4–7)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīmato dhārādhīśvarasya rājño bhojasya prabaṃdho likhyate || ādau dhārāyāṃ rājye siṃdhurājasaṃjño rājā ciraṃ prajāḥ pālitavān | tasya ca vṛddhatve sati bhojaḥ putrobhūt | (!) sa yadā paṃcavarṣas tadā pitā ʼtmano maraṇasamayaṃ viditvā mukhyāmātyān samāhūya anujaṃ muṃjaṃ ca mahābalamālokya putraṃ ca bālaṃ vīkṣya vicārayāmāsa | (fol. 1v1–4) End evaṃ śrutvā rakṣā prāhaḥ || guṭaka madhyekṣiptā karomyahaṃ sakala dhānya rakṣāṃ drāk māṃṣādaṃ te manujā muṣa(!)śuddhikarī sugaṃdhī ca yeṣāṃ na vidhyā na tapo na dānam || na cāpi śīlaṃ na guṇo na dharmaḥ te martyaloke bhuvibhārabhūtā || jānāmi tān naiva ca kīdṛśā[[ḥ]] syuḥ || 22 || (fol. 94r6–94v1) Colophon iti vi[[dva]]d goṣṭī(!) samāptā || iti śrīpaṃḍita valllāla ⟪paṃḍita…⟫[[ viracite dhārādhīnāthasya bhojasya prabaṃdhaḥ samāptaḥ ||]] (fol. 94v2) samvat 1774 śāke 1639 pravarttamāne prathama jyeṣṭha sudi 14 caṃdravāre saṃpūrṇaṃ-m astu || || (fol. 94v5)

Beginning ❖ oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha hita upadeśa(!) liṣyate || oṃ namaḥ sarvajñāyaḥ(!) siddhiḥ śādhye satām astu prasādāt tasya dhūrjjaṭeḥ jāhnavīphinalekheva yanmurddni śaśīnaḥ(!) Beginning śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ || || siddhisādhyesatāmastu prasādāttasya dhūrjateḥ || jānhavīphenalekheva yanmurddhi śaśinaḥ kalā || 1 || estā dhūrjaṭI bhannāmahārudrakā prasāda taṃhaṃ sajjana savaiko kārya siddhi havos || jas māhā rudrakā śirajaṭāmā vasthāki gaṃgākā phīna jasto seto caṃdramāko kalā śobhāyamāna bhairahaṃcha || || śruto hitopadeśoyaṃ pāṭavaṃsaṃ skṛtokti | vācā sarvatra vaicitryaṃ nīti vidhyā dadāti ca || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End || he rājaputra ho tumiharukana saṃjana mitralābha havosa. ti ādeśamā. lakṣmī āśraya garun. rājāharu pani. āphnā dharmamā. rahikana pṛthvīko pratipālanā garun. jastai. bharma(!) rki taruṇī svāsni savaikā mana parche. tastai maile bhanyāko nītiśāstra saṃjanaharu savaikā manaparos. arddhacaṃdra cūḍāmaṇI bhayākā bhagavān sadā śivale savaiko kalyāṇa garun || || (fol. 32r4–7) Colophon || iti śrī hitopadeśe nītiśāstrevālavodhāya bhāṣā kathane. mitralābha prathama kathā saṃgrahaḥ samāptaḥ || || vasvaṃka bhūpaiḥ pramite śake abde sarpasya tithyāṃ śanivāsareśudā || hitopadeśābhidha pustakaṃtadā. śrī bhānudatto alikhaddhanārthe || || śrī majjaganatīdhavo jayati. anena lipikāmaṃtrīpāṇI gṛhītā avalā prasannā astu || (fol. 32r8–10)

Beginning [Ṭīkā] śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ | śālvena nirākṛtayā amvākhyayā kāśīputryā tvaṃ mām uddhaheti pārthito bhīṣmas tām āha○ guṇiganeti yasya(2) bhīṣmākhyasya mama○ guṇigaṇagaṇanārambhe guṇisamūhasaṃkhyākalanopakrame susambhramād atitvarayā kaṭhinī khaṭikā na patati(3) nety atra kākuḥ apitu sambhramāt pataty eva○ tena bhīṣmeṇa yadi amvā kāśīrājajyeṣṭhaputrī sutinī bhavet tarhi○ bandhyā kīdṛ(4)śī bhavati vadeti pṛcchato bhīṣmasyāyam abhiporāyaḥ (fol. 1v1–4) [Mūla] guṇagaṇagaṇanāraṃbhe na patati kaṭhinī susaṃbhramād yasya tenāmbā yadi sutinī vada bandhā kīdṛśī bhavati || (fol. 1v6) End [Ṭīkā] ambā putra mātā yadi suti(5)nī bhavet tarhi bandhyā kīdṛśī bhavati vada duḥkṣaṇādhānotpannatanayena putravatī tāṃ sukhaṃ nānubhūyate(6) kintu tādṛśa guṇahīna putrotpatyā vṛthā tāruṇyaṃ taraṇer ayavaśaithilyās tācalāvalaṃvadarśanena ta(7)syāḥ putrahīna bandhyātulanām api kavir na hasata iti paṃcamo arthaḥ || 5 || śubham || śubham || (fol. 3r4–7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo gaṇeśāya || siddhiḥ sādhye satām astu, prasādāt tasya dhūrjjaṭeḥ | jāhnavīphanalekheva, yan mūrddhi śaśinaḥ kalā (2) || śruto hitopadeśoyaṃ, pāṭavaṃ saṃskṛtoktiṣu | vācāṃ sarvvatra vaicitryaṃ, nītividyāṃ dadāti ca || ajarāmaravat prājño(3) vidyām arthaṃ ca ciṃtayet || gṛhīta iva keśeṣu, mṛtyunā dharmmam ācaret || sarvvadravyeṣu vidyaiva dravyam āhur anuttamaṃ (4) | ahāryyatvād akṣayatvād anarghyatvāc ca sarvvadā || (fol. 1v1–4) End ity ākarṇya hiraṇyakaḥ prahṛ(6)ṣṭamanāḥ pulakitaḥ san-n uvāca || sādhu mitra sādhu || anenāśritānāṃ vātsalyena trailokyasyāpi prabhutvaṃ tvayi(7) yujyate | evam uktvā sarvveṣāṃ baṃdhanāni tena chinnāni | anantaraṃ hiraṇyakaḥ sādaraṃ saṃpūjy āha | sakhe citragrī–(fol. 9v5–7) Colophon

«Beginning» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya | si /// ḍhurjjate | jāhna(2)vīpheṇarekheva, yanmuddhi śa /// || samasta lokayātā upakāra ni(3)mirttina śrīviṣṇusarmmā dhayā /// paṃḍitana, nitiśāstrayā, sāra jukva saṃgraha(4) yāṅa, tayā khaṃ bālakapani bodha nimirttina, bhāṣāna hlāsyaṃhe, sāstrayā ādisa(5) samasta vighna mocakeyātā, maṃgalācarana dhakaṃ, parameśvarayātaṃ namaskāra yāṅā(6)va, śrīmahādevayā, prasādana, satpātra, paṃṇḍitapanisena yāṅā kāryyasa, siddhi juya(7)māra dhakaṃ viṣṇu sarmmāna, āsirvvāda biyā, gonakhu mahādevayā jatāmukuṭa(b1)sa jāhnavīgaṃgāyā phena lekhā coṅatheṃ candramāyā kalā kilaṇa coṃṅa, thathiṃṅa ma(2)hādevayā prasannanaṃ nivvighra(!) thajura dhakaṃ āśikhā biva, thva śirokayā artha juraṃ || 1 || (exp. 3t1-b2) «End» thvatothyaṃ tava mateva vicāra yāyamāla, ā(2)vayā jepaniṅa, sarago dhakāva, raśatāyāva rājaputrapani viśṇuśa(3)rmmāṇa, paṇḍitapani raśatāyāva, āśikha biyā, chapanisa śarjana, mitra dayakemāra, lakṣmī thīra juyamāla, chapani dharmmātmā juyamāla, thva jena daya(4)kā hi topade śa, puthi matyaṅā hmoco tayāthyaṃ, māṅāva ta<<>>yāthyaṃ sarjana(5)panisya<<>>na, tayamāla, parameśvara mahādevana, chapani śakalyaṇa juya(6)māla, guruyāke, śāstra senyasa rbhākta dayamāla, dhakāva āśikhā biyā(exp. 20t1) || chapani lihāvani dhakāva, byadā biyāva choyā, rājaputrapani, che vāṅa(2) juro: || || (exp. 19b1-20t2) «Colophon» iti hitopadeśa, nītisārasaṃgraha mitrarābha juva nāma(3) kathāsaṃgraḥ samāpta || || samvat 831 jyeṣṭha śukla śaniścaravāla ṣaṣṭhi na(4)ṣetra, punavasunakṣetra vṛṃhanayoga thokuhnu jagasiṃṅa || || śubha...stu (5) bijarakvacheyā || || śubham astu sarvvadāḥ || || śivagati (exp. 20t2-5)

«Beginning» ḥ | patir eko guru strīṇā, sarvvasyābhyā gato guruḥ || brāhmaṇayā guru juraṃ, agnidevatā | catu(2)varṇṇayā guru julaṃ, brāhmaṇā | strīlokayā guru juraṃ, thava puruṣa | lokasamastasa guru juraṃ, a(3)bhyāgata || 89 || utamasyāpi varṇṇasyanāṃ cāpi gṛham āgataḥ | pujaniyo tathānyāyaṃ sarvvasyā(4)bhyā gato guru || urttamajāti julasanoṃ, nicajāti jurasanoṃ, abhyāgata che varaṅāva, pujā(5) yāyamāla, suyāsinaṃ abhyāgata guru || 90 || (exp. 2:1-5) «End» atikleśena yan dravya, atilo(4)bhena sukha | parapiḍā ca yā vṛtrri, neva sādhūṣū vidyate || ati duḥkhana dhana dhana lāya, a(5)ti lobha yāṅana sukha lāya | mevayāke pīḍā yāya, thvate sādhujanayāke madu || 217 || (6) na śakyeṃ nālabhe prājñā, akārya naiva kārayata | svatvakāryaṃ na kuryārc ca, nisphala naiva seva (exp. 27b3-6) «Sub-Colophon» i(exp. 4b5)ti cānakyaśārasaṃgrahe prathamaśataka samāpta || ۞ || iti cānakyasārasaṅgrahe dvitiyaśanakaṃ samāptaḥ || ۞|| (exp. 24t5) «Colophon»

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || siddhiḥ sādhye satām astu, prasādāt tasya dhūrjjaṭeḥ | jāhnavīphenalekheva, yan muddhni śaśinaḥ kalā || śru(2)to hitopadeśoyaṃ pāṭavaṃ saṃskṛtoktiṣu | vācāṃ sarvvatra vaicitryaṃ nītividyāṃ dadāti ca | ajarāmaravat prājño vidyām arthaṃ ca(3) cintayet | gṛhīta iva keśeṣu mṛtyunā dharmmam ācaret || sarvvadravyeṣu vidyaiva, dravyam āhur anuttamaṃ | āhāryyatvād anargha(4)tvād akṣayatvāc ca sarvvadā || (fol. 1v1–4) End eka evopahāras tu(7) saṃdhir etat śataṃ hitaḥ | upahārasya bhedās tu, sarvve te maitravarjjitāḥ || abhiyoktāralīyastvā,d alabdhvā na nivṛ[[rttate | uapahārād ṛte tasmāt saṃdhir anyaṃ na vidyate || cakravākādbhuto++++++++++]]ṇa(1)ranti yāvat svarṇācaloyaṃ davadahanasamo yasya sūryaḥ sphūliṃgaṃ stāvan nārāyaṇena, pracaratu caritaḥ saṃgra(2)ho ʼyaṃ kathānāṃ || aparaṃ ca || śrīmān dhavalacaṃdrosau, vājīyāt māliko ripūn || yenāyaṃ saṃgraho yatnā(!) lekhayitvā(3) pracāritaḥ || (fol. 114v6:115r3) Colophon || iti hitopadeśe nītisāre, saṃdhir n-nāma caturthaḥ kathāsamgrahaḥ samāptaḥ || ❁ || śubha || (fol. 115r3)

Beginning oṃ namo hariharābhyāṃ || || siddhiḥ sādhye satām astu prasādāt tasya dhūrj-jaṭeḥ | jāhnavīphenalekheva yanmū(2)rddhni śaśinaḥ kalā || śruto hitopado || yaṃ(!) pāṭavaṃ saṃskṛtoktiṣu || vācāṃ sarvatra vaicitryaṃ nītividyāṃ dadāti ca || 2 || (3)ajarāmaravat prājño vidyā marthaṃ ca ciṃtayet || gṛhīta iva keśeṣu, mṛtyunā dharmmam ācaret || sarvadravyeṣu vidyai(4)va dravyam āhur anuttamaṃ || ahāryatvād akṣayatvād anarghatvā (!) ca sarvadā || (fol. 1v1–4) End prālayādreḥ sutāyāḥ praṇaya nivasati candramauliḥ sa yāvat yāval-lakṣmīr m-murārer j-ja(4)laḍa (!) iva taḍin mānasaṃ visphurantī | yāvat svarṇācaloyaṃ davadahana mamo yasya sūryyaḥ sphuliṃgas tāvan-nārā(5)yaṇena pracaratu caritaḥ saṃgrahoyaṃ kathānāṃ || aparaṃca || śrīmān dhavalacandro ʼsau, jīyān māṇḍaliko ripūn(6) | yenāyaṃ samgraho yatnāl-lekhayitvā pracāritaḥ || ||(fol. 115v3–6) Colophon iti hitopadeśe sandhir n-nāma caturthakathāsaṃgrahaḥ samāptaḥ || || (1)nepālābda gatepakṣa, vasusāgarasaṃyute | ākhāḍha śukla bhūtāyāṃ, vīrabhadro vyalīlikhat || 7 || yādṛṣṭaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā (2)…nadīyate || || śrībhavānīśaṃkarābhyān-namaḥ || śubha || (3)śrī śrī śrī (fol. 115v6–116r3)

Beginning –d iha kathyate || mitralābhaḥ suhṛdbhedo, vigrahaḥ sandhir eva caḥ (!) | pañcatantrāt tathānyasmād granthād ākṛ(2)ṣya liṣyate || asti bhāgīrathītīre, pāṭalīputraṇāmadheyaṃ(!) nagaraṃ | tatra sarvvasvāmi guṇopeta(3)ḥ sudarśano nāma narapatir āsīt, sa ca nṛpati, ekadā kenāpi paṭhyamānaṃ, ślokadvayaṃ śuśrāva(4) || anekasaṃśayocchedi, parokṣārthasya darśakaṃ | sarvvasya locanaṃ śāstraṃ, yasya nāsty andha eva saḥ || (!) (fol. 2r1–4) End prāleyādreḥ sutāyāḥ praṇayani(1)vasatiś candramauliḥ sa yāvad yāvallakṣmīr m-murāre jalada iva taḍin mānase visphuliṃgas tāva(2)n nārāyaṇena pracaratu caritaḥ saṃgrahoyaṃ kathānāṃ || aprañ ca || śrīmān dhavalacandrosau, jīyā(3)n māṇḍaliko ripūn | yenāyaṃ saṃgraho yatnāl-lekhayitvā pracāritaḥ || || (fol. 132v7–133r3) Colophon || iti hitopadeśe(4) sandhirnnāma caturthaḥ kathāsaṃgrahaḥ samāptaḥ || || samvat 781 pauṣa śukla daśamyān tithau ||(5) saṃpūrṇṇā likhitaṃ || śubham astu || (fol.133r3–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇēśāya namaḥ || śrīśuka uvāca || gopyaḥ kṛṣṇe vanaṃ yāte tamanudrutacetasaḥ kṛṣṇalīlāṃ pragāyaṃtyo ninyo duḥkhena vāsarām 1 gopya ucuḥ vāmabāhu kṛtavāmakapolo valgitabhruradharārpitaveṇuṃ komalāṃgulībhirāśritamārgaṃ gopya īrayati yatra mukuṃdaḥ 2 (fol. 1v1–4) End yadupatir viradarājavihāro yāminīpatir ivai sa dināṃte mudita vaktra upayāti duraṃtaṃ mocayan vrajagavāṃ dinatāpaṃ 25 śrīśuka uvāca evaṃ vrajastriyo rājan kṛṣṇalīlānugāyatiḥ remirehaḥ sutacittās tanmanaskā mahodayāḥ 26 (fol. 4r3–6) Colophon iti śrībhāgavate mahāpurāṇe daśamaskaṃdhe vṛdāvanakrīḍāyaṃ gopikāgītaṃ nāma paṃcatriṃśodhyāyaḥ ❁ (fol. 4r6–7)

Beginning ❖ śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || śrīsāvaraṇārdhanārīśvara nṛtyānandasvarupebhyo namaḥ || nāndīgītaṃ || rājavijayarāge || ekatāle || nādabrahmaharajahnika tralayaragāse bhaktajanamahika tralatakara vikāśa || jahnika lalāṭa soha ami akiraṇe maṅgaladāyaka jahni bhaja save jana || ambukāṃ īsarasija samajasgāta varābhayajasuhātha vandi aparāta || nṛpajagajyotikaha karaniravāha pūrāvathu manoratha tribhuvananāha || 1 || || (fol. 1r1–5) End mālaśrī || kharja || mātṛkāgaṇadīpakara dhaela jagata jananīyantravajā ola joginīgaṇe takhaneṃ harakhiye nṛtyasājararo mudita bhūtavetā tāladela mahābhairava mahāmṛdaṃga sādare sabahi samara aṃgaṇa anūpamaraṇga chājara laraṃ || talaradhūni sūni asūramohara, devamanasaṃgīta sohayare sakalacchalavalakala (fol. 18v5–19r2)

Beginning ❖ śrīśrī svestadevatāye (!) namaḥ || ❖ śrī nāṭeśvarābhyāṃ namaḥ || rāja vijaya || cau || prathamasa sū maraya gauriganēśa nṛtya sadā priya deva maheśa || sakala devadevinṛtyavilāsa duḥkha vimocana sukhayā prakāśaḥ nārada tuṃburu nārada sajīva nāda paṃcama vedamana sukhaviva || kiñcita kautuka nepālayā bhāsa murukhayā hāsa guṇiyā abhilāṣa || nṛpajagajyoti sakala niradīśa kevalaśaraṇa jagadambā īśa || 1 || (fol. 1v1–5) End paṃcama || jha || cyā gulipiṭhasaṅa gulidevisaṅa nivāsa tupalaju īśvarī madhyaprakāśa || bhagatanagara bhairavabhagavatipura janasakala saṃdevadevigati || suparṇakalaśatoraṇa abhiraṇaabhirāma hariharasvayaṃ tu sevā parināma || ādi bhavānicaraṇatalagati ravikulasaṃbhavadeśayā nṛpati || 15 || || (fol. 4r3–6) Colophon thvate nepālabhākhāna nānārtha paṃcasdaśakam gītaṃ saṃpūrṇam || || śubham astu sarvvadā || e || (fol. 4r6)

«Beginning: » ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || kailāśaśikhare ramye nānāratnopaśobhite | śaṃkaraṃ paripapraccha pārvvatī parameśvaraṃ || || śrīdevy uvāca || deva deva mahādeva sarvvajña sakaleśvara || tvattaḥ śrutā mayā deva nṛtyabhedāḥ salakṣaṇāḥ || idānīṃ śrotum icchāmi vādyānāṃ nirṇṇayaṃ sphuṭaṃ | mṛdaṃgalakṣaṇotpattiṃ kathayasva mayi prabho || || (exp. 11t1–6) «End: » ete vādyaprabhedā hi mṛdaṅgāntargatāḥ priye | gītaṃ vādyasamāyuktaṃ tasmā[dā]dau mahotsavaḥ | teṣu nṛtyādisaṃyogaṃ nānā bhāvakalānvitaṃ || devāsuramanuṣyādi siddhagandharvamohanaṃ | sarvvaparvvaṇi tīrthādau nādaśabdaḥ sukhāvahaḥ || mṛdaṃgopari saṃsthitvā dharmakāmārthasiddhidaḥ | mṛdaṃganādasaṃśrutvā prāpyate paramaṃ padaṃ || || (exp. 21b1–6) «Colophon: » iti śrīśadāśivamate mṛdaṃgādhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || śubha || (exp. 21b7)
