Beginning rāga ārati || ārati joti jagadambe māi ke || niraṃjanarūpa va rāma jotike || raviśaśi uta mana ārati sāje anahada sabda ghaṇṭa vajāvai || 1 || paṃcabhūta mili caṃvaṃra ḍolāvai joti tilakamaiṃ tanamana bhāvai || 2 || sevaka bhakti jana ārati gāvai aṃta dharma karma mokṣaphala pāvai || 3 || (exp. 2t1–2b2) End īndradamana siṃdhu vāje rohine ṣaḍi mārakaṇḍe sesa gaṃgā ānaṃda bhara-I ||3 || kaṃcana maṃcana dipadāna jarmaga kari navaniti aṃgatura vāti kājari || 4 || suranaramunī dvāre ṭhāḍe brahmaveda ucari dhande dhande rāgasura ājuki ghari || 5 || (exp. 5t5–5b4)

«Beginning: » ❖ āpīya madyam aniśaṃ vivaśāntarāyas tadbhāṣitaṃ kathaya kena vicāraṇīyaṃ | kvāpyardhavarṇavalitaṃ kvacid arthabādha- yuktaṃ virodhasahitaṃ rahitaṃ krameṇa || || ❖ ṣaḍjādayaḥ svarāḥ sapta sthānasthānavibhedataḥ | utpadyante kalau kāle kathā api tathā nṛṇāṃ || hṛdayārthagataṃ kaścit kaścidvacanarañjana | bhrūsaṃjñayā vadatyanyaḥ satyayukto hi durllabhaḥ || ityavetya manuṣyāṇāṃ vacanāni mṛdūnyapi | vicāryyāni(!) prayatnena kila kalyāṇam icchatā || (exp. 3t1–8) «End: » prācīnasya || etādṛśo guṇajñātā bhūmau bhavati naiva ca || yadi ko pi kadācit syād ghūrṇnayatyeva mastakaṃ || navi(!)nasya || śaile śaile na māṇīkyaṃ mauktikaṃ na gaje gaje | sādhavo na hi sarvatra candanaṃ na vane vane || prācīnasya || śaile śaile tu māṇikyaṃ mauktikaṃ tu gaje gaje | śrīkhaṇḍa sādhu sarvatra yadi bhāṅyānukūlatā || navinasya || (exp.35b6–36t3 ) «Colophon: »x

«Beginning: » oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || natvā pūrṇenduvaktrāṃ kamalabhavasutāṃ bhāratīṃ bhāsayantīṃ vīṇā vādyaṃ vahantīṃ vimalataratanuṃ pustakaṃ dhārayantīṃ vighnān saṃvārayantīṃ bhavajaladigatāṃ bhānavāṃṣtārayantīṃ śarmā bhauṇikya nāmā matim anugatavān rāgaratnaṃ tanoti 1 bhairavaś cātha hiṃdolo meghaśrīr dīpakas tathā kaiśikaś ceti vijñeyā rāgasaṃjñā saḍātmikā 2 (exp.3b1–6) «End: » saṃcāre meghamallārasaṃjño yam sthāyivarjjitaḥ sarigamapadhani sarima śrīrāgo mapadhanayaḥ sthāyīmadhye svarā yatra saṃcārī sarigakhyāḥ kathito nidhinā vicāryya śāstrāṇi mapadhani sarigamadhani sari ādau saptasvarāś cānte saṃcārī sarisaṃjñakau mālakauśaḥ sa vijñeyo yatra sthāyī na vi- atha bhaṭahārī yatra svarāḥ paṃcamādyā madhye saptasvarās tathā saṃcārī sarigākhyāś ca bhaṭahārī nigadyate padhani sarigamapadhani sariga «Colophon: »x

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāyaḥ(!) || śrīnṛtyanāthāya(!) || || praṇamya devadeveśaṃ praṇamya gajadhāranaṃ || praṇamya bhūtanāthaṃ ca praṇamya sacarācaraṃ || || śrīdevyauvāca(!) || kailāśaśikhare ramya(!) praṇamya pṛccha(!) pārvvatī || mṛgaṅgākṣala(!)utparṇaṃ(!) pravakṣyāmi ja(!)thākramaṃ || || śrī-īśvaruvāca(!) || śṛnu(!) devī(!) pravakṣyāmi utpaṃnahetulakṣaṇa(!) | deva deva tademahaṃ(!) vakṣye vyāptamānaṃ (!) jathākramaṃ(!) || (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » atha tālā(!) kaṃsatālaṃ ghaṇṭā ghurghuri eva hi paṃcamo ghaṭitālaṃ ca ghanapaṃca vidhi(!)yate | etāni vādye bheda(!)ni mṛdaṃga vidhi(!)dhāni ca | gītavādyasamāyuktaṃ tasmāt nādamahotsave || teṣu nṛtyādisaṃyoga nānābhāvakarā⟪gni⟫nnita(!) | devāsuramunīnāṃ ca siddhi(!)gandharvamohitā(!) || sarvvaparvvāni tirthāni nādasabdasuṣāvahaṃ || mṛgaṅgaparilaṃ(!) sthitvā prāpyate paramaṃ padaṃ || || (fol. 9r5–9v3) «Colophon: » iti sadāśivamate vādya⟪bhā⟫bhedo nāma mṛdagṅalakṣaṇādhyāyaṃ (!) samāptam iti ḥ(!) || || śubham astu || || (fol. 9v3–4)

«Beginning: » śrīśivau jayataḥ || praṇamya bharato bhaktyā sarvvadā śivadaṃ śivam | gītasy alakṣaṇaṃ prāha vādimattagajāṅkuśaḥ || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ gītam ucyate | yatastataḥ prayatnena geyaṃ śrotavyam eva ca || gurudevadvijātīnāṃ yatpuro gīyate naraiḥ | taddharmāya bhavetteṣāṃ svargāya vijayāya ca || (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » sajalajaladanīlaṃ darśitodāraśīlaṃ karadhṛtavaraśailaṃ veṇuvādyaikaśīlam | vrajajanakulapālaṃ kāminikelilolaṃ taruṇatulasimālaṃ naumigopālabālaṃ || varhāpīḍaṃ naṭavaravapuḥ karṇayoḥ karṇikāraṃ bibhradvāsaḥ kanakakapaiśaṃ vaijanantīṃ ca mālāṃ | raṃdhrān veṇor adharasudhayā pūrayan gopavṛndair vṛndāraṇyaṃ svapadaramaṇaṃ rāviśad gītakīrttiḥ || || (fol. 27v3–28r1) «Colophon: » iti śrīsaṃgītaśāstroktā rāgamālā samāptā || || digvyomanāgenduyukte śubhābde budhe vāsare kṛṇṇapakṣe navamyāṃ (śrī)prāṇanātho likha[[t pustakaṃ]] vai samastāṃ tathā mādhave rāgamālāṃ || śrīmallambodaryai(!) namaḥ | śubham āstām || (fol. 27r2–5)

«Beginning: » rāga bhajan || bhajo mana śrībadrīnārāyaṇa ahairā(!) aṣaṇḍa nirākāra rūpako || paramadhāma śrībadrītīrthako alaṣanaṃḍāṛṣigaṃgātīrthako || śrīkūrmadhārā śrīprahlādadhārāko taptakuṇḍanārada sūrjekuṇḍako || 1 || gaurilakṣmīdhārā brahmakapāliko śrībadrīnātha śrīpuruṣottamako || (exp. 3t1–7) «End: » rāga gauri || sāṃvare kahnaiyā maiṃ tumso yāri kini || tāna mṛdaṃga ddaṃga ghughuru bāje || ghugaru āpha bajaiyā || saki(!) gvālana gāṃvana lāge bṛjapata āpha nacaiyā || sā || 1 || meghavā kopa bhayo bṛja upara bṛjako deta vabhaiyā || sūradāsa prabhu tumāre milanakuṃ hamakuṃ pāra lagaiyā || sāṃvare kanaiyā || 2 || || || || (exp. 31b8–11) «Colophon: »x

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurucaraṇābhyāṃ namaḥ || praṇamya govindapadāravindaṃ devīṃ girāṃ gaurava†maṃhri†yugmaṃ || lokadvayānandakaraṃ karoti gūḍhāśayaṃ rājavidhānasāraṃ || 1 || nānānibandhanavilokanakhedaśāṃtyai saṃgṛhya dharmanayamūlavaco vibhāvya sāraṃ nigṛhya nṛpaśikṣaṇakautukāya śrīraṅganāthakṛtinā racito nibandhaḥ || 2 || nepāladeśālikakāntipuryāṃ gīrvāṇayuddhottaravikramasya || rājādhirājasya manaḥsarojaṃ prakāśayed rājavidhānasāra || 3 || (exp. 3a1–10) End suvṛtto rājyaraklṣādi samarthaś ca yadātmajaḥ || tadā maṃtryādisaṃmatyā yauvarājye bhiṣecayet || 41 || khyātaḥ paṇḍitarājaramyapadavīṃ yo hyadrirājeśvarād- āpta śrībrajanāthanāmavidito vedāṅgaśāstrojjvalaḥ || bhūpānandini tatsutena racite nītiprabandhe ʼtule saṃpūrṇo nṛpadharmabodhanipūṇo dvaito vilāsaḥ subhaḥ || || (exp. 28a10–28b3) Colophon iti śrīmadvidvanmukuṭamaṇigaṇakiraṇanīrājitacaraṇaśrīpaṇḍitarājavrajanāthapaṇḍitātmajaśrīpaṇḍitarājaraṅganāthasūriviracite rājavidhānasāre rājadharmakano nāma dvitīyo vilāsaḥ || 2 || śubham || ❁ (exp. 28b3–8)

«Beginning: » śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || praṇamya bharato bhaktyā sarvadā śivadaṃ śivam || gītasya lakṣaṇaṃ prāha vādimattagajāṃkuśaḥ || 1 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ gītam ucyate || atas tu tat prayatnena geyaṃ śrotavyam eva ca || 2 || gurudevadvijātīnāṃ yat puro gīyate naraiḥ || tad dharmāya bhavet teṣāṃ svargāya vijayāya ca || 3 || (fol. 1v1–3) «End: » sajalajaladanīlaṃ darśśitodāraśīlaṃ karadhṛtavaraśailaṃ veṇuvādyaṃ rasāḍhyaṃ || vrajajanakulapālaṃ kāminīkelilolaṃ taruṇatulasimālaṃ naumi gopālabālam || 48 || varhāpīḍaṃ naṭavaravapuḥ karaṇayoḥ karṇikāraṃ vibhrad vāsaḥ kanakakapiśaṃ vaijayaṃtīṃ ca mālām || randhān veṇor adharasudhayā pūrayan gopavṛndair vṛndāraṇyaṃ svapadaramaṇaṃ prāviśad gītakīrttiḥ || || 149 || || (fol. 14r1–5) «Colophon: » iti śrīrāgamālāyāṃ rāgarāgiṇyudāharaṇalakṣaṇapūr akadhyānakathanaṃ samāptam || || hari[r] haratu duritam || śaṃkarotu śaṃkaraḥ (fol. 14r5–6)

«Beginning: » ❖ svasti śrīsadāśivo jayati || natvā lakṣmipatiṃ devaṃ bharatādimunī tapī || rāgatattvavibodhāya vakṣye saṃgītalakṣaṇaṃ || 1 || sakalāḥ sakalāvidyāḥ śrīnivāso vibhāvya ca || kalāratnasya gānasya tattvato lakṣaṇaṃ bruve || 2 || nṛtyavādyaviśeṣābhyāṃ gānaṃ ced upabṛṃhitaṃ || tadā saṃgītam ity āhur lakṣalakṣaṇakovidaḥ || 3 || gītavāditranṛtyānāṃ yasmād aṃgyaṃ gatā bhavet || gānaṃ kevalam apy āhuḥ saṃgītaṃ laṣmavedinaḥ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) End navatrayodaśāpyante śrutir madhye vyavasthitāḥ || āhuḥ saṃvādināṃ kṣetravivekajñānasaṃbhavāḥ || caturbhis tau sari proktau ganī dvābhyāṃ vyavasthitau || catu[r]bhir madhapā yuktā rāvaṃ śruti vi[ni]rṇayaḥ || anyāś ca vikṛtān kuryāc chrutikṣetravibhāgataḥ || pratyakṣamānasiddh[y]arthe śābdabodho ʼpaṭur(!) bhavet || evaṃ cobhayapakṣajña jñātamelasamudbhavaḥ || anantā api rāgāḥ syuḥ †gakomad†graha(!)bhadataḥ || || (fol. 42v7–43r4) Colophon iti śrīnivāsakṛtarāgatattvavibodhaḥ samāptam(!) agamat || || ❁ || || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ (fol. 43r4–5)

«Beginning: » ❖ oṃ namo gaṇeśāya || praṇamya śirasā devau pri(!)tāmaheśvarau(!) | saṃgītaśāstre saṃkṣepas sārato yaṃ mayocyate || bharatādimataṃ sarrvam āloḍyātiprayatnataḥ || śrīmatāharibhaṭtena sajjanānandahetunā | pracarad(‥ ‥)dgitasārodrālo(!) vidhīyate || gītaṃ vādyañ ca narttanañ ca trayaṃ saṃjñātam ucyate ||<ref name="ftn1"> unmetrical </ref> mā(‥)deśīvibhāgena saṅgīta[ṃ] dvibhidaṃ(!) mataṃ || druhiṇeṇa yad u[d]dīṣṭaṃ prayuktaṃ bharatena ca || mahādevasya puratas tan mokṣākhyaṃ vimuktidaṃ taddeśas †tayavityata† syāllokānuvaṃjakaṃ || (fol. 1v1–3) «End: » atha gondalī | vāsye prabandhau kaṭhinaiḥ muktam enādibhis tathā | gītir mana ustaiṣyabandhaiś ca dhruvādibhiḥ | <ref name="ftn2"> unmetrical </ref> nāsyāṅge bandhitaṃ yatra nṛtyaṃ ca drutamānataḥ || svayaṃ gāyati vādyaṃ ...†vyatvamovīvāmevam vān† mūkagoṇḍanī | goṇḍanyā maṇḍanaṃ proktaṃ tad gaiḥ kāṇḍīṭadeśajaṃ || iti goṇḍanī || (fol. 50r6–9) «Colophon: » iti śrīmatpaṇḍitalakṣmīdharasuta catu[ra]dāmodarabhaṭṭaviracite saṅgītadarpane(!) nṛttā(!)dhyāya[ḥ] (fol. 50r9)

«Beginning: » ❖ gurugaṇapatibhyāṃ namaḥ || ambikāsahitaṃ śambhuṃ namāmi jagadāśrayaṃ || nādarāgādikaṃ kiñcillikhāmi tadanugrahāt || 1 || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ gītam ucyate || yatas tataḥ prayatnena geyaṃ śrotavyam eva ca || 2 || nāṭyalocanam ālokya naṭeśvaramataḥparaṃ || nāṭyadarpaṇam anyac ca daśarūpakanāmakam || 3 || ratnākaraṃ ratnakoṣaṃ tathā nāradasāradāṃ || tuṃburur nāṭakaṃ caiva tathā padmajabhāṣitaṃ || 4 || kalpabṛkṣaṃ kalpataru kalpavallīṃ ca śeṣaraṃ | cūḍāmaṇiṃ ca sarvasvaṃ muktāvalīm athāpi ca || 5 || saṅgītacandranāmānm ata saṅgītasārakaṃ | rāgārṇavaṃ samāsena dāmodarajagaddharau || 6 || ... eteṣāṃ sāram uddhṛtya kṛtaḥ sarvārthasaṃgrahaḥ | saṅgītacintāmaṇyākhya granṭhe(!) nepālabhūbhṛtā || 8 || śrījagajjyotir īśena sūryavaṃśābjabhānunā | saṅgītaviduṣāṃ prītyai śivabhaktyekasādhanaṃ || 9 || (fol. 1v1–6) «End: » saṃdaṃśo mukulo tha syāt padmakoṣaḥ kkaro paraḥ | ūrṇanābhīthahastaḥ syād alapallavasaṃjñitaḥ || asaṃyutā amī hastā caturvaiṃśatir īritāḥ | saṃyutatvaṃ ihāmīṣām abhineyavaśān mataṃ || aṃjaliḥ syāt kapotaś ca karkkaṭo gajadantakaḥ || niṣadhākhyaḥ puṣpapuṭaḥ ṣaṭakābaddhamānakaḥ || utsaṃgaḥ svastiko dolo bahittho makaras tathā | barddhamānāpy amī proktās trayodaśa ca saṃyuṭāḥ || || (fol. 109v1–4) «Sub-colophon: »? iti śubhaṅkaraviracitāyāṃ hastamuktāvalyāṃ samāpto yaṃ granthaḥ || || || śrībhavānī prīṇātu || || ... ❖ nepāle rasaṣaṣṭhiśailavimale jāte śubhe vatsare | bhādre śuklakuje ca manmathatithau svātyāṃ śubhe puṇyakṛt | śrīmat sūrakulāvataṃsavimalaḥ khyāto vinodātmajo- nantoyaṃ kuladīpano likhad iti muktāvalīpustakaṃ || udakānalacaurebhyo...(fol. 103v3–6)

«Beginning of the root text: » [[ viśvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamātmakam idaṃ yasyāhnikaṃ vāṅmayaṃ sarvaṃ vācikam indusūryabhagaṇādyāhāryam āryā jaguḥ | dīkṣā mārakṛtākhila tribhuvano yaḥ kevalaṃ svā(!)tviko rudraḥ śrīkṛtasavyabhāgasubhago bhūyāt sa vaḥ śreyase || ]] (fol. exp. 1top) «Beginning of the commentary: » ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || ajñānatimiradinakaram ānandasudhāsamudrapūrṇenduṃ tāpatrayāpaharaṇaṃ vande paradevatācaraṇaṃ || natvā gurūn atigurūn kṛtī jagajjyotir avanīśaḥ saṅgītabhāskaram amuṃ kurute sudhiyaṃ sametya vaṅ(!)śamaṇiṃ || nāṭyaśāstrāraṃbhe nirbighnasamāptyarthaṃ śiṣṭācāraparaṃparāprāptakarttavyatākam etacchāstrapravarttakasamucitaśiveṣṭadevatākīrtta[[na]]rūpaṃ maṃṅgalam ācarati granṭha(!)kāraḥ viśvamityādi (fol. 1v1–3) «End of root text: » evaṃ sālagasūtrasthair ekatālpavaśānakaiḥ | rūpakair narttanaṃ kṛtvā pātraṃ tyāge supāśrayet | narttakyasayaivam ādāya kathitā goṇḍalīvidhiḥ || (fol. 191v6–7) «End of commentary: » evam anena prakāreṇa ekatālpavaśānakaiḥ śeṣa ekatālītālakanṛtyayuktaiḥ śālagasūtraiḥ gītaprabaṃdhaiḥ rūpakaiś ca tālair nṛtyaṃ kṛtvā pātraṃ tyāgaṃ nṛtyavirāmaṃ kuryād ity artha || evaṃ anena prakāreṇa narttakasyānandāya mayā gōṇḍalīvidhiḥ kathita ity arthaḥ | (fol. 191v7–192r1) «Colophon: » iti saṃgītabhāskare goṇḍalīvidhiḥ || || idānīm avaśyakartta⟨vya⟩vyārtham āha yathā yathā prekṣakānā(!)ṃ camatkāeas tathā tathā ratim utpādayen nṛtya iti saṃgītasaṅgrahaḥ || ... śrīmajjagajjyotyir adhīśvarasya nideśam āsādya guṇottarasya | saṃgītaśāstrasya cakāra ṭīkā śrīmaithilo vaṅśamaṇir manīṣāṃ || sudhiyo pi hi nandanti jalpinair bbālakalpitaiḥ | tadeṣa paritoṣāya viduṣāṃ me śa(!)mudyamaḥ || nepālābde śaśiśaramunivyañjite śuklapakṣe | puṣye gaṇḍe suragurudine drākṣapakṣe daśamyāṃ | labdhvādeśaṃ guṇagaṇanidheḥ śrījagajjyotir īśāt | saṃgītādyaṃ samalikhad asau bhāskaraṃ vijña induḥ || śubha || (fol. 192r1–192v3)

«Beginning: » || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ nīlādrikaṃdarānandi maṃdarālayavaṃditaṃ vaṃde vandārumandāraṃ seṃdiraṃ paramaṃ mahaḥ | pravṛtta⟨ṃ⟩tālaṃ karatālikābhir ābhīrikāṇāṃ kalaveṇugītaṃ nṛtyantam atyantam udārahāsaṃ rāsaṃ bhajantaṃ harim antar īḍe prāleyaśailatanayā kucakoṭimuccair niṣcuṣyaṣaṇmukhamukhair atipītamuktāṃ harṣākulasya niyataṃ śubham ādiśantu laṃbho(!)darasya dara⟨sya⟩puṣkaradhūnanāni bālām ālāpatālādyair lālayaṃtī harer manaḥ caturbhujabhujāśliṣṭām iṣṭāṃ śraṣṭuḥ sutāṃ bhaje (fol. 1v1–4) «End: » aparaṃ ca dhruvagītānām udāharaṇāni tattad vivecanasthale | darśitāṇi(!) | yad adhītaṃ kaviratnāt puruṣottamamiśrato mayā sudhiyā | tattat prakaṭīkṛtam asmin sudhiyaḥ paritoṣayituṃ śataśaḥ | śrīḥ ...śrīmān mudetu loke | śrīḥ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 63v9–11) «Colophon: » iti śrīman nikhānvayottuṃgavaṃgavaṃśāvataṃśākhilaguṇasadmapadmanābhabhūmīpatitanūjanmano mahārājasya sāhityasaṅgītārṇavakarṇadhārakamaṇer gajapativīraśrīnārāyaṇadevasya kṛtau saṅgītanārāyaṇe śuddhaprabandhodāharaṇaṃ nāma caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ || 4 || śrīḥ || kadāpi me pāpahṛdā na līna- m aho mahodūṣaṇa cāpi cāpi durmūlakolaṅkaśaśātakuṃbha- bhramāvahaccārukucāpi cāpi || śrījagannāthāya namaḥ || śrīkaviratnapuruṣottamamiśrakṛtiḥ saṃgītanārāyaṇa nāmā granthaḥ samāptaḥ || śrīkṛṣṇo vijayate || saṃvat 1857 || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 63v11–64r3)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇādhipataye namaḥ || || vande ḍhuṃḍhiṃ sagaṇḍasthaladamalaharīvāhinī nātha pāthaḥ pūrāhāropaśarpajjaladharamatikṛd dhāla⟨e⟩lolambamālam || yacchuṃḍākuṃbhasaudhapravaraviharadaṃbhodhikanyāmatallī yātāyātānukūlākalitakuliśabhṛd ratnasopānapaṅktiḥ || 1 || adhyaṃkaṃ tava tāta lokajananīṃ velā calābhir bhavair dīvyair mārutaśāvakair amṛ[ta]dṛk kāruṇyasārāplutaiḥ || śāṃtaśrāṃtir ahaṃ tvayā samuditaṃ varṇaṃ tadākarṇayan kāśīnātha kadā labheya mahatīṃ āhlādapāraṃparī || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End pariṣvajyānyonyaṃ bhujarabhasakharvīkṛtakucaṃ jagatkhyātaṃ sarvaṃ dṛḍhatarasabhedaṃ ghaṭayatoḥ || ratikrīḍollāsaprakaṭitacidānandavapuṣo- dayaṃ jāyāpatyoḥ sukhayatu vihāraprathamayoḥ || 1 || aṃtaṃ prāpayate kṛtāṃtam alikajvāle smara jjuhvate kṛttiṃ mattgajasya kaṃcukayate bhāgerathiṃ vibhrate || ka[r]ṇottaṃsayate kalādharakalāṃ hālāhalaṃ jakṣate vedān vāhayate kṣitiṃ rathayate viśveśa tubhyaṃ namaḥ || 2 || kṛti[ḥ] śivānanda mahā munindunā kṛtāṃ purāreḥ padayoḥ samarpitām || avekṣya bhaktekarasām anukṣaṇaṃ dayārasā[r]drā rasayaṃtu sūrayaḥ || 3 || || ❁ || || (fol. 17r6–17v3) Colophon iti śrīśivānandamuniviracito madanacvilāśo nāmāṣṭapadī samāptaḥ śubham astu || || ❁ || || śrīśāke 1745 sāla miti | caitraśukla 14 citrānakṣatre bṛhaspativāre śrīśivamadanavi[lā]sāṣṭapadī śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇabhaṭtena likhitaṃ śubham astu śubhaṃ bhūyāt || || || || || || || || || (fol. 17v3–5)

«Beginning: » ❖ jīrṇāhāraḥ prabuddhaḥ san gītaṃ taddhi vicintayet | hemante śiśire tatra sānnidhyaṃ yāti bhāratī || || grīṣme pradoṣakāle tu niśīthe madhumādhave || prāvṛṭkāle ca madhyāhne śaratkāle yathāsukhaṃ || || granthāntare prabhāte bhairavo rāga udaye mālakauśikaḥ | yāme hiṇḍolarāgaś ca madhyāhne dīpakas tathā | dinānte caiva śrīrāgo megharāgo niśāntare | yasya yasyaiva rāgasya putrāgārasamanvitaḥ | tasya tasyaiva gātavyaṃ svavelāyāṃ sukhapradaṃ | (fol. 1v1–5) «End: » guṇadoṣau saṃpradāye mukhacārī tataḥ paraṃ || yati nṛtyaṃ śabdacārī dvātriṃśad uḍupāni ca || nṛtyabhūtplutyakaraṇaṃ daśadhā śuddhanṛtyakaṃ || deśīnṛtyaṃ pañcavidhaṃ nṛtyaśālagapa⟨r⟩ddhatiḥ || catvāri nṛtyāṅgānyatra nāṭyavargavidhis tataḥ || dṛṣtiyogo baṃdhanṛtyaṃ bahurūpaṃ tataḥ paraṃ || kolhāṭikā nṛtyam atra nāṭyarāsakasaṃjñakaṃ || daṇḍarāsakam apy atra carvvarīnṛtyam eva ca || etad va(!)tti samāsena saṃgītajñaḥ sa ucyate || saṃgītaśāstraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ eko vetti maheśvaraṃ(!) || (fol. 14v4–7) «Colophon: » iti saṃgītacūḍāmaṇav anukramaṇikādhyāyas tṛtīyaḥ || || eṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni vipradāsakṛta saṃgītacandre saṃgītakalpatarau ca varttante na mayātra ⟨na⟩ likhitāni || yattu tayor nāsti tad iha saṃgītacūḍāmaṇau likhitaṃ || saṃgītacūḍāmaṇyākhya grantha[ḥ] nepālabhūbhṛtāṃ śrīśrīraṇajinmallena sūryyavaṃśābjabhānunā⟨ḥ⟩ || bhavaṇī(!)śaṃkaraprītir astu janmani janmani || bhaviṣye || yo jāgaraṃ girisutābhirato dadāti caitrotsavādidivasesu ca sūryyavādī || vīnā(!)svarena(!) madhurasvarabhāṣīṇībhiḥ saṃṅīyate sa hi kṛśodarasundarībhiḥ || (fol. 14v8–10)

«Beginning of the root text: » śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || sāvarṇārddhanārīśvaranṛtyānandasvarūpebhyo namaḥ || skandapurāṇe sahyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍēyayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde catustriṃśe adhyāye markaṇḍeyavākyaṃ || gātṛvādanasaṃghāto vṛndam ityabhidhīyate || mukhānuvṛtir milanaṃ tālalīlānuvarttanaṃ || (fol. 1v5–7) «Beginning of the commentary: » mukhānuvṛttir iti || asyārthaḥ paṃktikrameṇāvasthite pātrāṇāṃ vāmadakṣiṇakrameṇa parasparaṃ mukhāvalokanaṃ iti mukhānuvṛttiḥ || milanaṃ teṣām eva parasparaṃ sannihitībhūyāvasthānaṃ || tālalīlānuvarttanaṃ gāyana(!)vādakanarttakānāṃ tālānusāreṇa gītavādye nṛtyakaraṇaṃ || mithas truṭitanirvāhaḥ teṣām eva gānavādyanṛtyatālānāṃ madhye yasya truṭir bhavati tasya itaraiḥ pātraiḥ samyag dhāraṇaṃ || (fol. 1v1–4) «End of the root text: » yātrāyāṃ devatīrthāṇāṃ(!) vivāhe priyasaṅgame | nagarāṇām agārāṇāṃ praveśe putrajanmani || brahmaṇoktaṃ prayoktavyaṃ māṅgalyaṃ sarvvakarmasu || caṇḍakādhvanim ākarṇya mahāpāpopapātakaiḥ | kṣaṇād eva vimucyeta satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | vīṇāvādanatattvajñaḥ śrutijātiviśāradaḥ | tālajñaś cā ʼprayāsena mokṣamārgaṃ sa gacchati || || (fol. 7v1–4) «End of the commentary: » atha rāgotpattiprakāram āha || pareti parā avyaktanādasvarūpā nābhideśe kuṇḍala(!)nīśaktau tiṣṭhati tata avyaktanādād eva utpannā kiñcit prakāśarūpā paśyanti vāk hṛdaye suṣumnā(!)m āsṛtya tiṣṭḥati tataopi vyaktāvasthām āpannā madhyamā vāk kaṇḍadeśe tiṣṭhati tata ativyaktāvasthām āpannā vaiṣa(!)rīvāk manuṣyoccāraṇayogyā dantatālvos tiṣṭhati tathā ca varṇānusāreṇaiva nābhideśād eva rāga utpadyata ity abhiprāyaḥ anye śolkāḥ spaṣṭārthaḥ || (fol. 6r1–4) «Colophon: » etāni vākyāni skandapurāṇāntargata sahyakhaṇḍānniṣkāśya likhitāni || śivaṃ || || || (fol. 7v4–5)

«Beginning: » ❖ śrīnṛtyanāthāya namaḥ || 3 || || rāga || tori || nau || śaṃkara bṛṣahāri candramā lilāta(!) vibhūti vasuke jāke gale ruṃdramālā || dhruºº || nīlakaṃ(ṭha) raddha(!) pāsa pārvvati yahi avasara kara triśūla damaru(!) dimi kāhū || kāma vaśana vasa kinnā(!) gau vāhana saṃga liyo a-esā bṛṣadhāri mahādeva suraloka mṛtaloka bhūmaloka me saṃbhu (exp. 2:1–5) «End: » || ❖ rāga || || cavaṃ(!) || manuvā re tum to rāmabhajana mora hiya || rāmabhajana murahya hmāro haribhajana murahiya || bhukhe anna piyāse pāni naṃge vasatra(!) dija mo prāni(!) vayakuṃtha(!) sudhāre (!) jagameṃ jasakara rije || hmāro || jo guruso upadeśavatāyā sohī manamo dhariya | ...(exp. 17t:3–6) «Colophon: »x

Beginning ❖ oṃ vātaroyayā osara, alaṃḍa hā, syeśī kyavu, kuṭa, lāha, soṃḍhena nesaṃ dāya, pāya, hmaṃsa hālvatheṃ kvācakaṃ, vātayā || o || pā osara, (2) halaḍa, aṃbala, behalaḍa, guhragu, ādasa, pvahrohravati, | samabhāga cona kastina vāla ñe maṃsa 6 syākva, pehara mado, vāta ro(3)yasaḥ || o || sovāchalādhvi cona osaraḥ chyā〇yeḥ marica maṃsa 6 piṃpili maṃsa 6 śuṇṭhi maṃsa 6 yumuni maṃsa 6 jiri maṃ(4)sa 6 bihisa maṃsa 6 cyataka maṃsa 6 sovācha〇la maṃsa 3 syaṃdho maṃsa 3 byaḍa maṃsa 3 śajikhāra maṃsa 3 yevasakhāra ma(5)sa 3 hiṃgva maṃsa 2 cona yaṃṅa ñe sovachalādhvi cona thvaḥ || o || (fol. 1v1–5) «Extracts:» mikhāsyākva(3)yā osara apāmārgga hā, so, cā, soḍhe〇sa cola kapāsasa bola thaṃña || mikhāsyākva, khuṭi luvayā (4) pyaṇḍeṭakarāya hā, gorocana, varati〇ni dekaṃ bole || raktacandana, kastina cola thaña || mikhāsa (5) khuṭi luva, syākvayā śuṇṭhi pipili 〇 maraca halaḍa, upala hā, kuṭa rasojana, samabhāga vartini dekaṃ (6) bole || (fol. 8v2–6) End vātapita śilakhena, gūlumayā, ghera khuṃña laṃkhva phaṃ 2 dudu kuhra 2 ghera kuhra 1 pipi(3)lī maraca śuṇṭhi piṃpalā mula, bālā〇ḍa, ajamoda, yu muni, vihusena ñaṃṭhi, hiṃgva, sovāchala, vyaḍa (4) sodhā saṃbharici, paṃgāci śiṃpe, ceta〇ka, ve, yevasakhāra, samabhāga maṃsa 6 dhāre, cona, ghera chala ji(5)raṅāva bokva seye, botaṅāva, thva cona〇na vāle, ña maṃsa 6 || ۞|| manavasya hetārtha okhadhi śarvva(6)sodhāyaḥ samāpada || (fol. 88v2–6) Colophon samvata 520 aśuni śudi 2 coyā śiddhvi || ۞|| iyaṃ pustaka vaidyārtha lokahitārthāya || (fol. 88v6)

Beginning yāgālayaṃ hi viśveśa gṛhāṇa racitaṃ mayā | āsamāptiṃ bhaja vibho kriyāṅgānāñ ca sarvvataḥ | āmantri (!) si de〇veśa kṛto yāgo yathāvidhiṃ (!) taṃma (!) harasva bhagavan sarvvakarmaprapūraṇaṃ | āmantrita jagannātha salakṣmyādigaṇai (!) saha | sānidhyaṅ kuru deveśa pavitrārthaṃ māmā(!)dhvare | samakṣaṃ bhagavatā bhaktyā svaprabhuṃ pūjayāmy ahaṃ || saṃnidhānam ata kāryaṃ madanugrahakāmyayā || iti prārthanā || (fol 108r3–5) End sarvvakāmārthasaṃdohe iha kāsyapi raṃmyatā || nava pañca catasro vā vinā ku(mbha) kva cin matāṃ || astrāmbhasā tataḥ snātvā hutvā mantrañ ca tatmayīṃ || śaktiśatyādimṛtīnāṃ dhyātvā tatvaṃñ ca vinyaset | hṛdā saṃpuṭayogena svamantrena tu vinyaset || sanidhākṛtyaṃ sarodha saṃpūjyas tatra vinyaset | sāntikumbhāmbhasā siñcet pādanyāsam ata smṛtam || prāsādañ ca tatra kuryāt tasya lakṣaṇam ucyate || devaḥ || (fol. 116r4–6) Colophon iti śrījayākṣarasaṃhitāyā ⟪śrī⟫ savidhi samāptaḥ paṇḍitena sodhanīya śubhaḥ || samvat 515 māghaśudi ekādasyā tithau || || (fol. 116r6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || || nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam || devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayam udīrayet || nama[[sta]]smai munīndrāya śrī(2)yutāya tapaśvine || śāntāya vītarāgāya vālmīkāya mahātmane || rāmāya rāmacandrāya rāmabhadrāya bedhase || raghunāthāya [[nāthāya]] sītāyāḥ pataye namaḥ || ja(3)yati raghuvaṃśa tilakaḥ kauśalyā hṛdayanandano rāmaḥ || daśavadananidhanakārī dāśarathiḥ puṃḍarīkākṣaḥ || (fol. 1v1–3) End vṛ(9)ttāṃtasaṃgrahaṃ vāpi paṭhitvā rāmabhaktimān || jāyate muniśārdūla nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || paṭhati yo rāmacaritamet (!) punāti pāpāt sukṛ(10)taṃ labheta || tīrthebhiṣekaṃ samare jayaṃ ca sa sarvayajñasya mahat phalaṃ ca || bhajet (!) yo nityam aciṃtyarūpaṃm ekena bhāvena ca bhūmiputrīm || etat su(11)puṇyaṃ śṛṇuyāt paṭhed vā bhūyo bhaven no jaṭhare jananyā || || || ||(fol. *34v8–11) Colophon ity ārṣe rāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye ‘dbhutottara(1)kāṃḍe saptaviṃśatitamaḥ sargaḥ || || || || rāmo jayate (!) || || samāptoyaṃ adbhutarāmāyaṇaṃ || || śrīrāmakṛṣṇāya namaḥ || || rāmaḥ || (2) śrīśākegniviyadbalāhakamite pakṣe śuceḥ sulkake (!) vāre citraśikhaṇḍijebjajatithā vṛkṣe tathā tasya ca || (3) bhūdevo madhusūdanodbhutam idaṃ rāmāyaṇābhīṣṭadaṃ trailokye prathitaṃ lilekha matimān saṃśodhanīyaṃ budhaiḥ || 1 || || (fol. 34v11–35r3)

(10) samaptaṃ (!) śākeṃduśasisaptabhūḥ māse śrāvaṇakṛṣṇāṣṭamiṣu vāsare saśiputraś ca litaṃ (!) daśarathaśarmmaṇēna || mokāṃ brāhmaṇagrāme śubham || || || (fol. 52r7–10)

«Beginning of the root text:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ jayati raghuvaṃśatilakaḥ kauśalyāhṛdayanaṃdano rāmaḥ (3) daśavadananidhanakārī- dāśarathiḥ puṃḍarīkākṣaḥ 1 pārvatyuvāca atha rāmaḥ (4) kim akarot kauśalyānaṃdavarddhanaḥ hatvā mṛdhe rāvaṇādīn rākṣasān bhīmavikra(5)maḥ 2 (fol. 1v2–5) «Beginning of the commentary:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ 1 mṛdhe yuddhe 2 3 kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa 4 śraddhadhanyāḥ (8) etacchravaṇe śraddhāvatyāḥ kathāmṛtam āsvādya me ma (!) tad āsvādanaviṣayā tṛṣṇā tyaṃ (!) baṃrdharte (!) 5 (fol. 1v1, 8) «End of the root text:» bhaktyā paṭhed yaḥ śṛṇu(4)yāt sa pāpair vimucyate janmagatodbhavaiś ca adhyātmarāmaṃ paṭhataś ca nit(5)yaṃ śrotuś ca bhaktyā likhataś ca rāmaḥ (!) atiprasannaś ca sadāsamīpe sītā(6)sametaḥ śriyam ātanoti 72 (fol. 104v3–6) «End of the commentary:» bhagavaṃtaṃ sarva(7)gataṃ rāmaṃ śrāvayāmīti buddhyā yo vācayati taṃ tatsarvagatvāt śrutvā vācakasyoparitoṣam eti (8) tat paritoṣena ca tasya sarvārthasiddhir iti bhāvaḥ anaṃtapuṇyaṃ vācakaśrotor anaṃtapuṇyada-(fol. 104v1,7–8) «Sub-colophon of the root text:» iti śrīmadadhyātmarāmā(7)yaṇe umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde uttarakāṃḍe aṣṭamaḥ sargaḥ 8 (fol. 94v6–7) «Sub-colophon of the commentary:» iti śrīmatsakalarājavipad uddharaṇasamarthetyādivirudāvalīvirājamānasya himmativa(9)rmaṇaḥ putrasya śrīrāmavarmaṇa (!) kṛtāvadhyātmarāmāyaṇe setā uttarakāṃḍe (!) aṣṭamaḥ sargaḥ 8 (fol. 94v8–9)

Beginning atha te vānarāḥ śūrās tadātyarthaṃ praharṣitā[[ḥ]] | guṇapūrvvābhir āśībhir hanūmaṃtaṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ | yenaudāryeṇa maghavā devā(2)surasamāgame | krāṃtavān yuddhyamānas tu kramatvaṃ tena tejasā yathā viṣṇur mahātejāḥ pṛthiviṃ krāṃtavān purā || trivi(3)kramo mahāsatvas taddhi tejobalaṃ ca te | yathā iṃdro (!) mahābāhur yajñe vividhadakṣiṇe | yogasiddho mahāvīryas tat te bhavatu maṃ(4)galaṃ | (fol. 1v1–4) End abhiṣikte tu kākutsthe dharmeṇa viditātmani | vyatītā sā niśā pūrvā paurāṇāṃ harṣadarśinī | tasyāṃ (7) rajanyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ prātar evāpare hani | vaṃdinaḥ samupātiṣṭhan saumyā nṛpativeśmani | te raktakaṃṭhinaḥ sarve kinnarā (8) iva śikṣitāḥ | tuṣṭuvur nṛpatiṃ vīraṃ yathāvat saṃpraharṣiṇaḥ | vīrasaumya prayudhyasva (!) kauśalyānaṃdavardhana | jagaddhi sa-(fol. 78v6–8) «Sub-colophon:» || ityārṣe rāmāyaṇe uttarakāṃḍe ṣaṭ(6)triṃśaḥ sargaḥ || || (fol. 78v5–6)

Beginning oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya || namas tasmai munīśāya, śrīyutāya tapasvine | sarvvajñānādhivāsāya, vālmīkāya namo namaḥ || tapaḥ svādhyāyanirataṃ, tapasvīvāgvidāṃvaraḥ | nāradaṃ paripapraccha, vālmī(2)kir munisattamaḥ || ko hy asmin prathito loke, sad guṇair gguṇavattaraḥ | dharmmajñaś ca kṛtajñaś ca, satyavākyo dṛḍhavrataḥ || udārācārasaṃpannaḥ, sarvvabhūtarataś ca kaḥ | vīryyavā[[n dhairyyasaṃpannaḥ pā]] ś ca vadānyaśca, kaścā(3)ti priyadarśanaḥ || (fol. 1v1–3) End striyo vṛddhās taruṇyaś ca devān rājan gṛhe gṛhe | abhiyācanta rāmasya, yauvarājyābhiṣecanaṃ | tān āmāyācitaṃ rājña, tvat prasādāt praṣi(5)dhyatāṃ (!) | igagreyaguṇagrāmaṃ prajānām anukampakam | paśyema yuvarājantam abhiṣiktan tavājñayā | sa rājavaryyātmajayātmajam ātmavantaṃ, guṇābhirāmaṃ naralokakāntam | rāmantu devārhasi lokanāthaṃ, yathābhiṣiktaṃ yuvarā(6)jam ūrvyāṃ || || || (fol. 95v4–6) Colophon ity ārṣe rāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye caturvviśatisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ādikāṇḍe rāmapraśaṃsā samāptaṃ (!) || 78 || śrīrāmalakṣmaṇābhyāṃ namaḥ || samvat 782 || || śubha || (7) agrahaṇa śudi dvitīyāṃ śrīmahādevaśarmmaṇaḥ pustakaṃ kenāpi likhitaṃ || || śubham astu || (fol. 95v6–7)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || sūta uvāca || tatah sa lakṣmaṇo rāmaḥ śanaiḥ paṃpāsaras taṭam || āgatya sarasāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayam āyayau || krośamātraṃ suvistīrṇa⟨ṃ⟩(2)m agādhamalaśaṃbaram || utphullāmbujakahlāramukuṃdotpamaṇḍitam (!) || haṃsakāraṇyasaṃkīrṇaṃ cakravākādiśobhitam || jalakukkuṭako yaṣṭhi (!) kroñcanā(3)dopanāditam (!) || (fol. 1v1–3) End gacchaṃtaṃ rāma(1)kāryārthaṃ vāyus tvām anugacchtuḥ (!) || ityāśīr bhis tam āmantrya visṛṣṭaplavagādhipaiḥ || mahendrādriśiro gatvā babhūvādbhutadarśanaḥ || mahānagendra(2)pratimo mahātmā suvarṇavarṇāruṇacā[[ru]]vikrama (!) || mahāphaṇindrābha sudīrghabāhuṃ (!) ⟨tā⟩vātātmajo dṛśyata sarvabhūtaiḥ ❖ (fol. 23v7–24r2) Colophon śrīmadadhyātmarāmāyaṇe umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde kiṣkiṃdhākāṇḍe navamaḥ sargaḥ ❖ kiṣkiṃdhākāṇde pañca(4)śataślokāḥ samāptaḥ ❖ kiṣkiṃdhākāṇḍe sarveṇa ukteṣu purāṇe (!) navamaḥ sargga ḥ pañcaśatāni ślo(5)kāni (!) duritaharā pañcaśat (!) || || śubham || || catur dvisaptaika bhubhe ca śāke kāvyedine mādhava māsayukte || kṛṣṇeṃ(6)tyabhe śaṃbhutithau suyoge likhat bhavānanda sudhir dvijāgraṇī || (7) || baddhamuṣṭiḥ kaṭigrīvā adhodṛṣṭir adhomukhaī || kaṣṭena likhitaṃ śāstraṃ yatnena paripālayet || śubham || (fol. 24r3–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ namaḥ kamaladalavipulanayanābhirāmāya namaḥ || || śrirāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ samastajagatāṃ rāmaṃ vinā kā ga(2)tī (!). rāmeṇa pratihanyate kalimalaṃ rāmāya kāryaṃ namaḥ || rāmāt ttrasyati kālabhīmabhujago rāmaśya sarvaṃ vaśe rāme bhaktir akhaṃḍitā bhavatu (3) me rāmas tvam evāśrayaḥ || 1 || citrakuṭālayaṃ rāmam iṃdirānaṃdamaṃḍiraṃ (!) || vande ca paramānandaṃ bhaktānām abhayapradam || 2 || brahmaviṣṇumaheśā(4)dyā yasyāṃśā lokasādhakāḥ || namāmi devaṃ cidrūpaṃ viśuddhaṃ paramaṃ bhaje || 3 || (fol. 1v1–4) End vācakāya śatasvarṇaniṣkaṃ dadhāt tu dakṣiṇā || aṃgulīyekavaśtrāṇi (!) kuṇḍale rukmanirmite (11) || 26 || ekamāsavidhis tveṣaḥ || kṛtsnaḥ prokto himādṛije || vatsarādiṣu kalpeṣu māse māsetvayaṃ vidhiḥ || 27 || (1) māsapārāyaṇavidhiṃ yaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ (!) soyam īśvarī || tava snehān mayākhyātaḥ sugopyo yaṃ prayatnataḥ || 28 || sarvam iṣṭaṃ labhe(2)d dhīmān kārayitvā yathāvidhiḥ (!) || (fol. 12v10–13r2) Colophon || ityekamāsarāmāyaṇaparāyaṇavidhiḥ sampūrṇaḥ || ❁ || || śubhbham (!) || || (fol. 13r2) iti śrīskandapurāṇe uttarakhaṇḍe rāmāyaṇamahātmye nāradasanatkumārasaṃvāde phalānukirttanaṃ nāma paṃcamodhyāya || 5 || (fol. 11v9–10)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīrāmāya namaḥ || || bāle bālena kalpena kṛtvā saṃ(2)rakṣaṇaṃ kratoḥ || sītā aṃke dhṛntā yena sa rāmaḥ pātu naḥ sadā || 1 || oṃ tapaḥsvādhyāyani(3)rataṃ tapasvī vāgvidāṃ varam || nāradaṃ paripapraccha vālmikir munipuṃgavam || [[2]] ko nvasmin sāṃprataṃ (4) loke guṇavān kaś ca vīryavān || dharmajñaś ca kṛtajñaś ca satyavākyo dṛḍhavrataḥ || 3 || cāritreṇa ca (5) ko yuktaḥ sarvabhūteṣu ko hitaḥ || vidvān kaḥ kaḥ samarthaś ca kaś caiva priyadarśanaḥ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–5) End yaḥ paṭhe(4)d rāmacaritaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || etad ākhyānam āyuṣyaṃ paṭhan rāmāyaṇaṃ naraḥ || 99 || sa putrapau(5)trasagaṇaḥ pretya svarge mahīyate || paṭhan dvijo vā gṛṣabhatvam īyāt syāt kṣatriyo bhūmipatitva(6)m īyāt || vaṇikjanaḥ puṇyaphalatvam īyāj janaś ca śūdro pi mahattvam īyāt || 100 || (fol. 10r3–6) Colophon || hari (7) oṃ ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe (vālmīkiye ādikāvye bālakāṃḍe) saṃkṣepa rāmāyaṇakathanaṃ prathamaḥ sargaḥ samāptaḥ śubhambhūyāt || || || || || || || || || || || || || || || (fol. 10r6–8)

Beginning śrigaṇeśāya namaḥ || tapaḥsvādhyāyanirataṃ tapasvī vāgvidāṃ vara(2)m || nāradaṃ paraipapraccha vālmīkir minipuṅgavam || 1 || ko nva(3)smin sāṃprataṃ loke guṇavān kaś ca vīryavān || dharmajñaś ca kṛtajña(4)ś ca satyavākyo dṛḍhavrataḥ || 2 || cāritreṇa ca ko yuktaḥ sarvabhūtahi(5)te rataḥ || vidvān kaḥ kaḥ samarthaś ca kaś caikapriyadarśanaḥ || 3 || ātmavā(6)n ko jitakrodho dyutimān ko nasūyakaḥ || kasya vibhyati devāś ca jātaroṣasya saṃyuge || 4 || (fol. 1v1–6) End sāhāyyaṃ varayāmāsa mārīcaṃ (4) nāmarākṣasam || vāryamāṇaḥ subahuśo mārīcena sa rāvaṇaḥ || 50 || (5) na virodho balavatā kṣamo rāvaṇa tena te || anādṛtya tu tadvākyaṃ (6) rāvaṇaḥ kālacoditaḥ || 51 || jagāma sahamārīcas tasyāśramapa(7)daṃ tadā || tena māyāvinā dūram avavāhya nṛpātmajau || 52 || jahā- (fol.6v3–7) Colophon

Beginning rāt | nimeṣāntaramātreṇa, śarair agniśiṣopamaiḥ (!) | yamaḥ śakraś ca durddharṣo mahāpārśvamahodarau | mahādraṃṣṭrā mahākāyas tau cobhau śukasāraṇau | te tu rāmeṇa tair vvāṇaiḥ sarvvagā(2)treṣu tāḍitāḥ | (fol. 25r1–2) End tathā ca sītā vinihatya durmmatiḥ prahṛṣṭacetāḥ sa babhūva rāvaṇiḥ | prahṛṣtarūpo tha nirīkṣya vānarā viṣaṇḍarūpān sa(2)mupādravat ripun || vikarṇṇacittā vilīnaṃ varīyaśo balādhikaṃ śatrubalapramarddhanam || vihāya saṃgrāma śirogataṃ tadā, pratasthire vāyusutaṃ tarasvinaṃ || || (fol. 94r1–2) Colophon || ityārṣe rāmāyaṇe laṃkākāṇḍe māyāsītāvadhonāmas sarggaḥ || || 56 || (fol. 94r2)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo rāmāya || || sabale sāgare tīrṇṇe rāme daśarathātmaje | amātyau rāvaṇaḥ śrīmān avravīc chukasāraṇau || samagraṃ sāgaraṃ tīrṇṇaṃ dustaram vānaraṃbalaṃ | abhūtapūrvvo rāmeṇa, setur baddhaś ca sāgare || aśraddheyam idaṃ karmma kṛtaṃ (2) rāmeṇa sāraṇa | sāgare setubandhena saṃkṣubdham iva me manaḥ || avaśyaṃ caiva saṃkhyeyaṃ tanmayā vānaraṃ balaṃ | tataḥ paścād vidhāsyāmi śrutvā tasya pratikriyāṃ | (fol. 1r1–2) End tena muṣṭinipātena rākṣāsasya mahāmṛdhe | cacāra hṛdayaṃ bhinnaṃ sa papāta tato bhuvi | tasmin nipatite bhūmau tatsainyaṃ ca pracikṣubhe | āviveśa mahākrodhaḥ samare rāvaṇeñ ca ha | sa tu jaladharavadvinadya nādaṃ– (exp. 87:10) Colophon ity ārṣe śrīrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye laṃkākāṇḍe komattavadhonāma sarggaḥ || 70 || || laṃkākāṇḍaḥ samāptaḥ || || | śubham astu sarvvajagatāṃ lokānāṃ || || 2 samvat 812 naṣṭabhādrapadaśuklacaturddeśī somavāra thva kuhnu śrīdevaśaṃkaraṇa, laṃkākāṇḍamadhukva, dhunakaḥ cokhyaṃ valānimhadvijavara śrīyadunandana juyātaviyādinajuro || || (exp. 87;8–9)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīvighneśvarāya || śrīrāma rāmacandrāya namaḥ || kūjaṃtaṃ rāmarāmeti madhuraṃ madhurākṣaraṃ || āruhya kavitāśākhāṃ, vande vālmī(2)kikokilaṃ || jayati laghuvaṃśatilakaḥ (!) kauśalyāhṛdayanandano rāmaḥ || daśavadananidhanakālī (!) dāśarathiḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ || namas ta(3)smai munīśāya, suvratāya tapasvine || śāntāya vītarāgāya, tasmai jñānātmane namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–3) End paśyema yuvarājan tam a(4)bhiṣiktan tavājñayā || sa rājavaryyātmajam ātmavantaṃ, guṇābhirāmaṃ naralokakāntaṃ || rāmantu devārhasi lokanāthaṃ, yathābhiṣiktaṃ (5) yuvarājam urvyāṃ || || pā○ || manokūlaṃ kuru lokanāthaṃ-m ihābhiṣiktaṃ yuvarājam ūrvyām || 79 || (fol. 151r3–5) Colophon || || ❁ || || ityārṣe rāmāyaṇe (6) vālmīkīye caturvviṃśatisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ādikāṇḍe rāmapraśaṃsonāma sarggaḥ || śrīādikāṇḍaṃ samāptaṃ || || śubhaṃ || ❁ || (7) || saṃvat 816 jyeṣṭhamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe ṣaṣṭhmyāṃ (!) tithau asmin divase amuṃ pustakaṃ rāmānandaḥ alikhat || || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || (fol. 151r5–7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīrāmacandrāya || kauśalyānayanakumudenduṃ daśarathahṛdayāravindamārttaṇḍaṃ | sītāmānasahaṃsa (!) rāmaṃ rājīvalocanaṃ vande || prāptarājyasya rāmasya, rākṣasānāṃ vadhe kṛte | ājagmur ṛṣayaḥ siddhā rā(2)ghavaṃ pratinandituṃ | aśito[[ṅgirā]]thayavakrītas caityas cyavana eva ca | kando medhātitheḥ putraḥ pūrvvāṃ ye saṃsthitāṃ diśaṃ || svastyātreyotha bhagavān amucovimucas tathā || ājanmus te sahāgastyā yeśritā dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ || (fol. 1r1–2) End evam etad yathāvṛttaṃ, samutthāya samāhitaḥ | śṛṇvan khyātiṃ ca kīrttiṃ ca, dharmmārthau ca samaśnūte | rāmāyaṇaṃ govisargge, madhyāhne vā (3) samāhitaḥ | sandhyāyām aparāhne (!) ca vācayan nāvasīdati || || gavāṃ śataṃ sakanaka śṛṃgiṇāṃ dade, (!) ddine dine ceha phalaṃ samāpnuyāt | (!) tad āpnuyād vigatabhayo vahūśrutaḥ, (!) paṭhetu yo daśa(4)rathaputrasaṃbhavaṃ || (fol. 112r2–4) Colophon ity ārṣe rāmāyeṇe caturviṃśatisāhasrayāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ vālmīkīye śrīmad uttarakāṇḍe śrīrāmasvarggārohaṇaṃ nāma sarggaḥ || uttarakāṇḍaḥ samāptaḥ || || śubhaṃ || ❖ samvat 813 mārggaśila (!) kṛṣṇacaturddaśī somavāra thva kuhnu svanihmavantāgṛhadvijaśrīdevaśaṃkareṇa rāmāyaṇa uttarakāṇda saṃpūrṇṇana cosyaṃ, vaṃlā nihma dvijavaraśrīyadunandanaju yāta viyā dina juro || || (fol. 112r4–6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīrāmacandrāya || jayati raghuvaṃśatilakaḥ kauśalyāhṛdayanandano rāmaḥ | daśavadananidhanakārī dāśarathiḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ || || tau tu dṛṣṭvā mahṭmānau, bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau | sugrīvaḥ paramodvi(2)gnaḥ sarvvair anucaraiḥ saha || cintayābhiparīrātmā, niścitya girilaṃghanaṃ | varāyudhadharau vīrau, sugrīvaḥ plava⟨ga⟩gādhipaḥ | na ca cakre manasthātuṃ, vīkṣyamānau mahābalau || udvignaḥ hṛdayaḥ sarvvā diśaḥ samavalokayan || (fol. 1r1–2) End tatas tatheti pravadantam aṅgadaṃ, praha(8)rṣayuktāt pravadat mahābalāḥ | sa cānvito jñati balena satvaro, jagāma taṃ gṛdhraniveditaṃ giriṃ || atha pavanasamāna gamanavikramāḥ, (!) plavagabalāḥ paripūrṇamānasāḥ | tvarita madbhi mukhādi saṃya(9)yus te, kṛtamatayaḥ pitṛrājarakṣitāṃ || (fol. 66v7–9) Colophon ityārṣe śrīrāmāyaṇe kiskindhākaṇḍe sītānveṣaṇe sampatipakṣodyamonāma sarggaḥ || 64 || || kiskindhākāṇḍe khaṇḍaṃ samāptaṃ || ❖ saṃ 812 śrāvaṇakṛṣṇacaturddaśī somavāra, śrīdevaśaṃkareṇa coya dhuṃkā || (fol. 66v9)

Beginning of the commentary text yas tu yukto buddhyā samarthaś ca san paraṃ svāmisaṃdiṣṭād adhikaṃ nṛpate(!)priyaṃ na kuryāt kiṃ tu kiṃ diṣṭam eva kuryāt taṃ madhyamam āhu++ (2)tes tu +++ kāryaṃ (3) na kuryāt nṛpateḥ priyaṃ bhṛtyo +++ samartho pi tam āher(!) madhyamaṃ naram iti pāṭhe yaḥ samartho pi bhṛtyaḥ paraṃ kāryaṃ na kuryāt na bhṛtyaḥ uktam ā+++ṇāt (fol. 2r1–3) Beginning of the root text yo niyuktaḥ paraṃ kāryaṃ na kuryān nṛpate priyaṃ | bhṛtyo yuktaḥ samarthaś ca tam āhur madhyamaṃ naraṃ || 8 || niyukto nṛpateḥ (6) kāryaṃ na kuryād yaḥ samāhitaḥ | bhṛtyo yukta sa(martha)ś ca tam āhuḥ puruṣādhamaṃ 9 (fol. 2r5–6) End of the root text kuṭuṃbavṛddhiṃ dhanadhānyavṛddhiṃ striyaś ca mukhyā sukham uttamaṃ ca śrutvā śubhaṃ kāvyam idaṃ mahārthaṃ prāpnoti sa(4)rvāṃ bhuvi cārthasiddhiṃ 121 āyuṣyam ārogyakaraṃ yaśasyaṃ saubhrātṛkaṃ buddhikaraṃ śubhaṃ ca śrotavyam etan ni(5)yamena sadbhir ākhyānam ojaskaram ṛddhikāmaiḥ 122 (fol. 312v3–5) End of the commentary text atra phalastutiślokā katakavyākhyāne nopalabhyante | (!) bhaktyā rāmasya ye cemāṃ saṃhitāṃ ṛṣiṇā kṛtāṃ [[ye li]]khaṃtīha<ref> ac: ṛṣi khaṃtīha </ref> ca narās teṣāṃ vāsas triviṣṭape 120 (fol. 312r14) <references/> Colophon hari oṃ ity ārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye yuddhakāṃḍe caturviṃśatisahasrikāyāṃ (!) saṃhitāyāṃ sarvajanaparivṛtasya rājādhirājasya śrīrāmabhadrasya padābhiṣeka bhadrākhyānaṃ nāma triṃ[[śad adhi]]kaśata[[ta]]maḥ sargaḥ 130 || ❁ || kataka○ 121 hari oṃ iti śrīgomatī[[tī]]ranaimiṣāraṇya (... ...) saṃhitāyāṃ śrīmad yuddhakāṇḍe paṃcaviṃśe hnivartamānakathāprasaṃgaḥ samāptaḥ (fol. 312v7–13) iti śrīrāmabhirāme śrīrāmīye rāmāyaṇatilake yuddhakāṃḍe triṃśadadhikaśatatamaḥ sargaḥ 130 kataka 121 nirma(2)laṃ kattakakṣodād api rāmāyaṇārṇavaṃ atyantanirmalaṃ cakre rāmativāsasā (!) 1 bhaṭṭanāgeśapūjyena setuḥ śrīrāmaśarmaṇā kṛta (!) (14) sarvopakṛtaye śrīmadrāmāyaṇāmbudhau 2 yuddhe hato daśagrīvaḥ sagarvo vītakalmaṣaḥ paśyan rāmātmakaṃ viśvaṃ svayaṃ rāmo babhūva ha3 (fol. 112:1–2, 14)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || rāmāya namaḥ || || gacchatā mātulakulaṃ bharatena tadānaghaḥ | śatrughno nitya śatru(2)ghno nītaḥ prītipuraskṛtaḥ || mātulenāśvapatinā putrasnehena lālitaḥ | tatrāpi nivasaṃ tau tau tarppamāṇau (3) ca kāmataḥ | bhrātarau smaratāṃ vīrau vṛddhaṃ daśarathaṃ nṛpaṃ | rājāpi tau mahātejā sasmāra proṣitau sutau | ubhau (4) bharata śatrughnau maheṃdravaruṇopamau | sarva eva tu tasyeṣṭāś catvāraḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ | (fol. 1v1–4) End ukṣiṣṭaṃ (!) vā pramattaṃ vā tāpasaṃ dharmacāriṇaṃ || adaṃtyasmin mahāraṇye tān nivāraya rāghava (3) || eṣa paṃthā maharṣīṇāṃ phalānyāharatāṃ vane || anena tu vanaṃ durgaṃ gaṃtuṃ rāghava te kṣamaṃ || itī(4)va taiḥ prāṃjalibhis tapasvibhir dvijaiḥ kṛta svastyayanaḥ paraṃtapa | vanaṃ sabhāryaḥ pravi(5)veśa rāghavaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ sūrya ivābhramaṃḍalaṃ || ||(fol. 232v2–5) Colophon ityārṣe rāmāyaṇe vālmīki(6)nā viracite ayodhyākāṇḍe ekonaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamaḥ sarggaḥ || || saṃvat 17(7)(83) samaya kārttika saptamyāṃ śukravāsare liṣitaṃ gorṣāgrāme narabhūpāla sāha rā(8)jye bhojyamāne śubhaṃ || 2 || rāmakṛṣṇagovindasahāya || || || || || || || (fol. 232v5–8)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śivāya || namas tasyai jaganmātre kumbhyoni prayāśriye | namaskṛya śivān devīṃ sarvvabhāgavatāṃ śubhāṃ || purāṇaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yathoktam ṛṣibhiḥ purā || ṛṣaya ucū(!) || bhagavaṃs tvaṃ samastasya dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasya tattvavit | purāṇārthaṃ vayaṃ sarvve āgatā bhāvabhāvināḥ || kathyatāṃ yatra ghorārthā bhūtāḥ sāṃpratadānavāḥ | bhaviṣyāś(!) ca vināśiṣye devī devanamaskṛtā || (fol. 1v1–3) End devyaḥ saṃpūjayitvā tu vidhinā nṛpasattamā | ṣaḍ ā≪va≫varttaṃ prakurvvaṃti pratyakṣā bhavate śivā || sadācāraḥ śubhācāraḥ sarvvasaṅgavivarjitaḥ || vācayan śatam arddhaṃ vā pratyakṣaṃ prāpnuyāc chivaṃ || etac cābhyudayaṃ pādaṃ śatais tribhir navottaraiḥ || sahasrair dvādaśair vatsa kathitaṃ sarvvasiddhidaṃ || || (fol. 229r9–11) Colophon ity ādye devyavatāre devīpurāṇaṃ samāptaṃ || śubhaḥ || saṃ 805 kāvaṭa samvat 805 kārttikavadi ‥(thva)kuhnu śrīśrīsumatijayajitāmitramalladevaśanabhāgi nāma pradhānāṅgayā balaśadevipurāna(!)(coca)kādina juro || thva devipunāna(!)mahāyatnanadayakā anaharāyāyamate ca yatnapūrvvakananidānayāyamāla || || (fol. 229r11–229v2)

«Beginning» ❖ namaḥ sarvajñāya || sārvaṃ praṇamya sarvajñaṃ durggagupta sya sūnunā | saṃhitā siddhasāreyaṃ raviguptena vakṣyate || āyu[r]vedo dadhin (!) tattum(!) aśaktā ya(!) ʼ⁅lpamedhasā⁆ teṣām iyam prabodhāya vihitā tantranau(!) dṛḍḥā || brahmā provāca yat svargge devam āyurnibandhanam | śiṣyebhyaḥ kathayāmasa kāśirājo [ʼpi] tatkramāt || tasya tv aṅgāni śālākṣaṃ(!) kāyabhūtacikitsite(!) | śalyāgadavayo bālarakṣābījavivarddhanam | śrīpuruṣo vyādhyadhiṣṭḥānam mahābhūtaguṇātmakam || (fol. 1v1–4) «End» caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ prasthaṃ prasthavatvā /// kāsaṃ pātrañ ca saṃproktaṃ tulā ca satam ucyate | mānam evamvidhan dṛṣṭaṃ su(!)ṣkadravyeṣu paṇḍitaiḥ | dravadravyeṣu cādreṣu dviguṇam tat ⌠prakīrtitam |⌡ /// ⁅ā⁆ nā desābhidhānandād dra(!)ṣkaro dravyanirṇṇayam | tathāpi dhārṣṭam uddhūya mayeyan dik pradarsiteti || ❁ || (fol. 76r4–6) «Colophon» siddhasārasaṃhi /// (fol. 76r6)

Beginning smṛtā pi taruṇā tapaṃ karuṇayā haraṃtī nṛṇām abhaṃgura tanutviṣāṃ balayitā śanair vidyutāṃ || kaliṃdagirinaṃdinītaṭasuradrumālaṃvinī madīyamaticumbinī bhavatu kāpi kādambinī || 1 || śrīmaj jñāneṃdra bhikṣor adhigatanikhilabramhavidyāprapaṃcaḥ kāṇādir ākṣayādīr api gahanagiror yo maheṃdrād avedīt | devādevādhyagīṣṭa smaraharanagare śāsanaṃ jaiminīyaṃ śeṣāṃka prāptaśeṣām alabhaṇitir abhūt sarvavidyādharo yaḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) Sub-colophon iti rasagaṃgādhare pratyanīkam || (fol. 334r6) End padyāṃtarvarttitvena padyabarhivarttitvena tāva[d] dvaividhyaṃ tatrādyasyābhinnavākyodgīrṇatvabhinnavākyodgīrṇatvābhyāṃ punar dvaividhyaṃ, padyāṃtarvartti padyabahir varttinor dvayor apy uttarayoḥ sakṛc chabdaśrutiparyāptvena śabdāvṛttiparyāptatvenānekeṣāṃ praśnānām ekapadativeditottaratvena prakārāṃtaraiś ca bahuprabhedatvaṃ | diṅ gātreṇodā kiṃ kurvate daridrāḥ kā sāravatī dharāmanojñatarā. ko pāvanas trilokyāṃ || (fol. 359r3–7)

Beginning || smṛtāpi taruṇātapaṃ karuṇayā haraṃtīnṛṇāṃ abhaṃguratanutviṣāṃ valayitāśanair vidyutām || kalindagiri naṃdinī taṭasuradrumālaṃvinī madīyamaticumvinī bhavatu kāpi kādamvinī || 1 || śrīmaj jñānendrabhikṣor adhigata nikhila bramhavidyāprapaṃcaḥ kāṇādir ākṣapādī apigahanagiro yo maheṃdrād avedīt || devādevādhyagīṣṭa smaraharanagare śāsanaṃ jaiminīyaṃ śeṣāṃkaprāptaśeṣāmalabhaṇitir abhūt sarvavidyādharo yaḥ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End mukhacaṃdra ity ādau mukhaniṣedham aṃtareṇa caṃdratvaṃ durāropam ity asyāpi suvacatvāt | tatrāpi mukhaniṣedhāpagame jitam apahnutyā || atha mukhaṃcaṃdra iti rūpake mukhatvasāmānādhiakaraṇyena candratādrūpyasyā ropyamāṇatayā na mukhaniṣedhāpakṣēti cet || prakṛtepi tarhi tādṛśa sādharaṇa–(fol. 132r4–6) Colophon || iti rasagaṃgādhare paṃḍitarājajagannāthabhaṭtanirmite ullekha prakaraṇaṃ || (fol. 129v3–4)

Beginning || śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ || ṣmṛtāpi taruṇā tapan kuruṇayā haraṃtī nṛṇām abhaṃguratanutviṣāṃ valayitāśatair vighnatāṃ | kaliṃdagirinaṃdiṇitaṭa suradramālaṃvinī madīyamaticuṃviṇī bhavatu kāpi kādaṃvinī 1 śrīmaj jñānendrabhikṣor adhigata nikhila bramhavidyāprapaṃcaḥ kāṇādīr ākṣapādīr api gahanagiro yo mahendrād avedīt || devādevādhyagīṣṭa smaraharanagare śāsanaṃ jaiminīyaṃ śeṣāṃ[[ka prāptaśeṣā]]mala bhaṇitir abhūt sarvavidyādharo yaḥ 2 (fol. 1v1–3) End maivaṃ ukttapadyasya virodhodāharaṇatāmātre tātparyāta (!) vyaṃgyatvepi tathā vasyā nayā yāta cāpyavirodhodāharaṇatāyātvapir atarbhāvyaḥ kecit tu virodhāt tasya vyaṃgyatvepi virodhidvayasya vācyatāmātreṇa virodhābhāsasya vācyālaṃkāra vyapadeśopapattaḥ (!) | ittham eva cāṃśātarasya vyaṃgyatvepekāśam (!) ādāya samāsonmādīnām api vācyālaṃkāravyapadeśa ity āhuḥ yathā vā kṛṣṇapakṣādhikaruciḥ sadāsaṃpūrṇamaṃḍalaḥ bhūyo yaṃ niḥkalaṃkān mā modate vasudhātale atra–(fol. 49v7–9) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || natvā gaṃgādharaṃmarma prakāśaṃ tanute laghu | rasagaṃgādharamaṇer atigūḍhārthasaṃvidaṃ || 1 || yācakānāṃ kalpataror arikacche hurāśanāt nāgeśaḥ śṛṃgavereśa rāamato labdhajīvikaḥ || 2 || prāripsitaprativaṃdhakaduritaśamanāya śṛṃgārā laṃvanādi vibhāvanayā tad devatātvena ca sa⟪vi⟫mucita sveṣṭadevatāvastunirdeśanarūpaṃ maṃgalam ācaran śiṣyaśikṣāyai vyākhyātṛśrotṛṇām anuṣaṃgato mamgalāya canibadhanāti | smṛtāpīti (fol.1v1–3) End haṃta ityāścarye pādānakiraṇātadhit saṃti dhartum icchaṃti dhāki ca śukravātmakāḥ yaiḥ saṃbhinne miśrite taruputrāgraniṣṭabalacaṃcavala | himakaṇeyārāḍimā vījasya buddhista caṃccāś cācalpagrahaṇārthavyāpāram aṃvati kurvatīty arthaḥ atra bhrāṃtimān alaṃkāraḥ tad vyaṃgyamāhatretiḥ (!) nvapinā ʼtiraścā uditam iti tādṛśālaṃkāreṇālaṃkārasya vyarthatyādiḥ tad avadhoti–(!) (fol. 35v7–9)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || gajamukha sanamukha hotahī vighnavimukha hoya jāta || jyau paga parata payāgamaga pāpapahāra hari naśāt || 1 || vānījuke varana juga suvarana kana paripāna || sukavi sumukha kuraṣaita pari sumeru samāna || 2 || kavitva || satva satva guna koki satya hī ki sattā śubha sidhi ki pratiddhiki subuddhivṛddhimāniye|| jñāna hī ki garimā ki mahimā viveka hī ki darasana hī ko darasana ura ānie || puṇyako prakāśa vedvidyāko vilāsa kidho jasako nivāsa kesaudāsa jagajānīe || (fol. 1r1–5) End pahirāī manohara hārahī ye saṣI gāta sugaṃdha samūhasa sacyo || harṣāī sirā kara darpanu lai kapapaṃkaja rujyo bahubhātinako || saṣi pāna ṣavāvatahī kehi kā ravako pupiyā paranāri racyo hrāsa vilāsa nivāsa jyoke sava kelividhāna dunī mai de vara jeṭha pita suta soi rahai suṣa hī maha vāsa sanī jai || – (fol. 38v24–28)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || lakṣmīm ālokya lubhyan nigamam upahasan śocayan yajñajaṃtūn [[kṣa]]traṃ śoṇākṣi paśyan sami(2)ti daśamukhaṃ vīkṣya romāṃca maṃcan || hṛtvā haiyaṃgavīnaṃ cakitam apasaran mlecha (!) raktair digaṃtān siṃcaṃ daṃtena bhū(3)miṃ tilam iva tulayan pātu vaḥ pītavāsāḥ || 1 || bhāratyāḥ śāstrakāṃtāra śrotāyāḥ śāṃtikariṇī || kriyate bhā(4)nunā bhūrirasā rasataraṃgiṇī || 2 || vāṇī kamalinī bhānor eṣā rasataraṃgiṇī || haṃsā kṛtadhiyaḥs (!) tatra (5) yuktam atra pratīyatāṃ || 3 ||(fol. 1v1–5) End vidvad vāridharāḥ snehaṃ tathā varṣaṃtu saṃtatam labhate vipu(3)lāṃ vṛddhi (!) yathā rasataraṅgiṇīḥ avagāhasva vāgdevi divyāṃ rasataraṅgiṇīṃ asmat padyena padmena racaya śrutibhūṣaṇaṃ 2 yād bhānoḥ sutā kāpi kaliṃdī bhu(4)vi vartate tāvat tiṣthatu me bhānor eṣa rasataraṅgiṇī 3 || || || (fol. 29v2–4) Colophon iti śrīkavikalāsanātha śrīgaṇanāthatanayamaithila śrībhānudattaviracitāyāṃ rasataraṃgiṇyāṃ prakīrṇa(6)kaṃ nāmāṣṭamas taraṃgaḥ || ||(fol. 29v5–6) eṣā rasataraṃgiṇyāḥ maha(10)t kaṣṭena lekhitā |(!) tripāṭhy uttamarāmasya suta jyeṣṭhena dhīmatā || || nagābdhi vasucaṃdrāṃke durmatyākhya (!) ca vatsere | syā(11)t tape cāsite pakṣe rudratīthyaṃduvāsare || || samāptoyaṃ graṃthaḥ || || śubham astu || || kalyāṇam astu || || rāma || ||(12) traºº(!) vallabharāmeṇa likhitaṃ svātmapathanārthaṃ paropakārārthaṃ saṃvat 1847 śake 1712 phālguṇakṛṣṇa10 caṃdre (fol. 29v9–12)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṃ devyai namaḥ || || lakṣmīm ālokya lubhyan nigamam upahasan śoca(2)yan yajñajaṃtūn kṣatraṃ śoṇākṣi paśyan samiti daśamukhaṃ vīkṣya romāṃca maṃcan || hṛtvā haiyaṃ(3)ga vīnaṃ cakitam apasaran mlecha (!) raktair digaṃtān siṃcan daṃtena bhūmiṃ tilam iva tulayan pātu māṃ pī(4)tavāsāḥ || 1 || bhāratyāḥ śāstrakāṃtāra śrāṃtāyāḥ śaityakāriṇī || kriyate bhanunā bhurirasā (5) rasataraṃgiṇī || 2 || (fol.1v1–5) … hetoḥ prūvavartitvaniyamād ataḥ prūvam eva tasyopanyāsaḥ samucitaḥ (9) rasasya hetavo bhāvādayas tena rasebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ bhavādaya eva nirūpyaṃte || (fol. 1v8–9) End vidvadvāridharāḥ snehaṃ tathā varṣaṃtu saṃtataṃ || labhate vipulāṃ vṛddhiṃ yathā (13) rasataraṃgiṇī || 1 || avagāhasva vāgdevi divyāṃ rasataraṃgīṇīṃ || asmat padyena padmena racayan śru(1)tibhūṣaṇaṃ || 2 || yāvad bhāno kṛtā kāpi kaliṃdī bhuvivartate || tāvat tiṣtatu (!) me bhānor eṣā ra(2)sataraṃgiṇī || 3 || || ❁ || || (fol. 28v12–29r2) Colophon iti śrīkalāsabhānāthagaṇanāthatanaya maithila śrībhanudatta(3)vircitā rasataraṃgiṇī samāptā || || ❁ || || saṃvat 1857 śāke 1722 pravarttamāne phālgunamā(4)se śuklapakṣe tithau trayodaśyaṃ 13 guruvāsare tāpitīra nivāsinā dayārāmātmajena joītā rāmeṇa likhitā rasataraṅgiṇī svapanārthaṃ vā paropakārārtham iti || || ❁ || || adṛṣtabhāvāt (6) matibharmādveti || śrīdevīcaraṇakamaler ʼpitā śubhadāmas tu ʼnityaṃ || || 6 || || śrīr astu (7)|| || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || ❁ || || ❁ ||(fol. 29r2–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha bhāṣārasataraṃgiṇī likhyate || || gurugaṇapatigirijāgiriśa gaṃgāgirā gopāla || vighnaharo siyarāma e mokauṃ(2) hou dayāla || 1 || śrīgurukavi śukadevako pāva pāi parasāda || varaṇata śaṃbhūnātha rasa jinamai sakala savāda || 2 || atha bhāva lakṣaṇam || hota pra(3)thamai hetu hai bhāva rasanako hetu || yāte pahile rasana te bhāvana hauṃ kahidetu || 3 || rasānukūla vikārako bhāva kahata matimāna || aura bhāṃtin hvai vo(4) ju hai so vikāra jiya jāna || 4 || (fol. 1v1–4) End yāme vrīḍā vyabhicāri mukhyatā raudrarasa gauna hai || dohā || rasavasusasidharavarasa me(5) pāi kavinako paṃtha || phāgunavadi ekādaśi pūraṇa kīno graṃtha || 445 || śrīgurukavi suṣadevake caraṇacāri phaladāni || mere hiya viha(6)rata rahata karata rahata kavitāni || 446 || (fol. 27v4–6) Colophon || iti śrīmiśraśaṃbhunāthaviracito bhāṣārasataraṃgaḥ samāptim agamat || || svasti śrīrājakumāraraṇabahādurasenājñāsaṃpādanakṣama vīrabhadrāṃtarvāṇir likhitavān rasataraṃgaṃ bhāṣā ghaṭitam || || || (fol. 27v6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ || || lakṣmīm ālokya lubhyan nigamam upahasan śocayan yajñajaṃtūn kṣātraṃ śoṇākṣipaśyan sam iti daśa(2)mukhaṃ vīkṣya romāṃcaṃ aṃcan || hṛtvā haiyyaṃgavīnaṃ cakitam apasaran mlecharaktair (!) digaṃtān siṃcan daṃtena bhūmiṃ tilam iva tulaya(3)n pātu māṃ pītavāsāḥ (!) || 1 || bhāratyāḥ śāstrakāṃtāra śrāṃtāyāḥ śāṃtikariṇī || kriyate bhānunā bhūrirasā rasataraṃgiṇī 2 (4) vāṇī kamalinī bhānor eṣā rasataraṃgiṇī || haṃsāḥ kṛtadhiyas tatra yuktam atra pratīyatāṃ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–3) End sa(5)ptāṃbhonidhitīrahīrapaṭalālaṃkāriṇīṃ mediṇīṃ dātuṃ viprakulāya yojitavataḥ saṃkalpavākyodyamaṃ | nābhīnīra(6)ruhāt saroruhabhuvā tatkālamāviḥ (!) kṛte hastāṃbhoruhir bhārgavasya kim api vrīḍāsmitaṃ pātu vaḥ || 61 || atrādbhuta (7) ratibhāvasya mukhyatā dānavīraraso gauṇaḥ | vidvadvaridharāḥ snehaṃ tathā varṣaṃtu saṃtataṃ labhate vipulāṃ vṛddhiṃ yathā (8) rasataraṃgiṇī || 62 || yāvad bhānoḥ kṛtākāpi kālindī bhuvi naṃdate | tāvat tiṣṭhatu me bhānor eṣā rasataraṃgiṇī || 63 || (fol. 38v4–8) Colophon iti śrīsakalakavikalāsanāthagaṇapatitanayabhānudattaviracitāyāṃ rasataraṃgiṇyām aṣṭamas taraṃgaḥ || 8 || śubham astu ❁ || || (2) samvat 1861 śāke || || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 29r1–2)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || paraspara tapaḥ saṃpat phalāyita parasparau | prapañca mātāpitarau prāñcau jāyāpatīstumaḥ || alaṅkāreṣu bālānām ava[[gā]]hana siddhaye lalitaḥ kriyate teṣāṃ lakṣalakṣaṇasaṃgrahaḥ || yeṣāṃ caṃdrāloke dṛśyaṃte lakṣalakṣaṇaślokaḥ | prāyasta eva teṣām itareṣāṃ tvabhinavā likhyaṃte || upamā yatra śādṛśya lakṣmīr ullasati dvayoḥ || haṃsīvakṛṣṇate kīrttiḥ svargaṃgām avagāhate || (fol. 1r1–5) End evam atra śloke eva caturṇṇām api saṅkarāṇāṃ yathāyogyaṃ saṅkaraḥ | evam anyatrāpy ū[[dā]]ha[[ra]]nīyāni(!) || || amuṃ kuvalayānandam akarod apya dīkṣitaḥ | niyogādḍhya kaṭayater virupādhikṛpānidheḥ || candrāloko vijayatāṃ śaradāgamasaṃbhramaḥ | hṛdyaḥ kuvalayānando yat pradād(!) abhūd ayam || (fol. 115v3–6) Colophon || iti śrīmad advaitavidyācārya śrībharadvājakulajalanidhikaustubha śrīraṅkarājādhvavidravaradasūnor apayyadīkṣitasya kṛtiḥ kuvalayānandaḥ sampūrṇṇaḥ || || samvat 814 vaiśākhamāse śuklapakṣe paṃcamyāṃ tithau śrībramhadevaḥ svapaṭhanārthaṃ kuvalayāndam alakāraṃ svahastena likhitavān || śubham astu || || (fol. 115v6–9)

Beginning /// || amarī kavarībhari bhramarī mukharīkṛtam || dūrī karotu duritaṃ gaurīcaraṇa paṃkajam || 1 || paraspara tapaḥ saṃpat pha(lār)pita parasparau || prapaṃca mātāpitarau prāñcau jāyāpatīstumaḥ || 2 || udghāṭya yogakalayā hṛdayābja kośaṃ dhanyaiś cirād apiyathā rucigṛhyamāṇaḥ || yaḥ prasphuratyavirataṃ paripūrṇarupaḥ śreyaḥ sa me diśatu śāśvatikaṃ mukundaḥ || 3 ||(fol. 1v1–4) End na hy eteṣāṃ parasparam anyatrāṃgatvam asti || udāttādi mātrasyaiva hetvalaṃkārādi cārutāpādakatvenātiśayoktti saṃkarasyāṃgatayānapekṣaṇāt || evam atra śloke caturṇām api saṃkarāṇāṃ yathāyogaṃ saṃkaraḥ || evam anyatrāpi udāharaṇāntarāṇi ūhyāni || || amuṃ kuvalayānandam akarod appa dīkṣitaḥ || niyogād veṅkaṭapater nirupādhikṛpānidheḥ || 1 || candrāloko vijayate śāradāgamasaṃbhavaḥ || hṛdyaḥ kuvalayānando yat prasādād abhūd ayam || 2 ||(fol. 76r10–76v4) Colophon ity apyadīkṣitasyakṛtiḥ kuvalayānandas saṃpūrṇaḥ || (!) || śubham astutarām || ||(fol. 76v4)

Beginning || || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || adhisarayūvaṭinī taṭam adhisāke tāṃ gaṇam api tad ughānaṃ || khelannālakalevra bālo me mānase sadā bhūyāt || 1 || anekaiḥ sleśair yan na paricitam adyāpi gahanaṃ parīhāsas tasmin mama bhavati yatnasya tad api || yaśodā kauśalyā tanayapadakṣāvāhitamanaḥ prastādaḥ(!) klsleśānāṃ phalati phalanyatyutkaṭam api || 2 || (!) sūnor dinakarasyaiṣā gāgābhaṭtamanīṣiṇaḥ candrālokasya vivṛtau kṛtir astu satāṃ mude|| 3 || (fol. 1v1–4) End jayaṃtīti jayadevasyaiva yūyūṣavarṣa iti mamāṃtare || mahādeva iti pūvavat (!) stuvaṃ nyanye graṃthakathanapi ca midaṃ tvayipare mahārājastuṣyed artahm api manuṣye dayiparaṃ paraṃ †cinyudrāyā vidhanasamapyena ca hrascamaṇo (!) maniṣyed atha janakajāyā parivṛdaḥ ||† (fol. 116r4–8) Colophon iti mīmāṃsaka bhata dinakara sūni viśvaiśvarāparanāmaka gāgābhaṭta kṛtaṃ caṃdrāvalokaṭīkāyāṃ sudhākhyāyā daśamomayūkhaḥ || śubham astu ||(!) (fol.116r8–-9)
