Beginning ❖ atha mahāniśāyāṃ mahānavamīpārvvaṇya khaḍgabhogapūjāṃ kārayet || hṅathukohnu yākonaṃ, strotratvaṃ || chāgavali dako (2) paśuyāga yāya || || the dhunaṅāva eṭākhaṃḍakuṭhisa, mahiṣavali || mahiṣavali || sakaleṅa dhunaṅāva, āgamasa chā(3)gavali yāya || || sakalabhiṃ nityakarmma yāya || || || pethuyā nitya lāne mamāla thvakuhnu pāṭha yāyasa (4) || || pāṭha yāya || || thvanali dvāphalasvāna akṣata joṅāva, kuhmaramāyā chesa, kuhmara bharaḍitoṃ saka(5)ra soravane || mūla mantraṇa japarapāva chucake, jimanehmaṃ 12 || bharāḍa nehmaṃ 2 bharaḍi 10 || || (fol. 28r1–5) iti śrīugracaṇḍāsiddhilakṣmīdevyā daśamīkha(8)ḍgajātrārccaṇavidhiḥ samāptā || || śrībhavānyā prasādāt || || End smaya tarppaṇa 3 hṅathvayā thyaṃ, gvāla ā()cāryyato prasādalape || || āgamasa duhaṃbijyāṅāva jopāva kvahā bijyāya || || thvate dhunaṅāva galaṃḍasa salaṃ laṃ so()ye || rāsā lāvago thānasa duṃte || || Colophon iti bhagavati ugracaṇḍādevyā mahādaśamīkhaḍgayātrā samāptā || || (exp. b7) ❖ yinakona metaṃ biya dhari phalakevo te sakalabhiṃ || khaṇḍache ⟪ma⟫piye madhu tole || khaṃḍache piye dhunaṅāva svāna kokāya || () sakalesa khaṇḍa pibiya || sayiṅavā sānakā vaṃkuli tale yaṃṅāva thāyasa khāsyaṃ tāthe || khaṃḍa dāko vaṃthu yaṃṅāva boye () hī vannakāva || pāṭha yāṅā puthi dāko pāyāva vaṃkulisa khāsyaṃ te yaṃne || thaṇḍila siṃdharape pāṭasaṃ muṅā()va kāya salimyālasa thāṅa kāya || kalaśa laṃkha sakaleṅa kalimyāsa thaṃṅāva kāyāva te || || thaṇdiliyā svānatvaṃ devasake kāyāva svāna svāṃ lohoṃphātasa vāya || || siṃdhra lāyalape || vādhāva dā(6)yake || kalaśa laṃkha thaṇdi siṃdhra tyaṃcho svāna kokāyāva svāna tara vane, thaṃjana jukosake || || ācāryyasyaṃ thāku(7)rasaske dhugoyā goya te || ācāryastaṃ upadohanī biye || || yinako kuṃbhārccana yāya kalaṃkāntaṃ || || (fol. 41v5–7)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīśrīmahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || śrīśrīśrīmahābhairavāya nama(2)ḥ || || yajamāna puṣpabhājana || oṃ adyādi || vākya || yajamānasya mānavagotra śrīśrījaya bhūpa(3)tīndramallavarmmaṇaḥ tolana pratiṣṭhā śrīśrīśrī ākāśamahābhairava prītyarthaṃ paṃcopacā(4)ra pūjā kartuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāmi || || śrī saṃmvarttā maṇḍalānte kramapadanihitā nandaśa(5)ktiḥ subhimā sṛṣṭaṃmyāya catuskaṃ akula kulagataṃ paṃcakaṃ cānya ṣaṭkaṃ | catvāraḥ pañcakonyaṃ punara(6)pi caturaṃ tatvato maṇḍalena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ yena tasmai namata guruvaraṃ bhairavaṃ śrīkujeśa || || (fol.1v1-6)) End svāna taya || kvākāśa kvasamīraṇa kvadahanaḥ kvāpaḥ kvavi(3)śvambharāḥ kvabrahmā kvajanārddanaḥ kvabujagaḥ kvendraḥ kvadevāsurāḥ kalpāntālabhaṭī (4) nata pramuditaḥ śrīsiddhiyogeśvaraḥ krīḍā nāṭakanāyako vijayate devo mahābhai(5)ravaḥ || || svāna mālakosta biya || || astra mantrana vali thvaya || vali visarjjana (6) yāya || || nosiya || vali bhokaruya || sākṣi thāya || || (fol.63v2-6) Colophon iti śrīśrīśrī mahābhairava (7) pūjāparddhati samāpataḥ || || (fol.63v6-7)

«Beginning» ❖ brāhmaṇa ācāryya josi thvatesanaṃ sthira hārāva vayāva || maṇḍapana pi uttara soya, ma(2)jirasā purvva soyaṃ teva || gajuli chākuhnuyā thva verasa yāya || thvana hṅāonli dina(3)patiṃ rajasārā karmmārccana yāya dhunaṅāva yāya || sāthacana purvvase madhyasa cha(4)pāta tayāva || purvvādikramana jimane pātana ṅuyake || yoginīvijaya || || (fol. 1v1-4) «End» bali choya vi(4)dhi || dathubheraju || pūrvvādikramena pūjā yāṅā kramana thava 2 thāyasa bali choya(5) || togaṇa || cārākhu || jujumā || nāśvara || nivata || hanumaṃta || rājakalaṃka || bhaga(6)vati || cāśvara || nāśvarayā bachalā || tuparaju || vidyāpīṭha || vaṭuka dumāju || go(7)rajā dhvākhā yināya || dvaṃdu dako dukhāpikhā || thvate sāṭhacayana pūrvvasa yogi(8)nīvijaya pāṭha pūjā samāptaṃ || || śubha || e || (fol. 32r3-8) «Colophon»

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīśrīmahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || śrīśrīśrīmahābhairavāya (2) namaḥ || || yajamāna puṣpabhājana || adyādi || vākya || śrīsaṃvarttā || brahmānī || śyāmāraktā || (3) utphulāṃ || uddaṇḍāsuramuṇḍa khaṇḍanakareḥ kādyālispūrṇṇāritā, brahmā muṇḍadharottamoḍa maru(4)dhaḥ khaṭvāṃgadāṇḍo hṛtāḥ | brahmānī varamātṛkābhiḥ sakalaiḥ pādārccanīyo vibhūḥ kṣoṇī(5)bhṛtkuharāntaraṃ vijayate devo mahābhairavaḥ || || siddhirastu kriyātyādi || || (fol.1r1-5) End aiṁ 5 ambe pūrvvagataṃ padaṃ bhagavatī, caitanya rūpātmikā, jñānecchā vahulā tathā ha(2)rīharau brahmā marīcī trayaṃ | bhāsvabhairava paṃcakaṃ tadunu ca śrīyoginī pañcakaṃ, candrārkko ca (3) marīci ṣaṭkamamalaṃ māṃ pātu nitya kujā || || yajamāna ādina mārakostā svāna biya || || vā(4)cana laṃkha kayāva taya || mohanī taya || laṃkhana hāya || ūkāraṃ vāyu vijetyādi || ceta || śrī(5)khaṇḍa || sidhara || vireśvarī mahātyā || mohanī || trailokyamohanītyādi || svāna taya || kvākvāsa || svā(6)na mālakostā biya || || astramantrana vali thvaya || nośiya || vali bhokaruya || || sākṣi thāya (7) || || (fol.39r1-7) Colophon iti śrīśrīśrīmahābhairavapūjāparddhati samāptaḥ || || śubhaṃvantu sarvvadā || || (fol.39r7)

«Beginning» vighna praśamanaṃ, sarvvaśāntikaraṃ śubhaṃ | āyuputrañ ca kāmaṃ ca (2) lakṣmīsantativarddhanaṃ || yathāvānatyādi || || suryyārgha || a(3)dyādi || vākya || varṇṇāntaṃ vījamuddhṛtya, tasyāpariśivaṃ nyaset (4) || ādi madhyāvaśāne tu, agnitrayavibhūṣitaṃ || varmmaṇādīpi(5)taṃ kṛtvā, sāvitryācaiva murddharet | (fol. 2r1-5) «End» gogrāsādi, yavodaka(5)visarjjana yāya || hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || || ṣoḍaśamātṛkāśa ta(6)yā siṃdhra, svāna kāya || muṅāva īśāna konasa choya || || (1) sākṣī thāya || || bali thava thava thāyasa choya || || (fol. 19r4-v1) «Colophon» iti yavodakavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || śubham astu || || (fol. 19v2)

Beginning dhavasuhṛṅgoṣṭhipramādāḥ sahā || || diṣṭhe varṣatu medyā jala api ca nṛṇāṃ saṃtu ratnādināryā rājā nepālayaṃtu pratihitavasudhā brahmadyā samastaṃ | devakucagrahādyā tu jaganiśivarāḥ saṃtu suprītamānyaṃ ga‥sātyadhanāyuḥ sutasujanasuhatastrīkuṭambā ʼstu bhadraṃ jihvādhoṣātpavanavalanāt śleṣmano vuṃduyānāt lekhau śuddhaṃ likhanapatitaṃ śuptayadyakṣārastu | mātrāhībhaṃ yadhi kudhathitaṃyathaānavinaṣṭam etat sarvaṃ tad api ca mayā stotram etat kṣamadhvaṃ || || (exp. 2: 1–5) End yadi doṣo [ʼ]sti yajñebhya ācāryyasya viśeṣataḥ | mantramudrāvihīnena sāstrapa(!)thanadoṣataḥ || mātrākṣarāhīhīnatvād avaṣi ca viśeṣataḥ | śūci līlādibhaṃgaṃ naḥ yajanapāṭhakarmasu || devaśāstrādy aśuddhena kriyāhīnena dehināṃ | kṣaṃtu arhasi tatsarvvaṃ urvvaṃtu śivamaṃgalaṃ || santaḥ satvaniraṃtaraṃ sukṛtināṃ vidhvaṃ sapāpodayā rājānaḥ paripālayaṃtu vasudhā darmmasthitā sarvadā | kāle saṃtattivarṣito jalamucaḥ saṃtu prajāṃ puṇyadām āhaṃtāṃ ghanavṛdhivāṃ (exp. 72b3–7) «Sub-Colophon» iti lakṣahomavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || || ❁ || || ❖ samvat 810 caitra śuklapaṃcamīaṃgāravāla || thvahnusaṃpūrṇayā ṅditajuro || likhitakarmmācārrya || nānā || || || śubham astu sarvvadā kālaṃ || || (exp. 67b9–15)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāyai namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || atha karmmavalilikhyate || || yajamānapuṣpabhājanayājake || adyādi || vākya || jayamānasvamānavagotre śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramallavarmmaṇa śrī 3 sveṣṭadevatāprītyarthaṃ pākhāna(!)nirmite prāsāsoparisuvarṇakalaśadvajāvalohanasidhāgnikādyāhutiyajñavarṣavarddhanakarmmavarlyārccana pūjānimityarthaṃ ‥‥‥ | janaṃ samarppayāmi || (fol. 1v1–6) End namaḥ kujeśanāthāya namo namaḥ || || dakṣiṇācchāya || || mohaniko kāyāt skacchāya || || tvānakokā‥ || ekāśakatyādi || ambapūrvvatyādi || śrīśrījujuyatāsvānataya || || vaiṣṇavivīṣṇumāyāca daityadurggāntanāsinī || harī tsmām evarṇāṅgī garuḍoparisaṃsthitāṃ || śaṃkhacakragaruḍahastā caturvvāhuvibhūṣitāḥ | ratnajvālāmahākrīḍānānāratnavibhūkhitāṃ | harīpuṣpaṃ ca gaṃdhañ ca sadāharitadhāritāṃ | svarggamatya(!) ca pātālasthitirūpeṇa saṃsthitāḥ || (fol. 98r5–98v) Colophon iti karmmavali || valithāyathāyacchāya || śubha || || ❁ || || (fol. 98v3–4)

Beginning munijanaiḥ sevitaṃ sarvvabhāvais tailā‥ pūjanīyaṃ sakalabhayabharaṃ kumbhamūrtiṃ namāmi || ❁ || || tato pātra‥ ‥ || ādhāraśaktayetyādi || 8 || dhyāna(!) || śāktārasanibhādevī sindūra‥ṇavigra‥ | aṣṭādaśabhujākīrṇṇaṃ śa‥‥‥rabhūṣitā(!) || kṣīrodamathanodbhūtaṃ ‥ṣṭisthitikā‥‥ devadevyāsūraṃ‥‥ ripubhaktā‥bhaṃ śī‥ ‥ (exp. 2: 1–6) End hrīṁ śrīṁ indrādilokapālebhyo 2 || ityādi 10 || || śaṃkhasthāpana(!) || raṁ agnimaṇḍalāya 2 || maṃcīsa(!) || ❁ sūryamaṇḍalāya 2 || śaṃkhasa || vavaruṇāya 2 || saṃsā‥maṇḍalāya 2 || || laṃkhathaṃ namantra(!) || gaṇge ca jamune caiva godāvarī sarasvatī | narmade sindu (exp. 12b1–5) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || vimṛśyātharvaṇaṃ vedaṃ kaumārīṃ saṃhitāṃ tathā || vālāmanovidhir samyak buddhirājena tanyate || 1 || athavā śākalya latā uddhāro yathā prayogapārijājākhye ātharvaṇe || maheśvara uvāca || turīyām ardharātre ca kuryāt saṃdhyāṃ vidhanavit || vinārkamaṃḍalaṃ devīṁ dhyānam anyat puroktavat || 1 || (fol. 1v1–6) End oṁ namo brahmaṇe 3 oṁ śāṃtiḥ 3 evaṃ niśāṃte pratyahaṃ caturvāraṃ paṭhet sarvaiśvaryaṃ bhavati || sarvavedāṃtaphalam aśnuta iti || vāṃchākalpalatās tu na homo na ca tarpaṇaṃ smaraṇād eva vidyāyā yad i[c]chati tathāpnuyāt || āvarttanatraye lakṣmīṃ paṃcavṛttau jagadvaśe || daśāvṛttau śivādīnāṃ devānāṃ śaktivān bhavet || śatāvṛtā nirdhano [ʼ]pi sārvabhauma bhaven naraḥ || nārthavādo [ʼ]tharvaṇaḥ syād vasiṣṭavacanaṃ yathā || tyātharvaṇe maṃtrārṇave saubhāgyakāṃḍe vāṃchākalatalopasthānaṃ aṃp (fol. 8r3–8v1) Colophon ity ātharvaṇe maṃtrārṇave saubhāgyakāṃḍe vāṃchākalpalatopasthānaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śrīmattripurasuṃdaryārpaṇam astu śrīr astu || (fol. 8v1–3)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha vāpi(!) kūpapraṇālikā pratisthālikṣate || tatrāpi pūjayet vāstu vibme bhāskarabhājite || īśasvāgnimṛgāś caiva pitṛrogam anudditiḥ || īśādīśāntakīleṣu sārddhadvipadanāyakā || (exp. 3b1–8) End oṁ ambe ambike || dhūpa dīpaphalanaivedy(!) || oṁ manojyutiḥ pratiṣṭḥā || jayastotraṃ || oṁ nāgapāśāmako nityaṃ jalarājo mahābalaiḥ | nimagnaś caiva vikhyāto nāgarājāyate namaḥ || yathākāryasthaṇḍilārccanavidhe tatsarvvaparipūrṇṇam astu || || || tato ratyādi || svasvamantreṇā pūjayet || || tato arthapadāsādhanaṃ || || ghṛtāhuti ghṛtāhuti pūrṇṇā‥lāhuti saṃ‥huti yathākarmma daivadatasāmṛttikāsnānavijaṃ nyāsa daśamarkka thirahāre || (exp. 14t16–14b12) Colophon

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || || atha varṣavarddhanadhvajāvalohana(!) likhyate || || mālakkavasaye || || kaṇḍasacatusama ādina vātralāvasidhalanaśrīcakracāṣa(!) || || yajamānapūṣpabhājana || adyādi || vākya | mānavagotrayajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevavarmmaṇaḥ śrīśrīśrīsveṣṭadevatāprītikāmanayā pāṣāṇanirmmita vā(!) prī prasādasuvarṇakalaśadhvajāvalohanasiddhāgni ayutāhutiyajñavarṣavarddhananimittyarthaṃ kartuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarpayāmi || || (fol. 1v1–2r1) End bhasmatilakakāya(!) || khphre(!) sakaladulitāriṣṭakleśadalanisvatatnrakavacāya huṁ || || arghapātrodakena kuṇḍatritrāmyate || 3 || ādho mukhaṃ kṛtvā || oṃ hrāṁ gaccha gaccha suraśreṣṭha ātmā saṃsāvavāhana(!) | yatra brahmālayo devā tatra gaccha hutāsana || || brahmāsiddhaya(!) || oṁ kṛtāya karmaṇe svāhā || oṁ akṛtāya karmmaṇe svāhā || || rekābrīhi(!) || lekāghṛtadoya || oṁ hrāṁ rāṁ rīṁ rūṁ agnaye svāhā 3 || || śiroveṣṭanakākāya || tāmburadāpa(!) || nyāsalikāya || valivisarjjanayāya || || kalasayā vācanayālaṃkhana abhikheka(!) || candranasiṃdūrasagvanasvānaviya || || sākṣithyāya || || valithavathavayhāya sachāya || || (fol. 142v2–143r4) Colophon iti vāpiprāsādapratiṣṭhāvarṣavardhanasiddhāgniyajñavidhi(!) samāpta(!) || śubham || || (fol. 143r4–5)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || śrī 3 vārāhīdevyai namaḥ || || atha mahādīpaprajvālitavidhir llikhyate || || yajamāṇapuṣpabhājana(!) || adyādi || vākya || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramallavarmmaṇaḥ śrīśrīśrīvārādevyai prītyarthaṃ mahādīpaprajvālitaviśvayātrāpañcopacāradevārccananimityartheṇa(!) kartuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāmi || || (fol. 1v1–5) End svānataya || vārāhī ghorarakṣāṅgī raktakeśī mahodarī | daṃṣṭrākarālagabhīrā bālārkkatejarocani || kapālamālīkā mālī vicitrapuṣpaśobhitā | mahāmahiṣam ārūḍhā jvalitāgnisamaprabhā || mīnāṅkuśakarttikādyā hātrābharaṇabhūṣitā | trinetrājvalitā dehā duṣṭadaityavināśanī || jayantī kṣatrasaṃsthānā nimbavṛkṣasamāśritā | nāgapīṭhasthitā nityaṃ kālarūpī namo [ʼ]stu te || || svānamālakkvastāviya || || astra mantra nvalithvaya || || valiṃ dīpaṃ visarjjanayāya || || devayā atra saṃvalivisarjjanayāya || || nośiya || valibhokaruya || || sākṣithāya || || (fol. 53r6–53v5) Colophon iti śrīśrīśrīvārāhīpūjāmahādīpaprajvālitaparddha(!)ti samāptaḥ || || śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevasamadayakājuro || śubhaṃ bhavatu sarvvadā || || (fol. 53v5–6)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāyai namaḥ || śrīgurupādukābhyāṃ namaḥ || śrī 3 puṇḍarīkāyai namaḥ || || atha kumārīpūjāvidhiḥ | || yajamānapuṣpabhājanayācake || ādyādi || vākya || jajamāṇasya mānavagotre śrī 3 jayabhūpatīndramallavarmmaṇaḥ śrī 3 vārāhīdevyājīrṇṇoddāraprāsādoparicurikāsthāandevārccanapūjākartuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāmi || || (fol. 1v1–4) End mohanīkokāya || || devasakecchāya || svānakokāyāva || || koṭolasataya || thamaṃcchaya || sva ātmaśīrvvāda || amve pūrvvatyādi || yajamāna ādinamālakāstāsvānaviya || vācanalakhakā yāvataya || mohanīntaya || || laṃkhanahāya || ukālaṃ || veta || śrīkhaṇḍa || siṃdhara || vīreśvarī || mohanī || trailokyamohanī || svānataya || vārāhīghorakākṣītyādi || svānamālakāstāviya || || astramantrana valivisarjjanayāya || nośiya || valibhokaruya || || sākṣithāya || || (fol. 18v7–19r3) Colophon iti śrī 3 vārāhāpiṭhipūjāpaddhati samāptaḥ || || ❁ || śubhaḥ || (fol. 19r3)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrigurupādukebhyo namaḥ || śrī 3 kubjikāsiddhilakṣmīmūrtivacchalādevyai namaḥ || || nośiye || tritatvana || khhaṁ hāṁ ātmatatvāya svāhā || khhaṁ hrīṁ vidyātatvāya svāhā || khhaṁ hrūṁ śīvatatvāya svāhā || || gurūnamaskāra || khhaṁ aiṁ 5 akhaṇḍamaṇḍalākāram ity ādi || gurur brhmā gurur viṣṇu[r] guru deva maheśvara || guru[r] deva jagatsarvvaṃ tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || paramagurubhyo namaḥ || parameṣṭhīgurubhyo namaḥ || paramācāryyagurubhyo namaḥ || padmāsanāya pādukāṃ kurmāsanāya pāḍukāṃ || (fol. 1r1–2r4) End sva ātmaśirvvāda || ambe purvvāda || amba pūrvvagataṃ tyādi || vā‥naṃ laṃ khayāyāvataya || māhanīyatāva || || jajamāṇa ādi namārakāstāṃ svātaviya || || laṃkhanahāya || ukāraṃ || || śrīkhaṇḍa || sindhura || vireśvarī || tai(!)lokyamohanī || svānatavya || cāmuṇḍā caṇḍikā(!)tyādi || namaste deva devesi || || astu mantravalivisarjjanayāya || || no siya || valihākabhākarupa || sākṣithāya || || (fol. 99v1–100v1) Colophon iti śrī 3 varcchalādevī pūjā samāptaḥ || || śubham astu sarvvadā || (fol. 100v1–2)

«Beginning: » ❖ aiṁ śrījayavacchaleśvarī devyāyai nama || aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ ▒ ▒ || akathyama śrutaṃ tathyaṃ vāṅmanātītagocaraṃ | taṃ tattvaṃ yena saṃprāptaṃ tasmai śrīgurave nama || gurunamaskāraṃ || yaṁ 10 sokhanaṃ || raṃ 12 dahanaṃ || laṃ 5 dehāvayaṃ || vaṃ 16 amṛtabījena pūranaṃ || haṃ śṛṣṭibīje udbhavaṃ || kṣaṃ ākāśabījenyamayaṃ || iti bhutaśuddhi divyādehaṃ || 5 aiṁ hrīṁ ādhārakamlāsnāya nama || aiṃ hrīṁ kla astrāya phaṭ 4 || karasodhanaṃ || (exp. 17t1–5) «End: » kaṭyākāraṃ kṛtas tatra atha ṣoḍasabhi dalaṃ | teṣvardha ca vipatrañ ca madhyabhāge tu kārayet || teṣvardha ghaṭarūpaṃ ca tasyordhva aṣṭadalaṃ kṛtaṃ | karṇṇikā ca catur dikṣu jamaṃ vānajuga kṛtaṃ || tasyordhvapīṭharī madhye ṣaṭakonaṃ cātrikoṇakaṃ | vindunādasamāyuktaṃ vacchalejantram uttamaṃ || karttavyaṃ sumuhū(r)tte ca śiva āgneya sthāpayet || ma(t)syamāṃsāsavaṃ bhaktaṃ pakvānnaṃ phalapāyasaṃ || puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ pūjite sarvakāmadaṃ || (exp. 21b9–22t5) «Colophon:» iti samayadikṣā || adhivāsanavidhiḥ samāptaḥ || || (exp. 11t4–5) iti śrīpaścimajyeṣṭhājyeṣṭha āmnāya kujikābhaṭtārikāya samayadikṣāvidhi samāpta || (exp. 14b9–15t1) iti umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde vāmakeśvare vacchalāpaddhatiḥ || ❁ || (exp. 22t5–6) khaḍgasthāpanakriyā samāptaḥ || śubha || ❁ ❁ (exp. 26t8) iti navātrapūjāviddhiḥ samāptaḥ || ❁ ❁ (exp. 31b4)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || || ghaṇṭāpratiṣṭhākalaśārccanavidhiḥ || || vidhitheḍakalatāmālakovasa‥ || || yajamānapuṣpabhājanaṃ || adyādi || vāvya || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramallavarmmaṇa śrīśrīśrīvatsalādevīprītyarthaṃ ghaṇṭānivedana‥‥‥ kalaśārccaṇapūjākartuṃ puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāṃi || || (fol. 1v1–3) End ukāraṃ vā yuvījaṇtyādu || || ceta || śrīkhaṇḍetyādi || || siṃdūra || vīreśvarītyādi || || mohanī || traikokyamohanīsyāṃ(!)tyādi || || || svāravi‥ || sūryyapūtro māhāvāho chāyāhṛdayanandana | turaṅgaṃ kuru me śāntir yathdevo namo [ʼ]stu te || || ‥‥ || ārati || pratiṣṭhā || pūrṇṇacandra(!) || || śāntithāya || || śrīśrīśrīvaccharādevyaughaṃṭhākalaśārcaṇapaddhati samāptaḥ || || (fol. 36r3–7) Colophon

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ || śrīśrīvarcchalādevyai namaḥ || || ghaṇṭhāpratiṣṭhāpañcopacāravidhi || mālakojiyake || || yajamānapūṣpabhājanaṃ || || adyādi || vā‥ || mānavagotrayajamānasya śrīśrījayabhūpanīndramallavarmmaṇa śrīśrīśrījayavarcchalādevīprītyarthaṃ ghaṃṭhānivedana‥‥‥ paṃcopacāladevārccaṇapūjānimityā‥na puṣpabhājanaṃ samarppayāmi || || (fol. 1v1–4) End yajamāna ādina svānaviya || || vācanalaṃkhakāyāvataye || mohanītaya || || || laṃkhanahāya || ūkāraṃ vāyu tyādi || || ceta ||śrīkhaṇḍetyādi || || siṃdhara(!) || vīreśvararītādi || || moha‥ || trailokyamohanītyādi || || snānaviya || aiṁkārāsanatyādi || || mālakostāṃ svānaviya || || astramantreṇa valivisarjjanayāya || nośiya || || valibhokaluṣa || || sākṣithāya || || (fol. 25v2–5) Colophon iti śrīśrīśrīcarcchalādevīpūjāpaddhatisamāptaḥ || śubha⟨ḥ⟩ ||(fol. 25v5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīvanadurgāyai namaḥ || maṃgalaṃ diśatu me vināyako maṃgalaṃ diśatu me sarasvatī || maṃgalaṃ diśatu me maheśvaro maṃgalaṃ diśatu me maheśvari || 1 || sahanāvavatu || sahanau bhunaktu || sahavīryaṃ karavāvahai tejasvināvadhītam astu mā vidvadvṣāvahai || oṁ śāṃtiḥ || 3 || asya śrīvanadurgāmahāvidyāmaṃtrādisakalasūktarājamahāmaṃtrasya || araṇyakirātarūpadhara īśvara ṛṣih || atyanuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ || (fol. 1v1–6) End oṁ poliºº oṁ pili piliºº || om valiºº || oṁ bali baliºº || oṁ haraº || oṁ hara haraºº || oṁ gaṃdharvāya || oṁ ga[ṃ]dharvādhipatayeºº || oṃ yakṣāyaºº || oṁ yakṣādhipatayeºº || oṁ rakṣāyaºº || oṁ rakṣādhipatayeºº || oṁ bhūḥ svāhā || oṁ bhuvaḥ svāhā oṁ svaḥ svāhāºº || oṁ bhūr bhuva svāhā || oṁ ulkāmukhīºº || oṁ rudrajaṭīºº || oṁ rudramukhīºº || oṁ brahmaviṣṇutejaseºº || (fol. 9v1–5) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīguruve namaḥ || || atha siddhāgniko(!) ty āhutiyajñavarṣavarddhanadeśavalividhiḥ || || tritatvatvena ācamya || hrāṁ ātmatatvāya svāhā hrīṁ vidyātatvāya svāhā || hrūṁ sivatatvāya svāhā || || adyādi || vācya(!) || sūryyārghaṃ || varṇāntaṃ bījam uddṛtya tasyopari śivaṃ nyaset || ādimadhyāvasāneṣu agnitrayabhūṣitaṃ || (!) marmmaṇā dīpitaṃ kṛtvā sāvitryā varabhūṣite || eṣa kūṭavarah śreṣṭo mahāmārttaṇḍabhairavaḥ || arghaṃ namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) End amba pūrvvagataṃ padaṃ bhagavatī caitanyarūpātmikā jñānecchābakurā tathā halihalau brahmāmarīcitrakaṃ bhāsvabhairavapaṃkaja tadanu ca śrīyoginīpaṃcakaṃ candrārkkāvamarīciṣaṭkam amalaṃ pātu nityaṃ śrīkujā || || ‥‥‥‥ṅāvavalivisarjanayāya || || daśaṅuyakaṃ valiholake vājanasurddhā || || (fol. 73v8–74r4) Colophon iti varṣavarddhanadeśavalividhi(!) samāptaḥ || || śubha(!) (fol. 74r4)

Beginning ṇḍalaparāyai pādukāṃ || caturagrapūrvvaṃ || śrīvidyātatvagurumaṇḍalaparāparayai pādukāṃ || dakṣiṇe || śrī ātmatatvagurumaṇḍalā aparāyai pādukāṃ || paścime || śrī ājñākuśumāyai pādukāṃ || uttare || śrījayāyai pādukāṃ || āgnaye || śrīvijayāyai pādukāṃ || naiṭtye || śrī ajitāyai pādukāṃ || vāyuvya(!) || (exp. 2: 1–4) End evaṃ rupaṃ navātmānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ gurumaṇḍalaṃ | dhyāyed yas tu prajñakāmākṣipraḥ siddhiṃ tu mānavā || sandhyadhyānavi(!) cintayet || ja▒ ā ▒ madhyarāja‥‥ mahāpūjāgurūmaṇḍalaśrīkubjikāya pādukāṃ || trikkaṇamadhya(!) || ▒ ai mahā‥‥gurumaṇḍālaśrīsavyāyai pādukāṃ || trikoṇadakṣa || uparameṣṭhigurumaṇḍālaśrīdevyāyai pādukāṃ || trikkeṇa vāme || sū i parama‥ ramaṇḍālaśrīgyānyayai pādukābhi trikkatāgre || glaṃ aguramaṇdalaśrī ājñāyai pādukāṁ || parāpare || śrīśivatatvaguruma (exp. 8b3–8) Colophon

Beginning ruvṣṇugurudevamaheśvara || gurudevajagansarvva tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || aiṁ 5 paramagurubhyo namaḥ || aiṁ 5 parameṣṭhīgurubhyo namaḥ || aiṁ 5 paramācāryyagurubhyo namaḥ || valisapadmāsanāya pādukāṃ || tha vaka kūrmmāsanāya pādukāṃ || pāśva akṣata vikaraṇaṃ || (exp. 2r1–3) End mārkkaṇḍeyāvipatu bhavatānugrahāyāṃ cakre yasya pracurṇikaraṇā brahmaṇī brahmakalyā | daityācchedapramuditaśirastotragarbhāpragarbbhā soyaṃ devyā bhavatu bhvatā śrīyase caṇḍikāyāṃ || || yā devī madhukaiṭabhapramathinī yā caṇḍamaṇ(!)ḍārddinī yām ādyā mahiṣā surakṣayakarī yā raktabījāmrayā | yā sā śuṃbhaniśuṃbha (exp. 58v6–9) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṁ namo nāṭyeśvarāya⟨ḥ⟩ || prathame pañcopahā(!)reṇa nāṭeśvarapūjayet || āṣāḍhe goyabhuṃ(!)dhārake vidhāna || valiviye || nyāsādikrmeṇa vidhithe pūjā || kodāripūjana || mantra || hraṁ astrāye phaṭ mahākodārine nama || vali || dhūpe || dīpa || jāpastotra || (exp. 3t1–9) End vyāghraṃ carmmākaṭisthaṃ navalasalayabhṛn naumi nṛtyasya soresa(!) || krodhādhvastamanāṃbhanānukaripūrvvāmāṃgaśaktiṃ prabhuṃ śṛṣṭhilakṣakasaṃphalaṃ jagaditaṃ helavasānimitaṃ | dhyānaśaktinimilarocanavibhujotānito siddhidaṃ kāleśvaranāyako vijayate nṛtyaśvaśaṃkalaḥ || kāleśvaśaṃkalaḥ || (!) dhyānāśaktinimilarocanavibhu jogānito siddhidaṃ kāleśvaranāyako vijayate nṛtyaśvaśaśaṃkalaḥ || (exp. 60t19–b6) Colophon sambat 813 māghaśūddhi tathvakuhnu || śrīśrīsumatijayajitāmitramalladevasanadayakājurāṃ || śubham astu sarvvadā || (exp. 60b7–9)

Beginning aiṁ 5 huṃ piṇḍagranthimeḍhrasthāne pādukāṃ || ccaparayā co || aiṁ 5 hddhaṁ brahmagranthibrahmasthāne pādukāṃ || ca saṃvola || aiṁ 5 ‥ sūryagranthinābhimadhye pādukāṃ || tyaphavadatthā || aiṁ 5 htthaṃ somagranthihṛdaye pādukāṃ || ngṛḍasa(!) || aiṁ 5 haiṁ prāṇagranthi udare pādukāṃ || pyaṃtasa || (exp. 2: 1–5) End aiṁ 5 śavakānanda asthimadhyapādukāṃ || kosamoḍāsa || aiṁ 5 ṣaśvetānandamarjjinī pādukāṃ || seladugaṃḍiko sadu || aiṁ 5 sabhūṃgoṇḍaklepādukāṃ || śukranaṭikāvune || aiṁ 5 halāṅulīśaprāṇādhvāle pādukāṃ|| nugvatrasane || (exp. 11: 4–7) Colophon

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ caṇḍikāyai nama || navarātrakohnuyānityakarmmanidhūnake || sakale bhiṃ dhunake 5 ṅā || || || nahyāsana devaghuriyāya || vaṃ kulīsadeakokāsyaṃ he || ugracaṇḍāhvavahvava || ugracaṇḍīliva śiva || (exp. 3b1–8) End śrīśrījayatrailokyamalladevaśrīśrījapatribhuvanamalladevabhṛbhūpasya vijayrājye likhitaṃ navarātravidhānena mahānavamīśāstra(!) likhyate guru upādhyāya mūlanāyaka vipraśrī ullāsarājadevasya śikhyakhārani‥‥ ḍāla kothunaniyā brahmapuricchayā śrīharṣadevayānaṃ rājasapāṭhayāyayānaṃ yocakaṃ dayakājuroṃ || || (exp. 21b2–7) Colophon svasti śreyo ʼstu samvat 390 āśvini māsyaśuklapakṣe caturthyān tithau anurodhanakṣatre aubhāgyayoge yathākaraṇamūhurtta aṃgāravāsare tularāśi gate davitari viccharāśi gate caṃdramasi || likhiti saṃpūrṇam idaṃ saṃphatrividyāpīḥa karmmācāya goviṃdasiṃhena || śrīdurggāprīrtir astu || || ❖ paṃcahastāvidyā || oṁ hrīṁ asi (exp. 21b7–22t5)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || || tato nitykarmmavidhi || laṃkhanahāyakevovoyavali arthapātravāya || cetasvānataya || || nosiye || ātmatatvāya svāhā || vidyātatvāya svāhā || śivatatvāya svāhā || || sūryyārtha || oṃ adya asmat nityakarmmapūjānimityarthaṃ śrīsūryyāya arthaṃ namaḥ puṣpaṃ namaḥ || || (3t1–5) End ātmatatvāya svāhā || vidyātatvāya svāhā || śivatatvāya svāhā || sūryārghaṃ || oṁ adya asmat nityakarmmapūjānimityarthaṃ śrīsūryyāya arghaṃ namaḥ puṣpaṃ namaḥ || || gurunamaskāra || maṇḍaladayakasvānataya || ketaṃne || śrīgurubhyo namaḥ 3 || svānaṃ thamacchaya || || nyāsa cetasāya || hrīṁ astrāya nama 4 || hrīṁ aṅguṣṭhābhyāṁ namaḥ || hrīṁ tarjjanībhyāṃ namaḥ || hrīṁ madhyamābhyāṁ namaḥ || (exp. 37b2–8) Colophon

Beginning navarātrayā paripāṭi || vaṃkulitale sa atharvvavedibrāhmaṇavā ācāryyavānahyāsyaṃ naṃ ugracaṇḍādeguriyāya || sūryyārgha ādina visarjanaṭāṃ || kahḍga ācātranaone || bhagavati atharvvavedibrāhmaṇanarjane || kvataṃ hayā || bhaṇḍārakhārasasnānayā cake || || navarātrakuṭhisadutaṃ haya || (exp. 3b1–5) End oṁ namokuti || pratiṣṭhā || japa || ṣaḍaṅgvdapāṭha || saptasanīpāṭha || thvate nāyakhārachesapūjāvidhi || || saṃvat 759 phālguṇakṛṣṇasaptamīmūlaśukre likhitaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ rājopāya vipraśrīmahādevarājena || || śubham astu sarvvadā kālaṃ || śrīdurgāyai || navarātrasvanekuhnuyāta || sesādayekethvate || tuse || mvāca || tavasa || kahnevala || dhāre || kusyālatu || māmalase || nalihyāla || āpa || Colophon

Beginning ṇḍaddinīya/// jāpahā || yā śumbhaniśumbha/// dakṣīṇabhūje caṇḍā‥‥‥‥‥|| 11 || aiṁ u‥ṇāṃ bhujaka | rṇṇe koparigatā śrīsiddhilakṣmī parā || lar[ire sphaṭikendukandra/// ṣēṣayāpahā || (exp. 2: 1–5) End ❖ aiṁ mārkkaṇḍeyo vipaduṣahatāhugrahārecakre yasendracūrṇṇakaraṇo brahmatī brahmakalpaṃ || daityāccheditasurreṇa totragarbhaprabhāvā || so yaṃ devyā bhavatu bhavatāśrasya caṇḍikāyā || 10 || || ❖ aiṁ yā devī madhukaitabhapramathanī yā caṇḍamu (fol. 27b4–27b7 Colophon

Beginning ///vanaṇaṃ śayaḥ || iti śrībhai/// trailokyamohanaṃ nāsatu/// atha yajñopavītadhāraṇaṃ/// tyāḥ śrīmanmahāmaṃgala/// hya ṛṣiḥ gāyatrīccha /// karaṃ | mahāmaṃgaladaṃ nityaṃ/// hemādrisadṛśākāraṃ | nadvā/// | vimuṃcan sagataṃ ghoraṃ mukhā/// śṛgālavadanaṃ aṃjanādrikṣayakaraṃ trinetraṃ ccharadakukaṃ (exp. 2: 1–3t5) End bhurjapi likhyaguṭhikā svarṇasthāṃ dhāraed yadi | puruṣo dakṣiṇe vāhau yoṣid vāmabhuje tathā | sarvvasiddhīśvaro bhūtvā vicaret bhairavo yathā | tadgātraṃ prāpya śastrāṇi brahmāstrādīni bhairavi | mālyāni kusumāny eva bhavanti sukhadāni ca | yasya gehe ciraṃ lakṣmi vāṇīvaktre vased dhruvaṃ | idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā kālikā bhajate [ʼ]dhamaḥ (exp. 56t5–b5) Colophon

Beginning oṁ namaḥ paramātmane || prāgdehasto yadāsaṃ tava caraṇayugaṃ nāśrito nārccito bhaṃ tenādyā kīrttivarggir jaṭhrajadahanair vādhyamāno varīṣaiḥ sthitvā janmāṃtaraṃ no punar iha bhavitā kāśrayaḥ kvāpi sevā kṣaṃtavyo me[ʼ]parādhaḥ prakaṭitavadane kāmarūpe karāle || 1 || vālpe bālābhilāṣair jaḍitajaḍamatir bālalīlāpraśakto na tvāṃ jānāṃi mātaḥ kalikaluṣaharāṃ bhogamaokṣaikadātrīṃ nācāro naiva pūjā na ca yajanakathā na smṛtir nāpi sevā kṣaṃtavyo me [ʼ]rādhaḥ prakaṭitavadane kāmarūpe karāle || 2 || (fol. 1v1–8) End ye tāvat kākavīśo bhavati dhanapatir jñānaśīlodayātmā niṣpāpī niṣkalaṃkaḥ kulapathi kuśalaḥ satyavāgdhārmikaś ca nityānamdo dayāvaraḥ paśugaṇavimukhaḥ satpathācāraśīlaḥ saṃsārāvidhaṃ sukhena pratarati giritā pādapadmāvalaṃvāt || (fol, 5r3–6) Colophon iti siddheśvarataṃtre aparādhabhaṃjanaṃ nāma śrīkālikāstotraṃ samāptam || ❁ || oṁ tat sat || śrīkālīcaraṇāravṛṃde mama matir āstāṃ || śrīḥ || (fol. 5r6–8)

Beginning rudrāṇi viddham apy atimām iva tvāya cintayan tv ataruṇakāntim anaṃnyarūpā | tān etya padmasamūhaprasabhambhavaijan tikaṇthāvasakalamṛduvākulatā yuvatyaḥ || 24 || ye cintayanty aruṇamaṇḍalamadhyavartti rūpan bhavāmbanavayāvakarpakaramyaṃ | teṣāṃ sadaiva kusumāyudhavāṇabhiruṃ vakṣasthalo mṛgadṛśo vaśago bhuvanti || 25 || (exp. 3: 1–4) End kuvasayadalanīlaṃvavvare‥mbakaṇaṃ gurutarakkucabhārākrāntakālāvalagnaṃ | kim iha vahubhi‥lva tsvarūpaaratraḥ sakalabhuvanamātaḥ sahṛtaṃ sannidhattā || 12 || akkīsubhimnāmbujalocanāya śītāṃśunālaṃkṛtakuṇḍalāya | pūrṇāvadātasuribhānanāya namo namaḥ śaṅkaravallabhāya || 33 || (exp. 6b5–9) Colophon iti ambāstuti samāptā || ❁ || (exp. 6b9)

Beginning svasti śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || athāmṛteśīyiginīmaṃtravidhānam || || oṁ juṁ saḥ hrauṁ saṃ kaṭe rogaṃ me paraṃ nāśaya naśaya hrauṁ saḥ jūṁ oṁ 23 || asya śrī īśvara ṛṣiḥ yathoktacchandaḥ amṛteśvarī yoginī devatā juṁ bījaṃ saḥ śaktiḥ oṁ kīlakaṃ mṛtyuṃjayārthe caturvidhapuruṣārthasidhyarthaṃ ca japārcane viniyogaḥ || oṁ oṁ hṛt oṁ jūṁ śira oṁ saḥ śikhā oṁ oṁ kavacaṃ oṃ juṁ netratrayaṃ oṁ saḥ astraṃ || (fol. 1v1–5) End tat tanmaṃtravaraṃ japtvā vidhnaśāntyai sahastradhā || saptāhena bhaved devī trividhotpātanāśane || graṃthāntare || ṣaṭbhujādhyānan tu piṃgalā bhrāmarī ulkā saṃkaṭānām eva || tad api grakarmaṇy eva || haumyan tu || vilvapatrais tatphalaaiś ca kamalair nāgakeśaraiḥ || juhuyāt pāyasānnnnena tathaiva kulavastubhiḥ || svasvavastubhih || sahastraṃ ayutaṃ vāpi lakṣaṃ vā kāminīkramāt || athavopakrameṇaiva juhūyāt svasvavastubhiḥ || dakṣiṇāntaṃ samāpyaiva tan taddiṣṭam anuṃ japed iti || || (fol. 7v3–7) Colophon iti bhaṭṭopanāmakadakṣiṇāmūrtiśivārādhakakāśīnāthaviracite maṃtrarājasamuccaye uttarārddhe ekādaśa paṭalaḥ || || 11 || śubham astu || || || (fol. 7v7–9)

Beginning ❖ oṁ nama⟨ḥ⟩ś caṇḍikāyai || avanti sasthitaṃ devī brahmaṇī haṃsavāhanī || pustakānte dharā nītyaṃ campakāvarṇasaṃnibhaṃ || uḍumbavṛkṣasaṃyuktaṃ kṣetrapālamāhāvala | ‥varggasaṃsthitaṃ devī brahmāṇī pranamo ʼ stu te || 1 || carītralālayā devī rudrāṇīvṛṣavāhani śurajukṣdharā nityā śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibhaṃ kṣatrapālamahā eṇḍakaraṃjavṛkṣāsaṃsthinaṃ || kavarggavyāpinaī devī rudrānipra(!) namo [ʼ]stu te || 2 || (fol. 1r1–7) End cakre na caṇḍikā devī siṃha tvaṃ nityavāhani || khaḍgapheṭakasaṃyuktaṃ rakṣa siṃdurasaṃnibhaṃ phattukakṣetrapālāsya ⟨||⟩ vanavṛkṣasamāsṛtoḥ śavarggavyāpinī devī caṇḍikāya namo [ʼ]stu te || 9 || ityāvaṃ yogini nāme ḥ la‥rgasyan nu pūjītaṃ || dhūpadīpagadhavaliṃ naivya vṛhya gṛhna iśvararī || ❁ || (fol. 2v1–5) Colophon iti aṣṭakṣētrayoginīstava samāpta(!)|| (fol. 2v6)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīgurūbhyo namaḥ || maṇḍalaṣaṭkoṇatrikoṇacoya || mācasarāyivali arghapātralaṃkhataya || kevoteya || laṃkanahāya || ceta siṃdhrarasvānachhāya || nosiya || hrāṃ ātmatatvāya namaḥ || hrīṁ vidhyātatvāya namaḥ || (exp. 3t1–4) End nosiya || nyāsalikāya || valithvaya || aiṁ gaccha 2 svāhā || aiṁ astrāya phaṭ 3 || hraḥ astrāya phaṭ 3 || svasthāna vāsva bhavantu || valisalaṃkhataya thamacchatu rutone || sākhithāya || nityakarmmasākṣiṇīsūryyāya arghena puṣpe namaḥ || (fol. 11b1–5) Colophon iti nityakatmadevārccanavidhi⟨ḥ⟩[ḥ] samātaḥ || || (exp. 11b6)

Beginning ❖ oṁ nama[ḥ] śrīgurave || ath caturddaśīvidhi[r] llikhyate || || mūlataleśaduthuṃ pithuṃ vāṁ thele || thvanalisāsakhi || siṃdro || tvāna || keśola || tāhāragha || thvatejoṅāvalaṃ khusavone || || laṃkusalaṃkhanahāya || sindhrate || svānatoke golate || sāsakhikāyāvalaṃ khanahāyāvamūlataseśatvaṃ hāyāvavane || || thvanalipūjāsāmagrīsamastaṃ yate || || pithusadevasnānayāya || || (exp. 3: 1–4) End asmatpaścimajyeṣṭhānjeṣṭhamahāmāyāśrīkubjikādevyo caturddaśīmahāparvvavyārccaṇapūjānimityarthaṃ kulamārttaṇḍamahābhairavāya mardhanna || aśṇāntaṃ bīja || puṣpan nama || gurunamaskāra || vatīsīnyāsa || japalātra || arghapātra || ātmapūjā || tato mālaṇīṃ pathet || paṃcavaliṃ dadyāt || śodhana(!) || tarppaṇa || prītipretā || thvatethutaṅāgane siye vindukāya || nityakarmmāyāyahnithāyāthyaṃ khāṅyāya || valiviye ajarādi || nirvvāṇacchāya || tvākamahāvali || dhūpadīpajāpastotra || śrīsaṃvartttā (exp. 6t8–6b12) Colophon

Beginning ❖ śreyo [ʼ]stu || || khaṇḍasānekohnuyā vibhiḥ || mohanīphamāla || devakohāvidyācakāvamāne śvarīsamadūralamohanīphe || || hanumantadarūdhidathvasalācake || hanumantayājavasasūryyarathadanuthitaye || || hanumantayākhavasa ināyadaruthitaya || daruthisvagudisaṃlaptakotasakevālavodanuthilicakaṃ ‥‥ || (exp. 3t1–17) End oṁ pāvakāna || oṁ namaḥ śaṃbhavāya || oṁ ‥ māle || oṁ jātavedase || oṁ ambe ʼmbike || oṁ agnimīḍe || oṁ iṣe vā || o agna āyāhi || oṁ śanno devī || oṁ ājighra || oṁ ambe ʼmbi || oṁ dyāṁ mālekhī || thavanaṃ || oṁ tīvvrānadyoṣā || nyāsalikāya || valivisarjjaṇa || oṁ ṭhadvayanta || valicchāyathavathavathāyasaṃ || kumārīvisarjjana || sarvvamalgala || || (exp. 18t2–18b1) Colophon iti navarātrasnāṇavidhi || śubha || sesādayaṃ vidhi || tu se || mvāca || hnelase || kahnevalase || dhāle || tu || āpa || sāmalase || nālikela || aṃvana || gvaya || gvā | la || thvatena ca rātre somekohnasesādayakāvate || || (exp. 18b2–12)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || jaunajīvako jaunadevatāsvāmī cha tyo ra jaunadevatālāī validāna dinu bhani śāstramā kahyāko cha tyo leṣī junajīva bhakṣya ho juna jīva abhakṣya ho tyasko vihorācāra tapasīla ṣolī leṣīmcha || chāgako vahnidevatā viṣṇuke validāna bhakṣya gaiḍāko brahmā devatā brahmāke validān bhakṣya ratuvāṅo vāyudevatā yakṣagaṇake validān bhakṣya (fol. 1: 1–7) End pattharako śakradevatā ratnako śakradevatā gṛhako sarvadeva devatā yatir bhaṃdāvāhik jo jo dravya chan tanko devatā rudra śubham (fol. 12: 5–8) Colophon śrīanaṅganātha pauḍyālako saujanyabāṭa prāpta nepālalalitapura mahābuddhanivāsī yajñānandagubhāñule pratilipigareko saṃvat 2017 jyeṣṭha 21 gate śukravāramā samāta || bīrapustakālayakā nimitta (fol. 12: 9–12)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha japavidhiḥ || ātmatatvāya namaḥ || vidyātatvāya namaḥ || śivatattvāya namaḥ || iti mantreṇa ācamya || sarvatattvāya namaḥ || iti karau prakṣālya || atha saṅkalpa[ḥ] || asya śrīkālīmantrasya bhairava ṛṣi uṣṭṇik chando dakṣiṇakāḷikā devatā hrīṁ bījaṃ hūṁ śakti krīṁ kīlakaṃ sarvābhīṣṭasiddhaye jap viniyogaḥ || ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ || bhairavāya ṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi uṣṇik chandase namo mukhe || (exp. 3t1–3b2) End yathāśaktijapaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṅanyāsaṃ kuryāt haste jalam ādāya devīkare japaṃ nivedayet guhyātiguhyagoptrī tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam || siddhr bhavatu me devi tvatprasādāt sureśvari guruṃ praṇamet || ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā cakṣur unmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ tata ācamya stotrapāṭhādikaṃ kuryāt (exp. 5t2–5b2) Colophon iti japavidhiḥ (exp. 5b2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṁ mahākāla uvāca || mahākautūhalaṃ stotraṃ hṛdayākhyaṃ mahottamam || śṛṇu priye mahāgopyaṃ dakṣiṇāyāḥ sugopitam || 1 || avācyam api vakṣyāmi tava prītyā prakāśitam || anyebhyaḥ kuru gopyaṃ ca satyaṃ satyaṃ ca śailaje || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End paṭhet stotraṃ kuleśani jīvanmuktaḥ sa ucyate || rajasvalābhagaṃ dṛṣṭvā paṭhed ekāgramānasaḥ || 39 || labhate paramaṃ sthānaṃ devī loke varānane || mahāduḥkhe mahāghore mahāsaṃkaṭake dine || 40 || mahābhaye mahāghore paṭhet stotraṃ mahottamaṃ || satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ gopyen mātṛjāravat || 41 || (fol. 4r4–6) Colophon iti śrīkālīkulārṇave dakṣiṇakālyā hṛdayam || || (fol. 4r6)

Beginning ❖ dhyāna[m] || raktapadmanibhāṃ devīṃ, vārārkkakiraṇā[[ruṇāṃ |]] | javākusumasaṃkāśāṃ, dāḍimīkusumopamāṃ || (fol. 1r1) End dadhim āhnikasaṃyuktaṃ, sarppiṣāparimi(‥)taṃ | madhuparkkaṃ gṛhānaṃ(!) me [[ma]]yā tubhyaṃ nivedayet || mulena madhuparkka(!) namaḥ || (4) || || (fol. 2r2–3) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || viśvaṃ darpaṇadṛṣyamānanagarītulyaṃ nijāṃtargataṃ paśyan nātmani māyayā bahir ivodbhūtaṃ yathā nidrayā || yaḥ sākṣī kurute prabodhasamaye svātmānam evādvayaṃ tasmai śrīgurumūrtaya(!) nama idaṃ śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtaye || 1 || (fol. 1v1–5) End maunavyākhyāprakaṭitaparabrahmatatvaṃ yuvānaṃ varṣiṣṭhāṃte vasad ṛṣigaṇair āvṛtaṃ brahmaniṣṭhaiḥ || ācāryaidraṃkarakalitacinmudram ānaṃdarūpaṃ svātmārāmaṃ muditavadanaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrttim īḍe || 15 || (fol. 5r5–5v3) Colophon iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryaśrīmacchaṃkarācāryaviracitaṃ dakṣiṇa(!)mūrtistotram saṃpūrṇa[m] || śubham || (fol. 5v3–5)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ mahānirvāṇaguhyakālyai || || devy uvāca || mantrā(!)dhyānaṃ purā proktaṃ rahasyaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ || sāṃgopāṅgarahasyaṃ ca kṛpayā vada me prabho || 1 || asaṃkhyāḥ kathitā deva vidyāmantrāś ca śāśvatāḥ || tattulyaṃ naiva paśyāmi sarvajñānakaraṃ paraṃ || 2 || (exp. 3t1–2) End phreṁ mreṁ khreṁ soṁ haṁ haṁsaḥ soṁ haṁ svāhā phreṁ phraḥ phreṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ srīṁ huṁ phraḥ phreṁ ātmajyotiḥ śivajyotiḥ śaktijyoti[ḥ] kalājyotiś cakrajyoti[r] vidyājyotis turyyajyoti[ḥ] brahmajyoti[ḥ] nirvāṇajyotir ity etat sarvamahānirvāṇajyotir bra⟨r⟩hmanirvāṇajyā(!)tis turyyā(!)jyotir ity etat tuyātītamalanirvāṇasphurattājyotis tu sarvam ekam ahaṃ svāhā || || tad aham ekaḥ svāhā tad evāham ekaḥ svāhā svāhā svāhā huṁ phaṭ namaḥ svāhā || || (exp. 8b2–6) Colophon iti śrīnirvāṇa⟨śrī⟩guhyamaṃtrādhyāna[ḥ] samāptaḥ || || śubham || ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ (exp. 8b6)

Beginning śrīguruprasanna(!) || maunavyākhyāprakaṭitaparabrahmatatvaṃ yuvānaṃ || varaśiṣṭhāṃte<ref name="ftn1"> For varṣiṣṭhāṃte </ref> vasad ṛsigaṇair āvṛtaṃ brahmaniṣṭhaiḥ || ācāreṃdraṃkaragalitaṃ<ref name="ftn2"> For ācāryaidraṃkarakalitacinmudram </ref> cinmudra⟪ā⟫m ānaṃdamūrttiṃ || svātmārāmaṃ munītavadanaṃ<ref name="ftn3"> For muditavadanaṃ </ref> dakṣiṇāmūrtim i(!)ḍe || 1 || viśvaṃ darpaṇadṛṣyamānanagarītulyaṃ nijāṃtargataṃ paśyan nātmanī(!) māyayā bahir īvo[d]bhūtaṃ yathā nidrayā || yat<ref name="ftn4"> For yaḥ </ref> sākṣāt kurute prabodhasamaye svātmānam e⟪otma⟫vādvayaṃ || tasmai śrīgurumūrtaye nama idaṃ śrīdakṣiṇāmūrttaye || 2 || (fol. 1r1–10) End vaṭaviṭapisamīpe bhūmibhāge niṣaṇṇaṃ || sakalamunijanānāṃ jñānadātāram ārāt || tribhūvanagurum īśaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtti⟪‥⟫devaṃ || jananamaraṇadukha[ś]cchedadakṣaṃ namāmi || 12 || (fol. 2v11–13, exp. 4 ll. 11–13) Colophon iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryaśrīśaṃkarācāryaviracitaṃ śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtistotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || (fol. 2v13–14, exp. 4 ll. 13–14)

Beginning śrīsarasvatyai [namaḥ] || || kailāsaśikhare ramye devadevaṃ maheśvaraṃ bhavānīrahasya(!) prītyā prayaccha varadāyakaḥ || 1 || śrīdevy uvāca || katham īśāna sarvajña labhate śaktim uttamaṃ || sādhakāya prasādena tan me kathaya suprabho || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End kilīnāya pradātavyaṃ tava bhaktiparāya ca || na deyaṃ devadeveśi gopyaṃ sarvāṃgame sadā || 66 || paṭhanīyaṃ mahādevi sarva(!)vasthāsu durllabhā || 167 || (fol. 11v2–4) Colophon iti śrīnīlataṃtre śrīnīlatārāsarasvatīsahasranāmastotraṃ samāptam || || śubham astu⟨ḥ⟩ || sampūrṇam || idaṃ pustakaṃ likhitvā amātyabharatalālasya(!) dadau || hanumatapurapule nivāsī || || || || (fol. 11v4–6)

Beginning rūpadhṛk || dvāviṃśārṇātmako rudraḥ kukṣiṃ me parirakṣatu || trivarṇātmā nīlakaṃṭho kaṃṭhaṃ rakṣatu sarvadā || 6 || triciṃtāmaṇiṃ bījarūpān, arddhanārīśvaro haraḥ || sadā rakṣatu me guhyaṃ sarvasaṃ⟨m⟩pat pradāyakaḥ || 7 || (fol. 5r1–3) End (mā)lpāni kusumāny eva bhavaṃti sukhadāni ca || tasya gehe ciraṃ lakṣmīr vvāṇ(!)ī vaktre vased dhruvam || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā tārā yo bhajate [ʼ]dhamaḥ || svalpāyur nirdhano mu(!)rkho bhavaty eva na saṃśayaḥ || 41 || || (fol. 17r3–5) Colophon iti śrībhairavītaṃtre bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde tārākalpe śrītārānīlasarasvatīkacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || || || ❁ || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || || ❁ || (fol. 17r5–17v1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrītārādevyai namaḥ || śrībhairavy uvāca || tārā pūjā śrūtā nātha vidyāś ca sakalās tathā sāṃprataṃ śrotum icchāmi kavacaṃ maṃtravigrahaṃ || 1 || trilokyamohanaṃ nāma sarvvāpadvinivāraṇaṃ || pū(!)raiva sūcitaṃ nātha kṛpayā me prakāśaya || 2 || (exp. 2t1–3) End mahātma(ne) sadā deyaṃ parikṣitaguṇāya ca || nābhaktāya pradātavyaṃ yathāntararatāya ca || 176 || na deyaṃ devadeveśi gopyaṃ sarvvāṃgame sadā || paṭhanīyaṃ sadā devī(!) sarvvāvasthāsu sarvvadā || 177 || (exp. 19t5–7) Colophon iti śrīnīlatantre tārānīlasarasvatīsahasranāma samāptam || || śubham (exp. 19t7)

Beginning śrīganeśāya namaḥ || oṁ namaḥ śrīnṛtyanāthāya || pārvaty uvāca || oṁ aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ khphreṁ (hlauṁ) hrīṁ devadeva mahādeva sarvvadevottamottama || nṛtyanāthasya kavacaṃ kathayasva mahāprabho || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yat tvayāhaṃ pracoditā || kavacaṃ nṛtyanāthasya śrūyatāṃ mama bhāṣitaṃ || (fol. 1v1–5) End nṛtyakāryyaṃ ca siddhyarthaṃ paścāt svarga(!) paraṃ yayau || sarvvapāpavinirmuktaṃ śivaloke sa gacchati || || (fol. 5r5–5v1) Colophon iti uḍḍāmarataṃtre yogaśāstre śrīharagaurīsamvāde aṣṭādaśa(ṣa 8)le śrīnṛtyeśvarakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || khacarendughane (1719) śāke †enabhasthe† divaspatau || navamyāṃ candraje vāre śivoktaṃ kavacaṃ varaṃ|| śrīmaddayānidhiprītyai likhitaṃ || śubhaṃ || (fol. 5v1–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || asya śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtti-aṣṭottaraśatadivyanāmāmṛtastotramahāmaṃtrasya †gurvettevāsi† vaśiṣṭha-ṛsiḥ anuṣtup chaṃdaḥ svayaṃprakāśo dakṣiṇāmūrttidevatā mama catuḥṣaṣṭikalāvidyāprāptaye jape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) End jaṭādhārī mahāyogī jñānamālyair alaṃkṛtaḥ || bhūtapretapiśācyā(!)dīn duṣṭamātreṇa paśyati || 37 || ahaṃ tv e(!)rkamuni⟨ḥ⟩śreṣṭha[ḥ] vīṇāyāṃ vada nityaśaḥ || nityaṃ japasva sadbhaktyā pūjyo lokeṣu vai mune⟨ḥ⟩ || 38 || (fol. 5v2–6) Colophon iti śivapurāṇe dakṣiṇāmūrtti-aṣṭottaraśatanāma saṃpūrṇam astu || śrīr astu || || (fol. 5v6–8)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīsuṃdarīnṛsiṃhāya namaḥ || kailāsaśikharāsīnaṃ śaṃkaraṃ candraśekharaṃ || uvāca pārvatī devī praṇamya śirasā śivaṃ || 1 || śrīdevy uvāca || devadeva mahādeva bhaktānugrahakāraka || tvatprasādān mayā nātha śrutāni vividhāni ca || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End dāṃbhikāya kuśīlāya niṃdakāya durātmane || gurubhaktivihīnāya cuṃbakāya tathaiva ca || 58 || prāṇāṃte pi na dātavyaṃ kavacaṃ manmukhoditaṃ || tava snehān mayākhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durllabhaṃ || 59 || kavacaṃ devadeveśi gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || || ❁ || (fol. 10v4–11r3) Colophon iti śrīsaṃmīlanataṃtre mahāsiddhiprade umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde śrīnṛsiṃhasuṃdarīkavacam || ❁ || || śrīnṛsiṃhāya namaḥ || || (fol. 11r3–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya ⟨n⟩namaḥ || oṁ asya śrīpaṃcamīstavarājamaṃtrasya dakṣiṇāmūrttir ṛṣir anuṣtup chaṃdaḥ śrīmantripurasuṃdarī devatā śrīṁ bījaṁ hrīṁ śaktiḥ mama caturvidhapuruṣārthasiddhyarthaṃ jape viniyogaḥ || mūlena ṣaḍaṃgaṃ kṛtvā guruṃ gaṇapatiṃ durgāṃ vaṭu[[kaṃ]] śivam acyutaṃ brahmāṇaṃ girijāṃ lakṣmīṃ vāṇīṃ vaṃde vibhūtaye || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End ākāśe suprakāśe sakalaguṇamayīṃ suṃdarīṃ raktanetrāṃ nityāṃ padmāsanasthāṃ taruṇaravinibhāṃ raktacaṃdraprabhā[ṃ] bhā(!)ṃ || ātmānaṃ sarvabhāvaiḥ sakalaguṇyutāṃ sarvadā yo hi paśyet sākṣād devaḥ śivo vā madanadahanakṛt khecaro jāyate saḥ || 175 || (fol. 10r5–7) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmalamahātaṃtre śivaśaktisaṃvāde paṃcamīstavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || || yad akṣara[ṃ] pada[ṃ] bhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnaṃ ca yad bhavet || tat sarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ devi prasīda parameśvari || 1 || bhūmau skhalitapādānāṃ bhūmir evāvalaṃbanaṃ || tvayi jātāparādhānāṃ tvam eva śaraṇaṃ śive || 2 || yad atra pāṭhe jagadaṃbike mayā visargaviṃdvakṣarahīnam īritaṃ || tad astu saṃpūrṇaphalaṃ prasādataḥ saṃkalpasiddhis tu sadaiva jāyatāṃ || 3 || || śubham astu || || śrīr astu || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 10r7–10v4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || ānandam ānandakaraprasannaṃ jñānasvarūpaṃ nijabhāvayuktaṃ || yogīṃdram īḍyaṃ bhavarogabai(!)dyaṃ śrīmadguruṃ nityam ahaṃ namāmi || 1 || guruṃ gaṇapatiṃ druggāṃ baṭukaṃ śivam acyutaṃ || brahmāṇaṃ girijāṃ lakṣmīṃ bā(!)ṇīṃ be(!)dabi(!)bhūtaye || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End ākāśe svaprakāśe sakalaguṇamayīṃ sundarīṃ raktanetrāṃ nityaṃ padmāsanasthāṃ taruṇarabi(!)nibhāṃ raktacaṃdraprabhāṃ tāṃ || ātmānaṃ sarvvabhāvaiḥ sakalaguṇa⟪‥‥⟫yutāṃ sarvvadā yo hi paśye(!) sākṣād devaḥ śivo bā(!) madanadahanakṛt khecaro jāyate saḥ || 153 || || || (fol. 6r8–10) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale mahāstotre paṃcamīstavarāja[ḥ] samāpta⟨m⟩[ḥ] iti || || yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ likhitaṃ mayā || yadi śuddham aśuddhaṃ bā(!) mama doṣo na dīyate || || śubham astu || || śrīr astu || || (fol. 6r11–12)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śivāya || namāmi sadgu⟪r⟫ruṃ śāntaṃ, pratyakṣaṃ śivarūpina(!)ṃ | śirasā yogapīṭhasthaṃ, muktikāmārthasiddhaye || 1 || yā nityā paramā śakti,r ⟪śakti⟫ †yagaś† caitnyarūpinī(!), | tān namāmi mahādevīṃ, pañcamīm ātmarūpinī(!)ṃ, (exp. 3 ll. 1–3) End mohanastambhanākarṣa,māraṇāccāṭanaṃ tathā | kalpanād eva jāyaṃte, sarvvasiddhim upālabhet || [[137 ||]] idaṃ tripurasuṃdaryā, stavarāja⟪su⟫manoharaṃ | rakṣāmantraṃ ca śubhadaṃ, śivena parikīrttitaṃ || 138 || (exp. 20b5–21 l. 2) Colophon iti śrīrudrajāmale<ref name="ftn1"> For rudrayāmale </ref>, śivabhaktavinirggate, daśamasaṃhitāyāṃ, pañcamīstvarāja[ḥ] samāpta[ḥ] || || samvat 818 kākavadi 12 śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevasana dayakā || śrīśrījayaraṇajit‥‥ śubhaṃ || (exp. 21 ll. 2–4)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha hāhārāvatantroktdaśavaktraguhyakālīdhyānaṃ || devyā dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi, yathāyātakrameṇa ca || yasya vijñānamātreṇa, kālikā siddhidā smṛtā || 1 || nīlotpaladalaśyāmā, jyotirmmaṇḍalasambhavā || daśavaktrā mahādevī triṃśallocanabhūṣitā || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End muktahūṁkāra-udbhinna,lālayantīṃ vicintayet || pratyālīḍhajayā dhārā, sarvvalakṣmīr jayeśvarī || 33 || evaṃ dhyeyā mahākālī, jihvāgre navayauvanā || bhasā kramasy amadhyasthā, anākhyeyā maheśvarī || 34 || || (fol. 6v2–5) Colophon iti dhyānaṃ || (fol. 6v5)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya nama[ḥ] || i(!)śvara uvāca⟨ḥ⟩ || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kavacaṃ sarvvasiddhidaḥ || paṭhitvā dhārayitvā ca, naro mucyeta saṃkaṭāt || (fol. 1v1–3) End evaṃ sthitāsi devi tvaṃ trilokyarakṣaṇātmike || rakṣa māṃ sarvvagātreṣu durge devi namo stu te || || (fol. 2r4–6) Colophon Iti kubjikātaṃtre durgākavacaṃ samāptaṃ śubham || || nepālasaṃvat 949 miti-āṣāḍhaśudi 9 roja 3 (fol. 2r6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || pravahya vanavegadyaditopi mavalati najajagad aṇupiṇubhāraḥ | laghugurutulanā tulāprakārā nu iṃṭhimaguṇaḥ prabhavat guṇatrayasya hiraṇyagarbhasya guru śarīrasaṃkhyā(2)vapuryya puruṣapurāṇaḥ | aṇor aṇīyān mahato mahīyān paśyatya cakṣu sa śaṇāṃtya karṇaḥ | sakalāṃkurakārivījānugataṃ yatad (!) akāri vyājñanaṃ kurvadrupatvaṃ nāmasāmānyaṃ na kalpayitu(3)m ucitaṃ goravāt (!) Beginning oṁ śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ || || cūḍāmaṇīkṛtavidhur valayīkṛtavāsukiḥ || bhavo bhavatu bhavyāya līlā tāṇḍavapaṇḍitaḥ || 1 || nijanirmitakārikāvalim atisaṃkṣiptaciraṃtanoktibhiḥ || viśadīkaravāṇi kautukān nanu rājīvadayāv.aśaṃvadaḥ || 2 || sadravyā guṇaguṃphitā sukṛtināṃ satkarmaṇā jñāpikā satsāmānyaviśeṣanityamilitā bhāvaprakarṣoj[j]valā || viṣṇor vakṣasi viśvanāthakṛtinā siddhāṃtamuktāvalī vinyastā manaso mudaṃ vitanutāṃ sadyuktir eṣā ciram || 3 || vighnavighātāya kṛtaṃ maṃgalaṃ śiṣyaśikṣāyai nibadhnāti nūtanetyādinā || nanu maṃgalaṃ [[na]] vighanadhvaṃsaṃ prati navā samāptiṃ prati kāraṇam || vināpi maṃgalaṃ nāstikādīnāṃ graṃthe nirvighnaparisamāptidarśanād iti cen na || avigītaśiṣṭācāraviṣayatvena maṃgalasya saphalatve siddhe tatra phalajijñāsāyāṃ saṃbhavati dṛṣṭaphalakatve adṛṣṭaphalakalpanāyā anyāyyatvād upasthitatvāc ca samāptir eva phalaṃ kalpyate || (fol. 1v1–8) End nanu sa evāyaṃ kakāra iti pratyabhijñānāc chabdasya nityatvaṃ itthaṃ cotpādavināśabuddhir bhramarūpaiva ity ata āha | so [ʼ]yaṃ ka iti | sājātyam iti tatra pratyabhijñānasya tatsajātīyatvaṃ viṣayo na tu [[ta]]dvyaktabhedo viṣyaḥ | uktapratītivirodhāt | itthaṃ ca dvayor api buddhyor na bhramatvam iti | nanu sajātīya(!) so [ʼ]yam iti pratyabhijñā kutra dṛṣṭā ity ata āha | tad eva iti | yad auṣadham a⟪‥⟫nena kṛtaṃ tad evauṣadhaṃ mayā kṛtam ityādidarśanād iti bhāvaḥ || || (fol. 54r3–6) Colophon iti śrīmahāmahopādhyāyaśrīvidyānivāsabhaṭṭācāryātmajamahāmahopādhyāyaśrīviśva-nāthapaṃcānanabhaṭṭācāryaviracitā siddhāṃtamuktāvalī samāptā || saṃpūrṇaś cāyaṃ graṃthaḥ || || ❁ || || | śāke 1683 || śubhaṃ bhūyāsuḥ(!) || (fol. 54r6–8)
