Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ kāśīviśveśvarāya namaḥ lakṣmīpādayugaṃ praṇamya pitaraṃ śrībālakṛṣṇābhidhaṃ bhāradvājakulāṃbudhau(2) vidhum iva śrīgauravāsyāṃvu[[jāt]] jñātvā śeṣamataṃ mitena vacasā siddhāṃtamuktāvalīṃ gūḍhārthāṃ tanute yathāmati mahādevaḥ pareṣāṃ kṛ(3)te 1 tatra tā[[va]]d bhāṣāparicchedavyākhyānaṃ cikīrṣuḥ (fol. 1v1–3) End na cānityatvamataṃ pratyabhijñāyās tajjātīyoyam iti syān na tu soyam itīti vācyaṃ | yatra(12) pratyabhijñāyāṃ jātitvena gatvāder bhānaṃ tatraiva tajjātīyoyam ity ākāraḥ yatra tuḥ (!) svarūpato bhānaṃ tatra soyam ity ā(1)dy abhinnakartṛkatvarūpa viruddhadharmādhyāsāhitabhedapratyayasya pratibaṃdhakasya sattvāt na vyakty abhedo viṣayaḥ kintu tat sajātīyābhedo viṣa(2)yaḥ iti bhāvaḥ bhānuṃ praṇamya paribhāvya ca śāstrasāraṃ muktāvalī(3)kiraṇa eṣa pitṛvyadiṣṭaḥ | sady uktibhir dinakareṇa kareṇa soyaṃ nītaḥ prakāśapadavīṃ sudhiyāṃ mudestu (4)|| 1 || muktāvalīprakāśo yaḥ prājñānatimirāpahaḥ | tena saṃtoṣam āyātu nīlakaṃṭhaḥ satāṃ priyaḥ || 2 || (fol. 151v11–152r4) Colophon (5)saṃ 1830 varṣe caitraśukla 14 bhaume likhitam idaṃ pustakaṃ || yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ likhi(6)taṃ mayā || yadi śuddhaṃ aśuddhaṃ vā mama doṣō na dīyate || 1 || || śrīr astu || ||śrīḥ || || śrīḥ || (7)pustakam idaṃ śrīkṛṣṇajośī rāmanagaravāle (satyānnāsti paro dharmaḥ) oṃ (fol. 152r5–7))

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || yāt kīrttiprabhayā suśuklabhuvane māyāprabhāvaiḥ prabhor nīlāder janitā pratītir aca(2)lā dyauḥ saṃvṛtā śobhate || yac chiṣyo ḍuguṇaiḥ same gurur aho hārdanyakārāpahaḥ śrīmad rāmadayālur iṃdur amalo mo(3)dāya bhūyāt sadā || 1 || natvā śaṃbhuṃ hariṃ gaurīṃ vidhiṃ ḍhuṃḍhiṃ ca bharatīṃ || kriyate raghunāthena laukikanyāyasaṃgra(4)haḥ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End yo bramhādeś ca viṣṇur vasutanur api yo yaś ca gauryādi mūrttir yaś cātmā sarvaja(1)ntoḥ śrutiśikharagirāṃ yaś ca tātparyabhūmiḥ | yasyāvodhātsamuttho vrajati ca vilayaṃ yasya vodhātprapaṃcas taṃ śuddhaṃ saṃprapadye śiva(2)m amaram ajaṃ śaṃbhum īśānam īḍyaṃ | 4 | (fol. 95v11: 96r1–2) Colophon iti śrīsādhuvṛṃdavaṃditapādāraviṃdavairāgyādiratnākaravidvadvara śrīmad rāmadayālu(3)śiṣyeṇa somavaṃśīyavindarāyakulottaṃśa bhagavatparāyaṇa śrīsevīdevyāśritapādāraviṃdaśrīgulāvarāyavarmātmajenodā(4)sīnāvasthena raghunāthavarmaṇā viracito laukikanyāyasaṃgrahaḥ samāptaḥ …(fol. 96r2–4)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || śābdabodhe ceti saptamīnirūpitatve va śabdaḥ prasiddhau ekapadārthe ghaṭe sa(2)ptamī anuyogitve ○ akarapadārthasya nīlapadārthasya ṣaṣṭhī pratiyogitve ○ saṃsargo abhedādiḥ saṃbaṃdhammaryādā samabhivyā(3)hārajñānakāryatāvachedaka (!) koṭipraviṣṭaḥ saṃbaṃdhatā tṛtīyā ʼbhede bhāsate ity atra bhāsanaṃ viṣayatā ākhyātārthaḥ āśra(4)yatā ○ (fol. 1v1–4) End ghaṭa ākāśaṃ na paśyati ityatre (!) ca mukhyatayā ʼmupapatti ity †ādirubhdāvitā† ityādipadāt aṃdhaḥ ā(3)kāśaṃ na paśyati abhāva ākāśaṃ na paśyati ghaṭo ghaṭaṃ na paśyatity ādīnāṃ saṃgrahaḥ (fol. 202v2–3) Colophon iti vyutpattivāde dvitīyābhibhaktyartha(4)nirūpaṇe prathamakhaṃḍaḥ (fol. 202v3–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || nūtanajaladhararucaye gopavadhūṭīdukūlacaurāya | tasmai kṛṣṇāya namaḥ saṃsāramahīruhasya vījāya || 1 || dravyaṃ guṇās ta(2)thā karma sāmānyaṃ saviśeṣakam | samavāyas tathā bhāvaḥ padārthāḥ sapta kīrttitāḥ || 2 ||(fol. 1v1–2) End sarvaśabdo nabhovṛttiḥ śrotrotpannas tu gṛhyate | vīcītaraṃganyāyena tad utpattis tu kīrttitaḥ || 65 || kadaṃvamukulanyā(6)yād utpatti kasyacinmate | utpannaḥ ko vinaṣṭaḥ kaḥ iti buddher anityatā || 66 || so ʼyaṃ ka iti buddhis tu sājātyam avalaṃvate || 67 || || (fol. 5r5–6) Colophon iti śrī(7)mahāmahopādhyāya śrīyutapaṃcānanabhaṭṭācāryaviracita bhāṣāparicchedaḥ samāptaḥ || || śrīḥ || || (fol. 5r6–7)

Beginning – ca kārikāvalīpratipāditortho boddhavya iti kim anena matkṛta viśada nibaṃdhenetyata uktam atisaṃkṣipteti | tathā ca līlāvatyādi prācīnanibaṃdheṣu graṃthabā(2)hulyena bahutaraduḥkhahetupratipattikatayā na bālānāṃ pratipattir iti bhāvaḥ | (fol. 2r1–2) End atra kecit sāmānādhikaraṇasaṃbaṃdhenaiva jñānādau āśrayagatam ekatvaṃ anumitau bhāsate | yad vā dvitvāsamānādhikaraṇyatvarūpa(4)m ekatva tad viṣayaḥ | na ca jīveśvaragata dvitvasāmānādhikaraṇyasya iśvarajñānādau(!) satvād baṃdha iti vācyam | duḥkhavadavṛttitvena dvitvasya viśeṣaṇiyatvāt | na caivam api ghaṭe –(fol. 6v3–4)

Beginning śrīvighnahartre namaḥ || || asya śrīpratyaṃgirāstotrasya mahādeva ṛṣir anuṣṭubdchaṃdaḥ śrīpratyaṃgirā devatā hūṃ bījaṃ svāhā śaktir mamābhīṣṭasidhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || || kubjikovāca || mandarasthaṃ suhāsīnaṃ bhagavantaṃ maheśvaram | samupāgamya caraṇau pārvatī paripṛ[c]chati || 1 || devy uvāca || dhāraṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṅgirā mahottamā || naranārīhitārthāya bālānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 2 || rājñāṃ māṇḍalikānāṃ ca dīnānāñ ca maheśvara || viduṣāṃ ca dvijātīnāṃ viśeṣārd dharmavardhinī || 3 || mahābhayeṣu dhoreṣu vidyudagnibhayeṣu ca || vyāghradaṃṣṭhikarīghāte nadīnadasamudbhavo || 4 || (exp. 2t1–7) End ya imāṃ dhārayed vidyāṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ vāpi yaḥ paṭhet || so pi duṣṭāṃtako devi hanyāc chatrūn asaṃśayaḥ || 27 || sarvatorakṣayed vidyā mahābhayavipattiṣu || mahābhayeṣu ghoreṣu na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || 28 || (exp. 6b4–6) Colophon iti śrīkubjikāmate caṃḍograśūlapāṇivadananirgatamahātaṃtre pratyaṅgirāsiddhimaṃtras tavoddhāraḥ samāptaḥ (exp. 6b7)

Beginning oṃ krān namaḥ aṃguṣṭābhyāº oṁ krīṃ namaḥ tarjanībhyāº oṁ krūṃ namaḥ madhyamāº oṁ krauṃ namaḥ kaniṣṭikābhyāº oṁ kraḥ namaḥ kartalakarº evaṃ hṛdayādi || atha stotradhānaṃ || (fol. 1v1–4) End kālīkarālavitkrāṃte kālike pāpahāriṇi || vikarālamukhe devī jvālāmuhi namo stu te || 5 || ādāv aṃte tacchaṃyor āvṛṇīmahe iti daśavāraṃ spṛṣṭvā japet || †tachaṃyor† āvṛṇīmahegātuṃ yajñāya gātuṃ jajñapataye daivī svastir astu naḥ svastir mānuṣebhyaḥ || urdhvaṃ jigātu bheṣajaṃ || śanno astu dvipadaṃ śaṃ catuṣpade || oṁ śāṃtiḥ śāṃtiḥ śāṃtiḥ (fol. 7r1–7v2)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṁ asya śrīpratyaṃgirāstotramaṃtrasya aṃgirā ṛṣir anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ pratyaṃgirā devatā manovāṃchitasidhyarthe pāṭhe viniyogaḥ | oṁ krāṃ aṃguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṁ krīṁ tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā | oṁ krūṃ madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ | oṁ kraiṁ anāmikābhyāṃ huṁ | (fol. 1v1–4) End tripurā tvaritā nityā trailokyavijayā jayā | jitā parājitā devī jayaṃtī bhadrakālikā | siddhalakṣmīr mahālakṣmīḥ kālarātri[r] namo stu te | kālīkarālavakrāṃte kālike pāpahāriṇi | vikarālamukhe devi jvālāmukhi namo stu te || yāṃ kalpayaṃti no rayaḥ rūrāṃ kṛtyāṃ vadhūm iva | tāṃ brahmaṇā apanirṇudmaḥ pratyak karttāram ṛcchatu || (fol. 4v3–7) Colophon iti pratyaṃgirāstotram saṃpūrṇam || (fol. 4v7)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṁ asya śrīpratyaṃgiāstotrasya mahādeva ṛṣir anuṣṭup cchaṃdah pratyaṃgirā devatā hūṁ bījaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ mamābhīṣṭasidhyartha[ṃ] jape viniyogaḥ || śrīkubjikovāca || maṃdarasthaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ maheśvaraṃ || samupāgamya caraṇau pārvvatī paryyapṛcchata(!) || 1 || śrīdevy uvāca || dhāriṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṃgirā mahottamā || naranārīhitārthāya bālānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 2 || rājñāṁ māṃḍālikānāṃ ca dīnānāṃ ca maheśvarī || vidūṣāṃ ca dvijātīnāṃ viśleṣād dharmmasādhinī || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End yavahomena dhānyaṃ syād ikṣubhiḥ caturaṃgulaiḥ || kumudair janavātsalyaṃ vakule caturāṃ śriyaṃ || aśokaiḥ putralābhaḥ syāt pāṭalībhih śubhāṃganāṃ || māṣahome nambakaḥ syān kādravair vyādhinī bhaven || elair vabhaitakair bhrāntā mriyate bhālmalīhunān || kaṭtailena vidveṣaḥ staṃbhaḥ pītaprasūnakaiḥ || vāyūvegotpatatpatrair haminoccāṭanaṃ †niakaḥ† || homānyeṣāṃ madārthānām (fol. 7v7–10)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha kṛtyāpratiharaṇaḥ || tasya ca sarvasyāpi sāmānyataḥ śakra ṛṣiḥ || kṛtyādūṣaṇaḥ śakra devatā || atijagatī śakkvaryyau sarvāṇi chaṃdāsi ca chaṃdāsi | yatra sarvāṇi chaṃdāsi iti vakṣyāṃmas tatra tatra gāyatryādijagatpataṃ saptachaṃdāsi prakṛtāni vijānīyād iti || (fol. 1v1–6) End tripurā tvaritā nitā trailokyaviayā jayā || jitā parājitā devi jaṃpati bhadri kālikā || siddhalakṣmīr mahālakṣmīḥ kāli(!)rātrir namo stu te || iti caturtha puṣpāṃjaliḥ || kālīkarālavikrāṃte kālike pāpahāriṇi || vikarālamukhe devi jvālāmukhī namo stu te || (fol. 22v4–9) Colophon iti puṣpāṃjali[r] || iti pratyaṃgirā (fol. 22v9)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīpratyaṃgirādevyai namaḥ || || atha svastivācanapūrvakaṃ saṃkalpaṃ kuryyāt || adyetyādi amukagotra amukaśarmā mama sarvāriṣṭaśāṃtipūrvakaśatrūpadravanāśapūrvakaśatrukṣayakāmaḥ || śrīpratyaṃgirāyāmālāmaṃtrastotrapuṭita atharvaṇoktanava ṛcaḥ || amukagotrasya śrīmannamukadevaśarmā brāhmaṇadvārā pāṭham ahaṃ kariṣye || (fol. 1v1–4) End staṃbhinī mihinī caiva kṣobhiṇī drāviṇī tathā || jṛṃbhiṇī bhrāmiṇī raudrī tathā saṃhāriṇīti ca || śaktayah kramayoge na śatrupakṣe nijitā || dhāritā sādhakendreṇa sarvaśatruvināśikā || ya imāṃ dhārayed vidyāṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ vāpi yaḥ paṭhet || so pi duḥkhāṃtako devi ripuhanyān na saṃśayaḥ || sarvato dhārayed vidyāṃ mahābhayavipattiṣu || mahābhayeṣu sarveṣu na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || || (fol. 8v1–5) Colophon iti śrīkubjikātaṃtre caṇḍograśūlapāṇimukhavinirgatapratyaṃgirāstotraṃ samāptaḥ śrīsambat 1864 sāla mārgaśīraśudi 8 roja 2 likhitam idaṃ pustakaṃ śrīśuke(!)devaśarmmaṇā śubhaṃ (fol. 8v5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ oṁ asya śrīpratyaṃ[[gi]]rāstotrasya mahādeva ṛṣir anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ || śrīpratyaṅgirā devatā huṁ bījaṃ svāhā śaktir mama sarvasa(!)trukṣayaṃkari arthadharmamokṣākāmārthe jape viniyogaḥ || oṁ kṛṣṇāṃvarī aṃguṣṭābhyāṃ namaṃ (fol. 1v1–4) End mahābhayeṣu ghoreṣu na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || iti kubjikāmate pratyaṃgirāstava || bhagnapṛṣṭikaṭigṛvāḥ taptadṛṣṭir adhomukhaṃ || kaṣṭena liṣitaṃ graṃthaḥ putravat pratipālanaṃ || saṃvat 1882 sāla adya caitramāse kṛṣṇapakṣe ṣaṣṭamyāṃ tithau budhavāsare śrībhadrakālīcaraṇalekṣākajaye dattasihasaranaḥ || (fol. 9v3–7)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīkālasaṃkalpyai(!) || śrī īśvara uvāca || aiṁ khraṁ namastu te mahāmāye dehātīte niraṃjane | pratyaṃgirājagaddhātrir rājalakṣmī namas tu te || varṇṇadehā mahāgaurī sādhakecchāprava[t]ttake | pade pade mahārambhā parāsiddhisamucchitā || tatvadehāsthitā devi sādhakānugrahā smṛtā | mahākuṇḍalinī bhitvā sahasradalabhedinī || (fol. 1r1–4) End yaṃ yaṃ cintayete kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ sidhyati nānyathā || satyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevī kārike tatsamo na hi || a[r]ddjarātre samutthāya dīpaprakṣalite niśi pa‥ne stotram etan tu sarvvavintitasiddhidaṃ || puraśca[r]yyā vine(!) naiva stotramātreṇa sidhyate | maṇḍale pratimā‥ vā maṇḍalāśrapaṭhed yati [ḥ] | idaṃ mahā‥prāk ‥ cintitārthasiddhidaṃ | nānyadevaratā yāntu ‥deyan tu kadācana dātavyaṃ bhaktiśaktāya kūladikṣāratāya ca | anyathā patanaṃ yānti ityājñā parameśvarī || (fol. 5r4–5v4) Colophon iti śrītridaśaḍāmare pratyaṃgirādevyā māhā‥stava samāptaḥ || || oṁ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmyai || aisā vācya vijayate saṃpūrṇakāmapradā saṃsārā navayo na bhāvapalamāṃ sarvāṇi hantā śivā || śrīsarvaṃ navadhṛtyamaṃgalagatā sānandasiddhi (fol. 5v4–6)

Beginning bhiḥ || golakaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi bhaiṣajyāni ca vaidyako || kātāya madakaṃ caiva dūrvāṃkuṃkumasecanaṃ abhaṣkaraviṃḍāriṣṭaṃ siddhārthaṃ mālatī[ṃ] tathā || etad dravyagaṇāṃ bhadre sādhako maṃtravit sadā | (fol. 3r1–2) End paṭhitā pāṭhitā vāpi yaḥ paṭhec ca yat paṭhet || tasya śatrū[r] kṣayo nityaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | sarva‥ skṣayed vidyām abhaye vipattiṣu || jale sthale cānta‥ kṣe na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || (fol. 8v4–6) Colophon iti śrīcaṃḍograśūlapāṇivaktranirgatapratyaṃgirāstavah saṃpūrṇaṃ(!) || || śrīśāke 1693 phālgune (fol. 8v6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīpratyaṃgirāyai namaḥ || oṁ asya śrīpratyaṃgirāstotramaṃtrasya aṃgirā ṛṣir anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrīpratyaṃgiro devatā oṁ bījaṃ hrīṁ śaktiḥ brahmākilakaṃ mamābhīṣṭasidhyarthaṃ jape viniyogaḥ || śirasi aṃgirā ṛṣaye namaḥ || mukhe anuṣṭupchandase namaḥ || hṛdaye śrīpratyaṃgirādevatāyai namaḥ || (fol. 1v1–4) End chāyāgraha satyagraha visalyagraha kālagraha sarvadoṣagraha viḍāvinisarvaduṣṭabhakṣiṇi sarvapāpaniṣūdini sarvayaṃtrasphoṭini sarvaśṛṃkhalātrauṭini sarvamudrāvidrāviṇi jvālājihvekarālavakre raudramūrtte devīpratyaṅgiresasarvade (fol. 4v6–8)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namah || devy uvāca || dhāriṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṃgirā mahodayā || naranārīhitārthāya vārāṇāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || rājñā māṇḍalikānāṃ ca dīnānāṃ maheśvara || viduṣā ca dvijāṭhīnāṃ viśeṣeṇārthasādhinī || mahābhayeṣu ghoreṣu vudyudagnibhaya(!)ṣu ca || vyāghraguṣṭikaridyāte nadīnade samūdrake || (fol. 1v1–6) End sādhyanāmārddhitīkṛtya śatrubhayaṃ ca pūttalī || bījaṃ tatra nidhāyaiva cittāgra(!) prakṣipat(!) tataḥ || ekāyutajapaṃ kṛtvā trirātrān māraṇaṃ ripoḥ || mahākkvaro bhavet tasya tāmrakasya ca śalākayā || gudadvāre pravinyasya saptāhānyamaraṇaṃ dhruvaṃ || (fol. 11v2–6) Colophon iti śrīcaṇaś(!)varaḥ. ‥rapāṇitaṃtre haragaurīsaṃvāde pratyaṃgirāstavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || śubham || (fol. 11v6–7)

Beginning ❖ oṁ pratyaṅgirāyai namaḥ || || mandarasthaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ bhagavantaṃ maheśvaraṃ || upasaṃgamya caraṇau pārvvatī paripṛcchati || 1 || pārvaty uvāca || dhāriṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṅgirā mahottamā | naranārīhitā †thaci† vārānāṃ lakṣaṇeṣu ca || 2 || rājñāṃ māṇḍalikānāñ ca dīnānāñ ca maheśvaraṃ | mahābhayeṣu sarvveṣu vidyudagnibhayeṣu ca || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End oṁ raudri sphaṁ sphaṁ mama śatrūn saṃtāpaya 2 oṁ saṃhāriṇi sphaṁ sphaṃ mama śatrūn saṃhāraya 2 | ya imāṃ dhārayed vidyāṃ trisaṃdhya[ṃ] cāpi yaḥ smaret | so pi duṣuṣvādāntako devi hanyāc chatrūn [na] saṃśayaḥ || sarvvato dhārayed vidyāṃ mahābhayavipattiṣu | mahābhayeṣu sarvveṣu na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || ya imāṃ dhārayed vidyāṃ trisaṃdhya[ṃ] cāpi yaḥ smaret | so pi duṣukhādāntakodevi hanyāc chatrūn [na] saṃśayaḥ || sarvato dhārayed vidyāṃ mahābhayabhavipattiṣu | mahābhayeṣu saveṣu na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || (fol. 8r1–4) Colophon iti caṇḍograśūlapāṇiviracitamantroddhārah saṃpūrṇaḥ || || śubham astu || || (fol. 8r1–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṁ asya śrīpratyaṃgirāstotrasya mahādeva ṛṣi[ḥ] pratyaṃgirā devatā haṁ bījaṃ svāhā śaktir mamābhīṣṭasidhaye pāṭhe viniyogaḥ || kubjikocāca || mandarasthaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ bhagavantaṃ maheśvaraṃ || samupāgamya caraṇau pārvatī paripṛ[c]chati || 1 || devy uvāca || dhāriṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṃgirā mahottamā || naranārīhitārthāya bālānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 2 || rājñāṃ māṃḍalīkānāṃ ca dīnānāṃ ca maheśvaraḥ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End oṁ raudriṇī sphe[ṃ] sphe[ṃ] mama śa[[trū]]n raudraya raudraya svāhā | oṁ saṃhāriṇī spheṃ spheṃ mama śatrūn saṃhāraya saṃhāraya svāhā oṁ śoṣiṇī spheṃ sphem mama śatrū[n] śoṣaya śoṣaya svāhā ya imāṃ dhārayed vidyāṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ vāpi yaḥ paṭhet so pi duṣṭāṃtako devi hanyāc chatrū[n] na saṃśayaḥ || 30 || sarvato rakṣayed vidyā mahābhayavipattiṣu mahābhayeṣu ghoreṣu na bhayaṃ vidyatai(!) kvacit || 31 || (fol. 6v5–7r3) Colophon iti śrīkubjikāmate caṇḍograśūlapāṇigadananirgate mahātaṃtre pratyaṅgirāśidd(!)dhimantrastavodhāra[ḥ] samāptaḥ || || ṭaṃkaṃ kapālaṃ ḍamaruṃ triśūlaṃ saṃvibhratī caṃdrakalāvatāṃsā || piṅgorddhakeśī sitabhīmadaṃṣṭrā bhūyā[d] vibhūtyai mama bhadrakālī || || iti saṃvat 1890 śubham (fol. 7r3–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṁ asya śrīpratyaṅgirāstotrasya mahādeva ṛṣir anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrīpratyaṅgirā devatā hūṃ bījaṃ svā[[hā]] śaktir mamābhiṣṭhasidhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || kubjikovāca || mandarasthaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ bhagvantaṃ maheśvaraṃ | samupāgamya caraṇau pārvatī paripṛ[c]chati || devy uvāca || dhāriṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṃgirā mahottamā | naranārīhitārthāya bālānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || rājñāṃ māṅgalikānāñ ca dīnānāñ ca maheśvara || vudūṣāṃ ca dvijātīnāṃ viśeṣād dharmasādhinī | (fol. 1v1–8) End oṁ jṛmbhiṇi mama śatrūn jṛṃbhaya 2 svāhā oṁ bhāmiṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrun(!) bhāmaya 2 svāhā oṁ raudriṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama raudraya 2 svāhā oṁ saṃhāriṇī spheṃ spheṃ mama śatrūn saṃhāaya 2 svāhā oṁ śoṣiṇi sphreṃ sphreṃ mama śatrun śoṣā śoṣaya svāhā ya imāṃ dhārayed vidyāṃ triśandhyaṃ vāpi yaḥ paṭhet | śo(!) pi duṣṭāṃ spreṃ sphreṃ 5 †yaratako† devī haṃnyān chatru[n] na saṃśayaḥ | sarvato rakṣayed vidyāṃ mahābhayavipattiṣu mahābhayeṣu ghoreṣu na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || (fol. 5r5–5v2) Colophon iti ku[bji]kāmate caṃḍograśūlapāṇīvadananrgatamahātaṃtre pratyaṃgirānamamaṃtroddhāra smāraṃ smāraṃ bhāratipādayugaṃ kāraṃ kāraṃ sadgurubhyo na ma ‥graṃthasyādau vighnarājaprasādāt svalpāraṃ bhākṣayaka rāja vaṃnditi śrīpratyaṃgirāstotraṃ samāptaṃ || su(!)bhaṃ || (fol. 5v2–6)

Beginning yasyāṃgasthā mahāvidyā pratyaṃgirā śivoditā || 15 || siddhidāsiddhavidyānāṃ vidyeyaṃ paramā smṛtā || śrīmatā ghorarūpeṇa bhāvitāgorarūpiṇī || 16 || patyaṃgirā sadā proktā ripuhanyān na saṃśayaḥ | haricaṃdanamiśreṇa rocanāṃkuṃkume || 17 || likhitvā bhurjapatraṃ tu dhāraṇī yā sadā nṛbhi[ḥ] || puṣpair dhūpair bilbapatrair nānāvalyupahārakai[ḥ] || 18 (fol. 3r1–4) End oṁ drāvini sphaiṁ sphaiṁ mama śatrūn drāvaya 2 || oṁ jṛṃbhini sphaiṁ sphaiṁ mama śatrūn jṛṃbhaya 2 || oṃ bhrāmiṇi sphaiṁ sphaiṁ mama śatrūn bhrāmaya 2 || oṁ raudrīṇi spheṁ sphaiṁ mama śatrūn tāpaya 2 || oṁ saṃhāriṇī spheṁ sphaiṁ mama śatrūn saṃhāraya 2 || oṁ pratyaṃgirā oṁ oṁ oṁ oṁ oṁ oṁ hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ hūṃ pratyeṃgiraṃ vikaṭadaṃṣṭre (fol. 7v4–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha pratyamgirāstotram || || oṁ adyehetyādiśarūpadravaśāṃtipūrvakāyur ārogyāvāptaye śrīpratyaṃgrāmālāmaṃtrapuṭiam adyārabhya yathākālaparyaṃtaṃ yathāsaṃkhyādāvṛttipāṭhaṃ kariṣye iti || || [[ācamya]] || oṁ asya śrīpratyaṃgirāmālāmaṃtrasya bhairava ṛṣir anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrīpratyaṃgirā devatā hūṃ bījaṃ hrīṁ śaktiḥ klīṁ kīlakaṃ mama śatrukṣayārthe jape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1v1–5) End mama śatrūṇāṃ mohya mohaya mama śatrūṇāṃ bhrāmaya bhrāmaya mama śatrūṇāṃ sarvāṇi marmāṇi khakhakhāhi khāhi tiṣṭa tiṣṭa baṃdha vaṃha hana hana amṛte hūṁ phaṭ svāhā || yad ramāṃ dhārayed vidyāṃ trisandhyaṃ vāpi yaḥ paṭhet lopi duḥkhāṃtako devi ripūn hanyān na saṃśayaḥ || 41 || sarvato dhārayed vidyāṃ mahābhayavipattiṣu || mahābhayeṣu sarveṣu na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || || (fol. 6v1–4) Colophon iti śrīkubjikāmate caṇḍograśūlapāṇivadanavinirgamamahātaṃtre śrīpratyaṃgirāstotram samāptam || (fol. 6v4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || namaḥ sarvadivasakalyāṇatithinakṣatramūhūrttabhadramaṃgalyarājā yat tathā gatāyārte sampan‥ buddhāya tad yathā || oṁ śodhaniviśodhanikleśaviśodhanipāpaviśodhani || prabhāsvare mahāprabhāsvaro | prabhāsvaraśarirekṣiṇi kṣiṇi sarvakalyāṇāni buddhābuddhavodhanibodhani avabodhani pratibodhani atisaṃbodhani rāgadveṣo jñite avidyāṃdhakāraviśodhani sunakṣatre sumaṃgalye siddhe susoddhe paramasiddhe dharadharadharidharipravarasiddhe nirmalānugate || (fol. 1v1–6) End sarve divasakalyāṇaṃ sarve nakṣatrabhadrakā arhanto na sravāh sarve sarve buddhā maharddhikā etena satyavākyena svsti bhavantu || sadā yānīhabhūtānāṃ samāgatānāṃ sthitāni bhumau avāntariṣe kurvantu mautrisatānāṃ prajāsudivāca rātrau ca caraṃtu dharmam || ❁ || (fol. 20v5–7) Colophon iti śrīmahāvidyāmaṃtramahāpratyaṅgirāyā svadehasarvarakṣā samāptā || yadi śuddham aśuddhaṃ vā mama doṣo na di(!)yate || (fol. 20v7–8)

Beginning aisīnakariya | gharakositāvisidhāriye || aho mahārāja jotupna ihai itapatyākariye ‥valākātīrthamo snānakariye || aiha pāśupatijīko koḍhavāla dharmeśvarajīkosavākariye || (exp. 3t1–4) End paśupatijī paśupāśavināśīsunitasudarśanako hama āśītapaye jojīvalākāvāsī kāhadurgamamātu‥dhosī || aho dharmmastu tuhyāro bhāgyate prāśarakṣā bhayo kṣatrapārakīhāthasāphīla (exp. 17b5–7)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ asya śrīprasaṃgirāstotramaṃtrasya māhādeva ṛṣiḥ || anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ || śrīpratyaṃgirā devatā || hūṃ bījaṃ || svāhā śaktiḥ || hrīṃ kīlakaṃ || mameṣṭasidhyarthe śrīpratyaṃgirā devatā prityarthe jape viniyogaḥ || maṃdarasthaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ bhagvaṃtaṃ maheśvaraṃ|| samupāgamya caraṇau pārvatī pṛ[c]chati || 1 || devy uvāca || dhāraṇī yā mahāvidyā prasaṃgirā mahodayā || naranārīhitārthāya ba(!)lānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 2 || (fol. 1v1–8) End vidyutkoṭitaḍitdhuni pratinibhāṃ protphūllanetrojvalāṃ oṁ kānvitapāhikāparivṛtātrighneśasaṃkhyair maṇaiḥ || svāṃtalīnamahāstarāṃganikarāṃ ⟨m⟩ānaṃdakaṃdākurāṃ baṃde haṃ paradevatā hitakarī prasaṃgirāṃ bhāvaye || 1 || śrīr astu śubhaṃ bhavatu ayutajapena sarvasiddhi 1 || (fol. 13r7–12)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ pratyaṃgirāyai || || oṁ asya śrīpratyaṃgirāstotrasya mahāvāmadeva ṛṣir anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ śrīpratyaṃgirā devatā mamābhīṣṭasidhyarthe pratyaṃgirāstavapāṭhe viniyogaḥ || śirasi || oṃ mahāvāmadeva ṛṣaye namaḥ || mukhe || oṃ anuṣṭupchaṃdase namaḥ || hṛdi || oṁ śrīpratyaṃgirādevatāyai namaḥ || mamābhīṣṭasidhyarthaṃ pratyaṃgirāstavapāṭhe viniyogaḥ || || (fol. 1v1–6) End ya imāṃ dhārayed vidyāṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ vāpi yaḥ paṭhet | so pi duḥkhāṃtamo devi hanyāc chatrūn asaṃśayaḥ || sarvvato vakṣāmāṃ vidye bhayeṣu ca vipattiṣu | mahābhayeṣu ghoreṣu na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || sarvvān kāmān avāpnoti sadyo devi na saṃśayaḥ || kūṭasthaṃ kurute dikṣu vidikṣu bījapaṃ ‥kaṃ | phaṭkāreṇā samopetaṃ rakṣayen sādhakottamaṃ || (fol. 9v7–10v5) Colophon iti śrīcaṃḍeśvaraśūlapāṇimahātaṃtrevinirggataṃ śivabhāṣitaṃ pratyaṃgirāstavarājaṃ samāptaṃ || || samvat 1845 pauṣaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ bhaume || śubham (fol. 10v5–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṁ namaḥ pratyaṅgirāyai taduktaṃ kubjikāmate || oṃ asya pratyaṅgirāstotramaṃtrasya mahādeva ṛṣir anuṣṭup chandaḥ pratyaṃgirā devatā hūṃ bījaṃ svāhā śakti mām(!)abhiṣṭasidhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || śrīkubjikovāca || maṃdarasthaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ bhagavantaṃ maheśvaraṃ samupāgamya caraṇau pārvvatī paripṛ[c]chati || śrīdevī uvāca || dhāriṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṃgirā mahottamā || naranārīhitārthāya bālānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || (fol. 1r1–5) End oṁ hrīṃ hraṃ phaṭ pratyaṃgire svāhā iti vipaītaprayaṃgirāmālāmaṃtraprayogavidhi[ḥ] samāptaṃ || ○ ||likhitaṃ maithilā śrījādevajī‥ śubham bhūyāt || ○ || atha pratyaṃgirāmūlamaṃta || || oṁ oṁ hūṃ hūṃ pratyaṃgirā phreṃ sphreṃ vikaṭadaṃṣṭre kāli kāli 2 sphreṃ sphreṃ phaṭkāriṇī mama sar(!)vaśatruṃ kṣedaya 2 svādaye 2 sarvvaduṣṭān māraya 2 khaṅgena chiṃddi 2 bhiṃdi 2 kici 2 rudhiraṃ sphreṃ sphreṃ kāli 2 kāli 2 mahākāḷi 2 oṁ auṃ hrīṃ krāṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || 1002 || jāpa || oṃ pratyaṃgirā mahāmāyā prasanno stu jagad ambike samarpayāmi namaḥ || ○ || || || || || || || || (fol. 10r8–10v4)

Beginning mahāṃ || || kacchapamūdrāyā bhūtaśuddhi[ḥ] || aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ ▒ ▒ ▒ ▒ śrīṁ hrīṁ aiṁ || || ātmapūjā || ▒<ref>khahraṃ</ref> ātmane candanaṃ namaḥ || ▒<ref>khahraṃ</ref> ātmane akṣataṃ namaḥ || ▒<ref>khahraṃ</ref> ātmane avīrabhasmaṃ namaḥ || (fol. 9r1–3) End aṃ aṃ aṃ amarīye vara vara vara dedyārahrūkārave gonārair nnārāntadā me jaya jaya padake koṭikarṇādhivāse | yo vīro vīravaṃdya adhigatiyato yogapīṭhopapīṭhe nutvā tvaṃ tassya nityaṃ vitara vara śubhe kāmarūpāvarīrṇaṃ || nāṃnā kṣatrāvalīyaṃ paṭhati bhayaśaḥ mantrasiṃhaṃ praśītā divyadivyādivighnāprabhavam iha bhave naiva †mīdaevipravā† || (fol. 11r5–11v4) Colophon iti śrī 3 siddhilakṣmīmate prakāśe jayadrathavidyāpīṭhe pratyaṃgiryā kṣatrāvalipīṭhe stavaṃ samāptaṃ || || pañcavali[ḥ] || jamarāsanāya pādukāṃ || śrī (fol. 11v4–6)

Beginning ❖ śrīgaṇeśojjatiḥ “atha pratyaṅgirā” adyetyādi amūkagotra amūkaśarmāhaṃ mama sarvāriṣṭaśāṃtiḥ śatrūpadravanāsapūrvvakaśatrukṣayakāma[ḥ] śrīpratyaṃgirāmālāmaṃtrastotre puti(!)tārthavanokta navava[va]rmātrā ca pā‥ ahaṃ kariṣyeti saṃkalpaḥ tatas trokoṇagarbhāṣṭadalamadmaṃ vilikhya devīṃ pūjayet atha ṛṣyādinyāsaḥ (fol. 1v1–4) End pathi(!)pāṭhitā vāpi yaḥ paṭhec caiva yaḥ paṭhet tasya śatrukṣayo nityaṃ jāyate nātra śaṃsayaḥ “sarvvato rakṣayed vidyāṃ mahābhayavipattiṣu “jale sthale cāṃtarikṣe na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || || (fol. 8r6–8v1) Colophon iti śrīca[n]drograśūlapāṇivratā †viravirgataṃ† pratyaṃgirāstotra[ṃ] samāptaṃ śubhaṃ || || (fol. 8v1)

Beginning śrīpratyaṃgirādevyai namaḥ || || oṃ namaḥ sarvasiddhiyoginībhyo namaḥ sarvasiddhimātṛkobh(!)yo namo nityoditānandananditāyai sakalakulacakranāyikāyai bhagavatyai ‥ṇḍakāpāli tad yathā oṁ hrīṁ hraṁ hrāṃ phreṁ kṣāṁ kroṁ namaḥ paramahaṃsini (fol.1v1–4) End oṁ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṁ saṃhāriṇī svpheṁ khyeṁ mama śatruṃ saṃhāraya saṃhāraya maṇībhrāmaṇīraudri tathā saṃhāriṇi ti ca staṃbhinī mohinī caiva kṣobhanidravaṇī tathā sarvatra dhāraya vidyāṃ mahābhayavipattiṣu || mahābha… …bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || || (fol. 5r6–5v2) Colophon iti śrīcandrograviracitaṃ śrīpratyaṃ…śuham astu sarvadā kāle || || śrīśāke 1738 ākhiv‥śukla…kṛṣṇapatiṃ ca pāṭhayat || || dirghāyur… (fol. 5v2–4)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīsiddhilakṣmī‥ve namaḥ || || prāta[ḥ]kṛtyaṃ || brāhme muhūrtte utthāya udaṃmukhe padmāsanaṃ kṛtvā || vāme aiṁ gurubhyo namaḥ || dakṣiṇe gaṁ gaṇapataye namaḥ || madhye phraṁ śrīmahāsiddhilakṣmīdevatāyai namaḥ || iti namaskṛtvā || hraṁ hūṁ pādadhānatrayo hraṁ phaṭ nālatrayaṃ || (exp. 3b1–4) End na deyaṃ paraśiṣyebhyo na deyaṃ jñānaśreṣṭhagau na deyaṃ nindakebhyo hi na deyaṃ garvvasaṃyute || deyaṃ śiṣyāya bhaktāya gurubhaktiparāya ca | jñānayuktāya dhīrāya dātavyam iti niścayaḥ || gopanīyaṃ prayatnena gopanīyaṃ sadā bhavet | gopanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonir iva pārvati || || (fol. 62t6–62b3) Colophon iti śrīmahākālasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīvālakaumārīdevyāṣṭhottarasahasranāmaṃ samāptaṃ || śrī 3 bālakaumārī sadā prasanno bhavatu || || śubha[m] || || || || || || (fol. 62t4–5)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrītripurāyai || || īśvara uvāca || || bālāyāḥ sadaśī(!) vidyā devatā naiva tādṛśī || bhogamokṣapradā caiva kathiteyaṃ maheśvarī || 1 || devy uvāca || yat tvayoktā mahādeva bālā sarvārthasiddhidā || bhogamokṣapradā caiva tadā siddhir na saṃśayaḥ || 2 || īśvara uvāca || || na jānāmi mahādevī lakṣaṇaṃ taṃtramaṃtrayoḥ || tene(!) daśoditaṃ vākyaṃ vācāṃ siddhikaraṃ punaḥ || 3 || kavacena vihinā yā sā vidyā na prasīdati || naiva pūjāphalaṃ vāsti upacāraśatair api || 4 || (fol. 1v1–2r5) End gopanīyaṃ prayatnena svayonir iva pārvatī || dhanaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ putrapautravivarddhanaṃ || 18 || maṃtrasiddhikaraṃ puṃsāṃ bhūtapretavināśanaṃ || devī prītikaraṃ devi kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ || 19 || idaṃ kavacam ajñātvā yo vālāṃ bhajate dhamaḥ || na tasya maṃtrasiddhi[ḥ] syāt japtair vvarṣaśatair api || 20 || (fol. 4v2–5r2) Colophon iti gaurīsārataṃtre suṃdarībālākavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaḥ || || ❁ || || śrīr astu⟨ḥ⟩ || || || kalyāṇam astuy⟨ḥ⟩ || || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || śrīḥ || || śrīḥ || || śrīḥ || || (fol. 5r2–5)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha bālātripurākavacam || śrīdevy uvāca || devadeva mahādeva bhaktānāṃ prītivarddhanam || sūcitā yā mahāvidyāḥ kvacaṃ kathayasva me || 1 || śrīmahādeva uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kavacaṃ devi durllabhaṃ aprakāśyaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ sādhanābhīṣṭasiddhidaṃ || 2 || kavacasya ṛṣir devi dakṣiṇāmūrttir avyayaḥ chaṃdaḥ paṃktisamudiṣṭaṃ devītripurasuṃdarī || 3 || dharmārthakāmamokṣārthe viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaṃ | vāgbhavaḥ kāmarājañ ca śaktibījaṃ sureśvarī || 4 || (fol. 1v1–4) End sā vidyā niravasyam astu yadi vā kiṃ vānayā ciṃtayā nūnaṃ stotram idaṃ paṭhaṣ(!)yati jano yasyāsti bhakti[s] tvayi saṃciṃtyāpi laghutvam ātmani dṛḍhaṃ saṃjāyamānaṃ haṭhāt tvadbhaktyā mukharīkṛtena racitaṃ yasmān mayāpi dhruvaṃ || 11 || ānaṃdodbhavakaṃ praccūrṇajananaṃ nidrāṭṭahāsadyutiḥ vedavyākaraṇavagāhakavitā tarkoktim u‥pradaṃ vaśyāvarṣapurapraveśanagaktī(!)bhādisiddhyaṣṭakaṃ labdhāṃ jāpyam idaṃ karopa īdaṃ yogīśvaraḥ sa dhruvaṃ || 12 || (!) gaurī tryaṃbakapatni pārvati sati(!) trailokyamātuḥ śive sarvāṇi tripure bhavāni varade rudrāṇi kātyāyini bhaume bhairavacaṃḍisarvasakale kāle kṛṇe śūlini tvatpādapraṇā(!)nād ananyamanasaḥ paryākulās trāhi naḥ || 13 || ārdram avallarajanīm araviṃdunādam ekān‥param ida[ṃ] kramikā vadanti maṃtra[ṃ] hi yena bhuvanarūpam aṃkitaṃ ca sṛṣṭisthi[ti]pralayahetum aciṃtyarūpaṃ || 14 || (!) (fol. 12r8–12v5) Colophon iti śrīlabdhācāryaviracite tripurālaghustotra[ṃ] saṃpūrṇam || śrīgaṇeºº (fol. 12v5–6)

Beginning śrīdevy uvāca || bālāpūjā śrutā nātha vidyāś ca sakalās tava sāṃprataṃ śrotum i[c]chāmi kavacaṃ maṃtravigrahaṃ || 1 || trailokyamohanaṃ nāma sarvāpadvinivāraṇaṃ | pūraiva sūcitaṃ nātha kṛpayā me prakāśaya || 2 || bhairava uvāca || devadānavavidyādhṛk pūjite prāṇavallabhe | trailokyamohanaṃ nāma kavacaṃ śrūyatāṃ paraṃ || 3 || sarvavidyāmayaṃ devi tavamaṃtramayaṃ dhruvaṃ | sarvarakṣākaraṃ sarvaṃ siddhividyāpradāyakaṃ 4 || na dadyāt paraśiṣyebhyo dadyā[c] chiṣyebhya eva ca | trailokyamohanasyāsya kavacasya ṛṣiḥ śivaḥ | 5 || chaṃdo virāṭ devatā ca bālā tripurabhairavī | caturvargeṣu vidyāyā viṣayeṣu prakīrtitā || dhyātvā hṛtkamale devīṃ śucis tadgatamānasaḥ | saṃpūrjya manasā samyak tatah kavacam ārabhet | 7 || (fol. 1r1–9) End āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ sutapatnīvivarddhanaṃ | siddhasārasvataṃ nāma viṣāṇāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavet || ṣaṭkarmasiddhidaṃ stotraṃ sadyas trailokyamohanaṃ || vakrāraviṃdamakaraṃdarasāvalepāṃ pānapramatacalitālikulālakāṃtāṃ | (fol. 4r6–10) Colophon iti bālāṣṭottaraśatanāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || || śrīr astu || (fol. 4r10–11)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrībālātripurasundaryyai namaḥ || śrīdevy uvāca | bālāpūjāyutā nātha vidyāñ ca sakalās tava || sāṃprataṃ śrotum icchāmi kavacaṃ maṃtravigrahaṃ || 1 || trailokyamohanaṃ nāma sarvāpadvinivāraṇaṃ || puraiva sūcitaṃ nātha kṛpayā me prakāśaya || 2 || || śrībhairava uvāca || || devadānavavdyādhṛk pūjite prāṇavallabhe || trailokyamohanaṃ nāma ka[[va]]caṃ śrūyatāṃ paraṃ || 3 || sarvavidyāmayaṃ devi tava maṃtramayam dhruvaṃ || sarvarakṣākaraṃ sarvasiddhividyāpradāyakaṃ || 4 || (fol. 1v1–6) End paṃcavarṣasahasrāṇaṃ pūjāphalam avāpnuyāt || bhūrje vilikya guṭikāṃ svarṇasthāṃ dhārayed yadi || 22 || puruṣo dakṣiṇe bāhau yoṣiddhāmabhuje tathā || tadgātraṃ prāpya śastrāṇi brahmāstrādīni bharavi || 23 || mālyāni kusumāny eva bhavaṃti sukhadāni ca || tasya g⟨e⟩ṛ sthirā lakṣmī bāṇīvaktre vased dhruvaṃ || 24 || || (fol. 3r4–3v1) Colophon iti śrībhaiavataṃtre śrībālākavacaṃ sampūrṇam || || śubham || || śrīrāmaḥ || || rāmaḥ || || rāmaḥ || || rāmaḥ || || rāmaḥ || || (fol. 3v2–3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīdevyai namaḥ || oṁ pratyaṃgirāya namaḥ || oṁ asya śrīpratyaṃgirāmaṃtrasya mahādeva ṛṣir anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ pratyaṃgirā devatā hrīṁ bījaṃ hūṁ śaktiḥ klĩṁ kīlakaṃ sarvāpacchāntaye viniyogaḥ || oṁ maṃdarasthaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ maheśvaraṃ || samupāgamya caraṇau pārvatī paripṛ[c]chati || 1 || devy uvāca || dhāriṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṃgirā mahodayā || naranārīhitārthāya bālānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End sarvopahārasaṃpanno raktavastraphalādibhiḥ || puṣpai[r] suraktavarṇaiś ca sādhayet kālikāṃ parāṃ || varṣād urdhvam ajaśreṣṭaṃ mṛgaṃvāvidhivadvaliṃ || marīcalājālavaṇaiḥ sarṣpair māraṇaṃ bhavet || mahāsaṃkaṭaroge ca na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || pretapiṃḍaṃ samādāya golakaṃ kārayet tataḥ || sādhyānām āṃkitā kṛtvā śatrūmayīṃ ca puttalīm || jīvaṃ tatra nidhāyaiva citāgnau prakṣipet tatah || ekāyutaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā trirātrau māraṇaṃ ripo[ḥ] || mahājvaro bhavet tasyā tāmrasya ca śalākayā || gṛhadvāre pravinyasya saptāhān māraṇaṃ dhruvaṃ || || (fol. 7r7–7v4) Colophon iti caṇḍeśvaraśūlapāṇimahātaṃtre haragaurīsaṃdāde pratyaṃgirāstavarājaḥ samāptiṃ †paphāṇa† || || śāke 1772 saṃvat 1902 likhitaṃ kṛṣṇalālaśarmaṇaḥ || || || || (fol. 7v4–6)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṁ asya śrībālātripurasundarīkhaḍgamālāmaṃtrasya dakṣiṇāmūrti ṛṣiḥ || śirasi || anuṣṭupchaṃdaḥ || mukheḥ || śrībālā || parameśvarī devatā hṛdaye aiṁ bījaṃ || nābhau klīṁ śaktiḥ || guhye || sauṁ kīlakaṃ || pādayoḥ || bālātripurasundarīprasādasidhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1r1–4) End kim anyaikahutivācā || kathite girinaṃdanī || jihvākoṭhi || sahastreṇa || purṇanākhyātum iś(!)vara[ḥ] || 14 || etasya paṭhanād devī || dhārāṇād vālikhat tava || satyaṃ ca sādhakaṃ satyaṃ sākṣā[d] devamayaṃ śivaḥ || || aiṁ namaḥ | 220 || (fol. 17r2–5) Sub-Colophon1 oṁ namo bhagavate śrīmadbālātripurasuṃdarīkhaḍgamālā || saṃpūrṇam astu rudrayāmale haragaurīsaṃvāde mālāmaṃtrasaṃpūrṇam astu || || ha mādhavarāvasāvājīpustakasvāsagataśrīrāmārpaṇam astu saṃ || 1901 || po. ba 2 || (fol. 5r8–10) Sub-Colophon2 śrīrudrayāmale || ūmāmaheśvarasaṃvāde tripurasundarīkavaca[ṃ] saṃpūrṇam astu || śrī || || sa[ṃ]mat(!) 1901 rāke 1766 moṣāvadya1 ha || mādhavarāvasāvājīpustaka || kakhāsagavaśrīrāmārpaṇam atu || (exp. 9b6–9) Colophon śrīrudrayāmale śivapārvatīsaṃvāde bālātripurasuṃdarīsahasranāmastotra[ṃ] saṃpūrṇam astu || śubhaṃ bhavatu || || mītī(!) aśāḍha śuddha || ❖ || saṃmat(!) || 1901 || śa(!)ke 1766 || mu || †gvālera† || ha || snākṣaramāghavarāvasāvājīvi‥ pustakasvāsagataśrīrāmārpaṇam astu⟨ḥ⟩ || (fol. 17r5–9)

Beginning || || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || ātmā(!)tatvāya svāhā || vidyātatvāya svāhā || śivatattvāya svāhā || ity ācamya sarvatatvāya namaḥ || iti jalam utsṛjet || viniyogaṃ kuryāt || asya maṃtrasya dakṣiṇāmūrtir ṛṣiḥ paṃktiś chaṃdas tripurābālā devatā sauṁ bījaṃ klīṁ śkaktir iṣṭārthe jape viniyoga || sakṣiṇāmurttaye ṛṣaye namaḥ śirasi || paṃktiś chandase namo mukhe || śrītripurābālā devatāyai namo hṛdi || sauṁ bījāya namo guhye || klīṁ śaktaye namaḥ pādayoḥ || (exp. 3a1–3b4) End mahālakṣmīṃ tataḥ paścād daleṣv eṣu bhajet sadā || asītāṃgo ruruś caiva krā(!)dhanotmattabhairavau || 11 || kapālī bhīṣaṇaś caiva saṃhāram antataḥ paraḥ || sarvadā taddalāgreṣu pūjanīyā yathākramam || 12 || ānandakusumānaṃgamekhalā madanāturā || anaṃgaveginī paścād anaṃgamadanāśrayā || 13 || anaṃgāṃkuśarekhākhyā tataḥ paṃcāṃgamālīnī || etaddalāge nityaṃ vā pūjanīyā yathākramam || 14 || i⟨ṃ⟩ndrādilokapālaiś ca pūjayet bhūpuradvayam || evaṃ krameṇa pūjayo haṃ devī pūjyā ca sarvadā || 15 || (exp. 22t3–23t3) Colophon iti śrībhairavayāmale bālāstavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ || ❁ (exp. 23t3–4)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrībālādevyai || || devy uvāca || śrotum i[c]chāmy haṃ [[deva]] bālāhṛdayam uttamaṃ || kṛpāṃ kṛtvā maheśāna yady ahaṃ tava vallabhā || 1 || śṛṇu devī varārohe bālāhṛdayam uttamaṃ || ⟨e⟩[ye]na vijñānamātreṇa sādhakaṃ siddhibhāg bhavet || 2 || yad jñātvā dānavān bhikṣuḥ līlayā na hṛtāraṇe || sūryo pi tejasā rāśī candro pi caṇḍikāpatiḥ || 3 || īsopy aha(!) samāsādya devadevādhipo bhavet || sāvitryā(!)dhipati brahmā yatprabhāvān maheśvarī || 4 || (fol. 1v1–6) End vidhāya līlāṃ bhuvane tathāṃte nirāmayaṃ brahmapadaṃ prayāti || dharāsatyatrivṛttāṣṭhapatravasvaśranāgareḥ || 4 || piṇḍipīṭhe ca yad vālo yo sau prāṃte priyo bhavet || iti yaṃtramayaṃs tasthyaṃ(!) paṭhed yas tripurāyā niśi vaniśāvaśāneḥ || (!) bhaved raviśārvabhaumamaulīs tridiveśakranamānasauryalakṣmī || 5 || iti taṃ devī bālāyās totraṃ taṃta(!)mayaṃ paraṃ⟨ḥ⟩ || na dātavya⟨ṃ⟩m abhaktebhyo gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || (fol. 32r4–32v4) Colophon itī(!) śrīumāmaheśvarasaṃvāde sundarīstotraṃ || śūbhaṃ || hṛdaya 1 kavaca 2 satanāma 3 sahasranāma 4 stotraṃ 5 ete paṃcāṃgapā(!)thakramastutī (!) || ❁ || vedāḥ khagaja aikaśākamilite vaiśāṣamāse siteḥ || kṛṣṇe ekatithu tathā su(!)bhadine vāre sya aṃgā tathā || 1 || vipraśrīyugarājavālaṣakṛtā ‥ṣin midaṃ puṣṭakaṃ || śrīramaṇo maithalīsya sarmaṇa ‥‥nāyet(!)dātavyaṃ puṣṭakaṃ || || || || || śubhaṃ yo poṣṭhakako talatiramāyomitīleṣmākonaharā unuhos harā īrākṣobhanyā paṃcamahāpātakalā ndacha(!) (fol. 32v4–33r6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || pārvaty uvāca || bhagavan sarvadharmajña[ḥ] sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ | pṛ[c]chāmi tvāṃ suraśreṣṭha bālāyāḥ kavacaṃ śubhaṃ || 1 || yena vijñānamātreṇa trailokyaṃ vaśayet kṣaṇāt || śrīr lakṣmīr yaśa ārogyaṃ siddhir nānāvidhā smṛtā || 2 || yātu karmāṇi mukhyāni sidhyaṃti yatprasādataḥ || sā māyā paramā mukti[r] hetubhūtā sanātanī || 3 || yā mūlaprakṛti[ḥ] jñeyā brahmaprāptimayī sadā || tasyāstu kavacaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ sadā || 4 || (fol. 1v1–2r3) End tasmāt sarvatra yuktena kavacaṃ paṭhate sadā || mamtrasiddhiḥ prajāyeta varṣamātreṇa suṃdari || 28 || bālātripurasauṃdaryā kavacaṃ devadurllabhaṃ pūrvajanmani deveśi kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ yadā bhavet || 29 || rasarudramite pātre sadādīpaṃ sa kārayet || goghṛtena prakartavyaṃ homaṃ caiva tathā kuru || 30 || aṣṭadalaṃ trikoṇaṃ ca biṃduyuktaṃ tu bhāmini || śrī || || (fol. 6r4–6v3) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale bālātripurākavacam saṃpūrṇaṃ || || saṃvat 1812 nā bhādrapadāśudi 2 some la(!)ṣitaṃm idaṃ (fol. 6v5–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || oṁ asya śrībālātripurāmaṃtrasya dakṣiṇāmūrtti ṛṣaye namaḥ si(!)rasi | paṃkti[c]chaṃdase namaḥ mukhe | bālādevatāyai namaḥ || hṛdaye || aiṁ bījāya namaḥ nābhau || sauḥ śkataye namaḥ guhye | klīṁ kīlakāya namaḥ pādayo[ḥ] śrībālāprasādasidhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || || atha nyāsaḥ || || aiṁ aṁguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ klĩṃ tarjjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | (fol. 1–3) End sarvādanaṃ mayaṃ sadāśivapadaṃ dvaṃdvaikam uktiṃ pradaṃ sāmrājyaṃ sukhadaṃ manorathakaraṃ ajñānavidhvaṃsanaṃ āyu[ḥ]kīrtiyaśodhivarttanakarasaṃsāramohatpradaṃ yānaṃ na [na]vanāthaśaktinavakaṃ prauḍhaṃ pratāpoditaṃ || 9 || kare mālā mukhe hālā vāme vālā ca śobhitā || hṛdaye tripurā bālā yajñaśālā gṛhe gṛhe || || śubhaḥ (fol. 5v4–6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || aiṃ ātmatatvāya namaḥ | klīṁ vidyātatvāya namaḥ | saūm⟨ḥ⟩ śivatatvāya namaḥ | ācamya || asya śrītripurāvālāmaṃtrasya dakṣiṇāmurtti ṛṣiḥ paṃkti[c]chandaḥ triurāvālā devatā aiṁ vijaṃ klīṁ śakti[ḥ] sauṁ⟨ḥ⟩ kilakaṃ tripurā bālā devatāprītaye ṛṣyādiṣāḍaṃganyāse jape viniyogaḥ || (fol. 1v1–6) End akhaṇḍamaṃḍalākāraṃ vyāptaṃ yena carācaraṃ tatpadaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ namo stu gurave tasmai parabrahmasvarupiṇe yasya vāgamṛtaṃ haṃti viṣaṃ saṃsārabaṃdhanam gurubhyo nama paramagurubhyo namaḥ parātparagurubhyo namaḥ parameṣṭigurubhyo namaḥ tataḥ kavacastotrādi paṭhet śubhaṃ bhūyāt śrīaṃbikāyai namaḥ || ○ || (fol. 2v7–3r3)

Beginning śrīḍhuṃḍhirājāya namaḥ || oṁ namo sarvavedāya || brahmaloke sukhāsīnaṃ sarvalokaguruṃ śivaṃ || sarvadevamayaṃ sākṣāt sarvatejomayam paraṃ || 1 || sarvavidyāparaṃ śaśvat jñānopāyārṇavaṃ parāṃ | praṇamya sarvadevāś ca ṛṣayaḥ praṣṭum āgatāḥ || 2 || vasiṣṭho vāmadevaś ca jābāliḥ kapilas tathā || nāradaś ca śukaḥ kaṇvo viśvāmitraś ca kaśyapaḥ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End śrīś ca kubjī mahākubjī kālikā guhyakālikā tripurā‥rijñā nityā trilokye vijayā jayā || jitā parājitā devi japaṃtī bhadrakālikā || siddhilakṣmīr mahālakṣmīḥ kālarātri[r] || 4 || kālī karālavikrāṃje kālike pāpahāriṇi || vikarālamukhe devi jvālāmukhi nami stu te || 5 || (fol. 15r6–15v2) Colophon iti pratyaṃgirāstotraṃ samāptaṃ || gāyatrījātavedābhyāṃ pratyaṃgirāmaṃtraṃ saṃpuṭitaṃ kṛtvā ādau rākavāraṃ japet | japāṃte gāyatrījñātavedobhyo ca japet | ākṣāvaṃte ca naṃ choyor iti datrāvāraṃ hṛdayaspṛṣṭvā japet oṁ śāṃtiḥ śāṃtiḥ śāṃtiḥ | satvaṃ lāraśākhī pakalpa samāptaḥ | śrībhavānīśaṃkarābhyāṃ namaḥ || ṣaṭphaṭ jahi hṛdayāya namaḥ mahākṛtyeśi hāvidhūmāgne śikhāyai śi ṣaṭ samaprameka huṁ | jahi śatrūs triśūlena netra vauṣaṭ | krudhyasvapivaśoṇitaṃ a. phaṭ rānakarādi iti mūlamaṃteṇā aṃganyāsā || yo ma ityādi ātmarakṣāṃ karoti || ❁ śrīḥ śrīḥ śrīḥ || (fol. 15v2–16r2)

Beginning lapradā || 13 || namaḥ svāhā ca vauṣaṭ ca hūṁkāravaṣāḍamtrake | etanmantrāmahādevī manrarūpāvatāriṇī || 15 || ādhāre tu sthitā devī ‥jagnakuṭilākṛti | sarppakkuṇḍalanī śaktir agamyāgamyacāriṇī || 14 || sanais sanaiḥ pracāreṇa brahmāṇḍadvābhedinī | aṇimādimahāsiddhir ṛddhisiddhipradāyinī || 1⟨4⟩[6] || pañcātmā piṇḍasaṃyuktā rādyalakṣmīpradāyinī | lakṣmīr varddhayate devī dīpakaṃ parameśvarī || 17 || sthūlarūpā maheśāni navatyādiśatadvaye | saptādaseṣa navamasapapañcaśaḍākṣare || 18 || ekākṣare mahādevī sūkṣmarūpā ca te namaḥ | ete mantrā mahādevi mantramātar maheśvarī || 19 || (exp. 2.1–3b4) End tvaṃ gaurī tvaṃ śivā tvaṃ naṭa iva vividhākārajālatvam ekā || mātaḥ pādāraviṃde dvayamadhūkaraniratāsvādayasvaitadīye sadyaś cittadvirehe vitarabhagavati snehayuktatvatkaṭākṣāiḥ | kṣonīºpālāham āṃgatpharitamanigaṇaprācchalacvānavīcī dhautāṃhnitvaṃ pradante guruvaravacane prahṛtatvaṃ maheśi || 6 || (fol. 31t3–32t1)

Beginning lānandarasikā munīndrā apy avyayaprakṛtipuruṣāsthānam amalaṃ || śrīnāthapūrvvanirvvāṇaṃ ca varaṇaṃ parapāvakaṃ | kūlaṃ kāmagavīḍakta raktau niṣkalarūpakau || sakalau ca tadā‥‥/// sadāśiva (exp. 2.1–3t4) End sarvaṃ tasya vaśaṃ yāti prāṇitāś ca caturvidhā varṣam ekaṃ paṭhe(!) bhaktyā kavacaṃ viṣṇunirmmataṃ || 70 || sa tu sarvvatrin vinirjitya rājārājo bhaved dhruvaṃ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena paṭhanīyaṃ sadā budhai[ḥ] || 71 || || ‥‥ śrōvavōyāmalapratyaṃgirākava (exp. 39t2–39b4)

Beginning pārvatī paripṛ[c]chati || 1 || śrīpārvaty uvāca || dhāraṇī paramā vidyā pratyaṃgirā mahodayā || naranārīhitārthāya bālānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 2 || rājñāṃ māṇḍalikānāṃ ca dīnānāṃ ca maheśvarī || viduṣāṃ ca dvijātīnāṃ viśeṣeṇārthasādhinī || 3 || (fol. 2r1–5) End madhye nāmāṃkitāṃ kṛtvā śatrumayīṃ ca pūtalī || jīvaṃ tatra vidhāyaiva citāgnau prakṣipet tataḥ || ekāyutaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā trirātrān maraṇaṃ ripoḥ || mahājvaro bhavet tasya tamatāmtraśalākayā || gudadvāre pravinyasya saptāhān maraṇaṃ ripoḥ || (fol. 16v5–174r) Colophon iti śrīcaṇḍeśvaraśūlapāṇimahātaṃtravinirgatagaurīsaṃvāde pratyaṃgirāstavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || ❁ || (fol. 17r4–6)

Beginning bhayāt || rājadaṇḍabhayāt || nāgadaṇḍabhayāt || vidyu[t]bhayāt || ‥śumṛgabhayāt || deva‥hāt || nāgagrahāt || asuragrahāt || marutagrahāt || garuḍagrahāt || gaṃdharvagrahāt || kiṃnaragrahāt || (fol. 7r1–3) End rājabhayāt || carabhayāt || udakabhayāt || viṣabhayāt || śastrabhayāt || praracakrabhayāt || iti kṣubhayāt || asalibhayāt || akālamṛtyubhayāt || dharaṇīkapa (fol. 7v4–5)

Beginning svasti śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || || śrībhavānyai namaḥ || || kailāśaśikhare ramye devadevaṃ jagadguruṃ || dhyānoparatam āsīnaṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajaṃ || 1 || surāsuraśiroratnaṃ raṃjitāṃghriyugaṃ vibhuṃ || praṇamya naṃdiko deva(!) baddhāṃjalir abhāṣata || 2 || || (fol. 1v1–5) End te dhanyāḥ kētapuṇyās te ta eva bhū(!)vi pūjitāḥ || ekabhāvaṃ sadā nityaṃ ye rccayaṃti mahaśvarīṃ || 251 || daivatānāṃ devatā yā brahmādyair yā ca pujitā⟨ḥ⟩ || bhūyāt sā varadā loke sādhūnāṃ viśvamaṃgalā || 252 || (fol. 33v6–34r2) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale naṃdikeśvarasaṃvāde bhavānīsahasranāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ || śubham || || śāke khāgnigarūpabheditiśubhe yoge jñavārorjjage sūrye mārgavadī tithert(!) tudivase lagne ghaṭa(!) saṃyute || likhet śarmagaṇgādharakaraḍiyādhīmāṃ paṭhet sarvadā nāpatyaṃ vijayai sadābhila(!)khitaiḥ satputrapautrārthakaiḥ || ||<ref name="ftn1"> pāda c is unmetrical. </ref> śrī3bhavānīśaṃkarebhya[ḥ] namaḥ (fol. 34r2–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrībhavānyai namaḥ || kailāśaśikhare ramye devadvaṃ maheśvaram || dhyānoparatam āsīnaṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajam || 1 || surāsuraśiroratnaraṃjitāṃghriyugaṃ prabhum || praṇamya naṃdiko devaṃ baddhāṃjalir abhāṣata⟨ṃ⟩ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End daivatānāṃ devatā yā brahmādyair yā ca pūjitā || bhūyāt sā varadā loke sādhūnāṃ viśvaṃgala[m] || 2 || (fol. 16r6–7) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale mahātaṃtre śrīmaheśvarasaṃvāde śrībhavānīsahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || śubhaṃ bhūyāt || saṃvat 1820 || kārttikamāse śuklapakṣe ekādaśyāṃ samāptam || || (fol. 16r7–8)

Beginning oṁ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || kailāsaśiṣare ramye devadevaṃ maheśvaraṃ || dhyānoparatam āsīnaṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajaṃ || 1 || surāsuraśiroratnaraṃjirāṃ(!)hi(!)yugaṃ prabhuṃ || prana(!)mya naṃdiko devaṃ baddhāṃjalir abhāṣata⟨ṃ⟩ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End devatānāṃ devatādyābrahmādyai[r] yā ca pūjitā || bhūyāt sā varadā loke sādhūnām ādyamaṃgala[m] | (fol. 24r2–3) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmalataṃtre naṃdikeśvarasaṃvāde bhavānīsahasranāmastava[ḥ] samāpta⟨ṃ⟩[ḥ] || || śrīśāke 1638 bhādrapada tithī 30 vāre 2 nakṣatre 10 (fol. 24r4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśo jayatī(!) śrībhīmarājāya namaḥ oṁ bhīmarūpaṃ mahākrodhaṃ raktavarṇaṃ sutejasam vāyupū(!)trāya vīrāya bhairavāya namo stu te 1 pārvaty uvāca devadeva mahādeva sarvatra sukha[ṃ] saṃbhavet āpadduḥkhadaridrāya pi(!)ḍī(!)tānāṃ nṛṇāṃ vibho 2 (fol. 1v1–3) End †śādhavaṃ† sarvalokeṣu śatyaṃ śatyaṃ na śaṃsayaḥ bhīmaśeno mahāśūro manaḥkāmaphalaṃ labhet 19 (fol. 2v6–7) Colophon itī(!) śrīddāmalatantre umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde bhīmaśenaka[va]caṃ saṃpūrṇam śubham śrīsadāśiva śrīśāka 1788 samvat 1923 māśe pauṣaśukla 12 roja 5 (fol. 2v6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīdevy uvāca || bhuvaneśyāś ca deveśa yā yā vidyāḥ prakāśitaḥ(!) || śrutāś cādhigatāḥ sarvāḥ śrotum icchāmi sān(!)prataṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End etat kavacam ajñātvā yo japed bhuvaneśvarīṃ || dāridryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya so cirān mṛtyum āpnut<ref name="ftn1"> for āpnuyāt </ref> || 32 || || (fol. 4v4–6) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale devī iśvarasamvāde<ref name="ftn2"> for devīśvarasamvāde </ref> śrībhuvaneśvarīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ samāptaḥ(!) || || ādarśadoṣān mativibhramād vā varātaviśeṣā<ref name="ftn3"> for tvarāviśeṣāl </ref> likhitasya vegāt || yadarthabhraṣṭan tadaśubhravarṇa[ṃ] kṣamantu santa khalu rekhasyaḥ<ref name="ftn4"> for lekhakasya </ref> || || śubham astu sarvvadā || || || bhuvaneśvarīdevyai namaḥ || (fol. 4v6–5r3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṁ śrībhuvaneśvaryai namaḥ || śrīdevy uvāca || bhuvaneśvaryā(!) devatāyā yā yā vidyāḥ prakāśitāḥ || śrutāś cādhigatāḥ sarvāḥ śrotum icchāmi sāṃprataṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End etat kavacam ajñātvā yo japed bhuvaneśvari(!)ṃ dāridryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya sācirāt mṛtyum āpnuyāt || || (fol. 4r4–5) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale taṃtre bhuvanesvari(!)kavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || śubham astu | saṃvat 1856 vaiśākhkṛṣṇa 4 lī(!)khitaṃ viṇīrāma śukravāra || prathama (saga) || || || || || || || (fol. 4r6–7)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrībhuvaneśvaryyai⟨ḥ⟩ || || devy uvāca || bhuvanevaryyāś ca deveśa yā yā vidyāḥ prakāsitā[[ḥ]] || śrutāś cādhigatāḥ sarvvāḥ śrotum icchāmi sāmprataṃ || 1 || (fol. 1r1–2) End brahmāstrādīni śastrāṇi, naiva kṛṃtati taṃ janaṃ || etat kavacam ajñātvā, yo bha⟨v⟩[j]ed bhuvaneśvarīṃ || 31 || dāridryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya so cirān mṛtyum āpnuyāt || 32 || || (fol. 4r4–6) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale devīśvarasamāde trailokyamaṃgalaṃ nāma śrībhuvaneśvarīkavacaṃ samāptam śubham bhūyāt || (fol. 4r6)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeṇaye namah || śrīharagorīye namaḥ || oṁ devadeva maheśān || madyahaṃ preyasi tava || paṭhale śrībālādevyā || stadā tn me prakaśa || ya || śrīīśvara ūvāca || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi || devi guhyatamottamaṃ || || yena vijñānamātreṇa || sādhako bhairavo bhavet || 2 || (fol. 1r1–4) End sīṃhavyāghrān tathā sarpān bhūtavetālarā || kṣasān || darśānād eva vaśyeti || tilakaṃ dhārayetu yāḥ || 57 || ity eṣe || paṭhalaṃ guhyo maṃtrarājamayo dhruvaḥ || sarvatatraika sarvasvaṃ || gopanīyaṃ || mumukṣibhi || (fol. 5r5–8) Colophon īti śrīviśvasāroghāre śrītripurasundarībālāpa || ṭhala saṃpūrṇam astu śubhaṃ bhavatu saṃ || 1901 || mārgisīrṣa śu(ddha) 15 || || haḥ mādhavarāvasāvājīviṃsapustaka rāmārpaṇam astuḥ || || || || || || (fol. 5r8–10)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || karṇa⟨ḥ⟩svarṇavilolakuṇḍaladharām āpīnavakṣoruhāṃ mukhāhāravibhūṣaṇāṃ parilasad ddhammillasanmīlikāṃ || līlālālitalocanāṃ śaśimukhīm ābaddhakāṃcīsrajaṃ divyaṃtīṃ bhuvaneśvarī⟨ṃ⟩m anu⟪bhaje⟫[[dinaṃ]] vaṃdāmahe mātaraṃ || 1 || atha saṃnamyādimahormimālākulitasya sakalendriyamakarakulāvadurāvagāhasthānavarataprabhūtabhavanmohamahā-bhramarasyasaṃsāravārā[ṃ]nidheḥ prataraṇāya satpotam iva sakalasaṃpadām āspadaṃ yasyāḥ prasādam āsādya caturacturānano pi sargādau nikhilanigamāditāś ca vidyāḥ samakurayāṃ cakāra || (fol. 1v1–4) End idānīṃ stotrasyāciṃtyamahimānam āha || || ko py aciṃtyaprabhāvo sya stotrasya pratyayāvahaḥ || śrīśaṃbhor ājñayā sarvāḥ siddhayo smin pratiṣṭhitā[ḥ] || 46 || || asya stotrasya ko pi aciṃtyaprabhāvaḥ pratyayāvaho varttate pratītijanako bhavatī yataḥ kāraṇāt śrīśaṃbhor ājñayā sarvāḥ aṇimādyāḥ siddhayaḥ asmin pratiṣṭhitāḥ || āropitāḥ || a evāciṃtyamahimastotram ity arthaḥ || padmanābhena kavinā vipulā vimalā kṛtā || śrīmat pṛthvīdharanute vṛttiḥ sadyuktidīpitā || 47 || || (fol. 16r8–16v1) Colophon iti śrīpadmanābhaviracitaṃ bhuvaneśvarīstotrabhāṣyaṃ samāptaṃ || || oṁ aiṁ hrīṁ klīṁ hrīṁ bhuvaneśvaryai namaḥ || yo vinduḥ sa pitāmaho harir asau turyyaḥ svaraḥ kīrtyate yo ra(!)pho<ref name="ftn1"> Probably for repho </ref> duritaughamardanakaro devaiḥ sadā gīyate || haḥ prāṇaḥ sa paraḥ sa eva bhagavān nādaḥ śivaḥ sarvadā devī candrakalākalaṃkarahitā māyeti tubhyaṃ namaḥ || 1 || ... dayād<ref name="ftn2"> probably for deyāt </ref> dayānupavano draviṇāṃbudhārā⟪ṃ⟫m asminn akiṃcanavihaṃgaśiśau (vidhasye) || duḥkarma dharmam apanīyacirāya dūrān nārāyaṇapraṇayinīnayanāṃbuvāhaḥ || 5 || || śubham astu || ❁ (fol. 16v1–3 and 7–8)

Beginning || śrīgaṇesāya nama[ḥ] || || oṁ namo durgāyai⟨ḥ⟩ || || kailāśaśikharāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ maheśvaram || bhavānī rahasi prītyā papraccha varadāyakam || 1 || śrīdevy uvāca || kathaye(!) śāstrasarvajña lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || śrīdevy uvāca || | vināṣṭajopacāreṇa vinā dhyānena yat phalam || japaṃ vinā vinā nyāsaṃ vinā paryaṭanena vā (fol. 1v1–5) End brāhmaṇī caiva bhekaṃḍā muṃḍāṃgī muṃḍabhūṣaṇā || citāsthitā nirmalā ca vimalā savavāhinī || nirmalā bhāskarī śvetā śvetaca⟨ṃ⟩ndanabhūṣaṇā | ci⟪ṃ⟫tāṃgārā ca citrā ca vicitrī kṣudraghaṃṭikā || || ❁ || || || || || || || || | || ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ || rāma || ❁ ❁ || śrī || || || ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ (fol. 9v1–7) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || ādhāraśaktir asi yā jagatas tvam ekā sarvātmasarvasadasadguṇabhedaśaktiḥ || brahmātmikā sṛjasi viśvam anaṃtam itthaṃ mātaḥ praīda bhuvaneśvari mā medāre || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2) End gaurīśvareṇa ghaṭito jhaṭiti tvadīyo māta[ḥ] stavo yam amalo bhavatān mudete || etat prapāṭhakajanāya subhāvine tvaṃ vidyāṃ dharaṃ sutatatiṃ sukham āśu dehi || 9 || (fol. 2r6–8) Colophon iti śrīgaurīśvaramahāpaṃḍitaviracito bhuvaneśvarīstavaḥ samāptaḥ || || śubhaṃ || || ( (fol. 2r8)

Beginning namaḥ śrīdurgāyai || || athānaṃdamayīṃ sākṣāc chabdabrahmasvarūpiṇīṃ || īḍe sakalasaṃpattyai jagatkāraṇam aṃbikāṃ || 1 || ādyām aśeṣajananīm araviṃdayoner viṣṇoḥ śivasya ca vapuḥ pratipādayitrīṃ || sṛṣṭisthitikṣayakarīṃ jagatāṃ trayāṇāṃ stutvā giraṃ vimalayāmy aham aṃbike tvāṃ || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End śrutisucaritapākaṃ śrīmatāṃ stotram etat paṭhati ya iha matyor nitym ārdrātarātmā || sa bhavati padam uccaiḥ saṃpadāṃ pādanamra- kṣitipamukuṭalakṣmī lakṣaṇānāṃ cirāya || 25 || || (fol. 3v4–6) Colophon iti taṃtrasāre bhuvaneśvarīstotraṃ samāptaṃ || || ṛtvakṣādrikamite śāke caitre site ṣṭamyāṃ likhitaṃ || śubham || (fol. 3v6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīgajānanaprasan(!) || harihiḥ 2 om || śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ ātmano amukasya vā amukakarma kartuṃ śarīraśudhyarthaṃ bhūtaśūddhiṃ kariṣye || iti saṃkalpa[ḥ] āsanabaṃdhaṃ kṛtvā || (fol. 1v1–3) End tvaṃ māle sarvadevānāṃ prītidā śubhadā mama | śubhaṃ kuruṣva me bhadre yaśo vīryaṃ ca sarvadā || 2 || guhyādiguhyagoptā tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japaṃ || siddhir bhavatu me deva tvatprasādān maheśvara || 3 || iti maṃtreṇa devasya dakṣiṇahastenaivedya(!) || ‥ || (fol. 12r4–7) Colophon bhūtaśuddhi[ḥ] samāptaḥ || ity upa⟪‥⟫nāmnā jāmakheḍakarakṛṣṇabhaṭṭena likhitaṃ || || ❁ || iti bhūtaśuddhi[ḥ] samāptaḥ || ❁ || śrīgajānanaprasan(!) || ❁ || (fol. 12r7–12v1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrībhairavāya namaḥ || merupṛṣṭe sukhāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ trilocanam || saṃkaraṃ paripapraccha pārvatī parameśvarī || 1 || pārvaty uvāca || bhagavan sarvadharmajña sarvaśāstrāgamādiṣu || āpaduddhāraṇaṃ maṃtraṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End bhairavo pi prahṛṣṭo bhūt s svayaṃ ca maheśvaraḥ || evaṃ śṛutvā tato devi⟪ī⟫ nāmāṣṭaśatam uttamam || 73 || saṃtoṣaṃ paramaṃ prāpya bhairavasya mahātmanaḥ || jajāpa parayā bhaktyā sadā sarveśvareśvari⟪ī⟫ || 74 || (fol. 13v2–6) Colophon iti śrī///rudrayāmale ḍamarutaṃtre umāmaheśvara(samvāde) ///ravo devatā bhairavastotrarājaḥ sampūrṇam || śrīsāke 1815 || miti samvat 1950 sāla sauramānena mārgacāndreṇa kārttikaśuklena 9 roja 7 śubham || || (fol. 13v6–14r4)

«Beginning of 1. Bālāstotra:» śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śvetapadmāsanāṛūḍhāṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibhām || vande vāgdeva⟪‥⟫tāṃ dhyātvā devīṃ tripurasundarīm || 1 || śailādhirājatanayāṃ śaṃkarapriyavallabhām || taruṇendranibhāṃ vande devīṃ tripurasundarīm || || 2 || (exps. 2 l. 1–3t1) «End of 5. Bālāstotra:» iti dvādaśabhiḥ ślokaiḥ stavanaṃ sarvasiddhikṛt || devyās tvaṃ khaṇḍarūpāyāḥ stavanas tava paṭhyate || 13 || toya tattvamayīvyāptir iti samyakpradarśitā || asyā niṣphalam ādhiṃ te tattvaṃ svātmacasākṛtam || 14 || (exps. 19t3–b1) «Colophon of 5. Bālāstotra:» iti śrīrudrayāmale śrībālāstotram || sampūrṇam || śubham || idaṃ pustakaṃ likhitam idaṃ tārānidhiarjyālaśrmaṇā⟨ḥ⟩ śubham || ❁ || ❁ || (fol. 19b1–4)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīpārvaty uvāca || || guṇādhīśa mahādeva rahasyaṃ vada satvaham || bālādevyāḥ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ stavarājāhvayaṃ prabho || 1 || i(!)śvara uvāca || || śṛṇu prāṇapriye vakṣye stavarājaṃ mahāphalam || kena kasya cidākhyāto gopyaṃ kuru sadā naghe || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End paṭhet stotraṃ sadā bhaktyā trailokyavijayī bhavet || rajasvalābhagaṃ spṛṣṭvā paṭhed ekāgramānasaḥ || 34 || satyaṃ satyaṃ varārohe labhate ⟨labhate⟩ paramaṃ padam || tasmāt sarvaprayatnena paṭhanīyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ || 35 || (fol. 6r3–6) Colophon iti śrībrahmayāmale mahātaṃtre bālādevyā stavarājaḥ samāpta⟨ṃ⟩[ḥ] hari (fol. 6r6)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || namaś caṃḍikāyai || bhavānyai namaḥ || kailāsaśikhare ramye devadevaṃ jagadguruṃ || (dhyāno) paratam āsīnaṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajaṃ || 1 || surāsuraśiroratnaraṃjitāṃghriyugaṃ prabhuṃ praṇamya naṃdiko devo baddhvāṃjalir abhāṣata || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End devatānāṃ devatāyā brahmādyair yā ca pūjitā || byūyāt sā varadā loke sādhūnāṃ viśvamaṃgalā || 200 || 53 (fol. 22r1–2) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale maheśvaranaṃdinīsaṃvāde mahesvaraproktaṃ bhavānisahasranā[ma]stotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ śubhaṃ || || yad akṣara[ṃ] pada[ṃ] bhraṣṭaṃ svaravyaṃjanavarjitaṃ [[||]] tat sarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ deva prasīda parameśvara || || śāke 1712 māse 6 pakṣe 1 vāre 5 nakṣatre 26 saṃvat 1847 || || (fo. 22r3–5)

Beginning oṁ sva[sti]śrīgaṇeśāye(!) namaḥ || śṛībhavānyai namaḥ || kailāśaśikhare ramye deadevaṃ maheśvaraṃ || dhyānoparatam āsīnaṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajaṃ || 1 || surāsuraśiroratnaraṃjitāṃghriyugaṃ prabhuṃ || praṇamya śirasā naṃdī baddhāṃjalir abhāṣata⟨ṃ⟩ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End te dhanyāḥ kṛtapuṇyās te ta eva bhuvi pūjitāḥ || ekabhāvaṃ sadā nityaṃ ye rcayaṃti maheśvarī[m] || 203 || devatānāṃ devatāyā brahmādyair yā ⟨c⟩ ca pūjitā || bhūyāt suvaradā loke sādhūnāṃ sarvamaṃgalā || 204 | (fol. 21r6–21v3) Colophon iti śrīrudrajā(!)male naṃdikeśvarasaṃvāde bhavānīsahasranāmastotra[ṃ] samāptaṃ ||| saṃvatsara || śrīsāke || 1590 || varṣe māse śrāva⟨na⟩[ṇa]sudi navamyāṃ tithau śukravāre liṣitaṃ jairāmagirīkirātadese tumaliṃga || grāme āruṇanaditīre | śudhaṃ visudhe mam doso na diyate || || yad accharaṃ padaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ mātrā ⟨na jāmāmī ‥⟩ hinaṃ tu yad bhavet || tat sarvaṃ chamitāṃ devi prasida parameśvaraṃ || ❁ || (fol. 21v3–22r4)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namo mahābhairavāya || yasmād dharmmas tadanu ca śivaḥ karmmasākṣī ya eko, yasmin ceto vipariṇamate⟨ḥ⟩ karmmataḥ śraddhayā ca, yat saṃsmṛtvā(!) sphuriparamānandasandohasampā(!)t<ref name="ftn1"> pāda c is unmetrical. </ref> pa(!)dāṃbhojaṃ⟨m⟩ trī(!)bhuvanaguroḥ bhaktita[ḥ] supranau(!)mi || (fol. 1r1–3) End (ka)ṣendro bindusaṃbhinnaṃ karam evo namas tathā || etan navākṣaram mantraṃ dvitīyaṃ varavarṇṇinī || khaphara || aiṃ hrīṃ 9 || karavīramate mantradhyāna(sū)traṃ || || (fol. 10v3–5) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || devy uvāca || || devadeva mahādeva bhaktānāṃ sukhavarddhana⟨ḥ⟩ || kena siddhiṃ dadāty āśu kālī trailokyamohinī || 1 || tan me vada dayāpāra sādhakābhīṣṭasiddhaye || kṛpāṃ kuru ja[[ga]]nnātha vada deva vidāṃvara || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End japaṃ kṛtvā paṭhed yas tu tasya siddhiḥ kare sthitā || idaṃ ka[[va]]cam ajñātvā kālīṃ yo bhajate naraḥ || 31 || naiva siddhir bhavet tasya vighna[ḥ] tasya pade pade || || (fo. 6r1–3) Colophon iti śrīgaṃdharvataṃtre mahākālakavacaṃ samāptaṃ || || yad akṣarapadabhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnaṃ tu yad bhavet || tat sarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ devī(!) prasīda parameśvarī(!) || 1 || śrīrāmaḥ (fol. 6r3–5)

«Beginning of 1. Mahākālapaṭala:» oṁ namaḥ paramadevatāyai || kailāsaśikharārūḍhaṃ gaurī pṛcchati śaṃkaraṃ | caṃdrārddhamukuṭaṃ devaṃ sūryyasomāgnilocanaṃ | gajacarmmaparīdhānaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaṃ | namaskṛtya mahādevaṃ viśvavyāpinam īśvaraṃ || devy uvāca || devadeva mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala | mahākālasya paṃcāṃgaṃ kathayasva dayānidhe || (fol. 1r1–3) «End of 3. Mahākālapañcāṅgastotra:» tatkṣaṇāt paṭhanān nasyet tamaḥ sūryyodaye yathā | mahākālasya paṃcaṃgaṃ premataḥ kathitaṃ tava | rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ pavitrakaṃ | gopyaṃ guhyatamaṃ guhyaṃ gopanīyaṃ svayonivat || (fol. 4r2–3) «Colophon of 3. Mahākālapañcāṅgastotra:» iti śrīviśvasāroddhāre pārvatīśvarasaṃvāde mahākālapaṃcāmagastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || ❁ || oṁ tat sat || śrīmahākālabhairavaśaraṇam || ❁ || (fol. 4r3–4)

«Beginning» || śrīḥ || || atha śūdraśrāddhasaṃkalpaprāraṃbhaḥ || || śrāddhadine uktakāle śucir bhūtvā svāsane prāṅmukhopaviśyācamya pavitre dhṛtvā viṣṇuṃ saṃsmṛtya deśaºº | puruṣaºº prāºº pitṛºº dāsānāṃgoºº vaºº | tṛptyarthaṃ pitur uddiśyāmukaśrāddhaṃ pārvaṇavidhinā sadaivaṃ sapiṃḍaṃ āmena haviṣā darbhabaṭuṣu sadyaḥ kariṣye || (fol. 1r1–4) «End» kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ tu nirvāyya sajātīnāṃ (śa saṃdadhati) vṛddhaparāśaravākyāt || sajātibhyo bhajanaṃ datvā svayaṃ suhṛdyuktaḥ sakṛd eva bhuṃjīteti (fol. 2v8–9) «Colophon» śrāddhaṃ samāptaṃ || (fol. 2v9)

Beginning oṁ śrīmahāmaṃgalamūrttaye namaḥ śrīdevy uvāca yad guhyaṃ bhagavatkhyātaṃ triṣu lekoṣu durllabhaṃ koṭigraṃtheṣu gopyatvāt sūcitaṃ na prakāśitaṃ 1 sarvvasaṃpatpradaṃ deva sarvāpatkṣayakārakaṃ tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi bhairavasya mātmanaḥ 2 (fol. 1v1–5) End kaulavratadharaḥ karmī kāmī kelipryakratuḥ kalādharaḥ kaṃṭakaghnaḥ kūṭasthaḥ koṭarāśrayaḥ 10 karuṇaḥ karuṇāvāsaḥ karuṇāmṛtavāridhiḥ kṛtī kṛtajñaḥ kṛtyā (fol. 18v3–6) Colophon

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śrīdevy uvāca || yad guhyaṃ bhagavan vyātaṃ<ref name="ftn1"> for khyātaṃ </ref> triṣu lokeṣu durlabham || koṭigrantheṣu gopyatvāt sūcitan na prakāśitam || 1 || sarvasampatpradaṃ deva sarvāpatkṣayakārakam || tad ahaṃ śrotum icchāmi bhairavasya mahātmana[ḥ] || 2 || nāmnāṃ sahsraṃ divyānāṃ sārataḥ sāram uddhṛtam || kṛpayā vada bhūteśa yady ahaṃ prāṇavallabhā || 3 || (fol. 1v1–4) End kārāgṛhe tu nigadair<ref name="ftn2"> probably for nigaḍair </ref> baddhaḥ kapaṭibhir vṛttaḥ || paṭhaṃt⟨i⟩[ī]daṃ divārātraṃ sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt || 53 || yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnoti niścitam || 154 || || (fol. 19v1–3) Colophon iti śrīśivāgamakalpe mahākālasahasranāmastotraṃ samāptam || || śubham || || saṃvat 1949 sālamiti śrāvaṇaśudi 12 roja 6 taddine likhitaṃ śubham || (fol. 19v3–5)

Beginning || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṁ namo bhairavāya || kailāśaśikhare ramye devadevaṃ jagadguruṃ || papraccha pārvatī śaṃbhuṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaraṃ || śrīpārvaty uvāca || || devadeva mahādeva sarvajña sukhadāyaka || | āpad[[duḥ]]khadaridrādipīḍitānāṃ nṛṇāṃ vibho || 1 || (fol. 1v1–3) End satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ [[satyaṃ]] satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || sarvakāma⟪ā⟫prado devi bhairavaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ 187 || satkulīnāya śāṃtāya mṛdave satyavādine || stotradānāt saṃprahṛṣṭo bhairavo bhūn maheśvaraḥ 188 || (fol. 20v2–4) Colophon iti śrī-uḍḍāmarataṃtre umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde [[bhairava]]sahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || saṃvat | 1649 | varṣe āśvinavadi || 14 || ravau likhitam idaṃ pustakaṃ raghunāthabhaṭṭasutadeveṃdrabhaṭṭena || goviṃdajyotirvide dattam idaṃ pustakaṃ || (fol. 20v4–6)

Beginning śumālinī || 103 || durāśayā durādharṣā durjeyā durgarūpiṇī || duraṃtā duṣkṛtiharā durdhyeyā duratikramā || 104 || haṃseśvarī trikoṇasthā śākaṃbharyy anukaṃpinī || trikoṇanilayā nityā paramāmṛtaraṃjitā || 105 || (fol. 10r1–3) End muktāḥ śrīcaraṇāraviṃdavimukhāḥ svargāmino bhogino bramopendraśivātmakārcanamukhaṃ loke pi saṃlebhire || śrīmacchaṃkarabhaktupūrvakamahākālīpadadhyāyino bhuktir muktimatī svayaṃ stutiparā bhaktiḥ karasthāyinī || 219 || (fol. 18r7–19v3) Colophon iti śrīkālīkulasarvasve śivaparaśurāmasaṃvāde śrīmahākālīsahasranāmaṃ samāptam || || śrīdurgārppaṇam astu || śrīnepālasaṃvat 877 āśvinīkṛṣṇa 6 somasutavāsare dhanaṃjayadevena dhanadattāya likhitaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || || śrīśrīśrībhagavatyai namaḥ || || śubham bhūyāt || (fol. 19v3–6)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ paradevatāyai || || śrīkārttikeya uvāca || kavacaṃ paradevyās tu śrotum icchāmi durlabhaṃ || sūcitaṃ yat tvayā pūrvaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakaṃ 1 †tadvināma†dhikāro sti japadhyānādikarmaṇi || †tattvaiva† kathitaṃ yasmāt tasmāt tad vada me guro 2 (fol. 1v1–2) End jagad vaśyaṃ bhavet tasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || devīputro bhavec cāṃte tvaṃ yathā mama putratā 33 iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ saguṇaṃ bhajate kramaṃ || nirguṇaṃ paramaṃ vakṣye turīyaṃ śṛṇu vatsaka 34 (fol. 2v7–8) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale harakumārasaṃvāde mahāturīyakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || ❁ || śrīśāke 1671 mārgaśī[r]ṣapaṃcamyāṃ likhitaṃ (fol. 2v8–9)

Beginning oṁ namaḥ śrīgaṇpataye || || śrīmahārājarājeśvarītripurasu[n]daryyai namaḥ || kailāśaśikhare ramye nānāratnopaśobhite || kalpapādapamadhyasthe nānāpuṣpā(!)paśobhite 1 munimaṃḍapamadhyasthe munigaṃdharvvasevite || taṃ kadācit sukhāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ jagadguruṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End tatkoṭiguṇitaṃ puṇyaṃ sakṛj †ja labhave† naraḥ || sarvavedeṣu yat proktaṃ tat phala[ṃ] parikīrttitaṃ || 188 || śrutavān balavāṃ putra[ḥ] dhanavān sarvasaṃpadaḥ || dehāṃte paramaṃ sthānaṃ yat surair api du[r]llabhaṃ || 189 || sa yāsyati na saṃdeha stavarājasya kīrttanāt || (fol. 18r3–5) Colophon iti śrīvāmakeśvarataṃtre harakumārasaṃvāde śrīmanmahātripurasuṃdarīmaṃtrasahasranāmastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam || || śubham || (fol. 18r6–7)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kailāsasyottare śṛṅge śuddha⟨sya⟩sphaṭikasaṃnibhe || tamoguṇavihīne tra jaṭāmṛtyuvivarjite || 1 || sarvārthasaṃpade vāre sarvajñānakṛtālaye || kṛtāṃjaliputo(!) bhūtvā sukhāsīnaṃ sadāśivaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End śataṃ varṣaṃ sa jīvet tu ‥ ‥ putrapratiṣṭhita[ḥ] uttamottamaviprasthā(!)py uttamapuru śubha(!) || 47 ||<ref name="ftn1"> pāda d is unmetrical. </ref> mṛtyuṃjaya(!)ti japtena cirakāla[ṃ] sa jīvati || saptajanmakṛtāt pāpa(!)n ucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || || (fol. 7r2–5) Colophon iti śrīpārameśvaratantre caturaśītisa(!)hasre śrīmṛtyuṃjayastavarāja samāptam || || yad akṣata(!)padabhraṣṭa[ṃ] mātrāhīnaṃ ca yad bhavet tat sarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ deva prasīda parameśvara || śivārpaṇam astu || lekhakapāṭhakayo śubhaṃ yo(!) ti(!)rthadadattapanthaśarmaṇaṃ(!) || || || || (fol. 7r5–7v3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || kailāsasyottare śṛṅge śuddhasphaṭikasannibhe tamoguṇavihīne tu jarāmṛtyuvivarjite 1 sarvārthasaṃpadādhāre sarvajñānakṛtālaye kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā sukhāsīnaṃ sadāśivam papraccha praṇato brahmā jānubhyām avanīṃ gataḥ kenopāyena deveśa cirāyur lomaśo [ʼ]bhavat || (fol. *1r1–2) End śatavarṣaṃ sa jīvet tu putrapautrapratiṣṭhitaḥ uttamottamavipraḥ syād uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ śubhaḥ mṛtyuṃjayena japtena cirakālaṃ sa jīvati saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 49 || (fol. *2r9–v1) Colophon iti śrīpārameśvarataṃtre caturaśītisāhasre śrīmṛtyu[ñ]jayastavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || śrīsāmbaśivāya namaḥ || śubham (fol. *2v1)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṁ asya śrīmṛtyuṃjayastotramaṃtrasya lomaśa ṛṣir anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ || śrīmṛtyuṃjayo devatā mama [[āyu]]rārogyavṛddhyarthaṃ jape viniyogaḥ [[dyānaṃ śu]]ddhaṃ śvetāvadātaṃ (harivṛṣa)gama[[naṃ]] jāpyamālāṃ triśūlaṃ dhāryaṃ ⟨||⟩ taṃ kūrmahastaṃ ⟨|⟩ varam abhakarayaṃ śaktiyuktaṃ trinetraṃ pūjā[jā]pyādimaṃtrair balikusumayutair dhūpadīpādivargair natvā mṛtyuṃjayākhyaṃ mṛtibhayahara⟨ṃ⟩[ṇaṃ] ⟪sarvalokaikanāthaṃ⟫ [[stotram etat paṭhiṣye]] || 1 || (fol. 1v1–2r4) End uttamottamavipra khyād uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ śubhaḥ ||<ref name="ftn1"> for uttamottamavipraḥ syād uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ śubhaḥ </ref> mṛtyuṃjayena japtena cirakālaṃ sa jīvati || 38 || sptajanmakṛtāt pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśaya[ḥ] || 49 || (fol. 12r4–12v3) Colophon iti śrīpara[[me]]śvarataṃtre caturasi(!)tisa(!)hasre śrīmṛtyuṃjayastavarājā(!) samāpta⟨m⟩ḥ || svasti śrīsamvat 1943 sālamitī lekhyā mṛtyuṃjayako pustaka ho || 50 || vaṃśanārān (fol. 12v4–13r3)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīśanaiścarāya || || oṁ praṇamya devadeveśaṃ, sarvvagrahanivāraṇaṃ | śanaiścarasya śāntyarthaṃ, cintayāmāsa pārthivaḥ | raghuvaṃśetivikhyāto, rājā daśarathaḥ purā || cakravarttī sa vijñeyaḥ saptadvīpādhipo bhavat 1 (fol. 1v1–3) End śatavarṣaṃ sa jīvet tu, putrapautrapratiṣṭhitaḥ | uttamottamavipra syāpyuttamaḥ<ref name="ftn1"> for vipraś cāpy uttamaḥ </ref> puruṣaḥ śubhaḥ || mṛtyuñjayena japtena, cirakālaṃ sa jīvati || saptajanmakṛtā(t) pāpān, mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || || (fol. 12v2–4) Colophon iti śrīpārameśvaratantre, caturāśītisāhasre, mṛtyuñjayastotraṃ samāptam || śubham astu || || ❁ || (fol. 12v4–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || śaṁ śanaiścarāya namaḥ nīlādriśobhāñcitadivyamūrttiḥ khaḍgī trīdaṇḍī śaracāpahastaḥ || śaṃbhur māhā⟪nīla⟫[[kāla]]śaniḥ purārir jayaty aśeṣāsuranāśakārī || 1 || [[iti dhyānaṃ]] merupṛṣṭhe sukhāsīnaṃ sāmarasye sthitaṃ śivam || praṇamya śirasā devī pṛcchati sma jagaddhitam 2 (fol. 1v1–2r1) End nātaḥ parataraṃ stotraṃ śanituṣtukaraṃ mahat || śāṃtikaṃ śīghraphaladaṃ sto[tra]m etan mayoditam || 100 || tasmāt sarvaprayatnena yad ikṣe(!)d ātmano hitam || kathanīyaṃ mahādevī(!) nai⟪ka⟫[[vā]]bhaktasya karhicit || 101 || (fol. 18v4–19r3) Colophon iti śrīmārttaṇḍabhaira[va]taṃtre mahākālaśanimṛtyuṃjastotram || śubham || samvat 1943 sālamiti mārgaśudi 2 roja 7 śubham || (fol. 19r3–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || kailāsasyottare śṛṅge śuddhasphaṭikasannibhe || tamoguṇavihīne tu jarāmṛtyuvivarjite || 1 || sarvārthasaṃpadādhāre sarvajñānakṛtālaye || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā sukhāsīnaṃ sadāsivaṃ || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End śatavarṣaṃ sa jīvet tu putrapautrapratiṣṭhitaḥ || uttamottamavipra syād uttamaḥ puruṣa śubhaḥ || 47 || mṛtyuṃjayena japtena cirakālaṃ sa jīvati || saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 48 || || (fol. 6r7–6v2) Colophon iti śrīpārameśvarataṃtre caturā(!)si(!)tisāhasre mṛtyuṃjayastavarājaḥ samāptaḥ || || samvat 1927 padmarājavaidyasya pustakaṃ śubham ❁ ❁ ❁ ❁ || (fol. 6v3–5)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || kailāśasyottare śṛṅge śuddhasphaṭikasannibhe || tamoguṇavihīne tu jarāmṛtyuvivarjite || 1 || sarvārthasampadādhāre sarvajñānakṛtālaye || kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā sukhāsīnaṃ sadāśivam || 2 || (fol. 1v1–4) End śatavarṣaṃ sa jīvet tu putrapautrapratiṣṭhitaḥ || uttamottamavipraḥ syād uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ śivaḥ || 47 || mṛtyuñjayena japtena cirakā⟨ra⟩laṃ sa jīvatī(!) || saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 48 || || (fol. 8v4–9r2) Colophon iti pārameśvaratantre caturā(!)śītisāhasre mṛtyuñjayastotram || śubham || || (fol. 9r2–3)

Beginning śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ || oṁ namaḥ śrīmṛtyuṃjayāya devāya⟨ḥ⟩ || oṁ namaḥ śivāya || śuddhaṃ svetāvadāttaṃ vṛṣahā(!)rigamanaṃ jāpyamālā[ṃ] triśūlaṃ || dhārji<ref name="ftn1"> for dhāryaṃ </ref> taṃ kūṃbhahastaṃ<ref name="ftn2"> for kūrmahastaṃ </ref> varadabhayakaraṃ<ref name="ftn3"> for varam abhayakaraṃ </ref> śaktiyuktaṃ trinetraṃ || pūjājāpyādimaṃtrair bali⟨ḥ⟩kuśumayuktair<ref name="ftn4"> ººyutair is correct to be metrical. </ref> dhūpadi(!)⟨p⟩pādirnātvai<ref name="ftn5"> for ºº dīpādivarggaiḥ </ref> || dhyātvā mṛtyuṃjayākhyā(!)ṃ mṛtyubhayaharaṇaṃ<ref name="ftn6"> mṛtibhayaharaṇaṃ is correct to be metrical. </ref> stvaṃ vai paṭhikṣye<ref name="ftn7"> for stotram etat paṭhiṣye </ref> || 2 || (fol. 1v1–5) End kamalā vasyatāṃ yāti gṛhe śubhasumaṃgalaṃ || yaḥ paṭhet sra[d]dhayā nityaṃ jāto jātī(!) smaro bhavet || 47 || mṛtyuṃjayena japtena cira⟨ṃ⟩kālaṃ sa jīvati || saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān mucyate nā[[tra]] saṃśayaḥ || 48 || (fol. 8r1–3) Colophon iti śrīpārameśvare taṃtre caturā(!)śītisāhasrake mṛtyuṃjayastotraṃ samāptaṃ || 49 || yad akṣara[ṃ] pada[ṃ] bhraṣṭaṃ mātrāhīnaṃ tu yad bhavet || tat sarvaṃ kṣamyatāṃ devī prasīda parameśvarī || 1 || rāmaḥ rāmaḥ rāmaḥ rāmaḥ (fol. 8r3–6)

Beginning ❖ oṁ namaḥ śrīgaṇādhipataye || || śuddhaṃ śvetāvadātaṃ vṛṣaharigamanaṃ jāpyamālā[ṃ] triśūlaṃ || dhāryaṃ taṃ kumbhahastaṃ varam abhayakaraṃ śaktiyuktaṃ trinetra⟨ṃ⟩m || 1 || pūjājāpyādimaṃtrair balikusumayutai[r] dhūpadīpādisarvai[r] natvā mṛtyuṃjayākhyaṃ mṛtabhayaharaṇārthaṃ stavaṃ vai paṭhiṣye <ref name="ftn1"> pāda d is unmetrical. </ref> || 2 || (fol. 1v1–3) End susvapnavarddhanaṃ nityaṃ sarvvaduṣkṛtanāśanam || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 47 || śatavarṣaṃ sa jīvet tu putrapautrapratiṣṭhitaḥ || uttamottamavipraś cāpy uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ śubhaḥ || 48 || mṛtyuṃjayena japtena cirakālaṃ sa jīvī(!)tī(!) || saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān mucyate nātra śaṃśayaḥ || 49 || (fol. 3v7–9) Colophon iti parameśvaramā(!)hātantre caturā(!)śītisāhasre mṛtyuṃjayasto[tra]ṃ samāpta⟨ṃ⟩m || 50 || subham astu sarvadā kālam || śivānandavarmmana(!)sya putra[ḥ] dīrgham āyur astu⟨ḥ⟩ || (fol. 3v9–10)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīpārvaty uvāca || bhagavaṃ devadeveśa bhaktānugrahakāraka || yad uktaṃ me mahādeva kavacaṃ suṃdarīpriyaṃ || 1 || tan me kathaya deveśa yadi snehena māṃ prati || īśvara uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kevacaṃ suṃdarīpriyaṃ || sarvārthasādhakaṃ devi sarvasaṃpattikārakaṃ || (fol. *1r1–6) End yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ kadācana || yas trisaṃdhyaṃ paṭhed devī(!) lakṣmī[s] tasya prajāyate || aṣṭamyaṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ yaḥ paṭhet prayataḥ sadā || prasaṃnnā⟨ṃ⟩ suṃdarī tasya sarvasaṃpattidāyinī || 20 || (fol. 2v2–6) Colophon iti śrīrudrayāmale umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde maṃtrayaṃtravigrahakavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ || śrīguruparadevatāsvarūpiṇīśrīmahātripurasuṃdarīrājarājeśvarī(!) [a]rpaṇam astu svāhā || deva‥ty upanāmakalakṣmīnārāyaṇena likhitaṃ (fol. 2v6–10)
