Beginning || || tad uktaṃ saṃketapaddhatyāṃ || amrāntaro(!) tu pīṭhasthā mahātripurasundarī || śaktisthānasamuddiṣṭo yo hy enān ucaren(!) namaḥ || so 'cirāl labhate siddhiṃ vākkāmaviṣanāśanīm || chinnā rudrāś ca ye mantrāḥ kaulitā mūrcchitāś ca ye || sidhyanti te 'cirāt tasya śaktivisphārabṛṃhitāḥ || mantrāvidyāś ca mantrāś ca yantraṃ mantrāś ca saṃsthitaṃ || tad ahaṃ pīṭharājeśaṃ oṃṅ(!)kārākhyaṃ namā⟪na⟫my ahaṃ || vākkāyaviṣamokṣāṇām ālayaṃ sarvvasiddhidaṃ || śrīpīṭharājaṃ duḥprekṣan tad ahaṃ saraṇāśraye || ajñānatimire dhvaṃsād ājñāsphārapradarśanam || (fol. 210r1-6) End athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dvīpāmnāyaṃ kramāgataṃ || susame bhūpradeśe tu nimnonnaṃta(!)vivarjjite || pūrvvapaścātpanaṃ(!) sūtraṃ catuṣkaṃ viniveśayet || dakṣasaumyāyatān eva punaś ca caturo nyaset || koṣṭhakā nava siddhyanti vinyasat(!) teṣu mātṛkān || madhyakoṣṭhe nyased yugmān svarān pūrvvāditaḥ kramāt || kādipaṃcakam atraindryā dikṣu madhye ca vinyaset || āgne /// (fol. 213v3-7) || ○ || iti śrīvidyānandanāthaviracitāyāṃ śrījñānadīpapradarśinyāṃ pāraṃparyyapaddhatiś caturviṃśatiḥ || 24 || || (fol. 213v2-3)

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || natvā gajānanaṃ devaṃ viśvanāthaḥ karoty asau | udāharaṇam ānaṃdamakaraṃdasya yatnataḥ || 1 || śrīsūryyasiddhāṃtamatena samyagviśvopakārāya guruprasādāt | tithyāti(?) sarvaṃ vimṛṇomi(!) kāśyām ānaṃdakaṃdo makaraṃdanāma || 2 || spaṣṭārthaḥ || || atha makaraṃdasyodāharaṇaṃ || tatrādau paṃcāṃgasādhanaṃ || tatrādau tithisādhanaṃ || tatrābhīṣṭavarṣādijatithivārādijñānam āha || iṣṭaśakamadhye pustakīyaḥ śakaḥ śodhyaḥ || sa yathā || pustakīyaśakapaṃktau iṣṭaśakāsanno yo nyūnaśakaḥ sa tāvac chodhyaḥ yāvad agrimapustakīyaśakatulya iṣṭaśako bhavati | tad anaṃtaraṃ dvayos tulyaśakayor mmadhye pustakīyaśakāpekṣayā ekena adhiko bhūtvā yadā iṣṭaśakaḥ agre gachati tadāsana śodhyaḥ yas tulyo jātaḥ sa śodhyaḥ || atrodāharaṇaṃ || iṣṭaśakaḥ 1551 etanmadhye ayaṃ pustakīyaśakaḥ śodhyaḥ 1544 ayaṃ tāvac chodhyo yāvad agripustakīyaśakaḥ 1560 tulya iṣṭaśako bhavati | tadanaṃtaraṃ iṣṭaśakaḥ 1561 madhye 'yaṃ pustakīyaśakaḥ 1560 śodhyaḥ yāvad agrimapustakīyaśakaḥ 1576 tulya iṣṭaśako bhavati | evam agre pi śodhyaṃ | (fol. 1v1-7) End ṣaṭ sūryye tithayaś caṃdre aṣṭau bhūmisute tathā | sapta deśenduputrasya daśa bhāskaranaṃdane || ekoviṃśati jīve ⟪ca⟫ rāhau dvāviṃśakaṃ bhavet | ekaviṃśatir ākhyātā śuktasyāpi tathaiva ca || ānayanaṃ || svasvāmivarṣādhipavatsare kyaṃ trighnaṃśarāḍhyaṃ tithi /// (fol. 17v10-11)

Beginning °tram aṃjanāya kajjalaṃ || paṃcamyāṃ catussamānulepanaṃ kareṇa copaharet || iti prathamadinakṛtyaṃ || athāśvaśālāyām aśvapūjāprayogaḥ || tatrāśvinaśukladvitīyāyāṃ svātinakṣatrayuktāyāṃ vā aśvaśālāyāṃ manoramānuliptāyāṃ sarvataḥ parivṛtāṃ nānākārapuṣpālaṃkṛtāṃ sudhūpitāṃ vidhāya tasyāṃ mukhyāśvabaṃdhanasthānāt paścimadiśi rapratrayāvṛtaṃ sthaṃḍilam anukalpya tadupari caṃdanādinā maṃḍaladvayaṃ kṛtvā tatra re maṃtam uccaiśrava saṃpūjayet || tatra kramaḥ || kuśatilajalāny ādāya || oṃ adya sakalāśvasvābhyutpātapīḍāpraśamananairujyadīrghāyustvasamṛddhikāmo re maṃtam uccaiśravasaṃ turaṃgam ahaṃ saṃpūjayiṣye iti saṃkalpā || «Sub-Colophons:» iti prathamadinakṛtyaṃ || iti gajāśvapūjāvidhiḥ || iti bilbābhimaṃtraṇavidhiḥ || iti balidānaṃ || ity aṣṭamīdinakṛtyaṃ || || iti triśūlinīpūjā || iti balidānavidhiḥ || iti pūjākramaḥ || iti kumārīpūjanavidhiḥ || atha kuṣmāṇḍabaliḥ || End kūṣmāṇḍam ānīya jalena prokṣya sindūrādinā puttalikā tadupari vilikhya gaṃdhādinā saṃpūjya || oṃ adyetyādi āśvine māsi śuklapakṣe navamyāṃ tithau amukagotrāmukaśarmā durgāprītikāma imaṃ kūṣmāṇḍabaliṃ durgāyai tubhyam ahaṃ ghātayiṣye || iti saṃkalpaḥ || kūṣmāṇḍam ugratejaṃ ca mahallomaṃ mahābalaṃ || vīraṃ kagalavadanaṃ brahmanā nirmitaṃ purā || evam uccāryya maṃtraṃ du///

Beginning śrī gurubhyo namaḥ || śāradīpūjā likhyate || adyetyādi tava caṇḍīvidhānam ahaṃ kariṣye iti saṃkalpya pūrvvasyāṃ diśi kādambarī gajārūḍḍhāṃ dhyātvā kādambari devi ihāgaccha iha tiṣṭha iha sannidhir bhava iha sanni[[ru]]ddho bhava sammukho bhava avaguṇṭhito bhava amṛtībhava hrāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ hrīṃ śirase svāhā || hrūṃ śikhāyaiva ṣaṭ || hraiṃ kavacāya hūṃ || hrauṃ netratrayavau(?) ṣaṭ || hraḥ astrāya phaṭ || iti pratiṣṭhāpya pādmādibhir upacārair ārādhya baliṃ haret || tadyathā tadagre pātrāntare || ghṛtaśarkkarāsahitaṃ pāyasaṃ nānāvyaṃjanādisahitam annaṃ ca nidhāya śrīkādaṃvarī eṣa te balir nnamaḥ || iti balim utsṛjya kṣamasveti praṇamet || (fol. [1]v1-7) End daśamī nityānantaraṃ aparājitā devī pūjyā | bhagavati aparājite ihāgaccha iha tiṣṭha svāhā || aparājitāyai 2 (pā)dyārghācamanīyagaṃdhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyādikaṃ dadyāt || japa 10 || stotra || asirvviśasanetyādi || paṭhitvā khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvā śamanaṃ kuryyāt || gamanaṃ cārthalābhāya kṣemāya vijayāya ca | śatrupakṣavināśāya khaḍganātha namo stu te | || ([11]v2-5)

Beginning śrīparadevatāyai namaḥ || mātaḥ śrītripure devī tatvasarvvaprakāśitā | kālānte adhunā mātas tvam ekaida(!) bhavaty api || 1 || pūrvve unmanīdevī dakṣiṇe ca niśaiśvarī paścime kubjikādevī uttare guhyakālikā || 2 || vajravailocanīdevi adhāmnāye sureśvarī || ūrddhvaṃ śrībrahmarūpā ca parāśrītripurāmbikā || 3 || ete siṃhāsanā vidyā sākṣāt murttiparāyinī | kālikāṃ caṇḍikāṃ tārāṃ bhairavīṃ cchinnamastakāṃ || 4 || vārāhīm unmukhiṃ(!) durggāṃ namāmi sundarīparāṃ vandi(!) caiva karāṃvālāṃ kubjikāṃ guhyakālikāṃ | siddhilakṣmī mahālakṣmī namāmi sundariṃ parāṃ || 5 || (1r1-6) End tathā hi kaulamārggeṇa śīghraṃ sarvvārthasādhakaṃ | pātakān muktisāyujyaṃ tansmāt(!) kaulaṃ praviṣṭayet || 12 || sarvvatra sarvvadā māta tvadbhakti jācayed(!) ahaṃ || tvatpādacaraṇāmbhojyo(!) jīvendriya mamarjja tu || 13 || gurau bhaktiḥ parā śaktiḥ kṛpādṛṣṭi sadā mayi | kulāgame sadā śakto janmajanmāntare śive || 14 || (fol. 1v6-2r2) Colophon iti śrījagadānandaviracitaṃ śrītripurasaundaryyāstava samāptaṃ || || (fol. 2r2)

Beginning cārucaṃcuś cirārecī caṃcaccīrarucārucaḥ || cacāra ruciraś cārucārau⁅r(!) ācāracaṃcu⁆raḥ || ghanaṃ vidāryārjunabāṇapūgaṃ saṃsārabāṇo yugalocanasya || punas tadvat || || vikāśam īyur jagatīśamārgaṇā vikāśam iyur jagatīśamārgaṇāḥ || punas tadvat || || unmajjan makara ivāmarāpagāyā vegena pratimukham etya bāṇanadyāḥ || gāṇḍivī kanakaśilānibhaṃ bhujābhyām ājaghne viṣamavilocanasya vakṣaḥ || || (1v1-5) End pāṇibhyāṃ calakaṃkaṇodyatajhaṇatkārottarābhyāṃ karoty abhyaṃgaṃ paripaśyato 'sya capalaṃ doraṃtaraṃ preyasaḥ || || … tarke karkaśavakroktir niṣṭhurā tasya bhāratī || jātā muhur asaṃdarbhe kāvye smin mṛdulā kathaṃ || || (fol. 2r6-9)

Beginning cārucaṃcuś cirārecī caṃcaccīrarucārucaḥ || cacāra ruciraś cārucārau⁅r(!) ācāracaṃcu⁆raḥ || ghanaṃ vidāryārjunabāṇapūgaṃ saṃsārabāṇo yugalocanasya || punas tadvat || || vikāśam īyur jagatīśamārgaṇā vikāśam iyur jagatīśamārgaṇāḥ || punas tadvat || || unmajjan makara ivāmarāpagāyā vegena pratimukham etya bāṇanadyāḥ || gāṇḍivī kanakaśilānibhaṃ bhujābhyām ājaghne viṣamavilocanasya vakṣaḥ || || (1v1-5) End pāṇibhyāṃ calakaṃkaṇodyatajhaṇatkārottarābhyāṃ karoty abhyaṃgaṃ paripaśyato 'sya capalaṃ doraṃtaraṃ preyasaḥ || || … tarke karkaśavakroktir niṣṭhurā tasya bhāratī || jātā muhur asaṃdarbhe kāvye smin mṛdulā kathaṃ || || (fol. 2r6-9)

Beginning śrīmṛtyuṃjayanyāsaṃ likhe || || asya śrītryaṃbakamṛtyuṃjayamahāmantrasya maittrāvaruṇaputro vasiṣṭha ṛṣir anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ śrīmṛtyuṃjayatryambakarudro devatā devadevyau praṇavau bījaśaktiḥ atra mūlamaṃtreṇa karaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā praṇavaṃ karatalayor vinyasya vyāhṛtyādimaṃtrapādacatuṣṭayaṃ karayor aṃguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāṃtaraṃgulīṣu vinyasya tataḥ sarveṇa vyāpakanyāsaṃ kṛtvā dehāmganyāsam ārabhet | oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvaḥ aṃguṣṭābhyāṃ namaḥ tryaṃbakaṃ yajāmahe tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | sugaṃdhiṃ puṣṭivarddhanaṃ madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | urvvārukam iva baṃdhanāt anāmikābhyānaṃ(!) | mṛtyor mukṣīya mā mṛtāt kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ tryambakam iti śirasi yajāmaha iti lalāṭe sugandhim iti mukhe puṣṭivarddhanam iti hṛdaye | urvārukam iti kukṣau iveti nābhau baṃdhanād iti kaṭyāṃ mṛtyor ity ūrudvaye mukṣīyeti jānudvaye meti jaṃghadvaye | amṛtād iti pādadvaye | evaṃ dehāṃganyāsaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṃganyāsam ārabhet || oṃ namo bhagavate tryambakāya śūlapāṇine svāhā hṛdayāya namaḥ | oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya amṛtamūrttaye māṃ jīva śirase svāhā śirase namaḥ | (fol. 16r1-9) End tāvatas tadgataprāṇaḥ svacitto haṃ sadāśiva | iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ japen maṃtraṃ tryaṃbakaṃ || || (fol. 16v6-7) Colophon iti mṛtyuṃjayajapaśāṃtiḥ || tulasīdale raktacaṃdanena likhitvā snānasamaye jale gatvā sarasvatīṃ vibhāvya nigilya(?) nimajjet trikoṇāṃtargataṃ aiṃ hrīṃ krīṃ maṃtraṃ likhet | tattulasībhakṣaṇād vācāṃ nidhir bhavet na saṃśayaḥ || || etc. <ref name="ftn1"> The remainig space of this page and the entire next page are covered with stanzas from various genres. </ref> (fol. 16v7-9) sānaṃdaṃ naṃdihastāhatamurajaravāhūtakaumārabarhis trāsānnāsāgraraṃdhrāṃ viśati phaṇipatau bhogasaṃkocabhāji || gaṃḍoḍḍīnālimālāmukharitakakubhas tāṇḍave śūlapāṇer vaināyakyaś ciraṃ vo vadanavidhutayaḥ pāṃtu cītkāravatyaḥ || 1 || (fol. 17r3-4) <references/>

Beginning atha yantrapratiṣṭhā || || brāhme mūhūrtte(!) utthāya kṛtanityavidhiḥ | dhūpite gṛhe candanānuliptaḥ | karpūrasuvāsitatāṃbūlena mukhaṃ surabhīkṛtya tāmrādau hemalekhanyāraktaṃ caṃcanādināsveṣṭayaṃtranirmāṇaṃ kuryāt | tadu uktaṃ sarvamaṃtrāṇi vilikhet ghṛṇo bhramasvaṃdanaiḥ | kāśmīrarocanālākṣārasaiḥ svarṇaśalākayā | sauvarṇe rājate tāmre bhūrjapatre śubhodare | snātaḥ svalaṃkṛto hṛṣṭaḥ pūgaiś ca pūritānanaḥ | prāṅmukho bhūtale śuddhe gomayenopalepite | puṣpaprakarasaṃkīrṇe dhūpāmodasugaṃdhite | (fol. 17v1-5) End oṃ yaṃtrarājāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi || tan no yaṃtraḥ pracodayāt || || aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā prakṛtidevatā yaṃtre prāṇamaṃtrasya ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ vidhāya devatāṃ dhyātvā aṣṭottarasahasraṃ śalaṃ vājayet | pādyādibhir upacaraiḥ saṃpūjya | mūlamaṃtreṇa yaṃtrasaṃpātasiktaṃ kuryāt | tataḥ punaḥ prakṛtidevatāṃ paṃcopacāraiḥ pūjayet | devapratiṣṭhā[[yā]]m apy ayaṃ || || (fol. 18r5-8) Colophon iti yaṃtrapratiṣṭhāvidhiḥ samāptā || || śukle pakṣe bhavati navamī kārttikākhye kṛtādisrotādiḥ syān niyatamamalomādhavākhye tṛtīyā || māghe māse pitṛtithir asau dvāparādir niyuktāḥ kalpādiḥ syāt smaratithir asau kṛṣṇapakṣe nabhasye || || (fol. 18r8-10)

Beginning ādau devakidevagarbhajananaṃ gopīgṛhe varddhanaṃ māyāpūtanijīvitāpaharaṇaṃ govarddhanoddhāraṇam || kaṃsachedanakauravādiharaṇaṃ kuntīsutāpālanam etad bhāgavataṃ purānakathitaṃ śrīkṛṣṇalīlāmṛtam || 1 || ādau pāṇḍavadhārttarāṣṭrajananaṃ lākṣāgṛhe dāhanaṃ dyūtaśrīharaṇaṃ vane viharaṇaṃ matsyālaye varttanaṃ || līlāgograhaṇaṃ raṇe viharaṇaṃ saṃdhikriyājaṃbhaṇaṃ paścād bhīṣmasuyodhanādinidhanaṃ caitan mahābhāratam || 2 || ciṃtām imāṃ vahasi kiṃ gajayūthanātha yogīva yogavinimīlitanetrayugmaṃ || piṃḍaṃ gṛhāṇa piba vāri yathopanītaṃ daivād bhavaṃti vipadaḥ khalu saṃpado vā || 1 || (fol. 18v1-5) End varṣe varṣe 'śvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ | māṃsāni ca na khāded yas tayoḥ puṇyaṃ phalaṃ samam iti bhā⁅rata⁆ | gaṃgāvarttasamānanābhivilasadvalmīkaraṃdhrāṃtaras tanvī śyāmalaromarājibhujagī nirgatya kāṃte tava || vaktrenduṃ grasatīti pannagabhayāt pīnau stanau saṃgatau ity ākhyātum iva tvadakṣiyugalaṃ karṇṇāṃtam āśiśriye || || bhavān yasmin kule jātaḥ karī yatra na hanyate || śūro si kṛtakṛtyo si mānyo si mahatām api || saiṃhyāmṛta++ [[vālakaṃ]] ‥naṃ pālya svaputraṃ gajagaṃḍasphoṭanaṃ śikṣitavatī tadāśvavālakenāpi haṃtum udyukte tadār⁅ya⁆pratyuttaraślokaḥ saiṃhya‥ | aṃbā kupyati tātamūrddhanihitā gaṅgeyam utsṛjya tāṃ vidvan ṣaṇmukha kā gatir mayi ciraṃ tasyā sthitāyā ⁅vā⁆ || roṣāve(sa)vaśād aśeṣavadanaiḥ pratyuttaraṃ dattavān aṃbhodhir jaladhiḥ payodhir udadhir vārāṃnidhir ⁅vāridhiḥ⁆ || padā sujātena nakhāruṇaśriyā bhuv⟪i⟫aṃ likhaṃty aśrubhir aṃjanāsitaiḥ || āsiṃcatī kuṃkumarūṣitau +++v adhomukhy atiduḥkharuddhavāk++ tasyāḥ suduḥkhabhayaśokavinaṣṭabuddher hastāc (chnu)thad(?) valayato nyatanaṃ ⁅prā⁆++ || gatvā a⁅ti⁆kṛśībhūte ity arthaḥ | dehaś ca viklavadhiyaḥ sahasaiva muhyan raṃbheva vāta vihatā pravikīrya ++++ (fol. 22v1-10)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ śrīsarasvatyai | śu‥ām brahmavicārasāraparamām ādyāṃ jagadvyāpinīṃ vīṇāpustakadhāriṇīm abhayadāṃ jāḍyāṃdhakārāpahām || haste sphāṭikamālikāṃ vidadhatīṃ padmāsane [[saṃ]]⟨sthāṃ⟩sthitāṃ vaṃde tāṃ parameśvarīṃ bhagavatīṃ buddhipradāṃ śāradāṃ || 1 || hrīṃ hrīṃ hṛdy ekabīje śaśirucikamalā kalpavispaṣṭaśobhe bhavye bhavyānukūle kumativanadave viśvavaṃdyāṃghripadmau || padme padmopaviṣṭe praṇatajanamanomodasaṃpādayitri pronmṛṣṭā jñānakūṭe harinijadayite devi saṃsārasāre || 2 || aiṃ aiṃ aiṃ jāpatuṣṭe himarucimukuṭe vallakī vyagrahaste mātar mātar namas te daha daha jaḍatāṃ dehi buddhiṃ praśastām | vidyeṣedāṃtavedye śrutiparipaṭhite mokṣade muktimārge mārgātītasvarūpe bhava mama varadā śārade śubhrahāre || 3 || (fol. 2v1-7) End varadā yadi me devi divyaṃ jñānaṃ prayaccha me | sarasvaty uvāca | | dattaṃ te nimalaṃ jñānam ajñānatimirāpahāṃ stotreṇānena ye bhaktyā saṃstuvaṃti sadā na+ teṣāṃ kaṃṭhe sadāvāsaṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ | 8 | (fol. 3r11-13) Colophon iti śrībṛhaspativiracitaṃ sarasvatīstotraṃ samāptam ārat || || (fol. 3r13-14)

Beginning | nedaṃ na bhūmaṇḍalamburāśir(!) nemāś ca tārā navaphenakhaṇḍāḥ || nāyaṃ śaśī kuṃḍalitaḥ phaṇīndro nāyaṃ kalaṃkaśayito murāriḥ || utpattiṃ ca vināśaṃ ca bhūtānām āgatiṃ gatiṃ | neti vidyām avighā(?) ca ṣa(ṭstaṃ)bhaga(?) itīritāḥ || jayadrathavadhe rājan duryodhanadhanaṃjayau | savilāram(!) udīkṣetāṃ prauḍhā bālā vadhūr iva || tarke karkaśatāṃ gatāpi nitarāṃ vāg vaikharī satkaver mādhuryaṃ prakaṭīkaroti kavitā kāleṣu kiṃ vādbhutaṃ || paśyātyaṃtakaṭhoratām upagatā grīṣme mayūkhāvaliḥ kiṃ nāviṣkuru tena vāmṛtabharaṃ bhāsāṃnidheḥ prāvṛṣi || || (fol. 3v1-5) End jñāsyase matprasādena ⁅bhujageṃ⁆drāparaṃ tathā || caturvidhaṃ paraṃ tālaṃ tri(!) prakāraṃ gaṇatrayaṃ | yatitrayaṃ tathātodyaṃ mayā dattaṃ caturivdhaṃ | etad bhavān matprasādā⁅t pannaga⁆+ paraṃ ca yat | asyāṃtargatam āyattaṃ svaravyaṃjanayogavit | tad aśeṣaṃ mayā dattaṃ bhavataḥ kambalasya ca | yathā nānyasya bhūloke(!) pātāle cāpi pannaga | praṇetārau bhavantau ca sarvasyāsya bhaviṣyataḥ | pātāle devaloke vā bhūrloke caiva pannaga || ity uktvā sā tadā devī sarvajihvā sarasvatī | jagāmādarśanaṃ sadyo nāgasya kamalekṣaṇā | tayoś ca tadyathā vṛttaṃ bhrātroḥ sarvvam ajāyata | vijñānam ubhayor agryaṃ padatālasvarādikam || || (9r7-9v2) Colophon iti mārkkaṇḍeyapurāṇe saumatibhārgavasaṃvāde vāṇīstutiḥ || (9v2)

Beginning madhye vyomnaḥ sphurati sumano dhanvanaḥ śyānacakraṃ maṃdākinyā vipulapulinābhyāgato rājahaṃsaḥ || a(jña)ś(?) chede tvaritacaraṇaṃ nyastam ākāśalakṣyāḥ saṃsarpantyā śravaṇagalitaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ mṛgāṇkaḥ || || śrīkaṃṭhāsa(kta)hastaḥ svagatamaṇigaṇaḥ śaiśave bhyastavidyo lāvaṇyādhvastakāmaḥ kavijanacakito yauvanāvāptadehā || ādattaḥ kṣoṇidaṃḍo dvija(kṛ)śakṛtabhūḥ kāṃcanāhārayuktaḥ śrīrājan rājavīratvam iva<ref name="ftn1"> two short syllables are missing here </ref> ripuḥ kiṃ tu mu(ktā)dyavarṇaḥ || uddeśo yaṃ sarasakadalī śreṇiśobhātiśāyī kuṃjotkarṣāṃkuritaramaṇīvibhramo narmadāyāḥ || sa(ṃ)ty etasmin suratasu(hṛ)da(ya)nvite(!) vāṃti vātā eṣām agraḥ saratikalitā kāṇḍakoṣo manobhūḥ || || (fol. 9v3-7) <references/> End chatradhārī hy asau rājā jaṭādhārī na śaṃkaraḥ || vṛṣṭikarttā hy asau megho vastuharttā na taskaraḥ || liṃgaṃ caturmukho na ca brahmā vṛṣārūḍho na śaṃkaraḥ || sṛṣṭikarttā na ca brahmā tasyāhaṃ kulavālikā || || eko devaḥ keśavo vā śivo vā ekā bhāryā suṃdarī vādarī vā || eko mitro bhūpatir vā yatir vā eko vāsaḥ paṭṭane vā vane vā || || etc.<ref name="ftn2"> an incomprehensible sentence follows </ref> (11r4-6) <references/>

Beginning puruṣavīryastambhaḥ || || jāyaphalabhāgara[[to]](?) aphīmamāsā(?) 6 sālavami śrīmāsā 6 utkaṭārāmāsā 6 pāṣāṇabhedamāsā 6 paṃca vastūni ekatra kṛtvā dhattūrakālimnaḥ bījāni ṣaṭ sthāpya mahajjātīphalo chidraṃ kṛtvāṃtaḥsthaṃ niṣkāṣya aṃtaḥ etac cūrṇaṃ pūrayet | jalamiśrita(go?)dhūmacurṇena upari lāpayet paścāt tilataile ānimagnaṃ mṛdbhāṃḍe sthāpya cu.āḥ adhaḥ pūryopari kāṣṭhāni jvālayet saptadināvadhi paścān niṣkvātha tatraiva dinatrikaṃ sthāpya paścāt śītalaṃ kṛtvā (go)dhūmadūrṇaṃ dūrīkṛtya varṣatrayasya purāṇaṃ guḍena gharṣayitvā golikāṃ badhnīyāt pramāṇaṃ tu nāsaikaṃ | (fol. 12v4-7) End mānavo māninī mānavidhvaṃsayan kiṃ punar yauvane nānvitair ⟪+++++++⟫auṣṭikaṃ pṛchase cauṣadhaṃ || || postā(?) dātā | vānarabījaḥ gokhura || (fol. 12v11-12) Colophon ity auṣadhaṃ ma(he)śena(?)<ref name="ftn1"> Two lines with later additions follow. </ref> (fol. 12v12) <references/>

Beginning || atha strīrogapratīkāraḥ || || hrīveraṃ caṃdanaṃ caiva tvakkṣīrīnāgakesaraṃ || taṃḍulodakasaṃyuktaṃ pīnaṃ pradaraṇāśanaṃ || 1 || [[raktasravarogaḥ ]] sitātaṃḍulasaṃmiśraṃ ++++++++ pradarān mucyate caiṣā pathyaṃ dāḍima(kṣu)rakāḥ || 2 || hrīveraṃ sugaṃdhavālā | caṃdanaṃ śrīkhaṃḍaṃ | tvak dālacīnī | kṣīrī | kṣīrakākolī | nāgakesaraṃ | 2 | dvitīyaṃ spaṣtam eva || 2 || atha puṣpīkaraṇaiṣadhaṃ || || tryūṣaṇaṃ ceṃdradaṃḍaṃ ca tilakvāthena saṃpibet | (fol. 13r1-3) End iti vīryastambhaḥ (fol. 13r14)

Beginning agnidāhe na me duḥkhaṃ na duḥkhaṃ lohatāḍane || ekam evaṃ mahadduḥkhaṃ tulyena guṃjayā saha || || vāṃchā sajjanasaṃgatau paraguṇe prītir gurau namratā vidyāyāṃ vyasanaṃ svayoṣiti ratir lokāpavādād bhayam || bhaktiḥ śūlini śaktir ātmadamane saṃsargamuktiḥ khale yeṣv ete nivasaṃti nirmalaguṇās tebhyo narebhyo namaḥ || || naika chāgo dvirāveyu tri gāvaḥ paṃca māhiṣāḥ || saptāśvā nava mātaṃgāḥ śakrasyāpi śriyaṃ haret || || ekaḥ śūdraś catur vaiśyāḥ paṃcadaśa ca kṣattriyāḥ || nava nārī na gaṃtavyāḥ na gached brāhmaṇatrayam || || (fol. 13v1-5) End rāmābhiṣeke mativihvalā yāḥ karāc cyuto hemaghaṭas taruṇyāḥ || sopānam āruhya cakāra śabdaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭhaṭhaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭhaṭhaṭhaṃ ṭhaṭhaṃ ṭhaṃ || gātraṃ saṃkucitaṃ gatir vigalitā bhraṣṭā ca + daṃtāvalī dṛṣṭir naśyati varddhate vadhiratā vaktraṃ ca lālāyate || vākyaṃ nādriyate ca bāṃdhavajanair bhāryā na śuśrūṣate hā kaṣṭaṃ puruṣasya jīrṇṇavayasaḥ putro py amittrāyate || ||<ref > One more stanza has been added to this page by a later hand. </ref> (15v6-9) <references/>

Beginning śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || mahāśāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi yāṃ prāpya mahatīṃ śriyaṃ || brāhmaṇakṣatriyo vāpi vaiśyo vāpy upasarjjati || 1 || brāhmaṇaḥ sarvakāmāptiṃ kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivījayaṃ || sarvatas tu samṛddhiṃ ca vaiśyaḥ samadhigachati || 2 || divyaṃ vā pārthivaṃ vāpi cāṃtarikṣam athāpi vā || mahāśāṃtiḥ śāmayati anyad vā bhayamutchitaṃ(?) || 3 || ārogyam arthaputrāṃś ca anumitraṃ tathaiva ca || saubhāgye ca samṛddhiṃ ca mahāśāṃtiḥ prayacchati || 4 || mahādevābhimṛṣṭasya mṛtyor āsyagato pi ca || gṛhaghorābhigṛstasya(!) mahāśāṃti(!) vimocani || 5 || (fol. 1v1-6) «Sub-Colophons» iti mahāśāṃtiprathamo dhyāyaḥ || || atha nakṣatraśāṃtir liṣyate || || (fol. 8r1-2) End dhaniṣṭhām āvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ śaśiva(lla)bhaṃ || dhaniṣṭhe tvam ihābhyehi cara karmmaprasādhake || 2 || ṛkṣam āvāhayiṣyāmi nāmnā śatabhiṣāṃ śubhāṃ || āgacha tvaṃ śatabhiṣe cara karmmasu śobhane || ṛkṣam āvāhayiṣyāmi pūrabhādrapadaṃ mahat | ehi bhādrapade pūrve ugrakarmmaprasādhake || || 4 || dhruvam ā /// (fol. 9r5-7)

Beginning ⁅u⁆bhayacaryāḥ || 4 || atha candrayogagṛhavicāra || || dvijapater ddhanagai(?) śunaphā bhavet (vepa)+nair aṇaphā ravivarjjitaiḥ || durūdhūrā(?) khacarair ūbhayasthitai munivarair uditā mahadāsadāḥ || 1 || ravivarjjaṃ dvādaśagair aṇaphā caṃdrādvitīyagai śunaphāḥ || ubhayasthitai grahendṛai durddharā kemadrumato nyathā || 2 || śunaphāyogaphalaṃ || || nijabhujārjitavittasamanvita || viśadarketi(!) yuto matimān sukhi || nanu naraṃ sunaphāprabhavo bhaven narapate saciva sukṛtikṛtam || 2 || raṇaphāyogaphala || || udāramurttiyukta sachilasāli subhavāk livāsaḥ(?) || kandarppe keli satataṃ vinitaprabhur nara syād anaphāvidhāneḥ || 3 || durddharāyogaphalam || || (fol. 7v1-7) End karmasthe bhṛguputre ca sukarmmānidhir annavān || rājasevī dhārmikaś ca jāyate devatāpriya || 10 || lābho śukra sadā lābhe ya sa satyaguṇāṃcitaṃ || dhanī bhogī kṛyāsuddha jāyate mānavottamā || 11 || vyaya śukre vyayakarttu gurūmitravirodhakṛt || mithyāvāhabaṃdhuvarge guṇahīno pi jāyate || 12 || || atha sanibhāvaphalam || || lagne sūrye sutarogī kurūpi kṛpanī nara || kusīlapāpabuddhiś ca durācāra sadā bhavet || 1 || dhane maṃnde sanai hīno vātapittakaphārttiṣuḥ || dehādyāḥ sthirarogāś ca /// (fol. 37v4-9)

Beginning oṃ svasti śrīgaṇapataya(!) namaḥ || || atha rudrānuṣṭhānapaddhatir ucyate || teṣāṃ vaidikamaṃtrai yuktakarmmaṇi kuryāt || || namo stu sarppebhya ity asya rājñī ṛṣayaḥ gāyatryuṣṇigānuṣṭubh chandāṃsi sarppā devatā rakṣoghne vinīyogaṃ || oṃ namo stu sarppebhyaḥ mantraḥ || tatra maṃtraiḥ || || atha bhūtoccāṭanaṃ || apasarpantu ye bhūtā ye bhūtā bhuvi saṃsthitā || ye bhūtā vighnakarttā ca te naśyantu śivājñayā || ye jatra(!) saṃsthitā bhūtā sthānam āsṛttya sarvadā || sthānaṃ tyaktvā tu tat sarvvaṃ yatrasthā tatra gacchatu || apakrāmantu bhūtānī piśācā sarvatodiśaṃ || sarveṣām avirodhena śivakarma śamārabhet || (fol. 1v1-8) «Sub-Colophon» iti bhūtaprabodha || || (fol. 2r1) End sa naḥ parṣati durgāṇi viśvā nāv eva sindhuduritā aggnir iti gude || gudāya namaḥ || oṃ māno mahāntam iṣv arke | kuru madhyāya namaḥ || ‥te‥bhāga ity asya prajāpatir ṛṣi paṃkti cchandaḥ rudro devatā jānu āśe viniyogaḥ || oṃ eṣa te iti jānujānubhyān namaḥ || || ye vṛkṣeṣv īttya parameṣṭi ṛṣir anuṣṭup chandaḥ bhadro devatā jaṃghonnyāśevi niyogaḥ || oṃ ye vṛkṣeṣv īti jaṃghe yo | jaṃghābhyān namaḥ || || bheṣajam ity asya prajāpatir ṛṣi kakup chandaḥ rudro devatya(!) gulpha āśeviniyogaḥ || (fol. 7v4-9)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ sūryāya, || kārttikeya uvāca || ādityasya kathaṃ rūpaṃ, matraṃ tasya kathaṃ bhavet, bhagavan śrotum icchāmi, kathaṃ dvādaśamūrttayaḥ || 1 || īśvarovāca(!) || śṛṇu vatsa paraṃ guhyaṃ, guhyād guhyataraṃ śubhaṃ | kathayāmi na sandeha,ḥ putrasnehād viśeṣataḥ || 2 || … (X19a1-6) End prātar ādityakīrtyas(!) tu sarvvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ | goghnaś caiva kṛtaghnaś ca, mucyate sarvvapātakaiḥ || 33 || trikālam ekakālaṃ vā, yaḥ paṭhed ravisaṃnidhau, | so bhīṣṭaphalam āpnoti, nātra kārya(!) vicāraṇāḥ(!) || 34 || sarvvapāpair vvinirmmuktaḥ, sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati || || (X23b1-5) Colophon iti śivokte mahāmantre, sūryāvatāre, sūryaśāntiḥ samāptā || (X23b6)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya || śrībhagavān uvāca || oṃm(!) ity ekākṣaraṃ brahmaviṣṇurudrā ṛṣayaḥ … viniyogaḥ | malanirmocanaṃ puṃsāṃ jalasnānaṃ dine dine | sakṛd gītāmbhasi snānaṃ saṃsāramalanāśanaṃ || arjjuna uvāca || oṃkārasya ca māhātmyaṃ, rūpaṃ sthānaṃ paraṃ tathā, | tat sarvvaṃ śrotum icchāmi, brūhi me puruṣottamaṃ(!) || (exp. 24 top1-bottom2) End sarvvaśāstramayī gītā sarvvadharmmamayo manuḥ | sarvvatīrthamayī gaṃgā sarvvadevamayo hariḥ || pādaṃ vāpy arddhapādam vā, ślokaṃ ślokārddham eva ca | nityaṃ dhārayate vipra sa mokṣam adhigacchati , || pūjākoṭisamaṃ stotraṃ, stotrakoṭisamo japaḥ | japakoṭisamaṃ dhyānaṃ, dhyānakiṭisamo layaḥ || 80 || (exp. 34 top1–bottom4) Colophon iti śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde, śrīkṛṣṇakṛtagītāsāraṃ samāptaṃ || (exp. 34bottom 4)

Beginning ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmahāgaṇeśāya || oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāya || nārāyaṇan namaskṛtya … tato jayam udīrayet || dvaipāyanoṣṭapuṭanisṛtam aprameyaṃ … kiṃ tasya puṣkarajalair abhiṣecanena || pitāmahādyaṃ pravadanti ṣaṣṭhaṃ maharṣim akṣayyavibhūtiyuktaṃ | nārāyaṇasyāṃśajam ekaputraṃ dvaipāyaṇaṃ vedamahānidhānaṃ || (fol. 1r1-3) End vede rāmāyaṇe puṇye bhārate bharatarṣabha || ādau cānte ca madhye ca, haris sarvvatra gīyate || yatra viṣṇukathā divyā śutayaś ca sanātanāḥ || tacchotavyaṃ manuṣyeṇa, paraṃ padam ihecchatā || etat pavitraṃ parama,m etadharmmaṇidarśanaṃ(!) | etat sarvvaṃ guṇopetaṃ śrotavyaṃ bhūmim(!) icchatā || || ❁ || || (fol. 438r1-2) Colophon iti śrīkhileṣu mahābhārate śatasāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pārijāte śrīharivaṃśabhaṭṭārakas samāpta[[ḥ]] || || śrī 3 kṛṣṇāya namaḥ || || ❁ || || samvat 856 naṣṭajyeṣṭhaśuklaṣaṣṭi, puṣyanakṣatra, budhvāra etasmin dine śrīharivaṃśa, rājadaivajña, padmadhvajena likhitaṃ, saṃpūrṇṇam iti, pustakaṃ || || śubham astu || || śrī 3 gopālajīsahāya || || ❖ || || (fol. 438r2-4)

Beginning oṃ namaḥ gaṇeśāya || || surālayapradhāne tu, devadeva maheśvaraṃ | śailādhirājatanayā, śaṃkaraṃ tam uvāca ha || 1 || śrī devy uvāca || parameśa paraṃ dhāma, pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ | nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ bagalā, mukhyā kathakaya (!) dullabhaṃ (!) || 2 || śrīīśvara uvāca || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi, nāmnā (!) devyā (!) sahasrakaṃ | paraṃ brahmāstravidyāyā,ś caturvargaphalapradaṃ || 3 || (fol. 1v1–5) End ya idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ, śivena sadṛśo bhavet | jīva (!) dharmārthabhogī syā (!) mṛta (!) mokṣapatir bhavet || 76 || satyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevī, satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśvarī | stavasyāsya prabhāvena, devena saha modate || 194 || stambhitāś cāsurā (!) sarva (!) stavarājasya kīrttanāt || 195 || (fol. 22v1–4) Colophon iti śrīutkaṭe śabare nagendraprayāgatantra(!) ṣoḍaśasahasre viṣṇuśaṃkarasaṃvāde śrībagalāmukhīsahasranāma samāptaṃ || || śubham, saṃ 963 śrāvaṇaśu 14 śukaravāra thva kuhnu śrīsiddhirājapādhyāna coyā || (fol. 22v4–6)

oṃ namo lokanāthāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇīya(!) || tadyathā || oṃ devāsuranarayakṣarākṣasādibhiḥ vanditapādapadmāya aśeṣanārakasatvoddhāraṇaparpparāya(!) mahākāruṇīkāya(!) sarvasatvāś ca narakādiduḥkhārttāraṇā 2 uddhara 2 samuddhara 2 buddhasatyena dharmmasatyena saṃghasatyena satyevādi(!) satyena oṃ phaṭ svāhā || iti sarvalokeśvaranāmadhāraṇī samāpta(!) || ○ || (fol. 212v2‒4)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namo bhagavatyai āryyamahāśītavatyai || tadyathā || aṅgā vaṅgā kaliṅgā | bhaṅgā | [[vara]]kuṅgā | saṃsārataraṅgā | sāsadaṅgā | bhagā | asurā | ekataraṅgā | asuravīrā || tara vīrā tara vīrā | tara 2 vīrā | kara vīra | kara kara vīrā | indrā || indakisa(!)vīrā | haṃśā | haṃśakisarā || picimalā | mahākiccā | viheṭhikā | kānucchikā(!) | … (fol. 87v1‒3)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namo śrīvajravidāraṇyaiḥ(!) || evam mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān vajreṣu viharati sma || sarvvaśarīraṃ vajram adhiṣṭhāyā(!) vajrakrodhaṃ bhayaṃ || vajrasāpadā bhāṣaṃte sma || (fol. 96r4–5) «End:» vajravidāraṇaṃ mantraṃ snāpayet pārthivaḥ sadā || eva paśyati dinā tataḥ saṃpadyate śubhaṃ || || idam avocaṭ(!) bhagavān vajravidāraṇī bhāṣitam abhyanaṃdaṃnn(!) iti || || (fol. 98v1–2) «Colophon:» āryyavajravidāraṇahṛdayamantradhāraṇī samāpta(!) || || ye dharmmā hetuprabhā(!) vākya<ref> The rest of the stanza is omitted. </ref>|| || (fol. 98v2) <references/>

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrījambhalāya || evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān śrāvatyāṃ viharati sma || jetavane ’nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārddhaṃm(!) arddhatrayodaśabhir bhikṣuśataiḥ | (fol. 104r4–6) «Colophon:» āryyajaṃbhalaja(lendra)ṇadhāranī samāpta(!) || || ○ || (fol. 104v7)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namo mañjunāthāya || atha vajradharaḥ śrīmāna(!) durddāntaḍamakaḥ(!) paraḥ | trailokyavijayī vīro guhyarāṭ kuliśeśvaraḥ || 1 || vibuddha(!) puṇḍarīkākṣa(!) protphullakamarānanaḥ(!) | prolālaya(!) vajravalaṃ(!) so kareṇa muhun(!) muhuḥ || 2 || bhṛkuṭītalaṃgapramukher(!) aṇantai(!) vajrapāṇibhiḥ | durddāntaḍamakai(!) (vvī)rai(!) vīlabībhatsa(!)rūpibhiḥ || 3 || ulālayeḥ(!) svakarai(!) (prasphu)lla(!)vajrakoṭibhiḥ | prajñopāyamahākaraṇājagadarthakaraiḥ paraiḥ || 4 || hṛṣṭatuṣṭāśayai(!) muditai(!) krodhavigraharūpibhiḥ | buddhakṛtyakarai(!) nāthai(!) sārddhaṃ praṇanta(!)vigrahaḥ || 5 || (fol. 114r1–5) «End:» yātītair bhāṣitāṃ(!) buddhai(!) bhāṣiṣyante hy anāgratāḥ(!) | pratyutpannāś ca saṃbuddhā yā bhāṣante punaḥ punaḥ || 12 || māyājāle mahātantre yā cāsmin saṃpragīyate | mahāvajradhara(!) hṛṣṭaiḥ raḥ(!) pramaye ⟨⟨‥⟫r manta(!)dhāribhiḥ || 13 || (!) ahañ cainā(!) dhārayikṣāmi(!) niryyāṇaṃ ca dhṛdhāśayaḥ | yathā bhavānmy(!) ahaṃ nātha sarvvasaṃbuddhaguhyadhṛk || 14 || prakāśayiṣya(!) satvānāṃ yathāśayaviśeṣaṭaḥ || aśeṣakleśanāṣāya aśeṣajñānahānaya(!) || 15 || evamm adheṣya guhyendro vajrapāṇis tathāgataḥ || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā prahvakāyasthito ’grataḥ || 16 || (fol. 114v4–115r2) «Colophon:» adhyaṣaṇā(!)gāthā ṣoḍaśaḥ(!) || ○ || (fol. 115r3)

imāṃ ṣanmantrarājāna(ṃ) saṃyuktām advayodvayāṃ(!) || anutpādadhatminī(!) gāthā(!) bhāṣante(!) sma girām pate(!) || 1 || a ā i ī u ū e ai o au aṃ aḥ || sthito hṛdiḥ(!) | jñānamūrttir ahaṃ buddho buddhānāṃ tryadhvavartīṇāṃ || 2 || oṃ vajratīṣṇṇa(!)duḥkhacchedaprajñānā(!)jñānamūrttaye | jñānakāyavāgīśvara-arapacanāya te namaḥ || 3 || (fol. 115v4‒116r1) Colophon māyālābhisaṃbodhikramagāthā triśe (!) || ❁ || (fol. 116r1)

«Beginning:» tadyathā || bhagavān buddho sabuddho(!) ’kāla(!)sambhavaḥ | akāla(!) sarvvavarṇṇāgryo mahārtho paramākṣaraḥ || 1 || mahāprāṇo hy aṇutpādo(!) vāgudāhāravarjitaḥ | sarvvābhirāpaheto(!) ’gra(!) sarvvavāg(!)suprabhāsvaraḥ || 2 || mahāmahamahārāga(!) sarvvasatvaratiṃkaraḥ | mahāmahamahādveṣa(!) sarvvakleśamahāripu(!)|| 3 || mahāmahamahāmoho mūḍhadhīmohasūdanaḥ | mahāmahamahākrodha(!) mahākrodhoripu(!) mahān || 4 || mahāmahamāhālota(!) sarvvalobhanisūdanaḥ || mahākāmo mahāśaukhyo(!) mahāmodo mahārati(!) || 5 || (fol. 116r1‒6) «End:» mahādhyānasamādhīṣṭho(!) mahāprajñāśarīradhṛka(!) | mahābaro(!) mahopāya(!) praṇīdhi(!)jñānasāgaraḥ || 10 || mahāmaitrīmayo meyo mahākāruṇīko ’gradhī(!) | mahāprajñāmahādhīmān mahopāya(!) mahākṛti(!) || 11 || ma(ho)ṛddhibaropeto(!) mahāvego mahārjavaḥ | mahārddhiko(!) maheśākṣo(!) mahābalaparākramaḥ || 12 mahābhavādrisaṃbherttā(!) mahāvajradharo ghanaḥ | mahākrūro mahāraudro mahābhayabhayaṃkaraḥ || 13 || mahāvidyottamo nātho mahāmantrottamo guruḥ | mahāyānanayārūḍho mahāyānanayottamaḥ || 14 || (fol. 116v3‒117r2) «Colophon:» vajradhātumahāmaṇḍalagāthāś caturdaśa || ○ || (fol. 117r2)

❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīāryyāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākārukāya(!) || tadyathā || oṃ cala 2 cili 2 culu 2 hulu 2 mulu 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ padmahastāya svāhā || mokṣapadanāmādhāraṇī samāpta(!) || || (fol.159v5–6)

❖ oṃ namo bhagavate sarvvahutāsanī(!)tejorājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya || tadyathā || oṃ hute 2 mahāhute sarvvahutāsanateje svāhā || bhojanaṃ bhuktvā saptadhemāṃ(!) dhāraṇīm āvartya saptabuddhakoṭayaḥ pūjitā bhavanti || || iti hutāsanatejodhāraṇī samāpta(!) || || || (fol. 164r3–5)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīs(!)trailokyavijayāyai || pūrvvoktavidhānena sūryyanīlahūṃkārajaṃ trailokya‥‥‥bhaṭṭārakaṃ | nīlaṃ caturmukhaṃ aṣṭabhujaṃ prathamamukhaṃ krodhaṃ śṛṅgāraṃ | vāmabhībhatsaṃ | (fol. 50v4‒5)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namo bhagavatyai āryyamahāmāyūryai || tadyathā || kāli | kalāti | kumbhāṇṇi || saṃkhiti | kamalākṣi | hārīti | harikesi | śrīmati | haripiṃgale | lambe | pralambe | lambodari | raudracinte | kālapāśe | (fol. 70r1‒3) «End:» rāgo dveṣaś ca mohaś ca ete lokatrayo viṣāḥ | niviṣā(!) bhagavān buddho buddhasatyahataṃ viṣam || rāgo dveṣaś ca mohaś ca ete lokatrayo viṣāḥ || nirviṣā(!) bhagavān [[dharmma]](!) dharmmasatyahataṃ viṣaṃ || rāgo dveṣaś ca mohaś ca ete lokatrayo viṣā(!) nirvviṣā(!) bhagavān saṃgha(!) saṃghasatyaṃhataṃ(!) viṣaṃ || yad balaṃ sarvabuddhānāṃ mahatāñ caiva yad yaśaḥ || tathāgatasya tejena mama sarvvasatvāñ ca kṛtaṃ svastyayanaṃ mayā || ○ || (!) (fol. 83v5–84r3) «Colophon:» āryyamahāmāyūrīvidyārājñā(!) avinaṣṭā yakṣamukhāt pratilabdhā samāptā || ○ ||

❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīsūryyāya || ādityaḥ prathame nāma dvitī(!) ravir ucyate | gabhastis tṛtīye nāma | caturthe vindas eva ca || paṃcame savi(!) nāma ṣaṣṭame(!) ca divākara(!) | dharmārthaḥ saptame nāma aṣṭame tapanas tathā || navame bhāskaro vidyāt daśame sahasrāṃśakaḥ | tuṣṭir ekādaśe nāma | dvādaśe śuryya eva ca || dvādaśaitāni nāmāni yaḥ paṭhed ravisannidhau || dvādaśa(!) harate vyādhi(!) kuṣṭapātakanāśanaṃ | sarvatīrtheṣu yat snāna(!) phalaṃ prāpnoti capsitaṃ(!) | mucyate sarvvapāpebhyo rakṣasāṃ sūryyadevatā || || iti dvādaśasūryyadevatotra(!) || śubha || (fol. 211r4‒v1)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīāryya-ugratārāyai || || bālārkālokatāmrapravarasuraśilaś(!) cārucūḍāmuṇiśrīḥ(!) saṃpatsaṃparkarāgānaticilalacitāraktakavyaktabhaktī(!) bhaktyā pādau (ta)vāryya(!) karaputamukutātopabhugnottamāṅgas tāriṇy āpaccharaṇye navaratikusumasragbhir abhyarccayāmi || 1 || (fol. 1v1‒4) «End:» saṃstutya tvaṃta(!)guṇaughāvayamam(!) aniyateyattam āptaṃ mayā yat puṇyaṃ puṇyārhavā(ñ)cchāphalamadhurarasāsvādam āmuktibhogyam lokas tecāryyalokeśvaracaraṇatarasvastikasvasticiṃhnām(!) ahnāyāya(!) prayāt(!) su(ga)tasutamahī(!) tā(!) sukhāvatyupākhyāṃ || 37 || (fol. 8v2‒4) «Colophon:» iti śrīāryya-ugratārābhaṭṭārikāyā(!) sarvvajñamitrapādaviracitaṃ śragdhadhārāstotraṃ(!) samāptam iti || ❁ || ye dharmā hetuprabhavā hetus teṣāṃ tathāgataḥ hy avadas (!) teṣāṃ ca ye nirodha evaṃvādi mahāśravaṇaṃ (!) || ○ || (fol. 8v4‒6)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namo bhagavatyai ā[[ryya]]mahāmantrāṇusāriṇyai || imāñ ca gāthā || visarata visarata visarata visarata visarata || 5 || buddho lokānukaṃpaka ājñāpayati | sarvvabuddānumatena sarvvapratyekabuddhānumatena | sarvvārhānumatena || sarvaśekṣānumatena(!) || sarvaśrāvakānumatena || sarvvasatyavākyānumate | pratyekabrahmānumatena | kāmeśvarānumatena || indrānumatena || devānumatena || asurendrānutena(!) | sarvāsurānumatena | (fol. 84r1‒4) «End:» svasti vaḥ kurutām buddhaḥ svasti devāḥ sacakrakāḥ | svasti sarvvāṇi bhūtāni sarvvakāla(!) diśantu vaḥ || buddhapuṇyānubhāvena devatānām matena ca | yo yo rthaḥ samabhipretaḥ sarvvo tho(!) dya samṛddhatām || svasti vo dvipado bhontu svasti [[vo]] stu catuśpade || svasti vo vrajatām mārge svasti pratyāgateṣu ca | svasti rātrau svasti divā svasti madhye dine sthite || sarvvatra svasti vo bhontu mā caiṣām pāpam āgamat | sarvve satvāḥ sarvve prāṇāḥ sarvve bhūtāś ca kevalāḥ | sarvve vai sukhina(!) santu sarvva(!) santu nilā[[ma]]yāḥ || sarvve bhadrāṇi paśyantu || mā kaścit pāpam āgamat || yāniha(!) bhūtāni samāgatāni sthitāni bhūmāv athavāntarīkṣe | kurvvantu maitrī(!) satatam prajāsu divā ca rātrau ca carantu dharmmam || (fol. 86v2–87r2) «Colophon:» āryyamahāmantrānuśāraṇi(!)vidyārājñī samāpteti || ○ || śubha || (fol. 87r2)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīyogāṃbarāya || oṃ tadyathā || oṃ hūṃ haḥ svāhā || oṃ a aḥ oṃ suṃ | oṃ kṣuṃ | oṃ yuṃ | oṃ hūṃ | oṃ smruṃ | oṃ smruṃ | etc. (fol. 212r1‒2) «End:» oṃ dhanāgre | oṃ svātani | oṃ bhubhurva || oṃ kuṃ a || khuṃ ā || guṃ i | ghuṃ ī | cuṃ u | cchuṃ ū | juṃ ṛ | jhuṃ ṝ | ṭuṃ ḷ | ṭhuṃ ḹ | ḍuṃ e | ḍhuṃ ai | tuṃ o | thuṃ au | duṃ aṃ | dhuṃ aḥ || (fol. 212r4‒5) «Colophon:» iti śrīyogāmbarasya karmmarājanāmadhāraṇī samāpta(!) || ○ || (fol. 212r5)

❖ oṃ namo maitrīya(!)nāthāya | bhāvividyāś(!)caraṇasaṃpannaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhāya sarvasatvārtha(dayita)cittāya puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ gaṃdhaṃ saṃsārādukhoddhṛtyānuttarāyāṃ(!) | samyaksaṃbodhau pratiṣṭhāya oṃ āḥ oṃ maitrīya(!)nāthāya hūm phaṭ svāhā || || iti śrīmaitrīya(!)nāmadhāranī samāpta(!) || śubha || (fol. 212r5‒v1)

❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmaṃjunāṃthāya(!) || oṃ arapacanāya || kumitidahanadakṣāya mañjubuddhipradāya candrakāntimaṇibuddhipradāya khaḍgapustakavyagrahastāya mañjuvānivarapradāya sarvasatvānāṃ ca śāntiṃ kuru puṣṭiṃ kuru rakṣāṃ kuru 2 oṃ āḥ dhīḥ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || ○ || iti arapacanamañjuśrīnāmadhāraṇī masamāpta(!) || śubha || (fol. 212v5‒213r1)

oṃ namaḥ saddharmmapuṇḍalīkāya || oṃ vajraghaṇṭhe āḥ 3 oṃ raṇa 2 praraṇa 2 saṃpraraṇasarvabuddhapracāriṇi prajñāpāramitānādasvatāve(!) vajrasatvahṛdayasaṃtoṣanakārāya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || saddharmmapāṭhādhe ghaṇṭhāvādanasaṃpannamantreṇa dadyāt | puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ gandhaṃ yathā vidhinā sarvan dadyāt | oṃ āḥ oṃ phaṭ svāhā || iti saddharmmapāṭḥadhāranī samāpta(!) || ○ || (fol. 213r1‒4)

oṃ namas tārāyai || oṃ tāre sarvavighnihare sarvabhayaśāntiṃ kare pratibhāse mama kṛte sarvaduṣṭān staṃbhaya 2 jaṃbhaya 2 mohaya 2 hūṃ phaṭ sarvaduṣṭambhaṃni(!) svāhā || iti vajratārānāmadhāraṇī samāpta(!) || || ○ || || (fol. 213r4‒6)

oṃ ugratārāyai nama(!) || oṃ tāraṇi sarvvaduḥkhabhayahāriṇi caturmārani vāraṇī sarvvadevāsuranaragaṃdharvvakinnaramahoraga | upaddrave pramarddani bhūtapretapiśācayakṣarākṣasan(!) ḍākaḍākinībhayavidhvaṃsani paramakṛtayantramantraprayogavināśini bhagavati durgottār(i)ṇī āgaccha 2 bhagavati eṣā vidyā sarvatathāgatāṃ(!) vākyaṃ sarvaśatrunā hana 2 gaha 2 paca 2 matha 2 ccheda 2 bheda 2 truta 2 sarvasanāṃ(!) ca śāntiṃ kuru puṣṭiṃ kuru rakṣāṃ kuru hrīḥ haḥ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || śubha || iti ugratārānāmadhāraṇī samāptā || || (fol. 213r6‒v4)

oṃ namo daśakrodhāyai || yamāntaka | prajñāntaka | padmāntaka | vighnāntaka| acara | ṭarkkirāja | nīladaṇḍa | mahābala | uṣṇīṣacakra sambharāja saparivāraṃ sapatnikebhyaḥ(!) sarvasatvānāṃ ca sarvavighnavināyakānāṃ kāyavākcitta(!) kīraya 2 vidhvaṃsaya 2 sarvamārān mārakāyikān yakṣāṃ rākṣasān mahoragān bhūtān pretān piśācān devān mānuṣān asurān kinnarān kuṃmbhāṇḍebhyaḥ(!) sarvvaśatrunān(!) | hana 2 daha 3 paca 2 matha 2 vighnavināśana kuru 2 hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || || iti daśakrodhānāṃ(!)dhāraṇī samāpta(!) || || śubha || (fol. 213v4‒214r2)

oṃ namaś caturdeśalokapārāya namaḥ || oṃ indrayamajamayakṣakṣabhūtāvahnirākṣasabrahmasūryyacandra-asurapṛthivīnāgānāṃ mama rakṣāṃ kuru 2 śāntiṃ kuruḥ(!) puṣṭiṃ kuruḥ(!) rakṣāṃ kuruḥ(!) sarvadevebhyaḥ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ gaṃdhaṃ ca sarkkarādisahita(!) rakṣa 2 svāhā || || iti lokapārasya nāma dhāraṇī samāpta(!) || || śubha || ye dharmmā hetuprabhāvāś(!) hetu(!) teṣāṃ<ref> The rest of the stanza is omitted. </ref> (fol. 214r2‒4) <references/>

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namo raktayamārīye(!) || tadyathā oṃ raktamakuṭāya raktajaṭāya raktamukhāya raktaśarīrāya raktabhujāya raktahārāya valīmālāya raktarathasamārūḍhāya raktāharaṇabhūṣitāya mama sarvvavighnān hara 2 caturmmātri(!) vāraya 2 trāśaya 2 bhrāmaya 2 cchinda 2 bhinda 2 nāśa 2 tāpa 2 śoṣa 2 ccheda 2 bheda 2 truta 2 hūṃ phaṭ 2 svāhā || (fol. 214r5–v1) «End:» svāhā sarvvanāgebhyo jalādhipataye namaḥ svāhā || sarvvabhūtebhyo namaḥ svāhā || haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā || ○ || (fol. 214v6–215r1) «Colophon:» iti raktayamārīnāmadhāraṇī samāpta(!) || || śubha || (fol. 215r1) Excerpts

oṃ namaḥ śrīmahābhailavāya || oṃ namo uṣṭotkaṭabhailavāya aśimuṣalaparaśupāśagṛhītahastāya oṃ amṛtakuṇḍaline | kha kha khāhi 3 tiṣṭha 2 bandha 2 hana 2 daha 2 paca 2 matha 2 sarvvayakṣarākṣasabhūtapretapisācopasmārān(!) sarvasatvānāṃ carakṣāṃ kuruḥ(!) hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || || iti śrīmahābhailavasya dhāraṇī smāptā || || śubha || (fol. 215r1‒4)

oṃ namaḥ śrīvighneśvarāya || oṃ namaḥ vighnāntakṛt mahākrodhamahābalaparākramam mantraṃ sarvatathāgatānā(!) bhāṣitaṃ | mama sarvavighnavināyakānāṃ kāyakākacittakīlaye(!) oṃ amṛtakuṇḍalīne(!) sarvvavighnān ccheda 2 bhede 2 truta 2 daha 2 paca 2 matha 2 oṃ avighnāntakṛt hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || iti siddhivighneśvarasya dhāraṇī smāptā || || (fol. 215r4‒6)

❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīmahākālāya sāsanopakāriṇe yadi prajñā samarasi (!) kāli kalāli vetāli caṇḍāli siddhiyoginī akṣobhyaḥ śirasi dhāriṇī sarvasatvānāṃ ca pracchopa 2 gṛhna 2 sarvvaśatrunāṃ(!) māraya 2 kāraya 2 bandha 2 ccheda 2 bheda 2 truta 2 mama sarvvasatvānāṃ ca rakṣa 2 hūṃ ṭ svāhā || || iti śrīmahākālasya dhāṇī(!) samāptā || || śubha || (fol. 215v1‒3)

oṃ namaḥ śrīganeśāya | sumukhaś caikadantaś ca kapirā(!) gajakarṇṇa(!) laṃbodalaś ca vikato vighnarājo vināyakaḥ || (dhū)maketur ggaṇādhikṣo(!) bhārandro(!) gajānanaṃ | (!) vakratuṇḍaḥ sūlparṇṇo(!) helaṃba(!) skaṃdapūrvvajaṃ ṣoḍaśaitāni nāmāni yat pathec chṛnuyād api || vidyārambhe vivāhe ca praveśe nirgame tathā | saṃgrāme saṃkaṭe caiva vighnas tasya na vidyate || || iti śrīgaṇeśaṣoḍaśanāma samāpta(!) || śubhaṃ bhūyāt || (fol. 215v3‒6)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namo cinye(!)sāgarebhyaḥ sarvvasamyaksaṃbuddhebhyaḥ || evam mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān naṃdopanandanāgarājabhavane viharati sma || śrīmaṇiratnagarbbhe mahāmeghamaṇḍalakūṭāgāre mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārddhaṃ mahatā ca bodhisatvasaṃghena sārddhaṃ mahatā ca nāgarājagaṇena sārddhaṃ || (fol. 216r1‒3) «End:» meghavāhini ḍhaka 2 ḍuḍumbe ghaṇa 2 sikhi sikhini kana 2 gaṇa 2 mahānāgagaṇe nirātrāṇyupaja(na)tkārī mahānāgahṛdaya | ghūma ghūma ghūmmāpaya ghūmāya stokajāṃgaribhujaṅgame vikaṭaghorarūpavisphar(jjana) vijṛmbhane ā(vā)hayāmi sarvanāgānāṃ sarvabuddhādhiṣṭhānena sarvatpradhva(!) tathāgatasatyena maitracittena pravarṣete(!) ha jaṃbudvīpe svāhā || namaḥ sa(rva)buddhebhyaḥ sidhyantu mantrapadāni svāhā || (fol. 221v6‒222r3) «Colophon:» || āryyamahāmeghanirnnādavijṛmbhitasurakerunāmadhāraṇī sarvabuddhabhāṣita(!) samāptā || || ye dharmmā || śubham astu likhitasya || || (fol. 222r3‒4)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrīnairātmādevyaiḥ(!) || pūrvoktavidhānena śūnyatānantaraṃ candamaṇḍale nīla aṃkārabījavarttīspharaṇādi pūrvakaṃ pariṇāmya śavakṛccandrasthārddhaparyyaṅkanādyasthitāṃ nairātmyakṛṣṇāṃ ekam ‥ṃ ūrddhapiṅgalakeśā akṣobhyamukuṭinīdraṣṭrākalālalakṣitadkādakṣiṇe(!) kattidhāraṇyaṃ | (fol. 222r5‒v1) «End:» tacchiraḥ kaṇṭḥe hṛdayaṣu(!) oṃ āḥ hūṃ kārān | kṛrccandramuṣṭicandre(!) aṃkāraṃ dṛṣṭvā imaṃ mantra(!) japet || oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ e ai o au oṃ a svāhā || jāpamantraḥ || || (fol. 222v1‒3) «Colophon:» iti śrīnairātmāsādhanadhāraṇī samā(pta)(!) || || ye dharmmā hetuprabhāvā(!) hetu(!) teṣān tagataḥ(!) | hy avadat te (fol. 222v3)

«Beginning» oṃ namo kāracakrāya(!) || akacaṭatapayaśa śabde ālikālinnītarthe loktā (!)| ālikālijāpena trailokyaṃ kṣobhayet mantrī | lakṣajāpeṇe kiṃ punar ekamātram iti | ākādi ucyate || (fol. 222v4‒5) «End» oṃ ta tā | oṃ tha thā | oṃ da dā | oṃ dha dhā | oṃ na nā | oṃ sa sā | oṃ jya jyā | oṃ ṣa ṣā | oṃ śa śā | oṃ hva hvā | iti | ādau oṃ kāran datvā kṣobhaṇe | akṛṣṭavarṇṇo vauṣaṭapade yaṃ | eva purakṣobhamantraḥ || || (fol. 223r3) «Colophon» iti kāracakre(!) nivarddhanāmadhāraṇī(!) samāpta(!) || || (fol. 222v4‒223r4)

«Beginning:» oṃ namo hevajranāthāya || praṇamya nāthahevajraṃ sarvadharmmaikasamvaraṃ | sa gṛhyapūjāvidhir mmayā || tatra śrīhevajrayogavānantrī pratyuṣe yathā vasaraṃ vā kṛtasamārjanādike bhūbhāge hastaṃ datvā oṃ rakṣa rakṣa huṃ huṃ phaṭ svāheti bhūmim adhiṣṭhāya | (fol. 223r4‒6) «End:» tathai(!) maṇḍalakam upari py āropya ca maṇḍalacakraṃ akṣaraṃ svahṛtmālāmantreṇa nāyikāyai || anyāsāṃ ‥ṇavatvāhāvidarbhita(!)svabījamantraiḥ pūjādikaṃ yathā sthānaṃ datvātrākṣararahitapuṣpadānāmantraḥ stutiñ ca kuryāt śeṣaṃ pūrvvavad iti | vāhyapūjāvidhiḥ | smṛtyai saṃgahādyatmayārjitaṃ(!) | punyatenāstu loko yaṃ sanpūjābhājanaṃ rasaṃ || (fol. 224v2‒4) «Colophon:» iti śrīhevajradhāraṇīpūjāvidhiḥ | saṃgrahaḥ samāptā(!) || ○ || śubha || (fol. 224v4‒5)

«Beginning:» oṃ namaḥ śrīmahāsarasvatyai || pūrvvoktavidhānena śūnyatāṃ yāvad abhimukhīkṛtyādhiṣṭhāya cāsitakamala(!) saptahastapramāṇa(!) tadupari śaśimaṇḍalaṃ tatmadhya(!) hrīḥkāraṃ śuklaṃ tena sitakamalaṃ svabījagarbbhaṃ bhāvayet | (fol. 224v5‒6) «End:» māṣamātra(!) prayoyuñjīta vāṇīṃ prāpnoty anuttarām | ṣaṇmāsopayogena sākṣād vāgīgīśvaro bhavet | mattakokilanirghoṣo jāte(!) madhuresvaraḥ | saṃśayā(!) neha karttavyo vicitrā bhāvaśaktayaḥ || (fol. 225v3‒5) «Colophon:» iti mahāsarasvatīdhāraṇī samāpta(!) || śubha || (fol. 225v5)

«Beginning:» oṃ namaḥ śrīvajrabhailavāya(!) || pūrvoktavidhānana(!) khadhāturephaje sūryyahūṃkāraṃ jvalabbhāsvaraṃ kalpānalam ivāsy ugraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇṇamahādyutiṃ | tad utpannaṃ mahāraudraṃ vajrahūṃkārasaṃjñakaṃ | (fol. 225v5‒6) «End:» oṃ āḥ hūṃ akṣaratrayaṃ| abhiṣekavidhānena cittavajreṇa mudrayet | mantraḥ | oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā || || (fol. 226r2) «Colophon:» iti śrīvajrahūṃkālabhailavasya(!) dhāraṇī samāpta(!) || śubha || (fol. 226r2‒3)

«Beginning:» ❖ oṃ namaḥ śrībhagavatyai āryyavasuṃdhārāye(!) kalpoditena vidhinā paripaśyamānāṃ yā dhāraṇīvividhi(!)ratnasuvarṇṇamṛtyai pūrṇṇaṃ karoti bhavanaṃ sahasaiva sarvva(ṃ tā)ṃ sarvvalokajananīṃ praṇamāmi bhaktyā || tvaṃ devi sa(r)vvaguṇaratnamahānidhānaṃ sa(r)vārthakāryyadhanadhānyasamṛddhah(et)uṃ | hārārddhahāramakuṭamaṇikalpavṛkṣaṃ trailokyanāthavasudhāranāmā(!) || utsṛṣṭarogabhayaranaikadoṣā(!) dāridraduḥkhavraṇarohaṇam oṣadhīnām | saubhāgyarūpaguṇapuṣkalagotravarṇṇa(!) sarvan dadāsi tava pādayugan namāmi || (fol. 27r1‒4) «End:» bhagavān āha || sucandrasya gṛhapateḥ paripṛcchety api dhāraya || sarvvadhanadhānyahiraṇyasuvarṇṇaratnanidhānam ity api dhārayānaṃda sarvvatathāgatapraśastety api dhāraya || sarvvatāthāgatādhiṣṭhitā(!) vasudhārā nāma dhāraṇīkalpam ity api dhāraya || ❁ || idam avocad bhagavān āttamanā āyuṣmān ānaṃdas te ca bhikṣavas te ca bodhisatvā mahāsatvāḥ sā ca sarvāvatī paṣat(!) sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāśitam abhyanandana(!) iti || ❖ (fol. 46r5‒v2) «Colophon:» āryyaśrīvasudhārānāmadhāraṇī samāptā || ❖ || ye dharmmā hetuprabhāvā(!) hetu(!) teṣān tathāgatoḥ(!) | hy avadat teṣāñ ca yo nirodha evamvādi(!) mahāśramaṇa(!) || ○ || oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ | hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ | hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ | oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ | kṣemārogyaṃ dhanaṃ dehi dadāpayasvā(!) || vasudhāyā(!)hṛdayamantra || || ❖ mama vajrācāryyaśrīdhanavṛnāmnena(!) idaṃ vasudhārā, kalpanāmadhāraṇī, likhitaṃ saṃpūrṇṇam iti || || śubhaṃ bhuyāt(!) || lakṣmīvṛddhir astu || āyuvṛddhir astu || dhanavṛddhir astu || saptavṛddhir astu || saṃkalpaṃ siddhir astu || ❖ || śubha || (fol. 46v2‒6)
